chapter.verse: Ekuqaleni uNkulunkulu wadala izulu nomhlaba.
Umhlaba wawungenasimo, ungenalutho, ubumnyama busibekele utwa. UMoya kaNkulunkulu wawuvunguza phezu kwamanzi.
UNkulunkulu wathi: “Makube khona ukukhanya.” Kwaba khona ukukhanya.
UNkulunkulu wabona ukuthi ukukhanya kuhle, uNkulunkulu wayesehlukanisa ukukhanya nobumnyama.
UNkulunkulu wakubiza ukukhanya ngokuthi yimini, ubumnyama wabubiza ngokuthi wubusuku. Kwahlwa, kwabuye kwasa, kwaba ngusuku lokuqala.
UNkulunkulu wathi: “Makube khona umkhathi phakathi kwamanzi, ozokwehlukanisa amanzi kwamanye.”
UNkulunkulu wenza umkhathi wokwehlukanisa amanzi aphansi kwawo naphezu kwawo. Kwaba njalo.
UNkulunkulu wawuqamba umkhathi ngokuthi yisibhakabhaka. Kwahlwa, kwabuye kwasa, kwaba ngusuku lwesibili.
UNkulunkulu wathi: “Amanzi aphansi kwesibhakabhaka mawaqoqeleke ndawonye, kuvele umhlabathi owomileyo.” Kwaba njalo.
UNkulunkulu wawubiza umhlabathi owomileyo ngokuthi ngumhlaba, amanzi aqoqeleke ndawonye wawabiza ngokuthi wulwandle. UNkulunkulu wakubona ukuthi kuhle.
UNkulunkulu wathi: “Makumile utshani emhlabeni, nezitshalo ezithela imbewu nezihlahla ezithela izithelo ezinembewu ngezinhlobo zazo.” Kwaba njalo.
Kwamila utshani emhlabeni: izitshalo ezithela imbewu, nezihlahla ezithela izithelo ezinembewu ngezinhlobo zazo. UNkulunkulu wakubona ukuthi kuhle.
Kwahlwa, kwabuye kwasa, kwaba ngusuku lwesithathu.
UNkulunkulu wathi: “Makuvele izikhanyisi emkhathini ukuze zehlukanise imini nobusuku, zibe yinkomba yezinkathi neyezinsuku neyeminyaka,
zibe yizikhanyisi esibhakabhakeni, zikhanyisele umhlaba.” Kwaba njalo.
UNkulunkulu wenza izikhanyisi ezinkulu ezimbili, isikhanyisi esikhulu ukubusa emini, nesikhanyisi esincane ukubusa ebusuku, nezinkanyezi.
UNkulunkulu wabeka izikhanyisi esibhakabhakeni ukuba zikhanyisele umhlaba,
zibuse imini nobusuku, zehlukanise ukukhanya nobumnyama. UNkulunkulu wakubona ukuthi kuhle.
Kwahlwa, kwabuye kwasa, kwaba ngusuku lwesine.
UNkulunkulu wathi: “Makugcwale uswebezane lwezidalwa eziphilayo ezinhlobonhlobo emanzini, kundize izinyoni emkhathini.”
UNkulunkulu wadala izilo ezinkulu zasolwandle, nezidalwa zonke ezitshuza emanzini ngezinhlobo zazo, nazo zonke ezindizayo ngezinhlobo zazo. UNkulunkulu wakubona ukuthi kuhle.
Wazibusisa zonke izidalwa wathi: “Zalanani nande nigcwalise ulwandle.” Nasezinyonini wathi: “Yandani emhlabeni.”
Kwahlwa, kwabuye kwasa, kwaba ngusuku lwesihlanu.
UNkulunkulu wathi: “Umhlaba mawuveze izinhlobonhlobo zezilwane eziphilayo, ezifuywayo, ezihuquzelayo nezilwane zasendle ngezinhlobo zazo.” Kwaba njalo.
UNkulunkulu wenza zonke izilwane zomhlaba ngezinhlobo zazo, nezilwane ezifuywayo ngezinhlobo zazo, nezihuquzelayo ngezinhlobo zazo. UNkulunkulu wakubona ukuthi kuhle.

UNkulunkulu wayesethi: “Masenze abantu babe ngumfanekiso wethu, basifuze, babuse phezu kwezinhlanzi zolwandle, izinyoni zezulu, izilwane ezifuywayo, nomhlaba wonke, nezilwanyana ezinwabuzelayo emhlabeni ngezinhlobo zazo.”
UNkulunkulu wamdala umuntu waba ngumfanekiso wakhe, wamenza ukuba afuze Yena, wabadala owesilisa nowesifazane,
wababusisa, wathi: “Zalanani nande, nigcwalise umhlaba; niwubuse. Nibuse phezu kwezinhlanzi zolwandle, naphezu kwezinyoni zezulu, nazo zonke izilwane ezinwabuzela emhlabeni.”
UNkulunkulu wathi: “Bhekani, ngininika izinhlobo zonke zezitshalo ezithela imbewu ezimila emhlabeni wonke, nezihlahla ezithela izithelo ezinembewu ukuba nikudle.
Kepha zonke izilwane zasendle, nazo zonke izinyoni emkhathini, nakho konke okuhuquzelayo emhlabeni, nakho konke okunomphefumulo, ngikunike konke okuluhlaza okumilayo ukuba kukudle.” Kwaba njalo.
UNkulunkulu wakubona konke ayekudalile ukuthi kwakukuhle kakhulu. Kwahlwa, kwabuye kwasa, kwaba ngusuku lwesithupha.
Kwase kuyapheleliswa ukudalwa kwezulu nomhlaba nakho konke okukukho.
Kuthe ngosuku lwesikhombisa uNkulunkulu esewuqedile wonke umsebenzi ayewenza, wayesephumula.
Ngakho-ke uNkulunkulu walubusisa usuku lwesikhombisa walungcwelisa, ngokuba ngalo uNkulunkulu waphumula kuwo wonke umsebenzi ayesewudalile, wawenza.
Nanku umlando wokudalwa kwezulu nomhlaba, lapho uSimakade uNkulunkulu ekwenza.
Ngesikhathi uSimakade uNkulunkulu edala umhlaba kwakungakabi bikho zihlahla ezweni, kwakungakamili nazitshalo emhlabathini ngoba wayengakayinisi imvula, futhi kungekho namuntu wokulima umhlabathi.
Kepha kwakuqubuka amanzi evela phansi komhlaba awuswakamise wonke umhlabathi.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wabumba umuntu ngomhlabathi, wayesemphefumulela ngomoya wokuphila emakhaleni, umuntu waba yisidalwa esiphilayo.
USimakade uNkulunkulu watshala insimu yezithelo e-Edeni ngasempumalanga, wambeka khona umuntu ayembumbile.

USimakade uNkulunkulu watshala zonke izinhlobo zezihlahla ezibukekayo ukuba zithele izithelo ezinhle ezidliwayo. Phakathi naleyo nsimu kwakumile umuthi wokuphila, nomuthi wokwazi ukwehlukanisa okuhle nokubi.
E-Edeni kwavela umfula wokunisela insimu, wase wehlukana uba yimifula emine.
Igama lowokuqala kwakuyiPhishoni. Yiwo ogobhoza uzungeze lonke izwe iHavila, lapho kunegolide khona.
Igolide lalelo lizwe lihle, kukhona nenhlaka enamakha anuka kamnandi, namatshe ayigugu.
Igama lomfula wesibili kwakuyiGihoni. Ugobhoza uzungeze lonke iKhushi.
Umfula wesithathu kwakuyiThayigrisi. Ugobhoza wedlule empumalanga ye-Asiriya. Umfula wesine kwakuyiYufrathe.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wabeka umuntu ensimini yase-Edeni ukuze ayilime, futhi ayilinde.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wamyala umuntu wathi: “Ungazidla izithelo zanoma yimuphi umuthi osensimini,
kodwa ungadli kwezomuthi wokwazi ukwehlukanisa okuhle nokubi, ngokuba mhla wadla kuwo, uyokufa nokufa.”
USimakade uNkulunkulu wathi: “Akukuhle ukuba umuntu ahlale yedwa. Ngizomenzela umsizi omfaneleyo.”

USimakade uNkulunkulu wathatha umhlabathi wabumba zonke izilwane zasendle, nazo zonke izinyoni zezulu. Waziletha kumuntu ukuze abone ukuthi uzoziqamba athini; lawo magama umuntu aziqamba ngawo zonke izilwane eziphilayo, kwaba ngamagama azo.
Umuntu waziqamba ngamagama zonke izilwane ezifuyiweyo, izinyoni zezulu nezilwane zasendle. Kepha asikho phakathi kwalezo zilwane esatholakala sifanele ukuba ngumsizi wakhe.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wenza ukuba umuntu azunywe ngubuthongo obukhulu, kuthe esalele wathatha olunye lwezimbambo zakhe, wayivala ngesicubu leyo ndawo.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wambumba owesifazane ngobambo ayeluthathe kumuntu, wayesemletha kuye.
Umuntu wathi: “Manje lo useyithambo lamathambo ami nenyama yenyama yami. Lona uzobizwa ngokuthi ngumfazi ngoba uthathwe endodeni.”
Ngakho-ke indoda iyoshiya uyise nonina inamathele kumkayo babe nyamanye.
Indoda nomfazi babehamba ze, futhi bengenamahloni.
Inyoka yayinobuqili kunazo zonke izilwane zasendle ayezenzile uSimakade uNkulunkulu. Yathi kowesifazane: “Ushilo yini uNkulunkulu ukuthi: ‘Ningalokothi nidle nakowodwa umuthi osensimini na?’ ”
Waphendula owesifazane wathi: “Uthe singazidla izithelo zanoma yimuphi umuthi osensimini,
kodwa uNkulunkulu wathi: ‘Ningasidli isithelo somuthi omile phakathi nensimu, futhi ningasithinti ngoba niyokufa nokufa.’ ”
Kepha inyoka yathi kowesifazane: “Ngeke nife neze.
Ngokuba uNkulunkulu uyazi ukuthi mhla nisidla, amehlo enu ayovuleka, nifane naye, nazi okuhle nokubi.”
Owesifazane ebona ukuthi umuthi muhle, ufanele ukudliwa, nokuthi uyaheha emehlweni, uyanxaneleka ekuhlakaniphiseni, wakha izithelo zawo wadla, wanika nomyeni wakhe owayenaye lapho, naye wadla.
Amehlo abo bobabili ayesevuleka, bazibona ukuthi bahamba ze, beluka amaqabunga omkhiwane, bawabhinca, bafihla ubunqunu babo.
Ntambama selipholile, indoda nomkayo bezwa izigi zikaSimakade uNkulunkulu ezihambela ensimini, base becasha phakathi kwemithi.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wammemeza umuntu wathi: “Ukuphi na?”
Waphendula wathi: “Ngizwe izigi zakho ensimini, ngase ngesaba ngoba ngihamba ze, ngacasha.”
Wathi kuye: “Ngubani okutshele ukuthi uhamba ze na? Ngabe udlile yini kulowo muthi engakudonsa ngendlebe ngathi ungadli kuwo na?”
Umuntu waphendula wathi: “Lo wesifazane owanginika yena, nguyena onginike isithelo somuthi, nami-ke ngasidla.”
USimakade uNkulunkulu wabuza kowesifazane wathi: “Ukwenzeleni lokhu na?” Waphendula wathi: “Yinyoka engiluthile, ngasidla.”
USimakade uNkulunkulu wathi enyokeni: “Ngokuba wenze lokhu, usuqalekisiwe kunezilwane zonke ezifuywayo, nezilwane zonke zasendle. Uyohuquzela ngesisu, udle uthuli izinsuku zonke zokuphila kwakho.
Ngizokwenza ubutha phakathi kwakho nowesifazane, ngizonenza nizondane nenzalo yowesifazane. Inzalo yowesifazane iyochoboza ikhanda leyakho, nenzalo yakho ishaye isithende senzalo yakhe.”
Kowesifazane wathi: “Ngiyokuzwisa izinhlungu ezinkulu usakhulelwe, uzwe iminjunju lapho ubeletha. Uyohlala ulangazelela indoda yakho, yona ikubuse.”

Endodeni wathi: “Ngenxa yokuba ulalele umkakho, wadla isithelo engikudonse ngendlebe ngathi ungasidli, ngalokho umhlabathi usuqalekisiwe ngenxa yakho. Uyokhandleka ukuze uthole ukudla kuwo, izinsuku zonke zokuphila kwakho.
Umhlabathi uyokuvezela ameva namakhakhasi, uphile ngokudla okuvela kuwo.
Uyokujulukela ukudla oyokudla, uze ubuyele emhlabathini owathathwa kuwo, njengoba uwuthuli, uyobuyela othulini.”
Indoda yamqamba umkayo ngokuthi ngu-Eva, ngokuba waba ngunina wabo bonke abaphilayo.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wenzela indoda nomkayo iziphuku, wabembathisa.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wathi: “Bhekani, umuntu usefana nathi, useyakwazi okuhle nokubi. Akanqandwe ukuba angalokothi adle isithelo somuthi wokuphila, bese ephila ingunaphakade.”
USimakade uNkulunkulu wayesemxosha umuntu ensimini yase-Edeni, wamkhipha ukuba ayolima umhlabathi ayebunjwe ngawo.
Wamxosha umuntu, wayesebeka amakherubhi empumalanga nensimu yase-Edeni, nenkemba evuthayo eyayiphendukela nxazonke, ukuqapha indlela eya emthini wokuphila.
U-Adamu walala nomkakhe u-Eva, wayesekhulelwa, wazala uKhayini, wathi: “Ngifumene insizwa kuSimakade.”
Wabuye wazala enye indodana wayiqamba ngokuthi ngu-Abela. U-Abela wayengumelusi, uKhayini engumlimi.
Kwathi ngokuhamba kwezinsuku uKhayini waletha kuSimakade umnikelo wezithelo zomhlabathi.
U-Abela naye waletha amazibulo emfuyo yakhe, wanikela ngezitho zawo ezinonileyo. USimakade wamnaka u-Abela nomnikelo wakhe,
kodwa uKhayini nomnikelo wakhe wakushaya indiva. UKhayini wathukuthela wagana unwabu, wahwaqabala ebusweni.
USimakade wambuza uKhayini wathi: “Uthukutheleleni na? Bunyukubaleleni ubuso bakho na?
Uma wenza okuhle, awuzukwamukela okuhle yini na? Uma ungenzi kahle, isono sisemnyango, siyakunyonyobela; sifuna wena, kodwa wena sinqobe.”
UKhayini wathi ku-Abela umnawakhe: “Asihambe siye endle.” Kuthe sebefike endle, uKhayini wambhudukeza umnawakhe wambulala.
USimakade wambuza uKhayini wathi: “Uphi umnawakho u-Abela na?” UKhayini waphendula wathi: “Angazi. Kanti ngingumlindi womfowethu yini na?”
Wathi kuye: “Ukwenzeleni lokho na? Igazi lomnawakho liyakhala kimi lisemhlabathini!
Usuqalekisiwe emhlabathini lona ovule umlomo wawo wemukela igazi lomnawakho olichithele kuwo ngesandla sakho.
Uma ulima, umhlabathi awuyikukunika sivuno; uzoba ngumhambuma nozulane emhlabeni.”
UKhayini wathi kuSimakade: “Ngeke ngisimele lesi sijeziso, siyangisinda.
Bheka, namuhla usungixoshile emhlabeni, sengingumhambuma nozulane ezweni, ngethuswa wubala, noma ngubani ohlangana nami uzofuna ukungibulala.”
USimakade wathi kuye: “Akusoze kwenzeka lokho, ngoba uma umuntu ekubulala, uyojeziswa kasikhombisa.” USimakade wayesembeka uphawu uKhayini ukuze lwexwayise noma ngubani ohlangana naye angambulali.
UKhayini wasuka phambi kukaSimakade, wahamba wayohlala eNodi, empumalanga ye-Edeni.
UKhayini walala nomkakhe wakhulelwa, wazala u-Enokhi. UKhayini wakha umuzi wawuqamba ngegama lendodana yakhe u-Enokhi.
U-Enokhi wazala u-Iradi, uyise kaMehujayeli, uMehujayeli wazala uMethushayeli, uMethushayeli wazala uLameki.
ULameki waganwa ngabafazi ababili, u-Ada noZila.
U-Ada wazala uJabhali, ukhokho walabo abahlala emathendeni abangabafuyi bemihlambi.
Igama lomnawakhe nguJubhali. Yena wayengukhokho walabo ababengababethi bogubhu nomtshingo.
UZila wazala uThubhali Khayini, owayengumkhandi wazo zonke izinhlobo zezinto ezenziwe ngethusi nangensimbi. Udadewabo kaThubhali Khayini kwakunguNahama.
ULameki wathi komkakhe: “We Ada noZila, ake ningilalele! Bafazi bakaLameki, yizwani engikushoyo! Ngibulale umuntu ngoba engilimazile, nensizwa ngokungishaya kwayo.
Uma uKhayini eyophindiselwa kasikhombisa, uLameki uyophindiselelwa kamashumi ayisikhombisa nesikhombisa.”
U-Adamu waphinde walala nomkakhe, wayesezala indodana wayiqamba igama wathi nguSethi, ngokuba wathi: “UNkulunkulu uphinde wangipha enye ingane esikhundleni sika-Abela, ngokuba uKhayini wambulala.”
USethi naye wazibula ngendodana wayiqamba ngokuthi ngu-Enoshe. Baqala lapho-ke abantu ukukhuleka egameni likaSimakade.
Nantu uhla lozalo luka-Adamu. Ngesikhathi uNkulunkulu edala umuntu wamenza wanjengaye.
Wadala owesilisa nowesifazane, wababusisa, wababiza ngokuthi ngabantu ngosuku abadala ngalo.
Kuthe lapho u-Adamu eseqede iminyaka eyi-130, wazala indodana eyayifana naye, wayiqamba igama wathi nguSethi.
Esezelwe uSethi, u-Adamu waphila iminyaka engama-800, waphinde wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
Isiyonke iminyaka eyaphilwa ngu-Adamu yaba ngama-930, wayesefa.
Kwathi uSethi eseneminyaka eyi-105, wazala u-Enoshe.
Esezelwe u-Enoshe, uSethi waphila iminyaka engama-807 emva kokuzalwa kuka-Enoshe, waphinde wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
Isiyonke iminyaka eyaphilwa nguSethi yaba ngama-912, wayesefa.
Kwathi u-Enoshe eseneminyaka engama-90, wazala uKhenani.
Esezelwe uKhenani, u-Enoshe waphila iminyaka engama-815, waphinde wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
Isiyonke iminyaka eyaphilwa ngu-Enoshe yaba ngama-905, wayesefa.
Kwathi uKhenani eseneminyaka engama-70, wazala uMahalaleli.
Esezelwe uMahalaleli, uKhenani waphila iminyaka engama-840, waphinde wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
Isiyonke iminyaka eyaphilwa nguKhenani yaba ngama-910, wayesefa.
Kwathi uMahalaleli eseneminyaka engama-65, wazala uJaredi.
Esezelwe uJaredi, uMahalaleli waphila iminyaka engama-830, waphinde wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
Isiyonke iminyaka eyaphilwa nguMahalaleli yaba ngama-895, wayesefa.
Kwathi uJaredi eseneminyaka eyi-162, wazala u-Enokhi.
Esezelwe u-Enokhi, uJaredi waphila iminyaka engama-800, waphinde wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
Isiyonke iminyaka eyaphilwa nguJaredi yaba ngama-962, wayesefa.
Kwathi u-Enokhi eseneminyaka engama-65, wazala uMethusela.
Esezelwe uMethusela, u-Enokhi waphila iminyaka engama-300 ehamba noNkulunkulu, waphinde wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
Isiyonke iminyaka eyaphilwa ngu-Enokhi yaba ngama-365.
U-Enokhi wayehamba noNkulunkulu. Wanyamalala, ngokuba uNkulunkulu wamthabatha.
Kwathi uMethusela eseneminyaka eyi-187, wazala uLameki.
Esezelwe uLameki, uMethusela waphila iminyaka engama-782, waphinde wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
Isiyonke iminyaka eyaphilwa nguMethusela yaba ngama-969, wayesefa.
Kwathi uLameki eseneminyaka eyi-182, wazala indodana.
Wayiqamba igama wathi nguNowa, ethi: “Lo nguyena ozosiphumuza emsebenzini wethu nasemshikashikeni wezandla zethu emhlabathini awuqalekisa uSimakade.”
Esezelwe uNowa, uLameki waphila iminyaka engama-595, waphinde wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
Isiyonke iminyaka eyaphilwa nguLameki yaba ngama-777, wayesefa.
Kwathi uNowa eseneminyaka engama-500, wazala uShemu, uHamu, noJafethi.
Kuthe lapho abantu sebeqala ukwanda ebusweni bomhlaba, sebezele amadodakazi,
amadodana kaNkulunkulu abona amadodakazi abantu ukuthi mahle, aziqokela abafazi phakathi kwawo.
USimakade wathi: “UMoya wami awuyukuhlala phakathi kwabantu kuze kube phakade, ngoba bayinyama nje. Iminyaka yabo yokuphila isizoba yi-120.”
Ngalezo zinsuku nasemveni kwazo, kwaba khona iziqhwaga emhlabeni. Amadodana kaNkulunkulu alala namadodakazi abantu, awazalela abantwana. Baba ngamaqhawe asendulo, adumileyo.
USimakade wabona ukuthi ububi babantu sebubukhulu emhlabeni nokuthi izizindlo zezinhliziyo zabo zihlala zizimbi njalo,
wayesezisola uSimakade ukuthi ubadaleleni abantu emhlabeni. Lokho kwamkhathaza enhliziyweni yakhe, wayesethi:
“Ngizobashaya ngibaqothule ebusweni bomhlaba abantu engibadalileyo. Abantu nezilwane, izilwane ezihuquzelayo, nezinyoni zezulu, ngokuba ngiyazisola ukuthi ngikudaleleni.”
Nokho uNowa wafumana umusa emehlweni kaSimakade.
Nanku umlando kaNowa nezizukulwane zakhe. UNowa wayengumuntu oqotho, engenasici esizukulwaneni sakhe, ehamba noNkulunkulu.
UNowa wazala amadodana amathathu: uShemu, uHamu, noJafethi.
Umhlaba wase wonakele kakhulu phambi kukaNkulunkulu, ugcwele ubudlova.
UNkulunkulu wabona ukuthi umhlaba wonakele, ngokuba bonke abantu babeziphethe kabi emhlabeni.
UNkulunkulu wathi kuNowa: “Senginqume ukubabhubhisa bonke abantu, ngoba umhlaba ugcwele ubudlova ngenxa yabo. Bheka, ngizobabhubhisa nomhlaba.
Wena zakhele umkhumbi ngezingodo zomgoferi, uwakhe ube namakamelo, uwubhixe ngebhithumeni ngaphakathi nangaphandle.
Uzowakha kanje: ubude bawo bube ngamakhubhithi angama-300, ububanzi bube ngamakhubhithi angama-50, kuthi ukuphakama kwawo kube ngamakhubhithi angama-30.
Uwufulele, ushiye isikhala esiyikhubhithi eyodwa phakathi kophahla macala wonke. Uwakhe ube namagumbi amathathu, elinye libe phezu kwelinye, kube nomnyango eceleni.
Bheka, Mina ngizokwehlisa uzamcolo emhlabeni, ubhubhise konke okuphilayo phansi komthunzi welanga, kufe konke okuphefumulayo emhlabeni.
Kepha ngizokwenza nawe isivumelwano, uzongena emkhunjini wena nomkakho namadodana akho nomkawo,
bese ungenisa zonke izilwane ngazimbili ngezinhlobo zazo, kube yiduna nensikazi ukuze ziphile nawe.
Ungenise izinyoni ngezinhlobo zazo, nezilwane ngezinhlobo zazo, nezihuquzelayo ngezinhlobo zazo, konke lokho kungene ngakubili ukuze kuphile.
Zithathele lonke uhlobo lokudla ukulondoloze, ukuze kube ngukudla kwenu nokwazo.”
UNowa wakwenza konke lokho uNkulunkulu ayemyale ukuba akwenze.
USimakade wathi kuNowa: “Ngena emkhunjini, wena nabo bonke abendlu yakho, ngokuba ngibonile ukuthi nguwena kuphela olungile phambi kwami kulesi sizukulwane.
Thatha amabhanqa ayisikhombisa azo zonke izilwane ezihlanzekile, iduna nensikazi, nakulezo ezingahlanzekile uthathe ngazimbili, iduna nensikazi.
Uthathe kulo lonke uhlobo lwezinyoni zezulu zibe ngamabhanqa ayisikhombisa: iduna nensikazi, ukuze kulondolozeke izinhlobo zazo emhlabeni wonke.
Ngokuba emva kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa ngizodedela imvula, ine emhlabeni izinsuku ezingama-40 nobusuku obungama-40, ngibhubhise konke okuphilayo engikudalileyo emhlabeni.”
UNowa wakwenza konke lokho njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile.
UNowa wayeseneminyaka engama-600 ngesikhathi liyithela ekazamcolo emhlabeni.
UNowa nowakwakhe namadodana akhe nomkawo bangena emkhunjini ukuze baphephe ezikhukhuleni zikazamcolo.
Izilwane nazo zangena ngazimbili kwezihlanzekile nezingahlanzekile, nezinyoni ngokunjalo, nezilwane zonke ezihuquzelayo emhlabeni,
zangena emkhunjini ngazimbili, iduna nensikazi kanye noNowa njengokuba uNkulunkulu ayeshilo kuye.
Uzamcolo waqala emhlabeni emva kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Kuthe lapho uNowa eseneminyaka engama-600, ngosuku lwe-17, ngenyanga yesibili, kwaqhuma zonke iziphethu zamanzi emajukujukwini, kwavuleka namafasitela ezulu.
Lana emhlabeni imini nobusuku izinsuku ezingama-40.
Ngalolo lusuku uNowa nowakwakhe namadodana akhe, uShemu, uHamu, noJafethi, nomkabo bobathathu bangena emkhunjini.

Kwangena zonke izilwane zasendle ngezinhlobo zazo, nezilwane ezifuywayo ngezinhlobo zazo, ezihuquzelayo emhlabeni ngezinhlobo zazo, nazo zonke izinyoni zezulu ngezinhlobo zazo, nakho konke okunamaphiko.
Kwangena emkhunjini kaNowa ngakubili konke okuphefumulayo,
njengalokhu uNkulunkulu ayemyalile uNowa, kwangena iduna nensikazi, kukho konke okuphilayo. Esengenile uNowa, uSimakade wavala umnyango.
Laqhubeka layithela imvula izinsuku ezingama-40, akhula amanzi, awuntantisa umkhumbi phezu komhlaba.
Amanzi akhula anda emhlabeni; umkhumbi wantanta phezu kwamanzi.
Amanzi anda kakhulu emhlabeni aze asibekela zonke iziqongo zezintaba ezinde.
Anda kakhulu aze azisibekela ngamakhubhithi ayishumi nanhlanu iziqongo zezintaba.
Kwafa konke okuphilayo emhlabeni: wena nyoni, wena nkomo, wena silo, wena silwanyana esinwabuzelayo emhlabeni, nabo bonke abantu.
Konke okuphefumulayo okwakusezweni, kwafa.

UNkulunkulu wakushaya wakuqothula konke okuphilayo ezweni: abantu nezilwane, nezilwane ezihuquzelayo nezinyoni zezulu, wakushaya wakuqothula emhlabeni. Kwasala kuphela uNowa nalabo ayenabo emkhunjini.
Amanzi anda emhlabeni kwaze kwaphela izinsuku eziyi-150.
UNkulunkulu wamkhumbula uNowa nazo zonke izilwane ezazinaye emkhunjini, ezifuywayo nezasendle. Wayesethumela umoya wavunguza phezu komhlaba, amanzi aya ngokuya ebohla.
Kwavaleka iziphethu ezisezinzulwini, kwavaleka namafasitela ezulu, yanqamuka imvula.
Amanzi aya ngokuya ebohla. Sekwedlule izinsuku eziyi-150 amanzi ayesehlile impela.
Ngosuku lwe-17 ngenyanga yesikhombisa, umkhumbi wathi cababa ezintabeni e-Ararathi.
Amanzi aya ngokuya ehla. Kwathi lulunye ngenyanga yeshumi, kwaqala kwabonakala iziqongo zezintaba.
Kwathi emveni kwezinsuku ezingama-40, uNowa wavula ifasitela lomkhumbi ayelenzile,
wakhiphela ngaphandle igwababa. Landiza njalo lehla lenyuka kwaze kwabohla amanzi emhlabeni.
Wabuye wathumela ijuba ukuze ahlole ngalo ukuthi nembala amanzi asenciphile yini ebusweni bomhlaba.
Kepha ijuba kalitholanga ndawo elalingahlala kuyo. Landiza labuyela emkhunjini, uNowa welula isandla walingenisa ngaphakathi.
Walinda izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, wabuye walikhipha ijuba.
Labuyela kuye sekuhlwile liphethe ngomlomo iqabunga lomnqumo eliluhlaza. Kwamcacela uNowa ukuthi amanzi asebohlile emhlabeni.
Walinda izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, wabuye walithumela ijuba, kodwa aliphindanga labuyela kuye.
Ngosuku lokuqala ngenyanga yokuqala uNowa eseqede iminyaka engama-601 ephila, wonke amanzi ayesehwamukile emhlabeni. UNowa waphakamisa uphahla lomkhumbi, wabona ukuthi sekomile phansi.
Kwafika usuku lwama-27 sekome nkwe phansi.
UNkulunkulu wakhuluma noNowa, wathi:
“Phuma emkhunjini, wena nomkakho namadodana akho nomkawo.
Khipha konke okuphilayo okunawe, izinyoni, zonke izilwane, nezilwane ezihuquzelayo, ukuze zizalane zande emhlabeni.”
Wayesephuma-ke uNowa nomkakhe, namadodana akhe nomkawo.
Emkhunjini kwaphuma zonke izilwane, zonke izilwane ezihuquzelayo, nazo zonke izinyoni, nakho konke okuhambayo emhlabeni ngezinhlobo zakho.
UNowa wakhela uSimakade i-althare, wathatha kuzo zonke izilwane nezinyoni ezihlanzekileyo ngezinhlobo zazo, wenza ngazo umnikelo wokushiswa kulelo althare ayelakhile.

Iphunga lalowo mnikelo lamthokozisa uSimakade, wayesethi enhliziyweni yakhe: “Umhlaba angisayukuphinde ngiwuqalekise ngenxa yabantu. Umuntu vele unemicabango emibi kusukela ebuncaneni bakhe. Ngeke ngiphinde ngikubhubhise ngozamcolo konke okuphilayo njengalokhu ngenzile.
“Inqobo nje uma umhlaba usekhona, kuyotshalwa kuvunwe, kube makhaza kushise, kube yihlobo nobusika, imini nobusuku, lokhu akuyukunqamuka.”
UNkulunkulu wambusisa uNowa namadodana akhe, wathi kubo: “Zalanani nande, nigcwalise umhlaba.
Konke ngikwethula ezandleni zenu: izinyoni zezulu nezilwane zonke zomhlaba, nezilwane ezihuquzelayo, nazo zonke izinhlanzi zolwandle; kuyakwehlelwa wuvalo, kunesabe, kuthuthumele.
Zonke izilwane eziphilayo, ziyokuba ngukudla kwenu, njengoba nganinika imifino, sengininika konke.
Kepha ningalokothi nidle inyama enegazi, ngokuba umphefumulo usegazini layo.
Maqondana negazi lenu okukulo ukuphila, ngiyakuliphindiselela kuzo zonke izilwane ngisho noma nibulalane nodwa.
“Ochitha igazi lomuntu, nelakhe liyochithwa ngumuntu, ngokuba umuntu wadalwa nguNkulunkulu, wamenza wafana naye.
Kepha nina zalanani nande, nigcwalise umhlaba, nande kuwo.”
UNkulunkulu wathi kuNowa nakumadodana akhe ayenaye:
“Bhekani, ngenza isivumelwano phakathi kwami nani, nezizukulwane zenu,
nakuzo zonke izilwane eziphilayo ezinani: izinyoni zezulu, izilwane ezifuywayo, nazo zonke izilwane eziphilayo emhlabeni enaphuma nazo emkhunjini.
Lesi yisivumelwano sami nani engithi ngaso: angisayukuphinde ngibhubhise yonke into ephilayo ngozamcolo. Akusayukuphinde kube khona uzamcolo ukuba ubhubhise umhlaba.”
UNkulunkulu wayesethi: “Lokhu kuluphawu lwesivumelwano engisenza phakathi kwami nani nazo zonke izilwane eziphilayo ezinani, nazo zonke izizukulwane ezisazozalwa:
Uthingo lwenkosazana ngilubeke emafini, ukuze lube wuphawu lwesivumelwano phakathi kwami nomhlaba.
Kuyothi lapho ngiwusibekela umhlaba ngamafu, kuvele uthingo lwenkosazana emafini,
bese ngikhumbula isivumelwano sami phakathi kwami nani nazo zonke izilwane ngezinhlobo zazo. Izikhukhula zingabe zisaphenduka uzamcolo wokucekela phansi konke okuphilayo.
Kuyothi njalo uma kuvela uthingo lwenkosazana emafini, ngilubheke qede ngikhumbule isivumelwano saphakade esikhona phakathi kwami nezilwane zonke eziphilayo emhlabeni ngezinhlobo zazo.”
UNkulunkulu wayesethi kuNowa: “Lokho kuluphawu lwesivumelwano sami engisenze phakathi kwami nabo bonke abantu emhlabeni.”
Amadodana kaNowa, uShemu, uHamu, noJafethi aphuma emkhunjini. UHamu wayenguyise kaKhanani.
Kulawa madodana kaNowa amathathu kwavela kuwo abantu abasabalala nomhlaba wonke.
UNowa owayengumlimi, waba ngowokuqala ukutshala isivini.
Kuthe esephuze iwayini, lamdaka walala enqunu ethendeni lakhe.
UHamu, uyise kaKhanani, wabona ubunqunu bukayise, waxoxela abafowabo ababengaphandle.
UShemu noJafethi bathatha ingubo bayibeka emahlombe abo, bahlehla nyovana, bangena, babufihla ubunqunu bukayise. Babufulathelisa ubuso babo ukuze bangabuboni ubunqunu bukayise.
Kwathi lapho selidamukile iwayini kuNowa, wezwa ukuthi indodana yakhe encane yenzeni kuye,
wayesethi: “Uqalekisiwe uKhanani! Uyoba yisigqila sezigqila kubafowabo.”
Wabuye wathi futhi: “Makabongwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu kaShemu, uKhanani makabe yisigqila sikaShemu.
UNkulunkulu makamnike indawo ebanzi uJafethi, ahlale emathendeni kaShemu, uKhanani abe yisigqila sabo.”
Emva kukazamcolo uNowa waphila iminyaka engama-350.
Isiyonke iminyaka eyaphilwa nguNowa yaba ngama-950, wayesefa.
Nanku umlando wamadodana kaNowa: uShemu, uHamu, noJafethi; nawo azala awawo amadodana emva kukazamcolo.
Amadodana kaJafethi kwakunguGomeri, uMagogi, uMadayi, uJavani, uThubhali, uMeshekhe noThirasi.
Amadodana kaGomeri kwakungu-Ashikenazi, uRifathi, noThogama.
Amadodana kaJavani kwakungu-Elisha, uTharishishi, uKhithimi, noDodanimi.
Kulaba kwadabuka izizwe ezisemazweni agudle ulwandle, zehlukana ngolimi, ngemindeni, nangezizwe.
Amadodana kaHamu kwakunguKhushe, uMizirayimi, uPhuthi, noKhanani.
Amadodana kaKhushe kwakunguSebha, uHavila, uSabitha, uRama, noSabhitheka. Amadodana kaRama kwakunguShebha noDedani.
UKhushe wazala uNimrodi, iqhawe lokuqala emhlabeni.
Wayeyiphisi elinamandla phambi kukaSimakade. Yingakho kunesisho esithi: “Kuhle kukaNimrodi iphisi elinamandla phambi kukaSimakade.”
Waqala ukubusa eBhabhele, e-Erekhi, e-Akhadi naseKhaline eShinari.
Wasuka kulelo lizwe walibangisa e-Asiriya lapho afike akha khona iNinive, iRehobhothi Iri, iKhala,
neReseni umuzi omkhulu ophakathi kweNinive neKhala.
UMizirayimi wazala amaLudi, ama-Anami, amaLehabi, amaNafethuhi,
amaPhathrusi, namaKhasuluhi okwadabuka kubo amaFilisti nabaseKhafithori.
UKhanani wazibula ngoSidoni, kwalandela uHethi,
nalezi zizwe: amaJebusi, ama-Amori, amaGirigashi,
amaHivi, ama-Akhi, amaSini,
ama-Arivadi, amaZemari, namaHamathi. Emveni kwalokho imindeni yamaKhanani yasabalala kulo lonke izwe,
imingcele yayo yayisuka eSidoni ibheke eGera kuze kube seGaza, iye eSodoma, eGomora, e-Adima, naseZebhoyimu, ize ifinyelele eLasha.
Yilawa amadodana kaHamu ngokwemindeni nangezilimi, emazweni nasezizweni zawo:
uShemu naye wazalelwa amadodana, ungukhokho waso sonke isizukulwane sabakwa-Ebhere nomnewabo kaJafethi.
Amadodana kaShemu kwakungu-Elamu, u-Ashuri, u-Arifaksadi, uLudi no-Aramu.
Amadodana ka-Aramu kwakungu-Uzi, uHulu, uGetheri, noMashe.
U-Arifaksadi wazala uShela, uShela wazala u-Ebhere.
U-Ebhere wazala amadodana amabili. Enye yawo kwakuthiwa nguPhelegi, ngoba ngesikhathi sakhe izwe ladatshulwa izifunda. Enye kwakuthiwa uJokithani.
UJokithani wazala u-Alimodadi, uShelefu, uHazamavete, uJera,
uHadoramu, u-Uzali, uDikila,
u-Obhali, u-Abhimayeli, uShebha,
u-Ofiri, uHavila noJobhabhu. Bonke laba babengamadodana kaJokithani.
Indawo ababakhe kuyo yayisuka eMesha ize ifike eSefari, kwelezintaba empumalanga.
Yilawo-ke amadodana kaShemu ngokwemindeni nangezilimi zawo, ezifundeni zawo nangokwezizwe zawo.
Yileyo-ke imindeni yamadodana kaNowa ngokozalo lwawo nangokwezizwe zawo. Kuwo kwavela izizwe ezasabalala nomhlaba wonke emveni kukazamcolo.
Emhlabeni wonke abantu babekhuluma lulimi lunye.
Basuka empumalanga baze bayofika emathafeni eShinari, bahlala khona.
Babonisana, bathi: “Wozani sibumbe izitini, sizipheke emlilweni ukuze ziqine!” Esikhundleni samatshe babumba izitini, esikhundleni sodaka benza ibhithumeni.
Base bethi: “Wozani sizakhele isithabathaba somuzi onombhoshongo omude ofinyelela esibhakabhakeni, ukuze ngawo sizakhele igama emhlabeni, singahlakazeki nezwe lonke!”
USimakade wehla ukuzobona umuzi nombhoshongo owawakhiwe ngabantu.
Wathi: “Bheka, laba bantu basizwe sinye, bakhuluma lulimi lunye. Lokhu kuseyisiqalo nje sezinto abazozenza. Manje sebezokwenza noma yini abazimisele ukuyenza.
Wozani sehle, siphambanise ulimi lwabo, khona bezogcina bengasezwani ukuthi omunye uthini komunye.”
USimakade wabahlakaza kanjalo-ke bagcwala umhlaba wonke, bakuyeka ukwakha umuzi.
Lowo muzi wabizwa ngokuthi yiBhabhele, ngokuba kulapho uSimakade aphambanisa khona ulimi lomhlaba wonke, wayesebahlakaza bagcwala umhlaba wonke.
Nanku umlando wezizukulwane zikaShemu. Kwaphela iminyaka emibili unqamukile uzamcolo, uShemu eseneminyaka eyikhulu, wazala u-Arifaksadi.
Esemzele u-Arifaksadi, waphila iminyaka engama-500: wayezele namanye amadodana namadodakazi.
Kuthe u-Arifaksadi eseneminyaka engama-35, wazala uShela.
Emva kokuzala uShela, u-Arifaksadi waphila iminyaka engama-403, wabuye wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
UShela wayeseneminyaka engama-30 ezala u-Ebhere.
Esemzele u-Ebhere, waphila iminyaka engama-403, wabuye wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
Kuthe u-Ebhere eseneminyaka engama-34, wazala uPhelegi.
Esemzele uPhelegi, u-Ebhere waphila iminyaka engama-430, wabuye wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
UPhelegi eseneminyaka engama-30, wazala uRegu.
Esemzele uRegu, uPhelegi waphila iminyaka engama-209, wabuye wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
URegu eseneminyaka engama-32, wazala uSerugi.
Esemzele uSerugi, uRegu waphila iminyaka engama-207, wabuye wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
USerugi eseneminyaka engama-30, wazala uNahori.
Esemzele uNahori, uSerugi waphila iminyaka engama-200, wabuye wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
UNahori eseneminyaka engama-29, wazala uThera.
Esemzele uThera, uNahori waphila iminyaka eyi-119, wabuye wazala amadodana namadodakazi.
Kuthe uThera eseneminyaka engama-70, wazala u-Abhrama, uNahori, noHarana.
Nanku umlando wezizukulwane zikaThera. UThera wazala u-Abhrama, uNahori, noHarana. UHarana wazala uLothi.
UHarana wafa kuqala kunoyise uThera ezweni ayedabuka kulo i-Uri lamaKhaledi.
U-Abhrama noNahori baganwa. U-Abhrama waganwa nguSarayi, uNahori waganwa nguMilikha, owayeyindodakazi kaHarana, owayezala u-Isikha.
USarayi wayeyinyumba, engenabantwana.

UThera wathatha indodana yakhe u-Abhrama noLothi owayezalwa nguHarana, nomalokazana wakwakhe uSarayi owayegane u-Abhrama, bonke base belifulathela i-Uri lamaKhaledi, balibangisa eKhanani. Bafika bahlala eHarana.
UThera waphila iminyaka engama-205, wafela eHarana.
USimakade wathi ku-Abhrama: “Phuma ezweni lakini, nasezihlotsheni zakho, nakwabendlu kayihlo, uye ezweni engizokukhombisa lona.
Ngizokwenza ube yisizwe esikhulu, ngikubusise, ngikunike udumo, wena ube yisibusiso.
Ngiyakubabusisa abakubusisayo, ngibaqalekise abakuqalekisayo. Yonke imindeni yomhlaba iyakubusiswa ngawe.”
U-Abhrama wayeneminyaka engama-75 ngesikhathi eqala uhambo lwakhe njengalokhu uSimakade ayemtshelile; wahamba noLothi, balifulathela iHarana.
Wathatha umkakhe uSarayi, noLothi indodana yomfowabo, nayo yonke impahla ababenayo, nezinceku ababezitholile eHarana, babhekisa amabombo eKhanani. Sebefikile eKhanani,
u-Abhrama wadabula kulo waze wafika eShekhemu nasemu-okhini eMore. Ngaleso sikhathi kulelo lizwe kwakusakhe amaKhanani.
USimakade wazibonakalisa ku-Abhrama, wathi: “Leli lizwe ngiyolinika isizukulwane sakho.” U-Abhrama wayesakha lapho i-althare likaSimakade owayezibonakalise kuye.

Wasuka lapho waya kwelezintaba empumalanga yeBhethele, wagxumeka ithende lakhe lapho. IBhethele yayingasentshonalanga, i-Ayi ingasempumalanga. Kulapho-ke akhela khona uSimakade i-althare, wakhuleka egameni likaSimakade.
Wayesekhukhula njalo waze wayofika eningizimu.
Kwase kuhlasela indlala eKhanani, u-Abhrama wayesehlela eGibhithe ukuyogogobala khona, ngokuba indlala yayidlangile ezweni lakubo.
Kuthe lapho sebezongena eGibhithe wayesethi kumkakhe uSarayi: “Ngazi kahle ukuthi ungowesifazane omuhle kakhulu.
Kuyothi uma amaGibhithe ekubona athi: ‘Ngumkakhe lo.’ Bese mina engibulala, kodwa wena akuyeke uphile.
Ubowatshela ukuthi ungudadewethu, khona ezongiphatha kahle ukuze ngisinde ngenxa yakho.”
Ekufikeni kuka-Abhrama eGibhithe, amaGibhithe ambona owesifazane ukuthi muhle ngokwedlulele.
Izikhulu zikaFaro nazo zambona zamncoma kuFaro, wayeselethwa esigodlweni sakhe.
UFaro wamphatha kahle u-Abhrama ngenxa yomkakhe, wamxoshisa ngezimvu, izinkomo, izimbongolo, amakameli, izinceku nezincekukazi.
USimakade washaya uFaro nabendlu yakhe ngobhubhane ngenxa kaSarayi umka-Abhrama.
UFaro wayesebiza u-Abhrama wathi kuye: “Yini le nto oyenze kimi na? Awungitshelanga ngani ukuthi ungumkakho na?
Usholoni ukuthi ungudadewenu ngaze ngamthatha ukuba abe ngumkami na? Manje-ke nangu umkakho. Mthathe uhambe.”
UFaro wayeseyaleza abantu bakhe ukuba babakhombe indlela ababeze ngayo o-Abhrama nomkakhe nakho konke ayenakho.
U-Abhrama nomkakhe nakho konke ayenakho basuka eGibhithe bakhuphuka babheka eningizimu noLothi.
Ngaleso sikhathi u-Abhrama wayesecebe kakhulu, enemfuyo, nesiliva negolide.
Wasuka eningizimu wahamba ephumula waze wayofika eBhethele, endaweni ephakathi kweBhethele ne-Ayi, lapho wayekade egobe khona amadlangala phambilini,
nalapho wayekade akhe khona i-althare. Wakhuleka egameni likaSimakade.
ULothi owayehambe no-Abhrama, naye wayesenezimvu, izimbuzi, izinkomo namathende.
Izwe ababehlezi kulo lalingasabenele, ngoba imfuyo yabo yabe seyande kakhulu kangangokuthi babengeke besakwazi ukuhlala ndawonye.
Abelusi bemfuyo ka-Abhrama nabekaLothi base beqale ukuxabana. Ngaleso sikhathi amaKhanani namaPherizi ayehlala kulelo lizwe.
U-Abhrama wathi kuLothi: “Masingaxabani, ingabi bikho nengxabano phakathi kwabelusi bethu, ngoba thina siyazalana.
Awuliboni yini leli lizwe eliphambi kwakho na? Masehlukane-ke. Uma uya enyakatho, mina ngizoya eningizimu. Uma uya eningizimu, mina ngizoya enyakatho.”
ULothi wabheka, walibona lonke ithafa eliseJordani kuze kube seZowari ukuthi lalivunde njengensimu kaSimakade, nanjengeGibhithe. Lokho kwenzeka uSimakade engakalibhubhisi iSodoma neGomora.
ULothi wazikhethela lonke ithafa eliseJordani, wayeselibhekisa ngasempumalanga. Ehlukana kanjalo-ke lawa madoda amabili.
U-Abhrama wayesehlala eKhanani, uLothi wahlala phakathi kwemizi esethafeni, wagxumeka ithende lakhe eduze komuzi iSodoma.
Abantu baseSodoma babonakele kakhulu, benza inkohlakalo yodwa phambi kukaSimakade.
Kwathi lapho uLothi esehambile, uSimakade wakhuluma ku-Abhrama wathi: “Manje phakamisa amehlo akho ubuke nxazonke lapho ukhona: enyakatho, eningizimu, empumalanga nasentshonalanga,
ngokuba lonke leli lizwe olibonayo ngizokunika lona; wena nezizukulwane zakho, kuze kube phakade.
Ngiyokwandisa izizukulwane zakho zibe ngangothuli lomhlaba, ukuze kuthi uma kukhona ongase akwazi ukubala uthuli lomhlaba, angazibala nezizukulwane.
Lihlole lonke leli lizwe, ngoba ngikunika lona.”
U-Abhrama wayesesusa ithende lakhe, wahamba, wafike wahlala eduze kwezihlahla ezinkulu zemi-okhi eMamre, eHebhroni, wayesemakhela khona uSimakade i-althare.
Ngalezo zinsuku kwasuka u-Amirafeli inkosi yaseShinari, no-Ariyokhi inkosi yase-Elasa, noKhedoloma inkosi yase-Elamu, noThidali inkosi yezizwe,
ahlasela uBhera inkosi yaseSodoma, noBhisha inkosi yaseGomora, noShinaba inkosi yase-Adima, noShemebha inkosi yaseZebhoyimu, nenkosi yaseBhela okuyiZowari.
Wonke lawo makhosi ahlanganisela amabutho awo esigodini iSidimu, okuwuLwandle Lukasawoti.
Lawo makhosi ayekade ekhonze kuKhedoloma iminyaka eyi-12, kodwa kuthe ngonyaka we-13 amvukela,
okuthe ngonyaka weshu-14, uKhedoloma namakhosi ayebambisene nawo bahlasela amaRefa e-Ashitherothi Karinayimu, amaZuzi eHamu, ama-Emi eShave Kiriyathayimi,
namaHori asezintabeni eSeyiri, bawanqoba, bawaxosha aze afika e-Eli Pharani ehlane.
Base bebuyela emuva, bafika e-Eni Mishiphathi okuyiKadeshi, balinqoba lonke izwe lama-Amaleki, nama-Amori ayakhe eHazezoni Thamari.
Amakhosi aseSodoma, eGomora, e-Adima, eZebhoyimu, naseBhela, elibuye laziwe ngokuthi yiZowari, ehlela esigodini iSidimu, aphaka impi yawo ngamahlandla,
abhekana noKhedoloma inkosi yakwa-Elamu, noThidali inkosi yezizwe, no-Amirafeli inkosi yaseShinari, no-Ariyokhi inkosi yase-Elasa, kungamakhosi amane ebhekene namakhosi amahlanu.
Isigodi iSidimu sasigcwele imigodi yebhithumeni, okwathi lapho amakhosi aseSodoma naseGomora ebaleka, amanye amadoda aphonseka kuyo, amanye athi galo yephuka ephikelele ezintabeni.
Amakhosi ayiphanga yonke impahla yaseSodoma, neyaseGomora nakho konke ukudla, ahamba nakho.
Amthumba noLothi, indodana yomfowabo ka-Abhrama, owayehlala eSodoma nempahla yakhe bemuka naye.

Kwafika ophume ngesamagundwane isabambene, wabikela u-Abhrama umHebheru, owayakhe eduze kwezihlahla ezinkulu zemi-okhi eMamre, umu-Amori, umfowabo ka-Eshikholi no-Aneri, ababenze isivumelwano no-Abhrama.
Kuthe angezwa u-Abhrama ukuthi isihlobo sakhe sithunjiwe, wayesekhipha amadoda angama-318 ayeqeqeshelwe impi, ezalelwe emzini wakhe, wahamba nawo; bayixosha eyesitha baze bayofika kwaDani.
Kwathi ebusuku u-Abhrama wawehlukanisa phakathi amadoda ayehamba nawo, ayithelekela nxazonke eyezitha; ayidudula aze ayithela eHobha enyakatho neDamaseku.
Wayithola yonke impahla kaLothi, wabuya naye uLothi, isihlobo sakhe, nabanye abantu nabesifazane.
U-Abhrama esebuya ekunqobeni uKhedoloma namakhosi ayemelekelela, inkosi yaseSodoma yakhuphuka yamhlangabeza esigodini iShave, okungukuthi yisigodi seNkosi.
UMelkhizedeki, inkosi yaseSalema, owayengumphristi kaNkulunkulu Ophezukonke, wamlethela isinkwa newayini.
Wambusisa u-Abhrama wathi: “U-Abhrama makabusiswe nguNkulunkulu oPhezukonke, uMdali wezulu nomhlaba.
Makabongwe uNkulunkulu oPhezukonke onikele ezandleni zakho izitha zakho.” U-Abhrama wayesenikela kuMelkhizedeki ngokweshumi kwakho konke.
Inkosi yaseSodoma yathi ku-Abhrama: “Nginike abantu, wena uthathe impahla.”
Kepha u-Abhrama waphendula wathi: “Ngifungile kuSimakade uNkulunkulu oPhezukonke, uMdali wezulu nomhlaba,
ngathi ngeke ngamukele lutho lwakho, ngisho umucwana womchilo wembadada, ukuze ungangijikeli bese uthi: ‘Yimi engimnothisile u-Abhrama.’
Ngakho-ke angizukuthatha lutho ngaphandle kwalokho osekudliwe yizinsizwa, nesabelo salawa madoda abengiphelezele: u-Aneri, u-Eshikholi, noMamre. Mabasifumane isabelo sabo.”
Emveni kwalezo zinto izwi likaSimakade lafika ku-Abhrama ngombono, lathi kuye: “Ungesabi Abhrama, ngiyisihlangu sakho, umvuzo wakho uyakuba mkhulu kakhulu.”
U-Abhrama waphendula wathi: “Nkosi Simakade, uzonginikani njengoba ngingenamntwana nje? Ngisho nefa lami imbala lizodliwa ngu-Eliyezeri waseDamaseku.”
U-Abhrama waqhubeka wathi: “Njengoba ungincishe umntwana nje, kusobala ukuthi le nceku ezalelwe lapha ekhaya yiyona ezokuba yindlalifa yami.”
Izwi likaSimakade lezwakala kuye lithi: “Le ndoda kayisoze yaba yindlalifa yakho, indlalifa yakho kuzokuba yindodana ephuma okhalo lwakho.”
Wayesemkhiphela phandle wathi: “Bheka esibhakabhakeni ubale izinkanyezi, uma ungazibala.” Wayesethi kuye: “Iyakuba ngako inzalo yakho.”
U-Abhrama wakholwa ngokwashiwo nguSimakade, ngenxa yalokho uSimakade wakubalela kuye kwaba ngukulunga.
Wayesethi ku-Abhrama: “NginguSimakade owakukhipha e-Uri lamaKhaledi ukuba ngikunike leli lizwe libe yifa lakho.”
U-Abhrama wathi kuye: “Nkosi Simakade, ngiyokwazi kanjani ukuthi liyokuba yifa lami na?”
Wathi kuye: “Ngilethele isithole esineminyaka emithathu, imbuzikazi eneminyaka emithathu, inqama eneminyaka emithathu, ihobhe nephuphu lejuba.”
U-Abhrama wakuletha kuSimakade konke lokho, wakwehlukanisa izingxenye ezimbili, wazihlela izinhlangothi zabhekana, kodwa izinyoni akazehlukanisanga.
Kwase kwehlela amanqe enyameni, kodwa u-Abhrama wawaxosha.
Kuthe seliyozilahla kunina u-Abhrama wazunywa ngubuthongo obukhulu. Esesebuthongweni wehlelwa ngubumnyama obesabekayo.
Wathi ku-Abhrama: “Yazi lokhu ukuqonde ukuthi inzalo yakho iyokuba ngabafokazi ezweni okungesilo elayo, ibe yizigqila, icindezelwe iminyaka engama-400.
Kepha ngiyosijezisa isizwe esiyobe siyigqilazile, kuthi ekugcineni iphume isinefa elikhulu.
Nokho wena uyokufa ngokuthula, amathambo akho ayobekwa nawawoyihlomkhulu, ungcwatshwe usumdala.
Kuyothi isizukulwane sakho sesine sibuyele kule ndawo, ngokuba ukona kwama-Amori akukapheleliswa.”
Selishonile ilanga, sekumnyama, kwabonakala imbawula eshunqayo nesihlonti sikhephuka ilangabi kudabula phakathi kwezinhlangothi zenyama.
Ngalolo lusuku uSimakade wenza isivumelwano no-Abhrama, wathi: “Ngiyakulinika inzalo yakho leli lizwe, kusukela emfuleni oseGibhithe kuze kube semfuleni omkhulu iYufrathe:
izwe lamaKheni, lamaKhenizi, lamaKhadimoni,
lamaHithi, lamaPherizi, lamaRefayi,
lama-Amori, lamaKhanani, lamaGirigashi, nelamaJebusi.”
USarayi umka-Abhrama wayengamtholeli bantwana; wayenencekukazi engumGibhithe, igama layo kunguHagari.
USarayi wathi ku-Abhrama: “Bheka, uSimakade ungivale inzalo. Hamba ulale nencekukazi yami, mhlawumbe ingase ingivusele umuzi.” U-Abhrama walilalela izwi lomkakhe uSarayi.
Kuthe lapho u-Abhrama esehlale iminyaka elishumi eKhanani, uSarayi umkakhe wathatha incekukazi yakhe uHagari, umGibhithe, wayinika umyeni wakhe ukuba ibe ngumkakhe.
U-Abhrama walala noHagari, wayesekhulelwa. Kwathi angazibona ukuthi usekhulelwe uHagari, waqala ukubukela phansi uSarayi inkosikazi.

USarayi wayesethi ku-Abhrama: “Sengathi lokhu okubi okwenzeka kimi lingathwalwa nguwe icala lakho. Mina ngakunika incekukazi yami, ithe ingazibona ukuthi isikhulelwe yayisingibukela phansi. USimakade makehlulele phakathi kwakho nami.”
U-Abhrama wathi: “Incekukazi yakho isezandleni zakho. Yenza noma yini oyibona ifanele.” USarayi wamhlupha uHagari waze wabaleka.
Ingelosi kaSimakade yamthola uHagari ehlane eduze kwesiphethu esasibuqamama nomgwaqo oya eShuri.
Yathi kuye: “Hagari, ncekukazi kaSarayi, uvelaphi, futhi ulibangisephi na?” Waphendula wathi: “Ngibalekela inkosikazi uSarayi.”
Ingelosi kaSimakade yathi kuye: “Buyela kuyo inkosikazi ufike uzithobe.”
Yaqhubeka yathi: “Ngiyozandisa izizukulwane zakho zibe ziningi kangangokuthi azinakubalwa.”
Ingelosi kaSimakade yathi kuye: “Ukhulelwe manje, uzozala indodana, uyiqambe igama uthi ngu-Ishmayeli, ngokuba uSimakade uluzwile usizi lwakho.
Uyakuba yindoda ewumdlwembe njengembongolo yasendle, amelane nabo bonke abantu, nabantu bonke bamelane naye, futhi uyoba nochuku ngisho nasezihlotsheni zakhe zonke.”
UHagari wayesembiza uSimakade owayekhulume naye wathi: “Ungu-Eli Royi,” ngokuba wathi: “Ngabe ngimbonile yini, ongibonayo na?”
Yingakho leso siphethu sisabizwa ngokuthi yiBheri Lahayi Royi. Siphakathi kweKadeshi neBheredi.
UHagari wamzalela u-Abhrama indodana. U-Abhrama wayiqamba indodana yakhe ngokuthi ngu-Ishmayeli.
Wayeneminyaka engama-86 u-Abhrama ngesikhathi uHagari emzalela u-Ishmayeli.
Kwathi u-Abhrama eseneminyaka engama-99, uSimakade wabonakala kuye wathi: “NginguNkulunkulu uSomandla. Hamba phambi kwami ungenasici.
Ngizosigcina isivumelwano esiphakathi kwami nawe, ngikwandise kakhulu.”
U-Abhrama wakhothama wathi mbo ngobuso, uNkulunkulu wathi kuye:
“Mina ngiyazibophezela kulesi sivumelwano engisenza nawe: uyakuba nguyise wezizwe eziningi.
Igama lakho alisayukuba ngu-Abhrama, kepha selizokuba ngu-Abhrahama, ngokuba ngikwenze uyise wezizwe eziningi.
Ngizokwandisa kakhulu, kuvele kuwe izizwe eziningi ngisho namakhosi imbala.
Ngiyakumisa isivumelwano esiphakade phakathi kwami nawe, nezizukulwane zakho, ngibe nguNkulunkulu wakho nowazo.
Ngikunika lonke iKhanani ongumfokazi kulo njengamanje, libe yifa lakho laphakade nelezizukulwane zakho, ngibe nguNkulunkulu wazo.”
Wayesethi uNkulunkulu ku-Abhrahama: “Gcina isivumelwano sami, wena nezizukulwane zakho.
Yilesi isivumelwano sami nawe nezizukulwane zakho, okufanele nisigcine: wonke umuntu wesilisa phakathi kwenu kufanele asokwe,
ukuze lokhu kube wuphawu lwesivumelwano phakathi kwami nani.

Ezizukulwaneni zonke umntwana ongumfana phakathi kwenu, osenezinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili ezelwe, kufanele asokwe, ngisho nalabo abazalelwe kwakho abangazalwa nguwe, noma ngabe bathengwe ngemali kowezizwe,
noma ngabe bazalelwe kwakho, noma bathengwe ngemali; mabasokwe. Lolu phawu alushaywe emizimbeni yenu lube yisivumelwano sami saphakade.
Bonke abesilisa abangasokile bayonqunywa, bangahlanganyeli nabantu bakubo, ngokuba basephulile isivumelwano sami.”
UNkulunkulu wabuye wathi ku-Abhrahama: “USarayi umkakho awusezukumbiza ngoSarayi, igama lakhe sekuzokuba nguSara.
Ngizombusisa akuzalele indodana, abe ngunina wezizwe eziningi okuyovela kuzo amakhosi ayobusa izizwe.”

U-Abhrahama wakhothama wathi mbo ngobuso wahleka, wakhuluma yedwa wathi: “Indoda ingayizala kanjani ingane isinekhulu leminyaka na? USara angabe esakwazi ukuzala ingane esehlanganise iminyaka engama-90, na?”
Wathi u-Abhrahama kuNkulunkulu: “Sengathi u-Ishmayeli angaphila phambi kwakho.”
UNkulunkulu wathi: “Akunjalo; ngumkakho uSara ozokuzalela indodana; uyiqambe igama uthi ngu-Isaka. Ngiyosigcina isivumelwano sami nakuye, sibe yisivumelwano saphakade ngisho nasesizukulwaneni sakhe.
Mayelana no-Ishmayeli ngisizwile isicelo sakho, naye ngizombusisa ngimuphe inzalo eningi, nezizukulwane eziningi. Uyakuba nguyise wamakhosi ayi-12, ngimenze abe yisizwe esikhulu.
Kepha isivumelwano sami ngiyosimisa no-Isaka, ozomzalelwa nguSara ngalesi sikhathi, ngonyaka ozayo.”
UNkulunkulu eseqedile ukukhuluma no-Abhrahama, wenyuka, wamshiya.
Ngalolo lusuku u-Abhrahama wabiza u-Ishmayeli nazo zonke izinceku ezazizalelwe kwakhe, nazo zonke izigqila ayezithengile, wabasoka, njengalokhu uNkulunkulu ayemyalile.
U-Abhrahama wayesehlanganise iminyaka engama-99 mhla esokwa.
U-Ishmayeli wayeseqede iminyaka eyi-13 mhla esokwa.
Ngalelo langa kwasokwa u-Abhrahama no-Ishmayeli indodana yakhe,
nabo bonke abendlu yakhe, labo ababezalelwe kwakhe, nezigqila ezazithengwe kwabezizwe.
USimakade wabonakala ku-Abhrahama ngasezihlahleni ezinkulu zemi-okhi eMamre, ezihlalele emnyango wethende lakhe, lishisa bhe.

Kwathi lapho u-Abhrahama ephakamisa amehlo, wabona amadoda amathathu emi buqamama naye. Uthe angawabona, wasuka emnyango wethende lakhe, wathathela ngejubane ewahlangabeza, wafike wakhothama wathi mbo ngobuso.
Wathi: “Nkosi yami, uma uthanda mawungayidluli inceku yakho.
Makulethwe amanzi, nigeze izinyawo, bese niphumula emthunzini.
Lokhu senize naphambukela emzini wenceku yenu, manginitholele isinkwa nimise insika, niphumule, bese niqhubeka nohambo lwenu.” Amphendula athi: “Kulungile.”
U-Abhrahama waphuthuma wangena ethendeni kuSara, wathi kuye: “Sheshisa uthathe imicengezi emithathu uyigcwalise impuphu, uyixove, wenze amaqebelengwane.”
U-Abhrahama wagijima waya emhlanjini, wafike wakhetha ithole elihle elinonophele, walinika inceku, yaphuthuma yalihlaba, yalilungisa.
Waletha izaqheqhe, nobisi, nenyama yethole ayeyilungisile, konke lokho wakubeka phambi kwawo. Ngesikhathi lawo madoda edla, yena wayemi eceleni kwawo phansi kwesihlahla.
Ambuza athi: “Uphi umkakho uSara na?” Wawaphendula wathi: “Usethendeni.”
Enye yalawo madoda yathi: “Ngizobuya noma kanjani ngalesi sikhathi ngonyaka ozayo; umkakho uSara uzobe esenendodana.” USara wakuzwa lokho esemnyango wethende ngemva kuka-Abhrahama.
U-Abhrahama noSara base bebadala, iminyaka yabo isihambile kakhulu, uSara engasakwazi ukuthola abantwana.
USara ekuzwa lokho wahleka usulu, wathi: “Kuzothi sengiguge nginje, nomyeni wami esemdala kangaka, siphinde sithokozisane na?”
USimakade wathi ku-Abhrahama: “Uhlekeleni uSara, ethi: ‘Ngisengamthola ngempela umntwana mina sengiguge nginjena na?’
Ngabe kukhona yini okulukhuni kakhulu okwehlula uSimakade na? Ngesikhathi engisinqumileyo ngonyaka ozayo, ngizobuya ngize lapha; ngizomfica uSara esenendodana.”
USara washaywa wuvalo, wenza izaba wathi: “Angihlekanga.” Kepha iNkosi yathi: “Qha, uhlekile.”
Lawo madoda asukuma ahamba alibhekisa eSodoma, u-Abhrahama wawaphelezela.
USimakade wathi: “Ngimfihlele yini u-Abhrahama engikuhlosile na?
Ngeke ngimfihlele, njengalokhu u-Abhrahama ezokuba yisizwe esikhulu nesinamandla, nezizwe zonke zomhlaba zibusiseke ngaye,
futhi ngimqokile ukuba afundise abantwana bakhe nabendlu yakhe, ukuba bagcine umyalo kaSimakade ngokwenza ukulunga nobulungiswa, ukuze uSimakade akufeze lokho amethembise khona.”
USimakade wamtshela u-Abhrahama wathi: “Isikhalo ngeSodoma neGomora sesisikhulu kakhulu, nezono zabo zimbi kakhulu.
Ngakho-ke ngizokwehlela khona ukuba ngibone ukuthi ngempela benze njengokwesikhalo esesifike kimi yini, uma kungenjalo, ngiyokwazi.”
Lawo madoda awufulathela umuzi ka-Abhrahama, alibangisa eSodoma, kodwa u-Abhrahama wasala emi phambi kukaSimakade.
U-Abhrahama wasondela kuye wathi: “Ngabe uzoqotha imbokodo nesisekelo yini kwabalungileyo nababi na?
Kungenzeka kube khona abalungileyo abangama-50 kulo muzi. Ngabe uzowuqothula wonke umuzi ungawuyeki ngenxa yabalungileyo abangama-50 abakuwo na?
Impela mazingafi ngamvunye, abalungileyo nababi. Makube kude nawe ukwenza into efana naleyo. UMehluleli womhlaba wonke angakwenza kanjani okungalungile na?”
USimakade wathi: “Uma ngithola abangama-50 abalungileyo emzini waseSodoma, ngiyakuyiyeka indawo ngingayibhubhisi ngenxa yabo.”
U-Abhrahama waphendula wathi: “Njengalokhu sengize ngazidela ngakhuluma eNkosini yize ngiwuthuli nomlotha nje,
uma kwenzeka laba abangama-50 abalungileyo behle ngabahlanu, usengawubhubhisa yini wonke umuzi ngenxa yabahlanu ababi na?” USimakade wathi: “Uma ngithola abangama-45 angiyukuwubhubhisa.”
U-Abhrahama waqhubeka wathi: “Mhlawumbe kwenzeke kutholakale abangama-40.” Wathi kuye: “Ngenxa yabangama-40 angiyukuwubhubhisa.”
Wayesethi: “Ngicela iNkosi ingangithukutheleli kengiphawule. Mhlawumbe kwenzeke kutholakale abangama-30.” Yaphendula yathi: “Angiyukuwubhubhisa uma ngithola abangama-30.”
U-Abhrahama wathi: “Njengoba sengizidelile ngakhuluma nawe Nkosi, mhlawumbe kwenzeke kutholakale abangama-20.” Yaphendula yathi: “Ngenxa yabangama-20 angiyukuwubhubhisa.”
Wayesethi: “Ngicela Nkosi ungangicasukeli, ngiphawule okokugcina. Mhlawumbe kwenzeke kutholakale lapho abalishumi.” Yaphendula yathi: “Ngenxa yabalishumi angiyukuwubhubhisa.”
Kwathi ukuba uSimakade aqede ukukhuluma no-Abhrahama, behlukana, u-Abhrahama waphindela ekhaya.
Izingelosi ezimbili zafinyelela eSodoma kusihlwa; uLothi wayehlezi esangweni eSodoma. Uthe angazibona, wasukuma, wazihlangabeza, wathi mbo ngobuso emhlabathini.

Wathi kuzo: “Makhosi ami, ake niphambukele endlini yenceku yenu ukuze nithole amanzi okugeza izinyawo, nilale okwanamuhla, bese nivuka ekuseni niqhubeke nohambo lwenu.” Zamphendula zathi: “Qha, sizohlala emgwaqweni.”
ULothi wazibelesela ezincenga zaze zaphambuka zangena endlini yakhe. Wabe esezilungisela idili, wazenzela namaqebelengwane angenamvubelo; zadla.
Kwathi lapho zingakalali, kwafika bonke abesilisa baseSodoma, abancane nabadala, bazungeza indlu kaLothi.
Bammemeza uLothi bethi: “Akuphi lawa madoda angenise kuleyo ndlu namuhla na? Akhiphele lapha phandle siwalale.”
ULothi wayesephumela phandle, wavala umnyango.
Wathi: “Bakwethu! Musani ukwenza into embi kangaka.
Lalelani lapha, nginamadodakazi amabili aseyizintombi; ngivumeleni ngininikeze wona nizibonele. Inqobo nje uma ningezukuwathinta lawa madoda angenise kwami ngokuba kuyisibopho sami ukuwavikela.”
Bathi: “Suka lapha lesi sifiki! Usuzosishayela imithetho! Sesizohlupha wena-ke kakhulu kunawo.” Ayesemdudula uLothi aze acishe awufohloza umnyango.
Amadoda ayesendlini amdonsela ngaphakathi uLothi, ayesevala umnyango.
Abesilisa abasha nabadala ababengaphandle kwendlu kaLothi bashaywa ngobumpumputhe, bawufuna umnyango baze badikibala.
Amadoda ayesendlini ambuza uLothi athi: “Uhlala nobani kuleli khaya na? Khipha amadodana akho, nabakhwenyana bakwakho, namadodakazi, nabo bonke ohlala nabo niphume kulo muzi.
Isikhalo ngalo muzi sesisikhulu phambi kukaSimakade. Ngalokho usithumile ukuba sizowubhubhisa.”
ULothi waphuma wakhuluma nabakhwenyana bakwakhe, wathi: “Phuthumani niphume niphele kulo muzi, ngokuba uSimakade uzowubhubhisa.” Kepha bekuzwa lokho bakuthatha njengamancoko nje.
Entathakusa, izingelosi zamnxusa uLothi zathi: “Lo muzi uzobhujiswa ngenxa yobubi bawo, ngalokho wena phangisa uvuke, uthathe umkakho namadodakazi akho womabili, funa ubhujiswe nawo.”
Esabamba eyeka, amadoda amxhakathisa ngesandla, yena, nomkakhe, namadodakazi akhe womabili, abakhiphela ngaphandle komuzi, ngokuba uSimakade ngomusa wakhe wayefuna ukubaphephisa.

Anele abakhipha nje, enye yamadoda yathi kuye: “Yithi galo yephuka uphephise impilo yakho. Ungajeqezi emuva futhi ungami ngisho ethafeni. Phikelela ezintabeni, ngokuba ungase uficwe ngamathonsi abanzi.”
ULothi wathi kuwo: “Yobe, makhosi ami,
ningenzele uzwelo nangiphatha ngomusa nangiphephisa. Kodwa angikwazi ukubalekela ezintabeni, funa ngehlelwe yinhlekelele, ngibhubhe.
Nankuya umuzi omncane oseduze, futhi mncane, ngingabalekela kuwo, ngiphephe.”
Yathi: “Kulungile, ngiyakuzwela kulokho, angisezukuwubhubhisa lo muzi owushoyo.
Kepha phangisa ubalekele kuwo, ngoba akukho engingakwenza ungakafiki kuwo.” Yingakho lowo muzi ubizwa ngokuthi yiZowari.
Kwathi eqambe efika eZowari uLothi, kwase kuse gelekeqe.
USimakade wehlisela ikloba lomlilo wesibabule njengemvula phezu kweSodoma neGomora, livela ezulwini.
USimakade wayibhubhisa kanjalo-ke leyo mizi nesifunda sonke, nabo bonke ababakhe kuyo, nokumile emhlabathini.
Kwathi besabaleka, umkaLothi wajeqeza emuva, wayesephenduka insika kasawoti.
U-Abhrahama wavuka kusempondozankomo waphindela endaweni lapho ayekade emi khona phambi kukaSimakade.
Kwathi lapho ethi uphonsa amehlo ezansi eSodoma naseGomora ebuka lonke izwe lamathafa, wabona isikhatha sentuthu senyuka sifana nentuthu yesithando somlilo.
Ngesikhathi uNkulunkulu ebhubhisa imizi eyayisethafeni wamkhumbula u-Abhrahama, wangambhubhisa uLothi naleyo mizi ayekade ehlala kuyo.
ULothi wasuka eZowari wakhuphukela entabeni, wahlala khona namadodakazi akhe amabili, ngokuba babesaba ukuhlala eZowari, ngakho-ke wahlala emgedeni namadodakazi akhe amabili.
Langa limbe indodakazi endala kaLothi yathi kwencane: “Ezweni lonke abantu bayaganana, kodwa lapha akukho ndoda esingayigana kanti nobaba usegugile.
Woza simgcince ngewayini adakwe, bese silala naye ukuze silondoloze uzalo lwakithi, siluphembe ngaye.”
Ngalobo busuku amgcinca ngewayini uyise, kwangena endala yalala naye, kodwa uLothi akezwanga lutho; akayizwanga ilala nalapho isivuka.
Ngakusasa indodakazi endala yathi kwencane: “Ngilalile nobaba izolo. Asimphuzise iwayini nanamhlanje bese wena ungena ulale naye, siphembe uzalo ngaye.”
Nangalobo busuku abuye amgcinca ngewayini uyise, kwase kungena indodakazi encane yalala naye, nalapho uLothi akezwanga lutho; akayizwanga ilala nalapho isivuka.
ULothi wawakhulelisa omabili amadodakazi akhe.
Indodakazi endala yazala umfana yamqamba yathi nguMowabi. Nguyena ongukhokho wesizwe sakwaMowabi nanamhlanje.
Indodakazi encane yazala nayo umfana yamqamba yathi nguBheni-Ami. Ungukhokho wesizwe sabakwa-Amoni nanamhlanje.
U-Abhrahama wayesesuka lapho ayekade egobe khona amadlangala, waya esifundeni esiseningizimu, wahlala phakathi kweKadeshi neShuri. Wahlala ngasemzini waseGerari engumfokazi.
U-Abhrahama wathi ngomkakhe uSara: “Ungudadewethu.” U-Abhimeleki, inkosi yaseGerari, wathumela ukuba alandwe uSara, ukuze azithathele yena.
UNkulunkulu wafika ebusuku ngephupho ku-Abhimeleki, wathi: “Uyabona, uzokufa ngenxa yalo wesifazane omthathile; ungumkamuntu.”
U-Abhimeleki wayengakalali noSara. Wayesethi: “Nkosi, impela uzobulala abantu abangenacala na?
Akashongo yini kimi wathi: ‘Ungudadewethu’ na? Naye luqobo uthe: ‘Ungumfowethu.’ Mina-ke ngikwenze lokhu ngenhliziyo emsulwa nangezandla ezingenacala.”
UNkulunkulu waqhubeka ephusheni, wathi kuye: “Nami impela ngiyakwazi ukuthi lokho okwenzile ukwenze ngenhliziyo emsulwa. Yingakho ngingakuvumelanga ukuba umthinte, ngakuthiya ukuze ungoni kimi.
Manje-ke lo mkamuntu mbuyisele endodeni yakhe, ngoba ingumphrofethi. Yona izokushwelezela uphile. Uma kodwa ungamphindiseli, yazi kahle ukuthi uzokufa nokufa, wena, nabo bonke abendlu yakho.”
U-Abhimeleki wavuka kusempondozankomo wabiza zonke izikhulu zakhe, wazilandisa ngalolo daba, zangenwa ngamanzi emadolweni.
U-Abhimeleki wabiza u-Abhrahama wathi: “Ukwenzeleni lokhu kithi, mina nombuso wami sikone ngani uze usethwese icala elingaka na? Wenze kithi okungafanele ukwenze.”
U-Abhimeleki wambuza u-Abhrahama wathi: “Iyini inhloso yakho ngokwenza le nto na?”
U-Abhrahama waziphendulela wathi: “Kufike kimi umcabango wokuthi uNkulunkulu akesatshwa kule ndawo, ngizobulawa ngifele umkami.
Kanti-ke nangaphezu kwalokho ungudadewethu okwangempela, sizalwa ndodanye, sehlukene ngomama, nokho-ke ngamenza umkami.
Kwathi lapho uNkulunkulu engikhipha kwabakithi ngathi kumkami: ‘Uyobe ukhombise ukuthembeka uma noma kuphi lapho sifika khona ubatshela ukuthi ngingumfowenu.’ ”
U-Abhimeleki wamnika u-Abhrahama izimvu, izinkomo nezigqila zesilisa nezesifazane, wambuyisela nomkakhe uSara.
U-Abhimeleki wayesethi: “Nanti izwe phambi kwakho, ungakha nomaphi lapho uthanda khona.”
Esebhekise kuSara wathi: “Bheka, umfowenu ngimnike izinhlamvu zesiliva eziyinkulungwane, eziyinhlawulo engishweleza ngazo ngesiphosiso asenze phambi kwabo bonke ohamba nabo, wena awunacala.”
U-Abhrahama wakhuleka kuNkulunkulu. UNkulunkulu wamelapha u-Abhimeleki, umkakhe nezigqila, wabuye wabavula izibeletho,
ngoba uSimakade wayekade ebavale izibeletho bonke abendlu ka-Abhimeleki ngenxa kaSara umka-Abhrahama.
USimakade wamhambela uSara njengoba ayekade eshilo, wamenzela lokho ayemethembise khona.
USara wakhulelwa, wamzalela u-Abhrahama indodana esemdala, ngesikhathi uNkulunkulu ayekhulume naye ngaso.
U-Abhrahama wayiqamba indodana ayizalelwe nguSara ngokuthi ngu-Isaka.
U-Abhrahama wamsoka u-Isaka esenezinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili ezelwe njengoba uNkulunkulu ayemyalile.
U-Abhrahama wayeseneminyaka eyikhulu ngesikhathi kuzalwa u-Isaka indodana yakhe.
USara wathi: “UNkulunkulu ungijabulisile ngahleka, bonke abakuzwayo lokhu bazojabula kanye nami.”
Waqhubeka wathi: “Ngubani owayengase athi ku-Abhrahama: ‘USara usengancelisa abantwana na?’ Kodwa nokho ngimzalele umntwana esemdala.”
Umntwana wakhula, walunyulwa ebeleni; u-Abhrahama wenza idili elikhulu mhla u-Isaka elunyulwa.
USara ebona ukuthi indodana ezalwa nguHagari umGibhithe, ayizalela u-Abhrahama, ihlekisa ngo-Isaka,
wathi ku-Abhrahama: “Xosha lesi sigqila nendodana yaso, ngokuba indodana yesigqila ngeke idle ifa nendodana yami u-Isaka.”
Lokhu kwamkhathaza u-Abhrahama ngenxa yendodana yakhe u-Ishmayeli.
UNkulunkulu wathi ku-Abhrahama: “Ungakhathazeki kangaka ngomfana nesigqila sakho. Lalela konke akushoyo uSara, ngokuba uzalo luka-Isaka oluyobizwa ngawe.
Kepha nozalo lwendodana yesigqila ngiyolwenza lube yisizwe esikhulu, ngoba nalo luyinzalo yakho.”
U-Abhrahama wavuka ngovivi, wathatha isinkwa nemvaba yamanzi wakunika uHagari, wayesemethwesa khona ehlombe, wamkhomba indlela benomfana. Owesifazane wazulazula ehlane eBheri Sheba.
Kwathi sekuphele amanzi emvabeni, owesifazane wambeka phansi kwesihlahla umfana.
Wasuka wathi qekelele, wahlala phansi ibanga elingangokuciba umcibisholo, ngokuba wathi: “Mangingakuboni ukufa komfana.” Wahlala phansi phambi kwakhe wadazuluka, wakhala.
UNkulunkulu wakuzwa ukukhala komfana. Ingelosi kaNkulunkulu yammemeza uHagari isezulwini, yathi kuye: “Kwenzenjani Hagari? Ungesabi, ngokuba uNkulunkulu ukuzwile ukukhala komfana, lapho ekhona.
Phakama umthathe umfana, umbambe ngesandla umqinise, ngokuba ngizomenza abe yisizwe esikhulu.”
UNkulunkulu wawavula amehlo akhe, wabona umthombo wamanzi. Waya kuwo wafike wakha amanzi, wagcwalisa imvaba, wamphuzisa umfana.
UNkulunkulu waba naye umfana, wakhula, wahlala ehlane ePharanu, waba yingcweti ngomcibisholo.
Esahlezi ehlane ePharanu, unina wamtholela umfazi eGibhithe.
Ngaleso sikhathi kwasuka u-Abhimeleki noPhikholi umkhuzi wamabutho akhe, wathi ku-Abhrahama: “UNkulunkulu unawe kukho konke okwenzayo.

Ngakho-ke funga phambi kukaNkulunkulu ukuthi ngeke usiphathe ngobuqili, mina nabantwana bami, nezizukulwane zami, kepha njengoba ngethembekile kuwe, nawe yethembeka kimi, nakuleli lizwe ogogobele kulo.”
U-Abhrahama wathi: “Ngiyafunga.”
U-Abhrahama wayesekhononda ku-Abhimeleki ngomthombo wamanzi ayewephucwe yizinceku zakhe.
U-Abhimeleki wathi: “Angazi ukuthi ngubani owenze leyo nto. Ngiyayeshwama nje namuhla, futhi nawe awukaze ungilume indlebe ngayo.”
U-Abhrahama wathatha izimvu nezinkomo wazinika u-Abhimeleki, bobabili base benza isivumelwano.
U-Abhrahama waqembula emhlanjini amawundlu ezinsikazi ayisikhombisa.
U-Abhimeleki wathi ku-Abhrahama: “Uqondeni ngalawa mawundlu ayisikhombisa osuwaqembule emhlanjini na?”
Waphendula wathi: “Yamukela lawa mawundlu ayisikhombisa abe ngubufakazi bokuthi lo mthombo wamanzi wambiwa yimi.”
Leyo ndawo yabizwa ngokuthi yiBheri Sheba, ngokuba bobabili bafunga lapho.
Base benza isivumelwano eBheri Sheba; u-Abhimeleki wasukuma noPhikholi umkhuzi wamabutho akhe baphindela ezweni lamaFilisti.
U-Abhrahama watshala umthamariske eBheri Sheba, wayesekhuleka egameni likaSimakade uNkulunkulu Ophakade.
U-Abhrahama wagogobala izinsuku eziningi ezweni lamaFilisti.
Sezedlule lezo zinto uNkulunkulu wamvivinya u-Abhrahama, wathi kuye: “Abhrahama!” Yena wathi: “Ngilapha.”

UNkulunkulu wathi kuye: “Thatha u-Isaka indodana yakho oyithandayo okungukuphela kwayo, uhambe nayo uye eMoriya, uthi ungafika khona unikele ngayo ibe ngumhlatshelo wokushiswa kwenye yezintaba engizokukhombisa yona.”

U-Abhrahama wavuka ekuseni ngovivi, wabophela imbongolo yakhe, wathatha izinceku zakhe ezimbili, no-Isaka indodana yakhe. Wacanda izinkuni zomhlatshelo wokushiswa, maqede wangena indlela, waya lapho uNkulunkulu emyalele khona.
Ngosuku lwesithathu u-Abhrahama waphakamisa amehlo akhe, wayelamela leyo ndawo ibuqamama.
Wathi ezincekwini zakhe: “Salani lapha nembongolo. Sisaya laphaya. Sizofike sikhuleke bese siyabuya size kini.”
U-Abhrahama wathatha izinkuni zomhlatshelo wokushiswa, wazethwesa u-Isaka, yena waphatha umlilo nommese ngesandla. Base besuka njalo bobabili bahamba.
U-Isaka wathi ku-Abhrahama: “Baba.” Yena wathi: “Ndodana.” Wayesethi: “Nanku umlilo nezinkuni, kodwa liphi iwundlu lomhlatshelo na?”
U-Abhrahama waphendula wathi: “Ndodana, uNkulunkulu uqobo uyakuzibonela iwundlu lomhlatshelo.” Baqhubeka nendlela yabo bobabili.
Sebefike kuleyo ndawo uNkulunkulu ayemtshele ngayo, u-Abhrahama wakha i-althare, wabeka izinkuni phezu kwalo. Wayibopha indodana yakhe u-Isaka, wayibeka phezu kwezinkuni e-althare.
U-Abhrahama welula isandla sakhe, wathatha ummese ukuba abulale indodana yakhe.
Kusenjalo, ingelosi kaSimakade yamemeza isezulwini, yathi: “Abhrahama, Abhrahama!” Wathi: “Ngilapha.”
Yathi: “Ungamthinti umfana, ungamenzi lutho, ngoba manje sengiyazi ukuthi ungumuntu omesabayo uNkulunkulu, ngokuba awungigodlelanga indodana yakho eyodwa.”
U-Abhrahama waphakamisa amehlo wabona; bheka, nansi inqama emva kwakhe ibhajwe ngezimpondo ehlozini. Wayithatha inqama wenza ngayo umhlatshelo wokushiswa esikhundleni sendodana yakhe.
U-Abhrahama wabiza igama laleyo ndawo ngokuthi: “KukwaSimakade uyabonelela,” njengoba kushiwo nanamuhla kuthiwa: “Entabeni kaSimakade kuyabonelelwa.”
Ingelosi kaSimakade yaphinda yambiza u-Abhrahama ngokwesibili isezulwini, yathi:
“Ngizifunge Mina, kusho uSimakade: ‘Ngenxa yokuba wenze lokhu, ungayigodlanga indodana yakho eyodwa,
ngizokubusisa impela, ngiyokwenza izizukulwane zakho zibe ziningi njengezinkanyezi esibhakabhakeni, nanjengesihlabathi ogwini lolwandle. Izizukulwane zakho ziyakunqoba izitha zazo, zidle nemizi yazo,
futhi zonke izizwe zomhlaba ziyakubusiswa ngezizukulwane zakho, ngokuba ulilalelile izwi lami.’ ”
U-Abhrahama waphindela ezincekwini zakhe, base besuka bephindela eBheri Sheba; u-Abhrahama wakha khona.
Emveni kwaleso sehlakalo u-Abhrahama wabikelwa ukuthi: “UMilkha uzalele umfowenu uNahori abantwana:
u-Uzi izibulo, uBhuzi umfowabo, uKhemuweli, uyise ka-Aramu,
uKhesedi, uHazo, uPhildashi, uJidilafu, noBhethuweli.”
UBhethuweli wayenguyise kaRibheka. Laba abayisishiyagalombili uMilkha wabazalela uNahori umfowabo ka-Abhrahama.
Nesancinza sakhe esigama laso kunguRehuma samzalela amadodana uTebha, uGahamu, uTahashi, noMahakha.
USara waphila iyiminyaka eyi-127.
Wafela emzini waseKhiriyathi Arbha, okusho ukuthi eHebhroni eKhanani. U-Abhrahama wangena, walila ngoSara.
U-Abhrahama wasuka eduze kwesidumbu somkakhe, wakhuluma namaHithi, wathi:
“Ngingowezizwe nomfokazi phakathi kwenu. Ngisikeleni indawo yokungcwaba ukuze ngifihle ithambo lomkami.”
AmaHithi amphendula u-Abhrahama, athi:
“Silalele nkosi yami. Wena ungowasebukhosini bukaNkulunkulu phakathi kwethu. Akekho phakathi kwethu ongenqaba nendawo yokungcwaba umkakho.”
U-Abhrahama wasukuma, wayesekhothamela amaHithi, abantu balelo lizwe.
Wathi kubo: “Uma ningivumela ukuba ngingcwabe ithambo lomkami, ngicela ningikhulumele no-Efroni indodana kaZohari
ukuba anginike umgede wakhe waseMakhaphela, osemngceleni wensimu yakhe. Makanginike le ndawo phambi kwenu, bese ngimkhokhela intengo yayo ephelele, ukuze ibe ngeyami yokungcwaba.”
U-Efroni wayehlezi phakathi kwamanye amaHithi. U-Efroni umHithi wamphendula u-Abhrahama kuzwa wonke amaHithi ayelapho esangweni lomuzi, wathi:
“Qha, nkosi yami, ngicela ungizwe kahle. Ngiyakunika le nsimu, futhi ngiyakunika nomgede okuyo. Ngikunika yona phambi kwabantu bakithi, mngcwabe umkakho kuyo.”
U-Abhrahama wayesekhothama phambi kwabantu balelo lizwe.

Wathi ku-Efroni bezwa bonke abantu balelo lizwe: “Ngilalele, ungizwe kahle mfowethu. Ngizokukhokhela yonke imali oyibizayo ngale nsimu. Vuma ukuba ngenze njalo, ukuze ngikwazi ukungcwaba umkami lapho.”
U-Efroni wamphendula u-Abhrahama, wathi:
“Mnumzane, ngilalele, lesi siqinti somhlaba singabiza amashekeli esiliva angama-400, bekuyini khona lokho phakathi kwami nawe na? Ngcwaba umkakho kuso.”

U-Abhrahama wavumelana no-Efroni, wayesembalela inani ayelibalulile phambi kwamaHithi, ngesisindo salo amashekeli ezinhlamvu zesiliva ezingama-400 ngokwezilinganiso ezazisetshenziswa ngabahwebi baleso sikhathi.
Ngakho-ke insimu ka-Efroni eseMakhaphela, eyayisempumalanga neMamre, insimu nomgede owawukuyo, nezihlahla zonke ezazingaphakathi komngcele wayo.
Konke lokho kwadluliselwa ku-Abhrahama, kwaba yimpahla yakhe phambi kwamaHithi ayelapho esangweni lomuzi.
U-Abhrahama wamngcwaba umkakhe uSara emgedeni osensimini eseMakhaphela ebhekene neMamre okuyiHebhroni eKhanani.
Insimu nomgede u-Abhrahama akunikwa ngamaHithi kwaguquka kwaba yindawo yakhe yokungcwaba.
U-Abhrahama wayesemdala, neminyaka yakhe isiminingi kakhulu. USimakade wayembusisile u-Abhrahama ezintweni zonke.
U-Abhrahama watshela inceku yakhe eyase ikhulile, futhi yengamele indlu yakhe, nakho konke ayenakho, wathi: “Faka isandla sakho phansi kwethanga lami.
Ngizakukufungisa phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wezulu nomhlaba, ukuthi ngeke uyithathele indodana yami umfazi emadodakazini amaKhanani, esihlala phakathi kwawo.
Kepha uyokuya kwelakithi ezihlotsheni zami, ufike uyithathele khona umfazi indodana yami u-Isaka.”
Inceku yathi kuye: “Mhlawumbe lowo wesifazane angathandi ukubuya nami eze lapha kuleli lizwe. Uma kunjalo-ke, indodana yakho ngiyithathe yini ngiyiyise ezweni owavela kulo na?”
U-Abhrahama wathi kuyo: “Uze ungalokothi ubuyisele indodana yami lapho.

USimakade uNkulunkulu wezulu owangikhipha endlini kababa nakwelakithi lengabade, wakhuluma kimi, wangethembisa ngesifungo, wathi: ‘Leli lizwe ngiyolinika isizukulwane sakho.’ Uyothumela ingelosi yakhe ikuhole, okwakho ukuyotholela indodana yami umfazi lapho.
Uma owesifazane lowo engathandi ukubuya nawe, uyobe ukhululekile kulesi sifungo engikufungise sona. Inqobo nje uma ungayibuyiselanga lapho indodana yami.”
Ngakho-ke inceku yafaka isandla sayo phansi kwethanga lika-Abhrahama umniniyo, yafunga yagomela ngalolo daba.
Inceku yathatha amakameli ayishumi omniniyo, yahamba iphethe izimpahla ezinhle ezinhlobonhlobo ezivela kumnumzane. Yalibangisa e-Aramu Naharayimu, emzini okwakwakhe kuwo uNahori.
Yawaguqisa amakameli ngaphandle komuzi ngasemthonjeni wamanzi, kwaze kwaba kusihlwa ngesikhathi okuphuma ngaso abesifazane ukuyokukha amanzi.
Yayisithandaza, ithi: “Simakade, Nkulunkulu wenkosi yami u-Abhrahama. Ngicela ukuba ungiphe impumelelo namhlanje, uyenzele isihawu inkosi yami u-Abhrahama.
Ngimi lapha ngasemthonjeni, izintombi zendawo ziyeza zizokukha amanzi.

Sengathi intombi engiyokuthi kuyo: ‘Ngicela uke uyethule imbiza yakho, ungiphuzise,’ iphendule ithi: ‘Phuza, futhi ngizowaphuzisa namakameli akho,’ kungaba yileyo oyimisele inceku yakho u-Isaka. Ngalokho ngiyoqiniseka ukuthi uyenzele isihawu inkosi yami.”
Ithe ingakaqedi ukuthandaza, kwafika uRibheka etshethe imbiza, wayezalwa nguBhethuweli indodana kaMilkha, umkaNahori, umfowabo ka-Abhrahama.
Wayenguzime, isiphalaphala sentombi eyayingakaze ithintwe yindoda. Wehlela emthonjeni, wagcwalisa imbiza, wayesekhuphuka.
Inceku yagijima yamhlangabeza, yathi kuye: “Ngicela ungiphuzise ithamo lamanzi embizeni yakho.”
Wayesethi: “Phuza nkosi yami.” Wayethula imbiza, wayinika inceku ukuze iphuze.
Eseyiphuzisile, wathi: “Namakameli akho nawo ngizowaphuzisa aze adele.”
Wathulula imbiza masinyane, wagijima ephindelela ethutha amanzi emthonjeni ewathela emkhombeni, aze adela wonke amakameli.
Indoda yayimile, ithule, imgqolozele, ifuna ukuqiniseka ukuthi ngabe uSimakade ulwenze uhambo lwayo lwaba yimpumelelo yini na?
Lapho amakameli eseqedile ukuphuza, inceku yathatha icici legolide lasekhaleni, elisisindo salo kuyingxenye yeshekeli, namasongo amabili asezingalweni, asisindo sawo singamashekeli ayishumi egolide,
yathi: “Ngitshele ukuthi uyindodakazi kabani na? Ikhona yini indawo endlini kayihlo engingaphumula kuyo kulobu busuku na?”
Waphendula wathi kuyo: “Ngiyindodakazi kaBhethuweli, indodana kaMilkha, ayizalela uNahori.”
Waqhubeka wathi: “Sinotshani nefolishi eliningi ekhaya, nendawo yokulala.”
Indoda yakhothama yamdumisa uSimakade uNkulunkulu,

yathi: “Makabongwe uSimakade, uNkulunkulu wenkosi yami u-Abhrahama, ongayekanga ukukhombisa umusa nokwethembeka kwakhe enkosini yami. Nami uSimakade ungiholile endleleni ngaze ngafinyelela emzini wesihlobo senkosi yami.”
URibheka wagijima wayotshela abendlu kanina ngalezo zinto.
URibheka wayenomfowabo ogama lakhe kunguLabani; uLabani wagijima waya kuleyo ndoda eyayisemthonjeni.

Kwathi ukuba abone indandatho ekhaleni, namasongo ezingalweni zikadadewabo, futhi esekuzwile okushiwo ngudadewabo uRibheka, ethi: “Ikhulume kanjalo indoda kimi,” waya kuleyo ndoda eyayimi eduze kwamakameli ngasemthonjeni.
Wathi kuyo: “Woza ungene, wena obusisekile kaSimakade. Usameleni ngaphandle lokhu sengikulungisele indlu nendawo yamakameli akho na?”
Ngakho-ke indoda yangena endlini, uLabani wawethula imithwalo amakameli, wayesewaphakela utshani nefolishi. Indoda namadoda ayeyiphelezela babanika amanzi okugeza izinyawo.
Base beyilethela okuya ngasethunjini, kodwa yathi: “Angizukudla ngize nginilandise indaba yami.” Wathi uLabani: “Silandise.”
Ngakho-ke yathi: “Ngiyinceku ka-Abhrahama.
USimakade uyibusisile kakhulu inkosi yami, iyisigwili. Uyiphe izimvu, izinkomo, isiliva, igolide, izinceku, nezincekukazi, amakameli nezimbongolo.
USara inkosikazi yenkosi yami yamzalela indlalifa esemdala, futhi uyinike konke anakho.
Inkosi yami yangifungisa yathi: ‘Uze ungayithatheli indodana yami umfazi ezintombini zamaKhanani engiphila ezweni lawo,
kodwa yana kwelakithi ezihlotsheni zami, uyithathele khona umfazi, indodana yami.’
“Ngathi enkosini yami: ‘Mhlawumbe lowo wesifazane ngeke athande ukubuya nami.’
“Yathi: ‘USimakade engiphila phambi kwakhe, uyothumela ingelosi yakhe ikuhole, enze indlela yakho ibe yimpumelelo. Wena uzakutholela indodana yami umfazi kwelakithi nasezihlotsheni zami.
Uma ufika ezihlotsheni zami bese ziyenqaba ukukuganisela, uyobe usukhululekile esifungweni engikufungise sona.’
“Ngifike namuhla emthonjeni, ngase ngithi: ‘Nkosi, Nkulunkulu wenkosi yami u-Abhrahama, yenza manje ukuba uhambo lwami lube yimpumelelo.
Ngimi lapha ngasemthonjeni, sengathi intombi efika ukuzokha amanzi engiyakuthi kuyo: “Ake ungiphuzise ithamo lamanzi embizeni yakho,”
bese ithi: “Phuza, futhi ngizokukha amanzi ngiwaphuzise namakameli akho,” kungaba yileyo ntombi uSimakade ayimisele indodana yenkosi yami.’
Ngingakaqedi ukuthandaza ngizindla enhliziyweni yami, kwathi memfu uRibheka etshethe imbiza, wehlela emthonjeni, wakha amanzi. Ngathi kuye: ‘Ngicela ungiphuzise.’
“Wayethula imbiza ngokushesha, wathi: ‘Phuza; ngizakuwaphuzisa namakameli akho.’ Ngase ngiphuza-ke; wawaphuzisa amakameli.
Ngambuza ngathi: ‘Uyindodakazi kabani na?’ “Wathi: ‘Ngiyindodakazi kaBhethuweli ozalwa nguNahori kuMilkha.’ “Ngakho-ke ngamfaka icici ekhaleni namabhengele ezihlakaleni zakhe.

Ngakhothama, ngamdumisa uSimakade, ngimbonga uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenkosi yami u-Abhrahama, ongiholile endleleni okuyiyona ngaze ngathola indodakazi yezihlobo zenkosi yami, ukuba ibe ngumfazi wendodana yayo.
Manje-ke ngicaciseleni ukuthi nizoyiphatha ngokwethembeka nangeqiniso yini inkosi yami, uma kungenjalo ngitsheleni, ukuze ngazi ukuthi ngenzenjani.”
ULabani noBhethuweli baphendula, bathi: “Le ndaba ivela kuSimakade, ngeke thina sakwazi ukusho noma yini.
Bheka, nangu uRibheka phambi kwakho. Mthathe uhambe naye, abe ngumfazi wendodana yenkosi yakho, njengoba ekhulumile uSimakade.”
Yathi ukuba inceku ka-Abhrahama iwezwe amazwi abo, yakhothama phambi kukaSimakade ubuso bayo buthinta emhlabathini.
Inceku yakhipha izipho eziwubucwebecwebe zesiliva, negolide, nezembatho, yamnika uRibheka, yanika futhi umfowabo nonina izipho eziyigugu.
Emveni kwalokho inceku nalabo eyayihamba nabo, badla, baphuza, base belala. Sebevukile ekuseni, inceku yathi: “Ngicela indlela ukuze ngiphindele enkosini yami.”
Umnewabo nonina bathi: “Ake uyivumele intombazane ihlale nathi okwesikhashana, okungenani izinsuku eziyishumi, bese niyahamba.”
Yathi kubo: “Ningangibambezeli, njengoba uSimakade eluphumelelisile uhambo lwami, ngivumeleni ngihambe ngiphindele enkosini yami.”
Base bethi: “Sizoyibiza intombazane sizwe ukuthi ithini.”
Bambiza uRibheka bathi kuye: “Uzohamba yini nalo muntu na?” Wathi: “Ngizohamba.”
Ngakho-ke bamvumela udadewabo uRibheka, nempelesi yakhe, bahamba nenceku ka-Abhrahama, nabantu bayo.
Bambusisa uRibheka bathi: “Dadewethu, sengathi ungakhula ube ngukhokho wezizukulwane eziyizinkulungwane zezigidi, izizukulwane zakho zinqobe amasango ezitha zazo.”
URibheka ekhashwa yizimpelesi zakhe basukuma, bagibela amakameli, balandela inceku. Inceku yamthatha kanjalo uRibheka, yabamba indlela.
U-Isaka wabuya ngaseBheri Lahayi Royi, ngokuba wayehlala ezweni eliseNingizimu.
Sekuhwalala u-Isaka waphuma wazulazula ensimini yakhe ezindla. Kuthe lapho ephakamisa amehlo, wabona amakameli eza.
URibheka waphakamisa amehlo, kwathi lapho embona u-Isaka, wehla ngokushesha ekamelini.
Wathi encekwini: “Ngubani lo muntu ohamba laphaya ensimini ozosihlangabeza na?” Inceku yathi: “Yinkosi yami.” URibheka wathatha imvakazi, wazemboza ngayo.
Inceku yamlandisa u-Isaka ngakho konke ekwenzileyo.
U-Isaka wamngenisa uRibheka ethendeni likanina uSara. Wamthatha uRibheka waba ngumkakhe, wamthanda, waduduzeka selokhu kwabhubha unina.
U-Abhrahama wabuye wathatha enye inkosikazi okuthiwa nguKethura.
Yamzalela uZimrani, uJokishani, uMedani, uMidiyani, u-Ishibhaki, noShuwa.
UJokishani wayenguyise kaShebha noDedani. Amadodana kaDedani kwakungama-Ashuri, amaLethushi, namaLewumi.
Amadodana kaMidiyani: kwakungu-Efa, u-Eferi, uHanokhi, u-Abhida, no-Elda. Bonke laba babeyizizukulwane zikaKethura.
U-Abhrahama walabela u-Isaka lonke ifa lakhe,
kodwa amadodana ezancinza zakhe, u-Abhrahama wawanika izipho esaphila, wayeseyawaqhelisa endodaneni yakhe u-Isaka, aya ngasempumalanga, empumalanga.
Isiyonke iminyaka eyaphilwa ngu-Abhrahama yayiyi-175.
U-Abhrahama wafa esemdala kakhulu, egculisekile yiminyaka ayiphilile, wangcwatshwa koyisemkhulu.
Amadodana akhe u-Isaka no-Ishmayeli bamngcwaba emgedeni eMakhaphela osensimini ka-Efroni indodana kaZowari umHithi, empumalanga neMamre,
insimu u-Abhrahama ayeyithenge kumaHithi. U-Abhrahama wangcwatshwa lapho kwathunwa khona umkakhe uSara.
Esefile u-Abhrahama, uNkulunkulu wayibusisa indodana yakhe u-Isaka. U-Isaka wakha e-Ebheri Lahayi Royi.
Nazi izizukulwane zika-Ishmayeli indodana ka-Abhrahama, ayizalelwa yisigqila sikaSara, uHagari umGibhithe.
Lawa ngamagama amadodana ka-Ishmayeli ngokwelamana kwawo: izibulo kwakunguNebhayothi, kulandele uKheda, u-Adibhiyeli, uMibhisamu,
uMishima, uDuma, uMasa,
uHadadi, uThema, uJethuri, uNaphishi, noKedema.
Yilawo-ke amagama amadodana ka-Ishmayeli ngokwakha kwawo emizaneni yawo, nangokuma kwawo enkanjini, ayizinhloko zezizwana ezilishumi nambili.
Isiyonke iminyaka yokuphila kuka-Ishmayeli yayiyi-137. Wafa, wangcwatshwa koyisemkhulu.
Izizukulwane zakhe zakha kusukela eHavila kuyoshaya eShuri, eduze nomngcele eGibhithe uma ulibhekise e-Ashuri. U-Ishmayeli wayengumdlwembe phakathi kwabafowabo, ehlala ebachukuluza.
Nanku umlando ka-Isaka indodana ka-Abhrahama: u-Abhrahama wazala u-Isaka.
U-Isaka wayeseneminyaka engama-40 ngesikhathi eganwa nguRibheka indodakazi kaBhethuweli umAramu wasePhadani Aramu; wayengudadewabo kaLabani umAramu.
U-Isaka wamkhulekela kuSimakade uRibheka umkakhe, ngokuba wayengabatholi abantwana, iNkosi yawuzwa umkhuleko wakhe, uRibheka wakhulelwa.
Abantwana babeqhubukushana ngaphakathi kuye, waze wathi: “Uma kuzoba nje, pho ngisaphilelani na?” Wayeseyobuza kuSimakade.
USimakade wathi kuye: “Esibelethweni sakho kukhona izizwe ezimbili; izinhlobo ezimbili zabantu ozozizala. Ziyakwehlukana ezibilini zakho; esinye isizwe siyakwehlula esinye, omkhulu akhonze omncane.”
Kwathi sesifikile isikhathi sokubeletha, wazibula ngamawele.
Owabona ilanga kuqala wayenomzimba ompofu ngebala, ephuphuzela uboya bunjengobesiphuku, lona wamqamba igama wathi ngu-Esawu.
Emva kwakhe kwazalwa umfowabo owaphuma ebambelele esithendeni sika-Esawu, wamqamba igama wathi nguJakobe. U-Isaka wayeneminyaka engama-60 ngesikhathi kuzalwa laba bafana.
Bakhula abafana, u-Esawu waba yiphisi, ekhonze ukuhlala endle; uJakobe wayengumuntu othule engumnqolo, ehlala emathendeni.
U-Isaka wayemthanda kakhulu u-Esawu, ngokuba wayeyithanda inyama yenyamazane, kanti uJakobe wayethandwa kakhulu ngunina uRibheka.
Langa limbe uJakobe epheke isilovela samalentili, kwafika u-Esawu evela endle, eyetha yindlala.
U-Esawu wathi kuJakobe: “Ake ungiphe kuleso silovela sakho esibomvu, ngafa yindlala.” Kungakho kuthiwa ungu-Edomi.
UJakobe wathi: “Ngithengisele kuqala ilungelo lobuzibulo bakho.”
U-Esawu wathi: “Ngiyafa yiphango. Linamsebenzi muni ilungelo lobuzibulo bami kimi na?”
UJakobe wathi: “Funga kuqala.” Wayesefunga-ke. U-Esawu wadayisa kanjalo-ke ngelungelo lobuzibulo bakhe kuJakobe.
UJakobe wayesemupha isinkwa nesilovela samalentili. U-Esawu wadla, waphuza, wahamba. U-Esawu walidela kanjalo ilungelo lobuzibulo bakhe.
Kwaba khona enye indlala ezweni ngaphandle kwaleyo eyayike yaba khona emihleni ka-Abhrahama. U-Isaka wathutha waya eGerari enkosini yamaFilisti u-Abhimeleki.
USimakade wabonakala ku-Isaka, wathi: “Ungehleli eGibhithe. Hlala kuleli lizwe engizokukhombisa lona.
Hlala kuleli lizwe njengomfokazi, Mina ngizoba nawe ngikubusise. Wonke lawa mazwe ngizokunika wona, wena nezizukulwane zakho, futhi ngisifeze isifungo engasenza ku-Abhrahama uyihlo.
Ngiyakusandisa isizukulwane sakho sibe siningi ngangezinkanyezi esibhakabhakeni, ngisinike wonke lawa mazwe, nezizwe zonke zomhlaba ziyobusiswa ngenxa yesizukulwane sakho,
ngoba u-Abhrahama walilalela izwi lami, wagcina imiyalo yami, imithetho, izimiso, neziyalo zami.”
U-Isaka wahlala eGerari.

Kwathi lapho amadoda akuleyo ndawo embuza ngomkakhe, wathi kuwo: “Ungudadewethu,” ngokuba wayengafuni ukulikhipha ngembaba elokuthi ngumkakhe, esaba ukuthi amadoda endawo azomsoconga ngenxa kaRibheka, kwazise wayemuhle kakhulu.
