U-Isaka esenesikhathi ezinze kuleyo ndawo, u-Abhimeleki, inkosi yamaFilisti, ezibukela nje ngefasitela, wamelamela u-Isaka ewotawota umkakhe uRibheka.
U-Abhimeleki wambiza u-Isaka, wathi: “Bheka, ngumkakho lo. Kungani pho uthe ngudadewenu na?” U-Isaka waphendula wathi: “Yingoba ngangicabanga ukuthi ngingase ngife ngenxa yakhe.”
U-Abhimeleki wathi: “Kuyini lokhu okwenze kithi na? Bekungenzeka omunye wamadoda alale nomkakho, bese sithwala icala.”
U-Abhimeleki wabayala bonke abantu, wathi: “Noma ngubani oyoke athinte lo muntu nomkakhe uyofa nokufa.”
U-Isaka watshala imbewu kulelo lizwe, kwathi ngawo lowo nyaka wavuna isivuno esikhulu kakhulu. USimakade wambusisa,
waceba kakhulu, waba nempumelelo enkulu, waceba wabedlula bonke.
Waba nemfuyo, nemihlambi, nomndeni omkhulu kwaze kwavuka umona ngaye kumaFilisti.
AmaFilisti ayesesuka eyigqiba ngomhlabathi yonke imithombo izinceku zikayise ezaziyimbe emihleni ka-Abhrahama.
U-Abhimeleki wathi ku-Isaka: “Hamba, usuke phakathi kwethu, usunamandla amakhulu kunathi.”
U-Isaka wasuka lapho, wagoba amadlangala esigodini eGerari, wahlala lapho.
U-Isaka wabuye wayimba imithombo eyayikade imbiwe emihleni ka-Abhrahama, wayibiza ngamagama ayeyiqambe wona uyise, ngokuba amaFilisti ayekade eyivalile emva kokufa kuka-Abhrahama.
Kwathi lapho izinceku zika-Isaka zimba esigodini zathola umthombo ogelezayo.
Kwaqubuka umbango phakathi kwabelusi baseGerari nabaka-Isaka, abaseGerari bethi: “Lawa manzi ngawethu.” Wawuqamba lowo mthombo wathi yi-Eseki okunguthi kusembangweni, ngoba bambangisa.
Base bemba omunye umthombo, babuye bababangisa nakulowo, wayesewuqamba ethi yiSithina.
Wasuka wayokumba omunye umthombo; kulowo abambangisanga, ngakho-ke wawuqamba ngokuthi yiRehobhothi, ngokuba wathi: “Manje uSimakade usesinike indawo ebanzi, wasenza sanda ezweni.”
Wasuka lapho wakhuphukela eBheri Sheba.

Ngalobo busuku, uSimakade wabonakala kuye wathi: “NginguNkulunkulu ka-Abhrahama uyihlo. Ungesabi, ngokuba nginawe, ngizakukubusisa, ngenze isizukulwane sakho sibe siningi kakhulu ngenxa ka-Abhrahama inceku yami.”
U-Isaka wayesakha i-althare lapho, wakhuleka egameni leNkosi, wagxumeka ithende lakhe, izinceku zakhe zamba umthombo lapho.
Kwase kufika u-Abhimeleki evela eGerari, ehamba no-Ahuzathi umeluleki wakhe, noPhikholo, umkhuzi wamabutho empi yakhe.
U-Isaka wathi kubo: “Nizofunani lapha kimi, ngoba nina niyangizonda, naze nangidingisa na?”
Bathi: “Kuyasikhanyela ukuthi uSimakade unawe. Yikho sithi: ‘Masenze isifungo phakathi kwethu nawe, kube khona isivumelwano phakathi kwethu,’
ukuze ungasenzakalisi njengoba nathi singazange sikwenzakalise, kodwa sakuphatha kahle, saze sakumukisa phakathi kwethu ngokuthula. Kusobala ukuthi wena ungobusisiweyo weNkosi.”
Wabalungisela indumezulu yedili, badla, baphuza.
Bavuka entathakusa ngakusasa bafungisana. U-Isaka wabaphelekezela behlukana ngokuthula.
Ngalolo lusuku kwafika izinceku zika-Isaka, zambikela ngomthombo ezaziwumbile, zathi: “Sithole amanzi.”
Kusukela lapho lowo mthombo wabizwa ngokuthi iShiba. Yikho nje igama lomuzi oseduze nawo ubizwa ngokuthi yiBheri Sheba kuze kube namuhla.
U-Esawu wakhula waze wahlanganisa iminyaka engama-40. Wayeseganwa nguJudithi, indodakazi kaBheri, umHithi, noBhasematha indodakazi ka-Eloni, umHithi.
Labo malokazana baletha olukhulu usizi emphefumulweni ka-Isaka noRibheka.
Kwathi lapho u-Isaka esegugile, namehlo akhe esefiphele, engasaboni kahle, wabiza indodana yakhe endala, wathi: “Ndodana yami!” Yathi kuye: “Ngilapha.”
U-Isaka wathi: “Sengimdala, futhi angilwazi usuku engizofa ngalo.
Ngakho-ke thatha umcibisholo nomnsalo wakho uye endle, ungizingelele inyamazane,
ubuye ungiphekele isilovela esehla esiphundu, usilethe kimi, ngidle, bese ngikubusisa ngingakafi.”
URibheka wayelalele lapho u-Isaka ekhuluma nendodana yakhe u-Esawu. Ngakho-ke kuthe ukuba aphume u-Esawu ukuyozingela inyamazane,
uRibheka wathi endodaneni yakhe uJakobe: “Ngimzwile uyihlo ethi kumfowenu u-Esawu:
‘Ngilethele inyamazane, ungiphekele isilovela esehla esiphundu, ngidle, bese ngiyakubusisa phambi kukaSimakade ngingakafi.’
Mntanami, lalela amazwi ami, wenze engikuyala ngakho.
Hamba uye emhlanjini, ufike ungithathele amazinyane amabili ekhethelo, ukuze ngiphekele uyihlo isilovela esehla esiphundu, njengoba esithanda,
bese wena usithatha usisa kuye, asidle, akubusise engakafi.”
UJakobe wathi kunina uRibheka: “Bheka, umnewethu u-Esawu uphuphuzela uboya, kanti mina nginesikhumba esibushelelezi.
Mhlawumbe ubaba angase angiphathe ngesandla, bese kuba sengathi ngimenza isilima, ngizilethele isiqalekiso esikhundleni sesibusiso.”
Unina wathi kuye: “Isiqalekiso esibhekiswe kuwe masehlele kimi mntanami. Wena lalela engikushoyo, ungilandele amazinyane lawo.”
Wahamba wawalanda amazinyane, wawaletha kunina, unina wawapheka wenzela uyise isilovela esehla esiphundu, ayesikhonzile.
URibheka wathatha izingubo zakwanokusho zika-Esawu indodana yakhe endala, ayezibeke endlini yakhe, wazigqokisa uJakobe.
Wamfaka izikhumba zamazinyane ezandleni, nasentanyeni yakhe eyayibushelelezi.
Wayesemnika isilovela esehla esiphundu nesinkwa ayesibhakile.
UJakobe wangena kuyise wathi: “Baba!” Uyise wamphendula wathi: “Ngilapha, ungubani wena ndodana na?”
UJakobe wathi kuyise: “Ngingu-Esawu izibulo lakho. Ngenze njengoba ubushilo. Phakama, uhlale, udle nansi inyama yenyamazane ukuze ungibusise.”
U-Isaka wathi endodaneni yakhe: “Kwenzeke kanjani uyithole ngokushesha okungaka ndodana na?” UJakobe wathi: “USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ungiphe impumelelo ngasheshe ngayithola.”
U-Isaka wathi kuJakobe: “Sondela eduzane ukuze ngikuthinte ndodana, ngizenelise ukuthi unguye ngempela u-Esawu noma qha.”
UJakobe wasondela kuyise, wamthinta, wayesethi: “Izwi ngelikaJakobe, kodwa izandla ngezika-Esawu.”
Wahluleka ukwehlukanisa ukuthi lona nguJakobe, ngoba izandla zakhe zaziphuphuzela uboya njengezika-Esawu umnewabo, ngakho-ke wambusisa.
Wathi: “Ngabe uyiyo ngempela indodana yami u-Esawu na?” Wathi: “Nginguye.”
U-Isaka wathi: “Yilethe kimi, ngidle inyama engiyilungiselwe yindodana yami, bese ngikubusisa.” Wayiletha kuye, wadla, wamlethela newayini, wehlisa ngalo.
U-Isaka uyise wathi kuye: “Sondela ungange ndodana.”
Kuthe lapho esondela kuye emanga, u-Isaka wahogela iphunga ezingutsheni zakhe, wayesembusisa. Wathi: “Iphunga lendodana yami lifana nephunga lensimu ebusiswe nguSimakade.
Sengathi uNkulunkulu angakwehlisela amazolo ezulu avundise amasimu akho. Makakuphe inala yamabele neyewayini.
Sengathi abantu bangakukhonza. Izizwe ngezizwe zikukhothamele. Busa phezu kwabafowenu, izizukulwane zikanyoko zikukhothamele. Mabaqalekiswe bonke abakuqalekisayo, babusiswe bonke abakubusisayo.”
Lapho nje eqeda u-Isaka ukubusisa uJakobe, kungakabi sikhathi esingakanani ephumile, kwangena umnewabo u-Esawu evela ekuzingeleni.
Naye wapheka isilovela esehla esiphundu, wasiletha kuyise, wathi kuyise: “Baba, phakama, uhlale udle inyama yenyamazane yendodana yakho, ukuze ungibusise.”
Uyise u-Isaka wathi kuye: “Ungubani wena na?” Wathi: “Ngiyindodana yakho, izibulo lakho u-Esawu.”
U-Isaka wethuka wagedezela, wathi: “Ngubani kanti lona ozingele inyamazane wayiletha kimi, ngayidla ungakafiki, ngambusisa na? Yebo, uyohlala engobusisekileyo impela.”
Lapho u-Esawu ezwa lawo mazwi kayise wadazuluka wakhala kalusizi, wathi kuyise: “Ngibusise nami baba!”
Kepha wathi: “Umfowenu ungene lapha ngobuqili, wathatha isibusiso sakho.”

U-Esawu wathi: “Akubanga yiphutha ukuba aqanjwe ngokuthi nguJakobe, ngokuba sekuze kwaba kabili engiqola. Wangephuca ilungelo lami lobuzibulo. Bheka manje usengithathele nesibusiso sami.” Wayesethi kuyise: “Akusekho ngisho nesisodwa nje isibusiso ongibekele sona na?”

U-Isaka wamphendula u-Esawu, wathi: “Sengimenze waba yinkosi yakho, nganikela abafowabo nodadewabo ukuba babe yizinceku zakhe, futhi ngamabela ukudla newayini. Yini-ke enye engingakwenzela yona ndodana yami na?”
U-Esawu wathi kuyise: “Baba, ubunesibusiso esisodwa na? Ngibusise nami baba!” Wadazuluka wakhala.
Uyise wayesethi kuye: “Uyohlala endaweni ekude nezwe elivundileyo, lapho kungekho mazolo avela phezulu ezulwini.
Uyophila ngenkemba yakho, ube yisikhonzi somfowenu, kodwa lapho usumvukela uyolephula ijoka lakhe entanyeni yakho.”
U-Esawu wamzonda uJakobe ngenxa yesibusiso uyise ambusisa ngaso. Wazindla enhliziyweni yakhe wathi: “Izinsuku zokulilela ubaba zingafika noma yinini. Uma sezedlule ngizombulala umfowethu uJakobe.”
Bambikela uRibheka amazwi ka-Esawu izibulo lakhe ayesongela ngawo umnawakhe uJakobe, ngakho-ke wathi kuye: “Umnewenu usonga ukukubulala ukuze aduduzeke.
Manje-ke ndodana yami ngilalele, baleka njengamanje uye kumfowethu uLabani eHarana,
uhlale lapho isikhashana luze lubohle ulaka kumnewenu.
Aze umnewenu axole, akhohlwe, ngiyobe sengikuthumelela ukuba ubuye lapho. Kungani ngizolahlekelwa yini nobabili ngalusuku lunye na?”
URibheka wayesethi ku-Isaka: “Ngikhathazekile ngempilo yami ngenxa yabesifazane bamaHithi. Uma uJakobe naye engase aganwe ngenye yezintombi zamaHithi akule ndawo, ngiyothi ngisaphilelani na?”
U-Isaka wabiza uJakobe wambusisa wayesemyala, wathi kuye: “Ungalokothi uganwe ngenye yezintombi zamaKhanani.
Hamba uye ePhadani Aramu endlini kaBhethuweli, uyihlomkhulu, ufike khona uzithathele umfazi emadodakazini kaLabani umalume wakho.
Sengathi uNkulunkulu uSomandla angakubusisa, akwandise kakhulu, ukuze kuvele kuwe izizwe eziningi.
Sengathi uNkulunkulu anganika wena, nezizukulwane zakho isibusiso sika-Abhrahama, ukuze ulidle leli lizwe ohlezi kulo manje njengomfokazi; izwe uNkulunkulu alinika u-Abhrahama.”
U-Isaka wamkhulula kanjalo-ke uJakobe, wayesengena indlela elibangisa ePhadani Aramu, kwamalume wakhe uLabani, indodana kaBhethuweli, umAramu, ongumfowabo kaRibheka, unina kaJakobe no-Esawu.

U-Esawu wabona ukuthi u-Isaka umbusisile uJakobe, wayesemthumela ePhadani Aramu ukuba ayothatha khona umfazi, nokuthi ngesikhathi embusisa wamyala wathi kuye: “Ungalokothi uganwe ngenye yezintombi zamaKhanani.”
Wezwa nokuthi uJakobe wamlalela uyise nonina waya ePhadani Aramu.
Kuthe lapho sekumkhanyela u-Esawu ukuthi abesifazane baseKhanani abamgculisi uyise u-Isaka,
u-Esawu waya ku-Ishmayeli, wathatha uMahalathi, indodakazi ka-Ishmayeli, indodana ka-Abhrahama, ongudadewabo kaNebhayothi, wengeza ngaye ebafazini bakhe.
UJakobe wasuka eBheri Sheba walibangisa eHarana.
Kwathi angafika endaweni ethile selishonile ilanga, wahlala lapho lobo busuku. Wathatha elinye lamatshe akuleyo ndawo waqamela kulo, walala.
Waphupha ebona isikhwelo simisiwe sisuka emhlabathini size sifinyelele ezulwini. Izingelosi zikaNkulunkulu zazenyuka zehla kuso.
USimakade wema eduze kwakhe, wathi kuye: “NginguSimakade uNkulunkulu kayihlomkhulu, u-Abhrahama nokayihlo u-Isaka, leli lizwe olele kulo ngiyakulabela wena nezizukulwane zakho.
Izizukulwane zakho ziyoba ngangothuli lomhlaba, uyosabalalela entshonalanga nasempumalanga, enyakatho naseningizimu; izizwe zonke zomhlaba ziyobusiswa ngawe nangezizukulwane zakho.
Yazi ukuthi nginawe; ngizokuvikela noma kuphi lapho uya khona, futhi ngiyokubuyisela kuleli lizwe, ngokuba anginakukushiya ngize ngikwenzele lokho engikwethembise khona.”
UJakobe waphaphama ebuthongweni, wathi: “Nembala uNkulunkulu ukule ndawo, bengingazi.”
Ekhungethwe wuvalo, wathi: “Yeka ukwesabeka kwale ndawo! Akusikho okunye, yindlu kaNkulunkulu, futhi leli yisango lezulu.”
UJakobe wavuka ekuseni, wathatha lelo litshe abeqamele kulo, walimisa laba yinsika, wathela amafutha esihlokweni salo.
Wayiqamba leyo ndawo ngokuthi yiBhethele, kodwa ekuqaleni igama lalowo muzi lalaziwa ngokuthi yiLuzi.
UJakobe wenza isifungo, wathi: “Uma uNkulunkulu ezoba nami, angivikele kulolu hambo lwami, angiphe ukudla nokokwembatha,
ngize ngibuyele emzini kababa ngiphephile, impela uSimakade uzokuba nguNkulunkulu wami,
naleli litshe engilimisileyo laba yinsika liyakuba yindlu kaNkulunkulu, bese kuthi konke ozongipha khona ngikunikele kuwe, kube ngokweshumi.”
UJakobe waqhubeka nohambo lwakhe, waze wayofika ezweni labantu basempumalanga.
Esabheka, wabona umthombo endle nemihlambi emithathu yezimvu ilele eduze kwawo, ngokuba yayiphuziswa kulowo mthombo. Itshe elalisemlonyeni wawo lalilikhulu kakhulu.
Kwakuthi lapho imihlambi isihlangene, abelusi bagingqe itshe emlonyeni womthombo, baphuzise izimvu, bese belibuyisela endaweni yalo, bagibekele ngalo umlomo womthombo.
UJakobe wabuza abelusi wathi: “Bafowethu, niliqhamukisaphi na?” Bamphendula bathi: “EHarana.”
Wathi kubo: “Niyamazi yini uLabani indodana kaNahori na?” Bathi: “Siyamazi.”
Wayesethi kubo: “Ngabe usaphila yini na?” Bathi: “Yebo, usaphila. Nansi indodakazi yakhe uRaheli iza nezimvu.”
Wathi kubo: “Ilanga lisaphakeme. Akukabi yisikhathi sokubuyisa imihlambi, phuzisani izimvu bese niyahamba niyoziklabisa edlelweni.”
Bathi: “Asikwazi ukwenza lokho, ize imihlambi iphelele yonke, kugingqwe itshe emlonyeni womthombo, bese siyaziphuzisa izimvu.”
Esakhuluma nabo uJakobe, kwafika uRaheli nezimvu zikayise, ngokuba nguyena owayezelusa.

Kuthe lapho uJakobe embona uRaheli, indodakazi kaLabani, umzala wakhe, nezimvu zikaLabani umalume wakhe, uJakobe wasondela, wagingqa itshe elisusa emlonyeni womthombo, waphuzisa izimvu zikaLabani umalume wakhe.
UJakobe wamanga uRaheli, wayesedazuluka ekhala kakhulu ngenxa yokujabula.
UJakobe wayesemtshela uRaheli ukuthi uhlobene noyise, ngokuba uyindodana kaRibheka. URaheli wagijima wayobikela uyise.
Lapho uLabani ezwa udaba ngomshana wakhe uJakobe, wagijima wayomhlangabeza, wamgona, wamanga, wabuyela naye emzini wakhe. UJakobe wamlandisa uLabani zonke lezo zinto.
ULabani wayesethi kuye: “Impela uyithambo lami nenyama yami.” UJakobe wahlala naye inyanga yonke.
ULabani wathi kuJakobe: “Uzongisebenzela mahhala yini ngoba uyisihlobo sami na? Ngitshele ukuthi izoba yini inkokhelo yakho na?”
ULabani wayenamadodakazi amabili, igama lenkosazana kwakunguLeya, elikathunjana kunguRaheli.
ULeya wayenamehlo ayebuthakathaka kanti uRaheli wayemuhle ngesimo ebukeka kahle.
UJakobe wamthanda uRaheli, wayesethi kuLabani: “Ngizokukusebenzela iminyaka eyisikhombisa ngoRaheli indodakazi yakho encane.”
ULabani wathi: “Kungcono ukuba ngimnike wena kunokuba ngimnike enye indoda. Hlala nami.”
UJakobe wasebenza iminyaka eyisikhombisa ukuze aganwe nguRaheli, kodwa ngenxa yothando ayemthanda ngalo uRaheli kwaba sengathi iyizinsuku ezimbalwa.
UJakobe wayesethi kuLabani: “Nginike umkami ukuze ngilale naye, ngokuba sesiphelile isikhathi esasivumelene ngaso.”
ULabani wabamema bonke abantu bakuleyo ndawo, wenza idili.
Kepha kusihlwa wathatha indodakazi yakhe uLeya wayiyisa kuJakobe; uJakobe walala nayo.
ULabani wanikela isisebenzi sakhe uZilipha ukuba sibe yisisebenzi sendodakazi yakhe uLeya.
Ekuseni wabona ukuthi ubelele noLeya. UJakobe waya kuLabani wathi kuye: “Yini lena oyenze kimi na? Angikusebenzelanga yini ukuze ngithole uRaheli na? Ungikhohliseleni na?”
ULabani wathi: “Akwenziwa lokho kuleli lizwe ukuba kuganiswe omncane engakagani omdala.
Qeda iviki lalona bese sikunika omunye naye ozomsebenzela kimi eminye iminyaka eyisikhombisa.”
UJakobe wenza kanjalo, waqeda iviki enoLeya, uLabani wayesemnika uRaheli, indodakazi yakhe, ukuba abe ngumkakhe.
ULabani wanika uRaheli, indodakazi yakhe, isisebenzi sakhe uBhiliha ukuba sibe ngesakhe.
UJakobe walala noRaheli, wamthanda kakhulu uRaheli ukwedlula uLeya. Wasebenzela uLabani eminye futhi iminyaka eyisikhombisa.
Lapho uSimakade ebona ukuthi uLeya uyisaliwakazi, wamvula isibeletho sakhe, kodwa wasivala esikaRaheli.
ULeya wakhulelwa, wazibula ngendodana, wayiqamba igama wathi nguRubeni, ngokuba wathi: “Kungoba uSimakade ulubonile usizi lwami. Impela umyeni wami usezongithanda manje.”
Wakhulelwa, wathola enye indodana, wayiqamba igama wathi nguSimeyoni, ngokuba wathi: “Kungoba uSimakade uzwile ukuthi ngiyisaliwakazi, wayesengipha nalena futhi indodana.”
Wakhulelwa futhi, wathola indodana, wayiqamba igama wathi nguLevi, ngokuba wathi: “Impela manje umyeni wami uzonamathela kimi, ngoba sengimzalele amadodana amathathu.”
Wakhulelwa futhi wathola indodana, wathi: “Manje ngizodumisa uSimakade,” wayiqamba igama wathi nguJuda, wayesema ukuthola abantwana.
URaheli ebona ukuthi akamzalele bantwana uJakobe, waba nomona ngodadewabo, wayesethi kuJakobe: “Nginike abantwana; kungenjalo ngizokufa.”
UJakobe wamthukuthelela uRaheli wathi: “Ngisesikhundleni sikaNkulunkulu yini okunguYena okuncishe inzalo na?”
URaheli wathi: “Nasi isisebenzi sami uBhiliha, lala naye ukuze angizalele abantwana, nami ngibe nezingane ngaye.”
Wamnika uBhiliha, isisebenzi sakhe saba yisancinza sakhe, uJakobe walala naye.
UBhiliha wakhulelwa, wamzalela uJakobe indodana.
URaheli wathi: “UNkulunkulu ungehlulele, futhi ulizwile izwi lokunxusa kwami, wangipha indodana.” Ngenxa yalokho wayiqamba igama wathi nguDani.
UBhiliha isisebenzi sikaRaheli saphinda sakhulelwa, samzalela uJakobe enye indodana.
URaheli wathi: “Ngibambene nodadewethu ngezikhwepha ezinkulu, ngamnqoba.” Wayeseyiqamba igama wathi nguNafethali.
ULeya esebona ukuthi usemile ukuzala, wathatha isisebenzi sakhe uZilipha wasinikela kuJakobe ukuba sibe yisancinza sakhe.
UZilipha isisebenzi sikaLeya samzalela indodana uJakobe.
ULeya wathi: “Nginenhlanhla,” wayiqamba igama wathi nguGadi.
UZilipha isisebenzi sikaLeya samzalela enye indodana uJakobe.
ULeya wathi: “Ngibusisiwe! Ngokuba abesifazane bazothi ngingobusisiweyo.” Wayiqamba igama wathi ngu-Asheri.
Ngezinsuku zokuvunwa kukakolo, uRubeni waya endle wathola amamandarike. Wawaletha kunina uLeya. URaheli wathi kuLeya: “Ake ungiphe nami amamandarike endodana yakho.”

Kepha wathi kuye: “Akwanele yini ukungithathela umyeni wami; manje usufuna ukungiphuca namamandarike omntanami na?” URaheli wathi: “Kulungile-ke, uJakobe uzolala nawe ngalobu busuku uma unginika amamandarike endodana yakho.”

Kwathi kusihlwa uJakobe esebuyela ekhaya evela emasimini, uLeya waphuma wamhlangabeza, wathi kuye: “Namhlanje uzolala nami, ngokuba ngikuqashe ngamamandarike endodana yami.” Walala naye ngalobo busuku.
UNkulunkulu wamlalela uLeya, wakhulelwa, wamzalela uJakobe indodana yesihlanu.
ULeya wathi: “UNkulunkulu ungiphe umvuzo, ngoba nginikele ngesisebenzi sami endodeni yami.” Wayiqamba igama wathi ngu-Isakhari.
ULeya wakhulelwa futhi, wamzalela uJakobe indodana yesithupha.
ULeya wathi: “UNkulunkulu ungiphe isipho esiyigugu. Umyeni wami usezongazisa manje ngoba sengimzalele amadodana ayisithupha.” Ngakho-ke wayiqamba igama wathi nguZebuloni.
Emveni kwalokho wamzalela indodakazi, wayiqamba igama wathi nguDina.
UNkulunkulu wamkhumbula noRaheli, wawuphendula umkhuleko wakhe, wasivula isibeletho sakhe.
Wakhulelwa, wazala indodana wathi: “UNkulunkulu ulisusile ihlazo lami.”
Wayiqamba igama wathi nguJosefa. “USimakade makanezele kimi ngenye indodana.”
Kwathi uRaheli esezele uJosefa, uJakobe wayesethi kuLabani: “Ngivumele ngihambe ngibuyele ekhaya kwelakithi.
Ngikhululele nomkami nabantwana bami engibasebenzeleyo ngihambe, ngokuba uyazi ukuthi ngikusebenzele kangakanani.”
ULabani wathi kuye: “Uma uzongivumela ukuba ngisho lokhu: ngizwile uma ngibhula ukuthi uSimakade ungibusise ngenxa yakho.
“Nquma iholo lakho ngizokunika lona.”
UJakobe wathi kuye: “Wena uyazi ukuthi ngikusebenzele kangakanani, nokuthi imfuyo yakho ichume kangakanani isesandleni sami;

ngokuba ngingakafiki wawunemfuyo encane, kodwa selokhu ngafika imfuyo yakho isiyande kakhulu, futhi uSimakade ukubusisile noma kuphi lapho bengiya ngakhona; kodwa manje ngizoyisebenzela nini mina indlu yami na?”
Wathi: “Ngizokunikani na?” UJakobe wathi: “Awuyukunginika lutho. Ngenzele kube kunye nje, ngizoqhubeka ngikwelusele umhlambi wakho, ngiwunakekele.
Namhlanje ngizodabula phakathi komhlambi wakho, ngisuse zonke ezimabhadubhadu, nezimabalabala, nazo zonke izimvu ezimnyama kuwo. Nginike ezinjalo kube yiholo lami.

Ubuqotho bami buzongifakazela ngomuso lapho usufika uzohlola iholo ongikhokhele lona. Leso silwane oyosithola kimi singemabhadubhadu, futhi singemabalabala ezimbuzini, nesingemnyama ezimvini zami, kuyoba ngisebile.”
ULabani wathi: “Kuhle-ke, akuye njengamagama enkehli.”

Ngalolo lusuku uLabani wakhetha zonke izimpongo ezihunqu, nezimabhadubhadu, nezimbuzikazi ezimabalabala, nezimabhadubhadu, zonke lezo ezazinamabala amhlophe, namawundlu amnyama, wakupha amadodana akhe.
Ayesehamba ibanga lezinsuku ezintathu eqhela kuJakobe, uJakobe waqhubeka nokwelusa umhlambi kaLabani.
UJakobe wathatha izinduku zikabhabhulini, nezomu-alimondi, nezesinana, wazixebula amaxolo, kwavela okumhlophe ezindukwini.
Wazibeka lezo zinduku ezixetshuliweyo kuyo yonke imikhombe ezazizophuza kuyo ukuze zibe phambi kwezimbuzikazi ngesikhathi zifika ukuzophuza, ngokuba yilapho zazikhwelana khona.
Ngenxa yokuba zazikhwelana phambi kwezinduku, zonke zazala amazinyane ahunqu, namabhadubhadu, namabalabala.

UJakobe wawehlukanisa lawo mazinyane emhlanjini kaLabani. Ngesikhathi zikhwela, wabhekisa ubuso bemihlambi kwezikaLabani, kwezinemishwi nezimnyama. Ezakhe wazehlukanisa azaze zahlangana nemihlambi kaLabani.
Kwakuthi njalo uma eziqinileyo emhlanjini zikhwelana, uJakobe abeke izinduku phambi kwazo emikhombeni ukuze zikhwelwe zibheke kuzo.
Uma kungezintekenteke emhlanjini angazibeki izinduku. Zonke ezintekenteke kwaba ngezikaLabani, eziqinile zaba ngezikaJakobe.
Ngokwenza kanjalo, uJakobe waba yisicebi esikhulu, enemihlambi emikhulu yezimvu, nezimbuzi, nezincekukazi, nezinceku, namakameli, nezimbongolo.
UJakobe wezwa ukuthi amadodana kaLabani ayakhononda, athi: “UJakobe useqole ubaba konke obekungokwakhe, nale ngcebo yonke anayo uyithole ngezinto obekungezikababa.”
UJakobe wabona nokuthi uLabani akasamnambithisisi kahle njengakuqala.
USimakade wathi kuJakobe: “Phindela ezweni lokhokho bakho nasezihlotsheni zakho, Mina ngizoba nawe.”
UJakobe wathumela wabiza uRaheli noLeya ukuba beze kuye endle lapho ayelusele khona umhlambi.
Wathi kubo: “Ngiyabona ukuthi uyihlo akasanginambithisisi kahle njengakuqala. Kepha uNkulunkulu kababa unami.
Nani niyazi ukuthi uyihlo ngimsebenzele ngokuzikhandla kangakanani,
kepha yena ungiqolile waguqula iholo lami izikhathi eziyishumi, kodwa uNkulunkulu akamvumelanga ukuba angilimaze.
Uma ebethi: ‘Ezimabhadubhadu zizoba yiholo lakho,’ yonke imihlambi ibizala amazinyane amabhadubhadu. Uma eguquka ethi: ‘Zonke ezinemishu zizoba yiholo lakho,’ yonke imihlambi ibizala ezinemishu.
Ngaleyo ndlela uNkulunkulu umephucile uyihlo imfuyo yakhe wayinika mina.
“Ngesikhathi sokukhwelana kwemihlambi ngake ngaba nephupho, ngabheka phezulu ngabona ukuthi izimpongo ezazikhwela zazinemishu, zimabhadubhadu, ezinye ziyihunqu.
Ingelosi kaNkulunkulu yayisithi kimi ephusheni: ‘Jakobe!’ “Ngathi: ‘Ngilapha.’
“Yathi: ‘Bheka phezulu, ubone ukuthi zonke izimpongo ezikhwela umhlambi zinemishu, ezinye zimabhadubhadu, nezinye ziyihunqu; ngokuba ngikubone konke uLabani akwenza kuwe.
NginguNkulunkulu waseBhethele lapho wagcoba khona insika, wenza nesifungo kimi. Manje suka, uphume kuleli lizwe ubuyele ezweni owazalelwa kulo.’ ”
URaheli noLeya bamphendula bathi: “Sikhona yini isabelo noma ifa esisenakho efeni emzini kababa na?
Akasithathi yini njengabezizwe na? Ngokuba uthengise ngathi, futhi wayisebenzisa nemali esakhishelwa yona.
Yonke impahla uNkulunkulu ayephuce ubaba ingeyethu nabantwana bethu. Ngakho-ke yenza konke uNkulunkulu akutshele khona.”
UJakobe walungiselela uhambo, abantwana bakhe, namakhosikazi akhe wabagibelisa emakamelini.
Wayiqhuba imihlambi yakhe yonke nempahla yonke ayeyithole ePhadani Aramu, walibangisa kuyise u-Isaka eKhanani.
ULabani wayengekho eyogunda izimvu zakhe, uRaheli wantshontsha onkulunkulu bakayise.
UJakobe wamkhohlisa uLabani, umAramu, ngokuba akamtshelanga ukuthi uhlose ukubaleka.
Wabaleka nakho konke ayenakho, waqala wawela umfula, walibangisa kwelezintaba kwaGileyadi.
Ngosuku lwesithathu uLabani wabikelwa ukuthi uJakobe ubalekile.
Wayesethatha izihlobo zakhe wamlandela izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, waze wamfica kwelezintaba kwaGileyadi.
Kepha uNkulunkulu wayesefikile ngephupho ebusuku kuLabani, umAramu, wathi kuye: “Uqaphele ukuba ungasho lutho kuJakobe noma ngabe kuhle noma kubi.”
ULabani wamfica uJakobe. UJakobe wayegxumeke ithende lakhe kwelezintaba, naye-ke uLabani nezihlobo zakhe bagoba amadlangala khona kwelezintaba kwaGileyadi.
ULabani wathi kuJakobe: “Yini le nto oyenzileyo na? Ungikhohlisile, wathatha amadodakazi ami ngokungathi athunjwe ngenkemba.
Ubalekeleni isinyelela wangangitshela, ngoba ngabe ngikuhambise kahle ngomgidi kuhutshwa, kushaywa ukhehlegume nezigubhu?
Awunginikanga ngani ithuba lokwanga abazukulu bami namadodakazi ami, ngibavalelise na? Okwenzileyo kungubuphukuphuku.
Kusemandleni ami ukuba ngikulimaze, kodwa uNkulunkulu kayihlo ukhulume nami ebusuku bayizolo, wathi: ‘Uqaphele ukuba ungasho lutho kuJakobe noma ngabe kuhle noma kubi.’
Noma ngabe weqe ngoba usukhumbule ekhaya kini, pho kungani untshontshe onkulunkulu bami na?”
UJakobe waphendula uLabani wathi: “Yingoba bengesaba, ngicabanga ukuthi uzongephuca amadodakazi akho ngendluzula.

Kepha-ke lowo muntu okuyotholakala kuye onkulunkulu bakho, akanakuphila. Phambi kwezihlobo zethu khomba ezintweni enginazo ukuthi yini engeyakho bese uyayithatha.” UJakobe wayengazi ukuthi uRaheli wayentshontshe onkulunkulu.
ULabani wangena ethendeni likaJakobe, kwelikaLeya, wedlulela nakwawezancinza zombili, kodwa akatholanga lutho. Waphuma ethendeni likaLeya wangena kwelikaRaheli.
URaheli wabathatha onkulunkulu bakayise, wabafaka esihlalweni sekameli, wahlala phezu kwaso. ULabani walipeketula lonke ithende, kodwa akabatholanga.
URaheli wathi kuyise: “Ungangithukutheleli ngokuba ngingazange ngisukume phambi kwakho, yingoba ngisesikhathini.” ULabani wacinga, kodwa akabatholanga onkulunkulu.
UJakobe wathukuthela wamthethisa uLabani, wathi: “Liyini icala lami na? Siyini isono sami uze ungihubhe ngale ndlela na?
Njengalokhu usupeketule yonke impahla yami nje, utholeni-ke olungolwakho na? Lubeke lapha phambi kwezihlobo zethu, zona zehlulele phakathi kwethu.
Le minyaka engama-20 ngihleli nawe, izimvukazi nezimbuzikazi zakho azikaze ziphunze, futhi angikaze ngidle nqama yomhlambi wakho.
Angikaze ngilethe kuwe edweshulwe yizilo zasendle. Uma kwenzekile yafa bengiyaye ngilithwale mina lelo cala. Ubukufuna kimi okwebiwe emhlanjini wakho, noma kwebiwe emini noma ebusuku.
Ngangishiswa yilanga emini, ngilala obenyoni ebusuku, ngiqhuqhwa ngamakhaza,
ngikusebenzele le minyaka engama-20, eyi-14 yayo ngisebenzela amadodakazi akho omabili, kwathi eyisithupha ngasebenzela imfuyo. Phezu kwalokho waliguqula kalishumi iholo lami.

Uma uNkulunkulu kababa ebengenami, uNkulunkulu ka-Abhrahama, noKwesaba kuka-Isaka, ngabe manje ungibuyisela emuva ngingenalutho. Kepha uNkulunkulu ukubonile ukuhlupheka nokuzikhandla kwami, wazibonakalisa kuwe ebusuku bayizolo, wakuthethisa.”

ULabani wamphendula uJakobe wathi: “Laba bangamadodakazi ami nalaba bangabazukulu bami, le mfuyo ingeyami, nakho konke lokhu okubonayo kungokwami. Pho-ke ngingakwenza kanjani okubi kulawa madodakazi ami nakubazukulu angizalele bona na?
Ngakho-ke mina nawe masenze isivumelwano esiyakuba ngubufakazi phakathi kwethu.”
UJakobe wathatha itshe walimisa laba yinsika.
Wayesethi ezihlotsheni zakhe: “Qoqelani ndawonye amatshe;” bawaqoqa aba yinqwatshana base bedla lapho eduze kwaleyo nqwatshana yamatshe.
ULabani wayibiza leyo ndawo ngokuthi yiJega Sahadutha, uJakobe wayibiza ngokuthi yiGaledi.
ULabani wathi: “Le nqwaba izokuba yisikhumbuzo phakathi kwethu sobabili.” Yingakho nje leyo ndawo yabizwa ngokuthi yiGaledi.
ULabani wayibiza futhi ngokuthi yiMizpha, ngokuba wathi: “USimakade makalinde phakathi kwami nawe, lapho omunye engekho phambi komunye.
Uma uyakuhlupha amadodakazi ami, noma uthatha abafazi ngaphandle kwamadodakazi ami, akukho muntu onathi; bheka, uNkulunkulu ungufakazi phakathi kwami nawe.”
ULabani wathi kuJakobe: “Bheka, nansi inqwaba yamatshe nensika yetshe engikumise phakathi kwethu.
Kokubili kungubufakazi bokuthi anginakweqela ngale kwale nqwaba ngize kuwe, nawe awunakwedlulela ngale kwale nqwaba nale nsika uzosenzakalisa.
Sengathi uNkulunkulu ka-Abhrahama noNahori, uNkulunkulu woyise, angehlulela phakathi kwethu.” UJakobe wenza isifungo ngoKwesaba kuka-Isaka, uyise.
Wanikela ngomhlatshelo elapho kwelezintaba, wamema nezihlobo zakhe ukuba zidle. Badla, base belala kulo elezintaba ngalobo busuku.
ULabani wavuka ekuseni, wanga abazukulu bakhe namadodakazi akhe, wababusisa, wayesehamba ebuyela emzini wakhe.
UJakobe wabamba eyakhe indlela, izingelosi zikaNkulunkulu zamhlangabeza.
UJakobe ezibona, wathi kuzo: “Leli yibutho likaNkulunkulu.” Wayiqamba leyo ndawo ngokuthi yiMahanayimu.
UJakobe wathumela izithunywa ukuba zimendulele ziye kumnewabo u-Esawu, owayeseSeyiri, kwa-Edomi,
waziyala wathi: “Niyakuthi ku-Esawu inkosi yami: ‘Ithi inceku yakho uJakobe: bengigogobele kwaLabani angaze ngashesha ukubuya kuze kube manje.
Nginezinkomo, izimbongolo, izimvu, izinceku zesilisa nezesifazane, ngakho-ke ngithumele ukuyazisa inkosi yami ukuze ngifumane umusa kuyo.’ ”
Izithunywa zabuyela kuJakobe zathi: “Sihambile saya kumnewenu u-Esawu, naye usendleleni ukuzokuhlangabeza, uza namadoda angama-400.”
UJakobe wesaba kakhulu, wakhathazeka, wayesehlukanisa abantu ayehamba nabo, nezimvu, nezinkomo, namakameli, kwaba ngamaqembu amabili,
ethi emcabangweni wakhe: “Uma u-Esawu efika eqenjini lokuqala elibhubhisa, elinye liyokwazi ukuphunyuka.”
UJakobe wathandaza wathi: “Nkulunkulu kababamkhulu u-Abhrahama nokababa u-Isaka. Wena Simakade wathi kimi: ‘Buyela ezweni lakini nasezihlotsheni zakho, ngizokwenzela okuhle.’
Angilufanele lolu thando ongenzele lona nokwethembeka okungaka okukhombise mina inceku yakho. Ngawela leli Jordani ngiphethe kuphela udondolo, kodwa manje senginamaqembu amabili.
Ngiyakunxusa, ngihlenge esandleni somnewethu u-Esawu, ngokuba ngiyamesaba, hleze afike angihlasele mina, nabafazi bami, nezingane zami.
Wena luqobo uthe: ‘Ngizokwenzela okuhle, ngandise izizukulwane zakho zibe njengezihlabathi zolwandle ezingenakubalwa.’ ”
Walala lapho ngalobo busuku. Kwathi ezintweni ayenazo wathathela umnewabo u-Esawu isipho:
izimbuzikazi ezingama-200, nezimpongo ezingama-20, izimvukazi ezingama-200, nezinqama ezingama-20,
amakameli ezinsikazi angama-30, namankonyane awo, izinkomazi ezingama-40, nezinkunzi ezilishumi, izimbongolo zezinsikazi ezingama-20, nezingamaduna eziyishumi.
Wazinikela zonke lezo zilwane esandleni sezinceku zakhe ukuba ziziqhube, umhlambi ngamunye. Wathi ezincekwini zakhe: “Hambani phambi kwami, nishiye isikhala phakathi kwemihlambi.”
Wathi kumholi womhlambi wokuqala: “Lapho uhlangana nomnewethu u-Esawu, bese ekubuza ethi: ‘Ungokabani wena na? Ulibangisephi? Ungokabani lo mhlambi ophambi kwakho na?’
Ubomphendula uthi: ‘Ungowenceku yakho uJakobe, uyisipho asithumelela inkosi yami u-Esawu, naye uyeza emva kwethu.’ ”
Wayala nowesibili, nowesithathu, nabo bonke ababeqhuba imihlambi, wathi: “Niyakuphendula ngokufanayo ku-Esawu lapho nihlangana naye,

futhi niyakuthi: ‘Bheka, inceku yakho uJakobe iyeza emva kwethu,’ ” ngokuba wacabanga ukuthi: “Ngingahle ngimthobise ngalesi sipho engisiqhuba phambi kwami, kuyothi lapho ngibona ubuso bakhe, mhlawumbe angemukele.”
Izipho zamendulela, kodwa yena ngalobo busuku wasala, walala lapho babekanise khona.
Ngalobo busuku wavuka, wathatha amakhosikazi akhe omabili, nezancinza zakhe zombili, namadodana akhe ayi-11, wabawelisa izibuko lomfula iJabhoki.
Wabathatha wabawelisa nempahla yonke ayenayo.
UJakobe wasala yedwa, indoda yimbe yabambana naye kwaze kwasa.
Lapho leyo ndoda ibona ukuthi ayimehluli uJakobe, yayisifinyelela enyongeni yakhe, yabhinyika esikhoxeni sayo besabambene.
Wayesethi kuJakobe: “Ngiyeke ngihambe ngokuba sekuyasa.” Wayiphendula wathi: “Anginakukudedela ungakangibusisi.”
Leyo ndoda yathi kuye: “Ungubani igama lakho na?” Wayiphendula wathi: “NginguJakobe.”
Yayisithi kuye: “Awusezukubizwa ngokuthi unguJakobe, usuzobizwa ngokuthi ungu-Israyeli, ngokuba ulwe noNkulunkulu nabantu, wanqoba.”
UJakobe wayesethi kuyo: “Ngicela ungitshele igama lakho.” Yamphendula wathi: “Ungibuzelani igama lami na?” Yayisimbusisa khona lapho.
UJakobe wayiqamba leyo ndawo wathi kusePheniyeli, ngokuba wathi: “Sibonene noNkulunkulu ubuso nobuso, angaze ngafa.”
Laphuma ilanga lapho edlula ePheniyeli, eqhuga ngenxa yokubhinyika inyonga.
Kungenxa yalokho-ke abakwa-Israyeli bengawudli umsipha onamathele ethebeni lenyonga kuze kube namuhla, ngokuba uJakobe wathintwa lapho.
UJakobe waphakamisa amehlo, wambona u-Esawu eza namadoda angama-400. Wehlukanisa abantwana bakhe, abanye bahamba noLeya, abanye noRaheli, abanye bahamba nezancinza zombili.
Wabeka izancinza nabantwana bazo phambili, kwalandela uLeya nabantwana bakhe, kwagcina uRaheli noJosefa.
Yena siqu wahamba phambili, ehamba ekhothama ngobuso emhlabathini kwaze kwaba kasikhombisa, waze wafika kumnewabo.
Kepha u-Esawu wathathela ngejubane wamhlangabeza uJakobe umnawakhe, wafike wamgona, wamgomothela, wamanga, base bekhala.
Lapho u-Esawu ephakamisa amehlo ebona abesifazane nabantwana, wathi: “Ngobani laba ohamba nabo na?” UJakobe wamphendula wathi: “Bangabantwana uNkulunkulu ngomusa wakhe abaphe inceku yakho.”
Izancinza nabantwana bazo basondela, bakhothama ngobuso emhlabathini.
Kwalandela uLeya nabantwana bakhe, nabo bakhothama, kwase kugcina uJosefa noRaheli, nabo bakhothama.
U-Esawu wathi: “Ngabe iyini injongo yakho ngayo yonke le mihlambi engihlangane nayo na?” Wamphendula wathi: “Ukuba ngithole umusa enkosini yami.”
U-Esawu wathi kuye: “Nginokwanele mnawami, zigcinele wena imfuyo yakho.”
UJakobe wathi: “Qha, uma ngifumene umusa kuwe, samukele isipho esivela kimi, ngokuba ukubona ubuso bakho nje kufana nokubona ubuso bukaNkulunkulu, njengoba ungamukele ngomusa ongaka.
Ngiyakuncenga, samukele isipho sami esithunyelwe kuwe, ngokuba uNkulunkulu ube nomusa kimi, futhi nginakho konke engikudingayo.” UJakobe waqhubeka emncenga, u-Esawu wagcina esesemukele isipho sakhe.
U-Esawu wathi: “Masisuke sihambe, mina ngizohamba phambi kwakho.”
UJakobe wathi: “Inkosi yami iyazibonela ukuthi abantwana basebancane, nokuthi izimvu nezinkomo engiziqhubayo ziyancelisa. Uma singakuxina usuku lube lunye nje, kungafa wonke umhlambi.
Ngicela inkosi yami idlule phambi kwenceku yayo, mina ngizobe ngitotobisa umhlambi nabantwana, ngize ngifinyelele emzini wenkosi yami eSeyiri.”
U-Esawu wathi: “Angikushiye namanye amadoda kulawa engihamba nawo.” UJakobe wathi: “Kungani inkosi yami ingenzela umusa ongaka na?”
Ngalolo lusuku u-Esawu waphindela emuva, wabamba indlela ebheke eSeyiri.
UJakobe walibhekisa eSukhothi, wafike wathi gozololo khona, wakha nemipheme yemfuyo yakhe. Yingakho nje leyo ndawo ayibiza ngokuthi yiSukhothi.
UJakobe wafika ephephile emzini iShekhemu owawuseKhanani, evela ePhadani Aramu, wagoba amadlangala phambi komuzi.
Wathenga isiqinti kuleyo nsimu ayegobe kuyo amadlangala, emadodaneni kaHamori, uyise kaShekhemu; sasibiza ikhulu lezinhlamvu zesiliva zenani eliphezulu.
Wakha i-althare lapho, walibiza ngokuthi yi-Eli Elohe Israyeli.
UDina, indodakazi kaLeya ayeyizalele uJakobe, wavakashela ezinye izintombi zendawo.
UShekhemu, indodana kaHamori, umHivi, owayebusa kulelo lizwe, wambona wamthatha, wamona, wamthela ngehlazo.
Wayethathekile nguDina, indodakazi kaJakobe, futhi emthanda, wakhuluma naye wathulula inhliziyo yakhe kuye.
UShekhemu wakhuluma noyise uHamori, wathi: “Ngithathele le ntombi ibe ngumkami.”
UJakobe wezwa ngesigameko sokungcoliswa kwendodakazi yakhe uDina, kodwa akaze asho lutho kwaze kwafika amadodana akhe evela ekwaluseni.
UHamori, uyise kaShekhemu wahamba waya kuJakobe eyokhonga.

Amadodana kaJakobe ayefika nje evela ekwaluseni lapho ezwa ngaleso sigameko, ashaqeka, awotha ubomvu, ngokuba wayenze ichilo kwa-Israyeli ngokungcolisa indodakazi kaJakobe, okwakuyinto eyayingafanele neze ukwenziwa.
UHamori wathi kubo: “Indodana yami uShekhemu iyayithanda indodakazi yenu. Mganiseleni yona ibe ngumkakhe.
Masiganiselane, nisinike amadodakazi enu abe ngabafazi bethu, nani nithathe amadodakazi ethu abe ngabafazi benu.
Hlalani phakathi kwethu, nanti izwe phambi kwenu. Yakhani, nithengiselane, nibe nezindawo zenu.”
UShekhemu wayesethi kuJakobe nakubafowabo bentombazane: “Uma ngifumene umusa kini, shonini enikufunayo, ngizoninika khona.
Nqumani ilobolo nezibizo zenu, akukhathaleki ukuthi nibiza kangakanani, mina ngizoninika konke enikufunayo, inqobo nje uma nizongiganisela indodakazi yenu ibe ngumkami.”
Amadodana kaJakobe aphendula uShekhemu noyise uHamori ngobuqili, ngokuba wayengcolise udadewabo uDina.
Athi kubo: “Asikwazi ukwenza into efana naleyo, yokuthatha udadewethu simendise kumuntu ongasokile, onejwabu. Lokho kuyihlazo kithi.
Siyakuvuma lokho, inqobo nje uma nizoba njengathi, kusoke bonke abesilisa bakini.
Siyakuninika amadodakazi ethu, nathi sizithathele amadodakazi enu, sihlale nani, sibe sizwe sinye.
Kepha-ke uma ningavumelani nokuthi nisokwe, sizothatha udadewethu sihambe naye.”
Amazwi abo ayithola indawo kuHamori noShekhemu indodana yakhe.
Le nsizwa ayipholisanga maseko, yasoka, kwazise yayisha amashushu ngoDina, futhi ihlonishwa kakhulu kunabo bonke abendlu kayise.
UHamori nendodana yakhe baphumela esigcawini somuzi, bakhuluma nezakhamuzi, bathi:
“Laba bantu bahlezi ngokuthula nathi. Asibavumele bahambe bazithengele izindawo ngokuba izwe libanzi nxazonke, ukuze sikwazi ukuganiselana nabo.
Bavumile ukuthi bangahlala phakathi kwethu, sibe muntu munye, kuphela nje uma bonke abesilisa phakathi kwethu bezosokwa njengoba nabo besokiwe.
Uma sibavumela, imihlambi yabo, impahla yabo, nayo yonke imfuyo yabo, akuyukuba ngokwethu na?”
Zonke izakhamuzi zavumelana noHamori nendodana yakhe uShekhemu, bonke abesilisa ababakhe kuleyo ndawo basokwa.

Kwathi ngosuku lwesithathu isabhokile iminjunju yokusokwa, amadodana kaJakobe, uSimeyoni noLevi, abafowabo bakaDina, bathatha kwaba yilowo nalowo inkemba, baphuma bayohlasela umuzi iShekhemu isinyelela, bashaya icole kwabesilisa.
Babulala uHamori noShekhemu indodana yakhe ngenkemba, bakhipha uDina endlini kaShekhemu, bahamba naye.
Afika namanye amadodana kaJakobe afica izidumbu, ayesewuphanga umuzi, ngokuba wayengcoliselwe lapho udadewabo.
Bashaqa imihlambi yezimvu, izinkomo, izimbongolo zabo, okwakusemzini nasemadlelweni,
nayo yonke ingcebo, bathumba izingane, amakhosikazi, bakuphanga konke okwakusezindlini.

UJakobe wayesethi kuSimeyoni noLevi: “Ningikhathazile, nangidonsela amanzi ngomsele kubantu bezwe, kumaKhanani namaPherizi; nina niyingcosana nje, bayakuhlangana basihlasele, bangichithe mina nendlu yami.”
Bamphendula bathi: “Bekufanele yini udadewethu aphathiswe okwesifebe na?”
UNkulunkulu wathi kuJakobe: “Suka ukhuphukele eBhethele, uhlale lapho. Yakha i-althare lapho, ulakhele uNkulunkulu ozibonakalise kuwe ngesikhathi ubalekela umnewenu u-Esawu.”
UJakobe wathi emndenini wakhe nakubo bonke ayenabo: “Lahlani bonke onkulunkulu bezizwe eninabo, nizihlambulule, bese nigqoka izingubo ezihlanzekileyo.
Sizosuka lapha silibangise eBhethele, lapho ngizofike ngakhe khona i-althare likaNkulunkulu, okunguYena owangikhulula enhluphekweni engangibishe kuyo, waba nami yonke indawo lapho bengihamba khona.”
Baletha kuJakobe bonke onkulunkulu bezizwe ababenabo, namacici ayesezindlebeni zabo. Wakuthatha wakugqiba phansi kwesihlahla somu-okhi esasiseduze neShekhemu.
Baphuma bahamba, kodwa abantu bezigodi ezazibazungezile, uNkulunkulu wabafaka ingebhe abaze bawaxosha amadodana kaJakobe.
UJakobe wafinyelela eLuzi, eKhanani, okuyiBhethele, nabo bonke ayehamba nabo.
Wakha lapho i-althare, leyo ndawo wayibiza ngokuthi yi-Eli Bhethele, ngokuba kulapho uNkulunkulu azibonakalisa kuye khona mhla ebalekela umnewabo.
UDebhora, umzanyana kaRibheka wafa, wangcwatshwa phansi kwesihlahla somu-okhi ezansi neBhethele. Ngakho-ke sabizwa ngokuthi yi-Aloni Bhakhuthi.
UNkulunkulu wabonakala futhi kuJakobe ngesikhathi ebuya ePhadani Aramu, wambusisa,
wathi: “Igama lakho unguJakobe, kodwa awusezukubizwa ngoJakobe, usuzobizwa ngo-Israyeli.” Ngakho-ke wabizwa ngo-Israyeli.
UNkulunkulu wathi kuye: “NginguNkulunkulu uSomandla. Zala wande, ube yisizwe esikhulu. Kuwe kuyovela izizwe eziningi. Nasokhalo lwakho kuyovela amakhosi.
Nezwe engalabela u-Abhrahama no-Isaka nawe ngikwabela lona nezizukulwane zakho.”
UNkulunkulu wenyuka, wamshiya uJakobe lapho ayekade ekhulume naye khona.
UJakobe wayesemisa insika lapho uNkulunkulu ayekhulume naye khona, insika yetshe, wathela amafutha kuyo, wathela nomnikelo wokuphuzwayo.
Wayibiza leyo ndawo uNkulunkulu ayekhulume naye kuyo wathi yiBhethele.
Bathutha eBhethele. Kuthe kuselibangana ukuba bafike e-Efratha, uRaheli wabeletha emveni kokuhelelwa kanzima.
Kwathi lapho isenzima ngempela imihelo yakhe, umbelethisi wamqinisa idolo, wathi: “Ungesabi, ngokuba uzothola enye indodana.”
Eseyalela sekuphuma umphefumulo, wayiqamba igama wathi nguBhenoni, kodwa uyise wathi nguBhenjamini.
URaheli wafa, wangcwatshwa ngasendleleni eya e-Efratha, okuyiBhethlehema.
UJakobe wamisa insika phezu kwethuna likaRaheli, lelo thuna liselapho kuze kube namuhla.
U-Israyeli wathutha lapho, wayogoba amadlangala ngale kombhoshongo e-Ederi.
Kwathi u-Israyeli esehleli kulelo lizwe, uRubeni walala noBhiliha isancinza sikayise. Uyise u-Israyeli wezwa ngaleyo ndaba. UJakobe wayenamadodana ali-12.
Amadodana kaLeya kwakunguRubeni, izibulo likaJakobe, kulandele uSimeyoni, uLevi, uJuda, u-Isakhare noZabuloni.
Amadodana kaRaheli kwakunguJosefa noBhenjamini.
Amadodana kaBhiliha incekukazi kaRaheli kwakunguDani noNafethali.
Amadodana kaZilipha incekukazi kaLeya kunguGadi no-Asheri. Yilawo-ke amadodana kaJakobe awazala esePhadani Aramu.
UJakobe wafika kuyise u-Isaka eMamre, iKhiriyathi Arbha, okuyiHebhroni, lapho u-Abhrahama no-Isaka babekade begogobele khona.
Iminyaka yokuphila ka-Isaka yaba yi-180 isiyonke.
U-Isaka wafa, wangcwatshwa noyisemkhulu, esekhulile impela, amadodana akhe o-Esawu noJakobe bamngcwaba.
Nanku umlando wezizukulwane zika-Esawu obuye abizwe ngo-Edomi.
U-Esawu wathatha abafazi emadodakazini amaKhanani: u-Ada, indodakazi ka-Eloni, umHithi, no-Oholibhama, indodakazi ka-Ana, indodakazi kaZibhiyoni, umHivi.
Wabuye waganwa nguBhasematha indodakazi ka-Ishmayeli, udadewabo kaNebhayothi.
U-Ada wamzalela u-Esawu u-Elifazi, uBhasematha wamzalela uRuweli,
u-Oholibhama wamzalela uJewushi, uJalamu noKhora. Yilawo-ke amadodana ka-Esawu awazalelwa eseseKhanani.

U-Esawu wathatha abafazi bakhe, amadodana akhe, amadodakazi akhe, nabo bonke ayenabo, izinkomo zakhe, yonke imfuyo yakhe, nempahla yonke ayeyithole eKhanani, wathuthela ezweni elaliqhelelene nomfowabo uJakobe.
Impahla yabo yayisiningi kakhulu ukuthi babengakwazi ukuqhubeka bahlale ndawonye. Izwe ababehlezi kulo lalingasabeneli bobabili ngenxa yemfuyo ababenayo.
U-Esawu owayaziwa ngokuthi ngu-Edomi wazinza kwelezintaba eSeyiri.
Nantu uhla lwezizukulwane zika-Esawu, ukhokho wabakwa-Edomi, ababehlala kwelezintaba eSeyiri.
Nanka amagama amadodana akhe: u-Elifazi owayezalwa ngu-Ada, noRuweli owayezalwa nguBhasematha.
Amadodana ka-Elifazi kwakunguThemane, u-Omari, uZefo, uGathamu noKhenazi.
UThimna owayeyisancinza sika-Elifazi, wamzalela indodana okuthiwa ngu-Amaleki. Laba babeyisizukulwane sika-Ada, umka-Esawu.
Amadodana kaRuweli, kwakunguNahathi, uZera, uShama, noMiza. Laba babeyisizukulwane sikaBhasemathi.
Lawa kwakungamadodana ka-Oholibhama indodakazi ka-Ana, engumzukulu kaZibhiyoni, umka-Esawu, kwakunguJewushi, uJalamu, noKhora.
Nazi izikhulu ezavela emadodaneni ka-Esawu: amadodana ka-Elifazi, izibulo lika-Esawu, kwakunguThemani, u-Omari, uZefo, uKhenazi,
uKhora, uGathamu, no-Amaleki. Yilezi-ke izikhulu ezavela ku-Elifazi kwa-Edomi zingamadodana ka-Ada.
Lawa ngamadodana kaRuweli, indodana ka-Esawu, isikhulu uNahathi, uZera, uShama, nesikhulu uMiza. Yilezo-ke izikhulu ezazalwa nguRuweli kwa-Edomi. Zaziyizizukulwane zika-Bhasematha.
Lawa ngamadodana ka-Oholibhama, umka-Esawu: kwakuyizikhulu uJewushi, uJalamu, noKhora. Yilazo-ke izikhulu ezazizalwa ngu-Oholibhama, indodakazi ka-Ana, umka-Esawu.
Yilolo-ke uhla lwamadodana nezikhulu ababezalwa ngu-Esawu ongu-Edomi.
Lawa ngamadodana kaSeyiri umHori ayehlala eSeyiri: kwakunguLothani, uShobhali, uZibhiyoni, u-Ana,
uDishoni, u-Ezeri, noDishani. Laba babengamadodana kaSeyiri ayebusa amaHori kwa-Edomi.
Amadodana kaLothani kwakunguHori noHomamu, udadewabo kaLothani kwakunguThimna.
Amadodana kaShobhali kwakungu-Alvani, uManahathi, u-Ebhali, uShefo, no-Onamu.
Amadodana kaZibhiyoni kwakungu-Ayiya no-Ana. U-Ana nguye owathola iziphethu zamanzi ashisayo ehlane, mhla eluse izimbongolo zikayise, u-Zibhiyoni.
Laba ngabantwana baka-Ana: uDishoni, no-Oholibhama owayeyintombazana.
Amadodana kaDishoni kwakunguHemidani, u-Eshibhani, u-Ithirani noKherani.
Amadodana ka-Ezeri, kwakunguBhilihani, uZavani, no-Akhani.
Amadodana kaDishani kwakungu-Uzi no-Arani.
Izikhulu zamaHori, kwakunguLothani, uShobhali, uZibhiyoni, u-Ana,
uDishoni, u-Ezeri, noDishani. Babebusa amaHori ngokwezigaba zabo eSeyiri.
Lawa ngamakhosi ayebusa kwa-Edomi kungakabi bikho nkosi kwa-Israyeli:
uBhela, indodana kaBheyori, wabusa kwa-Edomi, emzini owawubizwa ngokuthi yiDinihabha.
Kuthe ukuba akhothame uBhela, ubukhosi bathathwa uJobhabhu, indodana kaZera waseBhozira.
Wakhothama uJobhabhu, ubukhosi bathathwa uHushama waseThemane.
Wakhothama uHushama, ubukhosi bedlulela kuHadada, indodana kaBhedada owanqoba abakwaMidiyani esifundeni kwaMowabi. Igama lomuzi ayebusa kuwo kwakuthiwa yi-Avithi.
Wakhothama uHadada, kwabusa uSamila waseMasireka.
Wakhothama uSamila, kwathatha uShawuli waseRehobhothi ngasemfuleni.
Wakhothama noShawuli, kwabusa uBhali Hanana, indodana ka-Akhibhori.

Wakhothama noBhali Hanana, indodana ka-Akhibhori, kwase kubusa uHadari. Igama lomuzi ayebusa kuwo kwakuthiwa yiPhawu; igama lendlovukazi kunguMehethabheli, indodakazi kaMathiredi, owayeyindodakazi kaMezahabhi.
Lawa ngamagama ezkhulu ezadabuka ku-Esawu ngemindeni nangezifunda zawo: nguThimna, u-Alva, uJethethi,
u-Oholibhama, u-Ela, uPhinoni,
uKhenazi, uThemane, uMibhizari,
uMagidiyeli no-Iramu. Laba babeyizikhulu kwa-Edomi ezifundeni ababakhe kuzo, ezweni elaliyifa lazo. U-Esawu ngukhokho wabakwa-Edomi.
UJakobe wakha eKhanani, ezweni okwakukade kuhlala kulo uyise.

Lena yindaba kaJakobe nezizukulwane zakhe. Kwathi uJosefa eseneminyaka eyi-17, elusa umhlambi nabafowabo ababezalwa nguBhiliha noZilipha, abafazi bakayise, uJosefa wabika umbiko omubi ngabafowabo kuyise.
U-Israyeli wayemthanda uJosefa kunawo wonke amadodana akhe, kwazise wayemthole esemdala. Wamthungela ingubo enemikhono emide.
Abafowabo bakubona ukuthi uyise umthanda kunabo bonke abafowabo, ngakho-ke bamzonda, futhi ababe besakwazi ukukhuluma kahle naye.
UJosefa waphupha iphupho, wayeselitshela abafowabo, okuthe bangalizwa bamzonda ngokwedlulele.
Wathi kubo: “Ake nizwe iphupho engiliphuphileyo.
Besibopha izinyanda ensimini, kwathi inyanda yami yaphakama yema, ezenu zase ziyizungeza, zayikhothamela.”
Abafowabo bathi kuye: “Usho ukuthi uzoba yinkosi yethu usibuse na?” Yabhebhetheka kakhulu inzondo kubafowabo ngenxa yamaphupho namazwi akhe.
UJosefa wabuye waphupha, wabalandisa futhi abafowabo, wathi: “Ngiphuphe ngibona ilanga, nenyanga, nezinkanyezi eziyi-11 kungikhothamela.”
Wamlandisa noyise njengoba enze kubafowabo, kodwa uyise wamthethisa, wathi kuye: “Phupho lini leli oliphuphileyo na? Usho ukuthi unyoko nami nabafowenu siyokuza sikukhothamele na?”
Abafowabo baba nomona ngaye, kodwa uyise wawagcina enhliziyweni yakhe lawo maphupho.
Ngelinye ilanga abafowabo bakaJosefa bahamba nomhlambi kayise beyowelusela eShekhemu.
U-Israyeli wathi kuJosefa: “Abafowenu abelusele yini eShekhemu na? Woza ukuze ngikuthume kubo.” UJosefa wathi: “Ngilapha baba.”
Wathi kuye: “Hamba uyobona ukuthi abafowenu nemfuyo basaphatheke kahle yini, bese ungilethela umbiko.” Wamthuma esuka esigodini eHebhroni, waze wayofika eShekhemu.
Umuntu mumbe wamfumana ezulazula endle, wambuza wathi: “Ufunani lapha na?”
Wathi: “Ngifuna abafowethu. Ngiyakuncenga, ngitshele ukuthi ngabe belusele kuphi na?”
Leyo ndoda yathi: “Basukile lapha. Ngibezwe bethi: ‘Asihambe siye eDothani.’ ” UJosefa wahamba wabalandela, waze wabathola khona eDothani.
Bambona esekude engakasondeli eduze kwabo, base bemakhela ugobe lokumbulala.
Bathi omunye komunye: “Nansi inyanga yamaphupho iza.
Wozani siyibulale, siyiphonse komunye wemigodi, bese sithi kubaba: ‘Udliwe yisilwane esibi sasendle,’ sibone-ke ukuthi amaphupho akhe ayofika kuphi.”
URubeni ekuzwa lokho, wazama ukumphephisa kubo, wathi: “Asingambulali.
Ningalichithi igazi! Mphonseni emgodini khona lapha ehlane, ningambeki isandla!” Wayefuna ukumphephisa kubo ukuze amphindisele kuyise.
Uthe lapho uJosefa efika kubafowabo, bamhlubula ingubo yakhe ayeyigqokile embalabala, enemikhono emide.
Bamthatha, bamphonsa emgodini owawomile, ungenamanzi.
Bahlala phansi, badla; kuthe bephakamisa amehlo, babona ihele labakwa-Ishmayeli liqhamuka kwaGileyadi, amakameli abo ethwele inhlaka, nebhalisamu, nemure, bekwehlisela eGibhithe.
UJuda wathi kubafowabo: “Siyozuzani ngokubulala umfowethu, bese sifihla igazi lakhe na?
Asimthengisele abakwa-Ishmayeli engenamyocu, ngokuba ungumfowethu, uyinyama yethu.” Abafowabo bamlalela.
Kwathi lapho kwedlula abahwebi bakwaMidiyani, bamkhipha uJosefa emgodini, bamthengisa kwabakwa-Ishmayeli ngezinhlamvu zesiliva ezingama-20, ababe sebemthatha bahamba, baya naye eGibhithe.
URubeni wabuyela emgodini, washaqeka engasamfici uJosefa lapho, wayeseklebhula izingubo zakhe.
Wabuyela kubafowabo wathi kubo: “Akasekho umfana emgodini, ngizoshonaphi mina na?”
Bathatha ingubo kaJosefa ende, base behlaba impongo, bacwilisa ingubo kaJosefa egazini layo.
Bayithumela ingubo ende enemibala ehlukene kuyise, bathi: “Nakhu esikutholile. Ake uhlolisise ubone ukuthi akusiyona yini ingubo yendodana yakho na?”
UJakobe eyibona, wathi: “Yingubo yendodana yami le. Isilwane esibi sasendle simdlile. Simdwengulile uJosefa waba yizicucu.”
UJakobe wayeseklebhula izingubo zakhe, wembatha isaka okhalo lwakhe, walilela indodana yakhe izinsuku eziningi.
Onke amadodana namadodakazi akhe, afika ukuzomduduza, kepha kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya. Wathi: “Ngiyoze ngiye kwelabafileyo ngisayililela indodana yami.” Waqhubeka nokuyililela indodana yakhe.
AbakwaMidiyani bamthengisa uJosefa eGibhithe kuPotifari, inceku kaFaro, induna yabalindi.
Ngaleso sikhathi uJuda wabashiya abafowabo, wayohlala nomuntu wase-Adulama okuthiwa nguHira.
UJuda wabona indodakazi yendoda yaseKhanani egama layo linguShuwa. Wayithatha, yamgana, walala nayo.
Yakhulelwa, yazala indodana, wayiqamba igama wathi ngu-Eri.
Yabuye yakhulelwa, yazala enye indodana, wayiqamba igama wathi ngu-Onani.
Yalandelisa futhi ngenye indodana, wayiqamba igama wathi nguShela: babeseKhezibhi ngesikhathi ezalwa.
UJuda wathathela indodana yakhe eyizibulo, u-Eri, umfazi ogama lakhe linguThamari.
U-Eri, izibulo likaJuda, wayemubi phambi kukaSimakade, ngakho-ke uSimakade wambulala.
UJuda wathi ku-Onani: “Kuhle ukuba ungene umkamfowenu, umvusele umuzi.”
U-Onani wayazi ukuthi abantwana abazalwayo ngeke babizwe ngaye, kwathi noma elala nomkamfowabo wayichithela phansi imbewu, ukuze angamvuseli umfowabo umuzi.
Leyo nto ayenza yaba yimbi emehlweni kaSimakade, wayesembulala naye.

UJuda wayesethi kuThamari, umalokazana wakwakhe: “Kungcono uhlale ube ngumfelokazi emzini kayihlo kuze kukhule indodana yami uShela.” Ngokuba uJuda wathi: “Angase afe naye lo njengabafowabo.” UThamari wahamba wayohlala emzini kayise.
Emveni kwesikhathi wafa umkaJuda, indodakazi kaShuwa. UJuda esemzilele umkakhe, wakhuphukela kubagundi bezimvu zakhe eThimna, enomngani wakhe uHira wase-Adulamu.
UThamari watshelwa ukuthi: “Uyihlozala usendleleni ulibangise eThimna ukuyogunda izimvu zakhe.”
Wayesekhumula inzilo, wazemboza ngemvakazi, wahlala phansi ngasesangweni e-Enayimi, ngasemgwaqweni oya eThimna, ngokuba wabona ukuthi uShela usekhulile, kodwa wayenganikelwe kuye ukuba abe ngumkakhe.
UJuda embona lowo wesifazane, wacabanga ukuthi yisifebe nje, ngoba ezemboze ubuso.
Wayeseqonda kuye eceleni komgwaqo, wathi: “Woza ngilale nawe.” Wayengazi ukuthi lo wesifazane ungumalokazana wakwakhe. Owesifazane wambuza wathi: “Uzonginikani uma ngilala nawe na?”
Wathi yena: “Ngizokunika izinyane lembuzi emhlanjini wami.” Owesifazane wathi: “Uzonginika yini isibambiso uze ulithumele na?”
Wathi yena: “Ufuna ngikunike sibambiso sini na?” Owesifazane wathi: “Indandatho yakho yokusicilela, nomchilo wayo, nodondolo oluphethe esandleni.” Wamnika-ke, wayeselala naye, wakhulelwa.
UThamari wasuka lapho, wabuyela ekhaya, wayisusa imvakazi, wagqoka inzilo yakhe.
UJuda wayesethumela izinyane lembuzi ngesandla somngani wakhe wase-Adulamu, ukuze kubuye izimpahla zakhe ayebambise ngazo kowesifazane, kodwa akamtholanga.
Wayesebuza kubantu ababakhe lapho, wathi: “Saya ngaphi isifebe esasihlala eceleni komgwaqo e-Enayimi na?” Abantu bathi: “Akukaze kube khona sifebe lapha.”
Waphindela kuJuda, wathi: “Angisitholanga. Nabantu bakhona bathe: ‘Akukaze kube khona sifebe lapha.’ ”
UJuda wathi: “Masizithathele zona sizigcine, funa sihlazeke. Ngilithumele leli zinyane, kodwa wena awusifumananga.”

Sekwedlule izinyanga ezintathu, uJuda wathola umbiko othi: “UThamari, umalokazana wakwakho, unecala lobufebe, useze wakhulelwa kulobo bufebe bakhe.” UJuda wathi: “Mkhipheleni eshashalazini, ashiswe ngomlilo.”
Besamqhuba lona wesifazane, wathumela umyalezo kuyisezala, wathi: “Ngikhuleliswe yindoda engumnini walezi zimpahla; ake ubone ukuthi ngekabani le ndandatho yokusicilela, nomchilo, nodondolo.”
UJuda wazibona lezo zinto, wathi: “Ulungile lo wesifazane kunami, ngokuba angimnikanga uShela indodana yami.” UJuda akabuyanga walala naye.
Esebeletha, kwatholakala ukuthi ukhulelwe amawele.
Ngesikhathi ebeletha, elinye lawo lakhipha isandla. Umbelethisi wathandela intambo ebomvu esihlakaleni salo, wathi: “Lona uphume kuqala.”
Lapho esiphindisela emuva isandla sakhe, kwaphuma umfowabo. Umbelethisi wayesethi: “Hawu! Waze wafohla bo!” Wayeseqanjwa igama kwathiwa nguPherezi.
Emveni kwalokho umfowabo osandla sakhe sasinentambo ebomvu esihlakaleni, waphuma, igama lakhe kwathiwa nguZera.
UJosefa bamthatha baya naye eGibhithe, uPotifari, esinye sezikhulu zikaFaro, umphathi wabaqaphi, wamthenga kwabakwa-Ishmayeli ababefike naye.
USimakade wayenaye uJosefa, wamphumelelisa kukho konke. UJosefa wahlala endlini yenkosi yakhe yaseGibhithe.
Inkosi yakhe yabona ukuthi uNkulunkulu unaye, nokuthi uNkulunkulu uyakuphumelelisa konke akwenzayo,
ngakho-ke uJosefa wafumana umusa phambi kwayo, waba yinceku yayo; yamenza waba ngumphathi wendlu yayo, wengamela konke eyayinakho.

Kusukela ngaleso sikhathi eyambeka ngaso, waba ngumphathi wendlu yayo, nakho konke eyayinakho; uSimakade wawubusisa umuzi walowo mGibhithe, nakho konke ayenakho. Isibusiso sikaSimakade sasiphezu kwakho konke uPotifari ayenakho endlini nasemasimini.
Ngakho-ke uPotifari wakubeka konke ayenakho esandleni sikaJosefa, akabe esazihlupha ngalutho, ngaphandle kokudla okwakufanele akudle. UJosefa wayeyigeza, enesiqu, ebukeka kahle.
Emveni kwesikhathi umkaPotifari wamkhanuka, wathi kuye: “Lala nami.”
Kepha uJosefa wenqaba, wathi enkosikazini yomphathi wakhe: “Umphathi wami akakhathazeke ngalutho endlini yakhe, futhi ukunikele konke ezandleni zami.
Akamkhulu kule ndlu kunami, futhi akukho angigodlele khona ngaphandle kwakho, ngenxa yokuba ungumkakhe. Ngingakwenza kanjani-ke okubi kangaka, ngone kuNkulunkulu na?”
Nakuba umkaPotifari wayembelesela uJosefa imihla ngemihla, kodwa akavumanga ukulala naye, noma abe ndawonye naye.
Langa limbe lapho uJosefa engena endlini ezosebenza, kungekho muntu omunye endlini,
umkaPotifari wamdumela, wabamba ingubo yakhe, wathi: “Lala nami,” kodwa uJosefa waphulukundlela, washiya isembatho sakhe ezandleni zakhe, wabaleka, waphumela phandle.
Kwathi ukuba abone ukuthi ushiye ingubo esandleni sakhe, wabaleka,
wamemeza abendlu yakhe, wathi: “Ake nibheke, umyeni wami usilethele lo mHebheru ukuba azohlekisa ngathi. Uze kimi, wafuna ukulala nami, ngamemeza kakhulu;
unele wezwa ngiphakamisa izwi lami ngimemeza, washiya ingubo yakhe eduze kwami, wabaleka, waphumela phandle.”
Wayigcina leyo ngubo eduze kwakhe, waze wabuya umyeni wakhe.
Wamtshela le ndaba, wathi: “Le nceku yomHebheru owasilethela yona, ize kimi ifuna ukulala nami;
kuthe ukuba ngiphakamise izwi ngimemeza, yashiya ingubo yayo eduze kwami, yabaleka, yaphumela phandle.”
Esewezwile amazwi akhulunywe ngumkakhe, ethi: “Ingiphathe kanjalo inceku yakho,” wathukuthela wagana unwabu.
Umphathi wamthatha uJosefa, wamgquma ejele, lapho kwakuvalelwa khona iziboshwa zenkosi.
USimakade wayenaye uJosefa, wamenzela umusa, waba nogazi kumphathijele.
Umphathijele wambeka uJosefa waba yinduna yabo bonke ayevalelwe nabo, kubuzwa kuye konke okwakwenzeka lapho.
Umphathijele akabange esazikhathaza ngalutho, ngokuba konke kwakusesandleni sikaJosefa, futhi uSimakade wayemphumelelisa kukho konke akwenzayo.
Emveni kwalezo zinto umphathindebe wenkosi yaseGibhithe nombhakizinkwa bona enkosini yabo, inkosi yaseGibhithe.
UFaro wazithukuthelela zombili lezi zikhulu, induna yabaphathindebe nenduna yababhakizinkwa.
Wazivalela endlini yenduna yabalindi benkosi, zafakwa ejele, lapho kwakuvalelwe khona uJosefa.
Induna yabalindi benkosi yamqoka uJosefa ukuba azibheke, nokuba abhekane nezidingo zazo, kwaba yisikhashana zivalelwe.
Ngobunye ubusuku bobabili, umphathindebe nombhakizinkwa benkosi yaseGibhithe, ababevalelwe ejele, yilowo nalowo waphupha; yilelo nalelo phupho lalichaza okuthile.
Ngakusasa ekuseni lapho uJosefa efika kubo, wabona ukuthi bakhathazekile.
Ngakho-ke wazibuza izinceku zikaFaro ezazinaye, zivalelwe endlini yomphathi wakhe, wathi: “Yini namuhla nibukeke nidangele na?”
Bathi kuye: “Sibe namaphupho sobabili, akukho muntu ongasichazela wona.” UJosefa wathi kubo: “Ngabe incazelo ayiveli yini kuNkulunkulu na? Ngitsheleni amaphupho enu.”
Ngakho-ke induna yabaphathindebe yamtshela uJosefa iphupho layo. Yathi kuye: “Ephusheni lami bekunesihlahla somvini phambi kwami,
emvinini kukhona amagatsha amathathu. Kwathi eqeda nje ukubumba ayeseqhakaza, kwavela amahlukuzo amagilebhisi avuthiweyo kuwo.
Indebe kaFaro ibisesandleni sami; ngawathatha amagilebhisi ngawakhamela endebeni kaFaro, ngase ngimnika esandleni uFaro.”
UJosefa wathi kuye: “Nansi-ke incazelo yalo: amagatsha amathathu ayizinsuku ezintathu;
zingakapheli izinsuku ezintathu uFaro uzokuphakamisa, akubuyisele esikhundleni sakho, uzomnika indebe yakhe esandleni, njengoba wawenza ngesikhathi usengumphathindebe.
Uze ungikhumbule uma izinto sezikuhambela kahle, ungenzele umusa, uliphathe igama lami kuFaro, ukuze ngiphume kule ndawo.
Ngokuba empeleni ngathunjwa ezweni lamaHebheru, nalapha angenzanga lutho olufanele ukuba bangifake kulo mgodi.”
Lapho induna yababhakizinkwa ibona ukuthi incazelo ibe yinhle, yathi kuJosefa: “Nami ephusheni lami bekunamaqoma amathathu ezinkwa ezimhlophe ekhanda lami.
Eqomeni elingaphezulu bekukhona yonke inhlobo yokudla kukaFaro, kodwa izinyoni bezikudla kuleli qoma ebelisekhanda lami.”
UJosefa waphendula wathi: “Nansi incazelo yalo: amaqoma amathathu ayizinsuku ezintathu;
ezinsukwini ezintathu uFaro uzokunquma ikhanda, akuphanyeke esigxotsheni, izinyoni zezulu zidle inyama yakho.”
Kwathi ngosuku lwesithathu, okwakulusuku lokuzalwa kukaFaro, uFaro wenzela zonke izinceku zakhe idili. Waphakamisa phambi kwazo izikhulu zakhe, induna yabaphathindebe, nenduna yababhakizinkwa.
Wayibuyisela induna yabaphathindebe esikhundleni sayo, yabuye yanika uFaro indebe esandleni,
kodwa induna yababhakizinkwa wayiphanyeka, njengoba uJosefa ayebachazele amaphupho abo.
Nokho induna yabaphathindebe ayimkhumbulanga uJosefa; yamkhohlwa.
Emva kweminyaka emibili, uFaro waphupha emi ngasemfuleni.
Kwase kwenyuka emfuleni izinkomazi eziyisikhombisa ezibukeka kahle, zikhuluphele, zadla emhlangeni.
Kwaphinde kwenyuka emfuleni ezinye izinkomazi eziyisikhombisa, ezazibukeka kabi, zondile, zema eduze kwalezo ezazisosebeni lomfula.
Kwathi lezo ezibukeka kabi ezondileyo zadla lezo ezibukeka kahle ezondlekileyo. Wayesephaphama uFaro.
Walala, wabuye waphupha okwesibili. Bheka, kwahluma izikhwebu eziyisikhombisa ohlangeni olulodwa, zizinhle, futhi sezivuthiwe.
Wabona kuhluma ezinye izikhwebu eziyisikhombisa eziyiminconco, zizacile, futhi zishiswe ngumoya weshisandlu wasempumalanga.
Izikhwebu eziyisikhombisa ezizacileyo zagwinya izikhwebu eziyisikhombisa ezinhle nezivuthiweyo. Wayesephaphama uFaro; bheka, kwakuyiphupho.
Ekuseni uFaro wakhathazeka emoyeni wakhe, wathumela ukuba kubizwe zonke izanusi, nazo zonke izihlakaniphi zaseGibhithe, wabatshela ngamaphupho akhe, kodwa akekho namunye owakwazi ukumchazela wona.
Induna yabaphathindebe kaFaro yathi kuye: “Namhlanje ngiyawakhumbula amacala ami.
UFaro wayezithukuthelele izinceku zakhe, mina nenduna yababhakizinkwa wasigquma ejele, endlini yomphathi wabaqaphi.
Ngabusuku bunye saphupha, yilowo nalowo iphupho elinencazelo eyehlukile kwelomunye.
Kwakukhona lapho kanye nathi ibhungu lomHebheru, isigqila senduna yabalindi benkosi. Salilandisa ngamaphupho ethu, lawachaza, yilelo ngokwencazelo yalo,
kwaba njengoba lalishilo, mina ngabuyiselwa esikhundleni sami, kwathi induna yababhakizinkwa yaphanyekwa.”
UFaro wathumela ukuba kubizwe uJosefa, bashesha bamkhipha emgodini, wagunda, wagqoka izingubo ezihlanzekileyo, wayeseya kuFaro.
UFaro wathi kuJosefa: “Ngiphuphile, kodwa akekho umuntu okwazi ukungichazela. Ngizwile ngawe ukuthi kuyothi uma ulizwa leli phupho bese ungichazela.”
UJosefa wamphendula uFaro, wathi: “Angikwazi ukukwenza lokho; nguNkulunkulu ozochazela uFaro ngendlela egculisayo.”
UFaro wayesethi kuJosefa: “Ngiphuphe ngimi osebeni lomfula iNayili;
kwakhuphuka emfuleni izinkomazi eziyisikhombisa ezibukeka kahle ezikhulupheleyo, zaklaba emhlangeni.
Emva kwazo kwase kukhuphuka ezinye izinkomazi eziyisikhombisa ezondileyo zibukeka kabi. Angikaze ngizibone izinkomazi ezimbi ngale ndlela kulo lonke iGibhithe.
Izinkomazi ezondileyo, ezibukeka kabi, zadla lezi zokuqala ezikhulupheleyo.
Kuthe sezizidlile, akwabonakala mehluko wokuthi kukhona ezikudlileyo, zazibukeka zizimbi njengakuqala. Ngase ngiphaphama.”
“Ngabuye ngabona ephusheni izikhwebu eziyisikhombisa zibelethwe wuhlanga olulodwa, ziphelele, zizinhle.
Ngabuye ngabona kuhluma ezinye izikhwebu eziyisikhombisa emva kwazo, zizacile, zishiswe ngumoya weshisandlu wasempumalanga.
Izikhwebu eziyisikhombisa ezizacileyo zagwinya lezo ezinhle. Ngizazisile izanusi ngalawa maphupho, kodwa asikho esingichazele wona.”
UJosefa wayesethi kuFaro: “Iphupho likaFaro lilodwa. UNkulunkulu umambulele uFaro ngezinto azozenza.
Izinkomazi eziyisikhombisa ezinhle ziyiminyaka eyisikhombisa, nezikhwebu eziyisikhombisa ezinhle ziyiminyaka eyisikhombisa. Yiphupho elilodwa lelo.

Izinkomazi eziyisikhombisa ezondileyo nezibukeka kabi ezakhuphuka emva kwezinye, ziyiminyaka eyisikhombisa, kanjalo nezikhwebu eziyisikhombisa ezizacileyo, zashiswa ngumoya weshisandlu wasempumalanga, ziyiminyaka eyisikhombisa yendlala.
Lokhu engikushilo kuFaro, yilokho uNkulunkulu azokwenza, futhi umembulele khona uFaro.
Uyabona-ke, kuzoba khona iminyaka eyisikhombisa yenala kulo lonke iGibhithe.
Kuyolandela iminyaka eyisikhombisa yendlala, eyokwenza iminyaka yenala ikhohlweke eGibhithe, iyolikhahlameza kakhulu lonke izwe.
Akusayukukhumbuleka ukuthi kwake kwaba khona inala ngenxa yendlala elandelayo, eyoba nzima kakhulu ezweni.
Isizathu sokuba liphindwe kabili iphupho kuFaro ngukuthi uNkulunkulu usekunqumile lokhu, futhi uzosheshe akwenze.
Ngakho-ke uFaro makafune umuntu okhaliphileyo, nokwazi ukuhluza izinto, ambeke phezu kwalo lonke iGibhithe.
UFaro makenze kanjalo, aqoke izibonda zengamele lonke iGibhithe, ukuze ziqokelele ingxenye eyodwa kweziyisihlanu yesivuno esizotholakala kule minyaka eyisikhombisa yenala.
Mabaqokelele konke ukudla kule minyaka emihle yenala, bakugcine ezinqolobaneni phansi kwesandla sikaFaro, bakulondoloze emizini.
Lokhu kudla kufanele kulondolozelwe izwe lonke ukuze likwazi ukubhekana neminyaka eyisikhombisa yendlala, ezokhungatha iGibhithe, ngaleyo ndlela izwe lingashatshalaliswa yindlala.”
Lezwakala liphusile lelo qhinga kuFaro nakuzo zonke izinceku zakhe.
UFaro wazibuza izinceku wathi: “Singamtholaphi umuntu onjalo, onoMoya kaNkulunkulu na?”
UFaro wayesethi kuJosefa: “Njengalokhu uNkulunkulu ekwambulele konke lokhu, akekho omunye okwazi ukuhlaziya izinto nohlakaniphe njengawe.
Uzokwengamela isigodlo sami, nesizwe sami sonke siyokwenza njengoba usiyala; yimi kuphela ngokwesikhundla sami sobukhosi engizoba mkhulu kunawe.”
UFaro wathi kuJosefa: “Uyabona-ke, ngikubeka phezu kwalo lonke iGibhithe.”
UFaro wakhumula indandatho yakhe yokusicilela esandleni sakhe, wayifaka esandleni sikaJosefa, wamembathisa izembatho zelineni elicolekileyo, wamfaka nomgexo wegolide entanyeni.
Wamgibelisa enqoleni yempi egitshelwa yilowo ongowesibili emva kwakhe, bamemeza phambi kwakhe, bathi: “Guqani!” UFaro wambeka ngaleyo ndlela-ke uJosefa, ukuba abe ngumbusi walo lonke iGibhithe.
UFaro wathi kuJosefa: “Mina nginguFaro, kodwa ngaphandle kwemvume yakho akukho muntu oyophakamisa isandla, noma unyawo kulo lonke iGibhithe.”
UFaro wamqamba uJosefa ngokuthi unguZafenathi Phaneya, wayesemganisela u-Asenathi indodakazi kaPotifera, umphristi wase-Oni. UJosefa walithola kanjalo igunya phezu kwalo lonke iGibhithe.
UJosefa wayeneminyaka engama-30 ngesikhathi eqala ukusebenzela uFaro inkosi yaseGibhithe. UJosefa waphuma phambi kukaFaro, wahamba kulo lonke iGibhithe.
Ngaleyo minyaka eyisikhombisa yenala izwe lathela ukudla okuningi kakhulu.
UJosefa wakuqoqa konke ukudla okwatholakala ngaleyo minyaka eyisikhombisa yenala, wakulondoloza emizini: kwakungukudla okwakuvunwe emasimini azungeze yilowo nalowo muzi.
UJosefa waqoqa ukudla okusanhlamvu okwaba kuningi njengesihlabathi ogwini lolwandle, wayeka ukukubala, ngokuba kwakungasenakubalwa.
U-Asenathi, indodakazi kaPotifera, umphristi wase-Oni, wamzalela uJosefa amadodana amabili, ingakaqali iminyaka eyisikhombisa yendlala.
UJosefa waliqamba izibulo lakhe wathi nguManase, ngokuba ethi: “UNkulunkulu ungenze ngakukhohlwa ukuhlupheka kwami nendlu yonke kababa.”
Eyesibili indodana wayiqamba wathi ngu-Efrayimi, ngokuba ethi: “UNkulunkulu ungandisile ezweni lokuhlupheka kwami.”
Yaphela iminyaka eyisikhombisa yenala eyayikhona eGibhithe.
Iminyaka eyisikhombisa yendlala yaqala njengoba uJosefa ayeshilo. Kwaba nendlala kulo lonke izwe, kodwa eGibhithe kwakukhona ukudla.
Kwathi lapho indlala isiqala ukuzwela naseGibhithe, abantu bakhala kuFaro becela ukudla. UFaro wabatshela bonke abaseGibhithe wathi: “Hambani niye kuJosefa, nikwenze konke anitshela khona.”
Indlala yayisezweni lonke, ngakho-ke uJosefa wazivula zonke izinqolobane, wathengisela abaseGibhithe, ngokuba indlala yayisidlangile naseGibhithe.
Amazwe onke aya eGibhithe ukuyothenga ukudla kuJosefa, ngokuba indlala yayisinzima emhlabeni wonke.
UJakobe wezwa ukuthi kukhona ukudla eGibhithe, wayesethi emadodaneni akhe: “Kungani nilibele ukubukana na?”
Wathi: “Bhekani, ngizwile ukuthi kukhona ukudla eGibhithe. Yehlani, nisithengele okusanhlamvu khona, ukuze siphile, singafi.”
Abafowabo bakaJosefa abalishumi behla bayothenga okusanhlamvu eGibhithe.
Kepha uJakobe akamthumelanga uBhenjamini, ongumnawabo kaJosefa kanye nabo, ngokuba wathi: “Funa ehlelwe yingozi.”
Amadodana ka-Israyeli afika ukuzothenga ukudla ehambisana nabaningi ababezothenga, ngokuba indlala yayidlangile kulo lonke iKhanani.
UJosefa wayengumbusi ezweni, ethengisela bonke abantu bezwe, nabafowabo bafika, bamkhothamela bathi mbo ngobuso emhlabathini.
UJosefa wababona abafowabo, kodwa wazishaya ongabaziyo, wakhuluma nabo ngesankahlu, wathi: “Nivelaphi nina?” Bamphendula bathi: “Sivela eKhanani, sizothenga ukudla.”
UJosefa wababona abafowabo, kodwa bona abambonanga.
UJosefa wawakhumbula amaphupho ayewaphuphile. Wayesethi kubo: “Niyizinhloli, nize ukuzohlola ukuthi leli lizwe lintenga ngakuphi.”
Bamphendula bathi: “Qha nkosi, izinceku zakho zize ukuzothenga ukudla.
Sonke singamadodana endoda eyodwa, singabantu abaqotho, asiyizo izinhloli.”
Wathi kubo: “Qha, nize ukuzohlola izwe ukuthi lintengantenga kuphi.”
Bazilandulela bathi: “Izinceku zakho ziyizelamani ezili-12, zingamadodana endoda eyodwa, eyakhe eKhanani, uthunjana usele nobaba, omunye akasekho.”
UJosefa wayesethi kubo: “Kunjengoba ngishilo kini ukuthi niyizinhloli.
Ngimfunge uFaro, nizovivinywa ngalokhu, ngeke nihambe uma umfowenu omncane engafiki lapha.
Thumelani omunye wenu ukuba amlande umfowenu. Nina nonke nizoboshwa ukuze kubonakale ukuthi enikushilo kuyiqiniso yini; uma kungenjalo, ngimfunge uFaro, niyizinhloli.”
Wabagquma bonke ejele izinsuku ezintathu.
Ngosuku lwesithathu uJosefa wathi kubo: “Yenzani lokhu ukuze niphile, ngokuba ngingumuntu omesabayo uNkulunkulu.
Uma niqotho, makusale oyedwa wenu endlini yokulinda, nina nibuyele emuva emindenini yenu nokudla.
Kufanele nilethe umfowenu omncane ukuze ngibe nesiqiniseko sokuthi amazwi enu ayiqiniso; ningafi.” Nebala benza kanjalo.
Base behlanganisa amakhanda, bavumelana bathi: “Impela sinecala ngomfowethu, salubona usizi enhliziyweni yakhe, esincenga ukuba simhawukele, kodwa asimlalelanga, yingakho sivelelwa yinkathazo enje.”
URubeni wabaphendula wathi: “Angishongo yini ukuthi: ‘Ningakwenzi okuyisono kumfana,’ nangangilalela na? Manje igazi lakhe selifuneka kithi.”
Babengazi ukuthi uJosefa uyabezwa ngenxa yokuba kwakukhona ohumushayo phakathi kwabo.
Wabafulathela, wakhala; wabuye waphindela kubo, wakhuluma nabo, wayesesusa uSimeyoni kubo, waboshwa bebuka.
UJosefa wayala ukuba kugcwaliswe amasaka abo ngokusanhlamvu, futhi babuyiselwe imali emasakeni abo, baphiwe nomphako. Kwenziwa kanjalo kubo.
Bazethwesa izimbongolo zabo okusanhlamvu, base beqala uhambo lwabo.
Omunye kuthe evula isaka lakhe esikhungweni sokulala ukuba anike imbongolo yakhe ukudla, wafica imali yakhe emlonyeni wesaka.
Wathi kubafowabo: “Imali yami ibuyiselwe kimi, nansi esakeni lami.” Baphelelwa ngamandla, baqhaqhazela, babukana, bathi: “Yini lena uNkulunkulu asenza yona na?”
Sebefike kuyise uJakobe eKhanani, bamlandisa ngakho konke okwakubehlele, bathi:
“Leya ndoda engumbusi wezwe ikhulume nathi ngesihluku, yasibiza ngezinhloli ezizohlola izwe.
Sathi kuyo: ‘Siqotho thina, asizona izinhloli.
Siyizelamani ezili-12, amadodana endoda eyodwa, enye ayisekho, uthunjana kumanje usele nobaba eKhanani.’
Lowo muntu oyinkosi yalelo lizwe, wathi kithi: ‘Shiyani kimi omunye umfowenu, nihambe, nithathele imindeni yenu ukudla.
Uma senimlethile umfowenu omncane kimi, ngiyokwazi ukuthi aniyizo izinhloli, nokuthi ningamadoda aqotho; ngakho-ke ngiyobe sengininika umfowenu nihambe naye kuleli lizwe.’ ”

Kuthe lapho sebethulula amasaka abo, bamangala bonke lapho bebona ukuthi isikhwama semali salowo nalowo sisesakeni. Lapho bona noyise bebona ukuthi isikhwama salowo nalowo sisesakeni lakhe, bashaywa wuvalo.
Uyise uJakobe wayesethi kubo: “Niyangephuca abantwana bami; uJosefa akasekho, noSimeyoni akasekho, manje senifuna ukuthatha noBhenjamini; konke lokhu kungaphezu kwamandla ami.”
URubeni wathi kuyise: “Uma ngingambuyiseli kuwe, bulala amadodana ami omabili, kodwa manje mnikele esandleni sami, ngizombuyisela kuwe.”
UJakobe wathi: “Indodana yami ayiyukwehla nani, ngokuba umfowabo ufile, manje nguye yedwa osele, uma ehlelwa yingozi endleleni, niyokwenza ukuba ngiye kwelabafileyo nginomunyu.”
Indlala yayisalokhu idlangile ezweni.
Kuthe sekuphelile okusanhlamvu ababekade bekulande eGibhithe, uyise wathi kubo: “Phindelani niyosithengela okunye ukudla.”
UJuda wathi kuye: “Lowaya muntu waseGibhithe wafunga wagomela, wathi: ‘Ngeke nibubone ubuso bami ngaphandle kokuba nibuye nomfowenu.’
Uma umthumela nathi, siyakwehla sithenge ukudla.
Kepha uma ungamdedeli ahambe, nathi asiyi ndawo, ngoba lowaya muntu wasidonsa ngendlebe, wathi: ‘Ngeke nibubone ubuso bami ngaphandle kokuba nibuye nomfowenu.’ ”
U-Israyeli wababuza wathi: “Nibenzeleni lobu bubi kimi bokutshela lowo muntu ukuthi ninomunye umfowenu na?”

Bathi: “Lowaya muntu wasibuza wasiphenya nangezihlobo zethu, ethi: ‘Uyihlo usaphila yini na? Ninaye yini omunye umfowenu na?’ Thina samphendula, samtshela konke ayefuna ukukwazi. Sasingazi ukuthi angathi: ‘Lethani umfowenu.’ ”
UJuda wathi kuyise u-Israyeli: “Mdedele umfana ahambe nami, ukuze sivuke sihambe, yikhona thina sonke sizophila; singafi, thina nabantwana bethu.
Mina luqobo ngiyakuba yisibambiso sakhe; uyakumfuna kimi, uma ngingambuyisi ngimbeke phambi kwakho, lokho kuyakuba yicala lami imihla yonke yokuphila kwami,
ngokuba uma besingabambezelekanga ngabe sesibuyele kabili.”

Uyise u-Israyeli wathi kubo: “Uma kunjalo, yenzani lokhu: thathani okwekhethelo okuvela emhlabathini lapha, nikufake emasakeni enu, nifike nikuphe lowo muntu: ingcosana yebhalisamu, uju, amakha, inhlaka, amantongomane, nama-alimondi,
niphathe imali ephindwe kabili, nibuyisele leyo mali eyayifakwe emilonyeni yamasaka enu, kungenzeka ukuthi yayingene ngephutha.
Thathani umfowenu, nivuke, niphindele kulowo muntu.
Sengathi uNkulunkulu uSomandla anganenzela umusa phambi kwalowo muntu, akhulule umfowenu noBhenjamini; uma ngingafelwa ngabantwana bami, ngobe ngifile kwamina.”
Amadoda ayesethatha isipho, nemali ephindwe kabili, noBhenjamini, asuka ehlela eGibhithe, aziveza kuJosefa.
Kwathi ukuba uJosefa ambone uBhenjamini enabo, wathi enduneni eyayengamele indlu yakhe: “Ngenisa lawa madoda endlini, uhlabe, ulungise, ngokuba azodla nami emini.”
Indoda yenza njengoba uJosefa eshilo, yabangenisa endlini yakhe.

Bafikelwa yingebhe lapho bebona ukuthi bangeniswe endlini kaJosefa, bathi: “Kungenxa yemali eyabuyiselwa emasakeni ethu ekuqaleni, ngakho-ke silethwe kule ndawo ukuze asizume, asithathe asenze izigqila, aqhwage nezimbongolo zethu.”
Base beya enduneni eyayiphethe endlini kaJosefa eyayingasemnyango, bakhuluma nayo,
bathi: “Mnumzane, sicela uxolo. Safika lapha ekuqaleni sizothenga ukudla.

Kuthe lapho sesifike endlini yezihambi, sathi sivula amasaka ethu, kwaba yilowo nalowo wakhangwa yimali isemlonyeni wesaka lakhe, iphelele njengoba sasiyikhokhile, kodwa nansi ezandleni zethu siyibuyisile.
Sibuye saphatha nenye ukuze sithenge ngayo ukudla, ngokuba asazi ukuthi ngubani owafaka imali yethu emasakeni ethu.”
Yathi kubo: “Khululekani, ningesabi. UNkulunkulu wenu, uNkulunkulu kayihlo waninika umcebo emasakeni enu. Imali enathenga ngayo ngayithola.” Yayisimkhipha ejele uSimeyoni, yamletha kubo.
Induna yayisiwangenisa lawo madoda endlini kaJosefa, yawanika amanzi ukuze ageze izinyawo, yanika nezimbongolo zawo ifolishi.
Ayeselungisa isipho, alungela ukufika kukaJosefa emini, ngoba ayezwile ukuthi azodla lapho.
Kwathi lapho uJosefa efika ekhaya, amadoda ethula isipho ayefike naso, aguqa ayesethi mbo ngobuso emhlabathini.
Wawabuza impilo wathi: “Iphila kanjani indoda endala enguyihlo enangitshela ngayo na? Isawadla yini anhlamvana na?”
Bathi: “Inceku yakho ubaba ukhona, usaphila.” Baphinda bamkhothamela, bamkhulekela.

Waphakamisa amehlo, wabona umfowabo uBhenjamini, abashiyelana naye ibele, wathi: “Nguye lo umfowenu omncane enangitshela ngaye na?” Wathi kuBhenjamini: “Sengathi uNkulunkulu angaba nomusa kuwe ndodana yami.”
UJosefa wathinteka kakhulu enhliziyweni yakhe lapho ebona umnawakhe, waphuma masinyane, wafuna indawo lapho angase akhale khona. Waya endlini yakhe, wakhala lapho.
Wageza ubuso, waphuma, waziqinisa wathi: “Phakani ukudla.”
Bamphakela yedwa, base bebaphakela nabo kanjalo, nabaseGibhithe ababedla naye babaphakela ngokwabo, lokhu abaseGibhithe babengeke badle namaHebheru, ngokuba kwakuyisinengiso kubo.
Bahlaliswa phambi kwakhe ngokwelamana kwabo, izibulo ngobuzibulo balo, nomncane ngobuncane bakhe; abafowabo babhekana ngokumangala.
Baphakelwa izabelo zabo etafuleni likaJosefa, kodwa esikaBhenjamini sasiphindwe kahlanu kunezabanye. Baphuza, bathokoza naye.
UJosefa wayala induna eyayiphethe endlini yakhe, wathi: “Gcwalisa amasaka alawa madoda ngokudla ngokwamandla awo, bese uphindisela imali yawo ngayinye uyifake emilonyeni yamasaka awo.
Faka indebe yami yesiliva, nemali yokuthenga okusanhlamvu emlonyeni wesaka lomncane.” Yenza njengoba uJosefa eshilo.
Kwathi ukuba kuse, bavalelisana nalawo madoda, ayesengena indlela nezimbongolo zawo.
Esahambe ibangana ukusuka emzini, uJosefa wathi enduneni yakhe: “Suka uwalandele lawo madoda, lapho uwafica uthi kuwo: ‘Niphindiselani okuhle ngokubi na?
Akusiyo yini le indebe yenkosi yami ephuza ngayo, ibuye ibhule ngayo na? Enikwenzileyo kubi kakhulu.’ ”
Yawafica, yakhuluma kuwo lawo mazwi.
Ayesethi kuyo: “Kungani inkosi yami ikhulume amazwi anjengalawa na? Zingayenza kanjani izinceku zakho into efana naleyo na?
Bheka, imali esayithola emilonyeni yamasaka ethu, sabuya nayo sisuka eKhanani. Pho singaleba kanjani isiliva noma igolide endlini yenkosi yakho na?
Lowo ezincekwini zakho eyotholakala kuye makafe; thina sonke siyakuba yizigqila zenkosi yami.”
Yathi: “Kulungile, akuye njengamazwi enu. Lowo eyotholakala kuye uzokuba yisigqila sami, nina nonke aniyukuba nacala.”
Bawethula ngokushesha amasaka abo, bawabeka emhlabathini, bawavula, yilowo wavula isaka lakhe.
Induna yaqala ukucinga ezibulweni, yagcina ngothunjana. Indebe yatholakala esakeni likaBhenjamini.
Base beklebhula izingubo zabo, bagibelisa imithwalo ezimbongolweni, babuyela emzini.
UJuda nabafowabo bafika endlini kaJosefa, bamfica esekhona, base bezilahla phansi phambi kwakhe.
UJosefa wathi kubo: “Kuyini lokhu enikwenzileyo na? Anazi yini ukuthi umuntu onjengami uyakwazi ukubhula na?”

UJuda waphendula wathi: “Sizothini enkosini yami na? Sizakukhuluma sithini na? Sizakuzithethelela sithini na? UNkulunkulu uliveze obala icala lezinceku zakho. Bheka, silapha ukuba sibe yizigqila zenkosi yami, thina nalowo okutholakale kuye indebe.”
UJosefa wathi: “Angikwazi ukwenza into enjalo. Umuntu etholakale kuye indebe yami uzokuba yisigqila sami, nina yenyukani, nibuyele kuyihlo ngokuthula.”

UJuda wazidela amathambo, wakhuluma noJosefa wathi: “Ngicela uxolo, nkosi yami, yivumele inceku yakho ibeke libe linye nje enkosini yayo, ungayithukutheleli inceku yakho, ngokuba wena ulingana noFaro uqobo.
Inkosi yami yazibuza izinceku zayo, yathi: ‘Ninaye yini uyihlo noma umfowenu na?’
Sathi enkosini yami: ‘Sinaye ubaba osekhulile, nendodana esencane ayizala esegugile. Umfowabo sewafa, sekusele yona yodwa esiswini sikanina futhi uyise uyayithanda.’
“Wawusuthi ezincekwini zakho: ‘Mletheni kimi ukuze ngimbone.’
Sathi enkosini yami: ‘Umfana akanakumshiya uyise, ngokuba uma engamshiya, uyise angafa.’
Wathi ezincekwini zakho: ‘Uma ningezi nomfowenu omncane, ngeke niphinde nibubone ubuso bami.’
Sakhuphuka sabuyela encekwini yakho, ubaba, sambikela okushiwo yinkosi yami.
Ubaba wathi: ‘Buyelani niyosithengela ukudla.’
Thina sathi: ‘Asinakubuyela lapho uma umfowethu omncane engahambi nathi, ngokuba ngeke sibubone ubuso balowo muntu uma umfowethu omncane engekho.’
“Inceku yakho, ubaba, yathi kithi: ‘Niyazi ukuthi umkami wangizalela amadodana amabili;
omunye sewangishiya, sengize ngakuvuma ukuthi impela sewafa, wadweshulwa yisilwane sasendle, futhi angikaze ngiphinde ngimbone kuze kube namuhla lokhu.
Uma manje seningithathela nalena, bese yehlelwa yingozi, le mpunga niyoyehlisela kwelabafileyo igcwele usizi.’
“Manje uma ngibuyela encekwini yakho, ubaba, ngingabuyeli naye, lokhu inceku yakho imthanda kangaka lo mfana,
kuyothi lapho ibona ukuthi umfana akekho, ivele ife. Izinceku zakho ziyokuba yimbangela yokwehlisela le mpunga kwelabafileyo inomunyu.
Inceku yakho yethembisile kubaba ukuthi umfana uzophepha, yathi: ‘Uma ngingambuyiseli kuwe ephephile, lelo cala yimi engiyolithwala kuwe, baba, imihla yonke yokuphila kwami.’
“Ngiyacela ukuba uyivumele inceku yakho kusale yona esikhundleni somfana, ibe yisigqila sakho, kuthi umfana aphindele ekhaya nabafowabo.
Ngingabuyela kanjani kubaba engekho umfana na? Funa ngibone okubi okungahle kwehlele ubaba.”
UJosefa wayengasakwazi ukuzibamba phambi kwabo bonke ababemi naye, wakhala, wathi: “Khiphani bonke abanye abalapha phambi kwami.” Kwakungasekho muntu ngesikhathi uJosefa eziveza kubafowabo.
Wakhala kakhulu baze bezwa nabaseGibhithe, leso sililo saze safinyelela nasendlini kaFaro.
UJosefa wathi kubafowabo: “NginguJosefa. Ubaba usaphila na?” Abafowabo abakwazanga ukumphendula, ngoba babethuke kakhulu.
UJosefa wathi kubafowabo: “Sondelani kimi.” Basondela, wayesethi kubo: “NginguJosefa umfowenu, enathengisa ngaye eGibhithe.
Manje ningabe nisakhathazeka, futhi ningazisoli ngokuthi nangidayisa, ngokuba nguNkulunkulu owangithumela ukuba nginandulele ukuze ngilonde impilo.
Niyayibona le ndlala ekhona ezweni isathathe iminyaka emibili, isazoqhubeka eminye emihlanu kungalinywa, kungavunwa.
