UNkulunkulu wangithuma ukunandulela ukuze nibe yinsali emhlabeni, nisindiswe, kukhululwe abaningi.
Ngakho-ke akunina enangithuma lapha, kodwa nguNkulunkulu ongenze uyise kaFaro, nombusi ophethe endlini yakhe, naphezu kwezwe lonke iGibhithe.
“Ningabe nisapholisa maseko, yanini kubaba nifike nithi kuye: ‘UJosefa indodana yakho, ithi: uNkulunkulu ungibeke ngaba ngumbusi walo lonke iGibhithe, ungabe usalibala, yehla uze kimi.
Uyohlala eGosheni ukuze ube seduze kwami, wena nabantwana bakho, nabazukulu bakho, nemihlambi yakho yonke yezimvu nezinkomo, nakho konke onakho.
Ngizonondla nikuleyo ndawo, wena nabendlu yakho, nabo bonke abangabakho, ngokuba kusazokuba yiminyaka emihlanu indlala isalokhu idlangile.’ ”
“Nani niyazibonela, ngisho nomnawami uBhenjamini uyazibonela ukuthi yimina mathupha uJosefa osho lawa mazwi kini.
Nimbikele ubaba ngakho konke ukuhlonipheka kwami eGibhithe, nangakho konke enikubonileyo, bese nisheshe nimehlisa eze lapha.”
Wazilahlela entanyeni yomfowabo uBhenjamini, wakhala; noBhenjamini wakhalela entanyeni yakhe.
Wabanga bonke abafowabo ngamunye, ekhala. Emveni kwalokho abafowabo baxoxa naye.
Kwafika umbiko endlini kaFaro, othi: “Abafowabo bakaJosefa bafikile.” Kwaba kuhle lokho kuFaro nasezincekwini zakhe.
UFaro wathi kuJosefa: “Yisho kubafowenu uthi: ‘Yethwesani izimbongolo zenu, nihambe niye eKhanani,
nithathe uyihlo nemindeni yenu nize kimi, ukuze ngininike eyekhethelo eGibhithe, nitamuze okuhle kwalo.’
“Ngiyakuyala, batshele ukuthi ngithi: ‘Zithatheleni nina nomkenu nabantwana benu izinqola lapha eGibhithe, nigibelise uyihlo nize naye lapha.
Ningakhathazeki ngempahla yenu, ngokuba konke okuhle kwezwe eGibhithe kungokwenu.’ ”
Amadodana ka-Israyeli enza njengalokhu eyaliwe. UJosefa wawanika izinqola nomphako njengokusho kukaFaro.
Wabanika kwaba yilowo nalowo ingubo yokushintsha, kodwa uBhenjamini wamnika izinhlamvu zesiliva ezingama-300, nezingubo zakwanokusho ezinhlanu.
Wayesethumelela uyise lokhu: izimbongolo eziyishumi zithwele amagugu aseGibhithe, nezimbongolo eziyishumi zezinsikazi zithwele okusanhlamvu, nezinkwa nokunye okungumphako kayise.
Wayesebakhipha abafowabo, bangena indlela. Wathi kubo: “Ningaxabani endleleni.”
Base bephuma, bakhuphuka eGibhithe baze bayofinyelela kuyise uJakobe eKhanani.
Bambikela bathi: “UJosefa usaphila, ungumbusi walo lonke iGibhithe.” UJakobe waphela amandla, wakhungatheka, akaze abakholwa.
Bamlandisa konke okwakukhulunywe nguJosefa kubo, futhi wabona nezinqola ayezikhiphile ukuba zizomlanda. Waqala uJakobe ukuvuseleleka emoyeni.
U-Israyeli wathi: “Kwanele; uJosefa indodana yami usaphila. Ngizohamba ngiyombona ngingakafi.”
U-Israyeli waphuma eKhanani nakho konke ayenakho, kwathi lapho efika eBheri Sheba, wenzela uNkulunkulu kayise u-Isaka umhlatshelo.
UNkulunkulu wakhuluma ku-Israyeli ngemibono eminingi ebusuku, wathi: “Jakobe, Jakobe!” Yena wathi: “Ngilapha.”
UNkulunkulu wathi: “NginguNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu kayihlo; ungesabi ukwehlela eGibhithe, ngizokwenza ube yisizwe esikhulu lapho.
Ngizohamba nawe ukuya eGibhithe, futhi ngiyakukukhuphula lapho; yisandla sikaJosefa esiyokucimezisa.”
UJakobe wasuka eBheri Sheba, amadodana ka-Israyeli amgibelisa uyise, nabantwana bawo, nomkawo ezinqoleni ezazikhishwe nguFaro ukuba zibathwale.
Baqhuba yonke imihlambi yabo, bathatha nempahla yonke ababeyithole eKhanani, uJakobe wakhukhula naso sonke isizukulwane sakhe baze bayofika eGibhithe.
Amadodana akhe, namadodana awo, namadodakazi akhe, namadodakazi amadodana akhe, bonke abantwana bakhe nesizukulwane sakhe behla naye baya eGibhithe.
Nanka amagama abakwa-Israyeli abahamba baya eGibhithe noJakobe nesizukulwane sakhe: uRubeni, izibulo lakhe,
namadodana akhe uHanokhi, uPhalu, uHezironi noKharimi.
Amadodana kaSimeyoni kwakunguJemuweli, uJamini, u-Ohadi, uJakhini, uZoha noShawule, owayezalwa ngowesifazane ongumKhanani.
Amadodana kaLevi: nguGereshoni, uKhohathi, noMerari.
Amadodana kaJuda kungu-Eri, u-Onani, uShela, uPherezi, noZera. Kuwona u-Eri, no-Onani bafela eKhanani. Amadodana kaPherezi: kwakunguHezironi noHamuli.
Amadodana ka-Isakhari: kunguThola, uPhuva, uJashubi, noShimroni.
Amadodana kaZabuloni, kwakunguSeredi, u-Eloni, noJaleli.
Yilawo-ke amagama amadodana uLeya amzalela wona uJakobe ePhadani Aramu, noDina indodakazi yakhe. Esewonke amadodana namadodakazi kaJakobe ayengama-33.
Amadodana kaGadi: kwakunguZifiyoni, uHagi, uShuni, u-Ezibhoni, u-Eri, u-Arodi, no-Areli.
Amadodana ka-Asheri: kwakungu-Imna, u-Ishiva, u-Ishivi, uBheriya, noSera udadewabo. Amadodana kaBheriya: kwakunguHebhere noMalikhiyeli.
Yilawo-ke amagama amadodana ayeyi-16 kaZilipha, awazalela uJakobe. ULabani wayenike uLeya indodakazi yakhe uZilipha ukuba abe yisisebenzi sakhe.
Amadodana kaRaheli, umkaJakobe: kwakunguJosefa noBhenjamini.
Kuthe uJosefa eseGibhithe wazala uManase no-Efrayimi ku-Asenathi, indodakazi kaPotifera, umphristi wase-Oni.
Amadodana kaBhenjamini: kwakunguBhela, uBhekheri, u-Ashibheli, uGera, uNahamani, u-Ehi, uRoshi, uMuphimu, uHuphimu, no-Aridi.
Lawa kwakungamadodana kaRaheli ayemzalele wona uJakobe; esewonke ayeyi-14.
Indodana kaDani kwakunguHushimu.
Amadodana kaNafethali: kwakunguJahiziyeli, uGuni, uJezeri, noShilemu.
Lawo kwakungamadodana kaBhiliha, uLabani ayemunike yena uRaheli, indodakazi yakhe, esewonke ayeyisikhombisa.
Bonke abantu abangena eGibhithe noJakobe, abavela okhalo lwakhe ngaphandle kwabafazi babo, babengama-66.
Amadodana kaJosefa azalelwa eGibhithe aba mabili, ngakho-ke bonke abendlu kaJakobe abaya eGibhithe babengama-70.
UJakobe wathumela uJuda ukuthi ahambe phambili aye kuJosefa, ukuze abahole ukuya eGosheni. Ekufikeni kwabo eGosheni,
uJosefa wabophela inqola yakhe yempi, wakhuphuka, wamhlangabeza uyise u-Israyeli. UJosefa waziveza kuye, wamgona, wakhala isikhathi eside encike ehlombe lakhe.
U-Israyeli wathi kuJosefa: “Sengingafa manje njengoba sengizibonele ngawami ukuthi usawadla anhlamvana.”
UJosefa wayesethi kubafowabo nakwabendlu kayise: “Ake ngihambe ngiyobikela uFaro ukuthi abafowethu nabendlu kababa abebeseKhanani sebefikile ukuzohlala nami.
Lawa madoda angabelusi bemfuyo, amadoda anemihlambi, afike nayo yonke imfuyo yawo, nakho konke anakho.
Kuyothi lapho uFaro enibuza ethi: ‘Uyini umsebenzi wenu na?’
Niyothi: ‘Izinceku zakho selokhu kwathi nhlo zingabantu bemfuyo, thina nawobaba,’ ukuze anivumele nihlale eGosheni, ngokuba kwabaseGibhithe abelusi bayanengeka.”
UJosefa wangena, wabikela uFaro, wathi: “Ubaba nabafowethu, nemihlambi yabo yezimvu, neyezinkomo, nakho konke abanakho, sebefikile bevela eKhanani, manje sebeseGosheni.”
Wathatha abahlanu phakathi kwabafowabo wayobethula kuFaro.
UFaro wathi kubafowabo: “Uyini umsebenzi wenu na?” Bathi kuFaro: “Izinceku zakho zingabelusi bemihlambi, thina nobaba.”

Baqhubeka bathi kuFaro: “Size ukuzogogobala kuleli lizwe, ngokuba akukho madlelo emfuyo yezinceku zakho, lokhu indlala ibhokile eKhanani. Ngakho-ke izinceku zakho ziyacela ukuba uzivumele zihlale eGosheni.”
UFaro wathi kuJosefa: “Uyihlo nabafowenu beze kuwe,
iGibhithe lisezandleni zakho. Uyihlo nabafowenu bahlalise endaweni enhle ezweni, mabahlale eGosheni. Uma kukhona phakathi kwabo abanekhono lokwelusa, ubabeke babe ngabaphathi bemfuyo yami.”
UJosefa wayesemngenisa uyise, uJakobe, wamethula kuFaro. UJakobe wambusisa uFaro.
UFaro wathi kuJakobe: “Mingaki iminyaka yakho na?”

UJakobe waphendula wathi: “Izinsuku zokugogobala kwami emhlabeni seziyiminyaka eyi-130, zimfishane, kanti bezigcwele ubunzima. Kaziqhathaniseki nokho neminyaka eyaphilwa ngokhokho bami ngesikhathi eside sokugogobala kwabo.”
UJakobe wambusisa uFaro, wayesesuka phambi kukaFaro.
UJosefa wabahlalisa uyise nabafowabo, wabanika indawo eGibhithe, indawo enhle kakhulu eRamesesi njengoba uFaro ayebayalile.
UJosefa wamhlinzeka uyise, nabafowabo, nabo bonke abendlu kayise ngokudla, ngokwenani labantu abasezindlini zabo.
Kwakungekho kudla ezweni lonke, ngokuba indlala yayibhokile eGibhithe naseKhanani.
UJosefa waqoqa yonke imali eyayitholakala eGibhithe, neseKhanani, abantu ababeza ukuzothenga ngayo ukudla. Yonke leyo mali wayiyisa endlini kaFaro.
Lapho isiphelile imali eGibhithe naseKhanani, bonke abaseGibhithe beza kuJosefa, bathi: “Sinike ukudla. Yini ukuba sife ubhekile na? Isiphelile imali yethu.”
Wayesethi uJosefa: “Uma ningasenayo imali, lethani imfuyo yenu, mina ngizoninika ukudla.”
Baletha kuJosefa imfuyo yabo, imihlambi yezinkomo, izimbongolo, izimvu, izimbuzi, namahhashi, yena wabanika ukudla. Wabondla kanjalo-ke uJosefa ngalowo nyaka.

Kuthe sewuphelile lowo nyaka baphindela kuye ngonyaka olandelayo, bathi: “Singeke sikufihlele lokhu nkosi; imali, nemfuyo yethu, nezinkomo, sekuphelile; asisenalutho nkosi ngaphandle kwethu nomhlaba wethu.
Sizakufelani phambi kwakho na? Sithenge nemihlaba yethu, ukuze thina nemihlaba yethu sibe yizigqila zikaFaro, siphile, futhi sithole imbewu, singafi, nezwe lingabi yihlane.”
UJosefa wamthengela uFaro lonke iGibhithe, ngokuba bonke abaseGibhithe base bethengise ngamasimu abo ngenxa yokuba nzima kwendlala phezu kwabo; izwe lonke kwaba ngelikaFaro.
UJosefa wabasusa abantu kulo lonke iGibhithe, wabayisa emizini.
Umhlaba wabaphristi yiwo kuphela angawuthenganga, ngokuba kwakunesabelo sabaphristi esivela kuFaro. Babedla leso sabelo ababesinikwe nguFaro, yingakho bengawuthengisanga umhlaba wabo.
UJosefa wathi kubantu: “Njengoba manje uFaro sengimthengele nina nomhlaba wenu, nansi-ke imbewu yenu enizoniyihlwanyela emhlabathini.
Kuyakuthi lapho senivunile, uFaro nimnike ingxenye yesihlanu, izingxenye ezine zibe yimbewu yamasimu enu, nokudla kwenu, nokwabendlu yenu, nabantwana benu.”
Bathi: “Usisindisile, ngakho-ke masifumane umusa kuwe nkosi, siyakuba yizigqila zikaFaro.”

UJosefa wakumisa lokhu kwaba wumthetho mayelana nomhlaba eGibhithe; kusengumthetho osebenzayo nanamuhla, ukuthi ingxenye yesihlanu yezitshalo ingekaFaro. Ngumhlabathi wabaphristi kuphela ongazange ube ngokaFaro.
Abakwa-Israyeli bahlala eGibhithe eGosheni, baba nempahla eningi, bazalana, banda kakhulu.
UJakobe wahlala eGibhithe iminyaka eyi-17. Izinsuku zikaJakobe neminyaka yokuphila kwakhe emhlabeni kwaba yi-147.

Zasondela izinsuku zika-Israyeli zokuba afe, wayesebiza indodana yakhe uJosefa, wathi kuyo: “Uma ngifumene umusa emehlweni akho, ngiyakucela, faka isandla sakho phansi kwethanga lami, bese ungethembisa ukuthi uyongenzela umusa neqiniso. Uze ungangingcwabi lapha eGibhithe,
lapho sengilele kobaba, ubongithwala, ungikhiphe eGibhithe uyongingcwaba ethuneni lobaba.” UJosefa wathi: “Ngizokwenza njengoba ushilo.”
UJakobe wathi: “Funga.” Wayesefunga. U-Israyeli wayesekhothamela enhla nombhede.
Emveni kwalezo zinto uJosefa wathola umbiko othi: “Uyihlo uphathekile.” Wayesethatha amadodana akhe omabili uManase no-Efrayimi ukuyombona.
Kwabikwa kuJakobe kwathiwa: “Bheka, indodana yakho uJosefa iyeza izokubona.” U-Israyeli waziqinisa, wavuka, wahlala embhedeni.
UJakobe wathi kuJosefa: “UNkulunkulu uSomandla wabonakala kimi ngiseLuzi eKhanani, wangibusisa,
wathi kimi: ‘Ngizoyandisa inzalo yakho ibe yizinkumbi, ngikwenze izizwe eziningi, leli lizwe ngizolinika izizukulwane zakho libe yifa lazo laphakade.’
“Ngakho-ke lawa madodana akho amabili azalelwe lapha eGibhithe ngingakafiki, asengawami manje. U-Efrayimi noManase bangabami, njengoba kunjalo kuRubeni noSimeyoni.
Uma uthola amanye amadodana emva kwalawa, ayakuba ngawakho, kodwa ayakulotshwa phansi kohla lwabafowabo, ngokuba ifa lawo ayolithola kubo.
Lapho ngisesendleleni ngivela ePhadani Aramu, uRaheli wafela eKhanani kuselibangana ukufinyelela e-Efratha, ngase ngimngcwaba khona lapho eceleni kwendlela eya e-Efratha,” (eliyiBhethlehema).
U-Israyeli ebona amadodana kaJosefa, wabuza wathi: “Ngobani laba na?”
UJosefa wathi kuyise: “Ngamadodana ami uNkulunkulu angiphe wona ngikuleli lizwe.” Uyise wayesethi: “Alethe lapha ukuze ngiwabusise.”
Amehlo ka-Israyeli ayesenqundekile ngenxa yobudala, engasaboni kahle. Ngakho-ke uJosefa wawasondeza, wayeseyawanga, wawagona.
U-Israyeli wathi kuJosefa: “Ngangingasalindele ukuthi ngiyophinde ngibubone ubuso bakho. Manje bheka, uNkulunkulu ungivumele ukuba ngibone ngisho nabantwana bakho imbala.”
UJosefa wawasusa ethangeni likayise, wakhothamela emhlabathini wathi mbo ngobuso.
UJosefa wawathatha womabili, u-Efrayimi engakwesokunene eqondene nesokhohlo sika-Israyeli, uManase engakwesokhohlo eqondene nesokunene sika-Israyeli, wawasondeza kuye.

Kepha u-Israyeli welula isandla sakhe sokunene wasibeka ekhanda lika-Efrayimi, owayengomncane, wabeka isandla sokhohlo ekhanda likaManase, ephambanisa izandla zakhe ukuze asibeke kuManase owayeyizibulo.
Wambusisa uJosefa, wathi: “UNkulunkulu abahambe phambi kwakhe okhokho bami o-Abhrahama no-Isaka, uNkulunkulu obe ngumelusi wami yonke impilo yami kuze kube namuhla.
Ingelosi engihlenge ezingozini zonke, makabusise laba bafana, ukuze ngabo igama lami nelokhokho bami o-Abhrahama no-Isaka lichume njalo. Sengathi banganda babe baningi emhlabeni.”

UJosefa wabona ukuthi uyise ubeke isandla sakhe sokunene phezu kwekhanda lika-Efrayimi, akwaze kwamthokozisa lokho. Wasithatha isandla sikayise ukuba asisuse ekhanda lika-Efrayimi asibeke kwelikaManase.
UJosefa wathi kuyise: “Hhayi kanjalo baba, ngokuba lona nguye oyizibulo, beka isandla sakho sokunene ekhanda lakhe.”
UJakobe akavumanga, kodwa wathi: “Ngiyazi, ndodana yami, ngiyazi; naye uzokuba yisizwe, abe mkhulu. Nokho umnawakhe u-Efrayimi uzokuba mkhulu kunaye, izizukulwane zakhe zibe yizizwe eziningi.”

Ngakho-ke uJakobe wababusisa kanjalo ngalolo lusuku, ethi: “Ngawe u-Israyeli uyakubusisana athi: ‘UNkulunkulu makakwenze ufane no-Efrayimi noManase.’ ” UJakobe wambeka u-Efrayimi waba phambi kukaManase.
U-Israyeli wayesethi kuJosefa: “Sengizokufa, kodwa uNkulunkulu uzokuba nani, aniphindisele ezweni lokhokho benu.
Wena-ke ngikwabela okuthe xaxa kunabafowenu; ingxenye engayithatha ezandleni zama-Amori ngenkemba nangomnsalo wami.”
UJakobe wabiza amadodana akhe wathi: “Buthanani ukuze nginitshele okuzonehlela ezinsukwini ezizayo.
“Hlanganani, nilalele madodana kaJakobe, lalelani uyihlo u-Israyeli.
“Wena Rubeni uyizibulo lami, ungamandla ami, engabonakalisa ngawo ubudoda bami, uyingqongqo, unesithunzi, ingqongqo enamandla ukubedlula bonke.
Ubikizela njengamanzi omfula, kodwa ngeke usaba yingqongqo, ngoba wakhwela embhedeni kayihlo, wawungcolisa; wakhwela embhedeni wami.
“USimeyoni noLevi yizelamani, izinkemba zabo ziyizikhali zobudlova.
Umphefumulo wami mawungangeni emkhandlwini wabo, ungazibandakanyi nomgwamanda wabo, ngoba ekuthukutheleni kwabo babulala abantu, bagenca izinkabi imisipha.
Maluqalekiswe ulaka lwabo ngokuba luyavutha, nentukuthelo yabo ngokuba iwunya. Ngizobehlukanisela kwaJakobe, ngibahlakazele kwa-Israyeli.
“Juda, abafowenu bayokudumisa. Isandla sakho siyohlala entanyeni yezitha zakho, amadodana kayihlo akukhothamele.
UJuda uyibhongo lengonyama. Wenyuke empangweni ndodana yami. Uguqe, wacutha njengengonyama nanjengengonyamakazi, ngubani ongake akuvuse na?
Intonga yobukhosi ngeke isuke kuJuda, nodondolo lombuso ngeke lugudluzwe phakathi kwezinyawo zakhe, kuze kufike lowo ubukhosi obungobakhe; nezizwe ziyakumlalela.
Ubophela ithole lembongolo yakhe emvinini, nethole lembongolo emvinini wekhethelo. Uhlanza izingubo zakhe ewayinini, nezambatho zakhe ngegazi lezithelo zomvini.
Amehlo akhe ayakuba bomvu yiwayini, amazinyo akhe abe mhlophe kunobisi.
“UZabuloni uyokwakha ngasogwini lolwandle, abe ngasechwebeni lemikhumbi, imingcele yakhe iyoze ishaye eSidoni.
“U-Isakhari uyimbongolo enamandla, elala phakathi kwezibaya.
Uzothi angabona ukuthi izwe lihle, liyindawo yokuphumula, athobise ihlombe lakhe, ukuze athwale umthwalo, aphenduke isigqila esingakhokhelwa.
“UDani uyohola abantu bakhe njengesinye sezizwana zakwa-Israyeli.
UDani uyoba yinyoka ngasendleleni, ihobosha emzileni eliluma izithende zehhashi, ukuze umgibeli walo awe nyovane.
Nkulunkulu, ngiyilindele ngokulangazelela insindiso yakho.
“UGadi uyogaselwa yiviyo, kodwa yena uyolihlasela selibaleka.
“U-Asheri uyokudla okunonileyo, akhiqize ukudla okufanele amakhosi.
“UNafethali uyindluzelekazi ekhululekileyo, ekhuluma amazwi amnandi.
“UJosefa ungumuthi othelayo, ongasesiphethwini, omagatsha awo akhwela odongeni.
Abacibayo bamhlasela kanzima, bembambele amagqubu, futhi bangamaciko okuciba.
Nokho wawubamba umcibisholo wakhe, zaqiniswa izingalo zakhe ngonaMandla kaJakobe, okuvela kuye uMelusi oyidwala lika-Israyeli,
ngoNkulunkulu kayihlo ozokusiza, ngoSomandla ozokubusisa ngezibusiso zasezulwini phezulu, nezibusiso zasemajukujukwini omhlaba, nangezibusiso zamabele nezesibeletho.
Izibusiso zikayihlo ziqinile kunezibusiso zokhokho bami, zifinyelela ezintabeni zaphakade. Sengathi lezi zibusiso, zingehlela ekhanda likaJosefa, nasebunzini lakhe owehlukaniswa kubafowabo.
“UBhenjamini uyimpisi entwengulayo; ekuseni udla akubambileyo, kusihlwa ahlukanise akuphangileyo.”
Bonke laba yizizwana ezili-12 zakwa-Israyeli. Yilokho uyise akukhuluma ngesikhathi ebabusisa, ebusisa yilowo nalowo ngesibusiso esimfaneleyo.
UJakobe wabayala, wathi: “Sengizokufa ngingcwatshwe nobabamkhulu. Ngimbeleni nokhokho bami emgedeni osensimini ka-Efroni, umHithi,
emgedeni osensimini eMakhaphela eseduze kweMamre eKhanani, ensimini u-Abhrahama ayithenga ku-Efroni, umHithi, ukuba ibe yindawo yokungcwaba.
Kulapho u-Abhrahama noSara umkakhe bangcwatshwa khona, kulapho futhi no-Isaka nomkakhe uRibheka bengcwatshwe khona, nami ngamngcwaba lapho uLeya.
Insimu nomgede okuyo kwathengwa kumaHithi.”
Lapho uJakobe eseqedile ukukhuluma namadodana akhe, wagoqa izinyawo wazikhweza embhedeni, waphuma umphefumulo, wangcwatshwa nabakubo.
UJosefa waziphonsa phezu kukayise, wakhala, wamanga.
Wayeseyala izinceku zakhe eziyizinyanga ukuba zigqumise isidumbu sikayise ngemithi. Izinyanga zamgqumisa-ke u-Israyeli ngemithi.
Kwaphela izinsuku ezingama-40, okuyizinsuku zokugqumisa. AbaseGibhithe bamlilela izinsuku ezingama-70.
Sezedlule izinsuku zokumlilela uJakobe, uJosefa wakhuluma kwabendlu kaFaro, wathi: “Uma ngifumene umusa emehlweni enu, nginxuseleni kuFaro, nithi:
‘Ubaba wangifungisa wathi: “Sengizokufa. Uyabona-ke, ubongingcwaba ethuneni lami engazimbela lona eKhanani.” Bengicela ukuba ngidedelwe ngihambe ngiyongcwaba ubaba, bese ngibuya.’ ”
UFaro wathi: “Khuphuka uyongcwaba uyihlo njengalokhu akufungisa.”
UJosefa wakhuphuka wayofihla uyise, waphelezelwa yizinceku zikaFaro, nezikhulu zonke zendlu yakhe, nazo zonke izikhulu zaseGibhithe.
Kwaphuma nabendlu kaJosefa, abafowabo, nabendlu kayise, kwasala kuphela abantwana babo, nezimvu, nezinkomo zabo eGosheni.
Kwakhuphuka ngisho namabutho agibele izinqola zempi, nagibele amahhashi, kwaba yisixuku esikhulu kakhulu.
Kwathi lapho befika eGoreni Hathadi elingaphesheya komfula iJordani, kwasuka esinamathambo, bakhihla isililo, kwaba muncu. UJosefa wamlilela uyise izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.

Abakhileyo eKhanani bezwa leso sililo eGoreni Hathadi, bathi: “Saze sasikhulu isililo sabantu baseGibhithe bo!” Ngakho-ke bayiqamba leyo ndawo engaphesheya komfula iJordani ngokuthi kuse-Abeli Mizirayimi, okusho ukuthi yiSililo sabaseGibhithe.
Amadodana ka-Israyeli enza konke ayeyalwe ngakho nguyise.
Amadodana akhe amthatha uyise amyisa eKhanani, amngcwaba emgedeni osensimini eMakhaphela, u-Abhrahama ayewuthenge nensimu ku-Efroni umHithi, ukuze ube yindawo yokungcwaba, eduze naseMamre.
UJosefa wangcwaba uyise, qede wabuyela eGibhithe, nabafowabo, nabo bonke ababekhuphuke naye ukuyongcwaba uyise.
Kuthe ukuba abafowabo bakaJosefa babone ukuthi uyise usefile, bathi: “Mhlawumbe uJosefa usasibambele igqubu, funa azame ukuziphindiselela kithi ngabo bonke ububi esabenza kuye.”
Base bethumela kuJosefa, bathi: “Uyihlo washiya umyalelo engakafi, wathi:

‘Anotshela uJosefa ukuthi: ngiyakuncenga ukuba uxolele abafowenu isiphambeko sabo nesono sabo, ngokuba benza okubi kuwe.’ Manje siyakunxusa ukuba uxolele isiphambeko sezinceku zikaNkulunkulu kayihlo.” Kwathi ukuba lowo myalezo ufike kuJosefa, wakhala.
Abafowabo bafika kuye mathupha, bazilahla phansi phambi kwakhe, bathi: “Siyizinceku zakho.”
UJosefa wathi kubo: “Ningesabi. Kanti nginguNkulunkulu yini na?
Nakuba nangakhela uzungu nifuna ukungenzakalisa, kodwa uNkulunkulu wayehlose okuhle, ukuze namuhla kusindiswe izinkumbi zabantu.
Ngakho-ke ningesabi, ngizoninakekela nina nabantwana benu.” Wabaduduza ngokukhuluma nabo kanjalo.
UJosefa wahlala eGibhithe nabo bonke abendlu kayise. Waphila waze waba neminyaka eyi-110,
waze wabona ngisho isizukulwane sesithathu sabantwana baka-Efrayimi; nabantwana bakaMakhiri indodana kaManase, wabagona ethangeni lakhe besanda kuzalwa.
UJosefa wathi kubafowabo: “Sengizokufa mina, kodwa uNkulunkulu akasoze anilibala nakanye, uyonikhuphula kuleli lizwe, aniphindisele ezweni alethembisa ngesifungo ko-Abhrahama, no-Isaka, noJakobe.”
UJosefa wawafungisa amadodana ka-Israyeli, wathi: “UNkulunkulu uzakunihambela impela, anowakhuphula amathambo ami kule ndawo.”
UJosefa wafa eseqede iminyaka eyi-110, abantu bamgqumisa ngemithi, wayesefakwa ebhokisini lomngcwabo eGibhithe.
Lawa ngamagama amadodana ka-Israyeli afika noJakobe eGibhithe; yileyo naleyo nabedlu yayo:
uRubeni, uSimeyoni, uLevi, uJuda,
u-Isakhari, uZebuloni, uBhenjamini,
uDani, uNafethali, uGadi, no-Asheri.
Sebebonke abaphuma okhalo lukaJakobe babengabantu abangama-70. UJosefa wayevele eseseGibhithe.
UJosefa wafa, kwafa nabo bonke abafowabo, naso sonke leso sizukulwane.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli bazalana, banda, bachuma, baba namandla amakhulu; izwe lagcwala bona.
Kwaba khona inkosi entsha eGibhithe eyayingamazi uJosefa.
Yathi kubantu bayo: “Bhekani, abakwa-Israyeli sebebaningi kakhulu, futhi banamandla kunathi.
Masibaphathe ngesihluku, ngaphandle kwalokho bazokwanda kakhulu, bese kuthi uma kusuka impi bahlangane nezitha zethu, balwe nathi, qede bahambe kuleli lizwe.”
AbaseGibhithe baqoka abaphathi bezigqila ukuze babagqilaze abantu bakwa-Israyeli ngokubaphoqa ukwenza umsebenzi onzima, bamakhele uFaro imizi yokugcina izinto ePhithomi naseRamesesi.
Kwathi lapho bebacindezela, banda kakhulu, basabalala abantu bakwa-Israyeli; abaseGibhithe baqala ukubesaba.
AbaseGibhithe babagqilaza kanzima abantu bakwa-Israyeli,
benza impilo yabo yaba muncu ngokubasebenzisa kanzima odakeni nasezitinini, nasemisebenzini yonke emasimini. Babaphatha ngendlakadla enkulu kukho konke ababebenzisa khona.
Inkosi yaseGibhithe yathi kubabelethisi bamaHebheru, okwakungoShifira noPhuwa:
“Lapho nibelethisa abesifazane bamaHebheru sebesesigqikini sokubeletha, nibona ukuthi ngumfana, niyakumbulala, kodwa uma kuyintombazane niyiyeke iphile.”
Kepha ababelethisi babemesaba uNkulunkulu, abazange benze njengokuyala kwenkosi yaseGibhithe, kodwa babayeka abafana baphila.
Inkosi yaseGibhithe yababiza ababelethisi yathi kubo: “Nikwenzeleni lokhu, nayeka abafana ukuba baphile na?”
Ababelethisi bathi kuFaro: “Kungoba abesifazane bamaHebheru kabafani nabesifazane baseGibhithe; banamandla, kuthi engakafiki umbelethisi kubo, babe sebebelethile.”
UNkulunkulu wabenzela okuhle ababelethisi; abantu banda, baba namandla amakhulu.
Ngokuba ababelethisi bamesaba uNkulunkulu wabapha nabo imindeni.
UFaro wayeseyala bonke abantu bakhe wathi: “Bonke abafana abazozalwa ngamaHebheru kufanele baphonswe emfuleni, kodwa amantombazane niwayeke aphile.”
Kwasuka indoda kwabendlu kaLevi yaganwa yindodakazi kaLevi.
Wakhulelwa lowo wesifazane wazala indodana; kwathi lapho eyibona ukuthi yinhle, wayifihla izinyanga ezintathu.
Kuthe lapho engasakwazi ukuyifihla wayithatha wayifaka ebhokisini elaliphicwe ngekhwani, lahuqwa ngebhithumeni nekoliyati, walibeka emhlangeni owawusosebeni lomfula.
Udadewabo wema buqamama ukuze abone ukuthi kuzokwenzekani kuye.
Kwase kwehla indodakazi kaFaro iyogeza emfuleni, abaphelezeli bayo bagudla osebeni lomfula; yayisibona ubhasikidi emhlangeni, yayisithumela umsizi wayo ukuyowulanda.
Kwathi lapho iwuvula yabona; bheka, kwakungumfana; wayekhala. Yamhawukela, yayisithi: “Lona ngomunye wezingane zamaHebheru.”
Udadewabo wathi endodakazini kaFaro: “Ngihambe yini ngiyokulandela umzanyana kwabesifazane bamaHebheru ukuba akuncelisele yona na?”
Indodakazi kaFaro yathi kuye: “Hamba.” Intombazane yahamba yayobiza unina wengane.
Indodakazi kaFaro yathi kuye: “Thatha lo mntwana uyongincelisela yena, ngizokukhokhela.” Owesifazane wamthatha umntwana wamncelisa.
Umntwana wakhula, wayesemyisa endodakazini kaFaro, waba yindodana yayo; yamqamba ngokuthi nguMose, ngokuba yathi: “Ngamkhipha emanzini.”
Langa limbe uMose esekhulile, waya kubantu bakubo, wabubona ubunzima ababebuthwele; wabona umGibhithe eshaya umHebheru ongomunye wabantu bakubo.
Waqalaza ngapha nangapha, wangabona muntu, wayesembulala umGibhithe, wamfihla esihlabathini.
Ngakusasa lapho ephuma, nanka amadoda amabili amaHebheru elwa; wayesethi kuleyo ndoda eyayonile: “Umshayelani umfowenu na?”
Yaphendula yathi: “Ngubani okubeke inkosi nomehluleli phezu kwethu na? Ufuna ukungibulala njengalokhu ubulele umGibhithe na?” UMose wayesesaba, wacabanga wathi: “Impela lokhu sekuyaziwa.”
Lapho uFaro esezwile ngalokho wafuna ukumbulala uMose. Kepha uMose wabaleka phambi kukaFaro, wayohlala kwaMidiyani, wahlala phansi eduze komthombo.
Kwakukhona umphristi kwaMidiyani owayenamadodakazi ayisikhombisa; eza ezokukha amanzi, ukuba agcwalise imikhombe ukuze imfuyo kayise iphuze.
Abelusi bafika bawaxosha, kodwa uMose wasukuma wawasiza, wawuphuzisa umhlambi wawo.
Lapho efika kuyise uRehuweli, wathi kuwo: “Yini eyenze nabuya masinya namuhla na?”
Athi kuye: “UmGibhithe usikhululile esandleni sabelusi, wabuye wasikhelela amanzi, wawuphuzisa nomhlambi.”
Wathi emadodakazini akhe: “Pho uphi na? Nimshiyeleni? Mbizeni ukuze azokudla.”
UMose wavuma ukuhlala nalowo muntu. Waganisela uMose indodakazi yakhe uZiphora.
Wazala indodana wayibiza ngokuthi nguGereshomu, ngokuba ethi: “Ngingumfokazi ezweni labezizwe.”
Sekwedlule izinsuku eziningi, inkosi yaseGibhithe yakhothama. Abantu bakwa-Israyeli babubula ngenxa yokucindezelwa, bakhala benxusa, ukukhala kwabo kwafinyelela kuNkulunkulu.
UNkulunkulu wakuzwa ukububula kwabo, wayesesikhumbula isivumelwano ayesenze no-Abhrahama, no-Isaka, noJakobe.
UNkulunkulu wababheka abantu bakwa-Israyeli, futhi wabanakekela.
UMose wayelusa umhlambi womukhwe wakhe uJethro, umphristi wakwaMidiyani. Wawuqhuba wedlula ehlane, waze wayofika eHorebhe entabeni kaNkulunkulu.
Ingelosi kaSimakade yabonakala kuye elangabini lomlilo phakathi kwesihlahla. Wabona ukuthi isihlahla siyavutha, kodwa asipheli.
UMose wathi: “Ake ngichezuke ukuze ngibone lesi simangaliso esingaka, ukuthi kungani isihlahla singashi.”
Lapho uSimakade ebona ukuthi uchezukile ukuyobheka, uNkulunkulu wambiza esesihlahleni, wathi: “Mose, Mose!” Yena wathi: “Ngilapha.”
UNkulunkulu wathi: “Ungasondeli lapha; khumula izimbadada ezinyaweni zakho, ngokuba indawo omi kuyo ingumhlabathi ongcwele.”
Wayesethi: “NginguNkulunkulu kayihlo, uNkulunkulu ka-Abhrahama, uNkulunkulu ka-Isaka, noNkulunkulu kaJakobe.” UMose wafihla ubuso bakhe, ngokuba wayesaba ukubheka uNkulunkulu.
USimakade wathi: “Ngikubonile ukuhlupheka kwabantu bami abaseGibhithe, futhi ngikuzwile ukukhala kwabo ngenxa yababacindezelayo, ngiyakwazi nokuhlupheka kwabo.

Ngehlile ukuzobakhulula esandleni sabaseGibhithe, nokubakhuphula kuleli lizwe, ngibayise ezweni elihle nelibanzi, izwe elichichima ubisi noju, izwe lamaKhanani, amaHithi, ama-Amori, amaPherizi, amaHivi, namaJebusi.
Manje, bheka, ukukhala kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli sekufinyelele kimi, futhi ngikubonile ukucindezelwa kwabo ngabaseGibhithe.
Ngakho-ke hamba, ngiyakuthuma kuFaro ukuba uyokhulula abantu bami eGibhithe, abantu bakwa-Israyeli.”
Kepha uMose wathi kuNkulunkulu: “Ngingubani mina ukuthi ngingaya kuFaro, ngikhulule abantu bakwa-Israyeli eGibhithe na?”
Wathi: “Ngizokuba nawe. Lesi kuyakuba yisibonakaliso sokuthi ngikuthumile: uma usubakhiphile abantu eGibhithe, niyakumkhonza uNkulunkulu kule ntaba.”
UMose wathi kuNkulunkulu: “Uma ngifika kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, ngithi kubo: ‘UNkulunkulu woyihlo ungithumile,’ bese bengibuza bethi: ‘Ngubani igama lakhe na?’ ngiyakuthini kubo na?”
UNkulunkulu wathi kuMose: “Nginguye Enginguye.” Wathi: “Uyakubatshela abantu bakwa-Israyeli uthi: ‘UNginguye ungithumile kini.’ ”

UNkulunkulu wabuye wathi kuMose: “Uyakusho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli uthi: ‘USimakade uNkulunkulu woyihlo, uNkulunkulu ka-Abhrahama, uNkulunkulu ka-Isaka, noNkulunkulu kaJakobe ungithumile kini.’ Leli yigama lami kuze kube phakade, engiyakukhunjulwa ngalo ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.

“Hamba uqoqe amalunga akwa-Israyeli, uthi kuwo: ‘USimakade, uNkulunkulu wokhokho benu, uNkulunkulu ka-Abhrahama, no-Isaka, noJakobe uzibonakalisile kimi, wathi: “Ngikubonile konke okwenziwa kini eGibhithe,
ngathi ngizonikhuphula ekuhlushweni ngabaseGibhithe, nginiyise ezweni lamaKhanani, lamaHithi, lama-Amori, lamaPherizi, lamaHivi, nelamaJebusi, izwe elichichima ubisi noju.” ’

“Bayokulalela okushoyo; wena uyakuhamba namalunga akwa-Israyeli niye enkosini yaseGibhithe, nifike nithi: ‘USimakade, uNkulunkulu wamaHebheru uzibonakalisile kithi, ngakho-ke sivumele sihambe ibanga lezinsuku ezintathu, siye ehlane, ukuze sihlabele uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu.’
Ngiyazi ukuthi inkosi yaseGibhithe ayiyukunivumela ukuba nihambe, ngaphandle kokuba ngiyicindezele ngesandla esinamandla.
Ngiyakwelula isandla sami ngilishaye iGibhithe ngezimangaliso engiyakuzenza kulo; emveni kwalokho iyakunikhulula nihambe.
“Ngiyakunenzela umusa emehlweni abaseGibhithe. Lapho senihamba, aniyukuphuma nilambatha,

kodwa yilowo nalowo owesifazane uyocela kumakhelwane wakhe nakuye ogogobele emzini wakhe, izinto zesiliva, ezegolide, nezingubo zokugqoka, niyogqokisa amadodana namadodakazi enu; nibaphange kanjalo abaseGibhithe.”
UMose waphendula wathi: “Kepha bheka, ngeke bangikholwe noma bangilalele, bayakuthi: ‘USimakade akabonakalanga kuwe.’ ”
USimakade wathi kuye: “Yini le esesandleni sakho na?” Wathi: “Yinduku.”
Wayesethi: “Yiphonse emhlabathini.” Wayiphonsa emhlabathini, yaphenduka inyoka; uMose wayibalekela.
Kepha uSimakade wathi kuMose: “Yelula isandla sakho, uyibambe ngomsila.” Waselula isandla sakhe, wayibamba; yaphenduka induku esandleni sakhe.
“Bazokholwa-ke ukuthi uSimakade, uNkulunkulu wokhokho benu, uNkulunkulu ka-Abhrahama, uNkulunkulu ka-Isaka noNkulunkulu kaJakobe ubonakele kuwe.”
USimakade wabuye wathi kuye: “Faka isandla esifubeni sakho.” Wasifaka. Lapho esikhipha, mameshane, isandla sakhe sabe sesinochoko, simhlophe njengeqhwa.
UNkulunkulu wathi kuye: “Siphindisele esifubeni isandla sakho.” Wasiphindisela esifubeni sakhe. Kuthe lapho esesikhipha, habe, sesibuyele esimweni saso, sesifana nesikhumba sakhe.
“Uma bengakukholwa, noma bengasishayi mkhuba isibonakaliso sakho sokuqala, bayosikholwa esilandelayo.
Uma bengazikholwa zombili izibonakaliso noma bengakulaleli okushoyo, uyokukha amanzi eNayili, uwathele emhlabathini owomileyo, lawo manzi owakhe emfuleni ayophenduka igazi emhlabathini owomileyo.”
UMose wathi kuSimakade: “Nkosi, ngixolele, angikaze ngibe ngumuntu oyiciko lokukhuluma, kusukela kuqala kuze kube manje njengoba ukhuluma nenceku yakho, ngokuba nginamalimi, ulimi lwami lulukhuni.”
USimakade wathi kuye: “Ngubani owenza umlomo womuntu na? Ngubani owenza isimungulu nesithulu, obonayo noyimpumputhe na? AkusiMina Simakade na?
Ngalokho-ke hamba, ngizokuba semlonyeni wakho, ngikufundise ozokusho.”
Kepha wathi: “Nkosi, ngixolele, ngiyakucela ukuba uthumele omunye.”

Intukuthelo kaSimakade yamvuthela uMose, wathi: “Akekho yini umfowenu u-Aroni ongumLevi na? Ngiyazi ukuthi uliciko lokukhuluma; bheka, uyeza uzokuhlangabeza, lapho ekubona uyothokoza enhliziyweni yakhe.
Uyokhuluma naye, umtshele amazwi azowakhuluma ngomlomo wakhe, ngizokuba semlonyeni wakho nakowakhe, nginifundise enizokwenza.
Nguye ozokukhulumela kubantu; uyakuba ngumlomo wakho, wena ufane nonkulunkulu kuye.
Phatha le nduku ngesandla sakho, wenze ngayo izibonakaliso.”

UMose wahamba wabuyela kumukhwe wakhe uJethro, wathi kuye: “Ngiyakucela, ngivumele ngihambe, ngibuyele kubahlobo bami abaseGibhithe, ngiyobona ukuthi basaphila yini.” UJethro wathi kuMose: “Hamba ngokuthula.”
USimakade wathi kuMose ekwaMidiyani: “Hamba ubuyele eGibhithe, ngokuba sebafa bonke abebefuna ukukubulala.”
UMose wathatha umkakhe namadodana akhe, wabagibelisa embongolweni, wahamba wabuyela eGibhithe. UMose wayephethe induku kaNkulunkulu ngesandla.

USimakade wathi kuMose: “Lapho usubuyele eGibhithe, qikelela ukuthi uzenze zonke izimangaliso phambi kukaFaro engakunika amandla okuba uzenze, kodwa ngiyoyenza lukhuni inhliziyo yakhe, ukuze angabavumeli abantu ukuba bahambe.
Uyakuthi kuFaro: ‘Usho kanje uSimakade: “U-Israyeli uyizibulo lami,
ngathi kuwe: yivumele indodana yami ihambe ukuze ingikhonze, kepha wenqaba ukuyidedela ihambe, uyabona-ke, ngizoyibulala indodana yakho, izibulo lakho.” ’ ”
Esendleleni, endaweni yokuphumula, uSimakade wahlangana naye, wafuna ukumbulala.
UZiphora wathatha itshe elicijile wasika ijwabu lendodana yakhe, wathinta izinyawo zikaMose, wathi: “Ungumyeni wami wegazi kimi.”
Ngalokho wamyeka uMose uSimakade, ngokuba uZiphora wathi: “Ungumyeni wami wegazi, ngenxa yokusoka.”
USimakade wathi ku-Aroni: “Hamba uye ehlane uyohlangabeza uMose.” Wahamba, wahlangana naye entabeni kaNkulunkulu, wamanga.
UMose wayesetshela u-Aroni wonke amazwi kaSimakade ayemthume wona, nazo zonke izibonakaliso ayemyale ukuba azenze.
UMose no-Aroni bahamba baqoqa wonke amalunga abantu bakwa-Israyeli.
U-Aroni wawakhuluma wonke amazwi uSimakade ayewakhulume kuMose, wenza nezibonakaliso phambi kwabantu.
Abantu bakholwa lapho bezwa ukuthi uSimakade uqaphelile, wabona futhi ukuhlupheka kwabo, base bekhothama, bakhuleka.
Emveni kwalokho, uMose no-Aroni baya kuFaro, bathi kuye: “Usho kanje uSimakade, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Dedela abantu bami bahambe, ukuze bayogubha umkhosi wami ehlane.’ ”
Kepha uFaro wathi: “Ungubani uSimakade ukuthi ngingalalela izwi lakhe, ngivumele u-Israyeli ahambe na? Angimazi uSimakade, futhi anginakumdedela u-Israyeli ahambe.”

Base bethi: “UNkulunkulu wamaHebheru ubonakele kithi; sidedele sihambe uhambo lwezinsuku ezintathu, siye ehlane, siyokwenzela uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu umhlatshelo, funa asehlisele ngobhubhane, noma asiqothe ngenkemba.”
Kepha inkosi yaseGibhithe yathi kubo: “Mose no-Aroni, nibasuselani abantu emisebenzini yabo na? Hambani niye emisebenzini yenu.”
UFaro waqhubeka wathi: “Laba bantu sebebaningi kakhulu kunabantu bakuleli lizwe, nokho nifuna ukuba bayeke ukwenza imisebenzi yabo enzima.”
Ngalolo lusuku uFaro wayala izinduna zabantu nabaphathi babo, wathi:
“Ningabe nisabanika abantu utshani bokwenza izitini, njengoba benenza kuqala; mabahambe bazilandele utshani ngokwabo.
Kepha inani lezitini abazenzayo kufanele lifane nelezitini abazenze ngayizolo; ningalehlisi, ngokuba bayavilapha. Yingakho bekhala bethi: ‘Masihambe siyokwenzela uNkulunkulu wethu umhlatshelo.’
Mawenziwe nzima umsebenzi kubo yikhona bezonaka wona, bangawalaleli amazwi adukisayo.”
Izinduna nabaphathi babantu baphuma, bathi kubantu: “Nakhu okushiwo nguFaro uthi: ‘Angizukuninika utshani.’
Hambani nizifunele nina utshani noma kuphi lapho nibuthola khona, kodwa umsebenzi wenu awuzukuncishiswa nakancane.”
Ngakho-ke abantu bahlakazeka kulo lonke iGibhithe ukuyoqoqa izinhlanga esikhundleni sotshani.
Izinduna zazibakhaca zithi: “Qedani umsebenzi ngesilinganiso sansuku zonke ebenisenza ngesikhathi nisanikwa utshani.”

Abaphathi babakwa-Israyeli ababebekwe yizinduna zikaFaro ukubaphatha, bashaywa, babuzwa ukuthi: “Aniwuqedanga ngani umsebenzi wezitini ebeniwunqunyelwe izolo nanamuhla, njengoba benenza nsuku zonke na?”
Izinduna zabakwa-Israyeli zaya kuFaro, zakhala zathi: “Uziphathelani izinceku zakho kanje na?
Izinceku zakho azisanikwa tshani, nokho bathi kithi: ‘Yenzani izitini!’ Futhi kunjalo nje izinceku zakho ziyashaywa, kepha icala likubantu bakho.”
Wathi: “Niyavilapha, yingakho nithi: ‘Sidedele sihambe siyokwenzela uSimakade umhlatshelo.’
Hambani manje niyosebenza, ngokuba anizukunikwa tshani, kodwa nisazokwenza inani elifanayo lezitini.”
Izinduna zabakwa-Israyeli zazibonela ukuthi zisengxakini engakanani lapho kuthiwa kuzo: “Aniyukulehlisa inani lezitini enilenza ngosuku.”
Zahlangana noMose no-Aroni ababemi bezozihlangabeza ngesikhathi zisuka kuFaro.
Zathi kubo: “USimakade makanibheke anehlulele. Nisenze sanuka iququ phambi kukaFaro nezinceku zakhe, nabanika inkemba ezandleni zabo ukuba basibulale.”
UMose wabuyela kuSimakade, wathi: “Nkosi, yini wenze okubi kulaba bantu na? Ungithumeleni mina kubo na?
Selokhu ngaya kuFaro ukuyokhuluma egameni lakho, ubaphatha kabi laba bantu, futhi awubakhululi abantu bakho.”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Manje uzokubona engizokwenza kuFaro. Uzobadedela bahambe, ngenxa yesandla esinamandla; ngesandla esinamandla uzobaxosha ezweni lakhe.”
UNkulunkulu wakhuluma noMose, wathi kuye: “NginguSimakade.
Ngabonakala ku-Abhrahama, ku-Isaka, nakuJakobe njengoNkulunkulu uSomandla, kodwa igama lami, ‘uSimakade’ angibazisanga lona.
Ngenza isivumelwano nabo sokubanika iKhanani, izwe ababehlala kulo njengabafokazi.
Ngikuzwile futhi ukububula kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli abenziwe izigqila ngabaseGibhithe, ngase ngisikhumbula isivumelwano sami.

Ngakho-ke yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi: ‘NginguSimakade, ngiyakunikhulula emithwalweni yabaseGibhithe, nginikhulule ekugqilazweni yibo, nginihlenge ngengalo eyeluliweyo nangezenzo ezinkulu zokwehlulela.
Ngizonithatha nibe ngabantu bami, futhi ngibe nguNkulunkulu wenu. Niyokwazi ukuthi Mina Simakade nginguNkulunkulu wenu, onikhululile emithwalweni yabaseGibhithe.
Ngiyakuniyisa ezweni engafunga ukulinika u-Abhrahama, u-Isaka, noJakobe; ngiyakuninika lona libe yifa lenu. NginguSimakade.’ ”
UMose wakhuluma kanjalo kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, kodwa abazange bamlalele, ngenxa yezinhliziyo ezincane nokusebenza kanzima.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, ethi:
“Hamba ukhulume noFaro inkosi yaseGibhithe ukuba avumele abakwa-Israyeli baphume ezweni lakhe.”
Kepha uMose waphendula uSimakade, wathi: “Abantu abazange bangilalele; uzongilalela kanjani uFaro nginezindebe ezingasokwanga kanje na?”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose no-Aroni ukuba bayale abantu bakwa-Israyeli noFaro inkosi yaseGibhithe ukuba akhiphe abantu bakwa-Israyeli eGibhithe.
Nazi izinhloko zokhokho ngokwezindlu zazo: amadodana kaRubeni izibulo lika-Israyeli: nguHanoki, uPhalu, uHezironi, noKharimi. Yiyo-ke le imindeni kaRubeni.
Amadodana kaSimeyoni: nguJemuweli, uJamini, u-Ohade, uJakhini, uZohari, noShawule indodana yowesifazane waseKhanani. Yiyo-ke leyo imindeni kaSimeyoni.
Lawa ngamagama amadodana kaLevi ngezizukulwane zawo: nguGereshomu, uKhohathi, noMerari. Iminyaka kaLevi yokuphila yaba yi-137.
Amadodana kaGereshomu: nguLibhini noShimeyi ngemindeni yawo.
Amadodana kaKhohathi: ngu-Amramu, uJizihari, uHebhroni, no-Uziyeli. Iminyaka kaKhohathi yokuphila yaba yi-133.
Amadodana kaMerari: nguMaheli noMushi; yiyo-ke le imindeni yabaLevi ngezizukulwane zayo.
U-Amramu wathatha uJokhebedi uyisekazi, waba ngumkakhe, wamzalela u-Aroni noMose. Iminyaka ka-Amramu yokuphila yaba yi-137.
Amadodana kaJizihari: nguKhora, uNefegi, noZikhiri.
Amadodana ka-Uziyeli: nguMishayeli, u-Elizafani, noSithiri.
U-Aroni wathatha u-Elisheba indodakazi ka-Aminadaba, udadewabo kaNaheshoni, waba ngumkakhe, wamzalela uNadabi, u-Abhihu, u-Eleyazare, no-Ithamari.
Amadodana kaKhora: ngu-Asiri, u-Elikhana, no-Abhiyasafa. Yiyo-ke le imindeni kaKhora.
U-Eleyazare indodana ka-Aroni wathatha enye yamadodakazi kaPhuthiyeli, yaba ngumkakhe, yamzalela uFinehasi. Yilezi-ke izinhloko zokhokho babaLevi ngemindeni yabo.
Yibo o-Aroni noMose uSimakade athi kubo: “Khiphani abantu bakwa-Israyeli eGibhithe ngamaviyo abo.”
Yibo laba abakhuluma noFaro inkosi yaseGibhithe ukuba ikhiphe abantu bakwa-Israyeli eGibhithe, oMose no-Aroni.
Ngosuku uSimakade akhuluma ngalo noMose eGibhithe,
uSimakade wathi kuye: “NginguSimakade, khuluma kuFaro inkosi yaseGibhithe konke engikutshela khona.”
Kepha uMose wathi phambi kukaSimakade: “Njengoba nginezindebe ezingasokwanga nje, uzongizwa kanjani uFaro na?”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Uyabona-ke, ngikwenze wanjengonkulunkulu kuFaro, nomfowenu u-Aroni uyakuba ngumphrofethi wakho.
Wena uyakukhuluma konke engizokuyala ngakho, kuthi u-Aroni umfowenu akhulume kuFaro ukuba akhulule abantu bakwa-Israyeli, baphume ezweni lakhe.
Kepha Mina ngizokuyenza lukhuni inhliziyo kaFaro, ngiphindaphinde izibonakaliso nezimangaliso zami eGibhithe.
Uma uFaro engakulaleli, Mina ngizolishaya iGibhithe ngezenzo ezinkulu zokwehlulela, ngikhiphe abantu bami, u-Israyeli, ngamaviyo abo, eGibhithe.
AbaseGibhithe bayongazi ukuthi nginguSimakade, lapho sengilishaya iGibhithe, ngikhipha kulo abantu bakwa-Israyeli.”
UMose no-Aroni benza njengalokhu uSimakade ayebayalile.
UMose wayeseneminyaka engama-80, u-Aroni eneminyaka engama-83 ngesikhathi beyokhuluma noFaro.
USimakade wathi kuMose no-Aroni:
“Uma uFaro ethi yenzani isibonakaliso, ubokuthi ku-Aroni: ‘Thatha induku yakho uyiphonse phansi phambi kukaFaro; iyophenduka inyoka.’ ”
UMose no-Aroni baya kuFaro benza njengalokhu uSimakade ebayalile; u-Aroni wayiphonsa phansi induku yakhe phambi kukaFaro nezikhulu zakhe, yaphenduka inyoka.
UFaro wayesebiza amadoda ahlakaniphileyo, abalumbi, nosomlingo baseGibhithe, nabo benza okufanayo ngemilingo yabo.
Ngamunye baphonsa phansi izinduku zabo; zaphenduka izinyoka, kodwa induku ka-Aroni yazigwinya izinduku zabo.
Inhliziyo kaFaro yaba lukhuni, akabalalelanga, njengalokhu ayeshilo uSimakade.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Inhliziyo kaFaro ilukhuni; uyenqaba ukuvumela abantu ukuba bahambe.
Hamba uye kuFaro ekuseni, uyaphuma njengamanje uya emfuleni. Uyokuma umlinde ngasosebeni lomfula. Phatha ngesandla induku leyo eyaphenduka inyoka.
Uyakuthi kuye: ‘USimakade, uNkulunkulu wamaHebheru ungithume kuwe ukuba ngithi: “Vumela abantu bami bahambe ukuze bayongikhonza ehlane. Kepha kuze kube manje awulalelanga.
Uthi-ke uSimakade: ngalokhu uzokwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade. Uyabona-ke, ngale nduku engiyiphethe ngesandla, ngiyoshaya amanzi omfula iNayili, ayophenduka igazi.
Izinhlanzi ezisemfuleni ziyokufa, umfula iNayili unuke phu, abaseGibhithe bayakukhathazeka bengakwazi ukuwaphuza amanzi omfula.” ’ ”

USimakade wathi kuMose: “Yisho ku-Aroni uthi: ‘Thatha induku yakho uyelulele phezu kwamanzi aseGibhithe, phezu kwemithombo, naphezu kwemifula, phezu kwamaxhaphozi, namachibi, ukuze amanzi aphenduke igazi. Kuyoba negazi kulona lonke iGibhithe, ngisho nasezitsheni zokhuni nezitsha zamatshe.’ ”
UMose no-Aroni benza njengoba uSimakade ayebayalile. Wayiphakamisa induku yakhe, washaya amanzi emfuleni phambi kukaFaro nezinceku zakhe, onke amanzi ayesemfuleni iNayili aphenduka igazi,
kwafa izinhlanzi. Umfula wanuka kangangokuthi abaseGibhithe abakwazanga ukuphuza amanzi awo: kwakunegazi kulona lonke iGibhithe.
Kepha nosomlingo baseGibhithe nabo, ngemilingo yabo, benza into efanayo, ngakho-ke inhliziyo kaFaro yaba lukhuni, akavumanga ukubadedela, njengalokhu uSimakade ayeshilo.
UFaro waphenduka wabuyela esigodlweni sakhe, akaze akunaka lokho enhliziyweni yakhe.
Bonke abaseGibhithe bamba nxazonke zomfula iNayili ukuze bathole amanzi okuphuza, ngoba babengenakuwaphuza amanzi ayesemfuleni.
Kwedlula izinsuku eziyisikhombisa uSimakade eyishayile iNayili.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Hamba uye kuFaro uthi kuye: ‘USimakade uthi: vumela abantu bami bahambe ukuze bayongikhonza.
Uma ubenqabela ukuba bahambe, ngizolishaya lonke iGibhithe ngamasele.
Umfula iNayili uzogcwala amasele, azokwenyuka, enyukele endlini yakho, nasekamelweni lakho, embhedeni wakho, nasemizini yezinceku zakho, neyabantu bakho, nakohhavini nasezitsheni zokuxovela inhlama.
Amasele azokhuphukela kuwe nakubantu bakho, nakuzo zonke izinceku zakho.’ ”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Yisho ku-Aroni uthi: ‘Yelula isandla ophethe ngaso induku, uselulele phezu kwemithombo, imifula, namachibi, ukhiphele eGibhithe amasele.’ ”
U-Aroni welulela isandla sakhe phezu kwamanzi eGibhithe, kwaphuma amasele agcwala kulo lonke iGibhithe.
Kepha nosomlingo benza kanjalo ngemilingo yabo, bakhuphulela amasele eGibhithe.
UFaro wabiza uMose no-Aroni, wathi kubo: “Khulekani kuSimakade ukuze asuse amasele kimi nakubantu bami, ngizobadedela abantu bayokwenzela uSimakade umhlatshelo.”
UMose wathi kuFaro: “Ngitshele ukuthi ufuna ngikukhulekele nini wena nezikhulu zakho, nabantu bakho, ukuze amasele asuke kuwe nasezindlini zakho, asale kuphela emfuleni.”
Wathi: “Kusasa.” UMose wayesethi: “Makube njengalokhu ushilo ukuze wazi ukuthi akekho noyedwa ofana noSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu.
Uzakuwasusa amasele ezindlini zakho, nezezinceku zakho, nezabantu bakho, azosala kuphela emfuleni.”
UMose no-Aroni basuka kuFaro, uMose wanxusa kuSimakade mayelana namasele ayewathumelele uFaro.
USimakade wenza njengokucela kukaMose, amasele ayesezindlini, emagcekeni, nasemasimini afa.
Bawaqoqa bawabeka izinqwaba ngezinqwaba. Izwe lanuka.
Kepha lapho uFaro ebona ukuthi uthole ikhefu, wayenza lukhuni inhliziyo yakhe, akaze abalalela njengalokhu ayeshilo uSimakade.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Yisho ku-Aroni uthi: ‘Yelula induku yakho ushaye uthuli lomhlabathi, ukuze luphenduke omiyane eGibhithe.’ ”

Wenza kanjalo, u-Aroni welula isandla sakhe esasiphethe induku, washaya uthuli lomhlabathi, omiyane banamathela abantu nezilwane ngokufanayo. Lonke uthuli lomhlabathi lwaphenduka omiyane kulo lonke iGibhithe.
Osomlingo ngemilingo yabo bazama ukuveza omiyane, kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya. Omiyane bahlasela abantu nezilwane.
Osomlingo bathi kuFaro: “Lona ngumunwe kaNkulunkulu.” Kepha inhliziyo kaFaro yaba lukhuni, akafunanga ukubalalela njengalokhu ayeshilo uSimakade.
USimakade wayesethi kuMose: “Vuka ekuseni kakhulu uye kuFaro ngaphambi kokuba aye emfuleni, uthi kuye: ‘USimakade uthi: vumela abantu bami bahambe ukuze bayongikhonza.

Ngokuba uma ungabavumeli abantu bami, ngiyothumela izinkumbi zezibawu kuwe, ezincekwini zakho, kubantu bakho, nasezindlini zenu. Ezindlini zabaseGibhithe kuzogcwala izinkumbi zezibawu, ngisho nasezweni abahlala kulo imbala.
Ngalolo lusuku ngiyakulehlukanisa iGosheni lapho kuhlala khona abantu bami, akuyukuba bikho zinkumbi zezibawu khona, ukuze wazi ukuthi Mina Simakade ngikuleli lizwe.
Ngiyakuhlukanisa phakathi kwabantu bami nabakho. Lesi sibonakaliso sizokwenzeka kusasa.’ ”
USimakade wenza kanjalo, izinkumbi zezibawu zahlasela indlu kaFaro, nezindlu zezinceku zakhe, nalo lonke iGibhithe, kwaba nomonakalo ngenxa yezibawu.
UFaro wabiza uMose no-Aroni, wathi kubo: “Hambani kuleli lizwe niyokwenzela uNkulunkulu wenu umhlatshelo.”

Kepha uMose wathi: “Akunakwenzeka lokho, ngokuba imihlatshelo esizoyethula kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu ingokunengekayo kwabaseGibhithe. Singahlaba yini okunengekayo kwabaseGibhithe, singakhandwa ngamatshe na?
Siyakuhamba ibanga lezinsuku ezintathu siye ehlane, sethule umhlatshelo kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu njengalokhu esiyalile.”
UFaro wathi: “Ngizonivumela nihambe niyokwethula umhlatshelo kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu ehlane, kuphela nje uma ningezukuya kude. Ningikhulekele nami.”

UMose wathi: “Uma ngisuka lapha kuwe, ngizokhuleka kuSimakade ukuba kusasa azisuse izinkumbi zezibawu kuFaro, nasezincekwini zakhe, nakubantu bakhe. Kodwa-ke uFaro makangaphinde akhohlise ngokuthi uzakubavumela abantu bahambe ukuyokwenzela uSimakade umhlatshelo.”
UMose waphuma, wamshiya uFaro, wakhuleka kuSimakade.
USimakade wenza njengoba ecelile uMose: wazisusa izinkumbi zezibawu kuFaro, nasezincekwini zakhe, nakubantu bakhe, akwasala nasinye.
Kepha uFaro wayenza lukhuni inhliziyo yakhe nangalesi sikhathi, akaze avuma ukuba abantu bahambe.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Hamba uye kuFaro, uthi kuye: ‘Usho kanje uSimakade uNkulunkulu wamaHebheru uthi: “Vumela abantu bami bahambe, ukuze bangikhonze.
Ngokuba uma wenqaba ukubavumela ukuba bahambe, ulokhu ubabambile,
isandla sikaSimakade sizoyishaya ngesifo imfuyo esehlane: amahhashi, izimbongolo, amakameli, izinkomo, izimvu, nezimbuzi.
Kepha uSimakade uzohlukanisa phakathi kwemfuyo yabakwa-Israyeli nemfuyo yabaseGibhithe, ukuze kungafi lutho olungolwabantu bakwa-Israyeli.” ’ ”
USimakade wanquma isikhathi wathi: “Kusasa uSimakade uzokwenza lokhu ezweni.”
Ngakusasa uSimakade wakwenza lokho; yonke imfuyo yabaseGibhithe yafa, kodwa akufanga nayinye emfuyweni yabantu bakwa-Israyeli.
UFaro wathumela, kodwa wathola ukuthi akukho nasinye isilwane emfuyweni yabakwa-Israyeli esasifile. Kepha inhliziyo kaFaro yayilukhuni, akabavumelanga abantu ukuba bahambe.
USimakade wathi kuMose no-Aroni: “Thathani umlotha eziko ugcwale izandla bese uMose ewuphonsa phezulu emoyeni phambi kukaFaro.
Uzakuphenduka uthuli phezu kwezwe lonke iGibhithe, udale amathumba kubantu nasezilwaneni kulo lonke iGibhithe.”
Base bewuthatha umlotha eziko, bama phambi kukaFaro, uMose wawuphonsa phezulu emoyeni, wase udala amathumba kubantu nasezilwaneni.
Osomlingo abakwazanga ukuma phambi kukaFaro ngenxa yamathumba, ngoba nabo babehlaselwe ngamathumba nabo bonke abaseGibhithe.
Kepha uSimakade wayenza lukhuni inhliziyo kaFaro, akabalalelanga, njengoba uSimakade ayeshilo kuMose.
USimakade wayesethi kuMose: “Vuka ekuseni kakhulu uye kuFaro, uthi kuye: ‘Usho kanje uSimakade, uNkulunkulu wamaHebheru, uthi: “Vumela abantu bami bahambe bayongikhonza.
Ngokuba kulesi sikhathi ngizothumela zonke izinhlupheko zami enhliziyweni yakho, kweyezinceku zakho, nakweyabantu bakho, ukuze nazi ukuthi akekho onjengami emhlabeni wonke.
Manje ngiselulile isandla sami ukuba ngikushaye wena nabantu bakho ngesifo, nishabalale emhlabeni.
Kodwa ngenxa yalokhu, ngikugcinile waphila ukuze ngikukhombise amandla ami, nokwenza igama lami laziwe emhlabeni wonke.
Usaziphakamisa, awufuni ukuvumela abantu bami ukuba bahambe na?
Uyabona-ke, kusasa ngalesi sikhathi ngizothumela isichotho esinamandla amakhulu, esingakaze sibonwe eGibhithe selokhu laba khona kuze kube namuhla.
Ngakho-ke thumela ukuba kubuyiswe imfuyo yakho nakho konke onakho okusendle kufakwe endaweni ephephileyo. Bonke abantu nezilwane okuzobe kusendle, isichotho sizokwehlela kukho kufe.” ’ ”
Lezo zinceku zikaFaro ezazilesaba izwi likaSimakade zaphuthuma zafaka izigqila zazo, nemfuyo yazo endaweni ephephileyo.
Lezo ezingaligqizanga qakala izwi likaSimakade zazishiya izigqila nemfuyo yazo endle.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Yelulela isandla sakho ngasezulwini, ukuze isichotho sehlele kulo lonke iGibhithe, kubantu, ezilwaneni, nakuzo zonke izitshalo ezisemasimini eGibhithe.”
UMose waphakamisa induku yakhe wayibhekisa ngasezulwini, uNkulunkulu wathumela ukuduma nesichotho, nomlilo, kwehlela emhlabeni. USimakade wehlisa isichotho kulo lonke iGibhithe.
Kwehla isichotho nomlilo, nokuphazima okwakuhambisana nesichotho esasinamandla, esingakaze sibonwe eGibhithe selokhu laba yisizwe.
Isichotho sashaya savithiza kulo lonke iGibhithe, konke okwakusendle kusukela kubantu, izilwane, nazo zonke izitshalo emasimini; sashaya sayiphula yonke imithi yasendle.
KuseGosheni kuphela, lapho kwakuhlala khona abakwa-Israyeli, esingehlanga khona isichotho.
UFaro wathumela wabiza uMose no-Aroni, wathi kubo: “Kulokhu ngonile; uSimakade ulungile, mina nabantu bami sinecala.
Khulekani kuSimakade; sekwanele lokhu kuduma kukaNkulunkulu okungaka nesichotho. Ngizonivumela nihambe, ningabe nisachitha sikhathi lapha.”
UMose wathi kuye: “Lapho nje ngiphuma emzini ngizokwelulela izandla zami kuSimakade; ukuduma kuzophela, singabe sisehla nesichotho, ukuze wazi ukuthi umhlaba ungokaSimakade.
Kepha ngiyazi ukuthi wena nezikhulu zakho, anikamesabi uSimakade uNkulunkulu.”
Ifilakisi nebhali lashaywa lonakala, ngokuba ibhali lalikhahlele, nefilakisi seliqhakaza.
Kodwa ukolo nesipelithi akonakalanga ngoba kwakungakaqhumi.
UMose waphuma emzini kaFaro, welulela izandla zakhe kuSimakade; kwase kunqamuka ukuduma, nesichotho, nemvula, lasa.
UFaro wabona ukuthi imvula, ukuduma nesichotho sekunqamukile, wabuye wona futhi, wayenza lukhuni inhliziyo yakhe, yena nezikhulu zakhe.
Inhliziyo kaFaro yaba lukhuni akabavumelanga abantu bakwa-Israyeli ukuba bahambe, njengoba uSimakade ayeshilo ngoMose.
USimakade wayesethi kuMose: “Hamba uye kuFaro, ngokuba ngiyenze yaba lukhuni inhliziyo yakhe neyezinceku zakhe, ukuze ngikhombise lezo zibonakaliso zami kubo.
Lokhu uyoze ukuxoxele indodana yakho nabazukulu bakho ukuthi ngaliphatha ngesihluku esinjani iGibhithe, nokuthi zibonakaliso zini engazenza kulo ukuze nazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.”

UMose no-Aroni baya kuFaro, bathi kuye: “Usho kanje uSimakade uNkulunkulu wamaHebheru uthi: ‘Kuyoze kube nini wenqaba ukuzithoba phambi kwami na? Vumela abantu bami ukuba bahambe, ukuze bayongikhonza.
Uma wenqaba ukuvumela abantu bami ukuba bahambe, kusasa ngizothumela isikhonyane ezweni lakho.
Sizokwemboza izwe kungabi bikho muntu okwazi ukubona umhlabathi. Sizokudla lokho okusale esichothweni, sibhuqe yonke imithi esahlumayo emasimini.

Sizogcwala ezindlini zakho, ezindlini zezinceku zakho, nasezindlini zabo bonke abaseGibhithe, into engakaze ibonwe ngokhokho benu, ngisho nokhokho bokhokho benu, kusukela ngosuku abafika ngalo emhlabeni kuze kube yilolu lusuku lwanamuhla.’ ” Wayesephenduka, waphuma phambi kukaFaro.
Izinceku zikaFaro zathi kuye: “Kuyoze kube nini lo mfokazi ewugibe kithi na? Bavumele abantu ukuba bahambe, ukuze bayokhonza uSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo; awuboni yini ukuthi iGibhithe liyabhubha na?”
Base bebuyisa kuFaro oMose no-Aroni, wayesethi kubo: “Hambani niyokhonza uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu. Ngobani abazohamba na?”
UMose wathi: “Sizohamba nezinsizwa, abadala, amadodana, amadodakazi ethu, izimvu, izimbuzi, izinkomo, nemihlambi yethu, ngokuba sizogubha umkhosi kaSimakade ngakho konke esinakho.”
Wayesethi kubo: “USimakade makabe nani-ke, njengokuba ngizakunivumela ukuba nihambe nezingane zenu: sekuyacaca ukuthi kukhona okubi enikuhlosile.
Phinde neze! Hambani nina madoda niyokhonza uSimakade, ngokuba yilokho enikucelileyo.” Base bexoshwa phambi kukaFaro.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Yelula isandla sakho phezu kweGibhithe, ukuze kuphume isikhonyane phezu kwalo lonke iGibhithe, sidle konke okumilileyo ezweni, konke lokho okusale esichothweni.”
UMose welula induku yakhe phezu kweGibhithe; uSimakade wayesethumela umoya wasempumalanga ezweni imini nobusuku, ekuseni umoya wasempumalanga waletha isikhonyane.
Isikhonyane salihlasela lonke iGibhithe, sagcwala kulo lonke iGibhithe, sasinzima kakhulu. Sasingakaze sibonwe isikhonyane esinjengalesi ngaphambilini, futhi asikho esiyofana naso nasemveni kwalokhu.

Salemboza lonke iGibhithe kwangabonakala ngisho namhlabathi, kwaba mnyama kulo lonke izwe. Sashaya sabhuqa konke okumilileyo ezweni, nazo zonke izithelo ezazishiywe yisichotho ezihlahleni, kwangasala lutho oluluhlaza ezihlahleni, nakokumilileyo emasimini kulona lonke iGibhithe.
UFaro waphuthuma wabiza uMose no-Aroni, wathi kubo: “Ngonile kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu nakini.
Ngithetheleleni isono sami ngalesi sikhathi nje esisodwa, ningikhulekele kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu ukuze asuse lokhu kufa phezu kwami.”
Waphuma phambi kukaFaro, wakhuleka kuSimakade.
USimakade wayesewuguqula umoya waba ngumoya onamandla wasentshonalanga, waphephula isikhonyane wasithela oLwandle Lomhlanga, kwangasala nayinye intethe eGibhithe.
Kepha uSimakade wayenza lukhuni inhliziyo kaFaro, akabavumelanga abantu bakwa-Israyeli ukuba bahambe.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Yelulela isandla sakho ngasezulwini ukuze kube mnyama eGibhithe, ubumnyama obuphathekayo.”
UMose wayeselulela isandla sakhe ngasezulwini, kwase kuba khona isigayegaye sobumnyama izinsuku ezintathu kulo lonke iGibhithe.
Abantu babengakwazi ukubonana, akekho owakwazi ukusuka endaweni yakhe izinsuku ezintathu, kodwa kubo bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli kwakunokukhanya lapho babehlala khona.
UFaro wabiza uMose, wathi kuye: “Hambani niyokhonza uSimakade, kusale kuphela izimvu, izimbuzi, nezinkomo zenu; hambani ngisho nabantwana benu imbala.”
UMose wathi: “Uyakusinika yini imihlatshelo neminikelo yokushiswa esiyoyinikela kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu na?

Imfuyo yethu siyakuhamba nayo, akuyukusala ngisho nenselo eyodwa, ngokuba siyakuthatha kuyo ukuze sikhonze ngayo uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu, futhi-ke ngeke sazi ukuthi siyomkhonza ngani uSimakade, singakafiki lapho.”
Kepha uSimakade wayenza lukhuni inhliziyo kaFaro, akavumanga ukubadedela ukuba bahambe.
UFaro wathi kuye: “Suka phambi kwami! Qikelela ukuba ungaphinde ubone ubuso bami, ngokuba ngosuku oyobubona ngalo ubuso bami, uyokufa.”
UMose wathi: “Njengalokhu ushilo, angiyukuphinde ngibubone ubuso bakho.”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Ngizoletha enye futhi inhlupheko phezu kukaFaro naphezu kweGibhithe; emveni kwalokho uzonivumela ukuba nihambe lapha. Lapho enivumela uzakunixosha nokunixosha.
Ngakho-ke tshela abantu ukuthi yilowo nalowo wesilisa makacele kumakhelwane wakhe, nabesifazane bacele komakhelwane babo izimpahla zesiliva nezegolide.”
USimakade wabenzela umusa abantu phambi kwabaseGibhithe. Ngaphezu kwalokho uMose uqobo wayeyindoda eqavileyo eGibhithe, naphambi kwezinceku zikaFaro, naphambi kwabantu.
UMose wathi: “Usho kanje uSimakade: ‘Phakathi kwamabili ngizodabula kulo lonke iGibhithe.
Wonke amazibulo eGibhithe azokufa, kusukela ezibulweni likaFaro ohleli esihlalweni sobukhosi kuya ezibulweni elizalwa ngowesifazane oyisigqila ogwedla isigayo, nawo wonke amazibulo emfuyo.
Kuzokuba nesililo esikhulu, esingakaze sibe khona, futhi esingayukuphinde sibe khona kulo lonke iGibhithe.

Kepha ngasohlangothini lwabakwa-Israyeli akukho muntu nasilwane okuzokufa, ngisho inja imbala ayiyukugwavumela muntu namfuyo, ukuze nazi ukuthi uSimakade wehlukanisile phakathi kwabaseGibhithe nabakwa-Israyeli.’
Ngakho-ke zonke lezi zikhulu zizokuza kimi, zingikhothamele, zithi: ‘Hamba wena nabantu bonke abakulandelayo.’ Emveni kwalokho ngizohamba.” Waphuma wamshiya uFaro evutha bhe wulaka.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “UFaro ngeke akulalele ukuze izimangaliso zami ziphindaphindwe eGibhithe.”
UMose no-Aroni bazenza zonke lezo zimangaliso phambi kukaFaro, kodwa uSimakade wayenza lukhuni inhliziyo kaFaro, akabavumelanga abantu bakwa-Israyeli ukuba baphume ezweni lakhe.
USimakade wathi kuMose no-Aroni eGibhithe:
“Le nyanga iyakuba wuphawu kini lokuqala kwezinyanga; iyakuba yinyanga yokuqala yonyaka wenu.
Yishoni kuyo yonke inhlangano yakwa-Israyeli nithi: ‘Ngomhla zilishumi kule nyanga bayothatha yilowo nalowo mndeni, kube yiwundlu umndeni ngamunye.
Uma umndeni umncane kakhulu ukuba ungaqeda iwundlu, uyohlangana nomakhelwane ukuze uthole iwundlu; iwundlu liyakwehlukaniswa izingxenye ngokulingene abantu abayakulidla.
Iwundlu malingabi nasici, libe nonyaka, libe yiduna, ungalithatha ezimvini noma ezimbuzini.
Niyoligcina kuze kube lusuku lweshumi nane lwayo le nyanga, bese kuthi wonke umphakathi wakwa-Israyeli uhlabe amawundlu phakathi kwamabili.
Bayakuthatha ingxenye yegazi balibhece ezinsikeni zombili zomnyango, nasemakhothameni eminyango yezindlu abayakudlela kuzo.
Bayakulidla iwundlu ngalobo busuku; bayakulidla losiwe emlilweni nesinkwa esingenamvubelo nemifino ebabayo.
Ningakudli kuluhlaza noma kubiliswe ngamanzi, kodwa imilenze yalo, ikhanda, nezangaphakathi makosiwe emlilweni.
Makungasali lutho lwalo kuze kuse, okuyosala kuze kube sekuseni niyokushisa ngomlilo.
Niyakulidla kanje: izinkalo zenu ziboshiwe, nifake izimbadada ezinyaweni zenu, niphethe izindondolo zenu ngezandla, nilidle ngokuphangisa, liyiphasika likaSimakade.
“ ‘Ngokuba ngiyokwedlula eGibhithe ngalobo busuku, ngibulale wonke amazibulo eGibhithe, awabantu nawezilwane, ngibehlulele bonke onkulunkulu baseGibhithe: nginguSimakade.
Igazi liyokuba wuphawu lwenu ezindlini lapho nihleli khona: uma ngibona igazi, ngiyokwedlula kini, ngeke ubhubhane lunibhubhise lapho ngishaya iGibhithe.
“ ‘Lolo lusuku luyakuba lusuku lwesikhumbuzo kini, futhi niyakulugubha lube wumkhosi kaSimakade. Zonke izizukulwane ziyakulugcina lube yisimiso saphakade.

Niyakudla isinkwa esingenamvubelo izinsuku eziyisikhombisa. Ngosuku lokuqala niyakukhipha imvubelo ezindlini zenu, ngokuba lowo oyokudla isinkwa esinemvubelo kusukela osukwini lokuqala kuze kube lusuku lwesikhombisa uyodingiswa kwa-Israyeli.
Ngosuku lokuqala niyoba nombuthano ongcwele, nangosuku lwesikhombisa. Aniyukusebenza ngalezo zinsuku; niyolungisa kuphela lokho okuyobe kuzodliwa ngabantu bonke.
Niyogubha umkhosi wesinkwa esingenamvubelo, ngokuba ngalolo lusuku ngakhipha amaviyo enu eGibhithe. Lolu lusuku niyolugubha lube ngumkhosi omisiweyo phakade izizukulwane ngezizukulwane.
Ngenyanga yokuqala, ngosuku lwe-14 kusihlwa niyokudla isinkwa esingenamvubelo kuze kube kusihlwa ngosuku lwama-21.
Ngezinsuku eziyisikhombisa akuyukutholakala mvubelo ezindlini zenu, ngokuba lowo oyokudla okunemvubelo uyonqunywa ebandleni lakwa-Israyeli, noma ngabe ngumfokazi noma ngumnsinsi wokuzimilela.
Aniyukudla lutho olunemvubelo; kuzo zonke izindawo enihlala kuzo niyokudla isinkwa esingenamvubelo.’ ”
UMose wayesewabiza wonke amalunga akwa-Israyeli, wathi kuwo: “Hambani, nithathele imindeni yenu amawundlu, niwahlabele iphasika.
Niyothatha isixha sehisophi nisicwilise egazini elisemcengezini, bese nibheca izimpundu nezinsika zeminyango, makungaphumi muntu emnyango kuze kube ngakusasa.

Ngokuba uSimakade uzokwedlula ashaye iGibhithe, kuyothi lapho ebona igazi emakhothameni nasezinsikeni zeminyango, uSimakade awedlule lowo mnyango, angamvumeli umbhubhisi ukuba eze ezindlini zenu ukuba abhubhise.
Lesi simiso niyakusigcina sibe yisiko lenu nezizukulwane zenu nanini nanini.
Lapho nifika ezweni uSimakade ayoninika lona njengoba eshilo, niyowugubha lo mkhosi.
Kuyothi lapho abantwana benu benibuza, bethi: ‘Kuchazani ukugujwa kwalo mkhosi na?’
Niyothi: ‘Ngumhlatshelo wephasika likaSimakade, ngokuba wazedlula izindlu zabakwa-Israyeli eGibhithe, mzukwane ebulala abaseGibhithe, kodwa wazeqa izindlu zethu.’ ” Abantu bakhothama badumisa.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli bahamba njengoba uSimakade ebayalile oMose no-Aroni.

Phakathi kwamabili uSimakade wabhubhisa wonke amazibulo abaseGibhithe, kusukela ezibulweni likaFaro owayehleli esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi ngaleso sikhathi, kuya ezibulweni lesiboshwa esisejele, nawo wonke amazibulo emfuyo.
UFaro wavuka ebusuku nezinceku zakhe nabo bonke abaseGibhithe, ngokuba kwakunesililo esikhulu eGibhithe kungekho muzi okwakungafanga muntu kuwo.
Wabiza uMose no-Aroni khona ebusuku, wathi kubo: “Vukani, niphume niphele kubantu bami, nina nabantu bakwa-Israyeli! Hambani niyokhonza uSimakade, njengalokho nishilo.
Thathani imihlambi, izimvu, izimbuzi, nezinkomo, njengoba nishilo nihambe. Nami ningicelele isibusiso.”
AbaseGibhithe bancenga abantu ukuba basheshe baphume ezweni, ngokuba bathi: “Thina sonke sizokufa.”
Abantu bathatha inhlama yabo ngaphambi kokuba ifakwe imbiliso, nemicengezi yokuxovela, bakugoqa ngezingubo zabo bakuthwala emahlombe.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli benza njengoba uMose ayebatshelile; bacela kwabaseGibhithe ubucwebecwebe besiliva, igolide, nezimpahla zokugqoka.
USimakade wabenzela umusa emehlweni abaseGibhithe, babanika konke abakucelayo. Babaphundla kanjalo-ke abaseGibhithe.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli basuka eRamesesi baya eSukhothi. Kwakungamadoda abalelwa ezi-600 000 ayehamba ngezinyawo, ngaphandle kwezingane.
Ingxubevange yabantu yahamba nabo, imfuyo eningi kakhulu, imihlambi yezimbuzi, izimvu, nezinkomo.
Benza amaqebelengwane ngenhlama ababephume nayo eGibhithe; yayingenamvubelo ngokuba babexoshiwe eGibhithe bengasenakulinda, noma bagaye umphako.
Abakwa-Israyeli bahlala iminyaka engama-430 eGibhithe.
Ekupheleni konyaka wama-430, ngalo lolo lusuku, wonke amaviyo kaSimakade aphuma eGibhithe.
Kwakungubusuku bomlindo uSimakade abakhipha ngabo eGibhithe. Ngalobo busuku abakwa-Israyeli bayogcina umlindelo kaSimakade izizukulwane ngezizukulwane.
USimakade wathi kuMose no-Aroni: “Nasi isimiso sephasika: akukho mfokazi okumele ukuba alidle,
kodwa noma yisiphi isigqila esithengwe ngesiliva singalidla emva kokuba sisokiwe;
akukho sisebenzi esiqashiweyo esiyolidla.
“Liyodlelwa endlini eyodwa, aniyukukhiphela lutho oluyinyama yaleso silwane phandle, futhi aniyukwephula ngisho nelilodwa ithambo laso.
Lonke ibandla lakwa-Israyeli liyokwenza lokhu.

“Uma umfokazi ohlala nani efuna ukuligubha iphasika likaSimakade, kufanele asokwe yena nabo bonke abesilisa, bese beyasondela baligubhe iphasika, njengoba bonke abantu bengabakhe. Kepha bonke abangasokile akumele balidle iphasika.
Umthetho oyakubekelwa abozalo nabafokazi abagogobele phakathi kwenu uyakufana.”
Bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli benza njengoba uSimakade ayebayalile ngoMose no-Aroni.
Ngalolo lusuku uSimakade wabakhipha abantu bakwa-Israyeli eGibhithe ngamaviyo abo.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose wathi:
“Ngihlukanisele wonke amazibulo; noma yiliphi izibulo elivule isibeletho kwabakwa-Israyeli, kubantu nezilwane, ngokuba lingelami.”
UMose wathi kubantu: “Lukhumbuleni lolu lusuku enaphuma ngalo eGibhithe endlini yobugqila, ngokuba uSimakade wanikhipha lapho ngesandla sakhe esinamandla; makungadliwa sinkwa esinemvubelo ngalo.
Namuhla, niyaphuma ngenyanga u-Abibi.

Lapho uSimakade eseningenisa ezweni lamaKhanani, lamaHithi, lama-Amori, lamaHivi, nelamaJebusi, afunga ngalo koyihlomkhulu ukulinika nina, izwe elichichima ubisi noju, niyokuyigcina le nkonzo ngale nyanga.
Izinsuku eziyisikhombisa niyakudla isinkwa esingenamvubelo, kuthi ngosuku lwesikhombisa kube nomkhosi kaSimakade.
Isinkwa esingenamvubelo siyodliwa izinsuku eziyisikhombisa; akukho mvubelo eyotholakala phakathi kwenu, futhi akuyukutholakala mvubelo kuyo yonke indawo yenu.
Ngalolo lusuku uyoyitshela indodana yakho uthi: ‘Lokhu kungenxa yalokho uSimakade angenzela khona mhla ngiphuma eGibhithe.’ ”
“Kuyakuba kuwe wuphawu esandleni sakho, nesikhumbuzo esiphongweni sakho, ukuze umthetho kaSimakade uhlale ezindebeni zomlomo wakho, ngokuba ngesandla esinamandla uSimakade wakukhipha eGibhithe.
Lo mthetho uyakuwugcina ngesikhathi esifaneleyo minyaka yonke.”
“Lapho uSimakade esekungenisile ezweni lamaKhanani, wakunika lona, njengoba ayefungile kuwe nakoyihlomkhulu,
uyonikela ngawo wonke amazibulo kuSimakade, wonke amazibulo, amazibulo ezinkomo, nawo wonke amaduna ngakaSimakade.
Kepha wonke amazibulo ezimbongolo uyowahlenga ngemvu, uma ungalihlengi uyolephula intamo, kuthi wonke amazibulo abantu endlini yakho uwahlenge.
Kuyakuthi ngomuso lapho indodana yakho ikubuza, ithi: ‘Kuyini lokhu na?’ uyothi: ‘USimakade wasikhipha ngesandla esinamandla eGibhithe, indlu yobugqila.

Ngesikhathi uFaro elukhuni engavumi ukusidedela, uSimakade wabulala wonke amazibulo eGibhithe, kusukela kwawabantu kuya kwawezilwane. Ngakho-ke ngihlabela uSimakade konke okungamaduna okuvule isibeletho, kodwa ngiyawahlenga wonke amazibulo angamadodana ami.’
Lokhu kuyakuba wuphawu esandleni sakho, nesikhumbuzo esiphongweni sakho, ukuthi uSimakade wasikhipha ngesandla esinamandla eGibhithe.”

Ngesikhathi uFaro ebakhulula abantu ukuba bahambe, uNkulunkulu akabavumelanga ukuba bahambe ngendlela yasezweni lamaFilisti, nakuba yayinqamulela, ngokuba uNkulunkulu wathi: “Funa abantu, uma benqwamana nempi, baguqule umqondo bese bebuyela eGibhithe.”
UNkulunkulu wenza ukuba abantu bahambe ngendlela ethathelayo yasehlane ebheke oLwandle Lomhlanga. Abantu bakwa-Israyeli baphuma eGibhithe bezilungiselele impi.
UMose wathatha amathambo kaJosefa, wahamba nawo, ngokuba wayebafungisile abantu bakwa-Israyeli, wathi: “Impela uNkulunkulu uyakunihambela ngokwempela, anikhulule, niyakuwathwala amathambo ami lapha.”
Basuka eSukhothi bakanisa e-Ethamu emngceleni wehlane.
Emini uSimakade wayehamba phambi kwabo ngensika yefu ukubakhombisa indlela, kuthi ebusuku ahambe phambi kwabo ngensika yomlilo ukuze abakhanyisele, bahambe ubusuku nemini.
Akayisusanga phambi kwabantu insika yefu emini nensika yomlilo ebusuku.
USimakade wathi kuMose:
“Khuluma nabantu bakwa-Israyeli ukuze babuyele emuva, bayokanisa phambi kwePhi Hahirothi, phakathi kweMigidoli nolwandle, phambi kweBhali Zefoni; bakanise ngasolwandle babhekane nalo.
UFaro uyakuthi ngabantu bakwa-Israyeli: ‘Bayazulazula bedidekile ezweni, ihlane libavalele.’
“Ngiyakuyenza lukhuni inhliziyo kaFaro, uyakubalandela, ukuze ngithole udumo ngoFaro nangempi yakhe yonke; abaseGibhithe bayakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.” Benza kanjalo.

Yabikelwa inkosi yaseGibhithe ukuthi abantu babalekile. UFaro nezinceku zakhe baguqula umqondo mayelana nabantu, bathi: “Yini le esiyenzileyo ukuba sikhulule abakwa-Israyeli bangabe besasisebenzela na?”
Wabophela inqola yakhe yempi, wahamba nabantu bakhe;
wathatha izinqola ezikhethiweyo ezingama-600, nazo zonke ezinye izinqola zempi zaseGibhithe, nezinduna zempi.
USimakade wayenza lukhuni inhliziyo kaFaro inkosi yaseGibhithe, wabalandela abantu bakwa-Israyeli ngokuba babephume ngesandla esiphakeme.
AbaseGibhithe babalandela ngamahhashi, nezinqola zempi zikaFaro, nempi yakhe, babafica bekanise ngasolwandle ePhi Hahirothi, phambi kweBhali Zefoni.
Kwathi lapho uFaro esesondela, abantu bakwa-Israyeli baphakamisa amehlo abo bababona abaseGibhithe bebalandela, besaba kakhulu abantu bakwa-Israyeli, base bekhala kuSimakade.
Bathi kuMose: “Yingoba abengekho yini amangcwaba eGibhithe ukuba usikhiphele kuleli hlane sizofela khona na? Yini le osenze yona ngokusikhipha eGibhithe na?
Asishongo yini kuwe siseseGibhithe sathi: ‘Siyeke ukuze sisebenzele abaseGibhithe’ na? Ngokuba bekungcono ukusebenzela abaseGibhithe kunokuba sizofela ehlane.”
Kepha uMose wathi kubantu: “Ningesabi, qinani, nibone ukukhululwa uSimakade azonenzela khona namuhla; ngokuba laba baseGibhithe enibabona namuhla anisayukuphinde nibabone naphakade.
USimakade uzonilwela, nina thulani du.”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Ukhalelani kimi na? Khuluma kubantu bakwa-Israyeli ukuba bahambe.
Wena phakamisa induku yakho, welulele isandla sakho phezu kolwandle ulwehlukanise, yikhona abantu bakwa-Israyeli bezodabula ulwandle behamba emhlabathini owomileyo.
Mina ngiyakuyenza lukhuni inhliziyo yabaseGibhithe ukuze banilandele, ngiyofumana udumo ngoFaro nangayo yonke impi yakhe, izinqola zakhe zempi, nabagibele amahhashi.
AbaseGibhithe bayakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade lapho sengizitholele udumo ngoFaro, nezinqola zakhe zempi, nangabagibele amahhashi.”
Ingelosi kaNkulunkulu eyayihamba phambi kwempi yabakwa-Israyeli yasuka yaya ngemuva kwabo; nensika yefu eyayihamba phambi kwabo yasuka yaba ngemuva kwabo.
Yaba phakathi kwempi yabaseGibhithe nempi yabakwa-Israyeli. Kwakukhona ifu nobumnyama, ifu lakhanyisa ebusuku kodwa akekho owasondela komunye ubusuku bonke.
UMose welulela isandla sakhe phezu kolwandle, uSimakade walududula ulwandle ubusuku bonke ngomoya wasempumalanga onamandla, ulwandle waluphendula lwaba wumhlabathi owomileyo, amanzi ehlukana.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli badabula olwandle behamba emhlabathini owomileyo, amanzi enza udonga kwesokunene nakwesokhohlo sabo.
AbaseGibhithe ababebaxosha bangena olwandle, amahhashi wonke kaFaro, nezinqola zakhe zempi, nabagibele amahhashi.
Entathakusa uSimakade esensikeni yomlilo nasefini, wabheka phansi emshungwini wempi yabaseGibhithe, wayenza yadideka impi.
Izinqola zabo zempi zabhajwa, amasondo ahamba kanzima, ngakho-ke abaseGibhithe bathi: “Masibalekeni phambi kwabakwa-Israyeli, ngokuba uSimakade uyabalwela, umelene nabaseGibhithe.”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Yelulela isandla sakho phezu kolwandle, ukuze amanzi abuyele phezu kwabaseGibhithe, naphezu kwezinqola zabo zempi, naphezu kwabagibele amahhashi.”
UMose welulela isandla sakhe phezu kolwandle, ulwandle lwabuyela esimweni salo entathakusa. AbaseGibhithe babaleka, kodwa uSimakade wabaphonsa phakathi kolwandle abaseGibhithe.
Amanzi abuyela amboza izinqola zempi, nabagibele amahhashi, nayo yonke impi kaFaro eyayibalandela; baminza olwandle, akwaze kwasala namunye.
Kepha abakwa-Israyeli bahamba emhlabathini owomileyo bedabula ulwandle, amanzi aba wudonga kwesokunene nakwesokhohlo sabo.
Ngalolo lusuku uSimakade wabasindisa abakwa-Israyeli esandleni sabaseGibhithe; abakwa-Israyeli babona izidumbu zabaseGibhithe ogwini lolwandle.
U-Israyeli wawabona amandla amakhulu abonakaliswa nguSimakade phezu kwabaseGibhithe, abantu bakholwa nguSimakade nayinceku yakhe uMose.
UMose nabantu bakwa-Israyeli bahuba leli hubo kuSimakade, bathi: “Ngizohlabelela kuSimakade, ngokuba uphakeme kakhulu, ihhashi nomgibeli walo ukuphonse olwandle.
USimakade ungamandla ami nesivikelo sami, uyinsindiso yami, lona nguNkulunkulu wami, ngizokumtusa, nguNkulunkulu kababa, ngizokumphakamisa.
USimakade uyindoda yempi, nguSimakade igama lakhe.
Izinqola zikaFaro nempi yakhe ukuphonse olwandle; izikhulu zakhe ezikhethekileyo uziminzise oLwandle Lomhlanga.
Utwa lwabasibekela; bashona ezinzulwini njengetshe.
“Isandla sakho sokunene Simakade siyakhazimula ngamandla, isandla sakho sokunene Simakade sifihlize isitha.
Ebukhulwini bobukhosi bakho uthele phansi labo abamelana nawe, uthumele intukuthelo yakho yabaqothula njengamahlanga.
Ngokufutha kwamakhala akho amanzi ema aba yinqwaba, izikhukhula zaphakama njengendunduma, utwa lwashuba enhliziyweni yolwandle.
“Isitha sathi: ‘Ngizokubahubha, ngize ngibafice, ngehlukanise impango, ngizitike ngize ngidele ngabo. Ngiyakuhosha inkemba yami, isandla sami sibabhubhise.’
Uphephethe ngomoya wakho, ulwandle lwabemboza, bacwila njengomthofu emanzini anamandla.
“Ngubani onjengawe Simakade phakathi konkulunkulu na? Ngubani onjengawe ngobukhosi nangobungcwele, omangalisayo ngendumiso, owenza izimangaliso na?
Welule isandla sakho sokunene, umhlaba wabagwinya.
“Ngomusa wakho omiyo njalo uhole abantu bakho obakhululileyo; wabahola ngamandla akho wabayisa endaweni okuhlala kuyo ubungcwele bakho.
Izizwe zizwile, zathuthumela; iminjunju yehlela izakhamuzi zaseFilistiya.
Izikhulu zakwa-Edomi zaba netwetwe; izikhulu zakwaMowabi zathuthumela; zonke izakhamuzi zaseKhanani zaphelelwa ngamandla.
Behlelwe yingebhe novalo, ngobukhulu bamandla engalo yakho, bathulisa okwetshe, kwaze kwedlula abantu bakho Simakade, kwaze kwedlula abantu bakho ozithengele bona.
Uyakubabuyisa ubatshale entabeni eyifa lakho, indawo Wena Simakade ozenzele yona ukuba uhlale kuyo, indawo engcwele Simakade, emiswe yizandla zakho.
USimakade uyakubusa phakade naphakade.”

Kwathi ukuba amahhashi kaFaro, nezinqola zempi yakhe, nabagibele amahhashi bangene olwandle, uSimakade wawabuyisela phezu kwabo amanzi olwandle, kodwa abantu bakwa-Israyeli badabula behamba emhlabathini owomileyo.
Kwase kusuka uMiriyamu umphrofethikazi, udadewabo ka-Aroni, wathatha ithamborini ngesandla sakhe; waphuma nabo bonke abesifazane emva kwakhe, bephethe amathamborini, besina.
UMiriyamu wahlabelela wathi: “Hlabelelelani uSimakade, ngokuba uphakeme kakhulu, ihhashi nomgibeli walo ukuphonse olwandle.”
UMose wabahola abantu bakwa-Israyeli besuka oLwandle Lomhlanga, baze bafika ehlane iShuri, bahamba izinsuku ezintathu ehlane, kodwa abatholanga manzi.
Bafika eMara, kodwa abakwazanga ukuphuza amanzi eMara, ngokuba ayebaba, yingakho igama lendawo kwathiwa yiMara.
Abantu bakhononda ngoMose, bathi: “Siyakuphuzani na?”
Wakhala kuSimakade, uSimakade wamkhombisa umuthi; wawuphonsa emanzini, amanzi ayeseba mnandi. USimakade wabamisela khona lapho umthetho nesimiso, wayesebavivinya belapho.

Wathi: “Uma nililalela ngokucophelela izwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, nenze okulungileyo emehlweni akhe, nigcine imiyalo yakhe, nigcine zonke izimiso zakhe, angiyukunehlisela zonke izifo engazehlisela abaseGibhithe, ngokuba nginguSimakade oniphilisayo.”
Bafika e-Elimu, lapho kwakukhona khona imithombo eyi-12 yamanzi, namasundu angama-70, bakanisa lapho ngasemanzini.
Lonke ibandla labantu bakwa-Israyeli lasuka e-Elimu laze layofika ehlane iSini phakathi kwe-Elimu neSinayi, ngosuku lwe-15, ngenyanga yesibili bephumile eGibhithe.
Lonke ibandla lakwa-Israyeli lakhononda ngoMose no-Aroni ehlane.

Abantu bakwa-Israyeli bathi kubo: “Sengathi ngabe safa ngesandla sikaSimakade eGibhithe, lapho sasihlala ngasemabhodweni, sidle inyama nokunye ukudla sisuthe; kunokuba nisilethe lapha kuleli hlane, nizobulala lonke leli bandla ngendlala.”

USimakade wayesethi kuMose: “Bheka, ngizonisela kini isinkwa esivela ezulwini, abantu bazophuma nsuku zonke babuthe esanele lolo lusuku. Ngaleyo ndlela ngizobavivinya ukuthi bazowugcina yini umthetho wami noma qha.
Ngosuku lwesithupha bazobutha okuphindiwe kunalokho abakubutha nsuku zonke.”
UMose no-Aroni bathi kubantu bakwa-Israyeli: “Kusihlwa nizokwazi ukuthi nguSimakade owanikhipha eGibhithe.
Ekuseni nizobona inkazimulo kaSimakade, ngokuba ukuzwile ukukhononda kwenu ngaye. Ngokuba besingobani thina ukuba ningakhononda ngathi na?”

UMose wayesethi: “Lapho uSimakade enipha inyama ukuba nidle kusihlwa, nesinkwa esanele ekuseni, kungokuba uSimakade ekuzwile enikhononda ngakho ngaye, thina-ke besingobani? Ukukhononda kwenu anikubhekisile kithi, kodwa kuSimakade.”
UMose wathi ku-Aroni: “Tshela bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Sondelani kuSimakade, ngokuba ukuzwile ukukhononda kwenu.’ ”
Kwathi nje u-Aroni esakhuluma nabantu bonke bakwa-Israyeli, baphenduka babheka ngasehlane; bheka, babona inkazimulo kaSimakade efini.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Ngikuzwile ukukhononda kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli; khuluma kubo, uthi: ‘Ngakusihlwa niyakudla inyama, ekuseni nizitike ngesinkwa; niyokwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.’ ”
Kusihlwa kwakhuphuka izigwaca zemboza enkanjini; ekuseni kwakulele amazolo ezungeze enkanjini.
Kwathi lapho amazolo esehwamukile, bheka kwakusele untwentwesana olucolisakeleyo ehlane, lwaluluncane njengeqhwa emhlabathini.
Lapho abantu bakwa-Israyeli belubona, bakhuluma omunye komunye, bathi: “Kuyini lokhu na?” Ngokuba babengazi ukuthi kwakuyini lokho. UMose wathi kubo: “Yisinkwa uNkulunkulu aninike sona ukuba nisidle.
Yileli lizwi uSimakade aniyale ngalo wathi: ‘Kubutheni kube yilowo ngokwesilinganiso sakhe, i-omeri kumuntu ngokwesibalo sabantu, nithathele bonke abasemathendeni enu.’ ”
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli benza kanjalo, abanye babutha okuningi, abanye okuncane.
Kepha kwathi lapho bekulinganisa nge-omeri, kulabo ababebuthe okuningi akusalanga lutho, nalabo ababebuthe okuncane abantulanga: yilowo nalowo wayebuthe ngangokwesidingo sakhe.
UMose wathi kubo: “Makungabi bikho okushiyayo kuze kube sekuseni.”
Abantu nokho abamlalelanga uMose, abanye bashiya ingxenye kwaze kwaba sekuseni, yabola yaphethuka izimpethu, yanuka. UMose wabathukuthelela.
Njalo ekuseni kwaba yilowo nalowo wabutha ngangokwesidingo sakhe, kodwa lapho seliphakeme ilanga, kwakuncibilika.
Ngosuku lwesithupha babebutha ukudla okuphindwe kabili, ama-omeri amabili ngamunye. Bonke abaholi beza bambikela uMose,
wathi kubo: “USimakade ukhulumile wathi: ‘Kusasa lusuku lokuphumula, usuku olungcwele kuSimakade, bhakani enifuna ukukubhaka, nibilise enifuna ukukubilisa, okuseleyo kubekeni kuze kube sekuseni.’ ”
Bakubeka kwaze kwaba sekuseni, njengalokhu uMose ayebayalile; akunukanga, futhi akuzange kube nezimpethu.
UMose wathi: “Kudleni namuhla, ngokuba namuhla yisabatha kuSimakade, namuhla anizukukuthola endle.
Nizokubutha izinsuku eziyisithupha, kodwa kuthi ngolwesikhombisa oluyisabatha kungabi bikho.”
Ngosuku lwesikhombisa abanye abantu baphuma ukuyokubutha, kodwa abafumananga lutho.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Kuyoze kube nini nenqaba ukugcina imiyalo yami nemithetho yami na?

Bhekani, uSimakade uninike isabatha, ngakho-ke ngosuku lwesithupha uyaninika ukudla okwanele izinsuku ezimbili, hlalani yilowo nalowo endaweni yakhe, kungaphumi noyedwa endaweni yakhe ngosuku lwesikhombisa.”
Abantu baphumula ngosuku lwesikhombisa.
Indlu yakwa-Israyeli yakubiza lokho ngokuthi yimana, kwakufana nezinhlamvu zekhoriyenda, kumhlophe, kunambitheka njengekhekhebana elinoju.
UMose wathi: “Yileli izwi uSimakade aniyala ngalo, ethi: ‘Makugcinwe i-omeri eligcwele lalokhu ukuze izizukulwane zenu zibone ukudla enganondla ngakho ehlane, lapho nginikhipha eGibhithe.’ ”
UMose wathi ku-Aroni: “Thatha isitsha, ufake kuso i-omeri lemana ligcwale, ulibeke phambi kukaSimakade ukuze ligcinelwe izizukulwane zenu.”
Njengalokhu uSimakade emyalile uMose, u-Aroni walibeka i-omeri lemana phambi kobufakazi, ukuze lilondolozeke kahle.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli badla imana iminyaka engama-40, baze bafinyelela ezweni okwakhiwe kulo; bayidla imana baze bafika emngceleni weKhanani.
I-omeri ingokweshumi kwe-efa.
Lonke ibandla labantu bakwa-Israyeli lasuka ehlane iSini lahamba ngezigaba, njengokuyala kukaSimakade. Lakanisa eRefidimi, kodwa kwakungekho manzi okuba abantu baphuze.
Abantu baxabana noMose, bathi: “Sinike amanzi ukuze siphuze.” UMose wathi kubo: “Nilwelani nami na? Nimvivinyelani uSimakade na?”
Abantu bomela amanzi lapho; bakhononda kuMose, bathi: “Wasikhuphulelani eGibhithe ukuba usibulalise ngokoma thina nabantwana bethu nemfuyo yethu na?”
