UMose wakhala kuSimakade, wathi: “Ngiyakwenzani ngalaba bantu na? Sekusele kancane ukuba bangikhande ngamatshe.”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Hamba phambi kwabantu, uthathe amanye amalunga akwa-Israyeli, nenduku yakho owashaya ngayo umfula, yiphathe ngesandla sakho, uhambe.
Ngizobe ngimi phambi kwakho laphaya edwaleni eHorebhe. Uyakulishaya idwala kuphume amanzi kulo, ukuze abantu baphuze.” UMose wenza kanjalo ebuka amalunga akwa-Israyeli.

Leyo ndawo wayibiza ngokuthi kuseMasa neMeribha, ngenxa yokuphikisana kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli, nangenxa yokuba bamvivinya uSimakade lapho, bethi: “Ngabe uSimakade ukhona yini phakathi kwethu noma qha?”
Ama-Amaleki aphuma alwa nabakwa-Israyeli eRefidimi.
UMose wathi kuJoshuwa: “Sikhethele amadoda, uphume uyokulwa nama-Amaleki. Mina ngizobe ngimi esiqongweni sentaba, ngiphethe induku kaNkulunkulu esandleni.”
UJoshuwa wenza njengalokhu uMose eshilo kuye, walwa nama-Amaleki, ngesikhathi uMose, u-Aroni, noHure bekhuphukela esiqongweni sentaba.
Noma nini lapho isandla sikaMose siphakeme, u-Israyeli wayenqoba, kodwa uma esehlisa esiphumuza, kunqobe ama-Amaleki.

Kodwa izandla zikaMose zase zikhathele, ngakho-ke bathatha itshe balibeka phansi kwakhe, wahlala kulo. U-Aroni noHure baphakamisa izandla zakhe, omunye kuleli cala nomunye kwelinye icala, izandla zama kanjalo ziqinile laze lashona ilanga.
UJoshuwa wanqoba u-Ameleki nabantu bakhe ngenkemba.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Kulobe lokhu encwadini kube yisikhumbuzo, ukutshele uJoshuwa ngokuba ngizowabhubhisa aphele nya ama-Amaleki phansi kwezulu, angabe esakhunjulwa nhlobo.”
UMose wakha i-althare, waliqamba ngokuthi: “uSimakade Nisi”.
Wayesethi: “Isandla sisesihlalweni sikaSimakade! USimakade uyakulwa nama-Amaleki izizukulwane ngezizukulwane.”
UJethro, umphristi wakwaMidiyani, umukhwe kaMose, wezwa konke uNkulunkulu ayekwenzele uMose nabantu bakhe bakwa-Israyeli, ukuthi uSimakade wayemkhiphe kanjani u-Israyeli eGibhithe.
UJethro, umukhwe kaMose, wathatha uZiphora umkaMose owayekade uMose emphindisele emuva,
namadodana akhe amabili, igama lenye kwakunguGereshomu, ngokuba wayethi: “Ngingumfokazi ezweni labezizwe,”
igama lenye kungu-Eliyezeri, ngokuba ethi: “UNkulunkulu kababa ulusizo lwami, ungikhululile enkembeni kaFaro.”
UJethro, umukhwe kaMose, wafika ehlane lapho uMose ayekanise khona entabeni kaNkulunkulu, nomkaMose namadodana akhe.
Wathi kuMose: “Mina Jethro, umukhwe wakho, ngiyeza kuwe, nomkakho, namadodana akho omabili.”
UMose waphuma ukuyomhlangabeza umukhwe wakhe, wakhothama, wamanga, babuzana impilo, base bengena ethendeni.
UMose wamlandisa umukhwe wakhe konke uSimakade ayekwenze kuFaro nakwabaseGibhithe ngenxa ka-Israyeli, nobunzima bonke ababehlangabezane nabo endleleni, nokuthi uSimakade wabakhulula kanjani.
UJethro wathokoza ngakho konke okuhle uSimakade ayekwenzele u-Israyeli, ebakhulula esandleni sabaseGibhithe.
UJethro wathi: “Makabongwe uSimakade, onikhululile kwabaseGibhithe nasesandleni sikaFaro.
Manje ngiyazi ukuthi uSimakade mkhulu kunabo bonke onkulunkulu, ngoba ukhulule abantu bakhe kwabaseGibhithe, lapho bebebaphethe khona ngokubaqonela.”
UJethro umukhwe kaMose, waletha umnikelo wokushiswa nemihlatshelo kuNkulunkulu; u-Aroni nawo wonke amalunga akwa-Israyeli beza bazokudla nomukhwe kaMose, phambi kukaNkulunkulu.
Ngakusasa uMose wahlalela ukwehlulela abantu, abantu bema ngakuMose kusukela ekuseni kwaze kwaba kusihlwa.
Umukhwe kaMose wakubona konke lokhu ayekwenzela abantu, wathi kuye: “Kuyini lokhu obenzela khona abantu na? Kungani uhlale wedwa, uzungezwe ngabantu kusukela ekuseni kuze kuhlwe na?”
UMose wathi kumukhwe wakhe: “Kungokuba abantu beza kimi ukuzobuza okushiwo nguNkulunkulu.
Uma kunodaba phakathi kwabo, beza kimi ukuba ngahlulele phakathi komuntu nomakhelwane wakhe, bese ngibatshela imithetho nezimiso zikaNkulunkulu.”
Umukhwe kaMose wathi kuye: “Lokhu okwenzayo akukuhle.
Uzozikhandla uzikhathaze wena nalaba bantu onabo, ngokuba lo msebenzi mkhulu kakhulu kunawe, awunakukwazi ukuwenza uwedwa.
Manje ngilalele, ngizokweluleka, uNkulunkulu abe nawe. Ufanele ukukhulumela abantu phambi kukaNkulunkulu, ulethe izindaba zabo kuNkulunkulu;
bafundise izimiso nemithetho, ubenze bayiqonde indlela okumele bahambe ngayo, nomsebenzi okufanele bawenze.

Zifunele phakathi kwabo amadoda ahloniphekile, amesabayo uNkulunkulu, amadoda athembekile, akuzondayo ukuthola inzuzo ngokungalungile, uwabeke abe yizinduna zezinkulungwane, zamakhulu, zama-50, nezeshumi.
Makube yibona abehlulela abantu ngezikhathi zonke; balethe kuwe zonke izindaba ezinkulu, kodwa amacala amancane mawanqunywe yibo, ukuze bawenze ube lula umthwalo wakho, bathwalisane nawe.
Uma ukwenza lokhu, noNkulunkulu ekuyala kanjalo, uyokwazi ukuma, nabantu bonke babuyele emizini yabo benokweneliswa.”
UMose wamlalela umukhwe wakhe, wakwenza konke ayekushilo.
UMose wakhetha amadoda anekhono phakathi kwabakwa-Israyeli, wawabeka aba yizinduna zabantu, aba yizinduna phezu kwezinkulungwane, phezu kwamakhulu, phezu kwama-50, naphezu kweshumi.
Zehlulela abantu ngezikhathi zonke. Amacala anzima zaziwedlulisela kuMose. Zonke izindaba ezilula zehlulelwa yizo.
UMose wavalelisana nomukhwe wakhe, uJethro wahamba wabuyela ezweni lakubo.
Kwathi ngenyanga yesithathu emveni kokuphuma kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli eGibhithe, ngalo lolo lusuku, bafika ehlane iSinayi.
Basuka eRefidimi bafinyelela ehlane iSinayi, bakanisa ehlane; abakwa-Israyeli bakanisa lapho-ke, phambi kwentaba.
UMose wakhuphukela kuNkulunkulu; uSimakade wambiza esentabeni, wathi: “Yisho kanje kuyo indlu kaJakobe, umemezele kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi:
‘Nikubonile engikwenze kwabaseGibhithe, nokuthi nginithwale kanjani ngamaphiko okhozi nganiletha kimi.
Ngakho-ke uma nililalela ngokucophelela izwi lami, nigcine isivumelwano sami, niyokuba yisabelo sami esiligugu phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe, ngokuba umhlaba wonke ungowami.
Niyakuba ngumbuso wabaphristi kimi, nesizwe esingcwele. Yilawo mazwi oyokuwakhuluma kubantu bakwa-Israyeli.’ ”
UMose wahamba wabiza amalunga abantu, wakhuluma phambi kwawo wonke amazwi uSimakade ayemyale ngawo.
Bonke abantu baphendula ngazwi linye, bathi: “Siyokwenza konke uSimakade akushilo kithi.” UMose wabuyisela kuSimakade wonke amazwi ayekhulunywe ngabantu.

USimakade wathi kuMose: “Bheka ngizokuza kuwe ngefu elimnyama, ukuze abantu bezwe uma ngikhuluma nawe, nokuba emveni kwalokho bakholwe nguwe kuze kube phakade.” UMose wambikela uSimakade lokho okwakushiwo ngabantu.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Hamba uye kubantu, ubangcwelise namuhla nakusasa, bahlanze izembatho zabo,
bazilungiselele usuku lwesithathu, ngokuba ngosuku lwesithathu uSimakade uyokwehlela entabeni iSinayi phambi kwabantu bonke.
Uyakubamisela abantu umngcele nxazonke, uthi: ‘Qaphelani ningenyukeli entabeni, noma nithinte umngcele wayo. Noma ngubani othinta intaba uyakubulawa impela.

Mabangathintwa ngesandla, kodwa mabakhandwe ngamatshe, noma bacitshwe ngemicibisholo, noma ngabe yisilwane, noma ngumuntu akuyukuphila.’ Lapho icilongo likhala isikhathi eside, bayokhuphukela entabeni.”
UMose wehla entabeni, waya kubantu. Wabangcwelisa abantu base behlanza izingubo zabo.
Wathi kubantu: “Zilungiseleleni lezi zinsuku ezintathu; ningasondeli kwabesifazane.”
Ngosuku lwesithathu ekuseni, kwaba nokuduma, nombani, nefu elimnyama phezu kwentaba, nokukhala okukhulu kwecilongo, abantu bonke ababesenkanjini bathuthumela.
UMose wabahola abantu enkanjini ukuba bayohlangana noNkulunkulu, bama ekuqaleni kwentaba.
Yonke intaba iSinayi yayithunqa intuthu, ngokuba uSimakade wayehlele kuyo ngomlilo, intuthu yayo yenyuka njengentuthu yesithando somlilo; intaba yonke yazamaza kakhulu.
Lapho umsindo wecilongo wawulokhu uzwakala kakhulu ungathuli, uMose wakhuluma, uNkulunkulu wamphendula ngezwi elikhulu.
USimakade wehlela esiqongweni sentaba iSinayi, wayesebiza uMose ukuba akhuphukele kuso, uMose wakhuphuka.
USimakade wathi kuye: “Yehla, uxwayise abantu bangafohli ukuba babone uSimakade, ngokuba iningi labo liyobhubha.
Nabaphristi abasondela kuSimakade mabazingcwelise, funa uSimakade ababhubhise.”
UMose wathi kuSimakade: “Abantu ngeke bakhuphukele entabeni iSinayi, ngokuba Wena usixwayisile, wathi: ‘Misa umngcele, uyingcwelise intaba.’ ”
USimakade wathi kuye: “Yehla, uhambe ubuye no-Aroni nize lapha, kodwa abaphristi nabantu mabangafohli bakhuphukele kuSimakade funa ababhubhise.”
UMose wehla wakhuluma nabantu.
UNkulunkulu wakhuluma wonke lawa mazwi, wathi:
“NginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho owakukhipha eGibhithe, indlu yobugqila.
Ungabi nabanye onkulunkulu ngaphandle kwami.
Ungazenzeli isithombe esibaziweyo, sanoma yini olusezulwini phezulu, noma olusemhlabeni phansi, noma olusemanzini phansi komhlaba.

Ungazikhothameli, ungahungeki ukuba uzikhonze, ngokuba Mina Simakade uNkulunkulu wakho, nginguNkulunkulu onomhawu, ngihambela ububi bawoyise kubantwana, kuso isizukulwane sesithathu nesesine sabangizondayo,
kepha ngibenzela umusa abayizinkulungwane balabo abangithandayo, bagcine imiyalelo yami.
Ungaliphathi ngeze igama likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ngokuba uSimakade akayukumyeka angamjezisi oliphatha ngeze igama lakhe.
Khumbula usuku lwesabatha, ulungcwelise.
Uyosebenza ngezinsuku eziyisithupha, uwenze wonke umsebenzi wakho,

kepha usuku lwesikhombisa luyisabatha likaSimakade, uNkulunkulu wakho; awuyukwenza msebenzi ngalo, wena nendodana yakho, indodakazi yakho, inceku yakho, incekukazi yakho, imfuyo yakho, nomfokazi ogogobele emzini wakho,

ngokuba ngezinsuku eziyisithupha uSimakade wenza izulu nomhlaba, nolwandle, nakho konke okukukho, waphumula ngosuku lwesikhombisa, ngalokho uSimakade walubusisa usuku lwesabatha, walwehlukanisela ukuba lube ngcwele.
Hlonipha uyihlo nonyoko ukuze izinsuku zakho zande ezweni, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona.
Ungabulali.
Ungaphingi.
Ungebi.
Ungafakazi ngamanga ngomakhelwane wakho.
Ungayifisi indlu yomakhelwane wakho; ungamfisi umfazi womakhelwane wakho, inceku yakhe, incekukazi yakhe, inkabi yakhe, imbongolo yakhe, noma yini kamakhelwane wakho.”
Lapho bonke abantu bezwa ukuduma kwezulu, nombani, nokukhala kwecilongo, bebona nentaba ithunqa, bathuthumela, bamela kude.
Bathi kuMose: “Khuluma wena nathi, siyakukulalela, kodwa uNkulunkulu makangakhulumi nathi, funa sife.”
UMose wathi kubantu: “Ningesabi; uNkulunkulu uze ukuba anivivinye nokuba anifake uvalo ukuze ningoni.”
Kepha abantu bamela kude, kwaba nguMose kuphela osondela efini elimnyama lapho uNkulunkulu wayekhona.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Uyakusho lokhu kubantu bakwa-Israyeli uthi: ‘Nizibonele ukuthi ngikhulume nani ngisezulwini.
Aniyukuzenzela abanye onkulunkulu ngaphandle kwami, onkulunkulu besiliva noma begolide aniyukuzenzela bona.

Niyakungakhela i-althare ngomhlabathi, nenze phezu kwalo imihlatshelo yokushishwa neyokuthula, ngezimvu nezinkomo zenu, kuzo zonke izindawo lapho ngenza khona ukuba igama lami likhunjulwe, ngiyakuza nginibusise.
Uma ningakhela i-althare lamatshe, aniyukulakha ngamatshe abaziweyo, ngokuba nilingcolisile ngamashizolo eniwasebenzise kulo.
Awuyukwenyukela e-althare lami ngezitebhisi, funa kwambulwe ubunqunu bakho.’ ”
“Yilezi izehlulelo ozakuzimisa phambi kwabo:
uma uthenga isigqila somHebheru, masikusebenzele iminyaka eyisithupha, ngonyaka wesikhombisa siyakuhamba singesikhululekileyo, singakhokhi lutho.
Uma sifike sisodwa, siyakuphuma sisodwa, uma sifike sesiganiwe siyakuhamba nomkaso.
Uma umniniso esinike umfazi samzalela amadodana noma amadodakazi, owesifazane nabantwana bayoba ngabomnini wesigqila, sona siphume sihambe sodwa.
Kepha uma isigqila sisho ngokucacile sithi: ‘Ngiyamthanda umnumzane wami, nomkami nabantwana bami, ngakho-ke anginakuhamba njengokhululekileyo,’
umniniso uyosithatha asilethe kuNkulunkulu, uyosimisa ngasemnyango noma ngasensikeni yomnyango bese umniniso esibhoboza indlebe ngosungulo, sibe yisigqila sakhe impilo yaso yonke.
“Uma indoda ithengisa ngendodakazi yayo ukuba ibe yisigqila, ayinakukhululwa njengoba kukhululwa izigqila zesilisa.
Uma singamthokozisi umniniso, owasikhetha ukuba sibe ngesakhe, uyakuvuma ukuba sihlengwe; akayukuba nalungelo lokuba asidayisele abantu bezizwe, lokhu engasiphathanga kahle yena.
Uma ithenga isigqila sesifazane ukuze isinikele endodaneni yaso ngokwesiko iyosiphatha njengendodakazi yayo.
Uma indoda ithatha omunye umfazi, kufanele umfazi wokuqala iqhubeke nokumnikeza ukudla nezingubo njengakuqala, namalungelo akhe obufazi angaguquki.
Uma indoda ingasakufezi lokhu okuthathu esigqilini sayo, kufanele isikhulule, futhi ingakhokhelwa lutho ngaso.
“Umuntu oshaya omunye ambulale, naye uyakubulawa.
Kepha uma kube yingozi engakusophile, kunguNkulunkulu omnikele esandleni sakhe, ngiyakummisela indawo lapho eyobalekela khona.
Kodwa uma umuntu ehlasela abulale omunye ngobuqili, kufanele naye asuswe e-althare lami abulawe.”
“Oshaya uyise noma unina kufanele abulawe.
“Noma ngubani othumba omunye, athengise ngaye noma atholakale kuye, kufanele abulawe.
“Noma ngubani oqalekisa uyise noma unina kufanele abulawe.
“Nxa abantu belwa, omunye ashaye umakhelwane wakhe ngetshe noma ngenqindi, angafi, kepha alale embhedeni,
uma elulama, akwazi ukuzihambela phandle ngenduku, owamshayayo akayukujeziswa, nokho uyomkhokhela ngesikhathi sakhe esichithekileyo, elashwe aze alulame.
“Uma indoda ishaye isigqila sayo sesilisa noma sesifazane ngenduku saze safa phansi kwesandla sayo, kufanele ijeziswe nokujeziswa,
kodwa uma leso sigqila siphile izinsukwana ezimbili noma ezintathu ayiyukujeziswa, ngokuba isigqila siyimpahla yayo.

“Uma abantu belwa, balimaze owesifazane okhulelwe, aphuphunyelwe yisisu, kodwa yena angalimali ndawo, lowo muntu uyohlawuliswa njengoba indoda yalowo wesifazane inqumile ukuba ahlawule, ngokwesinqumo sabehluleli.
Uma kuvela ingozi kufanele kwenanwe ukuphila ngokuphila,
iso ngeso, izinyo ngezinyo, isandla ngesandla, unyawo ngonyawo,
ukushiswa ngokushiswa, umvimbo ngomvimbo, inxeba ngenxeba.
“Uma umuntu eshaya iso lesigqila sakhe sesilisa noma sesifazane, iso alibulale, uyosikhulula ngenxa yeso laso.
Uma eshaye isigqila sakhe sesilisa noma esesifazane saphuma izinyo, isigqila siyakuhamba singokhululekileyo ngenxa yezinyo laso.”
“Uma inkabi igwaze owesilisa noma owesifazane yambulala, leyo nkabi iyakukhandwa ngamatshe, ife; inyama yayo ayiyukudliwa, umniniyo akayukuba nacala.
Uma inkabi ijwayele ukugwaza abantu, futhi nomniniyo exwayisiwe ngalokho, kodwa angayibophi, uma-ke ibulala owesilisa noma owesifazane, iyokhandwa ngamatshe, nomniniyo abulawe.
Kepha uma umniniyo ehlawulisiwe, uyakukhokha leyo nhlawulo emisiweyo ngalowo obulewe.
Uma inkabi igwaze yabulala umfana noma intombazane le mithetho engenhla yiyona eyolandelwa.
Uma inkabi igwaze yabulala isigqila sesilisa noma sesifazane, umniniyo uyokhokhela umnini wesigqila amashekeli esiliva angama-30; inkabi ikhandwe ngamatshe.
“Uma umuntu evula umgodi noma emba umgodi angawembozi bese kukhalakathela kuwo inkabi noma imbongolo,
umnini womgodi uyokhokhela umnini wesilwane ngemali; yena athathe isilwane esifileyo sibe ngesakhe.
“Uma inkabi yomunye ibulala inkabi yomunye, bobabili bayoyithengisa inkabi ephilayo bese behlukaniselana ngemali; babuye behlukaniselane ngenyama yenkabi efileyo.
Kepha uma kwaziwa ukuthi le nkabi inomkhuba wokuhlasela, nomniniyo engayivaleli, kufanele akhokhele umnini wenkabi efileyo ngenkabi ephilayo; yena agcine leyo efileyo kube ngeyakhe.
“Uma umuntu entshontsha inkabi noma imvu, bese eyihlaba noma ayithengise, uyokhokhiswa izinkabi ezinhlanu ngenkabi, nezimvu ezine ngemvu.
Uma isela libanjwe ligqekeza, liyoshaywa lize life, akuyukuba nacala legazi.
Uma libanjwe emini kwabha, kuyoba yicala legazi phezu kwalo. Isela liyokhokha ngokuphindiwe; uma lingenalutho lokukhokha, kuyothengiswa ngalo ngenxa yokweba kwalo.
“Uma okwebiweyo kutholakala esandleni salo kusaphila, kungaba yinkabi, yimbongolo noma yimvu, isela liyakukhokha ngokuphindwe kabili.
“Uma umuntu eklabisa ensimini noma esivinini, ayekele izinkomo zakhe zidle ensimini yomunye, kufanele akhokhe lokho okudliweyo; akhiphe okwekhethelo esivinini noma ensimini yakhe kube yinkokhelo.
“Uma kuqubuka umlilo, wokheleke ezihlahleni ezinameva kuze kushe nezinhlanga zamabele, noma okusanhlamvu okungakavunwa, lowo othungele umlilo kufanele akhokhe.
“Uma umuntu enika umakhelwane wakhe imali noma izimpahla ukuba amgcinele ziphephile zibe zingezebiwe endlini kamakhelwane, uma libanjwa isela, liyakukhokha ngokuphindwe kabili.
Uma isela lingabanjwanga, umnini wendlu uyakulethwa phambi kukaNkulunkulu, ukuze kucaciswe ukuthi umnini wempahla ngabe uyintshontshe kwamakhelwane yini noma qha.

“Emacaleni wonke ombango wempahla, aphathelene nenkabi, imbongolo, imvu, isembatho, noma iyiphi nje enye impahla elahlekile, bobabili ababangayo bayoletha izikhalo zabo kuNkulunkulu. Olahlwa yicala phambi kukaNkulunkulu uyomkhokhela umakhelwane wakhe kuphindwe kabili.
“Uma umuntu enika umakhelwane wakhe imbongolo, noma inkabi, noma imvu, noma silwane sini, bese isilwane siyafa noma silimale noma sithunjwe singabonwa muntu,
isifungo phambi kukaSimakade yisona esiyakunquma phakathi kwabo ukuthi omunye akabanga nasandla empahleni yomunye. Umnini wesilwane uyakusamukela isifungo kungabi bikho sinxephezelo asitholayo.
Kepha uma yebiwe, umniniyo uyothola isinxephezelo.
Uma idwengulwe yizilwane zasendle, makulethwe ubufakazi; akuyukuba bikho sinxephezelo ngokudwenguliweyo.
“Uma umuntu eboleka isilwane komunye umuntu bese leso silwane siyalimala noma sife umniniso engekho, uyakukhokhelwa ngokugcwele.
Kepha uma umininiso ebekhona, akayukukhokhelwa, uma besiqashiwe, uyokhokhelwa inani lokusiqasha kuphela.
“Uma umuntu eyenga intombi engesiyo ingoduso, alale nayo, kufanele ayilobole, imgane.
Kepha uma uyise wentombi enqaba ukumganisela, uyakukhokha inani elilingana nelobolo lentombi.
“Awuyukumvumela umlumbikazi aphile.
“Lowo olala nesilwane, makabulawe.
“Owenzela abanye onkulunkulu umhlatshelo, angenzeli uSimakade yena yedwa, uyobhujiswa.
“Awuyukumphatha kabi noma umcindezele umfokazi ohlala nawe, ngokuba nawe wawungumfokazi eGibhithe.
Aniyukumhlupha umfelokazi nentandane.
Uma ubahlukumeza, bese bekhala kimi, ngiyokuzwa ukukhala kwabo,
ulaka lwami luvuthe, nginibulale ngenkemba, omkenu babe ngabafelokazi, izingane zenu zibe yizintandane.
“Uma uboleka omunye wabantu bami imali, uboleka ompofu phakathi kwenu, awuyukumphathisa okombolekisi wemali, awuyukumbiza nzalo.
Uma uthatha ingubo kamakhelwane wakho ibe yisibambiso, uyakuyibuyisela kuye lingakashoni ilanga,
ngokuba kungenzeka kube yiyona ngubo kuphela anayo ukuyembatha; uyokwembathani uma eselala na? Uma umakhelwane wakho ekhala kimi, ngiyokumlalela, ngokuba nginomusa.
“Awunakumthuka uNkulunkulu, noma uqalekise umholi wabantu bakini.
“Awuyukukhohlwa ukuletha iminikelo yesivuno sakho sokusanhlamvu nesewayini. “Amazibulo amadodana akho uyakuwanika Mina.
Uyokwenza okufanayo ngamazibulo ezinkomo zakho, nawezimvu zakho. Uyakuwavumela abe nonina izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, bese kuthi ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili uwanikele kimi.
“Niyakuba ngabantu abangcwele kimi, ngakho-ke ningayidli inyama yesilwane esidweshulwe yizilwane zasendle, kodwa aniboyiphonsela izinja.
“Awuyukusabalalisa umbiko ongamanga, awuyukubambisana nababi ukwethula ubufakazi obungamanga.
Awuyukulilandela iningi ekwenzeni okungalungile noma lapho wethula ubufakazi ecaleni, awuyukuzihlanganisa neningi ukuze uhlanekezele umthetho.
Awuyukukhombisa ukuvuna ompofu ecaleni.
“Uma ufumana inkabi yesitha sakho noma imbongolo yaso iduka, yibuyisele kuso.
Uma ubona imbongolo yalowo okuzondayo ipatalele phansi komthwalo, uyoyeka yini ukuyikhulula? Yelekelele ukuze ikhululeke.
“Awuyukubuhlanekezela ubulungiswa ngenxa yabampofu ecaleni labo.
Ziqhelelanise nokwethwesa omunye icala lamanga, ungambulali ongenacala noma labo abaseqinisweni, ngokuba angiyukumkhulula onecala.
“Awuyukwamukela ukufunjathiswa, ngokuba ukudizelwa kuyaziphuphuthekisa izikhulu, bese kuphambanisa nendlela yalabo abahamba ngokulunga.
Awuyukumcindezela umfokazi, uyayazi inhliziyo yomfokazi, ngokuba nani naningabafokazi eGibhithe.”
“Iminyaka eyisithupha uyakutshala insimu yakho, uvune isivuno sayo,

kodwa ngonyaka wesikhombisa uyakuyiphumuza, awuyukuyilima; uyakuyiyeka ibe yifusi, ukuze abampofu bakini badle, kuthi lokho abakushiyayo kudliwe yizilwane zasendle. Uyokwenza kanjalo nangesivini sakho nangeminqumo yakho.
“Uyakusebenza izinsuku eziyisithupha, uphumule ngosuku lwesikhombisa, ukuze inkabi yakho, nembongolo yakho kuphumule, nesigqila esizalelwe kwakho, nogogobele kwakho bahlunyelelwe.
“Kuqapheleni konke engikusho kini. Ningakhuleki emagameni abanye onkulunkulu; ningawaphathi ngisho nangemilomo yenu amagama abo.”
“Uyongenzela imikhosi kathathu ngonyaka.

“Ngenyanga u-Abibi, inyanga owaphuma ngayo eGibhithe, uyogubha umkhosi wesinkwa esingenamvubelo ngendlela engakuyala ngayo. Ezinsukwini eziyisikhombisa zalo mkhosi ungasidli isinkwa esinemvubelo. Makungezi muntu phambi kwami engaphethe lutho.
“Uyogubha umkhosi wokuvuna wezithelo zokuqala zomsebenzi wakho owuhlwanyele ensimini. “Ugubhe umkhosi wokuqoqa konke okulime ensimini ekupheleni konyaka.
Kathathu ngonyaka bonke abesilisa bakho bayokuza phambi kweNkosi uSimakade.
“Awuyukuletha kimi igazi lomhlatshelo wami nanoma yini okunemvubelo, noma ugcine amanoni omkhosi wami kuze kube ngakusasa.
“Ngonyaka uyoletha endlini kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho okwekhethelo kwesivuno sakho sokuqala. “Ungalipheki izinyane lembuzi obisini lukanina.”
“Bheka, ngizothumela ingelosi ikwandulele ukuze ikuvikele ohambeni, futhi ikufinyelelise endaweni engiyilungisileyo.
Ilalelisise, futhi uyithobele. Ungayivukeli, ngokuba ayiyukuzithethelela iziphambeko zenu, ngokuba igama lami likuyo.
Kepha uma ulalela nokulalela izwi layo wenza konke ekutshela khona, ngiyobazonda abakuzondayo, ngibe yisitha sezitha zakho.
Ingelosi yami izokwandulela, ikuyise kuma-Amori, kumaHithi, kumaPherizi, kumaKhanani, kumaHivi, nakumaJebusi, ngiyowabhubhisa.
Ungabakhothameli onkulunkulu bawo, ungahuheki ukuba ubakhonze, ungazenzi izinto azenzayo. Kodwa uyobabhidliza onkulunkulu bawo, ucekele phansi izinsika zabo zamatshe.
Niyakumkhonza uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, Mina ngiyobusisa ukudla namanzi enu, ngisuse izifo phakathi kwenu.
Ezweni lakini akekho owesifazane oyophuphunyelwa yisisu, noma oyoba yinyumba. Ngiyokupha impilo ende.
“Ngiyokwenza abantu abamelene nawe bangesabe; ngilethe ukudideka phakathi kwabantu olwa nabo, ngenze zonke izitha zakho zikubalekele.
Ngiyokwenza izitha zakho zithuthumele, ngigudluze amaHivi, amaKhanani namaHithi phambi kwakho.
Angiyukuzixosha phambi kwakho ngonyaka owodwa; uma ngingenza kanjalo, izwe liyosala dengwane, kuthi izilwane zasendle zibe ziningi kunawe.
Kunalokho, ngizozixosha phambi kwakho kancane kancane, uze wande ngokwanele ukuba ulidle izwe.

Ngiyokwandisa imingcele yezwe lakho kusukela oLwandle Lomhlanga kuze kufike olwandle lwamaFilisti, kusukela ehlane kuze kushaye emfuleni. Ngiyonipha amandla phezu kwezakhamuzi zezwe, nizixoshe phambi kwenu.
Ningenzi isivumelwano nazo, noma nonkulunkulu bazo.
Abayukuhlala ezweni lakini, funa banenze none kimi, ngokuba uma nikhonza onkulunkulu bazo, bayokuba wugibe kini.”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Khuphukela kuSimakade, wena, no-Aroni, noNadabi, no-Abhihu, namalunga angama-70 akwa-Israyeli; nikhothame ningikhonze nisekude.
NguMose kuphela oyakusondela kuSimakade, kepha abanye abayukusondela; nabantu abayukukhuphuka naye.”
UMose weza watshela abantu wonke amazwi kaSimakade nezehlulelo zonke; abantu bonke baphendula ngazwi linye, bathi: “Wonke amazwi uSimakade awakhulumile sizowenza.”
UMose wawabhala wonke amazwi kaSimakade. Wavuka ekuseni ngovivi, wakha i-althare phansi kwentaba, wamisa izinsika ezili-12 ngokwezizwe ezili-12 zakwa-Israyeli.
Wathuma izinsizwa zakwa-Israyeli zanikela ngeminikelo yokushiswa, zahlabela uSimakade amaduna ukuba abe yimihlatshelo yokuthula.
UMose wathatha ingxenye yegazi walithela ezitsheni, kwathi enye wafafaza ngayo i-althare.
Wayesethatha incwadi yesivumelwano, wayifunda belalele abantu, bonke bathi: “Konke uSimakade akukhulumile, sizokwenza, sizokukuhlonipha.”
UMose wathatha igazi wafafaza ngalo abantu, wathi: “Bhekani, leli yigazi lesivumelwano uSimakade asenze nani ngawo wonke lawa mazwi.”
UMose, u-Aroni, uNadabi, u-Abhihu namalunga akwa-Israyeli angama-70 bakhuphuka,
bambona uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli; phansi kwezinyawo zakhe kwakukhona okwakufana nendawo egandaywe ngamatshe esafire, kungathi yizulu uqobo ngokucweba.
UNkulunkulu akazenzakalisanga izikhulu zabantu bakwa-Israyeli, kodwa zambona, zadla, zaphuza.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Khuphukela kimi entabeni uhlale lapho, ngizokunika izibhebhe zamatshe, umthetho nemiyalelo engikubhalileyo ukuze ubafundise yona.”
UMose nenceku yakhe uJoshuwa bavuka, uMose wakhuphukela entabeni kaNkulunkulu.
Wathi kumalunga: “Silindeni lapha kule ndawo size sibuyele kini. Bhekani, u-Aroni noHure banani; noma ngubani onodaba makaye kubo.”
UMose wayesekhuphukela entabeni, ifu layisibekela intaba.
Inkazimulo kaSimakade yahlala entabeni iSinayi, ifu layisibekela intaba izinsuku eziyisithupha; kwathi ngosuku lwesikhombisa uSimakade esefini, wambiza uMose.
Ukubonakala kwenkazimulo kaSimakade kubantu bakwa-Israyeli kwakufana nomlilo oqothulayo esiqongweni sentaba.
UMose wangena phakathi efini, wakhuphukela entabeni, wayesentabeni izinsuku ezingama-40 nobusuku obungama-40.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Khuluma nabantu bakwa-Israyeli ukuze bangilethele umnikelo, kube yilowo nalowo anikele ngokuthanda kwenhliziyo yakhe; ningilethele umnikelo wami.
Yilo umnikelo eniyakuwuletha uvela kubo: igolide, isiliva, ithusi,
okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, okubukhwebezane, okubomvu, ilineni elicolekileyo, uboya bezimbuzi;
izikhumba zezinqama ezidaywe zabomvu; izikhumba zamahlengethwa, izingodo zokhuni lomkhambathi,
amafutha ezibani, amakha, amafutha okugcoba nawempepho,
amatshe amashohamu, namatshe okuhlobisa ingubo yamahlombe nasesifubeni.
“Mabangenzele ithabanakeli elingcwele ukuze ngihlale phakathi kwabo.
Yenzani konke njengalokho engizakunikhombisa khona, umfanekiso wethabanakeli, nayo yonke impahla ekulo, niyakuyenza kanjalo.”
“Bayakuwenza umphongolo ngokhuni lomkhambathi, ubude bube ngamakhubhithi amabili nengxenye, ububanzi bube yikhubhithi nengxenye, nokuphakama kwawo kube yikhubhithi nengxenye.
Uyakuwucaka ngegolide elicwengekileyo ngaphandle nangaphakathi, uwenzele umphetho wegolide nxazonke.
Uwenzele amasongo amane egolide, uwafake emilenzeni yawo yomine; amasongo abe mabili ohlangothini ngalunye.
Wenze izingongolo ngokhuni lomkhambathi bese uzicaka ngegolide,
izingongolo uzifake emasongweni asezinhlangothini zomphongolo ukuze uthwalwe ngazo.
Izingongolo kufanele zihlale emasongweni, zingasuswa kuwo.
Uyofaka emphongolweni izibhebhe zamatshe engizokunika zona.
Uyokwenza isivalo sesihlalo somusa ngegolide elicwengekileyo, ubude baso bube ngamakhubhithi amabili nengxenye, ububanzi baso bube yikhubhithi nengxenye.
Uyokwenza amakherubhi amabili ngegolide elicangcathiweyo; uwabeke emphethweni wesihlalo somusa nxazombili zaso.
Uyokwenza ikherubhi ngalinye libe sekugcineni kwezinhlangothi zombili, uwenze ekugcineni nxazombili, ahlangane nesihlalo somusa.
Amakherubhi ayokwelula amaphiko awo ngaphezulu, amboze ngawo isihlalo somusa, abhekane ngobuso; ubuso bawo buyobheka isihlalo somusa.
Uyosibeka isihlalo somusa phezu komphongolo, ufake phakathi izibhebhe zamatshe engizokunika zona.
Ngiyohlangana nawe lapho, ngikhulume nawe ngiphezu kwesihlalo somusa naphakathi kwamakherubhi amabili aphezu komphongolo wobufakazi, ngiyakukuyala ngakho konke oyakukukhuluma kubantu bakwa-Israyeli.”
“Uyokwenza itafula ngokhuni lomkhambathi, ubude balo bube ngamakhubhithi amabili, ububanzi balo bube yikhubhithi, nokuphakama kwalo kube yikhubhithi nengxenye.
Uyolicaka ngegolide elicwengekileyo, ulenzele umphetho wegolide nxazonke.
Uyolenzela unqenqema olungangesandla ububanzi nxazonke, ulenzele nomphetho wegolide nxazonke.
Uyolenzela amasongo amane ngegolide, uwafake emakhoneni omane asemilenzeni yalo.
Eduze konqenqema kuyakuba khona amasongo okuyongena kuwo izingongolo zokuthwala itafula.
Uyozenza izingongolo ngokhuni lomkhambathi, uzicake ngegolide ukuze itafula lithwalwe ngazo.
Uyokwenza izingqwembe zalo, izinkomishi, izinkezo, nezinkamba zokuthela; ukwenze ngegolide elicwengekileyo.
Uyobeka njalo phambi kwami phezu kwetafula isinkwa soBukhona bami.”

“Uyokwenza uthi lwezibani ngegolide elicwengekileyo, uyakulwenza ngomsebenzi ocangcathiweyo, isisekelo salo, nesiqu salo kwenziwe ngegolide elicangcathiweyo; izimbali zokuhlobisa, imiqumbe, namacembe, kube kunye nalo.
Kuyakuba khona amagatsha ayisithupha aphuma ezinhlangothini zalo, abe mathathu ngasohlangothini ngalunye.

Igatsha lokuqala kufanele lithwale izindebe ezintathu ezimise okwe-alimondi eliqhakazileyo, imiqumbe, namacembe avulekileyo. Igatsha lesibili kufanele lithwale izindebe ezintathu ezimise okwe-alimondi, nemiqumbe namacembe azo. Makufane kuwo wonke amagatsha ayisithupha enabele ngaphandle othini lwezibani.
Othini lwezibani makube nezindebe ezine ezimise okwe-alimondi, nemiqumbe yazo, namacembe azo.

Kuyokuba khona umqumbe phansi kwamagatsha amabili, umqumbe phansi kombanqwana bamagatsha esibili, nomqumbe phansi kombanqwana bokugcina bamagatsha, kuyoba njalo kuwo oyisithupha amagatsha enabele ngaphandle othini lwezibani.
Imiqumbe yawo, namagatsha awo ayokuba yingxenye eyodwa nawo, konke kube ngumsebenzi owodwa ocangcathiwe wegolide elicwengekileyo.
“Uyokwenza izibani eziyisikhombisa uzibeke othini, zikhanyise phambi kwalo.
Uyokwenza izindlawu nezitsha zomlotha ngegolide elicwengekileyo.
Uthi lwezibani nakho konke lokhu makwenziwe ngamathalenta egolide elicwengekileyo.
Qikelela ukuba lokho ukwenze ngendlela okhonjiswe yona kule ntaba.
“Uyokwenza ithabanakeli ngamakhethini alishumi enziwe ngelineni elicolekileyo lemicu ephothwe ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, okubukhwebezane, nokubomvu. Ingcweti iwahlobise ngamakherubhi.
Ubude bekhethini ngalinye bube ngamakhubhithi angama-28, ububanzi balo bube ngamakhubhithi amane. Wonke amakhethini ayakulingana.
Amakhethini ayisihlanu ayothungwa ahlanganiswe ndawonye, kanjalo namanye amakhethini ayisihlanu ayothungwa ahlanganiswe ndawonye.
Uyokwenza izihibe ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka emphethweni wekhethini lokuqala, kanjalo nasemphethweni wekhethini lesibili.
Uyokwenza izihibe ezingama-50 ekhethinini lokuqala, wenze futhi izihibe ezingama-50 nakwelesibili. Izihibe uyozenza ziqondane.
Uyokwenza izinkintsho zegolide ezingama-50 bese amakhethini uwahlanganisa ndawonye ngezinkintsho, ukuze ithabanakeli libe lilodwa.
“Uyokwenza amakhethini ngoboya bezimbuzi, abe yithende phezu kwethabanakeli, uyokwenza amakhethini ayi-11.
Ubude bekhethini buyoba ngamakhubhithi angama-30, ububanzi balo bube ngamakhubhithi amane. Lawa makhethini ayi-11 kufanele alingane.
Uyohlanganisa amakhethini ayisihlanu ndawonye, namakhethini ayisithupha uyakuwahlanganisa ndawonye, bese kuthi ikhethini lesithupha uliphinde kabili phambi kwethende.
Uyokwenza izinkintsho ezingama-50 emphethweni wekhethini lokuqala elingasekugcineni, nezinye ezingama-50 emphethweni wekhethini lesibili elingasekugcineni.
Uyokwenza izinkintsho zethusi ezingama-50, ufake amahhuku ezinkintshweni, bese ulihlanganisa ndawonye ithende ukuze libe yinto eyodwa.
Ingxenye eseleyo yamakhethini ethende, ingxenye yekhethini eliseleyo iyolenga ngemuva kwethabanakeli.
Ikhubhithi kulolu hlangathi nekhubhithi ngakolunye kwalokho okuseleyo ebudeni bamakhubhithi ethende, kuyakulengiswa emaceleni ethabanakeli kulemboze.
Ithende uyolenzela isembozo ngezikhumba zezinqama ezidaywe zabomvu, nesembozo sangaphandle ngezikhumba zamahlengethwa.
“Uyokwenza amapulangwe ethabanakeli ngokhuni lomkhambathi, uwamise.
Ubude bamapulangwe bube ngamakhubhithi ayishumi, ububanzi balelo nalelo bube yikhubhithi nengxenye.
Yilelo nalelo pulangwe liyokuba nezikhonkwane ezimbili zokuwaxhumanisa; uyokwenza kanjalo kuwo wonke amapulangwe ethabanakeli.
Uyokwenza amapulangwe ethabanakeli abe ngama-20 ngasohlangothini lwaseningizimu, olubheke eningizimu.

Uyokwenza izisekelo zesiliva ezingama-40 phansi kwamapulangwe angama-20, izisekelo ezimbili zibe phansi kwepulangwe lokuqala, ukuze zibambe izimpondo zalo; izisekelo ezimbili ngaphansi kwepulangwe elilandelayo, zibe yizikhonkwane ezimbili;
nasohlangothini lwesibili lwethabanakeli olungasenyakatho uyomisa amapulangwe angama-20,
nezisekelo zesiliva ezingama-40, izisekelo ezimbili zibe phansi kwepulangwe lokuqala, ezinye ezimbili zibe phansi kwepulangwe elilandelayo.
Ohlangothini lwethabanakeli olungasemuva ngasentshonalanga uyomisa amapulangwe ayisithupha.
Uyokwenza amapulangwe amabili ngasemuva kwethabanakeli abe ngamakhona alo.
Lawa mapulangwe asemakhoneni kufanele ahlanganiswe kusukela phansi kuze kuyofika phezulu, amapulangwe amabili enza amakhona ayokwenziwa kanjalo nawo.
Ngakho-ke kuyokuba namapulangwe ayisishiyagalombili anezisekelo zesiliva ezili-16, zibe mbili phansi kwepulangwe ngalinye.
“Uyokwenza imishayo eyisihlanu ngokhuni lomkhambathi, ibe ngamapulangwe ngakolunye uhlangothi lwethabanakeli,
imishayo emihlanu ibe ngeyamapulangwe ngakolunye uhlangothi lwethabanakeli, neminye emihlanu ibe ngeyamapulangwe asohlangothini lwethabanakeli olungasemuva ngasentshonalanga.
Umshayo ophakathi, phakathi kwamapulangwe udabule uze ufinyelele kuzo zombili izinhlangothi.
Uyowacaka amapulangwe ngegolide, wenze amasongo awo ngegolide, ukuze abambe imishayo, okufanele ukuba nayo icakwe ngegolide.
“Uyolimisa ithabanakeli ngendlela owakhonjiswa yona entabeni.”
“Uyokwenza isihenqo ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokubomvu, nangelineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo, ingcweti isihlobise ngamakherubhi.
Uyosilengisa ezinsikeni ezine zokhuni lomkhambathi ezicakwe ngegolide, ezinezinkintsho zegolide, futhi zimi ezisekelweni ezine.
Uyolengisa isihenqo phansi kwamahhuku asophahleni, bese ungenisa umphongolo wesivumelwano phakathi kwesihenqo, isihenqo siyakunehlukanisela indawo engcwele nendawo engcwelengcwele.
Uyakusibeka isihlalo somusa phezu komphongolo wesivumelwano endaweni engcwelengcwele.
Uyakubeka itafula ngaphandle kwesihenqo, uthi lwezibani ngaseningizimu lethabanakeli lubhekane netafula, ulibeke itafula ngasohlangothini olungasenyakatho.
“Uyokwenza isihenqo sasemnyango wethende ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokubomvu, nangelineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo, umsebenzi womfekethisi.
Isihenqo leso uyosenzela izinsika eziyisihlanu ngokhuni lomkhambathi, uzicake ngegolide, nezinkintsho zazo zibe yigolide, uzenzele izisekelo zethusi eziyisihlanu.

“I-althare uyolenza ngokhuni lomkhambathi; ubude balo bube ngamakhubhithi ayisihlanu, ububanzi balo bube ngamakhubhithi ayisihlanu. I-althare liyakuba yisikwele; ukuphakama kwalo kube ngamakhubhithi amathathu.
Uyokwenza izimpondo zalo emakhoneni omane alo, izimpondo zalo zibe yinto eyodwa ne-althare, ulicake ngethusi.
Uyokwenza izitsha zalo zokubutha umlotha, amafosholo alo, izitsha zalo, izimfologo zalo, nemicengezi yalo yomlilo, uyozenza zonke izimpahla zalo ngethusi.
Uyakulenzela futhi isisefo sethusi esenziwe njengenetha, uyokwenza amasongo amane ethusi enetheni kuwo omane amakhona alo.
Uyolibeka ngaphansi konqenqema oluzungeze i-althare, ukuba inetha leluleke lifinyelele ngaphakathi kwe-althare ukuya phezulu.
Uyokwenza izingongolo ze-althare ngokhuni lomkhambathi, uzicake ngethusi.
Izingongolo ziyofakwa emasongweni, ukuze zibe sezinhlangothini zombili ze-althare, uma lithwelwe.
Uyolenza ngamapulangwe libe lugobhozi. Ulenze ngendlela owayikhonjiswa entabeni.
“Uyokwenza igceke lethabanakeli. Ngaseningizimu yegceke kube khona amakhethini elineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo, ubude bawo bube ngamakhubhithi ayikhulu ohlangothini ngalunye;
izinsika zalo ezingama-20, nezisekelo zazo ezingama-20 ziyokwenziwa ngethusi; izinkintsho zezinsika nezibopho zazo zenziwe ngesiliva.

Kanjalo uyakulenzela amakhethini ngasohlangothini olungasenyakatho, ubude bawo bube ngamakhubhithi ayikhulu, izinsika zazo ezingama-20, nezisekelo zazo ezingama-20 zibe ngezethusi; izinkintsho zezinsika nezibopho zazo zenziwe ngesiliva.
“Ohlangothini olungasentshonalanga lobubanzi begceke makube khona amakhethini ububanzi bawo bube ngamakhubhithi angama-50, abe nezinsika ezilishumi, nezisekelo ezilishumi.
Ububanzi begceke ngasempumalanga ohlangothini olubheke empumalanga bube ngamakhubhithi angama-50.
Kuyokuba khona amakhethini angamakhubhithi ali-15 ngasohlangothini olulodwa, izinsika ezintathu, nezisekelo ezintathu.
Nakolunye uhlangothi kuyokuba khona amakhethini angamakhubhithi ali-15, izinsika ezintathu, nezisekelo ezintathu.

“Esangweni legceke kuyokuba khona isihenqo esingamakhubhithi angama-20; senziwe ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokubomvu, nangelineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo, okungumsebenzi womfekethisi. Siyakuba nezinsika ezine, nezisekelo ezine.
Zonke izinsika ezizungeze igceke ziyakucakwa ngesiliva, izinkintsho zazo zibe ngezesiliva, izisekelo zibe ngezethusi.

Ubude begceke buyokuba ngamakhubhithi ayikhulu, ububanzi bube ngangama-50, ukuphakama kube ngamakhubhithi ayisihlanu, kube namakhethini elineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo, nezisekelo zibe ngezethusi.
Zonke izimpahla ezisetshenziswa ethabanakelini, izikhonkwane zakhona nazo zonke ezasegcekeni mazenziwe ngethusi.
“Uyobayala futhi abantu bakwa-Israyeli ukuba balethe kuwe amafutha omnqumo acwengekileyo, agxotshelwe ukukhanyisa, ukuze izibani zihlale zivutha njalo.

Ethendeni lokuhlangana, ngaphandle kwesihenqo esiphambi kwesivumelwano, u-Aroni namadodana akhe bayakuzinakekela phambi kukaSimakade, kusukela kusihlwa kuze kube sekuseni. Lokho kuyakuba yisimiso saphakade esiyakuhlonishwa ngabantu bakwa-Israyeli, izizukulwane ngezizukulwane.
“Biza u-Aroni umfowenu phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli namadodana akhe, uNadabi, u-Abhihu, u-Eleyazare no-Ithamari beze kuwe, ukuba babe ngabaphristi bami bangikhonze.
Uyakumthungela u-Aroni umfowenu izingubo ezingcwele, ezinhle nezokuzihlobisa.
Uyakukhuluma kubo bonke abanekhono, engibaphile ikhono ukuba bathungele u-Aroni izingubo ukuze ahlukaniswe abe ngumphristi wami, angikhonze.

Yilezi izingubo abayozithunga: isivikelo sesifuba, ingubo yamahlombe, ingubo, ibhantshi elihlotshisiweyo, umshuqulo, nombhunkulo. Lapho bethungela u-Aroni namadodana akhe lezi zingubo ezingcwele ukuze bangikhonze bengabaphristi,
bayosebenzisa okuyigolide, okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, okubukhwebezane, okubomvu, nelineni elicolekileyo.
“Bayokwenza ingubo yamahlombe ngokuyigolide, ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokubomvu, nangelineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo, kube ngumsebenzi wobungcweti obukhulu.
Iyakuba neziziba ezimbili zasemahlombe ezihlanganisiwe emachosheni azo ukuze zikwazi ukubopheka.
Ibhande elikuyo liyokwenziwa ngobuciko obufanayo ngokuyigolide, ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokubomvu, nangelineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo.
Uyothatha amatshe amabili aligugu i-oniksi, uqophe kuwo amagama ali-12 amadodana ka-Israyeli;
amagama ayisithupha etsheni elilodwa, namanye ayisithupha kwelinye itshe njengokwelamana kwawo.
Njengomqophi eqopha isisicilelo, uyowaqopha lawa matshe amabili ngamagama amadodana ka-Israyeli, bese uwafaka azungezwe yizisekelo zegolide.
Uyowabeka lawa matshe ezizibeni zengubo yamahlombe njengesikhumbuzo samadodana ka-Israyeli, bese u-Aroni awembathe amagama abo emahlombe akhe phambi kukaSimakade kube yisikhumbuzo.
Uyokwenza izisekelo zegolide,
namaketanga amabili egolide elicwengekileyo, uwenze abe njengamagoda, uwathandele ezisekelweni zegolide.

“Uyokwenza isivikelo sesifuba sokwehlulela, ngobungcweti, uyakusenza ngendlela okwenziwe ngayo ingubo yamahlombe, sibe yigolide, okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, okubukhwebezane, okubomvu, nokwelineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo.
Siyakuba yisikwele, siphindwe kabili, ubude nobubanzi baso bube ngangokuvuleka kwesandla.
Uyofaka kuso imigqa emine yamatshe. Kuyokuba ngumugqa onerubhi, yithophazi nebherili;
emugqeni wesibili; kube yithurikhosi, yisefaya, ne-emeraldi;
emugqeni wesithathu; kube yijasinithe, yi-agathe, ne-amethiyisti;
emugqeni wesine kube yikhrisolithe, yi-oniksi, nejasipheri, konke lokhu kuzungezwe ngezisekelo zegolide.
Kuyakuba ngamatshe ali-12 ngangesibalo samagama amadodana ka-Israyeli. Ayofana nezisicilelo, yilelo nalelo liqoshwe igama lesizwe ngasinye kwezili-12.
Uyokwenza kuso isivikelo sesifuba amaketanga egolide anjengamagoda aphothiweyo.
Wenze kuso amasongo amabili egolide, uwanamathelise emachosheni esivikelo sesifuba.
Uyofaka amaketanga amabili egolide nezintambo zegolide emasongweni omabili esivikelo sesifuba asemaceleni.
Amachopho amabili amagoda, uyowathandela ezisekelweni bese uwathandela phambili ezizibeni zengubo yamahlombe.
Uyokwenza amasongo amabili egolide, uwafake emachosheni omabili esivikelo sesifuba, engxenyeni engaphakathi eseduze nengubo yamahlombe.
Uyokwenza amasongo amabili egolide, uwafake phambili emachosheni omabili omphetho wengubo yamahlombe kuthi okuhlanganisiwe kube phezu kwebhande elihlotshisiweyo.

Isivikelo sesifuba siyoboshwa ngamasongo aso, siboshelwe emasongweni engubo yamahlombe ngentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ukuze sibe phezu kwebhande lengubo yamahlombe elifekethisiweyo, nokuba isivikelo sesifuba singakhumuki engutsheni yamahlombe.

“U-Aroni uyokwembatha amagama amadodana ka-Israyeli esivikelweni sesifuba sokwehlulela esiqondene nenhliziyo yakhe, lapho engena endaweni engcwele, kube yisikhumbuzo esingapheliyo phambi kukaSimakade.

Uyofaka esivikelweni sesifuba sokwehlulela, i-Urimi neThumimi, kuyakuba ngasenhliziyweni ka-Aroni lapho engena phambi kukaSimakade, ngakho-ke u-Aroni uyakuthwala njalo enhliziyweni yakhe phambi kukaSimakade, ukwehlulelwa kwabakwa-Israyeli.”
“Uyokwenza ingubo emboza ingubo yamahlombe ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka,
iyakuba nembobo yekhanda phakathi nayo, ibe nomphetho owelukiweyo oyizungezile le mbobo, njengembobo yebhantshi lensimbi ukuze ingadabuki.
Emphethweni wayo ongezansi uyofaka amahananadi enziwe ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, nangokubomvu, kuwuzungeze wonke umphetho wayo, kube nokhencekhence begolide phakathi kwawo,
kube yisikhencezo segolide nehananadi kuzungeze umphetho wengubo.
U-Aroni uyakuyigqoka njalo uma eyokhonza, ukukhenceza kwayo kuyozwakala lapho eya endaweni engcwele phambi kukaSimakade, nalapho ephuma, ukuze angafi.
“Uyokwenza ucwecwe lwegolide elicwengekileyo, uqophe kulo njengokuqoshwa kwendandatho, ukuthi: ‘Wehlukaniselwe uSimakade.’
Uyolubophela emshuqulweni ngentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, lube phambi kwalo.

Luyokuba sebunzini lika-Aroni. U-Aroni uyakuthwala icala lanoma yimuphi umnikelo ongcwele, abantu bakwa-Israyeli abawehlukanisa njengomnikelo ongcwele, luyohlala njalo ebunzini lakhe ukuze bamukeleke phambi kukaSimakade.
“Uyokweluka ibhantshi ngelineni elicolekileyo, nomshuqulu ngelineni elicolekileyo, nebhande elifekethisiweyo.
Uyowathungela amabhantshi amadodana ka-Aroni, amabhande, nezigqoko, kube ngawokuhloba kwawo.
Uyokugqokisa u-Aroni, umfowenu namadodana akhe. Uyobagcoba, ubabeke, ubangcwelise ukuba bangikhonze bengabaphristi.
“Uyobenzela namabhulukwe elineni ukuze kufihlwe ubunqunu babo, asuke okhalo aze afinyelele emathangeni.

U-Aroni namadodana akhe bayowagqoka lapho bengena ethendeni lokuhlangana, nalapho besondela e-althare ukuyokhonza endaweni engcwele, uma bengenzi kanjalo bayakuzithwesa icala, bafe. Lokhu kuyakuba yisimiso saphakade kuye nasezizukulwaneni zakhe kuze kube phakade.
“Yilokhu oyokwenza lapho usubehlukanisa ukuze bangikhonze bengabaphristi. Thatha iduna lenkomo, izinqama ezimbili okungenasici,
isinkwa esingenamvubelo, namaqebelengwane angenamvubelo agcotshwe ngamafutha, ukwenze ngempuphu kakolo ecolisekileyo.
Uyokufaka eqomeni elilodwa ukulethe ngalo, ulethe neduna, nezinqama ezimbili.
Uyoletha u-Aroni namadodana akhe ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana, ubageze ngamanzi.
Bese uthatha izingubo zobuphristi umgqokise u-Aroni ingubo, ibhantshi, ingubo yamahlombe, nesivikelo sesifuba, umbophe ngebhande lengubo yamahlombe elifekethisiweyo.
Uyakumethwesa umshuqulu ekhanda, bese ubophela umqhele ongcwele emshuqulweni.
Uyothatha amafutha okugcoba uwathele ekhanda lakhe, umgcobe.
Uyosondeza namadodana akhe, uwagqokise amabhantshi.
Uyobopha u-Aroni namadodana akhe ngemibhunkulo okhalo lwabo, ubathwese nezigqoko, ubuphristi buyakuba ngobabo ngokwesimiso saphakade. Uyakumbeka kanjalo u-Aroni namadodana akhe.
“Uyoletha inkunzi phambi kwethende lokuhlangana. U-Aroni namadodana akhe bayokubeka izandla zabo ekhanda layo.
Uyoyihlaba inkunzi phambi kukaSimakade ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana.
Uyothatha ingxenye yegazi layo ulininde ngomunwe wakho ezimpondweni ze-althare, bese kuthi yonke ingxenye yegazi eliseleyo ulithululele phansi esisekelweni se-althare.
Uyowathatha wonke amafutha emboze okwangaphakathi, namanoni asesibindini, nezinso zombili namanoni akuzo, ukushise e-althare.
Kodwa inyama yenkunzi, nesikhumba sayo, nomswani wayo, uyokushisela ngaphandle kwenkambu; kungumnikelo wesono.
“Uyothatha futhi enye yezinqama, bese u-Aroni namadodana akhe bebeka izandla zabo ekhanda layo.
Uyoyihlaba inqama bese uthatha igazi layo ulifafaze nxazonke ze-althare.
Uyoyihlahla inqama, ugeze ezangaphakathi nemilenze yayo, ukubeke ndawonye nezitho nenhloko yayo.
Uyoyishisa yonke inqama e-althare ngoba ingumnikelo wokushiswa kuSimakade; iyiphunga elimnandi; ingumnikelo womlilo kuSimakade.
“Uyothatha inqama yesibili bese u-Aroni namadodana akhe bebeka izandla zabo ekhanda layo.

Uyoyihlaba inqama, bese uthatha ingxenye yegazi layo uninde indlebe ka-Aroni yakwesokunene, izindlebe zakwesokunene zamadodana akhe, izithupha zakwesokunene zezandla zabo, noqukula babo bezinyawo zakwesokunene, bese igazi ulifafaza nxazonke ze-althare.

Uyothatha ingxenye yegazi elise-althare namafutha okugcoba ufafaze ngakho u-Aroni nezingubo zakhe, namadodana akhe nezingubo zawo, ngakho-ke yena nezingubo zakhe uyokuba ngcwele, kanjalo namadodana akhe nezingubo zawo.
“Uyothatha amanoni enqama, amanoni omsila, umhlwehlwe, amanoni asesibindini, izinso zombili namanoni azo, nomlenze wangakwesokudla, ngokuba yinqama yokubekwa kwabo.
Uyothatha eqomeni elethulwe phambi kukaSimakade, isinkwa, neqebelengwane lesinkwa esinamafutha, nekhekheba,
ukubeke konke lokhu ezandleni zika-Aroni nasezandleni zamadodana akhe, ukuzungezise kube ngumnikelo wokuzungeziswa phambi kukaSimakade.
Uyobuye ukuthathe ezandleni zabo ukushise e-althare phezu komnikelo wokushiswa kube yiphunga elimnandi phambi kukaSimakade; kungumnikelo womlilo kuSimakade.
“Uyothatha isifuba senqama yokugcotshwa kuka-Aroni, usizungezise, sibe ngumnikelo wokuzungeziswa phambi kukaSimakade; sibe yisabelo sakho.

Uyobusisa isifuba esizungezisiwe njengomnikelo wokuzungeziswa nomlenze ozungezisiwe njengomnikelo wokuzungeziswa enqameni yokugcotshwa kuka-Aroni, ukwehlukanise kulokho okungokuka-Aroni namadodana akhe.

Lezi zinto ziyokuba yisimiso saphakade ku-Aroni namadodana akhe ezivela kuma-Israyeli, ngokuba lokhu kungumnikelo, futhi kuyokuba ngumnikelo wabakwa-Israyeli ovela eminikelweni yabo yokuthula, okungumnikelo kuSimakade.
“Izingubo ezingcwele zika-Aroni ziyodluliselwa emadodaneni akhe emva kwakhe, ayakugcotshwa, abekwe ngazo.
Indodana eyokuba ngumphristi esikhundleni sakhe iyozigqoka lezi zingubo izinsuku eziyisikhombisa lapho ingena ethendeni lokuhlangana izokhonza endaweni engcwele.
“Uyothatha inqama yokugcotshwa, ubilise inyama yayo endaweni engcwele.
U-Aroni namadodana akhe bayodla inyama yenqama nesinkwa esiseqomeni ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana.
Bona uqobo bayodla ukudla okwenzelwe ukubuyisana ukuze bangcweliswe futhi bahlukaniswe, kodwa akuyukuba khona omunye oyokudla lokhu, ngokuba kungcwele.
Uma kusale inyama yokugcotshwa noma kusale isinkwa kwaze kwaba sekuseni, kuyokushiswa ngomlilo lokho okuseleyo, kungadliwa, ngokuba kungcwele.
“Uyokwenza kanjalo ku-Aroni nakumadodana akhe, njengalokhu ngikuyalile; ukubehlukanisa kuyothatha izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Uyonikela futhi nsuku zonke, inkunzi ibe ngumnikelo wesono nowokubuyisana. Uyonikela umnikelo wesono we-althare, nalapho ulenzela umnikelo wokuhlanjululwa, uyoligcoba, ulehlukanise.
I-althare uyolenzela ukubuyisana izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, ulingcwelise, libe ngcwele kakhulu, ukuze kuthi konke okulithintayo nakho kube ngcwele.”
“Manje yilokhu oyokunikela e-althare: amawundlu amabili anyaka munye imihla ngemihla.
Iwundlu elilodwa uyolinikela ekuseni, kuthi elinye ulinikele kusihlwa.
Iwundlu lokuqala uyolinikela nokweshumi kwempuphu ecolisekileyo, ihlanganiswe nokwesine eshumini kwehini lamafutha agxotshiweyo, nokwesine eshumini kwehini lewayini, kube ngumnikelo wokuphuzwayo.
Uyonikela ngelinye iwundlu kusihlwa, uyolinikela nomnikelo wokusanhlamvu nowokuphuzwayo njengasekuseni, kube yiphunga elimnandi, umnikelo womlilo kuSimakade.

“Lowo kuyokuba ngumnikelo wokushiswa imihla ngemihla, izizukulwane ngezizukulwane, oyokwenziwa ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana, phambi kukaSimakade, lapho ngiyohlangana nani ukuba ngikhulume nani khona.
Ngiyohlangana nabantu bakwa-Israyeli lapho, leyo ndawo iyakungcweliswa yinkazimulo yami.
“Ngiyongcwelisa ithende lokuhlangana ne-althare, ngingcwelise u-Aroni namadodana akhe ukuba bangikhonze bengabaphristi.
Ngiyohlala phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli, ngibe nguNkulunkulu wabo.
Bayokwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo, owabakhipha eGibhithe ukuze ngihlale phakathi kwabo; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo.
“Uyokwenza i-althare okuyoshiswa kulo impepho, uyolenza ngokhuni lomkhambathi.
Ubude balo buyokuba yikhubhithi, nobubanzi balo bube yikhubhithi, libe yisikwele, ukuphakama kwalo kube ngamakhubhithi amabili. Izimpondo zalo zihlangane nalo.
Uyolicaka phezulu ngegolide elicwengekileyo, kuthi izinhlangothi zalo nxazonke, nezimpondo zalo, uzenzele unqenqema lwegolide macala wonke.
Uyolenzela amasongo amabili egolide phansi konqenqema lwalo ezinhlangothini ezimbili ezibhekene, ayokuba yizindawo zezingongolo eliyothwalwa ngazo.
Uyokwenza izingongolo ngokhuni lomkhambathi, uzicake ngegolide.
Uyolibeka i-althare phambi kwesihenqo esingaphezu komphongolo wesivumelwano, phambi kwesihlalo somusa esingaphezu kwawo, lapho ngiyohlangana nani khona.
“U-Aroni uyoshisa impepho enuka kamnandi njalo ekuseni, uyokuyishisa njalo ekuseni lapho elungisa izibani.
Nalapho u-Aroni esokhela izibani kusihlwa, uyakuyishisa impepho. Impepho iyoshiswa njalo phambi kukaSimakade, izizukulwane ngezizukulwane.
Aniyukunikela kulo ngempepho engengcwele, noma ngomnikelo wokushiswa, nangowokusanhlamvu, futhi aniyukuthela kulo umnikelo wokuphuzwayo.

U-Aroni uyokwenza umnikelo wokubuyisana phezu kwezimpondo zalo kanye ngonyaka. Izizukulwane ngezizukulwane, u-Aroni uyokwenza inkonzo yokulihlambulula kanye ngonyaka ngegazi lomnikelo wokuhlambulula isono. Lingcwelengcwele kuSimakade.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Lapho kubalwa abantu bakwa-Israyeli ukuze bonke babhaliswe, lapho bebhaliswa, bonke bayakukhokha inhlawulo yempilo yabo kuSimakade, ukuze bangehlelwa ubhubhane ngenxa yokubalwa.

Yilokhu okuyakunikelwa yinoma yimuphi oyobhalisela ukubalwa: ingxenye yeshekeli ngokwesilinganiso seshekeli lendawo engcwele, ishekeli lingamagera angama-20, ingxenye yeshekeli iyokuba ngumnikelo kuSimakade.
Yilowo nalowo osebaliwe, oneminyaka engama-20 ubudala nangaphezulu uyonikela umnikelo kuSimakade.
Ocebileyo akayukunikela eqise, kanjalo nompofu akayukunikela kancane kunengxenye yeshekeli lapho niletha lo mnikelo kuSimakade ukuze nihlawulele ukuphila kwenu.

Uyothatha imali yenhlawulo kubantu bakwa-Israyeli uyisebenzisele izinkonzo ethendeni lokuhlangana. Iyokuba yisikhumbuzo sesihlengo esenziwa ngenxa yempilo yabo phambi kukaSimakade, kubantu bakwa-Israyeli.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Uyokwenza indishi yethusi yokugezela, ibe nesinqe sethusi, uyoyibeka phakathi kwethende lokuhlangana ne-althare, uthele amanzi kuyo.
U-Aroni namadodana bayakugeza izandla nezinyawo zabo ngalawa manzi,
lapho bengena ethendeni lokuhlangana nalapho besondela e-althare ukuyokhonza, ukuyokwenza umnikelo wokushiswa kuSimakade, bayogeza ngamanzi ukuze bangafi.
Bayogeza izandla nezinyawo zabo ukuze bangafi. Lokhu kuyakuba ngumyalo ophakade kubo, kuye nasezizukulwaneni zakhe ngokwezizukulwane zazo.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Thatha izinongo zekhethelo: imure engamashekeli angama-500, isinamoni engama-250, ikalamu elinuka kahle elingama-250,
ikhasiya elingama-500 ngokweshekeli lendlu engcwele, nehini lamafutha omnqumo.
Uyokwenza ngalokhu amafutha okugcoba angcwele, anamakha athakiweyo njengokwenza komthaki, ayakuba ngamafutha angcwele okugcoba.
Uyakugcoba ngawo ithende lokuhlangana, umphongolo wesivumelwano,
itafula nezinto zonke zalo, uthi lwesibani nezinto ezikulo, i-althare lempepho,
i-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa nazo zonke izitsha zalo, nomcengezi nesinqe sawo.
Uyokungcwelisa ukuze kube ngcwele kakhulu; konke okuzithintayo kuyakuba ngcwele.
“Uyogcoba u-Aroni namadodana akhe, ubangcwelise ukuba bangikhonze bengabaphristi.
Uyakuthi kubantu bakwa-Israyeli: ‘Lawa ngamafutha ami angcwele okugcoba izizukulwane ngezizukulwane.
Awayukusetshenziswa ngabantu ukuba bagcobe ngawo imizimba yabo, futhi awuyukwenza amanye axutshwe njengawo, angcwele, futhi ayoba ngcwele kini.
Noma yimuphi oyogcoba ngawo umuntu ongafanele, uyonqunywa phakathi kwabantu.’ ”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Thatha amakha anuka kamnandi: inathafi, ishehelethe, ihelibena, namakha empepho ecwengekileyo.
Uyokwenza ngakho impepho, ukuxube namakha njengomthaki, ukufake usawoti ukuze kube yinto ecwengekileyo nengcwele.
Uyoqotha ingxenye yakho ibe yimpuphu, bese ubeka ingxenye yakho phambi komphongolo wesivumelwano ethendeni lokuhlangana, lapho ngiyohlangana nani khona, iyoba ngcwelengcwele kini.
Uma uthaka impepho ngale ndlela, awuyukuyithaka kube ngeyakho; uyoyithatha ngokuthi ingcwele kuSimakade.
Yilowo nalowo oyokwenza enjengale ukuba ayisebenzise njengamakha akhe, uyakunqunywa kubantu bakubo.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose wathi:
“Bheka, ngimbize ngegama uBhezaleli indodana ka-Uri, ka-Huri wesizwe sakwaJuda,
futhi ngimgcwalise ngoMoya kaNkulunkulu, ngamandla okwazi, ngokuhlakanipha nangokwazi lonke uhlobo lomsebenzi wezandla,
ukuze asebenze ngobungcweti ngegolide, ngesiliva, nangethusi,
abaze amatshe ezisekelo, abaze ukhuni, enze nayo yonke imisebenzi yezandla enhlobonhlobo.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngimkhethile yena no-Oholiyabe, indodana ka-Ahisamakhi wesizwe sakwaDani, futhi ngibanike ubuchwepheshe bonke abanamakhono, ukuze benze konke engikuyale ukuba ukwenze:
ithende lokuhlangana, umphongolo wesivumelwano, isihlalo somusa esiphezu kwawo, nayo yonke impahla yethende,
itafula nayo yonke impahla yalo, uthi lwezibani olwenziwe ngegolide elicwengekileyo nazo zonke izinto zalo, ne-althare lokushisela impepho,
i-althare lokushisela umnikelo nezitsha zalo, umcengezi nesinqe sawo,
izingubo ezenziwe kahle, izingubo zomphristi u-Aroni, nezamadodana akhe, zokuba bakhonze bengabaphristi,
amafutha okugcoba, nempepho enuka kahle yendawo engcwele. Bayokwenza konke lokhu njengalokhu ngikuyalile.”
USimakade wathi kuMose:
“Wena uqobo khuluma kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Niyakugcina amasabatha ami, ngokuba awuphawu phakathi kwami nani, naphakathi kwezizukulwane zenu, ukuba nazi ukuthi nginguSimakade oningcwelisayo.
Niyogcina isabatha ngokuba lingcwele kini. Yilowo nalowo olingcolisayo uyobulawa, nalowo owenza umsebenzi ngalo uyonqunywa phakathi kwabantu.
Uyokwenza umsebenzi ngezinsuku eziyisithupha, kodwa usuku lwesikhombisa luyisabatha lokuphumula, usuku olungcwele kuSimakade. Yilowo nalowo owenza umsebenzi ngosuku lwesabatha uyobulawa.
Ngakho-ke abantu bakwa-Israyeli bayoligcina isabatha, bayoligcina izizukulwane ngezizukulwane njengesivumelwano saphakade.
Liwuphawu lwaphakade phakathi kwami nabantu bakwa-Israyeli, lokuthi uSimakade wadala izulu nomhlaba ngezinsuku eziyisithupha, kwathi ngosuku lwesikhombisa waphumula, wahlumeleleka.’ ”
USimakade eseqedile ukukhuluma noMose entabeni iSinayi, wamnika izibhebhe ezimbili zesivumelwano, izibhebhe zamatshe, zibhalwe ngomunwe kaNkulunkulu.

Lapho abantu bebona ukuthi uMose usephuzile ukwehla entabeni, babuthana ku-Aroni, bathi kuye: “Woza, usenzele onkulunkulu abazohamba phambi kwethu, ngokuba lo Mose, umuntu owasikhipha eGibhithe, asazi ukuthi wehlelwe yini.”
U-Aroni wathi kubo: “Khumulani amacici egolide asezindlebeni zomkenu, nakwezamadodana enu, nakwezamadodakazi enu, niwalethe kimi.”
Bonke abantu bawakhumula amacici ayesezindlebeni zabo, bawaletha ku-Aroni.
Wawathatha ezandleni zabo, wawancibilikisa, wabumba, waqopha, wenza ithole ngalolo bumba. Abantu bathi: “Nampa onkulunkulu bakho, Israyeli, abakukhuphula eGibhithe.”
Kuthe ukuba u-Aroni akubone lokho, wakha i-althare phambi kwethole, wenza isimemezelo, wathi: “Kusasa kuzokuba nomkhosi kaSimakade.”
Abantu bavuka ekuseni ngakusasa, banikela ngeminikelo yokushiswa, baletha iminikelo yokuthula; bahlala phansi ukuba badle, baphuze; basukuma ukuba badlale.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi: “Phuthuma wehle, ngokuba abantu bakho owabakhipha eGibhithe benze isono.
Basheshe baphambuka endleleni engabayala ngayo. Bazenzele ithole elibunjiweyo, balikhonza, balihlabela, bathi: ‘Nampa onkulunkulu bakho, Israyeli, abakukhipha eGibhithe.’ ”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Ngibabonile laba bantu; bheka, bangabantu abantamo ilukhuni.
Ngakho-ke ngiyeke ukuze ulaka lwami lubavuthele, ngibaqede nya, wena ngikwenze ube yisizwe esikhulu.”
UMose washweleza kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakhe, wathi: “Simakade, ulaka lwakho lubavuthelelani abantu bakho owabakhipha eGibhithe ngamandla amakhulu, nangesandla esiqinileyo na?

Abazukusho yini abaseGibhithe bathi: ‘Wabakhipha ehlose okubi, ukuba ababulalele ezintabeni, abaqothe baphele nya emhlabeni.’ Phenduka olakeni lwakho olukhulu, uguqule umqondo wakho, ungabehliseli okubi abantu bakho.

Khumbula u-Abhrahama, u-Isaka, noJakobe, izinceku zakho owazifunga Wena kuzo, wathi: ‘Ngiyokwandisa izizukulwane zenu zibe ngangezinkanyezi zezulu, ngizinike lonke leli lizwe enganethembisa lona, libe yifa lazo kuze kube phakade.’ ”
USimakade wawuguqula umqondo wakhe ngenhlekelele ayehlose ukuyehlisela abantu bakhe.
UMose waphenduka, wehla entabeni ephethe ezandleni zakhe izibhebhe ezimbili zesivumelwano ezazibhalwe nxazombili, zibhalwe ngaphambili nangemuva.
Izibhebhe lezo zazingumsebenzi kaNkulunkulu, nombhalo, ubhalwe nguNkulunkulu, wawuqopha ezibhebheni zamatshe.
Lapho uJoshuwa ezwa umsindo wabantu bememeza, wathi kuMose: “Kunomsindo wempi enkanjini.”
UMose wathi: “Akusiwo umsindo wokunqoba, noma wokwehlulwa, kodwa ngizwa umsindo wokuhlabelela.”
Kuthe esesondele enkanjini, wabona ithole nokusina, wathukuthela wagana unwabu, wazilahla phansi izibhebhe ayeziphethe, wazephula phansi kwentaba.
Wathatha ithole ababelenzile, walishisa ngomlilo, waligaya lacoliseka laba luthuli, waluvuvuzela emanzini, wabaphuzisa wona abantu bakwa-Israyeli.
UMose wathi ku-Aroni: “Benzeni kuwe laba bantu ukuba ubehlisele isono esingaka na?”
U-Aroni wathi: “Ungangithukutheleli nkosi yami. Uyabazi abantu ukuthi bathanda ukwenza okubi.
Bathi kimi: ‘Senzele onkulunkulu abazohamba phambi kwethu, ngokuba uMose lowo, umuntu owasikhipha eGibhithe, asazi ukuthi wehlelwe yini.’
Ngase ngithi kubo: ‘Umuntu onegolide makalikhumule,’ base benginika lona, ngaliphonsa emlilweni, kwaphuma leli thole.”
UMose wabona ukuthi abantu sebeyimidlwembe, ngokuba u-Aroni wayebayekile baphuma esandleni, baze bahlekwa yizitha zabo.
UMose wayesema esangweni enkanjini, wathi: “AbakaSimakade mabeze kimi.” Wonke amadodana kaLevi abuthana kuye.

Wayesethi kuwo: “Usho kanje uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Yilowo nalowo makagaxe inkemba enqulwini yakhe, adabule enkanjini, ehle enyuka kusukela kwelinye isango kuya kwelinye isango enkanjini, yilowo nalowo abulale umfowabo, umngani wakhe, nomakhelwane wakhe.’ ”
Amadodana kaLevi enza njengoba ayeshilo uMose. Abulala abantu ababalelwa kwabayizi-3 000 ngalolo lusuku.
UMose wayesethi: “Namhlanje nizehlukanisele umsebenzi kaSimakade, ngokuba yilowo nalowo umelene nendodana yakhe, nomfowabo, ngaleyo ndlela nazilethela isibusiso namuhla.”
Ngakusasa uMose wathi kubantu: “Nenze isono esikhulu. Kepha manje ngizakukhuphukela kuSimakade, hleze ngikwazi ukunihlawulela isono senu.”
UMose wabuyela kuSimakade, wathi: “Maye! Laba bantu benze isono esikhulu, bazenzele onkulunkulu ngegolide.
Nokho ngiyakunxusa ukuba uthethelele isono sabo; uma ungabathetheleli, ngesule encwadini yakho oyibhalileyo.”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Owonileyo ngiyomesula encwadini yami.
Hamba manje, uhole abantu ubayise endaweni engakhuluma ngayo kuwe. Uyabona-ke, ingelosi yami izohamba phambi kwakho, kodwa lapho lufika usuku lokubajezisa, ngiyobajezisa ngenxa yesono sabo.”
USimakade wayesebashaya abantu ngobhubhane, ngokuba benza ithole, lelo elalenziwe ngu-Aroni.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Hamba, suka kule ndawo, wena nabantu owabakhipha eGibhithe, niye ezweni engafunga ngalo ku-Abhrahama, no-Isaka, noJakobe, ngathi: ‘Ngiyolinika izizukulwane zakho.’
Ngizothuma ingelosi phambi kwakho, ngiwaxoshe amaKhanani, ama-Amori, amaHithi, amaPherizi, amaHivi, namaJebusi.
Khuphukani niye ezweni elichichima ubisi noju, kodwa Mina ngeke ngibe phakathi kwenu, ngokuba ningabantu abantamo lukhuni, funa nginiqede nya endleleni.”
Kwathi ukuba abantu bezwe leyo ndaba embi, bakhala, akwaba bikho muntu owahloba ngobucwebecwebe bakhe.

Ngokuba uSimakade wayethe kuMose: “Shono kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Ningabantu abantamo lukhuni, uma nje ngingakhuphuka nani umzuzu ube munye, ngiyoniqothula nya. Ngakho-ke khumulani imvunulo yenu ukuze nginqume ukuthi ngizonenzenjani.’ ”
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli bayihlubula imvunulo yabo kusukela entabeni yaseHorebhe.

UMose wayevame ukuthatha ithende alimise ngaphandle kwenkambu, buqamama nayo, walibiza ngokuthi yithende lokuhlangana. Yilowo nalowo owayenodaba afuna ukuzwa ngalo kuSimakade, wayehamba aye ethendeni lokuhlangana elalingaphandle kwenkambu.
Noma nini lapho uMose eya ethendeni, bonke abantu babesukuma, kube yilowo nalowo ame ngasemnyango wethende lakhe, bambuke uMose aze ayongena ethendeni.
Lapho uMose engena ethendeni, kwakwehla insika yefu ime emnyango wethende, bese uSimakade ekhuluma noMose.
Lapho bonke abantu bebona insika yefu imi ngasemnyango wethende, bonke babesukuma, bakhothame, yilowo nalowo ngasemnyango wethende lakhe.
USimakade wakhuluma kanjalo noMose ubuso nobuso, njengomuntu ezikhulumela nomngani wakhe. Wabuyela enkanjini, kodwa inceku yakhe, insizwa enguJoshuwa indodana kaNuni, ayiphumanga ethendeni.
UMose wathi kuSimakade: “Bheka, uthe kimi: ‘Khuphula laba bantu,’ kodwa awungitshelanga ukuthi ngubani oyakumthuma nami. Uthe: ‘Ngiyakwazi ngegama, futhi ufumene umusa emehlweni ami.’
Ngakho-ke uma ngifumene umusa emehlweni akho, ake ungibonise izindlela zakho ukuba ngikwazi, ngifumane umusa emehlweni akho. Khumbula futhi ukuthi lesi sizwe singabantu bakho.”
USimakade wathi: “Ngizohamba nawe Mina uqobo, futhi ngiyakukuphumuza.”
UMose wathi kuye: “Uma Wena uqobo ungahambi nathi, ungasikhuphuli lapha.

Kuyokwaziwa kanjani ukuthi ngifumene umusa emehlweni akho, mina nabantu bakho, uma ungahambi nathi na? Akusikhona yini ukuhamba nathi okuzokwenza ukuthi mina nabantu bakho sehluke kubo bonke abanye abantu abasemhlabeni na?”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Ngizokwenza nalokho okucelileyo, ngokuba ufumene umusa emehlweni ami, futhi ngikwazi ngegama.”
UMose wathi: “Ngiyakuncenga, ake ungibonise inkazimulo yakho.”

USimakade wathi: “Ngiyakudlulisa phambi kwakho bonke ubuhle bami, ngimemeze phambi kwakho igama likaSimakade, ngibe nomusa kulowo engithanda ukuba nomusa kuye, nesihe kulowo engithanda ukuba nesihe kuye.”
Wathi: “Awunakububona ubuso bami, ngokuba akukho muntu ongangibona qede aphile.”
USimakade wathi: “Bheka, nansi indawo ngakimi, uyokuma edwaleni.
Kuyokuthi lapho yedlula inkazimulo yami, ngikufake emfantwini wedwala, ngikusithe ngesandla sami ngize ngidlule.
Bese ngisisusa isandla sami, ubone umhlane wami, kodwa ubuso bami abuyukubonwa.”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Zibazele izibhebhe ezimbili zamatshe zifane nezokuqala. Ngizobhala kuzo amazwi ayesezibhebheni zokuqala owazephulayo.
Zilungiselele ukuba ekuseni kusasa ukhuphukele entabeni iSinayi, uzibonakalise khona phambi kwami esiqongweni sentaba.
Akuyukukhuphuka muntu nawe, futhi makungabonakali muntu entabeni yonke, kungaklabi ngisho izimvu, izimbuzi nezinkomo phambi kwaleyo ntaba.”
UMose wabaza izibhebhe ezimbili zamatshe zafana nezokuqala, wavuka ekuseni ngovivi, wakhuphukela entabeni iSinayi njengoba uSimakade ayemyalile, ephethe izibhebhe ezimbili zamatshe.
USimakade wehla ngefu, wama naye lapho, wamemezela igama likaSimakade.
USimakade wadlula phambi kwakhe, wamemezela wathi: “USimakade! USimakade! UNkulunkulu onesihe nomusa, ophuza ukuthukuthela, novame ubumnene nokwethembeka,

ogcina umusa kubo abayizinkulungwane, athethelele ububi neziphambeko nezono, nokho ongayukumyeka engamjezisanga onecala, ohambela ububi babazali kubantwana, nakubantwana babantwana, kuze kube yisizukulwane sesithathu nesesine.”
UMose washeshe wakhothamela emhlabathini, wakhuleka.
Wathi: “Ngiyakuncenga, Nkosi, uma ngifumene umusa emehlweni akho, uSimakade makahambe nathi, nakuba laba bantu bengontamolukhuni. Sixolele ububi bethu, nezono zethu, usithathe sibe yifa lakho.”

Wathi kuMose: “Bheka, ngenza isivumelwano phambi kwabo bonke abantu bakho. Ngiyokwenza izimangaliso phambi kwabo bonke abantu bakho, ezingakaze zenziwe emhlabeni wonke, naphakathi kwezizwe zonke. Bonke abantu enihlala phakathi kwabo bayokuwubona umsebenzi kaSimakade, ngokuba kuyinto eyesabekayo lokhu engizokwenza ngawe.
Qaphela lokhu engikuyala ngakho namuhla. Uyabona-ke, ngizowaxosha phambi kwakho ama-Amori, amaKhanani, amaHithi, amaPherizi, amaHivi namaJebusi.
Qikelela ukuba ungenzi isivumelwano nabantu bezwe oya kulo, funa babe lugibe kuwe.
Kepha niyobhidliza ama-althare abo, niphihlize izinsika zabo, nigawule o-Ashera babo.
Ngokuba aniyukukhonza omunye unkulunkulu, lokhu uSimakade, ogama lakhe linguMhawu, unguNkulunkulu onomhawu.
Awuyukwenza isivumelwano nabantu balelo lizwe. Kuyothi lapho bephinga nonkulunkulu babo, bebahlabela imihlatshelo, omunye kubo akumeme, bese udla umhlatshelo wakhe;
uthathele amadodana akho amadodakazi abo aphinga nonkulunkulu babo, bese enza ukuba amadodana akho aphinge nonkulunkulu babo.
“Awuyukuzenzela onkulunkulu ababunjiweyo.

“Uyowugcina umkhosi wesinkwa esingenamvubelo. Uyakudla isinkwa esingenamvubelo izinsuku eziyisikhombisa njengoba ngakuyala, ngesikhathi esimisiweyo ngenyanga u-Abibi, ngokuba ngale nyanga waphuma eGibhithe.
“Wonke amazibulo angawami, ngisho namazibulo amaduna emfuyweni yakho, namazibulo ezinkomo zakho nezimvu zakho.
“Izibulo lembongolo uyolihlenga ngewundlu; uma ungalihlengi, uyolephula intamo. Wonke amazibulo emadodaneni akho uyowahlenga. Akuyukuza muntu phambi kwami engaphethe lutho.
“Uyosebenza izinsuku eziyisithupha, uphumule ngosuku lwesikhombisa. Uyophumula ngisho nangesikhathi sokulima nesokuvuna.
“Uyowugcina umkhosi wamaviki, owolibo lukakolo ovuniweyo, nomkhosi wokuvuna ekupheleni konyaka.
Bonke abesilisa bayobonakala kathathu ngonyaka phambi kweNkosi uSimakade, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.
Ngokuba ngiyozixosha izizwe phambi kwakho, ngandise imingcele yakho, akukho muntu oyonxanela izwe lakho lapho ukhuphuka ukuyobonakala kathathu ngonyaka phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.
“Awuyukunikela ngegazi lomhlatshelo wami nesinkwa esinemvubelo. Umhlatshelo womkhosi wephasika awuyukuhlala kuze kuse.
“Uyoletha endlini kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho isivuno sakho sokuqala. “Awuyukulipheka izinyane lembuzi ngobisi lukanina.”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Zibhalele lawa mazwi, ngokuba ngalawa mazwi ngenzile isivumelwano nawe no-Israyeli.”
Wahlala lapho noSimakade izinsuku ezingama-40, nobusuku obungama-40, akadlanga lutho, futhi akaphuzanga manzi. Wabhala ezibhebheni amazwi esivumelwano, imiyalelo elishumi.
Ngesikhathi uMose ehla entabeni iSinayi ephethe izibhebhe ezimbili zobufakazi esandleni sakhe, wayengazi ukuthi isikhumba sobuso bakhe sasikhazimula, ngokuba wayekade ekhuluma noSimakade.
Lapho u-Aroni nabo bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli bembona uMose, isikhumba sobuso bakhe sasikhazimula, ngakho-ke besaba ukusondela kuye.
Kepha uMose wababiza, u-Aroni nabo bonke abaholi bakwa-Israyeli, beza kuye, wakhuluma nabo.
Sekwedlule lokho, bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli basondela, wayesebayala ngakho konke uSimakade ayekukhulume kuye entabeni iSinayi.
UMose eseqedile ukukhuluma nabo, wamboza ubuso bakhe ngemvakazi.
Kodwa lapho uMose eya phambi kukaSimakade eyokhuluma naye wayeyisusa imvakazi, aze aphume. Uma esephumile wayekhuluma kubantu bakwa-Israyeli lokho ayekuyaliwe.
Abakwa-Israyeli babubona ubuso bukaMose ukuthi isikhumba sabo siyakhazimula; uMose wayebumboza ngemvakazi aze ayisuse uma eseyokhuluma noSimakade.
UMose walihlanganisa lonke ibandla lakwa-Israyeli, wathi kulo: “Yilokhu uSimakade aniyala ngakho ukuba nikwenze:
niyosebenza izinsuku eziyisithupha, kodwa ngosuku lwesikhombisa niyokuba neSabatha likaSimakade elingcwele lokuphumula, yilowo nalowo owenza umsebenzi ngalo uyobulawa.
Aniyukuwubasa umlilo emakhaya enu ngosuku lwesabatha.”
UMose wathi kuyo yonke inhlangano yabantu bakwa-Israyeli: “Yilokhu uSimakade ayale ngakho, ethi:
thathani phakathi kwenu umnikelo ube ngokaSimakade, bonke abanenhliziyo ethandayo mabanikele kuSimakade: ngegolide, ngesiliva, ngethusi;
ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokubomvu, ngelineni elicolekileyo, ngoboya bezimbuzi;
ngezikhumba zezinqama ezidaywe zabomvu, ngezikhumba zamahlengethwa, ngokhuni lomkhambathi,
ngamafutha okukhanyisa izibani, ngezinongo zamafutha okugcoba nezempepho,
nangamatshe ama-oniksi namanye aligugu ukuze afakwe engutsheni yamahlombe nasesivikelweni sesifuba.
“Bonke abanekhono phakathi kwenu bayokuza bezokwenza konke uSimakade ayale ukuba kwenziwe:
ithabanakeli, ithende lalo, nokokulifulela, izinkintsho zalo, amapulangwe alo, amabhaluko alo, izinsika zalo nezisekelo zalo;
umphongolo nezingongolo zawo, isihlalo somusa, namakhethini okuhenqa;
itafula nezinti zalo, nazo zonke izitsha zalo, nesinkwa soBukhona bakhe;
uthi lwesibani sokukhanyisa, izitsha zalo, izibani zalo, amafutha okukhanyisa,
i-althare lempepho nezingongolo zalo, amafutha okugcoba, impepho enuka kamnandi, isihenqo somnyango wokungena ethabanakeli;
i-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa, ithusi elinanyatheliselwe kulo nezingongolo zalo, nazo zonke izitsha zalo, nomcengezi nesinqe sawo,
amakhethini egceke, izinsika zalo, izisekelo zalo, ikhethini lasesangweni legceke,
izikhonkwane zethabanakeli, ezegceke, izintambo zazo,
izingubo ezifekethisiweyo zokukhonza endaweni engcwele, izingubo ezingcwele zika-Aroni umphristi, nezamadodana akhe zokukhonza bengabaphristi.”
Inhlangano yonke yabantu bakwa-Israyeli yayisisuka phambi kukaMose.

Bafika bonke labo ababenezinhliziyo ezithintekileyo, benentshisekelo emoyeni wabo. Baletha kuSimakade umnikelo owawuzosetshenziswa ethendeni lokuhlangana, nakuyo yonke eminye imisebenzi yalo, nokuthunga izingubo ezingcwele.

Beza abesilisa nabesifazane, bonke ababenezinhliziyo ezazinentshisekelo, baletha amacici, nalawo asemakhaleni, izindandatho, amasongo, nazo zonke izinto zegolide, bonke banikela kuSimakade ngomnikelo wegolide.

Bonke okwatholakala kubo okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, okubukhwebezane, okubomvu, ilineni elicolekileyo, uboya bezimbuzi, izikhumba zezinqama ezidaywe zabomvu, nezikhumba zamahlengethwa, lokho bakuletha.
Bonke abanikela ngomnikelo wesiliva nowethusi bakuletha kwaba ngumnikelo kuSimakade, nabo bonke okwafunyanwa kubo izingodo zokhuni lomkhambathi ezazingenza lowo msebenzi, baziletha.
Bonke abesifazane ababenekhono, baphotha ngezandla zabo, base beletha lokho ababekuphothile okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, okubukhwebezane, okubomvu, nelineni elicolekileyo.
Bonke abesifazane ababethintekile ezinhliziyweni, baphotha uboya bezimbuzi.
Abaholi baletha amatshe e-oniksi, amatshe engubo yamahlombe aligugu, awesivikelo sesifuba,
amakha, amafutha okukhanyisa nawokugcoba, nempepho enamakha amnandi.
Bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli, abesilisa nabesifazane, baletha ngokukhululeka noma yini ukuze kwenzeke umsebenzi uSimakade ayemyalile uMose ukuba wenziwe, bakuletha kuSimakade njengomnikelo wesihle.
UMose wathi kubantu bakwa-Israyeli: “Bhekani, uSimakade umbize ngegama uBhezaleli indodana ka-Uri, kaHuri, wesizwe sakwaJuda.
Umgcwalise ngoMoya kaNkulunkulu, wamupha ikhono, ukuqonda, ulwazi lwanoma yiluphi uhlobo lomsebenzi wezandla,
ukuba enze imisebenzi yobungcweti, asebenzise igolide, isiliva nethusi,
aqophe amatshe okuhlobisa, abaze ukhuni, nokuba enze yonke imisebenzi yobungcweti.
USimakade umphile yena no-Oholiyabhe indodana ka-Ahisamakhi, wesizwe sakwa-Dani ikhono lokufundisa.

Ubagcwalise ngokuhlakanipha ukuba benze yonke imisebenzi eyenziwa ngumqophi, ingcweti, nomfekethisi, ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwezane, ngokubomvu, nangelineni elicolekileyo, nemisebenzi yomaluki, eyalabo abenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi, nabenza imisebenzi yobungcweti.
“UBhezaleli no-Oholiyabhe bayosebenza nabo bonke abanekhono, uSimakade abeke kubo ukuhlakanipha, ukuqonda nokwazi ukwenza wonke umsebenzi wokwakha indawo engcwele, ngendlela uSimakade ayale ngayo.”
UMose wabiza uBhezaleli, u-Oholiyabhe nabo bonke abanekhono, uSimakade ayebaphe ukuhlakanipha, bonke ababenhliziyo zifisa ukuba bazokwenza lo msebenzi.
UMose wabanika bonke umnikelo wesihle abantu bakwa-Israyeli ababewulethele umsebenzi wokwakhiwa kwendawo engcwele. Babewuletha kuye umnikelo wesihle njalo ekuseni imihla ngemihla,
kwaze kwathi bonke abanamakhono ababenza imisebenzi eyehlukene endaweni engcwele beza kuMose, yilowo nalowo esuka emsebenzini ayewenza,
bathi kuMose: “Abantu baletha izinto eziningi kakhulu kunalezo ezidingekileyo ukwenza umsebenzi uSimakade ayale ukuba wenziwe.”
Ngakho-ke uMose wakhipha umyalo kwase kuyamenyezelwa enkanjini kuthiwa: “Akungabe kusaba bikho muntu wesilisa nowesifazane oletha umnikelo wendawo engcwele.” Abantu banqindwa ukuletha umnikelo,
ngokuba lokho abase bekulethile kwakungaphezu kokwanele ukuqeda wonke umsebenzi.

Bonke ababeyizingcweti phakathi kwabo, bakha ithabanakeli ngamakhethini alishumi elineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo, nangokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, nangokubomvu, kwathi ngobugcweti obukhulu bawahlobisa ngamakherubhi.
Ubude bekhethini babungamakhubhithi angama-28, ububanzi balo bungamakhubhithi amane; wonke ayelingana.
Bawahlanganisa amakhethini amahlanu baxhuma elinye kwelinye; namanye ayisihlanu bawahlanganisa baxhuma elinye kwelinye.
Benza izinkintsho ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka emphethweni engxenyeni engasekugcineni kwamakhethini okuqala, benza kanjalo futhi nasesiqeshini esingasekugcineni kwamakhethini esibili.
Benza izinkintsho ezingama-50 ekhithinini lokuqala. Benza nezinye ezingama-50 emphethweni wekhethini elihlanganisiweyo lesibili; amakhethini abhekana.
Benza izinkintsho zegolide ezingama-50 bahlanganisa ngazo amakhethini, ngakho-ke ithabanakeli laliyinto eyodwa.
Benza amakhethini ngoboya bezimbuzi, aba wuphahla lwethabanakeli; bawenza amakhethini aba li-11.
Ubude bekhethini babungamakhubhithi angama-30, ububanzi bawo bungamakhubhithi amane; amakhethini ali-11 ayelingana.
Bawahlanganisa amahlanu bawenza isiqephu esisodwa, nayisithupha ngokufanayo.
Benza izinkintsho ezingama-50 emphethweni wekhethini elaligcinile ekhethinini lokuqala, benza futhi izinkintsho ezingama-50 emphethweni wekhethini elaligcinile esiqeshini sesibili.
Benza izinkintsho zethusi zokuhlanganisa ithende ezingama-50, ukuze libe yinto eyodwa.
Benza okokufulela ithende ngezikhumba zezinqama ezidaywe zabomvu. Benza nokunye kokumboza phezulu ngezikhumba zamahlengethwa.
Benza amapulangwe ethende ngokhuni lomkhambathi, bawamisa.
Ubude bepulangwe babungamakhubhithi alishumi, ububanzi balo buyikhubhithi nengxenye.
Ipulangwe ngalinye lalinezikhonkwane ezimbili zokulixhumanisa; benza kanjalo kuwo wonke amapulangwe ethabanakeli.
Benza amapulangwe ethabanakeli angama-20 ohlangothini lwaseningizimu, olubheke eningizimu ngendlela efanayo.
Benza izisekelo ezingama-40, zizimbili phansi kwalelo nalelo pulangwe.
Ohlangothini lwesibili lwethabanakeli ngasenyakatho benza amapulangwe angama-20,
nezisekelo zesiliva ezingama-40, zizimbili phansi kwepulangwe ngalinye, kanjalo nalandelayo.
Ngasohlangothini olungemuva kwethabanakeli ngasentshonalanga, benza amapulangwe ayisithupha.
Benza amapulangwe amabili emagunjini angemuva ethabanakeli.
Ayehlukene phansi, ehlangene phezulu esongweni; bawenza omabili ngale ndlela emagunjini omabili.
Kwakunamapulangwe ayisishiyagalombili nezisekelo zawo zesiliva ezili-16; phansi kwalelo nalelo pulangwe kwakunezisekelo ezimbili.
Benza imishayo ngokhuni lomkhambathi, yaba mihlanu eyamapulangwe asohlangothini olulodwa lwethabanakeli,
nemishayo emihlanu yamapulangwe akolunye uhlangothi lwethabanakeli, neminye emihlanu entshonalanga ngasemuva kwethabanakeli.
Benza umshayo ophakathi nendawo, ukuba udabule usuka kulolu hlangothi, uye kolunye uhlangothi lwamapulangwe.
Bawacaka amapulangwe ngegolide, benza amasongo awo ngegolide ukuze abambe imishayo, bayicaka nemishayo ngegolide.
Benza ikhethini ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokubomvu, nangelineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo, lahlotshiswa ngamakherubhi ngobungcweti obukhulu.
Balenzela izinsika ezine ngokhuni lomkhambathi bazicaka ngegolide, izinkintsho zalo ziyigolide. Balenzela nezisekelo ezine zesiliva.
Benza amakhethini ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokubomvu, nangelineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo, umsebenzi wengcweti yokuhlobisa.
Benza izinsika ezinhlanu nezinkintsho zazo, bacaka izihloko zezinduku nezisekelo ngegolide, kodwa izisekelo zazo ezinhlanu zazingezethusi.
UBhezaleli wawakha umphongolo ngokhuni lomkhambathi; waba ngamakhubhithi amabili nengxenye ubude, yikhubhithi nengxenye ububanzi, nekhubhithi nengxenye ukuphakama.
Wawucaka ngegolide elicolekileyo ngaphakathi nangaphandle, wenza unqenqema lwegolide lwawuzungeza.
Wawenzela amasongo amane egolide ezinyaweni zozine zawo, amasongo ngamabili ngakulolu hlangothi, namabili ngakolunye uhlangothi.
Wenza izingongolo ngokhuni lomkhambathi, wazicaka ngegolide,
wafaka izingongolo emasongweni ezinhlangothini zomphongolo, ukuze uthwalwe ngazo.
Wenza isihlalo somusa ngegolide elicolisekileyo; saba ngamakhubhithi amabili nengxenye ubude, nekhubhithi nengxenye ububanzi.
Wenza amakherubhi amabili ngegolide elicangcathiweyo; wawabeka ezinhlangothini zombili ekugcineni kwesihlalo somusa,
ikherubhi ngalinye ekugcineni kwalolu hlangothi lwesihlalo somusa, nelinye ekugcineni kolunye uhlangothi, kulelo nalelo chopho lesivalo.
Amakherubhi ayendlale amaphiko awo phezu kwesihlalo somusa, esembozile; ebhekene ngobuso bawo, ayesebheka esihlalweni somusa.
Walakha itafula ngokhuni lomkhambathi, laba ngamakhubhithi amabili ubude, nekhubhithi ububanzi, nekhubhithi nengxenye ukuphakama.
Walicaka ngegolide elicolisekileyo, wenza unqenqema lwegolide nxazonke.
Walenzela unqenqema olungangokuvuleka kwesandla ububanzi, walucaka ngegolide elicolisekileyo nxazonke.
Wenza amasongo egolide amane, wawafaka emakhoneni alo omane, asemilenzeni yalo.
Amasongo okufaka izingongolo zokulithwala ayesondelene nonqenqema.
Wenza izingongolo ngokhuni lomkhambathi, wazicaka ngegolide.
Wenza ngegolide elicolisekileyo imicengezi eyayizohlala etafuleni, izingqwembe, nezitsha zempepho, izinkezo, nezindebe ezisetshenziselwa umnikelo wewayini.
Wenza futhi nothi lwezibani ngegolide elicolisekileyo, isinqe salo nothi lwalo kwakwenziwe ngokucangcathiweyo; izindebe, izimbali nemidumba kuhlanganisiwe kwaba yinto eyodwa.
Kwakukhona amagatsha ayisithupha ayexhume esiqwini sezibani, emathathu ohlangothini ngalunye.

Kwelinye igatsha kwakunezindebe ezintathu ezazimi njengezimbali zomu-alimondi, yileyo naleyo inemidumba nembali. Kwelinye igatsha kwakunezindebe ezintathu ezazimi njengezimbali zomu-alimondi, yileyo naleyo inemidumba nembali. Kwakunjalo kuwo wonke amagatsha ayisithupha aphuma othini lwezibani.
Othini lwesibani kwakukhona izindebe ezine ezazimise okwembali yomu-alimondi, zinemidumba nembali.
Kwakunomdumba ngaphansi kwamagatsha amabili, neminye imidumba phansi kwalelo nalelo gatsha, wonke amagatsha ayisithupha ayephuma kulo.
