Imidumba namagatsha ayephuma kulo, konke kwakungumsebenzi owodwa ocangcathiweyo wegolide elicwengekileyo.
Wenza izibani zalo eziyisikhombisa, nezindlawu zalo nezingqwembe zegolide elicwengekileyo zokukhongozela amalahle avuthayo.
Walwenza lona nazo zonke izimpahla zalo ngethalenta legolide elicwengekileyo.
Wenza i-althare lempepho ngokhuni lomkhambathi, ubude balo baba yikhubhithi, nobubanzi balo baba yikhubhithi; laba yisikwele, ukuphakama kwalo kwaba ngamakhubhithi amabili; kukhona nezimpondo kulo.
Walicaka ngegolide elicwengekileyo ngaphezulu, kwathi zonke izinhlangothi zalo nezimpondo zalo, wazenzela unqenqema lwegolide nxazonke.
Walenzela amasongo amabili egolide phansi konqenqema, nhlangothi zombili ukuze kungene izingongolo zokulithwala.
Walenzela izingongolo ngokhuni lomkhambathi, wazicaka ngegolide.
Wenza amafutha okugcoba angcwele, namakha empepho amnandi, ethakwe ngumthaki oyingcweti.
Wenza i-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa ngokhuni lomkhambathi; laba ngamakhubhithi ayisihlanu ubude, namakhubhithi ayisihlanu ububanzi; laba yisikwele, nokuphakama kwalo kwaba ngamakhubhithi amathathu.
Wenza izimpondo emakhoneni alo omane, izimpondo zazenzelwe kulo; wazemboza ngethusi.
Wenza zonke izimpahla ze-althare; amabhodwe, amafosholo, imicengezi, izimfologo nemicengezi yomlilo, konke wakwenza ngethusi.
Walenzela i-althare inetha lethusi elenziwe njengenetha phansi konqenqema lwe-althare ukuba lifinyelele ngaphakathi kwe-althare ukuya phezulu.
Wenza amasongo amane okulithwala, wawabeka emakhoneni omane.
Wenza izingongolo ngokhuni lomkhambathi, wazicaka ngethusi,
wazifaka izingongolo emasongweni asezinhlangothini ze-althare, ukuze lithwalwe ngazo. I-althare walenza ngamapulangwe; laba wugobhozi.
Wenza umcengezi nesinqe sawo ngethusi lezibuko zabesifazane ababesebenza emnyango wethende lokuhlangana.
Wenza negceke; ngaseningizimu kwakulenga amakhethini enziwe ngelineni lemicu ephothiweyo ecolekileyo, lingamakhubhithi ayikhulu ubude;
izinsika zalo zazingama-20, nezisekelo zalo zethusi ezingama-20; izinkintsho zezinsika nezibopho kwakuyisiliva.
Ngasohlangothini lwasenyakatho kunamakhethini angamakhubhithi ayikhulu ubude; izinsika zawo bungama-20, izisekelo zawo ezingama-20 zilithusi, izinkintsho namabhande kulisiliva.
Ngasohlangothini lwasentshonalanga kulenga amakhethini angamakhubhithi angama-50 ubude, enezinsika ezilishumi, nezisekelo ezilishumi; izinkintsho namabhande kulisiliva.
Ngasohlangothini lwasempumalanga kungamakhubhithi angama-50.
Amakhubhithi ohlangothini lwesango ayengamakhubhithi ali-15, enezinsika ezintathu, nezisekelo ezintathu.
Ngakolunye uhlangothi kusuka ngapha kuya ngale kwesango legceke kwakulenga amakhethini angamakhubhithi ali-15, enezinsika ezintathu, nezisekelo ezintathu.
Onke amakhethini eyezungeze igceke ayenziwe ngelineni lemicu ephothiweyo.
Izisekelo zezinsika zazilithusi; izinkintsho zezinsika namabhande akhona kulisiliva; izihloko zalo zicakwe ngesiliva, zonke izinsika zegceke zinezibopho zesiliva.

Isihenqo sesango legceke sasihlotshiswe ngensonto eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokubomvu, nangelineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo. Kwakungamakhubhithi angama-20 ubude, ukuphakama nobubanzi balo bungamakhubhithi ayisihlanu, kulingana namakhethini egceke.
Kwakunezinsika ezine nezisekelo zazo ezine kungezethusi, izinkintsho zalo kungezesiliva, izihloko zazo zembozwe ngesiliva, nezibopho zalo zingezesiliva.
Zazilithusi macala wonke zonke izikhonkwane zethabanakeli nezegceke.
Lezi kwakuyizindleko zethabanakeli; ithabanakeli lesivumelwano, ezahlanganiswa njengokuyala kukaMose, umsebenzi wabaLevi wawuphansi kuka-Ithamari, indodana ka-Aroni umphristi.
UBhezaleli indodana ka-Uri, kaHure wesizwana sakwaJuda, wenza konke lokho uSimakade ayeyale ngakho uMose.
Wayeno-Oholiyabhe indodana ka-Ahisamakhi wesizwana sakwaDani, umqophi, nengcweti yokuhlobisa, ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokubomvu, nangelineni elicolekileyo.
Lonke igolide elasetshenziselwa lowo msebenzi, kuwo wonke umsebenzi wendawo engcwele, igolide lomnikelo lalingamatalenta angama-29, namashekeli angama-730 ngokweshekeli lendlu engcwele.
Isiliva elathokala enhlanganweni eyayibaliwe laba ngamathalenta alikhulu, namashekeli ayi-1 775 ngokweshekeli lendlu engcwele.

Umuntu ngamunye wanikela ngebeka, okunguhhafu weshekeli ngokweshekeli lendlu engcwele, kubo bonke ababebaliwe ngesikhathi bebalwa, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, emadodeni ayizi-603 550.
Amathalenta ayikhulu esiliva ayengawokukhanda izisekelo zendawo engcwele, nezisekelo zesihenqo; izisekelo eziyikhulu zingamathalenta ayikhulu, kuyithalenta isisekelo ngasinye.
Wenza izinkintsho zezinsika ngamashekeli ayi-1 775 wacaka izihloko zawo, wenza nezibopho zazo.
Ithusi elalinikeliwe lalingamathalenta angama-70, namashekeli ayizi-2 400;
wenza ngalo izisekelo zesango lethende lokuhlangana, i-althare lethusi, inetha lethusi, nazo zonke izimpahla ze-althare,
zonke izisekelo ezizungeze igceke, nezesango legceke, nazo zonke izikhonkwane zethabanakeli nxazonke zegceke.
Benza izingubo ezinhle zokukhonza endaweni engcwele ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane nangokubomvu. Benzela u-Aroni izingubo ezingcwele njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Benza ingubo yamahlombe ngegolide, ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokubomvu, nangelineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo.

Bacangcatha igolide laba ngamacwecwe, base bewasika aba yimidweshana bayelukela ensontweni eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ebukhwebezane, ebomvu, naselinenini elicolekileyo, lokhu kwenziwa ngobuciko obukhulu.
Bayenzela iziziba zamahlombe ezihlanganisiweyo; bayixhuma emaceleni omabili.

Ibhande elihlotshisiwe lokuyibopha elalikuyo lalenziwe ngendlela efanayo nezingubo, lenziwe ngegolide, ngensonto eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokubomvu, nangelineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo; njengokuba uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Balungisa amatshe e-oniksi, ayezungezwe yizisekelo zegolide, eqoshwe njengendandatho, kwaqoshwa kuwo amagama amadodana kaJakobe.
Bawabeka ezizibeni zengubo yamahlombe, ukuze abe ngamatshe esikhumbuzo samadodana ka-Israyeli, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.

Benza isivikelo sesifuba ngobuciko obufanayo njengoba benza ingubo yamahlombe, ngokuyigolide, ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokubomvu nangelineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo.
Sasiyisikwele, isivikelo sesifuba siphindeka kabili, ubude baso bungangokuvuleka kwesandla, nobubanzi baso bungangokuvuleka kwesandla, siphindwe kabili.
Bafaka kuso imigqa emine yamatshe; kowokuqala bafaka irubhi, ithophazi negarinethi;
umugqa wesibili kwaba ithekhoyise, yisafire ne-emeralidi;
umugqa wesithathu kwaba yijasinithe, i-agathe ne-amethiyisithi
emugqeni wesine kwaba yikhrisolithe, yi-oniksi, nejasiperi; ayezungezwe yizisekelo zegolide lapho ayefakwe khona.
Kwakungamatshe ali-12 alingana namagama amadodana ka-Israyeli; ayeqoshwe njengendandatho yokusicilela, kuqoshwe kulelo nalelo igama lesizwana ngasinye kwezili-12.
Benza esivikelweni sesifuba amaketanga egolide elicolisekileyo anjengamagoda aphothiweyo.
Benza izisekelo ezimbili zegolide, namasongo amabili egolide; omabili bawafaka ngenhla emachosheni esivikelo sesifuba.
Base befaka izintambo ezimbili zegolide emasongweni omabili asemachosheni esivikelo sesifuba.
Izihloko ezimbili zamaketanga athandelweyo bazifaka emiphethweni yomibili, bazibeka ezizibeni ezisemahlombe ukuya ngaphambili kwazo.
Base benza amasongo amabili egolide bawafaka emachosheni omabili esivikelo sesifuba, eceleni laso eliqondene nengubo yamahlombe ngaphakathi.
Benza amanye amasongo amabili egolide bawafaka phansi phambili ezizibeni zombili zengubo yamahlombe ngalapho ihlangana khona, ngaphezu kwebhande layo elihlotshisiweyo.

Base bebopha isivikelo sesifuba ngamasongo aso, emasongweni engubo yamahlombe basibopha ngentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ukuba sibe phezu kwebhande elihlotshisiweyo lengubo yamahlombe, ukuze singakhumuki kuyo, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Benza ijazi lokwemboza ingubo yamahlombe ngokwalukiweyo okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kuphela.
Imbobo yengubo eyayiphakathi nayo, yayifana nembobo yejazi lensimbi, inomphetho ozungeze imbobo yalo ukuba lingadabuki.
Emphethweni wejazi ongezansi bafaka amahananadi enziwe ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, okubukhwebezane, okubomvu nelineni elicolekileyo eliphothiweyo.
Benza izinsimbi ezikhencezayo ngegolide elicolisekileyo, bazifaka izinsimbi phakathi kwamahananadi ngasemphethweni wayo, bawuzungeza wonke umphetho wayo.
Kwaba yinsimbi ekhencezayo, yihananadi, yinsimbi nehananadi emphethweni ozungeze ingubo yokukhonza, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Benzela u-Aroni namadodana akhe amabhantshi ngelineni elicolekileyo, okwakungumsebenzi wobuciko obukhulu
benza namaqhiya ngelineni elicolekileyo, okunye kokuthwala ekhanda ngelineni elicolekileyo, nezingubo zangaphansi ngelineni lemicu ephothiweyo elicolekileyo,
nebhande lelineni lemicu ephothiweyo, ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokubomvu, okwakwenziwe ngobuciko obukhulu ngumhlobisi, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Benza ucwecwe lomqhele ongcwele ngegolide elicwengekileyo, baqopha kulo umbhalo njengokuqoshwa kwendandatho othi kungcwele kuSimakade.
Babophela kulo intambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, base bekubeka ngaphezu kweqhiya; njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Waphothulwa kanjalo-ke wonke umsebenzi wethabanakeli lethende lokuhlangana; abantu bakwa-Israyeli benza njengakho konke uSimakade ayemyale ngakho uMose.
Baliletha ithabanakeli kuMose, ithende, nayo yonke impahla yalo: izinkintsho, amapulangwe, imishayo, izinsika nezisekelo zazo,
okokufulela okwakwenziwe ngezikhumba zezinqama ezidaywe zaba bomvu, okokufulela kwezikhumba zamahlengethwa, ikhethini lokuhenqa,
umphongolo wobufakazi, izingongolo zawo, isembozo esiyisihlalo somusa;
itafula nayo yonke impahla yalo, nesinkwa soBukhona bukaSimakade;
uthi lwezibani olwenziwe ngegolide elicwengekileyo nezibani zalo zihleliwe, nakho konke okuhambisana nalo, amafutha okukhanyisa,
i-althare legolide, amafutha okugcoba, impepho enuka kamnandi, isihenqo ekungeneni kwethende,
i-althare lethusi, inetha lalo lethusi, izingongolo zalo, nazo zonke izimpahla zalo, umcengezi nesinqe sawo,
amakhethini egceke, izinsika nezisekelo zalo, ikhethini elihenqa isango legceke, izintambo zalo, izikhonkwane zalo, nakho konke okusetshenziselwa inkonzo yethabanakeli ethendeni lokuhlangana,
izingubo zokukhonza endaweni engcwele ezenziwe ngokulukiwe, izingubo ezingcwele zika-Aroni umphristi, nezamadodana akhe zokukhonza bengabaphristi.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli bawenza wonke umsebenzi njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
UMose wawuhlola wonke umsebenzi, wawubona ukuthi wenziwe njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile, ngakho-ke uMose wababusisa.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga yokuqala uyakulimisa ithabanakeli lethende lokuhlangana.
Uyakufaka kulo umphongolo wesivumelwano, bese uwuhenqela umphongolo ngesihenqo.
Uyakungenisa itafula, uhlele izinto eziphezu kwalo, uyakufaka uthi lwesibani bese ubeka izibani zalo.
Uyakubeka i-althare legolide lokushisela impepho phambi komphongolo wesivumelwano, bese ufaka isihenqo somnyango wethabanakeli.
Uyakubeka i-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa phambi komnyango wethabanakeli lethende lokuhlangana.
Ubeke umcengezi phakathi kwethende lokuhlangana ne-althare, uthele amanzi kuwo.
Uyakulungisa igceke nxazonke, bese ulengisa isihenqo sesango legceke.
“Uyakuthatha amafutha okugcoba, ugcobe ithabanakeli nakho konke okukulo, ulingcwelise nayo yonke impahla yalo, ukuze libe ngcwele.
Uyakugcoba ne-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa nayo yonke impahla yalo, ulingcwelise i-althare, ukuze i-althare libe ngcwelengcwele.
Uyakugcoba umcengezi nesinqe sawo, uwungcwelise.
“Emveni kwalokho uyakuletha u-Aroni namadodana akhe ekungeneni kwethende lokuhlangana, bese ubageza ngamanzi.
Uyakugqokisa u-Aroni izingubo ezingcwele, bese umgcoba, umngcwelise, ukuze angikhonze engumphristi.
Uyakuletha futhi namadodana akhe, uwembathise amabhantshi enkonzo.
Uwagcobe njengalokhu wenzile kuyise, ukuze angikhonze engabaphristi. Ukugcotshwa kwabo kuyobangenisa ebuphristini baphakade izizukulwane ngezizukulwane.”
UMose wenza konke njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile.
Ngenyanga yokuqala ngonyaka wesibili, ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga, ithabanakeli lamiswa.
UMose walimisa ithabanakeli, wabeka izisekelo zalo, wamisa amapulangwe, wafaka imishayo, wamisa izinsika zalo.
Walendlala ithende phezu kwethabanakeli, weleka ngokokulimboza phezu kwalo, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Wathatha izibhebhe ezimbili zamatshe wazifaka emphongolweni. Wafaka izingongolo emphongolweni, wabeka isihlalo somusa phezu komphongolo.
Wawungenisa umphongolo ethabanakelini, wamisa isihenqo sokuhenqela umphongolo wesivumelwano, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Wafaka itafula ethendeni lokuhlangana, walibeka ohlangothini olungasenyakatho lwethabanakeli ngaphandle kwesihenqo,
wahlela kahle isinkwa phezu kwalo phambi kukaSimakade, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Wabeka uthi lwezibani ethendeni lokuhlangana, maqondana netafula elisohlangothini olungaseningizimu yethabanakeli.
Wayesebeka izibani phambi kukaSimakade, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Wabeka i-althare legolide ethendeni lokuhlangana phambi kwesihenqo,
wayeseshisa kulo impepho enuka kamnandi, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Walengisa isihenqo somnyango wethende.
Wabeka i-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa ngasemnyango wethabanakeli lethende lokuhlangana, wayesenikela phezu kwalo umnikelo wokushiswa, nowokusanhlamvu, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Wabeka umcengezi phakathi kwethende lokuhlangana ne-althare, wathela kuwo amanzi okugeza,
ababezogeza ngawo izandla nezinyawo oMose no-Aroni namadodana akhe.
Lapho bengena ethendeni lokuhlangana nalapho besondela e-althare, babegeza, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Walungisa igceke nxazonke zethabanakeli ne-althare, walengisa isihenqo sesango lalo. Wawuphothula kanjalo-ke uMose umsebenzi.
Ifu lalisibekela ithende lokuhlangana, inkazimulo kaSimakade yagcwalisa ithabanakeli.
UMose akakwazanga ukungena ethendeni lokuhlangana, ngokuba ifu lahlala phezu kwalo, nenkazimulo kaSimakade yagcwalisa ithabanakeli.
Kwakuthi lapho ifu liphakanyiswa phezu kwethabanakeli, abantu bakwa-Israyeli baqhubeke nohambo lwabo.
Kepha uma ifu lingaphakanyiswanga babengaqhubeki nohambo kuze kube lusuku eliphakanyiswa ngalo.
Ngokuba ifu likaSimakade laliba phezu kwethabanakeli emini, kuthi ebusuku kube khona umlilo efini. Bonke abakwa-Israyeli babekubona lokhu kuleyo naleyo ngxenye yohambo lwabo.
USimakade wabiza uMose wakhuluma naye esethendeni lokuhlangana, wathi:
“Khuluma kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Noma ngubani kini oletha umnikelo wemfuyo kuSimakade, uyoletha umnikelo awuthathe ezinkomeni noma ezimvini noma ezimbuzini.
“ ‘Uma umnikelo kungumnikelo wokushiswa othathwe ezinkomeni, uyonikela ngeduna elingenasici, uyoliletha emnyango wethende lokuhlangana ukuze emukeleke phambi kukaSimakade.
Uyobeka isandla sakhe enhloko yomnikelo wokushiswa, uyokwamukelwa ngenxa yakhe, njengomnikelo wokubuyisana.
Iduna liyohlatshwa phambi kukaSimakade; amadodana ka-Aroni angabaphristi alethe igazi, alifafaze nxazonke ze-althare elingasekungeneni kwethende lokuhlangana.
Umnikelo wokushiswa uyohlinzwa, kukhishwe izitho zawo.
Bayowunika amadodana ka-Aroni, umphristi abeke amalahle avuthayo e-althare, bese ehlela izinkuni phezu kwawo.
Amadodana ka-Aroni angabaphristi ayohlela izitho: inhloko, namanoni phezu kwezinkuni ezisemlilweni e-althare,
ezangaphakathi namanqina ayokugeza ngamanzi, umphristi bese ekushisa konke kube ngumnikelo wokushiswa, umnikelo womlilo, ube yiphunga elimnandi kuSimakade.
“ ‘Uma umnikelo wakhe ewuthathe emhlanjini wezimvu noma wezimbuzi, ukuba ube ngumnikelo wokushiswa, makanikele ngeduna elingenasici.
Uyolihlabela ngasohlangothini olusenyakatho lwe-althare phambi kukaSimakade, kuthi amadodana ka-Aroni angabaphristi afafaze igazi lalo nxazonke ze-althare.
Liyakukhishwa izitho, inhloko namanoni alo, umphristi akuhlele phezu kwezinkuni eziphezu kwe-althare,
kodwa ezangaphakathi namanqina kuyakugezwa ngamanzi. Umphristi akunikele konke, akushise kube nentuthu e-althare, kube ngumnikelo wokushiswa, ngumnikelo womlilo, kube yiphunga elimnandi kuSimakade.
“ ‘Uma umnikelo wakhe kuSimakade kungowezinyoni, uyakukhetha umnikelo wakhe phakathi kwamahobhe noma amaphuphu amajuba.
Umphristi uyakuwuletha e-althare, awushumpule inhloko, awushise kube nentuthu e-althare, akhamele igazi lawo ezinhlangothini ze-althare.
Uyosusa ingingila nokuphakathi kuyo nezimpaphe zawo akuphonse ngasempumalanga ye-althare, endaweni yomlotha.

Uyakulidabula phakathi kwamaphiko, kodwa angalehlukanisi. Umphristi uyakulishisa e-althare phezu kwezinkuni ezisemlilweni, libe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, umnikelo womlilo, ube yiphunga elimnandi kuSimakade.
“ ‘Noma ngubani oletha umnikelo wokusanhlamvu kuSimakade, umnikelo kufanele ube ngowempuphu ecolisekileyo, athele amafutha kuwo, abeke nenhlaka kuwo.

Uyowuletha emadodaneni ka-Aroni angabaphristi. Ayocaphuna ngesandla impuphu ecolisekileyo, amafutha, nayo yonke inhlaka, umphristi uyokushisa kube nentuthu e-althare kube yisikhumbuzo, umnikelo womlilo, ube yiphunga elimnandi kuSimakade.
Okuseleyo emnikelweni wokusanhlamvu kuyakuba ngokuka-Aroni namadodana akhe, kuyingxenye yeminikelo yomlilo kaSimakade engcwelengcwele.
“ ‘Uma unikela ngomnikelo wokusanhlamvu obhakwe kuhhavini, mawube ngowempuphu ecolisekileyo: amaqebelengwane angenamvubelo axovwe namafutha, noma amaweyifa angenamvubelo agcotshwe ngamafutha.
Uma umnikelo wakho ungowokusanhlamvu okugazingwe ngomqengele akube ngowempuphu ecolisekileyo engenamvubelo exovwe namafutha.
Wuhlephule ube yimvuthu bese uthela amafutha kuwo, kungumnikelo wokusanhlamvu.
Uma umnikelo wakho ungowokusanhlamvu okugazingwe emcengezini, uyokwenziwa ngempuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe namafutha.
Uyakunikela kuSimakade umnikelo wokusanhlamvu olungiswe ngalezi zindlela; uwunike umphristi, yena awuyise e-althare.
Umphristi uyothatha eyakhe ingxenye, kuthi okunye akushise kube nentuthu e-althare, umnikelo womlilo, ube yiphunga elimnandi kuSimakade.
Okusale emnikelweni wokusanhlamvu kuyokuba ngokuka-Aroni namadodana akhe; kungcwelengcwele eminikelweni yomlilo kaSimakade.
“ ‘Umnikelo wokusanhlamvu eninikela ngawo kuSimakade awuyukwenziwa ngokunemvubelo, ngokuba aniyukushisa imvubelo noju kube ngumnikelo womlilo kuSimakade.
Unganikela ngakho kuSimakade kube ngumnikelo wolibo, kodwa awuyukunikela ngakho e-althare kube yiphunga elimnandi.
Yonke iminikelo yakho yokusanhlamvu uboyiyolisa ngosawoti; ungawushiyi usawoti wesivumelwano sikaNkulunkulu wakho eminikelweni yakho yokusanhlamvu; yonke iminikelo yakho iyoba nosawoti.
“ ‘Uma uletha umnikelo wokusanhlamvu wolibo kuSimakade, uyonikela ngeminyani yamabele eshiswe ngomlilo, amabele abhuliweyo eminyani emisha, kube ngumnikelo wokusanhlamvu wolibo lwakho,
uthele amafutha kuwo, ubeke inhlaka phezu kwawo; kungumnikelo wokusanhlamvu.
Umphristi ashise okuyisikhumbuzo sawo, ingxenye yokusanhlamvu okugquliweyo kwawo nengxenye yamafutha awo nayo yonke inhlaka yawo; kungumnikelo womlilo kuSimakade.
“ ‘Uma umnikelo ungumhlatshelo wokuthula, ophuma emhlanjini, noma yiduna noma yinsikazi, uyonikela ngokungenasici phambi kukaSimakade.
Uyakubeka isandla sakhe enhloko yawo, awuhlabe ngasekungeneni kwethende lokuhlangana, amadodana ka-Aroni angabaphristi ayofafaza igazi lawo nxazonke ze-althare.
Uyothatha kulowo mnikelo wokuthula anikele ngawo ube ngumnikelo womlilo kuSimakade, umhlwehlwe nawo wonke amanoni amboze ezangaphakathi,
izinso zombili namafutha azembozile ngasokhalo, nengxenye yesibindi, akukhiphe konke.
Amadodana ka-Aroni ayokushisa konke lokhu kube nentuthu e-althare, nomnikelo wokushiswa ophezu kwezinkuni, kube ngumnikelo womlilo, ube yiphunga elimnandi kuSimakade.
Uma umnikelo ungumhlatshelo wokuthula kuSimakade ovela emhlanjini, noma yiduna noma yinsikazi uyonikela ngokungenasici.
Uma enikela ngewundlu libe ngumnikelo wakhe uyoliletha phambi kukaSimakade,
abeke isandla sakhe enhloko yomnikelo wakhe. Liyohlatshwa phambi kwethende lokuhlangana. Amadodana ka-Aroni ayofafaza igazi lalo nxazonke ze-althare.

Amanoni alo awathathe emnikelweni wokuthula, uyowanikela abe ngumnikelo womlilo kuSimakade: wonke umsila walo osikwe emgogodleni, amanoni emboze ezangaphakathi, nawo wonke amanoni aphezu kwezangaphakathi,
nezinso zombili namanoni azembozile asokhalo, namanoni aphezu kwesibindi, uyowasusa nezinso.
Umphristi uyakukushisa lokhu kube nentuthu e-althare, kungumnikelo wokudla womlilo kuSimakade.
“ ‘Uma umnikelo wakhe kuyisiphongwane, uyowethula phambi kukaSimakade,
abeke isandla sakhe enhloko yaso, asihlabele phambi kwethende lokuhlangana. Amadodana ka-Aroni ayofafaza igazi laso nxazonke ze-althare.
Uyothatha kuso, anikele kube ngumnikelo wakhe womlilo kuSimakade: amanoni amboze ezangaphakathi zaso, nawo wonke akwezangaphakathi,
nezinso zombili namanoni azembozile asokhalo, namanoni aphezu kwesibindi, uyowasusa ezinsweni.
Umphristi uyokushisa kube nentuthu e-althare, umnikelo womlilo ube yiphunga elimnandi. Onke amanoni angakaSimakade.
“ ‘Lokhu kuyakuba yisimiso esiphakade ezizukulwaneni zenu ezindaweni enihlala kuzo sokuthi aniyukuwadla amanoni negazi.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Uma umuntu ona engahlosile, ephule imiyalo kaSimakade ngezinto okungafanele zenziwe, yena aphikelele azenze,
uma kungumphristi ogcotshiweyo owonayo, ngaleyo ndlela ehlisele icala kubantu, uyonikela ngenxa yesono sakhe, ngeduna elingenasici liphuma emhlanjini wakhe libe ngumnikelo wakhe wesono kuSimakade.
Uyoliletha iduna phambi kukaSimakade ngasekungeneni kwethende lokuhlangana, abeke isandla sakhe enhloko yalo, iduna lihlatshwe phambi kukaSimakade.
Umphristi ogcotshiweyo uyothatha ingxenye yegazi leduna alilethe ethendeni lokuhlangana.
Umphristi uyogcobhoza umunwe wakhe egazini, achinse ingxenye yalo kasikhombisa phambi kukaSimakade phambi kwesihenqo sendlu engcwele.

Umphristi uyobheca ingxenye yegazi ezimpondweni ze-althare lempepho enephunga elimnandi elisethendeni lokuhlangana, phambi kukaSimakade: lonke igazi leduna eliseleyo uyolithululela esinqeni se-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa, elisemnyango wethende lokuhlangana.
Uyosusa wonke amanoni enyameni yeduna lomnikelo wesono; umhlwehlwe, nawo wonke amanoni aphezu kwezangaphakathi,
nezinso zombili namanoni azembozile nasokhalo, namanoni aphezu kwesibindi, awasuse nezinso,
njengalokhu enzile eduneni lomhlatshelo weminikelo yokuthula, bese umphristi ekushisa e-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa.
Isikhumba seduna nayo yonke inyama yalo, inhloko, amanqina, ezangaphakathi nomswani,
zonke izitho zeduna uyokukukhiphela ngaphandle kwenkambu, endaweni ehlambulukileyo lapho kuchithwa khona umlotha, akushise ezinkunini ezisemlilweni kuze kube ngumlotha.
“ ‘Uma kone yonke inhlangano yakwa-Israyeli ingahlosile, leyo nto ifihleke emehlweni ebandla, yenza noma ikuphi okunye okusemthethweni kaSimakade ayale ukuba kungenziwa, yaze yazenzela icala;
uma isono abasenzileyo sesaziwa, inhlangano iyonikela ngeduna livela emhlanjini libe ngumnikelo wesono, iyoliletha phambi kwethende lokuhlangana.
Amalunga enhlangano ayakubeka izandla zawo enhloko yeduna phambi kukaSimakade, bese lihlatshwa phambi kukaSimakade.
Umphristi ogcotshiweyo uyoletha ingxenye yegazi leduna ethendeni lokuhlangana.
Umphristi uyogcobhoza umunwe wakhe egazini, afafaze i-althare kasikhombisa phambi kukaSimakade naphambi kwesihenqo.

Enye ingxenye yegazi uyolibheca ezimpondweni ze-althare eliphambi kukaSimakade, ethendeni lokuhlangana, athululele lonke igazi elisele ngasesinqeni se-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa elingasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana.
Uyosusa wonke amanoni kulo awashise e-althare.
Uyokwenza ngaleli duna njengoba kwenziwe eduneni lomnikelo wesono; nakuleli uyokwenza kanjalo. Umphristi uyakubenzela ukubuyisana, bathethelelwe.
Uyolikhiphela iduna ngaphandle kwenkambu, alishise njengoba eshise elokuqala; lingumnikelo wesono webandla.
“ ‘Uma kona umholi ngokungenhloso, wephula omunye wale miyalo uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakhe ayale ngayo ukuba ingenziwa, aze azilethele icala,
uma azisiwe isono sakhe one ngaso, uyakuletha umnikelo wesiphongwane esingenasici.
Uyakubeka isandla sakhe phezu kwenhloko yesiphongwane; sihlatshelwe lapho kuhlatshelwa khona iminikelo yokushiswa phambi kukaSimakade, singumnikelo wesono.

Umphristi uyakuthatha ingxenye yegazi lomnikelo wesono ngomunwe wakhe alibhece ezimpondweni ze-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa, kuthi ingxenye yegazi eseleyo ayithululele ngasesinqeni se-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa.
Wonke amanoni aso uyowashisa kube nentuthu e-althare njengamanoni omhlatshelo wokuthula, umphristi amenzele ukubuyisana, athethelelwe.
“ ‘Uma umuntu ona engahlosile, ephula noma yimuphi umyalo kaSimakade ayale ukuba ungephulwa, aze azilethele icala,
uma azisiwe isono asenzileyo, uyoletha umnikelo wembuzi yensikazi engenasici, ngesono sakhe asenzileyo.
Uyobeka isandla sakhe enhloko yomnikelo wesono, awuhlabe umnikelo wesono endaweni yomnikelo wokushiswa.
Umphristi uyothatha igazi layo ngomunwe wakhe alibhece ezimpondweni ze-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa, kuthi lonke igazi layo alithululele ngasesinqeni se-althare.

Uyowasusa wonke amanoni ayo ngendlela okususwe ngayo amanoni emnikelweni wokuthula, umphristi ayishise kube nentuthu e-althare, kube yiphunga elimnandi kuSimakade, umphristi amenzele ukubuyisana, athethelelwe.
“ ‘Uma elethe iwundlu laba ngumnikelo wakhe wesono, uyoletha insikazi engenasici.
Uyobeka isandla sakhe enhloko yomnikelo wesono, awuhlabe ube ngumnikelo wesono lapho kuhlatshelwa khona umnikelo wokushiswa.
Umphristi uyothatha ingxenye yegazi lomnikelo wesono ngomunwe wakhe, alibhece ezimpondweni ze-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa, kuthi lonke eliseleyo alithululele ngasesinqeni se-althare.

Wonke amanoni ayo uyowasusa ngendlela okususwe ngayo amanoni emnikelweni wewundlu elinikelelwe ukuthula, umphristi awashise kube nentuthu e-althare, phezu kweminikelo yokushiswa kaSimakade, amenzele ukubuyisana ngesono sakhe asenzile, athethelelwe.

“ ‘Uma umuntu ebiziwe ukuba ethule ubufakazi obufungelwe ngalokho akuzwile, athi noma ekwazi ukubethula ubufakazi njengomuntu obonile noma olwaziyo udaba, kodwa athule angakhulumi, lowo uyothwala icala.

Noma ngubani othinta noma yini engcolileyo, kungaba yisidumbu sesilwane esingcolileyo, noma yisidumbu semfuyo engcolileyo, noma yisidumbu sesilwane esinwabuzelayo esingcolileyo, engasibonanga, nokho uyoba ngongcolileyo, abe necala.
“ ‘Othinta ukungcola komuntu, noma ngokwaluphi uhlobo, engabonanga, lapho esazi uyoba necala.
“ ‘Uma umuntu efunga egomela ngomlomo wakhe ukwenza okubi noma okuhle, kumbe akhulume budlabha afunge, engakucabangisisile, lapho esazi uyoba necala lokunye kwalokho.
“ ‘Kuyothi uma enecala lokunye kwalezi zinto, akuvume lokho akonileyo,
alethe umnikelo kuSimakade, ube yinhlawulo yesono asenzileyo, insikazi emhlanjini wakhe wezimvu noma wezimbuzi, ibe wumnikelo wesono; umphristi uyomenzela ukubuyisana ngesono sakhe.
“ ‘Uma engenamandla okukhipha imvu, uyoletha kuSimakade amahobhe amabili ngenxa yesono asenzileyo, noma amaphuphu amabili amajuba; elinye libe ngumnikelo wesono, elinye libe ngumnikelo wokushiswa.
Uyakuwaletha kumphristi, alethe kuqala elomnikelo wesono, alishuphule ikhanda entanyeni, kodwa angalehlukanisi nalo,
uyofafaza ngengxenye yegazi lomnikelo wesono ohlangothini lwe-althare, kuthi igazi eliseleyo alikhamele esinqeni se-althare; kungumnikelo wesono.
Ngelesibili uyokwenza umnikelo wokushiswa njengokwesimiso, umphristi amenzele ukubuyisana, owonile athethelelwe.

“ ‘Kepha uma engenamandla okuletha amahobhe amabili noma amaphuphu amabili amajuba, maqondana nesono sakhe, uyoletha okweshumi kwe-efa lempuphu ecolisekileyo, kube ngumnikelo wesono, akayukuthela mafutha phezu kwalo, futhi akayukubeka nhlaka phezu kwalo, ngokuba lingumnikelo wesono.
Uyoliletha kumphristi, yena acaphune kuyo isandla sigcwale, kube yisikhumbuzo, alishise e-althare phezu kweminikelo yomlilo kaSimakade; lingumnikelo wesono.
Umphristi uyakumenzela ukubuyisana mayelana nesono sakhe asenze kunoma yiyiphi kulezo zinto, athethelelwe; okuseleyo kube ngokomphristi, kungumnikelo wokusanhlamvu.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose wathi:

“Uma omunye wenu enza isiphambeko, ona engahlosile ezintweni ezingcwele zikaSimakade, uyoletha kuSimakade umnikelo wecala, inqama enganasici ezimvini zakhe, noma kube yizinhlamvu zesiliva ngokweshekeli lendlu engcwele; lokho kungumnikelo wecala.
Uyakukhokhela lokho akonile ezintweni ezingcwele, athasisele okwesihlanu kukho, bese ekunika umphristi, umphristi uyomenzela ukubuyisana ngenqama yomnikelo wecala, athethelelwe.
“Uma umuntu ona, enza noma yini ephambene nemiyalo uSimakade aniyale ngayo ukuthi mayingenziwa, noma ebengazi, uyoba necala, futhi alithwale icala lakhe.

Uyoletha kumphristi iwundlu elingenasici alithathe emhlanjini wakhe noma okulingana nalo, kube ngumnikelo wecala; umphristi uyomenzela ukubuyisana mayelana nesiphosiso aphosise ngaso engazi, bese ethethelelwa.
Kungumnikelo wecala; nempela unecala phambi kukaSimakade.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Uma umuntu ona, enza isiphambeko kuSimakade ngokukhohlisa umakhelwane wakhe ngento ebekiweyo, noma eyisibambiso, noma amqole, noma ecindezela umakhelwane wakhe,
noma ethola into ebilahlekile bese eyiphika, noma afunge ngenkohliso mayelana nanoma yikuphi kwalokho akwenzileyo, uyona.
Kuyothi uma onile, wabona ukuthi unecala, akubuyisele lokho abekwebile, nakudlileyo, noma obekubekwe kuye, noma lokho okwakulahlekile, wakuthola;
nayikuphi afunge ngamanga ngakho, uyokubuyisela, aze athasisele okwesihlanu kukho, uyokunika lowo obelahlekelwe ngosuku lomnikelo wakhe wecala.
Uyoletha kuSimakade umnikelo wakhe wecala, ube yinqama engenasici ayithathe emhlanjini noma olingana nayo ngokulinganisa kwakho, ibe ngumnikelo wecala, iyiswe kumphristi,
umphristi uyomenzela ukubuyisana phambi kukaSimakade, athethelelwe konke akwenzile waba necala ngakho.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:

“Yala u-Aroni namadodana akhe, uthi: ‘Nansi indlela engumthetho wokwenza umnikelo wokushiswa: umnikelo wokushiswa uyakuhlala e-althare ubusuku bonke kuze kube ngakusasa, umlilo ose-althare uhlale njalo uvutha.
Umphristi uyokwembatha isembatho sakhe selineni elimhlophe, agqoke ngaphansi ibhulukwe lakhe lelineni, bese esusa umlotha womlilo oshise umnikelo wokushiswa e-althare, awuthele eceleni kwalo.
Uyokhumula izembatho zakhe, agqoke ezinye bese ekhiphela umlotha ngaphandle kwenkambu, endaweni ehlambulukileyo.
Umlilo ose-althare kufanele uhlale uvutha, ungacinywa, umphristi uyokokhela izinkuni kuwo njalo ekuseni, ahlele umnikelo wokushiswa, ashise kulo amanoni eminikelo yokuthula.
Umlilo uyohlala uvutha njalo e-althare, ungacinywa.
“ ‘Lena yindlela yomthetho yomnikelo wokusanhlamvu eyolandelwa: amadodana ka-Aroni ayowunikela phambi kukaSimakade ngaphambi kwe-althare.

Ayocaphuna kuwo kugcwale isandla, impuphu ecolisekileyo namafutha omnikelo wokusanhlamvu, nayo yonke inhlaka ephezu komnikelo wokusanhlamvu, akushise e-althare kube yisikhumbuzo sephunga elimnandi kuSimakade.
U-Aroni namadodana akhe bayodla okusele kuwo, bakudle kungenamvubelo endaweni engcwele, egcekeni lethende lokuhlangana.
Akuyukubhakwa ngemvubelo. Ngikumisile kube yisabelo sabo eminikelweni yami yomlilo; kungcwelengcwele njengomnikelo wesono nomnikelo wecala.

Bonke abesilisa phakathi kwezizukulwane zika-Aroni bayokudla lokho, kumisiwe kwaba yisabelo saphakade ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane zabo, emnikelweni yomlilo kaSimakade; noma yini ewuthintayo iyakuba ngcwele.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:

“Lona ngumnikelo u-Aroni namadodana akhe abayakuwunikela kuSimakade mhla begcotshwa: okweshumi kwe-efa lempuphu ecolisekileyo kube ngumnikelo ojwayelekile; ingxenye yawo ekuseni nengxenye yawo kusihlwa.
Uyokwenziwa ngamafutha emqengeleni, uyowungenisa usuxutshwe kahle waba yizingcezu, uyowunikela uyizingcezu; ube yiphunga elimnandi kuSimakade.
Umphristi ogcotshiweyo esikhundleni sakhe phakathi kwamadodana akhe, uyowunikela uyisabelo esimisiwe esiphakade sikaSimakade; uyoshiswa wonke.
Yonke iminikelo yokusanhlamvu yomphristi iyoshiswa yonke; ingadliwa.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:

“Yisho ku-Aroni namadodana akhe, uthi: ‘Lena yindlela yomthetho eyolandelwa ngeminikelo yesono: umnikelo wesono kufanele uhlatshelwe endaweni lapho kuhlatshelwa khona umnikelo wokushiswa phambi kukaSimakade; ungcwelengcwele.
Umphristi onikela umnikelo wesono, uyowudla endaweni engcwele, egcekeni lethende lokuhlangana.
Noma yini eyothinta inyama yawo iyoba ngcwele; lapho igazi lawo lichaphazeleke engutsheni, uyoyigeza endaweni engcwele ingxenye yengubo echaphazelekile.
Kodwa isitsha sebumba obekuphekelwe kuso siyophihlizwa, kodwa uma bekuphekelwe kwesethusi kumele siphalwe bese sigezwa ngamanzi.
Uyakudliwa yibo bonke abesilisa phakathi kwabaphristi; ungcwelengcwele.
Kepha yonke iminikelo yesono okungeniswe igazi layo ethendeni lokuhlangana ukwenza ukubuyisana endaweni engcwele, ayinakudliwa; iyoshiswa ngomlilo.’ ”
“ ‘Lena yindlela yomthetho eyolandelwa ngeminikelo yecala. Ingcwelengcwele.
Umnikelo wecala uyakuhlatshelwa lapho kuhlatshelwa khona umnikelo wokushiswa, igazi lawo lifafazwe nxazonke ze-althare.
Uyakunikela ngawo wonke amanoni awo; umsila ononileyo, nomhlwehlwe,
izinso zombili ezisokhalo namanoni akuzo, nengxenye yesibindi enonile iyosuswa nezinso.
Umphristi uyakukushisa kube nentuthu e-althare, kube ngumnikelo womlilo kuSimakade; kungumnikelo wecala.
Bonke abesilisa abangabaphristi bayowudlela endaweni engcwele. Ungcwelengcwele.
“ ‘Uma kwenziwa umnikelo wesono njengomnikelo wecala kuyolandelwa indlela yomthetho efanayo; umphristi owenza ukubuyisana ngawo kuyoba ngowakhe.
Umphristi onikela ngomnikelo wokushiswa olethwe wumuntu, isikhumba somnikelo wokushiswa awunikele kuyoba ngesakhe.
Yonke iminikelo yokusanhlamvu ebhakwe kuhhavini, naleyo elungiselwe okhambeni nasemqengeleni ombozwayo iyakuba ngeyomphristi onikele ngayo.
Yonke iminikelo yokusanhlamvu exutshwe namafutha neyomileyo iyoba ngeyawo wonke amadodana ka-Aroni, anikwe ngokulinganayo.’ ”
“ ‘Lena yindlela yomthetho eyolandelwa lapho kwenziwa imihlatshelo yeminikelo yokuthula eyonikelwa kuSimakade.

“ ‘Uma enikela ngawo ube ngumnikelo wokubonga, uyakuwunikela uhambisana nomnikelo wokubonga wamaqebelengwane angenamvubelo axutshwe namafutha, namakhekheba angenamvubelo agcotshwe ngamafutha, namaqebelengwane empuphu ecolisekileyo exutshwe namafutha.
Uyakuletha nomnikelo wokubonga umhlatshelo wakhe wokuthula namaqebelengwane esinkwa esinemvubelo.
Uyothatha libe linye iqebelengwane emnikelweni wakhe, libe ngumnikelo kuSimakade, liyoba ngelomphristi oyofafaza igazi leminikelo yokuthula.
Inyama yomnikelo wakhe wokubonga ukuthula iyodliwa ngosuku anikele ngalo; akuyukushiywa lutho lwayo kuze kube sekuseni.
“ ‘Kepha uma umhlatshelo owunikelayo ungowesifungo noma ungowesihle, uyodliwa ngosuku onikelwe ngalo; okuseleyo kuwo kuyodliwa ngakusasa,
kodwa inyama eyosala kuze kube lusuku lwesithathu, iyoshiswa ngomlilo.

Uma nje inyama yomnikelo wakhe wokuthula idliwe ngosuku lwesithathu, umnikelo wakhe awuyukwamukeleka, futhi awuyukubalelwa kulowo owunikeleyo; uyakuba yisinengiso, kanjalo nomuntu oyidlayo uyothwala icala.
“ ‘Inyama eyothintana nokungcolileyo ayiyukudliwa; iyakushiswa emlilweni, nokho enye inyama bangayidla bonke abahlambulukileyo.
Kepha oyokudla inyama yomhlatshelo wokuthula kaSimakade esangcolile uyonqunywa.

Uma umuntu ethinta into engcolileyo, ukungcola komuntu, noma isilwane esingcolileyo, noma into engcolileyo, enengekayo, bese edla inyama yomhlatshelo weminikelo yokuthula kaSimakade, lowo muntu uyakunqunywa kwabakubo.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Aniyukuwadla amanoni enkomo, awenqama, nawembuzi.
Amanoni engcuba nawokudweshulwe yisilwane sasendle angasetshenziselwa yonke eminye imisebenzi, kodwa aniyukuwadla nhlobo.
Ngokuba oyokudla amanoni enkomo enikelwa kuSimakade ibe ngumnikelo womlilo, lowo owudlayo uyakudingiswa.
Aniyukulidla igazi, noma ngelenyoni noma ngelenkomo kunoma yiyiphi yezindlu zenu.
Oyodla igazi uyakunqunywa kubantu bakubo.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli uthi: ‘Onikela ngomhlatshelo wokuthula kuSimakade, uyakuletha umnikelo wakhe kuSimakade emnikelweni wakhe wokuthula.
Uyakuwuletha ngezandla zakhe umnikelo wokushiswa kaSimakade. Uyoletha amanoni nesifuba ukuze isifuba sizungeziswe, sibe ngumnikelo wokuzungeziswa phambi kukaSimakade.
Umphristi uyoshisa amanoni e-althare, kodwa isifuba kuyoba ngesika-Aroni namadodana akhe.
Umlenze wesokunene emhlatshelweni wokuthula, niyowunika umphristi; ube umnikelo.
Emadodaneni ka-Aroni, leyo eyonikela ngegazi leminikelo yokuthula nangamanoni, iyonikezwa umlenze wesokunene.

Isifuba sokuzungeziswa nomlenze ongumnikelo engikuthathe emihlatshelweni yeminikelo yokuthula yabakwa-Israyeli, ngikunike u-Aroni umphristi namadodana akhe kube yisabelo sabo esimisiweyo esiphakade esivela kubantu bakwa-Israyeli.’ ”
Lesi yisabelo esabelwa u-Aroni namadodana akhe eminikelweni yokushiswa kaSimakade, mhla belethwa ukuba bakhonze uSimakade bengabaphristi,
uSimakade ayala ngakho ukuba bakunikwe ngabantu bakwa-Israyeli mhla ebagcoba; kube yisabelo esimisiwe esiphakade ezizukulwaneni zabo.
Lena yindlela yomthetho eyolandelwa yeminikelo yokushiswa neminikelo yokusanhlamvu, neminikelo yesono, neminikelo yecala, nowokwehlukaniselwa, nowomhlatshelo weminikelo yokuthula,
uSimakade amyala ngawo uMose entabeni iSinayi, ngosuku ayala ngalo abakwa-Israyeli ukuba banikele ngeminikelo yabo kuSimakade ehlane iSinayi.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Thatha u-Aroni namadodana akhe, izembatho, amafutha okugcoba, inkunzi yomnikelo wesono, izinqama ezimbili, neqoma lezinkwa ezingenamvubelo,
uqoqele yonke inhlangano emnyango wethende lokuhlangana.”
UMose wenza njengalokhu uSimakade emyalile; waqoqela inhlangano ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana.
UMose wathi enhlanganweni: “Nakhu uSimakade ayale ukuba kwenziwe.”
UMose waletha u-Aroni namadodana akhe, wabageza ngamanzi.
Wamgqokisa ibhantshi, wambopha ngebhande okhalo, wamembathisa ijazi, wamfaka ingubo yamahlombe, wambhincisa ibhande lengubo yamahlombe elihlotshisiweyo, wayibopha ngalo.
Wamfaka isivikelo sesifuba, wafaka kuso i-Urimi neThumimi.
Wamethwesa iqhiya ekhanda, ngaphambili ebunzini wamfaka ucwecwe lwegolide, umqhele wobungcwele, njengalokho uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
UMose wathatha amafutha okugcoba, wagcoba ithabanakeli nakho konke okwakuphakathi kulo, wakungcwelisa.
Wafafaza ngamanye i-althare kasikhombisa, waligcoba i-althare nazo zonke izitsha zalo, nomcengezi nesinqe sawo, ukuba kungcweliswe.
Wathela amanye amafutha okugcoba ekhanda lika-Aroni, wamgcoba, wamhlukanisela umsebenzi.
UMose waletha namadodana ka-Aroni, wawagqokisa amabhantshi, wawabopha ngamabhande, wawafaka izigqoko njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile.
UMose wenza ukuba kusondezwe inkunzi yomnikelo wesono; u-Aroni namadodana akhe babeka izandla zabo enhloko yenkunzi yomnikelo wesono.

UMose wayihlaba, wathatha igazi walibheca ngomunwe wakhe ezimpondweni ze-althare nxazonke, walihlambulula i-althare, igazi eliseleyo walithululela esinqeni se-althare, walingcwelisa kanjalo ukuba alenzele ukubuyisana.
UMose wathatha wonke umhlwehlwe, namanoni aphezu kwesibindi, nezinso zombili amanoni azembozile, wakushisa e-althare.
Kepha inkunzi nesikhumba sayo, inyama yayo, nomswani wayo, wakushisa ngomlilo ngaphandle kwekamu, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Wayeseletha inqama yomnikelo wokushiswa; u-Aroni namadodana akhe babeka izandla zabo enhloko yayo.
UMose wayihlaba, wayesefafaza igazi nxazonke ze-althare.
Wayihlahlela inqama; inhloko yayo, izitho zayo, namanoni wakushisa.

UMose wageza ngamanzi ezangaphakathi namanqina, yonke inyama yenqama wayishisa e-althare; yaba ngumnikelo wokushiswa, oyiphunga elimnandi, ingumnikelo womlilo kuSimakade njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Waletha nenqama yesibili, inqama yokubabeka; u-Aroni namadodana akhe babeka izandla zabo enhloko yayo.
UMose wayihlaba, wathatha ingxenye yegazi layo walibheca endlebeni ka-Aroni yesokunene, nasesithupheni sesandla sokunene, nakuqukula wonyawo lwakhe lwesokunene.

UMose wayeseletha amadodana ka-Aroni, nawo wawabheca ngegazi ezindlebeni zawo zesokunene, nasezithupheni zezandla zawo zesokunene, nakoqukula bezinyawo zawo zesokunene, wayesefafaza igazi nxazonke ze-althare.
Wathatha amanoni, umsila ononile, umhlwehlwe, amanoni aphezu kwesibindi, nezinso zombili namanoni azembozile, nomlenze wesokunene,

wathatha iqebelengwane laba linye eqomeni lezinkwa ezingenamvubelo elaliphambi kukaSimakade, neqebelengwane lesinkwa samafutha laba linye, nekhekheba lalinye, wakubeka phezu kwamanoni, naphezu komlenze wesokunene,
konke lokhu wakunika u-Aroni namadodana akhe ezandleni, wakuzulazulisa kwaba ngumnikelo wokuzulazuliswa phambi kukaSimakade.
UMose wakuthatha ezandleni zabo wakushisa e-althare emnikelweni wokushiswa; kwaba ngumnikelo wokubabeka, kwaba yiphunga elimnandi; umnikelo womlilo kuSimakade.
UMose wathatha isifuba, wasizulisa saba ngumnikelo wokuzulazuliswa phambi kukaSimakade; saba yisabelo sikaMose enqameni yokubabeka njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.

UMose wathatha amafutha okugcoba, negazi elalise-althare, wafafaza ngalo u-Aroni nezembatho zakhe, namadodana akhe ayenawo lapho nezembatho zawo, wamngcwelisa u-Aroni nezembatho zakhe, namadodana akhe nezembatho zawo.

UMose wathi ku-Aroni namadodana akhe: “Phekani inyama ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana, niyidle lapho nesinkwa esiseqomeni lokwahlukaniselwa, njengalokhu ngayala ngathi: ‘U-Aroni namadodana akhe bayokukudla.’
Okuyosala enyameni nasesinkweni niyokushisa ngomlilo.
Aniyukuphuma emnyango wethende lokuhlangana kuze kuphele izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, ngokuba ukubekwa kuyizinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
USimakade uyalile ukuba kwenziwe njengalokhu kwenziwe namuhla, ukuze nenzelwe ukubuyisana.
Niyohlala ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana imini nobusuku, izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, nigcine umyalo kaSimakade ukuze ningafi, ngokuba ngiyaliwe kanjalo.”
U-Aroni namadodana akhe benza konke uSimakade ayeyale ngakho ngesandla sikaMose.
Kwathi ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili, uMose wabiza u-Aroni namadodana akhe namalunga akwa-Israyeli.
Wathi ku-Aroni: “Zithathele ithole leduna libe ngumnikelo wesono, nenqama ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa okungenasici, unikele ngakho phambi kukaSimakade.
Khuluma kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Thathani impongo nenze ngayo umnikelo wesono, nethole, newundlu okunonyaka, okungenasici, kube ngumnikelo wokushiswa,
nenkunzi nenqama kube yiminikelo yokuthula, nikuhlabe phambi kukaSimakade, nomnikelo wokusanhlamvu okuxovwe namafutha, ngokuba namuhla uSimakade uzozibonakalisa kini.’ ”
Baletha phambi kwethende lokuhlangana lokho uMose ayeyale ngakho, kwase kusondela yonke inhlangano yema phambi kukaSimakade.
UMose wayesethi: “Nakhu uSimakade aniyala ngakho ukuba nikwenze, ukuze ibonakale kini inkazimulo yakhe.”

UMose wathi ku-Aroni: “Sondela e-althare, unikele ngomnikelo wakho wesono, nangomnikelo wakho wokushiswa, uzenzele wena nabantu ukubuyisana andukuba unikele ngomnikelo wabantu ubenzele ukubuyisana, njengalokhu uSimakade eyalile.”
U-Aroni wasondela e-althare, wahlaba ithole lomnikelo wakhe wesono.
Amadodana akhe aletha igazi kuye, wagcobhoza ngomunwe kulo, walibheca ezimpondweni ze-althare, elinye igazi walithululela esinqeni se-althare,
kodwa amanoni nezinso nalawo asesibindini emnikelweni wesono wakushisa e-althare, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Inyama nesikhumba wakushisa ngomlilo ngaphandle kwenkambu.
Wahlaba nomnikelo wokushiswa; amadodana akhe aletha igazi kuye, wafafaza ngalo macala wonke e-althare.
Amnika izitho ngezitho zomnikelo wokushiswa, nenhloko, wakushisa e-althare.
Wageza ezangaphakathi namanqina, wakushisa phezu komnikelo wokushiswa e-althare.
Wayeseletha umnikelo wabantu, wathatha impongo yomnikelo wesono ongowabantu, wayihlaba, wabahlanza ngayo, njengaphambilini.
Waletha umnikelo wokushiswa, wawunikela njengalokhu kumisiwe.
Waletha nomnikelo wokusanhlamvu, wagcwalisa isandla sakhe ngawo, wawushisa e-althare ngaphandle komnikelo wokushiswa wasekuseni.
Wahlaba inkunzi nenqama kwaba yimihlatshelo yokuthula ongowabantu; amadodana akhe aletha igazi, walifafaza nxazonke e-althare,
amanoni enkunzi, awenqama, awomsila ononileyo, umhlwehlwe, namanoni ezinso nawesibindi,
awabeka phezu kwesifuba; wawashisa kwaba nentuthu e-althare;
izifuba, nomlenze wangakwesokunene u-Aroni wakuzungezisa, kwaba ngumnikelo wokuzungeziswa phambi kukaSimakade njengalokhu ayeyalile uMose.
U-Aroni waphakamisela izandla zakhe phezu kwabantu, wababusisa; wayesehla lapho ayekade enikela khona ngomnikelo wesono, nangomnikelo wokushiswa, nangeminikelo yokuthula.
UMose no-Aroni bangena ethendeni lokuhlangana, babuye baphuma, babusisa abantu. Inkazimulo kaSimakade bayibona bonke abantu.
Kwaphuma umlilo phambi kukaSimakade, waqothula umnikelo wokushiswa, namanoni okwakuse-althare; abantu bonke bekubona lokho, bakhamuluka, bakhothama phansi ngobuso.
ONadabi no-Abhihu, amadodana ka-Aroni, bathatha izitsha zabo zempepho ngamunye, bafaka kuzo umlilo, babeka impepho phezu kwazo, banikela phambi kukaSimakade ngomlilo ongafanele, angabayalanga ngawo.
Kwaphuma umlilo phambi kukaSimakade, wabashisa, bafa phambi kukaSimakade.
UMose wayesethi ku-Aroni: “Yikho lokhu uSimakade akukhuluma, wathi: “ ‘Ngalabo abaseduze nami ngiyakuzibonakalisa ngingcwele, phambi kwabantu bonke ngiyakukhazimuliswa.’ ” U-Aroni wathula.
UMose wabiza uMishayeli no-Elizafani, amadodana ka-Uziyeli, umfowabo ka-Aroni, wathi kubo: “Sondelani, nibasuse abafowenu phambi kwendawo engcwele, nibakhiphele ngaphandle kwenkambu.”
Base besondela, babasusa bembethe amabhantshi abo, babakhiphela ngaphandle kwenkambu, njengalokhu eshilo uMose.

UMose wayesethi ku-Aroni naku-Eleyazare naku-Ithamari, amadodana akhe: “Ningaziqaqi izinwele emakhanda enu, ningaziklebhuli izembatho zenu ukuze ningafi, bese intukuthelo yehlela yonke inhlangano, kepha abafowenu, indlu yonke yakwa-Israyeli, ingalila ngenxa yokusha akulethileyo uSimakade.
Ningaphumi emnyango wethende lokuhlangana, funa nife, ngokuba amafutha okugcoba kaSimakade aphezu kwenu.” Benza-ke njengezwi likaMose.
USimakade wakhuluma ku-Aroni, wathi:
“Ungaphuzi wayini naluphuzo olunamandla, wena namadodana akho, nxa ningena ethendeni lokuhlangana, ukuze ningafi; kuyakuba yisimiso esiphakade ezizukulwaneni zenu.
Niyakwehlukanisa phakathi kokungcwele nokungengcwele, okungcolileyo nokuhlanzekileyo,
nize nifundise abantu bakwa-Israyeli zonke izimiso uSimakade azikhulume kubo ngesandla sikaMose.”

UMose wakhuluma no-Aroni no-Eleyazare no-Ithamari, amadodana akhe ayesesele, wathi: “Thathani umnikelo wokusanhlamvu osale eminikelweni yomlilo kaSimakade, niwudle ungenamvubelo, eceleni kwe-althare, ngokuba ungcwelengcwele,
niyakuwudla endaweni engcwele, ngokuba uyisabelo sakho nesabelo samadodana akho eminikelweni yokushiswa kaSimakade, ngokuba ngiyalwe kanjalo.

Isifuba sokuzungeziswa nomlenze niyakuwudla endaweni ehlambulukileyo, wena namadodana akho namadodakazi akho, ngokuba kuyisabelo sakho nesabantwana bakho enisinikwa emihlatshelweni yeminikelo yokuthula yabantu bakwa-Israyeli.

Mabalethe umlenze wokuzungeziswa, nesifuba sokuzungeziswa, neminikelo yomlilo yamanoni ukuba bakuzungezise, kube ngumnikelo wokuzungeziswa phambi kukaSimakade. Kuyoba ngokwakho nokwamadodana akho, kuyisabelo senu saphakade, njengalokhu uSimakade eyalile.”
UMose wafunisisa impongo yomnikelo wesono; bheka, yayishisiwe. Wabathukuthelela o-Eleyazare no-Ithamari, amadodana ka-Aroni ayesele, wathi kuwo:
“Aniwudlelanga ngani umnikelo wesono endaweni engcwele na? Ungcwelengcwele, futhi uSimakade uwunike nina ukuze nisuse ububi benhlangano, niyenzele ukubuyisana phambi kukaSimakade.
Igazi lawo alingeniswanga endaweni engcwele; benifanele impela ukuba niwudlele endaweni engcwele, njengalokhu ngayala.”

U-Aroni wathi kuMose: “Uyabona, namuhla banikele ngomnikelo wabo wesono nangowokushiswa phambi kukaSimakade, nokho mina ngehlelwe yilokhu. Uma bengiwudlile umnikelo wesono namuhla, bekuzakwamukeleka yini emehlweni kaSimakade na?”
Esekuzwile lokho uMose, kwaba kuhle emehlweni akhe.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose no-Aroni, wathi kubo:
“Khulumani kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, nithi: ‘Phakathi kwazo zonke izilwane eziphilayo emhlabeni, nazi eningazidla:
zonke ezinezinselo ezehlukene, izinselo ezehlukene kabili, nezetshisayo emfuyweni, niyakuzidla.
“ ‘Kepha phakathi kwalezo ezetshisayo noma ezinselo zehlukene, aniyukuzidla lezi ezilandelayo: ikameli noma nje nalo letshisa, kodwa alinazo izinselo ezehlukene; lingcolile kini;
imbila, nakuba nayo yetshisa, kodwa ayinazo izinselo ezehlukene; ingcolile kini;
unogwaja uyetshisa, kodwa awunazo izinselo ezehlukene; ungcolile kini;
nengulube nakuba inselo yayo yehlukene, inselo ihlukene kabili, kodwa ayetshisi; ingcolile kini.
Aniyukuyidla inyama yazo, futhi aniyukuzithinta izidumbu zazo; zingcolile kini.
“ ‘Lezi niyakuzidla kuzo zonke ezisemanzini: zonke ezinezigwedlo namazenga ezisemanzini, nezisolwandle nasemifuleni, niyakuzidla.
Kepha zonke ezingenazigwedlo namazenga ezisolwandle nasemifuleni, nazo zonke ezitshuza emanzini, nakho konke okuphila emanzini kungamanyala kini.
Ziyoba yisinengiso kini; aniyukuyidla inyama yazo; nezilwane ezifile niyozithatha njengezinengekayo kini.
Zonke ezisemanzini ezingenazigwedlo namazenga ziyinto enengekayo kini.
“ ‘Nazi eziyakuba yisinengiso kini ezinyonini; aziyukudliwa, ziyisinengiso: ukhozi, inqe, ingqungqulu,
unhloyile, uheshe ngezinhlobo zakhe,
nawo wonke amagwababa ngezinhlobo zawo,
intshe, inkovana, inkanu, uklebe ngezinhlobo zakhe,
isikhova, umphishamanzi, umxwagele,
ifukezi, ivuba, iphalane,
unogolantethe, unozalizingwenya ngezinhlobo zakhe, uziningweni, nelulwane.
“ ‘Zonke izinambuzane ezinamaphiko, ezihamba ngezinyawo zozine, ziyisinengiso kini.
Kepha lezi kuzo zonke izinambuzane ezinamaphiko, ezihamba ngezinyawo zozine, niyakuzidla, ezinamanqina ngaphezu kwezinyawo ezigxuma ngazo emhlabeni;
kuzo niyodla lezi: isikhonyane ngezinhlobo zaso, amaboni ngezinhlobo zawo, amadiye ngezinhlobo zawo, nezintethe ngezinhlobo zazo.
Kodwa zonke ezinye izinambuzane ezinamaphiko nezinyawo ezine ziyisinengiso kini.
“ ‘Niyakungcoliswa yizo, kuthi bonke abathinta izidumbu zazo babe ngabangcolile kuze kuhlwe.
Bonke abathwala izilwane ezifile bayakuhlanza izingubo zabo, futhi babe ngabangcolile kuze kuhlwe.
“ ‘Zonke izilwane ezinezinselo ezehlukene inselo, zingehlukene kabili, futhi zingetshisi, zingcolile kini; bonke abazithintayo bayakuba ngabangcolile.
Zonke ezihamba ngezidladla kuzo zonke izilwane ezihamba ngezinyawo ezine zingcolile kini; bonke abathinta izidumbu zazo bayakuba ngabangcolile kuze kuhlwe.
Othwala isidumbu saso uyohlanza izingubo zakhe, abe ngongcolile kuze kuhlwe; zingcolile kini.
“ ‘Lezi zingcolile kini kuzo izilwane ezihuquzelayo emhlabeni: uchakide, impuku, uxamu ngezinhlobo zakhe,
isigcilikisha, isiquzi, intulo, isibankwa, nonwabu.
Zonke lezi zilwane zingcolile kini phakathi kwezilwane ezihuquzelayo; oyothinta isidumbu saso uyakuba ngongcolile kuze kube kusihlwa.

Konke esiyowela phezu kwakho sesifile kuyakuba ngokungcolileyo, noma ngumuthi, noma yingubo, noma yisikhumba, noma yisaka, noma ngabe yini nje okusetshenzwa ngayo; kuyakufakwa emanzini, kube ngokungcolile kuze kuhlwe; khona kuyakuhlanzeka.
Uma esinye sazo siwela ezitsheni, konke okukuzo kuyoba ngokungcolileyo, niyakusiphahlaza isitsha.
Konke ukudla okuzodliwa okukuzo kuyakuba ngokungcolileyo uma kuthintwe ngamanzi avela esitsheni esinjalo, nanoma yimaphi amanzi anokuphuzwa ayoba ngangcolileyo, uma evela esitsheni esinjalo.
Konke okuwele kukho okwesidumbu saso kuyakuba ngokungcolile, noma iziko noma ikhanzi; kuyophohlozwa; kungcolile futhi kuyohlala kungcolile kini.
Umthombo, umthombokwakhiwa, nepitsi kuyakuba ngokuhlambulukile, nokho okutholakala kunezilwane ezifile kukho kuyakuba ngokungcolile.
Uma ingxenye yesidumbu saso iwela phezu kwembewu ebekelwe ukuyohlwanyelwa, iyakuba ngehlambulukile.
Uma amanzi ethelwa embewini, bese ingxenye yesidumbu saso iwela phezu kwayo, ingcolile kini.
“ ‘Uma kufa isilwane esidliwayo, othinta leyo ngcuba uyakuba ngongcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.
Odla ingcuba makahlambulule izingubo zakhe, uyoba ngongcolile kuze kuhlwe. Othwala isidumbu saso makahlanze izingubo zakhe, abe ngongcolile kuze kuhlwe.
“ ‘Zonke izilwane ezinwabuzelayo emhlabeni ziyisinengiso; azinakudliwa.
Zonke ezihuquzela ngesisu, nazo zonke ezihamba ngezinyawo ezine noma ngezinyawo eziningi, nazo zonke ezinwabuzelayo emhlabeni, aniyukuzidla, ngokuba ziyisinengiso.
Ningazenzi isinengiso ngenxa yezilwane ezinwabuzelayo. Ningazingcolisi ngazo, bese niba ngabangcolile.
NginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu; ngakho-ke zingcweliseni, nibe ngcwele, ngokuba Mina ngingcwele; ningazingcolisi ngezilwane ezinwabuzelayo emhlabeni.
NginguSimakade owakukhuphula eGibhithe, ukuze ngibe nguNkulunkulu wenu; ngalokho yibani ngcwele, ngokuba Mina ngingcwele.
“ ‘Lena yindlela yomthetho elandelwayo ngezilwane nezinyoni nezilwane zonke ezitshuza emanzini, nezilwane zonke ezinwabuzelayo emhlabeni,
ukuba kwehlukaniswe phakathi kokungcolileyo nokuhlanzekileyo, naphakathi kokuphilayo okungadliwa nalokho okungedliwe.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Khuluma kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Uma owesifazane ekhulelwe azale umntwana womfana uyakuba ngongcolile izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, njengalokhu kwenzeka lapho esesikhathini, uyoba ngongcolile.
Ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili umfana uyosokwa ijwabu.
Unina uyohlala izinsuku ezingama-33 ukuze ahlanjululwe ekopheni kwakhe. Akayukuthinta lutho olungcwele, noma angene endlini engcwele, zize ziphelele izinsuku zokuhlambuluka kwakhe.
Kodwa uma ezale intombazane, uyobe engcolile amasonto amabili njengalokhu kwenzeka lapho esesikhathini. Isikhathi sokuhlambuluka kwakhe egazini siyoba yizinsuku ezingama-66.

“ ‘Lapho seziphelile izinsuku zokuhlanjululwa kwakhe emveni kokubeletha umfana noma intombazane, uyoletha iwundlu leduna elinonyaka, libe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, nephuphu lejuba noma ihobhe, libe ngumnikelo wesono. Lokhu uyokuletha kumphristi ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana.
Umphristi uyokunikela phambi kukaSimakade, amenzele ukubuyisana, ukuze ahlambuluke ekopheni kwakhe. Yilowo umthetho wozele umfana noma intombazane.

“ ‘Uma engenamandla okuthola imvu, uyothatha amahobhe amabili noma amaphuphu amabili amajuba, elinye liyoba ngumnikelo wokushiswa, elinye libe ngumnikelo wesono, umphristi uyomenzela ukubuyisana; ahlambuluke.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose no-Aroni, wathi:

“Uma umuntu emilwa iguludla esikhumbeni noma siba notwayi, noma yibala elikhanyayo bese liphenduka libe wuchoko, lowo muntu uyakulethwa ku-Aroni, umphristi, noma kwenye yamadodana akhe, angabaphristi.

Umphristi uyosihlola isifo esisesikhumbeni sakhe; uma uboya obusebaleni sebuphenduke baba mhlophe, nesifo sibonakala ukuthi sijulile esikhumbeni sakhe, kuyisifo esinzima, umphristi uyakukubona lokho bese ememezela ukuthi ungcolile.
Uma ibala elikhanyayo limhlophe esikhumbeni senyama yakhe, futhi libonakala lijulile esikhumbeni, noboya obukulo sebuphenduke baba mhlophe, umphristi uyakumvalela onesifo izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Umphristi uyakumhlola ngosuku lwesikhombisa, uma ebona ukuthi isifo simile asiqhubeki, umphristi uyakumvalela okwesibili ezinye izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Ngosuku lwesikhombisa uyakumhlola okwesibili, uma ibala lifiphele, nesifo singaqhubekanga, uyakumemezela ukuthi uhlambulukile, bekulutwayi, ageze izingubo zakhe, abe ngohlambulukile.
Kepha uma utwayi luqhubekile lwanda esikhumbeni emveni kokuba esezibonakalisile kumphristi ukuze kuqiniswe ukuthi usehlambulukile, uyophinde azibonakalise kumphristi okwesibili.
Umphristi uyakumbheka; uma ebona ukuthi utwayi lwandile esikhumbeni, uyakumemezela ukuthi ungcolile; kusho ukuthi unesifo sesikhumba esithathelanwayo.
“Uma umuntu etheleleke ngesifo sochoko, uyakuyiswa kumphristi,
umphristi uyakumbheka, uma ebona ukuthi lapho isikhumba sivuvukele khona sekumhlophe, noboya sebuphenduke baba mhlophe nokuthi kukhona inyama ebomvu ekuvuvukeni;
kusho ukuthi unesifo esinzima esithathelanwayo esisekhumbeni sakhe. Umphristi uyakumemezela ukuthi ungcolile, akayukumvalela, ngoba ungcolile.
“Uma uchoko lubhebhetheka lusibekele sonke isikhumba sakhe, kusukela ekhanda kuze kufike ezinyaweni njengokubona komphristi,
umphristi uyakumhlola, kuthi uma isifo sesiwemboze wonke umzimba, uyakusho athi onesifo uhlambulukile; konke kuphendukile kwaba mhlophe: uhlambulukile.
Kepha njalo uma kuphinda kuvela kuye inyama ebomvu, uyakuba ngongcolile.
Umphristi uyakuyihlola inyama ebomvu, bese ememezela ukuthi ungcolile; inyama ebomvu ingcolile ngokuba inochoko.
Uma-ke inyama ebomvu ibuye yaphenduka yaba mhlophe uyakuya kumphristi,
umphristi uyakumhlola, uma ibala seliphenduke laba mhlophe, umphristi uyakumemezela ukuthi uhlambulukile; obenesifo uhlambulukile.
“Uma bekunethumba esikhumbeni sayo eselipholile,
kuthi lapho bekunethumba khona kuvele iguludla elimhlophe, noma ibala elikhanyayo okubomvana kube mhlophe, liyakukhonjiswa umphristi,
umphristi uyakulihlola, uma libonakala lishonile kunesikhumba, futhi noboya sebuphenduke baba mhlophe, umphristi uyakumemezela ukuthi ungcolile: yisifo esithathelanwayo, sivele ethumbeni.
Uma umphristi elihlola kodwa bungekho uboya obumhlophe kulo, futhi lingashonile kunesikhumba, kepha selifiphele, umphristi uyakumvalela izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Uma libhebhetheka esikhumbeni, umphristi uyakumemezela ukuthi ungcolile; yisifo.
Kodwa uma ibala elikhanyayo limi endaweni eyodwa lingaqhubeki, sekuyisibazi sethumba; umphristi uyakumemezela ukuthi uhlambulukile.
“Uma umzimba unesibazi sokusha, inyama lapho kushe khona ibe yibala elibomvu ngokumhlophe noma elimhlophe,

umphristi uyakulihlola, uma uboya obusebaleni elikhanyayo sebuphendukile baba mhlophe, selibonakala ukuthi lishonile kunesikhumba, isifo esithathelanwayo; sivele esibazini; umphristi uyakumemezela ukuthi ungcolile; yisifo esithathelanwayo.
Kepha uma umphristi elihlola, ebona kungekho boya obumhlophe ebaleni elikhanyayo, lingashonile kunesikhumba, kodwa lifiphele, umphristi uyakumvalela izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Ngosuku lwesikhombisa uyomhlola, uma libhebhethekile esikhumbeni, umphristi uyakumemezela ukuthi ungcolile; yisifo esithathelanwayo.
Uma ibala elikhanyayo limi endaweni eyodwa, lingandanga esikhumbeni, kodwa lishabalele, kusele iguludla lesibazi; umphristi uyakusho ukuthi uhlambulukile, ngoba yisibazi sokusha.
“Uma owesilisa noma owesifazane enesifo ekhanda, noma esilevini,
umphristi uyakusihlola isifo; uma sibonakala sishonile kunesikhumba noboya bubuncane kuso, izinwele zimpofana, umphristi uyakumemezela ukuthi ungcolile: ngumuna, wuchoko lwekhanda noma lwesilevu.
Uma umphristi esihlola isifo somuna, sibonakala singashonile kunesikhumba, kungekho zinwele ezimnyama kuso, khona umphristi uyakumvalela onesifo somuna izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Ngosuku lwesikhombisa umphristi uyosihlola isifo; uma singandile futhi kungekho zinwele ezimpofu kuso, isifo sibonakala singashonile kunesikhumba,
uyakuphuca izinwele, kodwa akayukuwuphuca umuna, umphristi uyomvalela onomuna ezinye izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.

Ngosuku lwesikhombisa uyomhlola onomuna. Uma umuna ungandanga esikhumbeni, futhi ubonakala ungashonile kunesikhumba, umphristi uyakumemezela ukuthi uhlambulukile. Uyohlanza izingubo zakhe, ahlambuluke.
Kepha uma umuna wandile esikhumbeni emveni kokuba esehlambulukile,
umphristi uyobuye amhlole. Uma umuna ubhebhethekile esikhumbeni, umphristi akayukuzihlupha abheke izinwele ezimpofu; lowo ungcolile.
Kodwa uma ebona ukuthi umuna uwuhlolile, umile, awandi, sekumile nezinwele ezimnyama kuwo, usupholile, uhlambulukile; ngakho-ke umphristi uyomemezela ukuthi uhlambulukile.
“Uma owesilisa noma owesifazane eba namabala akhanyayo esikhumbeni sakhe, amabala amhlophe akhanyayo,
umphristi uyomhlola. Uma amabala akhanyayo asesikhumbeni sakhe emhloshana efiphele, yisithembuzane esimmilile, uhlambulukile.
“Uma umuntu elahlekelwa yizinwele ekhanda, eba yimpandla; uhlambulukile.
Uma elahlekelwa yizinwele zisuka ebunzini nasenhlafunweni, uyimpandla ebunzini kodwa uhlambulukile.
Kepha uma ekhanda eliyimpandla noma empandleni esesiphongweni kukhona isifo esibomvana ngokumhlophe, wuchoko lolo olumile empandleni esekhanda lakhe noma empandleni esebunzini lakhe,
umphristi uyakumhlola; uma iguludla elikhulayo limhlophe libomvana empandleni esekhanda lakhe noma empandleni esebunzini lakhe, lifana nesifo sochoko esikhumbeni sakhe,
unochoko; ungcolile; umphristi uyakumemezela ukuthi ungcolile; isifo sisekhanda lakhe.
“Umuntu onesifo sochoko ziyakuklejulwa izingubo zakhe, ikhanda lakhe linganakwa, awamboze amadevu, akhale athi: ‘Ngingcolile! Ngingcolile!’
Ungcolile ngaso sonke isikhathi. Uyohlala yedwa endlini yakhe engaphandle kwenkambu.
“Ingubo esinindeke ngesifo sochoko, noma yingubo yoboya noma yingubo yelineni,
noma ngabe sisezintanjeni eziqondileyo noma sikwezinqamulayo, ezelineni noma ezoboya bezimvu, noma sisesikhumbeni, noma sisentweni eyenziwe ngesikhumba,
uma ibala liluhlazana noma libomvana engutsheni noma esikhumbeni noma ezintanjeni eziqondileyo noma kwezinqamulayo noma entweni yesikhumba, kusho ukuthi yisifo sochoko, siyakukhonjiswa umphristi.
Umphristi uyakusihlola isifo, akuvalele konke lokho okunochoko izinsuku eziyisikhombisa,

uyobuye ayosihlola isifo ngosuku lwesikhombisa. Uma isifo sandile engutsheni noma ezintanjeni eziqondileyo noma kwezinqamulayo noma esikhumbeni, nakuba isikhumba sisetshenziswa noma kumuphi umsebenzi; isifo siluchoko olubi.
Uyoyishisa ingubo, noma izintanjana eziqondileyo noma ezinqamulayo, noma eyoboya bezimbuzi noma eyelineni, noma yini yesikhumba enesifo, ngokuba kuluchoko olubi; kuyakushiswa ngomlilo.
“Uma umphristi ehlole isifo, wathola ukuthi asandile engutsheni noma ezintanjeni eziqondileyo noma kwezinqamulayo noma entweni yesikhumba;
umphristi uyoyala ukuba kuhlanzwe lokho okunesifo, kuvalelwe ezinye izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Umphristi uyobuye akuhlole emveni kokuhlanzwa kwesifo. Uma ibala lingaguqukile embaleni walo, lingandile, ingcolile, uyoyishisa ngomlilo; kungumcothu odlayo noma ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle.
Uma umphristi eselihlolile ibala, wathola ukuthi selifiphele emveni kokuba lihlanziwe, uyakuliklebhula engutsheni noma esikhumbeni noma ezintanjeni eziqondileyo noma kwezinqamulayo.
Uma lisabonakala futhi engutsheni noma ezintanjeni eziqondileyo noma kwezinqamulayo noma entweni yesikhumba, uyokushisa ngomlilo lokho isifo esisavela kukho.
Ingubo noma izintanjana eziqondileyo noma ezinqamulayo noma yini yesikhumba uyakuyihlanza, uma ibala lisuka kuyo, kuyohlanzwa okwesibili, kuhlambuluke.”

Lena yindlela yomthetho eyakulandelwa esifeni sochoko engutsheni yoboya bezimvu noma kweyelineni noma ezintanjeni eziqondileyo noma kwezinqamulayo noma entweni yesikhumba, ukumemezela ukuthi kuhlambulukile noma kungcolile.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Lena yindlela yomthetho eyolandelwa kulowo onochoko ngosuku ahlanjululwa ngalo: uyolethwa kumphristi,
umphristi uyophumela ngaphandle kwenkambu. Bheka, uyakumhlolisisa khona ukuthi isifo sochoko sesiphelile yini.
Umphristi uyoyala ukuba ozohlanjululwa alethelwe izinyoni ezimbili ezihlambulukileyo, nomsedari, indwangu ebomvu nehisopi.
Umphristi uyakuyala ukuba ihlatshwe enye yezinyoni phezu kwamanzi esitsheni sebumba.
Uyothatha inyoni ephilayo, umsedari, indwangu ebomvu nehisopi, akucwilise nenyoni ephilayo egazini lenyoni ehlatshelwe phezu kwamanzi agelezayo.
Uyakulifafaza kasikhombisa kulowo ohlanjululwayo ochokweni, amemezele ukuthi uhlambulukile, bese eyayiyeka inyoni ephilayo, indizele endle.

“Ohlanjululwayo uyohlanza izingubo zakhe, aphuce zonke izinwele zakhe, ageze ngamanzi, ahlambuluke. Emveni kwalokho uyakungena enkanjini, kodwa uyohlala ngaphandle kwethende lakhe izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Ngosuku lwesikhombisa uyakuphuca zonke izinwele ekhanda lakhe, nasesilevini, nasemashiyeni; yebo, uyakuziphuca zonke izinwele zakhe. Uyohlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze umzimba ngamanzi, ahlambuluke.

“Ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili uyothatha izimvu ezimbili ezingenasici ezingamaduna, nemvu yensikazi engenasici enonyaka, nokuthathu eshumini kwempuphu ecolisekileyo exutshwe namafutha, nengxenye yelitha lamafutha.
Umphristi ohlambululayo uyobeka umuntu ozohlanjululwa nalezo zinto phambi kukaSimakade ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana.
Umphristi uyothatha imvu yeduna, anikele ngayo ibe ngumnikelo wecala, nengxenye yelogi lamafutha, akuzungezise kube ngumnikelo wokuzungeziswa phambi kukaSimakade.
Uyoyihlaba imvu yeduna lapho kuhlatshelwa khona umnikelo wesono nomnikelo wokushiswa, endaweni engcwele, ngokuba umnikelo wecala njengomnikelo wesono, ungowomphristi; ungcwelengcwele.
Umphristi uyothatha elinye igazi lomnikelo wecala, alibhece endlebeni yesokudla yalowo ohlanjululwayo, nasesithupheni sesandla sakhe sokunene, nakuqukula wonyawo lwakhe lwesokunene.
Umphristi uyothatha amanye amafutha kulo ilogi, awathele entendeni yesandla sakhe sokhohlo;
agcobhoze umunwe wakhe wesokunene emafutheni asesandleni sakhe sokhohlo, achinse amafutha ngomunwe wakhe kasikhombisa phambi kukaSimakade.

Amanye amafutha asele esandleni sakhe umphristi uyowagcoba endlebeni yesokunene yalowo ohlanjululwayo, nasesithupheni sesandla sakhe sokunene, nakuqukula wonyawo lwakhe lwesokunene, phezu kwegazi lomnikelo wecala.
Amafutha aseleyo esandleni somphristi uyowagcoba ekhanda lalowo ozohlanjululwa, bese umphristi emenzela ukubuyisana phambi kukaSimakade.
“Umphristi uyonikela umnikelo wesono, ewenzela lowo ohlanjululwayo ukuze athole ukubuyisana ngenxa yokungcola kwakhe, andukuba ahlabe umnikelo wokushiswa.
Umphristi uyonikela ngomnikelo wokushiswa nangomnikelo wokusanhlamvu e-althare; amenzele ukubuyisana, ahlambuluke.

“Uma empofu, engenakuphumelela kulokho, uyothatha imvu eyodwa eyiduna ibe ngumnikelo wecala, uzungeziswe ukumenzela ukubuyisana, nokukodwa eshumini kwempuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe namafutha, kube ngumnikelo wokusanhlamvu, nengxenye yelogi lamafutha,
namahobhe amabili noma amaphuphu amabili amajuba, ngokwamandla akhe. Elinye liyoba ngumnikelo wesono. Elinye libe ngumnikelo wokushiswa.
“Ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili uyowaletha kumphristi ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana, phambi kukaSimakade, abe ngawokuhlanjululwa kwakhe.
Umphristi uyothatha imvu yomnikelo wecala nengxenye yelogi lamafutha, uyokuzungezisa kube ngumnikelo wokuzungeziswa phambi kukaSimakade.
Uyohlaba imvu yomnikelo wecala, athathe igazi lomnikelo wecala, alibhece endlebeni yesokunene yohlanjululwayo, nasesithupheni sakhe sakwesokunene, nakuqukula wakhe wesokunene.
Umphristi uyothela amanye alawa mafutha entendeni yesandla sakhe sokhohlo;
achinse kasikhombisa ngomunwe wakhe wesokunene phambi kukaSimakade amanye amafutha asesandleni sakhe sokhohlo.

Umphristi uyothatha amafutha asesandleni sakhe, awagcobe endlebeni yesokunene yohlanjululwayo, nasesithupheni sakhe sakwesokunene, nakuqukula wakhe wesokunene, akwenzele endaweni yegazi lomnikelo wecala.
Amafutha asele esandleni somphristi uyowagcoba ekhanda lohlanjululwayo ukumenzela ukubuyisana phambi kukaSimakade.
Uyonikela ngelinye lamahobhe noma ngelinye lamaphuphu ejuba, njengalokhu engaphumelela ukwenza.
Elilodwa libe ngelomnikelo wesono, elinye libe ngelomnikelo wokushiswa nomnikelo wokusanhlamvu. Umphristi uyomenzela ohlanjululwayo ukubuyisana phambi kukaSimakade.”
Lena yindlela yomthetho eyolandelwa kulowo onesifo sochoko, ongenawo amandla okuba nomnikelo oqondene nokuhlanjululwa kwakhe.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose no-Aroni, wathi:
“Kuyothi lapho senifikile eKhanani engizakuninika lona libe yifa lenu, ngibeke isifo sochoko endlini, ezweni eniliphiweyo.
Umninindlu uyoza atshele umphristi, athi: ‘Kungathi kuvele isifo esithile endlini yami.’
Umphristi uyoyala ukuba kukhishwe okuphakathi endlini ngaphambi kokuba angene ukuyohlola ukuthi sikhona yini isifo, ukuze konke okusendlini kungangcoli, andukuba umphristi angene ukuhlola indlu.
Uyohlola ukuthi isifo sikhona yini, uma isifo sisezindongeni zendlu, kukhona amabala aluhlazana noma abomvana, nokubonakala kwawo kujulile kunodonga,
umphristi uyophuma aye ngasemnyango wendlu, ayivale indlu izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Umphristi uyobuya ngosuku lwesikhombisa, ukuhlola ukuthi ibala landile yini odongeni lwendlu.
Umphristi uyoyala ukuba amatshe ahlaselwe yisifo akhishwe, alahlwe endaweni engcolileyo ngaphandle komuzi.
Indlu iyophalwa ngaphakathi nhlangothi zonke, uthuli oluphaliweyo baluthele endaweni engcolileyo ngaphandle komuzi.
Bayothatha amanye amatshe bawafake endaweni yalawo akhishiweyo. Bayothatha udaka olusha bagudule ngalo indlu.
“Uma isifo sibuye savumbuka kabusha endlini emveni kokuba ekhiphe amatshe okuqala, nasemveni kokuphalwa kwendlu nokuphahlekwa kwayo,
umphristi uyohamba ayoyihlola. Uma isifo sandile endlini, kunochoko olubi olwandayo endlini; ingcolile.
Uyoyibhidliza indlu, amatshe ayo, amapulangwe ayo, nodaka lwayo akukhiphe emzini, akulahle endaweni engcolileyo.
“Oyongena endlini ngezinsuku isavaliwe uyakuba ngongcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.
Oyolala kuleyo ndlu noyodlela kuyo makahlanze izingubo zakhe.
“Uma umphristi efika ukuzoyihlola, athole ukuthi isifo asandile endlini emveni kokugudulwa kwayo, umphristi uyakumemezela ukuthi indlu ihlambulukile, ngokuba isifo siphelile.
Uyothatha izinyoni ezimbili, umsedari, indwangu ebomvu nehisopi, ukuze ahlambulule indlu.
Enye yezinyoni uyoyihlabela esitsheni sebumba phezu kwamanzi agelezayo.
Uyothatha umsedari, ihisopi, indwangu ebomvu nenyoni ephilayo, akucwilise egazini lenyoni ehlatshiweyo nasemanzini agelezayo, ayifafaze indlu kasikhombisa.
Uyakuyihlambulula indlu ngegazi lenyoni, ngamanzi agelezayo, ngenyoni ephilayo, ngomsedari, ngehisopi, nangendwangu ebomvu.
Uyoyiyeka inyoni ephilayo, indize iphume emzini iye endle, ayenzele kanjalo indlu ukubuyisana; ihlambuluke.”
Lena yindlela yomthetho eyolandelwa ngesifo sochoko esiyizinhlobonhlobo nangomuna:
uchoko lwengubo, olwendlu,
olweguludla, olotwayi, nolwebala elikhanyayo,
ukufundisa ukuthi kunini lapho umuntu engcolile nalapho ehlambulukile; yilowo-ke umthetho wochoko.
USimakade wakhuluma noMose no-Aroni, wathi:
“Yishoni kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, nithi kubo: ‘Uma owesilisa emfimfa emzimbeni wakhe, ungcolile ngokumfimfa kwakhe.
Lokho kungcola kudalwa ngukumfimfa kwakhe: noma ngabe umzimba wakhe umfimfa, noma sekunqamukile ukumfimfa, kuyakuba ngukungcola kwakhe.
“ ‘Yonke imibhede elala omfimfayo iyakuba ngengcolile; nakho konke ahlala kukho kuyakuba ngokungcolile.
Yilowo nalowo oyothinta umbhede wakhe uyakuhlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze ngamanzi, abe ngongcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.
Oyohlala entweni ekade kuhleli kuyo omfimfayo uyakuhlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze ngamanzi, abe ngongcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.
“ ‘Othinta umzimba womfimfayo uyakuhlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze ngamanzi, abe ngongcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.
“ ‘Uma omfimfayo ephimisela ngamathe ohlambulukileyo, ohlambulukileyo uyakuhlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze ngamanzi, abe ngongcolile kuze kuhlwe.
“ ‘Noma yisiphi isihlalo agibela kuso omfimfayo siyakuba ngesingcolileyo.
Bonke abathinta into ebiphansi kwakhe bayakuba ngabangcolileyo kuze kuhlwe, nalowo othwala into enjalo, uyakuhlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze ngamanzi, abe ngongcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.
“ ‘Wonke umuntu othintwe ngomfimfayo, engazigezanga izandla zakhe ngamanzi, uyakuhlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze ngamanzi, abe ngongcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.
“ ‘Isitsha sebumba esithintwe ngomfimfayo siyakuphihlizwa, zonke izitsha zokhuni ziyakuhashazwa ngamanzi.
“ ‘Uma omfimfayo ehlambulukile ekumfimfeni kwakhe, uyakuzibalela izinsuku eziyisikhombisa zokuhlanjululwa kwakhe, uyakuhlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze umzimba wakhe ngamanzi agelezayo, ahlambuluke.
Ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili uyozithathela amahobhe amabili noma amaphuphu amabili amajuba, eze phambi kukaSimakade ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana, awanike umphristi.
Umphristi uyakunikela ngawo, elinye libe ngumnikelo wesono, elinye libe ngumnikelo wokushiswa; uyakumenzela ukubuyisana phambi kukaSimakade ngenxa yokumfimfa kwakhe.
“ ‘Uma umuntu eshaywa yizibuko, uyakugeza wonke umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, abe ngongcolile kuze kuhlwe.
Zonke izingubo nazo zonke izikhumba elikuzo izibuko lakhe ziyakuhlanzwa ngamanzi, zibe ngezingcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.
Uma owesilisa elale nowesifazane wamthela ngesidoda, bobabili bayakugeza ngamanzi, babe ngabangcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.
“ ‘Uma owesifazane ejwayele ukumfimfa igazi emzimbeni wakhe, uyakuhlala engcolile izinsuku eziyisikhombisa; bonke abamthintayo bayakuba ngabangcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.
“ ‘Zonke izinto alala kuzo ngesikhathi engcolile ziyakuba ngezingcolileyo; noma yini ahlala kuyo iyakuba ngengcolileyo.
Lowo othinta umbhede wakhe uyakuhlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze ngamanzi, abe ngongcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.
Nalowo othinta noma yini ahlale kuyo uyakuhlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze ngamanzi, abe ngongcolile kuze kuhlwe.
Noma kungaba ngumbhede noma iyiphi enye into ahlale kuyo, uma ithintwa ngumuntu, uyakuhlala engcolile kuze kuhlwe.
“ ‘Uma owesilisa elala naye, ukungcola kwakhe kuyakuba kuye, uyakuba ngongcolile izinsuku eziyisikhombisa; nayo yonke imibhede alala kuyo iyakuba ngengcolileyo.

“ ‘Uma owesifazane emfimfa igazi izinsuku eziningi, hhayi ngesikhathi sokungcola kwakhe, noma emfimfa kwedlule esikhathini sokungcola kwakhe, ngazo zonke izinsuku zokumfimfa uyohlala engongcolile njengasezinsukwini zokungcola kwakhe; uyakuba ngongcolileyo.
Imibhede yonke alala kuyo ngazo zonke izinsuku zokumfimfa kwakhe iyakuba njengemibhede yokungcola kwakhe; nazo zonke izinto ahlala kuzo ziyakuba ngezingcolileyo njengokungcola kwalapho esesikhathini.
Noma yimuphi othinta lezi zinto uyakuba ngongcolileyo, uyakuhlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze ngamanzi, abe ngongcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.
“ ‘Uma ehlambulukile ekumfimfeni kwakhe, uyakuzibalela izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, emveni kwalokho uyobe esehlambulukile.
Ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili uyothatha amahobhe amabili noma amaphuphu amabili amajuba, awalethe kumphristi ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana.
Umphristi uyonikela elinye libe ngumnikelo wesono, nelinye libe ngumnikelo wokushiswa; uyomenzela ukubuyisana phambi kukaSimakade ngenxa yokumfimfa kwakhe.
“ ‘Kanjalo-ke niyakugcina abantu bakwa-Israyeli behlukanisiwe nokungcola kwabo ukuze bangafeli ekungcoleni kwabo, nokuba bangayingcolisi indawo yami engihlala kuyo phakathi kwabo.’ ”
Lena yindlela yomthetho eyolandelwa kulabo abamfimfayo: lowo oshaywa yizibuko ngaleyo ndlela abe ngongcolile,
nowesifazane osesikhathini, nanoma yimuphi omfimfayo, kungaba ngowesilisa noma ngowesifazane, nendoda elala nowesifazane ongcolileyo.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose emva kokufa kwamadodana amabili ka-Aroni, ayesondele phambi kukaSimakade, maqede afa.

USimakade wathi kuMose: “Khuluma no-Aroni, umfowenu, ukuba angangeni noma nini endaweni engcwele emva kwesihenqo phambi kwesihlalo somusa esiphezu komphongolo, ukuze angafi, ngokuba ngiyabonakala efini phezu kwesihlalo somusa.”
U-Aroni uyongena endaweni engcwele nalokhu: iduna, libe ngumnikelo wesono, inqama, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa,
embethe ibhantshi lelineni elingcwele, efake ibhulukwe lelineni, ezibophe ngebhande lelineni, ethwele umshuqulu welineni. Lezo yizembatho ezingcwele. Uyakugeza umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, bese ezigqoka.
Uyothatha enhlanganweni yabantu bakwa-Israyeli izimpongo ezimbili zibe ngumnikelo wesono, nenqama ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa.
U-Aroni makanikele ngenkunzi, ibe ngumnikelo wakhe wesono; azenzele yena nendlu yakhe ukubuyisana.
Uyothatha izimpongo ezimbili, azibeke phambi kukaSimakade ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana.
U-Aroni uyakwenza unkatho ngezimpongo zombili, olunye unkatho lube ngolukaSimakade, olunye unkatho lube ngoluka-Azazeli.
U-Aroni uyonikela ngempongo edliwe wunkatho lukaSimakade, ibe ngumnikelo wesono.
Kepha impongo edliwe wunkatho luka-Azazeli iyakubekwa iphila phambi kukaSimakade ukuze kwenziwe ngayo ukubuyisana, bese ithunyelwa ehlane ku-Azazeli.
U-Aroni uyonikela ngenkunzi engumnikelo wesono sakhe, azenzele ukubuyisana yena nabendlu yakhe.
Uyothatha isitsha sempepho esigcwele amalahle omlilo ase-althare phambi kukaSimakade, nempepho egxotshiwe igcwele izandla zakhe zombili, angene nayo ngaphakathi kwesihenqo.
Uyoyibeka impepho emlilweni phambi kukaSimakade ukuze ifu lempepho lisibekele isihlalo somusa esiphezu kobufakazi, ukuze angafi.
Uyothatha ingxenye yegazi lenkunzi achinse ngomunwe wakhe phambi kwesihlalo somusa ngasempumalanga, uyolichinsa ngomunwe wakhe kasikhombisa phambi kwesihlalo somusa.
Uyohlaba impongo ibe ngumnikelo wesono wabantu, alethe igazi layo ngaphakathi kwesihenqo, enze ngalo njengalokhu enzile ngegazi lenkunzi, alifafaze phezu kwesihlalo somusa naphambi kwaso.

Uyakuyenzela kanjalo ukubuyisana indawo engcwele, ngenxa yokungcola kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli, nangenxa yeziphambeko zabo, nazo zonke izono zabo. Uyakulenzela kanjalo nethende lokuhlangana elihleli phakathi kokungcola kwabo.

Akuyukuba bikho muntu ethendeni lokuhlangana kusukela ngesikhathi angena ngaso ukuyokwenza ukubuyisana endaweni engcwele kuze kube yisikhathi aphuma ngaso; esezenzele yena ukubuyisana nendlu yakhe nebandla lonke lakwa-Israyeli.
Uyakuphuma aye e-althare eliphambi kukaSimakade, alenzele ukubuyisana. Uyothatha igazi lenkunzi nelempongo, alibhece ezimpondweni ze-althare nxazonke.
Uyolichinsa ngegazi kasikhombisa ngomunwe wakhe, alihlambulule, alingcwelise ekungcoleni kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli.
Uma eseqedile ukwenzela indawo engcwele ukubuyisana, nethende lokuhlangana ne-althare, uyonikela ngempongo ephilayo.

U-Aroni uyobeka izandla zakhe zombili enhloko yempongo ephilayo, avume phezu kwayo bonke ububi babantu bakwa-Israyeli, neziphambeko zabo, nakho konke ukona kwabo, akubeke enhloko yempongo, bese eyihambisa ngesandla somuntu olungiselwe lokho, iye ehlane.
Impongo iyothwala ububi babo bonke, iye nabo kwahlongasibi, ayikhululele ehlane.
U-Aroni uyakungena ethendeni lokuhlangana, akhumule izembatho zelineni azembatha uma engena endaweni engcwele, azishiye lapho.
Uyogeza umzimba wakhe ngamanzi endaweni engcwele, agqoke izembatho zakhe, aphume, anikele ngomnikelo wakhe wokushiswa nangomnikelo wokushiswa wabantu; azenzele yena nabantu ukubuyisana.
Amanoni omnikelo wesono uyowashisa e-althare.
Lowo obehambise impongo ku-Azazeli uyohlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze umzimba ngamanzi, andukuba angene enkanjini.

Inkunzi yomnikelo wesono nempongo yomnikelo wesono, okungeniswe igazi lakho ukwenza ukubuyisana endaweni engcwele, ziyakukhishelwa ngaphandle kwenkambu, izikhumba zakho nenyama yakho nomswani wakho, kushiswe ngomlilo.
Okushisayo uyohlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze umzimba ngamanzi, andukuba angene enkanjini.
Lokhu kuyokuba yisimiso esiphakade kini: ngenyanga yesikhombisa, ngolweshumi lwenyanga, niyakuthobisa imiphefumulo yenu, ningenzi msebenzi, owolibo nomfokazi ogogobeleyo phakathi kwenu.
Ngokuba ngalolo lusuku niyokwenzelwa ukubuyisana ukuze nihlanjululwe; nihlambuluke ezonweni zenu zonke phambi kukaSimakade.
Luyisabatha lokuphumula okuphelele kini, niyozithiba; lokho kuyisimiso esiphakade.
Umphristi oyogcotshwa ahlukaniselwe ukuba abe ngumphristi esikhundleni sikayise, uyokwenza ukubuyisana, agqoke izembatho zelineni, izembatho ezingcwele.
Uyokwenzela indlu engcwele ukubuyisana, enzele abaphristi nabantu bonke bebandla ukubuyisana.
Lokhu kuyakuba yisimiso esiphakade kini ukwenzela abantu bakwa-Israyeli ukubuyisana kanye ngonyaka ngenxa yezono zabo zonke. UMose wenza njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Khuluma no-Aroni, namadodana akhe, nabo bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Yilokhu uSimakade ayale ngakho, ethi:
yilowo nalowo muntu wendlu yakwa-Israyeli oyohlaba inkunzi noma imvana noma imbuzi enkanjini, noma ayihlabele ngaphandle kwenkambu,

engayilethanga emnyango wethende lokuhlangana ukunikela ngayo ibe ngumnikelo kaSimakade ngaphambi kwethabanakeli likaSimakade, lowo muntu uyakubekwa icala legazi, ngokuba uchithile igazi; lowo muntu uyakunqunywa kwabakubo.
