Ngalokho abantu bakwa-Israyeli bayoletha imihlatshelo yabo abayihlabele endle, bayoyiletha kuSimakade, kumphristi ongasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana bayinikele ibe yiminikelo yokuthula kuSimakade.
Umphristi uyofafaza igazi e-althare likaSimakade ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana, ashise amanoni, abe yiphunga elimnandi kuSimakade,
ukuze bangaphinde banikele imihlatshelo yabo emadimonini abaphinga nawo. Lokhu kuyokuba yisimiso esiphakade kubo, ezizukulwaneni zabo.’
“Uyosho nalokhu kubo uthi: ‘Yilowo nalowo muntu wendlu yakwa-Israyeli noma umfokazi ogogobele phakathi kwabo onikela ngomnikelo wokushiswa noma ngomhlatshelo,
kodwa angawulethi emnyango wethende lokuhlangana ukuba awunikele kuSimakade, lowo muntu uyakunqunywa kwabakubo.
“ ‘Yilowo nalowo muntu wendlu yakwa-Israyeli noma umfokazi ogogobele phakathi kwabo odla igazi noma yiliphi, ngiyomelana nalowo muntu odla igazi, ngimnqume kwabakubo.
Ngokuba ukuphila komzimba kusegazini; ngininike lona ukwenzela imiphefumulo yenu ukubuyisana e-althare, yigazi elenza ukubuyisana.
Ngalokho, ngathi kubantu bakwa-Israyeli: “Makungabi bikho muntu phakathi kwenu odla igazi; nomfokazi ogogobele phakathi kwenu akayukulidla.”
“ ‘Yilowo nalowo muntu kwabakwa-Israyeli noma umfokazi ogogobele phakathi kwabo, ozingela abambe isilwane noma inyoni edliwayo, uyochitha igazi layo, alemboze ngothuli.

Ngokuba impilo yazo zonke izidalwa igazi lazo nomphefumulo wazo kusegazini lazo, ngalokho ngathi kubantu bakwa-Israyeli: “Aniyukulidla igazi lenyama yonke, ngokuba ukuphila kwazo zonke izidalwa kusegazini lazo; lowo olidlayo uyonqunywa.”
“ ‘Noma ngubani odla ingcuba noma isilwane esidweshulwe yizilo, noma ngabe ungowolibo noma ngumfokazi, uyohlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze ngamanzi, abe ngongcolileyo kuze kuhlwe, bese eyahlambuluka.
Kepha uma engazihlanzi, engawugezi umzimba wakhe, uyothwala ububi bakhe.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘NginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.
Aniyukwenza njengokwemisebenzi yeGibhithe enanihlala kulo, futhi aniyukwenza njengokwemisebenzi yeKhanani enginiyisa kulo, aniyukuhamba ngemithetho yabo.
Niyokwenza izehlulelo zami, nigcine imithetho yami, nihambe ngayo; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.
Niyogcina izimiso zami nezehlulelo zami; uma nizenza, niyakuphila ngazo; nginguSimakade.
“ ‘Akuyukuba bikho phakathi kwenu oyosondela esihlotsheni sakhe embule ubunqunu baso; nginguSimakade.
“ ‘Ubunqunu bukayihlo, nobunqunu bukanyoko, awuyukubembula; ungunyoko, awuyukubembula ubunqunu bakhe.
“ ‘Awuyukubembula ubunqunu bukamkayihlo; bungubunqunu bukayihlo.
“ ‘Awuyukubembula ubunqunu bukadadewenu, indodakazi kayihlo noma indodakazi kanyoko, ezelwe kwenu, noma ezelwe kwelinye ikhaya.
“ ‘Awuyukubembula ubunqunu bendodakazi yendodana yakho, noma bendodakazi yendodakazi yakho, ngokuba ubunqunu babo bungubunqunu bakho.
“ ‘Awuyukubembula ubunqunu bendodakazi yomkayihlo, ezalwa nguyihlo; ingudadewenu.
“ ‘Awuyukubembula ubunqunu bukababekazi wakho; uyisihlobo sikayihlo.
“ ‘Awuyukubembula ubunqunu bukadadewabo kanyoko, ngokuba uyisihlobo sikanyoko.
“ ‘Awuyukubembula ubunqunu bukamfowabo kayihlo, ungasondeli kumkakhe; ungunyoko.
“ ‘Awuyukubembula ubunqunu bukamalokazana wakho; ungumkandodana yakho.
“ ‘Awuyukubembula ubunqunu bukamkamfowenu; bungubunqunu bukamfowenu.

“ ‘Awuyukubembula ubunqunu bowesifazane nobendodakazi yakhe; awuyukuthatha indodakazi yendodana yakhe, noma indodakazi yendodakazi yakhe awuyukwembula ubunqunu bayo, ngokuba bayizihlobo; kungukonakala lokho.
“ ‘Awuyukuthatha owesifazane abe yimbangi kadadewabo ukuba wembule ubunqunu bakhe esekhona udadewabo.
“ ‘Awuyukusondela kowesifazane, wembule ubunqunu bakhe esangcolile ngokungcola kwakhe.
“ ‘Awuyukulala nomkamakhelwane ukuzingcolisa ngaye.
“ ‘Awuyukunikela ngenzalo yakho ibe ngumhlatshelo kuMolekhi, ungahlambalazi igama likaNkulunkulu wakho; nginguSimakade.
“ ‘Awuyukulala nowesilisa njengowesifazane; kuyisinengiso lokho.
“ ‘Awuyukulala nesilwane uzingcolise ngaso; nowesifazane akayukuma phambi kwesilwane ukuba alale naso; kuyichilo.
“ ‘Ningazingcolisi noma ngayiphi yalezo zinto, ngokuba izizwe engazixosha phambi kwenu zazizingcolisa ngazo.
Izwe lonakele, yingakho ngalihambela ngenxa yobubi balo ukuze ngilijezise, izwe labaphalaza abantu balo.
Niyakugcina izimiso zami nezehlulelo zami, aniyukwenza nesisodwa salezi zinengiso, noma ngabe ngowolibo noma ngumfokazi ogogobele phakathi kwenu,
ngokuba abantu bezwe abaphambi kwenu bazenzile lezi zinengiso, ngakho-ke izwe langcola.
Izwe liyakuniphalaza uma nilingcolisa, njengalokho laphalaza isizwe esasikhona phambi kwenu.
“ ‘Noma ngubani oyokwenza lezi zinengiso, lowo muntu uyonqunywa kwabakubo.
Ngalokho, gcinani umyalo wami ukuze ningenzi nasinye sezinengiso ezenziwa ngaphambi kwenu, ningazingcolisi ngazo; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Khuluma kuyo inhlangano yabantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kuyo: ‘Niyoba ngcwele ngokuba Mina Simakade uNkulunkulu wenu ngingcwele.
“ ‘Yilowo nalowo uyohlonipha uyise nonina, agcine amasabatha ami; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.
“ ‘Aniyukuphendukela konkulunkulu abayize, aniyukuzenzela izithombe ezakhiwe; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.
“ ‘Lapho ninikela ngomhlatshelo wokuthula kuSimakade, niyowunikela ngendlela eyokwenza namukeleke.
Niyowudla ngosuku eniwunikele ngalo nangakusasa, uma usalile kwaze kwaba lusuku lwesithathu, niyowushisa emlilweni.
Uma udliwa ngosuku lwesithathu, inyama yawo eseyonakele ayiyukwemukeleka.
Noma ngubani oyoyidla, uyothwala ububi bakhe, ngokuba ungcolise okungcwele kukaSimakade, lowo muntu uyonqunywa kubantu bakubo.
“ ‘Uma nivuna isivuno sezwe lakini, awuyukuvuna konke emagunjini ensimu yakho, noma ucoshe ngisho okuwe phansi ensimini yakho.
Awuyukuvuna konke esivinini sakho, awuyukubutha amagilebhisi avuthuluke kuso, uyowashiyela abampofu nabafokazi; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.
“ ‘Aniyukweba, aniyukuphathana ngobuqili, aniyukuqambelana amanga.
“ ‘Aniyukwenza isifungo samanga ngegama lami; nize nihlambalaze igama likaNkulunkulu; nginguSimakade.
“ ‘Awuyukumcindezela umakhelwane wakho, awuyukumphanga. Awuyukugodla inkokhelo yesisebenzi esiqashiweyo kuze kube ngakusasa.
“ ‘Awuyukusiqalekisa isithulu, awuyukubeka isikhubekiso phambi kwempumputhe, kodwa uyomesaba uNkulunkulu wakho; nginguSimakade.
“ ‘Aniyukuhlanekezela ukwehlulela. Aniyukumbandlulula ompofu, nivune ocebileyo, kodwa niyomehlulela ngokulunga umakhelwane wenu.
“ ‘Awuyukuhamba unyevuza phakathi kwabantu bakini. Awuyukufuna nzuzo ngegazi likamakhelwane wakho; nginguSimakade.
“ ‘Awuyukumzonda umfowenu enhliziyweni yakho. Uyomkhuza nokumkhuza umakhelwane wakho, kodwa ungabi nasono ngaye.
“ ‘Awuyukuphindisa, awuyukuba namagqubu nabantu bakini, kodwa uyothanda umakhelwane wakho njengalokhu uzithanda wena; nginguSimakade.

“ ‘Niyakuzigcina izimiso zami. Aniyukuvumela izilwane zenu zizekwe ngolunye uhlobo. Aniyukuhlwanyela ensimini yenu izinhlobo ezimbili zembewu, futhi aniyukugqoka ingubo eyenziwe ngezinhlobo ezimbili zezintanjana.
“ ‘Oyolala nowesifazane oyisigqila eyingoduso yomunye, kodwa engahlengiwe, noma athole inkululeko, kuyokwenziwa ucwaningo, abanakubulawa ngenxa yokuba wayengakanikwa inkululeko.
Uyoletha umnikelo wakhe wecala kuSimakade ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana, inqama ibe ngumnikelo wecala.
Umphristi uyomenzela ukubuyisana ngenqama yomnikelo wecala phambi kukaSimakade, ngenxa yesono sakhe asenzileyo, athethelelwe esonweni sakhe asenzileyo.
“ ‘Uma senifikile ezweni, niyotshala izinhlobonhlobo zemithi edliwayo, kuthi izithelo zayo nizithathe njengokungasoki kwayo iminyaka emithathu zibe njengezingasokiwe kini: aniyukuzidla.
Kepha ngonyaka wesine zonke izithelo zayo ziyokuba ngcwele, ezokudumisa uSimakade.
Ngonyaka wesihlanu niyokudla izithelo zayo, ukuze ithele kakhulu; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.
“ ‘Aniyukudla lutho olunegazi, aniyukwenza imilingo, noma nihumushe izimpawu.
“ ‘Aniyukudilinga amakhanda enu emaceleni; awuyukona isilevu sakho emaceleni.
“ ‘Aniyukuzigcaba emizimbeni yenu ngenxa yabafileyo; aniyukuqopha mibhalo emabalabala kuyo; nginguSimakade.
“ ‘Awuyukuyingcolisa indodakazi yakho ngokuyigqugquzela ukuba ibe yisifebe, funa izwe lehlelwe ngubufebe, ligcwale ukonakala.
“ ‘Anogcina amasabatha ami, nihloniphe indawo yami engcwele; nginguSimakade.
“ ‘Aniyukuphendukela emadlozini nakubathakathi, ningazingcolisi ngabo; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.
“ ‘Uyosukuma nxa kumi impunga phambi kwakho, uyomhlonipha umuntu omdala, umesabe uNkulunkulu wakho; nginguSimakade.
“ ‘Uma umfokazi egogobele ezweni lakini, aniyukumcindezela.
“ ‘Umfokazi ogogobele phakathi kwenu, uyokuba njengowolibo phakathi kwenu, niyomthanda njengalokhu nizithanda nina, ngokuba nani naningabafokazi eGibhithe; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.
“ ‘Aniyukwenza ukungalungi lapho nehlulela, nasekulinganiseni isisindo nomthamo.
Niyakuba nezilinganiso zeqiniso, nezisindo zeqiniso, ne-efa leqiniso, nehini leqiniso; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu owanikhipha eGibhithe.
“ ‘Niyozigcina zonke izimiso zami, nizenze zonke izehlulelo zami; nginguSimakade.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:

“Uyothi kubantu bakwa-Israyeli: ‘Noma ngubani kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, noma ngumfokazi ogogobele kwa-Israyeli, oyonikela noma ngayiphi yenzalo yakhe kuMolekhi; uyobulawa, abantu balelo lizwe bamkhande ngamatshe.
Mina uqobo ngiyomelana nalowo muntu, ngimnqume kubantu bakubo, ngokuba enikele ngenzalo yakhe kuMolekhi wangcolisa indawo yami engcwele, walihlambalaza iGama lami elingcwele.
Uma abantu balelo lizwe bethalalisa, benza sengathi ababoni lapho enikela ngenzalo yakhe kuMolekhi, bengambulali lowo muntu,
Mina uqobo ngiyakumelana nalowo muntu nomndeni wakhe, ngimnqume kubantu bakubo nabo bonke abahamba naye bayophinga, bephinga noMolekhi.
“ ‘Nalowo muntu oyakuphendukela kwabanamadlozi nakwabathakathayo ukuba aphinge nabo, ngiyomelana nalowo muntu, ngimnqume kubantu bakubo.
“ ‘Zingcweliseni nibe ngcwele, ngokuba Mina nginguSimakade, uNkulunkulu wenu.
Anogcina izimiso zami, nizenze; nginguSimakade oningcwelisayo.
“ ‘Yilowo nalowo othuka uyise nonina uyobulawa nokubulawa, lokhu ethuke uyise nonina; igazi lakhe liyoba phezu kwakhe.
“ ‘Umuntu ophinga nomfazi womunye, nomuntu ophinga nomfazi kamakhelwane wakhe, labo abaphingileyo bayakubulawa.
“ ‘Umuntu olala nomkayise, wembula ubunqunu bukayise; bobabili bayobulawa nokubulawa, igazi labo libe semakhanda abo.
“ ‘Uma umuntu elala nomalokazana wakwakhe, bobabili bayobulawa nokubulawa; benze ichilo; igazi labo liyoba semakhanda abo.
“ ‘Indoda elala nowesilisa njengowesifazane, bobabili benze okunengisayo; bayobulawa nokubulawa, igazi labo libe semakhanda abo.
“ ‘Umuntu oyothatha owesifazane nonina, kungukonakala lokho; bayakushiswa ngomlilo, yena nabo, ukuze kungabi bikho lobu bubi phakathi kwenu.
“ ‘Uma umuntu elala nesilwane, uyobulawa nokubulawa, nesilwane sibulawe.
“ ‘Uma owesifazane esondela esilwaneni ukuba alale naso, uyobulawa owesifazane nesilwane; bayobulawa nokubulawa, igazi labo libe semakhanda abo.

“ ‘Uma umuntu eyothatha udadewabo, indodakazi kayise noma indodakazi kanina, abone ubunqunu bayo, nayo ibone ubunqunu bakhe, kuyihlazo lokho; bayakunqunywa phambi kwabantu bakubo, ngokuba embulile ubunqunu bukadadewabo, uyothwala icala lakhe.
“ ‘Uma umuntu elala nowesifazane osesikhathini, embule ubunqunu bakhe, umembulile esesikhathini, naye uzembulile esesikhathini, ngakho-ke bobabili bayonqunywa kubantu bakubo.
“ ‘Ungabembuli ubunqunu bukanyokokazi, noma obukayihlokazi, ngoba uyobe unqunise isihlobo sakho; bayojeziswa.
“ ‘Umuntu olala noyisekazi, wambule ubunqunu bukayisekazi, bayakuthwala isono sabo, bafe bengazange babe nabantwana.
“ ‘Uma umuntu ethatha umkamfowabo, kungukungcola lokho; wambulile ubunqunu bomfowabo; bayokufa bengazange babe nabantwana.
“ ‘Ngakho-ke niyogcina zonke izimiso zami, nazo zonke izehlulelo zami nizenze, ukuze izwe enginiyisa kulo ukuba nihlale kulo linganiphalazi.
Aniyukuhamba ngezimiso zezizwe engizozixosha phambi kwenu, ngokuba zenzile zonke lezi zinto; nganengwa yizo.
Nokho, nganitshela ngathi: “Niyolidla izwe lazo, ngininike lona libe yifa lenu, izwe elichichima ubisi noju;” nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu onehlukanisile kwezinye izizwe.

“ ‘Ngakho-ke niyohlukanisa phakathi kwesilwane esihlanzekileyo nesingcolileyo; inyoni engcolileyo nehlanzekileyo, aniyukuzenza nenyanyeke ngesilwane noma inyoni, nanoma yini nje enwabuzelayo emhlabeni, engikwehlukanisile ngathi kungcolile.
Niyakuba ngcwele kimi, ngokuba Mina Simakade ngingcwele, nginehlukanisile kwabezizwe ukuba nibe ngabami.
“ ‘Owesilisa noma owesifazane ongenwe yidlozi, noma ngumoya wokubhula, uyobulawa nokubulawa, akhandwe ngamatshe, igazi lakhe libe phezu kwakhe.’ ”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Yisho kubaphristi, amadodana ka-Aroni, uthi kubo: ‘Makungabi bikho oyozingcolisa ngokuthinta ofileyo kubantu bakubo,
ngaphandle kwesihlobo esisondele kuye, njengonina, uyise, indodana yakhe, indodakazi yakhe, umfowabo,
udadewabo, intombi esondelene naye engenandoda, ngoba angazingcolisa ngenxa yayo.
Umyeni akayukuzingcolisa phakathi kwezihlobo zakhe; azihlambalaze.
“ ‘Abayukuphuca amakhanda abo emaceleni, noma baphuce izilevu emaceleni, abayukugcaba imizimba yabo.
Bayakuba ngcwele kuNkulunkulu wabo, bangahlambalazi igama likaNkulunkulu wabo, ngokuba banikela ngeminikelo yokushiswa kaSimakade, isinkwa sikaNkulunkulu wabo; ngalokho, bayakuba ngcwele.
“ ‘Abanakuthatha owesifazane oyisifebe nowonakeleyo, noma owesifazane olahlwe yindoda yakhe, ngokuba umphristi ungcwele kuNkulunkulu wakhe.
Uyakumehlukanisa abe ngcwele, ngokuba unikela ngesinkwa sikaNkulunkulu wakho. Uyakuba ngcwele kuwe, ngokuba Mina Simakade okwehlukanisayo, ngingcwele.
“ ‘Uma indodakazi yomphristi izingcolisa ngokufeba, ihlambalaza uyise; iyoshiswa ngomlilo.

“ ‘Ongumphristi ophakanyisiwe phakathi kwabafowabo, lowo owathelwa ngamafutha okugcoba ekhanda lakhe, wehlukaniswa ukuba embathe izembatho, akayukuwaqhaqha amagoda ekhanda lakhe, noma aklebhule izembatho zakhe,
akayukungena lapho kunofileyo khona, akayukuzingcolisa ngisho nangoyise noma unina imbala.
Akayukuphuma endaweni engcwele, akayukuyihlambalaza indawo kaNkulunkulu wakhe engcwele, ngokuba ukungcweliswa kwamafutha okugcoba kaNkulunkulu wakhe kuphezu kwakhe; nginguSimakade.
“ ‘Uyothatha owesifazane oseyintombi, amgane.
Akayukuganwa ngumfelokazi noma ngolahlwe yindoda noma owesifazane okhohlakele, nesifebe, kodwa uyothatha intombi phakathi kwabantu bakubo, ibe ngumkakhe.
Akayukuyihlambalaza inzalo yakhe phakathi kwabantu bakubo, ngokuba nginguSimakade omngcwelisayo.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Khuluma ku-Aroni uthi: ‘Akukho muntu okhubazekile ozalweni lwakho, ezizukulwaneni zalo, oyakusondela anikele ngesinkwa kuNkulunkulu wakhe.
Umuntu okhubazekile akayukusondela: noma oyimpumputhe, noma olunyonga, onekhala elilinyaziwe, nonezitho ezingalingani,
noma umuntu ononyawo olwaphukileyo, noma isandla esaphukileyo,
onesifumbu, oyisichwe, onomlanga esweni lakhe, onesithembuzane, onomuna, noma okhubazeke emasendeni.
Akuyukuba bikho muntu wozalo luka-Aroni, umphristi, oyosondela anikele ngeminikelo yomlilo kuSimakade uma ekhubazekile; akayukusondela anikele ngesinkwa kuNkulunkulu wakhe.
Uyakusidla isinkwa sikaNkulunkulu wakhe esingcwelengcwele nesingcwele.
Akayukungena esihenqweni, noma asondele e-althare, ngokuba ukhubazekile, ukuze angazihlambalazi izindawo zami ezingcwele; nginguSimakade obangcwelisayo.’ ”
UMose wakhuluma lokho ku-Aroni, nasemadodaneni akhe, nakubo bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Khuluma ku-Aroni namadodana akhe ukuba bahlukane nezinto ezingcwele zabantu bakwa-Israyeli, abazehlukanisela Mina njengezingcwele, ukuze bangalihlambalazi igama lami elingcwele; nginguSimakade.

“Yisho kubo uthi: ‘Yilowo nalowo, ozalweni lwenu lonke nakuzo zonke izizukulwane zenu, oyosondela ezintweni ezingcwele abantu bakwa-Israyeli abazehlukanisile njengezingcwele kuSimakade, ebe engcolile, lowo muntu uyonqunywa phambi kwami; nginguSimakade.
“ ‘Yilowo nalowo wozalo luka-Aroni onochoko noma omfimfayo akayukuzidla izinto ezingcwele aze ahlambuluke, nalowo othinta okungcoliswe yisidumbu, noma ngumuntu oshaywe yizibuko,
nalowo oyothinta okunwabuzelayo okungamngcolisa, noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ongamngcolisa, noma ngabe unakungcola kwaluhlobo luni.
Umuntu oyothinta okunjalo uyokuba ngongcolileyo kuze kuhlwe, angazidli izinto ezingcwele, aze ageze umzimba wakhe ngamanzi.
Uma selishonile ilanga uyoba ngohlambulukileyo, bese edla izinto ezingcwele, ngoba zingukudla kwakhe.
Akayukuyidla ingcuba nesilwane esidweshulwe yizilwane zasendle, ukuze angazingcolisi ngakho; nginguSimakade.
“ ‘Ngakho-ke bayogcina umyalo wami; ukuze bangabi nesono ngenxa yawo, bese befa ngokuba bewujivazile; nginguSimakade obangcwelisayo.
“ ‘Akukho mfokazi oyakudla okungcwele; ngisho umuntu ogogobele womphristi noma umqashwa, akayukukudla okungcwele.
Kepha uma umphristi ethenga umuntu, lowo amthenge ngemali yakhe uyokukudla, nalabo abazalelwe kwakhe bayosidla isinkwa sakhe.
Uma indodakazi yomphristi igana umfokazi, ayinakudla emnikelweni wezinto ezingcwele.
Kodwa uma indodakazi yomphristi ingumfelokazi noma ilahlwe yindoda, ingenamntwana, bese ibuyela endlini kayise njengasebusheni bayo, iyakusidla isinkwa sikayise, kepha umfokazi akayukusidla.
“ ‘Uma umuntu edle okungcwele ngephutha, uyothasisela ngokwesihlanu kwakho okungcwele, akunike umphristi.
Abayukuhlambalaza izinto ezingcwele abanikela ngazo kuSimakade abantu bakwa-Israyeli,
bazenze babe necala lokudla izinto ezingcwele; nginguSimakade obangcwelisayo.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:

“Yisho ku-Aroni namadodana akhe, nabo bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Yilowo nalowo wendlu yakwa-Israyeli noma ongumfokazi kwa-Israyeli, onikela ngomnikelo wakhe ngenxa yesifungo nanoma yisiphi, noma umnikelo wakhe wesihle, uyowunikela kuSimakade, ube ngumnikelo wokushiswa.
Ukuze amukeleke, uyonikela ngeduna lenkomo elingenasici noma lemvu noma lembuzi.
Aniyukunikela nganoma ngani enesici, ngokuba aniyukwemukeleka.
Umuntu onikela ngomnikelo womhlatshelo wokuthula kuSimakade ukufeza isithembiso noma owomnikelo wesihle ezinkomeni noma ezimvini, ukuze emukeleke, kuyoba ngengenasici.
Aniyukunikela ngephuphuthekayo, eyaphukile, elimele, enesilonda, enokhwekhwe nenomuna, futhi aniyukunikela ngazo kuSimakade, zibe ngumnikelo womlilo e-althare lakhe.
Inkunzi noma imvu enesitho eside kunezinye noma enesitho esincane, ninganikela ngayo ibe ngumnikelo wesihle, kodwa uma kungowesifungo awuyukwamukeleka.
Aniyukunikela kuSimakade ngethenwe ngokufihlizwa noma ngokuchotshozwa noma ngokudwengulwa noma ngokuhhumpulwa; aniyukwenza kanjalo ezweni lakini.
Aniyukwemukela lutho esandleni sowezizwe, bese ninikela ngakho kube yisinkwa sikaNkulunkulu wenu, ngokuba kunikelwe kunokungcola kukho, ngakho-ke akuyukwemukeleka.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Uma kuzalwa inkunzi noma inqama noma impongo, iyohlala nonina izinsuku eziyisikhombisa; ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili kuqhubeka iyokwemukeleka ukuba ibe ngumnikelo womlilo kuSimakade.
Aniyukuyinquma inkabi noma imvu nezinyane layo ngalusuku lunye.
“Niyohlabela uSimakade umhlatshelo wokubonga; niyakumhlabela ukuze namukeleke.
Uyakudliwa ngalolo lusuku, aniyukushiya lutho lwawo kuze kube sekuseni; nginguSimakade.
“Ngakho-ke niyoyigcina imiyalo yami, niyenze; nginguSimakade.
Aniyukulihlambalaza igama lami elingcwele; ngiyakuzibonakalisa ngingcwele phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli; nginguSimakade oningcwelisayo,
owanikhipha eGibhithe, ukuze ngibe nguNkulunkulu wenu; nginguSimakade.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Yilena imikhosi kaSimakade emisiweyo engiyimemezelayo kini ibe yimihlangano engcwele, iyimikhosi yami emisiweyo.

“ ‘Uyokwenza umsebenzi ngezinsuku eziyisithupha, kepha usuku lwesikhombisa luyisabatha; lusuku lokuphumula lomhlangano ongcwele. Awuyukwenza msebenzi ngalo, luyisabatha kuSimakade kuzo zonke izindlu zenu.
“ ‘Nansi-ke imikhosi emisiweyo kaSimakade, imihlangano engcwele eniyoyimemezela kubo ngezikhathi ezimisiweyo:
phakathi kwamabili, ngosuku lwe-14 ngenyanga yokuqala; yiphasika likaSimakade.
Ngosuku lwe-15 lwaleyo nyanga kuyoba ngumkhosi wesinkwa esingenamvubelo kuSimakade. Niyokudla isinkwa esingenamvubelo izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Ngosuku lokuqala niyokuba nomhlangano ongcwele, aniyukwenza msebenzi.
Niyonikela kuSimakade ngomnikelo womlilo izinsuku eziyisikhombisa. Ngosuku lwesikhombisa kuyoba ngumhlangano ongcwele; aniyukusebenza msebenzi.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Lapho senifikile ezweni engizakuninika lona, senivunile isivuno salo; niyoletha kumphristi isithungo solibo lokuqala lwesivuno senu.
Yena uyakusizungezisa isithungo phambi kukaSimakade ukuze namukeleke. Umphristi uyakusizungezisa ngosuku olulandela isabatha.
Ngalolo lusuku enizungezisa ngalo isithungo, niyakunikela ngemvu yeduna engenasici, enonyaka; ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuSimakade.

Umnikelo wokusanhlamvu uyoba ngokubili eshumini kwempuphu ecolisekileyo, exutshwe namafutha, umnikelo womlilo kuSimakade, ube yiphunga elimnandi, nomnikelo wokuphuzwayo uyoba ngokwesine kwehini lewayini.
Aniyukudla isinkwa notshwele nezikhwebu ezintsha kuze kufike lolo lusuku, nize nilethe umnikelo kaNkulunkulu wenu; lokhu kuyisimiso esiphakade ezizukulwaneni zenu, kuzo zonke izindlu zenu.
“ ‘Ngosuku olulandela isabatha eniyoletha ngalo isithungo somnikelo wokuzungeziswa, niyozibalela amasabatha ayisikhombisa apheleleyo;
kuze kube lusuku olulandela olwesabatha ngesonto lesikhombisa, niyobala izinsuku ezingama-50, bese ninikela kuSimakade ngomnikelo omusha wokusanhlamvu.
Niyoletha okuvela ezindlini zenu kube yizinkwa ezimbili zomnikelo wokuzungeziswa, okubili eshumini kwempuphu ecolisekileyo, ziyoba nemvubelo, bese ziphekwa, zibe lulibo lokuqala kuSimakade.

Niyakunikela, kanye nesinkwa, izimvu ezingamaduna eziyikhombisa ezingenasici ezinonyaka, neduna lenkomo, nezinqama ezimbili zibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuSimakade, umnikelo wazo wokusanhlamvu neminikelo yazo yokuphuzwayo, umnikelo womlilo, ube yiphunga elimnandi kuSimakade.
Niyakunikela ngempongo, ibe ngumnikelo wesono, nezinqama ezimbili ezinonyaka, zibe ngumhlatshelo womnikelo wokuthula.
Umphristi uyakuwuzungezisa nesinkwa solibo lokuqala kube ngumnikelo wokuzungeziswa phambi kukaSimakade; nezinqama ezimbili ziyakuba ngcwele kuSimakade, zibe ngezomphristi.
Niyakumemezela ngalolo lusuku, nibe nomhlangano ongcwele, aniyukusebenza msebenzi; lokhu kuyisimiso esiphakade ezizukulwaneni zenu, kuzo zonke izindlu zenu.
“ ‘Lapho senivuna isivuno sezwe lakini, aniyukuvuna konke emagunjini amasimu enu, aniyukuqeda konke, niyakushiyela abampofu nabafokazi; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Ngenyanga yesikhombisa ngolokuqala lwenyanga, niyoba nosuku lokuphumula ngokuphelele, umhlangano ongcwele, oyoba yisikhumbuzo ngokuba nishaye amacilongo.
Aniyukwenza msebenzi, niyonikela ngomnikelo womlilo kuSimakade.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Usuku lweshumi lwenyanga yesikhombisa luwusuku lokubuyisana; niyoba nomhlangano ongcwele, nithobise imiphefumulo yenu, ninikele ngomnikelo womlilo kuSimakade.
Aniyukwenza msebenzi ngalolo lusuku, ngokuba luwusuku lokubuyisana, ukuze nenzelwe ukubuyisana phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.
Yilowo nalowo muntu ongayikuzithoba ngalolo lusuku uyonqunywa kubantu bakubo.
Yilowo nalowo muntu oyokwenza umsebenzi othile ngalolo lusuku, lowo muntu ngiyakumbhubhisa, angabe esaba khona phakathi kwabantu bakubo.
Aniyukwenza msebenzi; kuyisimiso esiphakade ezizukulwaneni zenu, kuzo zonke izindlu zenu.
Kuyoba yisabatha lokuphumula ngokuphelele kini, nithobise imiphefumulo yenu. Ngosuku lwesishiyagalolunye lwenyanga, kusihlwa, kusukela kusihlwa kuze kube kusihlwa ngakusasa, niyogcina isabatha lenu.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Ngosuku lwe-15 lwenyanga yesikhombisa kuyakuba nguMkhosi Wamadokodo kuSimakade, izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Ngosuku lokuqala kuyakuba ngumhlangano ongcwele, aniyukwenza msebenzi.

Izinsuku eziyisikhombisa niyakunikela ngomnikelo womlilo kuSimakade. Ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili nibe nomhlangano ongcwele, niyonikela ngomnikelo womlilo kuSimakade, ngumhlangano ohloniphekileyo; aniyukwenza msebenzi.

“ ‘Lena yimikhosi emisiweyo kaSimakade eniyoyimemezela enhlanganweni engcwele ukuba ninikele ngayo ngomnikelo womlilo kuSimakade, umnikelo wokushiswa nomnikelo wokusanhlamvu, umhlatshelo neminikelo yokuphuzwayo, kube yilowo nalowo ngosuku lwawo,
ngaphandle kwamasabatha kaSimakade, nangaphandle kwezipho zenu, nangaphandle kwezithembiso zenu zonke, nangaphandle kweminikelo yenu yonke yesihle eniyonikela ngayo kuSimakade.

“ ‘Ngosuku lwe-15 lwenyanga yesikhombisa, lapho senibuthile izithelo zezwe, niyogubha uMkhosi kaSimakade izinsuku eziyisikhombisa. Ngosuku lokuqala nangosuku lwesishiyagalombili kuyoba yizinsuku zenu zokuphumula.
Ngosuku lokuqala niyothatha izithelo zemithi emihle, amagatsha amasundu, namagatsha emithi edumbileyo, neminyezane yemifula, nithokoze phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Niyakuwugubha uMkhosi kaSimakade izinsuku eziyikhombisa ngonyaka, lokhu kuyisimiso esiphakade ezizukulwaneni zenu; niyakuwugubha ngenyanga yesikhombisa.
Niyakuhlala emadokodweni izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, bonke abangabozalo kwa-Israyeli bayohlala emadokodweni,
ukuze izizukulwane zenu zazi ukuthi abantu bakwa-Israyeli ngabahlalisa emadokodweni emveni kokuba ngibakhiphe eGibhithe; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.’ ”
UMose wabatshela abantu bakwa-Israyeli ngemikhosi emisiweyo kaSimakade.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yala abantu bakwa-Israyeli ukuba balethe kuwe amafutha eminqumo acwengekileyo, agxotshelwe ukukhanyisa, ukuze izibani zivuthe njalonjalo,
ngaphandle kwesihenqo sobufakazi, ethendeni lokuhlangana. U-Aroni uyakuzilungisa njalo phambi kukaSimakade, kusukela kusihlwa kuze kuse. Lokhu kuyoba yisimiso saphakade ezizukulwaneni zenu.
Uyakulungisa njalo izibani othini olucwengekileyo, phambi kukaSimakade.
“Uyothatha impuphu ecolisekileyo upheke ngayo amaqebelengwane ali-12, iqebelengwane ngalinye libe okubili eshumini.
Uyowabeka abe yimigqa emibili, abe yisithupha kulowo nalowo mugqa etafuleni elicwengekileyo, phambi kukaSimakade.
Uyakubeka inhlaka ecwengekileyo kuyo yomibili imigqa, ibe yisikhumbuzo somnikelo wesinkwa, umnikelo womlilo kuSimakade.
Amasabatha ngamasabatha, uyakuzihlela njalo phambi kukaSimakade, njengokuzinikela kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli, nanjengesivumelwano esiphakade.
Ziyakuba ngezika-Aroni namadodana akhe, bayozidlela endaweni engcwele, ngoba zingcwelengcwele, zingezakhe phakathi kweminikelo yomlilo kaSimakade; ngokwesimiso esiphakade.”
Indodana yowesifazane wakwa-Israyeli noyise ongowaseGibhithe yaphuma yaya phakathi kwabakwa-Israyeli. Indodana yowesifazane wakwa-Israyeli yaxabana nomuntu wakwa-Israyeli enkanjini.
Yahlambalaza igama likaSimakade, yaliqalekisa; yalethwa kuMose. Unina waleyo ndodana kwakunguShelomithi, indodakazi kaDibhiri, wesizwana sakwaDani.
Bayifaka ejele kuze kuphume isinqumo sikaSimakade ukuthi benzenjani ngayo.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Mkhiphele ngaphandle kwenkambu lowo muntu othukile. Bonke abamuzwa mababeke izandla zabo ekhanda lakhe, inhlangano yonke imkhande ngamatshe.
Uyokhuluma nabantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Yilowo nalowo oyakuthuka uNkulunkulu wakhe uyakujeziswa ngenxa yesono sakhe.
Ohlambalaza igama likaSimakade uyokufa nokufa. Impela inhlangano yonke iyomkhanda ngamatshe. Umfokazi noma umnsinsi wokuzimilela uyobulawa, uma ehlambalaza igama likaSimakade.
“ ‘Umuntu oshaya omunye aze afe, impela uyobulawa.
Oshaya inkomo ize ife uyoyikhokha, kube ngukuphila ngokuphila.
Umuntu olimaza omunye, kuyokwenziwa kuye njengalokho naye enzile,
kube ngukwaphuka ngokwaphuka, iso ngeso, izinyo ngezinyo; njengalokho elimazile umuntu, kuyokwenziwa kanjalo nakuye.
Obulala inkomo, uyoyikhokha; obulala umuntu, uyobulawa.
Niyoba nesehlulelo esifanayo kumfokazi nakowozalo; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.’ ”
UMose wakhuluma nabantu bakwa-Israyeli; bamkhiphela ngaphandle kwenkambu lowo othukileyo, bamkhanda ngamatshe. Abakwa-Israyeli benza njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose entabeni iSinayi, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Lapho senifikile ezweni engininika lona, izwe liyogcina isabatha kuSimakade.
Uyakulima insimu yakho iminyaka eyisithupha, iminyaka eyisithupha uthene isivini sakho, ubuthe izithelo zaso,
kodwa ngonyaka wesikhombisa kuyakuba khona isabatha lokuphumula kwezwe, isabatha kuSimakade. Awuyukulima insimu yakho, futhi awuyukusithena nesivini sakho.
Amakhikhizela esivuno sakho awuyukuwavuna, nezithelo zomvini wakho ongatheniwe awuyukuzikha; kuyakuba ngunyaka wokuphumula kwezwe.
Okuyozimilela ngonyaka wesabatha kuyoba ngukudla kwenu: okwakho nenceku yakho, nencekukazi yakho, nesisebenzi sakho, nomfokazi ogogobele kwakho,
ngisho nemfuyo yakho nezilwane zasendle, konke okuzimilele ezweni kuyakuba ngukudla kwenu.
“ ‘Uyozibalela amasabatha ayisikhombisa eminyaka, iminyaka eyisikhombisa iphindwe kasikhombisa, izinsuku eziyisikhombisa zamasabatha ayisikhombisa ngonyaka, okwenza iminyaka engama-49.
Uyoshaya icilongo limpompoloze kuzwakale kulo lonke izwe lakini, ngosuku lweshumi lwenyanga yesikhombisa, okuwusuku lokubuyisana.

Unyaka wama-50 niyakuwungcwelisa, nimemezele ukukhululeka kwazo zonke izakhamuzi. Kuyakuba ngunyaka wejubhili kini, niyakubuyela, kube yilowo nalowo efeni lakhe, yilowo nalowo abuyele emndenini wakubo.
Unyaka wama-50 uyoba yijubhili kini; aniyukulima, aniyukuwavuna amakhikhizela awo, aniyukuzikha izithelo zomvini ongatheniwe.
Uyijubhili, ngakho-ke uyakuba ngcwele kini, niyodla okuvela emasimini.
“ ‘Ngonyaka wejubhili, yilowo nalowo uyobuyela efeni lakhe.
“ ‘Lapho uthengisela owezwe lakini okuthile noma ukuthenga kuye, aniyukuqolana;
niyakuthengiselana nomakhelwane wakho kuye ngenani leminyaka emva kwejubhili nangenani leminyaka yomkhiqizo.
Uyakuyikhuphula intengo kuye ngobuningi beminyaka, kodwa uma iminyaka imincane, uyakuyinciphisa intengo, ngokuba yinani leminyaka yesivuno enithengiselana ngayo.
Ningaqolani, kepha uyomesaba uNkulunkulu wakho, ngokuba nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.
“ ‘Niyogcina zonke izimiso zami, nezehlulelo zami nizenze, ukuze nihlale nivikelekile ezweni.
Izwe liyakuthela izithelo zalo ngobuningi bazo, nidle nisuthe, nihlale kulo nivikelekile.
Uma nithi: “Siyakudlani ngonyaka wesikhombisa na? Bheka, asiyukulima, asiyukuvuna kudla;”
khona ngiyakuyala isibusiso sami sehlele phezu kwenu ngonyaka wesithupha, ukuze uthele ukudla kweminyaka emithathu.
Niyolima ngonyaka wesishiyagalombili, nibe nisadla izithelo enizigcinile; kuze kufike unyaka wesishiyagalolunye, kungene izithelo zawo, niyakudla okugcinwe ezinqolobaneni.
“ ‘Izwe aniyukulithengisa kuze kube phakade, ngokuba izwe lingelami, nina-ke ningabafokazi abagogobeleyo nami.
Izwe lonke eliyifa lenu niyakuba nelungelo lokulihlenga.
“ ‘Uma umfowenu eba mpofu, bese ethengisa ngefa lakhe, kuyofika umhlengi oyisihlobo sakhe esisondele silihlenge ifa umfowabo athengise ngalo.
Uma umuntu engenaye umhlengi oyisihlobo sakhe, kodwa bese eba ngocebileyo, athole okwanele ukulihlenga,
uyobala iminyaka selokhu alithengisa, bese kuthi okuseleyo akudlulisele kulowo muntu ayemthengisele lona, yena abuyele efeni lakhe.
Uma engawatholi amandla okulibuyisela kuye, lelo ayelithengisile liyakusala esandleni sowalithengayo, kuze kufike unyaka wejubhili. Liyokhululeka ngejubhili, bese ebuyela efeni lakhe.
“ ‘Uma umuntu ethengisa ngendlu yokuhlala emzini onogange, angayihlenga uma unyaka ungakapheli ithengisiwe, ngokuba unyaka wonke uyakuba nalo ilungelo lokuyihlenga.
Uma engayihlenganga kwaze kwaphela unyaka, leyo ndlu esemzini onogange isiyohlala ingeyalowo oyithengileyo kuze kube phakade ezizukulwaneni zakhe. Ayiyukubuyiselwa koyithengisileyo ngejubhili.
Kepha izindlu zemizana engenalo ugange macala wonke ziyakubalwa namasimu; zinokuhlengwa, zibuyiselwe kubaninizo ngejubhili.
“ ‘Kepha imizi yabaLevi, izindlu zemizi eyifa labo, abaLevi bayoba nelungelo lokuzihlenga noma nini izindlu ezisemizini eyifa labo.

Uma umLevi engeke akwazi ukuyihlenga indlu eyayithengisiwe, izindlu okwathengiselwana ngazo emizini eyifa labo, ziyobuyiselwa kuye ngejubhili, ngokuba izindlu zemizi yabaLevi ziyifa labo phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli.
Amasimu namadlelo omuzi wabo akunakuthengiswa, ngokuba kuyifa labo, kuze kube phakade.
“ ‘Uma umfowenu eba mpofu, bese encika kuwe, uyakumsekela, ahlale nawe njengomfokazi nogogobele kwakho.
Awuyukuthatha kuye inzalo nenzuzo, kodwa uyomesaba uNkulunkulu wakho, ukuze umfowenu ahlale nawe.
Awuyukumboleka imali ukuze uthole inzalo, awuyukumnika ukudla kwakho bese umfuna inzuzo.
NginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, owanikhipha eGibhithe ukuninika iKhanani, ukuze ngibe nguNkulunkulu wenu.
“ ‘Uma umfowenu eba mpofu ehlala nawe, azithengise kuwe, awuyukumsebenzisa njengesigqila.
Kepha uyokuba njengesisebenzi nogogobele kwakho; uyokusebenzela kuze kufike unyaka wejubhili,
bese eyasuka angabe esahlala nawe. Uyobuyela nabantwana bakhe emndenini wakubo nasefeni lokhokho bakhe.
Bayizinceku zami engazikhipha eGibhithe, akuyukuthengiswa ngabo babe yizigqila.
Awuyukumphatha ngesihluku, kodwa uyomesaba uNkulunkulu wakho.
“ ‘Izigqila zakho zesilisa nezesifazane oyokuba nazo, uyakuzithenga kwabezizwe abanizungezileyo.
Uyakuzithenga emadodaneni abafokazi abagogobele phakathi kwenu. Nalezi zingane ezizalelwe ezweni lakini ziyoba yifa lenu, niyozithenga kwabomndeni wakubo.
Niyakuzishiyela amadodana enu zibe yifa lawo kuze kube phakade. Kepha makungabi bikho muntu oyophatha ngesihluku umfowabo kubantu bakwa-Israyeli.
“ ‘Uma umfokazi ogogobele kwakho eba nengcebo, omunye kubafowenu abe mpofu, bese ezithengisa kumfokazi noma kwenye ingxenye yomndeni wabafokazi,
uma esezithengisile unelungelo lokuhlengwa. Omunye wabafowabo angamhlenga;
kungaba nguyisekazi noma indodana kayisekazi engamhlenga, noma omunye oyisihlobo sakhe segazi angamhlenga, kodwa uma eba ngocebileyo angazihlenga yena.

Uyokhuluma nalowo omthengileyo babalelane inani leminyaka esasele kuze kufike unyaka wejubhili. Intengo okumele ayikhokhe iyoba ngangenani leminyaka; isikhathi abe naso phansi komthengi wakhe siyolingana neminyaka yokuqashwa kwakhe.
Uma kusasele iminyaka eminingi, uyakukhokha komthengileyo imali elingana naleyo athengwa ngayo.
Uma sekusele iminyaka emincane kufike unyaka wejubhili, uyobalisana naye imali njengeminyaka yakhe yokuhlengwa.
Njengesisebenzi esiqashwa iminyaka ngeminyaka, uyakuba ngaphansi kwesandla sakhe, kodwa akayukumphatha ngesihluku emehlweni akho.
“ ‘Uma engahlengwanga ngalezi zindlela, ngonyaka wejubhili uyokhululeka nabantwana bakhe.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli bayizinceku, izinceku zami engazikhipha eGibhithe; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.
“ ‘Aniyukuzenzela onkulunkulu abangasho lutho, aniyukuzimisela izinsika, aniyukuzibekela itshe elingumfanekiso ezweni lakini, ukuba nikukhothamele; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.
“ ‘Niyogcina amasabatha ami, nihloniphe indawo yami engcwele; nginguSimakade.
“ ‘Uma nihamba ngezimiso zami, nigcina imiyalo yami, niyenze,
ngiyakuninika imvula ngesikhathi sayo, izwe likhiqize ukudla, imithi yasendle ithele izithelo zayo.
Niyobhula kuze kube yisikhathi sokuvuna imivini, nivune imivini kuze kube yisikhathi sokulima; niyakudla isinkwa senu, nisuthe, futhi niyohlala ezweni lakini nivikelekile.
“ ‘Ngiyakuninika ukuthula ezweni, nilale ningesatshiswa muntu. Ngiyakuziqeda nya izilwane ezimbi ezweni, nenkemba ayiyukudabula ezweni lakini.
Niyakuxosha izitha zenu, ziwe ngenkemba phambi kwenu.
Abayisihlanu kini bayakuxosha abayikhulu, abayikhulu kini baxoshe abayizi-10 000, izitha zenu ziyakuwa ngenkemba phambi kwenu.
“ ‘Ngiyonenzela umusa, nginenze nichume kakhulu, nginandise, ngiqinise isivumelwano sami nani.
Niyakudla okugcinwe ezinqolobaneni, nikhiphe okudala ukuze ningenise okusha.
Ngiyakubeka ithabanakeli lami phakathi kwenu, umphefumulo wami awuyukuninenga.
Ngiyakuhamba phakathi kwenu, ngibe nguNkulunkulu wenu, nibe ngabantu bami.
NginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu owanikhipha eGibhithe ukuba ningabi yizigqila zabo; ngephulile izikeyi zejoka lenu, ngenza ukuba nihambe nikhululekile.
“ ‘Kepha uma ningangilaleli, ningayigcini yonke le miyalo,
uma nilahla izimiso zami, nomphefumulo wenu unengwa yizehlulelo zami, ukuze ningayenzi yonke imiyalo yami, kodwa naphula isivumelwano sami,
nakhu engiyokwenza kini: ngiyonehlisela ingebhe, ufuba, umkhuhlane ovala amehlo, nokudangala komphefumulo. Niyotshala imbewu ningazuzi lutho, kudliwe yizitha zenu ebenikutshalile.
Ngiyomelana nani, nishaywe phambi kwezitha zenu, labo abanizondayo bayobusa phezu kwenu; niyobaleka kungekho muntu onixoshayo.
“ ‘Uma ningangilaleli nangalezi zinto, ngiyonishaya ngokuphindwe kasikhombisa ngenxa yezono zenu.
Ngiyakuqeda ukuqhosha ngamandla enu, ngenze izulu lenu libe njengensimbi, nomhlabathi wenu ube njengethusi.
Isithukuthuku senu siyophelela obala; izwe lenu aliyukuthela lutho, nemithi ekulo ayiyukuthela zithelo.
“ ‘Uma niyohamba nimelene nami, ningavumi ukungilalela, ngiyakunehlisela izinhlupheko eziphindwe kasikhombisa, ngenxa yezono zenu.
Ngiyothumela izilwane zasendle phakathi kwenu, ziyakubulala abantwana benu, zibhubhise imfuyo yenu, zinicoboshise, zibhubhise nezindlela zenu.
“ ‘Uma phezu kwazo zonke izinto enginishaye ngazo ningaphendukanga, kodwa nahamba nimelene nami,
nami ngizomelana nani, ngizakunishaya, yebo, ngokuphindwe kasikhombisa, ngenxa yezono zenu.
Ngiyonehlisela inkemba yempindiselo, engiyakuziphindiselela ngayo ngenxa yesivumelwano sami. Niyobuthana ndawonye emizini yenu, ngithumele ubhubhane phakathi kwenu; ninikelwe esandleni sezitha zenu.
Lapho nginephuca ukudla okunisimamisile, abesifazane abalishumi bayakubhaka isinkwa eziko elilodwa. Bayakunilinganisela lapho besiletha kini, nidle ningasuthi.
“ ‘Uma nangalokhu ningangilaleli, kodwa nihamba nimelene nami,
nami ngizomelana nani ngolaka, yebo, ngizonishaya kuze kube kasikhombisa, ngenxa yezono zenu.
Niyokudla inyama yamadodana namadodakazi enu.
Ngiyakuchitha izindawo zenu eziphakemeyo, ngibhidlize ama-althare enu empepho, izidumbu zenu ngizilahle phezu kwezithombe zenu ezifihlikileyo; umphefumulo wami uyonengwa yini.
Ngiyakuyenza imizi yenu ukuba ibhidlizwe, ngizenze izindawo zenu ezingcwele zibe yincithakalo; angiyukuhogela unqambothi lwephunga lenu elimnandi.
Ngiyakulenza izwe libe yincithakalo; izitha zenu ezihlala kulo ziyakumangala ngalokhu.
Nina ngiyakunihlakazela phakathi kwezizwe, ngithumele inkemba emva kwenu, izwe lakini liyakuba yincithakalo, nemizi yenu ibe ngamabibi.
Ngaleso sikhathi izwe liyakuthokoza ngamasabatha alo ngesikhathi lisele liyincithakalo, nina niyobe nisezweni lezitha zenu ngaleso sikhathi; izwe liyakuphumula, lithokoze ngamasabatha alo.
Ngesikhathi lihlezi liyincithakalo liyakuphumula, ukuphumula elingakutholi ngamasabatha enu, lapho nihlezi kulo.

“ ‘Abayosala phakathi kwenu, ngiyakubehlisela indumalo ezinhliziyweni zabo, besemazweni ezitha zabo. Bayakuxoshwa ngisho nangukuhashaza kweqabunga lipheshethwa ngumoya, babaleke njengomuntu ebalekela inkemba, bawe kungekho obaxoshayo.
Bayakukhubeka omunye ekhutshwa ngomunye kungathi babalekela inkemba, kodwa kube kungekho muntu obaxoshayo. Aniyukuba namandla okuma phambi kwezitha zenu.
Niyakubhubha phakathi kwezizwe, izwe lezitha zenu linishwabadele.
Insali yabakini iyogcugca iphelele ezweni lezitha zenu, nazo ziyobhubha ngenxa yobubi boyise.
“ ‘Bayakubuvuma ububi babo nobubi bokhokho babo okwathi ekungethembekeni kwabo, benza ukungethembeki kimi, baqhubeka bamelena nami.
Nami ngokunjalo ngamelana nabo, ngabayisa ezweni lezitha zabo. Uma ngaleso sikhathi izinhliziyo zabo ezingasokile zithobeka, bekhombisa ukuphenduka ngobubi babo,
ngiyakusikhumbula isivumelwano sami noJakobe, nesivumelwano sami no-Isaka, nesivumelwano sami no-Abhrahama. Ngiyakusikhumbula, ngilikhumbule nezwe.

Bayakulishiya izwe, lithokoze ngamasabatha alo lisahlezi liyincithakalo, kungekho muntu kulo. Bona besamukeliswa isijeziso sobubi babo, ngokuba balahla izehlulelo zami, umphefumulo wabo wanengwa yizimiso zami.
Kepha nalapho besesezweni lezitha zabo angiyukubalahla, angiyukunengwa yibo ukuba ngingaze ngibaqothule, ngephule isivumelwano sami nabo, ngokuba nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo.
Ngenxa yabo ngiyosikhumbula isivumelwano nokhokho babo engabakhipha eGibhithe phambi kwezizwe, ukuba ngibe nguNkulunkulu wabo; nginguSimakade.’ ”
Lezi yizimiso nezehlulelo nemithetho okwamiswa nguSimakade phakathi kwakhe nabantu bakwa-Israyeli entabeni iSinayi, ngesandla sikaMose.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Uma umuntu enquma ukwenza isithembiso esithile kuSimakade, esiyisilinganiso ngomuntu,
isilinganiso ngowesilisa siyakuba: kusukela eminyakeni engama-20 kuya kwengama-60 siyakuba ngamashekeli esiliva angama-50 ngokwesilinganiso seshekeli lasendaweni engcwele.
Uma kungowesifazane, isilinganiso kuyakuba ngamashekeli angama-30.
Uma kungowesilisa oneminyaka emihlanu kuya kwengama-20, kuyakuba ngokulinganisa kwenu ngowesilisa amashekeli angama-20, kowesifazane amashekeli alishumi.
Uma kungowesilisa onenyanga kuya eminyakeni emihlanu, ngokwesilinganiso senu kuyakuba ngamashekeli ayisihlanu esiliva, owesifazane kube ngamashekeli amathathu esiliva.
Uma kungowesilisa oneminyaka engama-60 kuya phezulu kuyakuba ngamashekeli ali-15, uma kungowesifazane kube ngamashekeli alishumi.
Kepha uma owethembisayo empofu, uyoyiswa kumphristi, umphristi uyomlinganisela ngokwamandla akhe lowo owenze isithembiso.
“ ‘Uma kuyisilwane bazakunikela ngaso kuSimakade, noma yisiphi esinjalo siyakuba ngcwele kuSimakade.

Akayukuzishintshanisa, futhi akayukuzenana ngezinye, noma kungaba ngesihle ngesibi, noma ngesibi ngesihle; uma isilwane sinanwa ngesinye isilwane, zombili okungukuthi leso nokwenanwa ngaso ziyakuba ngcwele.
Uma kuyisilwane esingcolile okungenikelwe ngaso kuSimakade, isilwane siyakulethwa phambi komphristi,
umphristi uyakusihlola ukuze abone noma sihle noma sibi; njengalokho umphristi elinganisile, kuyakuba kanjalo.
Kodwa uma ethanda ngempela ukusihlenga, uyakuthasisela okwesihlanu kwaso kukho okulinganisiweyo.
“ ‘Uma umuntu eyakwehlukanisa indlu yakhe ibe ngcwele kuSimakade, umphristi uyakuyilinganisa ukubona ukuthi yinhle noma yimbi; njengalokhu umphristi eyilinganisile, kuyakuba kanjalo.
Uma oyingcwelisayo ethanda ukuyihlenga indlu yakhe, uyakuthasisela okwesihlanu kwemali yokulinganiswa, bese iba ngeyakhe.
“ ‘Uma umuntu engcwelisela uSimakade ingxenye yensimu eyifa lakhe, ukulinganiswa kwayo kuyakuba njengokukhiqiza kwayo, kube ngamashekeli angama-50 esiliva ehomere lebhali.
Uma engcwelisa insimu yakhe kusukela ngonyaka wejubhili, ukulinganisa kwakhe kuyakuma.
Kepha uma engcwelisa insimu yakhe ngemuva kwejubhili, umphristi uyombalela imali ngokweminyaka eseleyo kuze kufike unyaka wejubhili, bese kususwa lokho okulinganisiwe.
Uma ongcwelisa insimu ethanda ngempela ukuyihlenga, uyakuthasisela kuyo okwesihlanu kwemali yokulinganiswa kwayo, bese ibuyela kuye.
Kodwa uma engayihlengi insimu yakhe, noma eyithengisele omunye umuntu, akasayukukwazi ukuyihlenga.
Lapho insimu isikhululwa ngonyaka wejubhili, njengensimu enikelwe, iyakuba ngcwele kuSimakade; ibe yifa lomphristi.
“ ‘Uma umuntu engcwelisa kuSimakade insimu ayithengileyo, okungesiyo ingxenye yefa lakhe,
umphristi uyakumbalela isamba sayo kuze kufike unyaka wejubhili, intengo eyakukhokhwa ngalolo lusuku, iyakuba ngcwele kuSimakade.
Ngonyaka wejubhili insimu iyakubuyela kulowo eyayithengwe kuye, kulowo eyifa lakhe.
Konke ukulinganisa kuyakuba ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; amagera angama-20 ayakuba yishekeli.
“ ‘Amazibulo ezilwane, njengamazibulo angakaSimakade, awanakungcweliswa muntu; noma ngabe eliyinkabi noma eliyimvu, angakaSimakade.
Uma kungelesilwane esingcolileyo, uyakulihlenga ngenkathi lilinganiswa, uyothasisela okwesihlanu kwakho; uma lingahlengwa, kuyakuthengiswa ngalo lapho lilinganiswa.

“ ‘Nokho yonke into enikelwe, umuntu ayahlukanisele uSimakade kukho konke anakho, kungaba ngabantu, noma yizilwane, noma yinsimu eyifa lakhe, akuyukuthengiswa, futhi akunakuhlengwa; konke okunikelwe kungcwelengcwele kuSimakade.
“ ‘Umuntu oqalekisiweyo phakathi kwabantu akasoze ahlengwa; uyobulawa nokubulawa.
“ ‘Konke okweshumi kwezwe, okwembewu noma okwezithelo zemithi yezwe, kungokukaSimakade; kungcwele kuSimakade.
Uma umuntu efuna ukuhlenga okuthile kokweshumi kwakhe, uyakuthasisela kukho okwesihlanu kwakho.
Konke okweshumi kwezinkomo noma okwezimvu, konke okuyakudlula ngaphansi kwenduku yomelusi kubalwa okweshumi, kuyakuba ngcwele kuSimakade.
Akayukukuhlola ukuthi kuhle noma kubi, akayukukwenana ngokunye, kepha uma ngempela ekwenana ngokunye, kona naloko okwenanwa ngakho kuyakuba ngcwele; akuyukuhlengwa.’ ”
Le yimiyalo uSimakade ayala ngayo uMose ngabantu bakwa-Israyeli entabeni iSinayi.
Ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga yesibili ngonyaka, wesibili abakwa-Israyeli bephumile eGibhithe, uSimakade wakhuluma kuMose ehlane iSinayi ethendeni lokuhlangana, wathi:
“Bala yonke inhlangano yabantu bakwa-Israyeli ngemindeni yabo nangezindlu zokhokho, ngokwenani lamagama, bonke abesilisa ngezinhloko zabo;
kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, bonke kwa-Israyeli asebekwazi ukuphuma baye empini, wena no-Aroni, niyobabala ngamaviyo abo.
Kuleso naleso sizwana niqoke umuntu abe munye, abe yinhloko yendlu yokhokho bakhe.
Nanka amagama amadoda azonisiza: “kwaRubeni: u-Elizuri indodana kaShedewuri.
KwaSimeyoni: uShelumiyeli indodana kaZurishadayi.
KwaJuda: uNaheshoni indodana ka-Aminadaba.
Kwa-Isakhare: uNethaneli indodana kaZuwari.
KwaZebuloni: u-Eliyabe indodana kaHeloni.
Kumadodana kaJosefa: kwa-Efrayimi: u-Elishama indodana ka-Amihudi; kwaManase: uGamaliyeli indodana kaPhedazuri.
KwaBhenjamini: u-Abhidani indodana kaGideyoni.
KwaDani: u-Ahiyezeri indodana ka-Amishadayi.
Kwa-Asheri: uPhagiyeli indodana ka-Okhirani.
KwaGadi: u-Eliyasafa indodana kaDehuweli.
KwaNafethali: u-Ahira indodana ka-Enani.”
Yilaba ababizwa enhlanganweni, abaholi bezizwana zokhokho; babeyizinhloko zemindeni yakwa-Israyeli.
UMose no-Aroni bathatha lawa madoda ayebizwe ngamagama,

ngosuku lokuqala enyangeni yesibili, baqoqa yonke inhlangano, base bebabhalisa ngokokhokho babo, ngemindeni yabo, nangokwezindlu zokhokho babo. Wonke amagama abantu besilisa abaneminyaka engama-20 nangaphezulu abhalwa, futhi abalwa,
njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose, wababala ehlane iSinayi.

Abozalo lukaRubeni izibulo lika-Israyeli, nazo zonke izizwe zakwa-Israyeli, ngokolibo lwabo, ngemindeni yabo nangokwezizwana zokhokho babo, ngokwenani lamagama, bonke abesilisa ababeneminyaka engama-20 nangaphezulu abase bengaya empini:
labo ababalwayo kubo, abesizwana sakwaRubeni, babeyizi-46 500.

Abozalo lukaSimeyoni, ngokolibo lwemindeni yabo nangezindlu zawoyise, labo ababalwayo kubo njengokomumo wamagama, ngezinhloko zabo, bonke abesilisa, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma impi:
labo ababalwayo kubo, abesizwana sakwaSimeyoni, babeyizi-59 300.
Abozalo lukaGadi, ngokolibo lwemindeni yabo nangezindlu zawoyise njengokomumo wamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma impi:
labo ababalwayo kubo, abesizwana sakwaGadi, babeyizi-45 650.
Abozalo lukaJuda, ngokolibo lwemindeni yabo nangezindlu zawoyise njengokomumo wamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma impi:
labo ababalwayo kubo, abesizwe sakwaJuda, babeyizi-74 600.
Abozalo luka-Isakhare, ngokolibo lwemindeni yabo nangezindlu zawoyise njengokomumo wamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma impi:
labo ababalwayo kubo, abesizwe sakwa-Isakhare, babeyizi-54 400.
Abozalo lukaZebuloni, ngokolibo lwemindeni yabo nangezindlu zawoyise njengokomumo wamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma impi:
labo ababalwayo kubo, abesizwana sakwaZebuloni, babeyizi-57 400.
Abozalo lukaJosefa, okungukuthi uzalo lwabakwa-Efrayimi, ngokolibo lwemindeni yabo nangezindlu zawoyise njengokomumo wamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20, bonke abangaphuma impi:
labo ababalwayo kubo, abesizwana sakwa-Efrayimi, babeyizi-40 500.
Abozalo lukaManase, ngokolibo lwemindeni yabo nangezindlu zawoyise njengokomumo wamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma impi:
labo ababalwayo kubo, abesizwana sakwaManase, babeyizi-32 200.
Abozalo lukaBhenjamini, ngokolibo lwemindeni yabo nangezindlu zawoyise njengokomumo wamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma impi:
labo ababalwayo kubo, abesizwana sakwaBhenjamini, babeyizi-35 400.
Abozalo lukaDani, ngokolibo lwemindeni yabo nangezindlu zawoyise njengokomumo wamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma impi:
labo ababalwayo kubo, abesizwana sakwaDani, babeyizi-62 700.
Abozalo luka-Asheri, ngokolibo lwemindeni yabo nangezindlu zawoyise njengokomumo wamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma impi:
labo ababalwayo kubo, abesizwana sakwa-Asheri, babeyizi-41 500.
Abozalo lukaNafethali, ngokolibo lwemindeni yabo nangezindlu zawoyise njengokomumo wamagama, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, bonke abangaphuma impi:
labo ababalwayo kubo, abesizwana sakwaNafethali, babeyizi-53 400.
Yilabo ababalwayo, ababalwa nguMose no-Aroni nabaholi bakwa-Israyeli, bengamadoda ali-12, kwaba yileyo naleyo yamela indlu kakhokho wayo.
Bonke ababalwayo kwabakwa-Israyeli ngezindlu zokhokho babo, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, bonke abakwa-Israyeli abangaphuma impi,
sebebonke ababalwayo babeyizi-603 550.
AbaLevi ababalwanga ngokwesizwana sokhokho babo njengezinye izizwana zakwa-Israyeli.
USimakade wayekhulume kuMose, wathi:
“Yisizwana sakwaLevi kuphela esingayukubalwa, awuyukusibala sona phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli.
Kunalokho uyakubabeka abaLevi bengamele ithabanakeli lobufakazi nayo yonke impahla yalo, bayakulithwala ithabanakeli nempahla yalo yonke, bakhonze kulo, bakhe amathende abo, balizungeze.
Lapho sekusukwa, abaLevi bayoliwisa ithabanakeli, kuthi lapho kukaniswa khona, babuye balimise; umfokazi oyosondela kulo uyakubulawa.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli bayakumisa amathende abo, kube yilowo nalowo enkanjini yabo, yilowo nalowo ngasebhaneleni labo, ngamaviyo abo.

AbaLevi bayomisa amathende abo azungeze ithabanakeli lobufakazi, ukuze ulaka lungehleli phezu kwenhlangano yabantu bakwa-Israyeli. AbaLevi bayakufeza yonke imisebenzi yokuqapha ithabanakeli lobufakazi.”
Abakwa-Israyeli benza konke njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose no-Aroni, wathi:
“Makube yilowo nalowo kubantu bakwa-Israyeli akanise ngasebhaneleni lakhe ngasezimpawini zezindlu zokhokho bakhe; bayakukanisa nxazonke babhekane nethende lokuhlangana.”
Abakanisa ngasempumalanga ngalapho kuphuma khona ilanga kuyakuba ngabebhanela lenkambu yakwaJuda ngamabandla abo; umholi wabozalo lwabakwaJuda kunguNaheshoni indodana ka-Aminadaba.
Ibutho lakhe nalabo ababalwayo kubo babeyizi-74 600.
Abakanisa eceleni kwakhe kuyakuba yisizwana sakwa-Isakhare. Umholi wabozalo lwabakwa-Isakhare kuyakuba nguNethaneli indodana kaZuwari;
ibandla lakhe nalabo ababalwayo kulo babeyizi-54 400.
Isizwana sakwaZebuloni: umholi wabozalo lwabakwaZebuloni kungu-Eliyabe indodana kaHeloni;
ibandla lakhe nalabo ababalwayo kulo babeyizi-57 400.
Bonke ababalwayo benkambu yakwaJuda babeyizi-186 400 ngamabandla abo. Labo bayakusuka kuqala.
Ibhanela lenkambu yakwaRubeni liyakuba ngaseningizimu ngamabandla abo; umholi wabozalo lwabakwaRubeni kungu-Elizuri indodana kaShedewuri.
Ibandla lakhe nalabo ababalwayo kulo babeyizi-46 500.
Abakanisa eceleni kwakhe ngabesizwana sakwaSimeyoni; umholi wabozalo lwabakwaSimeyoni kunguShelumiyeli indodana kaZurishadayi.
Ibandla lakhe nalabo ababalwayo kubo babeyizi-59 300.
Isizwana sakwaGadi: umholi wabozalo lwabakwaGadi kungu-Eliyasafa indodana kaRehuweli.
Ibandla lakhe nalabo ababalwayo kubo babeyizi-45 650.
Bonke ababalwayo benkambu yabakwaRubeni babeyizi-151 450 ngamabandla abo. Labo bayakusuka babe ngabesibili.
Ithende lokuhlangana nenkambu yabaLevi kuyakusuka kube phakathi kwezinye izinkambu. Bayakusuka njengalokho bebekanisile, yilelo nalelo qembu endaweni yalo, ngokwamaviyo alo.
Ibhanela lenkambu yakwa-Efrayimi liyakuba ngasentshonalanga ngamabandla abo; umholo wabozalo lwabakwa-Efrayimi kuyakuba ngu-Elishama indodana ka-Amihudi.
Ibandla lakhe nalabo ababalwayo kubo babeyizi-40 500.
Eceleni kwakhe kuyakuba khona isizwana sakwaManase; umholi wabozalo lwabakaManase kunguGamaliyeli indodana kaPhedazuri.
Ibandla lakhe nalabo ababalwayo kubo babeyizi-32 200.
Isizwana sakwaBhenjamini; umholi wabozalo lwabakwaBhenjamini kungu-Abhidani indodana kaGideyoni.
Ibandla lakhe nalabo ababalwayo kubo babeyizi-35 400.
Sebebonke ababalwayo benkambu yabakwa-Efrayimi babeyizi-108 100 ngamabandla abo. Labo bayakusuka babe ngabesithathu.
Ibhanela lenkambu yakwaDani liyakuba ngasenyakatho ngamabandla abo; umholi wabozalo lwabakwaDani kungu-Ahiyezeri indodana ka-Amishadayi.
Ibandla lakhe nalabo ababalwayo kubo babeyizi-62 700.
Abakanisa eceleni kwakhe kwakuyisizwana sakwa-Asheri; umholi wabozalo lwabakwa-Asheri kunguPhagiyeli indodana ka-Okhirani.
Ibandla lakhe nalabo ababalwayo kubo babeyizi-41 500.
Isizwana sakwaNafethali: umholi wabozalo lwabakwaNafethali kungu-Ahira indodana ka-Enani.
Ibutho lakhe nalabo ababalwayo kubo babeyizi-53 400.
Sebebonke ababalwayo benkambu yakwaDani babeyizi-157 600. Labo bayakusuka babe ngabokugcina namabhanela abo.
Yilaba-ke ababalwa kubantu bakwa-Israyeli ngezindlu zokhokho babo. Bonke ababalwa enkanjini ngamaviyo abo babeyizi-603 550.
AbaLevi ababalwanga phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli benza njengakho konke uSimakade ayemyale ngakho uMose: bakanisa ngasemabhaneleni abo, basuka ngokwemindeni yabo, yilowo nalowo ngokwendlu yokhokho bakhe.
Laba ngabozalo luka-Aroni no-Mose ngosuku uSimakade akhuluma ngalo noMose entabeni iSinayi.
Lawa ngamagama amadodana ka-Aroni: nguNadabi izibulo, u-Abhihu, u-Eleyazare no-Ithamari.
Yilawo-ke amagama amadodana ka-Aroni ayegcotshwe aba ngabaphristi abehlukaniselwe ukukhonza bengabaphristi.

UNadabi no-Abhihu bafa phambi kukaSimakade, ngesikhathi benikela kuSimakade ngomlilo ongafanele ehlane iSinayi; babengenamadodana. U-Eleyazare no-Ithamari bakhonza bengabaphristi phambi kukayise u-Aroni.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Sondeza isizwana sakwaLevi, usimise phambi kuka-Aroni, umphristi, ukuba simsize.
Siyokwenza imisebenzi yakhe neyenhlangano yonke phambi kwethende lokuhlangana, siyokwenza nemisebenzi yethabanakeli.
Bayakunakekela yonke impahla yethende lokuhlangana nemisebenzi yabantu bakwa-Israyeli, senze umsebenzi wethabanakeli.
Uyakwethula abaLevi ku-Aroni nakumadodana akhe; bayokwethulwa kuye impela, bevela kubantu bakwa-Israyeli.
Uyoqoka u-Aroni namadodana akhe ukuba benze umsebenzi wobuphristi; umfokazi oyosondela kubo, uyakubulawa.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Mina ngibakhiphile abaLevi phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli esikhundleni samazibulo wonke avula isibeletho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli; abaLevi bayokuba ngabami.

Ngokuba wonke amazibulo angawami. Kusukela ngosuku engabulala ngalo wonke amazibulo eGibhithe, ngazehlukanisela wonke amazibulo akwa-Israyeli ukuba abe ngawami; kusukela kwawabantu kuya kwawezilwane. Ayokuba ngawami; nginguSimakade.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose ehlane iSinayi, wathi:
“Bala abozalo lwabaLevi ngezindlu zokhokho babo nangemindeni yabo; uyobala bonke abesilisa, kusukela konenyanga kuya phezulu.”
UMose wababala abaLevi njengezwi likaSimakade, njengalokhu ayemyalile uSimakade.
Lawa ngamadodana kaLevi ngamagama awo: uGereshoni, uKhohathi noMerari.
Lawa ngamagama amadodana kaGereshoni ngemindeni yawo: uLibhini noShimeyi.
Amadodana kaKhohathi ngemindeni yawo: u-Amramu, uJizihari, uHebhroni no-Uziyeli.
Amadodana kaMerari ngemindeni yawo: uMaheli noMushi. Leyo yimindeni yabaLevi ngezindlu zokhokho babo.
KuGereshomi kwavela umndeni kaLibhini nokaShimeyi, lena yiyona imindeni yakwaGereshoni.
Inani labo bonke abesilisa ababalwayo, kusukela konenyanga kuya phezulu, babeyizi-7 500.
Imindeni kaGereshoni iyakukanisa emva kwethabanakeli ngasentshonalanga.
Umholi wendlu kaGereshoni kwakungu-Eliyasafa indodana kaLayeli.
Umsebenzi wabozalo lwabakaGereshoni ethendeni lokuhlangana kwakungukunakekela ithabanakeli, ithende, isembozo salo, nekhethini elalisemnyango wethende lokuhlangana,
namakhethini asegcekeni nekhethini elisemnyango wegceke elizungeze ithabanakeli ne-althare, izintambo zalo, nayo yonke imisebenzi ephathelene nalezo zinto.
KuKhohathi kwavela le mindeni: oka-Amramu, okaJizihari, okaHebhroni noka-Uziyeli. Yilena imindeni kaKhohathi.
Inani labo bonke abesilisa, kusukela konenyanga kuya phezulu, babeyizi-8 600.
Imindeni yabozalo lwabakwaKhohathi iyakukanisa ohlangothini oluseningizimu lwethabanakeli.
Umholi wemindeni yamaKhohathi kwakungu-Elizafani indodana ka-Uziyeli.
Umsebenzi wabo kwakungukugcina umphongolo, itafula, uthi lwezibani, ama-althare, izitsha ezisetshenziswa endaweni engcwele, ikhethini nayo yonke imisebenzi eyayenziwa ngalezo zinto.
U-Eleyazare, indodana ka-Aroni, umphristi uyokwengamela abaLevi, abheke abenza imisebenzi endaweni engcwele.
KuMerari kwavela le mindeni: okaMaheli nokaMushi. Lena kwakuyimindeni kaMerari.
Inani labo bonke abesilisa ababalwa, kusukela konenyanga kuya phezulu, babeyizi-6 200.
Umholi wendlu kakhokho wemindeni yamaMerari kwakunguZuriyeli, indodana ka-Abhihayili, bona bayakukanisa ohlangothini olungasenyakatho lwethabanakeli.
Umsebenzi owawumiselwe abozalo lwakwaMerari kwakungukunakekela amapulangwe ethabanakeli: imishayo, izinsika, izisekelo zalo, nazo zonke izimpahla zalo, nayo yonke imisebenzi eyayenziwa ngalezo zinto.
Babebuye banakekele izinsika zegceke nxazonke, izisekelo, izikhonkwane, nezintambo zalo.

Ababekanise ngaphambi kwethabanakeli ngasempumalanga, phambi kwethende lokuhlangana lapho kuphuma khona ilanga, kwakunguMose, u-Aroni namadodana akhe. Umsebenzi wabo kwakungukwenza izinkonzo endaweni engcwele, bagcine umsebenzi wabantu bakwa-Israyeli; umfokazi oyosondela kubo uyobulawa.
Inani elabalwa nguMose no-Aroni kubo bonke abaLevi, kusukela konenyanga kuya phezulu, ngokwemindeni yabo njengalokhu uSimakade ayeshilo, kwakuyizi-22 000.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Bala wonke amazibulo esilisa abantu bakwa-Israyeli, kusukela kwabanenyanga kuya phezulu, uwabhalise ngamagama awo,
ungithathele abaLevi esikhundleni samazibulo wonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli, nawemfuyo; nginguSimakade.”
UMose wawabala wonke amazibulo abantu bakwa-Israyeli, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile.
Wonke amazibulo awabalayo kusukela kwabanenyanga kuya phezulu, ayeyizi-22 273.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Thatha abaLevi esikhundleni samazibulo wonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli, nemfuyo yabaLevi esikhundleni samazibulo emfuyo yabo, ngokuba abaLevi bangabami; nginguSimakade.
Ukuze uhlenge abangama-273 bamazibulo abantu bakwa-Israyeli abangaphezu kwabaLevi,
uyakuthatha amashekeli ayisihlanu ngenhloko ngayinye, lawo ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele. Uyothatha ishekeli elingamagera angama-20;
uyonika u-Aroni namadodana akhe leyo mali eyisihlengo salabo okweqe ngabo.”
UMose wathatha imali eyisihlengo salabo okwakweqe ngabo kulabo ababehlengwe ngabaLevi,
emazibulweni abantu bakwa-Israyeli wathatha imali engamashekeli ayi-1 365 ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele.
UMose wayinika u-Aroni namadodana akhe imali yesihlengo njengezwi likaSimakade, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose no-Aroni, wathi:
“Balani bonke abozalo lukaKhohathi, abaphakathi kwabozalo lukaLevi ngokwemindeni yabo nangokwezindlu zokhokho babo,
kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-30 kuya phezulu, kuze kufike kwabaneminyaka engama-50, bonke abangena ukuzokwenza umsebenzi ethendeni lokuhlangana.
“Umsebenzi wabozalo lukaKhohathi ethendeni lokuhlangana umayelana nezinto ezingcwelengcwele.
Uma inkambu ithutha, u-Aroni uyakungena namadodana akhe, behlise ikhethini elihenqile, bamboze ngalo umphongolo wobufakazi.
Bayowumboza ngaphezulu ngesikhumba samahlengethwa, bendlale indwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka phezu kwaso, bese befaka izingongolo zawo.
“Phezu kwetafula lezinkwa zobukhona, bayakwendlala indwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, babeke kuyo izingqwembe, izinkezo, izinkamba, nezindebe zomnikelo wokuphuzwayo; kuhlale kunesinkwa phezu kwalo.
Bayakwendlala phezu kwazo indwangu ebomvu, bayemboze ngesikhumba samahlengethwa, bese befaka izingongolo zalo.
“Bayakuthatha indwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, bamboze uthi lwezibani, nezibani zalo, izindlawu zalo, izitsha zalo zomlotha, nazo zonke izitsha zamafutha abazisebenzisa kulo;
bayakulufaka nezinto zalo zonke esikhumbeni samahlengethwa, bese bekubeka konke ohlakeni.
“Phezu kwe-althare legolide bayokwendlala indwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, bayemboze ngesikhumba samahlengethwa, bese befaka izingongolo zalo.
“Bayothatha zonke izimpahla zokukhonza abakhonza ngazo endaweni engcwele, bazifake endwangwini eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, bazemboze ngesikhumba samahlengethwa, bazibeke ohlakeni.
“Bayakususa umlotha e-althare, bendlale phezu kwalo indwangu ebukhwebezane,

babeke kuyo zonke izimpahla zalo abakhonza ngazo kulo, imicengezi yempepho, izimfologo, amafosholo, nezimpahla zonke ze-althare, bendlale phezu kwazo isembozo sesikhumba samahlengethwa, bese befaka izingongolo zalo.

“Nxa u-Aroni namadodana akhe sebeqedile ukwemboza indawo engcwele nempahla yonke yendawo engcwele, lapho inkambu seyithutha, kuyakuza abozalo lukaKhohathi ukuzokuthwala, kodwa abayukuthinta lutho olungcwele ngokuba bayokufa. Lezi zinto zingumthwalo wabozalo lukaKhohathi ethendeni lokuhlangana.

“U-Eleyazare, indodana ka-Aroni umphristi, uyakulungisa amafutha okukhanyisa impepho ethaphukayo, umnikelo wokusanhlamvu wemihla ngemihla, namafutha okugcoba futhi anakekele ithabanakeli lonke nakho konke okukulo; indawo engcwele nempahla yayo.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose no-Aroni, wathi:
“Niqikelele ukuba isizwana semindeni kaKhohathi singapheli phakathi kwabaLevi,
kodwa niyakubaphatha kanje ukuze baphile, bangafi uma besondela ezintweni ezingcwelengcwele: u-Aroni namadodana akhe bayongena babanikeze yilowo nalowo umsebenzi wakhe nomthwalo wakhe.
Abanakungena ukuba babuke okungcwele ngisho umzuzwana nje, funa bafe.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Bala inani labozalo lukaGereshoni ngokwezindlu zokhokho babo nangemindeni yabo,
kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-30 kuya phezulu, kuze kufike kwabaneminyaka engama-50, bonke abangena ukuyokwenza umsebenzi ethendeni lokuhlangana.
“Nanku umsebenzi wemindeni kaGereshoni, ngowokukhonza nowokuthwala:
bayakuthwala amakhethini ethabanakeli, ithende lokuhlangana, isembozo salo, isembozo esiyisikhumba samahlengethwa esiphezu kwalo, isihenqo esisemnyango wethende lokuhlangana,

amakhethini asegcekeni, isihenqo somnyango wesango legceke elingasethabanakelini nase-althare nxazonke, izintambo zalo, nayo yonke impahla abayisebenzisayo; bayokwenza konke okudinga ukwenziwa maqondana nabo.
Yonke imisebenzi yabozalo lwamaGerishoni nakho konke abakwenzayo nabayokwenza, kuyoya njengokuyala kuka-Aroni namadodana akhe, bayakuwamisela imisebenzi okumele ayenze.
Yilowo umsebenzi wemindeni yabozalo lwamaGereshoni ethendeni lokuhlangana, ebayakuyigcina phansi kwesandla sika-Ithamari, indodana ka-Aroni umphristi.
“Abozalo lukaMerari uyobabala ngemindeni yabo nangezindlu zokhokho babo;
kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-30 kuya phezulu, kuze kube kwabaneminyaka engama-50, uyobabala bonke abangena ukuyokwenza umsebenzi ethendeni lokuhlangana.
Nakhu abayalwa ukuba bakwenze, okungumsebenzi wabo ethendeni lokuhlangana: ukuthwala amapulangwe ethabanakeli, imishayo yalo, izinsika zalo, izinyawo zalo,
izinsika zegceke nxazonke, izisekelo zalo, izikhonkwane zalo, izintambo zalo, impahla yalo yonke, nomsebenzi walo wonke, niyoyisho ngamagama impahla okufanele bayithwale.
Yilowo umsebenzi wemindeni yabozalo lukaMerari abamiselwe ukuwenza ethendeni lokuhlangana phansi kwesandla sika-Ithamari, indodana ka-Aroni umphristi.”
UMose, u-Aroni nabaholi benhlangano, babala abozalo lukaKhohathi ngemindeni yabo nangezindlu zokhokho babo,
kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-30 kuze kube kwabeneminyaka engama-50, bonke abangena ukwenza umsebenzi wokukhonza ethendeni lokuhlangana.
Labo ababalwa ngemindeni yabo babeyizi-2 750.
Yilabo ababalwayo, bemindeni yamaKhohathi, bonke abakhonza ethendeni lokuhlangana, ababalwa nguMose no-Aroni njengesiyalezo sikaSimakade ngesandla sikaMose.
Labo ababalwayo bozalo lukaGereshoni ngemindeni yabo nangezindlu zokhokho babo,
kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-30 kuze kube kwabaneminyaka engama-50, bonke abangena emsebenzini wokukhonza ethendeni lokuhlangana,
labo ababalwayo kubo ngemindeni yabo nangezindlu zokhokho babo, babeyizi-2 630.
Yilabo ababalwayo bemindeni yozalo lukaGereshoni, bonke abakhonza ethendeni lokuhlangana, ababalwa nguMose no-Aroni njengesiyalezo sikaSimakade.
Labo ababalwayo, bemindeni yozalo lukaMerari ngemindeni yabo nangezindlu zokhokho babo,
kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-30 kuze kube kwabaneminyaka engama-50, bonke abangena emsebenzini wokukhonza ethendeni lokuhlangana,
labo ababalwayo kubo ngemindeni yabo, babeyizi-3 200.
Yilabo ababalwayo, bemindeni yozalo lukaMerari, ababalwa nguMose no-Aroni njengokusho kukaSimakade ngesandla sikaMose.
Bonke ababalwayo babaLevi, ababalwa nguMose no-Aroni nabaholi bakwa-Israyeli ngemindeni yabo nangezindlu zokhokho babo,
kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-30 kuze kube kwabaneminyaka engama-50, bonke abangena ukwenza umsebenzi wenkonzo nomsebenzi wokuthwala ethendeni lokuhlangana,
labo ababalwayo kubo, babeyizi-8 580.
Babalwa-ke njengesiyalezo sikaSimakade kuMose, kwaba yilowo nalowo emsebenzini wakhe nasemthwalweni wakhe. Babalwa kanjalo-ke, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yala abantu bakwa-Israyeli ukuba babakhiphe enkanjini bonke abanochoko, nabo bonke abamfimfayo, nabangcoliswe wukuthinta abafileyo.
Niyokhiphela ngaphandle kwenkambu abesilisa nabesifazane, ukuze bangalingcolisi inkambu engihlala kulo.”
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli benza kanjalo, babakhiphela ngaphandle kwenkambu; njengalokhu uSimakade ayekhulume noMose, benza kanjalo-ke abantu bakwa-Israyeli.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Uma owesilisa noma owesifazane benza isono esivame esintwini sonke, baphambuke kuSimakade, lowo muntu uyoba necala.
Uyovuma isono sakhe asenzileyo, akhokhe isinxephezelo ngaso, anezelele kuso isamba esingokwesihlanu, asinike lowo amonile.
Uma umuntu owoniweyo engenasihlobo okungakhokhwa kuso isinxephezelo, isinxephezelo esikhokhwa kuSimakade siyoba ngesomphristi, ngaphandle kwenqama yokubuyisana ayokwenzelwa ngayo ukubuyisana.
Yonke iminikelo yezinto ezingcwele zabantu bakwa-Israyeli abayoyinikela kumphristi, iyakuba ngeyakhe.
Izinto zonke ezingcwele ziyakuba ngezakhe, nakho konke abayakukunikela kumphristi kuyokuba ngokwakhe.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Uma umfazi womuntu ephambuka, angethembeki kuye,
alale nenye indoda, immithise, kufihleke endodeni yakhe, futhi angabanjwa, uzingcolisile, noma ngabe akukho fakazi nokho ngaye, futhi engabanjwanga egila lo mkhuba.
Uma indoda yakhe iba nesikhwele ngomkayo ozingcolisile, noma ifikelwe yisikhwele ngomkayo ongazingcolisanga,

indoda iyakuletha umkayo kumphristi, imlethele umnikelo wakhe, ube okweshumi kwe-efa lempuphu yebhali, ayiyukuthela amafutha kuyo, noma ibeke nenhlaka kuyo, ngokuba kungumnikelo wokusanhlamvu wesikhwele, umnikelo wokusanhlamvu wesikhumbuzo, wokuzikhumbuza ngobubi.
“ ‘Umphristi uyakumsondeza, ammise phambi kukaSimakade.
Umphristi uyothatha amanzi angcwele esitsheni sebumba, nothuli oluphansi ethabanakelini. Uyakuluthatha alufake emanzini,

umphristi uyommisa owesifazane phambi kukaSimakade, athukulule izinwele zekhanda lowesifazane, abeke umnikelo wokusanhlamvu wesikhumbuzo ezandleni zakhe, umnikelo wokusanhlamvu wesikhwele; kuthi esandleni somphristi kube namanzi ababayo aletha isiqalekiso.
Umphristi uyomfungisa owesifazane, athi: “Uma kungekho ndoda elale nawe, uma ungaphambukelanga ekungcoleni usephansi kwendoda yakho, khululeka kulawa manzi ababayo aletha isiqalekiso,
kodwa uma uphambukile usephansi kwendoda yakho, futhi uzingcolisile, walala nenye indoda engesiye umyeni wakho,”
umphristi uyomfungisa owesifazane ngesifungo sesiqalekiso, athi: “USimakade makakwenze isiqalekiso nesifungo sesiqalekiso kwabakini; uSimakade ashwabanise ithanga lakho, avuvukalise nesisu sakho;
lawa manzi aletha isiqalekiso, ayongena ezibilini zakho, avuvukalise isisu sakho, ashwabanise ithanga lakho;” owesifazane uyakuthi: “Amen! Amen!”
“ ‘Umphristi uyozibhala lezi ziqalekiso encwadini, azesule ngamanzi ababayo.
Uyomphuzisa owesifazane amanzi ababayo aletha isiqalekiso. Uyowaphuza amanzi ababayo angene kuye amlethele isiqalekiso sezinto ezibabayo.
Umphristi uyowuthatha esandleni sowesifazane umnikelo wokusanhlamvu wesikhwele, awuzungezise umnikelo wokusanhlamvu phambi kukaSimakade, awusondeze e-althare.
Umphristi uyowucaphuna ugcwale isandla umnikelo wokusanhlamvu, ube umnikelo oyisikhumbuzo, awushise e-althare andukuba aphuzise owesifazane amanzi.

Uma esemphuzisile amanzi, kuyakuthi uma ezingcolisile wenza ukungethembeki kumyeni wakhe, amanzi aletha isiqalekiso ayongena kuye, alethe isiqalekiso esibi, avuvukalise isisu sakhe, ashwabanise ithanga lakhe, owesifazane abe yisiqalekiso phakathi kwabakubo.
Kodwa uma engazingcolisanga, ehlambulukile, uyakukhululeka, akhulelwe, athole abantwana.
“ ‘Yilona umthetho wesikhwele, uma umfazi ephambukile esephansi kwendoda yakhe, wazingcolisa,
nalapho indoda ivukwa yisikhwele, iba nesikhwele ngomkayo: iyommisa owesifazane phambi kukaSimakade, umphristi enze kuye konke okubalulwa yilo mthetho.
Indoda iyakukhululeka ebubini, kodwa owesifazane uyobuthwala ububi bakhe.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Uma owesilisa noma owesifazane enza isithembiso esilukhuni sokuba ngumnaziri, abe ngumnaziri kuSimakade,

uyozehlukanisa newayini nophuzo olunamandla. Akayukuwuphuza uviniga wewayini, uviniga wophuzo olunamandla, akayukuphuza lutho lwezithelo zomvini, futhi akayukuwadla amagilebhisi asemasha noma omisiwe.
Zonke izinsuku zakhe njengomnaziri, akayukudla lutho olwenziwe ngewayini lezithelo zomvini, kusukela ezimbumbulwini kuze kufike emakhasini.
“ ‘Zonke izinsuku zesithembiso sakhe sobunaziri akuyukusondela nsingo ekhanda lakhe; uyoba ngcwele zize ziphelele izinsuku azehlukanisela ngazo kuSimakade, uyakuvumela ukuba nesihluthu ekhanda.
Akayukusondela esidunjini ngazo zonke izinsuku esengumnaziri kaSimakade.
Akayukuzingcolisa noma ngabe kufa uyise noma unina, noma umfowabo noma udadewabo, ngokuba isithembiso sakhe sobunaziri sisekhanda lakhe.
Ungcwele kuSimakade, zonke izinsuku zobunaziri bakhe.
“ ‘Uma umuntu efa ngokuzuma eceleni kwakhe, angcolise ikhanda lobunaziri bakhe, uyakuphuca ikhanda lakhe ngosuku lokuhlanjululwa kwakhe, aliphuce ngosuku lwesikhombisa.
Ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili uyoletha kumphristi amahobhe amabili noma amaphuphu amabili amajuba ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana.
Umphristi uyonikela ngelinye libe ngumnikelo wesono nelinye libe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, amenzele ukubuyisana, ngokuba wonile ngenxa yofileyo; angcwelise ikhanda lakhe ngalolo lusuku.
Izinsuku zakhe zobunaziri uyakuzehlukanisela uSimakade, alethe imvu yeduna enonyaka, ibe ngumnikelo wecala. Izinsuku zakhe zakuqala ziyoba yize, ngokuba ubunaziri bakhe bungcolisiwe.
“ ‘Nanku umthetho womnaziri lapho izinsuku zobunaziri bakhe seziphelele: uyakulethwa emnyango wethende lokuhlangana,

anikele ngomnikelo wakhe kuSimakade, imvu yeduna enonyaka engenasici, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa. Anikele nangensikazi engenasici enonyaka, ibe ngumnikelo wesono, inqama engenasici ibe ngumnikelo wokuthula,
iqoma lesinkwa esingenamvubelo, amaqebelengwane empuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe namafutha, namakhekheba angenamvubelo agcotshwe ngamafutha, nomnikelo wokusanhlamvu nowokuphuzwayo.
“ ‘Umphristi uyakukuletha phambi kukaSimakade, anikele ngomnikelo wakhe wesono nangowokushiswa.
Uyonikela ngenqama ibe ngumhlatshelo womnikelo wokuthula kuSimakade neqoma lesinkwa esingenamvubelo. Umphristi uyobuye anikele ngomnikelo wayo wokusanhlamvu nangowokuphuzwayo.
“ ‘Umnaziri uyophuca ikhanda lobunaziri bakhe ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana, athathe izinwele zekhanda lobunaziri bakhe, azibeke emlilweni ophansi komhlatshelo weminikelo yokuthula.
“ ‘Umphristi uyothatha umkhono wenqama ophekiweyo, neqebelengwane eqomeni, nekhekheba elingenamvubelo, akubeke ezandleni zomnaziri, ngesikhathi esephucule ubunaziri bakhe.
Umphristi akuzungezise, kube ngumnikelo wokuzungeziswa phambi kukaSimakade; lokhu kungcwele kumphristi nesifuba sokuzungeziswa nomlenze wokuzungeziswa. Emveni kwalokho umnaziri angaliphuza iwayini.

“ ‘Lowo ngumthetho womnaziri owenze isithembiso, nowomnikelo wakhe kuSimakade ngenxa yobunaziri bakhe, ngaphandle kokunye angaphumelela kukho. Njengesithembiso sakhe asenzayo, uyokwenza kanjalo, kungumthetho wobunaziri.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho ku-Aroni namadodana akhe, uthi kubo: ‘Niyakubabusisa abakwa-Israyeli, niyakuthi kubo:
“ ‘USimakade makakubusise, akulondoloze;
uSimakade makakhanyise ubuso bakhe kuwe, abe nomusa kuwe;
uSimakade makaphakamise ubuso bakhe phezu kwakho, akuphe ukuthula.’ ”
“Bayakulibeka kanjalo iGama lami phezu kwabakwa-Israyeli, Mina ngibabusise.”
Kwathi ngosuku uMose aqeda ngalo ukumisa ithabanakeli, waligcoba, walingcwelisa nayo yonke impahla yalo; wagcoba, wangcwelisa i-althare, nazo zonke izitsha zalo.
Izikhulu zakwa-Israyeli, izinhloko zezindlu zawoyise nabaholi bezizwe ababebekwe phezu kwababalwayo, zenza umnikelo.
Zaletha iminikelo yazo kuSimakade: izinqola eziyisithupha ezazimboziwe nezinkabi ezili-12, inqola eyodwa yabaholi ngababili nenkabi kumholi ngamunye, zakwethula kuSimakade.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Zemukele kuzo lezo zipho, ukuze zenze umsebenzi wokukhonza ethendeni lokuhlangana, uyozinika abaLevi kube yilowo nalowo ngokomsebenzi wakhe.”
UMose wathatha izinqola nezinkabi, wakunika abaLevi.
Izinqola ezimbili nezinkabi ezine wakunika abozalo lukaGereshoni ngokomsebenzi wabo.
Izinqola ezine nezinkabi eziyisishiyagalombili wakunika abozalo lukaMerari ngokomsebenzi wabo, ababephethwe ngu-Ithamari, indodana ka-Aroni, umphristi.
Abozalo lukaKhohathi abanikwanga lutho, ngokuba inkonzo yendlu engcwele yayingeyabo; isemahlombe abo.
Abaholi baletha futhi iminikelo yokungcweliswa kwe-althare ngosuku olwalumiselwe lokho. Abaholi bayiletha iminikelo yabo phambi kwe-althare,
uSimakade wathi kuMose: “Yilowo nalowo mholi uyakunikela ngomnikelo wakhe ngosuku lwakhe, ube ngowehlukaniselwe ukubusiswa kwe-althare.”
Ngosuku lokuqala uNaheshoni, indodana ka-Aminadaba wesizwana sakwaJuda, waletha umnikelo wakhe.

Wanikela ngoqwembe lwesiliva, isisindo salo singamashekeli ayi-130, nesitsha sesiliva esingumcengezi esingamashekeli angama-70 ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele. Kokubili kwakugcwele impuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe namafutha, kungumnikelo wokusanhlamvu,
isitsha segolide esingamashekeli ayishumi sigcwele impepho,
iduna, inqama, nemvu yeduna enonyaka, ukuze kube ngumnikelo wokushiswa,
nempongo ukuze kube ngumnikelo wesono.

Okomhlatshelo weminikelo yokuthula kwakuyilokhu: izinkabi ezimbili, izinqama eziyisihlanu, izimpongo eziyisihlanu, izimvu zamaduna ezinonyaka eziyisihlanu; yilokho-ke okwanikelwa nguNaheshoni, indodana ka-Aminadaba.
Ngosuku lwesibili kwanikela uNethaneli, indodana kaZuwari, umholi wabozalo luka-Isakhare.

Ngosuku lwesishiyagalolunye kwakungu-Abhidani, indodana kaGideyoni, umholi wabozalo lukaBhenjamini.

Wanikela ngesitsha sesiliva isisindo saso singamashekeli ayi-130, nesitsha sesiliva esingumcengezi esingamashekeli angama-70 ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele. Kokubili kwakugcwele impuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe namafutha, kungumnikelo wokusanhlamvu,
nesitsha segolide esingamashekeli ayishumi sigcwele impepho,
neduna, nenqama, nemvu yeduna enonyaka, kungumnikelo wokushiswa,
nempongo ukuze kube ngumnikelo wesono.

Okomhlatshelo weminikelo yokuthula kwakuyilokhu: izinkabi ezimbili, izinqama eziyisihlanu, izimpongo eziyisihlanu, izimvu zamaduna ezinonyaka eziyisihlanu; yilokho-ke okwanikelwa ngu-Abhidani, indodana kaGideyoni.
Ngosuku lweshumi kwakungu-Ahiyezeri, indodana ka-Amishadayi, umholi wabozalo lukaDani.

Wanikela ngesitsha sesiliva isisindo saso singamashekeli ayi-130, nesitsha sesiliva esingumcengezi esingamashekeli angama-70 ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele. Kokubili kwakugcwele impuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe namafutha, kungumnikelo wokusanhlamvu,
isitsha segolide esingamashekeli ayishumi sigcwele impepho,
iduna, inqama, imvu yeduna enonyaka, kungumnikelo wokushiswa,
nempongo ukuze kube ngumnikelo wesono.

Okomhlatshelo weminikelo yokuthula kwakuyilokhu: izinkabi ezimbili, izinqama eziyisihlanu, izimpongo eziyisihlanu, izimvu zamaduna ezinonyaka eziyisihlanu; yilokho-ke okwanikelwa ngu-Ahiyezeri, indodana ka-Amishadayi.
Ngosuku lwe-11 kwakunguPhagiyeli, indodana ka-Okhirani, umholi wabozalo luka-Asheri.

Wanikela ngesitsha sesiliva isisindo saso singamashekeli ayi-130, nesitsha sesiliva esingumcengezi esingamashekeli angama-70 ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele. Kokubili kwakugcwele impuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe namafutha, kungumnikelo wokusanhlamvu,
nesitsha segolide esingamashekeli ayishumi sigcwele impepho,
neduna, nenqama, nemvu yeduna enonyaka, kungumnikelo wokushiswa,
nempongo ukuze kube ngumnikelo wesono.

Okomhlatshelo weminikelo yokuthula kwakuyilokhu: izinkabi ezimbili, izinqama eziyisihlanu, izimpongo eziyisihlanu, izimvu zamaduna ezinonyaka eziyisihlanu; yilokho-ke okwanikelwa nguPhagiyeli, indodana ka-Okhirani.
Ngosuku lwe-12 kwakungu-Ahira, indodana ka-Enani, umholi wabozalo lukaNafethali.

Wanikela ngesitsha sesiliva isisindo saso singamashekeli ayi-130, nesitsha sesiliva esingumcengezi esingamashekeli angama-70 ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele. Kokubili kwakugcwele impuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe namafutha, kungumnikelo wokusanhlamvu,
isitsha segolide esingamashekeli ayishumi sigcwele impepho,
iduna, inqama, nemvu yeduna enonyaka, kungumnikelo wokushiswa,
nempongo ukuze kube ngumnikelo wesono.

Okomhlatshelo weminikelo yokuthula kwakuyilokhu: izinkabi ezimbili, izinqama eziyisihlanu, izimpongo eziyisihlanu, izimvu zamaduna ezinonyaka eziyisihlanu; yilokho-ke okwanikelwa ngu-Ahira, indodana ka-Enani.

Yilokhu-ke okwanikelwa ngabaholi bakwa-Israyeli ngosuku i-althare elangcweliswa ngalo lehlukaniselwa uSimakade: izitsha zesiliva ezili-12, izitsha zesiliva eziyimicengezi ezili-12, nezitsha zegolide ezili-12.

Yileso naleso sitsha sesiliva sasingamashekeli ayi-130, isitsha sesiliva esingumcengezi ngasinye singamashekeli angama-70. Selilonke isiliva elenza izitsha laba yizi-2 400 ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele.
Izitsha zegolide zili-12 zigcwele impepho, yileso naleso singamashekeli ayishumi ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele. Lonke igolide elenza izitsha lalingamashekeli ayi-120.
Zonke izinkomo ezenza umnikelo wokushiswa kwakuyizinkunzi ezili-12, izinqama ezili-12, izimvu ezingamaduna ezinonyaka ezili-12 nomnikelo wazo wokusanhlamvu, nezimpongo zomnikelo wesono ezili-12.

Sezizonke izinkomo ezenza umhlatshelo weminikelo yokuthula kwakuyizinkunzi ezingama-24, izinqama ezingama-60, izimpongo ezingama-60, nezimvu ezingamaduna ezingama-60. Lokhu kwakungumnikelo wokwehlukaniswa kwe-althare; mhla lingcweliswa.

Kwathi lapho uMose engena ethendeni lokuhlangana ukuyokhuluma noSimakade, wezwa izwi likhuluma naye livela phezu kwesihlalo somusa ngaphezu komphongolo wobufakazi phakathi kwamakherubhi amabili, wakhuluma naye.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho ku-Aroni uthi kuye: ‘Lapho ubeka izibani, izibani eziyisikhombisa ziyakukhanyisa phambi kothi lwezibani.’ ”
U-Aroni wenza kanjalo, wabeka izibani zalo ukuze zikhanyise phambi kothi lwezibani njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
