Uthi lwezibani lwalwakhiwe ngegolide elicangcathiweyo, kusukela esinqeni salo kuya ezimbalini zalo. Lalifana nse nomfanekiso uSimakade awubonisa uMose; walwenza kanjalo uthi lwezibani.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Thatha abaLevi kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, ubahlambulule.
Uyakubahlambulula kanje: bafafaze ngamanzi okuhlambulula, ubenze baphuce zonke iziboya ezisemizimbeni yabo, bahlanze izingubo zabo; bazihlambulule.
Bayothatha iduna nomnikelo wokusanhlamvu, impuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe namafutha. Uyothatha iduna lesibili libe ngumnikelo wesono.
Uyobaletha abaLevi phambi kwethende lokuhlangana, uqoqe yonke inhlangano yabantu bakwa-Israyeli.
Uyosondeza abaLevi phambi kukaSimakade, abantu bakwa-Israyeli babeke izandla zabo phezu kwamakhanda abo.
U-Aroni uyobaletha abaLevi phambi kukaSimakade babe ngumnikelo wokuzungeziswa ovela kubantu bakwa-Israyeli ukuze benze umsebenzi kaSimakade.
“AbaLevi bayobeka izandla zabo ezinhlokweni zamaduna, wena unikele ngelinye lawo libe ngumnikelo wesono, nangelinye libe ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuSimakade, ubenzele abaLevi ukubuyisana.
“AbaLevi uyakubabeka phambi kuka-Aroni namadodana akhe, unikele ngabo kuSimakade babe ngumnikelo wokuzungeziswa.
AbaLevi uyobehlukanisa phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli, abaLevi bayoba ngabami.
“Emveni kwalokho abaLevi bayongena ethendeni lokuhlangana ukuyokwenza inkonzo yalo. Uyakubahlambulula ubanikele, babe ngumnikelo wokuzungeziswa.
Banikelwe kimi bevela phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli, esikhundleni samazibulo wonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli, ngizithathele bona ukuba babe ngabami.
Wonke amazibulo phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli angawami, awabantu nawezilwane, ngazehlukanisela wona kusukela mhla ngibulala amazibulo wonke eGibhithe.
Nokho ngizithathele abaLevi esikhundleni sawo wonke amazibulo abantu bakwa-Israyeli.

AbaLevi ngibanike u-Aroni namadodana akhe ukuba abe yisipho sabo esivela kubantu bakwa-Israyeli ukuze benze umsebenzi wabantu bakwa-Israyeli ethendeni lokuhlangana, nokubenzela abakwa-Israyeli ukubuyisana, ukuze kungabi bikho sifo phakathi kwabo, lapho abantu bakwa-Israyeli besondela endaweni engcwele.”
UMose no-Aroni nayo yonke inhlangano yabantu bakwa-Israyeli, benza kubaLevi njengakho konke uSimakade ayeyale ngakho uMose ngabaLevi; abantu bakwa-Israyeli benza kanjalo-ke.
AbaLevi bazihlambulula, bahlanza nezingubo zabo. U-Aroni wayesebaletha njengomnikelo wokuzungeziswa phambi kukaSimakade, ukuze u-Aroni abenzele ukubuyisana, abahlambulule.
Emveni kwalokho abaLevi bahamba ukuyokwenza umsebenzi wabo ethendeni lokuhlangana phambi kuka-Aroni namadodana akhe, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose ngabo. Benza kanjalo-ke kubaLevi.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Nanku umsebenzi wabaLevi: kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-25 kuya phezulu, kwabayongena ukwenza umsebenzi wenkonzo ethendeni lokuhlangana.
Kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-50 bayoyeka ukwenza umsebenzi wenkonzo, abasayukuphinde bawenze futhi.
Kepha bangabasiza abafowabo ethendeni lokuhlangana ukuze bagcine imisebenzi yabo, nokho bona ngeke besawenza lowo msebenzi. Uyokwenza kanjalo-ke kubaLevi maqondana nemisebenzi yabo.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose ehlane iSinayi ngonyaka wesibili ngenyanga yokuqala bephumile eGibhithe, wathi:
“Abantu bakwa-Israyeli mabagcine iPhasika ngesikhathi salo esimisiweyo.
Ngosuku lwe-14 lwaleyo nyanga kusihlwa, niyakuligcina ngesikhathi esimisiweyo, njengokwazo zonke izimiso zalo nemithetho yonke yokugcinwa kwalo.”
UMose wabatshela abantu bakwa-Israyeli ukuthi bayolenza iphasika.
Bayolenza iphasika ehlane iSinayi ngenyanga yokuqala, ngosuku lwe-14, kusihlwa, njengakho konke uSimakade ayemyale ngakho uMose, abantu bakwa-Israyeli benza kanjalo-ke.
Kwakukhona abantu abathile ababengcoliswe yisidumbu somuntu, ababengakwazi ukugcina iphasika ngalolo lusuku; beza phambi kukaMose no-Aroni ngalolo lusuku.
Labo bantu bathi kuye: “Singcoliswe yisidumbu somuntu; kungani sivinjelwa ukuletha umnikelo kaSimakade ngesikhathi esimisiweyo phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli na?”
UMose wathi kubo: “Yimani, ukuze ngizwe ukuthi uSimakade uyakuyala athini ngani.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli uthi: ‘Noma yimuphi phakathi kwenu, noma owezizukulwane zenu ongcolileyo ngenxa yokuthinta isidumbu, ngisho noma esekuhambeni, ekude, uyakulenza iphasika kuSimakade.
Ngenyanga yesibili, ngosuku lwe-14, kusihlwa; bayakuligcina balidle nesinkwa esingenamvubelo nemifino ebabayo.
Abayukushiya lutho kuze kube sekuseni, abayukuphula thambo lalo. Bayakuligcina iphasika njengokwezimiso zalo zonke.
Kepha umuntu ohlambulukileyo, engekho ohambeni, ohluleka ukuligcina iphasika, lowo muntu uyakunqunywa kwabakubo, ngokuba engalethanga umnikelo kaSimakade ngesikhathi esimisiweyo; lowo muntu uyojeza.

“ ‘Uma umfokazi ogogobele phakathi kwenu, ethanda ukugcina iphasika kuSimakade, uyokwenza kanjalo njengokwesimiso sephasika nangokomthetho walo. Kuyakuba yisimiso esifanayo nakini nakogogobele phakathi kwenu nakwabokuzalwa ezweni.’ ”
Ngosuku okwamiswa ngalo ithabanakeli, ifu lalilisibekela ithabanakeli nethende lobufakazi; kusihlwa laliba phezu kwethabanakeli libonakale njengomlilo kuze kube sekuseni.
Kwakuhlala kunjalo, ifu lalilisibekela, kubonakale umlilo ebusuku.
Noma yinini lapho ifu liphakama ethendeni, abakwa-Israyeli babehamba, kuthi lapho ifu lima khona, nabo bakanise lapho.
Abakwa-Israyeli babesuka njengokusho kukaSimakade, kuthi ngokuyala kwakhe bakanise sonke isikhathi lapho ifu lihleli phezu kwethabanakeli.
Nalapho ifu lihleli phezu kwethabanakeli izinsuku eziningi, abakwa-Israyeli babesigcina isiyalo sikaSimakade, bangahambi.
Ngesinye isikhathi ifu lalima phezu kwethabanakeli izinsuku ezimbalwa. Babehlala enkanjini ngokwesiyalezo sikaSimakade, bahambe futhi njengokuyala kukaSimakade.
Kokunye ifu lalihlala ubusuku nje obubodwa kuze kube sekuseni; kuthi uma liphakanyiswa ekuseni, bahambe. Noma ngabe ifu lalingahlala ubusuku nemini, kwakuthi uma lenyuswa baqhubeke nohambo.

Noma lalihleli phezu kwethabanakeli izinsuku ezimbili, noma inyanga, noma isikhathi esingakanani, abakwa-Israyeli babehlala enkanjini bangaqhubeki nohambo, kodwa kwakuthi lapho liphakanyiswa, bahambe.
Ngezwi likaSimakade babekanisa, nangezwi likaSimakade bahambe; baligcina izwi likaSimakade aliyaleza ngesandla sikaMose.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Zenzele amacilongo esiliva amabili abe ngumsebenzi ocangcathiweyo, uyakuwasebenzisa ukubiza inhlangano nalapho seyisuka inkambu.
Lapho bewabetha kanyekanye, yonke inhlangano iyobuthana kuwe ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana.
Uma kubethwa elilodwa, bonke abaholi nezinhloko zezindlu zemindeni yakwa-Israyeli, ziyakubuthana kuwe.
Uma nihlaba umkhosi, izinkambu ezingasempumalanga ziyosuka zihambe.
Uma senihlaba umkhosi okwesibili izinkambu ezingaseningizimu ziyosuka, ziyohlaba umkhosi ekusukeni kwazo.
Lapho ubiza ibandla niyobetha amacilongo, kodwa ningawuhlabi umkhosi.
“Amadodana ka-Aroni angabaphristi ayoshaya amacilongo, kuyokuba kini yisimiso saphakade ezizukulwaneni zenu.
Kuyothi lapho niphuma impi ezweni lakini ukuyokulwa nesitha esinihlaselayo, nihlabe umkhosi ngamacilongo. USimakade uNkulunkulu wenu uyonikhumbula, anisindise ezitheni zenu.

Ngezinsuku zokuthokoza kwenu, nangemikhosi emisiweyo, nasekwethwaseni kwenyanga, niyakubetha amacilongo enu phezu kweminikelo yenu yokushiswa naphezu kwemihlatshelo yeminikelo yenu yokuthula. Iyoba yisikhumbuzo senu phambi kukaNkulunkulu wenu; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.”
Kwathi ngonyaka wesibili, ngenyanga yesibili, ngolwa-20 lwenyanga, ifu laphakanyiswa phezu kwethabanakeli lobufakazi.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli baqala uhambo lwabo besuka ehlane iSinayi, ifu laze lema ehlane iPharanu.
Lokhu kwakungokokuqala besuka ngokwesiyalezo sikaSimakade ngesandla sikaMose.
Kwasuka kuqala ibhanela lenkambu yabozalo lukaJuda ngamaqembu abo, beholwa nguNaheshoni, indodana ka-Aminadaba.
Ibandla lesizwana sabozalo luka-Isakhare laliholwa nguNethaneli, indodana kaZuwari.
Iqembu lesizwana sabozalo lukaZebuloni laliholwa ngu-Eliyabe, indodana kaHeloni.
Ithabanakeli lathwalwa ngabozalo lukaGereshoni nabolukaMerari, abangabathwali bethabanakeli.
Kwase kusuka ibhanela lenkambu yakwaRubeni ngamaqembu ayo. Laliholwa ngu-Elizuri, indodana kaShedewari.
Phezu kweqembu lesizwana sabozalo lukaSimeyoni kwakunguShelumiyeli, indodana kaZurishadayi.
Iqembu lesizwana sabozalo lukaGadi laliholwa ngu-Eliyasafa, indodana kaDehuweli.
Kwasuka nabakwaKhohathi abangabathwali bezinto zendawo engcwele: ithabanakeli lamiswa ngaphambi kokufika kwabo.
Kwase kusuka ibhanela lenkambu yabozalo luka-Efrayimi, ngamaviyo ayo. Laliholwa ngu-Elishama, indodana ka-Amihudi.
Owayehola isizwana sabantu sabozalo lukaManase kwakunguGamaliyeli, indodana kaPhedazuri.
Iqembu lesizwana sabozalo lukaBhenjamini laliholwa ngu-Abhidani indodana kaGideyoni.
Kwase kusuka ibhanela lenkambu yabozalo lukaDani, ngamabandla ayo, lona lalisemva kwazo zonke ezinye izinkambu. Owayelihola kwakungu-Ahiyezeri, indodana ka-Amishadayi.
Ibandla lesizwana sabozalo luka-Asheri laliholwa nguPhagiyeli, indodana ka-Okhirani.
Abantu besizwana sozalo luka-Nafethali babeholwa ngu-Ahira, indodana ka-Anani.
Leyo yiyona ndlela abantu bakwa-Israyeli ababehamba ngayo ngesikhathi besuka ngokwamaqembu abo.

UMose wathi kuHobhabhi, indodana kaRuweli wakwaMidiyani, umukhwe kaMose: “Sesizakusuka siye endaweni uSimakade asitshele ngayo, wathi: ‘Ngiyoninika yona.’ Woza, hamba nathi! Siyokwenzela okuhle ngokuba uSimakade ukhulumile okuhle ngo-Israyeli.”
Wathi kuye: “Angiyukuhamba, kunalokho ngizosuka ngiye kwelakithi nasezihlotsheni zami.”
Kepha wathi kuye: “Ngiyakuncenga, ungasishiyi, njengalokhu wazi ukuthi siyakukanisa ehlane, wena uyokuba ngamehlo ethu.
Kuyothi uma uhamba nathi, kwenzeka uSimakade asenzele noma yikuphi okuhle, nathi siyokwenzela okuhle.”
Basuka entabeni kaSimakade, bahamba ibanga lezinsuku ezintathu. Umphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade wahamba phambi kwabo ibanga lezinsuku ezintathu, ukubafunela indawo yokuphumula.
Ifu likaSimakade laliphezu kwabo emini, lapho besuka enkanjini.
Ekusukeni komphongolo, uMose wathi: “Vuka, Simakade; mazihlakazeke izitha zakho; abakuzondayo babaleke phambi kwakho.”
Ekumeni kwawo wathi: “Buyela, Simakade emashumini ezinkulungwane zemindeni yakwa-Israyeli.”

Abantu bakhononda, uSimakade wezwa, kwaba kubi ezindlebeni zakhe, ngakho-ke intukuthelo yakhe yavutha phakathi kwabo, umlilo kaSimakade washa ubuhanguhangu phakathi kwabo, wabhubhisa ngisho imikhawulo yenkambu.
Abantu bakhala kuMose. UMose wakhuleka kuSimakade, umlilo wabohla.
Leyo ndawo yaqanjwa ngokuthi yiThabhehera, ngokuba umlilo kaSimakade wavutha phakathi kwabo.
Ingxubevange eyayiphakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli yaqala ukulangazelela izinto zaseGibhithe nabantu bakwa-Israyeli babuye bakhala, bathi: “Ngubani oyakusipha inyama ukuba sidle na?
Siyakhumbula izinhlanzi esasizidla eGibhithe ngesihle, namakhukhamba, amakhabe, amaliki, uhanyanisi neswela.
Kepha manje sekuphele nokulangazelela ukudla. Akukho lutho olunye esingaludla ngaphandle kwale mana esiyidla imihla namalanga.”
Imana yayifana nembewu yekhoriyanderi, isanhlamvana, ibukeka iphuzi, injengenhlaka yebheduliyamu.
Abantu babephuma bayiqoqe, bayigaye ematsheni, noma bayigqule ezigqulweni, bayipheke emakhanzini, benze nangayo amaqebelengwane. Yayinambitheka okweqebelengwane elinamafutha.
Lapho amazolo ehlela enkanjini ebusuku nemana yayehla.
UMose wezwa abantu bekhala emindenini yabo ngasemnyango wethende lakhe. Intukuthelo kaSimakade yavutha kakhulu, lokhu kwamdabukisa kakhulu uMose.
UMose wathi kuSimakade: “Ukwenzeleni okubi encekwini yakho na? Kungani ngingafumananga musa emehlweni akho ukuba ungethwese umthwalo wabo bonke laba bantu na?
Ngabe bonke laba bantu bakhulelwa yimi, futhi bazalwa yimi yini na? Kodwa uthi kimi: ‘Bagone wena esifubeni sakho njengomzanyana egone umntwana oncelayo, ubayise ezweni owalifungela oyise na?’
Ngiyakuyithatha kuphi inyama engingabanika yona bonke laba bantu na? Bayangikhalela ukuba ngibanike inyama badle.
Mina ngokwami, angikwazi ukubathwala bonke laba bantu, ngokuba bayangisinda.
Vele wenza lokhu kimi ukuba ungibulale; ngiyakuncenga, ngibulale ngokushesha ukuze ngifumane umusa emehlweni akho, ungangivumeli ngibone usizi lwami.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi: “Ngiqoqele amadoda angama-70 kumalunga akwa-Israyeli, owaziyo ukuthi angamalunga nezinduna zabantu. Uwalethe ethendeni lokuhlangana, ayoma lapho kanye nawe.
Ngiyokwehla ngikhulume nawe lapho. Ngiyothatha okomoya ophezu kwakho, ngikubeke kuwo. Ayowuthwalisana nawe umthwalo wabantu, awuyukuwuthwala wedwa.

“Yisho kubantu ukuthi: ‘Zingcweliseleni usuku lwakusasa, niyokudla inyama, lokhu nikhalile ezindlebeni zikaSimakade, nathi: “Ngubani oyosipha inyama yokuba sidle, ngokuba kwakukuhle kithi eGibhithe;” yingakho nje uSimakade ezoninika inyama ukuba niyidle.
Aniyukuyidla nje usuku lube lunye, noma izinsuku ezimbili, noma izinsuku eziyisihlanu, noma izinsuku ezilishumi, noma izinsuku ezingama-20,
kodwa inyanga yonke, ize iphume ngamakhala, niyitshokoze, niyenyanye, ngokuba nimlahlile uSimakade ophakathi kwenu, nakhala phambi kwakhe, nathi: “Kungani kube nje, saphumelani eGibhithe na?” ’ ”
Wayesethi uMose: “Abantu engiphakathi kwabo abahamba ngezinyawo bayizi-600 000, wena uthi: ‘Ngiyakubanika inyama ukuba bayidle inyanga yonke.’
Bangahlatshelwa izimvu nezinkomo ukuba zibenele na? Ukhona yini oyakubalethela izinhlanzi zonke zolwandle ukuba zibenele na?”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Ngabe isandla sikaSimakade sifinyeziwe, asisenamandla na? Manje-ke nizakubona ukuthi izwi lami liyafezeka kini noma qha.”
UMose waphuma, wabatshela abantu amazwi kaSimakade; waqoqa amadoda angama-70 angamalunga abantu, wawamisa ethendeni nxazonke.
USimakade wehla ngefu, wakhuluma naye. Wathatha okomoya ophezu kwakhe, wakubeka kumalunga angama-70. Kwathi ukuba umoya uhlale kuwo, aphrofetha, kodwa awaphindanga akwenza lokho futhi.

Kepha kwakusele amadoda amabili enkanjini. Igama leyokuqala kwakungu-Elidadi, negama leyesibili kunguMedadi. Umoya wahlala phezu kwawo; ayephakathi kwalawo ayebhalisiwe, kodwa ayengayanga ethendeni, nawo aphrofetha enkanjini.
Kwasuka insizwa yagijima yayobikela uMose, yathi: “U-Elidadi noMedadi bayaphrofetha enkanjini.”
UJoshuwa indodana kaNuni, inceku kaMose kwasebusheni bayo, waphendula wathi: “Nkosi yami, Mose, benqabele.”
UMose wathi kuye: “Unomhawu ngenxa yami na? Sengathi ngabe bonke abantu bakaSimakade bangaba ngabaphrofethi, uSimakade abeke uMoya wakhe phezu kwabo.”
UMose wangena enkanjini, yena namalunga abakwa-Israyeli.

Kwavuka umoya ovela kuSimakade, waletha izigwaca zivela ngasolwandle, waziwisa ngasenkanjini kungathi ibanga losuku ngalapha, nebanga losuku nangale kwenkambu, nxazonke. Ukuphakama kwazo phezu komhlaba kungathi ngamakhubhithi amabili.
Abantu bavuka basebenza lonke lolo lusuku, nobusuku bonke, nangosuku olulandelayo, bebutha izigwaca. Okuncane abantu abakubuthayo kwakungamahomere alishumi; bazenekela zona zazungeza inkambu.
Kepha inyama isephakathi kwamazinyo abo, bengakayihlafuni, ulaka lukaSimakade lwabavuthela abantu. USimakade wabashaya abantu ngobhubhane olukhulu.
Igama laleyo ndawo kwathiwa yiKibhirothi Hathawa, ngokuba kwangcwatshwa lapho labo ababenenkwankwa.
Abantu basuka eKibhirothi Hathava, baya eHazerothi; bahlala eHazerothi.
UMiriyamu no-Aroni bamelena noMose ngenxa yowesifazane waseKhushe ayemthathile. Nembala wayeganwe ngowesifazane waseKhushe.
Bathi: “Ngabe uSimakade ukhuluma ngoMose kuphela na? Akakhulumile yini nangathi na?” USimakade wakuzwa lokho.
Kepha uMose wayengumuntu omnene kunabo bonke abantu ababesebusweni bomhlaba.
Ngokushesha uSimakade wakhuluma noMose no-Aroni noMiriyamu, wathi: “Wozani nobathathu ethendeni lokuhlangana.” Bahamba bobathathu.
USimakade wehla ngensika yefu, wema ngasemnyango wethende, wabiza u-Aroni noMiriyamu; baphuma bobabili baya kuye.
Wayesethi: “Yizwani manje amazwi ami: uma kukhona umphrofethi phakathi kwenu, Mina Simakade ngiyakuzibonakalisa kuye ngombono, ngikhulume naye ngephupho.
Kodwa akunjalo ngenceku yami uMose; uthembekile kuyo yonke indlu yami.
Yena, ngikhuluma ngokusobala umlomo nomlomo, hhayi ngombono noma ngamazwi ayimfumbe, futhi uyasibona isimo sikaSimakade. Kungani ningesabanga ukukhuluma ngenceku yami uMose na?”
Intukuthelo kaSimakade yabavuthela; wayesehamba.
Ifu laphakama phezu kwethende. Bheka, uMiriyamu wayesenochoko, emhlophe njengeqhwa. U-Aroni waphendukela ngakuMiriyamu, wabona ukuthi usenochoko.
U-Aroni wathi kuMose: “O Nkosi, ngixolele, ngiyakuncenga, ungabeki phezu kwethu isono esisenze ngobuwula.
Ngiyakuncenga, makangabi njengophume esibelethweni sikanina esefile, nesidumbu sakhe sidliwe ingxenye yaso.”
UMose wakhala kuSimakade, wathi: “Nkulunkulu, ngiyakuncenga, mphulukise!”

USimakade wathi kuMose: “Uma uyise ebemkhafulele ngamathe ebusweni, ubengelithwale yini ihlazo lakhe izinsuku eziyisikhombisa na? Makavalelwe ngaphandle kwenkambu izinsuku eziyisikhombisa; emveni kwalokho uyakubuye angeniswe.”
UMiriyamu wavalelwa ngaphandle kwenkambu izinsuku eziyisikhombisa. Abantu abazange bahambe, waze wabuyiswa uMiriyamu.
Emveni kwalokho abantu basuka eHazerothi bakanisa ehlane iPharanu.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Thumela amadoda ukuba ayohlola iKhanani engizakulinika abantu bakwa-Israyeli. Uthumele umuntu abe munye kuleso naleso sizwana sokhokho babo, yilowo nalowo abe ngumholi phakathi kwaso.”
UMose wawathuma amadodana esuka ehlane iPharanu ngesiyalezo sikaSimakade. Wonke lawo madoda ayeyizinhloko zabantu bakwa-Israyeli.
Lawa ngamagama awo: Owesizwana sakwaRubeni: nguShamuwa, indodana kaZakhuri.
Owesizwana sakwaSimeyoni: nguShafathi, indodana kaHori.
Owesizwana sakwaJuda: nguKhalebhi, indodana kaJefune.
Owesizwana sakwa-Isakhare: ngu-Igali, indodana kaJosefa.
Owesizwana sakwa-Efrayimi: nguHosheya, indodana kaNuni.
Owesizwana sakwaBhenjamini: nguPhaliti, indodana kaRafu.
Owesizwana sakwaZebuloni: nguGadiyeli, indodana kaSodi.
Owesizwana sakwaJosefa, owesizwana sakwaManase: nguGadi, indodana kaSusi.
Owesizwana sakwaDani: ngu-Amiyeli, indodana kaGemali.
Owesizwana sakwa-Asheri: nguSethuru, indodana kaMikhayeli.
Owesizwana sakwaNafethali: nguNabi, indodana kaVofisi.
Owesizwana sakwaGadi: nguGewuweli, indodana kaMakhi.
Yilawo amagama amadoda athunywa nguMose ukuyohlola izwe. UMose waqamba uHosheya, indodana kaNuni, ngokuthi nguJoshuwa.
Lapho uMose ebathuma ukuyohlola iKhanani, wathi kubo: “Yenyukani ngaseningizimu, nikhuphukele ezintabeni,
nihlole ukuthi izwe linjani, nabantu abakhe kulo ukuthi banamandla noma bantekenteke, bayingcosana noma baningi yini,
nokuthi izwe abakhe kulo linjani; ngabe lihle noma libi, nokuthi imizi abahlala kuyo injani, iyizinkambu noma iyizinqaba,
nokuthi izwe linjani, livundile noma limpofu, linezinkuni noma qha. Yibani nesibindi, nibuye nezithelo zezwe.” Kwase kuyisikhathi sezithelo zokuqala zomvini.
Bahamba-ke, balihlola izwe kusukela ehlane iSini kuze kube seRehobhe ngasekungeneni eHamathi.

Benyukela ngaseningizimu, bafika eHebhroni; lapho kwakukhona u-Ahimani, uSheshayi, uThalimayi, nalabo abayizizukulwane zika-Anaki. IHebhroni lalakhiwe iminyaka eyisikhombisa ngaphambi kokwakhiwa kweZowani, eGibhithe.
Bafika esigodini i-Eshikholi, banquma lapho igatsha elinehlukuzo lamagilebhisi, balithwala ngogongolo phakathi kwababili, namahananadi namakhiwane.
Leyo ndawo yabizwa ngokuthi yisigodi i-Eshikholi ngenxa yehlukuzo abantu bakwa-Israyeli abalinquma lapho.
Babuya ekulihloleni izwe sekuzophela izinsuku ezingama-40.
Bahamba, bafika kuMose no-Aroni nalo lonke ibandla labantu bakwa-Israyeli ehlane iPharanu, eKadeshi. Bethula umbiko ngababekubonile, babakhombisa nezithelo zalelo lizwe.
Bambikela bathi: “Siyile ezweni obusithume kulo salihlola; ngempela lichichima ubisi noju; nazi izithelo zalo.
Kodwa-ke abantu abakhe ezweni banamandla, imizi ibiyelwe, mikhulu kakhulu, futhi sibone nokuthi bayizizukulwane zika-Anaki.
Ama-Amaleki ahlala ngaseningizimu; amaHithi, amaJebusi nama-Amori akhe kwelezintaba; kuthi amaKhanani ahlale ngasolwandle olukhulu, agudle iJordani.”
UKhalebhu wabathulisa abantu, wathi kuMose: “Siyakwenyuka impela, silidle; akungabazeki ukuthi sizakulinqoba.”
Kepha amadoda ayenyuke naye athi: “Asinakwenyuka sihlasele laba bantu, ngokuba banamandla kunathi.”
Abethulela umbiko omubi abantu bakwa-Israyeli ngezwe ayelihlolile, athi: “Izwe esidabule kulo ukuyolihlola, liyizwe elidla abakhileyo kulo, nabo bonke abantu esibabone kulo bayimidondoshiya.
Sibone futhi laphaya neziqhwaga zozalo luka-Anaki. Thina sazibona sibancane njengezintethe phambi kwazo, saba njalo emehlweni azo.”
Inhlangano yonke yaphakamisa izwi layo yakhala, abantu bakhala ngalobo busuku.
Bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli bakhononda ngoMose no-Aroni, bathi kubo: “Sengathi ngabe safela eGibhithe, kunokuba sizofela kuleli hlane.
USimakade usiletheleni kuleli lizwe, ukuba sife ngenkemba na? Omkethu nabantwana bethu bayakuba yimpango, kungcono kithi ukuba siphindele eGibhithe.”
Yilowo nalowo wathi kumfowabo: “Masiqoke umholi, sibuyele eGibhithe.”
UMose no-Aroni bathi mbo ngobuso phansi, phambi kwebandla lonke lenhlangano yabantu bakwa-Israyeli.
UJoshuwa, indodana kaNuni noKhalebhu, indodana kaJefune, ababephakathi kwalabo ababeyohlola izwe, baklebhula izingubo zabo,
bathi kulo lonke ibandla labantu bakwa-Israyeli: “Izwe esadabula kulo silihlola, liyizwe elihle kakhulu.
Uma uSimakade esithanda, uyakusingenisa kuleli lizwe, futhi uyakusinika lona; liyizwe elichichima ubisi noju.
Kodwa ningamhlubuki uSimakade, ningabesabi abantu bakulelo lizwe. Bayofana nesinkwa nje kithi; umthunzi wabo usukile phezu kwabo, kodwa uSimakade unathi. Ningabesabi.”
Yonke inhlangano yathi mabakhandwe ngamatshe. Inkazimulo kaSimakade yabonakala kubo bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli ethendeni lokuhlangana.
USimakade wayesekhuluma kuMose, wathi: “Kuyoze kube nini laba bantu bengedelela na? Kuyoze kube nini bengakholwa yimi nayizibonakaliso zonke engizenze phakathi kwabo na?
Ngiyobashaya ngobhubhane, ngibaphuce ifa, ngikwenze isizwe esikhulu nesinamandla kunabo.”
UMose wathi kuSimakade: “AbaseGibhithe bayokuzwa, ngokuba nguwe owabakhipha kubo laba bantu ngamandla akho.

Bayotshela izakhamuzi zaleli lizwe. Sizwile ukuthi Wena Simakade uphakathi kwalaba bantu, ngokuba Wena Simakade bayakubona ubuso nobuso; ifu lakho lima phezu kwabo njengensika, nokuthi Wena uhamba phambi kwabo ngensika yefu emini, nangensika yomlilo ebusuku.
Manje uma ubabulala bonke laba bantu, lezi zizwe ziyakuthi: ‘Sizwile umbiko othi:
“Ngenxa yokuba uSimakade ubengenamandla okungenisa laba bantu ezweni afunga ngalo kubo, ngalokho-ke ubabhubhisile ehlane.”
“Ngakho-ke ake ubonakalise amandla akho njengalokhu wakhuluma, wathi:
‘USimakade uyephuza ukuthukuthela, uvame umusa, uthethelela ububi neziphambeko, nokho akayeki angamjezisi onecala, uhambela ububi bawoyise kubantwana, kuze kube sesizukulwaneni sesithathu nesesine.’
Bathethelele laba bantu ububi babo ngokobukhulu bomusa wakho, njengalokho ubathethelele laba bantu kusukela eGibhithe kuze kube manje.”
USimakade wathi: “Ngiyabathethelela njengesicelo sakho.
Nokho ngifunga ngiyagomela, uma nje inkazimulo kaSimakade isawugcwalisa umhlaba wonke,
bonke labo bantu ababone inkazimulo yami nezibonakaliso zami engazenza eGibhithe nasehlane nokho bangilinga lezi zikhathi ezilishumi, abaze balilalela izwi lami,
akukho namunye kubo oyakulibona izwe engafunga kokhokho babo ngalo. Bonke labo abangedelela ehlane abayukulibona.
Kepha inceku yami uKhalebhu, ngenxa yokuba enomoya owehlukile, futhi engilandele ngenhliziyo ephelele, ngiyomngenisa ezweni aye kulo, izizukulwane zakhe ziyakulidla.
Manje, ngenxa yokuba ama-Amaleki namaKhanani akhile esigodini, jikani kusasa, nilibangise ehlane ngendlela eya oLwandle Lomhlanga.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose no-Aroni, wathi:
“Kuyoze kube nini le nhlangano eyonakele ikhononda ngami na? Ngikuzwile ukukhononda abantu bakwa-Israyeli abakhononda ngakho ngami.
Yishoni kubo nithi: ‘Ngifunga ngiyagomela, kusho uSimakade, ngizokwenza kini njengalokhu enikushilo ezindlebeni zami.
Izidumbu zenu ziyoba zigingqane kuleli hlane; bonke abantu ababalwayo kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, abakhononde ngami,
abayukungena ezweni engafunga ngalo ukuthi ngiyakunakhisa kulo, ngaphandle kukaKhalebhu, indodana kaJefune noJoshuwa, indodana kaNuni.
Kodwa abantwana benu enithe bazoba yimpango, ngiyobangenisa kulo, balazi izwe enalilahla.
Nina-ke, izidumbu zenu ziyakuphelela kuleli hlane.
Abantwana benu bayakuba ngabelusi ehlane iminyaka engama-40, bayakuthwala icala lokuphinga kwenu, zize ziphele nya izidumbu zenu ehlane.
Njengokwenani lezinsuku enahlola ngazo izwe, izinsuku ezingama-40, usuku luyokuba unyaka. Niyakuthwala ububi benu iminyaka engama-40, nize nazi ukuthi kuba njani lapho ngimelana nani.’
Mina Simakade ngikhulumile. Ngiyakukwenza ngempela lokhu kuyo yonke le nhlangano eyonakele ehlangane yamelana nami kuleli hlane, bonke bayofela khona.”
Lawa madoda uMose ayewathumele ukuyohlola izwe, abuya ekhononda, enza nenhlangano yonke ikhononde ngaye, ngokuletha umbiko omubi ngezwe.
Lawo madoda ayelethe umbiko omubi ngezwe, aqedwa ubhubhane phambi kukaSimakade.
Kepha uJoshuwa, indodana kaNuni noKhalebhu, indodana kaJefune bona basinda kunalawo madoda ababehambe nawo ukuyohlola izwe.
UMose wakhuluma lawa mazwi kubo bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli; abantu balila kakhulu.
Bavuka ekuseni ngovivi, benyukela esiqongweni sentaba, bathi: “Bhekani, sesilapha, siyakuya endaweni ayithembisile uSimakade, nakuba sonile.”
UMose wathi: “Kuyini lokhu? Seneqa futhi izwi likaSimakade na? Aniyukuphumelela.
Ningenyuki, ngokuba uSimakade akayukuba khona phakathi kwenu, niyokwehlulwa yizitha zenu.
Bhekani, ngiwabekile ama-Amaleki namaKhanani phambi kwenu, ayakunibhuqabhuqa ngenkemba, lokhu nimfulathele uSimakade, ngalokho uSimakade akuzukuba nani.”
Bakhuphukela esiqongweni sezwe lezintaba ngokuziqhayisa nakuba umphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade noMose ungaphumanga enkanjini.
Ama-Amaleki namaKhanani ayehlala kulelo lezintaba ehla abashaya, abaqothula, abahlakaza bagcwala izinkalo kwaze kwaba seHorma.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Uma nifika ezweni engizakuninika lona ukuba nihlale kulo,

senenza umnikelo womlilo kuSimakade, umnikelo wokushiswa, noma umhlatshelo wokufeza isifungo, noma umnikelo wesihle, noma owemikhosi yenu emisiweyo ukwenza iphunga elimnandi kuSimakade, ezinkomeni noma ezimvini,
khona-ke lowo onikela ngomnikelo wakhe uyoletha kuSimakade umnikelo wokusanhlamvu wokweshumi kwempuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe nokwesine kwehini lamafutha;
newayini libe ngumnikelo wokuphuzwayo, uyonikela okwesine kwehini noma nomnikelo wokushiswa kube yimvana eyodwa yomhlatshelo.
“ ‘Inqama uyakuyilungisela okweshumi okubili kwempuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe nokwesithathu kwehini lamafutha, kube ngumnikelo wokusanhlamvu.
Uyonikela okwesithathu kwehini lewayini kube ngumnikelo wokuphuzwayo nephunga elimnandi kuSimakade.
“ ‘Uma unikela ngeduna njengomnikelo wokushiswa, noma umhlatshelo wokufeza isifungo, noma iminikelo yokuthula kuSimakade,
ngaphezu kweduna lelo, uyoletha umnikelo wokusanhlamvu wokweshumi okuthathu kwempuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe nengxenye yehini lamafutha.
Uyonikela ngengxenye yehini lewayini libe ngumnikelo wokuphuzwayo, kube ngumnikelo womlilo wephunga elimnandi kuSimakade.
Kuyokwenziwa kanjalo ngaleyo naleyo nkunzi, noma ngaleyo naleyo nqama, noma ngaleyo naleyo mvana yeduna, noma ngamazinyane ezimbuzi;
njengokwenani enililungisileyo, niyokwenza kanjalo kuleyo naleyo njengokwenani lazo.
“ ‘Bonke abangabozalo bayokwenza kanjalo lezi zinto, bayonikela ngomnikelo womlilo wephunga elimnandi kuSimakade.
Umfokazi ogogobele kwakho, noma ophakathi kwenu ezizukulwaneni zenu, uyonikela ngomnikelo womlilo wephunga elimnandi kuSimakade, uyokwenza njengalokhu nani nenza.
Kuyoba yisimiso esifanayo saphakade ebandleni, kini nakumfokazi ogogobeleyo kini, ezizukulwaneni zenu; njengani uyoba njalo umfokazi phambi kukaSimakade.
Kuyoba ngumthetho munye nesimiso esisodwa kinina nakumfokazi ogogobeleyo kini.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Uma nifika ezweni enginiyisa kulo,
kuyothi lapho nidla isinkwa sezwe, ninikele ngomnikelo wokuphakanyiswa kuSimakade.
Niyonikela ngeqebelengwane lenhlama yenu yokuqala libe ngumnikelo wokuphakanyiswa; njengalokhu nenza umnikelo wokuphakanyiswa wesibuya, niyowenza kanjalo.
Ngenhlama yenu yokuqala, niyonika uSimakade umnikelo wokuphakanyiswa ezizukulwaneni zenu.
“ ‘Uma nona, ningayigcini yonke le miyalo uSimakade ayitshele uMose,
konke uSimakade aniyale ngakho ngomlomo kaMose, kusukela ngosuku uSimakade aniyala ngalo kuqhubeke nakuzo zonke izizukulwane zenu,

uma lokho kwenziwe kungenganhloso, futhi inhlangano ingazi, inhlangano yonke iyonikela ngeduna libe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, iphunga elimnandi kuSimakade. Iyowunikela nomnikelo wayo wokusanhlamvu, nowokuphuzwayo njengokomthetho, nempongo ibe ngumnikelo wesono.

Umphristi uyokwenzela yonke inhlangano yabantu bakwa-Israyeli ukubuyisana; ithethelelwe ngenxa yokuba kwakungeyona inhloso, futhi iwulethile umnikelo wayo, umnikelo womlilo kuSimakade, umnikelo wabo wesono phambi kukaSimakade, ngesiphosiso sayo.
Yonke inhlangano yabantu bakwa-Israyeli iyothethelelwa nomfokazi ogogobele phakathi kwayo, ngokuba bonke abantu bakwenza ngesiphosiso.
“ ‘Uma umuntu ona ngokungenhloso, uyonikela ngembuzi enonyaka, ibe ngumnikelo wesono.
Umphristi uyomenzela lowo muntu ophosisileyo ukubuyisana, ngokuba wone engahlosile phambi kukaSimakade; uyomenzela ukubuyisana, athethelelwe.
Niyoba nomthetho ofanayo kowengabadi kwa-Israyeli nomfokazi ogogobeleyo phakathi kwenu, lapho bone ngokungenhloso.
“ ‘Kodwa noma ngubani owona ngehloso noma ngabe ungowengabadi noma ngumfokazi, ahlambalaze uSimakade, uyonqunywa kubantu bakubo,
ngokuba wedelele izwi likaSimakade, wephula umyalo wakhe, lowo muntu uyonqunywa ngokuphelele, icala lakhe libe phezu kwakhe.’ ”
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli besesehlane, bafumana umuntu etheza izinkuni ngosuku lwesabatha.
Labo abamfumana etheza izinkuni, bamletha kuMose no-Aroni nakuyo yonke inhlangano.
Bamshiya evalelwe ngoba kwakungakanqunywa ukuthi kuzokwenziwani ngaye.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Lowo muntu kufanele abulawe. Inhlangano yonke iyokumkhanda ngamatshe, ngaphandle kwenkambu.”
Inhlangano yonke yamkhiphela ngaphandle kwenkambu, yamkhanda ngamatshe, wafa, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
USimakade wathi kuMose:
“Khuluma kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, ubatshele ukuba bazenzele insephe emiphethweni yezingubo zabo ezizukulwaneni zabo, nokuba babeke igoda eliluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ngasemiphethweni yensephe.
Le nsephe niyothi njalo uma niyibheka, nikhumbule yonke imiyalo kaSimakade, niyenze. Aniyukuhamba ngokulawulwa yizinhliziyo zenu nangokubona kwenu enanivame ukukwenza nilandela izindlela zokuphinga.
Niyohlala nikhumbula ukugcina yonke imiyalo yami, nibe ngcwele kuNkulunkulu wenu.
NginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu owanikhipha eGibhithe, ukuze ngibe nguNkulunkulu wenu; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.”
UKhora, indodana kaJizihari, kaKhohathi kaLevi, ekanye namadodana amabili kaRubeni, uDathani no-Abhiramu, ababezalwa ngu-Eliyabe no-Oni ozalwa nguPhelethi baqoqa amadoda,
bamvukela uMose benamadoda akwa-Israyeli angama-250, angabaholi benhlangano, angamanxusa ebandla, amadoda adumileyo.
Bahlanganyela uMose no-Aroni, bathi kubo: “Sekwanele, yonke inhlangano ingcwele, futhi uSimakade uphakathi kwayo; niziphakamiselani phezu kwenhlangano kaSimakade na?”
Wathi ukuba uMose akuzwe lokhu wathi mbo ngobuso emhlabathini.
Wathi kuKhora neviyo lakhe: “Kusasa ekuseni uSimakade uzonazisa ukuthi ngubani ongowakhe, nongcwele, bese emsondeza kuye lowo akhetha ukumsondeza.
Yenzani lokhu: zithatheleni izitsha zempepho, wena Khora neviyo lakho lonke,
nifake kuzo amalahle avuthayo, nifake impepho kuzo kusasa phambi kukaSimakade. Kuyothi lowo uSimakade amkhethayo abe ngcwele. Kade nikwenza lokhu madodana kaLevi, kodwa namuhla nifike ekugcineni!”
UMose wathi kuKhora: “Ake nilalele nina bozalo lukaLevi:

akwanele yini kini ukuthi uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli unehlukanisile enhlanganweni yakwa-Israyeli, ukuba nisondele kuye ukuze nenze inkonzo yethabanakeli likaSimakade nokuba nime phambi kwenhlangano, nibe yizisebenzi zayo,
futhi ukusondezile wena nabafowenu bonke, bozalo lukaLevi kanye nawe, manje senifisa nobuphristi na?
Ngakho-ke wena nalo lonke iviyo lakho nihlanganele ukuzomelana noSimakade. Ubeyini u-Aroni ukuba ningaze nikhononde ngaye na?”
UMose wathumela wabiza uDathani no-Abhiramu, amadodana ka-Eliyabe, kodwa bathi: “Ngeke sikhuphuke.
Kuyinto encane yini ukuthi wasikhuphula ezweni elichichima ubisi noju ukuba sizofela lapha ehlane; usuzozenza umbusi phezu kwethu na?
Futhi awusingenisile ezweni elichichima ubisi noju, awukasiniki ifa lethu lamasimu nezivini; usuzama ukukhohlisa laba bantu na? Ngeke neze sikhuphuke.”
UMose wathukuthela kakhulu, wathi kuSimakade: “Ungawunaki neze umnikelo wabo; angithathanga nayinye imbongolo yabo, futhi angilimazanga namunye kubo.”
UMose wathi kuKhora: “Wena neviyo lakho lonke wozani kusasa, nime phambi kukaSimakade, wena, neviyo lakho no-Aroni.
Makube yilowo nalowo athathe isitsha sakhe sempepho, afake kuso impepho asilethe kuSimakade; izitsha zempepho ezingama-250, nawe kanjalo no-Aroni, izitsha zenu zempepho.”
Bathatha yilowo nalowo isitsha sakhe sempepho bafaka kuzo amalahle base befaka nempepho. UMose no-Aroni bama ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana.
UKhora wayeseqoqa yonke inhlangano, base bema ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana. Inkazimulo kaSimakade yabonakala kuyo yonke inhlangano.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose no-Aroni, wathi:
“Zehlukaniseni kule nhlangano ukuze ngiyiqothule ngokuphazima kweso.”
UMose no-Aroni bawa bathi mbo ngobuso phansi, bathi: “Nkulunkulu! Nkulunkulu! Mthombo wokuphila konke, usuzothukuthelela yonke inhlangano ngenxa yesono somuntu oyedwa nje?”
USimakade wathi kuMose:
“Khuluma enhlanganweni, uthi kuyo: ‘Khuphukani, niqhele ngasemathendeni oKhora noDathani no-Abhiramu.’ ”
UMose wasukuma waya kuDathani naku-Abhiramu; amalunga akwa-Israyeli amlandela.
Wakhuluma nenhlangano, wathi: “Ngiyaninxusa; dedani emathendeni alaba bantu ababi, ningathinti lutho olungolwabo, funa nibhujiswe ngezono zabo zonke.”
Base bekhuphuka ngasemathendeni oKhora noDathani no-Abhiramu. ODathani no-Abhiramu nomkabo namadodana nezingane zabo, baphuma bama ngasemnyango wamathende abo.
UMose wathi: “Ngalokhu niyokwazi ukuthi uSimakade ungithumile ukwenza yonke le misebenzi, angiyenzanga ngokwentando yami.
Uma laba bantu befa ngokufa okwejwayelekile, noma behlelwa ngokwehlela abantu bonke, uSimakade uyobe kangithumanga.
Kodwa uma uSimakade enza into entsha, umhlaba uvule umlomo wawo, ubagwinye nakho konke okwabo, baye kwalasha bephila, niyakuqonda ukuthi laba bantu bamedelelile uSimakade.”
Wathi eqeda nje ukukhuluma wonke lawa mazwi, umhlaba waqhekezeka ngaphansi kwabo.
Umhlaba wavula umlomo wawo, wabagwinya nezindlu zabo; nabo bonke abantu bakaKhora nempahla yabo yonke.
Baya kwalasha bezwa, nakho konke okungokwabo. Umhlaba wabagubuzela; bafa kanjalo phambi kwebandla.
Bonke abakwa-Israyeli ababelapho, bezwa ukukhala kwabo, bathi: “Funa umhlaba usigwinye nathi!”
Kweza umlilo uvela kuSimakade, wabaqothula abantu abangama-250 ababenikele ngempepho.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yisho ku-Eleyazare, indodana ka-Aroni umphristi, ukuba akhiphe izitsha zempepho emlilweni, awuhlakaze, ngokuba ungcwele.
Izitsha zempepho zalezi zoni sezingcwele ngenxa yomvuzo wempilo yazo nangokuba zaziletha kuSimakade. Zicangcathe zibe yizingcwecwe zokwemboza i-althare, zibe wuphawu futhi kubantu bakwa-Israyeli.”
U-Eleyazare, umphristi, wazithatha izitsha zempepho zethusi ababenikele ngazo labo abashayo. Wazicangcatha zaba yisembozo se-althare,

zaba yisikhumbuzo kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, ukuze kungabi bikho mfokazi ongesiye owozalo luka-Aroni oyakulokotha asondele ashise impepho phambi kukaSimakade; ukuze angabi njengoKhora neviyo lakhe, njengalokhu uSimakade akhuluma kuye ngoMose.
Ngakusasa yonke inhlangano yabantu bakwa-Israyeli yakhononda ngoMose no-Aroni, yathi: “Nibulele abantu bakaSimakade.”
Kwathi inhlangano isibavukela oMose no-Aroni, babheka ngasethendeni lokuhlangana. Bheka, ifu lalisibekela, inkazimulo kaSimakade yabonakala kulo.
UMose no-Aroni beza ngaphambi kwethende lokuhlangana.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Khuphuka, uqhele phakathi kwale nhlangano ukuze ngiyibhubhise ngokuphazima kweso.” Bawa ngobuso babo.

UMose wathi ku-Aroni: “Thatha isitsha sempepho, ufake kuso amalahle avuthayo ase-althare, nempepho, uphuthume uye ebandleni uyolenzela ukubuyisana, ngokuba intukuthelo kaSimakade isiphumile, seluqalile ubhubhane.”
U-Aroni wasithatha njengalokhu ekhulumile uMose, wagijima waya phakathi kwebandla. Uyabona-ke, lwaseluqalile ubhubhane phakathi kwabantu; wafaka impepho, wabenzela abantu ukubuyisana.
Wama phakathi kwabafileyo nabaphilayo; lwanqamuka ubhubhane.
Ababebulewe ubhubhane babeyizi-14 700, ngaphandle kwalabo abafa ngenxa kaKhora.
U-Aroni wabuyela kuMose ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana; lwaselunqamukile ubhubhane.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:

“Khuluma kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthathe kubo izintonga, ibe yinye kuleyo naleyo ndlu yokhokho babo, kubo bonke abaholi ngokwezindlu zokhokho; kube yizintonga ezili-12. Uyoloba igama lomniniyo entongeni yakhe.
Entongeni kaLevi uyoloba igama lika-Aroni, ngokuba kuyoba nenhloko eyodwa kuleyo naleyo ndlu yokhokho.
Uyozibeka ethendeni lokuhlangana ngaphambi kobufakazi, lapho ngihlangana nawe khona.
Kuyothi lowo muntu engiyokumkhetha, intonga yakhe ihlume, ukuze ngiqede ukukhononda abakwa-Israyeli abanakho ngani.”

UMose wakhuluma kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, kwathi bonke abaholi bamnika izintonga zabo. Intonga ngayinye kulowo nalowo mholi njengokwezindlu zokhokho; izintonga ezili-12. Intonga ka-Aroni yayiphakathi kwezintonga zabo.
UMose wazibeka izintonga phambi kukaSimakade ethendeni lokuhlangana.
Ngakusasa uMose waya ethendeni lobufakazi; bheka, intonga ka-Aroni yendlu kaLevi yayihlumile, yaveza imiqumbe, yaqhakaza izimbali, yathela ama-alimondi avuthiweyo.
UMose wazikhipha izintonga phambi kukaSimakade wazikhiphela kubo bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli, babona, kwaba yilowo nalowo wathatha intonga yakhe.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Buyisela intonga ka-Aroni ngaphambi kobufakazi, igcinwe ibe wuphawu kubahlubuki ukuba uqede ukukhononda kwabo ngami, ukuze bangafi.”
UMose wenza njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile. Wenza kanjalo-ke.
Abakwa-Israyeli bathi kuMose: “Uyabona-ke, siyabhubha, siyashabalala, siyaphela sonke ngothi lwethu.
Bonke abasondela ethabanakelini likaSimakade bayakufa; siyakufa siphele sonke na?”
USimakade wathi ku-Aroni: “Wena namadodana akho nabendlu kayihlo niyothwala ububi bendawo engcwele. Wena namadodana akho niyothwala ububi bobuphristi benu.
Abafowenu, besizwana sakwaLevi isizwana sikayihlo, basondeze nabo ukuze bahlanganiswe nawe, bakukhonze. Kepha wena, namadodana akho, niyoba ngaphambi kwethende lobufakazi.
Bayokwenza wonke umsebenzi wakho nomsebenzi wonke wethende, kodwa abayukusondela empahleni yendlu engcwele nase-althare, ukuze bona nani ningafi.
Bayakuzihlanganisa nawe, bagcine inkonzo yethende lokuhlangana kuwo wonke umsebenzi wethende; umfokazi akayukusondela kuwe.
“Niyakugcina inkonzo yendlu engcwele nenkonzo yase-althare, ukuze ulaka lungabe lusaba khona phezu kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli.
Bhekani, Mina ngithathe abafowenu abaLevi phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli. Bayisipho kini, esehlukaniselwe uSimakade ukwenza umsebenzi wethende lokuhlangana.

Wena, namadodana akho ahlala nawe, niyakugcina ubuphristi kukho konke okuphathelene ne-althare, nakukho konke okungaphakathi kwesihenqo. Lokhu kungumsebenzi wenu, ngokuba ngininika ubuphristi bube yinkonzo eyisipho kini, umfokazi osondelayo uyobulawa.”

USimakade wakhuluma ku-Aroni, wathi: “Uyabona-ke, Mina ngikunike igunya phezu kweminikelo yami naphezu kwazo zonke izipho ezingcwele zabantu bakwa-Israyeli. Ngizinike wena namadodana akho njengengxenye eyisimiso sabaphristi phakade.

Lokhu kuyakuba ngokwenu ezintweni ezingcwelengcwele ezisale emlilweni, kuyo yonke iminikelo yabo, nakuyo yonke iminikelo yabo yokusanhlamvu, nakuyo yonke iminikelo yabo yesono, nayo yonke iminikelo yabo yecala abayonikela ngayo kimi, iyoba ngcwelengcwele kuwe nakumadodana akho.
Lokhu niyokudlela endaweni engcwelengcwele, kuyodliwa yibo bonke abesilisa; kuyoba ngcwelengcwele kini.

“Nakhu okungokwakho: umnikelo wokuphakanyiswa wesipho sabo, nayo yonke iminikelo yokuzungeziswa yabakwa-Israyeli, ngikunika wena namadodana namadodakazi akho, kube ngokwenu kuze kube phakade. Yilowo nalowo ohlambulukileyo kwabendlu yakho uyakukudla.
“Konke okuhle kwamafutha amasha nakho konke okuhle kwewayini elisha nokusanhlamvu, ulibo lwalokho abanikela ngakho kuSimakade, ngikunike khona.
Ulibo lwakho konke okusezweni lakubo abaluletha kuSimakade luyakuba ngolwakho. Yilowo nalowo ohlambulukileyo kwabendlu yakho uyakukudla.
“Konke okwehlukanisiwe kwa-Israyeli kuyoba ngokwakho.
Amazibulo wonke ezintweni eziphilayo, abayonikela ngawo kuSimakade: kungaba ngawabantu noma ngawezilwane, kuyoba ngokwakho. Nokho izibulo lomuntu uyolihlenga, nezibulo lesilwane esingcolileyo.
Intengo yokuhlengwayo, kusukela kokunenyanga ngokulinganisa kwakho, iyoba ngamashekeli ayisihlanu esiliva ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele elingamagera angama-20.
“Kepha izibulo lenkomo, noma lemvu, noma lembuzi, awuyukulihlenga; lingcwele. Uyofafaza ngegazi lalo e-althare, ushise amanoni alo abe ngumnikelo womlilo oliphunga elimnandi kuSimakade.
Inyama yalo iyoba ngeyakho: isifuba sokuzungeziswa nomlenze wangakwesokunene kuyoba ngokwakho.

Yonke iminikelo yezinto ezingcwele zabantu bakwa-Israyeli abanikela ngayo, ngiyinika wena namadodana namadodakazi akho, ibe ngeyenu kuze kube phakade. Kuyisivumelwano sikasawoti, kuze kube phakade phambi kukaSimakade, kuwe nasezizukulwaneni zakho.”
USimakade wathi ku-Aroni: “Awuyukuba nafa ezweni lakubo, futhi awuyukuba nasabelo phakathi kwabo; Mina ngiyisabelo sakho nefa lakho phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli.
“Abozalo lukaLevi ngibanike okweshumi kwa-Israyeli ukuba kube yifa labo; ngomsebenzi abawenzayo ethendeni lokuhlangana.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli abayukusondela ethendeni lokuhlangana, funa bathwale isono, bafe.
AbaLevi bayokwenza umsebenzi wokukhonza ethendeni lokuhlangana, bathwale ububi bawo. Kuyoba yisimiso esiphakade ezizukulwaneni zabo, naphakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli abayukuba nalifa.

Okweshumi, abantu bakwa-Israyeli abanikela ngakho kube ngumnikelo wokuphakanyiswa kuSimakade, ngikunike abaLevi ukuba kube yifa labo. Yingakho ngithe kubo: ‘Abayukuba nalifa phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Uyobatshela abaLevi uthi kubo: ‘Uma nithatha okweshumi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli engininike khona kuvela kubo, kube yifa lenu, anonikela ngomnikelo wokuphakanyiswa kuSimakade, okweshumi kokweshumi.
Umnikelo wenu uyakubalelwa kini, njengokusanhlamvu kwesibuya nanjengokugcwala kwesikhamo sewayini.

Kanjalo nani niyakunikela ngomnikelo wokuphakanyiswa kuSimakade, ngakho konke okweshumi kwenu enikwamukela kubantu bakwa-Israyeli; niyakunikela ku-Aroni umphristi, ngomnikelo wokuphakanyiswa kuSimakade.
Kuzo zonke izipho eniziphiwayo, niyakwehlukanisa umnikelo ofanele uSimakade, okwekhethelo kukho konke kuyingxenye engcwelisiweyo.’
“Yisho futhi kubo uthi: ‘Uma ninikela ngokwekhethelo kwakho, kuyakubalelwa kubaLevi njengesivuno sesibuya nanjengesivuno sesikhamo sewayini.
Niyakukudlela noma kuyiphi indawo, nina nabezindlu zenu, ngokuba kungumvuzo wenu ngomsebenzi wenu ethendeni lokuhlangana.
Lapho seninikelile ngokwekhethelo kwakho, aniyukuba nacala, kodwa aniyukuzingcolisa izinto ezingcwele zabantu bakwa-Israyeli, futhi aniyukufa.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose no-Aroni, wathi:
“Lokhu kuyisimiso somthetho uSimakade ayale ngaso ukuba usitshele abantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Mabalethe kuwe isithole esibomvu esingenasici, esingasoleki, esingakaze siboshelwe ejokeni,
basinike u-Eleyazare umphristi, yena asikhiphele ngaphandle kwenkambu, asihlabe phambi kwakhe.
U-Eleyazare umphristi, uyothatha igazi laso ngomunwe wakhe, achinse ngalo kasikhombisa ngaphambi kwethende lokuhlangana.
Isithole uyosishisa phambi kwakhe, nesikhumba saso, nenyama yaso, negazi laso, nomswani waso.
Umphristi uyothatha umsedari, ihisophi, nendwangu ebomvu, akuphonse phakathi kokushayo kwesithole.
Umphristi uyohlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze umzimba ngamanzi ngaphambi kokuyongena enkanjini; abe ngongcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.
Oshisa leso sithole uyohlanza izingubo zakhe ngamanzi, ageze nomzimba wakhe, abe ngongcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.

“ ‘Umuntu ohlambulukileyo uyakubutha umlotha wesithole, ayowuchitha ngaphandle kwenkambu endaweni ehlambulukileyo, uyakugcinelwa inhlangano yabantu bakwa-Israyeli kube ngamanzi okuhlambulula; ungumnikelo wesono.
Obutha umlotha wesithole uyakuhlanza izingubo zakhe, abe ngongcolileyo kuze kube kusihlwa. Lokhu kuyakuba yisimiso esiphakade kubantu bakwa-Israyeli nakumfokazi ogogobele phakathi kwabo.
“ ‘Othinta isidumbu sanoma yimuphi umuntu uyakuba ngongcolileyo izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Uyozihlambulula ngamanzi ngosuku lwesithathu, ngosuku lwesikhombisa uyakuhlambuluka. Kodwa uma engazihlambululanga ngawo ngosuku lwesithathu, akayukuhlambuluka ngosuku lwesikhombisa.

Yilowo nalowo othinta isidumbu somuntu ofileyo, angazihlambululi ekungcoleni, uyongcolisa ithabanakeli likaSimakade. Lowo muntu uyonqunywa kwa-Israyeli, lokhu engafafazwanga ngamanzi okuhlambulula, uyakuhlala engongcolile; ukungcola kwakhe kungasuki kuye.
“ ‘Nanku umthetho uma umuntu efela ethendeni: yilowo nalowo ongena ethendeni nalowo osethendeni uyakuba ngongcolileyo izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Nazo zonke izitsha ezivulekileyo ezingenaso isisibekelo esiboshwe kuzo zingcolile.
“ ‘Yilowo nalowo othinta obulewe ngenkemba endle, noma ozifele nje, noma ithambo lomuntu, noma ithuna, uyakuba ngongcolileyo izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
“ ‘Abangcolileyo bayakuthatha umlotha wokushayo komnikelo wesono, namanzi agobhozayo bakuthele ndawonye esitsheni,
umuntu ohlambulukileyo uyothatha ihisopi, aligcobhoze emanzini, afafaze ngawo ithende, nezitsha zonke, nabantu abalapho, nalowo othinte ithambo, noma obuleweyo, noma isidumbu, noma ithuna.
Ohlambulukileyo uyofafaza ongahlambulukile ngosuku lwesithathu nangosuku lwesikhombisa, amhlambulule ngosuku lwesikhombisa, bese ehlanza izingubo zakhe, ageze ngamanzi, ahlambuluke ngakusihlwa.
Umuntu ongcolileyo futhi ongazihlambululanga, lowo uyakunqunywa ebandleni ngoba engcolise indawo kaSimakade engcwele. Lokhu engafafazwanga ngamanzi okuhlambulula, ungcolile.
Lokhu kuyakuba yisimiso esiphakade kubo; lowo oyofafaza amanzi okuhlambulula, uyakuhlanza izingubo zakhe, nalowo othinta amanzi okuhlambulula uyakuba ngongcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.
Konke okuyothintwa ngumuntu ongcolileyo kuyoba ngokungcolile; umuntu oyokuthinta uyoba ngongcolileyo kuze kuhlwe.’ ”
Ngenyanga yokuqala, yonke inhlangano yabantu bakwa-Israyeli yafika ehlane iSini. Abantu bahlala eKadeshi, uMiriyamu wafela khona, wangcwatshwa khona futhi.
Kwakungekho manzi okuba inhlangano iphuze; ngakho-ke bahlangana ndawonye bamelana noMose no-Aroni.
Abantu balwa noMose, bakhuluma bathi: “Sengathi ngabe safa ngesikhathi kufa abafowethu phambi kukaSimakade.
Niyiletheleni kuleli hlane inhlangano kaSimakade ukuba sizofela kulo, thina nemfuyo yethu na?
Nasikhuphulelani eGibhithe, ukuze nisilethe kule ndawo embi na? Akusiyo indawo yembewu, noma yamakhiwane, noma yemivini, noma yamahananadi, futhi akukho ngisho amanzi okuphuza.”
UMose no-Aroni basuka phambi kwebandla baya ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana. Bawa ngobuso bathi mbo emhlabathini, base bebona kuvela inkazimulo kaSimakade.
USimakade wathi kuMose:
“Thatha intonga, uqoqe inhlangano, wena no-Aroni umfowenu, ukhulume edwaleni phambi kwamehlo abo ukuba liveze amanzi alo. Uyakubavezela amanzi edwaleni, uyinike inhlangano nezinkomo zayo okokuphuza.”
UMose wathatha intonga phambi kukaSimakade, njengalokhu ayemyalile.
UMose no-Aroni baliqoqa ibandla phambi kwedwala; wathi kubo: “Yizwani bahlubuki ndini; sizakunivezela yini amanzi kuleli dwala na?”
UMose waphakamisa isandla sakhe, walishaya kabili idwala ngentonga yakhe, kwaphuma amanzi amaningi, yaphuza inhlangano nemfuyo yayo.
USimakade wathi kuMose no-Aroni: “Njengalokhu ningakholwanga yimi, futhi ningangingcwelisanga phambi kwamehlo abantu bakwa-Israyeli, ngalokho aniyukulingenisa leli bandla ezweni engilinike lona.”
Lawa ngamanzi eMeribha, ngokuba abantu bakwa-Israyeli balwa noSimakade, Yena wazibonakalisa engcwele phakathi kwabo.
UMose eseKadeshi wathumela izithunywa enkosini yakwa-Edomi, wathi: “Usho kanje umfowenu u-Israyeli: ‘Uyabazi bonke ubunzima esihlangabezane nabo,
ukuthi okhokho bethu behlela eGibhithe, sahlala eGibhithe isikhathi eside; abaseGibhithe basiphatha kabi thina nokhokho bethu.
Sakhala kuSimakade, walizwa izwi lethu, wathuma ingelosi, wasikhipha eGibhithe; bheka manje silapha eKadeshi, umuzi osemngceleni wezwe lakho.

Siyakuncenga sivumele sidabule ezweni lakho; asiyukuhamba emasimini nasezivinini, futhi asiyukuwaphuza amanzi emithonjeni; siyohamba ngomgwaqo wenkosi, asiyukujikela ngakwesokunene nangakwesokhohlo size sidlule ezweni lakho.’ ”
U-Edomi wathi kuye: “Aniyukudabula lapha, funa ngiphume ngikusukele ngenkemba.”
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli bathi kuye: “Siyakuhamba ngomgwaqo; uma siphuza amanzi akho, mina nemfuyo yami, ngiyakukhokhela imali yawo. Mangidabule nje ngezinyawo zami, kungabi ngokunye.”
Kepha wathi: “Awuyukudabula.” U-Edomi waphuma nempi enkulu, eyayihlome iphelele, yamvimba.
Wala kanjalo-ke u-Edomi ukuba u-Israyeli adabule ezweni lakhe; u-Israyeli wabe esechezuka.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli basuka eKadeshi baze bayofika entabeni iHori.
USimakade wathi kuMose no-Aroni, entabeni iHori esemngceleni wezwe lakwa-Edomi:
“U-Aroni uzokufa, akayukungena ezweni engibanike lona abantu bakwa-Israyeli, ngokuba naphambuka ezwini lami emanzini eMeribha.
Thatha o-Aroni no-Eleyazare, indodana yakhe, ukhuphukele nabo entabeni iHori.
Umkhumule u-Aroni izembatho zakhe, uzigqokise u-Eleyazare indodana yakhe; u-Aroni uyobuyela kwabakubo, afele khona.”
UMose wenza njengalokhu uSimakade emyalile; bakhuphukela entabeni iHori, inhlangano yonke ibabuka.
UMose wamkhumula u-Aroni izembatho zakhe, wazigqokisa u-Eleyazare, indodana yakhe. U-Aroni wafela khona lapho esiqongweni sentaba; oMose no-Eleyazare behla entabeni.
Inhlangano yonke yabona ukuthi u-Aroni ufile, yamlilela izinsuku ezingama-30, yonke indlu yakwa-Israyeli.
UmKhanani, inkosi yase-Aradi, owayakhe eningizimu, wezwa ukuthi u-Israyeli uyeza ngendlela ese-Atharimi. Walwa no-Israyeli, wathumba abanye kubo.
U-Israyeli wenza isifungo kuSimakade, wathi: “Uma ubanikela nokubanikela laba bantu esandleni sami, ngiyakuyichitha impela imizi yabo.”
USimakade walilalela izwi lika-Israyeli, wanikela kuye amaKhanani, bawaqothula nemizi yawo; igama laleyo ndawo kwathiwa yiHorma.
Basuka entabeni iHori ngendlela yoLwandle Lomhlanga ukuba bazungeze izwe lakwa-Edomi; inhliziyo yabantu yadikibala ngenxa yendlela.
Abantu bagxibha uNkulunkulu noMose, bathi: “Nisikhuphuleleni eGibhithe ukuba sizofela ehlane na? Akukho sinkwa, namanzi lapha, futhi sesidiniwe yilesi sinkwa esiludlana.”
USimakade wathumela izinyoka ezinesihlungu phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli, zabaluma, kwafa abantu abaningi kwa-Israyeli.
Abantu baya kuMose, bathi: “Sonile, ngokuba sikhulume kabi ngawe nangoSimakade; sikhulekele kuSimakade ukuba asuse izinyoka kithi.” UMose wabakhulekela abantu.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Zenzele inyoka enesihlungu, uyiphanyeke ensikeni. Kuyothi lowo olunywe yinyoka, lapho eyibheka, asinde.”
UMose wenza inyoka yethusi, wayiphanyeka ensikeni. Kwakuthi lapho umuntu elunywe yinyoka, bese ebheka inyoka yethusi, asinde.
Abakwa-Israyeli basuka baze bayokanisa e-Obhothi.
Basuka e-Obhothi, bakanisa e-Iye Abharimi ehlane elingaphambi kwelakwaMowabi lapho ilanga liphuma ngakhona.
Basuka lapho baze bayokanisa esigodini iZeredi.
Basuka nalapho baze bayokanisa maqondana ne-Arinoni, ehlane elize liyofika endaweni yama-Amori. I-Arinoni lalingumngcele owehlukanisa elakwaMowabi nelama-Amori.
Yingakho eNcwadini yeziMpi zikaSimakade kuthiwa: “IWahebi eseSufa, nezigodi ezise-Arinoni,
nomthambeka wezigodi oholela e-Ari, oncike emngceleni wakwaMowabi.”
Basuka lapho, baya eBheri; lowo ngumthombo athi ngawo uSimakade kuMose: “Qoqa abantu ukuze ngibaphe amanzi.”
U-Israyeli wayesehlabelela leli culo elithi: “Mpompoza, mthombo! Hlabelelani ngawo!
Ngumthombo owambiwa ngamakhosana, wambiwa ngabaholi ngezintonga zazo zobukhosi nangezindondolo zabo.” Basuka ehlane, baya eMathana.
Basuka eMathana, baya eNahaliyeli; basuka eNahaliyeli, baya eBhamothi.
Basuka eBhamothi, baya esifundeni sakwaMowabi nasesiqongweni iPhisiga, elibheke ezansi ngasehlane.
U-Israyeli wathuma izithunywa kuSihoni, inkosi yama-Amori, wathi:
“Ake usivumele sidabule ezweni lakho; asiyukuchezukela emasimini noma ezivinini, futhi asiyukuphuza manzi emithonjeni yakho. Siyakuhamba ngomgwaqo wenkosi, size siphume emngceleni wezwe lakho.”
USihoni akamvumelanga u-Israyeli ukuba adabule ezweni lakhe. USihoni waqoqa bonke abantu esifundeni sakhe, waphuma wayohlasela u-Israyeli ehlane. Wafika eJahazi, walwa no-Israyeli.
Abakwa-Israyeli bamnqoba ngenkemba, badla izwe lakhe kusukela e-Arinoni kuze kufike eJabhoki, baye bangquleka kwa-Amoni, ngoba umngcele wabakwa-Amoni uqinile.
U-Israyeli wayidla yonke leyo mizi; wahlala emizini yonke yama-Amori eHeshibhoni nasemizini yonke yalo.
IHeshibhoni kwakungumuzi kaSihoni inkosi yama-Amori owayewuthathe enkosini endala yakwaMowabi, wadla lonke izwe lakhe kwaze kwayofika e-Arinoni.
Kungakho abakhuluma ngezaga bethi: “Wozani eHeshibhoni lakhiwe kabusha; umuzi kaSihoni mawuvuselelwe,
ngokuba kwaqubuka umlilo eHeshibhoni, kwalavuka amalangabi emzini kaSihoni, alishaya aliqothula i-Ari lakwaMowabi, nezakhamuzi zasezindaweni eziphakeme e-Arinoni.
Maye kuwe, Mowabi! Nibhubhile nina bantu bakaKhemoshi. Wenze amadodana akhe aba ngabakhoseli, amadodakazi akhe aba ngabathunjwa benkosi yama-Amori, uSihoni.
“Sibacibe ngemicibisholo; iHeshibhoni siyibhubhisile saze sayofinyelela eDibhoni. Sibabhubhise saze sayofika eNofa elendlalekele eMedeba.”
Wahlala kanjalo-ke u-Israyeli ezweni lama-Amori.
UMose wathumela izinhloli ukuhlola iJazeri, balidla, bathatha imizi yalo, bawaxosha ama-Amori ayelapho.
Baphenduka, balibhekisa ngaseBhashani. U-Ogi inkosi yaseBhashani waphuma, wabahlasela yena nabo bonke abantu bakhe, balwa nabo empini yase-Edireyi.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Ungamesabi, ngokuba ngimnikele esandleni sakho nabantu bakhe bonke nezwe lakhe. Uyokwenza kuye njengalokhu wenza kuSihoni, inkosi yama-Amori, owayehlala eHeshibhoni.”
Bambulala yena namadodana akhe, nabo bonke abantu bakhe, kwangasala muntu; balidla izwe lakhe.
Abakwa-Israyeli bahamba, bakanisa emathafeni akwaMowabi, phesheya kweJordani maqondana neJerikho.
UBhalaki, indodana kaZiphori, wakubona konke u-Israyeli ayekwenze kuma-Amori.
AbakwaMowabi babesaba kakhulu abakwa-Israyeli, ngokuba babebaningi. UMowabi wangqangqazela luvalo ngenxa yabakwa-Israyeli.

UMowabi wathi ezingwevini zakwaMidiyani: “Manje lolu quqaba luzoqothula konke esinakho nxazonke, njengenkabi iqothula utshani edlelweni.” UBhalaki, indodana kaZiphori, wayeyinkosi yakwaMowabi ngaleso sikhathi.

Wathumela izithunywa kuBhileyamu, indodana kaBheyori, owayesePhethori ngasemfuleni ezweni labantwana babantu bakhe, ukuyombiza zithi kuye: “Bheka, kunoquqaba lwabantu, abaphuma eGibhithe asebegcwele yonke indawo, futhi sebehleli eduze kwami.
Ngakho-ke woza uzongiqalekisela bona, ngokuba banamandla kakhulu kunami, mhlawumbe ngiyokwazi ukubanqoba, ngibaxoshe ezweni. Ngokuba ngiyazi ukuthi ombusisayo ubusisiwe, nomqalekisayo uqalekisiwe.”
Amalunga akwaMowabi nawakwaMidiyani ahamba ephethe ugxa, aya kuBhileyamu, afike akhuluma kuye amazwi kaBhalaki.
UBhileyamu wathi kuwo: “Lalani lapha ngalobu busuku banamuhla, ngizoninika izwi njengalokho azakukusho kimi uSimakade.” Alala lapho amalunga akwaMowabi.
UNkulunkulu wafika kuBhileyamu wathi: “Ngobani lawa madoda anawe na?”
UBhileyamu wathi kuNkulunkulu: “Inkosi uBhalaki, indodana kaZiphori wakwaMowabi, ungithumelele lo myalezo, wathi:
‘Kunoquqaba lwabantu abaphuma eGibhithe asebegcwele ezweni lonke. Manje woza uzongiqalekisela bona, mhlawumbe ngingakwazi ukulwa nabo ngibaxoshe.’ ”
UNkulunkulu wathi kuBhileyamu: “Awunakuhamba, awunakubaqalekisa labo bantu, ngoba babusisiwe.”
Ngakho-ke uBhileyamu wavuka ekuseni, wathi ezikhulwini zikaBhalaki: “Phindelani ezweni lakini, ngokuba uSimakade ungenqabele ukuba ngihambe nani.”
Izikhulu zakwaMowabi zasuka, zaphindela kuBhalaki, zafike zathi: “UBhileyamu wenqabile ukukhuphuka nathi.”
UBhalaki wabuye wathumela ezinye izikhulu eziningi, neziqavile kunalezo ayezithumele kuqala.
Zafika kuBhileyamu, zathi kuye: “Usho kanje uBhalaki, indodana kaZiphori, uthi: ‘Ungavumeli lutho lukuvimbe ukuba uze kimi,
ngoba ngizokuhlonipha kakhulu, ngiyokwenzela noma yini oyifunayo. Ngiyakuncenga, woza uzongiqalekisela laba bantu.’ ”

UBhileyamu waziphendula izinceku zikaBhalaki, wathi: “Noma ngabe uBhalaki ubenganginika isigodlo sakhe sigcwele phama isiliva negolide, ngingeleqe izwi likaSimakade, uNkulunkulu wami, ngenze into noma ngabe inkulu noma incane kangakanani.
Kodwa nani ake nilale ubusuku banamuhla, yikhona ngizokuzwa ukuthi yini enye azongitshela yona uSimakade.”
Ngalobo busuku uNkulunkulu wafika kuBhileyamu, wathi: “Uma lawa madoda efikele ukuzokubiza, vuka uhambe nawo, kodwa uyokwenza kuphela lokho engizokutshela khona.”
UBhileyamu wavuka ekuseni, wabophela imbongolo yakhe, wahamba nezikhulu zakwaMowabi.
Kodwa intukuthelo kaNkulunkulu yamvuthela ngokuba wahamba nabo, ingelosi kaSimakade yema endleleni yamelana naye. UBhileyamu wayegibele embongolweni yakhe, ekhashwa yizinceku zakhe ezimbili.
Imbongolo yayibona ingelosi kaSimakade imi endleleni, ikhokhe inkemba yayo eyayiyiphethe ngesandla, yaphambuka endleleni, yayohamba ensimini. UBhileyamu wayishaya imbongolo ukuze ibuyele endleleni.
Ingelosi kaSimakade yama endleleni eyayingumngcingo phakathi kwezindonga zesivini nxazombili.
Imbongolo yaphinde yayibona ingelosi kaSimakade, yagudla yencika ngasodongeni, kwalimala unyawo lukaBhileyamu. Waphinde wayishaya.
Ingelosi kaSimakade yaqhubekela phambili yema endaweni eminyeneyo, okungekho ndlela yokuphendukela kwesokudla noma kwesokunxele.
Lapho imbongolo iyibona ingelosi kaSimakade, yalala phansi kwacindezeleka uBhileyamu egibele kuyo, wathukuthela kakhulu, wayibhonya ngenduku yakhe imbongolo.
USimakade wayivula umlomo imbongolo, yathi kuBhileyamu: “Ngenzeni kuwe ungaze ungishaye amahlandla amathathu, na?”
UBhileyamu wathi embongolweni: “Yingoba ungenza isilima! Ukuba benginenkemba esandleni, ngabe sengikubulele.”
Imbongolo yathi kuBhileyamu: “Angisiyona yini imbongolo yakho ohlale uyigibela, nanamuhla osayigibele na? Ngivamile yini ukukwenza lokhu kuwe na?” UBhileyamu wathi: “Qha.”
USimakade wavula amehlo kaBhileyamu, wayibona ingelosi kaSimakade imi endleleni, ikhokhe inkemba esandleni sayo. Wakhothama wathi mbo ngobuso.
Ingelosi kaSimakade yathi kuye: “Uyishayeleni imbongolo yakho kuze kube ngamahlandla amathathu na? Ngize ukuzomelana nawe ngoba le ndlela yakho oyithathile imbi, iyingozi.
Imbongolo ingibonile yachezuka phambi kwami kwaze kwaba kathathu. Ukuba ayizange ichezuke, ngabe sengikubulele, ngayisindisa yona.”
UBhileyamu wathi engelosini kaSimakade: “Ngonile ngokuba bengingazi ukuthi umi endleleni, umelene nami; uma kukubi ukuba ngiqhubekele phambili, ngizophindela emuva.”
Ingelosi kaSimakade yathi kuBhileyamu: “Hamba nalawa madoda, kodwa uyokhuluma kuphela lokho engizokutshela khona.” UBhileyamu wayesehamba namalunga kaBhalaki.
UBhalaki wezwa ukuthi uBhileyamu ufikile, waphuma wayomhlangabeza emzini wakwaMowabi emngceleni wase-Arinoni elingasekupheleni kwesifunda.
UBhalaki wathi kuBhileyamu: “Angithumelanga yini kuwe ngikubiza ukuba uphuthume na? Awufikanga ngani kimi na? Ubucabanga ukuthi ngeke yini ngikuhloniphe na?”
UBhileyamu wathi kuBhalaki: “Bheka, sengifikile kuwe manje, nokho anginamandla okusho utho kuwe. Ngiyokhuluma kuphela izwi uNkulunkulu alibeka emlonyeni wami.”
UBhileyamu wahamba noBhalaki, bafika eKiriyathi Huzothi.
UBhalaki wenza umhlatshelo ngezinkomo nezimvu, wayesekuthumela kuBhileyamu nezikhulu ayenazo.
Kwathi ekuseni uBhalaki wathatha uBhileyamu, benyukela eBhamothi Bhali, elapho wabona ingxenye yabantu bakwa-Israyeli.
UBhileyamu wathi kuBhalaki: “Ngakhele lapha ama-althare ayisikhombisa, bese ungilungisela izinkunzi eziyisikhombisa nezinqama eziyisikhombisa.”
UBhalaki wenza njengalokhu uBhileyamu eshilo. UBhalaki noBhileyamu banikela ngenkunzi nangenqama e-althare ngalinye.

UBhileyamu wathi kuBhalaki: “Yima maqondana nomnikelo wakho wokushiswa, mina ngizohamba, mhlawumbe uSimakade uyohlangana nami, angikhombise izwi nanoma yikuphi engifanele ukuba ngikusho kuwe.” Wayesenyukela egqumeni eliyiqwaqwasi.
UNkulunkulu wahlangana noBhileyamu, uBhileyamu wathi kuye: “Sengiwalungisile ama-althare ayisikhombisa, nganikela ngenkunzi nenqama phezu kwalelo nalelo althare.”
USimakade wamnika uBhileyamu okwakufanele akusho kuBhalaki, wathi: “Buyela kuBhalaki ukhulume uthi.”
Waphindela kuBhalaki, wamfica emile eceleni komnikelo wakhe wokushiswa, yena nazo zonke izikhulu zakwaMowabi.

UBhileyamu wayesewethula umbiko wakhe, wathi: “UBhalaki ungisuse e-Aramu wangiletha lapha, inkosi yakwaMowabi ngasezintabeni empumalanga. Yathi: ‘Woza, ungiqalekisele uJakobe; woza uzojivaza u-Israyeli.’
Ngingamqalekisa kanjani lowo uNkulunkulu angamqalekisanga na? Ngingamjivaza kanjani lowo uSimakade angamjivazanga na?
Ngiyambona ngiseziqongweni zamadwala, ngisemagqumeni, ngiyambona. Bheka, ngibona abantu abahlala bodwa abazibona beyisizwe esehlukile kwezinye izizwe.
Ngubani ongabala uthuli lukaJakobe, abale okwesine kuka-Israyeli na? Mangife ukufa kwabaqotho, isiphetho sami masifane nesakhe.”
UBhalaki wathi kuBhileyamu: “Wenzani kimi na? Ngikulethe lapha ukuba uqalekise izitha zami, kunalokho, bheka uzibusisile.”
UBhileyamu waphendula, wathi: “Akufanele yini ngiqikelele ukuba ngikutshele lokho uSimakade athe angikusho na?”
UBhalaki wathi kuye: “Woza sihambe, siye kwenye indawo lapho uzobabona khona; uzobona ingxenye yabo kuphela, hhayi bonke. Uma usulapho ungiqalekisele bona.”
Wamsusa lapho waya naye ensimini eZofimu, esiqongweni sentaba iPhisiga. Wakha ama-althare ayisikhombisa, kwathi kulelo nalelo althare wenza umnikelo ngenkunzi nenqama.
UBhileyamu wathi: “Mana lapha maqondana nomnikelo wakho wokushiswa; mina ngizoyohlangana noNkulunkulu.”
USimakade wahlangana noBhileyamu, wabeka izwi emlonyeni wakhe, wathi: “Buyela kuBhalaki ukhulume naye.”
Wabuyela kuye wamfica emi eceleni komnikelo wakhe wokushiswa ekanye nezikhulu zakwaMowabi. UBhalaki wathi kuye: “Utheni uSimakade na?”
UBhileyamu wayesewethula umbiko wakhe, wathi: “Sukuma Bhalaki, ubeke indlebe; ungilalele, wena ndodana kaZiphori.
UNkulunkulu akasiye umuntu, ukuba angaqamba amanga, futhi akasiyo indodana yomuntu ukuthi angaguquka kwakushilo. Ushilo, kanakukwenza akushilo na? Ukhulumile, kanakukufeza akushilo na?
Bheka, unginike umyalo wokuba ngibusise; Yena ubusisile, mina angikwazi ukukuguqula lokho.
Akayibonanga inhlekelele engehlela uJakobe, akabonanga nankathazo kwa-Israyeli. USimakade uNkulunkulu wabo unabo, inhlokomo yenkosi yabo iphakathi kwabo.
UNkulunkulu owabakhipha eGibhithe; unjengezimpondo zenyathi kubo.
Akukho mlingo ongamelana noJakobe, nakubhula okungamelana no-Israyeli. Manje sekuzothiwa ngoJakobe nango-Israyeli: ‘Bukani okwenziwe nguNkulunkulu!’
Laba bantu banjengengonyama; baziphakamisisa okwengonyama engaphumuli ingakayisobozeli inyamazane, iphuze igazi layo.”
UBhalaki wathi kuBhileyamu: “Ungalokothi ubaqalekise abakwa-Israyeli, futhi ungalokothi ubabusise!”
UBhileyamu waphendula, wathi kuBhalaki: “Angikutshelanga yini ukuthi konke akushoyo uSimakade ngizokwenza na?”
UBhalaki wathi kuBhileyamu: “Ngiyakuncenga woza, siye kwenye indawo, mhlawumbe uNkulunkulu uyakuthokoza ngayo bese ungiqalekisela bona lapho.”
UBhalaki wamthatha uBhileyamu wamyisa esiqongweni iPheyori elibheke ngezansi ngasehlane.
UBhileyamu wathi kuBhalaki: “Ngakhele ama-althare ayisikhombisa lapha, bese ungilungisela izinkunzi eziyisikhombisa nezinqama eziyisikhombisa.”
UBhalaki wenza njengokusho kukaBhileyamu, wanikela ngenkunzi nenqama kulelo nalelo althare.
Kuthe lapho uBhileyamu ebona ukuthi kuyamthokozisa uSimakade ukubusisa u-Israyeli, wangabe esahamba njengasemihleni ukuyofuna imilingo, kodwa waphendukela ngasogwadule.
UBhileyamu waphakamisa amehlo akhe wabona ukuthi u-Israyeli ukanise ngokwezizwe zakhe, uMoya kaNkulunkulu wehlela phezu kwakhe.
Wayesedlulisa umbiko, wathi: “Umbiko kaBhileyamu indodana kaBheyori, ukukhuluma kwalowo muntu oliso lakhe livulekile,
ukuphimisela kozwileyo amazwi kaNkulunkulu, obonile umbono kaSomandla owele phansi, kodwa amehlo akhe engamboziwe, uthi:
“Mahle kangakanani amathende akho Jakobe, namadlangala akho, Israyeli!
Endlalekise okwemfunda, nanjengezivande eziseceleni komfula, njengenhlaba etshalwe nguSimakade, nanjengemisedari ngaseceleni kwamanzi.
Amanzi ayakugobhoza, aphume ezimbizeni zakhe, imbewu yakhe ibe semanzini amaningi, inkosi yakhe ibe nkulu kuno-Agagi, umbuso wakhe uphakame.
“UNkulunkulu owabakhipha eGibhithe; unjengezimpondo zenyathi kubo; uyoqothula izizwe, izitha zakhe, ephule amathambo azo, azigwaze ngemicibisholo yakhe.
Wacutha njengengonyama, walala phansi njengengonyamakazi, ngubani oyakumvusa na? “Mababusiswe bonke abakubusisayo, baqalekiswe bonke abakuqalekisayo.”
UBhalaki wamthukuthelela kakhulu uBhileyamu, wahlanganisa izandla zakhe; wathi kuBhileyamu: “Ngikubize ukuba uzoqalekisa izitha zami, kunalokho, bheka uzibusisile kwaze kwakathathu.
Suka uphele lapha uphindele kini; ngathi ngizakukuhlonipha kakhulu, kodwa uSimakade wenqabile ukuba ngikuhloniphe.”
UBhileyamu wathi kuBhalaki: “Angizitshelanga yini izithunywa zakho owawuzithume kimi, ngathi:

‘Noma ngabe uBhalaki ubenganginika isigodlo sakhe sigcwele phama isiliva negolide, anginakuleqa izwi likaSimakade ngenze noma yini, okuhle noma okubi, ngizosho kuphela lokho uSimakade azongitshela ukuthi ngikusho na?’
Bheka, manje sengiphindela kwabakithi, kodwa-ke woza ngikweluleke ukuthi laba bantu bazokwenzani kubantu bakho ezinsukwini ezizayo.”
UBhileyamu wayesethatha ethi: “Umbiko kaBhileyamu indodana kaBheyori, umbiko womuntu oso lakhe livuliwe,
ozwileyo amazwi kaNkulunkulu, nowazi ukwazi koPhezukonke, obone umbono ovela kuSomandla, ewele phansi kodwa amehlo akhe engemboziwe, uthi:
“Ngiyambona, kodwa hhayi manje; ngiyambheka, kodwa akekho eduze. Kuyovela inkanyezi kuJakobe; intonga yobukhosi iyovuka kwa-Israyeli, iphohloze uMowabi nxazonke, ichithe amadodana kaSethi;
U-Edomi uyakuba yisabelo sakhe neSeyire izitha zakhe zibe yifa lakhe. U-Israyeli uyakudlondlobala ngamandla.
Kuyakuvela umbusi kuJakobe oyocoboshisa insali emzini.”
UBhileyamu wabona u-Amaleki, wayesewethula umbiko wakhe, wathi: “U-Amaleki wayengowokuqala ezizweni, kodwa isiphetho sakhe ngukubhujiswa.”
Wabona amaKheni wedlulisa umbiko wakhe, wathi: “Indawo ohlala kuyo ivikelekile, isidleke sakho sakhelwe edwaleni,
kodwa uKhayini uzochithwa; kuze kube yileso sikhathi u-Ashuri azonithumba ngaso.”
UBhileyamu wethula umbiko wakhe, wathi: “Maye, ngubani oyakuphila lapho uNkulunkulu enza lokhu na?
Kuyakuvela imikhumbi eKhithimi eyakuhlupha u-Ashuri no-Ebhere, nabo bagcine ngokubhujiswa.”
UBhileyamu wasuka, wahamba, waphindela kwakhe, noBhalaki wabona eze ngayo.
U-Israyeli wahlala eShithimi; abantu base beqala ukuphinga namadodakazi akwaMowabi.
Abamemela emadilini emihlatshelo yonkulunkulu bawo. Abakwa-Israyeli bafike badla, bakhothamela onkulunkulu bawo.
U-Israyeli wazihlanganisa noBhali Pheyori. Intukuthelo kaSimakade yamvuthela u-Israyeli.
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Thatha bonke abaholi babantu, ubabulalele uSimakade lingakashoni ilanga, ukuze intukuthelo kaSimakade evuthayo isuke ku-Israyeli.”
UMose wathi kubehluleli bakwa-Israyeli: “Yilowo nalowo makabulale abantu bakhe abazihlanganise noBhali Pheyori.”
Bheka, umuntu mumbe kwabakwa-Israyeli waletha owesifazane wakwaMidiyani emndenini wakhe, phambi kukaMose nebandla lonke labakwa-Israyeli, ngesikhathi bekhala emnyango wethende lokuhlangana.
UFinehasi, indodana ka-Eleyazare ka-Aroni umphristi, wakubona lokho, wasukuma phakathi kwenhlangano, wadumela umkhonto wakhe.
Wayesemlandela lowo muntu wakwa-Israyeli, wangena ethendeni lakhe, wababhokoda bobabili ngomkhonto esiswini, lwase lunqamuka ubhubhane kwabakwa-Israyeli.
Kepha lwase lwedlule nabantu abayizi-24 000.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“UFinehasi ka-Eleyazare ka-Aroni umphristi ukhalime intukuthelo yami kwabakwa-Israyeli, ngokuba utshengise intshisekelo ngami phakathi kwabo, ukuze ngingabaqothuli ngesikhwele sami.
Ngakho-ke batshele, uthi: ‘Bheka, ngizomnika isivumelwano sami sokuthula.
Siyakuba ngesakhe nezizukulwane zakhe, kube yisivumelwano sobuphristi obuphakade, ngokuba ube nentshisekelo ngoNkulunkulu wakhe, wenzela abakwa-Israyeli ukubuyisana.’ ”
Igama lendoda yakwa-Israyeli eyabulawa nowesifazane wakwaMidiyani, kwakunguZimri kaSalu, isikhulu sendlu yabakwaSimeyoni.
Igama lowesifazane wakwaMidiyani owabulawa kwakunguKhozibhi, indodakazi kaZuri owayengumholi wezizwana zabendlu yakwaMidiyani.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Bahluphe abakwaMidiyani, bese ubabulala,
ngokuba benze ubuqili, banikhohlisa ngodaba lukaPheyori nangendaba kaKhozibhi, indodakazi yomholi wakwaMidiyani, udadewabo owabulawa ngosuku lobhubhane ngenxa kaPheyori.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose no-Eleyazare, indodana ka-Aroni umphristi, wathi:
“Balani inani layo yonke inhlangano yabantu bakwa-Israyeli, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, ngokwezindlu zokhokho babo, bonke abakwa-Israyeli abangaphuma baye empini.”
UMose no-Eleyazare, umphristi, bakhuluma nabakwa-Israyeli emathafeni kwaMowabi ngaseJordani, phesheya kweJerikho, bathi:
“Balani bonke abaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, abaphuma eGibhithe njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose nabantu bakwa-Israyeli.” Nampa-ke abakwa-Israyeli abaphuma eGibhithe:
URubeni, izibulo lika-Israyeli: abozalo lukaRubeni: kuHanokhi: ngumndeni wabakwaHanokhi; kuPhalu: ngumndeni wabakwaPhalu;
kuHezironi: ngumndeni wabakwaHezironi; kuKharimi: ngumndeni wabakwaKharimi.
Yileyo imindeni yakwaRubeni; ababalwayo kuyo babeyizi-43 733.
Indodana kaPhalu: ngu-Eliyabe.
Amadodana ka-Eliyabe: nguNemuweli, uDathani no-Abhiramu. ODathani no-Abhiramu babekhethwe phakathi kwenhlangano, bamelana noMose no-Aroni beseviyweni likaKhora, lapho bavukela khona uSimakade.
Umhlaba wavula umlomo wawo, wabagwinya noKhora ekufeni kwalelo viyo, lapho umlilo wasobozela khona amadoda angama-250, aba yisixwayiso.
Kodwa amadodana kaKhora awafanga.
Abozalo lukaSimeyoni ngemindeni yabo yilaba: kuNemuweli: ngumndeni wabakwaNemuweli; kuJamini: ngumndeni wabakwaJamini; kuJakhini: ngumndeni wabakwaJakhini;
kuZera: ngumndeni wabakwaZera; kuShawule: ngumndeni wabakwaShawule.
Yileyo-ke imindeni kaSimeyoni, ababalwayo babeyizi-22 200.
Abozalo lukaGadi ngemindeni yabo yilaba: kuZefoni: ngumndeni wabakwaZefoni; kuHagi: ngumndeni wabakwaHagi; kuShuni: ngumndeni wabakwaShuni;
ku-Ozini: ngumndeni wabakwa-Ozini; ku-Eri: ngumndeni wabakwa-Eri;
ku-Arodi: ngumndeni wabakwa-Arodi; ku-Areli: ngumndeni wabakwa-Areli.
Yileyo-ke imindeni yabozalo lukaGadi, ababalwayo babeyizi-40 500.
Amadodana kaJuda: u-Eri no-Onani. U-Eri no-Onani bafela eKhanani.
Abozalo lukaJuda ngemindeni yabo yilaba: kuShela: ngumndeni wabakwaShela; kuPherezi: ngumndeni wabakwaPherezi; kuZera: ngumndeni wabakwaZera.
Abozalo lukaPherezi yilaba: kuHezironi: ngumndeni wabakwaHezironi; kuHamule: ngumndeni wabakwaHamule.
Yileyo-ke imindeni kaJuda, ababalwayo babeyizi-76 500.
Abozalo luka-Isakhare ngemindeni yabo yilaba: kuThola: ngumndeni wabakwaThola; kuPhuva ngumndeni wabakwaPhuva;
kuJashubi: ngumndeni wabakwaJashubi; kuShimroni: ngumndeni wabakwaShimroni.
Yileyo-ke imindeni ka-Isakhare, ababalwayo babeyizi-64 300.
Abozalo lukaZebuloni ngemindeni yabo yilaba: kuSeredi: ngumndeni wabakwaSeredi; ku-Eloni: ngumndeni wabakwa-Eloni; kuJaleli: ngumndeni wabakwaJaleli.
Yileyo-ke imindeni kaZebuloni, ababalwayo babeyizi-60 500.
Amadodana kaJosefa ngemindeni yawo yilawa: uManase no-Efrayimi.
Abozalo lukaManase: kuMakhiri: ngumndeni wabakwaMakhiri; uMakhiri wazala uGileyadi; kuGileyadi: ngumndeni wabakwaGileyadi.
Abozalo lukaGileyadi yilaba: ku-Iyezeri: ngumndeni wabakwa-Iyezeri; kuHeleki: ngumndeni wabakwaHeleki;
ku-Asiriyeli: ngumndeni wabakwa-Asiriyeli; kuShekhemi: ngumndeni wabakwaShekhemi;
kuShemida: ngumndeni wabakwaShemida; kuHeferi: ngumndeni wabakwaHeferi.
UZelofehadi, indodana kaHeferi, wayengenamadodana enamadodakazi wodwa. Amagama amadodakazi kaZelofehadi yilawa: kwakunguMahela, uNowa, uHogila, uMilikha noThiriza.
Yileyo-ke imindeni kaManase, ababalwayo babeyizi-52 700.
Abozalo luka-Efrayimi ngemindeni yabo yilaba: kuShuthela: ngumndeni wabakwaShuthela; kuBhekheri: ngumndeni wabakwaBhekheri; kuThahani: ngumndeni wabakwaThahani.
Abozalo lukaShuthela yilaba: ku-Eranu: ngumndeni wabakwa-Eranu.
Yileyo-ke imindeni yabozalo luka-Efrayimi, ababalwayo babeyizi-32 500. Lebo kwakungabozalo lukaJosefa ngemindeni yabo.
Abozalo lukaBhenjamini ngemindeni yabo yilaba: kuBhela: ngumndeni wabakwaBhela; ku-Ashibheli: ngumndeni wabakwa-Ashibheli; ku-Ahiramu: ngumndeni wabakwa-Ahiramu;
kuShefufamu: ngumndeni wabakwaShefufamu: kuHufamu: ngumndeni wabakwaHufamu.
Abozalo lukaBhela kwakungama-Arida namaNahamani; ku-Arida: ngumndeni wabakwa-Arida; kuNahamani: ngumndeni wabakwaNahamani.
Yilabo-ke abozalo lukaBhenjamini ngemindeni yabo; ababalwayo babeyizi-45 600.
Abozalo lukaDani ngemindeni yabo yilaba: kuShuhamu: ngumndeni wabakwaShuhamu. Yileyo-ke imindeni kaDani.
Bonke ababeyimindeni yabakwaShuhamu ababalwayo babeyizi-64 400.
Abozalo luka-Asheri ngemindeni yabo yilaba: ku-Imna: ngumndeni wabakwa-Imna; ku-Ishivi: ngumndeni wabakwa-Ishivi; kuBheriya: ngumndeni wabakwaBheriya.
Abozalo lukaBheriya yilaba: kuHebhere: ngumndeni wabakwaHebhere: kuMalikhiyeli: ngumndeni wabakwaMalikhiyeli.
Igama lendodakazi ka-Asheri nguSera.
Yileyo-ke imindeni yabozalo luka-Asheri, ababalwayo babeyizi-53 400.
Abozalo lukaNafethali ngemindeni yabo yilaba: kuJazeli: ngumndeni wabakwaJazeli; kuGuni: ngumndeni wabakwaGuni;
kuJezeri: ngumndeni wabakwaJezeri: kuShilemi: ngumndeni wabakwaShilemi.
Yileyo-ke imindeni kaNafethali, ababalwayo babeyizi-45 400.
Sebebonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli ababalwayo babeyizi-601 730.
USimakade wathi kuMose:
“Laba bayokwabelwa izwe libe yifa labo ngokwenani lamagama abo.
Abaningi uyakubabela ifa elikhulu, abayingcosana ubabele ifa elincane, yilowo nalowo abelwe ifa ngokwesibalo sabantu anabo.
Izwe liyokwabiwa ngonkatho. Yileso naleso sizwana sabelwe ngokwamagama okhokho baso.
Izwe liyakwabelwa abaningi nabayingcosana ngonkatho.”
Nampa ababalwayo kubaLevi ngemindeni yabo: kuGereshoni: ngumndeni wabakwaGereshoni; kuKhohathi: ngumndeni wabakwaKhohathi; kuMerari: ngumndeni wabakwaMerari.
Nansi imindeni yabaLevi: umndeni wabakwaLibhini, umndeni wabakwaHebhroni, umndeni wabakwaMaheli, umndeni wabakwaMushi, nomndeni wabakwaKhora. UKhohathi wazala u-Amramu.
Igama lomka-Amramu nguJokhebhedi, indodakazi kaLevi ayizalela eGibhithe; wazalela u-Amramu u-Aroni, uMose noMiriyamu udadewabo.
U-Aroni wazala uNadabhi, u-Abhihu, u-Eleyazare, no-Ithamari.
UNadabhi no-Abhihu bafela lapho ngesikhathi benikela ngomlilo ongafanele phambi kukaSimakade.

Sebebonke abaLevi besilisa kusukela konenyanga eyodwa ubudala kuya phezulu babeyizi-23 000. Bona ababalwanga nabesilisa bakwa-Israyeli, ngoba babengezukuthola sabelo esizoba yifa labo ezweni. Ababelwanga ifa kwabakwa-Israyeli.
Yilabo-ke abaLevi ababalwa nguMose no-Eleyazare, umphristi, ngesikhathi kubalwa abakwa-Israyeli emathafeni kwaMowabi ngaseJordani, phesheya kweJerikho.
Akukho namunye owasalayo phakathi kwalabo ababebalwe nguMose no-Aroni, umphristi, okuyibona ababala abakwa-Israyeli ehlane iSinayi,
ngoba uSimakade wayekhulumile ngabo, wathi: “Impela bayofela ehlane.” Akusalanga muntu kubo ngaphandle kukaKhalebhu, indodana kaJefune, noJoshuwa, indodana kaNuni.
Kwase kusondela amadodakazi kaZelofehadi kaHeferi kaGileyadi kaMakhiri emndenini kaManase, indodana kaJosefa. Nanka amagama amadodakazi akhe: kwakunguMahela, uNowa, uHogila, uMilikha noThiriza.
Ama ngasemnyango wethende lokuhlangana phambi koMose, u-Eleyazare umphristi, abaholi, nayo yonke inhlangano, athi:
“Ubaba wafela ehlane, wayengekho phakathi kweviyo labavukela uSimakade, iviyo likaKhora. Kepha wafela esakhe isono engenandodana.
Kungani igama likababa likhishiwe emndenini wakhe, yingoba engenandodana na? Sabeleni nathi ifa phakathi kwabafowabo bakababa.”
UMose walwethula udaba lwawo kuSimakade.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Amadodakazi kaZelofehadi akhulume kahle. Uyakuwabela nokuwabela izwe eliyifa lawo kubafowabo bakayise, uledlulisele kuwo.
“Abantu bakwa-Israyeli uyobatshela, uthi: ‘Uma umuntu efa engenandodana, ifa lakhe liyodluliselwa endodakazini yakhe.
Uma engenandodakazi, niyakulabela abafowabo.
Uma engenabafowabo, niyakulabela abafowabo bakayise.
Uma uyise engenabafowabo, niyakulabela isihlobo sakhe esisondelene naye emndenini, silidle. Lokhu kuyakuba yisimiso sobulungiswa kwabakwa-Israyeli, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.’ ”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Khuphukela entabeni i-Abharimi, ubone izwe engilabele abantu bakwa-Israyeli.
Uma usulibonile, nawe uyakuyiswa koyihlomkhulu njengomfowenu u-Aroni.

Okwathi phela, lapho inhlangano ingihlubuka ehlane iSini imelana nami, nani nangangihlonipha, nangabukhombisa ubungcwele bami phambi kwayo ngasemanzini.” Lawo ngamanzi eMeribha eseKadeshi ehlane iSini.
UMose wayesethi kuSimakade:
“USimakade, uNkulunkulu wemimoya yonke, makamise umuntu phezu kwenhlangano,
ozophuma angene phambi kwayo, abakhiphe, abafake, ukuze inhlangano kaSimakade ingabi njengezimvu ezingenamelusi.”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Thatha uJoshuwa, indodana kaNuni, umuntu onoMoya wami, ubeke isandla sakho phezu kwakhe,
ummise phambi kuka-Eleyazare, umphristi, naphambi kwenhlangano yonke, umgunyaze phambi kwayo ibuka.
Uyobeka udumo lwakho phezu kwakhe ukuze yonke inhlangano yabantu bakwa-Israyeli imhloniphe.

Uyakuma phambi kuka-Eleyazare, umphristi, oyombuzela ngokunquma kwe-Urimi phambi kukaSimakade; ngezwi lakhe bayakuphuma nangezwi lakhe bayakungena, yena nabo bonke abakwa-Israyeli, yebo, nayo yonke inhlangano.”
UMose wenza njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile; wamthatha uJoshuwa, wammisa phambi kuka-Eleyazare, umphristi, naphambi kwenhlangano yonke.
Wabeka izandla zakhe phezu kwakhe, wamgunyaza, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yala abantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Anoqikelela ukuba umnikelo wami, isinkwa sami seminikelo yami yomlilo yephunga elimnandi kimi, ninikele ngawo kimi ngesikhathi sawo.’
Uyothi kubo: ‘Nanku umnikelo womlilo eniyonikela ngawo kuSimakade: izimvu ezimbili ezingamaduna ezinonyaka ezingenasici, njalo ngosuku, zibe ngumnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke.
Enye imvu uyonikela ngayo ekuseni, enye kusihlwa.
Uyonikela nokweshumi kwe-efa lempuphu ecolisekileyo kube ngumnikelo wokusanhlamvu, oxovwe nokwesine kwehini lamafutha agxotshiweyo.
Kungumnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke, owamiswa entabeni iSinayi ukuze ube yiphunga elimnandi, umnikelo womlilo kuSimakade.
Umnikelo wawo wokuphuzwayo uyokuba ngokwesine kwehini ngemvu eyodwa. Umnikelo wesiphuzo esinamandla uyothululelwa uSimakade endaweni engcwele.
Enye imvu uyonikela ngayo kusihlwa. Uyonikela ngayo njengomnikelo wokusanhlamvu wasekuseni nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwayo, umnikelo womlilo wephunga elimnandi kuSimakade.

“ ‘Ngosuku lweSabatha niyonikela ngezimvu ezimbili ezingamaduna ezinonyaka ezingenasici, nokweshumi okubili kwempuphu ecolisekileyo kube ngumnikelo wokusanhlamvu oxovwe namafutha nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwayo.
Lo ngumnikelo oyoshiswa njalo ngeSabatha, wengeze phezu komnikelo wokushiswa wemihla ngemihla nowokuphuzwayo ohambisana nawo.
“ ‘Njalo ngosuku lokwethwasa kwenyanga, niyonikela kuSimakade ngomnikelo wokushiswa. Kuyoba ngamaduna amabili emhlanjini, inqama, amazinyane ayisikhombisa anonyaka, futhi angenasici.
