Niyonikela ngokuthathu eshumini kwempuphu ecolisekileyo, ibe ngumnikelo wokusanhlamvu okuxovwe namafutha ngalelo nalelo duna. Niyonikela ngokweshumi okubili kwempuphu ecolisekileyo, kube ngumnikelo wokusanhlamvu oxovwe namafutha nenqama.
Niyonikela ngokweshumi kwempuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe namafutha, kuyoba ngumnikelo wokusanhlamvu ngaleyo naleyo mvu, umnikelo wokushiswa wephunga elimnandi, umnikelo womlilo kuSimakade.

Umnikelo wabo wokuphuzwayo uyokuba yingxenye yehini lewayini ngenkunzi, nokwesithathu kwehini ngenqama, nokwesine kwehini ngemvu; lokhu kungumnikelo wokushiswa wezinyanga zonke, kuzo zonke izinyanga zonyaka.
Nempongo iyoba ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakade; kuyonikelwa ngayo nomnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwayo.
“ ‘Ngenyanga yokuqala ngosuku lwe-14 lwayo, kuyakuba yiphasika likaSimakade.
Ngosuku lwe-15 lwaleyo nyanga, kuyakuba ngumkhosi, kudliwe isinkwa esingenamvubelo izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Ngosuku lokuqala kuyakuba ngumhlangano ongcwele; aniyukusebenza msebenzi.
Niyonikela kuSimakade ngomnikelo womlilo, umnikelo wokushiswa: amaduna amabili, inqama, izimvu ezingamaduna eziyisikhombisa ezinyaka munye, futhi ezingenasici.
Niyonikela ngomnikelo wazo wokusanhlamvu, impuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe namafutha, niyonikela ngokweshumi okuthathu ngenkunzi nangokweshumi okubili ngenqama.
Niyonikela ngokweshumi ngaleyo naleyo mvu yezimvana eziyisikhombisa,
nempongo ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ukunenzela ukubuyisana.
Niyonikela ngalokho nomnikelo oshiswa ekuseni, ongumnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke.

Niyonikela kanjalo imihla yonke kube izinsuku eziyisikhombisa; isinkwa somnikelo womlilo ube yiphunga elimnandi kuSimakade. Kuyonikelwa ngakho, nomnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwayo.
Ngosuku lwesikhombisa niyoba nomhlangano ongcwele; aniyukusebenza msebenzi.
“ ‘Ngosuku lolibo, lapho ninikela kuSimakade ngomnikelo omusha wokusanhlamvu emkhosini wenu wamaviki, niyoba nomhlangano ongcwele; aniyukusebenza msebenzi.
Niyonikela ngomnikelo wokushiswa, ube yiphunga elimnandi: amaduna amabili, inqama, izimvu ezingamaduna eziyisikhombisa ezinyaka munye.
Niyonikela ngomnikelo wazo wokusanhlamvu, impuphu exovwe namafutha, okuthathu eshumini ngaleyo naleyo nkunzi, nokweshumi okubili ngenqama,
nokweshumi ngaleyo naleyo mvu yezimvana eziyisikhombisa,
nempongo, ukunenzela ukubuyisana.
Niyonikela ngazo, ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla ngemihla nomnikelo wawo wokusanhlamvu, zibe ngezingenasici, neminikelo yazo yokuphuzwayo.
“ ‘Ngenyanga yesikhombisa ngosuku lokuqala lwayo, niyoba nomhlangano ongcwele, aniyukusebenza msebenzi; kuyokuba wusuku lwenu lokushaya amacilongo.
Niyonikela ngomnikelo wokushiswa, ube yiphunga elimnandi kuSimakade: iduna, inqama, izimvu ezingamaduna eziyisikhombisa ezinyaka munye ezingenasici,
nomnikelo wazo wokusanhlamvu, impuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe namafutha, okweshumi okuthathu ngenkunzi, okweshumi okubili ngenqama,
nokweshumi ngaleyo naleyo mvu yezimvana eziyisikhombisa.
Impongo ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ukunenzela ukubuyisana,

ngaphandle komnikelo wokushiswa wokwethwasa kwenyanga nomnikelo wawo wokusanhlamvu, nomnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke nomnikelo wawo wokusanhlamvu, neminikelo yayo yokuphuzwayo ngokwesimiso sayo, kube yiphunga elimnandi, umnikelo womlilo kuSimakade.
“ ‘Ngolweshumi lwenyanga yesikhombisa niyoba nomhlangano ongcwele, niyakuphumula; ningenzi msebenzi.
Niyonikela kuSimakade ngomnikelo wokushiswa ube yiphunga elimnandi: iduna, inqama, izimvu ezingamaduna eziyisikhombisa ezinonyaka ezingenasici,
nomnikelo wazo wokusanhlamvu, impuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe namafutha, okweshumi okuthathu ngenkunzi, nokweshumi okubili ngenqama,
nokweshumi ngaleyo naleyo mvu yezimvana eziyisikhombisa.
Impongo ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngale komnikelo wesono wokubuyisana, nomnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke nomnikelo wawo wokusanhlamvu, neminikelo yayo yokuphuzwayo.
“ ‘Ngosuku lwe-15 lwenyanga yesikhombisa niyoba nomhlangano ongcwele; aniyukwenza msebenzi, niyogubhela uSimakade umkhosi izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Niyonikela ngomnikelo wokushiswa, umnikelo womlilo oyiphunga elimnandi kuSimakade: amaduna ali-13, izinqama ezimbili, izimvu ezingamaduna eli-14 ezinyaka munye ezingenasici,
nomnikelo wazo wokusanhlamvu, impuphu ecolisekileyo exovwe namafutha, okweshumi okuthathu ngaleyo naleyo nkunzi yezinkunzi ezili-13, nokweshumi okubili ngaleyo naleyo nqama yezinqama ezimbili,
nokweshumi ngaleyo naleyo mvu yezimvana ezili-14.
Impongo ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngale komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke nomnikelo wawo wokusanhlamvu nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwayo.
“ ‘Ngosuku lwesibili niyonikela ngalokhu: amaduna ali-12, izinqama ezimbili, izimvu ezingamaduna ezili-14 ezinyaka munye ezingenasici,
nomnikelo wazo wokusanhlamvu, neminikelo yazo yokuphuzwayo ngezinkunzi nangezinqama nangezimvu, njengokwenani lazo ngokwesimiso.
Impongo ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke nomnikelo wawo wokusanhlamvu neminikelo yayo yokuphuzwayo.
“ ‘Ngosuku lwesithathu niyonikela ngalokhu: izinkunzi ezili-11, izinqama ezimbili, izimvu ezingamaduna ezili-14 ezinyaka munye ezingenasici,
nomnikelo wazo wokusanhlamvu, neminikelo yazo yokuphuzwayo ngezinkunzi nangezinqama nangezimvu, njengokwenani lazo ngokwesimiso.
Impongo ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke nomnikelo wawo wokusanhlamvu nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwayo.
“ ‘Ngosuku lwesine niyonikela ngalokhu: izinkunzi ezilishumi, izinqama ezimbili, izimvu ezingamaduna ezili-14 ezinyaka munye ezingenasici,
nomnikelo wazo wokusanhlamvu, neminikelo yazo yokuphuzwayo ngezinkunzi nangezinqama nangezimvu, njengokwenani lazo ngokwesimiso.
Impongo ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke nomnikelo wawo wokusanhlamvu nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwayo.
“ ‘Ngosuku lwesihlanu niyonikela ngalokhu: izinkunzi eziyisishiyagalolunye, izinqama ezimbili, izimvu ezingamaduna ezili-14 ezinyaka munye ezingenasici,
nomnikelo wazo wokusanhlamvu, neminikelo yazo yokuphuzwayo ngezinkunzi nangezinqama nangezimvu, njengokwenani lazo ngokwesimiso.
Impongo ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke nomnikelo wawo wokusanhlamvu nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwayo.
“ ‘Ngosuku lwesithupha niyonikela ngalokhu: izinkunzi eziyisishiyagalombili, izinqama ezimbili, izimvu ezingamaduna ezili-14 ezinyaka munye ezingenasici,
nomnikelo wazo wokusanhlamvu, neminikelo yazo yokuphuzwayo ngezinkunzi nangezinqama nangezimvu, njengokwenani lazo ngokwesimiso.
Impongo ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke nomnikelo wawo wokusanhlamvu neminikelo yawo yokuphuzwayo.
“ ‘Ngosuku lwesikhombisa niyonikela ngalokhu: izinkunzi eziyisikhombisa, izinqama ezimbili, izimvu ezingamaduna ezili-14 ezinyaka munye ezingenasici,
nomnikelo wazo wokusanhlamvu, neminikelo yazo yokuphuzwayo ngezinkunzi nangezinqama nangezimvu, njengokwenani lazo ngokwesimiso.
Impongo ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke nomnikelo wawo wokusanhlamvu nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwayo.
“ ‘Ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili niyoba nombuthano ozothileyo; aniyukwenza msebenzi,
kepha niyonikela kuSimakade ngomnikelo wokushiswa, umnikelo womlilo wephunga elimnandi: inkunzi, inqama, izimvu ezingamaduna eziyisikhombisa ezinyaka munye ezingenasici,
nomnikelo wazo wokusanhlamvu, neminikelo yazo yokuphuzwayo ngenkunzi nangenqama nangezimvu, njengokwenani lazo ngokwesimiso.
Impongo ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngaphandle komnikelo oshiswa imihla yonke nomnikelo wawo wokusanhlamvu nomnikelo wawo wokuphuzwayo.

“ ‘Lokhu niyonikela ngakho kuSimakade ngemikhosi yenu emisiweyo, ngaphandle kwezithembiso zenu neminikelo yenu yesihle, kube yiminikelo yenu yokushiswa, neminikelo yenu yokusanhlamvu, neminikelo yenu yokuphuzwayo, neminikelo yenu yokuthula.’ ”
UMose wabatshela abantu bakwa-Israyeli konke lokho uSimakade ayemyale ngakho.
UMose wayesekhuluma nabaholi bezizwana zakwa-Israyeli, wathi: “Nakhu angiyale ngakho uSimakade:
‘Uma umuntu enza isifungo kuSimakade, noma enza isifungo ezibophezela ngaso, akayukulaphula izwi lakhe. Uyokwenza njengalokho akukhulume ngomlomo wakhe.
“ ‘Uma owesifazane enza isifungo kuSimakade, noma enze isifungo ezibophezela ngaso, esahlala ekhaya likayise, esemusha;

kuyothi uma uyise ezwa ngesifungo azibophezele ngaso, kodwa angasho lutho kuye ngaso, zonke izifungo zakhe ziyohlala zinjalo, zingaguquki, nanoma izithembiso azibophezele ngazo ziyohlala zinjalo, azinakuguquka.
Kodwa uma uyise emenqabela ngosuku ezwa ngalo, zonke izifungo nezithembiso zakhe azibophezele ngazo aziyukuma; uSimakade uyomthethelela, ngoba uyise emenqabele.
“ ‘Uma egana, emveni kokuba enze izifungo noma esheshe wakhuluma wazibophezela,
umyeni wakhe ezwe ngazo, kodwa angasho lutho kuye ngosuku ezwe ngalo, izifungo azibophezele ngazo ziyohlala zinjalo nezithembiso azibophezele ngazo ziyohlala zinjalo.
Kepha uma indoda yakhe imelana nakho ngosuku ekuzwa ngalo, uyakuzephula izifungo ayezibophezele ngazo, noma lokho asheshe wakukhuluma ngomlomo wakhe wazibophezela ngakho; uSimakade uyakumthethelela.
“ ‘Isithembiso somfelokazi noma esolahlwe yindoda, konke azibophezele ngakho, kuyohlala kunjalo kuye.
“ ‘Uma owesifazane enza isifungo esemzini wendoda ayiganile, noma ezibophezela ngaso,
bese indoda yakhe izwa ngalokho, qede ingasho lutho kuye, ingamenqabeli; zonke izifungo nezithembiso zakhe azibophezele ngazo ziyohlala zinjalo, aziyukuguquka.

Kodwa uma indoda yakhe kuthi ngosuku ezwa ngalo, ikwenze ize konke okwaphuma emlonyeni wakhe mayelana nezifungo zakhe nangesibopho sakhe, akuyukuhlala kunjalo, ngokuba indoda yakhe ikwenze ize; uSimakade uyomthethelela.
Zonke izifungo nazo zonke izithembiso azibophezele ngazo ukuzithobisa, indoda yakhe iyakuziqinisa, noma iziqede.

Kodwa uma indoda yakhe ithulile ayasho lutho kuye, kwadlula izinsuku ngezinsuku, iyaziqinisa zonke izifungo zakhe nazo zonke izibopho zakhe eziphezu kwakhe; iziqinisile, ngokuba ithulile ngosuku eyezwa ngalo.
Kepha uma izenze ize mhla izwa ngazo, iyolithwala icala lakhe.’ ”
Yilezo izimiso, uSimakade ayala ngazo uMose, eziyoba phakathi kwendoda nomkayo, uyise nendodakazi engaganile esahlala kubo.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Phindiselela abantu bakwa-Israyeli kwabakwaMidiyani, ungakedluli emhlabeni.”
UMose wayesekhuluma nabantu, wathi: “Hlomisani amadoda phakathi kwenu ukuze ayohlasela abakwaMidiyani, aphindiselele uSimakade kwabakwaMidiyani.
Kuleso naleso sizwana sakwa-Israyeli kuphume inkulungwane, nibathumele empini.”
Ezinkulungwaneni zabakwa-Israyeli kwaqokwa inkulungwane kuleso naleso sizwana, amadoda ayehlomile; ayizi-12 000.
UMose wawathumela empini, inkulungwane ivela kuleso naleso sizwana kanye noFinehasi, indodana ka-Eleyazare, umphristi, ephethe ngesandla izitsha zendawo engcwele namacilongo okuhlaba umkhosi.
Balwa nabakwaMidiyani njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose, babulala bonke abesilisa.
Babulala amakhosi amahlanu akwaMidiyani u-Evi, uRekhemi, uZuri, uHure, noRebha. UBhileyamu, indodana kaBheyori, naye bambulala ngenkemba.
Abakwa-Israyeli bathumba abesifazane bakwaMidiyani nezingane, bathatha yonke imfuyo yabo nawo wonke umcebo wabo, nempahla yabo, kwayimpango.
Yonke imizi yabo ezindaweni, lapho babehlala khona, nawo wonke amathende abo bakushisa ngomlilo.
Baphanga yonke impahla yabo, bathumba abantu nezilwane.
Abathunjwa nempahla ababeyidlile bakuletha kuMose no-Eleyazare, umphristi, nenhlangano yabakwa-Israyeli enkanjini emathafeni kwaMowabi angaseJordani, phesheya kweJerikho.
UMose no-Eleyazare, umphristi, nazo bonke abaholi benhlangano baphuma bayobahlangabeza ngaphandle kwenkambu.
UMose wazithukuthelela iziphathimandla zempi, izinduna zezinkulungwane nezinduna zamakhulu, ezazibuya empini.
UMose wathi kuzo: “Ngabe nibasindisile bonke abesifazane na?

Bhekani, yibo ababeyenga abantu bakwa-Israyeli belulekwe nguBhileyamu, benza abakwa-Israyeli ukuba bangathembeki kuSimakade ngalokho abakwenza ePheyori, kwase kuhlasela ubhubhane phakathi kwenhlangano kaSimakade.
Ngalokho, babulaleni manje bonke abafana, nabo bonke abesifazane asebeyazi indoda.
Kodwa wonke amantombazane angakayazi indoda, zigcineleni wona ephila.
“Bonke phakathi kwenu ababulele umuntu, nabathinte isidumbu, mabahlale ngaphandle kwenkambu izinsuku eziyisikhombisa. Zihlambululeni nabathunjwa ngosuku lwesithathu nolwesikhombisa.
Hlambululani zonke izingubo zenu, nakho konke okwenziwe ngesikhumba, nangoboya bezimbuzi noma ngokhuni.”
Umphristi, u-Eleyazare, wathi emabuthweni ayekade eye empini: “Nasi isimiso somthetho uSimakade ayale ngaso uMose:
igolide, isiliva, ithusi, insimbi, ithini, nomthofu,
konke okungeke kushe emlilweni, niyokudabulisa kuwo kuhlambuluke. Noma kunjalo niyokuhlambulula futhi ngamanzi okuhlambulula. Konke okushayo emlilweni, niyokudabulisa emanzini, kuhlambuluke.
Niyohlanza izingubo zenu ngosuku lwesikhombisa, nihlambuluke, andukuba ningene enkanjini.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Wena no-Eleyazare, umphristi, nabaholi bezindlu zawoyise benhlangano, yibaleni yonke impango ephangiweyo, abantu nezilwane.
Yehlukanise kabili impango, phakathi kwamabutho abeye empini nenhlangano yonke.
Uyothathela uSimakade intela emabuthweni akade esempini, kube kunye ema-500; awabantu, awezinkomo, awezimbongolo nawezimvu,
niyokuthatha engxenyeni yawo, nikunike u-Eleyazare, umphristi, kube ngumnikelo kuSimakade.
Engxenyeni yabantu bakwa-Israyeli uyothatha kube kunye ema-50, awabantu, awezinkomo, izimbongolo, nawezimvu, yebo, awezilwane zonke, ukunike abaLevi abagcina inkonzo yethabanakeli likaSimakade.”
UMose no-Eleyazare, umphristi, benza njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Impango eyasala kweyayinikwe amabutho kwaba yizimvu eziyizi-675 000,
izinkomo eziyizi-72 000,
izimbongolo eziyizi-61 000,
izintombi eziyizi-32 000.
Ingxenye eyabelwa ababephume impi kwaba yizimvu eziyizi-337 500,
kuzo kwakhishwa intela kaSimakade eyayiyizimvu ezingama-675.
Izinkomo eziyizi-36 000, intela kaSimakade kungezingama-72,
izimbongolo eziyizi-30 500, intela kaSimakade kungezingama-61.
Abantu baba yizi-16 000, intela kaSimakade kungabantu abangama-32.
UMose wanika u-Eleyazare, umphristi, intela eyayingumnikelo kaSimakade, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Engxenyeni yempango yabantu bakwa-Israyeli, uMose ayeyehlukanise kweyamabutho ayekade esempini,
eyatholwa yinhlangano kwaba yizimvu eziyizi-337 500,
izinkomo eziyizi-36 000,
izimbongolo eziyizi-30 500,
abantu beyizi-16 000.
Engxenyeni eyatholwa ngu-Israyeli uMose, wathatha okukodwa kubantu nasezilwaneni wakunika abaLevi ababenakekela ithabanakeli likaSimakade, njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
Iziphathimandla ezazingabakhuzi bezinkulungwane zebandla, izinduna zezinkulungwane nezinduna zamakhulu, zasondela kuMose,
zathi kuye: “Izinceku zakho zibale wonke amabutho asesandleni sethu, akukho nalinye elisalile.

Silethe umnikelo kaSimakade, yilowo nalowo kulokho akutholileyo: izinto zegolide, izigqizo, amasongo, izindandatho, amacici, nemigexo, ukuze senzele imiphefumulo yethu ukubuyisana phambi kukaSimakade.”
UMose no-Eleyazare, umphristi, bemukela igolide kubo, nawo wonke amagugu ezinto ezenziweyo.
Lonke igolide lomnikelo wokuphakanyiswa abanikela ngalo kuSimakade, elezinduna zezinkulungwane nelezinduna zamakhulu, laba ngamashekeli ayizi-16 750.
Amabutho wona ayezithathele impango, kwaba yilelo nalelo ngokwalo.
UMose no-Eleyazare, umphristi, bemukela igolide elalivela ezinduneni zezinkulungwane nakwezamakhulu, baliletha ethendeni lokuhlangana, laba yisikhumbuzo sabantu bakwa-Israyeli phambi kukaSimakade.
Abozalo lukaRubeni nabolukaGadi babenemfuyo eningi kakhulu. Lapho bebona ukuthi izwe lakwaJazeri nelakwaGileyadi liyindawo enhle emfuyweni yabo,
beza bakhuluma noMose, no-Eleyazare umphristi, nezikhulu zenhlangano, bathi:
“I-Atharothi, iDibhoni, iJazeri, iNimra, iHeshibhoni, i-Elehale, iSebhamu, iNebho neBhehoni,
izwe uSimakade alinqobela abakwa-Israyeli liyizwe elihle emfuyweni, kanti izinceku zakho zifuyile.”
Bathi futhi: “Uma sifumene umusa emehlweni akho, linike izinceku zakho leli lizwe libe yifa lazo; ungasiwelisi iJordani.”
UMose wathi kwabozalo lukaGadi nabolukaRubeni: “Kuyothi lapho abafowenu beyohlasela, nina nihlale lapha na?
Nibathenelani amandla abakwa-Israyeli baze bangafuni ukuwela baye ezweni uSimakade abanike lona na?
Noyihlo benza kanjalo mhlazana ngibathume ukuyohlola izwe besuka eKadeshi Bharineya.
Ekukhuphukeni kwabo beya esigodini i-Eshikholi balibona izwe, babathena amandla abakwa-Israyeli ukuba bangangeni ezweni uSimakade abanike lona.
Intukuthelo kaSimakade yavutha ngalolo lusuku, wafunga wathi:

‘Impela kulaba bantu abaphuma eGibhithe, akukho namunye kubo oyolibona izwe engafunga ngalo ku-Abhrahama, no-Isaka noJakobe, kusukela kwaba neminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu, ngokuba abangilandelanga ngokupheleleyo.
NguKhalebhu, indodana kaJefune, umKhenizi noJoshuwa, indodana kaNuni, kuphela abamlandela ngokupheleleyo uSimakade.’
Intukuthelo kaSimakade yabavuthela abakwa-Israyeli, wabazulisa ehlane iminyaka engama-40, saze saphela sonke leso sizukulwane esasenze okubi emehlweni kaSimakade.
“Bhekani, nina nzalo yezoni, senivukile esikhundleni sawoyihlo ukwandisa intukuthelo enkulu kaSimakade ngo-Israyeli.
Uma nibuyela emuva ningamlandeli, uyophinde abashiye ehlane, nibhubhise bonke laba bantu.”
Basondela kuye, bathi: “Lapha sizokwakhela izimvu, izibaya nezingane zethu, imizi;
kodwa thina luqobo siyosheshe sihlome, sihambe phambi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli, size sibafinyelelise endaweni yabo. Izingane zethu ziyosala emizini ebiyelweyo, ngenxa yabakhileyo ezweni.
Asiyukubuyela ezindlini zethu abakwa-Israyeli bengakalidli ifa labo, kube yilowo nalowo wabo athole isabelo sakhe.
Ngokuba asiyukulidla ifa nabo ngaphesheya kweJordani ngaleya, lokhu sesilidlile elethu ifa nganeno kweJordani, ngasempumalanga.”
UMose wayesethi kubo: “Uma senizokwenza lokhu, nihlome, nihambe phambi kukaSimakade, niyokulwa,
wonke amadoda akini ahlomile phambi kukaSimakade, awele iJordani, ephuce izitha zakhe phambi kwakhe;
izwe linqotshwe phambi kukaSimakade, khona niyobuyela emuva, ningenacala kuSimakade naku-Israyeli. Leli lizwe liyoba yifa lenu phambi kukaSimakade.
“Kepha uma ningeyukwenza kanjalo, niyobe nonile kuSimakade, futhi yazini ukuthi niyoba nesono.
Zakheleni nina nezingane zenu imizi, nakhele nezimvu zenu izibaya, nenze lokho ebenikushilo.”
Abozalo lukaGadi nabolukaRubeni bakhuluma kuMose, bathi: “Izinceku zakho ziyokwenza njengalokhu inkosi yami iyala.
Izingane zethu nomkethu nemfuyo yethu kuyohlala lapho emizini yakwaGileyadi,
kodwa izinceku zakho ziyowela, zihlomele ukulwa phambi kukaSimakade, ziyophuma zilwe, njengalokhu isho inkosi yami.”
UMose wayeseyala ngabo u-Eleyazare, umphristi noJoshuwa, indodana kaNuni, nabaholi bezindlu zawoyise bezizwana zabantu bakwa-Israyeli.
UMose wathi kubo: “Uma abakwaGadi nabakwaRubeni bewela nani iJordani, bonke behlomele ukulwa phambi kukaSimakade, izwe balinqobe phambi kwenu, niyobanika izwe lakwaGileyadi libe yifa labo.
Kodwa uma bengaweli nani behlomile, bayonikwa ifa phakathi kwenu eKhanani.”
Abozalo lukaGadi nabolukaRubeni baphendula, bathi: “Kuyoba njengalokhu uSimakade eshilo kuzo izinceku zakho, siyokwenza kanjalo.
Siyakuwela sihlomile phambi kukaSimakade, siye eKhanani, nokho izwe eliyifa lethu liyosala lingelethu ngaphesheya kweJordani.”

UMose wayesenika abozalo lukaGadi nabolukaRubeni nengxenye yesizwana sakwaManase, indodana kaJosefa, umbuso kaSihoni inkosi yama-Amori nombuso ka-Ogi inkosi yaseBhashani, izwe nemizi nezifunda ezizungeze imizi yezwe.
Abozalo lukaGadi bakha kabusha iDibhoni, ne-Athorithi, ne-Aroweri,
i-Athirothi Shofanu, iJazeri, iJogibheha,
iBhethi Nimra, neBhethi Harana, imizi ebiyelweyo nezibaya zezimvu.
Abozalo kukaRubeni bakha kabusha iHeshibhoni, i-Elehale, iKiriyathayimi,
iNebho, neBhali Mehoni neSibhima; yonke imizi bayiqamba amagama amasha.
Abozalo lukaMakhiri, indodana kaManase, badla elakwaGileyadi, baxosha ama-Amori ayekulo.
UMose wanika uMakhiri, indodana kaManase, elakwaGileyadi, wahlala kulo.
UJayiri, indodana kaManase, wahamba wadla imizana yalo, wayibiza ngokuthi yiHawothi Jayiri.
UNobha wahamba wadla iKenathi nemizi yalo, walibiza ngokuthi iNobha, okuyigama lakhe.
Nansi indlela abantu bakwa-Israyeli abahlelwa ngayo ngokwamathimba abo, ngesikhathi bephuma eGibhithe beholwa nguMose no-Aroni.
UMose waloba ngohambo lwabo lapho besuka khona, nalapho babekanisa khona njengesiyalezo sikaSimakade. Nanka amabanga abo njengokuhamba kwabo.
Basuka eRamesesi ngenyanga yokuqala ngosuku lwe-15 lwayo; ngosuku olulandela olwephasika. Abakwa-Israyeli baphuma ngendumiso bebuka bonke abaseGibhithe.
AbaseGibhithe babesangcwaba amazibulo abo ayebulawe nguSimakade. USimakade wayebehlulela nonkulunkulu babo.
Abakwa-Israyeli basuka-ke eRamesesi, bakanisa eSukhothi.
Basuka eSukhothi, bakanisa e-Ethamu eligudle ihlane.
Basuka e-Ethamu, babuyela ePhi Hahirothi elingaphambi kweBhali Zefoni; bakanisa phambi kweMigidoli.
Basuka eHahirothi, badabula phakathi kolwandle, baya ehlane. Bahamba ibanga lezinsuku ezintathu ehlane i-Ethamu, bakanisa eMara.
Basuka eMara, bafika e-Elimi; e-Elimi kwakunemithombo yamanzi eli-12 namasundu angama-70; bakanisa khona.
Basuka e-Elimi, bakanisa ngasoLwandle Lomhlanga.
Basuka oLwandle Lomhlanga, bakanisa ehlane iSini.
Basuka ehlane iSini, bakanisa eDofika.
Basuka eDofika, bakanisa e-Alushi.
Basuka e-Alushi, bakanisa eRefidimi, lapho kwakungekho manzi okuba abantu baphuze.
Basuka eRefidimi, bakanisa ehlane iSinayi.
Basuka ehlane iSinayi, bakanisa eKibhirothi Hathava.
Basuka eKibhirothi Hathava bakanisa eHazerothi.
Basuka eHazerothi, bakanisa eRithima.
Basuka eRithima, bakanisa eRimoni Pherezi.
Basuka eRimoni Pherezi, bakanisa eLibhina.
Basuka eLibhina, bakanisa eRisa.
Basuka eRisa, bakanisa eKehelatha.
Basuka eKehelatha, bakanisa entabeni iSheferi.
Basuka entabeni iSheferi, bakanisa eHarada.
Basuka eHarada, bakanisa eMakelothi.
Basuka eMakelothi, bakanisa eThahathi.
Basuka eThahathi, bakanisa eThera.
Basuka eThera, bakanisa eMithika.
Basuka eMithika, bakanisa eHashimona.
Basuka eHashimona, bakanisa eMoserothi.
Basuka eMoserothi, bakanisa eBhene Jahakani.
Basuka eBhene Jahakani, bakanisa eHori Hagidigadi.
Basuka eHori Hagidigadi, bakanisa eJothabatha.
Basuka eJothabatha, bakanisa e-Abhrona.
Basuka e-Abhrona, bakanisa e-Esiyoni Gebheri.
Basuka e-Esiyoni Gebheri, bakanisa eKadeshi elisehlane iSini.
Basuka eKadeshi, bakanisa entabeni iHori ngasemngceleni wakwa-Edomi.

U-Aroni, umphristi, wakhuphukela entabeni iHori ngokwesiyalezo sikaSimakade. Wafike wafela khona ngonyaka wama-40, emveni kokuphuma kwabakwa-Israyeli eGibhithe, ngenyanga yesihlanu ngosuku lokuqala lwayo.
U-Aroni wayeseneminyaka eyi-123 lapho efela entabeni iHori.
UmKhanani, inkosi yase-Aradi, owayehlala eningizimu eKhanani, wezwa ngokufika kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli.
Basuka entabeni iHori, bakanisa eZalimona.
Basuka eZalimona, bakanisa ePunoni.
Basuka ePunoni, bakanisa e-Obhothi.
Basuka e-Obhothi, bakanisa e-Iye Abharimi emngceleni kwaMowabi.
Basuka e-Iyimi, bakanisa eDibhoni Gadi.
Basuka eDibhoni Gadi, bakanisa e-Alimoni Dibhilathayimi.
Basuka e-Alimoni Dibhilathayimi, bakanisa ezintabeni i-Abharimi, phambi kweNebho.
Basuka ezintabeni i-Abharimi, bakanisa emathafeni kwaMowabi ngaseJordani, phesheya kweJerikho.
Bakanisa ngaseJordani kusukela eBhethi Jeshimothi kuze kufike e-Abhela Shithimi emathafeni kwaMowabi.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose emathafeni kwaMowabi ngaseJordani, phesheya kweJerikho, wathi:
“Khuluma kwabakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Uma niwela iJordani ukuba ningene eKhanani,
niyakuxosha bonke abakhileyo ezweni phambi kwenu, nibhubhise yonke imifanekiso yabo, nibulale zonke izithombe zabo ezibunjiweyo, nibhidlize zonke izindawo zabo eziphakemeyo.
Izwe niyakulidla, nihlale kulo, ngokuba ngininike lona ukuba nilidle.

Niyakulidla izwe ngonkatho, ngokwemindeni yakini, abaningi niyakubabela ifa elikhulu, nabayingcosana nibabele ifa elincane, noma kuphi lapho unkatho lumudla khona umuntu, kuyakuba ngelakhe; niyakulidla ifa ngokwezizwana zoyihlo.
“ ‘Kepha uma ningabaxoshi abantu balelo lizwe phambi kwenu, eniyobashiya bayoba ngameva emehlweni enu nanjengezincijo ezinhlangothini zenu, bayonihlupha ezweni enihlala kulo.
Ngiyokwenza kini lokho engangihlose ukukwenza kubo.’ ”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Yala abantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Senizofika eKhanani, leli yizwe elizokuba yifa lenu, izwe lamaKhanani nemingcele yalo.
Uhlangothi lwaseningizimu luyosuka ehlane iZini, lugudle kwa-Edomi. Umngcele wenu waseningizimu uyosuka ekugcineni koLwandle Lukasawoti, ngasempumalanga.
Umngcele wenu ujike ngaseningizimu yoKhalo Lwezitha, uze wedlule eZini, uphume eningizimu eKadeshi Bharineya, uye eHazari Adari, uze ufike e-Azimoni.
Kusuka e-Asimoni, umngcele uyojika ubheke ngasemfuleni eGibhithe, uphumele olwandle.
“ ‘Umngcele wasentshonalanga kuyoba wuLwandle Olukhulu, lube ngumngcele wenu entshonalanga.
“ ‘Umngcele wenu enyakatho uyoma kanje: kusukela oLwandle Olukhulu anomisa intaba iHori ibe wumngcele.
Ukusuka entabeni iHori anoziphawulela indlela eya eHamathi, umngcele uphume eZedadi,
bese uphumela eZifroni, wedlulele eHazari Enani; uyoma kanjalo-ke umngcele wenu enyakatho.
“ ‘Umngcele wenu empumalanga uyoma kanje: niyoziklamela umngcele empumalanga usuke eHazari Enani uze ufike eShefamu;
wehle eShefamu, uye eRibhila empumalanga e-Ayini, wehle njalo uze ufinyelele emmangweni ongasolwandle iKhinerethi, empumalanga.
Umngcele wehlele eJordani, uphume ngasoLwandle Lukasawoti. Yilelo-ke izwe lenu ngokwemingcele yalo, nxazonke.’ ”
UMose wabayala abakwa-Israyeli, wathi: “Leli yizwe eniyolaba ngonkatho, uSimakade ayale ngalo ukuba linikwe izizwe eziyisishiyagalolunye nengxenye,
ngokuba isizwana sabozalo lukaRubeni ngokwezindlu zokhokho babo nesizwana sabozalo lukaGadi ngokwezindlu zokhokho babo sezilitholile ifa lazo, kanjalo nengxenye yesizwana sakwaManase.
Lezi zizwe ezimbili nengxenye zalithola ifa lazo phesheya kweJordani ngasempumalanga yeJerikho, lapho kuphuma khona ilanga.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Nanka amagama amadoda ayoklama izwe eliyifa lenu: u-Eleyazare, umphristi noJoshuwa, indodana kaNuni.
Niyothatha umholi ngamunye kuleso naleso sizwana ukuba abe izwe libe yifa lenu.
Nanka amagama amadoda aqokwa: esizwaneni sakwaJuda: nguKhalebhu indodana kaJefune.
“Esizwaneni sabozalo lukaSimeyoni: nguShemuweli, indodana ka-Amihudi.
Esizwaneni sakwaBhenjamini: ngu-Elidadi, indodana kaKhisiloni.
Esizwaneni sabozalo lukaDani: ngumholi uBhuki, indodana kaJogili.
Emadodaneni kaJosefa: esizwaneni sabozalo lukaManase: ngumholi uHaniyeli, indodana ka-Efodi.
Esizwaneni sabozalo luka-Efrayimi: ngumholi uKemuweli, indodana kaShifethani.
Esizwaneni sabozalo lukaZebuloni: ngumholi u-Elizafani, indodana kaPharinakhi.
Esizwaneni sabozalo luka-Isakhare: ngumholi uPhalithiyeli, indodana ka-Azani.
Esizwaneni sabozalo luka-Asheri: ngumholi u-Ahihudi, indodana kaShelomi.
Esizwaneni sabozalo lukaNafethali: ngumholi uPhedaheli, indodana ka-Amihudi.”
Yilabo uSimakade abayala ukuba behlukanisele abantu bakwa-Israyeli ifa, eKhanani.
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose emathafeni kwaMowabi ngaseJordani, phesheya kweJerikho, wathi:
“Yala abantu bakwa-Israyeli ukuba baphe abaLevi, ezweni eliyifa labo, imizi ukuba bahlale kuyo. AbaLevi niyobanika namadlelo azungeze leyo mizi, nxazonke.
Imizi iyoba ngeyabo ukuba bahlale kuyo, namadlelo ezinkomo zabo abe yimpahla yabo, nawezilwane zonke zabo.
“Amadlelo emizi eniyowanika abaLevi ayosuka ogangeni lomuzi, amakhubhithi ayinkulungwane, nxazonke.

Umuzi niyakuwulinganisa ngaphandle kanje: ngasempumalanga, kube ngamakhubhithi ayizi-2 000, eningizimu, kube ngamakhubhithi ayizi-2 000, entshonalanga, kube ngamakhubhithi ayizi-2 000 nangasenyakatho, kube ngamakhubhithi ayizi-2 000; umuzi ube phakathi. Lokho kuyoba ngamadlelo emizi yabo.
“Imizi eniyoyinika abaLevi iyoba yimizi eyisithupha yokuphephela, lapho umbulali eyobalekela khona ukuba aphephe kuyo. Ngaphandle kwayo, niyobanika imizi engama-42.
Isiyonke imizi eniyoyinika abaLevi iyoba ngama-48, namadlelo ayo.

Imizi eniyobanika yona niyoyithatha kuso isabelo sabantu bakwa-Israyeli, kwesikhulu niyothatha eminingi, kwesincane nithathe eyingcosana. Yilowo nalowo uyonika abaLevi ngokuthi athathe emizini eyisabelo sefa lakhe alidlayo.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
“Tshela abantu bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Uma niwela iJordani, ningena eKhanani,
niyoqoka imizi yokuphephela lapho umbulali obulale umuntu ngokungeyona inhloso eyobalekela khona.
Kini iyokuba yimizi yokuphephela kumphindiseli, ukuze umbulali angafi engakemi phambi kwenhlangano, ahlulelwe.
Imizi eniyobanika yona ibe ngeyokuphephela, iyokuba yisithupha.
Niyoqoka imizi emithathu phesheya kweJordani, niqoke eminye emithathu eKhanani ibe yimizi yokuphephela.
Le mizi iyokuba ngeyokuphephela kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, kumfokazi, nakogogobeleyo phakathi kwabo, ukuze yilowo nalowo obulala umuntu ngokungenhloso abalekele kuyo.
“ ‘Uma umuntu eshaya omunye ngokwakhiwe ngensimbi afe, ungumbulali; impela umbulali uyobulawa.
Uma emshaya ngetshe aliphethe ngesandla, aze afe, ungumbulali; umbulali uyobulawa.
Uma ephethe isikhali sokhuni amshaye ngaso, aze afe, ungumbulali; umbulali uyobulawa.
Umphindiseli wegazi lapho ehlangana nombulali uyakumbulala.
Noma ngubani okuthi ngokuzonda omunye bese emdudula noma amcuthele, amjikijele ngokuthile, afe,
noma ngobutha, amshaye ngesibhakela, aze afe; ungumbulali. Umphindiseli wegazi lapho ehlangana nombulali uyakumbulala.
“ ‘Uma umuntu engazelele, ethuka sekungqubuzeka omunye kodwa engamzondi, noma emjikijela ngokuthile engamqamekelanga,
noma ngetshe elingambulala, engahlosile liwele kuye, afe, engeyiso isitha sakhe, futhi ebengahlose kumlimaza,
inhlangano iyokwehlulela phakathi koshayileyo nomphindiseli wegazi, ilandela lezi zehlulelo.

Inhlangano iyakumhlenga umbulali esandleni somphindiseli wegazi, imbuyisele emzini wakhe wokuphephela lapho ebebalekele khona, ahlale kuwo kuze kufe umphristi omkhulu owayegcotshwe ngamafutha angcwele.
“ ‘Uma kwenzeka umbulali eqa umngcele womuzi wokuphephela lapho ebalekele khona,
aficwe ngumphindiseli wegazi ngaphandle kwemingcele yomuzi wokuphephela, bese umphindiseli embulala umbulali, akayukuba nacala legazi,
ngokuba umbulali kufanele ahlale emzini wokuphephela kuze kufe umphristi omkhulu. Kodwa emva kokufa komphristi omkhulu, umbulali angabuyela ezweni eliyifa lakhe.
“ ‘Lokho kuyoba yisimiso sokwehlulela kini, nasezizukulwaneni zenu, kuzo zonke izindlu zenu.
“ ‘Noma ngubani obulala umuntu, uyobulawa ngenxa yobufakazi obethulwe ngaye. Kepha akekho oyobulawa ngenxa yobufakazi bomuntu oyedwa.
“ ‘Aniyukuthatha nhlawulo ukuze nisindise umbulali onecala okufanele afe ngenxa yalo, umbulali kufanele abulawe.
“ ‘Aniyukuyithatha inhlawulo kumuntu obalekele emzini wokuphephela, ukuze obhacile abuye azohlala ezweni, engakafi umphristi omkhulu.
“ ‘Aniyukulingcolisa izwe enihlala kulo, ngokuba igazi liyalingcolisa izwe; ayikho inhlawulo yezwe ngegazi elichitheke kulo, kuphela ngegazi lalowo olichithile.
Aniyukulingcolisa izwe enihlala kulo, ngokuba Mina Simakade ngihlala phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli.’ ”
Izinhloko zezindlu zoyise bemindeni yozalo lukaGileyadi kaMakhiri kaManase, nabozalo lukaJosefa, zasondela, zakhuluma phambi kukaMose naphambi kwabaholi, abayizinhloko zezindlu zoyise bakwa-Israyeli,

zathi: “USimakade wayiyala inkosi yami ukuba inike abantu bakwa-Israyeli izwe libe yifa labo ngonkatho. USimakade wayiyala futhi inkosi yami ukuba inike amadodakazi omfowethu uZelofehadi ifa lakhe, libe yifa lawo.
Uma egana amadodana ezinye zezizwe zabakwa-Israyeli, ifa lawo liyakususwa efeni lokhokho bethu, lithasiselwe efeni laleso sizwana ayakugana kuso; lisuswe ezweni esilabelwe njengefa lethu.
Ngesikhathi kufika ijubhili labantu bakwa-Israyeli, ifa lamadodakazi kaZelofehadi liyothasiselwa efeni laleso sizwana ayoba ngawaso, ifa lawo lisuswe efeni lesizwana sokhokho bethu.”
UMose wabayala abantu bakwa-Israyeli ngokwezwi likaSimakade, wathi: “Isizwana sozalo lukaJosefa siqinisile kulokhu esikushoyo.
USimakade wayala ngamadodakazi kaZelofehadi, wathi mawagane lowo athanda ukumgana, kodwa kufanele agane emndenini wesizwana sikayise,
ukuze kungabikho ifa labantu bakwa-Israyeli eliyakudluliselwa kwezinye izizwana, yilowo nalowo wabantu bakwa-Israyeli uyakunamathela efeni lesizwana sokhokho bakhe.
Yileyo naleyo ndodakazi enefa esizwaneni esithile sabakwa-Israyeli, iyakugana omunye womndeni wesizwana sikayise, ukuze bonke abakwa-Israyeli babe nefa esabelweni sokhokho babo.
Akukho lifa eliyakuthathwa lidluliselwe kwesinye isizwana, ngokuba yileso naleso sizwana sakwa-Israyeli siyakunamathela efeni laso.”
Amadodakazi kaZelofehadi enza njengalokhu uSimakade ayemyalile uMose.
UMahela, uThiriza, uHogila, uMilikha, noNowa, amadodakazi kaZelofehadi, agana amadodana abafowabo bakayise.
Agana emindenini yozalo lukaManase, indodana kaJosefa, kwathi ifa lawo lahlala esizwaneni somndeni kayise.
Yileyo imiyalelo nezehlulelo uSimakade ayala ngakho abakwa-Israyeli, ngomlomo kaMose, ngesikhathi bekanise emathafeni kwaMowabi ngaseJordani, phesheya kweJerikho.
Lawa ngamazwi uMose awakhuluma kubo bonke abakwa-Israyeli phesheya kweJordani, ehlane i-Araba, maqondana neSufi, phakathi kwePharanu, iThofeli, iLabhani, iHazerothi, neDi Zahabhi.
Kuthatha izinsuku ezili-11 ukusuka eHorebhe uya eKadeshi Bharineya uma uhamba ngendlela esentabeni iSeyiri.
Kwathi ngonyaka wama-40, ngenyanga ye-11, ngosuku lokuqala lwayo, uMose watshela abakwa-Israyeli konke lokho uSimakade ayemyale ngakho ukuba akukhulume kubo.
Lokhu kwenzeka emveni kokuba enqobe uSihoni, inkosi yama-Amori, owayehlala eHeshibhoni, no-Ogi, inkosi yaseBhashani, owayehlala e-Ashitharothi ngase-Edireyi.
Ngaphesheya kweJordani, kwaMowabi, uMose waqala ukuwuchaza lo mthetho, wathi:
“USimakade uNkulunkulu wethu wakhuluma kithi eHorebhe, wathi: ‘Senihlale isikhathi eside kule ntaba;

phendukani nihambe, niye kwelezintaba kwa-Amori nasezindaweni zonke ezakhelene nakhona e-Araba, kwelezintaba, ezansi, eningizimu, ogwini lolwandle, ezweni lamaKhanani, eLebhanoni, kuze kufike emfuleni omkhulu, umfula iYufrathe.
Bhekani, lelo lizwe ngininika lona; ngenani nilidle, yizwe uSimakade afunga kokhokho benu, o-Abhrahama, u-Isaka, noJakobe ukuthi uzobanika lona, bona nezizukulwane zabo.’
“Nganitshela ngaleso sikhathi, ngathi: ‘Anginakunithwala ngedwa.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wenu usenandisile, kangangokuthi namuhla senilukhumbintethe, ningangezinkanyezi emkhathini.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho benu makanithasisele kayinkulungwane, anibusise njengalokhu angitshela.
Mina ngedwa ngingazithwala kanjani izinhlupheko zenu, imithwalo yenu, nokuxabana kwenu na?
Ziqokeleni amadoda ahlakaniphileyo, anokuqonda futhi aziwayo ezizweni zenu, ukuze ngiwenze izinduna zenu.’
“Nangiphendula nathi: ‘Izwi ositshele lona ukuba silenze, lihle.’

“Ngase ngithatha izinhloko ngokwezizwana zenu, amadoda ahlakaniphileyo naziwayo, ngawamisa aba yizinduna zenu: aba yizinduna zezinkulungwane, izinduna zamakhulu, izinduna zama-50, izinduna zamashumi, neziphathimandla ezizwaneni zenu.
Ngabayala abehluleli benu ngaleso sikhathi, ngathi: ‘Zwanini okwenzeka phakathi kwabafowenu, bese nehlulela ngokulunga phakathi komuntu nomfowabo, nomfokazi okhosele kuye.
Maningakhethi abantu ekwehluleleni, mlaleleni omncane njengomkhulu, ningesabi buso bamuntu, ngokuba ukwehlulela kungokukaNkulunkulu. Indaba elukhuni kini niyoyiletha kimi, ngiyizwe.’
Nganiyala ngaleso sikhathi ngakho konke enaniyokwenza.
“Sasuka eHorebhe, sadabula lelo hlane elikhulu nelesabekayo enalibonayo endleleni ekwelezintaba lakwa-Amori, njengalokho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu ayesiyalile, saze safika eKadeshi Bharineya.
Ngase ngithi kini: ‘Senifikile kwelezintaba lakwa-Amori uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu asinika lona.
Niyabona-ke, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu uninikile izwe eliphambi kwenu: khuphukani nilidle, njengalokhu uSimakade, uNkulunkulu wokhokho benu ayenitshelile. Ningesabi, ningapheli amandla.’
“Nonke ngothi lwenu nasondela kimi, nathi: ‘Masithume amadoda ahambe kuqala ayosihlolela izwe, ukuze abuye asitshele indlela esimele ukukhuphuka ngayo, nemizi esiyofika kuyo.’
“Lokho kwaba kuhle emehlweni ami, ngathatha kini amadoda ali-12, kwaba yindoda eyodwa kuleso naleso sizwana.
Wona ahamba, akhuphukela kwelezintaba, afika esigodini i-Eshikholi, asihlola.
Akha izithelo zalelo lizwe, asiphathela zona, nezwi elithi: ‘Yizwe elihle uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu asinika lona.’
“Nokho anithandanga ukukhuphuka, kodwa nahlubuka esiyalezweni sikaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu;
nakhononda emathendeni enu, nathi: ‘Kungenxa yokuba uSimakade esizonda okwenze ukuba asikhiphe eGibhithe ukuzosinikela esandleni sama-Amori, ukuba asibhubhise.

Siyakukhuphukelaphi na? Abafowethu benzile ukuba izinhliziyo zethu ziphele amandla, ngokuba bathe: “Abantu balo banamandla, futhi bayimidondoshiya; imizi yakhona mikhulu, ibiyelwe kuze kube sezulwini, futhi sibone abozalo luka-Anaki khona.” ’
“Ngase ngithi kini: ‘Ningabi naluvalo, ningabesabi.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wenu ohamba phambi kwenu uyonilwela, njengoba enza kini eGibhithe nibuka.
Nasehlane, nibonile ukuthi uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu wanithwala njengendoda igqogqoshe indodana yayo, endleleni yonke enahamba ngayo, naze nafika kule ndawo.’
“Noma kunjalo, nokho anikholwanga nguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu,
owayehamba phambi kwenu endleleni enifunela indawo yokuba nikanise kuyo. Ebusuku wayenibonisa ngomlilo indlela enizohamba ngayo, nangefu emini.
“USimakade wezwa izwi enalikhuluma, wathukuthela, wafunga wathi:
‘Impela akukho namunye kulaba bantu balesi sizukulwane esibi oyolibona izwe elihle engafunga ukulinika okhokho babo,
ngaphandle kukaKhalebhu indodana kaJefune. Nguyena kuphela oyolibona. Ngiyakumnika izwe anyathele kulo, yena nabantwana bakhe, ngokuba wamlandela ngokupheleleyo uSimakade wakhe.’
“Nami uSimakade wangithukuthelela ngenxa yenu, wathi: ‘Nawe awuyukungena kulo;
nguJoshuwa, indodana kaNuni omi phambi kwakho, oyongena kulo. Wena mqinise, ngokuba nguyena oyokwenza u-Israyeli alidle izwe.
Izingane zenu, lezi ezingakwazi ukwehlukanisa okuhle nokubi, enathi zizoba yimpango, yizona eziyongena kulo, ngizolinika zona, zilidle.
Nina-ke jikani, niye ehlane ngendlela eya oLwandle Lomhlanga.’

“Naphendula, nathi kimi: ‘Sonile kuSimakade; siyakukhuphuka silwe njengakho konke asiyala ngakho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu.’ Nahloma, yilowo nalowo izikhali zakhe zokulwa; kwase kuba lula kini ukuba nikhuphukele kwelezintaba.
“USimakade wayesethi kimi: ‘Yisho kubo uthi: “Ningakhuphuki, ningalwi, ngokuba ngeke ngibe khona phakathi kwenu, funa zinehlule izitha zenu.” ’
“Ngakhuluma kanjalo-ke kini, kodwa anilalelanga, kunalokho nalihlubuka izwi likaSimakade, naba nenkani, nakhuphukela kwelezintaba.
Abakwa-Amori ababehlala kwelezintaba baphuma banihlasela, banixosha kuhle kwezinyosi, baninqoba eSeyiri, kwaze kwaba seHorma.
Nabuya, nakhala phambi kukaSimakade, kodwa uSimakade akalilalelanga izwi lokukhala kwenu.
Nahlala eKadeshi izinsuku eziningi, nilokhu nihlezi khona.”
“Sabe sesiphenduka, sahamba, salibhekisa ehlane ngendlela eya oLwandle Lomhlanga, njengalokhu ayeshilo kimi uSimakade. Intaba iSeyiri sayizungeza izinsuku eziningi.
“USimakade wathi kimi:
‘Sekwanele ukuba nilokhu nizungeza le ntaba; phendukani, nilibangise enyakatho.
Yala abantu, uthi: “Niyodabula umngcele wabafowenu bozalo luka-Esawu abahlala eSeyiri. Bayonesaba, nokho anoqaphela,
ningalwi nabo, ngokuba angiyukuninika izwe labo, ngisho nendawo yamathe onyawo, ngokuba iSeyiri ngalinika u-Esawu ukuba libe yifa lakhe.
Niyothenga kubo ngesiliva ukudla eniyokudla, namanzi eniyowaphuza, niwakhokhele isiliva.” ’

“USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ukubusisile emsebenzini wonke wesandla sakho. Ukwazile ukuhamba kwakho kuleli hlane elikhulu, nakule minyaka engama-40, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ube nawe, aweswelanga lutho.
“Sabe sesidlula kubafowethu bozalo luka-Esawu, abahlala eSeyiri, sayishiya indlela e-Araba, e-Elathi, nase-Eziyoni Gebheri. Saphenduka sadlula ngendlela esehlane kwaMowabi.

“USimakade wayesethi kimi: ‘Ungamkhathazi uMowabi, ungabahlaseli ukuba ulwe nabo, ngokuba angiyukukunika izwe lakhe libe yifa lakho, njengalokhu ngabanika lona abozalo lukaLothi, i-Ari, libe yifa labo.’ ”
Kwakuhlala khona kuqala ama-Emithe, abantu abakhulu, abaningi, nabade njengama-Anaki.
Nabo njengama-Anaki, kwakuthiwa ngamaRefa, kodwa abakwaMowabi babebabiza ngama-Emi.

AmaHori ayehlala lapho eSeyiri kuqala, ephucwa izwe lawo, abhujiswa phambi kwabo ngabozalo luka-Esawu, kwaba yibo abakha endaweni yawo, njengoba no-Israyeli enza ezweni eliyifa lakhe, aliphiwa nguSimakade.
“Manje sukani, niwele umfula iZeredi.” Sabe sesiwuwela umfula iZeredi.

“Izinsuku esazihamba sisuka eKadeshi Bharineya size siyowela umfula iZeredi kwaba yiminyaka engama-38, saze saphela sonke leso sizukulwane samabutho empi phakathi kwenkambu, njengalokho uSimakade ayefungile.
Impela isandla sikaSimakade sasimelene nawo ukuwabhubhisa phakathi kwenkambu, aze aphele nya.
“Kwathi lapho esefe aphela wonke amadoda empi phakathi kwabantu,
uSimakade wakhuluma kimi, wathi:
‘Wena usuzoliwela i-Ari, umngcele kwaMowabi.
Akothi lapho ususeduze nabakwa-Amoni, ungabakhathazi, ungalwi nabo, ngokuba angiyukukunika izwe labakwa-Amoni libe yifa lenu, lokhu ngibanike lona abozalo lukaLothi libe yifa labo.’ ”
Nalelo kwakuthiwa yizwe lamaRefa, ngoba amaRefa ahlala kulo kuqala. Abakwa-Amoni babewabiza ngokuthi ngamaZamuzumi,
abantu abakhulu, abaningi, nabade njengama-Anaki. USimakade wawabhubhisa bebuka, wawaphuca izwe lawo, kwase kwakha abakwa-Amoni endaweni yawo.
Njengalokhu enza kwabozalo luka-Esawu ababehlala eSeyiri, ngesikhathi ebhubhisa amaHori phambi kwabo, ewephuca izwe lawo, kwase kuhlala bona endaweni yawo kuze kube yinamuhla.
Kanjalo nama-Avi ayehlala emizaneni kuze kufike eGaza, nawo eza, abhubhisa amaKhafithori ayevela eKhafithori, abe esakha endaweni yawo.
“ ‘Sukani nihambe, niwele umfula i-Arinoni; bhekani, nginikele esandleni sakho uSihoni, umAmori inkosi yaseHeshibhoni, nezwe lakhe: qala ukulidla ngokuba ulwe naye empini.
Namuhla ngiyakuqala ukufaka uvalo nokukwesaba phezu kwezizwe zonke eziphansi kwezulu, lapho zizwa imibiko ngawe, ziyakuthuthumela, ziqhaqhazele ngenxa yakho.’
“Ngabe sengithumela izithunywa kuSihoni inkosi yaseHeshibhoni, zisuka ehlane iKedemothi, ziphethe amazwi okuthula, athi:
‘Ngicela ukudabula ezweni lakho, ngizohamba ngomgwaqo, angizukujikela kwesokunene noma ngakwesokhohlo.
Uyongithengisela ukudla ngemali ukuba ngidle, namanzi ngemali ukuba ngiphuze; ngivumele nje kuphela ukuba ngidabule ngezinyawo,
njengalokhu kwenza kimi abozalo luka-Esawu abahlala eSeyiri nabakwaMowabi abahlala e-Ari, ngize ngiwele iJordani, ngingene ezweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu asinika lona.’

Kodwa uSihoni, inkosi yaseHeshibhoni, akasivumelanga ukuba sidabule ezweni lakhe, ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho wawenza lukhuni umoya wakhe, wamenza waba nenkani enhliziyweni yakhe, ukuze amnikele esandleni sakho njenganamuhla.
“USimakade wayesethi kimi: ‘Bheka, sengiqalile ukunikela uSihoni nezwe lakhe kuwe: qala ukulidla izwe lakhe ukuba libe yifa lakho.’
“USihoni waphuma, yena nabo bonke abantu bakhe, ukuzobhekana nathi, alwe nathi eJahazi.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wethu wamnikela kithi, samnqoba, yena namadodana akhe nabantu bakhe bonke.
Sayidla yonke imizi yakhe ngaleso sikhathi, sayibhubhisa yonke imizi eyayinamadoda nabesifazane nezingane, sayiqeda nya; kwangasala muntu.
Sazithathela imfuyo nje yaba yimpango yethu, nalokho esakuphanga emizini esasiyinqobile.
Kusukela e-Aroweri elisosebeni lomfula i-Arinoni nasemzini osesigodini kuze kube kwaGileyadi, akubangabikho muzi owasehlulayo ngokuphakama; uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu wayinikela yonke kithi.
Nokho izwe labakwa-Amoni awuzange usondele kulo, kusukela engxenyeni engenhla yomfula iJakobi, nemizi ekwelezintaba, njengakho konke uSimakade uNkulunkulu ayesiyale ngakho.”
“Saphenduka, sakhuphuka ngendlela eya eBhashani, u-Ogi, inkosi yaseBhashani, waphuma wazobhekana nathi, yena nabantu bakhe bonke, balwa nathi ngase-Edireyi.
USimakade wayesethi kimi: ‘Ungamesabi, ngoba yena nabantu bakhe bonke nezwe lakhe ngikunikele esandleni sakho. Uyokwenza kuye njengoba wenzile kuSihoni, inkosi yama-Amori, owayehlala eHeshibhoni.’
“USimakade uNkulunkulu wethu wamnikela esandleni sethu u-Ogi, inkosi yaseBhashani nabantu bakhe bonke; sabacekela phansi ngenkemba, akwaze kwasala muntu.
Sayidla yonke imizi yakhe ngaleso sikhathi; akwaze kwasala muzi esingawudlanga: kwakuyimizi engama-60, sonke isifunda i-Arigobhi nombuso ka-Ogi eBhashani.
Yonke leyo mizi yayibiyelwe ngezingange eziphakemeyo, inamasango nemigoqo, ngaphandle kwemizana eminingi kakhulu eyayingabiyelwe.
Sayibhubhisa yaphela nya, njengalokhu senza kuSihoni, inkosi yaseHeshibhoni, sayishaya sayiqothula yonke imizi enamadoda, abesifazane, nezingane.
Sazithathela yonke imfuyo nempango eyayisemizini.
“Salithatha ngaleso sikhathi izwe esandleni samakhosi ama-Amori ayengaphesheya kweJordani, kusukela esigodini i-Arinoni kuze kube sentabeni iHermoni.
IHermoni, abakwaSidoni bayibiza ngokuthi yiSiriyoni; ama-Amori wona ayibiza ngokuthi yiSeniri,
sayithatha yonke imizi esethafeni lakwaGileyadi, iBhashani lonke kuze kube seSalekha nase-Edireyi, imizi yasembusweni ka-Ogi eBhashani.

Ngu-Ogi kuphela, inkosi yaseBhashani, owasala ensalini yamaRefa. Bheka, ibhokisi lakhe lomngcwabo kwakungelensimbi, alitholakali yini eRabha labantu bakwa-Amoni na? Ubude balo bungamakhubhithi ayisishiyagalolunye, ububanzi balo bungamakhubhithi amane, ngokwesilinganiso.
“Leli lizwe salidla ngaleso sikhathi; izwe elisukela e-Aroweri elisesigodini i-Arinoni, nengxenye yelezintaba kwaGileyadi, nemizi yalo, sakunika abakwaRubeni nabakwaGadi.
Ingxenye esele yakwaGileyadi, nalo lonke iBhashani, umbuso ka-Ogi, lokho ngakunika ingxenye yesizwana sakwaManase, sonke isifunda i-Arigobhi neBhashani lonke elibizwa ngokuthi izwe lamaRefa.
UJayire, indodana kaManase, wathatha sonke isifunda i-Arigobhi kuze kube semngceleni wamaGeshuri nowamaMahakhathi, iBhashani, walibiza ngegama lakhe wathi yiHawothi Jayire, kuze kube yinamuhla.
UMakhiri ngamnika elakwaGileyadi.
AbakwaRubeni nabakwaGadi ngabanika kusukela kwaGileyadi kuze kube sesigodini i-Arinoni, phakathi nesigodi kwaba ngumngcele wabo. Umfula iJakobi ingumngcele wabantu bakwa-Amoni,
i-Araba, neJordani kwaba ngumngcele kusukela eKhinerethi kuze kube solwandle i-Araba, kuya oLwandle Lukasawoti, phansi kwemithambeka iPhisiga, ngasempumalanga.
“Ngaleso sikhathi nganiyala ngathi: ‘USimakade uNkulunkulu wenu uninikile leli lizwe ukuba nilidle; niyakuwelisa phambi kwabafowenu bakwa-Israyeli wonke amadoda anesibindi ehlomile.
Kuyosala omkenu, izingane zenu, nemfuyo yenu kuphela, ngiyazi ukuthi ninemfuyo eningi; konke kuyosala emizini yenu engininike yona.
USimakade aze abanike abafowenu ukuphumula njengani, nabo balidle izwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu abanika lona ngaphesheya kweJordani, andukuba lowo nalowo abuyele efeni lakhe engimnike lona.’

“Ngamyala uJoshuwa ngaleso sikhathi, ngathi: ‘Amehlo akho abonile konke uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu akwenze kulawa makhosi amabili, ngakho-ke uSimakade uyokwenza kanjalo kuyo yonke imibuso enisazodabula kuyo.
Ningabesabi, ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu nguye ozakunilwela.’
“Ngaleso sikhathi nganxusa kuSimakade, ngathi:

‘Nkosi Simakade, uqalile ukubonisa inceku yakho ubukhulu bakho nesandla sakho esinamandla, ngokuba ngumuphi unkulunkulu ezulwini nasemhlabeni ongenza imisebenzi enjengeyakho nongenza imisebenzi emikhulu njengeyakho na?
Ngiyacela, ngivumele ngiwele ukuze ngilibone izwe elihle elingaphesheya kweJordani, lelo lizwe elihle lezintaba kanye neLebhanoni.’
“Kepha uSimakade wangithukuthelela ngenxa yenu, akabe esangilalela. USimakade wathi kimi: ‘Kwanele manje; ungaphinde ukhulume nami ngale ndaba.
Khuphukela esicongweni iPhisiga, uphakamisele amehlo akho ngasentshonalanga, enyakatho, eningizimu, nangasempumalanga, uzibonele ngokwakho, ngokuba awuyukuliwela leli Jordani.
Kodwa yala uJoshuwa, umqunge isibindi, umqinise, ngokuba uyakuwela ehola laba bantu, abenze ukuba balidle izwe oyakulibona.’
“Sahlala-ke esigodini esimalungana neBhethi Pheyori.”
“Manje-ke, Israyeli, yizwani izimiso nezehlulelo enginifundisa zona ukuba nizenze, ukuze niphile, ningene, nilidle izwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho benu aninika lona.
Aniyukuthasisela ezwini enginiyala ngalo, futhi aniyukunciphisa lutho kulo, kodwa gcinani imiyalo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu enginiyala ngayo.
“Amehlo enu akubonile uSimakade akwenza eBhali Pheyori, ukuthi uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho wababhubhisa kanjani bonke abantu owawukanye nabo, labo abalandela uBhali Pheyori.
Kodwa nina enanamathela kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, nisaphila nonke nanamuhla.
“Bhekani, nginifundisile izimiso nezehlulelo, njengokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wami engiyalile ukuba nenze kanjalo phakathi kwezwe enizongena kulo ukuba nilidle.

Ngalokho niyoqaphela ukuba nizigcine, ngokuba lokhu kuyoba ngukuhlakanipha kwenu nokuqonda kwenu emehlweni ezizwe eziyakuzwa ngazo zonke lezi zimiso, futhi ziyakuthi: ‘Impela lesi sizwe esikhulu singabantu abahlakaniphileyo nabaqondayo.’
Yisiphi isizwe esikhulu esinonkulunkulu oseduze naso njengoba enjalo uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu noma yinini lapho simbiza, na?
Yisiphi isizwe esikhulu esinezimiso nezehlulelo ezilungile njengawo wonke lo mthetho engiwubeka phambi kwenu namuhla na?

“Kepha qikelela, uqaphele kakhulu, funa ukhohlwe yizinto ozibonile ngamehlo akho, funa zisuke enhliziyweni yakho izinsuku zonke zokuhamba kwakho. Bazise zona abantwana bakho nabantwana babantwana babo nokuthi,

lwalunjani usuku owema ngalo phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho eHorebhe, lapho uSimakade athi kimi: ‘Ngiqoqele abantu ukuze ngibazwise amazwi ami, bafunde ukungesaba zonke izinsuku zokuhamba kwabo emhlabeni, futhi bawafundise nabantwana babo.’
“Nasondela, nema phansi kwentaba; intaba yayivutha umlilo kuze kube semkhathini, inamafu amnyama nesigayegaye sobumnyama.
USimakade wakhuluma kini ephakathi emlilweni; nezwa izwi likhuluma, kodwa anibonanga simo, nezwa izwi kuphela.
Wamemezela kini isivumelwano sakhe aniyala ngaso ukuba nisigcine, imiyalelo elishumi ayiloba ezibhebheni ezimbili zamatshe.
USimakade wangiyala ngaleso sikhathi ukuba nginifundise izimiso nezehlulelo ukuze nizigcine ezweni enizongena kulo ukulidla.
“Qaphelani kakhulu, lokhu ningabonanga simo ngalolo lusuku lapho uSimakade ekhuluma nani eHorebhe, ephakathi komlilo.
Funa nenze okubi, nizenzele izithombe ezibaziweyo, eziwumfanekiso wowesilisa noma wowesifazane,
umfanekiso wesilwane esisemhlabeni, noma wenyoni enamaphiko endiza emkhathini,
noma umfanekiso wesilwanyana esinwabuzelayo emhlabeni, noma umfanekiso wenhlanzi esemanzini phansi komhlaba;

hleze uphakamisele amehlo akho ezulwini, ubone ilanga, inyanga, izinkanyezi, nalo lonke ibandla lezulu, bese uyengeka, ukhuleke kukho, ukukhonze, lokho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akwabele izizwe zonke eziphansi kwezulu.
Nokho uSimakade wakuthatha wena, wakukhipha esithandweni sensimbi, iGibhithe, ukuze nibe ngabantu abayifa lakhe njenganamuhla.
“USimakade wangithukuthelela ngenxa yenu, wafunga ukuthi angiyukuliwela iJordani nokuthi angiyukungena kulelo lizwe elihle uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona, libe yifa lakho.
Kepha mina sengizakufa kuleli lizwe, angizukuliwela iJordani, kodwa nina nizoliwela, nilidle leli lizwe elihle.
Qaphelani, funa nikhohlwe isivumelwano sikaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu asenza nani, bese nizenzela izithombe ezibaziweyo ngomfanekiso wento uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akuyala ngayo.
Ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ungumlilo oqothulayo, unguNkulunkulu onomhawu.

“Kuyothi lapho sewuzele abantwana, nabo bazala ababo, senihlale isikhathi eside ezweni, bese nona, nenze izithombe ezibaziweyo ngomfanekiso wento ethile, nenze okubi emehlweni kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, nimthukuthelise,
ngibiza izulu nomhlaba ukuba kube ngufakazi ngani namuhla, ukuthi niyakuqothulwa niphele masinyane ezweni eniwela iJordani ukuba nilidle. Izinsuku zenu aziyukwanda kulo, niyakuqothulwa nokuqothulwa.
USimakade uyakunihlakazela ezizweni, nisale niyingcosana phakathi kwabezizwe, lapho uSimakade eyakunixoshela khona.
Lapho niyokhonza onkulunkulu abayimisebenzi yezandla zabantu, onkulunkulu bemithi namatshe, abangaboni, abangezwa, abangadli nabangahogeli.
Niyomfuna uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu nilapho, nimfumane. Niyakumfuna ngenhliziyo yenu yonke nangawo wonke umphefumulo wenu.
Ekuhluphekeni kwakho, lapho wehlelwa yizo zonke lezo zinto, uyophendukela kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ngezinsuku zokugcina, ulalele izwi lakhe.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho unguNkulunkulu onomusa; akayukukushiya, akayukukubhubhisa, futhi akayukusikhohlwa isivumelwano asifunga kokhokho bakho.

“Ake ubuze izinsuku ezidlulileyo ezaziphambi kwakho, kusukela osukwini uNkulunkulu adala ngalo abantu emhlabeni, kusukela kolunye uhlangothi lwezulu kuze kufike kolunye, ukuthi kukhona yini okufana nale nto engaka okwake kwenzeka, futhi kukhona yini okwake kwezwakala okufana nakho na?
Abantu bake balizwa yini izwi likaNkulunkulu likhuluma livela phakathi emlilweni, njengalokho ulizwile, baphila na?

Ukhona yini unkulunkulu owake walinga ukuza azithathele isizwe phakathi kwesinye isizwe ngezilingo, ngezibonakaliso, ngezimangaliso, ngempi, ngesandla esinamandla, ngengalo eyeluliweyo, nangengebhe enkulu njengakho konke uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu anenzela khona eGibhithe, nizibonela ngawenu, na?
“Wena wakuboniswa lokho ukuze wazi ukuthi uSimakade unguNkulunkulu, akekho omunye ngaphandle kwakhe.
Esezulwini wakuzwisa izwi lakhe ukuba akufundise; emhlabeni wakubonisa umlilo wakhe omkhulu; wawezwa amazwi akhe evela phakathi komlilo.
Ngenxa yokuba ebathanda okhokho bakho, wazikhetha izizukulwane zabo emva kwakho; wakukhipha Yena uqobo eGibhithe ngamandla akhe amakhulu,
waxosha izizwe ezinkulu nezinamandla kunawe phambi kwakho, ukuze akungenise, akunike izwe lazo, libe yifa lakho njengoba kunjalo nanamuhla.
“Yazi namuhla, ukufake enhliziyweni yakho ukuthi uSimakade unguNkulunkulu ezulwini phezulu nasemhlabeni phansi; akekho omunye.

Uyogcina izimiso zakhe nemiyalo yakhe engikuyala ngakho namuhla ukuze kube kuhle kuwe, nakubantwana bakho emva kwakho, ukuze zande izinsuku zakho ezweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona, kuze kube phakade.”
UMose wehlukanisa imizi emithathu phesheya kweJordani ngasempumalanga
ukuba umbulali abalekele khona, obulala umakhelwane wakhe engahlosile, ebekade engamzondi, uyophila uma ebalekela komunye waleyo mizi:
iBhezeri elisehlane ezweni eliyithafa libe ngelabakwaRubeni, iRamothi ekwaGileyadi ibe ngeyabakwaGadi, neGolanu eseBhashani ibe ngeyabakwaManase.
Yiwo lo umthetho uMose awubeka phambi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli,
yibo lobu ubufakazi, izimiso, nezehlulelo uMose akukhuluma kubantu bakwa-Israyeli ekuphumeni kwabo eGibhithe,
phesheya kweJordani esigodini maqondana neBhethi Pheyori ezweni likaSihoni inkosi yama-Amori, owayehlala eHeshibhoni, owanqotshwa nguMose nabantu bakwa-Israyeli ekuphumeni kwabo eGibhithe.
Balidla izwe lakhe, badla nelika-Ogi inkosi yaseBhashani, amakhosi amabili ama-Amori ayengaphesheya kweJordani ngasempumalanga,
kusukela e-Aroweri eliseceleni kwesigodi i-Arinoni kuya entabeni iSiyoni, okuyiHermoni,
nalo lonke i-Araba, phesheya kweJordani ngasempumalanga, kuze kube solwandle i-Araba phansi kwemithambeka iPhisiga.
UMose wayesebiza wonke u-Israyeli, wathi kuye: “Yizwa, Israyeli, izimiso nezehlulelo engizisho ezindlebeni zakho namuhla ukuba uzifunde bese uqikelela ukuzenza.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wethu wenza isivumelwano nathi eHorebhe.
USimakade akasenzanga lesi sivumelwano nobaba, wasenza nathi, thina sonke esilapha, esisaphila namuhla.
USimakade wakhuluma nani ubuso nobuso entabeni, esemlilweni.
Ngaleso sikhathi mina ngangimi phakathi kukaSimakade nani ukuze nginazise izwi likaSimakade, ngokuba nesaba ngenxa yomlilo, anikhuphukelanga entabeni. Wathi:
“ ‘NginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho owakukhipha eGibhithe, indlu yobugqila.
“ ‘Ungabi nabanye onkulunkulu ngaphandle kwami.
“ ‘Ungazenzeli izithombe ezibaziweyo zomfanekiso wokusezulwini phezulu, nokusemhlabeni phansi, nokusemanzini phansi komhlaba.
Ungazikhothameli, ungazikhonzi, ngokuba Mina Simakade uNkulunkulu wakho nginguNkulunkulu onomhawu, ngijezisela ububi bawoyise kubantwana kuso isizukulwane sesithathu nesesine sabangizondayo,
kepha ngibenzela umusa abayizinkulungwane abangithandayo, bagcine imiyalelo yami.
“ ‘Ungaliphathi ngeze igama likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ngokuba uSimakade akayukumyeka angamjezisi oliphatha ngeze igama lakhe.
“ ‘Gcina usuku lwesabatha, ulungcwelise, njengalokhu uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ekuyalile.
Uyosebenza izinsuku eziyisithupha, uwenze wonke umsebenzi wakho,

kepha usuku lwesikhombisa luyisabatha likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho; awuyukusebenza msebenzi ngalo, wena nendodana yakho, nendodakazi yakho, nenceku yakho, nencekukazi yakho, nenkabi yakho, nembongolo yakho, nayo yonke imfuyo yakho, nomfokazi ophakathi kwamasango akho, ukuze inceku yakho nencekukazi yakho baphumule njengawe.

Khumbula ukuthi nawe wawuyisigqila eGibhithe, nokuthi uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho wakukhipha khona ngesandla esinamandla nangengalo eyeluliweyo; yingakho-ke uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho wakuyala ukuba ugcine usuku lwesabatha.
“ ‘Yazisa uyihlo nonyoko, njengalokhu uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ekuyalile, ukuze izinsuku zakho zibe zinde, kube kuhle kuwe ezweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona.
“ ‘Ungabulali.
“ ‘Ungaphingi.
“ ‘Ungebi.
“ ‘Ungafakazi ngamanga ngomakhelwane wakho.
“ ‘Ungamfisi umfazi womakhelwane wakho; ungayifisi indlu yomakhelwane wakho, insimu yakhe, inceku yakhe, incekukazi yakhe, inkabi yakhe, imbongolo yakhe, nokunye kukamakhelwane wakho.’

“Yilawo amazwi uSimakade awakhuluma enhlanganweni yenu yonke entabeni, ephakathi komlilo, nefu, nesigayegaye sobumnyama, nangezwi elikhulu, akathasiselanga lutho. Wawaloba ezibhebheni ezimbili zamatshe, wanginika zona.
“Kwathi lapho nilizwa izwi elivela phakathi kobumnyama, intaba ivutha umlilo, nasondela kimi, zonke izinhloko zezizwana zenu namalunga enu,

nathi: ‘Bheka, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu usibonisile inkazimulo yakhe nobukhulu bakhe, salizwa izwi lakhe livela phakathi komlilo. Namuhla sibonile ukuthi uNkulunkulu uyakhuluma nomuntu, adlule aphile.
Pho siyakufelani na? Leli kloba liyakusiqeda. Uma sibuye salizwa izwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu, siyokufa,
ngokuba ngubani kubantu owake wezwa izwi likaNkulunkulu ophilayo njengathi, likhuluma livela emlilweni, waphila, na?
Sondela wena, uzwe konke lokho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu azokukhuluma, bese wena ukhuluma nathi, usitshele wonke amazwi uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu azowasho kuwe, siyokulalela, siwenze.’
“USimakade wawezwa amazwi enawakhuluma kimi; uSimakade wayesethi kimi: ‘Ngiwezwile amazwi alaba bantu, abawakhulume kuwe; basho kahle konke abakukhulumile.
Sengathi kungaba njalo enhliziyweni yabo, bangesabe, bayigcine njalo yonke imiyalelo yami, ukuze kube kuhle kubo nakubantwana babo kuze kube phakade.
“ ‘Hamba, usho kubo uthi: “Buyelani emathendeni enu.”
“ ‘Kepha wena, yima lapha nami ukuze ngiyikhulume kuwe yonke imiyalo, izimiso, nezehlulelo oyakubafundisa khona konke ukuba bakwenze ezweni engibanika lona, ukuba balidle.’
“Niyoqaphela ukuba nenze njengalokhu uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu eniyalile, ningaphendukeli ngakwesokunene noma ngakwesokhohlo.
Niyohamba njalo endleleni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu aniyale ngayo, ukuze niphile futhi kube kuhle kini, zande izinsuku zenu ezweni eniyakulidla.”
“Nanku umyalelo, nezimiso, nezehlulelo uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu ayala ukuba nikufundiswe, futhi nikwenze ezweni eniya kulo ukulidla,

ukuze umesabe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ugcine zonke izimiso zakhe nemiyalo yakhe engikuyala ngakho, wena nendodana yakho nendodana yendodana yakho, zonke izinsuku zokuhamba kwakho, kwandiswe imihla yakho.
Yizwa-ke Israyeli, uqikelele ukukwenza, ukuze kube kuhle kuwe, nande kakhulu, njengalokhu uSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho bakho akuthembisa izwe elichichima ubisi noju.
“Yizwa, Israyeli: uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu, uSimakade, munye.
Mthande uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ngayo yonke inhliziyo yakho, nangawo wonke umphefumulo wakho, nangawo wonke amandla akho.
Lawa mazwi engikuyala ngawo namuhla mawahlale enhliziyweni yakho.
Ubafundise wona abantwana bakho, uwakhulume lapho uhlezi endlini yakho, nalapho uhamba endleleni; lapho ulala, nalapho uvuka.
Uyakuwabophela abe wuphawu esandleni sakho, abe yisikhumbuzo phakathi kwamehlo akho.
Ubowaloba ezinsikeni zomnyango wendlu yakho nasemasangweni akho.
“Kuyothi lapho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ekungenisa ezweni afunga ngalo kokhokho, u-Abhrahama, u-Isaka, noJakobe, ukuthi uzoninika lona: imizi emikhulu nemihle ongayakhanga,
izindlu ezigcwele zonke izinto ezinhle ongazigcwalisanga, imithombo embiweyo ongayimbanga, izivini neminqumo ongakutshalanga, uyodla futhi usuthe,
kodwa uqaphele ukuba ungakhohlwa nguSimakade owakukhipha eGibhithe, indlu yobugqila.
“Mesabe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho; umkhonze Yena, ufunge igama lakhe.
Aniyukulandela abanye onkulunkulu, onkulunkulu babantu abanizungezile
ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ophakathi kwakho unguNkulunkulu onomhawu, funa intukuthelo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ikuvuthele, ikushabalalise ebusweni bomhlaba.
“Ningamlingi uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, njengalokhu namlinga eMasa.
Niyakugcina ngokucophelela imiyalo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, nobufakazi bakhe, nezimiso zakhe akuyale ngakho.
Uyokwenza okulungile nokuhle emehlweni kaSimakade, ukuze kube kuhle kuwe, ungene, ulidle lelo lizwe elihle uSimakade afunga kokhokho bakho
ukuthi uzozixosha zonke izitha zakho phambi kwakho, njengalokhu ekhulumile uSimakade.
“Lapho indodana yakho ikubuza ngesikhathi esizayo, ithi: ‘Bufakazi buni, nezimiso, nezehlulelo uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu aniyala ngakho, na?’
“Uyakuthi endodaneni yakho: ‘Sasiyizigqila zikaFaro eGibhithe, kodwa uSimakade wasikhipha eGibhithe ngesandla esinamandla.
USimakade wenza izibonakaliso nezimangaliso ezinkulu nezesabekayo phezu kweGibhithe, naphezu kukaFaro nendlu yakhe yonke phambi kwamehlo ethu,
wasikhipha lapho ukuze asingenise, asinike izwe alifungela kokhokho bethu.
USimakade wasiyala ukuba senze zonke lezo zimiso, simesabe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu, ukuze kube kuhle kithi njalo, asigcine siphilile njengoba kunjalo namuhla.
Kuyakuba ngukulunga kithi, uma siqaphela ukuyenza yonke le miyalo phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu, njengalokhu esiyalile.’ ”

“Kuyothi lapho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ekungenisa ezweni oya kulo ukuba ulidle, axoshe izizwe eziningi phambi kwakho, amaHithi, amaGirigashi, ama-Amori, amaKhanani, amaPherizi, amaHivi, namaJebusi; izizwe eziyisikhombisa ezinkulu nezinamandla kunawe,
nalapho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ezinikela phambi kwakho ukuba uzinqobe, uyozibhubhisa uziqede nya, awuyukwenza isivumelwano nazo, ungabi namusa kuzo.
Ungaganiselani nazo, ungayiniki indodana yakhe indodakazi yakho, ungathatheli indodana yakho indodakazi yakhe,
ngokuba uyakuphambukisa indodana yakho ekungilandeleni bese ikhonza abanye onkulunkulu; intukuthelo kaSimakade ikuvuthele, akubhubhise masinyane.
Niyokwenza kanje kubo: niyakudiliza ama-althare abo, niphihlize izinsika zabo, ninqume o-Ashera babo, nishise ngomlilo izithombe zabo ezibaziweyo.
Ngokuba uyisizwe esingcwele kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho. USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ukukhethile ukuba ube yisizwe esiyifa lakhe phezu kwezizwe zonke ezisebusweni bomhlaba.
“USimakade akanithandanga nje kuphela, akanikhethanga kunezinye izizwe ngoba nibaningi; naniyingcosana kunezizwe zonke.

Kepha kwaba ngenxa yokuba uSimakade enithanda, nangokuba wayegcina isifungo ayesenze nokhokho benu. USimakade unikhiphe ngesandla esinamandla, wanihlenga endlini yobugqila nasesandleni sikaFaro, inkosi yaseGibhithe.
Yazi-ke ukuthi uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho unguNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu othembekileyo, ogcina isivumelwano somusa kwabamthandayo abagcina imiyalo yakhe kuze kube sezizukulwaneni eziyinkulungwane,
ophindiselayo kwabamzondayo, ababhubhise; akayukulibala kulowo omzondayo, uyakuphindisela kuye.
Ngalokho-ke uyakugcina imiyalo, izimiso, nezehlulelo engikuyala ngakho namuhla, ukuba ukwenze.
“Kuyothi uma nilalela lezi zehlulelo, nizigcina, nizenza, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyakusigcina isivumelwano asenza nawe nomusa afunga ngawo kokhokho bakho.

Uyakukuthanda, akubusise, akwandise, abusise nesithelo sesibeletho sakho, isithelo somhlabathi wakho, okusanhlamvu kwakho, iwayini lakho, amafutha akho, inzalo yezinkomo zakho, nezimvu zakho zande ezweni afunga ngalo kokhokho bakho ukukunika lona.
Uyakubusiswa ngaphezu kwezizwe zonke, akuyukuba bikho phakathi kwenu owesilisa ongenanzalo nowesifazane oyinyumba, naphakathi kwemfuyo yenu.
USimakade uyakususa kuwe zonke izifo, akayukubeka kuwe izifo zaseGibhithe ezimbi ozaziyo, kodwa uyozehlisela phezu kwabo bonke abakuzondayo.
Uyakuziqeda nya zonke izizwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ayakuzinikela kuwe; iso lakho aliyukuzihawukela, awuyukubakhonza onkulunkulu bazo, ngokuba lokho kuyakuba lugibe kuwe.
“Uma uyakuthi enhliziyweni yakho: ‘Lezi zizwe ziningi kunami; ngingazixosha kanjani, na?’
ungazesabi, kodwa khumbula lokho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akwenza kuFaro nakulo lonke iGibhithe:

izilingo ezinkulu azibonayo amehlo akho, izibonakaliso, izimangaliso, isandla esinamandla nengalo eyeluliweyo, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akukhipha ngakho. USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyokwenza kanjalo kuzo zonke izizwe ozesabayo.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyothumela iminyovu phakathi kwazo, kuthi bonke abaseleyo nabazithukusileyo babhubhe baphele phambi kwakho.
Ngalokho-ke ungazesabi, ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, uNkulunkulu omkhulu nowesabekayo, uphakathi kwakho.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyozixosha lezi zizwe phambi kwakho kancane kancane; awuyukwazi ukuziqeda masinyane, funa izilwane zasendle zande zibe ziningi kunani.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyakuzinikela kuwe, uyakuzifaka ingebhe, zidideke, zize zibhujiswe.
Amakhosi azo uyowanikela esandleni sakho, wena uyoliqeda nya igama lawo phansi kwezulu; akukho muntu oyoma phambi kwakho, uze uqede ukuzibhubhisa.

Uyozishisa ngomlilo izithombe ezibaziweyo zonkulunkulu bazo; ungalifisi isiliva noma igolide elikuzo, awuyukuzithathela lona, funa libe wugibe kuwe, ngokuba lokho kuyanengeka kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.
Awuyukungenisa into eyisinengiso endlini yakho, funa nawe umiselwe ukubhujiswa njengayo; uyakuyenyanya nokuyenyanya, unengwe nokunengwa yiyo, ngokuba iyinto yokubhujiswa.”
“Yonke imiyalo enginiyala ngayo namuhla niyakuyigcina ngokucophelela ukuze niphile; niyokwanda, ningene, nilidle izwe uSimakade afunga ngalo kokhokho benu.

Uyoyikhumbula yonke indlela uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akuhola ngayo le minyaka engama-40 ehlane ukuba akuthobise, akuvivinye, ukuze azi okusenhliziyweni yakho, ukuthi uyoyigcina yini imiyalo yakhe noma qha.

Wakuthobisa, wakulambisa, wakupha ukuba udle imana obungayazi, nababengayazi ngisho okhokho bakho ukuze akwenze wazi ukuthi umuntu akaphili ngesinkwa sodwa, kodwa ngakho konke okushiwo nguSimakade; yilokho umuntu aphila ngakho.
Izingubo zakho azikugugelanga, nonyawo lwakho aluvuvukalanga kule minyaka engama-40.
Uyokwazi enhliziyweni yakho ukuthi njengalokhu wonke umuntu eyiyala indodana yakhe, kanjalo uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyakuyala nawe.
“Uyoyigcina imiyalo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ngokuhamba ezindleleni zakhe nangokuba umesabe.
Ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uzakukungenisa ezweni elihle, izwe elinemifudlana enamanzi, imithombo, namanzi aphuphuma ezinzulwini, ageleze ezigodini nasezintabeni,
izwe likakolo nebhali, imivini nemikhiwane namahananadi, izwe leminqumo enamafutha noju,
izwe lapho uyakudla khona isinkwa ungesweli lutho; awuyukudinga lutho; izwe elimatshe alo ayinsimbi, ezintabeni zalo uyakumba ithusi.
“Uyakudla usuthe, umbonge uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ngezwe elihle akunike lona.
Qaphela, funa ukhohlwe nguSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ungayigcini imiyalo yakhe, izehlulelo zakhe, nezimiso zakhe engikuyala ngakho namuhla.
Funa lapho usudlile wasutha, nalapho usuwakhile izindlu ezinhle, wahlala kuzo,
izinkomo zakho nezimvu zakho sekwandile, isiliva negolide lakho sekukuningi, sekwandile konke onakho,
bese inhliziyo yakho iqhosha, umkhohlwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho owakukhipha eGibhithe, indlu yobugqila,
wakuhola ehlane elikhulu nelesabekayo elinezinyoka ezinesihlungu nofezela nomhlabathi owomileyo, lapho kwakungekho manzi khona; wakuvezela amanzi edwaleni lensengetsha.
Wakupha imana ehlane, okhokho bakho ababengayazi, ukuze akuthobise, akuvivinye, kuthi ekugcineni akwenzele okuhle.
Uze uthi enhliziyweni yakho: ‘Amandla ami nezikhwepha zesandla sami kungizuzele yonke le mfuyo.’
“Kepha uyomkhumbula uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ngokuba nguye okupha amandla okuzuza imfuyo ukuba amise isivumelwano sakhe afunga ngaso kokhokho bakho, njenganamuhla.
“Ngiyanexwayisa namuhla ukuthi uma nje nike namkhohlwa uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, nalandela abanye onkulunkulu, nabakhonza, nakhuleka kubo, niyakubhubha nokubhubha.
Niyobhubha njengezizwe uSimakade azibhubhisa phambi kwenu, ngokuba ningalilalelanga izwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.”
“Yizwa Israyeli: uzakuwela iJordani namuhla, ungene ukuba wephuce izizwe ezinkulu nezinamandla kunawe, imizi emikhulu nebiyelwe kuze kube sezulwini,
abantu abakhulu nabade, abozalo lwama-Anaki obaziyo, ozwile ngabo kuthiwa: ‘Ngubani ongema phambi kwabozalo luka-Anaki na?’

“Yazi-ke namuhla ukuthi nguSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho odlula phambi kwakho njengomlilo oqothulayo; oyobabhubhisa, abanqobe phambi kwakho, wena uyakubaphuca izwe, ubabhubhise masinyane, njengalokhu uSimakade ekhulumile kuwe.

“Ungalokothi uzitshele enhliziyweni yakho, lapho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho esebaxoshile phambi kwakho, uthi: ‘Kwaba ngenxa yokulunga kwami ukuba uSimakade angingenise ukuze ngilidle leli lizwe,’ kodwa kungenxa yobubi balezo zizwe uSimakade azixoshile phambi kwakho.

Akubanga ngenxa yokulunga kwakho noma ubuqotho benhliziyo yakho ukuba ungene ulidle izwe lazo, kodwa kungenxa yobubi balezo zizwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho azixoshile phambi kwakho, ukuze aqinise izwi uSimakade afunga ngalo kokhokho bakho, u-Abhrahama, u-Isaka noJakobe.
Yazi-ke lokhu, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akakuniki leli lizwe elihle ukuba ulidle ngenxa yokulunga kwakho, ngokuba uyisizwe esintamo ilukhuni.
“Khumbula, ungakhohlwa ukuthi wamthukuthelisa uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ehlane. Benihlale nimhlubuka uSimakade kusukela osukwini owaphuma ngalo eGibhithe waze wafika kule ndawo.
NaseHorebhe namthukuthelisa uSimakade, uSimakade wanithukuthelela waze wafuna ukunibhubhisa.

Ngesikhathi ngikhuphukele entabeni ukuyokwemukela izibhebhe zamatshe, izibhebhe zesivumelwano uSimakade asenza nani, ngahlala entabeni izinsuku ezingama-40 nobusuku obungama-40, ngangingadli sinkwa, ngingaphuzi manzi.
USimakade wanginika izibhebhe ezimbili zamatshe, zilotshwe ngomunwe kaNkulunkulu. Kwakulotshwe kuzo wonke amazwi uSimakade ayewakhulume kini entabeni, ephakathi komlilo, ngosuku lokuhlangana.
“Ngasekupheleni kwezinsuku ezingama-40 nobusuku obungama-40, uSimakade wanginika izibhebhe ezimbili zamatshe, izibhebhe zesivumelwano.
USimakade wathi kimi: ‘Sukuma, wehle masinyane, ngokuba abantu bakho owabakhipha eGibhithe bonile, ngokushesha baphambukile endleleni engabayala ngayo; bazenzele isithombe esibunjiweyo.’
“USimakade wabuye wakhuluma kimi, wathi: ‘Ngibabonile laba bantu; bheka, bangabantu abantamo ilukhuni;
ngiyeke ukuze ngibabhubhise, ngilesule lishabalale igama labo phansi kwezulu, ngiyokwenza wena ube yisizwe esinamandla nesikhulu kunabo.’
“Ngase ngiphenduka ngehla entabeni, intaba yayivutha umlilo; izibhebhe ezimbili zesivumelwano zazisezandleni zami zombili.
Ngabona ukuthi nempela, nanonile kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu; nanizenzele ithole elibunjiweyo, naphambuka ngokushesha endleleni uSimakade ayeniyale ngayo.
Ngazithatha izibhebhe ezimbili, ngazilahla phansi ngazo zombili izandla zami, ngazephula phambi kwamehlo enu.

“Ngakhothama ngathi mbo phambi kukaSimakade njengakuqala, izinsuku ezingama-40 nobusuku obungama-40; ngingadli sinkwa, ngingaphuzi manzi ngenxa yesono senu enanone ngaso, nenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, namthukuthelisa.
Nakuba ngangilwesaba ulaka nentukuthelo uSimakade ayenithukuthelele ngakho ukuba anibhubhise, nokho uSimakade wangizwa futhi nangaleso sikhathi.
USimakade wamthukuthelela kakhulu u-Aroni, futhi wayekulungele ukuba ambhubhise; ngamkhulekela u-Aroni ngaleso sikhathi.
Ngase ngithatha isono senu, ithole enanilenzile, ngalishisa ngomlilo, ngaligxoba, ngaligayisisa laze laba njengothuli, ngaphonsa uthuli lwalo emfudlaneni owehla entabeni.
“EThabhehera, eMasa naseKibhirothi Hathava, namthukuthelisa uSimakade.
“Nalapho uSimakade enithuma, nisuka eKadeshi Bharineya, ethi: ‘Khuphukani, nilidle izwe engininike lona,’ nahlubuka ezwini likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, anaze nakholwa nguye, analilalela izwi lakhe.
Nimhlubukile uSimakade kusukela osukwini enganazi ngalo.
“Ngakhothama ngathi mbo ngobuso phambi kukaSimakade, izinsuku ezingama-40 nobusuku obungama-40, ngokuba uSimakade wayethe uzonibhubhisa.
Ngakhuleka kuSimakade, ngathi: ‘Nkosi Simakade, ungababhubhisi abantu bakho nefa lakho olihlengile ngobukhulu bakho, walikhipha eGibhithe ngesandla esinamandla.
Khumbula izinceku zakho u-Abhrahama, u-Isaka noJakobe, ungabheki inkani yalaba bantu, ububi babo, nesono sabo,
funa izwe owasikhipha kulo lithi: “Kwaba ngenxa yokuba uSimakade wayengakwazi ukubangenisa ezweni ayebathembise lona, futhi ebazonda; ubakhiphile ukuze ababulalele ehlane.”
“ ‘Bangabantu bakho nefa lakho owalikhipha ngamandla akho amakhulu nangengalo yakho eyeluliweyo.’ ”
“Ngaleso sikhathi uSimakade wathi kimi: ‘Zibazele izibhebhe zamatshe ezimbili zibe njengezakuqala, bese ukhuphukela kimi entabeni, uyozenzela ngomuthi umphongolo.
Ngiyoloba ezibhebheni amazwi ayekulezo zibhebhe zokuqala owazephulayo, bese uzifaka emphongolweni.’
“Ngase ngenza umphongolo ngomtholo, ngabaza izibhebhe ezimbili ngamatshe njengezakuqala, ngase ngikhuphukela entabeni ngiziphethe zombili izibhebhe esandleni sami.
Waloba ezibhebheni njengalokhu kwakulotshiwe kuqala, imiyalelo elishumi uSimakade ayikhuluma kini entabeni, ephakathi komlilo ngosuku lokuhlangana; uSimakade wanginika zona.
Ngaphenduka ngehla entabeni, ngazifaka izibhebhe emphongolweni engiwenzile; zikhona lapho, njengalokhu uSimakade engiyalile.”
Abakwa-Israyeli basuka eBheyerothi Bhene Jahakani, baya eMosera; u-Aroni wafela lapho, wangcwatshwa khona. U-Eleyazare, indodana yakhe, yaba ngumphristi esikhundleni sakhe.
Basuka lapho, baya eGudigoda; basuka eGudigoda baya eJothabatha, izwe lemifudlana enamanzi.
Ngaleso sikhathi uSimakade wehlukanisa isizwana sakwaLevi ukuba sithwale umphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade, nokuba sime phambi kukaSimakade ukumkhonza nokubusisa egameni lakhe, kuze kube namuhla.
Ngalokho uLevi akanasabelo nalifa kanye nabafowabo; uSimakade uyifa lakhe njengokusho kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho kuye.
“Ngahlala entabeni njengakuqala, izinsuku ezingama-40 nobusuku obungama-40; uSimakade wangilalela nangaleso sikhathi, akathandanga ukunibhubhisa.
USimakade wayesethi kimi: ‘Sukuma uhambe phambi kwabantu, ukuze bahambe, balidle izwe engafunga ngalo kokhokho babo ukubanika lona.’ ”

“Manje-ke, Israyeli, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ufunani kuwe, na? Ukuba umesabe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, uhambe ngezindlela zakhe zonke, umthande, umkhonze uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ngayo yonke inhliziyo yakho, nangawo wonke umphefumulo wakho,
ugcine imiyalo kaSimakade nezimiso zakhe engakuyala ngakho ngalolo lusuku ukuba kube kuhle kuwe.
“Bheka, izulu nezulu lamazulu, nomhlaba nakho konke okukuwo, kungokukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.
Nokho uSimakade wanamathela kokhokho benu, wabathanda, waziqoka nezizukulwane zabo emva kwabo, yebo, wakhetha nina phakathi kwezizwe zonke, njengoba kunjalo nanamuhla.
Ngalokho niyakusoka ijwabu lenhliziyo yenu, ningabe nisaba ntamo lukhuni.
Ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu unguNkulunkulu wonkulunkulu, neNkosi yamakhosi, uNkulunkulu omkhulu onamandla nowesabekayo, ongakhethi buso bamuntu, nongamukeli ukufunjathiswa.
Izintandane nomfelokazi ubenzela ubulungiswa. Uyathanda umfokazi, umnika ukudla nezingubo.
Bathandeni abafokazi, ngokuba nani naningabafokazi eGibhithe.
Uyomesaba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, umkhonze, unamathele kuye, ufunge igama lakhe.
Uludumo lwakho, unguNkulunkulu wakho okwenzele lezi zinto ezinkulu nezesabekayo ozibonile ngamehlo akho.
Okhokho bakho babengama-70 ngesikhathi behlela eGibhithe; manje uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ukwenzile waba lukhumbintethe ngangezinkanyezi zezulu.”
“Ngakho-ke uyomthanda uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ugcine imithetho yakhe, izimiso zakhe, izehlulelo zakhe, nemiyalo yakhe izinsuku zonke.
Yazini namuhla ukuthi akubona abantwana benu abangazanga nabangabonanga ukufundisa kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, ubukhulu bakhe, isandla sakhe esinamandla, ukwenza kwakhe okumangalisayo,
izibonakaliso zakhe, nezenzo zakhe azenza phakathi kweGibhithe, kuFaro inkosi yaseGibhithe nakulo lonke izwe lakhe,
nalokho akwenza empini yaseGibhithe, emahhashini abo, nasezinqoleni zabo zempi, lapho enza amanzi oLwandle Lomhlanga ukuba abaminzise ngesikhathi benixosha. USimakade wababhubhisa kuze kube namuhla.
Lokho akwenza kini ehlane naze nafika kule ndawo,

nalokho akwenza kuDathani naku-Abhiramu, amadodana ka-Eliyabe kaRubeni, lapho umhlaba uvula umlomo wawo ubagwinya nabendlu yabo, amathende abo, nayo yonke imfuyo yabo eyayiphakathi kwabo bonke abakwa-Israyeli.
Ngokuba amehlo enu ayibonile yonke imisebenzi kaSimakade emikhulu ayenzileyo.
“Ngalokho-ke niyoyigcina yonke imiyalo enginiyala ngayo namuhla ukuze nibe namandla, ningene, nilidle izwe eniwelela kulo ukuba nilidle,
nokuba nandise izinsuku zenu ezweni uSimakade afunga ngalo kokhokho benu ukubanika lona nezizukulwane zabo, izwe elichichima ubisi noju.
Izwe enizongena kulo ukuba nilidle alifani neGibhithe enaphuma kulo, lapho wawuvame ukuhlwanyela khona imbewu yakho, uyinisele njengesivande semifino,
kodwa izwe eniya kulo ukuba nilidle liyizwe lezintaba nezigodi, liphuza amanzi emvula yezulu.
Liyizwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho alinakekelayo; amehlo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ahlala eliqaphe njalo, kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka kuze kube sekupheleni kwawo.
“Kuyothi uma nilalela nokulalela imiyalo yami enginiyala ngayo namuhla, ukuba nimthande uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, nimkhonze ngayo yonke inhliziyo yenu nangawo wonke umphefumulo wenu,
ngiyolinika izwe lakini imvula ngesikhathi sayo, imvula yokuqala nemvula yakamuva, ukuba ubuthe okusanhlamvu kwakho, iwayini elisha lakho, namafutha akho.
Ngiyakunika izinkomo zakho utshani emadlelweni akho; uyodla, waneliswe.
“Qaphelani funa inhliziyo yenu ikhohliseke, niphambuke, nikhonze abanye onkulunkulu, nibakhothamele,
bese intukuthelo kaSimakade inivuthela, avale izulu, ukuze kungabi bikho mvula, izwe lingabe lisathela zithelo, niphele masinyane ezweni elihle uSimakade aninika lona.
Niyakuwabeka lawa mazwi ami enhliziyweni yenu nasemphefumulweni wenu, niwabophe abe wuphawu esandleni senu, abe yisikhumbuzo phakathi kwamehlo enu.
Niyakuwafundisa abantwana benu, ngokukhuluma ngawo, lapho uhlezi endlini yakho, nalapho uhamba endleleni, nalapho ulala, nalapho uvuka.
Uyakuwaloba ezinsikeni zomnyango wendlu yakho nasemasangweni akho
ukuba zandiswe izinsuku zakho nezinsuku zabantwana bakho ezweni uSimakade afunga kokhokho bakho ukuthi uzobanika lona, inqobo nje uma umkhathi usephezu komhlaba.
“Uma niyigcina nokuyigcina yonke le miyalo enginiyala ngayo ukuba niyenze, ukuba nimthande uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, nihambe ngazo zonke izindlela zakhe, ninamathele kuye,
uSimakade uyakuzixosha zonke lezi zizwe phambi kwenu, nizinqobe izizwe ezinkulu nezinamandla kunani.

Yonke indawo lapho amathe onyawo lwakho eyakunyathela khona, iyakuba ngeyenu, kusukela ehlane naseLebhanoni nasemfuleni, umfula iYufrathe, kuze kube solwandle olungasentshonalanga, iyakuba yindawo yenu.
Akuyukuba bikho muntu oyoma phambi kwenu. USimakade uNkulunkulu wenu uyakufaka uvalo nokwesaba ngani ezweni lonke eniyakunyathela kulo, njengalokhu akhuluma kini.
“Bheka, ngibeka phambi kwenu namuhla isibusiso nesiqalekiso.
Isibusiso, uma niyilalela imiyalo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu enginiyala ngayo namuhla.
