Isiqalekiso, uma ningayilaleli imiyalo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, kepha niphambuka endleleni enginiyala ngayo namuhla, bese nilandela abanye onkulunkulu eningabaziyo.
“Kuyothi lapho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu eningenisa ezweni eniya kulo ukulidla, nimemezele isibusiso nisentabeni iGerizimu nesiqalekiso nisentabeni i-Ebhali.
Lezi zindawo azingaphesheya yini kweJordani endleleni ebheke entshonalanga ezweni lamaKhanani ahlala e-Araba, maqondana neGiligali ngaseceleni kwemi-okhi eMore, na?
Ngokuba niyakuwela iJordani, ningene ukuba nilidle izwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu aninika lona, niyakulidla, nihlale kulo.
Niyakuqikelela ukugcina zonke izimiso nezehlulelo engizibeka phambi kwenu namuhla.”
“Nazi izimiso nezehlulelo eniyoqikelela ukuzigcina ezweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho benu aninika lona, ukuba nilidle zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwenu emhlabeni:
niyobhubhisa nishaye icole zonke izindawo lapho izizwe eniyakuziphuca izwe zazikhonza khona onkulunkulu bazo, ezintabeni eziphakemeyo, emagqumeni, naphansi kwayo yonke imithi eluhlaza.
Niyakudiliza ama-althare azo, niphihlize izinsika zazo, nishise ngomlilo o-Ashera bazo, ninqume izithombe ezibaziweyo zonkulunkulu bazo, nilishabalalise igama lazo kuleyo ndawo.
“Nina aniyukwenza kanjalo kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.
Kepha indawo uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu ayakuyikhetha, kuzo zonke izizwe zenu, ukuba abeke igama lakhe lihlale kuyo, leyo ndawo niyakuyifuna, niye kuyo,

niyiyise lapho iminikelo yenu yokushiswa, imihlatshelo yenu, okweshumi kwenu, umnikelo wenu wokuphakanyiswa wesandla senu, izithembiso zenu, iminikelo yenu yesihle, neyamazibulo ezinkomo nezimvu zenu.
Niyakudla lapho phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, nithokoze ngakho konke enibeka isandla senu kukho, nina nabendlu yenu, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho anibusise ngakho.
“Aniyukuzenza zonke izinto esizenza lapha namuhla, njengoba yilowo nalowo enza akubona kulungile emehlweni akhe,
ngokuba anikafiki endaweni yokuphumula nasefeni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu aninika lona.
Kepha niyowela iJordani, nihlale ezweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu aninika lona, libe yifa lenu. Uyakuninika ukuphumula ezitheni zenu zonke, nxazonke, futhi niyohlala nilondekile.

Kuyokuthi indawo uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu ayakuyikhetha ukuba kuhlale kuyo igama lakhe, nikuyise lapho konke enginiyala ngakho: iminikelo yenu yokushiswa, imihlatshelo yenu, okweshumi kwenu, umnikelo wokuphakanyiswa womkhiqizo wenu, nezithembiso zenu ezikhethiweyo enizethembisa uSimakade.

Niyothokoza phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, nina namadodana enu, amadodakazi enu, izinceku zenu, izincekukazi zenu, nomLevi ophakathi kwamasango enu, lokhu engenasabelo nafa elingelakhe phakathi kwenu.
Xwaya ukuba unganikeli ngeminikelo yakho yokushiswa ezindaweni zonke ozibonayo,
kodwa niyonikela ngeminikelo yenu yokushiswa endaweni uSimakade ayakuyikhetha kwesinye sezizwana zenu, nikwenze khona konke enginiyala ngakho.

“Ningahlaba, nidle inyama phakathi kwayo yonke imizi yenu njengesifiso senhliziyo yenu nanjengesibusiso uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu aniphe sona phakathi kwamasango enu. Ongcolileyo nohlambulukileyo bayokudla kukho njengalokhu benza kweyensephe neyendluzele.
Igazi kuphela eningayikulidla, kodwa niyakulichitha emhlabathini njengamanzi.

Okweshumi kokusanhlamvu kwakho, okwewayini lakho, okwamafutha akho, okwamazibulo ezinkomo zakho, okwezimvu zakho, izithembiso ozenzile, iminikelo yakho yesihle, umnikelo wokuphakanyiswa wesandla sakho, aniyukukudla ngaphakathi kwamasango enu.

Khona niyokudla phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, endaweni ayoyikhetha uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu. Kuleyo ndawo, wena nendodana yakho, indodakazi yakho, inceku yakho, incekukazi yakho, nomLevi ohlala emzini wakho, niyothokoza phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu ngayo yonke imikhiqizo yenu.
Qaphela, funa ningamnakekeli umLevi zonke izinsuku zokuhlala kwenu ezweni.

“Kuyothi lapho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu enweba umngcele wenu njengoba ayethembisile, bese nithi: ‘Ngifuna ukudla inyama,’ njengoba inhliziyo yenu ifisa ukudla inyama, niyoyidla inyama njengokufisa kwenhliziyo yenu.

Uma indawo uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu ayikhetha ukuba abeke kuyo igama lakhe ikude nani, niyohlaba emhlanjini wenu nasezimvini zenu aniphe zona uSimakade, njengalokhu nganiyala, niyokudla lokho phakathi kwamasango enu njengokufisa kwenhliziyo yenu.
Njengalokhu nidla insephe nendluzele, niyakukudla kanjalo. Ongcolileyo nohlambulukileyo bayakudla ngokufanayo.
Qaphelani kuphela ukuba ningalidli igazi, ngokuba igazi lingumphefumulo. Aniyukuwudla umphefumulo kanye nenyama.
Aniyukulidla, kodwa niyakulichitha emhlabathini njengamanzi.
Ningalidli ukuba kube kuhle kini nakubantwana benu emva kwenu, ngokuba niyobe nenza okulungile emehlweni kaSimakade.
“Izinto zenu ezingcwele ezingezenu nezithembiso zenu niyozithatha, niye nazo endaweni ayakuyikhetha uSimakade.
Niyonikela ngeminikelo yenu yokushiswa, inyama negazi e-althare likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, igazi lemihlatshelo yenu lithelwe phezu kwe-althare likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, nina nidle inyama.

Qaphelani, ukuba niwezwe wonke lawa mazwi enginiyala ngawo ukuze kube kuhle kini nakubantwana benu eniyobazala kuze kube phakade, ngokuba niyobe nenza okuhle nokulungile emehlweni kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.
“Lapho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho esezibhubhisile izizwe eziphambi kwakho, sewuzongena ukuba uzephuce izwe, nalapho sewuzephucile izwe, wahlala kulo,
emveni kokuba sezibhujisiwe, qaphela ukuba zingabi wugibe kuwe, ngokuba ubuze ngonkulunkulu bazo, uthi: ‘Lezi zizwe bezibakhonza kanjani onkulunkulu bazo, ukuze nami ngenze kanjalo na?’
Awuyukwenza kanjalo kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ngokuba zonke izinto uSimakade azenyanyayo zizenzile lezi zizwe, zenzela onkulunkulu bazo, zibashisele ngisho amadodana namadodakazi azo emlilweni.
“Konke enginiyala ngakho, qaphelani ukuba nikwenze; aniyukuthasisela kukho, futhi aniyukunciphisa lutho kukho.”
“Uma kuba khona umphrofethi phakathi kwenu, noma ophupha amaphupho, anitshele isibonakaliso nesimangaliso,
kuthi leso sibonakaliso noma isimangaliso asishilo kini senzeke, bese ethi: ‘Masilandele abanye onkulunkulu eningabaziyo, sibakhonze,’

aniyukuwalalela amazwi alowo mphrofethi, noma lowo ophupha amaphupho, ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu uyakunilinga ukuba azi ukuthi niyamthanda yini uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu ngayo yonke inhliziyo yenu nangawo wonke umphefumulo wenu, na?
“Niyolandela uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, nimesabe, nigcine imiyalo yakhe, nilalele izwi lakhe, nimkhonze, ninamathele kuye.

Lowo mphrofethi noma lowo mphuphi wamaphupho uyobulawa, ngokuba ukhulume okunihlubukisa kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu owanikhipha eGibhithe. Ngokuba nahlengwa endlini yobugqila, ukuba ningaphambukiswa endleleni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu aniyala ukuba nihambe ngayo. Niyobususa lobo bubi phakathi kwenu.

“Uma umfowenu, indodana kanyoko, noma indodana yakho, noma indodakazi yakho, noma umkakho ocamela esifubeni sakho, noma umngani wakho eningamathe nolimi naye ekuyenga ngasese, ethi: ‘Masihambe siyokhonza abanye onkulunkulu eningabaziyo,’ nina nokhokho benu,
onkulunkulu babantu abanizungezile, abaseduze nabakude nani, kusukela kolunye uhlangothi lomhlaba kuze kufike kolunye,
aniyukumvumela, aniyukumlalela; iso lakho aliyukumdabukela, aniyukumyeka, futhi aniyukumfihla,
kepha niyombulala impela. Nguwena oyogalela kuqala bese kulandela bonke abantu lapho ebulawa.
Niyakumkhanda ngamatshe aze afe, ngokuba uzame ukunihlubukisa kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu owanikhipha eGibhithe, indlu yobugqila.
Wonke u-Israyeli uyakuzwa, esabe, angaphinde enze ububi obunjengalobo obuphakathi kwenu.
“Uma uzwa kukhulunywa ngomunye wemizi yenu uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu anipha wona ukuba nakhe kuwo, kuthiwa,
abantu abathile abonakeleyo baphumile phakathi kwenu, bahlubukisa izakhamuzi zomuzi wakubo, bathi: ‘Masihambe siyokhonza abanye onkulunkulu eningabaziyo,’
uyohlola, uphenyisise, ubuzisise. Bheka, uma kuyiqiniso ukuthi leso sinengiso senziwe phakathi kwenu,
uyozibulala ngenkemba izakhamuzi zalowo muzi, uwuchithe impela, nakho konke okuphakathi kwawo, nemfuyo yawo, ukubhubhise ngenkemba.

Yonke impango yawo uyoyiqoqela phakathi nesigcawu sawo, uwushise ngomlilo, nayo yonke impango yawo, kube ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, umuzi ube yincithakalo yaphakade, ungabe usavuselelwa.
Akuyukunamathela lutho oluqalekisiweyo esandleni sakho ukuze uSimakade aphenduke entukuthelweni yakhe evuthayo, aniphathe ngomusa, abe nesihe kini, anandise, njengalokhu afunga kokhokho benu,
uma nililalela izwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu ukuba nigcine yonke imiyalo yakhe enginiyala ngayo namuhla, nenze okulungile emehlweni kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.”
“Ningabantu bakaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu; aniyukuzisika, aniyukuwaphuca amashiya enu ngenxa yofileyo.
Ngokuba ningabantu abangcwele kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu. Unikhethile ukuba nibe yisizwe esiyifa lakhe phakathi kwezizwe zonke ezisebusweni bomhlaba.
“Ungayidli noma yini enengekayo.
Nazi izilwane eniyakuzidla: inkomo, imvu, imbuzi,
indluzele, insephe, inyala, impala, impalampala, iwula, negogo.
Niyakuzidla zonke izilwane ezinezinselo ezihlukene, ezinezinselo ezihlukene kabili, nezetshisayo phakathi kwezilwane.
Kepha lezi aniyukuzidla kulezo ezetshisayo nezehlukene izinselo: ikamela, unogwaja, nembila, ngokuba ziyetshisa, azehlukene izinselo; zingcolile kini,
nengulube, nakuba yehlukene izinselo, kodwa ayetshisi; ingcolile kini; aniyukuyidla inyama yazo, aniyukuzithinta izidumbu zazo.
“Kuzo zonke ezisemanzini, nazi eniyozidla: zonke ezinamaphiko nezingcwecwe.
Kepha zonke ezingenawo amaphiko nezingcwecwe aniyukuzidla; zingcolile kini.
“Niyodla zonke izinyoni ezihlambulukileyo.
Kodwa yilezi eningayukuzidla: ukhozi, inqe, ingqungqulu,
isiphungumangathi, uheshe, unhloyile ngezinhlobo zakhe,
amagwababa wonke ngezinhlobo zawo,
intshe, inkovana, inkanku, uklebe ngezinhlobo zakhe,
isikhova, umxwagele, ifukezi,
ivuba, uphalane, umphishamanzi,
unogolantethe, unozalizingwenya ngezinhlobo zakhe, uziningweni, nelulwane.
“Zonke izilwanyana ezinamaphiko zingcolile kini: aniyukuzidla.
Kepha zonke ezinamaphiko ezihlambulukileyo niyozidla.

“Aniyukuyidla ingcuba; aniyukumnika umfokazi osemzini wenu ukuba ayidle, noma nithengise ngayo kowezizwe, ngokuba nina niyisizwe esingcwele kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu. Aniyukupheka izinyane lembuzi ngobisi lukanina.”
“Uyonikela okweshumi kwezithelo zonke zembewu yakho, ezivela ensimini unyaka nonyaka.

Uyokudla phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho endaweni ayoyikhetha ukuba igama lakhe lihlale kuyo, okweshumi kokusanhlamvu kwakho, okwewayini lakho, okwamafutha akho, okwamazibulo ezinkomo zakho, nokwezimvu zakho, ukuze ufunde ukumesaba njalo uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.

Uma indlela iyinde kakhulu kuwe ukuba ungakwazi ukukuthwala, nendawo lapho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akhethe ukubeka kuyo igama lakhe ikude kakhulu kuwe, lapho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ekubusisa,
uyakukwenana ngemali, uyisonge imali esandleni sakho, uye endaweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ayoyikhetha.

Uyothenga ngaleyo mali noma yini inhliziyo yakho eyithandayo: izinkabi, izimvu, iwayini, uphuzo olunamandla, noma yini efunwa yinhliziyo yakho, uyodla lapho phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, uthokoze, wena nabendlu yakho;
nomLevi ophakathi kwamasango akho awuyukumlahla, ngokuba akanasabelo nafa nawe.
“Ngasekupheleni kweminyaka emithathu uyokhipha njalo konke okweshumi kwezithelo zakho ngalowo nyaka, nikugcine emizini yenu;

nomLevi, lokhu engenasabelo nafa nawe, umfokazi, intandane, nomfelokazi, abasemizini yenu. Bayoza, badle, basuthe ukuze uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu anibusise emsebenzini wonke wesandla senu eniwenzayo.”
“Ngasekupheleni kweminyaka eyisikhombisa niyokwenza uyekelelo.
Nansi indlela eniyolwenza ngayo: yilowo nalowo otsheleka umakhelwane noma umfowabo okuthile, uyokuyeka angabe esakubiza kuye, ngokuba kuyobe sekumenyezelwe uyekelelo lukaSimakade.
Ningakubiza kowezizwe, kodwa noma yini eyakho ekulowo wezwe lakini, uyakuyiyekelela.
Ngaleyo ndlela akuyukuba bikho ontulayo phakathi kwenu. USimakade uNkulunkulu wenu impela uyonibusisa ezweni aninika lona ukuba nilidle, libe yifa lenu,
uma nililalela ngempela izwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, niyigcina yonke le miyalo enginiyala ngayo namuhla.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wenu uyonibusisa njengokwethembisa kwakhe, niyotsheleka izizwe eziningi, kodwa nina ningatsheleki lutho kuzo. Niyobusa izizwe eziningi, kepha zona aziyukunibusa.

“Uma kukhona ompofu phakathi kwenu, engomunye wabafowenu, ehlala komunye wemizi esezweni lakini uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu aninika lona, aniyukuyenza lukhuni inhliziyo yenu; aniyukumncisha lutho kweninakho umfowenu ontulayo.
Kepha niyomvulela isandla senu, umtsheleke ngokungathi uyamupha okwanele izidingo zakhe nokweswela kwakhe.

Qaphelani ukuba ningabi nomcabango omubi enhliziyweni yenu, nithi: ‘Unyaka wesikhombisa, unyaka woyekelelo ususondele,’ bese nimbheka kabi umfowenu ompofu, ningabe nisamnika lutho. Kuyothi lapho ekhala kuSimakade ngani, lokho kube yisono sakho.
Niyomnika ngokwevile, nangenhliziyo ekhululekile ngesikhathi nimnika, ngokuba ngenxa yalokho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyowubusisa wonke umsebenzi wenu, nakho konke enibeka isandla senu kukho.
Abampofu bayohlala bekhona ezweni; ngakho-ke ngiyaniyala, ngithi: ‘Niyomvulela nokumvulela umfowenu isandla senu ngokuphana, abampofu bakini nabasweleyo bakini ezweni lakini.’
“Uma umfowenu, umHebheru noma umHebherukazi, ezithengisa kini, ukuze anikhonze iminyaka eyisithupha, ngonyaka wesikhombisa niyakumyekela ukuba ahambe.
Uyakumyekela ukuba ahambe kodwa awuyukumhambisa elambatha.
Uyomupha kuvame izimvu, nanoma yini evela esibuyeni sakho, nasesikhamweni sakho sewayini; njengalokhu uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ekubusisile, wenze kanjalo nakuye.
Uyokhumbula ukuthi wawuyisigqila eGibhithe, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho wakuhlenga, ngakho-ke ngiyakuyala ngalokhu namuhla.
“Kuyothi uma ethi kuwe: ‘Angizukusuka kuwe,’ ngoba ekuthanda wena nendlu yakho, futhi ehlale kahle nawe,
uyothatha usungulo umbhoboze indlebe esesemnyango; abe yinceku yakho kuze kube phakade. Uyokwenza kanjalo nasencekukazini yakho.
“Ungakuthathi sengathi kungukucindezelwa nxa usumdedela ukuba ahambe, ngokuba ukukhonze iminyaka eyisithupha, umnika imali yomqashwa. USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyokubusisa kukho konke okwenzayo.”
“Wonke amazibulo amaduna ayozalwa ezinkomeni zakho nasezimvini zakho uyowangcwelisela uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho; awuyukusebenza ngezibulo lezinkomo zakho, awuyukuligunda izibulo lezimvu zakho.
Wena nabendlu yakho, niyolidla phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, iminyaka ngeminyaka, endaweni uSimakade ayakuyikhetha.
Uma linesici, liqhuga, noma liyimpumputhe, noma ngabe linasici sini, awuyukunikela ngalo kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.
Uyolidlela emasangweni akho, ongcolileyo nohlambulukileyo ngokufanayo njengoba kwenzeka ensepheni nasendluzeleni.
Igazi lalo kuphela ongeyukulidla; uyolithela emhlabathini njengamanzi.”
“Gcina inyanga ka-Abibi, wenze iphasika kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ngokuba ngenyanga ka-Abibi, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho wakukhipha eGibhithe ebusuku.
Uyonikela ngephasika kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ezimvini nasezinkomeni endaweni uSimakade ayoyiqokela ukuba kuhlale kuyo igama lakhe.

Awuyukudla sinkwa esivutshelweyo kanye nalo; izinsuku eziyisikhombisa uyakudla isinkwa esingenamvubelo kanye nalo, isinkwa senhlupheko, ngokuba waphuma eGibhithe ngokushesha ukuba ulukhumbule usuku owaphuma ngalo eGibhithe zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwakho.
Akuyukubonakala mvubelo kuwe endaweni yakho yonke, izinsuku eziyisikhombisa. Akuyukuba bikho nyama yomhlatshelo eyakusala ngosuku lokuqala kusihlwa, kuze kube ngakusasa.
“Iphasika awuyukulihlabela emizini yakho ewayinikwa nguSimakade uNkulunkulu,
kodwa niyokulihlabela endaweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu ayoyiqokela ukuba igama lakhe lihlale kuyo. Niyolihlabela lapho iphasika ekushoneni kwelanga kusihlwa, ngesikhathi owaphuma ngaso eGibhithe.
Uyolipheka, ulidle endaweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ayoyikhetha, bese uphenduka ekuseni ubuyela emathendeni akho.
Izinsuku eziyisithupha uyokudla isinkwa esingenamvubelo. Ngosuku lwesikhombisa, kuyoba ngumhlangano ozothileyo kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho; awuyukwenza msebenzi ngalo.
“Uyozibalela amasonto ayisikhombisa; kusukela esikhathini oqale ngaso ukuvuna okusanhlamvu, uqale ubale amasonto ayisikhombisa.
Uyogcina umkhosi wamasonto kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ngesipho somnikelo wesihle, wesandla sakho, oyakuwunikela njengalokhu uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ekubusisile.

Uyokwenama phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, wena nendodana yakho, indodakazi yakho, inceku yakho, incekukazi yakho, umLevi ohlala emzini wakho, umfokazi, intandane, nomfelokazi ohlala phakathi kwenu, uyokwenza lokhu endaweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ayakuyikhetha ukuba igama lakhe lihlale khona.
Uyokhumbula ukuthi wawuyisigqila eGibhithe, uqaphele ukuba uzilondoloze, futhi uzenze lezi zimiso.
“Uyogcina uMkhosi Wamadokodo izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, emveni kokubutha okwesibuya sakho nokwesikhamo sakho,
wename ngomkhosi wakho, wena nendodana yakho, indodakazi yakho, inceku yakho, incekukazi yakho, umLevi, umfokazi, intandane, nomfelokazi ophakathi kwamasango akho.

Uyogcina umkhosi kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, endaweni uSimakade ayoyikhetha, ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyokuwubusisa wonke umkhiqizo wakho, nawo wonke umsebenzi wezandla zakho, uthokoze kakhulu.

“Bonke abesilisa okanye nabo bayakuvela kathathu ngonyaka phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, endaweni ayoyiqoka: ngoMkhosi Wesinkwa Esingenamvubelo, ngoMkhosi Wamasonto, nangoMkhosi Wamadokodo; abayukuza phambi kukaSimakade bengaphethe lutho olungumnikelo ezandleni.
Yilowo nalowo uyokhipha ngokwamandla akhe, nanjengokwesibusiso uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho amuphe sona.”
“Uyozikhethela abehluleli nezinduna emizini yakho yonke uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika yona ngokwezizwe zakho. Bayokwehlulela abantu ngokwehlulela okulungileyo.
Awuyukuhlanekezela isehlulelo, ungakhethi buso bamuntu, ungafunjathiswa sipho, ngokuba isipho siyawaphuphuthekisa amehlo ohlakaniphileyo, siphendukezela amazwi olungileyo.
Uyokwenza ubulungiswa kuphela ukuze uphile, ulidle izwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona.”
“Ungazigxumekeli insika ka-Ashera yanoma luhlobo luni lwesihlahla eceleni kwe-althare likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho oyakuzakhela lona.
Ungazimiseli insika eyoba yisinengiso kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.”
“Ungamhlabeli uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho inkomo noma imvu enesici, enokuthile okubi, ngokuba lokho kuyisinengiso kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.
Uma komunye wemizi yakho owawunikwa nguSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, kutholakala owesilisa noma owesifazane owenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ngokweqa isivumelwano sakhe,
ahambe, akhonze abanye onkulunkulu, akhuleke kubo, noma kungaba yilanga, yinyanga, noma yibandla lezulu, engingayalanga ngakho ukuba kukhonzwe,
bese ubikelwa ngakho, uzwe, ubuzisise ngakho, uthole ukuthi kuyiqiniso, leyo nto enjalo eyisinengiso yenziwe kwa-Israyeli,
lowo wesilisa noma wesifazane uyomkhiphela ngaphandle komuzi lokhu enzile into embi, umkhande ngamatshe, aze afe.
Ngobufakazi bofakazi ababili noma abathathu lowo ofanele ukufa, uyakubulawa. Kodwa ngobufakazi bomuntu oyedwa, akayukubulawa.
Yilabo ofakazi abayoqala ukumkhanda ngamatshe, bese kulandela abantu. Uyobukhipha kanjalo ububi phakathi kwakho.”

“Uma kuba khona indaba okumele uyehlulele, kodwa ikwehlule ukuyehlulela, kungaba iphakathi kwegazi nokuphathelene nalo, phakathi kwecala nokuphathelene nalo, ukushaya nokulimaza, kuyizindaba zokuphikisana phakathi kwamasango akho, ubosuka uye endaweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ayoyikhetha.
Uye kubaphristi bamaLevi, nakumehluleli oyakuba khona ngalezo zinsuku, ukuze bakwazise isinqumo sokwehlulela.
Ubokwenza njengalokhu benqumile, wenze lokho abayokutshela khona kuleyo ndawo uSimakade ayoyikhetha, uqaphele ukukwenza konke lokho abakufundisa khona.
Wenze njengezwi lomthetho abayakukufundisa lona, nanjengesehlulelo abayakukutshela sona. Ungachezukeli ngakwesokunene noma ngakwesokhohlo ekwehluleleni kwabo.
Umuntu oziqhenyayo, ongafuni ukulalela umphristi omiyo okhonza phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, noma umehluleli, lowo muntu umelwe ngukufa; wena ukhiphe ububi kwa-Israyeli.
Bonke abantu bayakuzwa, besabe, bangabe besalokotha benze ngaleyo ndlela.
“Lapho usufikile ezweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona ukuba ulidle, uhlale kulo, bese uthi: ‘Ngizozibekela inkosi ingibuse njengazo zonke izizwe ezingizungezile,’
uyombeka nokumbeka akubuse, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ayakumkhetha; uyobeka omunye wabafowenu abe yinkosi, akubuse, ukuze ungabeki owezizwe, ongesiye umfowenu.
Kodwa akumele abe namahhashi amaningi, futhi angababuyiseli abantu eGibhithe, ukuze athole amahhashi amaningi. Ngokuba uSimakade ushilo kini, wathi: ‘Anisayukubuyela ngaleyo ndlela.’
Akayukuthola abafazi abaningi, funa inhliziyo yakhe ihlubuke, futhi angabi nesiliva negolide eliningi.
“Kuyothi lapho ehlala esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi, azilobele ifuzela lalo mthetho, ethathisela emqulwini okubaphristi abangabaLevi.
Liyohlala kuye, alifunde zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwakhe, ukuze afunde ukumesaba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakhe. Awagcine wonke amazwi omthetho kaSimakade, enze lezi zimiso,
angaziboni engcono kunabafowabo, angaphambuki emiyalweni aye ngakwesokunene noma ngakwesokhohlo, ukuze zande izinsuku zakhe embusweni wakhe, yena nabantwana bakhe, phakathi kuka-Israyeli.”
“Abaphristi abangabaLevi, sonke isizwana sakwaLevi asiyukuba nasabelo nafa no-Israyeli. Sona siyakudla iminikelo yomlilo kaSimakade nefa lakhe.
Abayukuba nafa phakathi kwabafowabo; uSimakade uyifa lakhe, njengalokhu eshilo kuye.
“Lokhu kuyoba yilungelo labaphristi elivela kubantu abanikela ngomhlatshelo, noma yinkomo noma yimvu; bayonika umphristi umkhono, imihlathi yomibili nenanzi.
Uyomnika futhi ulibo lokusanhlamvu kwakho, olwewayini lakho, olwamafutha akho amasha, nezandulela zoboya bezimvu zakho.
Ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ukhethe yena kuzo zonke izizwe zakini ukuba ame, akhonze egameni likaSimakade, yena namadodana akhe, kuze kube phakade.
“Uma umLevi eshiya noma yimuphi wemizi yenu yonke yakwa-Israyeli, lapho kade ehlala khona, aye endaweni ayakuyikhetha uSimakade,
uyokhonza egameni likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakhe njengabo bonke abafowabo, abaLevi, abama lapho phambi kukaSimakade, bemkhonza.
Uyodla isabelo esilingana nesabanye, ngisho noma ebethole okuthile ngokuthengisa ngefa likayise.”
“Kuyothi nxa usufike ezweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona, ungalokothi ufunde ukwenza izinengiso njengalabo bezizwe.
Makungafunyanwa muntu phakathi kwenu onikela ngendodana yakhe noma ngendodakazi yakhe ngokuyidabulisa emlilweni, noma umbhuli, ohlola imihlola, owenza imilingo, noma umlumbi,
owenza iziphonso, othinta imimoya yabangasekho, nobiza akhuphule imimoya yamadlozi.
Yilowo nalowo owenza lezo zinto uyisinengiso kuSimakade, ngenxa yalezo zinengiso, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho wazixosha lezo zizwe phambi kwakho.
Mawungabi nacala kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.
“Lezo zizwe oyoziphuca izwe lazo ziyabalalela abahlola imihlola nezangoma, kodwa wena uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akakuvumelanga ukwenza kanjalo.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyokuvusela umphrofethi onjengami phakathi kwakho, kubafowenu; niyomlalela yena,

njengakho konke owakucela kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho eHorebhe ngosuku lomhlangano, wathi: ‘Mangingabe ngisalizwa izwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wami, nalo mlilo omkhulu kangaka mangingabe ngisawubona, funa ngife.’
“USimakade wayesethi kimi: ‘Benze kahle ngalokho abakukhulumile.
Ngizobavusela umphrofethi onjengawe phakathi kwabafowabo, ngibeke amazwi ami emlonyeni wakhe, uyobatshela konke engimyala ngakho.
Yilowo nalowo ongayukuwalalela amazwi ami ayowakhuluma eGameni lami, Mina ngiyobheka ukuba aziphendulele ngalokho.
Kepha umphrofethi oyozitshela ukuthi ukhuluma izwi eGameni lami, ngibe ngingamyalanga ukuba akhulume, noma okhuluma egameni labanye onkulunkulu, lowo mphrofethi uyakufa.’
“Ungasho enhliziyweni yakho, uthi: ‘Siyakulazi kanjani izwi uSimakade angalikhulumanga, na?’

“Uma umphrofethi ekhuluma egameni likaSimakade, leyo nto ingenzeki, nezwi alikhulumile lingafezeki, lelo lizwi kalikhulunywanga nguSimakade, kodwa ngumphrofethi ozikhulumele nje lokho, ezigabisa; ungamesabi.”
“Kuyothi lapho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho esezishabalalisile izizwe ezizwe lazo uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona, wena uzixoshe, bese uhlala emizini yazo nasezindlini zazo.
Uyozehlukanisela imizi emithathu phakathi nezwe lakho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona ukuba ulidle.
Uyolungisa indlela, wehlukanise kathathu izifunda zezwe lakini uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona ukuba libe yifa, ukuze bonke ababulali babalekele lapho.
“Kuyothi uma umbulali ebalekela khona, aphile: yilowo nalowo oyobulala umakhelwane wakhe engaqondile, futhi ebengamzondi phambilini,
nomuntu oyohamba nomngani wakhe baye ehlathini ukuyogawula imithi, kuthi esagawula, kuphume insimbi emphinini wembazo imshaye umakhelwane wakhe, afe, lowo muntu uyobalekela komunye wale mizi.
Kungenzeka umphindiseli wegazi amlandele umbulali esagcwele intukuthelo enhliziyweni yakhe, amfice, ngoba umuzi ukude, amshaye aze afe, noma ebengafanele ukufa, lokhu ebengazange amzonde phambilini.
Ngalokho ngiyakuyala ngithi: ‘Uyakuzehlukanisela imizi emithathu.’
“Uma uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho eyandisa indawo yakho, njengalokhu ayefungile kokhokho bakho, akunike lonke izwe ethembisa ukulinika okhokho bakho,

uyoyigcina yonke le miyalo engikuyala ngayo namuhla ukuba uyenze, ukumthanda uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ukuhamba nsuku zonke ngezindlela zakhe, uyozithasiselela futhi ngeminye imizi emithathu ngaphezu kwalena emithathu ekhona,
ukuze igazi lomuntu ongenacala lingachithwa phakathi kwezwe lakini uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona ukuba libe yifa lakho, ngaphandle kwalokho, uyothwala icala legazi.
“Kepha uma umuntu ezonda umakhelwane wakhe, amlalele unyendle, amvukele, amshaye ambulale, abalekele komunye wale mizi,
amalunga akulowo muzi ayothumela, alandwe lapho, amnikele esandleni somphindiseli wegazi ukuba abulawe.
Iso lakho aliyukumhawukela, kepha uyolisusa igazi elingenacala kwa-Israyeli ukuba kube kuhle kuwe.”
“Awuyukuwugudlula umngcele kamakhelwane wakho owamiswa ngokhokho, ukuba ube yindawo yefa lakho oyakulidla ezweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona ukuba ulidle.”
“Ubufakazi obuyokwethulwa ngumuntu oyedwa abunakumcindezela umuntu ngobubi, ngesono, noma nangasiphi isono one ngaso. Kodwa ngubufakazi bofakazi ababili noma abathathu obuyoyenza indaba ime iqine.
“Uma ufakazi wamanga emvukela umuntu, afakaze ngaye ngokubi,
bobabili labo bantu abaxabeneyo bayokuma phambi kukaSimakade, naphambi kwabaphristi nabehluleli abayobe bekhona ngaleso sikhathi.
Abehluleli bayophenyisisa; bheka, uma ufakazi engufakazi mbumbulu obefakaza amanga ngomuntu wezwe lakubo,
uyokwenza kuye lokho abehlose ukukwenza kumuntu wezwe lakubo; uyobususa kanjalo ububi phakathi kwenu.
Abaseleyo bayozwa, besabe, bangabe besabenza ububi obunjalo phakathi kwenu.
Iso lakho aliyukuhawukela; makube ngukuphila ngokuphila, iso ngeso, izinyo ngezinyo, isandla ngesandla, unyawo ngonyawo.”
“Nxa uphuma uyokulwa nezitha zakho, bese ubona amahhashi, izinqola, nabantu abaningi kunawe, ungabesabi, ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho unawe, Yena owakukhuphula eGibhithe.
Kuyothi lapho nisondela empini, umphristi afike akhulume kubantu,
athi kubo: ‘Yizwa, Israyeli! Namuhla nisondela empini ukuhlasela izitha zenu; inhliziyo yenu mayingadangali, ningesabi, ningaqhaqhazeli, ningabi natwetwe phambi kwazo.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho nguye ohamba nani, anilwele nezitha zenu ukuze aniphe ukunqoba.’
“Izinduna ziyothi kubantu: ‘Iyiphi indoda eyakhe indlu entsha engakayivuli, na? Mayihambe, ibuyele endlini yayo, funa ifele empini, bese enye indoda isale iyivula.
Iyiphi indoda etshale isivini engakazidli izithelo zaso, na? Mayihambe, ibuyele endlini yayo, funa ifele empini, bese enye indoda isidla.
Ngumuphi umuntu onengoduso angakayithathi, na? Makahambe, abuyele endlini yakhe, funa afele empini, bese ithathwa ngomunye umuntu.’

Izikhulu ziyokhuluma futhi kubantu, zithi: ‘Ngumuphi umuntu owesabayo, ozizwa entekenteke enhliziyweni, na? Makahambe, abuyele endlini yakhe, funa izinhliziyo zabafowabo zibe ntekenteke njengenhliziyo yakhe.’
Kuyothi lapho izikhulu seziqedile ukukhuluma kubantu, bese zikhetha izinduna ezizohola amabutho.
“Kuyothi lapho ususondele emzini oyolwa nawo, umemezele ukuthula kuwo.
Kuthi uma impendulo kungeyezwi lokuthula, ukwemukela, abantu bonke abayotholakala kuwo bayoba yizisebenzi zakho ngempoqo, bakukhonze.
Kepha uma nawe ungafuni ukwenza ukuthula, kodwa uzimisele ukulwa, uyokuwuhlasela, uwubhubhise.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyowunikela esandleni sakho, wena uyobhubhisa abesilisa bawo ngenkemba.
Kodwa abesifazane, abantwana, izinkomo, nakho konke okusemzini, yonke impango yawo, uyothatha khona kuphela kube ngokwakho, uyakuyidla impango yezitha zakho, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunike yona.
Uyokwenza kanjalo kuyo yonke imizi ekude nawe, engesiyo imizi yalezi zizwe.
“Kepha ngemizi yalezo zizwe, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika yona njengefa lakho, awuyukusindisa lutho oluphefumulayo kuyo.
Uyoyibhubhisa impela: uwabhubhise amaHithi, ama-Amori, amaKhanani, amaPherizi, amaHivi, namaJebusi, njengalokhu uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ekuyalile,
ukuze banganifundisi ukwenza zonke izinengiso zabo abazenzele onkulunkulu babo, bese nona kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.

“Uma uvimbezela umuzi isikhathi eside ulwa nawo ukuze uwudle, awuyukuzicekela phansi izihlahla ngokuzigawula ngezembe, ngokuba uyakudla kuzo; ungazigawuli, ngokuba isihlahla sasendle singumuntu yini ukuba ungaze usihlasele, na?
Izihlahla ozaziyo ukuthi aziyizo ezezithelo ezidliwayo, uyakuzibhubhisa, uyakuzigawula, wakhe ngazo izinqaba ngasemzini olwa nawe, uze uwunqobe.”
“Uma kutholakala umuntu obulewe ezweni akunika lona uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ukuba ulidle, edindilize endle, kungaziwa ukuthi ubulewe ngubani;
izingwevu zakini nabehluleli bakini bayophuma, amabanga ukuya emizini ezungeze obuleweyo.
Kuyothi umuzi oseduze nobuleweyo, amalunga akulowo muzi athathe ezinkomeni isithole esingakaze siboshelwe, sindonse ijoka.
Amalunga alowo muzi ayokwehlisela isithole esigodini esinomfudlana ogelezayo, esingakaze silinywe noma kutshalwe kuso, bese ephula intamo yesithole khona lapho esigodini.

Abaphristi, amadodana kaLevi, bayosondela, ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ubakhethile ukuba bamkhonze, babusise egameni likaSimakade; yibona abayokhipha isinqumo mayelana nakho konke ukuxabana nokulwa.
Wonke amalunga alowo muzi oseduze nalapho kubulawelwe khona lowo muntu, ayogeza izandla zawo phezu kwesithole esephulwe intamo esigodini.
Ayofakaza athi: ‘Izandla zethu azilichithanga leli gazi, namehlo ethu awakubonanga lokhu.
Simakade, thethelela abantu bakho, u-Israyeli, obahlengileyo. Susa igazi elingenacala phakathi kwabantu bakho, u-Israyeli,’ ngakho bayothethelelwa icala legazi.
Uyolisusa kanjalo-ke igazi elingenacala phakathi kwakho, uyokwenza okulungile emehlweni kaSimakade.”
“Kuyothi lapho uphuma uya empini, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho azinikele izitha zakho ezandleni zakho, uzithathe, uzithumbe.
Uma ubona phakathi kwabathunjwa besifazane owesifazane omuhle, ohunga inhliziyo yakho, ufune ukumthatha abe ngumkakho,
uyomyisa ekhaya lakho; uyakuphuca ikhanda lakhe, anqume izinzipho zakhe,
akhumule izingubo zakhe zokuthunjwa; uyohlala endlini yakho, alilele uyise nonina inyanga yonke, andukuba uye kuye ulale naye, ube yindoda yakhe, yena abe ngumkakho.
Kepha uma ungenelisekile ngaye, uyomkhulula ahambe aye lapho ethanda ukuya khona; impela awuyukuthengisa ngaye ngemali, awuyukumphatha njengesigqila, ngokuba umthele ngehlazo, walala naye.”
“Uma indoda inabafazi ababili, omunye eyintandokazi, omunye eyisaliwakazi, bayizalele amadodana, bese kuthi indodana eyizibulo ibe ngeyalowo oyisaliwakazi,
kuyothi mhla ehlukanisela amadodana akhe ifa analo, ngeke akwazi ukwenza indodana yentandokazi ibe yizibulo phezu kwendodana yesaliwakazi, okuyiyona eyizibulo.
Kodwa uyokuvuma obala ukuthi indodana yesaliwakazi yiyo eyizibulo ngokuyinika isabelo esiphindiweyo sakho konke anakho, ngokuba yiyona engukuqala kwamandla akhe; ilungelo lobuzibulo lingelayo.”
“Uma umuntu enendodana enenkani, ehluphayo, engalilaleli izwi likayise noma elikanina, engalaleli noma beyiyala,
uyise nonina bayoyibamba, bayiyise kumalunga omuzi wakubo nasesangweni lakubo.
Bathi kumalunga omuzi: ‘Le ndodana yethu inenkani, iyahlupha, ayilaleli izwi lethu; iyisiminzi nesidakwa.’
Onke amadoda omuzi wakubo ayoyikhanda ngamatshe ize ife, uyobususa kanjalo-ke ububi phakathi kwakho, wonke u-Israyeli uyozwa, esabe.”
“Uma umuntu onile efanelwe wukufa, uyobulawa, aphanyekwe emthini.

Isidumbu sakhe asiyukuhlala ubusuku bonke emthini, kodwa uyomngcwaba impela ngalolo lusuku, ukuze isiqalekiso sikaNkulunkulu sibe phezu kophanyekiweyo, ungalingcolisi izwe lakini uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona ukuba libe yifa lakho.”
“Awuyukuyiyekela inkabi yomfowenu noma imvu yakhe iduka, ushaye sengathi awuziboni, kodwa uyozibuyisela nokuzibuyisela kumfowenu.
Uma umfowenu engekho eduze nawe futhi ungamazi, uyoziyisa endlini yakho zibe kuwe, aze umfowenu azifune kuwe, bese uzibuyisela kuye.
Uyokwenza kanjalo ngembongolo yakhe, ngezingubo zakhe, nangazo zonke izinto zomfowenu ezimlahlekele, wena wazithola, awunakukubalekela lokho.
“Awuyukubona imbongolo yomfowenu noma inkabi yakhe iwile endleleni, bese wena ungenzi lutho; uyomsiza impela ukukuvusa.
“Owesifazane akanakugqoka izinto zabesilisa, nowesilisa makangayigqoki ingubo yowesifazane, ngokuba yilowo nalowo owenza lokho uyisinengiso kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.”
“Uma uzithela esidlekeni senyoni endleleni, siphambi kwakho emithini noma siphansi, sinamaphuphu noma amaqanda, unina efukamele amaphuphu noma amaqanda, awuyukumthatha unina namaphuphu.
Kepha uyomyeka unina ukuba asuke, bese wena uthatha amaphuphu ukuze kube kuhle kuwe, zande izinsuku zakho.
“Lapho wakha indlu entsha, uyokwenza umpheme ophahleni lwayo ukuze ungazethwesi icala legazi uma umuntu ewa lapho.
“Awuyukutshala esivinini sakho izinhlobo ezimbili ezingafani zembewu, funa imbewu oyitshalile nesivuno sesivini sakho kube ngcwele.
“Awuyukulima ngenkabi iboshelwe nembongolo.
“Awuyukugqoka ingubo enezinhlobonhlobo zezintanjana, uboya bezimvu obuhlanganiswe nelineni.
“Uyozenzela izinsephe emachosheni amane esembatho sakho osembathayo.”
“Uma indoda ithatha intombi iyigane, ilale nayo, bese iyayizonda,
iyisole ngezinto eziyihlazo, ihlambalaze igama layo, ithi: ‘Ngamthatha lo wesifazane; kwathi ngisondela kuye, ngathola ukuthi akaseyiyo intombi,’
uyise nonina bentombi bayoyithatha intombi, balethe ubufakazi bokuthi ibiyintombi nto, phambi kwamalunga omuzi esangweni.
Uyise wentombi uyothi kumalunga: ‘Ngaganisela lo muntu indodakazi yami ukuba ibe ngumkakhe, manje useyayala;
useyisola ngezinto eziyihlazo, uthi: “Angiyitholanga indodakazi yenu iyintombi,” ngakho nabu ubufakazi bokuthi indodakazi yami ibiyintombi.’ Bayokwendlala ingubo phambi kwamalunga omuzi.
Amalunga omuzi ayoyithatha indoda, ayijezise,
ayihlawulise amashekeli esiliva ayikhulu, awanike uyise wentombi, ngokuba ukhulume kabi ngentombi yakwa-Israyeli. Iyakuba ngumkakhe; akayukuyilahla, zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwakhe.
“Nokho uma lokho kuyiqiniso, bungatholakalanga ubufakazi bokuthi ibiseyintombi,

bayoyikhiphela ngasemnyango wendlu kayise intombi, amadoda omuzi ayikhande ngamatshe ize ife, ngokuba yenze ihlazo kwa-Israyeli, yafeba, yahlaza indlu kayise. Uyobukhipha kanjalo ububi phakathi kwakho.
“Uma kutholakala indoda ilele nowesifazane ogane enye indoda, bayobulawa bobabili, indoda ebilele nowesifazane uqobo ukuze kususwe ububi kwa-Israyeli.
“Uma kukhona intombazana eyintombi, nokho esiyingoduso yendoda, bese umuntu eyithola emzini, alale nayo,

bobabili niyobakhiphela ngasesangweni lalowo muzi, nibakhande ngamatshe baze bafe, intombi, ngokuba ayikhalanga emzini yafuna usizo, nendoda, ngokuba imonile umfazi womakhelwane wayo. Uyobukhipha kanjalo ububi phakathi kwakho.
“Uma indoda ithola endle intombi eyingoduso, bese iyibamba, ilale nayo, kuyokufa kuphela indoda elale nayo.
Ungayenzi lutho intombi, ngokuba ayinasono esifanele ukuba ife, lokhu leyo ndaba ifana nokuthi umuntu avukele umakhelwane wakhe, ambulale,
ngoba indoda iyifumane endle; noma intombi eyingoduso ikhalile, kodwa bekungekho muntu obengayihlenga.
“Uma indoda ithola intombi engesiyo ingoduso, iyibambe, ilale nayo, bese bebanjwa oqotsheni,
indoda ebilale nentombi iyonika uyise wentombi amashekeli esiliva angama-50, bese iba ngumkayo, ngokuba iyonile. Ayiyukuyilahla, zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwayo.
“Umuntu akakwazi ukuthatha umkayise, ambule ingubo kayise.”
“Olimele emasendeni noma onqunywe umphambili akanakungena ebandleni likaSimakade.
“Umntwana wesihlahla akanakungena ebandleni likaSimakade, yebo, ngisho isizukulwane sakhe asiyukungena ebandleni likaSimakade kuze kube sesizukulwaneni seshumi.
“Owakwa-Amoni nowakwaMowabi abayukungena ebandleni likaSimakade, yebo, akukho namunye kubo oyakungena ebandleni likaSimakade kuze kube sesizukulwaneni seshumi, kuze kube phakade.
Ngokuba abanihlangabezanga ngesinkwa nangamanzi endleleni lapho niphuma eGibhithe, nokuthi baqasha uBhileyamu, indodana kaBheyori wasePhethori e-Aramu Naharayimi, ukuba amelane nawe, akuqalekise.
Nokho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akamlalelanga uBhileyamu, kodwa uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho waphendula isiqalekiso saba yisibusiso kuwe, ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho wakuthanda.
Awuyukufuna ukuthula kwabo nempumelelo yabo zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwakho kuze kube phakade.
“Unganengwa ngowakwa-Edomi, ngokuba ungumfowenu; awuyukunengwa ngowaseGibhithe, ngokuba wawungumfokazi ezweni lakubo.
Abantwana besizukulwane sesithathu abayobazala, bayongena ebandleni likaSimakade.”
“Uma uphuma enkanjini uyokulwa nezitha zakho, ubozigcina, ungakwenzi okubi.
Uma kukhona phakathi kwenu umuntu ongahlambulukile ngenxa yokumehlele ebusuku, uyophumela ngaphandle kwenkambu, angangeni phakathi kwayo,
kodwa kusihlwa uyogeza ngamanzi, lapho selishonile ilanga, uyongena enkanjini.
“Makube khona indawo yokuzikhulula ngaphandle kwenkambu, uyophumela lapho ukuyozikhulula.
Uyophatha isimbo ezimpahleni zakho, ukuze kuthi lapho uhlala phansi uzikhulula, umbe ngaso, bese ukugqiba lokho okuphume kuwe,

ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyahamba ehla enyuka phakathi kwenkambu ukukuhlenga, futhi izitha zakho uzinikele kuwe. Ngalokho-ke inkambu yakho liyokuba ngcwele ukuze angaboni into engcolileyo phakathi kwenu, bese ekufulathela.”
“Ungasinikeli kumniniso isigqila esibalekile seza kuwe.
Siyeke sihlale ngaphakathi kwakho endaweni esiyoyikhetha phakathi kweminye imizi yakho, lapho sithanda khona; ungasicindezeli.
“Makungabi bikho sifebe sethempeli emadodakazini nasemadodaneni akwa-Israyeli.
Ungayilethi inkokhelo yesifebe nemali yenja endlini kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ukuba ufeze isithembiso, ngokuba kokubili kuyisinengiso kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.
“Awuyukumtsheleka umfowenu bese ufuna inzalo yalokho, kungaba yinzalo yemali, inzalo yokudla, neyanoma yini umuntu ayikhokhela inzalo.

Umfokazi ungamtsheleka bese ufuna inzalo, kodwa umfowenu awuyukumtsheleka bese ufuna inzalo ukuze uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akubusise kukho konke obeka kukho isandla sakho ezweni ongena kulo, ukulidla.
“Uma wenza isifungo kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ungalibali ukusifeza, ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ulindele ukuba usifeze impela, ukungasifezi kuyakuba yisono kuwe.
Kepha uma ungenzi sifungo, akuyukuba yisono kuwe.
Amazwi omlomo wakho uyakuwagcina, uyoqikelela ukuba wenze njengalokhu wethembisile kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, isithembiso osenze ukhululekile futhi ungaphoqiwe, wasiphumisela ngomlomo wakho.
“Uma ungena esivinini sikamakhelwane wakho, uyakudla izithelo zomvini ngokuthanda kwakho, uzanelise, kepha ungazifaki esitsheni sakho.
“Uma ungena ezinhlangeni zokusanhlamvu kwamakhelwane wakho, uyakukha izikhwebu ngesandla sakho, kodwa awuyukulisebenzisa isikela ezinhlangeni zokusanhlamvu kwamakhelwane wakho.”

“Lapho umuntu ethatha umfazi, amgane, kodwa angabe esamthokozisa ngoba ethole kuye okuthile okwenyanyekayo, uyombhalela incwadi yesehlukaniso, amnike yona esandleni sakhe, bese emkhipha endlini yakhe.
Uma esephumile endlini yakhe, angahamba-ke abe ngowenye indoda.
Uma indoda yesibili ingasamthandi, iyombhalela incwadi yesehlukaniso, imnike yona esandleni, bese imkhipha endlini yayo, noma le ndoda yesibili ebimthathile waba ngumkayo ingafa,

indoda yakhe yokuqala eyamxosha ayikwazi ukubuyela kuye imthathe futhi abe ngumkayo, ngokuba usengcolisekile ngale ndlela, lokho kuyisinengiso phambi kukaSimakade. Awuyukwenza ukuba izwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona ukuba libe yifa lakho, libe necala.
“Uma umuntu esanda kuthatha umfazi, akayukuphuma aye empini, futhi akayukunikwa noma yimuphi umsebenzi; uyohlala ekhaya ekhululekile unyaka, athokozise umkakhe amthathileyo.”
“Akuyukuba bikho muntu oyakuthatha itshe lokugaya noma imbokodwe kube yisibambiso, ngokuba uyobe ethathe konke okuphilwa ngakho, kwaba yisibambiso.”
“Uma umuntu ebanjwa eduna omunye wabafowabo babantu bakwa-Israyeli, amphathe njengesigqila, noma athengise ngaye, lowo mduni uyokufa, ngaleyo ndlela uyobukhipha kanjalo ububi phakathi kwakho.
“Qaphela mayelana nesifo sochoko, uqaphelisise impela, wenze konke njengalokhu abaphristi abangabaLevi bezokufundisa. Uqaphele ukuba wenze njengalokhu ngibayalile.
Khumbula lokho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akwenza kuMiriyamu endleleni lapho niphuma eGibhithe.
“Uma utsheleka umakhelwane wakho utho, awuyukungena endlini yakhe ukuyothatha utho lube yisibambiso sakhe.
Uyokuma ngaphandle, bese umuntu omtshelekayo eletha kuwe isibambiso.
Uma engumuntu ompofu, ungalali nalokho okuyisibambiso sakhe,
kepha uyakukubuyisela impela kuye okuyisibambiso ekushoneni kwelanga, ukuze alale ngengubo yakhe, akubusise. Lokho kuyokuba ukulunga kuwe phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.
“Awuyukuyicindezela inceku eqashiweyo, empofu nentulayo, noma ngabe ingumfowenu noma ingumfokazi osezweni lakini emzini wakho.
Uyoyikhokhela imali yayo ngosuku lwayo, lingaze lishone ilanga ungakwenzile lokho, ngokuba impofu, futhi ikhathazekile ngayo, funa ikhale kuSimakade ngenxa yakho, lokho kube yisono kuwe.
“Oyise abayukubulawa ngenxa yamadodana, namadodana awayukubulawa ngenxa yawoyise; yilowo nalowo uyobulawa ngenxa yesono sakhe.
“Awuyukuhlanekezela ubulungiswa lapho ubhekene nomfokazi noma intandane, futhi ungayithathi ingubo yomfelokazi ibe yisibambiso,
kepha uyokhumbula ukuthi wawuyisigqila eGibhithe nokuthi uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho wakuhlenga lapho; ngalokho ngiyakuyala ukuba wenze lokhu.

“Uma uvuna isivuno sakho ensimini, bese ukhohlwa yisithungu ensimini yakho, ungabuyeli ukuyosilanda, kodwa masibe ngesomfokazi, intandane, nomfelokazi ukuze uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akubusise kuyo yonke imisebenzi yezandla zakho.
Lapho ugxoba umnqumo wakho, ungabuyeli ugxobe amagatsha ngokwesibili, kepha lokho makube ngokomfokazi, intandane, nomfelokazi.
Uma uvuna okwesivini sakho, awuyukukhothoza futhi, kodwa lokho makube ngokomfokazi, intandane, nomfelokazi.
Uyokhumbula ukuthi wawuyisigqila eGibhithe, ngalokho ngiyakuyala ukuba wenze lokhu.”
“Uma kukhona ukuxabana phakathi kwabantu, bese beya esigcawini sokwehlulela, kuthethwe icala labo, liyomthetha icala olungileyo, limlahle onecala.
Uma onecala kufanele ukuba ashaywe, umehluleli uyomlalisa phansi, ashaywe ngomunye phambi kwakhe. Ubuningi bemivimbo buyoba ngangokwecala lakhe.
Angamshaya imivimbo engama-40, angedluli lapho, funa imivimbo ashaywe yona ibe miningi kakhulu, bese umfowenu uyahlazeka emehlweni akho.
“Ungayifaki inkabi isimfonyo, uma ibhula.”

“Uma abozalo behlala ndawonye, omunye wabo efa engenandodana, umfazi wofileyo akayukugana umfokazi ongaphandle, kodwa umfowabo wendoda yakhe uyakumngena, amthathe abe ngumkakhe, aphelelise wonke amalungelo endoda kuye.
Kuyothi izibulo alizalayo lime egameni lomfowabo ofileyo ukuze igama lakhe lingesulwa kwa-Israyeli.
“Uma indoda ingathandi ukumthatha umkamfowabo, umkamfowabo uyakukhuphukela kumalunga esangweni, athi: ‘Umfowabo wendoda yami uyala ukuvusela umfowabo umuzi kwa-Israyeli; akathandi ukungingena.’
Amalunga omuzi wakubo ayombiza, akhulume naye; uma emi emazwini akhe, ethi: ‘Angithandi ukumthatha,’
umkamfowabo uyosondela kuye phambi kwamalunga, akhumule isicathulo onyaweni lwakhe, amkhafulele ebusweni bakhe, athi kuye: ‘Makwenziwe kanje endodeni engayakhi indlu kamfowabo.’
Igama lakhe liyakuthiwa kwa-Israyeli ‘Indlu yosicathulo sikhunyuliwe.’
“Uma amadoda amabili elwa, bese umfazi wenye esondela ukuyokhulula indoda yakhe esandleni saleyo eyishayayo, elule isandla sakhe, ayibambe ngomphambili,
uyosinquma isandla sakhe, ungakhombisi sihe kuye.”
“Makungabi bikho esikhwameni sakho izisindo ezehlukeneyo, esikhulu nesincane.
Makungabi bikho endlini yakho izilinganiso ezehlukeneyo, esikhulu nesincane.
Uyokuba nesikali sesisindo esiyisona nesifaneleyo, futhi ube nesilinganiso seqiniso nesifaneleyo, ukuze izinsuku zakho zibe zinde ezweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona.
Ngokuba bonke abenza kanjalo, bonke abenza ukungalungi, bayisinengiso kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.”
“Khumbula lokho akwenzayo kuwe u-Amaleki endleleni, lapho niphuma eGibhithe,
ukuthi wakuhlangabeza endleleni, wakuhlasela kanjani ngasemuva, ebulala bonke ababebuthakathaka bekhathele, betotoba emva kwakho; akazange amesabe uSimakade.

Kuyothi lapho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho esekuphumuzile kuzo zonke izitha zakho ezikuzungezile ezweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona ukuba ulidle, libe yifa lakho, bese ukuqeda nya ukukhunjulwa kwama-Amaleki phansi kwezulu. Ungakhohlwa yilokho.”
“Kuyokuthi lapho usufikile ezweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona ukuba, ulidle, wakhe kulo, libe yifa lakho.

Uyothatha ulibo lwezithelo zonke zomhlabathi oyoluvuna ezweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona, ulufake eqomeni, uye endaweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ayoyikhetha ukuba igama lakhe lihlale kuyo.
Uyoya kumphristi oyobe elapho ngalezo zinsuku, uthi kuye: ‘Ngiyaqinisa namuhla kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ukuthi sengifikile ezweni uSimakade afunga kokhokho ukusinika lona.’
Umphristi uyothatha iqoma esandleni sakho, alibeke phansi, phambi kwe-althare likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.

Wena uyophendula phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, uthi: ‘Ukhokho wami wayengumAramu owayezulazula, wehlela eGibhithe, wagogobala khona nabantu abayingcosana; waba yisizwe esikhulu khona, esinamandla nesiningi.
AbaseGibhithe basiphatha kabi, basihlupha, basisebenzisa kanzima kakhulu.
Sakhala kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho bethu, uSimakade walizwa izwi lethu, wakubona ukuhlupheka kwethu, umshikashika wethu, nokucindezelwa kwethu.
USimakade wasikhipha eGibhithe ngesandla esinamandla, ngengalo eyeluliweyo, ngezenzo ezesabekayo nezinkulu, ngezibonakaliso nangezimangaliso.
Wasiletha kule ndawo, wasinika leli lizwe, izwe elichichima ubisi noju.
Manje-ke, bheka, ngilethe ulibo lwezithelo zomhlaba onginike wona, Wena Simakade,’ bese ulubeka phansi, phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ukhuleke phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho,
uyothokoza ngakho konke okuhle uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunike khona, wena nendlu yakho, wena nomLevi, nomfokazi ophakathi kwenu.”

“Kuyothi lapho usuqedile ukuthatha konke okweshumi kwezithelo zakho, ngonyaka wesithathu, okungunyaka wokweshumi, usumnikile, wadla, wasutha umLevi, umfokazi, intandane, nomfelokazi ohlala nawe emzini wakho,

uyothi phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho: ‘Ngikhiphile izinto ezingcwele endlini yami, ngazinika umLevi, umfokazi, intandane, nomfelokazi; njengoba ungiyalile ngemiyalo yonke ongiyale ngayo; angiweqanga namunye wemiyalo yakho, futhi angiyikhohlwanga.
Angikudlanga okweshumi ekulileni kwami, angisusanga lutho kukho ngingcolile, anginikelanga ngakho kofileyo; ngilalele izwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wami, ngikwenze konke njengalokhu ungiyalile.
Bheka phansi usendaweni yobungcwele bakho emazulwini, ubusise abantu bakho u-Israyeli nomhlaba osinike wona njengokufunga kwakho kokhokho, izwe elichichima ubisi noju.’
“Namuhla uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ukuyala ukuba ugcine lezi zimiso nezehlulelo; uyoqikelela ukuba uzigcine, uzenze ngayo yonke inhliziyo yakho.
USimakade namuhla umnikile isiqiniseko sokuthi uyokuba nguNkulunkulu wakho, uyohamba ezindleleni zakhe, ugcine izimiso zakhe, imiyalo yakhe, nezehlulelo zakhe; ulalele izwi lakhe.
USimakade unikezile isiqiniseko namuhla sokuthi wena uyokuba yisizwe esiyifa lakhe njengokwesithembiso sakhe, ugcine yonke imiyalo yakhe,
ukuze akuphakamise phezu kwazo zonke izizwe azenzileyo ngokubongwa, ngegama, nangodumo, ube yisizwe esingcwele kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, njengokusho kwakhe.”
UMose namalunga akwa-Israyeli bayala abantu, bathi: “Gcinani yonke imiyalo esiniyala ngayo namuhla.
Kuyothi mhla niwela iJordani niya ezweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona, uyozimisela amatshe amakhulu, uwahuqe ngomcako,

ulobe kuwo wonke amazwi alo mthetho, uma usuwelile ukuba ungene ezweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona, izwe elichichima ubisi noju njengoba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho benu ekhulumile kuwe.
Kuyothi lapho seniliwelile iJordani, nimise lawa matshe enginiyala ngawo namuhla entabeni i-Ebhali, uwahuqe ngomcako.
Uyomakhela lapho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho i-althare, i-althare lamatshe, awuyukuwabaza ngento eyinsimbi.
Uyokwakha i-althare likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ngamatshe apheleleyo, unikele kulo ngeminikelo yokushiswa kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.
Uyonikela iminikelo yokuthula, uyidlele khona lapho, wename phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.
Uyakuloba ematsheni wonke amazwi alo mthetho, uwaqophisise kahle.”
UMose nabaphristi abangabaLevi bakhuluma kuyena wonke u-Israyeli, bathi: “Thula, ulalele, Israyeli: namuhla sewuyisizwe sikaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.
Ngalokho uyolalela izwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ugcine imiyalo yakhe nezimiso zakhe engikuyala ngakho namuhla.”
UMose wayala abantu ngalolo lusuku, wathi:
“Yilaba abazoma entabeni iGerizimu, babusise abantu ngesikhathi seniliwelile iJordani: uSimeyoni, uLevi, uJuda, u-Isakhare, uJosefa, noBhenjamini.
Nampa abayokuma entabeni i-Ebhali ukuba baqalekise: uRubeni, uGadi, u-Asheri, uZebuloni, uDani, noNafethali.
“AbaLevi bayophendula ngezwi elikhulu, bathi kubo bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli:
“ ‘Makaqalekiswe umuntu owenza isithombe esibaziweyo nesibunjiweyo, isinengiso kuSimakade, umsebenzi wezandla zengcweti, asimise esithe.’ “Bonke abantu bayothi: ‘Amen.’
“ ‘Makaqalekiswe owedelela uyise nonina.’ “Bonke abantu bayothi: ‘Amen.’
“ ‘Makaqalekiswe ogudluza isikhonkwane sikamakhelwane wakhe.’ “Bonke abantu bayothi: ‘Amen.’
“ ‘Makaqalekiswe owedukisa impumputhe endleleni.’ “Bonke abantu bayothi: ‘Amen.’
“ ‘Makaqalekiswe ohlanekezela isehlulelo kongumfokazi, intandane, nongumfelokazi.’ “Bonke abantu bayothi: ‘Amen.’
“ ‘Makaqalekiswe olala nomkayise, ngokuba wambulile isidwaba sikayise.’ “Bonke abantu bayothi: ‘Amen.’
“ ‘Makaqalekiswe olala nesilwane.’ “Bonke abantu bayothi: ‘Amen.’
“ ‘Makaqalekiswe olala nodadewabo, indodakazi kayise noma indodakazi kanina.’ “Bonke abantu bayothi: ‘Amen.’
“ ‘Makaqalekiswe olala nomkhwekazi wakhe.’ “Bonke abantu bayothi: ‘Amen.’
“ ‘Makaqalekiswe obulalela umakhelwane wakhe esithe.’ “Bonke abantu bayothi: ‘Amen.’
“ ‘Makaqalekiswe owemukela ukufunjathiswa ukuze abulale ongenacala, achithe igazi lakhe.’ “Bonke abantu bayothi: ‘Amen.’
“ ‘Makaqalekiswe ongawagcini amazwi alo mthetho, ukuba awenze.’ “Bonke abantu bayothi: ‘Amen.’ ”

“Kuyothi uma ulalela nokulalela izwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, uqikelele ukugcina yonke imiyalo yakhe engikuyala ngayo namuhla. USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyokuphakamisa phezu kwazo zonke izizwe zomhlaba.
Zonke lezi zibusiso ziyokwehlela kuwe, kube ngezakho, uma ulalela izwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.
“Uyakubusiswa emzini, ubusiswe nasensimini.
“Siyakubusiswa isithelo sesibeletho sakho, nesomhlaba wakho, nesemfuyo yakho, kwande amankonyane ezinkomo zakho namazinyane ezimvu zakho.
“Kuyakubusiswa iqoma lakho, nomkhombe wakho wokuxovela isinkwa.
“Uyakubusiswa ekungeneni kwakho, ubusiswe nasekuphumeni kwakho.
“USimakade uyozenza izitha ezikuvukelayo ukuba zehlulwe phambi kwakho, ziyakuza kuwe zivela ngasendaweni eyodwa, kodwa ziyakubaleka ngezindlela eziyisikhombisa.
“USimakade uyakuyala isibusiso sibe phezu kwakho, ezinqolobaneni zakho nakukho konke okwenzayo, uyakukubusisa ezweni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona.
“USimakade uyakukumisa ube yisizwe esingcwele kuye njengoba afunga kuwe, uma ugcina imiyalo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, uhamba ezindleleni zakhe.
Bonke abantu bomhlaba bayakubona ukuthi ubizwe ngegama likaSimakade, bakwesabe.
USimakade uyakukwandisela okuhle: isithelo sesibeletho sakho, esemfuyo yakho, nesomhlabathi wakho, ezweni uSimakade afunga kokhokho bakho ukukunika lona.

“USimakade uyakukuvulela indlu yakhe yengcebo, izulu, anise imvula ezweni lakho ngesikhathi esifaneleyo, abusise wonke umsebenzi wesandla sakho. Uyokwetsheleka izizwe eziningi, kodwa ungatsheleki lutho kuzo.
USimakade uyakukwenza ube yinhloko, ungabi ngumsila; uyoba phezulu kuphela, ungabi phansi, uma ulalela imiyalo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho engikuyala ngayo namuhla futhi uyigcine, uyenze.
Ungaphambuki kuwo wonke amazwi engikuyala ngawo namuhla, uye ngakwesokunene noma ngakwesokhohlo, ulandele abanye onkulunkulu, ubakhonze.
“Kuyothi uma ungalaleli izwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ukuba uqikelele ukugcina yonke imiyalo yakhe nezimiso zakhe engikuyala ngakho namuhla, zonke lezi ziqalekiso ziyokwehlela, zikusibekele.
“Uyakuqalekiswa emzini, uqalekiswe nasensimini.
“Iqoma lakho liyakuqalekiswa, kuqalekiswe nomkhombe wakho wokuxovela isinkwa.
“Isithelo sesibeletho sakho, isithelo somhlabathi wakho, amankonyane ezinkomo zakho, namazinyane ezimvu zakho, kuyakuqalekiswa.
“Uyakuqalekiswa ekungeneni kwakho, uqalekiswe nasekuphumeni kwakho.
“USimakade uyakwehlisela kuwe isiqalekiso, ukudideka nokusolwa, kukho konke oyokwenza, uze ubhujiswe, ushabalale ngokushesha, ngenxa yobubi bezenzo zakho, ngokuba ungishiyile.
USimakade uyakunamathelisa kuwe isifo, aze akubhubhise ezweni ongena kulo ukulidla.
USimakade uyokushaya ngalezi zifo: isifuba, umkhuhlane, ukushisa komzimba, imfiva, ukushisa okukhulu, isikhutha kanye nenkemba; kuyokuxosha uze ubhubhe uphele.
Izulu lakho phezu kwekhanda lakho liyakuba yithusi, umhlaba ophansi kwakho ube yinsimbi.
USimakade uyoyenza imvula yezwe lakini ibe ngumsizi nothuli, uthuli oluvela ezulwini, lwehlele phezu kwakho, uze ubhujiswe.
“USimakade uyokwenza izitha zakho zikunqobe, uyakuzihlasela ngandlelanye; ubaleke ngezindlela eziyisikhombisa. Uyoba yinto eyesabisayo, kuyo yonke imibuso yomhlaba.
Isidumbu sakho siyakuba ngukudla kwazo zonke izinyoni zezulu nokwezilwane zomhlaba; akuyukuba bikho oyoziphazamisa.
USimakade uyokushaya ngamathumba aseGibhithe, ngamaqhubu, ngomuna, nangotwayi, okungelapheki.
USimakade uyokushaya ngokuhlanya, ngobumpumputhe, nangokudideka komqondo.
Uyophuphutheka emini njengempumputhe iphuphutheka ebumnyameni. Awuyukuphumelela ezindleleni zakho, uyakucindezelwa kuphela, uphangwe; akuyukuba bikho muntu oyokuhlenga.
“Uyakuthembisana umendo nowesifazane, omunye amdlwengule alale naye; uyakukwakha indlu, ungahlali kuyo; uyakutshala isivini, ungazikhi izithelo zaso.

Inkabi yakho iyakuhlatshwa uzibonela ngawakho amehlo, ungayidli; imbongolo yakho iyakuhlwithwa ebusweni bakho, ingabuyiselwa kuwe; izimvu zakho ziyakunikwa izitha zakho, akuyukuba bikho oyakukusindisa.
Amadodana akho namadodakazi akho ayakunikwa ezinye izizwe, ubuka ngamehlo akho, uyofisa ukuwasiza usuku lonke, kodwa isandla sakho singabi namandla okwenza utho.
Izithelo zomhlabathi wakho nawo wonke umphumela wokusebenza kwakho, kuyodliwa yisizwe ongasaziyo, wena ucindezelwe kuphela, uchotshozwe nsuku zonke.
Uyakusanganiswa yilokho oyokubona ngamehlo akho.
USimakade uyokushaya ngamathumba amabi, ongenakuphulukiswa kuwo, kusukela emadolweni akho nasemilenzeni, ematheni onyawo lwakho kuze kube sokhakhayini lwekhanda lakho.
“USimakade uyokuyisa, wena nenkosi oyibeke phezu kwakho, esizweni wena nokhokho bakho eningasazi, niyokhonza lapho abanye onkulunkulu bokhuni nabamatshe.
Uyakuba yinto esabisayo, nesiga, nombhinqo phakathi kwezizwe zonke lapho uSimakade eyokunixoshela khona.
“Uyophuma nembewu eningi, uye ensimini, uvune okuyingcosana, ngokuba kuyodliwa yisikhonyane.
Uyotshala izivini, usebenze, kodwa awuyukuliphuza iwayini noma ubuthe isivuno sazo, ngokuba siyodliwa ngumswenya.
Uyakuba neminqumo ezifundeni zakho zonke, kodwa awuyukuzigcoba ngamafutha, ngokuba izithelo zeminqumo yakho ziyakuvuthuluka.
Uyakuzala amadodana namadodakazi, kodwa awayukuba ngawakho, ngokuba ayakuthunjwa.
Yonke imithi yakho nezithelo zomhlabathi wakho kuyodliwa yisikhonyane.
“Umfokazi ohlala phakathi kwenu uyodlondlobala kunawe, wena uye ngokuya wehla.
Uyakukuboleka wena, wena ungakwazi ukumboleka; yena uyakuba yinhloko, wena ube ngumsila.

“Zonke lezi ziqalekiso ziyokwehlela kuwe, zikulandele, zikukhungathe, uze ubhujiswe, ngokuba awulalelanga izwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, awuyigcinanga imiyalo yakhe nezimiso zakhe akuyala ngakho.
Ziyokwehlela phezu kwakho nasozalweni lwakho zibe yisibonakaliso nesimangaliso kuze kube phakade,
ngokuba awumkhonzanga uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ngokujabula nangokwenama kwenhliziyo, ngenxa yobuningi bezinto.
Uyozikhonza izitha zakho uSimakade ayozithumela kuwe ngokulamba, ngokoma, ngobunqunu, nangokweswela izinto zonke, uyobeka ijoka lensimbi entanyeni yakho, aze akubhubhise.
“USimakade uyothumela kuwe isizwe esivela kude ekugcineni komhlaba, esihlwitha njengokhozi. Kuyoba yisizwe ongayukuluqonda ulimi lwaso,
isizwe esibuso baso bugcwele ulunya, esingenandaba nomuntu omdala, nesingenaluzwelo komusha.
Siyokudla isithelo semfuyo yakho, nesomhlabathi wakho, uze ubhujiswe, asiyukushiya okusanhlamvu, iwayini elisha, amafutha amasha, amankonyane, amazinyane ezimvu zakho, size sikushaye sikubhuqe.

Siyakukuvimbezela kuwo wonke amasango akho, zize ziwe izingange zakho ozethembayo ezweni lakho lonke, siyakukuvimbezela kuwo wonke amasango akho ezweni lakho lonke uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunike lona.
“Uyakudla isithelo sesibeletho sakho, inyama yamadodana akho neyamadodakazi akho, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akunike wona ekuvinjezelweni nasekuhlaselweni, izitha zakho eziyakukuhlasela ngakho.
Umuntu onokulunga phakathi kwenu, iso lakhe liyakuba libi kumfowabo, kumkakhe amthandayo, nakuyo insali yabantwana bakhe.
Akayukunika namunye inyama yabantwana bakhe ayobe eyidla, ngokuba kungekho naye okumsalele ekuvinjezelweni nasekuxinekeni eziyakukuxina ngakho izitha zakho kuwo wonke amasango akho.

Owesifazane ontekenteke, ozwelayo phakathi kwenu, othambe ngendlela yokuthi akakaze azame ngisho ukubeka amathe onyawo lwakhe emhlabathini, ngenxa yokuthamba nokutetema, uyakuyikluluza indoda yakhe ayithandayo, nendodana yakhe, nendodakazi yakhe,
umzanyana ophuma phakathi kwemilenze yakhe, nabantwana bakhe ayokubazala, ngokuba uyakubadla ngasese ngenxa yokuswela kwakhe lapho evinjezelwe, exinwe yizitha zakhe kuwo wonke amasango akho.
“Uma ungaqapheli ukuwenza wonke amazwi alo mthetho alotshwe kule ncwadi ukuba ulesabe igama lakhe elidumisekayo nelesabekayo elithi USIMAKADE UNKULUNKULU WAKHO,
uSimakade uyakwenza ubhubhane lwakho ukuba lumangalise, nobhubhane lozalo lwakho, ubhubhane olukhulu oluhlala isikhathi eside nesifo esinzima esihlala isikhathi eside.
Uyobuyisela kuwe zonke izifo zaseGibhithe owawuzesaba, zinamathele kuwe.
Konke ukugula nalo lonke ubhubhane okungalotshiwe encwadini yalo mthetho, lokho uSimakade uyakukuletha phezu kwakho, uze ubhujiswe.
Noma nanibaningi ngangezinkanyezi zezulu, niyakushiywa niyingcosana, ngokuba awulalelanga izwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.

Kuyothi njengalokhu uSimakade wayejabula ngani ukuba anenzele okuhle nokunenza nande, kanjalo uSimakade uyojabula ngani lapho esenibhubhisa, nishatshalaliswe, nidwengulwe ezweni eningena kulo ukuba nilidle.
“USimakade uyakukuhlakazela ezizweni zonke, kusukela kolunye uhlangothi lomhlaba kuze kufike kolunye, uyokhonza lapho abanye onkulunkulu bemithi namatshe ongabaziyo, wena nokhokho bakho.
Awuyukukuthola ukuphumula phakathi kwalezo zizwe, akuyukuba bikho ukuphumula ematheni onyawo lwakho, kodwa uSimakade uyokunika inhliziyo egubhazelayo, namehlo anqundekayo, nokudangala komphefumulo.
Uyohlalela ovalweni wesabe ubusuku nemini, ungabe usaba nethemba ngokuphila kwakho.
Ekuseni uyothi: ‘Sengathi ngabe sekukusihlwa,’ nakusihlwa uthi: ‘Sengathi ngabe sekusile,’ ngenxa yengebhe eyakuba senhliziyweni yakho, nangenxa yalokho okubonwa ngamehlo akho.

USimakade uyakukubuyisela eGibhithe ngemikhumbi ngendlela engasho ngayo kuwe, ngathi: ‘Awusayukuphinda uyibone futhi.’ Lapho niyakuzithengisa ezitheni zenu nibe yizigqila nezigqilakazi; ningathengwa muntu.”
Nanka amazwi esivumelwano uSimakade amyala ngawo uMose ukuba asenze nabantu bakwa-Israyeli kwaMowabi ngaphandle kwaleso asenza nabo eHorebhe.
UMose wababiza bonke abakwa-Israyeli, wathi kubo: “Nikubonile konke uSimakade akwenza eGibhithe nibuka, kuFaro nakuzo zonke izinceku zakhe, nasezweni lakhe lonke:
izinhlupheko ezinkulu azibonayo amehlo akho, izibonakaliso nalezo zimangaliso ezinkulu.
Kepha uSimakade akaninikanga inhliziyo yokuba nazi, namehlo okuba nibone, nezindlebe zokuba nizwe kuze kube yinamhlanje.
Nganihola iminyaka engama-40 ehlane; izingubo zenu aziguganga emizimbeni yenu, nesicathulo asiguganga onyaweni lwenu.
Anidlanga sinkwa, aniphuzanga wayini noma uphuzo olunamandla, ukuze nazi ukuthi nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.
“Ekufikeni kwenu kule ndawo uSihoni, inkosi yaseHeshibhoni no-Ogi, inkosi yaseBhashani, baphuma bazolwa nathi, kodwa sabanqoba.
Sadla izwe labo, salabela abakwaRubeni, nabakwaGadi, nengxenye yesizwana sakwaManase, laba yifa labo.
“Ngalokho gcinani amazwi alesi sivumelwano, niwenze ukuze niphumelele kukho konke enikwenzayo.
“Namuhla nimi nonke phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu: izinhloko zenu, izizwana zenu, amalunga enu, izinduna zenu, bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli,
izingane zenu, omkenu, nomfokazi ophakathi kwezinkambu zakho, kusukela kogawula izinkuni kuya kulowo okha amanzi,
ukuba ungene esivumelwaneni sikaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, nasesifungweni sakhe asenza nawe namuhla uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho,
ukuze azimisele wena namuhla ube yisizwe sakhe, naye abe nguNkulunkulu wakho, njengalokhu asho kuwe, nanjengalokhu afunga kokhokho bakho, u-Abhrahama, u-Isaka, noJakobe.
Angenzi lesi sivumelwano nalesi sifungo nani kuphela,
ngisho nalowo omi nathi lapha namuhla phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu, nalowo ongenathi namuhla
ngokuba nina niyazi ukuthi sahlala eGibhithe nokuthi sadlula phakathi kwezizwe enadabula kuzo,
nizibonile izinengiso zazo, nezithombe zazo, zemithi, amatshe, isiliva, negolide, okwakuphakathi kwazo

funa kube khona phakathi kwenu indoda, noma umfazi, noma umndeni, noma isizwe esinhliziyo yaso ifulathela uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu namuhla ukuyokhonza onkulunkulu balezo zizwe, bese kuba khona phakathi kwenu impande ethela inhlungunyembe nokubabayo,
kuze kuthi, lapho ezwa amazwi alesi sifungo, azibusise enhliziyweni yakhe ngokuthi: ‘Ngiyakuba nokuthula, noma ngihamba ngenkani yenhliziyo yami,’ ukuze kuqedwe okuswakemeyo nokomileyo,

uSimakade angamthetheleli, kodwa intukuthelo kaSimakade nesikhwele sakhe kumvuthele lowo muntu, kuze kuthi zonke iziqalekiso ezilotshwe kule ncwadi zibe phezu kwakhe, uSimakade alesule igama lakhe phansi kwezulu.
USimakade uyakumehlukanisela ububi kuzo zonke izizwe zakwa-Israyeli njengazo zonke izivumelwano ezilotshwe kule ncwadi yomthetho.
“Isizukulwane senu, abantwana benu eniyobazala, nomfokazi oyakuphuma ezweni elikude bayakubona izinhlupheko zaleso sizwe, nobhubhane uSimakade alithele ngalo,

lonke izwe lakhona lishiswe ngesibabule nosawoti, akunakutshalwa kulo, akukhuli lutho kulo, akumili lutho oluluhlaza, linjengokubhujiswa kweSodoma neGomora neZebhoyimi okwabhujiswa nguSimakade ngentukuthelo yakhe nangolaka lwakhe.
Yebo, zonke izizwe ziyothi: ‘USimakade wenzeleni kanje kuleli lizwe na? Kungani ukuvutha kwalolu laka kukukhulu kangaka na?’
“Kuyothiwa ngalokho: ‘Ngokuba basishiya isivumelwano sikaSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho babo asenza nabo mhla ebakhipha eGibhithe,
bahamba bayokhonza abanye onkulunkulu, bakhuleka kubo, onkulunkulu ababengabazi, futhi abangahlukaniselwanga bona,
ngalokho intukuthelo kaSimakade yalivuthela lelo lizwe ukuba alehlisele zonke iziqalekiso ezilotshwe kule ncwadi.
USimakade wabadwengula ezweni lakubo ngolaka, ngokufutheka, nangentukuthelo enkulu, wabaphonsa ngaphandle kwelinye izwe, njenganamuhla.’
“Izimfihlakalo zingezikaSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu, kodwa okwambuliweyo kungokwethu nozalo lwethu kuze kube phakade ukuba siwenze wonke amazwi alo mthetho.”
“Kuyothi lapho zonke lezi zinto, izibusiso neziqalekiso engizibeke phambi kwakho, uzindle ngazo enhliziyweni yakho phakathi kwezizwe lapho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ayokudingisela khona,
bese uphendukela kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ngenhliziyo yakho yonke nangawo wonke umphefumulo wakho, ulalela izwi lakhe njengakho konke engikuyala ngakho namuhla, wena nabantwana bakho,
khona uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyakuguqula ukuthunjwa kwakho, akuhawukele, uyakubuya, akuqoqe ezizweni zonke, lapho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ayekuhlakazele khona.
Uma ekhona oxoshelwe nasekugcineni kwezulu, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyakukuqoqa, akulande lapho.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyakukubuyisela ezweni okhokho bakho abalidlayo, nawe uyakulidla. Uyokwenzela okuhle, akwandise ngaphezu kokhokho bakho.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyakusoka inhliziyo yakho nenhliziyo yozalo lwakho, ukuze umthande uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ngenhliziyo yakho yonke nangawo wonke umphefumulo wakho, ukuze uphile.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyakubeka zonke lezi ziqalekiso phezu kwezitha zakho naphezu kwabakuzondayo nabakuhlukumezile.
Uyakuphenduka, ulalele izwi likaSimakade, uyenze yonke imiyalo yakhe engikuyala ngayo namuhla.

USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyokwenza uphumelele kuyo yonke imisebenzi oyenzayo, isithelo sesibeletho sakho, esemfuyo yakho, nesomhlabathi wakho, kube kuhle, ngokuba uSimakade uyobuye athokoze ukuba anichumise njengokuba athokoza ekuchumiseni okhokho bakho,

uma nje ulalela izwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ugcina imiyalo nezimiso zakhe ezilotshwe kule ncwadi yomthetho, uphendukela kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho ngayo yonke inhliziyo yakho nangawo wonke umphefumulo wakho.
“Ngokuba lo myalo engikuyala ngawo namuhla awulukhuni kuwe, awukude.
Awukho ezulwini ukuba ungathi: ‘Ngubani oyakukhuphuka ngenxa yethu aye ezulwini, asilandele wona, ukuze siwuzwe, siwenze, na?’
Futhi awuphesheya kolwandle ukuba ungathi: ‘Ngubani oyakusiwelela aye phesheya kolwandle, asilandele wona, ukuze siwuzwe, siwenze, na?’
Kodwa, izwi liseduze kakhulu nawe, lisemlonyeni wakho nasenhliziyweni yakho ukuba ulenze.
“Bheka, ngibeka namuhla phambi kwakho, ukuphila nenqubekela phambili, ukufa nokubi,

engikuyala ngakho namuhla ukuba umthande uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, uhambe ezindleleni zakhe, ugcine imiyalo yakhe, izimiso zakhe, nezehlulelo zakhe, ukuze uphile, wande, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho akubusise ezweni ongena kulo, ukulidla.
“Kepha uma uyifulathelisa inhliziyo yakho ungalaleli; uyengeke ukuba ukhuleke kwabanye onkulunkulu, ubakhonze,
ngiyaqinisa kini namuhla ukuthi niyakubhubha nokubhubha; izinsuku zenu aniyukuzandisa ezweni eniwela iJordani ukuba ningene kulo, nilidle.
“Ngibiza izulu nomhlaba ukuba kube ngofakazi ngani namuhla ukuthi ngibeke phambi kwenu ukuphila nokufa, isibusiso nesiqalekiso; ngalokho khethani ukuphila ukuze niphile, wena nenzalo yakho,

umthande uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ulalele izwi lakhe, unamathele kuye, ngokuba lokho kungukuphila kuwe nobude bezinsuku zakho, uyohlala ezweni uSimakade afunga kokhokho bakho, u-Abhrahama, u-Isaka, noJakobe, ukuthi uyakubanika lona.”
UMose waya wakhuluma lawa mazwi kubo bonke abakwa-Israyeli,
wathi kubo: “Namuhla ngineminyaka eyi-120 angisakwazi kuphuma nakungena; uSimakade uthe kimi: ‘Awuyukuliwela leli Jordani.’
Kepha uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uyakuwela phambi kwakho, abhubhise lezi zizwe ubuka, uzidle; uJoshuwa uyowela phambi kwakho njengalokhu uSimakade eshilo.
USimakade uyokwenza kuzo njengalokhu enza kuSihoni no-Ogi, amakhosi ama-Amori awabhubhisayo, kanjalo nasezweni lawo.
USimakade uyozinikela kini, nenze kuzo ngokwemiyalo yonke enginiyale ngayo.
Qinani, nime isibindi, ningesabi, ningashaywa luvalo ngabo, ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho nguyena ohamba nawe; akayukukulahla, akayukukushiya.”

UMose wambiza uJoshuwa, bebuka bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli, wathi kuye: “Qina, ume isibindi, ngokuba uyakuhamba nalaba bantu uye ezweni uSimakade afunga kokhokho babo ukubanika lona. Nguwena oyakwenza ukuba balidle ifa lalo.
USimakade nguye ohamba phambi kwakho; uyakuba nawe; akayukukulahla, akushiye; ungesabi, ungashaywa luvalo.”
UMose waloba lo mthetho, wawunika abaphristi, amadodana kaLevi ayethwala umphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade, nawo wonke amalunga akwa-Israyeli.
UMose wawayala wathi: “Ekupheleni konyaka wesikhombisa, njalo ngesikhathi esinqunyiweyo sonyaka woyekelelo ngomkhosi wamadokodo,
lapho wonke u-Israyeli eze ukubonakala phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho endaweni Yena ayoyikhetha, uyofunda lo mthetho phambi kuka-Israyeli wonke elalele.
Qoqa abantu: abesilisa, abesifazane, abantwana, nomfokazi osemzini wakho ukuze bezwe, bafunde, bamesabe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, baqikelele ukwenza wonke amazwi alo mthetho,
nokuthi abantwana babo abangawaziyo bawuzwe, bafunde ukumesaba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu ngazo zonke izinsuku nihleli ezweni eniwela iJordani ukuba nilidle.”
USimakade wathi kuMose: “Bheka, izinsuku zakho zokuba ufe sezisondele, biza uJoshuwa, ningene ethendeni lokuhlangana ukuze ngimyale.” UMose noJoshuwa bahamba, bema ethendeni lokuhlangana.
USimakade wabonakala ethendeni esensikeni yefu, insika yefu yema ngasemnyango wethende.

USimakade wathi kuMose: “Bheka, usuzoyolala noyihlomkhulu; laba bantu bayakusuka, bayophinga nonkulunkulu babezizwe abasezweni abaya kulo ukuba bahlale phakathi kwabo, bayakungishiya, basaphule isivumelwano engisenze nabo.

Intukuthelo yami iyakubavuthela ngalolo lusuku, ngiyakubashiya, ngibafulathele; bayakudliwa, behlelwe yizinhlekelele nezinhlupheko eziningi, baze bathi ngalolo lusuku: ‘Lezi zinhlupheko azisehlelanga yini ngoba uNkulunkulu wethu engekho phakathi kwethu na?’
Mina ngiyobafulathela impela ngalolo lusuku ngenxa yabo bonke ububi ababenzileyo, lokhu bephendukele kwabanye onkulunkulu.
“Ngalokho, zilobeleni leli hubo, nilifundise abantu bakwa-Israyeli, libekeni emilonyeni yabo ukuze leli culo libe kimi ngubufakazi kubantu bakwa-Israyeli.

Ngokuba lapho sengibangenisile ezweni engafunga kokhokho babo, izwe elichichima ubisi noju, bayodla, basuthe, bakhuluphale, bese bephendukela kwabanye onkulunkulu, babakhonze, bangedelele, basephule isivumelwano sami.

Kuyothi lapho sebehlelwe yizinhlekelele nezinhlupheko eziningi, leli hubo liyoba ngufakazi omelene nabo, ngokuba aliyukukhohlakala emilonyeni yozalo lwabo, lokhu ngiyayazi imicabango yabo abayicabangayo namhlanje, ngaphambi kokuba ngibangenise ezweni engafunga ngalo kubo.”
UMose waliloba lelo hubo ngalolo lusuku, wabafundisa lona abantu bakwa-Israyeli.
Wamgunyaza uJoshuwa, indodana kaNuni, wathi: “Qina, ume isibindi, ngokuba nguwe ozongenisa abantu bakwa-Israyeli ezweni engafunga ngalo kubo; Mina ngizokuba nawe.”
Kwathi lapho uMose eseqedile ukuloba wonke amazwi alo mthetho encwadini,
uMose wayeseyala abaLevi abathwala umphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade, wathi:
“Thathani le ncwadi yomthetho, niyibeke ngaseceleni komphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, ihlale khona, ibe ngubufakazi, imelane nani.
Mina ngiyakwazi ukuhlubuka kwakho nokuba nguntamo lukhuni kwakho. Bheka nje, ngisekhona nani namuhla seniyamhlubuka uSimakade; pho kuyoba kukhulu kangakanani sengifile, na?
Ngiqoqele wonke amalunga ezizwaneni zenu nezinduna zenu ukuze ngikhulume kuwo lawa mazwi, elalele, ngibiza izulu nomhlaba kube ngufakazi.

Ngiyazi ukuthi uma sengifile niyokona nokona, niphambuke endleleni enginiyale ngayo. Ngezinsuku ezizayo niyokwehlelwa ngububi, ngokuba niyokwenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, nimthukuthelise ngemisebenzi yezandla zenu.”
UMose wakhuluma wonke amazwi ehubo ibandla lonke lakwa-Israyeli lilalele.
“Lalelani nina mazulu, ngiyakhuluma; umhlaba mawuzwe amazwi omlomo wami.
Isifundiso sami masehle njengemvula, inkulumo yami iconse njengamazolo, njengomkhizo otshanini, nanjengezihlambi ohlazeni,
ngokuba ngiyomemezela igama likaSimakade: ngimnike udumo uNkulunkulu wethu.
“Uyidwala, umsebenzi wakhe uphelele, zonke izindlela zakhe zingukulunga; unguNkulunkulu wokwethembeka ongenakonakala; ulungile, uqotho Yena.
“Bonile kuye; abaseyibo abantwana bakhe, ngenxa yesici sabo; bayisizukulwane esiphambeneyo nesiyisigwegwe.
Ngabe nimbonga kanjalo uSimakade, na? Nina bantu abayiziwula nabangahlakaniphile, akasiye yini uyihlo anidalwanga nguye wanenza, wanimisa, na?
“Khumbula izinsuku zasendulo, ubheke iminyaka yezizukulwane ngezizukulwane; buza kuyihlo, uyakukulandisa, nezingwevu zizokutshela.
OPhezukonke lapho abela izizwe ifa lazo, lapho ehlukanisela abantwana babantu, wamisa imingcele yezizwe ngokwenani labantu bakwa-Israyeli.
Ngokuba isabelo sikaSimakade singabantu bakhe. UJakobe uyisifunda sefa lakhe.
“Wamthola ezweni eliyihlane, nasoqwathuleni lomkhulungwane kwahlongasibi, wamzungeza, wamnakekela, wamgcina njengenhlamvu yeso lakhe.
Njengokhozi lunyakazisa isidleke salo, lubhakuza phezu kwamaphuphu alo, welula amaphiko akhe, wabathatha, wabathwala ngamaphikho akhe.
NguSimakade kuphela owamqondisa, akukho nkulunkulu wabezizwe onaye.
“Wamkhweza ezindaweni eziphakemeyo zomhlaba, wadla izithelo zamasimu, wammuncisa uju edwaleni, namafutha eweni lensengetsha.
Wadla izaqheqhe zemihlambi, ubisi lwezimvu, amafutha amawundlu, izinqama zohlobo lwaseBhashani, izimbuzi, namanoni kakolo wekhethelo; waphuza iwayini livela egazini lamagilebhisi.
“UJeshuruni wakhuluphala, wayesekhahlela; usekhuluphele, uzimukile, futhi uchachambile. Wamshiya uNkulunkulu owamenza, waledelela iDwala lensindiso yakhe.
Bamenza waba nesikhwele ngonkulunkulu babezizwe, bamthukuthelisa ngezinengiso.
“Bahlabela amadimoni angeyena uNkulunkulu, nonkulunkulu abangazange babazi, onkulunkulu abasha, abasanda kuhlangabezana nabo, nababengaziwa ngokhokho babo.
Walikhohlwa iDwala elakuzalayo, wamkhohlwa uNkulunkulu owakudalayo.
“USimakade wakubona lokho, wanengwa ngukuchukuluzwa ngamadodana namadodakazi akhe.
Wathi: ‘Ngizobufihla ubuso bami kubo, ngibone ukuthi sizoba yini isiphetho sabo; ngokuba bayisizukulwane esiphambeneyo, nabantwana okungekho ukwethembeka kubo.
Bangenze nganesikhwele ngokungesiye uNkulunkulu, bangithukuthelisa ngokuyize kwabo; ngiyobenza babe nesikhwele ngabangesiso isizwe, ngibathukuthelise ngesizwe esiyisiwula.
Ngokuba umlilo uphenjwe yintukuthelo yami; uyabhebhetheka kuze kube sendaweni yabafileyo engaphansi, uyaqothula umhlaba nezithelo zawo, wokhela nezisekelo zezintaba.
“ ‘Ngiyonqwabelisa izinhlekelele phezu kwabo ngibacibe ngemicibisholo yami:
bayakuphela amandla yindlala, baqedwe wubhubhane, baqothulwe yisifo esibi, ngibathumele ngezinzawula zezilwane zasendle ezinesihlungu nezihuquzela othulini, zibalume.
Emigwaqweni inkemba iyodla lubi, emakamelweni kubhoke uvalo: ezinsizweni nasezintombini, koncelayo nasempungeni.
Ngathi: “Ngizobavithiza babe yizicucu ngiqede ukukhunjulwa kwabo kubantu,”
kungenjalo, ngesaba ukuchukuluzwa yisitha, funa abamelene nabo baqonde, bathi: “Izandla zethu eziphakamile, akusiye uSimakade owenze konke lokhu.” ’ ”
“Bayisizwe esingenangqondo, akukho ukuqonda kubo.
Uma bebehlakaniphile bebeyakukuqonda lokhu, baqonde nesiphetho sabo.
Oyedwa angayixosha kanjani inkulungwane, ababili bahubhe izinkulungwane ezilishumi, uma idwala labo belingathengisanga ngabo, uSimakade ebengabanikelanga, na?
Impela idwala labo alifani neDwala lethu; nezitha zethu ziyakuvuma lokho.
Umvini wabo ungumvini waseSodoma ovela emasimini aseGomora; izithelo zawo ziwubuthi, amahlukuzo awo amuncu.
Iwayini labo liyisihlungu sezinyoka, lingubuthi bemfezi.
Lokho akugciniwe yini kimi, kwavalelwa ezinqolobaneni zami, na?

Impindiselo ingeyami, nokunxephezela kungokwami, lapho unyawo lwabo lushelelela okwesikhashana, ngokuba usuku lwabo lwenhlekelele selusondele, izinto abalungiselelwe zona uyozenza zifike ngokushesha kubo.
“USimakade uyobehlulela abantu bakhe, abe nesihawu ezincekwini zakhe, lapho ebona ukuthi amandla abo aphelile, akusekho oboshiweyo nokhululekileyo.
Uyakuthi: ‘Baphi onkulunkulu babo, nedwala ababephephela kulo,
ababedla amanoni emihlatshelo yabo, bephuza iwayini lomnikelo wabo wokuphuzwayo, na? Mabanisize, mababe yisiphephelo senu.
“ ‘Bonani manje ukuthi Mina, yebo, Mina Nginguye, akekho unkulunkulu ngaphandle kwami; Mina ngiyabulala, ngibuye ngiphilise, ngilimaze, futhi ngipholise; akekho ongabahlenga esandleni sami.
Ngiphakamisela isandla sami ezulwini, ngithi: Mina ngiyakuphila kuze kube phakade.
Uma ngilola inkemba yami ebengezelayo, isandla sami sibambelele ekwehluleleni, ngiyophenduka ngiphindisele kwabamelene nami, ngiphindisele kwabangizondayo.’ ”
“Imicibisholo yami ngiyoyidakisa ngegazi, inkemba yami idle abantu, ngegazi lababuleweyo nabathunjiweyo, kuqala enhlokweni yabaholi bezitha.
Memezani ngokuthokoza bantu bakhe, nina zizwe, ngokuba uyakuliphindiselela igazi lezinceku zakhe, aziphindiselele kwabamelene naye, ahlambulule izwe lakhe nabantu bakhe.”
UMose noJoshuwa, indodana kaNuni, wafika wakhuluma wonke amazwi aleli hubo kubantu bonke belalele.
UMose eseqedile ukukhuluma wonke lawa mazwi kubo bonke abakwa-Israyeli,
wathi kubo: “Agcineni enhliziyweni yenu wonke lawa mazwi enginixwayisa ngawo namuhla, niyale ngawo abantwana benu, ukuze baqikelele ukuwenza wonke amazwi alo mthetho.
Ngokuba leli lizwi alisiwo amampunge nje kini, lingukuphila kwenu; ngalawa mazwi niyokwandisa izinsuku zenu ezweni eniwela iJordani, ukuba nilidle.”
USimakade wakhuluma kuMose ngokubaluleka kwalolu lusuku, wathi:
“Khuphukela entabeni i-Abharimi, okuyintaba iNebho kwaMowabi, eqondene neJerikho, ulibuke iKhanani engizakubanika lona abantu bakwa-Israyeli, ukuba libe yifa labo.
Uyofela kuleyo ntaba okhuphukela kuyo, ubuyele kwabakini, njengoba no-Aroni, umfowenu, afela entabeni iHori, wabuyela kwabakubo,
ngokuba naphambuka phambi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli namelana nami ngasemanzini eMeribha eKadeshi, ehlane iZini, lokhu ningangingcwelisanga phambi kwabakwa-Israyeli.
Uyakulibona izwe phambi kwakho, kodwa awuyukungena kulo, izwe engibanika lona abantu bakwa-Israyeli.”
Nasi isibusiso uMose, umuntu kaNkulunkulu, abusisa ngaso abantu bakwa-Israyeli, engakafi;
wathi: “USimakade weza evela eSinayi, wabakhanyisela evela eSeyiri, wakhazimula entabeni iPharanu. Weza nezigidi zabangcwele; ebaphathele umthetho ovuthayo esandleni sakhe sokunene.
Yebo, uyazithanda izizwe, bonke abangcwele bakhe basesandleni sakho; baholelwe ngasezinyaweni zakho, bayakwemukela okwamazwi akho.
UMose wasinika umthetho, waba yifa lenhlangano kaJakobe.
USimakade waba yinkosi eJeshuruni, ngesikhathi izinhloko zabantu ziqoqana ndawonye, nezizwana zakwa-Israyeli zabuthanela ndawonye.
“Sengathi uRubeni angaphila, angafi; amadodana akhe ande kakhulu.
“Washo lokhu ngoJuda: ‘Yizwa, Simakade, yizwa izwi likaJuda, umlethe kwabakubo; izandla zakho zimlwele, umsize kwabamelene naye.’
“NgoLevi wathi: ‘IThumimi lakho ne-Urimi lakho makuye kothembekileyo wakho, owamvivinya eMasa, owaphikisana naye ngasemanzini eMeribha,’
owathi ngoyise nonina: ‘Angibabonanga,’ wangabanaka abafowabo, akaze abanakekela abantwana bakhe. Ngokuba baligcina izwi lakho, basigcina isivumelwano sakho.
Bafundisa uJakobe izehlulelo zakho, no-Israyeli umthetho wakho; babeka impepho phambi kwamakhala akho, nomnikelo oshiswa wonke e-althare lakho.
