anibalahlanga abafowenu ngazo zonke lezi zinsuku kuze kube namuhla, kodwa nikuqikelele ukugcina konke uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu aniyale ngakho.

Manje uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu usebanike ukuthula abafowenu njengoba ayebathembisile; ngakho-ke buyelani emuva emathendeni enu ezweni eliyisabelo senu, izwe uMose inceku kaSimakade aninika lona ngaphesheya kweJordani.

Qaphelani ukuba nigcine imiyalo nomthetho aniyala ngakho uMose, inceku kaSimakade, ukuba nimthande uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, nihambe kuzo zonke izindlela zakhe, nigcine imiyalo yakhe, ninamathele kuye, nimkhonze ngayo yonke inhliziyo yenu nangawo wonke umphefumulo wenu.”
UJoshuwa wayesebabusisa, wabakhulula ukuba bahambe, bahamba babuyela emathendeni abo.

Enye ingxenye yesizwana sakwaManase, uMose wayeyabele isabelo sayo eBhashani, kodwa enye ingxenye uJoshuwa wayabela phakathi kwabafowabo izwe elisentshonalanga, phesheya kweJordani. Ngesikhathi ebabuyisela emathendeni abo, wababusisa,
wathi kubo: “Buyelani emathendeni enu nengcebo eningi, nemfuyo eningi, nesiliva, igolide, ithusi, insimbi, nezimpahla eziningi, nabelane nabafowenu impango eniyithathe ezitheni zenu.”

Ngakho-ke abozalo lukaRubeni nabolukaGadi nengxenye yesizwana sakwaManase babuyela emakhaya, behlukana nabanye bakwa-Israyeli eShilo, eKhanani, ukuba babuyele kwaGileyadi, ezweni labo ababelidle laba yisabelo sabo njengokuyala kukaSimakade ngoMose.
Kwathi lapho befika emngceleni eJordani, eKhanani, abozalo lukaRubeni, abolukaGadi, nengxenye yesizwana sakwaManase bakha i-althare elikhulu kakhulu.
Abakwa-Israyeli bezwa ukuthi abakwaRubeni, abakwaGadi, nengxenye yesizwana sakwaManase bakhe i-althare malungana neKhanani ezifundeni ezingaseJordani, ohlangothini lwabakwa-Israyeli.
Kuthe ukuba abakwa-Israyeli bakuzwe lokho, yonke inhlangano yabakwa-Israyeli yabuthana eShilo ukuze balwe nabo.
Abakwa-Israyeli bathumela uFinehasi, indodana ka-Eleyazare umphristi, kwabozalo lukaRubeni, olukaGadi, nengxenye yesizwana sakwaManase kwaGileyadi.
UFinehasi wayehambisana nezikhulu ezilishumi, kuyisikhulu ngendlu kayise kuzona zonke izizwana zakwa-Israyeli, kuyileso naleso simele indlu kayise phakathi kwemindeni yakwa-Israyeli.
Bafika ozalweni lukaRubeni nolukaGadi nasengxenyeni yesizwana sakwaManase kwaGileyadi, bathi kubo:

“Isho kanje inhlangano yonke kaSimakade: ‘Siphambeko sini lesi enisenze kuNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli ukuba nimjikele namuhla ngokungabe nisamlandela uSimakade ngokuzakhela i-althare, na? Ningamhlubuka kanjani uSimakade namuhla, na?
Asonanga yini ngokwanele ePheyori, okuze kube manje asikazihlambululi kubo, okwathi ngenxa yabo, yonke inhlangano kaSimakade yehlelwa wubhubhane,
ukuba namuhla nimhlubuke ningabe nisamlandela uSimakade, na? Uma nimhlubuka namuhla uSimakade, uzoyithukuthelela yonke inhlangano ka-Israyeli kusasa.

Kepha uma izwe lenu lingcolile, welelani ezweni eliyifa likaSimakade, lapho kukhona ithabanakeli likaSimakade, nibe nefa phakathi kwethu; ningamhlubuki uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu, futhi ningasihlubuki nathi ngokuzakhela i-althare, kunalelo likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu.
U-Akhani, indodana kaZera, akenzanga yini isiphambeko ngokuqalekisiweyo, kwathi yonke inhlangano yakwa-Israyeli yehlelwa yintukuthelo, na? Akazange abhubhe yedwa ngenxa yesiphambeko sakhe.’ ”
Abozalo lukaRubeni, nabolukaGadi, nengxenye yesizwana sakwaManase baziphendulela kanje kuzo izinhloko zemindeni yakwa-Israyeli, bathi:
“Simakade, Nkulunkulu wonkulunkulu! USimakade, uNkulunkulu wonkulunkulu uyazi, no-Israyeli makazi! Uma kungukuhlubuka noma kungukwephula ukholo kuSimakade, ningasiyekeli sisinde namuhla,

ngokuzakhela i-althare ukuze sihlubuke ekulandeleni uSimakade; noma uma lokhu sikwenze ukuze sinikele kulo iminikelo yokushiswa noma yokusanhlamvu noma yobudlelwane, uSimakade uqobo makaziphindiselele.
Qha, silakhe ngokwesaba ukuthi esikhathini esizayo abantwana benu bayothi kwabethu: ‘Ninamsebenzi muni noSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, na?
Ngokuba uSimakade ulenzile iJordani laba ngumngcele phakathi kwethu nani, nina bakwaRubeni nabakwaGadi; aninasabelo kuSimakade.’ Izingane zenu zingenza abantwana bethu bayeke ukukhonza uSimakade.
“Ngakho-ke sithe: ‘Manje masakhe i-althare, lingabi ngelomnikelo wokushiswa noma elomhlatshelo,’

kodwa libe ngubufakazi phakathi kwethu nani, naphakathi kwezizukulwane emva kwethu, ukuthi siyayenza inkonzo kaSimakade phambi kwakhe ngeminikelo yethu yokushiswa, ngemihlatshelo, nangeminikelo yobudlelwane, ukuze abantwana benu bangaze bathi kwabethu ngesikhathi esizayo: ‘Aninasabelo kuSimakade.’

“Sathi-ke: ‘Uma kungase kushiwo lokhu kithi nasezizukulwaneni zethu ngomuso, siyokuthi: “Bhekani lo mfanekiso we-althare likaSimakade abalenza okhokho bethu, bengalenzeli iminikelo yokushiswa nemihlatshelo, kodwa ukuze libe ngubufakazi phakathi kwethu nani.” ’

“Makube kude nathi ukuhlubuka uSimakade sichezuke namuhla ekulandeleni uSimakade ngokwakha i-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa nowokusanhlamvu noma umhlatshelo, kunalelo althare likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu eliphambi kwethabanakeli lakhe.”
Lapho uFinehasi umphristi, izikhulu zenhlangano, nezinhloko zemindeni yakwa-Israyeli ababenaye bezwa lawo mazwi akhulunywa ngabozalo lukaRubeni, olukaGadi, nolukaManase, beneliseka.

Umphristi uFinehasi, indodana ka-Eleyazare, wathi kwabakwaRubeni nabakwaGadi nabakwaManase: “Namuhla sesiyazi ukuthi uSimakade uphakathi kwethu, ngokuba anisenzanga lesi siphambeko kuSimakade; namuhla nibasindisile abakwa-Israyeli esandleni sikaSimakade.”
Umphristi uFinehasi, indodana ka-Eleyazare, nezikhulu babuyela emuva besuka kwaRubeni nakwaGadi kwaGileyadi eKhanani, babuyela kwa-Israyeli nezwi abaliphathisiwe.
Umbiko wabathokozisa abakwa-Israyeli, base bembonga uNkulunkulu, ababe besayiphatha eyokukhuphuka babahlasele ukuze babhubhise izwe abahlala kulo abozalo lukaRubeni nabolukaGadi.
AbakwaRubeni nabakwaGadi balibiza lelo althare ngokuthi: “Ngubufakazi,” ngokuba bathi: “Lingubufakazi phakathi kwethu bokuthi uSimakade unguNkulunkulu.”
Sekwedlule izinsuku eziningi, uSimakade esenike u-Israyeli ukuthula ezitheni zakhe nxazonke, noJoshuwa esemdala, iminyaka isihambile,
uJoshuwa wabiza bonke abakwa-Israyeli, amalunga akhona, izinhloko, abehluleli, nezikhulu, wathi kubo: “Manje sengimdala, neminyaka yami isiminingi,
futhi nikubonile konke uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu akwenza kuzo zonke lezi zizwe ngenxa yenu, ngokuba nguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu owanilwela.
Bhekani, nginabele njengefa lezizwana zenu, zonke izizwe ezisasele, nazo zonke izizwe engazibhubhisa, kusukela eJordani kuze kufike oLwandle Olukhulu entshonalanga.
USimakade uNkulunkulu wenu uyakuzixosha, azidungule phambi kwenu; niyakulidla izwe lazo, njengalokhu uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu ethembisile kini.
“Ngakho-ke qinani kakhulu ukuze nigcine futhi nenze konke okulotshwe encwadini yomthetho kaMose, ukuba ningachezukeli kwesokunene noma kwesokhohlo,
ukuze ningahlangani nalezi zizwe ezisele phakathi kwenu, noma nibize amagama onkulunkulu bazo, nifunge ngabo, nibakhonze, noma nibakhothamele,
kodwa nibambelele niqine kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu njengoba nenzile kuze kube namuhla.
Ngokuba uSimakade uzixoshile phambi kwenu izizwe ezinkulu nezinamandla; nina-ke akukho muntu okwazile ukumelana nani kuze kube namuhla.
Oyedwa kini uxoshe inkulungwane, ngokuba nguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu onilwelayo njengalokhu ayekhulume kini.
Qaphelani ukuba nimthande uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.
“Ngokuba uma nihlehlela emuva, ninamathele kuleyo nsali yalezi zizwe ephakathi kwenu, niganiselane nazo, nize niganwe ngabesifazane bazo nazo ziganwe ngabenu,

yazini impela ukuthi uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu akayukuqhubeka axoshe lezi zizwe phambi kwenu, kodwa ziyoba wugibe nonoxhaka kini, nenkalivasi ezinhlangothini zenu, nameva emehlweni enu, nize nibhubhe kuleli lizwe elihle uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu aninike lona.

“Bhekani, namuhla sengizokufa; niyazi ezinhliziyweni nasemiphefumulweni yenu nonke ukuthi akukho nokukodwa okwaphuthayo kwangaphumelela kulokho uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu akwethembisa mayelana nani; konke kwaphumelela, akukho nakunye okwaphutha.
Kodwa njengoba zonke izinto ezinhle uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu anethembisa zona zigcwalisekile, kanjalo uSimakade uyonehlisela konke okubi, aze anibhubhise kuleli lizwe elihle uSimakade aniphe lona.

Uma nephula isivumelwano sikaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu aniyala ngaso bese nihamba niyokhonza abanye onkulunkulu, nibakhothamele, ulaka lukaSimakade luyonivuthela, nibhubhe ngokushesha kuleli lizwe elihle aninike lona.”
UJoshuwa wayeseqoqa zonke izizwana zakwa-Israyeli eShekhemi, wabiza amalunga akwa-Israyeli, izinhloko, abehluleli, nezikhulu, bema phambi kukaNkulunkulu.

UJoshuwa wathi kubo bonke abantu: “Usho kanje uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Emandulo okhokho benu, uThera namadodana akhe u-Abhrahama noNahori, babehlala ngaphesheya komfula, bekhonza abanye onkulunkulu.
Ngamthatha ukhokho wenu u-Abhrahama ngaphesheya komfula, ngamhola edabula lonke iKhanani, ngenza isizukulwane sakhe saba singi, ngamnika u-Isaka.
U-Isaka ngamnika uJakobe no-Esawu. Ngamnika u-Esawu elezintaba kuze kube seSeyiri ukuba alidle libe yifa lakhe, kodwa uJakobe nabantwana bakhe behlela eGibhithe.
“ ‘Ngathumela uMose no-Aroni, ngalihlupha iGibhithe ngalokho engakwenza phakathi kwalo; emveni kwalokho nganikhipha.
Lapho ngibakhipha okhokho benu eGibhithe, nafika olwandle; abaseGibhithe babaxosha okhokho benu ngezinqola nangamahhashi, baze bafika oLwandle Lomhlanga.

Lapho bekhala kuSimakade, waletha ubumnyama phakathi kwenu nabaseGibhithe. Wenza ulwandle ukuba lubuyele phezu kwabo lubagubuzele; nakubona engakwenza kwabaseGibhithe; emveni kwalokho nahlala ehlane izinsuku eziningi.
“ ‘Nganingenisa ezweni lama-Amori ahlala phesheya kweJordani, alwa nani; ngawanikela esandleni senu, nalidla izwe lawo; ngawabhubhisa phambi kwenu.
Inkosi uBhalaki, indodana kaZiphori wakwaMowabi, waphuma ukuyolwa no-Israyeli. Wathumela ukuyobiza uBhileyamu indodana kaBheyori ukuba aniqalekise,
kodwa angimlalelanga uBhileyamu; ngakho-ke wanibusisa, nganikhulula esandleni sakhe.
“ ‘Lapho niwela iJordani, nafika eJerikho; izakhamuzi zalo zalwa nani, kanjalo nama-Amori, amaPherizi, amaKhanani, amaHithi, amaGirigashi, amaHivi, namaJebusi, ngabanikela esandleni senu.
Ngathumela iminyovu phambi kwenu, eyaxosha phambi kwenu amakhosi amabili ama-Amori, kwakungengankemba yakho noma ngomnsalo wakho.
Nganinika izwe eningalikhandlekelanga nemizi eningayakhanga, nihlala kuyo; nidla izithelo zemivini nezeminqumo eningakutshalanga.’
“Manje mesabeni uSimakade, nimkhonze ngobuqotho nangeqiniso, nibasuse onkulunkulu ababekhonzwa ngokhokho besengaphesheya komfula naseGibhithe, nikhonze uSimakade.

Uma kukubi emehlweni enu ukukhonza uSimakade, khethani namuhla ukuthi ngubani eniyakumkhonza, noma ngonkulunkulu ababekhonzwa ngokhokho benu besengaphesheya komfula, noma ngonkulunkulu bama-Amori enihlala ezweni lawo, kepha mina nendlu yami siyakumkhonza uSimakade.”
Abantu baphendula bathi: “Makube kude nathi ukushiya uSimakade sikhonze abanye onkulunkulu,

ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu nguYena owasikhipha thina nokhokho bethu Gibhithe, endlini yobugqila, nowenza lezo zibonakaliso emehlweni ethu. Wasivikela endleleni yonke esahamba kuyo, naphakathi kwabo bonke abantu esedlula phakathi kwabo.
USimakade waxosha bonke abantu phambi kwethu, ama-Amori ayehlala ezweni; yingakho siyomkhonza uSimakade, ngokuba unguNkulunkulu wethu.”
UJoshuwa wathi kubantu: “Aninakumkhonza uSimakade, ngokuba unguNkulunkulu ongcwele. UnguNkulunkulu onomhawu, akayukuxolela iziphambeko zenu noma izono zenu.
Uma nimshiya uSimakade, nikhonze abanye onkulunkulu babezizwe, uyophenduka, anenzakalise, aniqothule esenenzele lokhu okuhle.”
Abantu bathi kuJoshuwa: “Qha, siyokumkhonza uSimakade.”
UJoshuwa wayesethi kubantu: “Nina ningofakazi uqobo bokuthi yinina enizikhethele uSimakade ukuba nimkhonze.” Bathi: “Singofakazi.”
Wathi kubo: “Ngakho-ke lahlani onkulunkulu babezizwe abaphakathi kwenu, niphendulele izinhliziyo zenu kuSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.”
Abantu bathi kuJoshuwa: “Siyomkhonza uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu, silalele izwi lakhe.”
Ngakho-ke uJoshuwa wenza isivumelwano nabantu ngalolo lusuku, wabamisela izimiso nemithetho eShekemi.
UJoshuwa wawaloba lawa mazwi encwadini yomthetho kaNkulunkulu, wathatha itshe elikhulu, walimisa lapho phansi komu-okhi, endaweni engcwele kaSimakade.
UJoshuwa wathi kubo bonke abantu: “Bhekani, leli litshe liyokuba ngufakazi ngathi, ngokuba lizwile wonke amazwi kaSimakade awakhulume kithi; liyoba ngufakazi ngani, uma senimphika uNkulunkulu wenu.”
UJoshuwa wayesebadedela abantu, babuyela efeni labo.
Kwathi emveni kwazo zonke lezo zinto uJoshuwa, indodana kaNuni, inceku kaSimakade, wafa eseneminyaka eyi-110.
Bamngcwaba eThiminathi Sera eyifa lakhe, ekwelezintaba kwa-Efrayimi, enyakatho yentaba iGahashi.
U-Israyeli wamkhonza uSimakade ngazo zonke izinsuku zikaJoshuwa, nangezamalunga aphila izinsuku ezedlula ezikaJoshuwa, futhi ayekwazi konke uSimakade ayekwenzele u-Israyeli.

Amathambo kaJosefa ayekhushulwe ngabakwa-Israyeli eGibhithe, bawangcwaba eShekhemi esiqeshini somhlaba esasithengwe nguJakobe emadodaneni kaHamori, uyise kaShekemi, ngamakesita ayikhulu, saba yifa labantu bakwaJosefa.
U-Eleyazare indodana ka-Aroni wafa; bamngcwaba eGibheya umuzi kaFinehasi indodana yakhe, ayewunikiwe kwelezintaba kwa-Efrayimi.
Emveni kokufa kukaJoshuwa, abantu bakwa-Israyeli babuza kuSimakade, bathi: “Ngubani ozosihola siyokulwa namaKhanani, na?”
USimakade wathi: “NguJuda ozokwenyuka. Bheka, izwe ngilinikele esandleni sakhe.”
UJuda wathi kumfowabo uSimeyoni: “Yenyuka nami siye ezweni engilabelwe ukuze silwe namaKhanani, nami ngizohamba nawe ngiye ezweni owabelwe lona.” USimeyoni wayesehamba naye.
UJuda wenyuka. USimakade wanikela amaKhanani namaPherizi esandleni sakhe; babulala abantu abayizi-10 000 eBhezekhi.
Bazithela phezu kuka-Adoni Bhezekhi, eBhezekhi, balwa naye, bawabulala amaKhanani namaPherizi.
U-Adoni Bhezekhi wabaleka, kodwa bamhubha, bambamba, bamnquma izithupha noqukula.

U-Adoni Bhezekhi, wathi: “Amakhosi angama-70 anqunywe izithupha noqukula ayevame ukucosha imvuthuluka ewa etafuleni lami, njengoba ngenzile, ngalokho uNkulunkulu uphindisele kimi.” Bamletha eJerusalema, wafela khona.
Abantu bakwaJuda balwa neJerusalema, balidla, balibhubhisa ngenkemba, bawuthungela umuzi ngomlilo.
Emveni kwalokho abantu bakwaJuda behla bayokulwa namaKhanani ayehlala kwelezintaba eNingizimu, nasemathafeni.
UJuda walwa namaKhanani ayehlala eHebhroni, okwakuthiwa yiKiriyathi Arbha, babulala uSheshayi, u-Ahimani, noThalimayi.
Ukusuka lapho balwa nezakhamuzi zaseDebhiri okwakuthiwa yiKiriyathi Seferi.
UKhalebhu wathi: “Lowo oyonqoba, alidle iKiriyathi Seferi, ngiyomnika u-Akhisa indodakazi yami, abe ngumkakhe.”
Kwasuka u-Othiniyeli, indodana kaKhenazi, umnawabo kaKhalebhu, walidla; wayesemganisela indodakazi yakhe, u-Akhisa, yaba ngumkakhe.
Wathi lapho efika kuye, wamnxusa ukuba acele insimu kuyise. Lapho ehla embongolweni yakhe, uKhalebhu wathi kuye: “Ufunani, na?”
Wathi kuye: “Ngicela ungiphe isipho, njengoba ungibeke ezweni eningizimu, ngiphe futhi nemithombo yamanzi.” UKhalebhu wamnika imithombo esenhla nesezansi.
Abozalo loMkheni, umukhwe kaMose, bakhuphuka nabozalo lukaJuda bisuka emzini wamasundu baya ehlane lakwaJuda eNegevu ese-Aradi. Yena wahamba wayohlala nabantu.
UJuda wahamba noSimeyoni umfowabo, banqoba amaKhanani ayehlala eZefathi, balicekela phansi. Ngakho-ke umuzi wabizwa ngokuthi yiHorma.
UJuda wadla iGaza nezindawo zalo, i-Ashikeloni nezindawo zalo, ne-Ekhroni nezindawo zalo.
USimakade wayenoJuda, walinqoba elezintaba, kodwa akakwazanga ukuxosha izakhamuzi zasemathafeni, ngokuba zazinezinqola zensimbi.
IHebhroni lanikwa uKhalebhu njengalokhu uMose ayeshilo, waxosha kuyo amadodana amathathu ka-Anaki.
Kodwa abozalo lukaBhenjamini abawaxoshanga amaJebusi ayehlala eJerusalema, ngakho-ke amaJebusi asahlala eJerusalema phakathi kwabozalo lukaBhenjamini kuze kube namuhla.
Abendlu kaJosefa benyuka bahlasela iBhethele, uSimakade wayenabo.
Bathumela izinhloli eBhethele elalikade laziwa ngokuthi yiLuzi.
Lapho izinhloli zibona indoda eyayiphuma emzini, zathi kuyo: “Sikhombise indlela yokungena emzini, sizokuphatha kahle.”
Ngakho-ke yabakhombisa indlela yokungena emzini, bawubhubhisa umuzi ngenkemba, kodwa indoda nomndeni wayo wonke babadedela bahamba.
Indoda yahamba yaya ezweni lamaHithi, yakha umuzi yawuqamba ngokuthi yiLuzi, usabizwa ngalelo gama kuze kube namuhla.

UManase akazixoshanga izakhamuzi zaseBhethi Sheyani nemizana yalo, ezaseThahanakhi nemizana yalo, ezaseDori nemizana yalo, ezase-Ibheleyami nemizana yalo, nezaseMegido nemizana yalo, kodwa amaKhanani aqhubeka ahlala kulelo lizwe.
Kuthe u-Israyeli esenamandla, wawaphoqa amaKhanani ukuba amsebenzele, kodwa akawaxoshanga aphume aphele phakathi kwakhe.
No-Efrayimi akawaxoshanga amaKhanani ayehlala eGezeri, kodwa amaKhanani ahlala phakathi kwabo eGezeri.
UZebuloni akazixoshanga izakhamuzi zaseKhithroni, nezaseNahaloli, kodwa amaKhanani ahlala phakathi kwabo bawaphoqa ukuba abasebenzele.
U-Asheri akazixoshanga izakhamuzi zase-Akho, ezaseSidoni, ezase-Ahelabhi, ezase-Akhizibhi, ezaseHelibha, ezase-Afiki nezaseRehobhi,
kodwa abakwa-Asheri bahlala phakathi kwamaKhanani ayakhe kulelo lizwe, ngokuba abawaxoshanga.

UNafethali akazixoshanga izakhamuzi zaseBhethi Shemeshi, nezaseBhethi Anathi, kodwa wahlala phakathi kwamaKhanani ayakhe kulelo lizwe; izakhamuzi zaseBhethi Shemeshi, nezaseBhethi Anathi baziphoqelela ukuba zibasebenzele.
Ama-Amori acindezela isizwe sakwaDani ukuba sihlale kwelezintaba, awaze asivumela ukwehlela esigodini.
Ama-Amori aqhubeka ahlala entabeni iHeresi, e-Ayijaloni, naseShahalibhimi, kodwa abakwaJosefa bawacindezela kanzima ama-Amori, bawaphoqa ukuba abasebenzele.
Umngcele wama-Amori wawusuka wenyukele phezulu emsahweni e-Akhrabhimi, eSela, wenyuke.

Ingelosi kaSimakade yakhuphuka eGiligali, yaya eBhokhimi, yathi: “Nganikhipha eGibhithe, nganiletha ezweni engalethembisa okhokho benu, ngathi: ‘Angisoze ngasephula isivumelwano sami nani kuze kube phakade.
Nani-ke ningasenzi isivumelwano nezakhamuzi zakuleli lizwe. Bhidlizani ama-althare azo.’ Kepha aniwulalelanga umyalo wami. Bonani enikwenzileyo.
Ngakho-ke manje ngithi: angizukuzixosha phambi kwenu, kodwa zizomelana nani, onkulunkulu bazo bayoba wugibe kini.”
Ngesikhathi ingelosi kaSimakade ikhuluma lawo mazwi ku-Israyeli wonkana, abantu badazuluka, bakhala.
Bayibiza leyo ndawo ngokuthi yiBhokhimi, benza umhlatshelo kuSimakade kuleyo ndawo.
Kwathi ukuba uJoshuwa abakhulule abantu, abakwa-Israyeli babuyela efeni labo ezweni ababelwe lona.
Abantu bamkhonza uSimakade zonke izinsuku zikaJoshuwa, nangazo zonke izinsuku zezingwevu ezaphila kade kunoJoshuwa, ezaziwubonile wonke umsebenzi omkhulu uSimakade ayewenzele u-Israyeli.
UJoshuwa, indodana kaNuni, inceku kaSimakade, wafa eseneminyaka eyi-110.
Bamngcwaba emngceleni wefa lakhe eThimnathi Heresi, kwelezintaba kwa-Efrayimi, enyakatho yentaba iGahashi.
Sonke leso sizukulwane safa sabekwa nokhokho baso, kwakhula esinye isizukulwane emva kwabo, esasingamazi uSimakade nomsebenzi ayewenzele u-Israyeli.
Abakwa-Israyeli base benza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, bakhonza oBhali;
bamshiya uSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho babo, owabakhipha eGibhithe, balandela abanye onkulunkulu, onkulunkulu babantu ababebazungezile, babakhothamela, baluchukuluza ulaka luSimakade.
Bamshiya uSimakade, bakhonza uBhali no-Ashitharothi.
Intukuthelo kaSimakade yamvuthela u-Israyeli, wayesebanikela kubaphangi, babaphanga, wabathengisa emandleni ezitha ezazibazungezile, ababe besakwazi ukumelana nazo.
Noma yinini lapho bephuma impi, isandla sikaSimakade sasimelana nabo ukubehlisela okubi, njengalokhu uSimakade ayebaxwayisile wafunga kubo, babekhathazekile kakhulu.
USimakade wabavusela abehluleli ababakhulula esandleni salabo ababebaphanga.

Nokho ababalalelanga abehluleli babo, ngokuba baphinga nabanye onkulunkulu, babakhothamela. Ngokushesha bachezuka endleleni abahamba kuyo oyisemkhulu, ababelalela imiyalo kaSimakade, abazange basilandele isibonelo sabo.

Noma yinini lapho uSimakade ebavusela abehluleli, uSimakade wayeba naye umehluleli, futhi wayebakhulula esandleni sezitha zabo ngazo zonke izinsuku zalowo mehluleli, ngokuba uSimakade wayeba nozwelo lapho sebebubula ngenxa yalabo ababebacindezele, bebahlupha.

Kepha noma yinini lapho umehluleli efa, babebuyela emuva baziphathe kabi ngokwedlulele kunoyisemkhulu, ngokulandela abanye onkulunkulu ukuba babakhonze, babakhothamele. Abayekanga namunye wemikhuba yabo, nezindlela zabo zenkani.
Intukuthelo kaSimakade yamvuthela u-Israyeli, wathi: “Ngenxa yokuba laba bantu basephulile isivumelwano sami engabayala ngaso okhokho babo, futhi abalalelanga izwi lami,
angiyukuphinde ngixoshe abantu phambi kwabo, noma yisiphi sesizwe kwezashiywa nguJoshuwa ekufeni kwakhe,
ukuze uSimakade amvivinye u-Israyeli, abone ukuthi uyakuqikelela yini noma qha ukuhamba ngezindlela zakhe njengoba benza okhokho babo.”
USimakade wazishiya lezo zizwe, akaze azixosha kanyekanye, futhi kazinikelanga esandleni sikaJoshuwa.
Nazi izizwe uSimakade azishiya ukuze avivinye ngazo bonke abakwa-Israyeli ababengenalwazi ngempi eKhanani,
ukuze lezo zizukulwane zabakwa-Israyeli ezilandelayo zikwazi ukulwa, kufundiswe lezo ezingakaze ziyazi impi phambilini.
Kwakuyilezi izizwe: amakhosi ayisihlanu amaFilisti, nawo wonke amaKhanani, amaSidoni, amaHivi ayehlala entabeni iLebhanoni, kusukela entabeni iBhali Hermoni kuze kube seHamathi.
Zazishiyelwe ukuvivinywa ngabakwa-Israyeli, ukuze kwazeke ukuthi bayoyilalela yini imiyalelo kaSimakade abayala ngayo okhokho babo ngoMose.
Ngakho-ke abantu bakwa-Israyeli bahlala phakathi kwamaKhanani, amaHithi, ama-Amori, amaPherizi, amaHivi, namaJebusi,
baganwa ngamadodakazi alezi zizwe, aba ngamakhosikazi abo, amadodana abo aganwa ngamadodakazi azo, base bekhonza onkulunkulu bazo.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli benza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, bakhohlwa nguSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo, bakhonza oBhali no-Ashera.

Ngakho-ke intukuthelo kaSimakade yamvuthela u-Israyeli, wamthengisa esandleni senkosi uKhushani Rishathayimi wase-Aramu Naharayimi, abakwa-Israyeli bamkhonza uKhushani Rishathayimi iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili.
Kodwa lapho abantu bakwa-Israyeli bekhala kuSimakade, wabavusela umkhululi abakwa-Israyeli, owabakhulula, u-Othiniyeli indodana kaKhenazi, umnawabo kaKhalebhu.

UMoya kaSimakade wehlela phezu kwakhe, wabehlulela abakwa-Israyeli; waphuma waya empini, uSimakade wayinikela esandleni sakhe inkosi uKhushani Rishathayimi yase-Aramu, wamehlula uKhushani Rishathayimi.
Izwe laba nokuthula iminyaka engama-40. U-Othiniyeli, indodana kaKhenazi, wafa.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli babuye benza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, uSimakade waqinisa u-Egiloni wakwaMowabi wamelana nabakwa-Israyeli, ngokuba babenzile okubi emehlweni kaSimakade.
U-Egiloni ehlangene nabakwa-Amoni nabase-Amaleki bamhlasela, bamehlula u-Israyeli, badla uMuzi Wamasundu.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli bamkhonza u-Egiloni, inkosi yakwaMowabi, iminyaka eli-18.

Lapho abantu bakwa-Israyeli bekhala kuSimakade, uSimakade wabavusela omunye umkhululi, u-Ehudi indodana kaGera wakwaBhenjamini, owayeyinxele. Abakwa-Israyeli bathumela umnikelo enkosini u-Egiloni wakwaMowabi ngesandla sika-Ehudi.
U-Ehudi wazenzela inkemba ebukhali nhlangothi zombili, ubude bayo buyikhubhithi, wayibophela ethangeni lakhe lakwesokunene ngaphansi kwezingubo zakhe.
Wahambisa umnikelo ku-Egiloni, inkosi yakwaMowabi. U-Egiloni wayekhuluphele kakhulu.
U-Ehudi eseqedile ukwethula umnikelo ku-Egiloni, wabamukisa abantu ababethwele umnikelo.

Kepha yena waphenduka eduze nesithombe setshe esasiqoshwe eduze neGiligali, wabuyela emuva, wathi: “Nginombiko oyimfihlo engimele ngikutshele wona, nkosi.” Inkosi yathi: “Thulani.” Zonke izinceku zayo zaphuma lapho yayikhona.
U-Ehudi weza kuyo ngesikhathi ihleli yodwa ophahleni ekamelweni layo elipholile, wathi: “Nginomyalezo wakho ovela kuNkulunkulu.” Yayisisukuma esihlalweni sayo.
U-Ehudi wayeselula isandla sakhe sasekhohlo wahosha inkemba yakhe eyayisethangeni lakhe lesokunene, wamgwaza ngayo u-Egiloni esiswini;
inkemba yangena nesibambo sayo yaze yayophumela emhlane. Yambozeka emafutheni ngokuba u-Ehudi wayengazange ayikhiphe esiswini sika-Egiloni.
U-Ehudi waphumela emhubheni wavala iminyango yekamelo eliphezulu, wayihluthulela.
Esehambile u-Ehudi, izinceku zangena, lapho zithola ukuthi iminyango yekamelo eliphezulu ihluthulelwe, zathi: “Mhlawumbe inkosi iyazikhulula ekamelweni layo elipholile.”
Zalinda zaze zakhathala. Kwathi ukuba zibone ukuthi ayiyivuli iminyango yekamelo eliphezulu, zathatha isihluthulelo zavula. Bheka, zayithola inkosi yazo iwele phansi ifile.
U-Ehudi waphulukundlela ngesikhathi zisalindile, wedlula ezithombeni ezibaziweyo, wabalekela eSeyiri.
Kwathi ukuba afike lapho, washaya icilongo ekwelezintaba kwa-Efrayimi. Abantu bakwa-Israyeli behla naye kwelezintaba, ebahola.

Wathi kubo: “Ngilandeleni, ngokuba uSimakade uzinikele esandleni senu izitha zenu zakwaMowabi.” Behla bemlandela, bavimba emazibukweni omfula iJordani awelela kwaMowabi, abaze bavumela muntu ukuba awele kuwo.
Ngaleso sikhathi babulala abakwaMowabi abayizi-10 000 abanamandla, amadoda ayizidlakela, akuzange kuphunyuke namunye.
Kusukela ngalolo lusuku abakwaMowabi baba ngaphansi kwesandla sabakwa-Israyeli. Izwe laba nokuthula, iminyaka engama-80.
Emva kwakhe kwalandela uShamgari, indodana ka-Anathi, owabulala amaFilisti angama-600 ngomcijo wokuhlokoloza izinkomo. Naye futhi wamkhulula u-Israyeli.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli baphinde benza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, emva kokufa kuka-Ehudi.
Ngakho-ke uSimakade wabanikela esandleni sikaJabhini, inkosi yaseKhanani, owayebusa eHazori, umkhuzi wempi yakhe kwakunguSisera owayehlala eHaroshethi labezizwe.

Abantu bakwa-Israyeli base bekhala kuSimakade becela usizo, ngokuba uJabhini wayenezinqola zempi ezenziwe ngensimbi ezingama-900. Wayebacindezele, ebaphethe ngonya olukhulu abakwa-Israyeli, iminyaka engama-20.
Ngaleso sikhathi uDebhora umphrofethikazi, umkaLaphidothi, wayengumehluleli kwa-Israyeli.
Wayevame ukuhlala phansi kwesihlahla sesundu sikaDebhora, phakathi kweRama neBhethele kwelezintaba kwa-Efrayimi. Abantu bakwa-Israyeli babenyukela kuye ukuba abehlulele.

Wathumela eKedeshi kwaNafethali ukuba kubizwe uBharaki, indodana ka-Abhinowami, wathi kuye: “USimakade, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, ukuyale wathi: ‘Hamba umise entabeni iThabori, uthathe amabutho ayizi-10 000 ozalweni lukaNafethali nolukaZebuloni uye nawo entabeni iThabhori.
Ngizokumyenga uSisera, umkhuzi wempi kaJabhini nezinqola zakhe zempi namabutho akhe, ukuba babhekane nawe ngasemfuleni iKhishoni, ngizakumnikela esandleni sakho.’ ”
UBharaki wathi kuye: “Uma uhamba nami, ngizokuya, kodwa uma ungahambi nami, ngeke ngihambe.”

UDebhora wathi: “Ngizohamba nawe, kodwa-ke indlela oyithathayo manje ayizukukunika udumo, ngokuba uSimakade uyomnikela uSisera esandleni sowesifazane.” UDebhora wasukuma, wahamba noBharaki, baya eKedeshi.
UBharaki wababizela eKedeshi abakwaZebuloni nabakwaNafethali; amabutho ayizi-10 000 amlandela noDebhora, akhuphuka naye.
UHebhere umKheni kodwa wayezehlukanisile namaKheni, ayeluzalo lukaHobhabhi, umukhwe kaMose, wamisa ithende lakhe ngasesihlahleni esikhulu eZananimi eliseduze neKedeshi.
Kwathi ukuba uSisera bamtshele ukuthi uBharaki, indodana ka-Abhinowami, wenyukele entabeni iThabhori,
uSisera waqoqa zonke izinqola zakhe zempi, izinqola zensimbi ezingama-900 nawo wonke amabutho ayenawo, basuka eHaroshethi labezizwe baya emfudlaneni iKhishoni.

UDebhora wathi kuBharaki: “Sukuma! Lolu lusuku uSimakade amnikele ngalo uSisera esandleni sakho. USimakade akahambanga yini phambi kwakho, na?” Ngakho-ke uBharaki wehla entabeni iThabhori namabutho ayizi-10 000 emlandela.
USimakade wamehlula ngenkemba uSisera nazo zonke izinqola zakhe zempi namabutho akhe phambi kukaBharaki, uSisera wehla enqoleni yakhe, wabaleka ngezinyawo.
UBharaki waxosha amabutho agibele ezinqoleni nahamba ngezinyawo kwaze kwaba seHaroshethi labezizwe. Yonke impi kaSisera yafa ngenkemba, akwasala namunye.
USisera wabaleka ngezinyawo waze wayofika ethendeni likaJayeli, umkaHebhere umKheni, ngokuba kwakunokuthula phakathi kukaJabhini, inkosi yaseHazori, nabendlu kaHebhere umKheni.
UJayeli waphuma wamhlangabeza uSisera, wathi kuye: “Phambukela ngapha, nkosi yami, phambukela ngakimi, ungesabi.” Wayesephambukela kuye ethendeni, wayesemmboza ngengubo.
Wayesethi kuye: “Ngicela ungiphuzise amanzi amancane, ngokuba ngomile.” Wayesevula igabha lobisi, wamnika ukuba aphuze, wayesemmboza.
Wathi kuye: “Yima emnyango wethende, uma kufika noma ngubani ebuza, ethi: ‘Kukhona bani lapha, na?’ ubothi: ‘Akukho muntu.’ ”

Kodwa uJayeli, umkaHebhere, wathatha ngesandla sakhe isikhonkwane sethende nesando, wanyonyoba waya kuye esazunywe ngubuthongo, wasiphisela isikhonkwane enhlafunweni saze saphumela emhlabathini. Wayezunywe ngobukhulu ubuthongo, ekhathele. Wafa kanjalo-ke uSisera.

Wathi efika uBharaki exosha uSisera, uJayeli waphuma wayomhlangabeza, wathi kuye: “Woza ngizokukhombisa indoda oyifunayo.” Wayesengena ethendeni likaJayeli; wamfica uSisera edindilizile, efile, kunesikhonkwane enhlafunweni yakhe.
Ngalolo lusuku uNkulunkulu wamnqoba uJabhini, inkosi yamaKhanani, phambi kwabakwa-Israyeli.
Isandla sabantu bakwa-Israyeli saya ngokuqina phezu kukaJabhini, inkosi yaseKhanani, baze bambhubhisa nya uJabhini, inkosi yamaKhanani.
UDebhora noBharaki, indodana ka-Abhinowami, bacula ngalolo lusuku, bathi:
“Uma abaholi bakwa-Israyeli behamba phambili, nabantu bazinikela ngokukhululeka, makadunyiswe uSimakade!
“Lalelani makhosi, bekani indlebe zikhulu, ngizakumhubela uSimakade ngizakuhlabelela kuSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.
“Simakade lapho uphuma eSeyiri, uphuma esifundeni kwa-Edomi umhlaba wazamazama namazulu ayithulula, amafu athulula amanzi.
Izintaba zathuthumela phambi kukaSimakade waseSinayi, phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.
“Ezinsukwini zikaShamgari, indodana ka-Anathi, ezinsukwini zikaJayeli, abantu bayibalekela imigwaqo emikhulu, abahamba ngalezo ndlela bahamba ngezindlela ezimazombezombe.
Imizi yakwa-Israyeli yama ingenamuntu, Debhora, kwaze kwafika wena, wafika njengonina ku-Israyeli.
Bakhetha onkulunkulu abasha, kwase kuba khona impi emasangweni. Phakathi kwezinkulungwane ezingamashumi amane kwa-Israyeli, ukhona yini owake waphatha isihlangu nomkhonto, na?
Inhliziyo yami ikubaholi bakwa-Israyeli abazinikele phakathi kwabantu. Dumisani uSimakade!
“Khulumani ngakho, nina enigibela izimbongolo ezimhlophe, nina enihlala emacansini ezinjinga, nani enedlula ngendlela.
Lalelani umsindo wabaculi besemithonjeni yamanzi, lapho bephinda ukunqoba kuka-Simakade, ukunqoba kwezihlupheki kwa-Israyeli. Abantu bakaSimakade behlela emasangweni.
“ ‘Vuka, vuka, we Debhora! Vuka, vuka uhube ihubo. Vuka, we Bharaki, hola abathunjwa bakho, ndodana ka-Abhinowami.’
“Kwase kwehla insali yesikhulu, abantu bakaSimakade bahamba behla ukubhekana nonamandla.
Kusukela kwa-Efrayimi baphumela esigodini, kulandela wena Bhenjamini nabafowenu, kusukela eMakhiri, bahamba abakhuzi bempi behla kusukela kwaZebuloni, kwehla abaphethe induku yomkhuzi wempi.
Izikhulu zakwa-Isakhare zeza noDebhora, no-Isakhare wethembeka kuBharaki; baphuthuma esigodini besezithendeni zakhe. Phakathi kwabomndeni kaRubeni kwaba nokuzihlola okukhulu ezinhliziyweni.
Wahlalelani esihulugwini ukuze uzwe ukukhala kwemihlambi na? Phakathi kwabomndeni wakwaRubeni kwakukhona okukhulu ukuzihlola ezinhliziyweni.
UGileyadi wahlala phesheya kweJordani; noDani walibalelani ngasemikhunjini, na? U-Ashera wahlala akanyakaza ogwini lolwandle, wahlala ngasethekwini lalo.
UZebuloni yisizwe samadelakufa, noNafethali ngokunjalo, ezindaweni eziphakemeyo zezwe.
“Amakhosi afika, alwa; alwa namakhosi aseKhanani, eThahanakhi, ngasemanzini eMegido; awatholanga mpango yesiliva.
Izinkanyezi zalwa ezulwini, emizileni yazo zalwa noSisera.
Umfudlana iKhishoni wabakhukhula, umfudlana odla izindwani, umfudlana iKhishoni. Nyathela, mphefumulo wami, nyathela ngamandla.
Kwezwakala umsindo wezinselo zamahhashi zigabadula, zigabadula izinjomane ezinamandla.
‘Qalekisani iMerozi,’ kusho ingelosi kaSimakade; ‘ziqalekiseni kabi izakhamuzi zalo, ngoba azizanga ukuzosiza uSimakade, ukuzosiza uSimakade elwa nesiqhwaga.’
“Ungobusisiwe kwabesifazane, Jayeli mkaHebhere umKheni, ungobusisiwe kwabesifazane abahlala emathendeni.
Wacela amanzi, wamnika ubisi, wamlethela izangqondo ngomcengezi ofanele amakhosi.
Wabeka isandla sakhe esikhonkwaneni sethende nesokudla sakhe esandweni sezisebenzi; wamgqema ingozi uSisera wamfihliza ikhanda, wamgqobhoza, wambhoboza esikhaleni sendlebe.
Wawa, wadindiliza, wawa ngasezinyaweni zakhe, wawela lapho, wafa.
“Walunguza efasiteleni unina kaSisera, wakhala ngemuva kwekhethini, ethi: ‘Ilibaleleni inqola yakhe ukubuya, na? Uphi umsindo wezinqola zakhe, na?’
Abesifazane bakhe abahlakaniphileyo bayaphendula, wawuphendula yena uqobo umbuzo:

‘Bayitholile, futhi ababelani impango, na? Intombi, yebo, izintombi ezimbili endodeni; impango yezinto ezidayiwe kuSisera, impango yezinto ezidayiwe zahlotshiswa, iziqephu ezimbili zomsebenzi oyimpango odayiwe wahlotshiswa, ongowentamo yami.’
“Simakade, sengathi zingabhubha zonke izitha zakho! Kodwa abakuthandayo mabafane nelanga liphuma ngamandla alo.” Izwe lalinokuthula iminyaka engama-40.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli benza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, uSimakade wabanikela esandleni sabakwaMidiyani iminyaka eyisikhombisa.
Isandla sabakwaMidiyani sabehlula abantu bakwa-Israyeli, ngenxa yabakwaMidiyani, abakwa-Israyeli bazakhela izindawo zokucasha ezintabeni, emigedeni, nasezinqabeni.
Ngokuba njalo lapho abakwa-Israyeli sebelimile, abakwaMidiyani nama-Amaleki nezinye izizwe zasempumalanga babekhuphuka, babahlasele.
Babekanisa eduzane nakwa-Israyeli baqothule isivuno sezwe kuze kuyofika komakhelwane eGaza, bangabashiyeli kudla kwa-Israyeli, wena zimvu, zinkabi, nazimbongolo.
Ngokuba babekhuphuka nemfuyo yabo namathende abo, kube sengathi zinkumbi zesikhonyane; amadoda akhona, namakameli kwakukuningi kakhulu kungabaleki; babetheleka ezweni ukuba balibhubhise.
Ngakho-ke abakwa-Israyeli babengenalutho ngenxa yabakwaMidiyani, base bekhala abantu bakwa-Israyeli kuSimakade, bacela usizo.
Lapho abakwa-Israyeli bekhala kuSimakade ngenxa yabakwaMidiyani,
uSimakade wathumela umphrofethi kwabakwa-Israyeli, wathi kubo: “Usho kanje uSimakade, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli: ‘Nganikhuphula eGibhithe, nganikhipha endlini yobugqila;
nganikhulula esandleni sabaseGibhithe, nasesandleni sabo bonke ababenicindezela, ngabaxosha phambi kwenu, nganinika izwe labo;
ngathi kini: “NginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, aniyukukhonza onkulunkulu bama-Amori enihlala ezweni lawo,” kodwa anilalelanga izwi lami.’ ”
Ingelosi kaSimakade yafika e-Ofira yahlala phansi komu-okhi, owawungokaJowashi umAbhiyezeri, ngesikhathi indodana yakhe, uGideyoni, ibhula ukolo esikhamweni sewayini, ukuze iwufihlele abakwaMidiyani.
Ingelosi kaSimakade yabonakala kuye, yathi: “USimakade unawe, qhawe elinamandla.”

UGideyoni wathi kuyo: “Kodwa mnumzane, uma uSimakade enathi, kungani kwenzeke konke lokhu kithi, na? Ziphi zonke izenzo zakhe ezimangalisayo, okhokho bethu abasixoxela ngazo, bethi: ‘Akazange yini uSimakade asikhuphule eGibhithe, na?’ Kepha manje uSimakade usilahlile, wasinikela esandleni sabakwaMidiyani.”
USimakade waphendukela kuye, wathi: “Hamba ngalawa mandla akho, ukhulule u-Israyeli esandleni sabakwaMidiyani; angikuthumanga yini, na?”
Waphendula wathi: “Kodwa Nkosi, ngingamkhulula kanjani u-Israyeli, na? Umndeni wakithi ungomncinyane kwaManase, nami ngingomncane endlini kababa.”
USimakade wathi kuye: “Ngizokuba nawe, uyakubabulala abakwaMidiyani kungathi ubulala umuntu oyedwa.”
Wayesethi kuye: “Uma ngifumene umusa emehlweni akho, ngikhombise isibonakaliso sokuthi nguwena okhuluma nami.
Ungasuki lapha ngize ngibuye kuwe, ngikulethele isipho sami, ngisibeke phambi kwakho.” Wayesethi: “Ngizohlala uze ubuye.”

UGideyoni wangena endlini yakhe, wahlaba izinyane lembuzi, wenza namaqebelengwane angenamvubelo nge-efa lempuphu; inyama wayifaka equthwini, umhluzi wawuthela ekhanzini, wakuletha kuye phansi kwesihlahla somu-okhi.
Ingelosi kaNkulunkulu yathi kuye: “Thatha inyama namaqebelengwane angenamvubelo ukubeke kuleli dwala, uthulule umhluzi.” Wenza kanjalo.

Ingelosi kaSimakade yayisithinta inyama namaqebelengwane angenamvubelo ngesihloko senduku eyayisesandleni sayo; kwaphuma umlilo edwaleni, wadla inyama namaqebelengwane angenamvubelo; ingelosi kaSimakade yayisinyamalala emehlweni akhe.
Kwamkhanyela uGideyoni ukuthi bekuyingelosi kaSimakade; wayesethi uGideyoni: “Maye, Nkosi Simakade! Ngokuba ngibonile ingelosi kaSimakade ubuso nobuso.”
Kepha uSimakade wathi kuye: “Ukuthula makube kuwe; ungesabi, awuzukufa.”
UGideyoni wamakhela uSimakade i-althare lapho, waliqamba wathi: uSimakade Ungukuthula. Kuze kube namuhla lisekhona lapho e-Ofira lama-Abhiyezeri.
Ngalobo busuku uSimakade wathi kuye: “Thatha inkunzi kayihlo, eyesibili eneminyaka eyisikhombisa, ubhidlize i-althare likaBhali elingelikayihlo, ugawule nensika engcwele eseduze kwalo,

bese wakha i-althare likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho phezu kwaleyo nqaba elapho ngokuhlelekileyo, uthathe inkunzi yesibili, uyinikele njengomnikelo wokushiswa phezu kwezinkuni zensika engcwele ozakuyigawula.”
UGideyoni wathatha izinceku zakhe ezilishumi, wenza njengalokhu uSimakade emtshelile, kodwa ngenxa yokuba wayesaba abomndeni wakubo nabantu bomuzi, kakwenzanga lokhu emini, kodwa ebusuku.
Lapho bevuka ngakusasa ekuseni abantu bomuzi, i-althare likaBhali libhidliziwe, nensika engcwele eseduze kwalo igawuliwe, nenkunzi yesibili inikelwe phezu kwe-althare elalakhiwe.
Babuzana bodwa, bathi: “Ngubani owenze lokhu, na?” Emveni kokufuna bebuzisisa, batshelwa ukuthi: “NguGideyoni, indodana kaJowashi, owenze lokhu.”
Abantu balowo muzi bathi kuJowashi: “Ikhiphele phandle indodana yakho, ukuze ife, ngokuba ibhidlize i-althare likaBhali, yagawula nensika engcwele ebiseduze kwalo.”

Kodwa uJowashi wathi kubo bonke ababemi bebhekene naye: “Niyakulwela uBhali, na? Nizama ukumsindisa, na? Oyakumlwela uBhali makabulawe ekuseni. Uma engunkulunkulu makazilwele yena, ngoba yi-althare lakhe elibhidliziwe.”
Kusukela ngalolo lusuku uGideyoni wabizwa ngokuthi nguJerubhali, okungukuthi: “UBhali makalwe naye,” ngoba nguye owabhidliza i-althare lakhe.
Kwase kubuthana bonke abakwaMidiyani, abase-Amaleki, nabantu basempumalanga, bawela iJordani, bakanisa esigodini iJizreyeli.
UMoya kaSimakade wehlela kuGideyoni, washaya icilongo, ama-Abhiyezeri abuthana, amlandela.
Wathuma izigijimi kulo lonke elakwaManase, nabo babuthana, bamlandela. Wabuye wathuma ezinye izigijimi kwa-Asheri, kwaZebuloni nakwaNafethali, bakhuphuka ukuyohlangana nabo.
UGideyoni wayesethi kuNkulunkulu: “Ukuze ngibone ukuthi uyakumkhulula yini u-Israyeli ngesandla sami njengoba ushilo;
ngizobeka uboya esibuyeni, uma kulale amazolo phezu kwabo kuphela, kodwa komile emhlabathini, ngizokwazi ukuthi uzomkhulula u-Israyeli ngesandla sami, njengoba ushilo.”
Nebala kwaba njalo. Ngesikhathi evuka ekuseni ngakusasa, wabukhama uboya, kwaphuma oboyeni amazolo ayengagcwala umcengezi wamanzi.

UGideyoni wayesethi kuNkulunkulu: “Ungaluvumeli ulaka lwakho lungivuthele, ake ngikhulume futhi; ngiyakucela, ake ngilinge futhi ngoboya kube kanye; makube nguboya kuphela obomileyo, emhlabathini wonke kube khona amazolo.”
UNkulunkulu wenza kanjalo ngalobo busuku. Uboya babomile, kukhona amazolo emhlabathini wonke.
UJerubhali okunguGideyoni, nawo wonke amabutho ayehamba naye, bavuka ekuseni bayokanisa ngasemthonjeni kaHarodi. Inkambu yabakwaMidiyani yayingasenyakatho kwabo, phansi kwegquma iMore, esigodini.
USimakade wathi kuGideyoni: “Amabutho anawe maningi kakhulu ukuba nginikele abakwaMidiyani esandleni sawo, funa u-Israyeli athathe udumo kungabi ngolwami, ethi: ‘Isandla sami singisindisile.’
Manje memezela lokhu emabuthweni, uthi: ‘Owesabayo, ethuthumela, makabuyele emuva, makasuke entabeni kwaGileyadi.’ ” Kwabuyela emuva abayizi-20 000, kwasala abayizi-10 000.

USimakade wathi kuGideyoni: “Abantu basebaningi kakhulu, yehla nabo uye emanzini, ngizokuvivinyela bona lapho. Uma ngithi: ‘Lona uzohamba nawe,’ uzohamba nawe; uma ngithi: ‘Lona akazukuhamba nawe,’ akayukuhamba.”

Wehlela ngasemanzini namabutho; uSimakade wathi kuGideyoni: “Bonke labo abaxhapha amanzi ngolimi njengokuxhapha kwenja, bamise nganhlanye; nabo bonke labo abaguqa ngamadolo ukuba baphuze bebeka izandla emilonyeni yabo, nabo bamise nganhlanye.”
Inani lalabo abawaxhaphayo, bebeke izandla emilonyeni yabo, kwakungamadoda angama-300, kepha bonke abanye baguqa phansi ngamadolo ukuba baphuze amanzi.
USimakade wayesethi kuGideyoni: “Ngalawo madoda angama-300 axhaphe amanzi, ngizokunikhulula, nginikele abakwaMidiyani esandleni sakho. Bonke abanye mababuyele emakhaya abo.”
Abantu baphatha umphako namacilongo abo ngezandla, bonke abanye bakwa-Israyeli wababuyisela emathendeni abo, wasala nalawo madoda angama-300. Inkambu yakwaMidiyani yayingezansi kwakhe, esigodini.
Ngalobo busuku uSimakade wathi kuye: “Vuka wehlele enkanjini, ngokuba ngiyinikele esandleni sakho.
Kepha uma wesaba ukuyihlasela, yehlela enkanjini nenceku yakho uPhura,
uyokuzwa abakushoyo, emveni kwalokho uyakuqina idolo, wehlele enkanjini.” Wahamba noPhura, inceku yakhe, waya emaphethelweni alabo abahlomile ababesenkanjini.
AbakwaMidiyani nabase-Amaleki, nabo bonke abasempumalanga babelele esigodini bebaningi njengesikhonyane; namakameli abo engenakubalwa njengesihlabathi solwandle.

Ngesikhathi efika uGideyoni, enye yamadoda yayixoxela umngani wayo iphupho layo, ithi: “Ngibe nephupho; ngiphuphe iqebelengwane lesinkwa esiyindilinga sebhali ligingqikela enkanjini yakwaMidiyani. Lifike lashaya ithende lawa, lagumbuqela, lapatalala.”
Umngani wayo waphendula wathi: “Lokhu akusho lutho ngaphandle kokuthi inkemba kaGideyoni, indodana kaJowashi, indoda yakwa-Israyeli, uNkulunkulu unikele esandleni sayo uMidiyani nempi yakhe yonke.”
Lapho uGideyoni elizwa iphupho nencazelo yalo, wakhuleka, wayesebuyela enkanjini yakwa-Israyeli, wafike wathi: “Vukani, ngokuba uSimakade uyinikele esandleni senu impi yakwaMidiyani.”
Emveni kokuba amadoda angama-300 esewehlukanise amaviyo amathathu, wawanikeza amacilongo ezandleni zawo, nezitsha ezingenalutho nezihlonti phakathi ezitsheni.
Wathi kuwo: “Bhekani mina, nenze njengami uma ngifika emaphethelweni enkambu, nenze njengoba ngenza.
Lapho ngishaya icilongo nabo bonke abakanye nami, nani niyoshaya amacilongo nizungeze yonke inkambu, nimemeze, nithi: ‘EkaSimakade nekaGideyoni!’ ”

UGideyoni nabayikhulu ababehamba naye bafika emaphethelweni enkambu yakwaMidiyani ngokuqala komlindo ophakathi, lapho abaqaphi bephuma kungena abanye; babetha amacilongo baphihliza izitsha ezazisezandleni zabo.
Omathathu amaqembu abetha amacilongo, abulala izitsha ayeziphethe, ephethe izihlonti ngezandla zawo zokudla, ashaya amacilongo amemeza, athi: “Inkemba kaSimakade nekaGideyoni!”
Wonke amadoda ama, yileyo naleyo endaweni yayo ezungeze inkambu, wonke amadoda ayesenkanjini akhala, abaleka, acela empunzini.

Ngesikhathi eshaya amacilongo angama-300, uSimakade wenza ukuba izitha zibulalane zodwa, yonke impi yesitha; impi yabaleka yaze yayofika eBhethi Shitha ngaseZerera, nasemngceleni wase-Abhela Mehola ngaseThabhathi.
Kwabizwa wonke amadoda akwa-Israyeli, kwaNafethali nakwa-Asheri nakulo lonke elakwaManase, abaxosha abakwaMidiyani.

UGideyoni wathumela izigijimi kulo lonke elisezintabeni kwa-Efrayimi, wathi: “Yehlani nilwe nabakwaMidiyani, nithathe imithombo kuze kuyofika eBhethi Bhara naseJordani.” Wonke amadoda akwa-Efrayimi abizwa, athatha imithombo yamanzi kwaze kwayofika eBhethi Bhara naseJordani.

Abamba abakhuzi bempi bakwaMidiyani ababili, u-Orebhi noZebhi, u-Orebhi bambulalela edwaleni lika-Orebhi, uZebhi bambulalela esikhamweni sewayini sikaZebhi, ngesikhathi bexosha abakwaMidiyani. Baletha amakhanda o-Orebhi noZehebhi kuGideyoni, phesheya kweJordani.
Abakwa-Efrayimi base bethi kuGideyoni: “Ukwenzeleni lokhu kithi, ukuba ungasibizi uma uyolwa nabakwaMidiyani, na?” Bamthethisa kakhulu.
Wathi kubo: “Ngenzeni mina manje okungaqhathaniswa nokwenziwe yini, na? Ngabe ukuvunwa kwamagilebhisi kwakwa-Efrayimi akungcono yini kunewayini elisha lakwa-Abhiyezeri, na?
UNkulunkulu unikele esandleni senu abakhuzi bempi yakwaMidiyani, u-Orebhi noZebhi; yini engiyenzile engaqhathaniswa nenikwenzile, na?” Lapho esho lokhu, ulaka lwabo lwabohla.
UGideyoni wafika eJordani waliwela namadoda angama-300 ayehamba nawo, bekhathele futhi befile yindlala.
Wayesethi kubantu baseSukhothi: “Ngiyanicela, ake ninike laba abangilandelayo izinkwa, ngokuba bakhathele, futhi ngisalandela uZebha noZalimuna, amakhosi akwaMidiyani.”
Kodwa izikhulu zaseSukhothi zathi: “Ngabe senibabambile yini oZebha noZalima ukuthi sesiyinganika impi yakho izinkwa, na?”
UGideyoni waziphendula wathi: “Kulungile-ke, uma uSimakade esebanikele esandleni sami oZebha noZalimuna, ngiyakuhlebhula inyama yenu emeveni nasemakhakhasini asehlane.”
Wenyuka lapho waya ePhenuweli, nakubo wabacela okufanayo, abantu basePhenuweli bamphendula njengabantu baseSukhothi.
Wayesethi kubantu basePhenuweli: “Uma sengibuya nginqobile ngiyakuwubhidliza lo mbhoshongo.”
Ngaleso sikhathi uZebha noZalimuna babeseKharikhori nebutho labo, elalingamadoda ayizi-15 000, ayesale empini yabantu basempumalanga, ngoba kwakufe ngenkemba amadoda ayizi-120 000 ayehlome ngenkemba.
UGideyoni wakhuphuka ngomzila walabo ababehlala emathendeni ngasempumalanga kwaseNobha, naseJogibheha, wayihlasela impi ngoba yayingazelele.
UZebha noZalimuna babaleka, kodwa wabahubha, wawabamba lawo makhosi amabili akwaMidiyani, amabutho wonke angenwa yingebhe.
Lapho uGideyoni, indodana kaJowashi, ebuya empini ngendlela enyukelayo eHereshi,
wabamba insizwa yaseSukhothi wayibuza; yamtshela ukuthi zingobani izikhulu namalunga baseSukhothi, nokuthi bangabantu abangama-77.
Wafika kubantu baseSukhothi, wathi kubo: “Nampa oZebha, noZalimuna enangichukuluza ngabo, nithi: ‘Usubathumbile yini oZebha noZalimuna, ukuba singanika amabutho akho akhathele izinkwa, na?’ ”
Wabamba amalunga omuzi, wathatha ameva asehlane, nogagane, wanenebula abantu baseSukhothi.
Wabhidliza umbhoshongo ePhenuweli, wabulala amadoda omuzi.
Wathi kuZebha noZalimuna: “Nithini ngamadoda enawabulala eThabhori, na?” Baphendula bathi: “Lawo madoda ayefana nawe, wonke ayefana namadodana enkosi.”
UGideyoni wathi: “Ayengabafowethu, sizalwa mfazi munye nawo. Ngiyafunga ngithi ukuba nawasindisa, nami bengingeke nginibulale.”
Wayesethi kuJetheri izibulo lakhe: “Hamba ubabulale.” Kepha indodana ayizange iyihoshe inkemba yayo, ngoba yayesaba, kwazise yayisengumfana.
UZebha noZalimuna bathi: “Woza usibulale, ngokuba njengoba injalo indoda, anjalo namandla ayo.” Ngakho-ke uGideyoni wasondela wababulala, wathatha imihlobiso eyayisezintanyeni zamakameli abo.
Abakwa-Israyeli bathi kuGideyoni: “Sibuse, wena nendodana yakho nomzukulu wakho, ngokuba usikhululile esandleni sabakwaMidiyani.”
UGideyoni wathi kubo: “Angizukunibusa, nendodana yami ayizukunibusa; nguSimakade ozonibusa.”
Wayesethi uGideyoni kubo: “Ngiyacela kini, makube yilowo nalowo anginike icici kulawo eniwaphangile.” Isitha besinamacici egolide ngokuba bekungesakwa-Ishmayeli.
Bathi: “Sizokunika wona ngokukhululeka.” Ngakho-ke bendlala ingubo, kwayilowo nalowo waphonsa icici ayelithathe njengempango.

Isisindo samacici egolide ayewacelile saba yi-1 700 amashekeli egolide, ngaphandle kwemihlobiso enhlobonhlobo nezingubo ezibukhwebezane ezazembathwa ngamakhosi akwaMidiyani, nemigexo eyayisezintanyeni zamakameli abo.
UGideyoni wenza ingubo yamahlombe, wayibeka emzini wakhe e-Ofira, bonke abakwa-Israyeli baphinga nayo lapho, yaba wugibe kuGideyoni nabomndeni wakhe.
AbakwaMidiyani bathotshiswa phansi kwabakwa-Israyeli, abaphindanga babavukela. Izwe laba nokuthula iminyaka engama-40 ngezinsuku zikaGideyoni.
UJerubhali, indodana kaJowashi, wahamba wayohlala endlini yakhe.
UGideyoni wayenamadodana angama-70 ayephume okhalo lwakhe, ngokuba wayenabafazi abaningi.
Isancinza sakhe esasiseShekhemi samzalela naso indodana, wayiqamba ngokuthi ngu-Abhimelekhi.
UGideyoni, indodana kaJowashi, wafa esekhulile, wangcwatshwa ethuneni likayise uJowashi e-Ofira kwa-Abhiyezeri.
Kwathi ukuba uGideyoni afe, abakwa-Israyeli babuye baphinga noBhali, benza uBhali Bherithi waba ngunkulunkulu wabo.
Abakwa-Israyeli abamkhumbulanga uSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo, owayebakhulule esandleni sazo zonke izitha zabo ezazibazungeze nxazonke.
Abakhombisanga ukwethembeka endlini kaJerubhali, okunguGideyoni, ngakho konke okuhle ayekwenzele u-Israyeli.
U-Abhimelekhi, indodana kaJerubhali, waya eShekhemi ezihlotsheni zikanina nakubo bonke abomndeni wasekhayakonina, wathi:

“Shonini kuzwa zonke izikhulu zaseShekhemi, ukuthi: ‘Yikuphi okungcono kini, ukuba nibuswe yiwo wonke amadodana kaJerubhali angama-70 noma nibuswe ngumuntu oyedwa, na?’ Khumbulani futhi ukuthi mina ngiyithambo lenu nenyama yenu.”
Omalume bakhe base bekhuluma wonke lawo mazwi egameni lakhe, kuzwa zonke izikhulu zaseShekhemi; izinhliziyo zazo zathanda ukulandela u-Abhimelekhi, ngokuba zathi: “Ungumfowethu.”
Zamnika izinhlamvu zesiliva ezingama-70 ezazizithathe ethempelini likaBhali Bherethi; u-Abhimelekhi aqasha ngazo iziduphunga nezixhwanguxhwangu zamadoda, ukuba zimlandele.
Waya endlini kayise e-Ofira, wabulala abafowabo, amadodana kaJerubhali angama-70 etsheni elilodwa, kwasala uJothamu, uthunjana kaJerubhali, ngokuba wacasha.
Zonke izakhamuzi zaseShekhemi nalo lonke iBhethi Milo zahlangana ngasensikeni yomu-okhi eShekhemi, zahamba zambeka u-Abhimelekhi, waba yinkosi.
Lapho uJothamu etshelwa ngalokho, wahamba wayoma esicongweni sentaba iGerizimu, wakhala, wamemeza kakhulu, wathi kuzo: “Ngilaleleni, nina zakhamuzi zaseShekhemi, ukuze uNkulunkulu anilalele nani.
“Imithi yake yahamba yayozibekela inkosi ezoyibusa. Ngakho-ke yathi esihlahleni somnqumo: ‘Busa! Busa! Phezu kwethu.’
“Isihlahla somnqumo sathi: ‘Ngiyeke ukukhiqiza amafutha ami acebile okuhlonishwa ngawo onkulunkulu nabantu, ngihambe ngiyobusa phezu kwemithi, na?’
“Imithi yathi emkhiwaneni: ‘Woza wena, ubuse phezu kwethu.’
“Umkhiwane waphendula, wathi: ‘Ngiyeke yini ukukhiqiza izithelo zami ezimnandi nezinambitheka kamtoti, ngihambe ngiyobusa phezu kwemithi, na?’
“Imithi yase ithi emvinini: ‘Woza wena, ubuse phezu kwethu.’
“Umvini waphendula wathi: ‘Ngiyeke yini ukukhiqiza iwayini elithokozisa onkulunkulu nabantu, ngihambe ngiyobusa phezu kwemithi, na?’
“Ngakho-ke yonke imithi yathi ejikijolweni: ‘Woza wena, ubuse phezu kwethu.’
“Isihlahla sejikijolo saphendula sathi: ‘Uma ningibeka ngibe yinkosi yenu, wozani nizokhosela phansi komthunzi wami, uma kungenjalo, makuvele umlilo ejikijolweni, uqothule imisedari eLebhanoni.’

“Ngakho-ke uma nikwenze lokhu ngezinhliziyo ezinhle, nangokuhlonipha, lapho nibeka u-Abhimeleki abe yinkosi, futhi namphatha kahle uJerubhali nabendlu yakhe, nenza kuye njengoba kufanele ngenxa yezenzo zakhe,
ngokuba ubaba wanilwela, wabeka impilo yakhe ebucayini, wanikhulula esandleni sabakwaMidiyani,

kodwa namhlanje niyivukele indlu kababa, nabulala amadodana akhe, angama-70 etsheni elilodwa, nabeka u-Abhimelekhi, indodana yowesifazane oyisigqila, ukuba abe yinkosi phezu kwezakhamuzi eShekhemi, ngoba nje eyisihlobo senu,
uma ngithi nenze okuhle ngokuhlonipha uJerubhali nabendlu yakhe namhlanje, ngakho-ke jabulani ngo-Abhimelekhi, naye ajabule ngani,
kodwa uma kungenjalo, makuphume umlilo ku-Abhimelekhi, uqothule zonke izakhamuzi zaseShekhemi naseBhethi Milo, kuphume umlilo ezakhamuzini zaseShekhemi naseBhethi Milo ubhubhise u-Abhimelekhi.”
UJothamu wayesebaleka, waya eBheyeri, wahlala khona ngoba esaba umfowabo u-Abhimelekhi.
U-Abhimelekhi wabusa u-Israyeli iminyaka emithathu.
UNkulunkulu wathumela umoya omubi phakathi kuka-Abhimelekhi nezakhamuzi zaseShekhemi, zamphatha ngonya u-Abhimelekhi.

Lokho kwenzeka ukuze kuphindiseleke unya alwenza emadodaneni kaJerubhali angama-70, nokuba igazi lawo libe phezu komfowabo u-Abhimelekhi, owawabulalayo, naphezu kwezakhamuzi zaseShekhemi ezenza abe namandla okubulala abafowabo.
Ngenxa yobutha kuye, izikhulu zaseShekhemi zabeka ezicongweni zezintaba abantu ukuba bamlalele unyendle. Bagebenga bonke ababedlula ngaleyo ndlela; kwabikwa lokho ku-Abhimelekhi.
Kwathi lapho uGali, indodana ka-Ebhedi, ethuthela eShekhemi nezihlobo zakhe, izakhamuzi zaseShekhemi zethembela kuye.
Zaya emasimini, zabutha amagilebhisi ezivinini zazo, zawagxoba, zagubha umkhosi. Zaya ethempelini likankulunkulu wazo, zadla, zaphuza, zahlekisa ngo-Abhimelekhi.

UGali, indodana ka-Ebhedi, wabuza wathi: “Ungubani u-Abhimelekhi, futhi singobani thina baseShekhemi ukuba singakhonza yena, na? Ayikaze yini indodana kaJerubhali noZebhuli, induna yakhe, bakhonze emadodaneni kaHarmori uyise kaShekhemi, na? Pho thina simkhonzelani, na?
Uma nje laba bantu bebephethwe yimi, bengizomsusa u-Abhimelekhi, ngithi kuye: ‘Yandisa impi yakho, uphume silwe.’ ”
Lapho uZebhuli, umbusi womuzi, ezwa amazwi kaGali, indodana ka-Ebhedi, wathukuthela wabila.
Wathumela izigijimi ku-Abhimelekhi e-Aruma, wathi kuye: “Uyabona-ke, uGali indodana ka-Ebhedi nezihlobo zakhe bafike eShekhemi, bakuphehlela udweshu emzini.
Ngakho-ke hambani ebusuku, wena namabutho anawe niyocutha endle.
Kuyothi ekuseni, lapho kuphuma ilanga, nivuke niphuthume emzini lapho yena namabutho ahambisana nawo bephuma beyokulwa nawe, ubenzakalise ngendlela obona ngayo.”
U-Abhimelekhi nawo wonke amabutho ayenawo bavuka ebusuku, bayolindela ukuhlasela iShekhemi, bazihlela amaviyo amane.
Lapho uGali, indodana ka-Ebhedi, ephuma, wama esikhaleni sesango lomuzi, u-Abhimelekhi namabutho akhe basuka lapho babecashe khona, bamthelekela.
Ngesikhathi uGali ebabona, wathi kuZebhuli: “Bheka, kunabantu abehla ezicongweni zezintaba.” UZebhuli wathi kuye: “Amathunzi ezintaba abukeka njengabantu kuwe.”
UGali wakhuluma futhi, wathi: “Uyabona, kunabantu abehla enkabeni yezwe, elinye iviyo liqhamuka ngendlela yomu-okhi okuhlolelwa kuwo.”
UZebhuli wathi kuye: “Kuphi ukuziqhayisa kwakho manje, wena obuthi: ‘Ungubani u-Abhimelekhi ukuba simkhonze, na?’ Akuwona yini lawa amabutho obuwathatha kalula, na? Phuma manje, ulwe nawo.”
Ngakho-ke uGali waphuma wahola izakhamuzi zaseShekhemi, balwa no-Abhimelekhi.
U-Abhimelekhi wamxosha, wabaleka phambi kwakhe. Abaningi bawa belimele kwaze kwaba sekungeneni esangweni lomuzi.
U-Abhimelekhi wahlala e-Aruma, uZebhuli wamxosha uGali nezihlobo zakhe, ukuze bangaphinde bahlale eShekhemi.
Ngakusasa abantu baya endle. Lapho bembikela u-Abhimelekhi,
wathatha amabutho akhe wawehlukanisa amaviyo amathathu, walala unyendle endle. Kwathi lapho ebona abantu bephuma emzini, wavuka walwa nabo, wababulala.
U-Abhimelekhi neviyo elalinaye baphuthuma, bama esikhaleni sesango lomuzi, ngesikhathi amaviyo amabili ephuthume ukubulala bonke ababesendle.
U-Abhimelekhi walwa nomuzi lonke lolo lusuku; wawudla umuzi, wabulala abantu ababekuwo, wawushisa umuzi, wawufaza ngosawoti.
Kwathi ukuba zizwe ngalokho izakhamuzi zombhoshongo eShekhemi, zangena enqabeni yethempeli lika-Eli Bherethi.
U-Abhimelekhi watshelwa ukuthi zonke izakhamuzi zombhoshongo eShekhemi zibuthene ndawonye,

ngakho-ke wenyukela entabeni iZalimoni, yena nawo wonke amabutho ayehamba nawo. U-Abhimelekhi wathatha imbazo ngesandla sakhe, wagawula igatsha, waliphakamisa walibeka ehlombe lakhe. Wayesethi emabuthweni ayenaye: “Lokho eningibone ngikwenza, kwenzeni ngokushesha, njengami.”

Kwaba yilelo nalelo butho lagawula igatsha, balandela u-Abhimelekhi, bawabeka enqabeni, base beyithungela ngomlilo ngaphezu kwabo; bafa bonke abantu basembhoshongweni eShekhemi, amadoda abalelwa enkulungwaneni nabesifazane.
U-Abhimelekhi waya eThebhezi, wakanisa malungana neThebhezi, walidla.
Kodwa kwakukhona umbhoshongo oqinile phakathi emzini, bonke abesilisa nabesifazane nazo zonke izakhamuzi zomuzi babalekela kuwo, bazivalela phakathi, base bekhuphukela ophahleni lombhoshongo.
U-Abhimelekhi wafika embhoshongweni, walwa nawo, wasondela emnyango wombhoshongo ukuze awushise.
Kepha owesifazane othile wawisela itshe ekhanda lika-Abhimelekhi, lamphohloza ikhanda.
Masinyane wabiza insizwa eyayiwudibi lwakhe, wathi kuyo: “Hosha inkemba yakho, ungibulale ukuze abantu bangathi ngami: ‘Wabulawa ngowesifazane.’ ” Insizwa yamgwaza wafa.
Kwathi ukuba abakwa-Israyeli babone ukuthi ufile u-Abhimelekhi, babuyela emakhaya.
UNkulunkulu waphindisela kanjalo ku-Abhimelekhi ngobubi ayebenze kuyise, ngokubulala abafowabo abangama-70.
UNkulunkulu wabuye wenza nobubi babantu baseShekhemi ukuba behlele phezu kwabo, baphinde behlelwa nayisiqalekiso uJothamu, indodana kaJerubhali, ayesikhulume kubo.
Emva kuka-Abhimelekhi kwavela uThola, indodana kaPhuwa kaDodo, umuntu wakwa-Isakhare ukuba akhulule u-Israyeli, owayehlala eShamiri kwelezintaba kwa-Efrayimi.
Wehlulela u-Israyeli iminyaka engama-23. Wayesefa, wangcwatshwa eShamiri.
Emva kwakhe kwalandela uJayiri, umGileyadi, wehlulela u-Israyeli iminyaka engama-22.
Wayenamadodana angama-30 ayegibela izimbongolo ezingama-30, enemizi engama-30 kwaGileyadi elibizwa ngokuthi yiHavothi Jayiri kuze kube namuhla.
UJayiri wafa, wangcwatshwa eKhamoni.

Abakwa-Israyeli babuye benza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, bakhonza oBhali no-Ashitharothi, onkulunkulu bama-Aramu, nonkulunkulu bamaSidoni, nonkulunkulu bakwaMowabi, nonkulunkulu bama-Amoni, nonkulunkulu bamaFilisti. Bamshiya kanjalo uSimakade, ababe besamkhonza.
Ngakho-ke ulaka lukaSimakade lwamvuthela u-Israyeli, wabanikela esandleni samaFilisti, nasesandleni sabakwa-Amoni,
babahlukumeza, babacindezela abantu bakwa-Israyeli ngalowo nyaka. Kwaphela iminyaka eli-18 bebacindezele bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli ababehlala phesheya kweJordani, ezweni lama-Amori, kwaGileyadi.
Abakwa-Amoni bawela iJordani ukuyolwa noJuda, noBhenjamini, nabendlu ka-Efrayimi, u-Israyeli wakhathazeka kakhulu.
Abakwa-Israyeli base bekhala kuSimakade, bathi: “Sonile kuwe, ngokuba simshiyile uNkulunkulu wethu, sayokhonza oBhali.”
USimakade wathi kubantu bakwa-Israyeli: “Anginihlenganga yini kwabaseGibhithe, nabakwa-Amori, nabakwa-Amoni, nakumaFilisti, na?
AmaSidoni, ama-Amaleki, nabakwaMahoni banicindezela, nakhala kimi, nganikhulula esandleni sabo.
Nokho ningishiyile, nayokhonza abanye onkulunkulu, ngakho-ke angisayukubuye nginikhulule.
Hambani niyokhala konkulunkulu enizikhethele bona; mabanikhulule ngezikhathi zobunzima benu.”
Abakwa-Israyeli bathi kuSimakade: “Sonile; yenza kithi noma yini obona ukuthi kufanele uyenze, kodwa sikhulule namhlanje.”
Base besusa onkulunkulu babezizwe ababephakathi kwabo, bakhonza uSimakade; akakwazanga ukukubekezelela ukubona u-Israyeli ehlupheka.
Kwase kubizwa abakwa-Amoni ukuba bahlome, bakanise kwaGileyadi; abakwa-Israyeli bahlangana, bakanisa eMizpha.
Abakhuzi bempi yakwaGileyadi bathi omunye komunye: “Ngubani ozoqala impi nabakwa-Amoni, na? Uyokuba yinhloko phezu kwazo zonke izakhamuzi zakwaGileyadi.”
UJeftha wakwaGileyadi owayeyindodana yesifebe, wayeyiqhawe elinamandla. Uyise kwakunguGileyadi.
UmkaGileyadi wamzalela naye amadodana. Kuthe lapho amadodana omkakhe ekhula, amxosha, ethi kuye: “Awunakuthola lutho oluyifa endlini kababa, ngokuba uyindodana yomunye umfazi.”
UJeftha wayesebaleka kubafowabo, wahlala eThobi. UJeftha wazungezwa yizephulamthetho ayephuma ahlasele nazo.
Emveni kwesikhathi, abakwa-Amoni balwa nabakwa-Israyeli.
Kwathi lapho abakwa-Amoni belwa nabakwa-Israyeli, amalunga akwaGileyadi ahamba ukuyolanda uJeftha eThobi.
Athi kuJeftha: “Buya uzoba ngumkhuzi wempi yethu, ukuze silwe nabakwa-Amoni.”
Kodwa uJeftha wathi kumalunga akwaGileyadi: “Anisibo yini labo abangala, bangixosha endlini kababa, na? Pho nilethwa yini kimi uma senisenkathazweni, na?”
Amalunga akwaGileyadi athi kuye: “Noma kunjalo, sesibuyele kuwe manje ukuze uhambe nathi uyokulwa nabakwa-Amoni, ube yinhloko phezu kwethu naphezu kwazo zonke izakhamuzi zakwaGileyadi.”
UJeftha wathi kumalunga akwaGileyadi: “Uma ningibuyisela ekhaya ukuba ngilwe nabakwa-Amoni uSimakade abanikele kimi, ngiyokuba yinhloko yenu.”
Amalunga akwaGileyadi athi kuye: “USimakade uyokuba ngufakazi phakathi kwethu, impela sizokwenza njengalokhu usho.”
UJeftha wahamba namalunga akwaGileyadi, abantu bamenza inhloko yabo, nomkhuzi wempi yabo, uJeftha wawakhuluma wonke lawo mazwi akhe phambi kukaSimakade, eMizpha.
UJeftha wayesethumela izithunywa enkosini yakwa-Amoni, wathi kuyo: “Yini lena ekhona phakathi kwethu, uze ufike uzolwa nezwe lami, na?”

Inkosi yabakwa-Amoni yaphendula izithunywa zikaJeftha, yathi: “Kungenxa yokuba ngesikhathi u-Israyeli ephuma eGibhithe wathatha izwe lami, kusukela e-Arinoni kuye eJabhoki kuze kube seJordani; ngakho-ke manje libuyise ngokuthula.”
UJeftha waphinda wathumela izithunywa enkosini yabakwa-Amoni,
wathi kuyo: “Yilokhu okushiwo nguJeftha, uthi abakwa-Israyeli abazange balithathe izwe lakwaMowabi nelabakwa-Amoni,
kodwa lapho benyuka bevela eGibhithe, abakwa-Israyeli badabula ihlane baya oLwandle Lomhlanga, baze bafika eKadeshi.

Abakwa-Israyeli bathumela izithunywa enkosini yakwa-Edomi, bathi: ‘Sicela usivumele sidabule ezweni lakho,’ kodwa inkosi yakwa-Edomi ayifunanga ukubalalela. Babuye bathumela nasenkosini yakwaMowabi, kodwa nayo yenqaba, ngakho-ke abakwa-Israyeli bahlala eKadeshi.

“Base behamba ehlane, bazungeza izwe lakwa-Edomi nelakwaMowabi, baze bafinyelela empumalanga yezwe lakwaMowabi, bakanisa ngakolunye uhlangothi e-Arinoni. Kabangenanga endaweni yabakwaMowabi, ngokuba i-Arinoni yayingumngcele kwaMowabi.
“Abakwa-Israyeli bathumela izithunywa enkosini yama-Amori, uSihoni, inkosi yaseHeshibhoni, u-Israyeli wathi kuyo: ‘Sivumele sidabule ezweni lakho, sidlulele kwelethu.’
Kodwa uSihoni akazange abethembe abakwa-Israyeli ukuba bangadabula endaweni yakhe, ngakho-ke uSihoni waqoqa bonke abantu bakhe, wakanisa eJahazi, walwa no-Israyeli.
“USimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli wamnikela uSihoni nabo bonke abantu bakhe esandleni sabakwa-Israyeli, bamnqoba, abakwa-Israyeli base belidla lonke izwe lama-Amori ayehlala lapho.
Balidla lonke izwe lama-Amori, kusukela e-Arinoni kuye eJabhoki, nasehlane kuze kube seJordani.
“Ngakho-ke manje, uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli uwanqobile ama-Amori ukuze kuzuze abantu bakhe bakwa-Israyeli. Ngabe usophe ukudla izwe labo, na?
Aneneliswa yini yizwe unkulunkulu wenu uKhemoshi aninike lona laba yifa lenu, na? Thina asifanele yini ukudla lonke izwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu asinqobele lona ukuba libe yifa lethu, na?
Pho wena ungcono yini kunenkosi uBhalaki, indodana kaZiphori wakwaMowabi, na? Wake wabanga yini nabakwa-Israyeli, noma waya empini nabo, na?

Ngesikhathi abakwa-Israyeli besahlala eHeshibhoni nasemizaneni yalo, nase-Aroweri nemizana yalo, nakuyo yonke imizi emaqondana ne-Arinoni, iminyaka engama-300, awuyithathanga ngani ngaleso sikhathi, na?
Akuyimi engonileyo kuwe, kodwa nguwe owenza okubi kimi ngokulwa nami. Sengathi uSimakade ongumehluleli anganquma namuhla phakathi kwabakwa-Israyeli nabakwa-Amoni.”
Nokho inkosi yakwa-Amoni ayizange iwashaye mkhuba amazwi uJeftha ayewathumele kuyo.
UMoya kaSimakade wehlela phezu kukaJeftha, wadabula kwaGileyadi nakwaManase. Wedlulela eMizpha kwaGileyadi, wasuka eMizpha kwaGileyadi waya kubantu bakwa-Amoni.
UJeftha wenza isifungo kuSimakade, wathi: “Uma uyakunikela abakwa-Amoni esandleni sami,
kuyothi noma yini eyophuma emnyango wendlu yami izongihlangabeza, lapho ngibuya ngokuthula kubantu bakwa-Amoni, kube ngokukaSimakade, nginikele ngakho kube ngumnikelo wokushiswa.”
UJeftha wayesedlulela kubantu bakwa-Amoni ukuba alwe nabo; uSimakade wabanikela esandleni sakhe.
Wababulala kusukela e-Aroweri kuye kuyofika eMinithi, imizi engama-20, nase-Abhela Kheramimi. Abakwa-Amoni banqotshwa ngabakwa-Israyeli.
UJeftha wabuyela ekhaya eMizpha; mamo, nakho-ke sekuphuma indodakazi yakhe imhlangabeza, iza nezigubhu isina; kwakuyiyona yodwa ingane ayenayo; wayengenandodana nandodakazi ngaphandle kwayo.

Lapho eyibona, waklebhula izingubo zakhe, wathi: “Hawu, ndodakazi yami, waze wangilaya, wangibangela ukuhlupheka okukhulu. Phela ngivule umlomo wami ngakhuluma kuSimakade, manje angisakwazi ukusihoxisa isifungo sami.”
Yathi kuye: “Baba, uma ukhulumile kuSimakade, yenza kimi njengalokhu ufungile, lokhu uSimakade ukuphindiselele ezitheni zakho, abantu bakwa-Amoni.”
Yayisithi kuyise: “Mangenzelwe lokhu: ngiyeke izinyanga ezimbili ngihambe, ngehlele ezintabeni, ukuze ngililele ubuntombi bami, mina nabangani bami.”
Uyise wathi kuyo: “Hamba.” Wayihambisa izinyanga ezimbili; yahamba nabangani bayo, yalilela ubuntombi bayo ezintabeni.
Ekupheleni kwezinyanga ezimbili, yabuyela kuyise, owenza kuyo njengokwesifungo sakhe ayesenzile; yayingakaze ilale nandoda. Kwabe sekuvela isimiso kwa-Israyeli sokuba,
yonke iminyaka, amadodakazi akwa-Israyeli ahambe ayolilela indodakazi kaJeftha wakwaGileyadi izinsuku ezine.

Amadoda akwa-Efrayimi abizwa ukuba ahlome, ase ewelela eZafoni, athi kuJeftha: “Uweleleni wayokulwa nabakwa-Amoni, wangasibiza thina ukuba sihambe nawe, na? Sizoyithungela ngomlilo indlu yakho, iwele phezu kwakho.”
UJeftha wathi kubo: “Mina nabantu bakithi sasilwa nabakwa-Amoni ababesicindezele kakhulu, kodwa lapho nginibiza anizange ningikhulule esandleni sabo.

Lapho ngibona ukuthi aningihlenganga, ngabeka impilo yami engcupheni, ngawela ngayolwa nabakwa-Amoni, uSimakade wabanikela esandleni sami. Yini-ke enenze manje nikhuphukele kimi namuhla, ukuzokulwa nami, na?”

UJeftha wayeseqoqa wonke amadoda akwaGileyadi, walwa nabakwa-Efrayimi; amadoda akwaGileyadi abehlula abakwa-Efrayimi, ngokuba bathi: “Ningabakhoselayo bakwa-Efrayimi nina bakwaGileyadi, niphume phakathi kwabakwa-Efrayimi nabakwaManase.”
AbakwaGileyadi badla amazibuko eJordani phambi kwabakwa-Efrayimi. Kwakuthi okhoselayo wakwa-Efrayimi uma ethi: “Mangiwele,” abantu abakwaGileyadi bathi: “Ungowakwa-Efrayimi, na?” Uma ethi: “Qha,”

bese bethi kuye: yithi: “Shibholethi,” uma ethi: “Sibholethi,” ngoba engakwazi ukulibiza ngokufanele leli gama, bambambe, bambulalele emazibukweni eJordani. Kwafa ngaleso sikhathi abakwa-Efrayimi abayizi-42 000.
UJeftha wehlulela u-Israyeli iminyaka eyisithupha. UJeftha, umGileyadi, wayesefa wangcwatshwa emzini kwaGileyadi.
Emva kukaJeftha kwalandela u-Ibizani waseBhethlehema ukwehlulela u-Israyeli.

Wayenamadodana angama-30. Amadodakazi angama-30 wawaganisa ngaphandle kwesizwe sakhe, wathathela amadodana akhe izintombi ezingama-30 ngaphandle kwesizwe sakhe. Wehlulela u-Israyeli iminyaka eyisikhombisa.
U-Ibizani wafa, wangcwatshwa eBhethlehema.
Emva kuka-Ibizani, u-Eloni umZebuloni, waba ngumehluleli kwa-Israyeli, wehlulela u-Israyeli iminyaka elishumi.
U-Eloni umZebuloni wafa, wangcwatshwa e-Ayijaloni, lakwaZebuloni.
Emva kuka-Eloni, u-Abhidoni, indodana kaHileli umPhirathoni, wehlulela u-Israyeli.
Wayenamadodana angama-40, nabazukulu abangama-30 ababegibela izimbongolo ezingama-70; wehlulela u-Israyeli iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili.
U-Abhidoni, indodana kaHileli umPhirathoni, wafa, wangcwatshwa ePhirathoni, ezweni lakwa-Efrayimi kwelezintaba lama-Amaleki.
Abakwa-Israyeli babuye benza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade; uSimakade wabanikela esandleni samaFilisti iminyaka engama-40.
Kwakukhona indoda ethile eZora, yomndeni wakwaDani, igama layo kunguManowa. Umkayo wayeyinyumba, engenabantwana.
Ingelosi kaSimakade yabonakala kowesifazane, yathi kuye: “Nanxa uyinyumba, ungakaze uzale bantwana, uzakukhulelwa, uzale indodana.
Qaphela ukuthi ungaliphuzi iwayini nophuzo olunamandla, futhi ungadli lutho olungcolileyo,
ngoba uzakukhulelwa, uzale indodana: awuyukuliphuca ikhanda layo, ngokuba umfana uzokuba ngumnaziri kaNkulunkulu kwasesibelethweni; nguye oyakuqala ukukhulula u-Israyeli esandleni samaFilisti.”

Owesifazane wahamba wabikela umyeni wakhe, wathi: “Kufike kimi umuntu kaNkulunkulu, isimo sakhe sifana nesengelosi kaNkulunkulu, esabeka kakhulu. Angimbuzanga ukuthi uvelaphi, futhi akangitshelanga igama lakhe,

kodwa uthe kimi: ‘Uzakukhulelwa, uzale indodana. Ngakho-ke ungaphuzi wayini nophuzo olunamandla, futhi ungadli lutho olungcolileyo, ngokuba umfana uzokuba ngumnaziri kaNkulunkulu kwasesibelethweni kuze kube sosukwini lokufa kwakhe.’ ”
UManowa wayesekhuleka kuSimakade, wathi: “Nkosi, ngiyakunxusa, makuthi umuntu kaNkulunkulu obumthumile abuye eze kithi asifundise ukuthi siyakwenzenjani maqondana nomfana ozakuzalwa.”
UNkulunkulu wamlalela uManowa, ingelosi kaNkulunkulu yabuyela kowesifazane ehleli ensimini, kodwa umyeni wakhe wayengekho lapho.
Owesifazane wagijima ngokushesha watshela indoda yakhe, wathi: “Umuntu owabonakala kimi ngaleliya langa ubonakele futhi kimi.”
UManowa wasukuma walandela umkakhe, wafika kulowo muntu, wathi kuye: “Ngabe uyilowo muntu owakhuluma kulo wesifazane, na?” Wathi: “Yebo, nginguye.”
Wayesethi uManowa: “Nxa sekwenzekile owakukhulumayo, iyakuba yini indlela yomntwana, uyakwenzani, na?”
Ingelosi kaSimakade yathi kuManowa: “Owesifazane makakulalele konke engimtshele khona.
Akayukudla lutho oluvela esithelweni somvini, akayukuphuza wayini noma uphuzo olunamandla, futhi akayukukudla okungcolileyo. Makakugcine konke engimyale ngakho.”
UManowa wathi engelosini kaSimakade: “Ake usivumele sikulibazise, sikuhlabele izinyane lembuzi.”

Ingelosi kaSimakade yathi kuManowa: “Uma ungilibazisa, angiyukukudla ukudla kwakho, kodwa uma ufuna ukulungisa umhlatshelo wokushiswa, uyakuwunikela kuSimakade.” Kwakungoba uManowa wayengazi ukuthi lona uyingelosi kaSimakade.
UManowa wayesethi engelosini kaSimakade: “Ngubani igama lakho, ukuze sikuhloniphe lapho amazwi akho esefezekile?”
Kepha ingelosi kaSimakade yathi kuye: “Ulibuzelani igama lami, na? Liyisimangaliso!”
UManowa wayesethatha izinyane lembuzi nomnikelo wokusanhlamvu, wakunikela kuSimakade phezu kwedwala, kuye owenza izimangaliso.
Kwathi lapho ilangabi lenyukela ezulwini, lisuka e-althare, ingelosi kaSimakade yenyuka ngalo, uManowa nomkakhe bebukela, base bethi mbo ngobuso emhlabathini.
Ingelosi kaSimakade ayiphindanga yabonakala futhi kuManowa nomkakhe. UManowa wayeseqonda ukuthi bekuyingelosi kaSimakade.
UManowa wathi kumkakhe: “Impela sizokufa ngokuba sibone uNkulunkulu.”

Kepha umkakhe wathi kuye: “Ukuba uSimakade ubeqonde ukusibulala, ubengeke awemukele umnikelo wokushiswa nowokusanhlamvu ophuma ezandleni zethu, noma asikhombise konke lokhu, futhi ubengeke asitshele izinto ezifana nalezi.”
Owesifazane wazala indodana, wayiqamba igama wathi nguSamsoni. Umfana wakhula, uSimakade wambusisa.
UMoya kaSimakade waqala ukumsebenzisa ngesikhathi eseMahane Dani, phakathi kweZora ne-Eshithawoli.
USamsoni wehlela eThimna, eselapho wabona enye yamadodakazi amaFilisti.
Wayesenyuka, wabikela uyise nonina, wathi: “Ngibone owesifazane womFilisti eThimna; ngithatheleni yena abe ngumkami.”

Abazali bakhe bathi kuye: “Akukho ntombi yini phakathi kwezihlobo zakho noma phakathi kwabantu bakithi bonke, ukuba usungahamba uyothatha umfazi kumaFilisti angasokile, na?” Kodwa uSamsoni wathi kuyise: “Ngithathele yena, ngoba ngiyamthanda.”
Uyise nonina babengazi ukuthi lokhu kuvela kuSimakade, ngokuba wayefuna ithuba lokuthi alwe namaFilisti. Ngaleso sikhathi amaFilisti ayebusa phezu kuka-Israyeli.
USamsoni wayesehla noyise nonina, baya eThimna. Lapho befika esivinini eThimna, kwaqhamuka masinyane ibhongo lengonyama, leza kuye libhodla.
UMoya kaSimakade wehlela kuye ngamandla, walidwengula ngezandla zakhe kwangathi udwengula izinyane lembuzi. Wayengaphethe lutho esandleni sakhe, kodwa akabatshelanga oyise nonina lokho ayekwenzile.
Wayesehla, wakhuluma nowesifazane, wamgculisa lowo owesifazane uSamsoni.
Emveni kwesikhathi wabuyela khona ukuze aganwe nguye. Waphambuka ukuyobheka isidumbu sengonyama. Bheka, kwakunequlu lezinyosi noju esidunjini sengonyama.
Wazitapa ngezandla zakhe, waqhubeka ehamba edla. Lapho efika kuyise nonina, wabanika nabo badla, kodwa akabatshelanga ukuthi uju wayelutape esidunjini sengonyama.
Uyise wehla, waya kowesifazane, uSamsoni wenza idili lapho njengokuba izinsizwa zazijwayele ukwenza.
Lapho abantu bembona, baletha kuye izinsizwa ezingama-30 ukuba zizomzimazisa.

USamsoni wathi kuzo: “Ake ngininike imfumbe, ngibone ukuthi ningangichazela yini yona ngezinsuku eziyisikhombisa zedili. Uma nikwazile ngizoninika izingubo zelineni ezingama-30 nezingubo zokuphendulela ezingama-30.
Kepha uma nehluleka ukungichazela yona, niyonginika izingubo zelineni ezingama-30 nezingubo zokuphendulela ezingama-30.” Zathi kuye: “Sitshele imfumbe yakho sifuna ukuyizwa.”
Wayesethi kuzo: “Kodlayo kwaphuma ukudla, konamandla kwavela okumnandi.” Ezinsukwini ezintathu azikwazanga ukuyichaza imfumbe leyo.

Ngosuku lwesikhombisa zathi kumkaSamsoni: “Mnxenxe umyeni wakho ukuba asichazele imfumbe, kungenjalo sizokushisa ngomlilo wena nendlu kayihlo. Ngabe usimemele lapha ukuba nizosiphundla sibe mpofu, akunjalo na?”

Ngalokho-ke umkaSamsoni wakhala phambi kwakhe, wathi: “Uyangizonda, awungithandi neze. Ubuze abantu bakithi imfumbe, kodwa awukaze ungichazele mina.” USamsoni wamphendula wathi: “Bheka, angikaze ngimtshele ubaba noma umama imbala. Pho ngiyakukutshela kanjani wena, na?”
Wakhala phambi kwakhe kwaze kwaphela izinsuku eziyisikhombisa zedili labo, kodwa ngenxa yokuba wayelokhu embelesele, ngosuku lwesikhombisa uSamsoni wamtshela. Wayesebachazela abakubo imfumbe.

Amadoda omuzi athi kuye ngosuku lwesikhombisa, lingakashoni ilanga: “Yini emnandi kunoju na? Yini enamandla kunebhubesi na?” Wayesethi kuwo: “Ukuba anilimanga ngesithole sami, ngabe aniyitholanga incazelo yemfumbe yami.”

UMoya kaSimakade wehlela phezu kwakhe ngamandla, uSamsoni wayesehlela e-Ashikeloni. Wabulala amadoda angama-30, wawaphanga. Labo ababechaze imfumbe wabanika izingubo zokuphendulela. Wabuyela endlini kayise ethukuthele kakhulu.
UmkaSamsoni waganiselwa umngani owayekade engumkhaphi kaSamsoni.

Sekwedlule isikhathi, ngesikhathi sokuvunwa kukakolo, uSamsoni wahamba wayovakashela umkakhe, ephethe izinyane lembuzi, wathi: “Ngivumele ngingene ekamelweni lomkami.” Kodwa umukhwe wakhe akamvumelanga ukuba angene.
Umukhwe wakhe wathi kuye: “Ngangiqinisekile ukuthi usumlahlile, ngase ngimnika umngani wakho. Udadewabo omncane akamuhle yini kunaye, na? Yini ungathathi yena esikhundleni sakhe, na?”
USamsoni wathi kubo: “Ngalesi sikhathi, uma ngenza okubi kumaFilisti, angizukuba nacala.”
USamsoni wahamba wabamba izimpungushe ezingama-300, wathatha izihlonti, wayesenza ukuba izimpungushe zilinganisane ngemisila, wabophela izihlonti phakathi kwemisila yazo.
Esezithungele izihlonti, wazidedela izimpungushe ukuba zingene phakathi kukakolo wamaFilisti ungakavunwa. Washisa izithungo nezinhlanga zikakolo, izivini nezihlahla zeminqumo.

AmaFilisti ayesebuza ethi: “Kwenziwe ngubani lokhu, na?” Baphendula bathi: “NguSamsoni, umkhwenyana womThimna, ngenxa yokuba umukhwe wakhe uthathe umkaSamsoni wamnika umngani kaSamsoni.” AmaFilisti enyuka, amshisa yena noyise.
USamsoni wathi kuwo: “Uma kuyilokhu enikwenzayo, ngiyafunga ukuthi anginakuphumula ngize ngiziphindiselele kini.”
Wawahlasela ngonya olwesabekayo, wabulala amaningi; wayesehamba wayohlala emfantwini wedwala e-Ethamu.
AmaFilisti abe esenyuka ayokanisa kwaJuda, asatshalaliswa eLehi.
Amadoda akwaJuda athi: “Nenyukeleni ukuzolwa nathi, na?” Aphendula amaFilisti, athi: “Senyukele ukuba sizobopha uSamsoni, ukuze senze kuye njengalokhu enzile kithi.”

Kwase kwehla amadoda akwaJuda ayizi-3 000 aya emfantwini wedwala e-Ethamu, athi kuSamsoni: “Awazi yini ukuthi amaFilisti angababusi bethu, na? Pho yini lena oyenzile kithi, na?” Waphendula wathi: “Ngenze kubo njengalokhu benzile kimi.”
Athi kuye: “Sehlele ukuba sizokubopha, ukuze sikunikele esandleni samaFilisti.” USamsoni waphendula wathi: “Fungani kimi ukuthi nina uqobo anizukungihlasela.”
Athi kuye: “Qha, sizokubopha nje kuphela, bese sikunikela esandleni sawo, asizukukubulala thina.” Ambopha ngezintambo ezimbili ezintsha, amkhipha edwaleni.

Lapho efika eLehi, amaFilisti eza ukuzomhlangabeza ememeza; uMoya kaSimakade wehlela kuye, izintambo ezazisezingalweni zakhe zancibilikisa okwefilakisi lishiswa ngumlilo, izibopho ezazisezandleni zakhe zancibilika zasuka ezandleni zakhe.
Wathola umhlathi osemusha wembongolo, wawuthatha, wabulala ngawo amadoda ayinkulungwane.
USamsoni wathi: “Ngomhlathi wembongolo, yebo, ngomhlathi wembongolo, ngibulele amadoda ayinkulungwane.”
Eseqedile ukukhuluma, wawulahla umhlathi wembongolo, leyo ndawo yabizwa ngokuthi yiRamathi Lehi.
Ngaleso sikhathi wayesomile kakhulu, wakhala kuSimakade wathi: “Wenze lokhu kukhululwa okukhulu ngesandla senceku yakho. Sengizakufa yini ukoma bese ngiwela ezandleni zabangasokile, na?”
UNkulunkulu wavula umgodi eLehi, kwaphuma amanzi kuwo. Esephuzile abuya amandla akhe, wavuseleleka. Ngakho-ke leyo ndawo yabizwa ngokuthi yi-Eni Hakhore, isekhona eLehi kuze kube namuhla.
Wehlulela u-Israyeli ngezinsuku zamaFilisti iminyaka engama-20.
Ngelinye ilanga uSamsoni waya eGaza, lapho wabona isifebe, walala naso.

AbaseGaza batshelwa ukuthi: “USamsoni ufikile lapha.” Bayizungeza indawo, bamlalela unyendle ubusuku bonke, esangweni lomuzi. Bathula ubusuku bonke, bethi: “Masilinde kuze kube nokukhanya kokusa, bese siyambulala.”

USamsoni walala kwaze kwaba phakathi kwamabili, wavuka phakathi kobusuku wabamba iminyango yesango lomuzi nezinsika zalo zombili, wakubhoncula nomgoqo, wakuthwala emahlombe akhe, wenyukela nakho esicongweni sentaba eyayiphambi kweHebhroni.
Emveni kwalokho wathanda owesifazane wasesigodini iSoreki, igama lakhe kunguDelila.

Amakhosi amaFilisti akhuphukela kuye, athi: “Yenga uSamsoni, uthole ukuthi yini amandla akhe emakhulu kangaka, nokuthi singamehlula kanjani ukuze simbophe, simnqobe; siyakukunika ngamunye izinhlamvu zesiliva eziyi-1 100.”
UDelila wathi kuSamsoni: “Ake ungitshele ukuthi yini ekwenza ube namandla amakhulu kangaka, nokuthi ungaboshwa kanjani ukuze unqotshwe, na?”
USamsoni wathi kuye: “Uma bengangibopha ngezintambo ezintsha eziyisikhombisa ezingakomiswa, ngiyakuba ntekenteke, ngifane nawo wonke umuntu.”
Amakhosi amaFilisti aletha kuye izintambo ezintsha eziyisikhombisa ezingakomiswa, wambopha ngazo.

Amadoda ayesophe ukumbulala ayesegumbini lakhe elingaphakathi, elinde khona, wayesethi kuye: “AmaFilisti aphezu kwakho, Samsoni!” Kepha wazigqabula kalula nje izintambo kwangathi umucu kahalibhoma lapho ushiswa ngumlilo. Ngakho-ke imfihlo yamandla akhe ayaziwanga.
UDelila wathi kuSamsoni: “Uhlekise ngami, wangitshela amanga; ngiyakuncenga ngitshele ukuthi ungaboshwa kanjani.”
Wathi kuye: “Uma bengibopha ngezintambo ezintsha ezingakaze zisetshenziswe, khona ngiyoba ntekenteke, ngifane nawo wonke umuntu.”

UDelila wayesethatha izintambo ezintsha wambopha ngazo, wayesethi kuye: “AmaFilisti aphezu kwakho, Samsoni.” Amadoda ayesophe ukumbulala ayesegumbini elingaphakathi. Wazigqabula izintambo ezingalweni zakhe kwangathi umucu kakotini.

UDelila wathi kuSamsoni: “Kuze kube manje usahlekisa ngami, futhi ungitshela amanga; ngitshele ukuthi ungaboshwa kanjani, na?” USamsoni wathi kuye: “Uma ungeluka amagoda ayisikhombisa ekhanda, uwahlanganisa nezintambo eziphothiwe, uwabethele esikhonkwaneni, ngizoba ntekenteke, ngifane nawo wonke umuntu.”
Wawabethela-ke ngesikhonkwane, wathi kuye: “AmaFilisti aphezu kwakho, Samsoni.” Wavuka ebuthongweni bakhe, wasingcothula isikhonkwane nezintambo ezelukiweyo neziphiciweyo.
UDelila wayesethi kuSamsoni: “Ungasho kanjani ukuthi uyangithanda, uma inhliziyo yakho ingenami, na? Usungikhohlise kwaze kwaba kathathu, awungitsheli ukuthi yini ekwenza ube namandla angaka.”
Ekugcineni, emva kokumcindezela ngamazwi usuku nosuku, embelesele, waze wacikeka kakhulu uSamsoni.

Ngakho-ke wayesemtshela yonke imfihlo yakhe, wathi kuye: “Ikhanda lami alikaze liphucwe ngensingo, ngokuba ngingumnaziri kaNkulunkulu kwasesibelethweni sikamame. Uma ngigundwa ayophela amandla ami, ngibe ntekenteke, ngifane nabo bonke abantu.”

UDelila ebona ukuthi umtshele yonke imfihlo yakhe, wathumela wayobiza amakhosi amaFilisti, wathi kuwo: “Khuphukani, ngokuba manje usengitshele yonke imfihlo yakhe.” Amakhosi amaFilisti enyuka eza kuye, ephethe isiliva ezandleni zawo.
Wamlalisa emathangeni akhe, wayesebiza indoda, wamphuca amagoda ayisikhombisa ayesekhanda lakhe. Waqala ukumhlupha, amandla akhe asuka kuye.
UDelila wayesethi: “AmaFilisti aphezu kwakho, Samsoni.” Lapho evuka ebuthongweni wathi: “Ngizophuma njengasesikhathini esedlule, ngizithintithe.” Wayengazi ukuthi uSimakade umshiyile.
