Kwakukhona esikhaleni sesango abantu abane abanochoko; bathi omunye komunye: “Sihlaleleni lapha sizoze sife na?

Uma sithi: ‘Siyakungena emzini,’ kunendlala emzini, siyakufela khona; uma sihlala lapha, siyakufa futhi. Ngalokho masihambe siye enkanjini yabase-Aramu; uma besiyeka, siyakuphila; uma besibulala, siyakufa.”
Basuka kuhwalala, baya enkanjini yabase-Aramu; sebefike emaphethelweni enkambu yabase-Aramu, bafica kungekho muntu lapho.

INkosi yenza ukuba impi yabase-Aramu izwe umsindo wezinqola, umsindo wamahhashi, nomsindo wempi enkulu baze bakhuluma bodwa, bathi: “Uyabona, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli iqashe amakhosi amaHithi namakhosi aseGibhithe ukuba eze kithi.”
Basuka babaleka kuhwalala, bashiya amathende abo, amahhashi abo, izimbongolo zabo, nenkambu injengalokhu injalo, babaleka ukuze basinde.

Kwathi labo abanochoko sebefikile emaphethelweni enkambu, bangena kwelinye ithende, badla, baphuza, bathatha lapho isiliva, igolide, nezingubo, bayokufihla; babuya, bangena kwelinye ithende, bathatha nalapho, base beyokuthukusa.

Base bethi omunye komunye: “Asenzi kahle. Lolu lusuku lwanamuhla wusuku lwezindaba ezinhle, kodwa sithule nje silinde ukuba kuze kube sekuseni, siyakuthola isijeziso ngalokho, masihambe, sitshele indlu yenkosi.”

Bahamba, babiza abalindisango bomuzi, babatshela, bathi: “Sihambile saya enkanjini yabase-Aramu; bekukhala ibhungane, kungekho muntu, kungekho ngisho umsindo wodwa lo, kuphela amahhashi, nezimbongolo okuboshiweyo, namathende enjengalokhu enjalo.”
Abalindisango bamemeza, babikela indlu yenkosi ngaphakathi.

Inkosi yavuka ebusuku, yathi ezincekwini zayo: “Ake nginitshele ngalokhu ukuthi abase-Aramu basilungisele lugibe luni. Bayazi ukuthi silambile, ngakho-ke baphumile enkanjini ukuba bacashe, bethi: ‘Bazophuma emzini, sibabambe, bese singena kuwona umuzi.’ ”

Enye yezinceku zayo yaphendula yathi: “Makuthathwe amahhashi ayisihlanu kwasele lapho; isimo sawo siyafana nesixuku sonke sabakwa-Israyeli esisele lapha, nanjengesixuku sonke sakwa-Israyeli esesiphelile; masithumele ukuze sibone.”
Bathatha izinqola ezimbili namahhashi; inkosi yathumela emva kwempi yabase-Aramu, yathi: “Hambani niyohlola.”
Bawalandela baze bayofika eJordani; bheka, yonke indlela yayigcwele izingubo nezimpahla ama-Aramu ayezilahlile lapho ebaleka. Izithunywa zabuya, zayitshela inkosi.
Abantu baphuma, baphanga inkambu yabase-Aramu. Iseya lempuphu ecolekileyo lathengiswa ngeshekeli, namaseya amabili ebhali, ngeshekeli, njengokusho kukaSimakade.
Inkosi yabeka esangweni induna eyisethenjwa sayo. Abantu bayinyathela esangweni, yafa njengokusho komuntu kaNkulunkulu owayekhulume ngesikhathi inkosi yehlile yeza kuye.
Kwathi lapho umuntu kaNkulunkulu ekhuluma enkosini, wathi: “Kuyakuba ngamaseya amabili ebhali, ngeshekeli, neseya lempuphu ecolekileyo ngeshekeli, ngalesi sikhathi kusasa esangweni eSamariya.”

Induna yamphendula umuntu kaNkulunkulu, yathi: “Uyabona, noma ngabe uSimakade ubengenza amafasitela ezulwini, le nto ingenzeka njengaleli lizwi na?” Wathi: “Wena uyakukubona ngamehlo akho, kodwa awuyukukudla.”
Kwenzeka kanjalo kuyo: abantu bayinyathela esangweni, yafa.

U-Elisha wayekhulume kowesifazane ayevuse indodana yakhe yaphila, wathi: “Suka uhambe nabendlu yakini, uyohlala lapho ungahlala khona, ngokuba uSimakade ubikezele ukuthi kuzokuba nendlala ezohlasela izwe iminyaka eyisikhombisa.”
Owesifazane wasuka, wenza njengezwi lomuntu kaNkulunkulu, wahamba nabendlu yakhe, wayogogobala ezweni lamaFilisti iminyaka eyisikhombisa.
Kwathi isiphelile iminyaka eyisikhombisa, owesifazane wabuya ezweni lamaFilisti. Wahamba wayozikhalela, ecela usizo enkosini ngendlu yakhe nangezwe lakhe.
Inkosi yakhuluma noGehazi, inceku yomuntu kaNkulunkulu, yathi: “Ake ungilandise ngazo zonke izinto ezinkulu azenzileyo u-Elisha.”

Esayilandisa inkosi ukuthi wavusa ofileyo, owesifazane, ondodana yakhe ayeyivusile, wakhala ecela usizo enkosini ngendlu yakhe nangezwe lakhe. Wayesethi uGehazi: “Nkosi yami, nkosi, nguye lo wesifazane; yiyo le indodana yakhe u-Elisha ayivusayo yaphila.”

Inkosi yambuza owesifazane, wayilandisa. Inkosi yayisiqoka induna, yathi kuyo: “Buyisela konke okwakungokwalo wesifazane, zonke izithelo zensimu kusukela ngosuku alishiya ngalo leli lizwe kuze kube namuhla.”
U-Elisha waya eDamaseku ngesikhathi uBheni Hadadi, inkosi yase-Aramu idunguzela; yabikelwa ukuthi: “Umuntu kaNkulunkulu ufikile lapha.”
Inkosi yayisithi kuHazayeli: “Thatha isipho, uhambe uyomhlangabeza umuntu kaNkulunkulu. Ubuze kuSimakade uthi: ‘Ngizosinda yini kulesi sifo na?’ ”

UHazayeli wayesehamba wayomhlangabeza, wathatha izipho nazo zonke izinto ezinhle eDamaseku; imithwalo yamakameli angama-40. Wafika wema phambi kuka-Elisha, wathi kuye: “Indodana yakho uBheni Hadadi, inkosi yase-Aramu, ingithume kuwe, yathi: ‘Ngabe ngizosinda yini kulesi sifo na?’ ”
U-Elisha, wathi kuye: “Hamba uthi kuye: ‘Uyakusinda nokusinda, kodwa uSimakade ungibonisile ukuthi uyakufa nokufa.’ ”
Wamgqolozela uHazayeli, waze waba namahloni. Umuntu kaNkulunkulu wayeseqhumuka wakhala.

UHazayeli wathi: “Ngabe inkosi yami ikhalelani na?” Yathi: “Kungenxa yokuthi ngiyakwazi ozokwenza kubantu bakwa-Israyeli; uyakubalimaza, uthungele ngomlilo izinqaba zabo, ubulale ngenkemba izinsizwa zabo, uphahlaze izingane zabo, uqhaqhe abesifazane bakhona abazethwele.”
UHazayeli wathi: “Kodwa ibiyini inceku yakho, iyinja nje; ingakwenza kanjani lokhu okukhulu kangaka na?” Wathi u-Elisha: “USimakade ungibonisile ukuthi uzokuba yinkosi e-Aramu.”
Wayesesuka ku-Elisha, wabuyela enkosini yakhe, yathi kuye: “Utheni kuwe u-Elisha na?” Wathi: “Uthe, wena uyakusinda nokusinda.”
Kwathi ngakusasa wathatha indwangu yokwemboza, wayicwilisa emanzini, wamboza ubuso benkosi yaze yafa. UHazayeli waba yinkosi esikhundleni sayo.
Ngonyaka wesihlanu wokubusa kukaJoramu, indodana ka-Ahabi, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, uJehoramu, indodana kaJehoshafathi, waba yinkosi kwaJuda.
Wayeneminyaka engama-32 ngesikhathi eqala ukubusa, wabusa iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili eJerusalema.
Wahamba ngendlela yamakhosi akwa-Israyeli, njengalokhu kwenza indlu ka-Ahabi, kwazise wayeganwe yindodakazi yakhe u-Ahabi. Wenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade.
USimakade wayengathandi ukumbhubhisa uJuda ngenxa kaDavide, inceku yakhe, nanjengokuba ayeshilo kuye ukuthi uyakumnika yena nezizukulwane zakhe isibani izinsuku zonke.
Emihleni yakhe abakwa-Edomi bahlubuka phansi kwesandla sakwaJuda, bazibekela inkosi.
UJoramu wawelela eSayiri nazo zonke izinqola zakhe. Waphuma ebusuku, wabhubhisa abakwa-Edomi ababemzungeze nhlangothi zonke, nezinduna zezinqola. Kepha abantu babalekela emathendeni abo.
Abakwa-Edomi base behlubuka-ke phansi kwesandla sakwaJuda kuze kube namuhla. Kwahlubuka futhi neLibhina ngaso leso sikhathi.
Ezinye izindaba zikaJoramu, nakho konke akwenzayo, akulotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwaJuda na?
UJoramu wayeselaliswa kokhokho bakhe, wembelwa koyisemkhulu emzini kaDavide; u-Ahaziya, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngonyaka we-12 wokubusa kukaJoramu, indodana ka-Ahabi, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, u-Ahaziya, indodana kaJehoramu, waba yinkosi kwaJuda.
Wayeneminyaka engama-22 ngesikhathi eba yinkosi, wabusa unyaka eJerusalema. Igama likanina kwakungu-Athaliya, indodakazi ka-Omri, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli.
Wahamba ngendlela yendlu ka-Ahabi, wenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade njengendlu ka-Ahabi; wayengumkhwenyana wendlu ka-Ahabi.
Wahamba noJoramu, indodana ka-Ahabi, bayokulwa noHazayeli, inkosi yase-Aramu, eRamothi Gileyadi. Abase-Aramu bamlimaza uJoramu.

Inkosi uJoramu yabuyela eJizreyeli ukuze kuphole amanxeba eyayiwathole empini yaseRama nabase-Aramu, ngesikhathi belwa noHazayeli, inkosi yabo. U-Ahaziya, indodana kaJehoramu, inkosi yakwaJuda, wehla ukuyobona uJoramu, indodana ka-Ahabi, eJizreyeli, ngokuba wayelimele.
U-Elisha, umphrofethi, wabiza enye yamadodana abaphrofethi, wathi kuyo: “Bhinca ingubo yakho okhalo, uthathe lo mfuma wamafutha ngesandla, uye eRamothi Gileyadi.
Uyothi ungafika khona, ufune uJehu, indodana kaJehoshafathi kaNimishi. Uyongena, umsukumise phakathi kwabafowabo, umyise ekamelweni elingaphakathi.
Uyothatha umfuma wamafutha, uwathele ekhanda lakhe, uthi kuye: ‘Usho kanje uSimakade, uthi: “Ngiyakugcoba ukuba ube yinkosi kwa-Israyeli.” ’ “Bese uvula umnyango, qede ubaleke, ungalibali.”
Leyo nsizwa eyayingumphrofethi, yahamba yalibangisa eRamothi Gileyadi.
Yafika khona yafica abakhuzi bempi behleli, yayisithi: “Ake silumane indlebe nawe, nduna.” UJehu wathi: “Usho bani phakathi kwethu na?” Yathi: “Ngisho kuwe, nduna.”
Wasukuma, wangena endlini, yayisimthela ngamafutha ekhanda, yathi kuye: “Usho kanje uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Ngiyakugcoba ukuba ube yinkosi yabantu bakaSimakade, u-Israyeli.
Uyakuyibhubhisa indlu ka-Ahabi, inkosi yakho, ukuze ngiphindiselele igazi lezinceku zami, abaphrofethi, negazi lezinceku zonke zikaSimakade elachithwa yisandla sikaJezebheli.
Yonke indlu ka-Ahabi iyakubhujiswa; ngiyoqothula wonke owesilisa ka-Ahabi kusukela komncane kuya komdala.
Ngiyoyenza indlu ka-Ahabi ifane nendlu kaJerobhowamu, indodana kaNebhathi, nanjengendlu kaBhahasha, indodana ka-Ahiya.
Izinja ziyakumudla uJezebheli esifundeni eJizreyeli. Akukho muntu oyakummbela.’ ” Yayisivula umnyango, yabaleka.
UJehu waphumela phandle ezincekwini zenkosi yakhe. Enye yazo, yathi kuye: “Ngabe konke kusalungile yini na? Beluzofunani lolu hlanya na?” Wathi kuzo: “Niyamazi nina lowo muntu nakushilo.”
Kepha, zathi: “Ngamanga lawo; ake usitshele.” Wayesethi kuzo: “Usho lokhu nalokhu kimi, ethi: ‘Usho kanje uSimakade uthi: ngiyakugcoba ukuba ube yinkosi kwa-Israyeli.’ ”
Ngokushesha, zathatha kwaba yileyo naleyo ingubo yayo, zazibeka phansi kwakhe esikhwelweni, zase zibetha icilongo, zathi: “UJehu uyinkosi.”
UJehu, indodana kaJehofathathi, wamakhela uzungu uJoramu. UJoramu wayesalokhu elinde eRamothi Gileyadi kanye nawo wonke u-Israyeli, ngenxa kaHazayeli, inkosi yase-Aramu.

Inkosi uJoramu yayibuyile eJizreyeli ukuze yelashwe amanxeba ayo eyayiwalinyazwe ngama-Aramu ngesikhathi belwa noHazayeli inkosi yakhona. UJehu wathi: “Uma lokhu kuvela kini, makungabaleki muntu aphume emzini, ukuze ayobika eJizreyeli.”
UJehu wagibela enqoleni, walibangisa eJizreyeli, ngoba uJoramu wayelele lapho. U-Ahaziya, inkosi yakwaJuda, wayehlele khona ukuyobona uJoramu.

Umlindi owayemi embhoshongweni eJizreyeli wabona iviyo likaJehu liza, wayesethi: “Ngibona iviyo liza.” UJoramu wathi: “Thumela ogibele ihhashi abahlangabeze, ababuze, athi: ‘Nize ngokuthula yini na?’ ”

Owayegibele ihhashi wabahlangabeza, wathi kubo: “Isho kanje inkosi, ithi: ‘Nize ngokuthula yini na?’ ” UJehu wathi: “Unandabani nokuthula wena na? Qhela phambi kwami, ubuyele emva kwami.” Umlindi wabuye wabika, wathi: “Isithunywa sesifikile kubo, kodwa asibuyile.”
Wayesethumela owesibili egibele ihhashi, waya kubo, wathi: “Isho kanje inkosi, ithi: ‘Nize ngokuthula yini na?’ ” UJehu wathi: “Unandabani nokuthula wena na? Qhela phambi kwami, ubuyele emva kwami.”
Umlindi wabika, wathi: “Sesifikile naleso kubo, kepha naso asibuyile. Ukushayela kwaso kufana nokushayela kukaJehu oqhuba sengathi luhlanya.”

UJehoramu wayesethi: “Bophelani.” Base beyibophela-ke inqola yakhe. UJehoramu, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, no-Ahaziya, inkosi yakwaJuda, baphuma bayomhlangabeza uJehu, kuyilowo nalowo egibele enqoleni yakhe. Bamfica esiqeshini sezwe likaNabothi waseJizreyeli.
Kwathi ukuba uJoramu ambone uJehu, wayesethi: “Uze ngokuthula yini, Jehu na?” Wathi: “Ukuthula kwani, kusekuningi kangaka ukufeba nokulumba kukanyoko uJezebheli?”
UJehoramu waphenduka wacela empunzini, wamemeza u-Ahaziya, wathi: “Wugobe, Ahaziya!”
UJehu wayesensala umnsalo, waciba uJehoramu, umcibisholo wangena phakathi kwamahlombe akhe, waze wayophumela enhliziyweni yakhe, wawela phansi enqoleni yakhe.

UJehu wathi kuBhidikhari, induna yakhe: “Mthathe, umphonse esiqintini sezwe likaNabothi waseJizreyeli. Khumbula ukuthi ngesikhathi mina nawe sigibele silandela u-Ahabi, uyise, uSimakade walusho lolu daba ngaye,

wathi: ‘Ngenxa yegazi likaNabothi, negazi lamadodana akhe engilibonile izolo,’ kusho uSimakade, ‘ngiyakuphindisela kuwe kulesi siqinti sezwe,’ kusho uSimakade. Ngalokho-ke, mthathe umdinsile kulesi siqinti sezwe njengokusho kwezwi likaSimakade.”

U-Ahaziya, inkosi yakwaJuda, esekubonile lokho, wabaleka ngendlela eseBhethi Hagani, nokho uJehu wamhlala ezithendeni, wathi: “Mbulaleleni naye enqoleni yakhe.” Bambulala enqoleni yakhe emmangweni eGuri ongaseJibhileyamu. Wabalekela eMegido, wafela lapho.
Izinceku zakhe zamyisa ngenqola eJerusalema, zammbela ethuneni lakhe nokhokho bakhe, emzini kaDavide.
Ngonyaka we-11 wokubusa kukaJoramu, indodana ka-Ahabi, u-Ahaziya waba yinkosi kwaJuda.
UJehu waya eJizreyeli, uJezebheli wezwa ngalokho, wayesegqaba amehlo akhe, wazihlobisa ikhanda, walunguza ngefasitela.
UJehu esengena esangweni wathi: “Kusahleziwe kahle yini, wena Zimri, mbulali wenkosi yakho na?”
Waphakamisa ubuso bakhe, wabheka ngasefasiteleni, wathi: “Ngubani ongakimi? Ngubani na?” Kwase kulunguza izinduna ezimbili noma ezintathu.
Wayesethi kuzo: “Mphonseni phansi.” Zamphonsa, igazi lakhe lasaphazekela odongeni nasemahhashini. Wamfihliza ngezinyawo zakhe.
Wangena, wadla, waphuza, wayesethi: “Mbhekeni lo mqalekiswakazi, nimmbele, ngoba uyindodakazi yenkosi.”
Bahamba bayombheka ukuze bammbele, nokho abatholanga lutho ngaphandle kwekhanda, izinyawo, nezintende zezandla.
Babuyela kuye bambikela. Wathi: “Yizwi likaSimakade alikhuluma ngomlomo wenceku yakhe u-Eliya waseThishibhi, ethi: esiqeshini sezwe eJizreyeli izinja ziyokudla inyama kaJezebheli.
Isidumbu sikaJezebheli siyokuba njengomquba phezu komhlabathi, esiqintini sezwe eJizreyeli, ukuze kungabi bikho muntu oyakuthi: ‘Nangu uJezebheli.’ ”
U-Ahabi wayenamadodana angama-70 eSamariya. UJehu wabhala izincwadi, wazithumela eSamariya ezikhulwini zaseJizreyeli, kumalunga, nakubaqaphi bakwa-Ahabi, wathi:
“Manje njengoba le ncwadi ifika kini, amadodana enkosi yenu enani, izinqola zempi, amahhashi, umuzi obiyelweyo, nezikhali,
niyozibonela ukuthi yiyiphi enhle nefaneleyo emadodaneni enkosi yenu, bese niyibeka esihlalweni sobukhosi sikayise, nilwele indlu yenkosi yenu.”
Kepha besaba kakhulu, bathi: “Amakhosi amabili awakwazanga ukumelana naye, pho thina singobani ukuba singema endleleni yakhe na?”

Owengamele isigodlo, nomphathi womuzi namalunga nabaqaphi bathumela kuJehu, bathi: “Thina siyizinceku zakho, konke ositshela khona siyakukwenza; asiyukubeka muntu abe yinkosi; yenza okubona kukuhle emehlweni akho.”

Waphinda futhi wababhalela incwadi yesibili, ethi kubo: “Uma-ke ningakimi, futhi nilalela izwi lami, thathani amakhanda awo wonke amadodana enkosi yenu niwalethe lapha kimi eJizreyeli, kusasa ngalesi sikhathi.” Amadodana enkosi ayengama-70 ayehlala ezikhulwini zomuzi, ziwakhulisa.
Kwathi ukuba bayithole incwadi, bawathatha wonke amadodana enkosi, bawabulala, abantu abangama-70, bafaka amakhanda awo emaqomeni, bawathumela kuJehu eJizreyeli.
Kwase kufika isithunywa sathi kuye: “Sebewalethile amakhanda amadodana enkosi.” Wathi: “Abekeni abe yizinqwaba ezimbili ngasesikhaleni sesango kuze kube sekuseni.”
Kwathi ekuseni waphuma, wema, wathi kubantu bonke: “Nina nilungile; bhekani, mina ngenzele inkosi yami ugobe, ngayibulala, kodwa ngubani obulele bonke laba na?
Yazini manje ukuthi akuyukuwela phansi nelilodwa lezwi likaSimakade, alikhulumayo uSimakade ngendlu ka-Ahabi; uSimakade ukwenzile lokho akukhulumayo ngomlomo wenceku yakhe, u-Eliya.”
UJehu wababulala bonke ababesasele bendlu ka-Ahabi eJizreyeli, zonke izikhulu zakhe, abazana naye, nabaphristi bakhe, akwaze kwasala noyedwa kubo.
Wayesesuka, wahamba waya eSamariya; kwathi esendlini yokugunda yabelusi endleleni,
uJehu wafumana abafowabo baka-Ahaziya, inkosi yakwaJuda, wathi: “Nina ningobani na?” Bathi: “Singabafowabo baka-Ahaziya; sehla ukuyobingelela abantwana benkosi nabantwana bendlovukazi.”
Wathi: “Babambeni bephila.” Bababamba bephila, bababulala ngasemgodini wendlu yokugunda, abantu abangama-42, abaze bashiya muntu kubo.

Wasuka lapho wafumana uJehonadaba, indodana kaRekhabhi ezomhlangabeza; wayesembingelela, wathi kuye: “Ngabe kulungile yini enhliziyweni yakho njengoba kunjalo kweyami na?” UJehonadaba wathi: “Yebo.” UJehu wayesethi: “Uma-ke kunjalo, letha isandla sakho.” Waselula isandla sakhe, wayesemgibelisa enqoleni yakhe.
Wayesethi uJehu: “Hamba nami ukuze ubone indlela engimshisekelela ngayo uSimakade.” Base bemgibelisa enqoleni yakhe.
Esefike eSamariya, wababulala bonke abendlu ka-Ahabi ababesasele lapho, waze wabaqeda nya njengezwi likaSimakade alikhuluma ku-Eliya.
UJehu wabaqoqa bonke abantu, wathi kubo: “U-Ahabi wamkhonza kancane uBhali, kodwa uJehu uyakumkhonza kakhulu.

Ngakho-ke, ngibizeleni bonke abaphrofethi bakaBhali, zonke izinceku zakhe, nabo bonke abaphristi bakhe, kungasali namunye, ngokuba nginomhlatshelo omkhulu kaBhali; bonke abangekho lapha abayukuphila.” Kepha uJehu wenza lokhu ngobuqili ukuze abhubhise izinceku zikaBhali.
Wayesethi uJehu: “Mahlukaniseleni uBhali umhlangano womkhosi.” Bawumemezela-ke.

UJehu wathumela ku-Israyeli wonke; zonke izinceku zikaBhali zafika, akwaze kwaba bikho muntu ongafikanga. Zangena endlini kaBhali, indlu kaBhali yagcwala yathi nswi, kungekho ngisho nendawo yokufaka unyawo.
Wathi kumphathi wekamelo lezembatho: “Khiphela zonke izinceku zikaBhali izembatho.” Wazikhiphela-ke izembatho.

UJehu noJehonadaba, indodana kaRekhabhi, bangena endlini kaBhali; wathi ezincekwini zikaBhali: “Cingani, nibone, funa kube khona lapho oyedwa wezinceku zikaSimakade, kodwa makube yizinceku zikaBhali kuphela ezilapho.”

Bangena bezonikela ngemihlatshelo nangeminikelo yokushiswa. UJehu wayemise ngaphandle amadoda angama-80, wathi: “Uma kuphunyuka omunye walaba bantu engibaletha ezandleni zenu, kuyakuba ngukuphila ngokuphila.”

Kwathi lapho eqeda ukunikela ngomnikelo wokushiswa, uJehu wathi kubalindi nasezinduneni: “Hambani nibabulale, kungaphunyuki ngisho noyedwa.” Bababulala ngenkemba. Abalindi nezinduna babantshinga phandle, bangena ekamelweni eliphakathi lendlu kaBhali.
Bakhipha izinsika ezazisendlini kaBhali, bazishisa.
Babhidliza insika engcwele kaBhali, badiliza indlu kaBhali, bayenza yaba yindlu yendle, kuze kube namuhla.
UJehu wamchitha-ke uBhali kwa-Israyeli.
Kepha akasukanga ekulandeleni izono zikaJerobhowamu, indodana kaNebhathi, onisa ngazo u-Israyeli, namathole egolide ayeseBhethele nakwaDani awasuswanga.

USimakade wathi kuJehu: “Ngenxa yokuba wenze kahle ngokufeza okulungile emehlweni ami, futhi wenza endlini ka-Ahabi njengakho konke okwakusenhliziyweni yami, uzalo lwakho lwezizukulwane ezine luyakuhlala esihlalweni sobukhosi sika-Israyeli.”
Kepha uJehu akakuqaphelanga ukuhamba emthethweni kaSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli ngayo yonke inhliziyo yakhe, futhi akayekanga ukwenza izono ezazenziwa nguJerobhowamu onisa ngazo u-Israyeli.
Ngalezo zinsuku uSimakade waqala ukunciphisa elakwa-Israyeli. UHazayeli walinqoba lonke izwe lakwa-Israyeli,
kusukela eJordani ngasempumalanga, lonke izwe lakwaGileyadi, lakwaGadi, lakwaRubeni, nalakwaManase, kusukela e-Aroweri elingasemfuleni i-Arinoni, kwaGileyadi naseBhashani.
Ezinye izindaba zikaJehu, nakho konke akwenzayo, nawo wonke amandla akhe, akulotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwa-Israyeli na?
UJehu walaliswa nokhokho bakhe, bammbela kwabakubo eSamariya. UJehowahazi, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Isikhathi uJehu abusa ngaso kwa-Israyeli, eSamariya, kwaba yiminyaka engama-28.
Kwathi ukuba u-Athaliya, unina ka-Ahaziya, abone ukuthi indodana yakhe ifile, waqala ukubhubhisa bonke abasebukhosini.

Kepha uJehoshebha, indodakazi yenkosi uJoramu, udadewabo ka-Ahaziya, wathatha uJowashi, indodana ka-Ahaziya. Wameba phakathi kwamadodana enkosi ayezobulawa, wamfihla nomzanyana wakhe ekamelweni. Wamfihla kanjalo ku-Athaliya ukuze angabulawa.
UJowashi wahlala efihlwe lapho endlini kaSimakade iminyaka eyisithupha, ngesikhathi izwe libuswa ngu-Athaliya.

Ngonyaka wesikhombisa, uJehoyada wathumela walanda izinduna zamakhulu zamaKharithe nezabalindi, wazingenisa kuye endlini kaSimakade. Wenza isivumelwano nazo, wazifungisa zisendlini kaSimakade, wayesezibonisa indodana yenkosi.
Waziyala wathi: “Nansi into okumele niyenze: ingxenye eyodwa kokuthathu yenu engena ngesabatha iyakuba ngabalindi bendlu yenkosi,
enye ingxenye yokuthathu yenu ibe sesangweni eZuri, enye ingxenye yokuthathu yenu ibe sesangweni emva kwabalindi, niyilinde nokuyilinda indlu ngokudedelana.
Amaviyo enu amabili abo bonke labo abaphuma ngesabatha, ayakulinda indlu kaSimakade enkosini.
Niyakuyizungeza inkosi nxazonke, yilowo nalowo ephethe izikhali zakhe ngesandla. Oyongena phakathi kwezinhla uyakubulawa; yibani nenkosi lapho iphuma nalapho ingena.”
Izinduna zamakhulu zenza njengalokhu uJehoyada, umphristi, eziyalile. Kwaba yileyo naleyo yathatha amabutho ayo abezongena ngesabatha nalawo ayezophuma ngalo, zeza nawo kuJehoyada, umphristi.
Umphristi wanika izinduna zamakhulu imikhonto namahawu okwakungokwenkosi uDavide, okwakusendlini kaSimakade.
Abalindi bema, bayingunga inkosi, kuyilowo nalowo ephethe izikhali zakhe ngesandla; kusukela ohlangothini lwakwesokunene lwendlu kuze kube kolwakwesokhohlo lwayo, nxazonke ze-althare, nendlu.
UJehoyada wayeseyikhipha indodana yenkosi, wayethwesa umqhele, wayinika ubufakazi, base beyibeka ukuba ibe yinkosi, bayigcoba, bashaya ihlombe behalalisa, bethi: “Mana njalo, nkosi!”
U-Athaliya wezwa umsindo wabalindi nowabantu, wayeseya kubantu endlini kaSimakade,

wabona inkosi imi ngasensikeni njengokusho komthetho. Izikhulu nabamacilongo babengakuyo, bonke abantu bahlala ezweni bethokozile, beshaya amacilongo. U-Athaliya waklebhula izingubo zakhe, wamemeza, wathi: “Wugobe! Wugobe!”

UJehoyada, umphristi, wayala izinduna zamakhulu nezikhulu ezaziphethe impi, wathi kuzo: “Mkhipheleni phandle kwendlu, nimfake phakathi kwezinhla. Omlandelayo nimbulale ngenkemba. Umphristi wathi: ‘Makangabulawelwa endlini kaSimakade.’ ”
Bamdedela nxazombili, wayesehamba ngendlela okungena ngayo amahhashi endlini yenkosi; wabulawelwa lapho.
UJehoyada wenza isivumelwano phakathi kukaSimakade nenkosi nabantu, sokuba ngabantu bakaSimakade. Wenza futhi isivumelwano phakathi kwenkosi nabantu.

Bonke abantu abahlala ezweni baya endlini kaBhali, bayibhidliza, ama-althare ayo nezithombe zayo bakuphahlaza kwaba yizicucu, babulala uMathani, umphristi kaBhali, phambi kwama-althare. Umphristi wabeka abalindi endlini kaSimakade.

Wayeseqoqa izinduna zamakhulu, amaKharithe, abalindi, nabo bonke abantu bezwe, bayithatha inkosi bayehlisa isuka endlini yesango labalindi esigodlweni, ngendlela yesango labalindi. Yafike yahlala esihlalweni sobukhosi.
Abantu bonke bezwe bathokoza kakhulu, umuzi waba nokuthula. U-Athaliya babembulele ngenkemba esigodlweni.
UJehowashi wayeneminyaka eyisikhombisa ngesikhathi eqala ukubusa.
Ngonyaka wesikhombisa kaJehu, uJehowashi waba yinkosi; wabusa eJerusalema iminyaka engama-40. Igama likanina kwakunguSibhiya waseBheri Sheba.
UJehowashi wenza okulungile emehlweni kaSimakade izinsuku zonke zakhe, ngesikhathi uJehoyada umphristi emyala.
Kepha-ke akazisusanga izindawo eziphakemeyo; abantu babesalokhu behlaba, beshisa nempepho kuzo.

UJehowashi wathi kubaphristi: “Lonke isiliva lezinto ezingcwele elilethwa endlini kaSimakade, imali eyamukelwayo, imali yilowo nalowo muntu anqunyelwe yona, yonke imali umuntu ayinikela ngokwenhliziyo yakhe endlini kaSimakade,
makuthathwe ngabaphristi. Makube yilowo nalowo akuthathe kumakhelwane wakhe, yikho abazolungisa ngakho izimfa zendlu, kuyo yonke indawo lapho kutholakala khona ufa.”
Kodwa nangonyaka wama-23 wokubusa kwenkosi uJehowashi, abaphristi babengakazilungisi izimfa zendlu.

Inkosi uJehowashi yabiza uJehoyada, umphristi, nabanye abaphristi, yathi kubo: “Kungani kuze kube manje izimfa zendlu zingalungisiwe na? Ngakho-ke ningabe nisayithatha imali kwabasondelene nani, kodwa niyinikelele izimfa zendlu.”
Abaphristi bavuma ukuthi abasezukuyithatha imali evela kubantu, futhi abasezukuzilungisa izimfa endlini.

UJehoyada, umphristi, wathatha ibhokisi, wabhoboza imbobo esivalweni salo, walibeka ngase-althare ngakwesokunene ukuze lapho umuntu engena endlini kaSimakade, abaphristi abalinda umbundu bayifake khona yonke imali eyayilethwa endlini kaSimakade.
Kwathi ukuba babone ukuthi seyiyiningi imali ebhokisini, kwase kwenyuka umbhali wenkosi nomphristi omkhulu, bayibopha base beyibala imali eyayitholakele endlini kaSimakade.
Imali ababeyilinganisile bayinika abasebenza ukuqapha indlu kaSimakade, bona base beholela ngayo ababesebenza lapho, babuye bakhokhela ababazi nabakhi ababesebenza khona.
Baholela ababakha ngamatshe, ababebaza amatshe, nokuba kuthengwe izigxobo namatshe abaziweyo ukuze kulungiswe izimfa endlini kaSimakade, nakho konke okwathengwa ukuba kulungiswe ngakho indlu.
Imali eyayilethwe endlini kaSimakade ayisetshenziselwanga ukwenza izindebe zesiliva, izizenze, izitsha, amacilongo, zonke izinto zegolide nezinto zesiliva,
ngokuba yanikwa ababesebenza, kwalungiswa ngayo indlu kaSimakade.
Ababengamele ukusetshenziswa kwemali lokho babekwenza ngokwethembeka; abazange bachaze kubantu ukuthi imali bayisebenzisa kanjani ukuholela abasebenzayo.
Imali yeminikelo yamacala neyeminikelo yezono, yayingeniswa endlini kaSimakade ngokuba yayingeyabaphristi.
Kwase kusuka uHazayeli, inkosi yase-Aramu, walwa neGathi, walinqoba. UHazayeli wayesebhekisa amabombo eJerusalema.

UJehowashi, inkosi yakwaJuda, wathatha zonke izinto ezingcwele ezazingcweliswe nguJehoshafathi, uJehoramu no-Ahaziya, okhokho bakhe ababengamakhosi akwaJuda, nazo zonke izinto zakhe ezingcwele nalo lonke igolide elatholakala engcebeni yendlu kaSimakade nasesigodlweni, wakuthumela kuHazayeli, inkosi yase-Aramu. UHazayeli wayesesuka eJerusalema.
Ezinye izindaba zikaJowashi, nakho konke akwenzayo, akulotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwaJuda na?
Izinceku zakhe zenza ugobe, zambulala uJowashi esendlini eMilo, uma wehla ubheke eSila.
Wabulawa yizinceku zakhe uJozakhari, indodana kaShimeyathi, noJehozabhadi, indodana kaShomeri, wembelwa nokhokho bakhe emzini kaDavide. U-Amaziya, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngonyaka wama-23 wokubusa kukaJowashi, indodana ka-Ahaziya, inkosi yakwaJuda, uJehowahazi, indodana kaJehu, waba yinkosi kwa-Israyeli, wabusa eSamariya iminyaka eli-17.
Wenza okubi phambi kukaSimakade, wenza izono ezenziwa nguJerobhowamu, indodana kaNebhathi, onisa ngazo u-Israyeli; akachezukanga kuzo.
Intukuthelo kaSimakade yamvuthela u-Israyeli, wayesemnikela esandleni sikaHazayeli, inkosi yase-Aramu, nasesandleni sikaBheni Hadadi, indodana yakhe, sonke leso sikhathi.
UJehowahazi wamnxusa uSimakade, uSimakade wamuzwa. USimakade wabona ingcindezelo inkosi yase-Aramu eyayicindezele ngayo u-Israyeli.
USimakade wanika u-Israyeli umkhululi; base bekhululeka phansi kwesandla sama-Aramu, abantu bakwa-Israyeli bahlala emathendeni abo njengakuqala.
Nokho abaphendukanga ezonweni zendlu kaJerobhowamu onisa ngazo u-Israyeli; bahamba ngazo, u-Ashera abaze bamsusa eSamariya.

Akashiyanga muntu kuJehowahazi, kuphela impi eyayingevile kwabamahhashi abangama-50, izinqola zempi ezilishumi namabutho ahamba ngezinyawo ayizi-10 000, ngokuba inkosi yase-Aramu yayibaqothe bafana nothuli esibhulweni.
Ezinye izindaba zikaJehowahazi, nakho konke akwenzayo, namandla akhe, akulotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwa-Israyeli na?
UJehowahazi walaliswa kokhokho bakhe, wembelwa kwabakubo eSamariya, uJowashi waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngonyaka wama-37 wokubusa kukaJowashi, inkosi yakwaJuda, uJehowashi, indodana kaJehowahazi, waba yinkosi kwa-Israyeli eSamariya; wabusa iminyaka eli-16.
Wenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, akachezukanga kuzo zonke izono zikaJerobhowamu, indodana kaNebhathi, onisa ngazo u-Israyeli, wahamba kuzo.
Ezinye izindaba zikaJowashi, nakho konke akwenzayo, namandla akhe alwa ngawo no-Amaziya, inkosi yakwaJuda, akulotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwa-Israyeli na?
UJowashi walaliswa kokhokho bakhe; uJerobhowamu wahlala esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi; uJowashi wembelwa eSamariya namakhosi akwa-Israyeli.
U-Elisha wagula ngesifo esagcina simthathile. UJowashi, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, wehla waya kuye, wakhala kakhulu, wathi: “Baba, Baba, inqola ka-Israyeli nabamahhashi bakhe!”
U-Elisha wathi kuye: “Thatha umnsalo nemicibisholo.” Wayesekuthatha-ke.
U-Elisha wathi enkosini yakwa-Israyeli: “Beka-ke isandla sakho emnsalweni.” Wenza kanjalo, wawubamba ngesandla sakhe. U-Elisha wayesebeka isandla sakhe phezu kwezandla zenkosi.

Wathi kuyo: “Vula ifasitela elingasempumalanga.” Yalivula. U-Elisha wathi: “Ciba,” yayisiwuciba. Wayesethi u-Elisha kuyo: “Lo ngumcibisholo kaSimakade wokunqoba, ngumcibisholo ozonenza ninqobe kuma-Aramu, ngokuba uyakuwabulala ama-Aramu, uwaqede e-Afeki.”
Wayesethi: “Thatha imicibisholo.” Yayithatha-ke. Wathi enkosini yakwa-Israyeli: “Shaya emhlabathini.” Yashaya kathathu, yayeka.
Umuntu kaNkulunkulu wayithukuthelela inkosi, wathi: “Ukuba ubushaye kahlanu noma kayisithupha, i-Aramu ubuzolehlula uliqede nya, kodwa manje uyakulehlula kathathu kuphela.”
U-Elisha wafa, bammbela. Kwakuthi ngokwethwasa konyaka, izwe lihlaselwe ngamaviyo akwaMowabi.
Kwathi-ke besambela umuntu othile; bheka, babona iviyo liza; bamlahla lowo muntu ethuneni lika-Elisha. Kwathi lapho isidumbu sakhe sithinta amathambo ka-Elisha, waphila, wema ngezinyawo zakhe.
Kepha uHazayeli, inkosi yase-Aramu, yayimcindezele u-Israyeli zonke izinsuku zikaJehowahazi.
USimakade wayenomusa kubo; wayenesihe kubo, waphendukela kubo ngenxa yesivumelwano sakhe no-Abhrahama, no-Isaka noJakobe, akathandanga ukubabhubhisa, futhi akabalahlanga ebusweni bakhe.
UHazayeli, inkosi yase-Aramu, wafa; uBheni Hadadi, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.

UJehowashi, indodana kaJehowahazi, wamephuca uBheni Hadadi, indodana kaHazayeli, leyo mizi ayekade eyidle empini kusabusa uyise, uJehowahazi. UJowashi wamehlula kwaze kwaba kathathu, wayibuyisa imizi yakwa-Israyeli.
Ngonyaka wesibili wokubusa kukaJowashi, indodana kaJehowahazi, kwa-Israyeli, u-Amaziya, indodana kaJowashi, inkosi yakwaJuda, waba yinkosi.
Wayeneminyaka engama-25 ngesikhathi eqala ukubusa, wabusa iminyaka engama-29 eJerusalema. Igama likanina kwakunguJehoyadini waseJerusalema.
Wenza okuhle emehlweni kaSimakade, nokho akazange afane nokhokho wakhe uDavide. Kukho konke ukwenza kwakhe, wenza njengalokho kwenza uyise uJowashi.
Akazibhidlizanga izindawo eziphakemeyo abantu ababenikela benze imihlatshelo kuzo.
Kwathi lapho umbuso usuzinzile esandleni sakhe, wabulala izinceku ezazibulale uyise, inkosi.

Kepha akawabulalanga amadodana ababulali, njengalokhu kulotshiwe encwadini yomthetho kaMose; ngokomyalo kaSimakade, othi: “Abazali abayukubulawa ngenxa yabantwana, nabantwana abayukubulawa ngenxa yabazali, kodwa yilowo nalowo uyobulawelwa izono zakhe.”
Wabulala izi-10 000 zabakwa-Edomi eSigodini Sikasawoti, wadla iSela; wayeseliqamba kabusha ethi yiJokitheyeli, okuyigama lalo kuze kube namuhla.
U-Amaziya wathumela izithunywa kuJehowashi, indodana kaJehowahazi kaJehu, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, wathi: “Woza sibukane mahlanze.”

UJehowashi, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, yathumela ku-Amaziya, inkosi yakwaJuda, ithi: “Isihlahla somkhaya eLebhanoni sathumela kwesomsedari naso esiseLebhanoni, sathi kuso: ‘Ganisela indodana yami, indodakazi yakho, ibe ngumkayo.’ “Kwase kwedlula isilwane sasendle eLebhanoni, sasifihliza isihlahla somkhaya.
Umnqobile impela u-Edomi; inhliziyo yakho isiqhoshile; dumiseka ngalokho, uhlale ekhaya. Kungani ufuna uthuthuva, bese uwa, wena noJuda wonkana na?”
Kepha u-Amaziya akalalelanga. UJehowashi, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, wenyuka, base betholana phezulu no-Amaziya, inkosi yakwaJuda, eBhethi Shemeshi lakwaJuda.
UJuda wanqotshwa ngu-Israyeli; babaleka, kwaba yilowo nalowo waya ethendeni lakhe.

UJehowashi, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, yambamba u-Amaziya, inkosi yakwaJuda, indodana kaJehowashi ka-Ahaziya, eBhethi Shemeshi. UJehowashi weza eJerusalema, wabhidliza ugange lwakhona kusukela esangweni kwa-Efrayimi kuze kube sesangweni iGumbi; kwaba yisikhala esingamakhubhithi angama-400.
Waphanga lonke igolide, isiliva, nazo zonke izitsha azithola endlini kaSimakade nasengcebeni yesigodlo senkosi kanye nababeyisibambiso, wayesebuyela eSamariya.
Ezinye izindaba zikaJehowashi azenzayo, amandla akhe, impi yakhe no-Amasiya inkosi yakwaJuda, akulotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwa-Israyeli na?
UJehowashi walaliswa kokhokho bakhe, wembelwa eSamariya namakhosi akwa-Israyeli; uJerobhowamu, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
U-Amaziya, indodana kaJowashi, inkosi yakwaJuda, waphila iminyaka eli-15 emva kokukhothama kukaJehowashi, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli.
Ezinye izindaba zika-Amaziya azilotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwaJuda na?
Abantu bamakhela uzungu eJerusalema, wayesebalekela eLakhishi, kodwa bathumela eLakhishi emva kwakhe, bambulalela khona.
Bamthwala ngamahhashi, wembelwa kokhokho bakhe, eJerusalema emzini kaDavide.
Bonke abantu bakwaJuda bathatha u-Azariya owayeneminyaka eli-16, bambeka waba yinkosi esikhundleni sikayise, u-Amaziya.
Wakha kabusha i-Elathi, wayeselibuyisela kuJuda emva kokuba inkosi isingcwatshwe kokhokho bayo.
Ngonyaka we-15 wokubusa kuka-Amaziya, indodana kaJowashi, inkosi yakwaJuda, uJerobhowamu, indodana kaJowashi, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, waba yinkosi kwa-Israyeli eSamariya; wabusa iminyaka engama-41.
Wenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, akazange asuke nakwesisodwa sezono zikaJerobhowamu, indodana kaNebhathi, onisa ngazo u-Israyeli.

Wabuyisela umngcele wakwa-Israyeli kusuka eLibho Hamathi kuze kube solwandle i-Araba, njengokusho kwezwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli alikhuluma ngomlomo wenceku yakhe, uJona, indodana ka-Amithayi, umphrofethi waseGathi Heferi.
USimakade wakubona ukuhlupheka kuka-Israyeli, kwamunyu kakhulu, abancane nabakhulu baphela amandla; kwakungekho ongamsiza u-Israyeli.
USimakade wayengashongo yini ukuthi uyakwesula igama lika-Israyeli phansi kwezulu, kodwa wabasindisa ngesandla sikaJerobhowamu, indodana kaJowashi na?

Ezinye izindaba zikaJerobhowamu, nakho konke akwenzayo, namandla akhe, nokulwa kwakhe, nokubuyisela kwakhe ku-Israyeli iDamaseku neHamathi elalingelakwaJuda, akulotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwa-Israyeli na?
UJerobhowamu walaliswa kokhokho bakhe, amakhosi abakwa-Israyeli; uZakhariya waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Kwathi ngonyaka wama-27 wokubusa kukaJerobhowamu, inkosi ka-Israyeli, u-Azariya, indodana ka-Amaziya, inkosi yakwaJuda, waba yinkosi kwaJuda.
Wayeneminyaka eli-16 ngesikhathi eqala ukubusa. Wabusa iminyaka engama-52 eJerusalema. Igama likanina kwakunguJekholiya waseJerusalema.
Wenza okulungile emehlweni kaSimakade njengalokhu kwenza uyise, u-Amaziya.
Kepha izindawo eziphakemeyo azisuswanga, abantu babesalokhu behlaba khona, beshisa impepho kuzo.
USimakade wayishaya ngesifo sochoko inkosi kwaze kwaba sekukhothameni kwayo; yayihlala endlini eqhelile kwezinye. UJothamu, indodana yenkosi, wayengamele umuzi, ehlulela abantu bezwe.
Ezinye izindaba zika-Azariya, nakho konke akwenzayo, akulotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwaJuda na?
U-Azariya walaliswa kokhokho bakhe, bammbela kokhokho bakhe emzini kaDavide. UJothamu, indodana ka-Azariya, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngonyaka wama-38 wokubusa kuka-Azariya, inkosi kwaJuda, uZakhariya, indodana kaJerobhowamu, waba yinkosi kwa-Israyeli, eSamariya, izinyanga eziyisithupha.
Wenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade njengoba kwenza okhokho bakhe, akachezukanga ekwenzeni izono ezazenziwa nguJerobhowamu, indodana kaNebhathi, onisa ngazo u-Israyeli.
UShalumi, indodana kaJabheshi, wamakhela uzungu wambulala phambi kwabantu, wayeseba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Ezinye izindaba zikaZakariya azilotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwa-Israyeli na?
Yilelo izwi likaSimakade alikhuluma kuJehu, wathi: “Amadodana akho, kuze kube sesizukulwaneni sesine, ayakuhlala esihlalweni sakwa-Israyeli.” Kwaba kanjalo.
UShalumi, indodana kaJabheshi, waba yinkosi ngonyaka wama-39 wokubusa kuka-Uziya, inkosi yakwaJuda, wabusa inyanga yaba yinye vo, eSamariya.
UMenahemu, indodana kaGadi, wenyukela eThiriza; wafika eSamariya wabulala uShalumi, indodana kaJabheshi, wayesebusa esikhundleni sakhe.
Ezinye izindaba zikaShalumi, nogobe lwakhe alwenzayo kulotshiwe ngazo encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwa-Israyeli.
Ngaleso sikhathi, uMenahemu wabhubhisa iThifisa nakho konke okwakukulo, izifunda zalo kusuka eThiriza, ngokuba abazange bamvumele. Walibhubhisa, waqhaqha bonke abesifazane ababekhulelwe.
Ngonyaka wama-39 wokubusa kuka-Azariya, inkosi kwaJuda, uMenahemu, indodana kaGadi, waba yinkosi kwa-Israyeli, wabusa iminyaka elishumi eSamariya.
Wenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, akachezukanga, zonke izinsuku zakhe, ezonweni zikaJerobhowamu, indodana kaNebhathi, onisa ngazo u-Israyeli.
Kwase kufika uPhuli, inkosi yase-Asiriya, ukuzohlasela izwe. UMenahemu wamnika uPhuli amathalenta ayinkulungwane esiliva, ukuze amsize ukuqinisa umbuso esandleni sakhe.

UMenahemu wakhokhisa u-Israyeli nabo bonke abantu ababecebile, imali, umuntu ngamunye wayekhipha amashekeli angama-50 ukuze awanike inkosi yase-Asiriya. Inkosi yase-Asiriya yayisibuyela kwelakubo, ayabe isahlala ezweni.
Ezinye izindaba zikaMenahemu, nakho konke akwenzayo, akulotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwa-Israyeli na?
UMenahemu walaliswa kokhokho bakhe; uPhekhaya, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngonyaka wama-50 wokubusa kuka-Azariya, inkosi yakwaJuda, uPhekhaya, indodana kaMenahemu, waba yinkosi kwa-Israyeli, eSamariya; wabusa iminyaka emibili.
Wenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, akachezukanga ezonweni zikaJerobhowamu, indodana kaNebhathi, onisa ngazo u-Israyeli.
UPheka, indodana kaRemaliya, umkhuzi wempi yakhe, wamakhela uzungu ekanye nabangama-50 bakwaGileyadi. Bambulala eSamariya esenqabeni yesigodlo no-Arigobhi no-Ariye, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Ezinye izindaba zikaPhekhaya nakho konke akwenzayo, kulotshiwe encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwa-Israyeli.
Ngonyaka wama-52 wokubusa kuka-Azariya, inkosi yakwaJuda, uPheka, indodana kaRemaliya, waba yinkosi kwa-Israyeli, wabusa iminyaka engama-20 eSamariya.
Wenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, akachezukanga ezonweni zikaJerobhowamu, indodana kaNebhathi, onisa ngazo u-Israyeli.

Ngezinsuku zenkosi uPheka kwa-Israyeli, uThigilathi Phileseri, inkosi yase-Asiriya, wahlasela, wadla i-Ijoni, i-Abhela Bhethi Mahakha, iJanowa, iKedeshi, iHazori, iGileyadi, iGalile nalo lonke izwe lakwaNafethali, wabathumba, wabayisa e-Asiriya.
UHosheya, indodana ka-Ela, wamakhela uzungu uPheka, indodana kaRemaliya, wamhlasela, wambulala, wayeseba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe; kwakungunyaka wama-20 wokubusa kukaJothamu, indodana ka-Uziya.
Ezinye izindaba zikaPheka nakho konke akwenzayo, kulotshiwe encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwa-Israyeli.
Ngonyaka wesibili wokubusa kukaPheka, indodana kaRemaliya, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, uJothamu, indodana ka-Uziya, waba yinkosi yakwaJuda.
Wayeneminyaka engama-25 ngesikhathi eqala ukubusa, wabusa iminyaka eli-16 eJerusalema. Igama likanina kwakunguJerusha, indodakazi kaZadoki.
Wenza okulungileyo emehlweni kaSimakade, wenza njengakho konke ayekwenzile uyise u-Uziya.
Nokho izindawo eziphakemeyo azisuswanga; abantu babesahlaba, beshisa impepho ezindaweni eziphakemeyo. Wakha isango elingenhla endlini kaSimakade.
Ezinye izindaba zikaJothamu, nakho konke akwenzayo, akulotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwaJuda na?
Ngalezo zinsuku uSimakade wathumela kwaJuda, uRezini, inkosi yase-Aramu, noPheka, indodana kaRemaliya.
UJothamu walalaliswa kokhokho bakhe, wembelwa kokhokho bakhe emzini kaDavide. U-Ahazi, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngonyaka we-17 wokubusa kukaPheka, indodana kaRemaliya, u-Ahazi, indodana kaJothamu, waba yinkosi kwaJuda.
Wayeneminyaka engama-20, ngesikhathi eqala ukubusa. Wabusa iminyaka eli-16 eJerusalema. Akakwenzanga okulungile phambi kukaSimakade, uNkulunkulu wakhe, njengoDavide, ukhokho wakhe.
Kepha wahamba ngendlela yamakhosi akwa-Israyeli, waze wadabulisa nendodana yakhe emlilweni, njengezinengiso zabezizwe uSimakade abaxosha phambi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli.
Wahlaba, washisa nempepho ezindaweni eziphakemeyo, emagqumeni naphansi kwazo zonke izihlahla eziluhlaza.
Ngaso leso sikhathi kwakhuphuka uRezini, inkosi yase-Aramu, noPheka, indodana kaRemaliya, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, bahlasela iJerusalema. Bamvimbezela u-Ahazi, kodwa abakwazanga ukumnqoba.
Ngaleso sikhathi uRezini, inkosi yase-Aramu, wabuyisela i-Elathi e-Aramu, wabaxosha abaJuda e-Elathi, kwase kufika ama-Aramu nabakwa-Edomi bahlala kulo kuze kube namuhla.

U-Ahazi wathumela izithunywa kuThigilathi Phileseri, inkosi yase-Asiriya, wathi: “Mina ngiyinceku yakho nendodana yakho; khuphuka ungisindise esandleni senkosi yase-Aramu, nasesandleni senkosi yakwa-Israyeli, abangivukele.”
U-Ahazi wathatha isiliva negolide alithola endlini kaSimakade nasengcebeni yesigodlo, walithumela enkosini yase-Asiriya, laba yisipho sayo.
Inkosi yase-Asiriya yamlalela; yakhuphuka yayohlasela iDamaseku, yalidla, yathumba abantu bakhona, yabasa eKhiri, yambulala uRezini.

Inkosi u-Ahazi yaya eDamaseku yayohlangabeza uThigilathi Phileseri, inkosi yase-Asiriya, yabona i-althare elaliseDamaseku. Inkosi u-Ahazi yathumela ku-Uriya, umphristi, imtshela nge-althare, isimo salo, nokuthi injani indlela elenziwe ngayo, nakho konke okwakukulo.
U-Uriya, umphristi, walakha i-althare njengokwemiyalelo yenkosi u-Ahazi eyayimthumelele yona iseDamaseku, yaze yabuya inkosi u-Ahazi eDamaseku.
Inkosi isibuyile eDamaseku, yalibona i-althare, yasondela kulo, yanikela kulo.
Yashisa umnikelo wayo wokushiswa, nomnikelo wayo wempuphu, yathulula umnikelo wayo wokuphuzwayo, yafafaza igazi leminikelo yokuthula e-althare.
Kepha i-althare lethusi elaliphambi kukaSimakade, yalisusa phambi kwendlu naphakathi kwe-althare nendlu kaSimakade, yalibeka ohlangothini olungasenyakatho lwe-althare layo.

Inkosi u-Ahazi yamyala u-Uriya, umphristi, yathi: “E-althare elikhulu shisa umnikelo wokushiswa wasekuseni, umnikelo wokusanhlamvu wakusihlwa, umnikelo wokushiswa wenkosi, nomnikelo wayo wokusanhlamvu nomnikelo wokushiswa wabo bonke abantu abasezweni: umnikelo wabo wokusanhlamvu, neminikelo yabo yokuphuzwayo. Ulifafaze ngalo lonke igazi lomnikelo wokushiswa, nalo lonke igazi lomhlatshelo, kodwa i-althare lethusi lizokuba ngelami, ukubuza izinto kulo.”
U-Uriya, umphristi, wenza konke njengokuyala kwenkosi u-Ahazi.
Inkosi yazinquma izisekelo zezinqe, yawususa umcengezi wokugezela, ulwandle olwaluphezu kwezinkabi zethusi yalwehlisa, yalubeka endaweni eyayigandaywe ngamatshe.
Indlela esibekelweyo yesabatha eyayakhiwe ngaphakathi esigodlweni, nendlela yangaphandle inkosi eyayingena ngayo, yakususa endlini kaSimakade; ngenxa yenkosi yase-Asiriya.
Ezinye izindaba zika-Ahazi azenzayo, azilotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwaJuda na?
U-Ahazi walalaliswa kokhokho bakhe, wembelwa kokhokho bakhe emzini kaDavide. UHezekiya, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngonyaka we-12 wokubusa kuka-Ahazi inkosi yakwaJuda, uHosheya, indodana ka-Ela, waba yinkosi kwa-Israyeli; wabusa iminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye.
Wenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, noma yena engafananga namakhosi akwa-Israyeli ayemendulele.
UShalimenazeri, inkosi yase-Asiriya, wenyuka ukuba amhlasele. UHosheya waba yisikhonzi sakhe, wathumela kuye intela.

Inkosi yase-Asiriya yezwa ngozungu uHosheya ayeselwakhele yona, ngokuba wayethumele izithunywa kuSo, inkosi yaseGibhithe, futhi engayilethanga intela enkosini yase-Asiriya, ayeyithela minyaka yonke, ngakho-ke inkosi yase-Asiriya yambopha, yamvalela ejele.
Inkosi yase-Asiriya yenyuka yadabula izwe lonke, yenyukela naseSamariya, yalivimbezela iminyaka emithathu.
Ngonyaka wesishiyagalolunye wokubusa kukaHosheya, inkosi yase-Asiriya, yalinqoba iSamariya, yathumba u-Israyeli, yamyisa e-Asiriya, yambeka eHala, eHabhori ngasemfuleni iGozani nasemizini yamaMede.
Kwaba kanjalo kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, ngokuba babonile kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo owayebakhuphule eGibhithe, phansi kwesandla sikaFaro, inkosi yakhona, besaba abanye onkulunkulu.
Base behamba ngezimiso zabezizwe uSimakade ayebaxoshile phambi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli, nangezimiso zamakhosi akwa-Israyeli azimisayo.

Abakwa-Israyeli babenza ngasese izinto ezingalungile phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo; bazakhela izindawo eziphakemeyo emizini yabo yonke, kusukela embhoshongweni wabalindi, kuze kube semizini ebiyelweyo.
Bazigxumekela izinsika zo-Ashera emagqumeni wonke aphakemeyo, naphansi kwazo zonke izihlahla eziluhlaza.
Bashisa impepho ezindaweni zonke eziphakemeyo njengalokhu kwakwenza abezizwe uSimakade ayebaxoshile phambi kwabo. Benza izinto ezimbi, baluchukuluza ulaka lukaSimakade.
Bakhonza izithombe uSimakade ayebatshelile ngazo, wathi: “Aniyukuyenza into enjalo.”

Nokho uSimakade wayemxwayisile u-Israyeli noJuda ngomlomo wabo bonke abaphrofethi nababoni, wathi: “Phendukani ezindleleni zenu ezimbi, nigcine imiyalo yami nezimiso zami, nenze wonke umthetho engabayala ngawo okhokho benu, nengawuthumela kini ngomlomo wezinceku zami, abaphrofethi.”
Kepha abamlalelanga, benza lukhuni izinhliziyo zabo, njengokhokho babo abangazange bamethembe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo.

Badelela izimiso zakhe, isivumelwano sakhe asenza nokhokho babo nezexwayiso ayebaxwayisa ngazo, balandela okuyize. Benza okuyize, baba yize njengezizwe abazilandelayo ezazibazungezile, uSimakade ayebayale ukuba bangenzi njengazo.
Bayishiya yonke imiyalo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo, bazenzela izithombe ezibunjiweyo, amathole amabili, benza nezigxobo zika-Ashera, bakhuleka kulo lonke ibandla lasezulwini, bakhonza uBhali.
Badabulisa amadodana namadodakazi abo emlilweni, babhula, benza imilingo, bazithengisela ukwenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, ukuchukuluza ulaka lwakhe.
Yingakho nje uSimakade wamthukuthelela kakhulu u-Israyeli, wamsusa phambi kwakhe, akwaze kwasala muntu, ngaphandle kwesizwe sakwaJuda kuphela.
UJuda naye akayigcinanga imiyalo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakhe, kunalokho wahamba njengalokhu kwenza u-Israyeli.
USimakade wabafulathela bonke abozalo luka-Israyeli, wabahlupha, wabanikela esandleni sabaphangi, waze wabalahla ebusweni bakhe.
USimakade wehlukanisa u-Israyeli nendlu kaDavide. UJerobhowamu, indodana kaNebhathi, bambeka waba yinkosi, nokho wahlubukisa u-Israyeli, akabe esalandela uSimakade, wamonisa ngesono esikhulu.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli benza zonke izono zikaJerobhowamu, abaze basuka kuzo.
USimakade waze wamsusa u-Israyeli ebusweni bakhe, njangalokhu ayeshilo ngomlomo wabaphrofethi bakhe. U-Israyeli waya ekuthunjweni, e-Asiriya, wasuka kwelakubo kuze kube namuhla.
Inkosi yase-Asiriya yalanda abantu eBhabhele, eKhutha, e-Ava, eHamathi, naseSafarivayimi, yabahlalisa emizini eSamariya endaweni yabakwa-Israyeli, balidla iSamariya, bahlala emizini yakhona.
Kwathi beqala nje ukuhlala lapho, abaze bamesaba uSimakade, ngakho-ke uSimakade wathumela phakathi kwabo amabhubesi, abulala abanye babo.

Base bethi enkosini yase-Asiriya: “Abezizwe obathumbile wabahlalisa emizini eSamariya, abawazi umthetho kankulunkulu wezwe, yingakho ebathumelele amabhubesi; uyabona-ke, ayababulala, ngoba abawazi umthetho kankulunkulu wezwe.”
Inkosi yase-Asiriya yayisiyala, ithi: “Thathani omunye wabaphristi abathunjiweyo, ahambe ayohlala eSamariya, ukuze abafundise umthetho kankulunkulu wezwe.”
Omunye wabaphristi ababethunjwe eSamariya, wabuya, wahlala eBhethele, wabafundisa ukumesaba uSimakade.
Kepha zonke izizwe zazenzela onkulunkulu bazo, zababeka ezindlini ezindaweni eziphakemeyo ezazenziwe ngamaSamariya, kwaba yileso naleso sizwe, emizini esasihlezi kuyo.
Abantu baseBhabhele benza uSukhothi Bhenothi, abaseKhutha benza uNerigali, abaseHamathi benza u-Ashima,
ama-Avi enza uNibhihazi noTharithaki, amaSefarivayimi ashisa abantwana bawo emlilweni ka-Adirameleki no-Anameleki, okwakungonkulunkulu baseSefarivayimi.
Nokho babemkhonza noSimakade, nakuba babezenzela abaphristi phakathi kwabo, babesezindaweni eziphakemeyo ababehlabela kuzo, ezindlini eziphakemeyo ababezakhile.
Bamesaba uSimakade, baqhubeka nokukhonza onkulunkulu babo njengomthetho wezizwe ababethunjwe phakathi kwazo.

Kuze kube namuhla basenza imikhuba yabo yakuqala. Abamesabi uSimakade, abazilandeli izimiso zakhe, izehlulelo, imithetho, nemiyalelo uSimakade ayala ngakho abantwana bakaJakobe, amqamba igama wathi ngu-Israyeli.
USimakade wayenze no-Israyeli isivumelwano, wabayala, wathi: “Aniyukwesaba abanye onkulunkulu, aniyukubakhothamela, aniyukubakhonza, aniyukubahlabela.
Kepha uSimakade owanikhuphula eGibhithe ngamandla amakhulu, nangengalo enamandla, niyokwesaba Yena kuphela, nimkhothamele, nimhlabele.
Niyogcina zonke izimiso, izehlulelo, umthetho, nemiyalo anilobela khona, futhi niyoqikelela ukuba nikwenze. Ningabesabi abanye onkulunkulu.
Ningasikhohlwa isivumelwano engasenza nani, ningabesabi abanye onkulunkulu.
Kepha niyokwesaba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, Yena uyakunisindisa esandleni sazo zonke izitha zenu.”
Kepha abazange balalele, baqhubeka benza njengokwemithetho yabo yakuqala.
Lezi zizwe zesaba uSimakade, kodwa zakhonza izithombe zazo ezibaziweyo, kanjalo nabantwana bazo, nabantwana babantwana bazo; njengalokhu benzile oyise, zenza kanjalo nazo kuze kube namuhla.
Kwathi ngonyaka wesithathu wokubusa kukaHosheya, indodana ka-Ela, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, uHezekiya, indodana ka-Ahazi, inkosi yakwaJuda, waba yinkosi.
Wayeneminyaka engama-25 lapho eba yinkosi. Wabusa eJerusalema iminyaka engama-29. Igama likanina kwakungu-Abhi, indodakazi kaZakhariya.
Wenza okulungile emehlweni kaSimakade njengakho konke akwenzayo uDavide, ukhokho wakhe.

Wasusa izindawo eziphakemeyo, wadiliza izinsika, wanquma o-Ashera, wachitha inyoka yethusi eyayenziwe nguMose, ngokuba abakwa-Israyeli, kuze kube yileso sikhathi, babesashisa impepho kuyo; yayisibizwa ngokuthi nguNehushithani.
Wamethemba uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, akubanga bikho onjengaye emva kwakhe, phakathi kwawo wonke amakhosi akwaJuda, nakulawo ayengaphambi kwakhe.
Wabambelela kuSimakade akaze achezuka ekumlandeleni, wagcina imiyalo uSimakade ayeyale ngayo uMose.
USimakade waba naye noma kuphi lapho ayeya khona, wachuma, wayihlubuka inkosi yase-Asiriya, akabe esayikhonza.
Wabhubhisa amaFilisti kwaze kwayofika eGaza nezifunda zayo, kusukela embhoshongweni wabalindi kuze kube semizini ebiyelweyo.

Kwathi ngonyaka wesine, uHezekiya, inkosi ebusa kwaJuda, okwakungunyaka wesikhombisa wokubusa kukaHosheya, indodana ka-Ela, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, uShalimaneseri, inkosi yase-Asiriya wakhuphuka, walivimbezela iSamariya.
Ngasekupheleni kweminyaka emithathu walinqoba iSamariya; kwakungunyaka wesithupha uHezekiya ebusa kwaJuda, kungunyaka wesishiyagalolunye uHosheya ebusa kwa-Israyeli.
Inkosi yase-Asiriya yathumba abakwa-Israyeli yabayisa e-Asiriya, yababeka eHala naseHabhori, ngasemfuleni iGozani nasemizini yamaMede,
ngokuba abalalelanga izwi likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo, kepha beqa isivumelwano sakhe; nakho konke ayeyale ngakho uMose, inceku kaSimakade, kabavumanga ukukulalela nokukwenza.
Ngonyaka we-14 wokubusa kukaHezekiya, inkosi, uSaneheribhi, inkosi yase-Asiriya, wakhuphuka, wahlasela yonke imizi yakwaJuda ebiyelweyo, wayidla.

UHezekiya, inkosi yakwaJuda, wathumela enkosini yase-Asiriya eLakhishi, wathi: “Ngonile kuwe, kodwa phindela emuva; noma yini oyibeka kimi, ngiyakuyenza.” Inkosi yase-Asiriya yamnqumela ukuba inkosi uHezekiya athele kuyo amathalenta esiliva angama-300 nawegolide angama-30.
UHezekiya wayinika lonke isiliva elalisendlini kaSimakade nelalisengcebeni yesigodlo senkosi.
Ngaleso sikhathi, uHezekiya wanquma izivalo zethempeli likaSimakade nezinsika okwakunamekwe nguHezekiya, inkosi yakwaJuda, wakunika inkosi yase-Asiriya.

Inkosi yase-Asiriya yathumela abakhuzi bempi abakhulu, uRabi Sarisi, noRabi Shake ukuba basuke eLakhishi baye enkosini uHezikiya eJerusalema, benempi enkulu. Bakhuphuka, bafika eJerusalema. Bakhuphuka bafike bema ngasemseleni wechibi elisenhla elingasendleleni yeNsimu yoMhlanzi.
Bayibiza inkosi, kwase kuphuma u-Eliyakimi, indodana kaHilikiya, owayengamele isigodlo, uShebhina, umbhali, noJowa, indodana ka-Asafa, umqophi.
Wathi kubo uRabi Shake: “Ake nisho kuHezekiya, nithi: ‘Isho kanje inkosi enkulu, inkosi yase-Asiriya, ithi: uthembelephi, yini le ekwenza ube nesibindi na?
Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi ukukhuluma amazwi ngomlomo kungamasu namandla okulwa na? Pho wethemba bani, ngoba ungihlubukile na?

Manje wena wethemba udondolo lwalo mhlanga ofecekileyo oyiGibhithe, okuthi uma umuntu ezimelela ngalo, lumhlabe esandleni sakhe, lusigwaze; unjalo-ke uFaro, inkosi yaseGibhithe, kubo bonke abamethembayo.

Kepha uma nithi kimi: “Siyamethemba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu;” akusiye yini ozindawo zakhe eziphakemeyo nama-althare akhe uHezekiya akususile, wathi kuJuda nakulo iJerusalema: “Niyakukhuleka phambi kwaleli althare eJerusalema na?”
“ ‘Ngakho-ke ake uvumelane nenkosi yami, inkosi yase-Asiriya, mangikunike amahhashi ayizi-2 000, uma ungabeka abagibeli kuwo.
Pho ungayibuyisela kanjani emuva induna eyodwa ezincekwini ezincane zenkosi yami, ube wethembele eGibhithe ukuthola khona izinqola zempi nabamahhashi na?
Manje ucabanga ukuthi ngikhuphuke yini ngaphandle kukaSimakade, ukuza kuleyo ndawo ukuze ngiyibhubhise na? USimakade wathi kimi: “Khuphukela kuleli lizwe ulibhubhise.” ’ ”

U-Eliyakimi, indodana kaHilikiya, uShebhina, noJowa, bathi kuRabi Shake: “Ake ukhulume nezinceku zakho ngesi-Aramu, ngokuba siyasizwa, ungakhulumi nathi ngolimi lwabaJuda, funa kuzwe abantu abasogangeni.”

Kepha uRabi Shake wathi kubo: “Ngabe inkosi yami ingithumile yini enkosini yakho nakini ukuzokhuluma lawa mazwi, hhayi nakwabanye abantu abahlezi ogangeni ukuba badle indle yabo, baphuze umchamo wabo kanye nani na?”
URabi Shake wayesema, wamemeza ngezwi elikhulu, ngolimi lwesiJuda, wakhuluma wathi: “Yizwani amazwi enkosi enkulu, inkosi yase-Asiriya.
Isho kanje inkosi, ithi: ‘Maningakhohliswa nguHezekiya, ngokuba akayukuba namandla okunophula esandleni sami,
futhi uHezekiya makanganenzi nethembe uSimakade, nithi: “USimakade uyakusophula nokusophula, nalo muzi awuyukunikelwa esandleni senkosi yase-Asiriya.” ’

“Ningamlaleli uHezekiya, ngokuba isho kanje inkosi yase-Asiriya, ithi: ‘Yakhani ukuthula nami, niphumele ngaphandle kimi, nidle, yilowo nalowo emvinini wakhe, yilowo nalowo emkhiwaneni wakhe, niphuze, yilowo nalowo amanzi omthombo wakhe,

ngize ngifike, nginiyise ezweni elinjengezwe lakini, izwe lokusanhlamvu nelewayini, izwe lesinkwa nelezivini, izwe leminqumo, lamafutha amasha neloju, ukuba niphile, ningafi.’ “Futhi ningamlaleli uHezekiya, lapho enidukisa ethi: ‘USimakade uzosisindisa.’
“Ngabe abanye onkulunkulu bezinye izizwe bake bawasindisa nokuwasindisa yini amazwe abo esandleni senkosi yase-Asiriya na?
Baphi onkulunkulu baseHamathi nase-Ariphadi na? Baphi onkulunkulu baseSefarivayimi, nabaseHena, nabase-Iva na? Balophulile yini iSamariya esandleni sami na?
Ngobani phakathi konkulunkulu bamazwe abake bophula izwe labo esandleni sami, ukuba nicabange ukuthi uSimakade angalophula iJerusalema esandleni sami na?”
Kepha abantu bathula, abamphendulanga ngazwi, ngokuba umyalo wenkosi wathi: “Ningamphenduli.”

U-Eliyakimi, indodana kaHilikiya owayengamele isigodlo, uShebhina, umbhali, noJowa, indodana ka-Asafa, umqophi, babuyela kuHezekiya izingubo zabo beziklebhulile, bamlandisa amazwi ayekhulunywe nguRabi Shake.
Kwathi ukuba inkosi uHezekiya izwe lokho, yaklebhula izingubo zayo, yembatha indwangu eyisaka, yangena endlini kaSimakade.
Yathumela u-Eliyakimi owayengamele isigodlo, noShebhina, umbhali, namalunga wonke, begqoke indwangu eyisaka, baya ku-Izaya, umphrofethi, indodana ka-Amose.
Bathi kuye: “Usho kanje uHezekiya, uthi: ‘Lolu lusuku losizi, nolokusolwa nolokwedelelwa, ngokuba abantwana sebekulungele ukuzalwa, kodwa awekho amandla okubazala.

Mhlawumbe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uwezwile wonke amazwi kaRabi Shake othunywe yinkosi yakhe, inkosi yase-Asiriya, ukuzokwedelela ngawo uNkulunkulu ophilayo. USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho athi angawezwa, awasole lawo mazwi, bese kuthi ngenxa yensali, awuzwe umkhuleko wakho.’ ”
Izinceku zenkosi uHezekiya zafika ku-Izaya.
U-Izaya wathi kuzo: “Niyakusho kanje enkosini yenu, nithi: ‘Usho kanje uSimakade, uthi: “Ungawesabi amazwi owezwileyo, izinceku zenkosi yase-Asiriya ezingithuke ngawo.
Bheka, ngizothumela kuye umoya, uyakuzwa umbiko, bese ebuyela ezweni lakubo, ngimwise khona ngenkemba.” ’ ”
URabi Shake waphindela emuva, emveni kokuba ezwe ukuthi inkosi isukile eLakhishi, wayifumana inkosi yase-Asiriya ilwa neLibhina.
Esezwile ngoThirahaka, inkosi yaseKhushe, kuthiwa: “Bheka, iphumile ukuba izokulwa nawe, wabuyela emuva, wathumela izithunywa kuHezekiya, ethi:
‘Niyokuthi kuHezekiya, inkosi yakwaJuda: “Ungavumi uNkulunkulu wakho omethembayo akukhohlise ngokuthi iJerusalema aliyukunikelwa esandleni senkosi yase-Asiriya.”
“ ‘Uyabona-ke, uzizwele nawe okwenziwe ngamakhosi ase-Asiriya kuwo wonke amazwe, awabhubhisa. Pho wena uyakusinda na?
Onkulunkulu balezo zizwe ezabhujiswa ngokhokho bami, iGozani, iHarana, iRezefi, abase-Edene, nabaseThelasari, bakwazi yini ukuzisindisa na?
Iphi inkosi yaseHamathi, eyase-Ariphadi, eyomuzi iSafarivayimi, eHena, nase-Iva na?’ ”
UHezekiya wayamukela incwadi eyayilethwe yizithunywa, wayifunda. UHezekiya wayesekhuphukela endlini kaSimakade, wafike wayeneka phambi kukaSimakade.
UHezekiya wakhuleka phambi kukaSimakade, wathi: “Simakade Nkulunkulu ka-Israyeli ohleli phezu kwamakherubhi, Wena wedwa unguNkulunkulu, nguwe wedwa owenze izulu nomhlaba.
Simakade, beka indlebe yakho ulalele; vula amehlo akho, Simakade, ubone, uzwe amazwi kaSaneheribhi awathumele ukweyisa ngawo uNkulunkulu ophilayo.
“Kuliqiniso impela Simakade ukuthi amakhosi ase-Asiriya azibhubhisile izizwe, namazwe azo,
aphonsa onkulunkulu bawo emlilweni, ngokuba babengeyibo onkulunkulu, babe ngumsebenzi wezandla zabantu nje, imithi, namatshe, yingakho ebabhubhisile.
Manje, Simakade Nkulunkulu wethu, ake usisindise esandleni sakhe, ukuze yonke imibuso yomhlaba yazi ukuthi Wena, Simakade, unguNkulunkulu, Wena wedwa.”
U-Izaya, indodana ka-Amose, wathumela kuHezekiya, wathi: “Usho kanje uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Lokho obukukhulekela kimi ngoSaneheribhi, inkosi yase-Asiriya, ngikuzwile.’
“Nanti izwi uSimakade alikhulumile ngaye, uthi: “ ‘Ikwedelele, yakuhleka usulu intombi; indodakazi yaseZiyoni, ikunikinele ikhanda indodakazi yaseJerusalema.
Weyise bani, wathuka bani na? Uliphakamisele bani izwi, uwabhekisele bani amehlo akho phezulu na? Ongcwele ka-Israyeli!

Ngesandla sezithunywa zakho, uyijivazile iNkosi, wathi: “Ngobuningi bezinqola zami, ngikhuphukele phezulu ezintabeni, phakathi kweLebhanoni, ngigawula imisedari yalo emide, nemisayiphuresi yalo ekhethekileyo, ngingene endaweni yalo esekugcineni nasehlathini lalo eliminyeneyo.
Ngemba, ngaphuza amanzi angaziwayo; ngomisa ngamathe onyawo lwami, yonke imifula eGibhithe.”
“ ‘Awuzwanga yini kwakudala ukuthi ngakuhlela kwasemandulo na? Ngakunquma; manje sengikufikisile ukuba ubhubhise imizi ebiyelweyo, ibe yizinqwaba.
Abakhe kuyo babe namandla amancane, besaba, bajabha; baba njengotshani basendle, nembali notshani obuluhlaza, nokuluhlaza ophahleni lwezindlu, nokusanhlamvu okuhamukile kungakakhuli.
“ ‘Kepha ukusukuma kwakho, nokuhlala kwakho, ukuphuma nokungena kwakho, ngiyakwazi, nokungithukuthelela kwakho.
Ngenxa yokuba ungithukuthelele, nokuzidla kwakho kwenyukele ezindlebeni zami, ngiyakubeka ingwegwe yami emakhaleni akho, netomu lami emlonyeni wakho, ngiyakukubuyisela endleleni oweza ngayo.’
“Lokhu kuyakuba yisibonakaliso kuwe: niyakudla ngalo nyaka okuzikhulelayo, nangonyaka wesibili isihlabane, nangonyaka wesithathu hlwanyelani, nivune, nitshale izivini, nidle izithelo zazo.
Abasindileyo bendlu yakwaJuda, abaseleyo bayakubuye bagxile phansi, bathele izithelo phezulu.
Ngokuba kuyakuphuma eJerusalema insali, nasentabeni iZiyoni abayakusinda; ukushisekela kukaSimakade kuyakufeza lokho.
“Ngalokho usho kanje uSimakade enkosini yase-Asiriya, uthi: “ ‘Ayiyukungena kulo muzi, ayiyukucibishela mcibisholo khona; ayiyukubhekisa kuwo isihlangu, ayiyukunqwabela iduli kuwo.
Ngendlela eyafika ngayo, iyakubuyela ngayo; ayiyukungena kulo muzi, kusho uSimakade.
Ngiyakuwuvikela lo muzi, ngiwusindise ngenxa yami, nangenxa yenceku yami, uDavide.’ ”
Kwathi ngalobo busuku, kwaphuma ingelosi kaSimakade, yabulala enkanjini yabase-Asiriya abayizi-185 000; sebevuka ekuseni, bheka, kwakuyizidumbu zodwa.
Wayesesuka uSaneheribi, inkosi yase-Asiriya, wahamba, wabuya, wahlala eNinive.

Kwathi ekhuleka endlini kaNisiroki, unkulunkulu wakhe, u-Adirameleki noSarezeri, amadodana akhe, ambulala ngenkemba, abalekela e-Ararathi. U-Esari Hadoni, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.

Ngalezo zinsuku uHezekiya wagula; kwakwembulwa kwembeswa. Kwafika kuye u-Izaya, umphrofethi, indodana ka-Amose, wathi kuye: “Usho kanje uSimakade, uthi: ‘Yaleza endlini yakho, ngokuba awuyukusinda, uyakufa nokufa.’ ”
Waphendula ubuso bakhe, wabheka ngasodongeni, wakhuleka kuSimakade, wathi:
“Simakade, ngiyakuncenga, ake ukhumbule ukuthi ngihambile phambi kwakho ngeqiniso, nangenhliziyo epheleleyo, ngenza okuhle phambi kwakho.” UHezekiya wadazuluka wakhala kakhulu.
Kwathi u-Izaya engakaphumi emzini egcekeni elingaphakathi, izwi likaSimakade lafika kuye, lathi:

“Buyela kuHezekiya umbusi wabantu bami, uthi kuye: ‘Usho kanje uSimakade uNkulunkulu kaDavide, ukhokho wakho, uthi: “Ngiwuzwile umkhuleko wakho, ngizibonile izinyembezi zakho; ngizokuphilisa, bese ngosuku lwesithathu ukhuphukela endlini kaSimakade.
Ngizokwengeza ezinsukwini zakho iminyaka eli-15, ngikusindise, wena nalo muzi, esandleni senkosi yase-Asiriya. Ngiyakuwuvikela lo muzi, ngenxa yami nangenxa yenceku yami, uDavide.” ’ ”
U-Izaya wathi: “Lethani isigaxa samakhiwane.” Basilanda-ke, base besibeka ethumbeni, wasinda.
UHezekiya wayesethi ku-Izaya: “Siyakuba yini isibonakaliso esizongitshengisa ukuthi uSimakade impela uzongiphilisa, nokuthi ngiyokhuphukela endlini kaSimakade ngosuku lwesithathu na?”
U-Izaya wathi: “Nasi-ke isibonakaliso sakho esivela kuSimakade: uSimakade uzokwenza lokho akushilo. Isithunzi siyakuya phambili izinyathelo, noma sihlehle izinyathelo ezilishumi.”
UHezekiya wathi: “Kulula ukuba isithunzi seluleke izinyathelo ezilishumi, cha, isithunzi kungcono ukuba sihlehle izinyathelo ezilishumi.”
Umphrofethi u-Izaya wakhala kuSimakade, uSimakade wasihlehlisa izinyathelo ezilishumi esabe sesedlule ngazo ezinyathelweni zika-Ahazi.
Ngaleso sikhathi kwasuka uMerodaki Bhaladari, indodana kaBhaladani, inkosi yaseBhabhele, wathumela kuHezekiya izincwadi nesipho, ngokuba wayezwile ukuthi kade ebambekile.

UHezekiya wabalalela, wababonisa yonke indlu yengcebo yakhe, isiliva, igolide, amakha, amafutha amahle, indlu yezikhali zakhe, nakho konke okwakutholakala engcebeni yakhe. Akukho lutho olwalusesigodlweni sakhe nasembusweni wakhe wonke angazange abakhombise lona.
Kwase kufika umphrofethi u-Izaya enkosini uHezekiya, wathi kuye: “Bebezothini labo bantu, futhi bebevela kuphi na?” UHezekiya wathi: “Bavela ezweni elikude, eBhabhele.”
Wayesethi: “Ubakhombiseni esigodlweni sakho?” UHezekiya wathi: “Ngibakhombise konke okusesigodlweni sami; akukho lutho engcebeni yami engingabakhombisanga lona.”
U-Izaya wathi kuHezekiya: “Yizwa izwi likaSimakade:
nakanjani izinsuku ziyeza, lapho konke okusendlini yakho nalokho okhokho bakho abakubekelela khona kuze kube namuhla, kuyakuthathwa, kuyiswe eBhabhele; akuyukusala lutho, kusho uSimakade.
Amanye amadodana akho owazalayo ayothunjwa, abe ngabathenwa esigodlweni senkosi yaseBhabhele.”
UHezekiya wayesethi ku-Izaya: “Izwi likaSimakade alikhulume kimi, lingifanele.” Ngokuba ngokucabanga kwakhe wayethi: “Pho kunani uma kuzokuba nokuthula nokuvikeleka ngezinsuku zami na?”
Ezinye izindaba zikaHezekiya, nawo wonke amandla akhe, nokwenza kwakhe ichibi nomsele, nokungenisa kwakhe amanzi emzini, akulotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwaJuda na?
UHezekiya walaliswa kokhokho bakhe, uManase, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
UManase wayeneminyaka eli-12 eqala ukubusa, wabusa iminyaka engama-55 eJerusalema. Igama likanina kwakunguHefizibha.
Wenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, njengezinengiso ezazenziwa ngabezizwe uSimakade abaxosha phambi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli.

Wabuye wazakha izindawo eziphakemeyo ezazibhidlizwe nguyise uHezekiya, wamisela uBhali i-althare, wagxumeka izigxobo zika-Ashera njengoba kwakwenze u-Ahabi, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, wakhuleka kulona lonke ibandla lasezulwini, walikhonza.
Wakha ama-althare endlini kaSimakade, uSimakade ayethe ngayo: “EJerusalema, ngizobeka khona igama lami.”
Wakhela lonke ibandla lasezulwini ama-althare emagcekeni amabili endlu kaSimakade.
Wadabulisa indodana yakhe emlilweni, wahlola imihlola, wabhula, wavumela abanamadlozi nabathakathi. Wenza okubi okuningi phambi kukaSimakade, wachukuluza ulaka lwakhe.

Wabeka isithombe esibaziweyo sika-Ashera ayesenzile endlini uSimakade ayekhulume ngayo kuDavide noSolomoni indodana yakhe, wathi: “Kule ndlu naseJerusalema engilikhethile ezizwaneni zonke zakwa-Israyeli ukuba ngibeke khona iGama lami, kuze kube phakade.

Angiseyukuzenza izinyawo zika-Israyeli zizulazule, zisuke ezweni engalinika okhokho babo, kuphela nje uma beqikelela ukugcina futhi benze njengakho konke engibayale ngakho, nanjengawo wonke umthetho eyabayala ngawo inceku yami, uMose.”
Kepha abalalelanga; uManase wabaphambukisa, benza okubi ukwedlula abezizwe uSimakade ababhubhisa phambi kwabo, abantu bakwa-Israyeli.
USimakade wakhuluma ngezinceku zakhe, abaphrofethi, wathi:
“Ngenxa yokuba uManase, inkosi yakwaJuda, wenze lezi zinengiso, wenza okubi ukwedlula konke okwakwenziwe ngama-Amori ayephambi kwakhe, wonisa uJuda ngezithombe zakhe.
Ngakho-ke usho kanje uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Ngizokwehlisa okubi phezu kweJerusalema naphezu kukaJuda, okuyothi abezwa ngakho, kuhlale kunkeneneza njalo ezindlebeni zabo.
Ngizakwelula phezu kweJerusalema umucu wokulinganisa waseSamariya, nomthofu wokumisa indlu ka-Ahabi; ngiyakulesula iJerusalema njengomuntu esula isitsha, uyasesula aphinde asibhekise phansi.
Ngiyakuyilahla insali yefa lami, ngiyinikele esandleni sezitha zayo, iyokuba yimpango nento ebanjiweyo yazo zonke izitha zayo,
ngokuba yenze okubi emehlweni ami, iluchukuluzile ulaka lwami kusukela ngosuku okhokho bayo abaphuma ngalo eGibhithe, kuze kube namuhla.’ ”
UManase futhi wachitha kakhulu igazi elingenacala waze wagcwalisa iJerusalema kusukela kulolu hlangothi kuya kolunye, ngaphandle kwesono sakhe onisa ngaso uJuda ngokwenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade.
Ezinye izindaba zikaManase, nakho konke akwenzayo, nesono sakhe ona ngaso, akulotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla zamakhosi akwaJuda na?
UManase walaliswa kokhokho bakhe, wembelwa ensimini esigodlweni sakhe, insimu ka-Uza. U-Amoni, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
U-Amoni wayeneminyaka engama-22 ngesikhathi eba yinkosi, wabusa iminyaka emibili eJerusalema. Igama likanina kwakunguMeshulemethi, indodakazi kaHaruzi waseJothiba.
Wenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade njengalokhu kwakwenze uyise uManase.
Wahamba ngazo zonke izindlela uyise ahamba ngazo, wakhonza izithombe azikhonzayo uyise, wakhuleka kuzo.
Wamshiya uSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho bakhe, akaze ahamba endleleni kaSimakade.
Izinceku zika-Amoni zamakhela uzungu; zayibulala inkosi endlini yayo.
Kepha abantu bezwe bababulala bonke ababenzele inkosi u-Amoni ugobe, babeka uJosiya, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Ezinye izindaba zika-Amoni azenzayo azilotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla zamakhosi akwaJuda na?
Wembelwa ethuneni lakhe ensimini ka-Uza; uJosiya, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
UJosiya wayeneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ngesikhathi eba yinkosi, wabusa iminyaka engama-31 eJerusalema. Igama likanina kwakunguJedida, indodakazi ka-Adayiya waseBhozikhathi.
Wenza okulungile emehlweni kaSimakade, wahamba ngayo yonke indlela uDavide, ukhokho wakhe, ayehambe ngayo, kachezukelanga ngakwesokunene nangakwesokhohlo.
Kwathi ngonyaka we-18 wokubusa kwenkosi uJosiya, inkosi uJosiya yathumela uShafani, indodana ka-Azaliya kaMeshulamu, umbhali, endlini kaSimakade, wathi:
“Yenyukela kuHilikiya, umphristi omkhulu, uthi makabale imali yonke esendlini kaSimakade eqoqwe ngabalindiminyango kubantu,
mayinikwe izisebenzi ezimiselwe ukwenza umsebenzi endlini kaSimakade; mayinikwe izisebenzi ezisendlini kaSimakade ukuze zilungise izimfa endlini kaSimakade,
ababazi, abakhi, abakha ngamatshe, ukuze bathenge imithi namatshe abaziweyo kokulungisa indlu.
Nokho akuyukubuzwa midanti ngokusebenzisa kwabo imali ababeyamukele, ngokuba umsebenzi wabo babewenza ngokwethembeka.”
UHilikiya, umphristi omkhulu, wathi kuShafani, umbhali: “Bheka, ngithole incwadi yomthetho endlini kaSimakade.” UHilikiya wayinika uShafani leyo ncwadi, ukuba ayifunde.
UShafani, umbhali, waya enkosini, wafike wayethulela umbiko othi: “Izinceku zakho ziyithululile imali eyatholakala endlini, zayinika izisebenzi ezimiselwe ukwenza umsebenzi endlini kaSimakade.”
UShafani, umbhali, wabika enkosini, ukuthi: “UHilikiya, umphristi, unginike incwadi.” UShafani wayeseyifunda phambi kwenkosi.
Kwathi lapho inkosi iwezwa amazwi ayesencwadini yomthetho, yaklebhula izingubo zayo.
Inkosi yayala uHilikiya, umphristi, u-Ahikamu, indodana kaShafani, u-Akhibhori, indodana kaMikhaya, uShafani, umbhali no-Asaya, inceku yenkosi, yathi kubo:

“Hambani ningibuzele kuSimakade, mina nabantu naye wonke uJuda, maqondana namazwi ale ncwadi etholakeleyo, ngokuba inkulu intukuthelo kaSimakade esivuthelayo. Okhokho bethu abawalalelanga amazwi ale ncwadi, ukuze benze njengakho konke okulotshwe ngathi kuyo.”

UHilikiya umphristi, u-Ahikamu, u-Akhibhori, uShafani, no-Asaya baya kuHulda umphrofethikazi, umkaShalumi, indodana kaThikiva kaHarihasi, umgcinizingubo, owayehlala eJerusalema engxenyeni yesibili, bakhuluma naye.
Wathi kubo: “Usho kanje uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Yishoni kumuntu onithumele kimi nithi:
usho kanje uSimakade uthi: ngiyokwehlisela okubi kule ndawo naphezu kwabakhe kuyo, njengokusho kwawo wonke amazwi encwadi eyifundile inkosi yakwaJuda,
ngokuba bangishiyile, bashisela abanye onkulunkulu impepho, bachukuluza ulaka lwami ngawo wonke umsebenzi wezandla zabo. Intukuthelo yami iyakuyivuthela le ndawo, futhi ayiyukucinywa.’
Kepha enkosini yakwaJuda enithumileyo ukuba nibuze kuSimakade, niyothi kuyo: ‘Usho kanje uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, uthi: amazwi owezwileyo,

ngenxa yokuba inhliziyo yakho ithambile, wazithoba phambi kukaSimakade, ngesikhathi uwezwa, lokho engakukhuluma kule ndawo nakwabakhileyo kuyo, ukuthi kuyakuba yincithakalo nesiqalekiso, wawusuklebhula izingubo zakho, wakhala phambi kwami, nami ngikuzwile, kusho uSimakade.
Ngakho-ke ngiyokubuthela kokhokho bakho, ubuthelwe edlinzeni lakho ngokuthula, amehlo akho awayukukubona konke okubi engiyakukwehlisela phezu kwale ndawo.’ ” Base bebuyisela enkosini lelo lizwi.
Inkosi uJosiya yathumela ukuba kubizwe amalunga wonke akwaJuda nawaseJerusalema.

Inkosi yenyukela endlini kaSimakade, bonke abantu bakwaJuda, nababakhe eJerusalema bekanye nayo, nabaphristi nabaphrofethi, yebo, bonke abantu, abancane nabadala, yafunda wonke amazwi encwadi yesivumelwano eyayitholakele endlini kaSimakade, bonke abantu bezwa.

Inkosi yema ngasensikeni, yenza isivumelwano phambi kukaSimakade ukuthi izomlandela, igcine imiyalo yakhe, ubufakazi bakhe, nezimiso zakhe ngenhliziyo yayo yonke, nangomphefumulo wayo wonke, nokuthi iyogcina wonke amazwi alesi sivumelwano esibhalwe kule ncwadi. Bonke abantu basamukela isivumelwano.

Inkosi yayala uHilikiya umphristi omkhulu, nabaphristi besigaba sesibili, abalindimnyango, ukuba bakhiphe ethempelini likaSimakade zonke izinto ezazenzelwe uBhali no-Ashera, nebandla lonke lasezulwini. Yazishisa ngaphandle kweJerusalema, emasimini aseKidroni, umlotha wakho wayiswa eBhethele.

Yabulala abaphristi bezithombe, amakhosi akwaJuda ayebaqokile ukuba bashise impepho ezindaweni eziphakemeyo emizini yakwaJuda, nxazonke zeJerusalema, kanye nalabo ababeshisa impepho kuBhali, kulo ilanga, inyanga, izinkanyezi nalo lonke ibandla lasezulwini.
Yamkhiphela ngaphandle kweJerusalema u-Ashera, endlini kaSimakade, yamshisa emfudlaneni iKidroni, yamgaya waba luthuli, yalahla umlotha wakhe emangcwabeni amadodana abantu.
Yadiliza izindlu zezifebe zesilisa ezazisendlini kaSimakade, lapho abesifazane babelukela khona amathende ka-Ashera.

Yabakhipha bonke abaphristi emizini yakwaJuda, yazingcolisa izindawo eziphakemeyo, lapho labo baphristi babeshisela khona impepho, kusukela eGebha kuze kube seBheri Sheba. Yazidiliza izindawo eziphakemeyo emasangweni asesikhaleni sesango likaJoshuwa, umphathimuzi, ezazingakwesokhohlo somuntu ngasesangweni lomuzi.
Abaphristi basezindaweni eziphakemeyo babengenyukeli e-althare likaSimakade eJerusalema, kodwa badla isinkwa esingenamvubelo phakathi kwabafowabo.
Yangcolisa iThofethi esigodini sabantwana bakwaHinomu ukuze kungabe kusaba bikho odabulisa indodana noma indodakazi yakhe emlilweni kaMolokhi.

Yasusa namahhashi amakhosi akwaJuda ayenikele ngawo kulo ilanga, ngasendleleni yokungena endlini kaSimakade, ngasekamelweni likaNathani Meleki, induna eyayisePhariwarimi, yashisa izinqola zelanga ngomlilo.

Ama-althare ayesophahleni lwekamelo eliphezulu lika-Ahazi, elalakhiwe ngamakhosi akwaJuda, nama-althare ayenziwe nguManase emagcekeni omabili endlu kaSimakade, inkosi yawadiliza, yasuka yagijima, yalahla umlotha emfudlaneni iKidroni.

Inkosi yangcolisa izindawo eziphakemeyo ezaziphambi kweJerusalema, ngakwesokunene sentaba Yokonakala, inkosi uSolomoni yakwa-Israyeli eyayizakhele u-Ashitharothi isinengiso samaSidoni, noKhemoshi isinengiso sabakwaMowabi noMilikhomu isinengiso sabakwa-Amoni.
Yaphahlaza izinsika, yanquma o-Ashera, yagcwalisa izindawo zabo ngamathambo abantu.

I-althare elaliseBhethele, nendawo ephakemeyo eyenziwa nguJerobhowamu, indodana kaNebhathi, owonisa u-Israyeli, nalelo althare nendawo ephakemeyo yakudiliza, yayishisa indawo ephakemeyo, yayiqothisisa yaba ngumlotha, yashisa no-Ashera.

UJosiya waphenduka wabona amathuna ayelapho entabeni; wathumela, wawakhipha amathambo emathuneni, wawashisa e-althare, walingcolisa njengokusho kwezwi likaSimakade elamenyezelwa ngumuntu kaNkulunkulu owayememezela lezi zinto.
Wayesethi: “Yisikhumbuzo sani lesi engisibonayo na?” Abantu bomuzi bathi kuye: “Yithuna lomuntu kaNkulunkulu owayevela kwaJuda, owamemezela lezi zindaba osuzenzile nge-althare laseBhethele.”
Wathi: “Myekeni; mawanganyakaziswa muntu amathambo akhe.” Base bewayeka amathambo akhe nalawo omphrofethi owayevela eSamariya.
UJosiya wazisusa nazo zonke izindlu zezindawo eziphakemeyo ezazisemizini eSamariya, lezo ezazakhiwe ngamakhosi akwa-Israyeli amcunula ngazo uSimakade, wenza kuzo njengoba ayenze eBhethele.
Wabulala bonke abaphristi basezindaweni eziphakemeyo lapho kwakunama-althare khona, washisa amathambo abantu phezu kwawo, wayesebuyela eJerusalema.
Inkosi yayisiyala bonke abantu, yathi: “Yenzelani uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu iphasika njengalokhu kulotshiwe kule ncwadi yesivumelwano.”
Lalingakaze ligcinwe iphasika kusukela emihleni yabehluleli ababehlulela u-Israyeli, nasemihleni yawo wonke amakhosi akwa-Israyeli nawakwaJuda.
Kwathi ngonyaka we-18 wokubusa kwenkosi uJosiya, lagcinwa leli phasika kuSimakade eJerusalema.

Abanamadlozi, abathakathi, amatherafi, izithombe nazo zonke izinengiso ezazibonakala kwaJuda naseJerusalema, uJosiya wakususa ukuze afeze amazwi omthetho alotshwe encwadini uHilikiya, umphristi, ayeyithole endlini kaSimakade.

Kwakungakaze kube khona nkosi enjengaye ngaphambi kwakhe, eyaphendukela kuSimakade ngayo yonke inhliziyo yayo, nangawo wonke umphefumulo wayo, nangawo wonke amandla ayo nanjengakho konke okwakushiwo ngumthetho kaMose, ngisho nangasemva kwakhe akuvelanga enjengaye.
Nokho uSimakade akaphendukanga entukuthelweni enkulu ayemthukuthelele ngayo uJuda, nangokuchukuluza uManase achukuluza ulaka lwakhe ngakho.
USimakade wathi: “Naye uJuda ngiyakumsusa ebusweni bami njengoba ngenzile ku-Israyeli, lo muzi engawukhethayo, iJerusalema, nendlu engathi ngayo iGama lami liyakuba lapho, ngizakuwulahla.”
Ezinye izindaba zikaJosiya, nakho konke akwenzayo, akulotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwaJuda na?

Emihleni yokubusa kukaJosiya uFaro Nekho, inkosi yaseGibhithe, yakhuphukela enkosini yase-Asiriya ngasemfuleni iYufrathe. Inkosi uJosiya yakhuphuka ukuyoyihlangabeza; kwaba ukuyibona nje, yayibulala eMegido.

Izinceku zikaJosiya zasithatha ngenqola isidumbu sakhe eMegido, zasibuyisela eJerusalema, zasimbela edlinzeni layo. Abantu bezwe base bethatha uJehowahazi, indodana kaJosiya, bamgcoba, bambeka waba yinkosi esikhundleni sikayise.
UJehowahazi wayeneminyaka engama-23 lapho eba yinkosi, wabusa izinyanga ezintathu eJerusalema. Igama likanina kwakunguHamuthali, indodakazi kaJeremiya waseLibhina.
Wenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, njengakho konke okwenziwe ngokhokho bakhe.
UFaro Nekho wamvimbezela eRibhila eHamathi, ukuze angabe esabusa eJerusalema; izwe walithelisa intela engamathalenta esiliva ayikhulu nethalenta legolide.

UFaro Nekho wabeka u-Eliyakimi, enye indodana kaJosiya, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sikayise. Wamguqula igama kwaba nguJehoyakimi. Wamsusa uJehowahazi eRibhila wamyisa eGibhithe, waze wakhothamela khona.
UJehoyakimi wanika uFaro isiliva negolide; wathelisa izwe ukuze anike uFaro imali njengokusho kwakhe. Wakhiphisa abantu ababehlala ezweni isiliva negolide, ukuze akunike uFaro Nekho.
UJehoyakimi wayeneminyaka engama-25 lapho eba yinkosi, wabusa iminyaka eli-11 eJerusalema. Igama likanina kwakunguZebhida, indodakazi kaPhedaya waseRuma.
Wenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade njengakho konke okwenziwa okhokho bakhe.
Emihleni yakhe kwenyuka uNebukhadinezari, inkosi yaseBhabhele; uJehoyakimi wayeyinceku yakhe, ekhonze kuye iminyaka emithathu, wabuye wamhlubuka.
USimakade wathumela kuye amaviyo amaKhaledi, awama-Aramu, awakwaMowabi nawakwa-Amoni, wawathumela ukuba ambhubhise uJuda njengezwi likaSimakade alikhuluma ngomlomo wezinceku zakhe, abaphrofethi.
Kwenzeka ngokweqiniso kwaJuda lokho uSimakade ayekukhulumile ukuze abasuse ebusweni bakhe ngenxa yezono zikaManase, nakho konke ayekwenzile,
nangenxa yegazi elingenacala ayelichithile, wagcwalisa iJerusalema ngalo, lokho uSimakade akazange avume ukukuthethelela.
Ezinye izindaba zikaJehoyakimi, nakho konke akwenzayo, akulotshiwe yini encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yamakhosi akwaJuda na?
UJehoyakimi walaliswa kokhokho bakhe, uJehoyakini, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Inkosi yaseGibhithe ayibuyanga futhi yaphuma ezweni lakubo, ngoba inkosi yaseBhabhele yayithathe konke okwenkosi yaseGibhithe, kusukela emfuleni eGibhithe kuze kuyofika eYufrathe.
UJehoyakini wayeneminyaka eli-18 ngesikhathi eba yinkosi, wabusa izinyanga ezintathu eJerusalema. Igama likanina kwakunguNehushitha, indodakazi ka-Elinathani waseJerusalema.
Wenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade njengakho konke okwenziwa ngokhokho bakhe.
Ngaleso sikhathi izinceku zikaNebukhadinezari, inkosi yaseBhabhele, zakhuphukela eJerusalema, zawuvimbezela umuzi.
UNebukhadinezari, inkosi yaseBhabhele, wafika emzini owawuvinjezelwe yizinceku zakhe.

Inkosi uJehoyakini wakwaJuda wazinikela enkosini yaseBhabhele, yena, unina, izinceku zakhe, izikhulu zakhe nezikhulu esigodlweni sakhe. Inkosi yaseBhabhele yamthatha ngonyaka wesishiyagalombili wokubusa kwakhe.

Yakhipha yonke ingcebo yendlu kaSimakade, ingcebo yasesigodlweni senkosi, yaphihliza zonke izinto zegolide inkosi uSolomoni wakwa-Israyeli ayezenzele ithempeli likaSimakade njengoba uSimakade ayeshilo.
Yathumba lonke iJerusalema, zonke izikhulu, wonke amaqhawe anamandla, abathunjwa abayizi-10 000, izingcweti nabakhandi, ayishiyanga muntu, ngaphandle kwalabo bezwe ababedla imbuya ngothi.
Yathumba uJehoyakini, yamyisa eBhabhele, indlovukazi unina wenkosi, amakhosikazi enkosi, izinduna zayo, nezikhulu zezwe, bonke yabathumba besuka eJerusalema yabayisa eBhabhele.
