Wonke amadoda anamandla ayizi-7 000, izinyanga, abakhandi, izinkulungwane zamaqhawe ayezilungiselele ukulwa; bonke inkosi yaseBhabhele yabathumba yabayisa eBhabhele.
Inkosi yaseBhabhele yabeka uMathaniya, uyisekazi, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe, yaliguqula igama lakhe waba nguZedekiya.
UZedekiya wayeneminyaka engama-21 ngesikhathi eba yinkosi. Wabusa eJerusalema iminyaka eli-11. Igama likanina kwakunguHamithali, indodakazi kaJeremiya waseLibhina.
Wenza okubi emehlweni kaSimakade, njengakho konke okwenziwa nguJehoyakimi.
Lokho kwenzeka eJerusalema kwaJuda ngenxa yentukuthelo kaSimakade, waze wabalahla ebusweni bakhe. UZedekiya wayihlubuka inkosi yaseBhabhele.

Kwathi ngonyaka wesishiyagalolunye wokubusa kukaZedekiya, ngenyanga yeshumi, ngolweshumi lwayo, kwafika uNebukhadinezari, inkosi yaseBhabhele, eJerusalema nayo yonke impi yakhe. Bakanisa maqondana nalo; bakha khona udonga lokuvimbezela, nxazonke.
Umuzi bawuvimbezela kwaze kwaba ngunyaka we-11 wokubusa kukaZedekiya, inkosi.
Ngosuku lwesishiyagalolunye yayibhokile indlala emzini, kwakungekho kudla kubantu bezwe.

Wonke amabutho awufohla umuzi ngalobo busuku, abaleka ngendlela yesango elaliphakathi kwezingange zombili ezazingasensimini yenkosi. AmaKhaledi ayewuzungeze nxazonke umuzi, amabutho ahamba ngendlela ese-Araba.
Impi yamaKhaledi yayixosha inkosi, yayifica emathafeni eJerikho, yonke impi yayo yahlakazeka, yayishiya.
Ayibamba inkosi ayiletha enkosini yaseBhabhele, eRibhila, ayehlulela.
Amadodana kaZedekiya abulawa phambi kwakhe, uZedekiya amkhipha amehlo, ambopha ngamaketanga, amyisa eBhabhele.
Ngenyanga yesihlanu, ngosuku lwesikhombisa lwayo, okwakungunyaka we-19 wenkosi uNebukhadinezari, inkosi yaseBhabhele, kwafika eJerusalema uNebuzaradani, induna yabalindi, inceku yenkosi yaseBhabhele.
Washisa ngomlilo indlu kaSimakade nesigodlo senkosi, nazo zonke izindlu ezinkulu, wazishisa ngomlilo.
Induna yabalindi, nayo yonke impi yamaKhaledi eyayinayo, yadiliza izingange eJerusalema, nxazonke.
Abanye abantu abasala emzini, nalabo abahlubukayo, bahlubukela ngasohlangothini lwenkosi yaseBhabhele, nesixuku esiseleyo, uNebuzaradani, induna yabalindi, wabathumba bonke.
Kepha ababempofu balelo lizwe, induna yabalindi yabashiya ukuba banakekele izivini namasimu.
Izinsika zethusi ezazisendlini kaSimakade, izinqe zolwandle lwethusi okwakusendlini kaSimakade, akuhlephula amaKhaledi, alithwala ithusi aya nalo eBhabhele.
Amabhodwe, izimfologo, izizenze, izinkezo, nezitsha zethusi, ababekhonza ngakho, akuthatha.
Imicengezi yomlilo, izitsha zegolide lodwa, nezesiliva lodwa, nalokho induna yabalindi yakuthatha.
Izinsika zombili, nolwandle olwalulunye nje, nezinqe uSolomoni ayekwenzele indlu kaSimakade, isisindo sethusi okwakwenziwe ngalo zonke lezi zinto sasingenakulinganiswa.

Ukuphakama kwensika eyodwa kwakungamakhubhithi ali-18; phezu kwayo kwakukhona isihloko sethusi; ukuphakama kwesihloko esisodwa kwakungamakhubhithi amathathu. Kwakukhona nenetha namahananadi phezu kwesihloko, nxazonke, konke kwakungokwethusi; kwakunjalo nasensikeni yesibili enetheni.
Induna yabalindi yathumba uZeraya, umphristi omkhulu, uZefaniya, umphristi wesibili, abalindimnyango abathathu,

yathumba emzini induna eyayibekwe ukwengamela amabutho, abantu abayisihlanu ababesondelene nenkosi abatholwa emzini, umbhali womkhuzi wempi eyayibala abantu ezweni, kwatholakala ezweni abantu abangama-60 ababehlala emzini.
UNebuzaradani, induna yabalindi, yabathumba yabayisa enkosini yaseBhabhele, eRibhila.
Inkosi yaseBhabhele yabashaya, yababulalela khona eRibhila, eHamathi. UJuda waya ekuthunjweni esuswa ezweni lakubo.
UNebukhadinezari, inkosi yaseBhabhele, wabeka uGedaliya, indodana ka-Ahikamu kaShafani, ukuba abe ngumbusi phezu kwensali yakwaJuda ayeyishiyile ezweni.

Zonke izinduna zempi nabantu bezwa ukuthi inkosi yaseBhabhele ibeke uGedaliya waba ngumbusi ezweni, zase ziya kuGedaliya eMizipha: u-Ishmayeli, indodana kaNethaniya, noJohanani, indodana kaKhareya, noZeraya, indodana kaThanihumethi waseNethofa, noJahazaniya, indodana yomMahakha, nabantu babo.
UGedaliya wafunga kubo nakubantu babo, wathi: “Ningazesabi izinceku zamaKhaledi; hlalani ezweni, nikhonze enkosini yaseBhabhele ukuze kunihambele kahle.”

Kwathi ngenyanga yesikhombisa kwafika u-Ishmayeli, indodana kaNethaniya ka-Elishama ongowozalo lwasebukhosini, ehamba namadoda alishumi, wafika washaya uGedaliya waze wafa kanye nabaJuda namaKhaledi ayenabo eMizpha.
Bonke abantu, abancane, nabadala, nabakhuzi bempi basuka babalekela eGibhithe, ngokuba babesaba amaKhaledi.

Kwathi ngonyaka wama-37 athunjwa uJehoyakini, inkosi yakwaJuda, ngenyanga ye-12, ngosuku lwama-27 lwayo, u-Evili Merodaki, inkosi yaseBhabhele, ngonyaka wakhe wokuqala eyinkosi, wamkhulula ejele uJehoyakini, inkosi yakwaJuda.
Wakhuluma kahle naye, wabeka isihlalo sakhe saba phezu kwezihlalo zamakhosi ayenaye eBhabhele.
Wamkhumula izingubo ayezigqoka ejele, wadla naye njalo, zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwakhe.
Isabelo sakhe ayesiphiwa yinkosi, sasiyisabelo esimiyo semihla ngemihla, zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwakhe.
U-Adamu, uSethi, u-Enoshe,
uKhenani, uMahalalele, uJarede,
u-Enokhi, uMethushela, uLameka,
uNowa, uShemi, uHamu, noJafethi.
Amadodana kaJafethi: nguGomere, uMagoge, uMadayi, uJavani, uThubhali, uMesheke noTirase.
Amadodana kaGomere: ngu-Ashikhenaze, uDifathe noThogarma.
Amadodana kaJavani: ngu-Elisha, uTharishishi, uKhithimi noRodanimi.
Amadodana kaHamu: nguKhushe, uMizirayimi, uPhuthi noKhanani.
Amadodana kaKhushe: nguZebha, uHavila, uSabhitha, uRama noSabhitheka. Amadodana kaRama: nguSheba noDedani.
UKhushe wazala uNimrode; yena waqala ukuba ngonamandla emhlabeni.
UMizirayimi wazala amaLudi, ama-Anami, amaLehabhi, amaNafethuhi,
amaPhathrusi, amaKhasuluhi, lapho kwavela khona amaFilisti, namaKhafithori.
UKhanani wazibula ngoSidoni, kwalandela uHethi,
amaJebusi, ama-Amori, amaGirigashi,
amaHivi, ama-Arikhi, amaSini,
ama-Arivadi, amaSemari, namaHamathi.
Amadodana kaShemi: ngu-Elamu, u-Ashuri, u-Ariphakishade, uLude, u-Aramu, u-Uze, uHule, uGetheri noMeshekhe.
U-Ariphakishade wazala uShela; uShela wazala u-Ebhere.
U-Ebhere wazala amadodana amabili: igama lenye kwakunguPhelege, ngokuba emihleni yayo izwe ladatshulwa. Igama lomfowabo kwakunguJokothane.
UJokhothane wazala u-Alimodade, uShelefe, uHasaramavethe, uJera,
uHadoramu, u-Uzali, uDikila,
u-Ebhali, u-Abhimayele, uShebha,
u-Ofiri, uHavila, uJobhabhi; bonke laba babengamadodana kaJokothane;
uShemi, u-Ariphakishade, uShela,
u-Ebhere, uPhelege, uRehu,
uZerugi, uNahori, uThera,
u-Abhrama ongu-Abhrahama.
Amadodana ka-Abhrahama: u-Isaka no-Ishmayeli.
Lezi yizizukulwane zabo: izibulo lika-Ishmayeli uNebhayothi, uKhedari, u-Adibheli, uMibhishamu,
uMishima, uDuma, uMasa, uHadadi, uThema,
uJethuru, uNafishi, noKhedema. Laba babengamadodana ka-Ishmayeli.
Amadodana kaKhethura, isancinza sika-Abhrahama: uZimrani, uJokishani, uMedani, uMidiyani, u-Ishibhaki, uShuwa. Amadodana kaJokishani: uSheba noDedani.
Amadodana kaMidiyani: u-Efa, u-Eferi, uHanokhi, u-Abhida, u-Elidaha. Bonke laba babengamadodana kaKhethura.
U-Abhrahama wazala u-Isaka. Amadodana ka-Isaka: u-Esawu no-Israyeli.
Amadodana ka-Esawu: u-Elifazi, uRehuweli, uJewushe, uJalamu, noKora.
Amadodana ka-Elifazi: uThemani, u-Omari, uZefi, uGathamu, uKenazi, uThimna no-Amaleki.
Amadodana kaRehuweli: uNahathi, uZera, uShama noMiza.
Amadodana kaSeyiri: uLothani, uShobhali, uZibheyoni, u-Ana, uDishoni, u-Ezeri noDishani.
Amadodana kaLothani: uHori, noHomamu; udadewabo kaLothani kwakunguThimna.
Amadodana kaShobhali: u-Aliyani, uManahathi, u-Ebhali, uShefi no-Onamu. Amadodana kaZibheyoni: u-Aya, no-Ana.
Indodana ka-Ana: uDishoni. Amadodana kaDishoni: uHamrani, u-Eshibhani, uJithrani noKherani.
Amadodana ka-Ezeri: uBhilihani, uZahawana noJahakhani. Amadodana kaDishani: u-Uze no-Arana.
Lawa ngamakhosi abusa kwa-Edomi, kungakabi bikho nkosi eyayibusa abantu bakwa-Israyeli: uBhela, indodana kaBheyori. Igama lomuzi wakhe kwakuseDinihaba.
UBhela wakhothama; kwabekwa uJobhabhi, indodana kaZera waseBhozira, esikhundleni sakhe.
UJobhabhi wakhothama; uHushamu wakwaThemani wabusa esikhundleni sakhe.
UHushamu wakhothama; esikhundleni sakhe kwabusa uHadadi, indodana kaBhedadi, owanqoba abakwaMidiyani esifundeni kwaMowabi. Igama lomuzi wakhe kwakuyi-Avithi.
UHadadi wakhothama; kwabusa uSamla waseMazireka, esikhundleni sakhe.
USamla wakhothama, kwabusa uShawule waseRehobhothi ngasemfuleni, esikhundleni sakhe.
UShawule wakhothama; kwabusa uBali Hanani, indodana ka-Akhibhori, esikhundleni sakhe.
UBhali Hanani wakhothama; kwabusa uHadadi, esikhundleni sakhe. Igama lomuzi wakhe kwakuyiPhayi. Igama lomkakhe kunguMehethabheli, indodakazi kaMathiredi, indodakazi kaMezahabhi.
UHadadi naye wafa. Nanka amagama ezikhulu zakwa-Edomi: uThimna, u-Aliya, uJethethi,
u-Oholibhama, u-Ela, uPhinoni,
uKhenazi, uThemani, uMibhizari,
uMagidiyeli no-Iramu. Yilezo-ke izikhulu zakwa-Edomi.
Nanka amadodana ka-Israyeli: uRubeni, uSimeyoni, uLevi, uJuda, u-Isakhare, uZebuloni,
uDani, uJosefa, uBhenjamini, uNafethali, uGadi no-Asheri.
Amadodana kaJuda: u-Eri, u-Onani noShela, laba bobathathu wabazala kumKhananikazi, uBhathi Shuwa. U-Eri, izibulo likaJuda, wenza okubi phambi kukaSimakade; uSimakade wambulala.
UThamari, umalokazana wakwakhe, wamzalela uPherezi, noZera. Esewonke amadodana kaJuda ayeyisihlanu.
Amadodana kaPherezi: uHezironi noHamule.
Amadodana kaZera: uZimri, u-Ethani, uHemani, uKhalikholi noDara; esewonke ayeyisihlanu.
Amadodana kaKharmi: u-Akhari, umhluphi ka-Israyeli, owenza isiphambeko ngokuqalekisiweyo.
Indodana ka-Ethani: u-Azariya.
Amadodana kaHezironi awazalelwayo: uJerameli, uRamu noKhelubhayi.
URamu wazala u-Aminadaba; u-Aminadaba wazala uNaheshoni, isikhulu sabakwaJuda;
uNaheshoni wazala uSalima; uSalima wazala uBhowazi;
uBhowazi wazala u-Obhede; u-Obhede wazala uJese.
UJese wazibula ngo-Eliyabe, owesibili kwaba ngu-Abhinadaba, owesithathu kwaba nguShimeya,
owesine kwaba nguNethaneli, owesihlanu kwaba nguRadayi,
owesithupha kwaba ngu-Osemi, owesikhombisa kwaba nguDavide;
odadewabo: kwakunguZeruya no-Abhigayili. Amadodana kaZeruya: u-Abhishayi, uJowabe no-Asaheli, ayemathathu.
U-Abhigayili wazala u-Amasa. Uyise ka-Amasa kwakunguJetheri, umIshmayeli.
UKhalebhi, indodana kaHezironi, wazala ku-Azuba, umkakhe, nakuJeriyothi; nanka amadodana akhe: uJesheri, uShobhabhi no-Aridoni.
Esefile u-Azuba; uKhalebhu wathatha u-Efrathi, wamzalela uHure.
UHure wazala u-Uri; u-Uri wazala uBhezaleli.
Kwathi sekwedlule isikhathi, uHezironi wangena indodakazi kaMakhiri, uyise kaGileyadi. Wamthatha eseneminyaka engama-60, wamzalela uSegubhi.
USegubhi wazala uJayire, owayenemizi engama-23 kwaGileyadi.
UGeshuri no-Aramu bathatha imizana kaJayiremi, iKenathi nemizana yalo, imizi engama-60. Bonke laba babengamadodana kaMakhiri, uyise kaGileyadi.
Emva kokufa kukaHezironi eKhalebhu Efratha, u-Abhiya, umkaHezironi, wamzalela u-Ashuri uyise kaThekhowa.
Amadodana kaJerameli, izibulo likaHezironi, kwakunguRamu izibulo, elanywe ngoBhuna, u-Oreni, u-Osemi no-Ahiya.
UJerameli wayenomunye umfazi, igama lakhe kungu-Athara; engunina ka-Onamu.
Amadodana kaRamu, izibulo likaJerameli, kwakunguMahazi, uJamini no-Ekheri.
Amadodana ka-Onamu kwakunguShamayi noJada. Amadodana kaShamayi: kwakunguNadabi no-Abhishuri.
Igama lomka Abhishuri kwakungu-Abhihayili, wamzalela u-Ahibhani noMolidi.
Amadodana kaNadabi: uSeledi no-Aphayimi; uSeledi wafa engenantwana.
Indodana ka-Aphayimi: kwakungu-Ishi. Indodana ka-Ishi: kwakunguSheshani. Indodana kaSheshani: kwakungu-Ahilayi.
Amadodana kaJada, umfowabo kaShamayi: kwakunguJetheri noJonathani; uJetheri wafa engenamntwana.
Amadodana kaJonathani: kwakunguPhelethi noZaza. Laba babengamadodana kaJerameli.
USheshani wayengenamadodana, enamadodakazi wodwa. USheshani wayenenceku eyayivela eGibhithe, igama layo kunguJariha.
USheshani waganisela uJariha, inceku yakhe, indodakazi yakhe, ukuba ibe ngumkakhe; wamzalela u-Athayi.
U-Athayi wazala uNathani; uNathani wazala uZabhadi.
UZabhadi wazala u-Efilali; u-Efilali wazala u-Obhede.
U-Obhede wazala uJehu; uJehu wazala u-Azariya.
U-Azariya wazala uHelezi; uHelezi wazala u-Eleyasa.
U-Eleyasa wazala uSisamayi; uSisamayi wazala uShalumi,
uShalumi wazala uJekhamiya; uJekhamiya wazala u-Elishama.
Amadodana kaKhalebhu, umfowabo kaJerameli: kwakunguMesha izibulo lakhe, owayenguyise kaZifi, namadodana kaMaresha, uyise kaHebhroni.
Amadodana kaHebhroni: kwakunguKhora, uThaphuwa, uRekemi noShema.
UShema wazala uRahamu, uyise kaJorikeyamu; uRekemi wazala uShamayi.
Indodana kaShamayi: kwakunguMahoni; uMahoni wayenguyise kaBhethi Zuri.
U-Efa, isancinza sikaKhalebhu, wazala uHarana, uMoza, noGazezi; uHarana wazala uGazezi.
Amadodana kaJadayi: kwakunguRegemi, uJothamu, uGeshani, uPhelethi, u-Efa noShahafi.
UMahakha, isancinza sikaKhalebhu, wazala uShebheri noThirihana.
Wazala noShahafi, uyise kaMadimana, uSheva, uyise kaMakhibhena, noyise kaGibheya. Indodakazi kaKhalebhu kwakungu-Akhisa.
Nampa ababengabozalo lukaKhalebhu: amadodana kaHure, izibulo lika-Efratha: kwakunguShobhali, uyise kaKiriyathi Jeharimi,
uSalima uyise kaBhethlehema, noHarefi uyise kaBhethi Gaderi.
UShobhali, uyise kaKiriyathi Jeharimi, wayenalawa madodana: oHarowe nengxenye kaMenuhothi.
Imindeni kaKiriyathi Jeharimi kwakungamaJetheri, amaPhuthi, amaShumathi namaMishirayithi; kubo kwavela amaZorathi nama-Eshithawoli.
Amadodana kaSalima: kwakunguBhethlehema, uNethofa, u-Atharothi Bhethi Jowabe, nengxenye yamaManahathi, amaZori.
Imindeni yababhali ababehlala eJabhezi: ngamaThirathi, amaShimeyathi namaSukhathi. Laba babengamaKheni ayevela kuHamathi, uyise wendlu kaRekhabhi.
Nanka amagama amadodana kaDavide abamzalela wona eHebhroni: izibulo u-Amnoni ku-Ahinohama, umHizireyelikazi; owesibili nguDaniyeli, ku-Abhigayili, umKharmelikazi;
owesithathu ngu-Absalomu, indodana kaMahakha, indodakazi kaThalimayi, inkosi yaseGeshuri; owesine ngu-Adoniya, indodana kaHagithi;
owesihlanu nguShefathiya ku-Abhithali; owesithupha ngu-Ithereyamu ku-Egila, umkakhe.
Wazalelwa ayisithupha eHebhroni; wabusa khona iminyaka eyisikhombisa nezinyanga eziyisithupha; eJerusalema wabusa iminyaka engama-33.
Nanka-ke amadodana abamzalela wona eJerusalema: uShimeya, uShobhabhi, uNathani noSolomoni, ayemane, kuBhathi Shuwa, indodakazi ka-Amiyeli wazala:
uJibhari, u-Elishama, u-Elifelethi,
uNoga, uNefegi, uJafiya,
u-Elishama, u-Eliyada no-Elifeleti, ayeyisishiyagalolunye.
Wonke lawo kwakungamadodana kaDavide, ngaphandle kwalawo ayezalwa yizancinza. Udadewabo kwakunguThamari.
Indodana kaSolomoni kwakunguRehobhowamu, yena wazala u-Abhiya. U-Abhiya wazala u-Asa; u-Asa wazala uJehoshafathi.
UJehoshafathi wazala uJoramu; yena wazala u-Ahaziya; yena wazala uJowashi.
UJowashi wazala u-Amaziya; yena wazala u-Azariya; yena wazala uJothamu.
UJothamu wazala u-Ahazi; yena wazala uHezekiya; yena wazala uManase.
UManase wazala u-Amoni; yena wazala uJosiya.
UJosiya wazala amadodana amane: izibulo nguJohanani, eyesibili nguJehoyakimi, eyesithathu nguZedekiya, eyesine nguShalumi.
Amadodana kaJehoyakimi: uJekhoniya, indodana yakhe, noZedekiya, indodana yakhe.
Amadodana kaJekhoniya umthunjwa: kwakunguSheyalitiyeli,
uMalikhiramu, uPhedaya, uShenazari, uJekamiya, uHoshama noNedabiya.
Amadodana kaPhedaya: kwakunguZerubhabhele noShimeyi. Amadodana kaZerubhabhele: kwakunguMeshulamu noHananiya nodadewabo uShelomithi,
uHashubha, u-Oheli, uBherekhiya, uHasadiya noJushabhi Hesedi, eyisihlanu esewonke.
Amadodana kaHananiya: kwakunguPhelathiya, uJeshaya, amadodana kaRefaya, amadodana ka-Arinani, amadodana ka-Obhadiya, namadodana kaShekhaniya.
Indodana kaShekhaniya: kwakunguShemaya; amadodana kaShemaya: kwakunguHathushi, u-Igali, uBhariya, uNehariya noShafathi, eyisithupha esewonke.
Amadodana kaNehariya: kwakungu-Eliyohenayi, uHezekiya no-Azirikamu, emathathu esewonke.
Amadodana ka-Eliyohenayi: kwakunguHodaviya, u-Eliyashibhi, uPhelaya, u-Akubhi, uJohanani, uDelaya no-Anani, eyisikhombisa esewonke.
Amadodana kaJuda: kwakunguPherezi, uHezironi, uKharmi, uHure, noShobhali.
URewaya, indodana kaShobhali, wazala uJahathi; uJahathi wazala u-Ahumayi noLahadi. Laba babengabemindeni yamaZorathi.
Nampa abazalwa ngu-Ethami: nguJizreyeli, u-Ishima, u-Idibhashi, udadewabo kunguHaseleliphoni,
uPhenuweli, wayenguyise kaGedori, u-Ezeri kunguyise kaHusha. Yilabo-ke ababengabakaHure, izibulo lika-Efratha, uyise kaBhethlehema.
U-Ashuri, uyise kaThekhowa, wayenabafazi ababili, uHela noNahara.
UNahara wamzalela u-Ahuzamu, uHeferi, uThemeni noHawahashithari. Yilabo ababengamadodana kaNahara.
Amadodana kaHela: kwakunguZerethi, uJizihari no-Ethinani.
UKozi wazala u-Anubhi, uZobeba, nemindeni ka-Ahariheli, indodana kaHarumu.
UJabhezi wayetuseka kunabafowabo. Unina wamqamba igama wathi: “NguJabhezi,” ngoba wathi: “Ngokuba ngamzala ngobuhlungu.”

UJabhezi wakhuleka kuNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, wathi: “Sengathi ungangibusisa nokungibusisa, wandise umngcele wami, isandla sakho sibe nami, ungivikele ebubini, ngingehlelwa wubuhlungu.” UNkulunkulu wamnika akucelayo.
UKhelubhi, umfowabo kaShubha, wazala uMehiri owayenguyise ka-Eshithoni.
U-Eshithoni wazala uBhebhi Rafa, uPhaseya, noThehina, uyise ka-Iri Nahashi. Yilabo-ke ababengamadodana kaRekha.
Amadodana kaKenazi: kwakungu-Otheniyeli noSeraya; indodana ka-Otheniyeli: kunguHathathi.
UMehonothayi wazala u-Ofira. UZeraya wazala uJowabe, uyise wesigodi sabakhandi, ngokuba babengabakhandi.
Amadodana kaKhalebhu, indodana kaJefune: kwakungu-Iru, u-Ela, noNahamu, namadodana ka-Ela, noKenazi.
Amadodana kaJehaleli: kwakunguZifi, uZifa, uThiriya no-Asareli.
Amadodana ka-Ezra: kwakunguJetheri, uMeredi, u-Eferi, noJaloni; wazala uMiriyamu, uShamayi no-Ishibha, uyise ka-Eshithemowa.
Umkakhe owayengumJudakazi wazala uJeredi, uyise kaGedori, uHebhere, uyise kaSokho, noJekuthiyeli, uyise kaZanowa. Abanye babengamadodana kaBhithiya, indodakazi kaFaro, eyathathwa nguMeredi.
Amadodana omkaHodiya, udadewabo kaNahamu, ayenguyise kaKeyila, umGarimi, no-Eshithemowa, umMahakha.
Amadodana kaShimoni: kwakungu-Amnoni, uRina, uBheni Hanani noThiloni. Amadodana ka-Ishi: kwakunguZohethi noBheni Zohethi.
Amadodana kaShela, indodana kaJuda: kwakungu-Eri, uyise kaLekha, uLahada, uyise kaMaresha, nemindeni yendlu yabaluka ilineni elicolekileyo, bendlu ka-Ashibheya,
uJokimi, nabantu baseKhozebha, uJowashi, uSarafi, ababebusa kwaMowabi, noJashubhi Lehemi. Kepha lezi zindaba ngezasemandulo.
Labo babengababumbi nabakhileyo eNethayimi naseGedera; bahlala khona nenkosi, benza umsebenzi wayo.
Amadodana kaSimeyoni: kwakunguNemuweli, uJamini, uJaribi, uZera noShawule,
uShalumi indodana yakhe, uMibhisamu indodana yakhe noMishima, indodana yakhe.
Amadodana kaMishima: kwakunguHamuweli, uZakhuri noShimeyi.
UShimeyi wayenamadodana ali-16, namadodakazi ayisithupha, kodwa abafowabo babengenabantwana abaningi, nomndeni wabo awandanga njengabakwaJuda.
Bahlala eBheri Sheba, eMolada, eHazari Shuwali,
eBhiliha, e-Ezemi, eTholadi,
eBhethuweli, eHorma, eZikilagi,
eBhethi Marikhabhothi, eHazari Susimi, eBhethi Bhiri, naseShaharayimi. Yileyo-ke okwakuyimizi yabo, kwaze kwabusa uDavide.
Imizana yabo: i-Ethamu, i-Ayini, iRimoni, iThokheni ne-Ashani, kuyimizi eyisihlanu,
nayo yonke imizana eyayiyizungezile, kwaze kwaba seBhali. Lezo kwakuyizindawo zabo, bebhalwe ngezizukulwane zabo.
UMeshobhabhi, uJamilekhi, uJosha, indodana ka-Amasiya,
uJoweli, uJehu kaJoshibhiya kaSeraya ka-Asiyeli,
u-Eliyohenayi, uJahakhoba, uJeshohaya, u-Asaya, u-Adiyeli, uJesimiyeli, uBhenaya,
noZiza kaShifi ka-Aloni kaJedaya kaShimri kaShemaya.
Bonke laba ababizwe ngamagama ngenhla babengabaholi emindenini yabo. Izindlu zokhokho babo zanda kakhulu.
Baya ngasekungeneni eGedori, ngasohlangothini lwasempumalanga lwesigodi, bayofunela izimvu zabo idlelo.
Bathola idlelo elivundileyo nelihle; izwe lalibanzi nxazombili, lizolile, linokuthula, ngokuba ababehlala khona kuqala ngabakwaHamu.

Labo bafika ngezinsuku zikaHezekiya, inkosi yakwaJuda, babhubhisa amathende abo nawamaMehuni atholakala lapho, babaqothula kuze kube namuhla, base behlala endaweni yabo, ngokuba bathola idlelo lemfuyo yabo lapho.
Abanye babo ababengabozalo lukaSimeyoni babengama-500, baya entabeni iSeyiri beholwa nguPhelathiya, uNehariya, uRefaya no-Uziyeli, indodana ka-Ishi.
Bayibhubhisa insali yama-Amaleki eyayiphunyukile, basahlala lapho kuze kube namuhhla.

Amadodana kaRubeni, izibulo lika-Israyeli. Wayeyizibulo, kodwa ngenxa yokuba wangcolisa umbhede kayise, ubuzibulo bakhe banikwa amadodana kaJosefa, indodana ka-Israyeli, futhi akabhalwangwa nasezizukulwaneni njengezibulo.
Noma uJuda wayenamandla kunabafowabo, kwavela kuye umbusi, ubuzibulo nokho babungobukaJosefa.
Amadodana kaRubeni, izibulo lika-Israyeli: kwakunguHanokhi, uPhalu, uHezironi noKharmi.
Amadodana kaJoweli: kwakunguShemaya, uGogi, uShimeyi,
uMikha, uRewaya, uBhali,
noBhera, owathunjwa nguThiligathi Phileneseri, inkosi yase-Asiriya; wayengumholi wakwaRubeni.
Abafowabo nabo babebhalwe ngemindeni yabo, nangezizukulwane zabo: uJehiyeli, inhloko noZakhariya,
uBhela ka-Azazi kaShema kaJoweli, owayehlala e-Aroweri kwaze kwaba seNebho, noBhali Mehoni.
Wakha ngasempumalanga kwaze kwaba sekuqaleni kwehlane elisuka emfuleni iYufrathe, ngokuba imfuyo yabo yanda kwaGileyadi.
Emihleni kaSawule bahlasela amaHagiri, bawanqoba, base behlala emathendeni awo ngasempumalanga yalo lonke elakwaGileyadi.
Amadodana kaGadi ahlala maqondana nabo eBhashani, kwaze kwaba seSaleka.
Izinhloko kwakunguJoweli, owesibili kunguShafamu, kulandele uJahanayi noShafani.
Abafowabo babemi kanje ngokwezindlu zoyise: kwakunguMikhayeli, uMeshulamu, uShebha, uJorayi, uJakhani, uZiya no-Ebhere, beyisikhombisa sebebonke.
Laba babengamadodana ka-Abhihayili kaHuri kaJarowa kaGileyadi kaMikhayeli kaJeshishayi kaJahido kaBhuzi.
U-Ahi ka-Abhidiyeli kaGuni wayeyinhloko yezindlu zokhokho babo.
Bahlala kwaGileyadi eBhashani nasemizaneni yalo, nasemadlelweni wonke eSharoni, kwaze kwaba semingceleni yawo.
Bonke laba babhalwa ngezizukulwane zabo emihleni kaJothamu, inkosi yakwaJuda, nasemihleni kaJerobhowamu, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli.
Amadodana kaRubeni, nabakwaGadi, nengxenye yesizwana sakwaManase, kwakungamadoda anamandla, aphatha ihawu nenkemba, ansale umnsalo futhi eqeqeshelwe ukulwa, ayeyizi-44 760 aya empini,
ahlasela amaHagiri, noJethuri, noNafishi noNodabhi.
Ngesikhathi ethola usizo lokulwa nabo, amaHagiri anikelwa ezandleni zawo nabo bonke ababenawo, ngokuba akhala kuNkulunkulu empini, amncenga, ngoba ayemethemba.
Adla izinkomo zabo, amakamela ayizi-50 000, izimvu eziyizi-250 000, izimbongolo eziyizi-2 000, nabantu abayizi-100 000.
Kwawa abaningi bebulewe, ngoba impi yayingekaNkulunkulu. Ahlala endaweni yabo aze athunjwa.
Abantu ababeyingxenye yesizwana sakwaManase bahlala kulelo lizwe, kusukela eBhashani kuze kube seBhali Hermoni, eSeniri, nasentabeni iHermoni.

Nazi izinhloko zezindlu zokhokho babo: ngu-Eferi, u-Ishi, u-Eliyeli, u-Aziriyeli, uJeremiya, uHodaviya noJahidiyeli; babengamaqhawe anamandla, amadoda anegama futhi eyizinhloko zezindlu zokhokho babo.
Kepha baphambuka kuNkulunkulu wokhokho babo, balandela onkulunkulu babantu balelo lizwe, baphinga, uNkulunkulu ababhubhisa phambi kwabo.

UNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli wavusa umoya kaPhuli, inkosi yase-Asiriya, nomoya kaThiligathi Philineseri, inkosi yase-Asiriya, babathumba abakwaRubeni, abakwaGadi, nengxenye yesizwana sakwaManase, babayisa eHala, eHabhori, eHara, nasemfuleni iGozani, kuze kube namuhla.
Amadodana kaLevi: uGereshoni, uKohathi, noMerari.
Amadodana kaKohathi: u-Amramu, uJizihari, uHebhroni no-Uziyeli.
Amadodana ka-Amramu: u-Aroni, uMose, noMiriyamu. Amadodana ka-Aroni: uNadabi, u-Abhihu, u-Eleyazare no-Ithamari.
U-Eleyazare wazala uFinehasi; uFinehasi wazala u-Abhishuwa;
u-Abhishuwa wazala uBhuki; uBhuki wazala u-Uzi;
u-Uzi wazala uZeraya; uZeraya wazala uMerayothi;
uMerayothi wazala u-Amariya; u-Amariya wazala u-Ahithubi;
u-Ahithubi wazala uZadoki; uZadoki wazala u-Ahimahazi;
u-Ahimahazi wazala u-Azariya; u-Azariya wazala uJohanani;
uJohanani wazala u-Azariya; nguye owayengumphristi endlini eyakhiwa nguSolomoni eJerusalema.
U-Azariya wazala u-Amariya; u-Amariya wazala u-Ahithubi.
U-Ahithubi wazala uZadoki; uZadoki wazala uShalumi;
uShalumi wazala uHilikiya; uHilikiya wazala u-Azariya;
u-Azariya wazala uSeraya; uSeraya wazala uJehozadaki,
kodwa uJehozadaki wahamba ngesikhathi uSimakade ethumba uJuda neJerusalema ngesandla sikaNebukhadinezari.
Amadodana kaLevi: kwakunguGereshomu, uKhohathi noMerari.
Nanka amagama amadodana kaGereshomu: nguLibhini noShimeyi.
Amadodana kaKhohathi: ngu-Amramu, uJizihari, uHebhroni no-Uziyeli.
Amadodana kaMerari: nguMaheli noMushi. Nansi imindeni yabaLevi ngokokhokho babo:
kwaGereshomu: kwakunguLibhini, uJahathi, uZima,
uJowa, u-Ido, uZera noJewatherayi.
Amadodana kaKhohathi: kwakungu-Aminadaba, uKhora, u-Asiri,
u-Elikhana, u-Ebhiyasafa, u-Asiri,
uThathi, u-Uriyeli, u-Uziya, uShawule.
Amadodana ka-Elikhana: kwakungu-Amasayi no-Ahimothi,
u-Elikhana, uZofayi, uNahathi,
u-Eliyabe, uJerohamu no-Elikhana.
Amadodana kaSamuweli: izibulo kwakunguJoweli, eyesibili kungu-Abhiya.
Amadodana kaMerari: kwakunguMaheli, uLibhini, uShimeyi, u-Uza,
uShimeya, uHagiya no-Asaya.
Nampa abantu uDavide ababeka ukuba bahole ukuhlabelela endlini kaSimakade, ngesikhathi umphongolo usubekwe khona.
Babekhonza ngokuhlabelela phambi kwethabanakeli lethende lokuhlangana, waze uSolomoni wakha indlu kaSimakade eJerusalema. Babambelela njengokwenqubo yomsebenzi wabo.
Yilaba ababema namadodana abo: kumadodana amaKhohathi: nguHemani, umhlabeleli, kaJoweli, kaSamuweli,
ka-Elikhana, kaJerohamu, ka-Eliyeli, kaThowa,
kaZufi, ka-Elikhana, kaMahathi, ka-Amasayi,
ka-Elikhana, kaJoweli, ka-Azariya, kaZefaniya,
kaThathi, ka-Asiri, ka-Ebhiyasafa, kaKhora,
kaJizihari, kaKhohathi, kaLevi, ka-Israyeli.
Umfowabo u-Asafa wayemi ngakwesokunene sakhe; u-Asafa, kaBherekhiya, kaShimeya,
kaMikhayeli, kaBhahaseya, kaNalikhiya,
ka-Ethini, kaZera, ka-Adaya,
ka-Ethani, kaZima, kaShimeyi,
kaJahathi, kaGereshomu, kaLevi.
Amadodana kaMerari, abafowabo ababema ngakwesokunene: kungu-Ethani, kaKhishi, ka-Abhidi, kaMalukhi,
kaHashabhiya, ka-Amaziya, kaHilikhiya,
ka-Amizi, kaBhani, kaShemeri,
kaMaheli, kaMushi, kaMerari, kaLevi.
Abafowabo abaLevi banikwa inkonzo yonke yethabanakeli lendlu kaNkulunkulu.

U-Aroni namadodana akhe babeshiya iminikelo e-althare leminikelo yokushiswa nase-althare lempepho, benza wonke umsebenzi endaweni engcwelengcwele, benzela u-Israyeli ukubuyisana njengakho konke ayale ngakho uMose, inceku kaNkulunkulu.
Nanka amadodana ka-Aroni: ngu-Eleyazare, uFinehasi, u-Abhishuwa,
uBhuki, u-Uzi, uZeraya,
uMerayothi, u-Amariya, u-Ahithubi,
uZadoki no-Ahimahazi.
Nazi izindawo zawo zokuhlala, izinkambu zawo emingceleni yawo: amadodana ka-Aroni awomndeni kaKhohathi, ngokuba yiwo adliwa wunkatho kuqala.
Wona anikwa iHebhroni, kwaJuda namadlelo alizungezileyo.
Kepha amasimu omuzi nemizana yawo bakunika uKhalebhu, indodana kaJefune.
Abozalo luka-Aroni balunika imizi yokuphephela: iHebhroni, neLibhina namadlelo ayo, iJathiri, ne-Eshithemowa namadlelo ayo,
iHileni namadlelo alo, iDebhiri namadlelo alo,
i-Ashani namadlelo alo, iBhethi Shemeshi namadlelo alo.
Esizwaneni sakwaBhenjamini bawanika iGebha namadlelo alo, i-Alemethi namadlelo alo, ne-Anathothi namadlelo alo. Isiyonke imizi yawo ngokwemindeni yawo yayiyimizi eli-13.
Abozalo lukaKhohathi ababesele banikwa ngonkatho imizi elishumi emndenini, engxenyeni yesizwana sakwaManase, emindenini yakhona ngokwemindeni yawo.
Abozalo lukaGereshomu, ngemindeni yabo, anikwa esizwaneni sakwa-Isakhare, nesakwa-Asheri, nesakwaNafethali, nasengxenyeni yesizwana sakwaManase, eBhashani, kwaba yimizi eli-13.
Abozalo lukaMerari banikwa ngonkatho ngokwemindeni yabo esizwaneni sakwaRubeni, nakwesakwaGadi, nakwesakwaZebuloni, kwaba yimizi eli-12.
Abakwa-Israyeli banika abaLevi leyo mizi namadlelo ayo.
Leyo mizi ebizwe ngamagama banikwa yona ngonkatho esizwaneni sakwaJuda, nakwesakwaSimeyoni, nakwesakwaBhenjamini.
Eminye imindeni yabozalo lukaKhohathi yayinemizi emingceleni yesizwana sakwa-Efrayimi.
Bayinika imizi yokuphephela: iShekhemi, ezintabeni kwa-Efrayimi, namadlelo alo, iGezeri namadlelo alo,
iJokhimeyamu namadlelo alo, iBhethi Horoni namadlelo alo,
i-Ajaloni namadlelo alo, iGathi Rimoni namadlelo alo,
nasengxenyeni yesizwana sakwaManase, i-Anere namadlelo alo, neBhileyamu namadlelo alo, kwaba ngokomndeni owawusele wozalo lukaKhohathi.
Abozalo lukaGereshomu banikwa emndenini wengxenye yesizwana sakwaManase iGolanu, iBhashani namadlelo alo, i-Ashitharothi namadlelo alo;
nasesizwaneni sakwa-Isakhare, iKedeshi namadlelo alo, iDabherathi namadlelo alo,
iRamothi namadlelo alo, i-Anemi namadlelo alo;
nasesizwaneni sakwa-Asheri: iMashali namadlelo alo, i-Abhidoni namadlelo alo,
iHukhokhi namadlelo alo, iRehobe namadlelo alo;
nasesizwaneni sakwaNafethali, iKedeshi, eGalile, namadlelo alo, iHamoni namadlelo alo, iKiriyathayimi namadlelo alo.
Kwathi abozalo lukaMerari abebesele banikwa esizwaneni sakwaZebuloni: iRimono namadlelo alo, iGabhori namadlelo alo,
phesheya kweJordani ngaseJeriko, empumalanga neJordani, esizwaneni sakwaRubeni, banikwa iBhezeri, ehlane, namadlelo alo, iJahaza namadlelo alo,
iKedemothi namadlelo alo, neMefahathi namadlelo alo;
nasesizwaneni sakwaGadi, banikwa iRamothi, kwaGileyadi, namadlelo alo, iMahanayimi namadlelo alo,
iHeshibhoni namadlelo alo, neJazeri namadlelo alo.
Amadodana ka-Isakhare: kwakunguThola, uPhuwa, uJashubhi noShimroni; esewonke ayemane.

Amadodana kaThola: kwakungu-Uzi, uRefaya, uJeriyeli, uJahemayi, u-Ibhisamu, noShemuweli. Babeyizinhloko zezindlu zokhokho babo, abakwaThola, bengamaqhawe anamandla ngezizukulwane zabo. Ubuningi babo ngesikhathi sikaDavide babeyizi-22 600.
Indodana ka-Uzi: kunguJizirahiya. Amadodana kaJizirahiya: kwakunguMikhayeli, u-Obhadiya, uJoweli noJishiya; eyisihlanu esewonke futhi wonke eyizinhloko.
Kuwo kwakukhona amabutho ngamaviyo awo, ezizukulwaneni zezindlu zokhokho bawo. Kwakungamabutho ayizi-36 000, ngokuba babenabafazi abaningi namadodana amaningi.
Abakwa-Isakhare ngokwemindeni babeyizi-87 000, bengamaqhawe, futhi bonke bebhalwe ngezizukulwane zabo.
Amadodana kaBhenjamini: kwakunguBhela, uBhekheri noJediyayeli; emathuthu esewonke.

Amadodana kaBhela: kwakungu-Eshibhoni, u-Uzi, u-Uziyeli, uJeremothi, no-Iri, eyisihlanu esewonke. Ayeyizinhloko zezindlu zawoyise, engamaqhawe anamandla, ayeyizi-22 034, wonke ebhalwe ngokwezizukulwane zawo.
Amadodana kaBhekheri: kwakunguZemira, uJowashi, u-Eliyezeri, u-Eliyohenayi, u-Omri, uJeremothi, u-Abhiya, u-Anathothi no-Alemethi. Bonke laba abangenhla kwakungamadodana kaBhekheri.
Abhalwa ngokwezizukulwane zawo, eyizinhloko zezindlu zokhokho bawo, engamaqhawe anamandla, eyizi-20 200.
Indodana kaJediyayeli: kwakunguBhilihani. Amadodana kaBhilihani: kunguJewushe, uBhenjamini, u-Ehudi, uKhenahana, uZethani, uTharishishi no-Ahishahari.
Bonke laba babengamadodana kaJediyayeli, beyizinhloko zezindlu zawoyise, bengamaqhawe anamandla, beyizi-17 000 abase bekulungele ukuphuma impi.
Amadodana ka-Iri: kwakunguShuphimi noHuphimi. UHushimi eyindodana ka-Aheri.
Amadodana kaNafethali: kwakunguJaziyeli, uGuni, uJezeri noShalumi, amadodana kaBhiliha.
Amadodana kaManase: kwakungu-Asiriyeli ayemzalelwe isancinza sakhe, umAramukazi, sazala noMakhiri uyise kaGileyadi.
UMakhiri wathathela uHuphimi noShuphimi abafazi, udadewabo kwakunguMahakha. Igama lowesibili kwakunguZelofehadi. UZelofehadi wayenamadodakazi wodwa.
UMahakha, umkaMakhiri, wazala indodana, wayiqamba igama wathi nguPhereshi; igama lomfowabo kunguShereshi; amadodana akhe kungu-Ulamu noRakhemi.
Indodana ka-Ulamu: kunguBhedani. Labo babengabozalo lukaGileyadi kaMakhiri kaManase.
Udadewabo, uHamolekhethi, wazala u-Ishihodi, u-Abhiyezeri noMahela.
Amadodana kaShemida: kwakungu-Ahiyani, uShekhemi, uLikhihi no-Aniyamu.
Abozalo luka-Efrayimi: kwakunguShuthela, uBheredi, uThahathi, u-Eleyada uThahathi,
uZabhadi, uShuthela, u-Ezeri no-Eleyadi, babulawa ngabantu baseGathi ababezelwe kulelo lizwe, ngokuba behla ukuzothatha imfuyo yabo.
U-Efrayimi uyise walila izinsuku eziningi; abafowabo beza bamduduza.
Walala nomkakhe, wakhulelwa, wazala indodana, wayiqamba igama wathi nguBheriya, ngokuba wathi indlu yakhe beyehlelwe yinhlekelele.
Indodakazi yakhe kwakunguSheyera owakha iBhethi Horoni eZansi naseNhla, ne-Uzeni Sheyera.
Indodana yakhe kwakunguRefa, uThela, uThahani,
uLadani, u-Amihudi, u-Elishama,
uNuni, noJoshuwa.
Ifa labo nezindawo zabo zokuhlala kwakuyiBhethele nemizana yalo, ngasempumalanga kuyiNaharani, ngasentshonalanga kuyiGezeri nemizana yalo, iShekemi nemizana yalo, kwaze kwaba se-Aya nemizana yalo;
ngasemingceleni yabakwaManase kuyiBhethi Sheyani nemizana yalo, iThahanakhi nemizana yalo, iMegido nemizana yalo, neDori nemizana yalo. Kuleyo ndawo kwahlala abakwaJosefa, indodana ka-Israyeli.
Amadodana ka-Asheri: kwakunguJimna, u-Ishiva, u-Ishivi, uBheriya, nodadewabo uSera.
Amadodana kaBheriya: kunguHebhere, noMalikhiyeli owayenguyise kaBhirizayithi.
UHebhere wazala uJafelethi, uShomeri, uHothamu, noShuwa, udadewabo.
Amadodana kaJafelethi: kwakunguPhasakhi, uBhimihali, no-Ashivathi. Laba kwakungamadodana kaJafelethi.
Amadodana kaShemeri: kwakungu-Ahi, uRohiga, uJehuba no-Aramu.
Amadodana kaHelemi, umfowabo: kunguZofa, uJimna, uSheleshi no-Amali.
Amadodana kaZofa: kwakunguShuwa, uHarineferi, uShuhali, uBheri no-Imra,
uBhezeri, uHodi, uShama, uShilisha, u-Ithrani noBheyera.
Amadodana kaJetheri: kwakunguJefune, uPhisipha no-Ara.
Amadodana ka-Ula: kungu-Ara, uHaniyeli noRiziya.

Bonke laba babengabozalo luka-Asheri, izinhloko zezindlu zokhokho, amaqhawe akhethekileyo anamandla, izinhloko zabaholi. Inani labo sebebonke elibhalwe ngezizukulwane zabo ukuba balwe empini, kwakungamabutho ayizi-26 000.
UBhenjamini wazibula ngoBhela, welanywa ngu-Ashibheli, owesithathu kwaba ngu-Ahara,
owesine kwaba nguNoha, owesihlanu kwaba nguRafa.
Amadodana kaBhela: kwakungu-Adari, uGera, u-Abhihudi,
u-Abhishuwa, uNahamani, u-Ahowa,
uGera, uShefufani noHuramu.
Nanka amadodana ka-Ehudi, izinhloko zezindlu zawoyise zezakhamuzi zaseGebha, ezathunjelwa eManahathi,
zayiswa ekuthunjweni: nguNahamani, u-Ahiya, uGera owayezala u-Uza no-Ahihudi.
UShaharayimi wazala abantwana kwaMowabi, esebahambisile omkakhe uHushimi noBhahara.
Wazala amadodana kuHodeshi, umkakhe; kwakunguJobhabhi, uSibiya, uMesha, uMalikhamu,
uJewuze, uShakhiya, noMirima. Laba kwakungamadodana akhe, izinhloko zezindlu zawoyise.
Wazala kuHushimi u-Abhithubhi no-Eliphahali.
Amadodana ka-Eliphahali: kwakungu-Ebhere, uMishamu, noShemedi; yiwona akha i-Ono, neLodi, nemizana yakhona;
uBheriya, noShema babeyizinhloko zezindlu zawoyise, zezakhamuzi zase-Ajaloni, ezaxosha ababakhe eGathi.
U-Ahiyo, uShashakhi, uJeremothi,
uZebadiya, u-Aradi, u-Edere,
uMikhayeli, uJishipha, uJoha, kwakungamadodana kaBheriya.
UZebadiya, uMeshulamu, uHiziki, uHebhere,
u-Ishmerayi, uJiziliya, uJobhabhi, kwakungamadodana ka-Eliphahali.
UJakimi, uZikhiri, uZabhidi,
u-Eliyenayi, uZilethayi, u-Eliyeli,
u-Adaya, uBheraya, uShimrathi, kungamadodana kaShimeyi.
UJishiphani, u-Ebhere, u-Eliyeli,
u-Abhidoni, uZikhiri, uHanani,
uHananiya, u-Elamu, u-Anithothiya,
u-Ifideya, uPhenuweli, kwakungamadodana kaShashaki.
UShamusherayi, uShehariya, u-Athaliya,
uJahareshiya, u-Eliya, noZikhiri, kungamadodana kaJerohamu.
Laba babeyizinhloko zezindlu zawoyise, beyizinhloko ngokwezizukulwane zabo; babehlala eJerusalema.
EGibheyoni kwakuhlala uyise kaGibheyoni, igama lomkakhe kunguMahakha.
Izibulo lakhe kwakungu-Abhidoni elanywe uZuri, uKhishi, uBhali, uNadabhi,
uGedori, u-Ahiyo noZekheri.
UMakhilothi wazala uShimeya. Nabo bahlala nabafowabo eJerusalema.
UNeri wazala uKishi; uKishi wazala uSawule; uSawule wazala uJonathani, uMalikhi Shuwa, u-Abhinadaba no-Eshi Bhali.
Indodana kaJonathani kwakunguMeribhi Bhali. UMeribhi Bhali wazala uMikha.
Amadodana kaMikha: kwakunguPhithoni, uMelekhi, uThareya no-Ahazi.
U-Ahazi wazala uJehohada; uJehohada wazala u-Alemethi, u-Azimavethi, uZimri; uZimri wazala uMosa;
uMosa wazala uBhineya, uRafa, u-Eleyasa, u-Azeli.
U-Azeli wayenamadodana ayisithupha, nanka amagama awo: kwakungu-Azirikamu, uBhokheru, u-Ishmayeli, uShehariya, u-Obhadiya noHanani. Bonke laba kwakungamadodana ka-Azeli.
Amadodana ka-Esheki umfowabo: izibulo kwakungu-Ulamu, owesibili kunguJewushe, owesithathu kungu-Elifelethi.
Amadodana ka-Ulamu ayengamaqhawe anamandla, ansala umnsalo; ayenamadodana amaningi, namadodana amadodana amaningi, eyi-150. Laba babengabozalo lukaBhenjamini.
U-Israyeli wonke wabhalwa ngezizukulwane zakhe encwadini yamakhosi akwa-Israyeli. UJuda wathunjelwa eBhabhele ngenxa yeziphambeko zakhe.
Abahlala kuqala emizini eyifa labo kwakungu-Israyeli, abaphristi, abaLevi namaNethini.
EJerusalema kwakuhlala abakwaJuda, abakwaBhenjamini, nabakwa-Efrayimi, noManase:
u-Uthayi ka-Amihudi ka-Omri ka-Imri kaBhani, kwabozalo lukaPherezi kaJuda.
KumaShiloni: kwakungu-Asaya, izibulo, namadodana akhe.
Kumadodana kaZera: kunguJehuweli nabafowabo, bengama-690.
Kumadodana kaBhenjamini: kwakunguSalu kaMeshulamu kaHodaviya kaHasenuwa,
u-Ibhineya, indodana kaJerohamu, u-Ela ka-Uzi kaMikhiri, uMeshulamu kaShefathiya kaRehuweli kaJibhiniya,
nabafowabo, ngezizukulwane zabo, bengama-956. Bonke laba bantu babeyizinhloko zezindlu zoyise, ngokokhokho babo.
Kubaphristi: kwakunguJedaya, uJehoyaribi, uJakhini,
u-Azariya kaHilikiya, kaMeshulamu, kaZadoki, kaMerayothi, ka-Ahithubi, umphathi wendlu kaNkulunkulu.
No-Adaya kaJerohamu, kaPhashuri, kaMalikhiya, uMahasayi ka-Adiyeli, kaJahizera, kaMeshulamu, kaMeshilemithi, ka-Imeri,
nabafowabo, beyizinhloko zezindlu zokhokho babo, beyi-1 760, amadoda ahlakaniphile emsebenzini wenkonzo endlini kaNkulunkulu.
KubaLevi: kwakunguShemaya kaHashubhi, ka-Azirikamu, kaHashabhiya, kwabozalo lukaMerari.
KunguBhakibhakari, uHereshi, uGalali, uMathaniya kaMikha, kaZikhiri, ka-Asafa,
u-Obhadiya kaShemaya, kaGalali, kaJeduthuni, uBherekhiya ka-Asa, ka-Elikhana owayehlala emizaneni yamaNethofa.
Abalindisango kwakunguShalumi, u-Akubhi, uThalimoni, u-Ahimani, nabafowabo; uShalumi wayeyinhloko.
Kwaze kwaba yileso sikhathi bengabalindi besango lenkosi ngasempumalanga; babengabalindisango benkambu yabozalo lukaLevi.

UShalumi kaKhore, ka-Ebhiyasafa, kaKhora, nabafowabo bendlu kayise, amaKhorahi; babephethe umsebenzi wenkonzo, bengabalindi bompheme wethabanakeli. Okhokho babo babengabalindisango benkambu kaSimakade.
UFinehasi, indodana ka-Eleyazare owayebengamele ngesikhathi esidlulileyo, uSimakade wayenaye.
UZakhariya, indodana kaMeshelemiya wayengumlindisango ethendeni lokuhlangana.
Bonke ababekhethwe ukuba babe ngabalindisango babengama-212. Babhalwa ngezizukulwane zabo emizaneni yabo. UDavide noSamuweli, umboni, bababeka ezikhundleni zabo.
Bona nabozalo lwabo babephethe amasango endlu kaSimakade, indlu yethende, beyiqapha.
Kwakukhona abalindisango ezinhlangothini zozine: ngasempumalanga, entshonalanga, enyakatho, nangaseningizimu.
Abafowabo emizaneni yabo babengena njalo emveni kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa, izikhathi ngezikhathi, ukuba babe nabo.
Abalindi abane abakhulu ababengabaLevi babesesikhundleni njalo, bengamele amakamelo nengcebo endlini kaNkulunkulu.
Ebusuku babehlala beyizungeza indlu kaNkulunkulu, ngokuba yibona okwakumele bayiqaphe, bayivule futhi ekuseni, imihla ngemihla.
Abanye babengamele izitsha zenkonzo, ngokuba zazibalwa zingeniswa, zibalwe zikhishwa.
Abanye babo babebheka impahla, izitsha zonke zendlu engcwele: impuphu, iwayini, amafutha, inhlaka namakha.
Abanye bamadodana abaphristi babegxoba amakha abe ngamafutha.
UMathithiya, omunye wabaLevi, owayeyizibulo likaShalumi, umKhorahi, wayenesikhundla sokubheka ukwenziwa kwamakhekhe ayizicaba okuthiwa amaweyifa emabhodweni.
Abanye abafowabo bamadodana amaKhohathi babengamele izinkwa zokubukwa ukuba bazilungise ngawo wonke amasabatha.
Abanye abahlabeleli babeyizinhloko zezindlu zoyise zabaLevi, besemakamelweni, bekhululiwe kweminye imisebenzi, ngokuba babesemsebenzini imini nobusuku.
Labo babeyizinhloko zezindlu zawoyise babaLevi, izinhloko ezizukulwaneni zabo, babehlala eJerusalema.
EGibheyoni kwakuhlala uyise kaGibheyoni, uJehiyeli; igama lomkakhe kunguMahakha,
Izibulo lakhe kwakungu-Abhidoni elanywe uZuri, uKhishi, uBhali, uNeri, uNadabi,
uGedori, u-Ahiyo, uZakhariya, noMikhilothi.
UMakhilothi wazala uShimeyamu. Wahlala nabafowabo eJerusalema.
UNeri wazala uKishi; uKishi wazala uSawule; uSawule wazala uJonathani, uMalikhi Shuwa, u-Abhinadaba, no-Eshi Bhali.
Indodana kaJonathani kwakunguMeribhi Bhali. UMeribhi Bhali wazala uMikha.
Amadodana kaMikha: kwakunguPhithoni, uMelekhi, uThareya no-Ahazi.
U-Ahazi wazala uJara; uJara wazala u-Alemethi, u-Azimavethi, uZimri; uZimri wazala uMosa;
uMosa wazala uBhineya, uRefaya, u-Eleyasa, u-Azeli.
U-Azeli wayenamadodana ayisithupha, nanka amagama awo: kwakungu-Azirikamu, uBhokheru, u-Ishmayeli, uShehariya, u-Obhadiya noHanani. Bonke laba kwakungamadodana ka-Azeli.
AmaFilisti alwa no-Israyeli. Abantu bakwa-Israyeli babaleka bexoshwa ngamaFilisti, abanye bawa begwaziwe entabeni iGilibhowa.
AmaFilisti amxosha uSawule namadodana akhe, abulala uJonathani, u-Abhinadaba, namaMalikhi Shuwa, amadodana kaSawule.
Impi yaba nzima kuSawule, abacibayo bamfica esezinhlungwini ezinkulu ngenxa yababemcibile.

USawule wathi odibini lwakhe: “Hosha inkemba yakho, ungigwaze ngayo, funa labo abangasokile bafike bangihlukumeze.” Kepha aluvumanga udibi lwakhe, ngokuba lwalwesaba kakhulu. Ngalokho uSawule wathatha inkemba, wawela phezu kwayo.
Udibi lwakhe selubonile ukuthi uSawule ufile, lwawela phezu kwenkemba yalo, nalo lwafa.
Wafa-ke uSawule namadodana akhe amathathu, nendlu yakhe; bonke bafa kanyekanye.
Kwathi lapho bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli ababesesigodini bebona ukuthi abanye bayabaleka, nokuthi uSawule namadodana akhe bafile, bashiya imizi yabo, babaleka. AmaFilisti afika ahlala kuyo.
Kwathi ngakusasa amaFilisti afika ezophanga ababuleweyo, amthola uSawule namadodana akhe befile entabeni iGilibhowa.
Amphanga, athatha ikhanda lakhe nezikhali zakhe. Athumela ezweni lonke lamaFilisti ukuba kuyomenyezelwa izindaba ezinhle ezithombeni zawo nakubantu.
Azibeka izikhali zakhe endlini yonkulunkulu bawo, achoma ikhanda lakhe endlini kaDagoni.
Sebezwile bonke abaseJabheshi Gileyadi ngakho konke okwenziwe ngamaFilisti kuSawule,
asuka wonke amadoda anamandla ayothatha isidumbu sikaSawule nezamadodana akhe, aziletha eJabheshi. Amathambo abo awambela phansi kwe-okhi eJabheshi, azila ukudla izinsuku eziyikhombisa.
USawule wakhothama kanjalo-ke, ngenxa yesiphambeko sakhe asenza kuSimakade, akaze aligcina izwi likaSimakade, nangokuba aya kobhula konedlozi, wabuza kuye,
engabuzanga kuSimakade. Ngakho-ke wambulala, umbuso wawubuyisela kuDavide, indodana kaJese.
U-Israyeli wonke wabuthana kuDavide eHebhroni, wathi: “Thina phela siyithambo lakho nenyama yakho.

Nangesikhathi esedlule, kusabusa uSawule, nguwe owawuhola impi ka-Israyeli, uphume nayo ubuye ungene nayo. USimakade uNkulunkulu wakho wathi kuwe: ‘Wena uyakwalusa abantu bami, u-Israyeli; wena uzakuba ngumbusi wabantu bami, u-Israyeli.’ ”

Wonke amalunga akwa-Israyeli eza enkosini eHebhroni. UDavide wenza nawo isivumelwano eHebhroni, phambi kukaSimakade. Amgcoba uDavide waba yinkosi kwa-Israyeli, njengokusho kwezwi likaSimakade ngomlomo kaSamuweli.
UDavide no-Israyeli wonke baya eJerusalema eliyiJebusi, lapho kwakuhlala khona izakhamuzi zakulelo lizwe, amaJebusi.
Abakhileyo eJebusi bathi kuDavide: “Awusoze wangena lapha.” UDavide nokho wayinqoba inqaba iZiyoni, wayidla yaba ngumuzi wakhe.
UDavide wathi: “Lowo muntu oyohlabana kuqala, abulale umJebusi, nguye ozokuba yinhloko nenduna.” UJowabe, indodana kaZeruya, wenyuka kuqala, wawudla umhlanganiso, wabe eseba yinhloko.
UDavide wahlala enqabeni, ngakho-ke bayibiza ngokuthi umuzi kaDavide.
Wakha umuzi, wayizungeza kusuka eMilo kuya kuzo zonke izindawo. UJowabe wavusa okwakusasele komuzi.
UDavide waqhubeka njalo wakhula, ngokuba uSimakade Wamabandla wayenaye.
Yilezi izinhloko zamaqhawe kaDavide ayenazo, ezamsekela ngamandla embusweni wakhe kanye no-Israyeli wonkana, zambeka waba yinkosi njengokwezwi likaSimakade ngo-Israyeli.
Nanti-ke inani lamaqhawe kaDavide: kwakunguJashobhehamu, indodana yomHakhimoni, inhloko yezinduna ezingama-30; wagwaza wabulala abangama-300 ngomkhonto wakhe, ngasikhathi sinye.
Wayelandelwa ngu-Eleyazare, indodana kaDodo, umAhohi, owayengomunye wamaqhawe amathathu.
Wayekanye noDavide ePhasi Damimi, ngesikhathi kubuthana amaFilisti lapho ukuyokulwa nabo. Kwakukhona isiqinti sezwe esasigcwele ibhali. Abantu babebalekile phambi kwamaFilisti.
Bama phakathi nesiqinti sezwe, basivikela, bawabulala amaFilisti. USimakade wabasindisa ngokusindisa okukhulu.
Kwathi ngesikhathi amabutho amaFilisti ekanise eSigodini samaRefa, kwehla abathathu kwabayizinhloko ezingama-30, baya etsheni kuDavide, emgedeni wase-Adulamu.
UDavide wayesenqabeni, impi yamaFilisti yayikanise ngaseBhethlehema.
UDavide wayomile, omele amanzi, wathi: “Ngubani ozakunginika amanzi asemthonjeni eBhethlehema ongasesangweni, ngiphuze na?”
Lawo maqhawe amathathu afohla, angena enkanjini yamaFilisti, akha amanzi emthonjeni eBhethlehema ongasesangweni. Awathatha awaletha kuDavide, kepha akavumanga ukuwaphuza; wawathululela uSimakade.

Wathi: “Makube kude nami, Simakade, ukuba ngenze lokhu; ngingaliphuza yini igazi lalaba bantu ababeke impilo yabo engcupheni?” Akavumanga ukuwaphuza. Yilezi-ke izinto ezenziwa yilawo maqhawe amathathu.
U-Abhishayi, umfowabo kaJowabe, wayeyinhloko yalaba abangama-30. Wagwaza ngomkhonto wakhe abangama-300, wababulala, wazenzela igama phakathi kwalabo abathathu.
Nguye owanconywa kakhulu phakathi kwabangama-30, futhi waba ngumkhuzi wempi yabo, akafinyelelanga nokho kwabathathu bokuqala.

UBhenaya, indodana kaJehoyada, wayeyindoda eyiqhawe elinamandla, elenza imisebenzi emikhulu. WayengowaseKhabizeyeli, wabulala amaqhawe amabili, u-Ariyeli wakwaMowabi, waphinde wehla, wabulala ingonyama emgodini, ngosuku kukhithike iqhwa.

Wabulala nowaseGibhithe owayebukeka. Lona waseGibhithe wayephethe umkhonto esandleni sakhe, kodwa uBhenaya wabhekana naye ephethe induku nje. Wawuhlwitha umkhonto esandleni somGibhithe, wambulala ngawo umkhonto wakhe.
UBhenaya, indodana kaJehoyada, wenza lezi zinto, wazenzela igama phakathi kwabathathu.
Wayehlonipheke kakhulu phakathi kwabangama-30, kodwa akafikanga kulaba abathathu ngokuhlonishwa. UDavide wambeka ukuba engamele abaqaphi bakhe.
Phakathi kwalawo maqhawe anamandla kwakungo-Asaheli, umfowabo kaJowabe, u-Elihanani indodana kaDodo waseBhethlehema,
uShamothi wakwaHarori, uHelezi wasePheloni,
u-Ira, indodana ka-Ikeshi waseThekowa, u-Abhiyezeri wase-Anathothi,
uSibhekayi umHushathi, u-Ilayi umAhohi,
uMaharayi waseNethofa, uHeledi, indodana kaBhahana waseNethofa,
u-Ithayi, indodana kaRibhayi waseGibheya labozalo lukaBhenjamini, uBhenaya wasePhirathoni,
uHurayi wangasemifudlaneni kwaGahashi, u-Abhiyeli umAraba,
u-Azimavethi waseBharihumi, u-Eliyaba waseShahalibhoni,
amadodana kaHashemi waseGizoni, uJonathani, indodana kaShage waseHarari,
u-Ahiyamu, indodana kaShakhari wase-Arari, u-Elifali, indodana ka-Uri,
uHeferi waseMekheri, u-Ahiya wasePheloni,
uHeziro waseKharimeli, uNaharayi, indodana ka-Ezibhayi,
uJoweli, umfowabo kaNathani, uMibhihari, indodana kaHagiri,
uZeleki wakwa-Amoni, uNaharayi waseBherothi, udibi lukaJowabe, indodana kaZeruya,
u-Ira waseJetheri,
u-Uriya umHithi, uZabadi, indodana ka-Ahilayi,
u-Adina, indodana kaShiza wakwaRubeni, inhloko yakwaRubeni, enabangama-30,
uHanani, indodana kaMahakha, uJeshoshafathi umMitheni,
u-Uziya wase-Ashitharothi, uShama noJehiyeli, amadodana kaHothamu wase-Aroweri,
uJediyayeli, indodana kaShimri, uJoha, umfowabo umThizi,
u-Eliyeli umMahavi, uJeribhayi noJoshaviya, amadodana ka-Elinahama, u-Ithima wakwaMowabi,
u-Eliyeli, u-Obhede, noJahashiyeli umMezobha.
Nanka amagama alabo abafika kuDavide ngesikhathi esagogobele eZikilagi, ngenxa kaSawule, indodana kaKhishi; ababephakathi kwamaqhawe ayelekelela empini.
Babehlome ngeminsalo, bengamakhabe, bekwazi ukuciba nokuphonsa amatshe ngesokhohlo nangesokunene. Babengabafowabo bakaSawule, bevela kwaBhenjamini, okwakuyilaba:
inhloko kwakungu-Ahiyezeri noJowashi, ababengamadodana kaShemaha waseGibheya; uJeziyeli noPhelethi, amadodana ka-Azimavethi; uBherakha, uJehu wase-Anathothi;
u-Ishmaya waseGibheyoni, iqhawe elalingomunye wabangama-30, engamele abangama-30; uJeremiya, uJahaziyeli, uJohanani, noJozabhadi waseGedera;
u-Eluzayi, uJerimothi, uBhehaliya, uShemariya, uShefathiya umHarufi;
u-Elikhana, uJishiya, u-Azareli, uJohezeri, uJashobhehamu, amaKhora;
uJowela noZebadiya, amadodana kaJerohamu waseGedori.

KwabakwaGadi, abanye bazehlukanisa baya kuDavide enqabeni ehlane, amaqhawe anamandla, amabutho azilungiselele ukulwa, abakwazi ukuphatha isihlangu nomkhonto, ababuso babo bufana nobuso bezingonyama, abanejubane njengezinsephe ezintabeni:
u-Ezeri inhloko, owesibili u-Obhadiya, owesithathu u-Eliyabe,
owesine uMishimana, owesihlanu uJeremiya,
owesithupha u-Athayi, owesikhombisa u-Eliyeli,
oweshiyagalombili uJohanani, owesishiyagalolunye u-Elizabhadi,
oweshumi uJeremiya, owe-11 uMakhibhanayi.
Laba kwakungabozalo lukaGadi ababeyizinhloko zempi: omncinyane kubo wayelingana nekhulu, omkhulu elingana nenkulungwane.
Yibo labo abawela iJordani ngenyanga yokuqala, lapho ligcwele lidla izindwani, ugu lonke lwalo luphuphuma amanzi. Yibo abaxosha bonke ababesezigodini, ngasempumalanga nangasentshonalanga.
Abanye bozalo lukaBhenjamini nabakwaJuda bafika kuDavide esenqabeni.

UDavide waphuma wayobahlangabeza, wathi kubo: “Uma nize lapha kimi ngokuthula, nizongisiza, sizobambisana, kodwa uma nizongiyengela ezitheni zami, uNkulunkulu wokhokho bethu makakubone lokho, abe nguMehluleli.”

Kwase kwehla umoya phezu kuka-Amasayi, owayeyinhloko yabangama-30, wathi: “Singabakho thina, Davide, sinawe, wena ndodana kaJese; ukuthula, ukuthula makube nawe, ukuthula makube nabakusizayo, ngokuba uNkulunkulu wakho ukusizile.” Wayesebamukela uDavide, wabenza izinhloko zeviyo.

Kwafika ingxenye yabakwaManase kuDavide, ngesikhathi izolekelela amaFilisti ukulwa noSawule, kodwa abawalekelelanga ngokuba abaholi bamaFilisti babonisana, bamkhomba indlela bethi: “Lo uyakuhlubukela enkosini yakhe uSawule, adayise ngathi, asibulale.”
Ngesikhathi eya eZikilagi, abakwaManase abaqembuka beza kuye yilaba: u-Adina, uJozabhadi, uJediyayeli, uMikhayeli, uJozabhadi, u-Elihu, uZilethayi, nezinhloko zezinkulungwane zabakwaManase.
Bamsiza uDavide ekulweni namabutho ayemhlasela, ngokuba bonke babengamaqhawe anamandla, bengabakhuzi bempi.
Imihla ngemihla, kwakufika abazomsiza uDavide, kwaze kwaba yimpi enkulu enjengekaNkulunkulu.
Nanti inani lezinhloko ezazihlomile ezeza kuDavide eHebhroni, ukuba ziguqulele kuye umbuso kaSawule njengokusho kwezwi likaSimakade.
Kwabozalo lukaJuda ababephethe izihlangu nemikhonto, behlomele ukulwa babeyizi-6 800.
Kwabozalo lukaSimeyoni, amaqhawe anamandla empini babeyizi-7 100.
Kwabozalo lukaLevi babeyizi-4 600.
UJehoyada wayengumholi wakwa-Aroni enezi-3 700,
noZadoki, insizwa eyiqhawe elinamandla, nabakhuzi bempi abangama-22 ababevela endlini kayise.
Kwabozalo lukaBhenjamini, abafowabo bakaSawule, kwakuyizi-3 000, ngokuba kuze kube namuhla iningi labo lisathembekile endlini kaSawule.
Kwabozalo kuka-Efrayimi kwakuyizi-20 800, amaqhawe anamandla, amadoda ayenegama ezindlini zokhokho bawo.
Engxenyeni yesizwana sakwaManase kwakuyizi-18 000 ezazibizwe ngamagama ukuba zifike zizobeka uDavide, abe yinkosi.
Kwabozalo luka-Isakhare, labo ababeqonda ngezikhathi ukuba bazi okufanele kwenziwe ngu-Israyeli; izinhloko zabo ezazingama-200; bonke abafowabo balalela izwi labo.
KwaZebuloni kwaphuma abayizi-50 000 ababekulungele ukuya empini, behlome ngazo zonke izikhali zokulwa futhi bekulungele ukusiza uDavide, benhliziyonye.
KwabakwaNafethali kwaba ngabakhuzi bempi abayinkulungwane, benababephethe izihlangu nemikhonto abayizi-37 000.
KwabakwaDani, ababekulungele ukuya empini, babeyizi-28 600.
Kwabakwa-Asheri, ababevuthiwe bengaphuma baye empini, babeyizi-40 000.
Ngaphesheya kweJordani, kwabakwaRubeni nabakwaGadi nengxenye yesizwana sakwaManase, babeyizi-120 000 ababehlome ngezikhali zonke zokulwa empini.

Wonke lawa mabutho ayehlelwe ngendlela yokulwa, afika eHebhroni ngenhloso eyodwa, yokuzobeka uDavide ukuba abe yinkosi kwa-Israyeli, nabo bonke abaseleyo bakwa-Israyeli babenhliziyonye ukubeka uDavide abe yinkosi.
Bahlala lapho noDavide izinsuku ezintathu, bedla, bephuza, ngokuba abafowabo babebalungisele.

Nabakhelene nabo, kusukela kwa-Isakhare, kwaZebuloni, nakwaNafethali, baletha isinkwa ngezimbongolo, ngamakameli, ngeminyuzi, nangezinkabi. Baletha ukudla okusanhlamvu, izigaxa zamakhiwane, izigaxa zamareyizini, iwayini namafutha, izinkabi nezimvu eziningi, ngokuba kwakunokuthokoza okukhulu kwa-Israyeli.
UDavide wahlanganisa amakhanda nabakhuzi bempi bezinkulungwane nabamakhulu, nabaholi bonke.

UDavide wayesethi kulo lonke ibandla lakwa-Israyeli: “Uma kukuhle kini, futhi kuvela kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu, masiphume ngandlela zonke sithumele kubafowethu abasele ezweni lonke kwa-Israyeli, nabaphristi nabaLevi emizini yabo enamadlelo, ukuba babuthane beze lapha kithi.
Masihambe siyowulanda siwubuyisele kithi umphongolo kaNkulunkulu wethu, ngokuba asizange siwufune ngezinsuku zikaSawule.”
Ibandla lonke lathi makwenziwe kanjalo, ngokuba lokho kwakuthokozisa kubo bonke abantu.
UDavide wambuthela ndawonye wonke u-Israyeli, kusukela eShihori eGibhithe, eLebo, kuze kube seHamathi, ukuba kuyolandwa umphongolo kaNkulunkulu eKiriyathi Jeharimi.

UDavide wakhuphuka kanye no-Israyeli wonke, baya eBhahala, okungukuthi eKiriyathi Jeharimi kwaJuda, ukuze bakhuphule lapho umphongolo kaNkulunkulu uSimakade ohleli phezu kwamakherubhi, obizwa ngegama lakhe.
Bawukhipha umphongolo kaNkulunkulu endlini ka-Abhinadaba, bawukhweza enqoleni entsha eyayishayelwa ngu-Uza no-Ahiyo.
UDavide naye wonke u-Israyeli babethokoza phambi kukaNkulunkulu ngamandla abo wonke, behuba amahubo ngamahabhu, ngezingubhu, ngezigubhu, ngamasimbali nangamacilongo.
Lapho befika esibuyeni sikaKhidoni, izinkabi zashelela, u-Uza wayeselula isandla sakhe ukuba abambe umphongolo.
Intukuthelo kaSimakade yamvuthela u-Uza, wamshaya, ngokuba wayelulele isandla emphongolweni. Wafela khona lapho phambi kukaNkulunkulu.
UDavide wathukuthela ngokuba uSimakade ehlasele u-Uza. Wayibiza leyo ndawo ngokuthi yiPherezi Uza, kuze kube namuhla.
UDavide wamesaba uNkulunkulu ngalolo lusuku, wathi: “Pho ngingawungenisa kanjani kwami umphongolo kaNkulunkulu na?”
UDavide akabange esawuyisa emzini wakhe umphongolo, kodwa wachezuka, wawuyisa endlini ka-Obhedi Edomi, umGithi.
Umphongolo kaNkulunkulu wahlala izinyanga ezintathu nabendlu ka-Obhede Edomi, endlini yakhe. USimakade wayibusisa indlu ka-Obhede Edomi nakho konke ayenakho.
Inkosi yaseThire, uHiramu, yathumela izithunywa kuDavide, imisedari, abakhi nababazi ukuba bayomakhela indlu.
UDavide waqonda ukuthi uSimakade wayembekile impela ukuba abe yinkosi kwa-Israyeli, ngokuba umbuso wakhe waphakanyiselwa phezulu ngenxa yabantu bakhe u-Israyeli.
UDavide eseseJerusalema wabuye wathatha abanye abafazi, wazala amanye amadodana namadodakazi.
Nanka amagama abantwana abazala eJerusalema: uShamuwa, uShobhabhi, uNathani, uSolomoni,
uJibhari, u-Elishuwa, u-Eliphelethi,
uNoga, uNefegi, uJafiya,
u-Elishama, uBheyeliyada no-Elifeleti.
Kwathi esezwile amaFilisti ukuthi uDavide ubekiwe ukuba abe yinkosi ka-Israyeli, akhuphuka ayomfuna; kuthe lapho uDavide ekuzwa lokho waphuma, wawahlasela.
AmaFilisti esegasele esigodini samaRefa,
uDavide wabuza kuNkulunkulu, wathi: “Ngenyuke yini ukuyohlasela amaFilisti na? Uyakuwanikela yini esandleni sami?” USimakade wathi kuye: “Khuphuka, ngokuba ngiyakuwanikela esandleni sakho.”

Base bekhuphuka eBhali Pherazimu, uDavide wawabhubhisa. UDavide wathi: “UNkulunkulu uthelekele izitha zami ngesandla sami njengamanzi ebhodloza avinjwe ngakho.” Yingakho-ke leyo ndawo bayiqamba bathi iBhali Pherazimu.
AmaFilisti abashiya lapho onkulunkulu bawo, uDavide wathi mababashise ngomlilo.
AmaFilisti abuye asigasela isigodi.
UDavide wabuye wabuza kuNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu wathi kuye: “Ungenyuki uwalandele, kunalokho aqhamukele maqondana namajikijolo.
Kuyothi lapho sewuzwa umsindo wokuhamba ezihlokweni zamajikijolo, uphume impi, ngokuba uNkulunkulu uphumile ngaphambi kwakho ukubhubhisa amabutho amaFilisti.”
UDavide wenza njengokuba uNkulunkulu ayemyalile, bawabhubhisa amabutho amaFilisti, kusukela eGibheyoni kuze kube seGezeri.
Igama likaDavide laphumela emazweni wonke; uSimakade wehlisela izizwe zonke ingebhe ngaye.
UDavide wakha izindlu emzini wakhe, walungisela umphongolo kaNkulunkulu indawo, wawumisela ithende.
UDavide wayesethi: “Umphongolo kaNkulunkulu mawungathwalwa muntu, kuphela abaLevi, ngokuba yibo abaqokwe nguSimakade ukuthwala umphongolo kaSimakade, nokumkhonza kuze kube phakade.”
UDavide waqoqela ndawonye eJerusalema wonke u-Israyeli ukuba kukhushulwe umphongolo kaSimakade uyiswe endaweni awulungiselele yona.
UDavide waqoqa amadodana ka-Aroni nabaLevi.
Ozalweni lukaKhohathi: u-Uriyeli umholi, nabafowabo, beyi-120;
ozalweni lukaMerari: u-Asaya umholi, nabafowabo, bengama-220;
ozalweni lukaGereshomu: uJoweli umholi, nabafowabo, beyi-130;
ozalweni luka-Elizafani: uShemaya umholi, nabafowabo, bengama-200;
ozalweni lukaHebhroni: u-Eliyeli umholi, nabafowabo, bengama-80;
ozalweni luka-Uziyeli: u-Aminadaba umholi, nabafowabo, beyi-112.
UDavide wabiza uZadoki, u-Abhiyathara, abaphristi, abaLevi, u-Uriyeli, u-Asaya, uJoweli, uShemaya, u-Eliyeli no-Aminadaba.
Wathi kubo: “Nina niyizinhloko zezindlu zoyise babaLevi, zingcweliseni, nina nabafowenu, ukuba nikhuphule umphongolo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, niwuyise endaweni engiwulungisele yona.
Ngenxa yokuba aniwuthwalanga ngesikhathi esedlule, uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu wasithelekela, ngokuba asimfunanga njengokwesimiso.”
Abaphristi nabaLevi base bezingcwelisa ukuze bakhuphule umphongolo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.
Abozalo lwabaLevi bawuthwala ngezingongolo emahlombe umphongolo kaNkulunkulu, njengokuyala kukaMose, ngezwi likaSimakade.
UDavide watshela abaholi babaLevi ukuba babeke abafowabo, abahlabeleli bashaye izinsimbi ezishaywayo, izingubhu, amahabhu, amasimbali, bakushaye, bamemeze ngokuthokoza.
AbaLevi base bebeka uHemani, indodana kaJoweli, nakubafowabo babeka u-Asafa, indodana kaBherekhiya, nasemadodaneni kaMerari, abafowabo, u-Ethani, indodana kaKhushaya.

Babekanye nabafowabo besigaba sesibili: uZakhariya, uBheni, uJahaziyeli, uShemiramothi, uJehiyeli, u-Uni, u-Eliyabe, uBhenaya, uMahaseya, uMathithiya, u-Elifelehu, uMikhineya, u-Obhede Edomi, noJehiyeli, abalindisango.
Abahlabeleli: uHemani, u-Asafa, no-Ethani ukuba bakhalise amasimbali ethusi.
UZakhariya, u-Aziyeli, uShemiramothi, uJehiyeli, u-Uni, u-Eliyabe, uMahaseya, noBhenaya bashaye izingubhu ezilungiselwe i-Alamothi.
UMathithiya, u-Elifelehu, uMikhineya, u-Obhede Edomi, uJehiyeli, no-Azaziya, babephethe amahabhu alungiselwe iSheminithi ukuba bahole.
UKhenaniya, umholi wabaLevi, wayengamele umsebenzi wokuthwala, efundisa ukuthwala ngokuba wayekwazi.
UBherekhiya no-Elikhana babengabalindisango bomphongolo.

UShebhaniya, uJehoshafathi, uNethaneli, u-Amasayi, uZakhariya, uBhenaya, u-Eliyezeri, abaphristi, babeshaya amacilongo phambi komphongolo kaNkulunkulu. U-Obhede Edomi noJehiya bona babengabalindisango bomphongolo.
KwakunguDavide, namalunga akwa-Israyeli, nezinduna zezinkulungwane abahamba bethokoza bayokhuphula umphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade endlini ka-Obhede Edomi.
Kwathi lapho uNkulunkulu esebasizile abaLevi, abathwali bomphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade, base benikela ngezinkunzi eziyisikhombisa nezinqama eziyisikhombisa.
UDavide wayembethe ingubo yelineni elicolekileyo, njengabo bonke abaLevi ababethwele umphongolo, nabahlabeleli, noKhenaniya umholi wabahlabeleli. UDavide wayenengubo yamahlombe yelineni.
Wonke u-Israyeli wawukhuphula kanjalo-ke umphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade; ngokukhamuluka nangomsindo womtshingo, amacilongo, amasimbali, ebetha izingubhu namahabhu.

Kwathi lapho umphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade usungeniswa emzini kaDavide, uMikhali, indodakazi kaSawule, walunguza ngefasitela, wabona inkosi uDavide isina, igida; wayedelela enhliziyweni yakhe.
Bawungenisa umphongolo kaNkulunkulu, bawubeka phakathi nethende uDavide ayelimisele wona. Base benikela ngeminikelo yokushiswa nangeminikelo yokuthula phambi kukaNkulunkulu.
Eseqedile uDavide ukunikela ngomnikelo wokushiswa nangeminikelo yokuthula, wabusisa abantu egameni likaSimakade.
Wabela bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli, abesilisa nabesifazane, yilowo nalowo isinkwa, isigaxa sengqansundu, nekhekhe elinamagilebhisi omisiwe.
Wamisa phambi komphongolo kaSimakade abanye babaLevi ukuba bakhonze, benze isikhumbuzo, babonge futhi bamdumise uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.

U-Asafa nguye owayengamele nesigaba sakhe sesibili, uZakhariya, uJeyiyeli, uShemiramothi, uJehiyeli, uMathithiya, u-Eliyabe, uBhenaya, u-Obhede Edomi noJeyiyeli, bephethe izingubhu namahabhu, u-Asafa ephethe amasimbali, ewashaya.
UBhenaya noJahaziyeli, abaphristi, bephethe amacilongo, bema njalo phambi komphongolo wesivumelwano sikaNkulunkulu.
Ngalolo lusuku uDavide waqala ukuhlela ukuba uSimakade abongwe, kuhola u-Asafa nabafowabo.
Bongani uSimakade, nibize igama lakhe, nizazise kubantu izenzo zakhe.
Mhlabeleleni, nimhubele, nikhulume ngazo zonke izimangaliso zakhe.
Gabani ngegama lakhe elingcwele; mazithokoze izinhliziyo zabafuna uSimakade.
Mfuneni uSimakade namandla akhe, nibufunisise njalo ubuso bakhe.
Khumbulani izimangaliso zakhe azenzileyo, izibonakaliso zakhe, nezehlulelo zomlomo wakhe,
nina nzalo ka-Israyeli, inceku yakhe, nina bantwana bakaJakobe, abakhethiweyo bakhe.
Yena unguSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu; izehlulelo zakhe zisemhlabeni wonke.
Khumbulani isivumelwano sakhe kuze kube phakade, izwi ayala ngalo izizukulwane eziyinkulungwane,
isivumelwano asenza no-Abhrahama, nesifungo sakhe ku-Isaka;
wasiqinisa kuJakobe, saba ngumthetho, naku-Israyeli, saba yisivumelwano esiphakade,
ethi: “Ngizakukunika iKhanani libe yisabelo sefa lenu,
lapho naniseyingcosana ngesibalo, yebo, naniseyingcosana, futhi niyizihambi kulo.”
Bazulazula ezizweni ngezizwe, besuka kulo mbuso, beya kwabanye abantu.
Akavumelanga muntu ukubacindezela, wajezisa amakhosi ngenxa yabo,
ethi: “Ningabathinti abagcotshiweyo bami, ningabalimazi abaphrofethi bami.”
Hlabelela kuSimakade mhlaba wonke, memezela izimangaliso zakhe usuku nosuku.
Landani ngenkazimulo yakhe phakathi kwabezizwe, izimangaliso zakhe phakathi kwabantu bonke.
Ngokuba mkhulu uSimakade, ufanele ukudunyiswa kakhulu; uyesabeka ngaphezu kwabo bonke onkulunkulu.
Bonke onkulunkulu babezizwe bayizithombe ezingenamsebenzi, kepha uSimakade walenza izulu.
Udumo nobukhosi kusebusweni bakhe; amandla nokuthokoza kusendaweni yakhe.
Mnikeni uSimakade nina mindeni yabantu, mnikeni uSimakade udumo namandla.
Mnikeni uSimakade udumo lwegama lakhe, nilethe umnikelo, nize phambi kwakhe, nikhuleke kuSimakade nihlobe ngobungcwele.
Thuthumela phambi kwakhe, mhlaba wonke; izwe limisiwe, alinakunyakaziswa.
Malijabule izulu, uthokoze umhlaba; makuthiwe ezizweni: “USimakade uyinkosi.”
Maluhlokome ulwandle nokugcwala kwalo, kwename amasimu nakho konke okukuwo.
Khona imithi yehlathi iyakukhamuluka ngokujabula phambi kukaSimakade, ngokuba uyeza uzokwehlulela umhlaba.
Bongani uSimakade, ngokuba muhle, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.
Yishoni nithi: “Sisindise Nkulunkulu wensindiso yethu, usiqoqe, usihlenge kwabezizwe, ukuze sidumise igama lakho elingcwele, sithokoze ekukudumiseni.”
Makabongwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, kusukela phakade kuze kube phakade. Bonke abantu bathi: “Amen,” bamdumisa uSimakade.
UDavide wayeseshiya u-Asafa nabafowabo phambi komphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade ukuba bakhonze njalo phambi komphongolo, ngokwenza imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla.
Washiya u-Obhede Edomi, indodana kaJeduthuni, nabafowabo abangama-68 noHosa ukuba babe ngabalindisango.
Washiya uZadoki, umphristi, nabafowabo, abaphristi, phambi kwethabanakeli likaSimakade, endaweni ephakemeyo eyayiseGibheyoni,
ukuba banikele njalo kuSimakade ngeminikelo yokushiswa, phezu kwe-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa, ekuseni nakusihlwa njengalokhu konke kulotshwe emthethweni kaSimakade ayala ngawo u-Israyeli.
UHemani noJeduthumi nabo bonke abaseleyo ababekhethiwe babizwa ngamagama ukuba bambonge uSimakade, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.
UHemani noJeduthumi babephethe amacilongo namasimbali okushaywa, nezinye izinsimbi zokubethwa kudunyiswa uNkulunkulu. Amadodana kaJeduthumi aqokwa amiswa ngasesangweni.
Bonke abantu bahamba, yilowo nalowo waya endlini yakhe. UDavide wabuya wazobusisa abendlu yakhe.
Kwathi lapho uDavide esehleli esigodlweni sakhe, wathi kuNathani, umphrofethi: “Bheka, mina ngihlala esigodlweni semisedari, kodwa umphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade uphansi kwamakhethini.”
UNathani wathi kuDavide: “Yenza konke okusenhliziyweni yakho, ngokuba uNkulunkulu unawe.”
Kwathi ngalobo busuku izwi likaNkulunkulu lafika kuNathani, lathi:
“Hamba uyotshela uDavide, inceku yami, uthi: ‘Usho kanje uSimakade, uthi: “Wena awuyukungakhela indlu ukuba ngihlale kuyo,
ngokuba angikaze ngihlale endlini kusukela ngosuku engakhuphula ngalo u-Israyeli kuze kube namuhla, kodwa bengisemathendeni ngamathende, nasemathabanakelini.

Ezindaweni zonke engihambe kuzo naye wonke u-Israyeli ngake ngalikhipha yini izwi nakoyedwa wabehluleli bakwa-Israyeli engangibayale ukuba beluse abantu bami, ngathi: Aningakhele ngani indlu yemisedari na?” ’ ”
“Ngakho-ke uyakusho kanje kuDavide inceku yami, uthi: ‘Usho kanje uSimakade Wamabandla, uthi: “Mina ngakuthatha edlelweni, ekweluseni izimvu, ukuba ube ngumbusi wabantu bami u-Israyeli.
Nganginawe noma kuphi lapho wawuya khona, ngazibhubhisa zonke izitha zakho phambi kwakho. Ngiyakwenza igama lakho libe njengamagama abakhulu abasemhlabeni.
Ngiyakubamisela indawo abantu bami, u-Israyeli, ngibatshale ukuba bahlale endaweni yabo, bangaphinde bakhathazwe nakukhathazwa ngababi bababhubhise njengakuqala,
kusukela emihleni engamisa ngayo abehluleli ukuba babuse abantu bami u-Israyeli, ngiyakuzinqoba zonke izitha zakho. Ngiyakutshela futhi ukuthi uSimakade uyakukwakhela indlu yakho.
Kuyothi lapho izinsuku zakho seziphelele ukuba uye koyihlomkhulu, ngimise abozalo lwakho omunye zalweni lwakho, ngiwuqinise umbuso wakhe.
Nguye oyakungakhela indlu, ngiyakusiqinisa isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi, kuze kube phakade.
Mina ngiyakuba nguyise kuye, yena abe yindodana kimi; angiyukuwususa umusa wami kuye, njengalokho ngawususa kulowo owayengaphambi kwakho.
Ngiyakumbeka endlini yami nasembusweni wami, kuze kube phakade; isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi siqiniswe, kuze kube phakade.” ’ ”
UNathani wakhuluma kuDavide njengawo wonke lawa mazwi nanjengawo wonke lo mbono.
Inkosi uDavide yahamba yahlala phambi kukaSimakade, yathi: “Ngingubani Simakade Nkulunkulu, nendlu yami iyini ukuba ungithwale kuze kube lapha na?
Nalokho kwakuyinto encane emehlweni akho, Nkulunkulu; ukhulumile nangendlu yenceku yakho isekude, wangibuka kungathi ngingumuntu ophakemeyo, Simakade Nkulunkulu.
“UDavide angenezela ngokuthini kuwe ngodumo inceku yakho elwenzelweyo na? Wena uyayazi inceku yakho.
Simakade, ngenxa yenceku yakho nanjengokwenhliziyo yakho, wenzile konke lokhu okukhulu ukuba kwaziswe bonke lobu bukhulu.
“Simakade, akekho onjengawe, akekho uNkulunkulu ngaphandle kwakho, kukho konke esikuzwileyo ngezindlebe zethu.

Ngubani onjengabantu bakho, u-Israyeli, isizwe esisodwa emhlabeni, uNkulunkulu azihlengela sona ukuba sibe ngabantu bakhe, wazenzela igama ngezinto ezinkulu nezesabekayo ngokuxosha abezizwe phambi kwabantu bakho owabahlenga eGibhithe na?
Wabenza abantu bakho, u-Israyeli, baba ngabantu bakho kuze kube phakade, Wena Simakade waba nguNkulunkulu wabo.
“Manje Simakade, izwi olikhulume ngenceku yakho nangendlu yayo, maliqiniswe kuze kube phakade, futhi yenza njengalokhu ushilo.

Maliqiniswe libe likhulu igama lakho kuze kube phakade, ukuze kuthiwe: ‘USimakade Wamabandla unguNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, yebo, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli,’ nendlu kaDavide, inceku yakho, iqinisiwe phambi kwakho.
“Wena Nkulunkulu wami ukwambulile endlebeni yenceku yakho ukuthi uyakuyakhela indlu, ngakho-ke inceku yakho ize ukuba izokhuleka phambi kwakho.
Manje Simakade, unguNkulunkulu, ukhulume okuhle encekwini yakho,
ake uvume ukubusisa indlu yenceku yakho, ukuba ibe phambi kwakho kuze kube phakade, ngokuba okubusisile Wena Simakade, kubusisekile kuze kube phakade.”
Kwathi emveni kwalokho, uDavide wahlasela amaFilisti, wawanqoba, wayidla iGathi nemizana yalo esandleni samaFilisti.
Wamnqoba uMowabi; abakwaMowabi baba yizinceku zikaDavide, bathela intela kuye.
UDavide wahlasela uHadadezeri, inkosi yaseZobha, ngaseHamathi, ngesikhathi ephumile ukuyoqinisa umbuso wakhe ngasemfuleni iYufrathe.
UDavide wathatha kuye izinqola eziyinkulungwane, abamahhashi abayizi-7 000 nemigundatshani eyizi-20 000. UDavide wanquma imisipha yamahhashi ayedonsa izinqola, washiya kuphela awezinqola eziyikhulu.
Kwase kufika ama-Aramu aseDamaseku ezosiza uHadarezeri, inkosi yaseZobha, uDavide wabulala abantu bakhona abayizi-22 000.
UDavide wamisa amabutho e-Aramu eDamaseku. Ama-Aramu aba yizinceku zikaDavide, athela intela kuye. USimakade wamenza ukuba uDavide anqobe noma kuphi lapho eya khona.
UDavide wathatha izihlangu zegolide ezazisezincekwini zikaHadadezeri, waziletha eJerusalema.
UDavide wathatha ithusi eliningi kakhulu eThibhahathi naseKhuni, imizi kaHadadezeri, uSolomoni enza ngalo ulwandle lwethusi nezinsika nezitsha zethusi.
Kwathi ukuba uThowu, inkosi yaseHamathi, ezwe ukuthi uDavide uyibhubhisile yonke impi kaHadadezeri, inkosi yaseZobha,

wathumela uHadoramu, indodana yakhe, enkosini uDavide ukuyocela ukuba babe nesivumelwano sokuthula nokuyibusisa, ngokuba yayilwile noHadadezeri, yamnqoba, ngokuba uHadadezeri wayevame ukulwa noThowu. Wamphathisa izinhlobo zonke zezitsha zegolide nezesiliva nezethusi.
Inkosi uDavide wazingcwelisa nalezi zitsha kuSimakade, nesiliva negolide ayekudle ezizweni zonke zakwa-Edomi, kwaMowabi, nakubantu bakwa-Amoni, nakumaFilisti nakuma-Amaleki.
U-Abhishayi, indodana kaZeruya, wabulala abakwa-Edomi abayizi-18 000 eSigodini Sikasawoti.
Wamisa amabutho kwa-Edomi; bonke abakwa-Edomi baba yizinceku zikaDavide. USimakade wenza uDavide ukuba anqobe noma kuphi lapho ayeya khona.
UDavide wabusa phezu kwawo wonke u-Israyeli, wenza ubulungiswa nokulunga kubo bonke abantu bakhe.
UJowabe, indodana kaZeruya, wayephethe impi uJehoshafathi, indodana ka-Ahiludi, engumabhalane.
UZadoki, indodana ka-Ahithubi, no-Abhimeleki, indodana ka-Abhiyathara, babengabaphristi, uShawusha engumbhali.
UBhenaya, indodana kaJehoyada, wayengamele amaKherethi namaPhelethi; amadodana kaDavide ayesondele, engawokuqala ngasenkosini.
Kwathi emveni kwalokho uNahashi, inkosi yakwa-Amoni, wakhothama, indodana yakhe yabusa esikhundleni sakhe.

UDavide wathi: “Ngiyakumenzela umusa uHanuni, indodana kaNahashi, ngokuba uyise wangenzela umusa.” UDavide wayesethumela izithunywa ukuba ziyomduduza ngokulahlekelwa nguyise. Izinceku zikaDavide zafika kwa-Amoni kuHanuni, zamduduza.

Kepha izikhulu zakwa-Amoni zathi kuHanuni: “Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi uDavide uthumele abazokududuza, ngokuba ehlonipha uyihlo na? Akazithumelanga yini izinceku zakhe ukuba zizohlola izwe nokuba ziwuqumbe phansi umbuso wakho na?”
UHanuni wayesezibamba izinceku zikaDavide, waziphuca amakhanda nezilevu, wasika izingubo zazo kwaze kwaba sezinqeni, wayesezikhomba indlela.
Bahamba bamazisa uDavide ngalawo madoda. Wayesethumela ukuba ahlangatshezwe, ngokuba ayenamahloni kakhulu. Yathi inkosi: “Hlalani eJerikho zize zihlume izilevu zenu, bese niyabuya-ke.”

Abantu bakwa-Amoni babona ukuthi bazithele ngesigcwagcwa kuDavide. UHanuni nabakwa-Amoni bathumela amathalenta esiliva ayinkulungwane ukuba baqashe izinqola nabamahhashi e-Aramu Naharayimi, e-Aramu Mahakha, naseZobha.
Baqasha izinqola eziyizi-32 000, nenkosi yaseMahakha nabantu bayo beza bakanisa phambi kweMedebha. Abakwa-Amoni babuthana bephuma emizini yabo; beza ukuzokulwa.
UDavide wezwa ngalokho, wathumela uJowabe nayo yonke impi namabutho angamaqhawe.
Abakwa-Amoni baphuma bayihlela impi yabo belungela ukulwa ngasesangweni lomuzi, kepha amakhosi ayefikile ayewodwa endle.
UJowabe esebona ukuthi impi ingaphambili nangasemva kwakhe, wakhetha amadoda kwabakhethekileyo bonke bakwa-Israyeli, wawahlela ukuze alwe nama-Aramu.
Abantu abaseleyo wabashiya esandleni sika-Abhishayi, umfowabo, bazihlela ukuba balwe nabakwa-Amoni.
Wathi: “Uma ama-Aramu eba namandla kunami, uyakuza ungihlenge, kodwa uma abakwa-Amoni beba namandla kunawe, ngizoza ngikophule.
Qinani, masibe nesibindi ngenxa yabantu bakithi nangenxa yemizi kaNkulunkulu wethu; uSimakade makenze okuhle akubona kufanele.”
UJowabe namabutho ayenaye basondela kuma-Aramu ukuba balwe nawo, kodwa wona acela empunzini.
Abakwa-Amoni babona ukuthi ama-Aramu acele empunzini, nabo babaleka phambi kuka-Abhishayi, umfowabo waya emzini. UJowabe waya eJerusalema.
Ama-Aramu esebonile ukuthi anqotshiwe ngu-Israyeli, athuma izithunywa, akhipha ama-Aramu ayengaphesheya komfula noShofakhi, umkhuzi wempi kaHadadezeri, phambi kwawo.
UDavide wabikelwa ngalokho, wayeseqoqa wonke u-Israyeli, bawela iJordani, bafika kuwo; wase eyihlela impi, walwa nawo.
Ama-Aramu abaleka phambi kuka-Israyeli. UDavide wabulala ama-Aramu ayizi-7 000 ayegibele ezinqoleni, nemigundatshani eyizi-40 000, wabulala noShofaki, umkhuzi wempi.
Izinceku zikaHadadezeri zabona ukuthi zehluliwe ngu-Israyeli, zenza ukuthula noDavide, zamkhonza. Ama-Aramu awaphindanga afuna ukusiza abakwa-Amoni.

Kwathi sekwedlule unyaka, ngesikhathi amakhosi aphuma ahlasele ngaso, uJowabe wahola amaqhawe empi, wabhubhisa izwe labakwa-Amoni. Wahamba wavimbezela iRabha, kodwa uDavide wayesele eJerusalema. UJowabe wahlasela iRabha, walinqoba.
UDavide wathatha umqhele wenkosi yabo ekhanda layo, wathola ukuthi isisindo sawo sasiyithalenta legolide; wawunetshe eliyigugu; wabekwa ekhanda likaDavide. Wathatha emzini impango eningi kakhulu.
UDavide wakhipha abantu ababekuyo yonke imizi yabakwa-Amoni, wabanquma ngamasaha, ngezibhuqo zensimbi, nangamazembe.
Kwathi emveni kwaleso sehlakalo kwaqubuka impi phakathi kuka-Israyeli namaFilisti eGezeri. USibhekhayi, umHushathi, wabulala uSiphayi, enye yamadodana amaRefa; anqotshwa amaFilisti.
Kwaphinda kwaqubuka enye impi namaFilisti. U-Elihanani, indodana kaJayire, wabulala uLahimi, umfowabo kaGoliyathi, umGithi; uthi lomkhonto ayewuphatha lwalungangogongolo lomaluki.

Kwaphinda futhi kwaba nempi eGathi, lapho kwakukhona umuntu owayemude kakhulu; eneminwe eyisithupha esandleni ngasinye, kanjalo nasezinyaweni enezinzwani eziyisithupha unyawo ngalunye, sekukonke kungama-24. Naye wayezalwa ngamaRefa.
Wamedelela u-Israyeli; ngakho-ke uJonathani, indodana kaShimeya, umfowabo kaDavide, wambulala.
Yibo laba ababeyizizukulwane zamaRefa eGathi, ababulawa nguDavide, nezinceku zakhe.
USathane wamelana no-Israyeli, wamyenga uDavide ukuba abale u-Israyeli.
UDavide wathi kuJowabe nakubaholi babantu: “Hambani nibale u-Israyeli kusukela eBheri Sheba kuze kube kwaDani, nilethe inani labo kimi ukuze ngazi ukuthi ungakanani.”

UJowabe wathi: “USimakade makenezelele kubantu bakhe kuphindwe kayikhulu. Nkosi yami, nkosi, kanti abasizo yini izinceku zenkosi yami bonke na? Inkosi yami ifunelani ukwenza lokhu na? Kungani ifuna ukuba yimbangela yecala ku-Israyeli na?”
Izwi lenkosi nokho lamehlula uJowabe. UJowabe waphuma walihamba lonke elakwa-Israyeli waze wayofika eJerusalema.
UJowabe wamnika uDavide inani labantu ababebaliwe. Esewonke u-Israyeli wayeyisi-1 100 000 ababengaphuma baye empini, uJuda yena eyizi-470 000.
AbaLevi nabakwaBhenjamini abazange babalwe, ngokuba uJowabe wayecunulwe yizwi elalikhishwe yinkosi.
Lokhu kwakukubi phambi kukaNkulunkulu, ngalokho-ke wamjezisa u-Israyeli.
UDavide wayesethi kuNkulunkulu: “Ngonile kakhulu ngale nto engiyenzileyo. Manje Simakade, ake uthethelele inceku yakho icala elenzileyo, ngokuba ngenzile ubuwula obukhulu.”
USimakade wayesekhuluma kuGadi, umboni kaDavide, ethi:
“Hamba uyokhuluma noDavide, uthi: ‘Usho kanje uSimakade, uthi: “Nginezinto ezintathu engizibeka phambi kwakho; khetha ibe yinye kuzo ukuba ngikwenzele yona.” ’ ”
UGadi wafika kuDavide, wathi kuye: “Usho kanje uSimakade, uthi:

‘Zikhethele noma kube yiminyaka emithathu yendlala, noma izinyanga ezintathu unqotshwa yizitha zakho ngenkemba yazo, noma izinsuku ezintathu zenkemba kaSimakade nobhubhane ezweni, ingelosi kaSimakade ibhubhisa kulo lonke elakwa-Israyeli. Manje-ke qoka, lizwi lini engiyakulibuyisela kongithumileyo na?’ ”
UDavide wathi kuGadi: “Ngidabuka kakhulu; kungcono mangiwele esandleni sikaSimakade, ngokuba umusa wakhe mkhulu kakhulu, kunokuba ngiwele esandleni somuntu.”
USimakade wathumela ubhubhane kwa-Israyeli, kwafa abantu abayizi-70 000 kwa-Israyeli.

UNkulunkulu wathumela ingelosi eJerusalema ukuba ilibhubhise. Kwathi lapho isabhubhisa uSimakade wabuka, wazisola ngale nhlekelele, wathi engelosini eyayibhubhisa: “Sekwanele manje, finyeza isandla sakho.” Ingelosi kaSimakade yayimi ngasesibuyeni sika-Orinani, umJebusi.

UDavide waphakamisa amehlo akhe wayibona ingelosi kaSimakade imi emkhathini womhlaba nezulu, ikhokhe inkemba esandleni sayo iyelulele phezu kweJerusalema. UDavide namalunga babembethe ingubo yesaka base bekhothama bathi mbo ngobuso.

UDavide wathi kuNkulunkulu: “Akumina yini owayaleza ukuba kubalwe abantu na? Yimi engonileyo, ngenze okubi kakhulu, kodwa lezi zimvu zenzeni na? Isandla sakho, Simakade Nkulunkulu wami, masijezise mina nendlu kababa, hhayi laba bantu bakho obashaya ngobhubhane.”
Ingelosi kaSimakade yamyala uGadi ukuba ayotshela uDavide ukuthi makakhuphuke, amisele uSimakade i-althare esibuyeni sika-Orinani, umJebusi.
UDavide wakhuphuka njengalokhu eshilo uGadi ekhuluma egameni likaSimakade.
U-Orinani waphenduka wayibona ingelosi; amadodana akhe amane acasha, u-Orinani wayebhula ukolo.
UDavide wafika ku-Orinani, u-Orinani wabheka, wabona uDavide, waphuma esibuyeni, wakhothama kuDavide, ubuso bakhe bubheke phansi.
UDavide wathi ku-Orinani: “Nginike le ndawo eyisibuya ukuba ngakhele kuyo uSimakade i-althare; ngizoyikhokhela imali epheleleyo ukuze lolu bhubhane lunqamuke kubantu.”

U-Orinani wathi kuDavide: “Zithathele yona; inkosi yami, inkosi, mayenze lokho okuhle emehlweni ayo. Bheka, ngiyakukunika izinkabi zibe ngezeminikelo yokushiswa, izibhulo zibe yizinkuni, nokolo ube ngumnikelo wokusanhlamvu; ngikunika konke lokho.”
Inkosi uDavide yathi ku-Orinani: “Qha, ngiyakukukhokhela konke imali epheleleyo, ngokuba angizukumthathela uSimakade okungokwakho, noma nginikele umnikelo wokushiswa ongabizanga lutho.”
UDavide wamkhokhela u-Orinani ngaleyo ndawo amashekeli egolide angama-600 ngokwesisindo.
UDavide wamakhela lapho uSimakade i-althare, wanikela ngeminikelo yokushiswa nangeminikelo yokuthula, wakhuleka kuSimakade. USimakade esezulwini waphendula ngomlilo e-althare leminikelo wokushiswa.
USimakade wakhuluma engelosini; yayisiyibuyisela inkemba yayo emgodleni wayo.
Ngaleso sikhathi lapho uDavide esebonile ukuthi uSimakade umphendulile esibuyeni sika-Orinani umJebusi, wenza umhlatshelo khona lapho.
Ngokuba ithabanakeli likaSimakade ayelenzile uMose ehlane, ne-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa kwakusendaweni ephakemeyo eGibheyoni ngaleso sikhathi,
uDavide akakwazanga ukuya phambi kwalo ukuba abuze kuNkulunkulu, ngokuba wayesaba inkemba yengelosi kaSimakade.
UDavide wayesethi: “Le yindlu kaSimakade uNkulunkulu, leli yi-althare lomnikelo wokushiswa ka-Israyeli.”
UDavide wayala ukuba kuqoqwe bonke abafokazi ababekwa-Israyeli, wabeka ababazi bamatshe ukuba babaze amatshe axhoziweyo, ukuze kwakhiwe indlu kaNkulunkulu.
UDavide waqokelela nensimbi eningi yokwenza izipikili zeminyango nezamasango nezokuhlanganisa ithusi eliningi elisisindo salo singenakulinganiswa,
nemisedari engenakubalwa, ngokuba abaseSidoni nabaseThire babemlethele imisedari eminingi uDavide.

UDavide wathi: “USolomoni, indodana yami, usengumfana, akakaqini ukuba angakhela uSimakade indlu, ngokuba indlu okumele yakhelwe uSimakade kumele ibe yinhle kakhulu, ibatshazwe, ibe negama nodumo emazweni wonke; ngakho-ke ngizakuqala mina ukuyilungiselela.” UDavide wayilungiselela kakhulu engakafi.
Wayesebiza uSolomoni, indodana yakhe, wamyala ukuba akhele uSimakade indlu.
UDavide wathi kuSolomoni, indodana yakhe: “Bekusenhliziyweni yami ukuba ngakhe indlu, ngiyakhela igama likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wami.
