Kepha izwi likaSimakade lathi kimi: ‘Uchithe igazi eliningi, waphaka izimpi eziningi, ngalokho awuyukulakhela igama lami indlu, ngokuba liningi igazi olichithe emhlabathini phambi kwami.
Bheka, uzozalelwa indodana eyakuba ngumuntu wokuthula. Ngiyakumnika ukuthula ezitheni zakhe nxazonke, ngokuba igama lakhe uyakuba nguSolomoni, ngiyakunika u-Israyeli ukuthula noxolo ngezinsuku zakhe.
Uyakulakhela igama lami indlu; uyakuba yindodana yami, Mina ngibe nguyise. Isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi sombuso wakhe kwa-Israyeli ngiyosimisa kuze kube phakade.’
“Manje-ke, ndodana yami, uSimakade makabe nawe, ube nempumelelo, umakhele indlu kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho njengolokhu akhuluma kuwe.
Kuphela nje, sengathi uSimakade angakupha ukuhlakanipha nokuqonda, akuyale ngo-Israyeli ukuba ugcine umthetho kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho.
Khona uyakuphumelela, uma ugcina izimiso nezehlulelo uSimakade ayala ngazo uMose ngo-Israyeli. Qina, ume isibindi, ungesabi, ungabi naluvalo.

“Uyabona, ekuhluphekeni kwami, ngiyilungiselele indlu kaSimakade: amathalenta egolide ayizi-100 000, amathalenta esiliva ayizi-100 000, ithusi nensimbi okungenakulinganiswa ngenxa yobuningi bakho; ngilungise nemithi namatshe, wena-ke usuyokwenezela kukho.
Kukhona kuwe izisebenzi eziningi, ababazi, izisebenzi zamatshe nezemithi, nabo bonke abayizingcweti emisebenzini yonke:
eyegolide, eyesiliva, eyethusi, neyensimbi, okungenakubalwa; suka usebenze; uSimakade abe nawe.”
UDavide wayala zonke izikhulu zakwa-Israyeli ukuba zimelekelele uSolomoni, wathi:
“USimakade uNkulunkulu wenu akanani na? Akaninikanga yini ukuphumula nxazonke na? Unikele kini izakhamuzi zakuleli lizwe, walinqoba leli lizwe phambi kukaSimakade naphambi kwabantu bakhe.

Ngakho-ke nikelani inhliziyo yenu nomphefumulo wenu, nifune uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu. Sukani nakhe indawo engcwele kaSimakade uNkulunkulu, ukuze kungeniswe umphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade, nezinto ezingcwele zikaNkulunkulu kuleyo ndlu eyokwakhelwa igama likaSimakade.”
UDavide wayesemdala esenelisiwe yizinsuku; wambeka uSolomoni, indodana yakhe, ukuba abe yinkosi kwa-Israyeli.
Waqoqa bonke abaholi bakwa-Israyeli, abaphristi nabaLevi.
AbaLevi babalwa kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-30 kuya phezulu. Inani labo laliyizi-38 000.
Abayizi-24 000 kulaba yibona abayongamela umsebenzi wendlu kaSimakade. Abayizi-6 000 babe yizikhulu nabehluleli.
Abayizi-4 000 bayoba ngabalindisango, kuthi abayizi-4 000 badumise uSimakade ngezinto engazenzela ukudumisa.
UDavide wabehlukanisa ngezigaba zabo njengamadodana kaLevi: uGereshoni, uKhohathi noMerari.
KwabakaGereshoni: nguLadani noShimeyi.
Amadodana kaLadani: nguJehiyeli, inhloko, uZethamu noJoweli, emathathu.
Amadodana kaShimeyi: nguShelomothi, uHaziyeli noHarana, emathathu. Labo babeyizinhloko zoyise kwaLadani.
Amadodana kaShimeyi: uJahathi, uZina, uJewushe noBheriya. Labo bobane kwakungamadodana kaShimeyi.
UJahathi wayeyinhloko, owesibili kunguZina, kodwa uJewushe noBheriya babengenawo amadodana amaningi, ngakho-ke bahlanganiswa baba yindlu eyodwa.
Amadodana kaKhohathi: ngu-Amramu, uJizihari, uHebhroni no-Uziyeli, bebane.

Amadodana ka-Amramu: ngu-Aroni noMose. U-Aroni wahlukaniswa wangcweliselwa izinto ezingcwelengcwele, yena namadodana akhe, kuze kube phakade, ukuba ashise impepho phambi kukaSimakade, amkhonze, nokuba abusise egameni likaSimakade, kuze kube phakade.
UMose, umuntu kaNkulunkulu, amadodana akhe abizwa ngesizwana sakwaLevi.
Amadodana kaMose, nguGereshomu no-Eliyezeri.
Amadodana kaGereshomu, nguShebuweli owayeyinhloko.
Amadodana ka-Eliyezeri: nguRehabhiya, inhloko. U-Eliyezeri wayengenawo amanye amadodana, kodwa amadodana kaRehabhiya ayemaningi kakhulu.
Amadodana kaJizihari: nguShelomithi, inhloko.
Amadodana kaHebhroni: nguJeriya, inhloko, owesibili u-Amariya, owesithathu uJahaziyeli, owesine nguJekhameyamu.
Amadodana ka-Uziyeli: nguMikha, inhloko, owesibili nguJishiya.
Amadodana kaMerari: nguMaheli noMushi. Amadodana kaMaheli: ngu-Eleyazare noKhishi.
U-Eleyazare wafa enganandodana, enamadodakazi wodwa; athathwa ngabafowabo amadodana kaKhishi.
Amadodana kaMushi: nguMaheli, u-Edere noJeremoti, bebathathu.

Yilabo-ke okwakungabozalo lukaLevi ngokwezindlu zokhokho babo, izinhloko zoyise, bebalwa ngamanani abo, ngamagama abo nangezinhloko zabo. Yibona ababenza umsebenzi wokukhonza endlini kaSimakade, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu.
UDavide wathi: “USimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli unikile abantu bakhe ukuphumula, uhleli eJerusalema, kuze kube phakade.
AbaLevi bayakuthwala ithabanakeli nazo zonke izinto zalo zenkonzo.”
Njengokwezwi lokugcina likaDavide, leli yinani labozalo lukaLevi, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engama-20 kuya phezulu.
Umsebenzi wabo kwakungukusiza abozalo luka-Aroni emsebenzini wendlu kaSimakade, emagcekeni, emakamelweni, ukuhlambulula zonke izinto ezingcwele, nokwenza umsebenzi wokukhonza endlini kaNkulunkulu,
ukusiza futhi nangezinkwa zokubukwa, impuphu ecolisekileyo yomnikelo wempuphu, amaqebelengwane angenamvubelo, okuphekwe ngamabhodwe, okuxutshanisiweyo, neyazo zonke izilinganiso nobukhulu;
ukuma njalo ekuseni ukuba babe ngabadumisa uSimakade, kanjalo nakusihlwa;
ukunikela njalo kuSimakade, ngayo yonke iminikelo yokushiswa, ngamasabatha, ngokwethwasa kwenyanga, nangemikhosi emisiweyo, njengokubalula komthetho wabo phambi kukaSimakade.
Bayakugcina umsebenzi wethende lokuhlangana, nezimfanelo zendawo engcwele, nezimfanelo zabozalo luka-Aroni, abafowabo, ekukhonzeni endlini kaSimakade.
Nazi izigaba ozalweni luka-Aroni. Amadodana ka-Aroni: nguNadabi, u-Abhihu, u-Eleyazare no-Ithamari.
UNadabi no-Abhihu bafa kuqala kunoyise, bengenabantwana. U-Eleyazare no-Ithamari bakhonza bengabaphristi.
UDavide, uZadoki, omunye wozalo luka-Eleyazare, no-Ahimeleki, wozalo luka-Ithamari, babehlukanisa ngezigaba zabo, ngokomsebenzi wabo.

Ozalweni luka-Eleyazare kwatholakala amadoda amaningi ayizinhloko kunasozalweni luka-Ithamari. Ahlukaniswa kanje: ozalweni luka-Eleyazare kwakukhona abali-16 ababeyizinhloko zezindlu zokhokho, nasozalweni luka-Ithamari kwatholakala abayisishiyagalombili ngokwezindlu zokhokho.
Bahlukaniswa ngokonkatho, ngokuba phakathi kwabo kwakukhona izikhulu zendlu engcwele nezikhulu zikaNkulunkulu ozalweni luka-Eleyazare noluka-Ithamari.

UShemaya, indodana kaNethaneli, umbhali ongumLevi, waloba phambi kwenkosi, nezikhulu, naphambi kukaZadoki, umphristi, no-Ahimeleki, indodana ka-Abhiyathara, nezinhloko zoyise, abaphristi nabaLevi. Enye indlu yoyise yayivela ku-Eleyazare, enye ivela endlini ka-Ithamari.
Unkatho lokuqala lwadla uJehoyaribi, olwesibili uJedaya,
olwesithathu uHarimi, olwesine uSehorimi,
olwesihlanu uMalikhiya, olwesithupha uMijamini,
olwesikhombisa uHakhosi, olwesishiyagalombili u-Abhiya,
olwesishiyagalolunye uJeshuwa, olweshumi uShekhaniya,
olwe-11 u-Eliyashibhi, olwe-12 uJakhimi,
olwe-13 uHupha, olwe-14 uJeshebheyabe,
olwe-15 uBhiliga, olwe-16 u-Imeri,
olwe-17 uHeziri, olwe-18 uHaphizezi,
olwe-19 uPhethahiya, olwama-20 uJehezekeli,
olwama-21 uJakini, olwama-22 uGamuli,
olwama-23 uDelaya, nolwama-24 uMahaziya.
Lezi kwakuyizigaba zabo ngokomsebenzi wabo, ukuba bangene endlini kaSimakade ngokomthetho ababewunikwe ngesandla sika-Aroni, uyise, njengalokho uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli ayemyalile.
Abaseleyo emadodaneni kaLevi kwakuyilaba: emadodaneni ka-Amramu nguShubhayeli; emadodaneni kaShubhayeli nguJehedeya.
KuRehabhiya: emadodaneni kaRehabhiya: nguJishiya, inhloko.
KumaJizihari: nguShelomothi; emadodaneni kaShelomothi: nguJahathi.
Amadodana kaHebhroni: nguJeriya, inhloko, owesibili ngu-Amariya, owesithathu nguJahaziyeli, owesine nguJekhameyamu.
Indodana ka-Uziyeli: nguMikha; indodana kaMikha nguShamiri.
Umfowabo kaMikha nguJishiya. Indodana kaJishiya nguZakhariya.
Amadodana kaMerari: nguMaheli, noMushi; indodana kaJahaziya nguBheno.
Amadodana kaMerari: nguJahaziya, uBheno, uShohamu, uZakhuri no-Ibhiri.
KuMaheli: ngu-Eleyazare, ongabanga namntwana.
KuKhishi: indodana kaKhishi nguJerameli.
Amadodana kaMushi: nguMaheli, u-Edere noJerimothi. Yilaba-ke ababengamadodana abaLevi ngezindlu zokhokho babo.
Nalaba benza unkatho njengabafowabo, amadodana ka-Aroni phambi kukaDavide, inkosi, uZadoki, u-Ahimeleki, nezinhloko zawoyise, abaphristi nabaLevi; omkhulu kubo kanjalo nomfowabo omncane.

UDavide nabakhuzi bempi behlukanisela umsebenzi amanye amadodana ka-Asafa, nakaHemani nakaJeduthuni; ayezophrofetha ngamahabhu, ngezingubhu, nangamasimbali. Abantu ababezokwenza umsebenzi wenkonzo babeyileli nani, bemi kanje:
emadodaneni ka-Asafa: nguZakhuri, uJosefa, uNethaniya no-Asharela, amadodana ka-Asafa, ephethwe ngu-Asafa owayephrofetha ngokulawulwa yinkosi.

KuJeduthuni: amadodana akhe: nguGedaliya, uZeri, uJeshaya, uShimeyi, uHashabhiya noMathithiya, esewonke eyisithupha, ephethwe nguyise uJeduthuni owayephrofetha ngohabhu, ngokubonga nangokudumisa uSimakade.

KuHemani: amadodana kaHemani: nguBhukiya, uMathaniya, u-Uziyeli, uShebhuweli, uJerimothi, uHananiya, uHanani, u-Eliyatha, uGidalithi, uRomamithi Ezeri, uJoshibhekasha, uMalothi, uHothiri noMahaziyothi.
Bonke labo kwakungamadodana kaHemani, isiboni senkosi ngokwezwi likaNkulunkulu, ukuze siphakamise uphondo lwayo. UNkulunkulu wamupha uHemani amadodana ali-14, namadodakazi amathathu.
Bonke laba babephethwe nguyise ekuhlabeleleni endlini kaSimakade ngamasimbali, ngezingubhu nangamahabhu ekukhonzeni endlini kaNkulunkulu. U-Asafa, uJeduthuni noHemani babephethwe yinkosi.
Inani labo bonke sebehlangene nabafowabo ababefundiswe ukuhlabelelela uSimakade, nababeyizazi babengama-288.
Benza unkatho ngemisebenzi yabo kusukela komncane njengokomdala, isazi nomfundi.
Unkatho lokuqala lwadla uJosefa ka-Asafa, olwesibili uGedaliya, yena ekanye nabafowabo namadodana akhe, sebebonke beli-12.
Olwesithathu lwadla uZakhuri, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12,
olwesine lwadla uJiziri, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwesihlanu lwadla uNethaniya, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwesithupha lwadla uBhukiya, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwesikhombisa lwadla uJesharela, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwesishiyagalombili lwadla uJeshaya, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwesishiyagalolunye lwadla uMathaniya, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olweshumi lwadla uShimeya, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olweshumi nanye lwadla u-Azareli, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwe-12 lwadla uHashabhiya, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwe-13 lwadla uShubhayeli, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwe-14 lwadla uMathithiya, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwe-15 lwadla uJeremothi, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwe-16 lwadla uHananiya, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwe-17 lwadla uJoshibhekaya, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwe-18 lwadla uHanani, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwe-19 lwadla uMalothi, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwama-20 lwadla u-Eliyatha, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwama-21 lwadla uHothiri, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwama-22 lwadla uGidalithi, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwama-23 lwadla uMahaziyothi, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Olwama-24 lwadla uRomamithi Ezeri, amadodana akhe nabafowabo, beli-12.
Nazi izigaba zabalindimasango: kumaKhorahi: nguMeshelemiya, indodana kaKhore emadodaneni ka-Asafa.
UMeshelemiya wayenalawa madodana: izibulo kunguZakhariya, eyesibili uJediyayeli, eyesithathu uZabhadiya, eyesine uJathiniyeli,
eyesihlanu u-Elamu, eyesithupha uJehohanani, eyesikhombisa kungu-Eliyohenayi.
U-Obhede Edomi wayenalawa madodana: izibulo kunguShemaya, eyesibili uJehozabhadi, eyesithathu uJowa, eyesine uSakhari, eyesihlanu uNethaneli,
eyesithupha u-Amiyeli, eyesikhombisa u-Isakhare, eyesishiyagalombili uPhewulethayi; uNkulunkulu wayembusisile impela.
Naye uShemaya wayenamadodana ayebusa indlu kayise, ngokuba ayengamaqhawe anamandla.
Amadodana kaShemaya: kungu-Othini, uRefayeli, u-Obhedi, u-Elizabhadi nabafowabo ababengamaqhawe anamandla, u-Elihu noSemakhiya.
Bonke labo kwakungabozalo luka-Obhede Edomi, bona, namadodana abo, nabafowabo, amadoda aqinileyo anamandla enkonzweni, babengama-62.
UMeshelemiya wayenamadodana nabafowabo, amadoda anamandla, eli-18.
UHosa owayengomunye wobozalo lukaMerari wayenamadodana: uShimiri wayeyinhloko nakuba engesilo izibulo, nguyise owambeka waba yinhloko.
Owesibili kwakunguHilikiya, owesithathu uThebhaliya, owesine kunguZakhariya; sebebonke, amadodana nabafowabo bakaHosa babeli-13.
Lezo zigaba zabalindimasango, izinhloko zabantu, zaba negunya ukukhonza endlini kaSimakade njengabafowabo.
Bashaya unkatho isango ngesango naphakathi komncane njengakomdala, ngokwezindlu zawoyise.
Unkatho lwasempumalanga lwadla uShelemiya. Base benza unkatho ngendodana yakhe, uZakhariya, owayengumeluleki owayehlakaniphile, wadliwa wunkatho lwasenyakatho.
Olwaseningizimu lwadla u-Obhede Edomi namadodana akhe, ukuba baqaphe inqolobane.
Olwasentshonalanga lwadla uShuphimi noHosa, ukuba babe ngabalindi abalinda ngasesangweni eShalekethi, ngendlela eyenyukayo.
Ngasempumalanga kwakunabaLevi abayisithupha, ngasenyakatho bebane ngosuku, ngaseningizimu bebane ngosuku nasenqolobaneni bebane.
Kwakukhona abane ngasentshonalanga endleleni, ePharibhari, kuthi ePharibhari uqobo kube nababili.
Lezo zigaba yizona ezabalindi ababevela ozalweni lukaKhorahi nakolukaMerari.
KubaLevi, u-Ahiya wayephethe ingcebo yendlu kaNkulunkulu nengcebo yezinto ezingcwele.
Amadodana kaLadani, ozalo lwamaGereshoni akwaLadani, izinhloko zoyise zakwaLadani umGereshoni, amaJehiyeli,
amadodana amaJehiyeli, uZethamu noJoweli umfowabo, ayengamele ingcebo endlini kaSimakade.
Kuma-Amramu, kumaJizihari, kumaHebhroni nakuma-Uziyeli;
uShebhuweli, indodana kaGereshomu kaMose, wayengumphathisikhwama.
Abafowabo ku-Eliyazeri: kwakunguRehabhiya, indodana yakhe, uJeshaya, uJoramu, uZikhiri noShelomothi.
UShelomothi nabafowabo babengamele yonke ingcebo yezinto ezingcwele ezazingcweliswe yinkosi uDavide, izinhloko zoyise, abakhuzi bempi bezinkulungwane, abakhuzi bempi bamakhulu nabakhuzi bempi.
Yibona ababengcwelisa okutholakale empini nasempangweni ukuba kulungiswe indlu kaSimakade,

nakho konke uSamuweli umboni, uSawule indodana kaKhishi, u-Abhineri indodana kaNeri noJowabe indodana kaZeruya ababekungcwelisile; lokho okwakungcweliswe ngabantu abehlukene, konke kwaphathwa nguShelomothi nabafowabo.
KumaJizihari, uKhenaniya namadodana akhe babephethe umsebenzi ongaphandle kwa-Israyeli, beyizikhulu nabehluleli.

KumaHebhroni, uHashabhiya nabafowabo, bengamaqhawe anamandla ayi-1 700, futhi bengababonisi kwa-Israyeli, phesheya kweJordani entshonalanga. Bengababonisi emsebenzini wonke kaSimakade nasezinkonzweni zenkosi.
KumaHebhroni, nguJeriya owayeyinhloko yezizukulwane ngokwezindlu zoyise. Ngonyaka wama-40 wokubusa kukaDavide kwafunwa, kwatholakala phakathi kwabo amaqhawe anamandla eJazeri kwaGileyadi.

Abafowabo, amaqhawe anamandla, babeyizi-2 700, izinhloko zoyise ezenziwa ababonisi abaphethe kwaRubeni, kwaGadi, nasengxenyeni yesizwana sakwaManase. Babephethe ezindabeni zonke zikaNkulunkulu, nasezindabeni zenkosi.

Nanti inani labantu bakwa-Israyeli ngokwezinhloko zezindlu zoyise, abakhuzi bempi bezinkulungwane nabezamakhulu, izikhulu zabo ezazikhonza inkosi kukho konke ngokwezigaba, ezazingena ziphuma inyanga nenyanga, ezinyangeni zonke zonyaka. Babekhona kuleso naleso sigaba, bekhonza, sebebonke beyizi-24 000.
UJashobhehamu, indodana kaZabhidiyeli, wayengamele isigaba sokuqala esasingena ngenyanga yokuqala. Esigabeni sakhe kwakukhona abayizi-24 000.
Owayengomunye wozalo lukaPherezi, esiyisikhulu sabo bonke abakhuzi bempi ngenyanga yokuqala.
Owayephethe isigaba sesibili kwakunguDadayi, umAhohi; singena ngenyanga yesibili isigaba sakhe. Esigabeni sakhe kwakukhona umbusi, uMikhilothi, beyizi-24 000.
Induna yempi yesithathu eyayingena ngenyanga yesithathu kwakunguBhenaya, indodana kaJehoyada, umphristi. Wayeyinhloko; esigabeni sakhe kukhona abayizi-24 000.
Nguye lowo Bhenaya owayeyiqhawe phakathi kwabangama-30, nowayengamele. Esigabeni sakhe kwakuno-Amizabhadi, indodana yakhe.
Owayengamele isigaba sesine esasingena ngenyanga yesine kwakungu-Asaheli, umfowabo kaJowabe, elekelelana nendodana yakhe, uZebadiya. Esigabeni sakhe kwakukhona abayizi-24 000.
Ngenyanga yesihlanu kwakunguShamhuthi, umJizirahi, owayengamele; esigabeni sakhe kwakukhona abayizi-24 000.
U-Ira, indodana ka-Ikheshi waseThekhowa, wayephethe ababengena ngenyanga yesithupha; esigabeni sakhe kwakukhona abayizi-24 000.
UHelezi, umPheloni, nguyena owayengamele ababengena ngenyanga yesikhombisa, wayevela kwa-Efrayimi; esigabeni sakhe kwakukhona abayizi-24 000.
USibhekhayi, umHushathi kwabakwaZera, nguye owayengamele ababengena ngenyanga yesishiyagalombili; esigabeni sakhe kwakukhona abayizi-24 000.
U-Abhiyezeri, umAnathothi wakwaBhenjamini, wayengamele abangena ngenyanga yesishiyagalolunye; esigabeni sakhe kukhona abayizi-24 000.
UMaharayi waseNethofa kwabakwaZera, wayengamele ababengena ngenyanga yeshumi; esigabeni sakhe kukhona abayizi-24 000.
UBhenaya, umPhirathoni wakwa-Efrayimi, wayephethe ababengena ngenyanga yeshumi nanye; esigabeni sakhe kukhona abayizi-24 000.
UHelidayi waseNethofa, ozalwa ngu-Otheniyeli, wayengamele abangena ngenyanga ye-12; esigabeni sakhe kukhona abayizi-24 000.
Ababemele izizwana zakwa-Israyeli kwakuyilaba: kwesakwaRubeni, umbusi kwakungu-Eliyazeri, indodana kaZikhiri. KwesakwaSimeyoni kunguShefathiya, indodana kaMahakha.
KubaLevi kunguHashabhiya, indodana kaKhemuweli. Ku-Aroni kunguZadoki.
KuJuda kungu-Elihu, umfowabo kaDavide. Ku-Isakhare kungu-Omri, indodana kaMikhayeli.
KwaZebuloni kungu-Ishimaya, indodana ka-Obhadiya; kwaNafethali kunguJeremothi indodana ka-Aziriyeli.
Kwabakwa-Efrayimi kunguHosheya, indodana ka-Azaziya; engxenyeni yesizwana sakwaManase kunguJoweli, indodana kaPhedaya.
Engxenyeni kaManase kwaGileyadi kungu-Ido, indodana kaZakhariya; kwabakwaBhenjamini kunguJahasiyeli, indodana ka-Abhineri;
kwabakwaDani kungu-Azareli, indodana kaJerohamu. Yilabo ababengabakhuzi bempi ezizwaneni zakwa-Israyeli.
UDavide akazange alibale inani lalabo ababeneminyaka engama-20 nabancane kunalokho, ngokuba uSimakade wayeshilo ukuthi uyomandisa u-Israyeli abe ngangezinkanyezi zezulu.

UJowabe, indodana kaZeruya, waqala ukubala abantu, kodwa akazange aqede ngenxa yolaka olwaqubuka phezu kuka-Israyeli, inani labantu alizange lifakwe encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla yenkosi uDavide.
U-Azimavethi, indodana ka-Adiyeli, wayephethe ingcebo yenkosi. UJonathani, indodana ka-Uziya, engamele izinto zasemasimini, emzini, emizaneni nasezinqabeni.
U-Eziri, indodana kaKhelubi, wayephethe abebenza umsebenzi wasendle, belima umhlabathi.
UShimeyi waseRama wayephethe izivini; uZabhidi ephethe iwayini eligciniweyo elithathwe ezivinini.
UBhali Hanani, umGederi, wayephethe iminqumo nemikhiwane okwakusehlanzeni; uJowabe ephethe izigcinamafutha.
Imihlambi eyayiklaba eSharoni yayiphethwe nguShithirayi, umSharoni; kuthi imihlambi eyayisezigodini iphathwe nguShafathi, indodana ka-Adilayi.
U-Obhili wakwa-Ishmayeli wayephethe amakameli; uJehedeya, umMeronothi, ephethe izimbongolo.
UJazizi, umHagiri, wayephethe izimvu. Bonke laba babeyizinduna zemfuyo yenkosi uDavide.
UJonathani, umfowabo kayise kaDavide, wayengumeluleki engumuntu ohlakaniphileyo, futhi engumbhali. UJehiyeli, indodana kaHakhimoni, wayehlala namadodana enkosi.
U-Ahithofeli wayengumeluleki wenkosi. UHushayi, umArikhi, engumngani wenkosi,
owayelandela u-Ahithofeli kwakunguJehoyada, indodana kaBhenaya no-Abhiyathara. UJowabe wayengumkhuzi wempi yenkosi.

UDavide wayeseqoqa zonke izikhulu zakwa-Israyeli, abaholi bezizwana, izinduna zezigaba ezazikhonza inkosi, abakhuzi bempi bezinkulungwane nabezamakhulu, izinduna zayo yonke imfuyo yenkosi neyamadodana ayo, izinduna zasendlunkulu, amaqhawe, nawo wonke amadoda anamandla eJerusalema.

UDavide, inkosi, wasukuma wama ngezinyawo, wathi: “Ngilaleleni bafowethu, nani bantu bami: bekusenhliziyweni yami ukuba ngakhele umphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade indlu yokuphumula, neyisenabelo sezinyawo zikaNkulunkulu wethu; ngiwenzile amalungiselelo okuba ngakhe.
Kepha uNkulunkulu wathi kimi: ‘Awuyukulakhela igama lami indlu, ngokuba wena uyindoda yempi, uchithe igazi.’

“Nakuba kunjalo, uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli wangiqoka endlini yonke kababa ukuba ngibe yinkosi kwa-Israyeli kuze kube phakade. Ngokuba ukhethe uJuda ukuba abe ngumbusi, endlini kaJuda, indlu kababa, emadodaneni kababa, wangithanda mina ukuba angibeke ngibe yinkosi yawo wonke u-Israyeli.
Emadodaneni ami wonke, ngokuba uSimakade ungiphile amadodana amaningi, ukhethe uSolomoni, indodana yami, ukuba ahlale esihlalweni sobukhosi sombuso kaSimakade kwa-Israyeli.
Wathi kimi: ‘USolomoni, indodana yakho, nguye oyakwakha indlu yami namagceke ami, ngokuba ngimkhethile ukuba abe yindodana yami, mina ngibe nguyise.
Ngiyakuwumisa umbuso wakhe kuze kube phakade, uma eqinisela ukugcina imiyalo yami nezahlulelo zami njenganamuhla.’

“Ngakho-ke phambi kwabo bonke abakwa-Israyeli, ibandla likaSimakade, nasezindlebeni zikaNkulunkulu wethu, bonani nifune yonke imiyalo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu ukuze nilidle leli lizwe elihle, nize nilishiye, libe yifa labantwana benu ingunaphakade.

“Wena Solomoni, ndodana yami, mazi uNkulunkulu kayihlo, umkhonze ngenhliziyo epheleleyo nangomphefumulo ovumayo, ngokuba uSimakade uhlola zonke izinhliziyo, uqonda zonke izizindlo zemicabango. Uma umfuna, uyakufunyanwa nguye, kodwa uma umshiya uyakukulahla kuze kube phakade.
Bheka manje, qina ukwenze lokhu, ngokuba uSimakade ukukhethile ukuba wakhe indlu, ibe yindlu engcwele.”
UDavide wanika uSolomoni umfanekiso wompheme, izindlu zethempeli, ingcebo yalo, amakamelo alo aphezulu nangaphakathi kwayo, indlu yesihlalo somusa,
umfanekiso wakho konke ayenakho emicabangweni yakhe ngamagceke endlu kaSimakade, amakamelo nxazonke, ingcebo yendlu kaNkulunkulu, nengcebo yezinto ezingcwele,
izigaba zabaphristi nezabaLevi, wonke umsebenzi wokukhonza endlini kaSimakade, zonke izitsha zenkonzo endlini kaSimakade,
igolide, ngokwesilinganiso segolide sezinto zegolide zezinkonzo ngezinkonzo, izinto zonke zesiliva isisindo sazo, nazo zonke izinto zezinkonzo ngezinkonzo.
Isisindo sezinti zezibani zegolide nezibani zazo zegolide, isisindo salolo nalolo luthi lwesibani nezibani zalo, izinti zesiliva, isisindo sothi nezibani zalo njengomsebenzi walolo nalolo luthi.
Isisindo segolide lamatafula ezinkwa zokubukwa, amatafula ngamatafula, isiliva lamatafula esiliva.
Izingwegwe zenyama, izinkamba, izitsha zegolide elicwengekileyo, zonke izindebe zegolide, isisindo saleso naleso sitsha.
I-althare lempepho lingelegolide elicwengekileyo isisindo salo, umfanekiso wenqola, amakherubhi egolide ayelule amaphiko awo, asibekela umphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade.
UDavide washo wathi: “Konke lokho ngikubhalile ngiqondiswa nguSimakade, yebo, wonke umsebenzi walo mfanekiso.”

UDavide wayesethi kuSolomoni, indodana yakhe: “Qina, ume isibindi, wenze lokhu. Ungesabi, ungabi naluvalo, ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu, yebo, uNkulunkulu wami, unawe. Akayukukuyeka, akayukukushiya, uze uphele wonke umsebenzi wokwakha le ndlu kaSimakade.

Bheka, nazi izigaba zabaphristi nabaLevi zazo zonke izinkonzo zendlu kaNkulunkulu. Emsebenzini wonke uyothola abantu abazinikele ngenhliziyo nabayizingcweti emisebenzini yonke. Izikhulu nabantu bonke bayakukulalela konke okushoyo.”

Inkosi uDavide yathi kulo lonke ibandla: “USolomoni, indodana yami, nguye yedwa okhethwe nguNkulunkulu, usengumfana, akakaqini ukhakhayi, nomsebenzi mkhulu, ngokuba ithempeli alisilo elomuntu, kepha ngelikaSimakade uNkulunkulu.

Sengiyilungisele indlu kaNkulunkulu wami ngamandla ami wonke, igolide lokwegolide, isiliva lokwesiliva, ithusi lokwethusi, insimbi yokwensimbi, imithi yokwemithi, amatshe amashohamu nawokufakwa, amatshe ahlobisayo nanemibala eyehlukeneyo, izinhlobo zonke zamatshe ayigugu, namatshe amhlophe amaningi.
Futhi njengokuba ngiyayithanda indlu kaNkulunkulu wami, nginengcebo yegolide nesiliva, ngiyakunikela endlini kaNkulunkulu wami, phezu kwakho konke engikulungisele indlu engcwele,
amathalenta egolide ayizi-3 000, igolide lase-Ofiri, amathalenta ayizi-7 000 esiliva elicwengekileyo ukunameka ngalo izindonga zezindlu,
igolide lokwegolide, nesiliva lokwesiliva, yebo, kuwo wonke umsebenzi wezandla zezingcweti. Ngubani pho othokozela namuhla ukuzehlukanisela uSimakade na?”
Zase zinikela izikhulu zawoyise, abaholi bezizwana zakwa-Israyeli, abakhuzi bempi bezinkulungwane nabezamakhulu nezinduna zomsebenzi wenkosi.

Banikelela umsebenzi wendlu kaNkulunkulu ngalokhu: amathalenta egolide ayizi-5 000, amadarike ayizi-10 000, amathalenta esiliva ayizi-10 000, amathalenta ethusi ayizi-18 000, namathalenta ensimbi ayizi-100 000.
Ababenamatshe bawanikela engcebeni yendlu kaSimakade, phansi kwesandla sikaJehiyeli, umGereshoni.
Abantu bajabula ngokunikela kwabo ngenhliziyo, ngokuba banikela ngenhliziyo epheleleyo kuSimakade; naye uDavide, inkosi, wajabula ngokujabula okukhulu.
UDavide wayesemdumisa uSimakade phambi kwebandla lonke, wathi: “Mawubongwe Simakade Nkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, ubaba, kuze kube phakade.

Simakade, bungobakho ubukhulu, namandla, nodumo, nenkazimulo, nobukhosi, ngokuba konke okusezulwini nokusemhlabeni kungokwakho. Ungowakho umbuso, Simakade. Wena uphakeme, uyinhloko phezu kwakho konke.
Ingcebo nenkazimulo kuvela kuwe, Wena uyabusa phezu kwakho konke. Esandleni sakho kukhona amandla nezikhwepha, ukukhulisa nokunika bonke amandla.
Ngalokho-ke, Nkulunkulu wethu, siyakubonga, siyalidumisa igama lakho elitusekayo.
“Ngokuba ngingubani mina, nabantu bami bayini ukuba sibe namandla okunikela kangaka na? Ngokuba konke kuvela kuwe, thina-ke sikunika okuvela esandleni sakho.
Ngokuba singabafokazi phambi kwakho, nezihambi njengabo bonke okhokho bethu; izinsuku zethu emhlabeni zinjengethunzi, nethemba alikho.
Simakade Nkulunkulu wethu, zonke lezi zinto esizilungisele ukwakhela igama lakho elingcwele indlu, zivela esandleni sakho, zonke zingezakho.

Nkulunkulu wami, ngiyazi ukuthi uhlola inhliziyo, uthanda ubuqotho. Mina-ke ngobuqotho benhliziyo yami nginikele ngokuthokoza zonke lezi zinto, manje sengibonile abantu bakho abakhona lapha benikela kuwe ngokukhululeka nangokuthokoza.
Simakade, Nkulunkulu ka-Abhrahama noka-Isaka noka-Israyeli, okhokho bethu, gcina lokhu njalo ezizindlweni zemicabango yenhliziyo yabantu bakho, uqondise inhliziyo yabo kuwe,
unike uSolomoni, indodana yami, inhliziyo epheleleyo ukuba agcine imiyalo yakho, ubufakazi bakho, izimiso zakho, nokwenza konke lokhu, nokwakha ithempeli engililungisileyo.”
UDavide wathi kulo lonke ibandla: “Ake nibonge uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.” Lonke ibandla lambonga uSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho babo, lakhothama, lakhuleka kuSimakade nasenkosini.

Ngakusasa bamhlabela uSimakade imihlatshelo, banikela ngeminikelo yokushiswa kuSimakade: izinkunzi eziyinkulungwane, izinqama eziyinkulungwane, amawundlu ayinkulungwane neminikelo yakho yokuphuzwayo, nemihlatshelo eminingi evela ku-Israyeli wonke.
Badla, baphuza phambi kukaSimakade ngalolo lusuku, bathokoza kakhulu. USolomoni, indodana kaDavide, baphinda okwesibili bambeka, bamgcobela uSimakade ukuba abe ngumbusi, uZadoki abe ngumphristi.
USolomoni wahlala esihlalweni sobukhosi sikaSimakade waba yinkosi esikhundleni sikaDavide, uyise, waba nempumelelo; wonke u-Israyeli wamlalela.
Zonke izikhulu, amaqhawe, nawo wonke amadodana enkosi uDavide bazithoba phansi kwenkosi uSolomoni.
USimakade wamenza waba mkhulu uSolomoni phambi kwabo bonke abakwa-Israyeli, wamnika udumo lobukhosi olungakaze lube khona nakuyiphi inkosi yakwa-Israyeli eyamendulelayo.
UDavide, indodana kaJese, wabusa u-Israyeli wonke.
Wambusa u-Israyeli iminyaka engama-40; iminyaka eyisikhombisa wabusa eseHebhroni, engama-33 wayibusa eseJerusalema.
Wafa esemdala, esenelisiwe yizinsuku nengcebo nodumo; uSolomoni, indodana yakhe, wabusa esikhundleni sakhe.
Izinto ezenziwa nguDavide ekuqaleni nasekugcineni, zonke zilotshiwe encwadini yezindaba zikaSamuweli umboni, encwadini yezindaba zikaNathani umphrofethi, nasencwadini yezindaba zikaGadi umboni.
Zonke izindaba ngokubusa kwakhe, amandla akhe, izehlo ezamehlelayo, yena no-Israyeli, nayo yonke imibuso namazwe.
USolomoni, indodana kaDavide, waziqinisa embusweni wakhe. USimakade uNkulunkulu wakhe, wayenaye, wamenza waba mkhulu, wadlondlobala.
USolomoni wakhuluma kuye wonke u-Israyeli, kubakhuzi bempi bezinkulungwane nabezamakhulu, kubehluleli, kubo bonke abaholi bakwa-Israyeli, nasezinhlokweni zoyise.
USolomoni wahamba nebandla lonke elalinaye, baya endaweni ephakemeyo eGibheyoni, ngokuba lalilapho ithende lokuhlangana likaNkulunkulu elalenziwe ehlane nguMose, inceku kaSimakade.
Kepha umphongolo kaNkulunkulu ayewukhuphulile uDavide eKiriyathi Jeharimi, wayiswa ethendeni uDavide ayelimisele wona, eJerusalema.
I-althare lethusi elalenziwe nguBhezaleli, indodana ka-Uri kaHure, nalo wayelibeke phambi kwethabanakeli likaSimakade. USolomoni nebandla baya kulo ukuyobuza kuSimakade.
USolomoni wakhuphuka waya e-althare lethusi elaliphambi kukaSimakade, lisethendeni lokuhlangana, wanikela kulo ngeminikelo yokushiswa eyinkulungwane.
Ngalobo busuku uNkulunkulu wabonakala kuSolomoni, wathi kuye: “Cela lokho othanda ukuba ngikuphe khona.”
USolomoni wathi kuNkulunkulu: “Ubaba uDavide umenzele umusa omkhulu, nami ungibeke inkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Manje Simakade Nkulunkulu, izwi lakho owalisho kuDavide ubaba maliqiniswe, ngokuba ungibekile inkosi phezu kwabantu abaningi ngangothuli lomhlabathi.
Manje ngiphe ukuhlakanipha nokwazi ukuze ngihole laba bantu, ngokuba ngubani ongehlulela laba bantu bakho abaningi kangaka na?”

UNkulunkulu wayesethi kuSolomoni: “Ngenxa yokuthi lokhu kuvela enhliziyweni yakho ukuba ungaceli ingcebo, imfuyo, nodumo, nokuba abakuzondayo bafe, futhi ungacelanga ukuphila isikhathi eside, kodwa ucele ukuhlakanipha nokwazi ukuze wehlulele abantu bami engikubeke ukuba ube yinkosi yabo;
ngiyakukunika ukuhlakanipha nokwazi; ngiyakukunika nengcebo, imfuyo, nodumo angazange abe nakho amakhosi akwandulelayo, nalawo ayokulandela awayukuba nakho.”
USolomoni wabuya endaweni ephakemeyo eGibheyoni, ethendeni lokuhlangana, waya eJerusalema, wabusa u-Israyeli.
USolomoni waqoqa izinqola nabamahhashi, waba nezinqola eziyi-1 400, nabamahhashi abayizi-12 000, wakubeka emizini yezinqola naseJerusalema, lapho ayehlala khona.
Inkosi yenza isiliva negolide kwaba yinsada eJerusalema njengamatshe, imisedari yayenza yaba njengemithombe esigodini ngobuningi.
Amahhashi kaSolomoni ayevela eGibhithe naseKhuwe. Labo ababehwebela inkosi babewathenga eKhuwe.
Bathenga eGibhithe inqola, bayidayisa ngamashekeli esiliva angama-600, ihhashi lilinye libiza amashekeli ayi-150. Bathengisela wonke amakhosi amaHithi namakhosi ama-Aramu ngaleyo ndlela.
USolomoni wakhipha umyalo wokuba kwakhelwe igama likaSimakade indlu nesigodlo sombuso wakhe.
USolomoni wabala izisebenzi eziyizi-70 000, ababazi bamatshe abayizi-80 000 kwelezintaba, nezinduna eziyizi-3 600 ukuba zibengamele.
USolomoni wathumela kuHuramu, inkosi yaseThire, wathi: “Njengalokho wenza kuDavide, ubaba, wathumela kuye imisedari, ukuba akhe indlu, ahlale kuyo, yenza kanjalo-ke nakimi.

Ngizokwakhela igama likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wami indlu, ukuba ngimngcwelisele yona, ngishise phambi kwakhe impepho enuka kahle, njalo kubekwe izinkwa zokubukwa, kunikelwe ngeminikelo yokushiswa ekuseni nakusihlwa ngamasabatha, ngokwethwasa kwenyanga, nangemikhosi emisiweyo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu. Lokhu kungumthetho kwa-Israyeli kuze kube phakade.
“Indlu engiyakuyakha iyakuba nkulu, ngokuba mkhulu uNkulunkulu wethu phezu kwabo bonke onkulunkulu.
Kepha ngubani onamandla okumakhela indlu, lokhu izulu nezulu lamazulu lingemanele na? Pho ngingubani mina ukuba ngingamakhela indlu, ukuze kushiswe impepho phambi kwakhe na?

“Ngakho-ke ake uthumele kimi umuntu oyingcweti, osebenza ngegolide, ngesiliva, ngethusi, ngensimbi, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokubomvu, nangokuluhlaza; oyingcweti yokuqopha yonke imiqopho, azosebenza nezingcweti ezinami kwaJuda naseJerusalema, ezabekwa nguDavide ubaba.
“Ngithumelele futhi imisedari, imisayiphuresi, nemi-alimugi evela eLebhanoni, ngokuba ngiyazi ukuthi izinceku zakho ziyakwazi ukugawula imithi eLebhanoni. Izinceku zami ziyosebenza nezinceku zakho,
ukungilungisela imithi eminingi, ngoba indlu engiyakuyakha iyakuba nkulu ngokumangalisayo.
Bheka, ngiyakunika izinceku zakho ezigawula imithi, amakhora kakolo ayizi-20 000, amakhora ebhali ayizi-20 000, amabhati ewayini ayizi-20 000, namabhati ayizi-20 000 amafutha.”
UHuramu, inkosi yaseThire, waloba wayesethumela kuSolomoni, wathi: “USimakade uyabathanda abantu bakhe; ukubeke waba yinkosi phezu kwabo.”

UHuramu wabuye wathi: “Makabongwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli owenza izulu nomhlaba, nowanika uDavide, inkosi, indodana ehlakaniphileyo, enolwazi nokuqonda, ezokwakhela uSimakade indlu nesigodlo sasebukhosini.
“Manje ngikuthumelela umuntu ohlakaniphileyo nonolwazi, uHuramu Abhi,

uyindodana yowesifazane wamadodakazi akwaDani; uyise wayengumuntu waseThire, owayekwazi ukusebenza ngegolide, ngesiliva, ngethusi, ngensimbi, ngamatshe, ngemithi, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokuluhlaza, ngelineni elicolekileyo, nangokubomvu, nokuqopha yonke imiqopho, nokuqamba yonke imisebenzi yobungcweti. Mnike izingcweti zakho nezingcweti zenkosi yami uDavide, uyihlo.
“Ngakho-ke ukolo, ibhali, amafutha, newayini inkosi yami ekhulume ngakho, mayikuthumele kuzo izinceku zayo.
Thina sizogawula imithi eLebhanoni njengalokhu uyidinga, siyithumele kuwe eJopha ngolwandle ngezihlenga, wena uyikhuphulele eJerusalema.”
USolomoni wabala bonke abezizwe ababesezweni kwa-Israyeli, ngendlela uDavide uyise ayebabale ngayo phambilini. Wathola ukuthi bayizi-153 600.
Wabeka kubo abayizi-70 000 ukuba bathwale imithwalo, abayizi-80 000 ukuba babe ngababazi bamatshe ezintabeni, nabayizi-3 600 ukuba bengamele abantu abasebenzayo.
USolomoni waqala ukwakha indlu kaSimakade eJerusalema, entabeni iMoriya, lapho uSimakade abonakala khona kuyise uDavide, endaweni uDavide ayeyilungisile, esibuyeni sika-Orinani, umJebusi.
Waqala ukwakha ngolwesibili lwenyanga yesibili, ngonyaka wesine wokubusa kwakhe.
Nasi-ke isisekelo esabekwa nguSolomoni ukuba kwakhiwe indlu kaNkulunkulu: ubude ngokulinganisa ngamakhubhithi akuqala kwakungamakhubhithi angama-60, ububanzi bungamakhubhithi angama-20.
Ubude nobubanzi bomphemegumbi owawuphambi kwendlu babungamakhubhithi angama-20, ukuphakama kungamakhubhithi ayi-120; wawuhuqa ngaphakathi ngegolide elicwengekileyo.
Indlu enkulu wayigcaya ngaphakathi ngemisayiphuresi; wayicaka ngegolide elicolisekileyo, waqopha imifanekiso yamasundu namaketanga kulo.
Indlu wayihlobisa ngamatshe ayigugu nangegolide elalivela ePharivayimi.
Wahuqa indlu, imishayo, imibundu, izindonga zayo, neminyango yayo ngegolide, waqopha amakherubhi ezindongeni.
Wakha indawo engcwelengcwele: ubude bayo bulingana nobubanzi bendlu, ingamakhubhithi angama-20, nobubanzi bungamakhubhithi angama-20. Wayicaka ngegolide elicolisekileyo elingamathalenta angama-600.
Isisindo sezipikili sasingamashekeli egolide angama-50.
Endlini engcwelengcwele wakha amakherubhi amabili aqoshiweyo, wawacaka ngegolide.

Ubude bamaphiko amakherubhi babungamakhubhithi angama-20, iphiko ngalinye lingamakhubhithi ayisihlanu, lithinte odongeni lwendlu. Elinye iphiko elalingamakhubhithi ayisihlanu, lalithinte kwelinye iphiko lelinye ikherubhi.
Iphiko lelinye ikherubhi elalingamakhubhithi ayisihlanu, lathinta odongeni lwendlu; elinye iphiko nalo elalingamakhubhithi ayisihlanu, lalithinte ephikweni lelinye ikherubhi.
Amaphiko ala makherubhi ayeluleke ngamakhubhithi angama-20, emi ngezinyawo zawo, ubuso bawo bubheke endlini.
Wenza isihenqo ngokuluhlaza, ngokububende, ngokubomvu nangelineni elicolekileyo, wabeka amakherubhi kuso.
Ngaphambi kwendlu, wamisa izinsika ezimbili ezingamakhubhithi angama-30 ubude, kunesihloko esasiphezu kwaleyo naleyo nsika, esasingamakhubhithi ayisihlanu.
Wenza amaketanga egumbini, wawabeka ezihlokweni zezinsika, wenza amahananadi ayikhulu wawabeka emaketangweni.
Wamisa izinsika phambi kwethempeli, enye ngakwesokunene nenye ngakwesokhohlo. Eyangakwesokunene wayiqamba igama wathi uJakhini, eyangakwesokhohlo wathi uBhowazi.
Wakha i-althare lethusi: ubude balo bungamakhubhithi angama-20, ububanzi balo bungamakhubhithi angama-20, nokuphakama kwalo kungamakhubhithi alishumi.

Wenza nolwandle olubunjiweyo: kusukela kulolu dini kuya kolunye udini luyisiyingilizi; lungamakhubhithi alishumi, ukuphakama kwalo kungamakhubhithi ayisihlanu. Lalizungezwe ngomucu ongamakhubhithi angama-30.
Phansi kwalo kwakunokufana nezintangazane kuluzungezile, kungamakhubhithi alishumi, nxazonke. Izintangazane zazisezinhleni zombili zolwandle, zibunjelwe kulo.

Lwalumi phezu kwezinkabi ezilishumi nambili, ezintathu zibheke ngasenyakatho, ezintathu zibheke ngasentshonalanga, ezintathu zibheke ngaseningizimu, ezintathu zibheke ngasempumalanga; ulwandle lwalumiswe phezu kwazo, zonke zifulathelene.
Uhlonze lwalo lwalungangobubanzi besandla; udini lwalo lwalwenziwe njengodini lwendebe, lunjengembali yomnduze; lumumatha okulingene namabhati ayizi-3 000.

Wakha imicengezi elishumi, eyisihlanu wayibeka ngakwesokunene, neminye eyisihlanu ngakwesokhohlo ukuze kuhlanjelwe kuyo. Bagezele kuyo okweminikelo yokushiswa, kodwa ulwandle lwaluhlambela abaphristi kuphela.
Wenza izinti zezibani zegolide njengomthetho wazo, wazibeka ethempelini, eziyisihlanu ngakwesokunene, neziyisihlanu ngakwesokhohlo.
Wenza amatafula alishumi, wawabeka ethempelini, ayisihlanu ngakwesokunene, nayisihlanu ngakwesokhohlo. Wenza nezitsha zegolide eziyikhulu.
Wenza igceke labaphristi, igceke elikhulu, iminyango yegceke, nezivalo zayo wazemboza ngethusi.
Ulwandle walubeka kwesokunene empumalanga yangaseningizimu yendlu.
UHuramu wenza amabhodwe, amafosholo, nezitsha. UHuramu wawuqeda umsebenzi ayewenzela inkosi uSolomoni endlini kaNkulunkulu:
izinsika ezimbili, izihloko ezimbili ezinjengezinkamba ezaziphezu kwezinsika, amanetha amabili okwemboza lezo zihloko ezimbili ezinjengezinkamba, ezaziphezu kwezinsika,
amahananadi angama-400 awo womabili amanethi, izinhla ezimbili zamahananadi kulelo nalelo netha, ukuze emboze izihloko zombili ezinjengezinkamba eziphezu kwezinsika.
Wenza imilenze, wenza nemicengezi emilenzeni,
wakha ulwandle olulodwa, nezinkabi ezili-12 phansi kwalo.
Wenza amabhodwe, amafosholo, izingwegwe zenyama, nazo zonke izimpahla uHuramu Abhi akwenzela inkosi uSolomoni ngethusi elikhazimulayo, kwaba ngokwendlu kaSimakade.
Inkosi yayikwenzela esigodini eJordani, emhlabathini oyibumba ophakathi kweSukhothi neZereda.
USolomoni wenza yonke leyo mpahla eyayiningi kakhulu kangangoba isisindo sethusi sasingenakulinganiswa.
USolomoni wenza yonke impahla eyayisendlini kaNkulunkulu: i-althare legolide, amatafula okwakukhona kuwo izinkwa zobukhona,
izinti zezibani nezibani zazo ukuze zivuthe njengokubalula komthetho, phambi kwegumbi elingaphakathi, kwenziwe ngegolide elicwengekileyo.
Izimbali zezibani, nezindlawu kwenziwe ngegolide, igolide elicwengekileyo.
Izizenze, izitsha, izinkezo nemicengezi yomlilo kwenziwe ngegolide elicwengekileyo. Iminyango yendlu, izivalo zayo ezingaphakathi endaweni engcwelengcwele, nezivalo zendlu yethempeli kwakuligolide.

Wonke umsebenzi uSolomoni ayewenza endlini kaSimakade waphothulwa. USolomoni wayesengenisa zonke izinto ezingcwele zikaDavide, uyise; igolide, isiliva nazo zonke izitsha, wakubeka engcebeni yendlu kaNkulunkulu.

USolomoni wayeseqoqa amalunga akwa-Israyeli, zonke izinhloko zezizwana, abaholi bawoyise babantu bakwa-Israyeli eJerusalema ukuba bakhuphule umphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade, bewususa emzini kaDavide iZiyoni.
Wonke amadoda akwa-Israyeli ahlangana enkosini, emkhosini owawungenyanga yesikhombisa.
Esefikile wonke amalunga akwa-Israyeli, abaLevi bawuphakamisa umphongolo.
Bawukhuphula umphongolo, nethende lokuhlangana nazo zonke izinto ezingcwele ezazisethendeni; kwakhushulwa ngabaphristi nabaLevi.
Inkosi uSolomoni, nayo yonke inhlangano yakwa-Israyeli eyayihlangene nayo lapho phambi komphongolo, bahlaba izimvu nezinkabi ezingenakubalwa ngenxa yobuningi bazo.
Abaphristi bawungenisa umphongolo wesivumelwano sikaSimakade endaweni yawo, egumbini elingaphakathi lendlu, indawo engcwelengcwele, phansi kwamaphiko amakherubhi.
Amakherubhi ayelule amaphiko awo phezu kwendawo yomphongolo; amakherubhi awusibekela umphongolo nezingongolo zawo.
Izingongolo zazizinde kangangokuba izihloko zazo zazibonakala endaweni engcwele, phambi kwegumbi elingcwele elingaphakathi, nokho zazingaveli ngaphandle kwalo. Umphongolo uselapho kuze kube namuhla.
Umphongolo wawungenalutho, ngaphandle kwezibhebhe zamatshe ezimbili ezazibekwe khona nguMose eHorebhe, ngesikhathi uSimakade enza isivumelwano nabantu bakwa-Israyeli, ekuphumeni kwabo eGibhithe.
Kwathi lapho abaphristi sebephumile endaweni engcwele, ngokuba bonke abaphristi ababelapho babezingcwelisile, kungabhekwanga izigaba zabo,

bonke abahlabelelayo abangabaLevi; u-Asafa, uHemani, uJeduthumi namadodana abo, nabafowabo, bembethe ilineni elicolekileyo, bephethe amasimbali, izingubhu namahabhu babemi ngasempumalanga ye-althare. Kwakumi kanye nabo abaphristi abayi-120, beshaya amacilongo.

Kwakungumsebenzi walabo ababephethe amacilongo nabahlabeleli ukuba bezwakalise kanyekanye, ngazwi linye, indumiso nokubonga kuSimakade. Ngesikhathi bezwakalisa indumiso ngamacilongo, amasimbali, nangazo zonke izinto zokudumisa, babedumisa uSimakade ngokuba emuhle, umusa wakhe umi phakade; indlu yagcwaliswa yifu, indlu kaSimakade.
Abaphristi abakwazanga ukuba ngaphakathi ukuze bakhonze, ngenxa yefu, ngokuba inkazimulo kaSimakade yagcwalisa indlu kaNkulunkulu.
Khona uSolomoni wakhuluma, wathi: “USimakade ushilo ukuthi uyakuhlala esigayegayeni.
Kepha mina ngikwakhele indlu yokuphakama kwakho, indawo oyakuhlala kuyo kuze kube phakade.”
Inkosi yayisiphenduka, yabusisa lonke ibandla lakwa-Israyeli, lonke ibandla lakwa-Israyeli lalimi.
Yathi: “Makabongwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli owakhuluma ngomlomo wakhe kuDavide, ubaba, ukugcwalisile ngesandla sakhe, ethi:

‘Kusukela osukwini engakhipha ngalo abantu bami u-Israyeli eGibhithe angikhethanga muzi ezizwaneni zonke zakwa-Israyeli ukwakha indlu ukuba igama lami libe khona lapho, futhi angikhethanga muntu ukuba abe ngumbusi wabantu bami u-Israyeli,
kodwa ngilikhethile iJerusalema ukuba igama lami libe lapho, ngimkhethile noDavide ukuba abe phezu kwabantu bami, u-Israyeli.’
“Kwakusenhliziyweni kaDavide, ubaba, ukwakhela igama likaSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli indlu,
kepha uSimakade wathi kuDavide, ubaba: ‘Njengokuba kwakusenhliziyweni yakho ukwakhela igama lami indlu, wenza kahle, ngokuba kwakusenhliziyweni yakho lokho.
Kepha wena awuyukuyakha indlu, kodwa indodana yakho eyakuphuma okhalo lwakho, yiyo eyokwakhela igama lami indlu.’

“USimakade uliqinisile izwi alikhulumayo, ngokuba ngingenile esikhundleni sikaDavide, ubaba, ngihlezi esihlalweni sobukhosi sakwa-Israyeli njengokusho kukaSimakade, ngilakhele igama likaSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli indlu.
Ngiwubekile lapho umphongolo okukuwo isivumelwano sikaSimakade asenza nabantu bakwa-Israyeli.”
USolomoni wema phambi kwe-althare likaSimakade, phambi kwalo lonke ibandla lakwa-Israyeli, welula izandla zakhe.

USolomoni wayakhe ibhesituli lethusi, walibeka phakathi negceke: ubude balo bungamakhubhithi ayisihlanu, ububanzi bona bungamakhubhithi amathathu. Wema kulo, waguqa ngamadolo phambi kwalo lonke ibandla lakwa-Israyeli. Welulela izandla zakhe ngasezulwini,
wathi: “Simakade Nkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, akekho uNkulunkulu emazulwini nasemhlabeni onjengawe; Wena ogcina isivumelwano nomusa nezinceku zakho ezihamba phambi kwakho, ngayo yonke inhliziyo yazo,
ogcine nenceku yakho uDavide, ubaba, lokho owakusho kuyo, yebo, owakukhuluma ngomlomo wakho ukufezile ngesandla sakho namuhla.

“Manje Simakade Nkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, gcina nenceku yakho uDavide, ubaba, lokho owakukhuluma kuyo uthi: ‘Akuyukwesweleka muntu kuwe, phambi kwami, oyohlala esihlalweni sobukhosi sakwa-Israyeli. Uma nje abozalo lwakho beqaphela indlela yabo, ukuba bahambe emthethweni wami, njengalokhu wena uhambile phambi kwami.’
“Ngakho-ke Simakade Nkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, maliqiniswe izwi lakho owalikhuluma encekwini yakho, uDavide.
“Ngabe uNkulunkulu uyakuhlala impela nabantu emhlabeni na? Izulu namazulu amazulu angekwanele; pho kakhulu kangakanani le ndlu engiyakhileyo na?
Wubheke umkhuleko wenceku yakho nokunxusa kwayo, Simakade Nkulunkulu wami, uzwe ukukhala kokunxusa nomkhuleko inceku yakho ekukhuleka phambi kwakho.
Amehlo akho mawayibheke le ndlu ubusuku nemini, indawo owakhuluma ngayo ukuthi uyakubeka khona igama lakho, uze ulalele umkhuleko inceku yakho eyakuwukhuleka kule ndawo.
Kulalele ukunxusa kwenceku yakho nokwabantu bakho, u-Israyeli, abayakukhuleka kule ndawo, uzwe usendaweni yakho yokuhlala ezulwini, nalapho usuzwile, uthethelele.
“Uma umuntu ona omunye, kufuneka ukuba enze isifungo, bese eza ezofunga phambi kwe-althare lakho kule ndlu,
mawuzwe usezulwini, uthathe izinyathelo, wehlulele izinceku zakho, owonileyo alahlwe yicala, ajeze ngobubi bakhe, kuthi olungileyo limthethe, azuze ngangokulunga kwakhe.
“Uma abantu bakho, u-Israyeli, benqotshwa yisitha ngenxa yokuba bonile kuwe, bese bephenduka bebuyela kuwe, bavume igama lakho, bakhuleke, banxuse kuwe bekule ndlu,
mawuzwe wena usezulwini, uthethelele isono sabantu bakho, u-Israyeli, ubabuyisele ezweni owalinika bona nokhokho babo.
“Lapho izulu livaliwe, kungekho mvula, ngenxa yokuba bonile kuwe, bese bekhuleka bebheke kule ndawo, bavume igama lakho, baphenduke esonweni sabo, ngoba uyabajezisa,

mawuzwe Wena usezulwini, uthethelele isono sezinceku zakho nesabantu bakho, u-Israyeli. Uyakubaqondisa endleleni enhle abayakuhamba ngayo, uthumele imvula ezweni lakho owabanika lona abantu bakho ukuba libe yifa labo.
“Uma kuba khona indlala ezweni, noma imbo, noma ukuhwamuka, nesikhutha, isikhonyane, umswenya noma izitha zabo zibavimbezela ezweni lemizi yabo, noma inhlupheko yahlobo luni nasifo sini,

bese kuzwakala noma ngabe luhlobo luni lomkhuleko noma ukunxusa okuyokwenziwa noma ngubani noma yibo bonke abantu bakho, u-Israyeli, abayokwazi ukubeka inhlupheko noma usizi lwabo kuwe, kube yilowo nalowo elulele izandla zakhe kule ndlu,

mawuzwe Wena usezulwini, indawo yakho yokuhlala, uthethelele, kube yilowo nalowo umuphe ngokwezindlela zakhe zonke. Nguwe owazi inhliziyo yakhe ngokuba nguwe kuphela owazi izinhliziyo zabantwana babantu.
Ngakho-ke mabakwesabe, bahambe ngezindlela zakho zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwabo ezweni owalinika okhokho bethu.
“Kuyakuthi uma owezizwe ongesiye owabantu bakho u-Israyeli, evela ezweni elikude, ngenxa yegama lakho elikhulu nesandla sakho esinamandla nengalo yakho eyeluliweyo, afike akhuleke kule ndlu,

mawuzwe Wena usezulwini, indawo yakho yokuhlala, wenze njengakho konke ukukhala owezizwe akhala ngakho kuwe, ukuze bonke abantu bomhlaba balazi iGama lakho, bakwesabe Wena njengabantu bakho, u-Israyeli, nokuba bazi futhi ukuthi le ndlu engiyakhileyo ibizwe ngeGama lakho.
“Uma abantu bakho bephuma impi ukuyokulwa nezitha zabo ngendlela obathuma ngayo, bese bekhuleka kuwe bebheke kulo muzi owukhethileyo nale ndlu engiyakhele iGama lakho,
mawuzwe Wena usezulwini umkhuleko wabo nokunxusa kwabo, uyimele indaba yabo.
“Uma bona kuwe, ngoba akukho muntu ongoni, bese ubathukuthelela, ubanikele esitheni, sibathumbe sibayise ezweni laso, elikude noma eliseduze,
bese becabanga belapho ezweni abathunjelwe kulo, baphenduke, banxuse kuwe besezweni lokuthunjwa kwabo, bathi: ‘Sonile, senze okuphambeneyo, saziphatha kabi.’

“Uma bephendukela kuwe ngayo yonke inhliziyo yabo, nangawo wonke umphefumulo wabo besezweni abathunjelwe kulo, bakhuleke kuwe bebheke ngasezweni lakubo owalinika okhokho babo, nomuzi owukhethileyo, nendlu engiyakhele igama lakho,
mawuzwe umkhuleko wabo nokunxusa kwabo usezulwini, indawo yakho yokuhlala, uyimele indaba yabo, ubathethelele abantu bakho abonileyo kuwe.
“Ngakho-ke Nkulunkulu wami, amehlo akho mawabheke, nezindlebe zakho zilalele umkhuleko owenziwa kule ndawo.

“Manje, sukuma Simakade Nkulunkulu, uze endaweni yakho yokuphumula Wena nomphongolo wakho wamandla. Abaphristi bakho Simakade Nkulunkulu, abaphristi bakho mabembathiswe insindiso, nabathembekile bakho bathokoze ngokuhle.
Simakade Nkulunkulu, ungamfulatheli ogcotshiweyo wakho. Khumbula umusa wakho kuDavide inceku yakho.”
Kwathi lapho uSolomoni eseqedile ukukhuleka, kwehla umlilo ezulwini, wadla umnikelo wokushiswa nemihlatshelo; inkazimulo kaSimakade yagcwalisa indlu.
Abaphristi abakwazanga ukungena endlini kaSimakade, ngokuba inkazimulo kaSimakade yayiyigcwalisile indlu kaSimakade.

Ngesikhathi abantu bakwa-Israyeli bebona ukwehla komlilo, nenkazimulo kaSimakade iphezu kwendlu, bakhothama bathi mbo ngobuso emhlabathini, phezu kwendawo eyayigandayiwe, bakhuleka, bambonga uSimakade, ngokuba muhle nangokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.
Inkosi nabo bonke abantu banikela ngomhlatshelo phambi kukaSimakade.
Inkosi uSolomoni yanikela ngomhlatshelo wezinkunzi eziyizi-22 000, nezimvu eziyizi-120 000. Inkosi nabo bonke abakwa-Israyeli, bayibusisa kanjalo-ke indlu kaNkulunkulu.

Abaphristi nabaLevi bema ngokwezikhundla zabo, bephethe izinto ezishaywayo ezazenziwe nguDavide, inkosi, ukuba babonge uSimakade, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade, ngesikhathi uDavide edumisa ngezandla zabo; abaphristi babeshaya amacilongo phambi kwabo, wonke u-Israyeli wayemile.

USolomoni wangcwelisa ingaphakathi legceke elaliphambi kwendlu kaSimakade, wanikela lapho ngeminikelo yokushiswa namanoni eminikelo yokuthula, ngokuba i-althare lethusi ayelenzile uSolomoni lalingeke lanele ukwenzela umnikelo wokushiswa, owokusanhlamvu namanoni.
Ngaleso sikhathi uSolomoni wagubha umkhosi izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, wonke u-Israyeli enaye, eyibandla elikhulu kakhulu, kusukela eLebo Hamathi kuze kube semfuleni eGibhithe.
Kwathi ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili benza umhlangano ozothileyo ngokuba begcinile ukubusiswa kwe-althare izinsuku eziyisikhombisa nomkhosi izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.

Ngosuku lwama-23 lwenyanga yesikhombisa, uSolomoni wabamukisa abantu ukuba baphindele emathendeni abo. Babethokoza benezinhliziyo ezenamileyo ngobuhle uSimakade ayebenzele uDavide, uSolomoni no-Israyeli abantu bakhe.
USolomoni waqeda ukwakha indlu kaSimakade nesigodlo senkosi; konke ayekufisa enhliziyweni yakhe ukuba akwenze endlini kaSimakade nasesigodlweni sakhe, waphumelela ukukwenza.
USimakade wabonakala kuSolomoni ebusuku, wathi kuye: “Ngiwuzwile umkhuleko wakho, ngiyikhethile le ndawo ukuba ibe ngeyami, ibe yindlu yomhlatshelo.
“Uma ngivala izulu, imvula ingani, noma ngiyala isikhonyane ukuba sidle okusezweni, noma ngithumela ubhubhane kubantu bami,
bazithobe abantu bami ababizwa ngegama lami, bakhuleke, bafune ubuso bami, baphenduke ezindleleni zabo ezimbi, ngiyakuzwa ngisezulwini, ngithethelele isono sabo, ngiphilise izwe labo.
Manje amehlo ami ayakuvuleka, izindlebe zami zilalele umkhuleko owenziwa kule ndawo.
Le ndlu ngiyiqokile ngayingcwelisa ukuba igama lami libe kuyo kuze kube phakade. Amehlo ami nenhliziyo yami kuyakuba kuyo njalo.
“Wena-ke, uma uyakuhamba phambi kwami njengoba kuhambe uDavide, uyihlo, ukwenze konke engikuyale ngakho, ugcine izimiso nezehlulelo zami,
ngiyakusimisa isihlalo sobukhosi sombuso wakho njengoba ngenza kuDavide, uyihlo, ngathi: ‘Akuseyukwesweleka umuntu ovela kuwe ukuba abe ngumbusi kwa-Israyeli.’
“Kepha uma ningifulathela, nilahle izimiso zami nemiyalo yami engikubeke phambi kwenu, nihambe niyokhonza abanye onkulunkulu, nikhuleke kubo,
ngiyakubasiphula ezweni lami engibanike lona, nale ndlu engiyingcwelisele igama lami ngiyakuyilahla, isuke phambi kwami, ngiyenze isaga nesifengqo phakathi kwabantu bonke.
Le ndlu ephakeme kangaka, kuyothi bonke abedlula ngakuyo bakhexe imilomo, bathi: ‘Kungani uSimakade enze kanje kuleli lizwe nakule ndlu na?’

“Bayakuphendula, bathi: ‘Kungokuba bamshiya uSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho babo owabakhipha eGibhithe, babambelela kwabanye onkulunkulu, bakhuleka kubo, babakhonza, ngakho-ke ubehlisele konke lokhu okubi.’ ”
Kwathi ekupheleni kweminyaka engama-20, uSolomoni eyakhile indlu kaSimakade nesigodlo sakhe,
uSolomoni wakha kabusha imizi ayeyinikwe nguHuramu, wayesehlalisa kuyo abantu bakwa-Israyeli.
USolomoni wahlasela iHamathi Zobha, walinqoba.
Wakha iThadimori ehlane, kwathi eHamathi wakha imizi eyizinqolobane.
Wakha iBhethi Horoni engenhla, neBhethi Horoni engezansi, imizi ebiyelweyo enezingange, amasango, nemigoqo.
Wakha neBhalathi, nayo yonke imizi eyizinqolobane. Yonke imizi yezinqola, imizi yabamahhashi, kwakungekaSolomoni, nakho konke ayefisa ukukwakha eJerusalema, eLebhanoni nakulo lonke izwe ayelibusa.
Bonke abantu ababeyinsali yamaHithi, ama-Amori, amaPherizi, amaHivi namaJebusi, ababengesibo abozalo lwabaka-Israyeli,
abozalo lwabo ababesele ezweni, ababengababhubhisanga abantu bakwa-Israyeli, uSolomoni wabenza izigqila kuze kube namuhla.
Kepha uSolomoni akabenzanga abantu bakwa-Israyeli izigqila ezenza umsebenzi wakhe, kodwa babengamabutho, bengabakhuzi bempi beyizikhulu zakhe, nezinduna zezinqola zakhe.
Labo ababeyizikhulu ezinkulu zenkosi uSolomoni babengama-250, bephethe abantu.

USolomoni wakhuphula indodakazi kaFaro emzini kaDavide, wayiyisa endlini ayakhela yona, ngokuba wathi: “Umkami akanakuhlala endlini kaDavide, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, ngokuba ingcwele, kulapho kwafikela khona umphongolo kaSimakade.”
USolomoni wanikela lapho ngeminikelo yokushiswa kuSimakade, e-althare likaSimakade ayelakhe phambi kompheme,

njengalokhu kufanele, imihla ngemihla. Wayenikela njengokomyalo kaMose, ngamasabatha, ngokwethwasa kwenyanga, nangemikhosi emisiweyo. Wayenikela kathathu ngonyaka: ngomkhosi wesinkwa esingenamvubelo, ngomkhosi wamasonto, nangomkhosi wamadokodo.

Njengokomthetho kayise uDavide, abaphristi wabamisa ngokwezigaba zabo enkonzweni, nabaLevi ezikhundleni zabo, ukuba badumise, bakhonze phambi kwabaphristi njengemfanelo imihla ngemihla. Abalindimasango nabo wabamisa ngezigaba zabo emasangweni; kulelo nakulelo sango, ngokuba uDavide, umuntu kaNkulunkulu, wayeyale ukuba kube kanjalo.
Kabazange baphambuke emiyalweni yenkosi, kubaphristi nakubaLevi, nakokuphathelene nengcebo.
Wonke umsebenzi kaSolomoni wahlelwa kusukela osukwini okwabekwa ngalo isisekelo sendlu kaSimakade kwaze kwaba sekupheleni kwendlu kaSimakade.
USolomoni wayesesuka waya eZiyoni Gebheri nase-Elathi, ogwini lolwandle, kwa-Edomi.

UHuramu wathumela kuye ngezinceku zakhe imikhumbi nezinceku ezazilujwayele ulwandle. Zahlangana nezinceku zikaSolomoni, zaya e-Ofiri, zalanda khona amathalenta angama-450 egolide, zawayisa enkosini uSolomoni.

Kwathi indlovukazi yaseShebha seyizwile ngodumo lukaSolomoni, yasuka yaya eJerusalema ukuba iyovivinya uSolomoni ngezimfumbe. Yayinehele elikhulu kakhulu, amakameli ayethwele amakha, igolide eliningi, namatshe ayigugu. Yafika kuSolomoni yakhuluma naye ngakho konke okusenhliziyweni yayo.
USolomoni wayiphendula kukho konke eyambuza khona, akukho lutho olufihlakeleyo uSolomoni angakwazanga ukuyichachisela khona.
Indlovukazi yaseShebha isibonile ukuhlakanipha kukaSolomoni, nendlu ayeyakhile,

ukudla okusetafuleni lakhe, indlela izinceku zakhe ezazihlala ngayo, nezazima ngayo, izembatho zazo, abaphathizitsha nezembatho zabo, negumbi lakhe eliphezulu endlini kaSimakade, ayibange isaba nalutho olunye engalusho.
Yathi enkosini: “Konke engikuzwe ngawe ezweni lakithi kuliqiniso, mayelana namazwi akho nangokuhlakanipha kwakho.
Kepha angikholwanga ngamazwi abo, ngaze ngafika, ngazibonela ngamehlo ami; angitshelwanga ngisho ingxenye yobukhulu bokuhlakanipha kwakho.
Babusisiwe abantu bakho, zibusisiwe lezi zinceku zakho ezihlala zimi njalo phambi kwakho, zizwa ukuhlakanipha kwakho.

Makabongwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho okwaba kuhle kuye ukuba akubeke esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi, ube yinkosi kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho. Ngokuba uNkulunkulu wakho uyamthanda u-Israyeli futhi uyathanda ukummisa kuze kube phakade, yingakho ekubeke waba yinkosi phezu kwakhe, ukuba wenze ubulungiswa nokulunga.”

Indlovukazi yaseShebha yanika inkosi amathalenta egolide ayi-120, amakha amaningi kakhulu, namatshe ayigugu; akukho omunye owake wanika inkosi uSolomoni amakha amaningi njengalawo awaphiwa yindlovukazi yaseShebha.
Izinceku zikaHuramu nezinceku zikaSolomoni ezabuya negolide e-Ofiri, zaletha imi-alimugi namatshe ayigugu.
Inkosi yakha izikhwelo zendlu kaSimakade nezesigodlo ngemi-alimugi, yakha amahabhu, nezingubhu zabahlabeleli okungakaze kubonwe okunjengakho phambilini kwaJuda.
Inkosi uSolomoni yanika indlovukazi yaseShebha konke ekufunayo neyakucelayo, ngaphandle kwalokho eyayikulethe enkosini. Yasuka yabuyela ezweni layo nezinceku zayo.
Isisindo segolide elalilethwa kuSolomoni minyaka yonke lalingamathalenta angama-666 egolide,
ngaphandle kwalelo elalifika nabahwebi nabathengisi, nawo wonke amakhosi ase-Arabhiya, nababusi bezwe ababeletha igolide nesiliva kuSolomoni.
Inkosi uSolomoni yenza izihlangu zegolide elicangcathiweyo ezingama-200, isihlangu ngasinye singamashekeli egolide elicangcathiweyo angama-600.
Yakhanda futhi nezihlangu zegolide elicangcathiweyo ezingama-300; isihlangu ngasinye singamashekeli egolide elicangcathiweyo angama-300; inkosi yazibeka eNdlini Yehlathi eLebhanoni.
Inkosi yenza isihlalo sobukhosi esikhulu ngezimpondo zendlovu, yasicaka ngegolide elicwengekileyo.

Isihlalo sobukhosi sasinezikhwelo eziyisithupha, sinesenabelo segolide esasinamatheliswe esihlalweni sobukhosi, nemikhono ngalapha nangalapha kwendawo yokuhlala, kumi izingonyama ezimbili eceleni kwemikhono.
Kwakumi izingonyama ezili-12 ngalapha nangalapha kwezikhwelo eziyisithupha. Akukho okunjengalokhu okwake kwenziwa kweminye imibuso.
Zonke izitsha zokuphuza zenkosi uSolomoni zaziyigolide, nazo zonke izitsha ezaziseHlathini eLebhanoni zaziyigolide elicwengekileyo; isiliva lalingento etheni emihleni kaSolomoni.

Inkosi uSolomoni yathumela imikhumbi yayo eTharishishi kanye nezinceku zikaHuramu. Kwakuthi kanye emuva kweminyaka emithathu, ifike imikhumbi yaseTharishishi ithwele igolide, isiliva, izimpondo zendlovu, izimfene, namapigogo.
Inkosi uSolomoni yaba nkulu kunawo onke amakhosi omhlaba ngengcebo nangokuhlakanipha.
Wonke amakhosi omhlaba ayefuna ukumbona uSolomoni ubuso nobuso, ukuzwa ngokuhlakanipha kwakhe, uNkulunkulu ayekubeke enhliziyweni kaSolomoni.
Yileyo naleyo yayimlethela isipho: izitsha zesiliva, izitsha zegolide, izingubo, izikhali, amakha, amahhashi neminyuzi, ekwenza lokhu iminyaka ngeminyaka.
USolomoni wayenamabhanqa ayizi-4 000 amahhashi nezinqola, abamahhashi abayizi-12 000, wababeka emizini yezinqola nasenkosini eJerusalema.
Wabusa phezu kwawo wonke amakhosi, kusukela emfuleni kuze kube sezweni lamaFilisti nasemngceleni waseGibhithe.
Inkosi yenza ukuba isiliva lixhaphake njengamatshe eJerusalema, nemisedari yayenza yaba miningi njengemithombe ehlanzeni.
USolomoni bamlethela amahhashi evela eGibhithe nasemazweni onke.

Ezinye izindaba zikaSolomoni, ezakuqala nezakamuva, azilotshiwe yini ezindabeni zikaNathani umphrofethi, nasesiphrofethweni sika-Ahaya waseShilo, nasemibonweni ka-Ido umboni ngoJerobhowamu indodana kaNebhathi na?
USolomoni wabusa eJerusalema phezu kuka-Israyeli wonke iminyaka engama-40.
USolomoni wayesekhothama, bamngcwaba kokhokho bakhe, emzini kaDavide uyise. URehobhowamu, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
URehobhowamu waya eShekemi, ngokuba wonke u-Israyeli wayeye lapho eShekemi ukuba ambeke, abe yinkosi.
Kwathi ukuba uJerobhowamu, indodana kaNebhathi owayebalekele eGibhithe ngenxa yokwesaba inkosi uSolomoni, akuzwe lokho, wabuya eGibhithe.
Bathumela bambiza, uJerobhowamu naye wonke u-Israyeli beza kuRehobhowamu, bakhuluma naye, bathi:

“Uyihlo wenza ijoka lethu laba nzima, manje siyakucela ukuba wena uwenze lula umsebenzi olukhuni uyihlo ayesethwese wona, nejoka lakhe elinzima ayelibeke phezu kwethu, siyokukhonza uma wenze kanjalo.”
Wathi kubo: “Hambani kuthi emva kwezinsuku ezintathu nibuye nize kimi.” Basuka-ke abantu.
Inkosi uRehobhowamu yacela iseluleko ezingwevini ezazikade zeluleka uSolomoni, uyise, esaphila, yathi: “Nina ningeluleka ukuba ngibuyisele impendulo ethini kulaba bantu na?”
Zakhuluma kuye, zathi: “Uma namuhla uzokuba yinceku yalaba bantu, ubakhonze, ukhulume amazwi amahle lapho ubaphendula, bayokuba yizinceku zakho zonke izinsuku zabo.”
Kepha akasishayanga mkhuba iseluleko sezingwevu ezazimeluleke ngaso, wayesecela iseluleko ezinsizweni ezaziyintanga yakhe, ezaziwa zivuka naye.
Wathi kuzo: “Nina ningeluleka ukuba ngibuyisele mpenduloni kulaba bantu abakhulume kimi ngokuthi: ‘Yenza lula ijoka uyihlo alibeka phezu kwethu,’ na?”

Izinsizwa ezingontanga yakhe zathi kuye: “Uyothi kulaba bantu abakhulume kuwe, bathi: ‘Uyihlo walenza laba nzima ijoka lethu, kepha wena lenze libe lula kithina,’ uyokhuluma kanje kubo: ‘Ucikicane wami mkhulu kunokhalo lukababa.
Ubaba wanethwesa ijoka elinzima, mina-ke ngizothasisela ejokeni lenu. Ubaba wanishaya ngeziswebhu, kodwa mina ngizonishaya ngofezela.’ ”
UJerobhowami nabo bonke abantu bafika kuRehobhowamu ngosuku lwesithathu, njengalokhu yayishilo inkosi, yathi: “Buyani kimi ngosuku lwesithathu.”
Inkosi yabaphendula kanzima abantu, yasishaya indiva iseluleko izingwevu ezazimeluleke ngaso.
Yakhuluma kubo njengokwelulekwa yizinsizwa, yathi: “Ubaba wayenethwese ijoka elinzima, mina-ke ngizothasisela ejokeni lenu; ubaba wanishaya ngeziswebhu, mina ngizonishaya ngofezela.”
Inkosi ayibalalelanga abantu, ngokuba lokho kwakuvela kuSimakade, ukuze uSimakade agcwalise izwi alikhuluma ngomlomo ka-Ahiya waseShilo kuJerobhowamu, indodana kaNebhathi.

Wonke u-Israyeli lapho ebona ukuthi inkosi ayibalalelanga, abantu bayiphendula inkosi, bathi: “Sinasabelo sini kuDavide na? Asinafa endodaneni kaJese. Israyeli, buyela emathendeni akho, zibhekele indlu yakho manje, Davide.” U-Israyeli wabuyela emathendeni akhe.
Kepha uRehobhowamu wabusa phezu kwabo bonke abantu bakwa-Israyeli ababakhe emizini yakwaJuda.
Inkosi uRehobhowamu yathuma u-Adoramu owayengamele izisebenzi ku-Israyeli. Kepha u-Israyeli wonke wamkhanda ngamatshe, wafa. Inkosi uRehobhowamu yashesha yagibela enqoleni yayo, yabaleka eJerusalema.
U-Israyeli wayihlubuka indlu kaDavide kuze kube yinamuhla.

URehobhowamu esefikile eJerusalema, waqoqa yonke indlu yakwaJuda nesizwana sakwaBhenjamini, abantu abakhethiweyo abayizi-180 000, amabutho, ukuze balwe nendlu yakwa-Israyeli, umbuso bawubuyisele kuye uRehobhowamu, indodana kaSolomoni.
Kwase kufika izwi likaNkulunkulu kuShemaya, umuntu kaNkulunkulu, lathi:
“Yisho kuRehobhowamu, indodana kaSolomoni, inkosi yakwaJuda, nayo yonke indlu yakwa-Israyeli ekwaJuda neyakwaBhenjamini, uthi:

‘Usho kanje uSimakade, uthi: ningakhuphuki ukuyolwa nabafowenu, abantu bakwa-Israyeli; phindelani, kube yilowo nalowo endlini yakhe, ngokuba lokhu kuvela kimi.’ ” Balilalela izwi likaSimakade, baphindela emuva, kabamhlasela uJerobhowamu.
URehobhowamu wahlala eJerusalema, wakha imizi eyizinqaba kwaJuda.
Wakha iBhethlehema, i-Ethamu, iThekhowa,
iBhethi Zuri, iSoko, i-Adulamu,
iGathi, iMaresha, iZifi,
i-Adorayimi, iLakhishi, i-Azekha,
iZora, i-Ajaloni, neHebhroni; leyo mizi ebiyelweyo yayikwaJuda nakwaBhenjamini.
Izinqaba waziqinisa, kuzo wabeka abakhuzi bempi, wagcina ukudla, amafutha, newayini kuzo.
Kuyo yonke imizi, wabeka izihlangu nemikhonto emzini ngamunye, wayiqinisa kakhulu impela. ElakwaJuda nelakwaBhenjamini kwakungokwakhe.
Abaphristi nabaLevi ababekulo lonke elakwa-Israyeli bazihlanganisa noRehobhowamu, bevela kuzo zonke izifundazwe.
AbaLevi bashiya amadlelo abo nefa labo, baya kwaJuda naseJerusalema, ngokuba uJerobhowamu namadodana akhe bawenqabela ukuba abe ngabaphristi bakaSimakade.
Wazimisela abaphristi bezindawo eziphakemeyo, abezimbuzi nabamathole ayewabumbile.

Emva kokuhamba kwabo, kwalandela ababevela kuzo zonke izizwana zakwa-Israyeli, ababenhliziyo ziphokophelele ukufuna uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, baya eJerusalema ukuyohlabela uSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho babo.
Base bewuqinisa-ke umbuso wakwaJuda, benza uRehobhowamu, indodana kaSolomoni, waba namandla iminyaka emithathu, ngokuba bahamba iminyaka emithathu endleleni kaDavide noSolomoni.
URehobhowamu waganwa nguMahalathi, indodakazi kaJerimothi, indodana kaDavide neka-Abhihayili, indodakazi ka-Eliyabe, indodana kaJese.
Wamzalela lawa madodana: uJewushe, uShemiya noZahamu.
Emva kwakhe, wathatha uMahakha, indodakazi ka-Absalomu. Yona yamzalela: u-Abhiya, u-Athayi, u-Uza, noShelomithi.

URehobhowamu wamthanda uMahakha, indodakazi ka-Absalomu, ukwedlula bonke abafazi bakhe nezanciza zakhe; wayeganwe ngabafazi abali-18 nezancinza ezingama-60. Wazala amadodana angama-28, namadodakazi angama-60.
URehobhowamu wabeka u-Abhiya, indodana kaMahakha, waba yinhloko nombusi phakathi kwabafowabo, kwazise wayehlose ukumbeka abe yinkosi.
Wenza ukuhlakanipha, amadodana akhe wawehlukanisa, ahlala emazweni wonke akwaJuda nakwaBhenjamini, nasemizini yonke ebiyelweyo; wawanika ukudla okuningi, wawatholela nabafazi abaningi.
Kwathi lapho umbuso kaRehobhowamu ususimeme waqina impela, wawushiya umthetho kaSimakade, no-Israyeli wonke wenza njengaye.
Kuthe ngonyaka wesihlanu wokubusa kwenkosi uRehobhowamu, kwakhuphukela eJerusalema uShishaki, inkosi yaseGibhithe, ngokuba babephambukile kuSimakade.
UShishaki wayenezinqola eziyi-1 200, abamahhashi abayizi-60 000, nokhumbintethe lwabantu abaphuma naye eGibhithe: amaLubhi, amaSuki, namaKhushe.
Wayidla imizi yakwaJuda ebiyelweyo, waze wafika naseJerusalema.

UShemaya umphrofethi wafika kuRehobhowamu nakubaholi bonke bakwaJuda abebuthene eJerusalema, ngenxa kaShishaki, wathi kubo: “Usho kanje uSimakade uthi: ‘Nina ningifulathele Mina, ngakho-ke nami nginilahlele esandleni sikaShishaki.’ ”
Base bezithoba abaholi bakwa-Israyeli nenkosi, bathi: “USimakade ulungile.”

Ngesikhathi uSimakade ebona ukuthi bayazithoba, wathumela izwi kuShemaya, wathi: “Bazithobile; angiyukubabhubhisa, kodwa ngizokubakhulula emveni kwesikhashana, nentukuthelo yami ayiyukwehlela iJerusalema ngesandla sikaShishaki.
Nokho bazokuba yizinceku zakhe ukuze bazi umsebenzi wami nomsebenzi wemibuso yezizwe.”
UShishaki, inkosi yaseGibhite, wakhuphukela eJerusalema, wathatha ingcebo yendlu kaSimakade nengcebo yasesigodlweni senkosi. Wathatha konke, wathatha nezihlangu zegolide ezazenziwe nguSolomoni.
Inkosi uRehobhowamu yenza izihlangu zethusi esikhundleni sazo, yazinikela ezandleni zezinduna zabalindi abaqapha umnyango wesigodlo senkosi.
Kwakuthi njalo lapho inkosi ingena endlini kaSimakade abalindi bayikhaphe beziphethe, bese kuthi kamuva bazibuyisele endlini yabalindi.
Ngenkathi uRehobhowamu ezithoba, intukuthelo kaSimakade yasuka kuye, ayibange isambhubhisa nya; kwakusekhona okuhle kwaJuda.

Inkosi uRehobhowamu yaziqinisa eJerusalema. Yaqala ukubusa ineminyaka engama-41; yabusa iminyaka eli-17 eJerusalema, umuzi uSimakade ayewukhethe phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe zakwa-Israyeli ukuba abeke kuwo igama lakhe. Igama likanina kwakunguNahama, umAmonikazi.
Wenza okubi, akaze ayibhekisa inhliziyo yakhe ekufuneni uSimakade.

Izindaba zikaRehobhowamu, ezakuqala nezokugcina, azilotshiwe yini ezindabeni zikaShemaya umphrofethi, nezika-Ido umboni, ngokwezizukulwane, nezimpi zikaRehobhowamu noJerobhowamu zonke izinsuku zabo na?
URehobhowamu walaliswa kokhokho bakhe, wembelwa emzini kaDavide. U-Abhiya, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.
Kwathi ngonyaka we-18 wokubusa kukaJerobhowamu, u-Abhiya waba yinkosi kwaJuda.
Wabusa eJerusalema iminyaka emithathu. Igama likanina kwakunguMikhaya, indodakazi ka-Uriyeli waseGibheya. Kwakukhona ukulwa phakathi kuka-Abhiya noJerobhowamu.
U-Abhiya waphuma ukuyokulwa enempi yamaqhawe anamandla empini, amadoda akhethiweyo ayizi-400 000. UJerobhowamu yena wehla ukuyokulwa naye, enamadoda akhethiweyo ayizi-800 000, angamaqhawe anamandla.
U-Abhiya wema entabeni iZemarayimi ekwelezintaba kwa-Efrayimi, wathi: “Ake ungilalele Jerobhowamu no-Israyeli wonkana.
Anazi yini ukuthi uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli wanika uDavide namadodana akhe umbuso kwa-Israyeli, kuze kube phakade, ngesivumelwano sikaSawoti na?
Kepha kwasuka uJerobhowamu, indodana kaNebhathi, inceku kaSolomoni, indodana kaDavide, wavukela inkosi yakhe, wayihlubuka.
Kwabuthana kuye wonke amayiyane, nabantu abakhohlakele baba namandla kunoRehobhowamu, indodana kaSolomoni. URehobhowamu wayesemusha, engakaqini ukhakhayi, akakwazanga ukumelana nabo.

“Manje nicabanga ukuthi nizokwazi ukumelana nobukhosi bukaSimakade obusesandleni samadodana kaDavide, wena nalesi sixuku esikhulu kangaka, futhi kunamathole egolide enenzelwa wona nguJerobhowamu ukuba abe ngonkulunkulu benu.

Anixoshanga yini abaphristi bakaSimakade, amadodana ka-Aroni nabaLevi, nazimisela abaphristi njengabantu bezizwe na? Noma ngubani ofika efuna ukwehlukaniselwa leyo nkonzo, ephethe iduna nezinqama eziyisikhombisa, uba ngumphristi walokho okungesibo onkulunkulu.
“Kepha thina, uSimakade unguNkulunkulu wethu, asimfulathelanga, sinabaphristi abamkhonzayo uSimakade emisebenzini yabo, abozalo luka-Aroni nolukaLevi.

Njalo ekuseni nakusihlwa bashisela uSimakade iminikelo yokushiswa nempepho enephunga elimnandi, bahlela isinkwa sokubukwa etafuleni elihlanzekileyo, bokhele uthi lwezibani lwegolide nezibani zalo njalo kusihlwa, ngokuba thina sisawugcina umyalo kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu, kodwa nina nimshiyile.

Bhekani, uNkulunkulu unathi, uyasihola, nabaphristi bakhe baphethe amacilongo empi ukuze bahlabe umkhosi ngenxa yenu. Bantu bakwa-Israyeli, ningalwi noSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho benu, ngokuba aniyukuphumelela.”
UJerobhowamu wayebalalele unyendle wabazungeza, ukuze aqhamuke ngemuva nangaphambili kukaJuda.
Lapho abakwaJuda bebheka emuva; bheka, kwakukhona amabutho phambi kwabo nasemuva kwabo. Bakhala kuSimakade, abaphristi bashaya amacilongo.
Abantu bakwaJuda base benza isaho, bekhuza iziqubulo zempi, kwathi lapho abakwaJuda bekhamuluka, uNkulunkulu washaya uJerobhowamu no-Israyeli wonke phambi kuka-Abhiya noJuda.
Abakwa-Israyeli babaleka phambi kwabaJuda; uNkulunkulu wabanikela esandleni sabo.
U-Abhiya namabutho akhe bababhubhisa, bebulala abakhulu nabancane kwa-Israyeli. Kwafa amabutho akhethiweyo ayizi-500 000.
Abakwa-Israyeli bathotshiswa ngaleso sikhathi, kodwa abakwaJuda banqoba, ngokuba babencike kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho babo.
U-Abhiya wamhubha uJerobhowamu, wadla imizi elandelayo: iBhethele nemizana yalo, iJeshana nemizana yalo, ne-Efroni nemizana yalo.
UJerobhowamu akaphindanga waba namandla emihleni ka-Abhiya. USimakade wamshaya wafa.
U-Abhiya waziqinisa waba namandla, wathatha abafazi abali-14, wazala amadodana angama-22 namadodakazi ali-16.
Ezinye izindaba zika-Abhiya, izindlela zakhe, namazwi akhe, kulotshiwe esichasiselweni somphrofethi u-Ido.
U-Abhiya wayeselaliswa kokhokho bakhe, bammbela emzini kaDavide. U-Asa, indodana yakhe waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe. Emihleni yakhe izwe laba nokuthula iminyaka elishumi.
U-Asa wenza okuhle nokulungileyo phambi kukaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakhe.
Wasusa ama-althare abezizwe ezindaweni eziphakemeyo, wabhidliza izinsika, wagawula nezingongolo zo-Ashera,
watshela uJuda ukuba afune uSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho babo, agcine umthetho nemiyalo.
Wasusa kuyo yonke imizi yakwaJuda izindawo eziphakemeyo, nama-althare empepho; umbuso wazola phambi kwakhe.
Wakha imizi ebiyelweyo kwaJuda, izwe laba nokuthula; kwakungekho ukulwa kuleyo minyaka ngokuba uSimakade wayemnike ukuthula.

Wathi kubaJuda: “Masakhe le mizi, siyibiyele ngogange, kube nemibhoshongo, izivalo nemigoqo. Izwe kusengelethu, ngokuba simfunile uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu; simfunile, Yena wasiphumuza nxazonke.” Base beyakha-ke baphumelela.

U-Asa wayenamabutho ayizi-300 000, aphatha izihlangu nemikhonto, ayevela kwaJuda, nalawo ayevela kwaBhenjamini eyizi-280 000, ayephatha amahawu, nansala ngeminsalo. Wonke lawo mabutho ayengamaqhawe anamandla.
UZera, umKhushe, waphuma namabutho ayizi-100 000 nezinqola eziyizi-3 000 ukuba azolwa naye, wafika eMaresha.
U-Asa waphuma ukuba abhekane naye, wawahlela amabutho akhe esigodini eZefatha, ngaseMaresha.

U-Asa wakhala kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakhe, wathi: “Simakade, akekho ngaphandle kwakho ongasiza nongenamandla phakathi kwabaningi. Sisize, Simakade Nkulunkulu wethu, ngokuba sethembele kuwe, siphumile egameni lakho ukuzobhekana nalolu quqaba. Simakade, Wena unguNkulunkulu wethu, mawungahlulwa muntu.”
USimakade wawashaya amaKhushe phambi kuka-Asa noJuda; amaKhushe abaleka.

U-Asa nabantu ababenaye, bawaxosha amaKhushe aze afika eGerari, afa wonke amabutho, akwaze kwasala namunye ophilayo, ngokuba abhujiswa phambi kukaSimakade nempi yakhe. Babuyela emuva nempango eningi kakhulu.
Bayibhubhisa yonke imizi ezungeze iGerari, ngokuba behlelwa wuvalo olwaluvela kuSimakade. AbakwaJuda baphanga yonke imizi ngokuba kwakunempango eningi kuyo.
Bacekela phansi amathende emfuyo, bathatha izimvu eziningi namakameli, babuyela eJerusalema.
UMoya kaNkulunkulu wehlela ku-Azariya, indodana ka-Odedi;
u-Azariya waphuma waya ku-Asa, wathi kuye: “Ngilaleleni, wena Asa noJuda wonke, noBhenjamini; uSimakade unani, uma ninaye, uma nimfuna niyakumfumana, kodwa uma nimshiya, naye uyakunishiya.
Kwase kuyisikhathi eside u-Israyeli engenaye uNkulunkulu weqiniso, kungekho namphristi ofundisayo, kungekho namthetho.
Kepha lapho ehluphekile wayephendukela kuSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, amfune, amfumane.
Ngalezo zikhathi kwakungekho ukuthula nokuphepha kophumayo noma kongenayo, ngokuba kwakukuningi okuphazamisa izakhamuzi zezwe.
Isizwe sasicoboshiswa ngesinye isizwe, nomuzi ngomunye umuzi, ngokuba uNkulunkulu wabahlupha ngezinhlupho eziningi.
Kepha nina yibani namandla, zingadangali izandla zenu, ngokuba umsebenzi wenu uyakuba nomvuzo.”

Kwathi ukuba u-Asa awezwe lawo mazwi nesiphrofetho sika-Odedi umphrofethi, waqina idolo, wazisusa izinengiso ezweni lonke kwaJuda nakwaBhenjamini, nasemizini yonke ayeyidle kwelezintaba kwa-Efrayimi, wavusa i-althare likaSimakade elaliphambi kompheme kaSimakade.

Waqoqa wonke uJuda noBhenjamini, nababegogobele nabo bevela kwa-Efrayimi, kwaManase, kwaSimeyoni, ngokuba uquqaba oluningi lwaluhlubukele kuye, luvela kwa-Israyeli, ngesikhathi selubona ukuthi uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakhe unaye.
Kwathi ngenyanga yesithathu, ngonyaka we-15 wokubusa kuka-Asa, babuthana eJerusalema.
Ngalolo lusuku bahlabela uSimakade okunye kwempango ababeyidlile; izinkabi ezingama-700 nezimvu eziyizi-7 000.
Benza isivumelwano sokumfuna uSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho babo ngayo yonke inhliziyo yabo, nangawo wonke umphefumulo wabo.
Bavumelana nangokuthi bonke abangayukumfuna uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli bayobulawa; noma ngabe bancane noma badala, owesilisa noma owesifazane.
Bafunga phambi kukaSimakade ngezwi elikhulu, bakhamuluka ngamacilongo nangemitshingo.
Wonke uJuda wathokoza ngesifungo ababesenzile, ngokuba babefungile ngenhliziyo yabo yonke, bamfuna ngentando yabo yonke, bamfumana. USimakade wabanika ukuthula nxazonke.
U-Asa wamsusa unina uMahakha ukuba abe yindlovukazi, ngokuba wayenzele u-Ashera isithombe esinengekayo. U-Asa wasigenca leso sithombe, wasiqotha sacoliseka, wasishisa ngasemfudlaneni iKidroni.
Kepha izindawo eziphakemeyo akazisusanga kwa-Israyeli, nakuba inhliziyo ka-Asa yayiphelele zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwakhe.
Wabuyisa endlini kaNkulunkulu izinto ezingcwele zikayise nezinto zakhe ezingcwele; isiliva, igolide, nezitsha.
Akuzange kube khona impi, kwaze kwaba ngunyaka wama-35 wokubusa kuka-Asa.
Kwathi ngonyaka wama-36 wokubusa kuka-Asa, uBhahasha, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, wakhuphuka wayohlasela uJuda. Wakha iRama ukuze angavumeli muntu ukuba aphume noma angene ku-Asa, inkosi yakwaJuda.
U-Asa wakhipha isiliva negolide engcebeni yendlu kaSimakade neyasesigodlweni senkosi, wakuthumela kuBheni Hadadi, inkosi yase-Aramu owayehlala eDamaseku, wathi:

“Makube khona isivumelwano phakathi kwami nawe, njengoba sasikhona naphakathi kukababa noyihlo, phela sengithumele isiliva negolide; hamba wephule isivumelwano sakho noBhahasha, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, ukuze asuke kimi.”
UBheni Hadadi wayilalela inkosi u-Asa, wathumela abakhuzi bempi yakhe, bahlasela imizi yakwa-Israyeli. Banqoba i-Ijoni, iDani, i-Abhela Mayimi, nayo yonke imizi yakwaNafethali, eyayiyizinqolobane.
Kwathi ukuba uBhahasha akuzwe lokho, wayeka ukwakha iRama, wawumisa umsebenzi wakhe.
Kepha u-Asa, inkosi, noJuda wonke, bahamba bathatha amatshe eRama nemithi uBhahasha ayakhe ngakho. Wakha ngakho iGebha neMizpha.

Ngaleso sikhathi kwafika uHanani, umboni ku-Asa, inkosi yakwaJuda, wathi kuye: “Ngenxa yokuba manje uthembele enkosini yase-Aramu, awuthembelanga kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, ngakho-ke impi yenkosi yase-Aramu iphunyukile esandleni sakho.
AmaKhushe namaLubi ayengesiyo yini impi enkulu, enezinqola nabamahhashi abaningi kakhulu na? Kepha ngenxa yokuba wawuthembele kuSimakade, Yena wayinikela esandleni sakho.
Amehlo kaSimakade abona emhlabeni wonke ukuqinisa labo abanhliziyo yabo iphelele kuye. Wenze ubuwula kule nto, ngokuba kusukela manje sekuzohlala kunokulwa.”
U-Asa wamthukuthelela umboni, wayesemfaka ejele, ngokuba wathukuthela ngenxa yale nto umboni ayemtshele yona. U-Asa wabacindezela abanye abantu ngaleso sikhathi.
Bheka, izindaba zika-Asa, ezakuqala nezakamuva, zilotshiwe encwadini yamakhosi akwaJuda nakwa-Israyeli.
Kwathi ngonyaka wama-39 wokubusa kwakhe u-Asa, wahlaselwa yisifo ezinyaweni zakhe; isifo esasimphethe sasinzima kakhulu, kodwa akamfunanga uSimakade ngenxa yaso; waya ezinyangeni.
U-Asa walaliswa kokhokho bakhe, wayekhothame ngonyaka wama-41 wokubusa kwakhe.

Bamngcwaba ethuneni lakhe ayeziqophele lona emzini kaDavide. Bambeka endaweni yokulala egcwele iphunga elimnandi namakha anhlobonhlobo ayexutshwe alungiswa ngokwenza komthaki. Bashisa impepho eningi kakhulu.
UJehoshafathi, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe, waziqinisa ukuba alwe no-Israyeli.
Wakanisa impi kuyo yonke imizi yakwaJuda ebiyelweyo, wabeka amabutho kwaJuda nasemizini yakwa-Efrayimi eyayinqotshwe nguyise u-Asa.
USimakade wayenaye uJehoshafathi, ngokuba wahamba ngezindlela zakuqala zikakhokho wakhe uDavide, akazange afune oBhali,
kepha wamfuna uNkulunkulu kayise, wahamba emthethweni wakhe, akaze alingisa okwenziwa ngu-Israyeli.
Ngakho-ke uSimakade wawusimamisa umbuso esandleni sakhe, wonke uJuda wathela intela kuJehoshafathi; waba nodumo olukhulu nengcebo eningi.
Inhliziyo yakhe yashisekela izindlela zikaSimakade, wazisusa izindawo eziphakemeyo, no-Ashera kwaJuda.
Ngonyaka wesithathu wokubusa kwakhe, wathumela izikhulu zakhe uBheni Hayili, u-Obhadiya, uZakhariya, uNethaneli noMikhaya ukuba ziyofundisa emizini yakwaJuda,
zinabaLevi: uShemaya, uNethaniya, uZebadiya, u-Asaheli, uShemiramothi, uJehonathani, u-Adoniya, uThobiya noThobi Adoniya. Ababenalaba baLevi kwakungo-Elishama noJehoramu, abaphristi.
Bafundisa kwaJuda bephethe incwadi yomthetho kaSimakade, bajikeleza kuyo yonke imizi yakwaJuda, befundisa abantu.
Yonke imibuso yamazwe azungeze elakwaJuda jikelele yehlelwa yingebhe ngoSimakade, ayizange ilwe noJehoshafathi.
Abanye bamaFilisti baletha izipho kuJehoshafathi, nesiliva elaliyintela. Nabase-Arabhiya baletha kuye imihlambi, izinqama eziyizi-7 700, nezimpongo eziyizi-7 700.
UJehoshafathi waya ngokuya edlondlobala; wakha izinqaba nemizi eyizinqolobane kwaJuda.
Wayenokuningi emizini yakwaJuda, amadoda empi, namaqhawe anamandla, eJerusalema.
Babemi kanje ngokwezindlu zoyise: kwaJuda, abakhuzi bempi bezinkulungwane: u-Adina umkhuzi wempi, enamaqhawe anamandla ayizi-300 000.
Emva kwakhe kunguJehohanani umkhuzi wempi, enezi-280 000.
Wayelandelwa ngu-Amasiya, indodana kaZikhiri, owazinikela ngenhliziyo epheleleyo kuSimakade, enamaqhawe anamandla ayizi-200 000.
KwaBhenjamini, kungu-Eliyada, iqhawe elinamandla, enabahlome ngeminsalo nangezihlangu abayizi-200 000.
Emva kwakhe kunguJehozabhadi, enamabutho ahlomele ukulwa ayizi-180 000.
Yilaba-ke ababekhonza inkosi, ngaphandle kwalabo inkosi eyayibabeke emizini ebiyelweyo eyayikulo lonke elakwaJuda.
UJehoshafathi wayenengcebo nodumo olukhulu, waba nobuhlobo no-Ahabi ngokuganiselana.
Ngasekugcineni kweminyaka ethile, wehlela eSamariya ku-Ahabi. U-Ahabi wamhlabisa, yena nabantu ababenaye, izimvu nezinkabi eziningi, wamncenga ukuba akhuphuke ahlasele iRamothi Gileyadi.
