Izisebenzi zasethempelini yilezi: abozalo lukaZiha, lukaHasufa, lukaThabhawothi,
lukaKerosi, lukaSiyaha, lukaPhadoni,
lukaLebhana, lukaHagabha, luka-Akubhi,
lukaHagabhi, lukaShamulayi, lukaHanani,
lukaGideli, lukaGahari, lukaRewaya,
lukaRezini, lukaNekhoda, lukaGazamu,
luka-Uza, lukaPhaseya, lukaBhesayi,
luka-Asina, lukaMehuni, lukaNefisimi,
lukaBhakhibhukhi, lukaHakhufa, lukaHarihuri,
lukaBhaziluthi, lukaMehida, lukaHarisha,
lukaBharikosi, lukaSisera, lukaThema,
lukaNeziya nozalo lukaHathifa.
Abozalo lwezinceku zikaSolomoni yilaba: ababozalo lukaSothayi, lukaHasoferethi, lukaPheruda,
lukaJahala, lukaDarikoni, lukaGideli,
lukaShefathiya, lukaHathili, lukaPhokherethi Hazebhayimi nabozalo luka-Ami.
Zonke izisebenzi zasethempelini nabozalo lwezinceku zikaSolomoni babengama-392.
Nampa ababuya bevela eTheli Mela, eTheli Harisha, eKherubhi, e-Adani, nase-Imeri, kepha abakwazanga ukusho ukuthi bangabaziphi izindlu zoyise uma babedabuka kwa-Israyeli:
abozalo lukaDelaya, lukaThobiya nolukaNekoda, bebengama-652.
Abozalo lwabaphristi: kwakungabozalo lukaHabhaya, lukaHakozi nolukaBharizilayi, owathatha umfazi emadodakazini kaBharizilayi wakwaGileyadi, wabizwa ngegama lawo.
Laba bazifuna ohleni lwabaphristi olubhaliwe, kepha abafunyanwanga; ngalokho bakhishwa ebuphristini, kwathiwa bangcolile.
Umbusi wabatshela ukuthi bangakudli okungcwelengcwele, kuze kuvele umphristi one-Urimi neThumimi.
Lonke ibandla selihlangene laliyizi-42 360,
ngaphandle kwezinceku zabo nezincekukazi zabo ezaziyi-7 337; babenabahlabeleli besilisa nabesifazane abangama-200.
Amahhashi abo ayengama-736; iminyuzi yabo yayingama-245;
amakameli abo ayengama-435; izimbongolo zazingama-672.
Kuthe ukuba bafike endlini kaSimakade eJerusalema, abanye bezinhloko zoyise banikela ngeminikelo yesihle ukuze kwakhiwe indlu kaSimakade esizeni sayo.
Banikela ebhokisini lomnikelo ngokwamandla abo: sekukonke okwaqoqwa lapho kwaba ngamadalike egolide angama-61 000, namamane esiliva ayizi-5 000 nezingubo zabaphristi eziyikhulu.
Abaphristi, abaLevi, abanye abantu, abahlabeleli, abalindisango nabantu ababesebenza ethempelini bahlala emizini yakubo. Wonke u-Israyeli wahlala emizini yakubo.
Ekuqaleni kwenyanga yesikhombisa, abantu bakwa-Israyeli sebesemizini, bahlangana bonke ngothi lwabo eJerusalema.

UJeshuwa, indodana kaJozadaki, nabanye abaphristi noZerubhabhele, indodana kaSheyalitiyeli, nabafowabo, balakha kabusha i-althare likaNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli ukuze kunikelwe phezu kwalo iminikelo yokushiswa, njengoba kulotshiwe emthethweni kaMose, umuntu kaNkulunkulu.
Noma izizwe ezazibazungezile zazibesabisa, balakha kabusha i-althare phezu kwezisekelo zalo, base benikela phezu kwalo kuSimakade iminikelo yokushiswa, iminikelo yokushiswa yasekuseni neyakusihlwa.
Bagubha umkhosi wamadokodo, njengokomthetho, banikela ngeminikelo yokushiswa usuku nosuku, ngokwenani elinqunyelwe usuku nosuku, njengoba kulotshiwe.
Emveni kwalokho baletha iminikelo yokushiswa ejwayelekile, eyokwethwasa kwenyanga, eyayo yonke imikhosi emisiweyo kaSimakade neminikelo yesihle eyayinikelwa ngabantu kuSimakade.
Ngosuku lokuqala, ngenyanga yesikhombisa, baqala ukunikela iminikelo yokushiswa kuSimakade, nanxa isisekelo sethempeli lakhe sasingakabekwa.

Abantu bakhokhela ababazi bamatshe, nababazi bokhuni, nabakhi imali; banika amaSidoni nabaseThire ukudla, okuphuzwayo namafutha ukuze balande imisedari eLebhanoni, bayilethe olwandle eJopha, ngokwemvume kaKhoresi, inkosi yasePheresiya.

Ngenyanga yesibili, ngonyaka wesibili bebuyele endlini kaNkulunkulu eJerusalema, uZerubhabhele, indodana kaSheyalitiyeli noJeshuwa, indodana kaJozadakhi, nabo bonke abafowabo nabaphristi nabaLevi nabo bonke ababeseJerusalema bebuya ekuthunjweni, bawuqala umsebenzi. Baqoka abaLevi, ababeneminyaka engaphezu kwama-25 ukuba bengamele izisebenzi ezazisebenza endlini kaSimakade.
UJeshuwa namadodana akhe, nabafowabo, noKhadimiyeli namadodana akhe, uBhinuyi noHodaviya namadodana kaHenadadi, umLevi, amadodana abo nabafowabo bonke bengamela izisebenzi zasendlini kaNkulunkulu.

Lapho abakhi bebeka isisekelo sethempeli likaSimakade, abaphristi bagqoka izingubo zabo zobuphristi, baphatha amacilongo. AbaLevi ababengamadodana ka-Asafa bathatha amasimbali, bahlabelela bedumisa uSimakade njengesimiso sikaDavide, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli.

Babemdumisa uSimakade, bembonga ngamaculo, becula bethi: “Ngokuba uSimakade muhle, umusa wakhe umi phakade ku-Israyeli.” Bonke abantu bakhamuluka, bamemeza kakhulu ngentokozo, bedumisa uSimakade lapho bebona kubekwa isisekelo sendlu yakhe.

Abaningi babaphristi, abaLevi, izinhloko zemindeni nabantu abadala ababeyibonile indlu yokuqala, bakhala ngezwi elikhulu lapho bezibonela ngawabo kubekwa isisekelo saleyo ndlu; abaningi babememeza ngentokozo.
Umsindo wawumkhulu kangangokuthi wawuzwakala ukude, kodwa umuntu wayengekwazi ukwehlukanisa noma ungowokujabula noma ungowokukhala.
Kwathi ukuba izitha zamadoda akwaJuda nawakwaBhenjamini zizwe ukuthi labo ababebuye ekuthunjweni sebelakha kabusha ithempeli likaSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli,

zaya kuZerubhabhele nasezinhlokweni zemindeni, zathi kubo: “Masinisize nathi ekwakheni, ngokuba sikhonza uNkulunkulu njengani; besilokhu sethula imihlatshelo kuye kusukela ngezinsuku zika-Esari Hadoni, inkosi yase-Asiriya, okunguyena owasiletha lapha.”

Kepha uZerubhabhele noJeshuwa nabanye ababeyizinhloko zemindeni yakwa-Israyeli babaphendula bathi: “Aninalo ilungelo lokusisiza ekwakheni indlu kaNkulunkulu wethu; yithina ngokwethu esizomakhela uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli; nguKhoresi, inkosi yasePheresiya, osiyale ukuba senze kanjalo.”
Abantu bendawo bazama ukubadikibalisa abantu bakwaJuda ababebuye ekuthunjweni, ukuze bayeke ukwakha indu.
Zafumbathisa izikhulu ukuba zimelane nesu labo ngesikhathi sokubusa kukaKhoresi, inkosi yasePheresiya, kwaze kwaba ngesokubusa kukaDariyu, inkosi yasePheresiya.
Ngesikhathi sokubusa kuka-Ahasheveroshi, esaqala nje ukubusa, izitha zabhala incwadi zimangalela izakhamuzi zakwaJuda naseJerusalema.

Sekubusa u-Arithahishashitha, inkosi yasePheresiya, uBhishilamu, uMithiredathi, uThabeheli nabo bonke ababebambisene nabo babhalela u-Arithahishashitha, inkosi yasePheresiya, incwadi ngesi-Aramayikhi, bayihumusha.
URehumi, umbusi noShimishayi, unobhala, babhala incwadi emelana neJerusalema, bayiqondisa enkosini u-Arithahishashitha, ithi:
URehumi umbusi, umShimshayi unobhala, nabanye, nabo bonke abangani babo, abehluleli nazo zonke izikhulu ezidabuka e-Erekhi, eBhabhele naseShushani ezweni lama-Elamu,
nazo zonke izizwe ezathunjwa ngu-Osinaphari omkhulu nonamandla wazihlalisa emzini eSamariya nakwezinye izindawo, esifundazweni entshonalanga yeYufrathe.
Leli yifuzela lencwadi abayithumela ku-Arithahishashitha, inkosi: “Le ncwadi ivela ezincekwini zakho, amadoda asentshonalanga yeYufrathe.
“Sifuna ukuyazisa inkosi ukuthi abaJuda abavela ezindaweni zakho sebefike eJerusalema bawakha kabusha umuzi ohlubukayo nomubi. Sebeqedile ukwakha kabusha izingange, nokuvuselela izisekelo.
“Manje makwazeke enkosini ukuthi uma lo muzi nezingange zawo kwakhiwa kabusha kuphele, abantu bazoyeka ukukhokha intela, imali yendlela, nentela yasebukhosini izokwehla.
Manje, ngoba thina sikukhonze ngempela nkosi, asifuni le nto yenzeke, asifuni ukubona inkosi idelelwa; ngakho-ke sithumele ukuzokwazisa inkosi ngalokhu,

ukuze kuphenywe emiqulwini yemilando yokhokho bakho. Uyokuthola kuyo ukuthi lo muzi bewuhlale uwuhlupho, uvukela umbuso, nokuthi kusukela emandulo amakhosi nababusi bezifunda bewubahlalisa lubhojozi. Abantu bakhona bavele bangamambuka, yingakho nje umuzi wabhujiswa.
Makwazeke enkosini ukuthi uma lo muzi nezingange zawo kwakhiwa kabusha kuphele, ngeke usathola sabelo esifundeni esingaphesheya komfula.”
Inkosi yathumela le mpendulo: “KuRehumi, umbusi waseShimishayi, nonobhala nabangani babo abahlala eSamariya, nabo bonke abasentshonalanga yeYufrathe, ngiyanibingelela.
“Incwadi enisithumelele yona ihunyushiwe ngafundelwa yona.
Ngiyale ukuba lolu daba lusukunyelwe phezulu, nempela kwatholakala ukuthi kusukela emandulo lo muzi ubuvukela amakhosi, futhi ugcwele abahlubuki nabaphehli bodweshu.
Kakade kwakubusa amakhosi anamandla eJerusalema, ebusa sonke isifundazwe sasentshonalanga yeYufrathe, eqoqa intela nemali yendlela.
Ngakho-ke khipha umyalo wokuba labo bantu bayeke ukwakha kabusha umuzi, ngize ngishaye umthetho.
Qaphelani, ningasichithi isikhathi, funa balimaze umbuso wami! Kungani kuzoyekelelwa umonakalo ukhule, ulimaze amakhosi na?”

Kwathi ukuba ifuzela lencwadi yenkosi u-Arithahishashitha lifundwe lonke phambi kukaRehumi, noShimishayi umbhali, nabangani babo, baphuthuma baya eJerusalema bayophoqa abaJuda ukuba bayeke ukwakha kabusha umuzi.
Umsebenzi endlini kaNkulunkulu eJerusalema wawusumile; kwakungasenziwa lutho, kwaze kwaba ngunyaka wesibili wokubusa kukaDariyu, inkosi yasePheresiya.
Abaphrofethi, uHagayi noZakhariya, indodana ka-Ido, baphrofetha kubaJuda ababehlala kwaJuda naseJerusalema egameni likaNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli owayebabusa.
Emveni kwalokho uZerubhabhele, indodana kaSheyalitiyeli noJeshuwa, indodana kaJozadakhi, baqala ukwakha kabusha indlu kaNkulunkulu eJerusalema, besizwa ngabaphrofethi.
Ngaso leso sikhathi uThathenayi, umbusi wasentshonalanga yeYufrathe noShethari Bhozenayi, nabangani babo bakhuluma nabo, bathi: “Ngubani onigunyaze ukwakha le ndlu, nokuqeda lesi sakhiwo na?”
Babuza bathi: “Ngobani amagama amadoda akhe lesi sakhiwo na?”
Kepha uNkulunkulu wabo wayenabo, ngakho-ke izikhulu zakwaJuda zanquma ukungawumisi umsebenzi zize zibhalele uDariyu, zithole kuye impendulo.
Nanti ifuzela lencwadi uThathenayi, umbusi wasentshonalanga yeYufrathe, noShethari Bhozenayi, nabangani babo ababesesifundazweni esasisentshonalanga yeYufrathe, abayithumela kuDariyu, inkosi.
Bayithumelela umbiko owawubhalwe kanje: “KuDariyu, inkosi, makube ngukuthula konke!

“Makwazeke enkosini ukuthi siyile esifundazweni kwaJuda, endlini kaNkulunkulu omkhulu eyakhiwe ngamatshe amakhulu, kwafakwa namapulangwe ezindongeni. Lowo msebenzi uqhubeka ngesineke, bayaphumelela ukuwenza.
“Sase sikhuluma nalezo zikhulu, sababuza sathi: ‘Ngubani onigunyaze ukwakha le ndlu, nokuqeda lesi sakhiwo na?’
Sibuye sazibuza namagama azo, sawabhala, ukuze sikwazise ukuthi bangobani abaholi balo msebenzi.

“Nansi impendulo eziphendula ngayo: ‘Siyizikhonzi zikaNkulunkulu wasezulwini nasemhlabeni, sakha kabusha indlu eyayakhiwe eminyakeni eminingi eyedlule, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli enamandla eyayiyakhe yayiqeda.

Kepha okhokho bethu bamthukuthelisa uNkulunkulu wasezulwini, wayesevumela inkosi yaseBhabhele, uNebukhadinezari, inkosi yombuso wamaKhaledi, ukuba ibanqobe. Yabhubhisa le ndlu, abantu yabathumba yabasa eBhabhele.
“ ‘Kepha ngonyaka wokuqala wokubusa kwenkosi uKhoresi eBhabhele, yakhipha isimemezelo sokuthi le ndlu kaNkulunkulu kumele yakhiwe kabusha.

Yazibuyisela eJerusalema zonke izitsha zegolide nesiliva zasendlini kaNkulunkulu ezazithathwe nguNebukhadinezari ethempelini eJerusalema, wayozibeka ethempelini eBhabhele. UKhoresi wazikhipha lezo zitsha wazinika indoda egama layo linguSheshibhazari, wayeseyibeka ukuba ngumbusi kwaJuda.
Yathi kuye: “Thatha lezi zitsha, uhambe nazo, uzibeke ethempelini eJerusalema, indlu kaNkulunkulu yakhiwe kabusha esizeni sayo.”
“ ‘Ngakho-ke uSheshibhazari wafike wabeka izisekelo zendlu kaNkulunkulu eJerusalema; kusukela ngaleso sikhathi kuze kube manje isakhiwa, ayikaqedwa.’

“Manje uma kukuhle enkosini, vuma ukuba kuphenywe endlini yemiqulu yemilando yasebukhosini baseBhabhele ukuze kubonakale ukuthi ngempela inkosi uKhoresi yayiwushayile yini umthetho wokuthi akwakhiwe kabusha indlu kaNkulunkulu eJerusalema. Inkosi mayisazise ukuthi ihlose ukuba kwenziweni ngalolu daba.”
Inkosi uDariyu yashaya umthetho wokuthi akuphenywe emiqulwini esendlini yemilando egcinwe eBhabhele.
Kwatholakala umqulu e-Ekhibhathana, inhlokomuzi yesifundazwe eMediya, okwakulotshwe kuwo: Isikhumbuzo.

“Ngonyaka wokuqala wokubusa kwenkosi uKhoresi, yashaya umthetho othi: maqondana nendlu kaNkulunkulu eseJerusalema mayakhiwe kabusha, indawo lapho imihlatshelo yayinikelelwa khona neminikelo yokushiswa eyayilethwa khona, ubude bayo kumele bube ngamakhubhithi angama-60, nobubanzi bayo bube ngamakhubhithi angama-60.
Izindonga zibe imigqa emithathu yamatshe, omunye phezu komunye, bese zilandelwa ngowodwa wezingodo ezintsha. Izindleko mazikhishwe esikhwameni sengcebo yendlu yenkosi.

Izitsha zegolide nezesiliva zasendlini kaNkulunkulu ezazithathwe nguNebukhadinezari ethempelini eJerusalema wazisa eBhabhele, nazo kumele zibuyiselwe eJerusalema, yileso naleso endaweni yaso endlini kaNkulunkulu.”
“Manje kuwe Thathenayi, mbusi wasentshonalanga yeYufrathe, nakuwe Shethari Bhozenayi, nabangani benu abasesifundazweni esisentshonalanga yeYufrathe, qhelani lapho;
hlukanani nomsebenzi wendlu kaNkulunkulu; yekelani umbusi wabaJuda nezikhulu bayakhe kabusha indlu kaNkulunkulu esizeni sayo.

“Ngishaya umthetho maqondana nalezo zikhulu zabaJuda ezizokwakha kabusha le ndlu kaNkulunkulu, ngithi: izindleko zokukhokhela laba bantu mazikhokhwe ngokuphelele nsuku zonke, ziphume emalini yasebukhosini, etholakala ngentela evela esifundazweni entshonalanga yeYufrathe, ukuze lowo msebenzi ungami.

Noma yini abayidingayo: amaduna, izinqama, amawundlu abazokwenza ngakho iminikelo yokushiswa kuNkulunkulu wasezulwini, nokolo, usawoti, iwayini, namafutha, njengokusho kwabaphristi abaseJerusalema, mabanikwe lokho nsuku zonke, kungaphuthi,
ukuze banikele iminikelo emthokozisayo uNkulunkulu wasezulwini, bakhulekele ukuphila kwenkosi namadodana ayo.
“Ngiyaniyala ngithi: uma kukhona oyoguqula lo mthetho engiwushayile, kuyokhishwa ibhanuko emshayweni wendlu yakhe, ajojwe ngalo, umuzi wakhe ube ngumquba.

UNkulunkulu owenza ukuba igama lakhe lihlale lapho, sengathi angasusa esikhundleni noma yiyiphi inkosi nesizwe okuzama ukuguqula lokhu, noma ukubhubhisa le ndlu kaNkulunkulu eseJerusalema. Mina Dariyu, ngishaye lo mthetho; mawuhlonishwe ngokucophelela.”
UThathenayi, umbusi wesifunda esingasentshonalanga yeYufrathe, noShethari Bhozenayi nabangani babo, bakwenza ngokucophelela lokho inkosi uDariyu eyayibalayeze khona.

Izikhulu zakwaJuda zaqhubeka ngempumelelo ukwakha indlu, zigqugquzelwa ngukuphrofetha kukaHagayi noZekhariya, indodana ka-Ido. Zaqeda njengalokho zaziyalwe nguNkulunkulu wakwa-Israyeli ngomthetho owashaywa nguKhoresi, uDariyu, nenkosi u-Arithahishashitha, basePheresiya.
Zaqeda ukukwakha indlu ngosuku lwesithathu lwenyanga u-Adari, ngonyaka wesithupha wokubusa kwenkosi uDariyu.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli, abaphristi, abaLevi nabo bonke abantu ababuye ekuthunjweni, bayehlukanisela uNkulunkulu indlu ngenkulu injabulo.

Lapho beyehlukanisa, benza umhlatshelo ngezinkunzi ezilikhulu, izimvu ezingama-200, namawundlu angama-400, nezimbuzi ezili-12 ezaba ngumnikelo wesono, ngayinye imele isizwana ngesizwana sakwa-Israyeli.
Babuye babeka abaphristi nabaLevi ngokwemikhakha yabo, ukuze baqhube inkonzo kaNkulunkulu eJerusalema, njengoba kulotshiwe encwadini kaMose.
Abantu ababebuya ekuthunjweni bagubha uMkhosi wePhasika ngosuku lwe-14, ngenyanga yokuqala,
ngokuba bonke abaphristi nabaLevi base bezihlambululile, bonke sebehlambulukile. Bahlabela iPhasika bonke ababebuya ekuthunjweni, nabaphristi, nabo luqobo.
Abantu bakwa-Israyeli ababebuye ekuthunjweni nabo bonke abase beyiyekile imikhuba yabezizwe bazinikela ekukhonzeni uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, badla iPhasika.

Babuye bawugubha ngentokozo umkhosi wesinkwa esingenamvubelo izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, ngokuba uSimakade wayebathokozisile, waguqula inhliziyo yenkosi yase-Asiriya, yabeseka ukwakha kabusha indlu kaNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.
Emveni kwalokho, ngesikhathi sokubusa kwenkosi u-Arithahishashitha ePheresiya, u-Ezra, indodana kaSeraya, ka-Azariya kaHilikiya,
kaShalumi, kaZadoki, ka-Ahithubi,
ka-Amariya, kaMerayothi,
kaZeraya, ka-Uzi, kaBhuki,
ka-Abhishuwa, kaFinehasi, ka-Eleyazari, ka-Aroni, umphristi omkhulu,

lowo Ezra wasuka eBhabhele waya eJerusalema. Wayengumbhali onekhono emthethweni kaMose ayewunikwe nguSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli; inkosi yamnika konke akucelayo, ngokuba isandla sikaSimakade uNkulunkulu wakhe sasinaye.
U-Ezra waphuma eBhabhele ngonyaka wesikhombisa wokubusa kuka-Arithahishashitha, waya eJerusalema nabanye bakwa-Israyeli, abaphristi, abaLevi, abaculi, abalindisango nezisebenzi zasethempelini.
Bafika eJerusalema ngenyanga yesihlanu, ngonyaka wesikhombisa wokubusa kwenkosi.
Baphuma eBhabhele ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga yokuqala, kwathi ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga yesihlanu, bafika eJerusalema, ngokuba isandla somusa sikaNkulunkulu wakhe sasinaye,
ngokuba inhliziyo ka-Ezra yayigxile ekufundeni umthetho kaSimakade, nokuwenza, nokufundisa izimiso nemithetho kwa-Israyeli.
Leli yifuzela lencwadi inkosi u-Arithahishasitha alinika u-Ezra, umphristi, umbhali, owayengumbhali wemithetho nezimiso zikaSimakade ku-Israyeli, ethi:
“U-Arithahishasitha, inkosi yamakhosi ku-Ezra, umphristi nombhali womthetho kaNkulunkulu wezulu: ukuthula.
“Ngishaya umthetho othi: noma yimuphi umuntu wakwa-Israyeli, noma abaphristi bakhona, noma abaLevi abasembusweni wami abathanda ukuya eJerusalema, bangahamba nawe.
Ngokuba uthunywa yinkosi nabeluleki bayo abayisikhombisa, ukuba niyobheka ukuthi kuhamba kanjani kwaJuda naseJerusalema ngokomthetho kaNkulunkulu wenu osesandleni sakho,
nokuhambisa isiliva negolide inkosi nabeluleki bayo abalinikele ngesihle kuNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, ondlu yakhe iseJerusalema;
nithathe nalo lonke isiliva negolide eniyokufumana esifundazweni sonke eBhabhele, neminikelo yesihle yabantu neyabaphristi, abayinikela ngesihle endlini kaNkulunkulu wabo eJerusalema.
Niyisebenzise ngokucophelela leyo mali, nithenge izinkunzi, izinqama, amawundlu, iminikelo yokusanhlamvu neminikelo yokuphuzwayo, nikunikele e-althare endlini kaNkulunkulu wenu eJerusalema.
“Wena nabafowenu, lokho enikubona kufanele ukuba nikwenze ngesiliva nangegolide elisalileyo, kwenzeni ngokwentando kaNkulunkulu wenu.
Izitsha ozinikiwe ukuba zisetshenziselwe inkonzo yendlu kaNkulunkulu wakho, uyakuzibuyisela kuNkulunkulu wakho eJerusalema.
Noma yini enye edingekayo endlini kaNkulunkulu wakho okufanele niyihlinzeke ngokwenu, ithatheni engcebeni yenkosi.

“Mina Arithashashitha, inkosi, ngiyala bonke abagcinimafa abasesifundanzweni entshonalanga yeYufrathe ukuba noma yini ayoyifuna kini u-Ezra, umphristi nombhali womthetho kaNkulunkulu wasezulwini, yenziwe ngokucophelela okukhulu,
kuze kufike ekhulwini lamathalenta esiliva, nekhulu lamakhora kakolo, amabhathi ayikhulu ewayini, amabhathi alikhulu amafutha, nosawoti ongenakubalwa.
Konke okuyalwe nguNkulunkulu wasezulwini makwenziwe ngesineke, kwenzelwa indlu kaNkulunkulu wasezulwini, funa intukuthelo kaNkulunkulu yehlele inkosi namadodana ayo.
Futhi siyanazisa ukuthi anivunyelwe ukukhokhisa intela abaphristi, abaLevi, abaculi, abalindisango, izisebenzi zasethempelini nezinye izisebenzi ezisebenza kule ndlu kaNkulunkulu.

“Wena-ke Ezra, makuthi ngokuhlakanipha uNkulunkulu akuphe khona, uqoke abehluleli nezimantshi abayokwehlulela bonke abantu bakini abasesifundazweni esisentshonalanga yeYufrathe; makube ngabantu abawaziyo umthetho kaNkulunkulu wenu, abangawaziyo kufanele bawufundiswe.
Bonke abangawulaleli umthetho kaNkulunkulu wakho nomthetho wenkosi, kumele bajeziswe ngokubafaneleyo, kungaba ngokufa noma ngokudingiswa, noma ngokudlelwa impahla noma ngokuboshwa.”
Makadunyiswe uSimakade, uNkulunkulu wokhokho bethu, obeke into enje enhliziyweni yenkosi, ukuba ihlobise indlu kaSimakade eJerusalema ngale ndlela,

ongenzele umusa phambi kwenkosi nabeluleki bayo, naphambi kwazo zonke izikhulu zenkosi ezingamaqhawe. Ngaba nesibindi ngoba isandla seNkosi uSimakade sasinami, ngaqoqa abaholi kwa-Israyeli ukuba benyuke nami.
Nantu uhla lwezinhloko zemindeni ezazisekuthunjweni eBhabhele, ezabuya no-Ezra eJerusalema ngesikhathi sokubusa kwenkosi u-Arithahishashitha:
Kwabozalo lukaFinehasi, nguGereshomu. Kwabozalo luka-Ithamari, nguDaniyeli. Kwabozalo lukaDavide, nguHathushi,
kaShekhaniya. Kwabozalo lukaPharoshi, nguZekhariya namadoda ayi-150 omndeni wakhe.
Kwabozalo lukaPhahathi Mowabi, ngu-Eliyehonayi kaZerahiya namadoda angama-200.
Kwabozalo lukaZathu, nguShekhaniya kaJahaziyeli namadoda angama-300.
Kwabozalo luka-Adini, ngu-Ebhedi kaJonathani namadoda angama-50.
Kwabozalo luka-Elamu, nguJeshaya ka-Athaliya namadoda angama-70.
Kwabozalo lukaShefathiya, nguZebadiya, indodana kaMikhayeli namadoda angama-80.
Kwabozalo lukaJowabe, ngu-Obhadiya, indodana kaJehiyeli namadoda angama-218.
Kwabozalo lukaShelomithi, indodana kaJosifiya namadoda ayi-160.
Kwabozalo lukaBhebayi, nguZekhariya, indodana kaBhebayi namadoda angama-28.
Kwabozalo luka-Azigadi, nguJohanani, indodana kaHakathani namadoda ayi-110.
Kwabozalo luka-Adonikamu, ngu-Elifelethi, uJehiyeli, noShemaya namadoda angama-60 afika kamuva.
Kwabozalo lukaBhigivayi, ngu-Uthayi, noZakhuri namadoda angama-70.
Ngabahlanganisa ndawonye ngasemfuleni oya e-Ahava, sagoba amadlangala lapho izinsuku ezintathu. Lapho ngibuzisisa abantu nabaphristi, ngafumana ukuthi babengekho abozalo lukaLevi.
Ngase ngithumela, ngabiza u-Eliyezeri, u-Ariyeli, uShemaya, u-Elinathani, uJaribi, u-Elinathani, uNathani, uZekhariya noMeshulamu ababengabaholi, uJohiyaribhi no-Elinathani ababengabafundisayo,

ngabathumela ku-Ido owayengumholi eKhasifiya, ngibatshela ukuthi bayothini ku-Ido nabangani bakhe, izisebenzi zasethempelini eKhasifiya, ukuba basithumelele abantu ababezosebenza endlini kaNkulunkulu.
Ngenxa yokuba isandla somusa sikaNkulunkulu wethu sasinathi, basithumelela uMahili, indoda enengqondo, wozalo lukaLevi ka-Israyeli noSherebhiya namadodana akhe nabafowabo abali-18;
noHashabhiya enoJeshaya, wozalo lukaMerari, nabafowabo namadodana abo angama-20;
ngaphezu kwama-220 ezisebenzi zasethempelini ezaziqokwe nguDavide nezikhulu zakhe ukuba belekelele abaLevi, ababizwe bonke ngamagama abo.
Ngase ngimemezela ukuzila ngasemfuleni i-Ahava nokuba sizithobe phambi kukaNkulunkulu wethu, sizicelele indlela enhle nephephile, thina nabantwana bethu, nayo yonke impahla yethu.

Nganginamahloni ukucela enkosini iviyo lamabutho, nagibele amahhashi, ukuze asivikele ezitheni endleleni, njengokuba sasiyitshelile inkosi ukuthi: “Isandla sikaNkulunkulu wethu siyabavikela abamfunayo, kodwa amandla akhe nentukuthelo yakhe kumelana nabo bonke abamhlubukayo.”
Ngakho-ke sazila, samnxusa uNkulunkulu wethu ngalokhu, wakuzwa ukunxusa kwethu.
Ngakho-ke ngaqoka abali-12 kubaholi babaphristi: uSherebhiya, uHashabhiya nabalishumi abayizihlobo zabo.
Ngabalinganisela isiliva, igolide, izitsha, neminikelo yendlu kaNkulunkulu wethu okwakunikelwe yinkosi, abeluleki bayo, izikhulu zayo, nakho konke okwakunikelwe ngabantu bakwa-Israyeli ababelapho;
nakhu engabanika khona: amathalenta esiliva angama-650, amathalenta ayizitsha zesiliva alikhulu, amathalenta egolide alikhulu,
izindebe zegolide ezingama-20 ezisisindo singamadarikhe ayinkulungwane, nezitsha ezimbili zethusi elicolisekileyo ezazizinhle njengegolide.
Ngathi kubo: “Ningcwele kuSimakade, nezitsha zingcwele, isiliva negolide liyiminikelo yesihle kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho benu.
Kuqapheleni, nikugcine nize nikulinganise phambi kwabaphristi abakhulu nabaLevi, nezinhloko zemindeni kwa-Israyeli eJerusalema, emakamelweni endlu kaSimakade.”
Abaphristi nabaLevi bathatha isiliva, igolide nezitsha, njengoba kwase kulinganisiwe, bakuyisa eJerusalema endlini kaNkulunkulu wethu.
Kwakulusuku lwe-12, ngenyanga yokuqala, ngesikhathi sisuka emfuleni i-Ahava silibhekise eJerusalema. UNkulunkulu wethu wayenathi, esivikela ezitheni ezazisihlasela nezazisilalela unyendle endleleni.
Sesifikile eJerusalema, sahlala izinsuku ezintathu.

Ngosuku lwesine sisendlini kaNkulunkulu wethu, kwakalwa isiliva, igolide nezitsha, kwase kwedluliselwa kumphristi uMeremothi, indodana ka-Uriya, owayeno-Eleyazare, indodana kaFinehasi nabaLevi, uJozabhadi kaJeshuwa noNowadiya kaBhinuyi.
Konke kwabalwa, kwakalwa, kwase kubhalwa phansi isisindo sakho.

Bonke labo ababuya ekuthunjweni banikela ngeminikelo yokushiswa kuNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli. Banikela ngezinkunzi ezili-12 ezazimele u-Israyeli wonkana, izinqama ezingama-96, namawundlu angama-77; banikela ngezimpongo ezili-12 zaba ngumnikelo wesono. Konke lokho kwaba ngumnikelo wokushiswa owanikelwa kuSimakade.
Bayethula kubabusi nezikhulu zesifundazwe esisentshonalanga yeYufrathe incwadi ababeyinikwe yinkosi, nabo beseka abantu nendlu kaNkulunkulu.

Sekwenziwe konke lokho, abaholi beza kimi, bathi: “Abantu bakwa-Israyeli, abaphristi, abaLevi abazehlukanisanga kubantu bezizwe nasemikhubeni yabo eyenyanyekayo, eyamaKhanani, amaHithi, amaPherizi, amaJebusi, ama-Amoni, abakwaMowabi, abaseGibhithe nama-Amori.

Ngokuba bazithathela amadodakazi azo aba ngabafazi babo, bathathela namadodana abo. Balungcolisile ulibo olungcwele ngokuzihlanganisa nabezizwe. Abaholi nezikhulu baba ngobhongoza ekwenzeni lokho kungethembeki.”
Ngikuzwa lokho, ngaklebhula ingubo yami nesembatho sami, ngazihluthula izinwele ekhanda nasesilevini, ngahlala phansi, ngimangele.
Kwase kubuthana bonke labo abathuthumela uma bezwa okwakushiwo nguNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, ngenxa yokungethembi kwababebuye ekuthunjweni, bahlala nami kwaze kwaba yisikhathi somnikelo wakusihlwa.
Ngesikhathi somnikelo wakusihlwa, ngasukuma ekuzileni, izingubo zami nesembatho sami kuklebhukile, ngaguqa ngaphakamisela izandla zami kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wami,
ngathi: “Nkulunkulu wami, nginamahloni, ngihlazeke kakhulu, ngesaba ngisho ukubheka kuwe, Nkulunkulu wami, ngokuba izono zethu sezedlula amakhanda ethu, necala lethu selifinyelela emazulwini.

Kusukela emihleni yokhokho bethu kuze kube namuhla, sithe shi ezonweni, ngenxa yezono zethu, namakhosi ethu, nabaphristi, sinikelwe emakhosini ezinye izizwe, enkembeni, ekuthunjweni, ekuphangweni nasehlazweni elikhulu, njengoba kunje manje.

“Kepha manje uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu usenzele umusa okwesikhashana, washiya insali, wasenza saba nesabelo endaweni yakhe engcwele ukuze akhanyise amehlo ethu, asinike ikhefu, asophule ebugqileni bethu.

Ngokuba siseyizigqila, uNkulunkulu wethu akasishiyanga ebugqileni bethu, kodwa usenzele ububele bakhe phambi kwamakhosi asePheresiya; asinika impilo entsha ukuze sakhe kabusha indlu kaNkulunkulu wethu, sakhe kabusha obekuyincithakalo, wasenzela ugange kwaJuda naseJerusalema.
“Kepha manje, Nkulunkulu wethu, sesizothini ngalokhu na? Phela siyilahlile imithetho yakho

owasiyala ngayo ngomlomo wezinceku zakho, abaphrofethi, uthi: ‘Izwe eningena kulo ukulidla lingcoliswe ngukungcola kwabantu bezizwe ngamanyala abo. Baligcwalise ngokungcola kusukela kulo mngcele kuya kuloya.

Ngakho-ke amadodakazi enu ningawaganiseli amadodana azo, namadodana enu ningawathatheli abafazi kumadodakazi azo, ningalokothi nifune ukuthula kwazo nempumelelo yazo, ukuze nibe namandla, futhi nidle okuhle kwezwe, nilishiyele abantwana benu libe yifa labo laphakade.’
“Emuva kokuba sezisehlele zonke lezo zinto ngenxa yezenzo zethu ezimbi, necala lethu elikhulu, kodwa Wena Nkulunkulu, awusijezisanga ngokufanele iziphambeko zethu, wabuye washiya insali efana nalena,
kambe singabuye siyephule yini imithetho yakho ngokuganana nabezizwe abenza amanyala anjengalawa na? Ubungayukusithukuthelela yini uze usibhubhise nya, kungasali nsali na?

Simakade Nkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, Wena ulungile, kodwa thina usiphunyukisile, sasala sayinsali njengoba kunje namuhla. Siphambi kwakho necala lethu, nakuba kungekho namunye ongama phambi kwakho ngenxa yalokho.”

Kwathi u-Ezra esakhuleka evuma izono, ekhala, ezilahle phansi phambi kwendlu kaNkulunkulu, isixuku esikhulu sabakwa-Israyeli sabuthana lapho, amadoda, abesifazane, nezingane, bonke babekhala kalusizi.
UShekhaniya, indodana kaJehiyeli, wozalo luka-Elamu, wathi ku-Ezra: “Asethembekanga kuNkulunkulu ngokuthi siganwe ngabesifazane bezizwe, kodwa noma kunjalo u-Israyeli usenalo ithemba.

Manje-ke masenze isivumelwano noNkulunkulu wethu sokubalahla bonke laba besifazane nezingane zabo, ngokwesiluleko senkosi yami nalabo abayesabayo imithetho kaNkulunkulu wethu; makwenziwe njengokumisiweyo emthethweni.
Vuka wenze okuthile, ngokuba lolu daba luqondene nawe; sinawe; qina, ukwenze lokhu.”
U-Ezra wasukuma, wafungisa abaholi babaphristi, abaLevi no-Israyeli wonkana ukuthi bayokwenza njengoba eshilo. Bafunga-ke.

U-Ezra wasuka phambi kwendlu kaNkulunkulu, waya endlini kaJehohanani, indodana ka-Eliyashibhi, wahlala lapho ubusuku bonke, engadli lutho, futhi engaphuzi lutho, ngokuba wayelila ngenxa yokungethembeki kwabantu ababebuye ekuthunjweni.
Bathumela isimemezelo kulo lonke elakwaJuda naseJerusalema, kubo bonke ababebuye ekuthunjweni, ukuba bahlangane eJerusalema,
nokuthi uma bengafinyelelanga emhlanganweni ngezinsuku ezintathu, bayokwephucwa yonke impahla yabo, badingiswe enhlanganweni yabathunjwa ngokwesinqumo sabaphethe nezikhulu.

Bonke abantu bakwaJuda nabakwaBhenjamini babuthana eJerusalema ezinsukwini ezintathu; kwakuyinyanga yesishiyagalolunye, ngolwama-20 lwenyanga. Bonke abantu bahlala phansi phambi kwendlu kaNkulunkulu, beqhaqhazela ngenxa yobucayi balolu daba, nangenxa yemvula enkulu.
U-Ezra, umphristi, wayesesukuma, wathi kubo: “Nonile, naganwa ngabesifazane bezizwe, ngaleyo ndlela nathasisela icala lika-Israyeli.
Ngakho-ke vumani izono zenu kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wokhokho benu, nenze intando yakhe; zehlukaniseni kubantu bezwe nakubafazi bezizwe.”
Inhlangano yonke yaphendula ngezwi elikhulu, yathi: “Siyavuma! Kufanele senze njengoba usho!
Kepha kunabantu abaningi lapha, futhi lina kakhulu, asikwazi ukuma phandle. Ngaphezu kwalokhu, lolu daba alusilo olosuku olulodwa noma ezimbili, ngokuba iningi lethu liyachaphazeleka kulolu daba.

Vumelani abaholi bethu kube yibona abazosimela kulolu daba, bamele inhlangano yonke. Makuthi bonke emizini yakithi abaganwe ngabesifazane bezizwe beze ngezikhathi ezimisiweyo, behambisana namalunga nabehluleli bemizi yonke, luze lusuke kithi ulaka lukaNkulunkulu maqondana nalolu daba.”
UJonathani, indodana ka-Asaheli noJahazeya, indodana kaThikhiva, bamelana nalesi sinqumo, besekwa ngoMeshulami noShabhethayi, abaLevi.

Ababuye ekuthunjweni benza kanjalo. U-Ezra umphristi waqoka amadoda, izinhloko zemindeni ngokwezindlu zokhokho bazo, yileyo naleyo ibizwe ngegama. Lawo madoda ahlangana ngosuku lokuqala, ngenyanga yeshumi, ukuze aphande kabanzi ngalolu daba.
Aluphothula lolo daba lwalawo madoda ayethathe abesifazane babezizwe, ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga yokuqala.
Abafunyaniswa phakathi kwabozalo lwabaphristi ukuthi baganwe ngabesifazane babezizwe yilaba: kwabozalo lukaJeshuwa: indodana kaJozadaki, nakubafowabo, nguMahaseya, u-Eliyezeri, uJaribi noGedaliya.
Bavuma ukuthi bazobalahla abafazi babo; lokhu benecala, banikela ngenqama, yaba wumhlatshelo wezono zabo.
Kwabozalo luka-Imeri: nguHanani noZebhadiya.
Kwabozalo lukaHarimi: nguMahaseya, u-Elija, uShemaya, uJehiyeli no-Uziya.
Kwabozalo lukaPhashuri: ngu-Eliyohenayi, uMahaseya, u-Ishmayeli, uNethaneli, uJozabhadi no-Eleyasa.
KubaLevi: nguJozabhadi, uShimeyi, uKhelaya onguKhelitha, uPhethahiya, uJuda no-Eliyezeri.
Kubahlabeleli: ngu-Eliyashibhi. Kubalindisango: nguShalumi, uTheleme no-Uri.
Kwabanye bakwa-Israyeli: kwabozalo lukaPharoshi: nguRamiya, u-Iziya, uMalikhiya, uMijamini, u-Eleyazare, uMalikhiya noBhenaya.
Kwabozalo luka-Elamu: nguMathaniya, uZakhariya, uJehiyeli, u-Abhidi, uJeremothi no-Eliya.
Kwabozalo lukaZathu: ngu-Eliyohenayi, u-Eliyashibhi, uMathaniya, uJeremothi, uZabhadi no-Aziza.
Kwabozalo lukaBhebayi: nguJehohanani, uHananiya, uZabhayi no-Athilayi.
Kwabozalo lukaBhani: nguMeshulamu, uMalukhi, u-Adaya, uJashubhi, uSheyali noJeremothi.
Kwabozalo lukaPhahathi Mowabi: ngu-Adina, uKhelali, uBhenaya, uMahaseya, uMathaniya, uBhezaleli, uBhinuwi noManase.
Kwabozalo lukaHarimi: ngu-Eliyezeri, uJishiya, uMalikhiya, uShemaya, uShimeyoni,
uBhenjamini, uMalukhi noShemariya.
Kwabozalo lukaHashumi: nguMathenayi, uMathatha, uZabhadi, u-Elifelethi, uJeremayi, uManase noShimeyi.
Kwabozalo lukaBhani: nguMahadayi, u-Amramu, u-Uweli,
uBhenaya, uBhedeya, uKheluhi,
uVaniya, uMeremothi, u-Eliyashibhi,
uMathaniya, uMathenayi noJahasu.
Kwabozalo lukaBhinuwi: nguShimeyi,
uShelemiya, uNathani, u-Adaya,
uMakhenadebhayi, uShashayi, uSharayi,
u-Azareli, uShelemiya, uShemariya,
uShalumi, u-Amariya noJosefa.
Kwabozalo lukaNebho: nguJehiyeli, uMathithiya, uZabhadi, uSebhina, u-Ido, uJoweli noBhenaya.
Bonke labo babeganwe ngabesifazane babezizwe, base bebalahla bonke abesifazane bezizwe ababebaganile nabantwana babo.
Nanka amazwi kaNehemiya, indodana kaHakaliya. Ngenyanga uKhisilevi, ngonyaka wama-20, ngiseShushani inhlokomuzi,
uHanani, omunye wabafowethu, wafika evela kwaJuda, ehamba nesigejane samadoda. Ngababuza ngabaJuda ababesinde ekuthunjweni basala kwaJuda, nangesimo seJerusalema.
Baphendula bathi: “Abasala esifundazweni sakwaJuda, abaze bathunjwa, basenkathazweni enkulu nasehlazweni; izingange zeJerusalema zidilizelwe phansi, namasango alo ashiswe ngomlilo.”
Ngathi ukuba ngizwe lezo zindaba, ngahlala phansi, ngakhala, ngazila izinsuku eziningi, ngizile ukudla ngikhuleka kuNkulunkulu wezulu.
Ngathi: “Ngiyakunxusa Simakade, Nkulunkulu wezulu, Wena omkhulu nowesabekayo, ogcina isivumelwano nothando olungenambandela kulabo abakuthandayo, begcina imithetho yakho.

Beka indlebe yakho, ubheke ngamehlo akho, uzwe umkhuleko wenceku yakho ewukhuleka kuwe namuhla, imini nobusuku, ikhulekela izinceku zakho, abantu bakwa-Israyeli, ivuma izono zabakwa-Israyeli, esone ngazo kuwe. Mina nomndeni wami sonile.
Senze ububi kuwe, asaze sayigcina imithetho, izimiso, nemiyalo owakunika uMose, inceku yakho.
Khumbula owakusho kuMose lapho uthi: ‘Uma ningihlubuka ngizonihlakazela phakathi kwezizwe,

kodwa uma nibuyela kimi, nibuye nigcine imithetho yami, nenze enganiyala ngakho, ngiyoniqoqa lapho nikhona, nginibuyisele endaweni engayiqokela ukuba iGama lami lihlale kuyo, ngisho noma ngabe nisemikhawulweni yomhlaba.’
“Bayizinceku zakho nabantu bakho owabophula ngamandla akho amakhulu nangesandla sakho esinamandla.

Nkosi, ake ubeke indlebe yakho emthandazweni wenceku yakho nasemithandazweni yezinceku zakho ezikuthokozelayo ukudumisa iGama lakho. Iphumelelise inceku yakho namuhla, uyiphe umusa phambi kwalo muntu.” Ngaleso sikhathi ngangingumphathindebe wenkosi.
Ngenyanga uNisani, ngonyaka wama-20 wokubusa kwenkosi u-Arithahishashitha, iwayini liphambi kwenkosi, ngalithunga ngalinika inkosi. Ngangingakaze ngibe ngodangele phambi kwayo.
Inkosi yathi kimi: “Kungani ubuso bakho budangele wena ube ungaguli na? Lokhu kufanele kube ngukudangala okuvela enhliziyweni.” Ngesaba kakhulu.
Ngaphendula ngathi enkosini: “Mana njalo, nkosi! Kungenzeka kanjani ukuba ubuso bami bungadangali, lapho umuzi oyindawo yamathuna okhokho uyincithakalo, namasango awo eshiswe ngomlilo na?”
Inkosi yathi kimi: “Ukhala ngani na?” Ngase ngikhuleka kuNkulunkulu wezulu.
Ngathi enkosini: “Uma kukuhle emehlweni akho nkosi, nengikucelayo kwemukeleka kuwe, ngicela ukuba ungithumele kwaJuda, emzini wamathuna obabamkhulu, ukuba ngiyowakha kabusha.”
Inkosi yathi kimi, nendlovukazi ihlezi eduze kwayo: “Uyohamba isikhathi esingakanani, futhi ubuye nini na?” Kwayithokozisa inkosi, yase ingivumela, nganquma isikhathi engiyobuya ngaso.

Ngathi enkosini: “Uma kwemukelekile enkosini, manginikwe izincwadi engiyozethula kubabusi besifundazwe esisentshonalanga yomfula iYufrathe, ukuze banginike imvume yokudabula ngaphandle kwezihibe, ngize ngifike kwaJuda.

Ngacela nencwadi eya ku-Asafa, umqaphi wehlathi lenkosi, eyayimyala ukuba anginike izingodo zokwakha imishayo yamasango enqaba yethempeli, izingange zomuzi nezendlu engangizohlala kuyo.” Inkosi yanginika konke engakucelayo, ngokuba isandla esihle sikaNkulunkulu sasinami.
Inkosi yathumela izikhulu zempi nabagibele amahhashi ukuba bangiphelekezele. Ngafinyelela kubabusi besifundazwe esiseNtshonalanga yeYufrathe, ngabanika izincwadi ezazibhalwe yinkosi.
Kodwa lapho uSanibhalathi, umHoroni noThobiya, inceku yakwa-Amoni, bezwa ukuthi kufike umuntu ozosebenzela inhlalakahle ka-Israyeli, bacunuka kakhulu.
Ngafika eJerusalema ngahlala khona izinsuku ezintathu.

Ngavuka ebusuku, ngahamba namanye amadoda; angitshelanga muntu ngalokho uNkulunkulu wami ayekubeke enhliziyweni yami ukuba ngikwenzele iJerusalema. Angithathanga silwane ngaphandle kwaleso engangisigibele.

Ngaphuma ebusuku ngeSango Lesigodi, ngahamba ngaseningizimu yoMthombo KaDrago, ngaze ngayofika eSangweni Lomquba, ngazihlola izingange eJerusalema ezazibhidlizelwe phansi namasango alo ayeshiswe ngomlilo.
Ngaqhubekela eSangweni Lomthombo naseChibini Lenkosi, kodwa kwakungasekho ndlela yokuba isilwane engangigibele kuso siqhubeke.
Ngakhuphuka ngomhosha ebusuku, ngihlola ugange. Ngase ngibuyela emzini, ngangena ngeSango Lesigodi; ngabuya kanjalo-ke.
Akukho namunye ezikhulwini owayazi ukuthi bengiyephi nokuthi ngangenzani. Ngangingakabatsheli abaJuda, abaphristi, abaholi, izikhulu nabanye ababezokwenza umsebenzi.
Ngase ngithi kubo: “Niyayibona yini inkathazo esikuyo, ukuthi iJerusalema liyincithakalo, namasango alo ashisiwe na? Wozani, masakhe kabusha ugange ukuze singaphinde sibe yihlazo.”
Ngabatshela ukuthi isandla esihle sikaNkulunkulu wami sibe nami kanjani, nangamazwi inkosi eyayiwakhulume kimi. Bathi: “Masisukume sakhe.” Base bewuqala ngentshisekelo umsebenzi.
Kwathi lapho uSanibhalathi umHoroni, uThobiya inceku engumAmoni, noGeshemi umArabhu bekuzwa lokho, basihleka usulu besibhinqa, bethi: “Nenzani nje nempela na? Senivukela inkosi na?”
Ngabathumelela impendulo ethi: “UNkulunkulu wezulu uzosiphumelelisa, thina zinceku zakhe sizosukuma, siqale sakhe kabusha, kodwa nina aninasabelo, nalungelo, nanto eyisikhumbuzo eJerusalema.”

Kwasuka u-Eliyashibhi, umphristi omkhulu nabanye abaphristi, bakha kabusha iSango Lezimvu, balinikela, bamisa namasango ezindaweni zawo. Banikela ugange kusukela eMbhoshongweni Wekhulu kuze kube seMbhoshongweni KaHananeli.
Eduze kwakhe kwakwakha amadoda aseJerikho, kwathi ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa nguZakhari, indodona ka-Imri.
ISango Lenhlanzi lakhiwa ngamadodana kaHasena. Afaka imishayo namasango ezindaweni zakho, afaka imigoqo nezihluthulelo.

Ingxenye elandelayo yalungiswa nguMeremothi, indodana ka-Uriya, umzukulu kaHakozi. Elandelayo yakhiwa nguMeshulami, indodana kaBherekhiya, umzukulu kaMeshezabheli. Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa nguZadoki, indodana kaBhahana.
Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa ngamadoda aseThekhowa, kodwa abaholi bakulowo muzi benqaba ukwenza umsebenzi ababewunikwe ngabaphathi babo.
ISango iJeshana lakhiwa nguJoyada, indodana kaPhaseya, noMeshulami, indodana kaBhesodeya. Bafaka imishayo namasango ezindaweni zakho, bafaka imigoqo nezihluthulelo.

Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa nguMelathiya waseGibheyoni, noJadoni waseMeronothi, kwathi ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa ngamadoda akwaGibheyoni naseMizpha kwaze kwayofika lapho kuhlala khona umbusi wesifundazwe esisentshonalanga yeYufrathe.
Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa ngu-Uziyeli, indodana kaHarihaya, umkhandigolide. Elandelayo yayihamba ize iyofika oGangeni Olukhulu, yona yakhiwa kabusha nguHananiya, owayenza amakha.
Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa nguRefaya, indodana kaHuri, umbusi wengxenye yesifunda eJerusalema.
Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa nguJedaya, indodana kaHarumafi, kwazise yayiseduze nomuzi wakhe. Elandelayo yakhiwa nguHathushi, indodona kaHashabhineya.
Ingxenye elandelayo noMbhoshongo Wohhavini kwakhiwa nguMalikhija, indodana kaHarimi noHashubhi, indodana kaPhahathi Mowabi.
Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa nguShalumi, indodana kaHaloheshi, umbusi wenye ingxenye yesifunda eJerusalema. Amadodakazi akhe amsiza kulowo msebenzi.

ISango Lesigodi lakhiwa kabusha nguHanuni nezakhamuzi zomuzi iZanowa. Bamisa amasango ezindaweni zawo, bafaka imigoqo nezihluthulelo, bakha kabusha ugange olungamakhubhithi ayinkulungwane kuze kuyofika eSangweni Lomquba.
ISango Lomquba lakhiwa kabusha nguMalikhija, indodana kaRekhabhi, umbusi wesifunda eBhethi Hakhiheremi. Wamisa amasango ezindaweni zawo, wafaka imigoqo nezihluthulelo.

ISango Lomthombo lakhiwa kabusha nguShalumi, indodana kaKholihoze, umbusi wesifunda eMizpha. Walakha, walifulela, wamisa amasango ezindaweni zawo, wafaka imigoqo nezihluthulelo, wakha nogange echibini iShela ngasengadini yenkosi, kwaze kwaba sezikhwelweni ezehlela emzini kaDavide.
Ingxenye elandelayo yayize iyofika ngaphambi kwedlinza likaDavide, kuya echibini nendlu yamaqhawe, kwakhiwa nguNehemiya, indodana ka-Azibhuki, umbusi wengxenye yesifunda iBhethi Zuri.

Laba baLevi abalandelayo bakha kabusha izingxenye ezithile zogange: uRehumi, indodana kaBhani, wakha ingxenye elandelayo; uHashabhiya, umbusi wengxenye yesifunda iKheyila, wakha ingxenye elandelayo, enzela isifunda sakhe.
Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa nguBhavayi, indodana kaHenadadi, umbusi wenye ingxenye yesifunda iKheyila.
Ingxenye elandelayo ephambi kwendawo yezikhali kuze kuyofika endaweni lapho ugange lujika khona yakhiwa ngu-Ezeri, indodana kaJeshuwa, umbusi waseMizpha.
Ingxenye elandelayo kuze kuyofika esangweni lendlu yomphristi omkhulu, u-Eliyashibhi, yakhiwa nguBharukhi, indodana kaZabhayi.
Ingxenye elandelayo kuze kuyofika ekugcineni kwendlu ka-Eliyashibhi yakhiwa nguMeremothi, indodana ka-Uriya, indodana kaHakozi.
Emva kwakhe kwalungisa abaphristi namadoda asezindaweni ezazizungeze lapho.

Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa nguBhenjamini noHashubhi, kwazise yayiphambi kwemizi yabo. Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa ngu-Azariya, indodana kaMahaseya, indodana ka-Ananiya, kwazise yayiphambi komuzi wakhe.
Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa nguBhinuwi, indodana kaHenadadi, kusukela endlini ka-Azariya kuze kuyofika ejikeni logange.
UPhalali, indodana ka-Uzayi, wakha ingxenye elandelayo, kusukela ejikeni logange nombhoshongo wesigodlo esasingenhla eduze negceke labaqaphi. Emva kwakhe, uPhedayi, indodana kaPharoshi

nezisebenzi ezazihlala ethempelini e-Oferi, bakha kabusha ingxenye emalungana neSango Lamanzi, empumalanga yejika lombhoshongo. Lokhu kwakuseduze nengxenye yomuzi okwakuthiwa yi-Ofeli, lapho kwakuhlala khona amadoda ayesebenza ethempelini.
Ingxenye elandelayo esuka malungana nombhoshongo omkhulu oqaphe ithempeli kuze kuyofika eduze kodonga oluseduze ne-Ofeli, yakhiwa ngamadoda aseThekhowa. Lokho kwase kuyingxenye yawo yesibili.
Ngenhla kweSango Lehhashi, kwakha abaphristi, yilowo nalowo akha phambi komuzi wakhe.
Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa nguZadoki, indodana ka-Imeri, ngoba yayiphambi komuzi wakhe. Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa nguShemaya, indodana kaShekhaniya, umlindi wesango iMpumalanga.
Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa nguHananiya, indodana kaShelemiya noHanuni, indodana kaZalafi yesithupha. Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa nguMeshulamu, indodana kaBherekhiya, ngoba yayiphambi komuzi wakhe.

Ingxenye elandelayo yakhiwa nguMalikhija, umkhandigolide, kusukela endlini eyayisetshenziswa ngamadoda ayesebenza ethempelini nabahwebi, eyayingasesangweni iMifikhadi, eduze nendlu ephezu kogange, ejikeni elisenyakatho mpumalanga yalo.
Abakhandigolide, nabahwebi bakha ingxenye yokugcina, kusukela endlini esejikeni kuze kuyofika eSangweni Lezimvu.
Kwathi ukuba uSanibhalathi ezwe ukuthi sase silwakha kabusha ugange, wathukuthela wagana unwabu, wabhodla umlilo, wabaklolodela abaJuda.

Wakhuluma nabangani bakhe nempi eSamariya, wathi: “Benzani laba baJuda abantekentekana na? Ngabe bazokwakha kabusha izinto? Bazokwenza imihlatshelo na? Bazoyiqeda ngosuku na? Ngabe bazovuselela amatshe engqumbini yamabibi, bese beshisela phezu kwawo na?”
UThobiya, umAmoni, wema eduze kwakhe wakloloda, wathi: “Ngisho bengazakha kabusha lezi zingange, uma kukhwela impungushe phezu kwazo ziyomane ziziwele!”
Ngase ngikhuleka, ngithi: “Nkulunkulu wami, yizwa ukuthi basedelela kanjani, uyibuyisele kubo inhlamba yabo, ubanikele babe njengempango ezweni lokuthunjwa.
Ungabaxoleli izono zabo, necala labo ungalesuli phambi kwakho, ngokuba bakwedelele phambi kwabakhi.”
Saqhubeka nokwakha, saphumelela ukulwakha kabusha ugange lwaze lwaphakathi nendawo ubude, ngoba abantu babenomdlandla wokusebenza.
Lapho uSanibhalathi, uThobiya, ama-Arabhu, ama-Amoni nama-Ashidodi, bezwa ukuthi ugange eJerusalema luyakhuphuka nokuthi izimfa ziyavalwa, bathukuthela kakhulu,
base bakha uzungu lokuza kanyekanye bazolwa nalo iJerusalema, badale inxushunxushu.
Sakhuleka kuNkulunkulu wethu, sabeka abaqaphi ukulinda ubusuku nemini.
UJuda wathi: “Amandla abathwala imithwalo aphelile, maningi amabibi, asisakwazi ukuqhubeka sakhe kabusha ugange.”
Izitha zethu zathi: “Sizobazuma, sibathelekele bengazelele, sibabulale, ungabe usaqhubeka umsebenzi.”
AbaJuda ababakhelene nazo, bafika basixwayisa kaninginingi, bethi: “Zizofika zivela ezindaweni zonke ezihlala kuzo zizomelana nathi.”
Ngase ngimisa abantu ngokwemindeni yabo, ngezansi ezindaweni ezisemuva kogange nakwezisobala, benezinkemba, imikhonto neminsalo yabo.
Ngakubona lokho, ngaphakama, ngathi kubaholi nezikhulu nakubantu bonke: “Ningazesabi. Khumbulani iNkosi enamandla neyesabekayo, nilwele abafowenu, abantwana benu, omkenu nemizi yenu.”
Izitha zethu zezwa ukuthi sesizwile ngozungu lwazo, nokuthi uNkulunkulu uliphunzisile icebo lazo. Sonke sabuyela ogangeni, kwayilowo nalowo emsebenzini wakhe.
Kusukela ngalolo lusuku enye ingxenye yezinceku zami yakha, enye yaphatha imikhonto, amahawu, iminsalo nezivikelo zesifuba. Abaholi babeseka abendlu yakwaJuda,
ababakha kabusha ugange. Ababethwala imithwalo, bathwala imithwalo yabo ngesandla esisodwa ngesinye bephethe izikhali.
Bonke abakhayo babegaxe izinkemba ezinqulwini zabo, beqhubeka bakha. Indoda eyayihlaba umkhosi ngecilongo, yayiseduze kwami.
Ngathi kubaholi nezikhulu nakubantu: “Umsebenzi mkhulu, wendlalekile, thina siqhelelene kakhulu ogangeni.
Uma nizwa kuhlatshwa umkhosi ngecilongo, anobuthana ngakimi. UNkulunkulu wethu uzosilwela.”
Saqhubeka kanjalo nokusebenza, enye ingxenye ihlome ngemikhonto ilungele ukulwa, kusukela entathakusa kuze kuqhakaze izinkanyezi.
Ngaleso sikhathi ngabuye ngayala bonke abantu, ngathi: “Yilowo nalowo nenceku yakhe mabahlale phakathi eJerusalema ukuze basiqaphe ebusuku, basebenze emini.”
Mina-ke, abafowethu, izinceku zami namadoda ayengabaqaphi ayengilandela, asizange sizikhumule izimpahla zethu; yilowo nalowo wayephethe isikhali ngesandla sakhe.
Kwaba khona ukukhala kwabantu okukhulu, amadoda nomkabo bekhononda ngabafowabo abangabaJuda.
Ngokuba kwakukhona labo ababethi: “Thina namadodana ethu namadodakazi ethu sibaningi, masithole okusanhlamvu ukuze sidle, siphile.”
Kwakukhona futhi nabathi: “Sibambise ngamasimu ethu, ngezivini zethu, nangemizi yethu, ukuze sithole okusanhlamvu ngenxa yendlala.”
Abanye babethi: “Sibambise ngamasimu ethu nezivini zethu ukuze sithole imali yokukhokha intela enkosini.
Siyafana nabafowethu, nezingane zethu ziyafana nezabo, kodwa siphoqa amadodana ethu namadodakazi ethu ukuba abe yizigqila; asinamandla, amasimu ethu nezivini zethu manje sekungokwabanye.”
Ngathukuthela kakhulu lapho ngizwa izikhalo zabo namazwi abo.
Ngacabangisisa ngalolu daba, izikhulu nabaholi ngababeka icala, ngathi kubo: “Nina nonke nibakhokhisa inzalo abantu bakini.” Ngabiza ibandla elikhulu ukuba libhekane nabo.

Ngathi kulo: “Sisanda kubahlenga ngokusemandleni ethu abafowethu abangabaJuda, abebekade bethengiselwe ezinye izizwe; manje senidayisa ngabafowenu, sekufanele sibathenge kini na?” Bathula bathi du, ngoba bengenamazwi okuphendula.
Ngase ngithi: “Le nto eniyenzayo yimbi. Beningehambe yini ngokumesaba uNkulunkulu wethu ukuze nigweme ukuhlanjalazwa ngabezizwe, abayizitha zethu na?
Mina, abafowethu nezinceku zami, sabetsheleka imali nokusanhlamvu. Masikuyeke ukubiza inzalo.
Buyiselani kubo khona namhlanje amasimu abo, izivini zabo, izingadi zabo zeminqumo, izindlu zabo, inzalo yemali yabo, okusanhlamvu, iwayini namafutha ebenibaqola khona.”
Baphendula bathi: “Sizobabuyisela konke, futhi singafuni lutho kubo. Sizokwenza njengoba ushilo.” Ngase ngibiza abaphristi, ngabafungisa ukuba benze njengoba bethembisile.

Ngase ngithintitha umphetho wengubo yami, ngathi: “Sengathi uNkulunkulu angamvuthulula kanjalo noma ngubani ongeyukusigcina lesi sivumelwano; endlini nasempahleni, angamshiyeli lutho.” Yonke inhlangano yaphendula yathi: “Amen!” Yadumisa uSimakade. Yenza njengoba yayethembisile.

Kusukela ngosuku inkosi u-Arithahishashitha eyangibeka ngalo ngaba ngumbusi wabo ezweni lakwaJuda, ngonyaka wama-20 wokubusa kwayo, kuze kube ngunyaka wama-32, okuyiminyaka eli-12 isiyonke, mina nabafowethu asidlanga sabelo sombusi.

Ababusi engibalandelayo babethwesa abantu umthwalo onzima, befuna intela yokudla newayini, ngaphezu kwezinhlamvu ezingama-40 zesiliva abebevele bezikhokha. Ngisho nezinceku zabo zabacindezela abantu, kodwa mina angenzanga kanjalo, ngenxa yokwesaba uNkulunkulu.
Ngasebenza ngokuzikhandla emsebenzini wami wokwakha kabusha ugange, angizange ngizithengele nsimu. Zonke izinceku zami zazimatasatasa ekwakhiweni kabusha kogange.
Ngaphezu kwalokho ngangidla nabantu abayi-150, abaJuda nezikhulu, ngaphandle kwalabo abavela ezizweni esakhelene nazo.

Ngalolo nalolo suku kwakuhlatshwa inkabi nezimvu zekhethelo eziyisithupha, ngilungiselwe nezinkukhu. Kwakukhishwa iwayini eliningi, kanye ezinsukwini eziyishumi. Ngangazi ukuthi abantu bathwele umthwalo onzima kangakanani, ngakho-ke angizange ngisifune isabelo sombusi.
Nkulunkulu wami, ngikhumbule ngakho konke okuhle engikwenzele laba bantu.

Kwathi ukuba bezwe oSanibhalathi, uThobiya, uGeshemi umArabhu, nazo zonke izitha zethu ukuthi sengilwakhile ugange, futhi akusasele sikhala kulo, noma-ke ngaleso sikhathi ngangingakazifaki izicabha emasangweni,
uSanibhalathi noGeshemi bangithumelela umyalezo othi: “Woza sihlale phansi sidingide lolu daba komunye wemizana esethafeni e-Ono.” Kepha babehlose ukungenza isilo sengubo.
Ngathumela izigijimi kubo, ngathi: “Ngimatasatasa ngomsebenzi omkhulu, ngeke ngehle ngize lapho kini. Ngizowuyekelani umsebenzi engiwenzayo, ngehle ngize lapho kini na?”
Bangithumelela umyalezo ofanayo kwaze kwaba amahlandla amane, nami ngilokhu ngibabuyisela impendulo efanayo.
Ngehlandla lesihlanu, uSanibhalathi wangithumelela lowo myalezo ngenceku yakhe, kodwa kwakuyincwadi engavaliwe.

Kwakulotshwe kuyo ukuthi: “Kunamahlebezi ezizweni athi wena nabaJuda niceba ukuvukela inkosi, yingakho wakha kabusha ugange nje; ngokwalowo mbiko wena uzoba yinkosi yabo, noGashimu uyawafakazela lawo mahlebezi.
Usuqoke abaphrofethi eJerusalema abazommezela ngawe, bathi: ‘Kunenkosi kwaJuda!’ Lawo mahlebezi angahle afinyelele enkosini, ngakho-ke woza sizohlangana, sikhulume.”
Ngase ngithumela kuye, ngathi: “Lokho okushoyo akusilona iqiniso; nguwena nje ozakhele lezo zinto.”
Ngokuba bonke babefuna ukusethusa, bethi: “Bazodikibala bayeke ukusebenza.” Ngakhuleka ngathi: “Nkulunkulu, qinisa izandla zami.”

Ngelinye ilanga ngavakashela uShemaya, indodana kaDelaya owayezalwa nguMehethabheli. UShemaya wayengaphumi emzini wakhe. Waphrofetha wathi: “Masihlangane endlini kaNkulunkulu, ngaphakathi ethempelini, sihluthulele iminyango yalo, ngokuba bayeza ukuzokukubulala. Impela bazofika ngalobu busuku ukuzokukubulala.”
Ngamphendula ngathi: “Ngabe indoda enjengami nje ingabaleka yini na? Ngabe indoda efana nami ingangena yini ethempelini ukuze isindise impilo yayo na? Ngeke ngingene kulo.”
Ngabona ukuthi wayengathunywanga nguNkulunkulu, kodwa wayeqashwe nguThobiya noSanibhalathi ukuba asho leso siphrofetho ngami.
Babemqashe ngenhloso yokungesabisa ukuze ngenze isono ngokwenza kanjalo, bangigxibhe, bangithele ngehlazo.
“Nkulunkulu wami, khumbula okwenziwe nguThobiya noSanibhalathi, ungiphindiselele kubo nakumphrofethikazi uNowadiya, nakwabanye abaphrofethi abazama ukungesabisa.”
Umsebenzi wokwakhiwa kabusha kogange waphela mhla zingama-25 ngenyanga u-Eluli, wathatha izinsuku ezingama-52.
Kwathi lapho zonke izitha zethu zizwa ngalokho, nazo zonke izizwe esasakhelene nazo, zesaba kakhulu, zadikibala, ngokuba zabona ukuthi lowo msebenzi waphumelela ngosizo lukaNkulunkulu wethu.
Phezu kwalokho izikhulu zakwaJuda, ngalezo zinsuku, zazibhalelana noThobiya,

ngokuba abaJuda abaningi babenesibopho sesifungo ababesenze naye, ngoba wayeganwe yindodakazi kaShekhaniya, indodana ka-Ara, indodana yakhe, uJehohanani, iganwe yindodakazi kaMeshulami, indodana kaBherekhiya.
Phambi kwami, babehlale betusa izenzo zakhe ezinhle; bembikela ngakho konke engangikusho. UThobiya wayengithumelela izincwadi zokungesabisa.
Kwathi sekuphelile ukwakhiwa kogange lomuzi, kwafakwa namasango, kwamiswa abalindisango, abaculi nabaLevi,
umfowethu uHanani ngambeka ukuba engamele iJerusalema, noHananiya abe ngumengameli wenqaba, ngokuba uHananiya wayeyindoda ethembekile, emesabayo uNkulunkulu kunabaningi.

Ngathi kubo: “Amasango aseJerusalema mabangawavuli lize liphakame ilanga, kusihlwa basheshe bavale imigoqo nezicabha, ngesikhathi abaqaphi besaqaphile ezindaweni zabo. Ngabuye ngathi mabaqoke abaqaphi phakathi kwabantu abahlala eJerusalema, babamise ezindaweni ezithile, abantu behle benyuka bezungeza indawo eseduze nemizi yabo.”
IJerusalema lalingumuzi omkhulu, linendawo ebanzi, kodwa zaziyingcosana kakhulu izakhamuzi ezazihlala kulo; yayingeminingi imizi eyayakhiwe kabusha.

UNkulunkulu wangenza ngaba nevuso enhliziyweni yami, ngase ngimemela abantu embizweni yeziphathimandla nezikhulu nabantu, ukuba bazobhalisa ngokwemindeni yabo. Ngathola umlando wolibo lwalabo ababebuye kuqala. Nakhu engakutholayo:
Laba ngabantu besifundazwe ababebuye ekuthunjweni nguNebukhadinezari, inkosi yaseBhabhele, bebuyela eJerusalema nakwaJuda. Yilowo nalowo wabuyela emzini wakubo;
bebuya noZerubhabhele, uJeshuwa, uNehemiya, u-Azariya, uRahamiya, uNahamani, uMoridekhayi, uBhilishani, uMisipherethi, uBhigivayi, uNehumi noBhahana. Inani labantu bakwa-Israyeli yileli:
abozalo lukaPharoshi bayizi-2 172,
abolukaShefathiya bangama-372,
aboluka-Ara bangama-652,
abolukaPhahathi Mowabi ozalweni lukaJeshuwa noJowabe bayizi-2 818,
aboluka-Elami bayi-1 254,
abolukaZathu bangama-845,
abolukaZakhayi bangama-760,
abolukaBhinuyi bangama-648,
abolukaBhebayi bangama-628,
aboluka-Azigadi bayizi-2 322,
aboluka-Adonikamu bangama-667,
abolukaBhigivayi bayizi-2 067,
aboluka-Adini bangama-655,
aboluka-Atheri, wozalo lukaHezekiya, bangama-98,
abolukaHashumi bangama-328,
abolukaBhezayi bangama-324,
abolukaHarifi bayi-112,
abolukaGibheyoni bangama-95.
Amadoda aseBhethlehema naseNethofa ayeyi-188,
awase-Anathothi eyi-128,
awaseBhethi Azimavethi engama-42,
awaseKiriyathi Jeharimi, eKhefira naseBheherothi engama-743,
awaseRama naseGebha engama-621,
awaseMikhimashi eyi-122,
awaseBhethele nase-Ayi eyi-123,
amanye akwenye iNebho engama-52,
amanye akwenye i-Elami eyi-1 254,
awase-Arimi engama-320,
awaseJerikho engama-345,
awaseLodi, awaseHadidi nase-Ono engama-721,
awaseSenaya eyizi-3 930.
Abaphristi: abozalo lukaJedaya, ozalweni lukaJeshuwa, bengama-973,
aboluka-Imeri beyi-1 052,
abolukaPhashuri beyi-1 247,
abolukaHarimi beyi-1 017.
AbaLevi: abozalo lukaJeshuwa, ozalweni lukaKhadimiyeli, emndenini kaHodaviya, babengama-74.
Abaculi: abozalo luka-Asafa babengama-148.
Abalindisango: abozalo lukaShalumi, baka-Atheri, bakaThalimoni, baka-Akhubhi, bakaHathitha nabakaShobhayi babeyi-138.
Izisebenzi zasethempelini yilezi: abozalo lukaZiha, lukaHashufa, lukaThabhawothi,
lukaKerosi, lukaSiya, lukaPhadoni,
lukaLebana, lukaHagaba, lukaShalimayi,
lukaHanani, lukaGideli, lukaGahari,
lukaRewaya, lukaRezini, lukaNekoda,
lukaGazami, luka-Uza, lukaPhaseya,
lukaBhesayi, lukaMewunimi, lukaNefusimi,
lukaBhakibhuki, lukaHakufa, lukaHarihuri,
lukaBhaziluthi, lukaMehida, lukaHarisha,
lukaBharikosi, lukaSisera, lukaThema,
lukaNeziya nolukaHathifa.
Abozalo lwezinceku zikaSolomoni yilaba: abozalo lukaSothayi, lukaSoferethi, lukaPherida,
lukaJahala, lukaDarikoni, lukaGideli,
lukaShefathiya, lukaHathili, lukaPhokherethi Hazebhayimi noluka-Amoni.
Izisebenzi zasethempelini, abozalo lwezisebenzi zikaSolomoni, babengama-392.
Laba abalandelayo babevela eThelimela, eTheliharisha, eKherubhi, e-Adoni, nase-Imeri. Kodwa behluleka ukuveza isiqiniseko sokuthi bangabozalo lwakwa-Israyeli yini:
abozalo lukaDelaya, lukaThobiya nolukaNekoda babengama-642.
Ababevela kubaphristi yilaba: abozalo lukaHobhaya, lukaHakozi, nolukaBharizilayi owayeganwe yindodakazi kaBharizilayi umGileyadi, owayebizwa ngalelo gama.
Labo ababefuna imininingwane yemindeni yabo, kodwa abayitholanga, ngakho-ke abafakwanga ohleni lwabaphristi, bathathwa ngokuthi kabahlanzekile.
Ngakho-ke umbusi wabayala ukuba bangakudli ukudla okubusisiweyo, kuze kube nomphristi one-Urimi neThumimi.
Sebebonke babeyizi-42 360,
ngale kwezinceku zabo zesilisa eziyizi-7 337 nezesifazane; babenabaculi besilisa nabesifazane abangama-245.
Babenamahhashi angama-736, iminyuzi engama-245,
amakameli angama-435 nezimbongolo eziyizi-6 720.

Ezinye zezinhloko zemindeni zanikela esikhwameni sokwenza umsebenzi. Umbusi wanikela esikhwameni ngamadarike egolide ayinkulungwane, imicengezi engama-50, nezingubo zokugqoka zabaphristi ezingama-530.
Ezinye izinhloko zemindeni zanikela esikhwameni somsebenzi ngamadarike egolide ayizi-20 000 nawomina besiliva abayizi-2 200.
Sekukonke okwanikelwa ngabantu kwakungamadakire egolide ayizi-20 000, omina besiliva abayizi-2 000 nezingubo zabaphristi ezingama-67.
Abaphristi, abaLevi, abalindisango, abaculi, izisebenzi zasethempelini, abanye abantu no-Israyeli wonke bahlala emizini yakubo. Ngenyanga yesikhombisa, abantu base bezinzile emizini yakubo.
Abantu base behlangana, kwangathi bamuntu munye, egcekeni elaliphambi kweSango Lamanzi. Bamtshela u-Ezra, umbhali, ukuba alethe incwadi yomthetho kaMose, uSimakade awunika u-Israyeli.
Kwakulusuku lokuqala lwenyanga yesikhombisa. U-Ezra, umphristi, wayiletha incwadi yomthetho phambi kwebandla, abesilisa, nabesifazane nabo bonke ababezwa, baqonde.
Wafunda kuyo ebheke ngaseshashalazini elalingaphambi kweSango Lamanzi. Waqala entathakusa kwaze kwaba semini, phambi kwabesilisa nabesifazane nalabo abasebenokuqonda.

U-Ezra, umbhali, wayemi phezu kwebhesituli yokhuni, yenzelwe lowo msebenzi. Eceleni ngakwesokunene sakhe kwakumi uMathathiya, uShema, u-Anaya, u-Uriya, uHilikiya noMahaseya; ngakwesokhohlo sakhe kunguPhedaya, uMishayeli, uMalikhija, uHashumi, uHashibhadana, uZekhariya noMeshulami.
U-Ezra wema phezu kobamba, wayivula incwadi phambi kwabo bonke abantu bembuka, ngoba wayemi ngenhla kwabo. Kwathi lapho eyivula, bonke basukuma.
U-Ezra wamdumisa uSimakade uNkulunkulu, bonke abantu baphendula, bathi: “Amen! Amen,” bephakamise izandla zabo, bakhothama, bathi mbo ngobuso emhlabathini, bakhuleka kuNkulunkulu.

AbaLevi: uJeshuwa, uBhani, uSherebhiya, uJamini, u-Akhubhi, uShebhethayi, uHodiya, uMahaseya, uKhelitha, u-Azariya, uJozabhadi, uHanani noPhelaya, bachazela abantu umthetho; ngesikhathi abantu bemi endaweni yabo.
Bafunda encwadini yomthetho kaNkulunkulu, bawuhumusha ukuze abantu bawuqonde ukuthi uthini.

Abantu lapho bezwa amazwi omthetho, balila kodwa uNehemiya umbusi, no-Ezra umphristi nombhali, nabaLevi ababefundisa abantu bathi kubo: “Ningakhali, ningalili, ngokuba lolu lusuku lungcwele kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.”

Wayesethi kubo: “Hambani nidle izibiliboco, niphuze newayini elimtoti, nabele nalabo abantulayo, ngokuba lolu lusuku olumiselwe uSimakade iNkosi yethu, ningabi lusizi, ngokuba intokozo eniyiphiwa nguSimakade iyinqaba yenu.”
NabaLevi babaqinisa idolo, bathi: “Yekani ukukhala, ningabe nisadabuka, ngokuba namuhla lusuku olungcwele.”
Bonke abantu bahamba bayokudla, baphuza, bapha abantulayo ukudla, bajabula kakhulu, ngokuba babekuzwile abakutshelwayo.
Ngosuku olulandelayo, zonke izinhloko zemindeni, abaphristi nabaLevi, beza ku-Ezra, umbhali, ukuze abafundise kabanzi amazwi omthetho.
Bafumanisa kulotshiwe emthethweni uSimakade ayeyale ngawo uMose ukuthi abantu bakwa-Israyeli kumele bahlale emadokodweni ngesikhathi somkhosi, ngenyanga yesikhombisa.

Kumele bamemezele eJerusalema nakuyo yonke eminye imizi, bathi: “Khuphukelani ezintabeni, nigawule amagatsha omnqumo nomnqumo wasendle, uthathawe, amasundu nezinye izihlahla, nakhe amadokodo njengokulotshiweyo.”

Abantu base bephuma beyogawula amagatsha, yilowo nalowo wazakhela idokodo ophahleni lwendlu yakhe, emagcekeni abo, emagcekeni endlu kaNkulunkulu, naseshashalazini elingaphambi kweSango Lamanzi, nelingaphambi kweSango Lika-Efrayimi.

Lonke ibandla lababekade bethunjiwe, lakha amadokodo, lahlala kuwo. Kwakungokokuqala kwenzeka kanje, kusukela ezinsukwini zikaJoshuwa, indodana kaNuni, kuze kube namuhla, abantu bakwa-Israyeli babengakaze benze kanjalo. Umkhosi bawugubha ngenjabulo enkulu.

Nsuku zonke, kusukela osukwini lokuqala lomkhosi kuze kube ngolokugcina, wayefunda encwadini yomthetho kaNkulunkulu. Bawugubha izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, kwathi ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili bahlangana, ukuze bawuvale ngesizotha umkhosi njengoba kubekwe emthethweni.
Kwathi ngosuku lwama-24, lwaleyo nyanga, abakwa-Israyeli bahlangana ngosuku lokuzila ukudla, bembatha indwangu eyisaka, bazithela ngenhlabathi.
Abozalo luka-Israyeli bazehlukanisa kubo bonke abezizwe, bama, bavuma izono zabo nobubi obenziwa ngokhokho babo.
Bama ezindaweni zabo, kwase kufundwa umthetho kaSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo, kwathatha ingxenye yosuku; ngenye ingxenye yosuku bavuma izono zabo, badumisa uSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo.
Kwase kuma endaweni ephakeme yabaLevi; uJeshuwa, uBhani, uKadimiyeli, uShabhaniya, uBhuni, uSherebhiya, uBhani noKhenani. Bamemeza ngezwi elikhulu kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo.

AbaLevi: uJeshuwa, uKadimiyeli, uBhani, uHashabhineya, uSherebhiya, uHodiya, uShebhaniya noPhethahiya, bama kwenye indawo ephakeme, bamemeza bathi: “Sukumani nidumise uSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu, kusukela phakade, kuze kube phakade.” “Malibongwe iGama lakho elidumisekayo neliphakeme phezu kwakho konke ukubonga nokudumisa.”

“Nguwe wedwa onguSimakade, nguwe owenza izulu, izulu lamazulu, nayo yonke imikhosi ekulo, umhlaba nakho konke okukuwo, nezilwandle nakho konke okukuzo, konke ukuphe ukuphila, imikhosi yasezulwini iyakukhothamela.”
“Wena unguSimakade, uNkulunkulu owakhetha u-Abhrama, wamsusa e-Uri lamaKhaledi, waguqula igama lakhe, waba ngu-Abhrahama.

Wayithola inhliziyo yakhe yethembekile kuwe, wenza isivumelwano naye, wethembisa ukwabela abozalo lwakhe izwe lamaKhanani, amaHithi, ama-Amori, amaPherizi, amaJebusi namaGirigashi, wakufeza owawukwethembisile ngokuba ulungile.”
“Wakubona ukuhlupheka kokhokho bethu eGibhithe nasoLwandle Lomhlanga, wakuzwa ukunxusa kwabo.

Wenza izibonakaliso nezimangaliso ezinkulu phambi kukaFaro nezinceku zakhe, nabo bonke abantu baseGibhithe, ngoba wawazi ukuthi babaphathe ngonya olunjani abantu bakho. Wazakhela igama elisamile kuze kube namuhla.
Ulwandle waludabula kabili ukuze bawele behamba emhlabathini owomileyo, kodwa ababehubha u-Israyeli wabaphonsa ekujuleni, bazika njengetshe emanzini anamandla.
Emini wawubahola ngensika yefu, ebusuku ngensika yomlilo eyayibakhanyisela endleleni ababehamba kuyo.”
“Wehlela entabeni iSinayi, wakhuluma nabo usezulwini. Wabanika izehlulelo ezilungileyo, imithetho eliqiniso, izimiso nemiyalelo emihle.
Wabazisa ngeSabatha lakho elingcwele, wabashayela imithetho, izimiso nemiyalelo ngenceku yakho uMose.
Lapho belambile, wabanika isinkwa esivela ezulwini, waqhumisa isiphethu edwaleni, ukuze baqede ukoma. Wabatshela ukuba bangene ezweni owawubethembise lona ngesifungo, ukuthi uyobanika lona.”
“Kepha bona nokhokho bethu benza ububi, baziphakamisa, baba nenkani, bayephula imiyalelo yakho.

Benqaba ukukulalela, abaze bazikhumbula izimangaliso owazenza phakathi kwabo, kepha baqinisa amakhanda, bazimisela ukubuyela ebugqileni. Kodwa Wena unguNkulunkulu othethelelayo; onomusa nesihe, uyephuza ukuthukuthela, ugcwele isihawu, ngakho-ke awuzange ubalahle,
ngisho lapho sebezibumbele umfanekiso wethole, bethi: ‘Lona nguNkulunkulu wethu, owasikhipha eGibhithe,’ nalapho benza amahlazo esabekayo.
“Nokho awubalahlanga ehlane, ngenxa yobubele bakho obukhulu. Emini insika yefu ayiyekanga ukubahola endleleni yabo, nasebusuku insika yomlilo yaqhubeka yabakhanyisela endleleni yabo.
Wabanika uMoya wakho omuhle, ukubafundisa. Awuzange ubancishe imana yakho, wabuye wabanika amanzi okucima ukoma.
Iminyaka engamashumi amane, wabanakekela ehlane; abantulanga lutho, izingubo zabo aziguganga, nezinyawo zabo azivuvukalanga.
“Wanikela kubo imibuso nezizwe, wandisa imingcele yabo. Badla izwe likaSihoni, inkosi yaseHeshibhoni nelika-Ogi, inkosi yaseBhashani.
Izizukulwane zabo wazandisa njengezinkanyezi esibhakabhakeni, waziletha ezweni owawulethembise okhokho bazo ukuthi ziyongena kulo, zilidle.

Izizukulwane zabo zangena kulo, zahlala. Labo ababehlala kulelo lizwe, wabenza bakhonza kuzo. AmaKhanani namakhosi awo nabanye abantu ababehlala ezweni, wabanikela kuzo ukuba zibaphathe ngokuthanda kwazo.

Banqoba imizi ebiyelweyo nezwe elivundileyo; badla izindlu ezigcwele yonke into enhle, imithombo embiweyo, izivini, amasimu emikhiwane nezithelo eziningi ezidliwayo. Badla, basutha, banonophala, bawuthokozela umusa wakho omkhulu.
“Kodwa abalalelanga, bakuhlubuka, bawufulathela umthetho wakho. Babulala abaphrofethi bakho, ababebagqugquzela ukuba babuyele kuwe; benza amahlazo enyanyekayo.
Wawusubanikela ezitheni zabo ukuba zibacindezele. Kepha lapho sebesenhluphekweni, bakhala kuwe, wabezwa usezulwini, ngesihawu sakho esikhulu, wabanika abakhululi ukubakhulula ezitheni zabo.
“Kepha kuthe sebehleli ngokuthula, babuye benza okubi emehlweni akho. Wawusubayekela ezitheni zabo ukuze zibabuse. Kwathi lapho sebekunxusa, wabezwa usezulwini, ngesihawu sakho wabakhulula futhi.

Wabexwayisa ukuba babuyele emthethweni wakho, kodwa baba nenkani, abaze bayilalela imiyalelo yakho nezehlulelo zakho. Bona bephula izimiso zakho, okuthi uma umuntu ezigcina aphile. Bakufulathela, baqinisa amakhanda, benqaba ukukulalela.
Wababekezelela iminyaka eminingi, wabexwayisa ngoMoya wakho, wakhuluma ngabaphrofethi bakho, kodwa abakugqizanga qakala lokho, ngakho-ke wabanikela kubantu abakhelene nabo.
Nokho ngomusa wakho omkhulu, awubabhubhisanga, futhi awubalahlanga, ngokuba unguNkulunkulu onesihawu nomusa.

“Ngakho-ke, Nkulunkulu wethu, Nkulunkulu omkhulu, onamandla nowesabekayo, uhlale usigcina njalo isivumelwano sakho somusa. Yonke le nkathazo esehlelayo mayingabi ncane ebusweni bakho, thina namakhosi ethu, nezikhulu zakithi, nabaphristi bakithi, nabaphrofethi, nawokhokho, nabo bonke abantu bakho, kusukela ezinsukwini zamakhosi ama-Asiriya kuze kube namuhla.
Nokho bewufanele ukusehlisela zonke lezo zinto; wenze okulungileyo, thina senza okubi.
Amakhosi ethu, abaholi bethu, abaphristi nokhokho abawugcinanga umthetho wakho; abayinakanga imiyalelo yakho nalapho ubaxwayisa.
Ngisho embusweni wabo, ebuhleni obukhulu obenzele bona, nasezweni elibanzi nelivundileyo obanike lona, abazange bakukhonze, abaphendukanga emisebenzini yabo emibi.
“Awubheke nje, siyizigqila namuhla, izigqila ezweni owalinika okhokho bethu ukuze badle izithelo zalo, nokunye okuhle elikukhiqizayo. Bheka-ke, sesiyizigqila manje.
Ngenxa yezono zethu, isivuno salo esikhulu sesidliwa ngamakhosi owabeke phezu kwethu. Abusa thina nemfuyo yethu ngokuthanda kwawo. Sisenhluphekweni enkulu.”
“Ngenxa yakho konke lokho, manje sesenza isivumelwano, sisibhala phansi, abaholi bethu, abaLevi bethu nabaphristi bethu bashaya isigxivizo.”
Abashaya isigxivizo kwaba yilaba: uNehemiya umbusi, indodana kaHakaliya, uZedekiya,
uSeraya, u-Azariya, uJeremiya,
uPhashuri, u-Amariya, uMalikhiya,
uHathushi, uShebhaniya, uMalukhi,
uHarimi, uMeremothi, u-Obhadiya,
uDaniyeli, uGinethoni, uBharukhi,
uMeshulamu, u-Abhiya, uMijamini,
uMahaziya, uBhiligayi noShemaya; laba babe ngabaphristi.
AbaLevi: uJeshuwa, indodana ka-Azaniya, noBhinuwi wamadodana kaHenadadi, noKhadimiyeli,
nabafowabo uShebhaniya, uHodiya, uKhelitha, uPhelaya, uHanani,
uMikha, uRehobhe, uHashabhiya,
uZakhuri, uSherebhiya, uShebhaniya,
uHodiya, uBhani noBheninu.
Izinhloko zabantu: uPharoshi, uPhahathi Mowabi, u-Elamu, uZathu, uBhani,
uBhuni, u-Azigadi, uBhebayi,
u-Adoniya, uBhigivayi, u-Adini,
u-Atheri, uHezekiya, u-Azuri,
uHodiya, uHashumi, uBhezayi,
uHarifi, u-Anathothi, uNobhayi,
uMagiphiyashi, uMeshulamu, uHeziri,
uMeshezabheli, uZadoki, uJaduwa,
uPhelathiya, uHanani, u-Anaya,
uHosheya, uHananiya, uHashubhi,
uHaloheshi, uPhiliha, uShobheki,
uRehumi, uHashabhina, uMahaseya,
u-Ahiya, uHanani, u-Anani,
uMalukhi, uHarimi noBhahana.

Abanye abangagagulwanga ngamagama, abaphristi, abaLevi, abalindisango, abaculi, izisebenzi zasethempelini, nabo bonke ababezehlukanisile nabezizwe, bazihlanganisa nomthetho kaNkulunkulu, nomkabo nabantwana babo, bonke ababenolwazi nokuqonda,

bahlanganyela nabafowabo nezikhulu zabo, benza isifungo esimbaxambili, sokuthi bazohamba ngomthetho kaNkulunkulu awunika uMose, inceku yakhe, nokuthi bazoyigcina yonke imiyalelo kaSimakade iNkosi yabo, nayo yonke imithetho nezimiso zakhe; uma besephula leso sifungo, siyophenduka isiqalekiso.
“Asiyukubaganisela abezizwe amadodakazi ethu, futhi ngeke siwathathele amadodana ethu abafazi kubo.

Uma abezizwe besilethela okuthengisayo noma yini okusanhlamvu ngesabatha, asiyukukuthenga ngesabatha noma ngaluphi usuku olungcwele, futhi asiyukuvuna ngonyaka wesikhombisa; sesule zonke izikweletu ngalowo nyaka.
“Siyazibophezela ukuthi njalo ngonyaka, siyonikela ingxenye yesithathu yeshekeli, ibe ngeyomsebenzi wendlu kaNkulunkulu wethu,

eyosetshenziselwa ukubhaka isinkwa esibekwa ethempelini, neminikelo yansuku zonke yokusanhlamvu neyokushiswa, neminikelo yangeSabatha, nemikhosi yokwethwasa kwenyanga, neminye imikhosi emisiweyo, neminikelo yesono eyenzelwa inhlawulo yezono zika-Israyeli, nawo wonke umsebenzi wasendlini kaNkulunkulu wethu.

“Thina baphristi, abaLevi, nabantu bonke, senze unkatho lokuthi minyaka yonke silethe umnikelo wezinkuni endlini kaNkulunkulu wethu, ngokwezindlu zokhokho, ngezikhathi ezinqunyiweyo, ukuze zibaswe phezu kwe-althare likaSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu, njengokulotshwe emthethweni.
Unyaka nonyaka, sizibophezela ukwethula izithelo zokuqala zesivuno somhlabathi wethu nesemithi yonke enhlobonhlobo endlini kaSimakade.
Siyoletha kubaphristi abakhonza endlini kaNkulunkulu wethu, amazibulo amadodana ethu, awemfuyo yethu, njengoba kulotshiwe emthethweni, amazibulo emihlambi yethu, nawezimvu zethu.

Siyoletha futhi kumphristi emagunjini endlu kaNkulunkulu wethu, inhlama eyenziwe ngokusanhlamvu kwesivuno sokuqala, nezithelo zayo yonke imithi, iwayini elisha namafutha amasha. Siyoletha futhi kubaLevi okweshumi komhlabathi wethu, ngokuba ngabaLevi abaqoqa okweshumi emizini yonke.
Abaphristi bozalo luka-Aroni kumele bahambe nabaLevi ngesikhathi beqoqa okweshumi, abaLevi bathathe okweshumi kulokho okweshumi okulethiwe, bakuyise endlini kaNkulunkulu, emagunjini endlu yengcebo.

Abakwa-Israyeli nabaLevi bayoletha okweshumi kokusanhlamvu, okwewayini namafutha omnqumo emagunjini lapho kugcinwe khona izitsha zendlu engcwele, nalapho kuhlala khona abaphristi, abalindisango nabaculi. Asiyukuyishiya indlu kaNkulunkulu wethu.”
Abaholi babantu bahlala eJerusalema; abantu abaseleyo benza unkatho, bakhetha oyedwa kwabalishumi ukuba ayohlala eJerusalema, umuzi ongcwele, nabayisishiyagalolunye emizini yakubo.
Abantu babusisa bonke abantu abazinikela ukuhlala eJerusalema.

Nazi izinhloko zezifundazwe ezazihlala eJerusalema, kodwa emizini yakwaJuda bonke babehlala ezindaweni zabo: abakwa-Israyeli, abaphristi, abaLevi, izisebenzi zasethempelini, nabozalo lwezinceku zikaSolomoni.
EJerusalema kwakuhlala abathile bakwaJuda nabakwaBhenjamini: ozalweni lukaJuda: ngu-Athaya ka-Uziya, kaZakhariya, ka-Amariya, kaShefathiya, kaMahalalele wozalo lukaPherezi;
noMahaseya kaBharukhi, kaKholi Hoze, kaHazaya, ka-Adaya, kaJoyaribhi, kaZakhariya, indodana yomShiloni.
Bonke abozalo lukaPherezi ababehlala eJerusalema kwakungamadoda anamandla angama-468.
Abozalo lukaBhenjamini: nguSalu kaMeshulamu, kaJohedi, kaPhedaya, kaKolaya, kaMahaseya, ka-Ithiyeli, kaJeshaya.
Emva kwakhe: nguGabhayi noSalayi, bengama-928.
UJoweli, indodana kaZikhiri, wayengumphathi wabo, uJuda, indodana kaHasenuwa, wayephethe ingxenye entsha yomuzi.
Kubaphristi: nguJedaya, indodana kaJoyaribhi, uJakhini,
noSeraya kaHilikiya, kaMeshulamu, kaZadoki, kaMerayothi, ka-Ahithubi, umphathi wendlu kaNkulunkulu;
nabafowabo abaqhubeka benza umsebenzi wasethempelini, bengamadoda angama-822, no-Adaya kaJerohamu, kaPhelaliya, ka-Amizi, kaZakhariya, kaPhashuri, kaMalikhiya;
nabafowabo ababeyizinhloko zemindeni, bengamadoda angama-242, no-Amashisayi ka-Azareli, ka-Ahizayi, kaMeshilemothi, ka-Imeri;
nabafowabo, amaqhawe anamandla ayeyi-128. Umphathi wabo omkhulu kwakunguZabhidiyeli, indodana kaHagedolimi.
KubaLevi: uShemaya kaHashubhi, ka-Azirikamu, kaHashabhiya, kaBhuni;
uShabhethayi noJozabhadi beyizinhloko zabaLevi ababephethe umsebenzi wangaphandle wendlu kaNkulunkulu,
noMathaniya kaMikha, kaZabhidi, ka-Asafa, induna yomkhuleko wokubonga, noBhakibhukiya, owesibili phakathi kwabafowabo, no-Abhida kaShamuwa kaGalali kaJeduthuni.
Bonke abaLevi abasemzini ongcwele babengama-284.
Abalindisango: ngu-Akubhi, uThalimoni, nabafowabo ababelinda ngasemasangweni, babeyi-172.
Abakwa-Israyeli abaseleyo, abaphristi nabaLevi, babekuyo yonke imizi yakwaJuda, yilowo endaweni eyifa lakhe.
Izisebenzi zasethempelini ezazihlala e-Ofeli, nguZiha noGishipha yibona ababeziphethe.
Umphathi wabaLevi eJerusalema kwakungu-Uzi kaBhani, kaHashabhiya, kaMathaniya, kaMikha wabozalo luka-Asafa, abaculi, ephethe umsebenzi wendlu kaNkulunkulu.
Abaculi babephethwe ngumyalelo wenkosi owawuqondisa abakwenzayo nsuku zonke.
UPhethahiya, indodana kaMeshezabheli, wabozalo lukaZera, indodana kaJuda, wayemele inkosi ezindabeni zonke eziphathelene nabantu.
Maqondana nemizana namasimu ayo, kwahlala abanye abantu bakwaJuda: eKiriyathi Arbha nasemizaneni yalo, eDibhoni nasemizaneni yalo, eJekabhizeyeli nasemizaneni yalo,
eJeshuwa, eMolada, eBhethi Phelethi,
eHazari Shuwali, eBheri Sheba nasemizaneni yalo,
eZikilagi, eMekhona nasemizaneni yalo,
e-Eni Rimoni, eZora, eJarimuthi,
eZanowa, e-Adulamu nasemizaneni yawo, eLakhishi namasimu alo, e-Azeka nasemizaneni yalo. Bamisa kusukela eBheri Sheba kuze kube sesigodini SikaHinomu.
Abozalo lukaBhenjamini, kusukela eGebha, bahlala eMikhimashi, e-Ayi, eBhethele nasemizaneni yalo,
e-Anathothi, eNobhi, e-Ananiya,
eHazori, eRama, eGithayimi,
eHadidi, eZebhoyimi, eNebhalathi,
eLodi nase-Ono, iSigodi Sababazi.
Elinye iqembu labaLevi bakwaJuda lahlala kwaBhenjamini.
Nampa abaphristi nabaLevi ababuya noZerubhabhele, indodana kaSheyalitiyeli noJeshuwa: uSeraya, uJeremiya, u-Ezra,
u-Amariya, uMalukhi, uHathushi,
uShekhaniya, uRehumi, uMeremothi,
u-Ido, uGinethoyi, u-Abhiya,
uMijamini, uMahadiya, uBhiliga,
uShemaya, uJoyaribi, uJedaya,
uSalu, u-Amoki, uHilikiya noJedaya. Labo babeyizinhloko zabaphristi nezabafowabo, emihleni kaJeshuwa.
AbaLevi: uJeshuwa, uBhinuwi, uKadimiyeli, uSherebhiya, uJuda, uMathaniya owayengamele amahubo okudumisa, nabangani bakhe,
uBhakibhukiya, u-Uno nabafowabo, bemaqondana nabo ngezigaba.
UJeshuwa wazala uJoyakimi; uJoyakimi wazala u-Eliyashibhi; u-Eliyashibhi wazala uJoyada;
uJoyada wazala uJonathani; uJonathani wazala uJaduwa.
Emihleni kaJoyakimi, izinhloko zoyise babaphristi kwakuyilezi: ekaSeraya: nguMeraya; ekaJeremiya: nguHananiya;
eka-Ezra: nguMeshulamu; eka-Amariya: nguJehohanani;
ekaMalukhi: nguJonathani; ekaShebhaniya: nguJosefa;
ekaHarimi: ngu-Adina; ekaMerayothi: nguHelekayi;
eka-Ido: nguZakhariya; ekaGinethoni: nguMeshulamu;
eka-Abhiya: nguZikhiri; ekaMiniyamini, ekaMohadiya: nguPhilithayi;
ekaBhiliga: nguShamuwa; ekaShemaya: nguJehonathani;
ekaJoyaribhi: nguMathenayi; ekaJedaya: ngu-Uzi;
ekaSalayi: nguKalayi; eka-Amoki: ngu-Ebhere;
ekaHilikiya: nguHashabhiya; ekaJedaya: nguNethaneli.
AbaLevi babhalwa emihleni ka-Eliyashibhi, noJoyada, noJohanani, noJaduwa; njengezinhloko zemindeni yoyise nabaphristi ekubuseni kukaDariyu, umPheresiya.
Abozalo lukaLevi izinhloko zoyise abalotshwa encwadini yezindaba zemihla ngemihla, kwaze kwaba sezinsukwini zikaJohanani indodana ka-Eliyashibhi.
Izinhloko zabaLevi nazi: uHashabhiya, uSherebhiya noJeshuwa, indodana kaKadimiyeli, nabafowabo bebhekene nabo bedumisa, bebonga njengemiyalo kaDavide, umuntu kaNkulunkulu, isigaba sibhekene nesigaba.
UMathaniya, uBhakibhukiya, u-Obhadiya, uMeshulamu, uThalimoni no-Akhubhi babengabalindisango, belinda izindlu zokubekelela ngasemasangweni.
Labo babekhona ezinsukwini zikaJoyakimi, indodana kaJeshuwa, kaJozadaki, nasezinsukwini zikaNehemiya umbusi, nomphristi u-Ezra, umbhali.

Ngomkhosi wokubusiswa kogange eJerusalema abaLevi bafunwa ezindaweni zabo zonke, ukuba bayiswe eJerusalema ukuyogubha umkhosi ngentokozo, ngokubonga, ngokuhlabelela, ngamasimbali, ngezigubhu nangamahabhu.
Amaqembu abaculi abuthana evela ethafeni elalizungeze iJerusalema, nasemizaneni yabaLevi,
naseBhethi Giligali, nasemasimini eGebha, nase-Azimavethi, ngokuba babezakhele imizana nxazonke zeJerusalema.
Abaphristi nabaLevi base bezihlambulula; bahlambulula nabantu, amasango nogange.
Ngase nginyusela phezu kogange abaholi bakwaJuda, ngabeka izigaba ezimbili ezinkulu ezazibonga, zahlaba ihele; esinye sahamba ngakwesokunene sogange, saya ngaseSangweni Lomquba;
emva kwaso kwahamba uHoshaya nengxenye yabaholi bakwaJuda,
u-Azariya, u-Ezra, uMeshulamu,
uJuda, uBhenjamini, uShemaya, uJeremiya
namadodana athile abaphristi ephethe amacilongo: uZakhariya kaJonathani, kaShemaya, kaMathaniya, kaMikhaya, kaZakhuri, ka-Asafa
nabafowabo uShemaya, u-Azareli, uMilalayi, uGilalayi, uMahayi, uNethaneli, uJuda noHanani, bephethe izinto zokubethwa zikaDavide, umuntu kaNkulunkulu; u-Ezra, umbhali, engaphambi kwabo.
NgaseSangweni Lomthombo, phambi kwabo, bakhuphuka ngezikhwelo zomuzi kaDavide, ezikhwelweni zogange, ngasenhla kwendlu kaDavide, kwaze kwaba seSangweni Lamanzi, empumalanga.
Esinye isigaba saya ngakwesokhohlo, mina ngasilandela nengxenye yabantu ogangeni, ngasenhla kombhoshongo wezithando, kwaze kwaba soGangeni Olubanzi,

nangenhla kweSango Lakwa-Efrayimi, naseSangweni Elidala, eSangweni Lenhlanzi, eMbhoshongweni KaHananeli, eMbhoshongweni KaHameya, naseMbhoshongweni Wekhulu, kwaze kwaba seSangweni Lezimvu; bema eSangweni Lejele.
Zase zima endlini kaNkulunkulu lezo zigaba zombili zababongayo, nami nezikhulu engangihamba nazo;
nabaphristi u-Eliyakimi, uMahaseya, uMiniyamini, uMikhaya, u-Eliyohenayi, uZakhariya, noHananiya, bephethe amacilongo,
noMahaseya, uShemaya, u-Eleyazare, u-Uzi, uJehohanani, uMalikhiya, u-Elamu, no-Ezeri. Abahlabeleli bahlabelela bebhidiswa ngumphathi wabo, uJizirahiya.
Banikela ngemihlatshelo emikhulu ngalolo lusuku, bathokoza, ngokuba uNkulunkulu wayebathokozise ngentokozo enkulu; abesifazane nabantwana bathokoza, kwezwakala kude ukuthokoza kweJerusalema.

Ngalolo lusuku kwaqokwa amadoda okuqapha amagumbi lapho kwakugcinwe khona izipho ethempelini; izithelo zokuqala, nokweshumi kwamabele, nokwezithelo, minyaka yonke. Lawo madoda ayehambele yonke imizi ukuyoqoqa umkhiqizo owawunikelelwa ukunakekela abaphristi nabaLevi, njengalokhu kubhaliwe emthethweni. Bonke abantu bakwaJuda babewuthokozela umsebenzi owenziwa ngabaphristi nabaLevi,
ngoba yibona ababenza isiko lokuhlanza abantu ngokwemithetho kaNkulunkulu wabo, njengoba kwakwenza abahlabeleli nabalindisango, ngokomyalo kaDavide noSolomoni, indodana yakhe.
Kusukela kudala, ngezinsuku zikaDavide no-Asafa, kwakunabaholi babaculi, behola amaculo okudumisa nokubonga uNkulunkulu,

ezinsukwini zikaZerubhabhele noNehemiya, wonke u-Israyeli wanikela ingxenye yansuku zonke ukubonelela abaculi nabalindisango. Bahlukanisa lokho okwakungokwabaLevi, nabaLevi bakuhlukanisela abozalo luka-Aroni.

Ngalolo lusuku abantu bafundelwa incwadi yomthetho kaMose, kwafika endaweni lapho okwakubhalwe khona ukuthi akukho muntu wakwa-Amoni noma wakwaMowabi okufanele avunyelwe nanini ukuba yingxenye yebandla labantu bakaNkulunkulu,
ngoba labo bantu benqaba ukunika abakwa-Israyeli ukudla namanzi, kunalokho baqasha uBhalamu ukuba abaqalekise, kodwa uNkulunkulu wethu waguqula isiqalekiso saba yisibusiso.
Kwathi abantu sebekuzwile okushiwo ngumthetho, babaxosha bonke abantu ababenokhokho abaxubileyo, bashiya abakwa-Israyeli boqobo.
Ngaphambi kwalokho, u-Eliyashibhi, umphristi owayengamele amagumbi endlu kaNkulunkulu wethu, eyisihlobo sikaThobiya,

walungisela uThobiya igumbi elikhulu lapho kwakubekwa khona umnikelo wokusanhlamvu, impepho, izitsha, okweshumi kokusanhlamvu, iwayini, amafutha, okwakunikwe ngokomthetho abaLevi, abaculi, abalindisango neminikelo yabaphristi.
