Ngaleso sikhathi ngangingekho eJerusalema, ngokuba ngonyaka wama-32 wokubusa kuka-Arithahishashitha, ngabuyela kuye ngayombikela ngokwakwenzekile. Emuva kwesikhathi ngacela imvume enkosini,
ngase ngiphindela eJerusalema. Ngafika ngabona into embi eyenziwa ngu-Eliyashibhi, elungisela uThobiya igumbi emagcekeni endlu kaNkulunkulu.
Ngathukuthela kakhulu, ngazijikijela phandle izimpahla zikaThobiya ezazisendlini.
Ngase ngiyala abaphristi ukuba bahlanze lezo zindlu, babuyisele izitsha zasendlini, neminikelo yokusanhlamvu nempepho.
Ngabuye ngezwa nokuthi abanye abaLevi nabaculi ababesebenza ethempelini sebehambile bayosebenza emasimini abo, ngoba abantu base beyekile ukuba babanike isabelo sabo.
Ngabathethisa abaholi, ngathi kubo: “Yini eyenze ukuba nilahle indlu kaNkulunkulu na?” Ngawaqoqa lawo madoda, ngawabuyisela emsebenzini wawo ayewenza endlini kaNkulunkulu.
Bonke abantu bakwaJuda base beqala futhi ukunikela okweshumi kokusanhlamvu, iwayini elisha namafutha amasha, kwafakwa ezinqolobaneni.

Ngaqoka amanye amadoda ukuba abe ngabagcinimafa bezinqolobane: uShelemiya umphristi, uZadoki ungoti kwezomthetho noPhedaya umLevi. UHanani, indodana kaZakhuri indodana kaMathaniya, wayezoba ngumsizi wabo. Lawo madoda ngangiwethemba ukuthi ayezoba qotho lapho esehlukaniselana nabanye ayesebenza nabo.
Nkulunkulu wami, ngikhumbule kulokhu, ungakhohlwa ukwethembeka engikwenzile, ngikwenzela indlu yakho nomsebenzi owenziwa kuyo.

Ngalezo zinsuku ngabona abantu kwaJuda bekhama amagilebhisi ngeSabatha. Abanye babethwese izimbongolo zabo okusanhlamvu, iwayini, amagilebhisi, amakhiwane nezinye izinto, bekuyisa eJerusalema; ngabexwayisa ukuthi bangathengisi lutho ngeSabatha.
Kwakukhona futhi idlanzana labantu baseThire, ababehlala eJerusalema, bethengisa izinhlanzi nokunye, bekuthengisela abantu bakwaJuda emzini ngeSabatha.
Ngabathethisa abaholi bakwaJuda, ngathi kubo: “Nibenzelani lobu bubi bokungcolisa iSabatha na?
Akuyibo yini lobu bubi noyihlo ababenza, obalethela thina nalo muzi inhlekelele na? Manje nani niyaqhubeka nigovuza ulaka lukaNkulunkulu ukuba amelane no-Israyeli ngokuthi ningcolise iSabatha na?”

Manje sengishaya umthetho wokuthi amasango eJerusalema ahluthulelwe ngaphambi kokuqala kweSabatha, aze avulwe lapho sekwedlule iSabatha. Ngizobeka ezinye zezinceku zami emasangweni ukuze zibheke ukuthi akukho lutho olungeniswa emzini ngeSabatha.
Abahwebi nabathengisi nayo yonke impahla yabo babehlala ngaphandle kweJerusalema ebusuku, kanye noma kabili,
kodwa ngabenqabela, ngathi: “Yini eyenza nibe seceleni kogange ebusuku na? Uma niphinda nikwenza lokho ngizonibopha.” Kusukela ngalolo suku abaphindanga balala lapho ngasogangeni ebusuku.
Ngayala abaLevi ukuba bazingcwelise, kube yibo abaqapha emasangweni ebusuku ukuze kugcinwe usuku lweSabatha lungcwele. Ungikhumbule Nkulunkulu wami, ube nomusa kimi ngokuba mkhulu umusa wakho.
Ngalezo zinsuku, ngabona abanye abaJuda abasebeganwe ngabesifazane base-Ashidodi, kwa-Amoni nakwaMowabi.
Ingxenye yezingane zabo yayikhuluma ulimi lwase-Ashidodi kuphela, ingaluzwa ulimi lwakubo.

Ngawathethisa lawo madoda, ngawaqalekisa, amanye ngawashaya, ngawahluthula izinwele, ngathi awenze isifungo kuNkulunkulu: “Aniyukuwaganisela amadodana abo ngamadodakazi enu, futhi aniyukuwathathela amadodana enu, noma nizithathele nina abafazi emadodakazini abo.

USolomoni, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli, akonanga yini ngenxa yabesifazane na? Phakathi kwezizwe eziningi, ayikho inkosi eyayifana naye. Nanxa uNkulunkulu ayemthanda waze wambeka inkosi ka-Israyeli, wadukiswa ngamakhosikazi akhe abezizwe.
Nani senenza isono esifanayo; nihlubuka uNkulunkulu ngokuganwa ngabafazi babezizwe na?”
UJehoyada, indodana ka-Eliyashibhi, umphristi omkhulu, wavumela indodana yakhe ukuba iganwe yindodakazi kaSanibhalathi waseBhethi Horoni, ngakho-ke ngamxosha.
Nkulunkulu wami, ungawakhohlwa lawo madoda ukuthi abungcolise kanjani ubuphristi nesivumelwano sabaphristi nabaLevi.
Abaphristi nabaLevi ngabahlambulula kukho konke ukungcola kwabezizwe. Ngamisa futhi imisebenzi eyehlukene yabaphristi nabaLevi, yilowo nalowo enomsebenzi wakhe.
Ngabuye ngahlela ukulethwa kwezinkuni ngezikhathi ezimisiweyo, nokwethulwa kwesivuno sokuqala. Nkulunkulu wami, ngikhumbule ngokuhle engikwenzileyo.
Lokhu kwenzeka ngesikhathi sokubusa kwenkosi u-Ahasheveroshi; lona ngu-Ahasheveroshi owayebusa izifundazwe eziyi-127, kusukela eNdiya kuye eKhushe.
Inkosi u-Ahasheveroshi, ngaleso sikhathi, yayibusa ihlezi esihlalweni sayo esasisenhlokomuzi yayo, iShushani,
kwathi ngonyaka wesithathu wokubusa kwayo, yenzela zonke izikhulu zayo nezinceku zayo idili, abombutho wempi yasePheresiya naseMediya, izikhulu nababusi bezifundazwe, babelapho.
Izinsuku eziningi ezaba yi-180, yayibukisa ngomcebo wayo, nodumo lombuso wayo, nobukhazikhazi nangengcebo yobukhulu bayo.

Ekupheleni kwalezo zinsuku, inkosi yenzela bonke abantu ababelapho eShushani, inhlokomuzi yayo, idili, abantukazana nezikhulu; idili elathatha izinsuku eziyisikhombisa yalenzela egcekeni lengadi yesigodlo sayo.

Igceke lalihlotshiswe ngamakhethini kakotini amhlophe naluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, kunemichilo yelineni elicolekileyo nebukhwebezane, kuboshelwe kokusandilinga kwesiliva ezikwedlaneni zemabuli. Izihlalo zokuphumula ezenziwe ngegolide nesiliva zibekwe egcekeni elaligandaywe ngemabuli emhlophe, amagwadle abomvu, amagobolondo ahlotshiswe ngaphakathi acwebezelayo, netshe eliyigugu eliluhlaza sasibhakabhaka.
Okuphuzwayo kwakuthungelwa ezindebeni zegolide ezahlukahlukene, iwayini laliliningi njengokufanele inkosi.
Okuphuzwayo kwakhishwa ngokomthetho, akekho owayephoqwa; ngokuba inkosi yayiyale zonke izikhulu zayo zasesigodlweni ukuba zenzele wonke umuntu ngokufisa kwakhe.
Indlovukazi uVashiti yabenzela idili abesifazane basesigodlweni senkosi u-Ahasheveroshi.
Ngosuku lwesikhombisa, inkosi seyeneme kakhulu ngenxa yewayini, yayala abathenwa ababengabasizi bayo, uMehumani, uBhizitha, uHaribhora, uBhigitha, u-Abigitha, uZethari noKarikhasi,
ukuba balethe indlovukazi uVashiti ifake umqhele wobundlovukazi. Indlovukazi yayingowesifazane omuhle, inkosi yayifuna ukubukisa ngobuhle bayo kubantu nasezikhulwini.
Kodwa indlovukazi uVashiti yenqaba ukuza njengoba kwakuyaleze inkosi kubathenwa. Lokho kwayenza inkosi yathukuthela kakhulu, yabhodla umlilo.
Kwakuwumkhuba wenkosi ukubuza maqondana nezinto eziphathelene nomthetho nokwehlulela, kubeluleki,
abaseduze nayo, uKarishena, uShetari, u-Adimatha, uTharishishi, uMeresi, uMarisena noMemukhani, okwakuyibona ababeyisiza, futhi beyizethenjwa zayo.
Yabuza yathi kubo: “Njengoba ngithumele abathenwa ukuba bayolanda indlovukazi uVashiti, kodwa ayiwugqizanga qakala umyalelo wami, ngabe uthini umthetho maqondana nalolo daba na?”
UMemukhani wayesethi phambi kwenkosi nezikhulu: “UVashiti akadelelanga nje inkosi kuphela, kodwa wedelele zonke izikhulu nabantu bonke abasezifundazweni zenkosi u-Ahasheveroshi.
Uma abesifazane bakuzo zonke izizwe bezwa ukuthi uVashiti uziphathe kanje, kuzobenza ukuthi bonke abesifazane bangabe besabahlonipha abayeni babo, ngoba inkosi imbizile, yena wenqaba ukuza kuyo.
Khona namuhla amakhosikazi ezikhulu zamaPheresiya namaMediya, uma ezwa ngokuziphatha kwendlovukazi, azomelana nezikhulu zenkosi, kube nendelelo nentukuthelo.

Uma kukuhle kuwe nkosi, mawukhiphe isimemezelo sasebukhosini, sibhalwe emthethweni ukuthi uVashiti uyamenqabela ukuba aphinde angene lapho inkosi ikhona, kube wumthetho wamaPheresiya namaMediya ongaguquki, bese inkosi ithatha enye indlovukazi engcono kunaye.
Uma abantu kuwo wonke umbuso wakithi, njengoba umkhulu kangaka, bezwa ngaleso simemezelo, bonke abesifazane, noma ngabe bangabantukazana noma yizikhulu, bayobahlonipha abayeni babo.”
Leso seluleko sikaMemukhani sayithokozisa inkosi nezikhulu zayo, inkosi yenza njengoba eyelulekile uMemukhani,

yathumela izincwadi kuzo zonke izifundazwe, kuleso naleso sifundazwe, ngokohlelo lokubhala lwakhona, nakulabo bantu ngolimi lwakubo, sigcizelela ukuthi: onke amadoda angomakhonya emizini yawo, nokuthi wulimi lwesizwe sakubo oluzokhulunywa kulelo khaya.
Emveni kwalezo zinto, selubohlile ulaka lwenkosi u-Ahasheveroshi, yakhumbula uVashiti nayekwenzile, nokuthi kwakhishwa simemezelo sini ngaye.
Izinsizwa ezazisiza inkosi zathi kuyo: “Inkosi mayifunelwe izintombi ezinhle.

Inkosi iqoke izikhulu kuzo zonke izifundazwe embusweni wayo, ukuba ziqoqe zonke izintombi ezibukekayo, zilethwe esigodlweni kuHegayi, umthenwa, okunguyena owengamele indlu yabesifazane, azinike izimonyo zazo.
Inkosi mayikhethe intombi eyoyithanda, ibe yindlovukazi esikhundleni sikaVashithi.” Sayithokozisa inkosi leso seluleko, yenza kanjalo.
Kwakukhona eShushani inhlokomuzi, uMoridekhayi umJuda, indodana kaJayiri, kaShimeyi, kaKhishi wakwaBhenjamini,
owayethunjwe eJerusalema nguNebukhadinezari, inkosi yaseBhabhele, ngesikhathi ithumba uJekhoniya, inkosi yakwaJuda.
Wayenomzala ogama lakhe lingu-Esteri, elesiHebheru kunguHadasa, owayemuhle futhi eme kahle. Uyise nonina babengasekho, ngakho-ke uMoridekhayi wamthatha wamkhulisa njengendodakazi yakhe.

Kwathi sesiphumile isimemezelo senkosi, kwalethwa izintombi eziningi ekomkhulu eShushani, ukuba zibhekwe nguHegayi; no-Esteri walethwa esigodlweni ukuba azobhekwa nguHegayi owayengamele indlu yabesifazane.

U-Esteri waba nogazi, wathandeka kuHegayi, futhi wafumana umusa kuye, washeshe wamnika okokuziqhola nesabelo sakhe sokudla kwekhethelo. Wamnika indawo enhle kakhulu esigodlweni, waqoka izintombi eziyisikhombisa ezikhethekile esigodlweni ukuba zimnakekele.
U-Esteri akatshelanga muntu ngezihlobo zakhe noma ngabakubo, ngoba wayemdonse ngendlebe uMoridekhayi ukuba angasho lutho.
Nsuku zonke uMoridekhayi wayezidlisa satshanyana ngasesangweni lendlu yabesifazane, ukuze ahogele ukuthi uqhuba kanjani u-Esteri, nokuthi yini ezokwenzeka kuye.

Ukucolwa kwabesifazane kwakuvamise ukuthatha isikhathi esingunyaka. Izinyanga eziyisithupha zokuqala, owesifazane wayegcotshwa ngamafutha emure, kuthi ngezilandelayo aqholwe ngamafutha ebhalisamu. Uma sekwenziwe lokho, intombi ngayinye yayithathwa ingeniswe enkosini u-Ahasheveroshi.
Uma isuka endlini yabesifazane iya esigodlweni, yayigqoka noma yini eyithandayo.

Yayiya lapho kusihlwa, kuthi ngakusasa ekuseni iyiswe kwenye indlu iyonakekelwa nguShawashigazi, umthenwa owayengamele izancinza zenkosi. Yayingeke iphinde ingene enkosini, ngaphandle kokuba inkosi iyithandile, yayibiza ngegama.

Laze lafika nethuba lika-Esteri indodakazi ka-Abhihayili, umfowabo kaMoridekhayi. UMoridekhayi wayemkhulise kwangathi yindodakazi yakhe. U-Esteri akazange acele lutho ngaphandle kwalokho uHegayi, umthenwa owayephethe, ayethe akakusebenzise. Bonke ababembona babethatheka ngubuhle bakhe.
Wasiwa enkosini u-Ahasheveroshi ngenyanga yeshumi, inyanga okuthiwa uThebhethi, ngonyaka wesikhombisa wokubusa kwayo.

Inkosi yamthanda kakhulu ukwedlula bonke abesifazane; wafumana umusa emehlweni ayo, yamphatha kahle ukuzedlula zonke izintombi. Yamethwesa umqhele wobukhosi yamenza indlovukazi esikhundleni sikaVashithi.
Inkosi yenzela zonke izikhulu zayo nezinceku zayo idili: “Idili lika-Esteri.” Lolo lusuku lwaba yiholide ezifundazweni, futhi yapha abantu izipho njengobuningi bengcebo yasebukhosini.
Lapho izintombi ziqoqwa okwesibili, uMoridekhayi wayehleli esangweni lenkosi.

U-Esteri wayengakaze atshele muntu ukuthi ungumJuda, nokuthi bangobani abomndeni wakubo, njengoba uMoridekhayi ayemyalile, ngoba wayengachezuki eziyalweni zikaMoridekhayi njengangesikhathi esahlala naye.
Ngelinye ilanga uMoridekhayi ehleli esangweni lesigodlo, uBhigithana noThereshi, abathenwa ababili ababeqapha isango lendlu yenkosi, babenokukhononda ngenkosi, ngakho-ke benza uzungu lokuyibulala.
Wayesesuka uMoridekhayi wayobikela indlovukazi u-Esteri, yona yabikela inkosi ngaleyo ndaba eyayiyitshelwe nguMoridekhayi.
Lwaphenywa lolo daba kwatholakala ukuthi luyiqiniso, ngakho-ke laba bathenwa ababili balengiswa esiphanyekweni. Le ndaba yabhalwa phansi emilandweni yenkosi phambi kwayo.
Emveni kwalezo zinto, inkosi u-Ahasheveroshi yaqokela esikhundleni esiphezulu uHamani, indodana kaHamedatha, umAgagi, yamenza umengameli wazo zonke izikhulu ezikanye naye.
Zonke izikhulu zenkosi ezazisesangweni layo zaziguqa, zikhothamele uHamani njengokusho kwenkosi. UMoridekhayi nokho akazange amguqele noma amkhothamele uHamani.
Izikhulu zenkosi ezazisesangweni zambuza uMoridekhayi, zathi: “Kungani weqa umyalo wenkosi na?”
Nanxa zazikhuluma naye nsuku zonke zimbuza, uMoridekhayi akazange azilalele. Zase zihamba zayotshela uHamani ukuze zizwe ukuthi uMoridekhayi uzoma yini emazwini akhe okuthi ungumJuda.
UHamani ebona ukuthi uMoridekhayi akamguqeli, futhi akamkhothameli, wacasuka kakhulu.
Wakubona kungenele ukuthi enzakalise uMoridekhayi kuphela, ngoba wayesezwile ukuthi ungumJuda, wenza icebo lokubulala bonke abaJuda, abantu bakubo kaMoridekhayi ababehlala embusweni ka-Ahasheveroshi.

Ngenyanga yokuqala, inyanga uNisani, ngonyaka we-12 wokubusa kuka-Ahasheveroshi, benza iPhure (unkatho) phambi kukaHamani, imihla ngemihla, nyanga zonke, ukuze abone ukuthi isu lakhe liyolunga, liphumelele ngayiphi inyanga nangaluphi usuku. Waqoka ukuba lokho kwenziwe ngenyanga ye-12, inyanga u-Adari.

UHamani wayesethi enkosini u-Ahasheveroshi: “Kukhona isizwe esithile esihlakazakele kuzo zonke izifundazwe zombuso wakho, sinemithetho eyehlukile kweyezizwe zonke. Siyishaya indiva imithetho yombuso wakho. Akulungile ukuba inkosi isiyeke siqhubeke.
Uma kukuhle enkosini, makulotshwe ukuba sibhujiswe, mina ngizokhokha amathalenta ayizi-10 000 esiliva kulabo abenza umsebenzi wenkosi, ukuze afakwe engcebeni yenkosi.”
Inkosi yase ikhipha indandatho yokusicilela emunweni wayo, yayinika uHamani, indodana kaHamedatha, umAgagi, isitha sabaJuda.
Yathi kuHamani: “Isiliva ngelakho nabantu, yenza ngakho njengoba ubona kufanele.”

Kuthe ngosuku lwe-13 ngenyanga yokuqala, kwabizwa bonke onobhala benkosi. UHamani wabayala ukuba babhale konke ayebatshela khona, bakuhumushele kuzo zonke izilimi, ezincwadini eziya kuzo zonke izifundazwe, bese bekuthumelela iziphathimandla zenkosi, nababusi, nabaholi babantu, nakuzo zonke izifundazwe; kwabhalwa egameni lenkosi u-Ahasheveroshi, kwasicilelwa ngendandatho yayo.

Lezo zincwadi zanikwa izigijimi, zathunyelwa kuzo zonke izifundazwe zenkosi. Umyalelo wawuthi kumele kubulawe bonke abaJuda, abancane nabadala, nezinsana nabesifazane, ngalusuku lunye okwakungolwe-13, ngenyanga ye-12, inyanga u-Adari, nempahla yabo ibe yimpango.
Kwakukhona nomyalo othi kumele kwenziwe nezinye izincwadi zaleso sinqumo, zisiwe kuzo zonke izifundazwe kube ngumthetho, ukuze bonke abantu bazi ngawo, bame ngomumo ngalolo lusuku.
Izigijimi zashesha njengoba zaziyalwe yinkosi; kwashaywa umthetho enhlokomuzi iShushani. Inkosi noHamani bahlala phansi baphuza, kodwa kwaba nokudideka okukhulu emzini iShushani.
Kwathi ukuba uMoridekhayi ezwe ngakho konke okwakwenzekile, waklebhula izingubo zakhe, wagqoka isaka, wazithela ngomlotha ekhanda, wazulazula emzini ekhala kakhulu nakalusizi.
Wahamba waya esangweni lesigodlo senkosi, ngokuba akekho owayevunyelwe ukungena ngalo egqoke indwangu eyisaka.

Kuzo zonke izifundazwe lapho kwafinyelela khona izwi lenkosi nomthetho wayo, kwaba nomsindo wokulila okukhulu kubaJuda; bazila ukudla, bakhala, balila, iningi labo lalala phansi ligqoke indwangu eyisaka, lazithela ngomlotha.
Izintombi eziyizisebenzi zika-Esteri nabathenwa bamazisa ngalokho, waphatheka kabi kakhulu, wamthumelela izingubo uMoridekhayi ukuze akhumule indwangu eyisaka, agqoke zona, kodwa wazenqaba.

U-Esteri wayesebiza uHathakhi, omunye wabathenwa basesigodlweni, inkosi eyayimqokele ukusebenzela indlovukazi, ukuba ayobuza kuMoridekhayi ukuthi kwenzenjani, nokuthi yini eyenza aziphathe ngalolo hlobo na?
UHathakhi waya kuMoridekhayi owayesesigcawini somuzi, phambi kwesango lesigodlo.
UMoridekhayi wamtshela konke okwakumehlele, nangesamba sesiliva uHamani ayethembise ukusikhokha esikhwameni senkosi ukuze kubhujiswe abaJuda.
UMoridekhayi wamnika ifuzela lesimemezelo esasibhalwe sakhishwa eShushani ukuba kubhujiswe abaJuda, ukuze alikhombise u-Esteri, bese emyala ukuthi aye enkosini ayonxusela abantu bakubo.
UHathakhi wahamba wayotshela u-Esteri lokho okwakushiwo nguMoridekhayi.
U-Esteri watshela uHathakhi umyalezo okwakufanele ukuba awuse kuMoridekhayi, othi:

“Zonke izikhulu zenkosi nalezo ezihlala ezifundazweni ziyazi ukuthi noma ngabe ngowesilisa noma ngowesifazane ongena egcekeni lenkosi elingaphakathi engabiziwe yiyo, ubhekana namthetho munye ofanayo wokuba abulawe, ngaphandle uma inkosi imkhombe ngentonga yayo yegolide, lowo angaphila. Kodwa mina ayingibizile inkosi kulezi zinsuku ezingama-30.”
Bambikela uMoridekhayi ngokwakushiwo ngu-Esteri.
Wayesebuyisela impendulo ngabo, ethi ku-Esteri: “Ungacabangi ukuthi ngoba wena usesigodlweni uzosinda kubo bonke abaJuda.

Uma uthula ngesikhathi esifana nalesi, usizo nokukhululwa kwabaJuda kuzovela ndawana thize, kodwa wena nabendlu kayihlo nizobhubha. Ngubani owaziyo? Mhlawumbe ungene embusweni waba yindlovukazi ngenxa yesikhathi esifana nalesi.”
U-Esteri wawuphendula umlayezo kaMoridekhayi, wathi:

“Hamba uqoqe bonke abaJuda abahlala eShushani; nizile ngenxa yami, ningadli, ningaphuzi kuze kuphele izinsuku ezintathu, imini nobusuku. Mina nezintombi ezingisebenzelayo sizozila njengani; ngiyobe sengiya-ke enkosini noma kungukwephula umthetho lokho. Uma ngibhubha, mangibhubhe.”
UMoridekhayi wahamba wenza konke lokho u-Esteri ayemyale ngakho.

Kwathi ngosuku lwesithathu, u-Esteri wagqoka ingubo yobundlovukazi, wema egcekeni lesigodlo senkosi elingaphakathi, eliqondene nendlu yenkosi. Inkosi yayihleli esihlalweni sayo sobukhosi, iqondene nesango elingenela esigodlweni.
Ithe ukuba inkosi ibone indlovukazi u-Esteri imi egcekeni, yaba nomusa kuyo. Yayikhomba ngentonga yegolide eyayiyiphethe ngesandla. U-Esteri waya kuyo, wathinta isihloko sentonga yobukhosi.
Inkosi yathi kuye: “Kwenzenjani, ndlovukazi Esteri na? Ukhala ngani? Noma yini oyicelayo, ngisho kungaba yingxenye yombuso, uyoyinikwa.”
U-Esteri wathi: “Uma kukuhle enkosini, mayize inkosi noHamani namuhla edilini engiyilungisele lona.”
Inkosi yathi: “Phuthumani nibize uHamani ukuze sikwazi ukwenza lokho okucelwe ngu-Esteri.” Inkosi noHamani base beya edilini elalilungiswe ngu-Esteri.
Besaphuza iwayini, inkosi yathi ku-Esteri: “Ucelani na? Uzoyenzelwa. Ukhala ngani? Ngisho ingxenye yombuso uyoyinikwa.”
U-Esteri wayesephendula wathi: “Nasi isicelo sami nengikunxusayo:
uma ngingathola umusa kuwe nkosi, ungenzele engikucelayo nengikunxusayo, makuthi inkosi noHamani beze kusasa edilini engizobe ngibalungisele lona, ngizobe sengenza njengokusho kwenkosi.”

UHamani waphuma esigodlweni ejabule, umoya wakhe uthe cosololo ngalolo lusuku, kodwa kuthe lapho ebona uMoridekhayi esangweni lesigodlo, engamsukumeli noma athuthumele lapho embona, wagcwala intukuthelo, ethukuthelela uMoridekhayi,
kodwa wazibamba, wahamba waqonda emzini wakhe, wathumela, waqoqa abangani bakhe nomkakhe uZereshi,
waqhosha ngomcebo wakhe omkhulu, namadodana amaningi, nezikhundla zonke inkosi embeke kuzo, nokuthi imenze wamkhulu phezu kwezikhulu nabaholi.
UHamani wathi: “Ngisho nendlovukazi u-Esteri ayimemanga muntu omunye edilini ngaphandle kwami nenkosi, nakusasa ngiyaphindela, mina nenkosi isimemile,
kodwa konke lokho akungenelisi uma nje ngisabona uMoridekhayi, umJuda, ehleli esangweni lesigodlo senkosi.”

Umkakhe uZereshi nabo bonke abangani bakhe bathi kuye: “Tshela abantu bagxumeke isigxobo sokuphanyeka esingamakhubhithi angama-50 ubude, bese ucela enkosini ekuseni ukuba kulengiswe kuso uMoridekhayi, uhambe nenkosi uyozitika ukhululekile.” Leso seluleko samthokozisa uHamani, wayesesenza isiphanyeko.
Ngalobo busuku inkosi yaqwasha, yase iyala ukuba kulethwe kuyo umqulu womlando okubhalwe kuwo izehlakalo zemihla ngemihla zombuso wayo, zafundwa phambi kwenkosi.
Kwatholakala lapho kwakulotshwe khona ukuthi uMoridekhayi wabaceba kanjani abathenwa ababili, ababengabaqaphi besango lenkosi uBhigithani noThereshi, ngozungu ababelwakhele inkosi u-Ahasheveroshi.
Inkosi yabuza yathi: “Wahlonishwa kanjani, futhi wanikwa mklomelo muni uMoridekhayi ngaleso senzo na?” Izinceku zenkosi ezazilapho ziyikhonza zaphendula, zathi: “Akenzelwanga lutho.”

Inkosi yayisibuza, yathi: “Ngubani osegcekeni?” UHamani wayesanda kungena egcekeni lesigodlo senkosi elingaphandle, ezokhuluma nenkosi ukuba kulengiswe uMoridekhayi esiphanyekweni ayemlungiselele sona.
Izinceku zenkosi zaphendula, zathi: “Bheka, nguHamani omi egcekeni.” Inkosi yathi kuzo: “Mngeniseni.”
UHamani wangena, inkosi yambuza, yathi: “Angenzelwani umuntu inkosi efuna ukumphakamisa na?” UHamani wacabanga ngaphakathi, wathi: “Ngubani omunye inkosi engafuna ukumphakamisa ngaphandle kwami?”
Wayeseyiphendula inkosi, ethi: “Umuntu inkosi efuna ukumphakamisa,

makulethwe ingubo yenkosi ekade iyembethe, nehhashi ebiligibele lifakwe umqhele wobukhosi ekhanda lalo, kumele agqokiswe ingubo egqokwa yinkosi, agitsheliswe ihhashi eligitshelwa yinkosi, lifakwe umqhele wobukhosi ekhanda lalo,

bese kuthi esinye sezikhulu zakho eziqavile, simgqokise ingubo lowo muntu inkosi efuna ukumdumisa, simgibelise ehhashini, simhole siye naye eshashalazini lomuzi. Uma sesifike lapho siyomemezela, sithi: ‘Kuyokwenziwa kanje kumuntu inkosi efuna ukumdumisa!’ ”
Inkosi yathi kuHamani: “Phuthuma uthathe ingubo nehhashi okhulume ngakho, ukwenze lokhu kuMoridekhayi, umJuda, ohlala esangweni lesigodlo senkosi. Ukwenze konke lokhu okushilo.”

UHamani wayesethatha ingubo nehhashi, wagqokisa uMoridekhayi, wamgibelisa ehhashini, wamusa esigcawini somuzi ehamba phambi kwakhe ememeza, ethi: “Bhekani, uyokwenzelwa lokhu umuntu inkosi ethanda ukumdumisa nokumklomelisa!”
UMoridekhayi wayesephindela esangweni lesigodlo, kodwa uHamani washesha waqonda emzini wakhe, ezemboze ubuso ngenxa yokuhlazeka.

Waxoxela umkakhe nabo bonke abangani bakhe ngento eyayimehlele. Labo bangani bakhe abahlakaniphile nomkakhe, bathi kuye: “Njengoba uMoridekhayi engumJuda, ukuwa kwakho sekuqalile. Ngeke ukwazi ukumelana naye ubuso nobuso, impela uzokuqumba phansi.”
Besakhuluma naye uHamani, kwafika abathenwa benkosi, bephuthuma ukuzomlanda uHamani ukuze aye edilini u-Esteri ayelilungisile.
Inkosi noHamani baya edilini lendlovukazi u-Esteri.

Ngosuku lwesibili edilini, besaphuza iwayini, inkosi yambuza okwesibili u-Esteri, yathi: “Ndlovukazi, Esteri, siyini isicelo sakho na? Uzosenzelwa. Ufunani-ke? Uyakunikwa noma kungaba yingxenye yombuso.”
Indlovukazi u-Esteri yaphendula, yathi: “Uma ngifumene umusa kuwe nkosi, futhi kukuhle kuwe, mangibuyiselwe ukuphila kwami nokwabantu bakithi, yileso isicelo sami, yilokho engikucelayo.
Ngokuba mina nabantu bakithi sithengisiwe, sizobulawa, sibhujiswe, siqedwe nya. Ukuba besithengisiwe sayoba yizigqila bengizozithulela, ngokuba leyo nkathazo ibingeke iyilimaze inkosi.”
Inkosi u-Ahasheveroshi yabuza indlovukazi u-Esteri, yathi: “Ngubani lowo? Uphi lowo muntu onesibindi sokwenza into enjengalena na?”
U-Esteri wathi: “Umuntu omelene nathi, isitha, yilo Hamani okhohlakeleyo.” Kwaphela nasozwaneni wuvalo kuHamani, phambi kwenkosi nendlovukazi.
Inkosi yasukuma yashiya idili, yaphuma ithukuthele ibila, yaya engadini yasesigodlweni. UHamani wasala encenga indlovukazi u-Esteri ukuba angabulawa.

Kuthe lapho inkosi ibuya engadini yasesigodlweni, ingena endlini yedili, yafica uHamani ewele embhedeni okwakucambalele kuwo u-Esteri, yathi: “Awunamahloni okubhudukeza indlovukazi phambi kwami, esigodlweni sami pho?” Ithe ingasho lawo mazwi inkosi, abathenwa baphuthuma bemboza ubuso bukaHamani.

UHaribhona omunye wabathenwa ababephambi kwenkosi, wathi: “Kunesigxobo sokuphanyeka eside uHamani asimisele ukuphanyeka kuso uMoridekhayi, indoda eyasindisa impilo yakho, nkosi; singamakhubhithi angama-50 ubude.” Inkosi yayaleza, yathi: “Mphanyekeni kuso!”
Base bemphanyeka esigxotsheni sokuphanyeka, uHamani ayekade esilungiselele uMoridekhayi. Yayisibohla intukuthelo enkosini.
Ngalolo lusuku inkosi u-Ahasheveroshi yanika u-Esteri, indlovukazi, indlu kaHamani, isitha sabaJuda. UMoridekhayi weza enkosini, ngokuba u-Esteri wayeseyitshelile ukuthi bahlobene kanjani.
Inkosi yathatha indandatho yayo yokusicilela, leyo eyayiyephuce uHamani, yayinika uMoridekhayi. U-Esteri waqoka uMoridekhayi ukuba engamele indlu kaHamani.
U-Esteri waphinda wakhuluma nenkosi, wakhothamela ezinyaweni zayo, wakhala, wayincenga ukuba ibuguqule kubantu bakubo ububi uHamani, umAgagi, ayebucebe ngabo.
Inkosi yamkhomba ngentonga yayo yegolide u-Esteri, wayesesukuma ema phambi kwayo,

wathi: “Uma kukuhle enkosini, ngifumene umusa kuyo, futhi uma kulungile phambi kwayo, ngicela ibhale umyalelo wokuhoxisa icebo likaHamani, indodana kaHamedatha, umAgagi, owabhala izincwadi zokuthi kubhujiswe abaJuda abahlala kuzo zonke izifundazwe zenkosi.
Ngingakumela kanjani ukubona ububi behlela abantu bakithi na? Ngingakumela kanjani ukuchithwa kwezihlobo zami na?”
Inkosi u-Ahasheveroshi yase ithi ku-Esteri noMoridekhayi, umJuda: “Bhekani, indlu kaHamani ngiyinike indlovukazi u-Esteri, uHamani walengiswa esiphanyekweni ngenxa yozungu alwakhela abaJuda,

kodwa umbhalo olotshwe egameni lenkosi wagxivizwa ngesigxivizo sasebukhosini, awusoze waguqulwa. Nokho-ke, nina nobabili ningababhalela abaJuda noma yini eniyifisayo; ningayibhala egameni lami, nifake isisicilelo sasebukhosini.”

Ngaleso sikhathi kwase kubizwa ababhali benkosi. Kwakuwusuku lwama-23, ngenyanga yesithathu ebizwa ngokuthi uShivani. Bayalwa ukuba babhale noma yini uMoridekhayi abayala ukuba bayibhalele abaJuda ababesembusweni ka-Ahasheveroshi, neziphathimandla, nababusi, nezikhulu ezazikuzo zonke izifundazwe eziyi-127, kusuka eNdiya kuya eKhushe. Izincwadi bazibhala ngolimi lwaleso naleso sizwe, ngokwehlukana kwazo, nangokubhala kwazo, nakubaJuda, ngokubhala kwabo nangolimi lwabo.

Lezo zincwadi bazibhala egameni lenkosi u-Ahasheveroshi; uMoridekhayi wazifaka isisicilelo sasebukhosini. Zathunyelwa ngezigijimi ezazigibele amahhashi anejubane, ayekhuliswe esitebeleni sasebukhosini.

Kulezo zincwadi kwakubhalwe ukuthi abaJuda, emizini yonke babevunyelwe ukuba bahlangane, bazivikele, babulale, babhubhise amabutho esifundazwe abahlaselayo, izingane nabesifazane, baphange nezimpahla zabo,
ngosuku olwaluqokelwe ukuba abaJuda ababehlala kuzo zonke izifundazwe zenkosi u-Ahasheveroshi, zili-13 ngenyanga ye-12, inyanga u-Adari.
Ifuzela lalowo mthetho lalizokhishwa, libe ngumthetho kuzo zonke izifundazwe, laziswe bonke abantu kuleso naleso sizwe, ukuze abaJuda bame ngomumo ngalolo lusuku, bazivikele ezitheni zabo.
Izigijimi zagibela amahhashi asebukhosini anejubane, zaphuma ngesivinini, ziqhutshwa ngumyalezo wenkosi. Lowo mthetho wawushaywe ngisho eShushani, inhlokomuzi.

Ngesikhathi uMoridekhayi ephuma esigodlweni wayegqoke ingubo yasebukhosini enokuluhlaza sasibhakabhaka nokumhlophe, umjiva welineni elicolekileyo elibukhwebezane, nomqhele omuhle ocwebezelayo wegolide. Kwachwaza umuzi waseShushani ngomsindo wenjabulo nentokozo.
KumaJuda kwakunokukhanya, nenjabulo, nentokozo, nokuhlonipheka.

Kulowo nalowo muzi, nakuleso sifundazwe, lapho izwi lenkosi nomthetho wayo kwase kufinyelele khona, kwaba nenjabulo nentokozo, abaJuda benedili, nosuku oluhle, bejabulile. Abantu abaningi bendawo baphenduka baba ngabaJuda, ngoba base bebesaba abaJuda.

Lwaze lwafika usuku lwamanqamu, mhla zilishumi nantathu ngenyanga u-Adari, olwalubhalwe esimemezelweni senkosi, usuku izitha zabaJuda ezazilumisele ukushaya icole ngalo kubaJuda, kanti kuzophenduka izikhuni, kube ngabaJuda abazobusa phezu kwazo.

Kuzo zonke izifundazwe zenkosi u-Ahasheveroshi, nakuyo yonke imizi lapho kwakuhlala khona abaJuda, abaJuda bahlangana ukuzobulala bonke ababekade befuna ukubabhubhisa. Akukho namunye owayezomelana nabaJuda, ngokuba zonke izizwe zase zibesaba kakhulu.
Bonke ababusi bezifundazwe, iziphathimandla, izikhulu, ababusi nabaphathi benkosi beseka abaJuda, ngokuba nabo base bengenwe ngukwesaba uMoridekhayi.
UMoridekhayi waba ngumuntu omkhulu esigodlweni, nodumo lwakhe lwanda kuzo zonke izifundazwe, waqhubeka njalo waba ngumuntu onamandla.
AbaJuda benza ababefisa ukukwenza ezitheni zabo. Bazihlasela ngenkemba, babulala noma ngubani ababefuna ukumbulala, bonke ababeyizitha zabo.
Enhlokomuzi iShushani, abaJuda babulala amadoda angama-500. Babulala namadodana alishumi kaHamani, indodana kaHamedatha, isitha sabaJuda:
uPharishandatha, uDalifoni, u-Ashiphatha,
uPhoratha, u-Adaliya, u-Aridathi,
uPharimashitaha, u-Arisayi, u-Aridayi noVayizatha.
Nokho awazange athathe mpango.
Ngalolo lusuku, umbiko ngenani lalabo ababebulewe enhlokomuzi iShushani, wethulelwa inkosi,

yayisithi endlovukazini u-Esteri: “Enhlokomuzi iShushani, abaJuda babulale amadoda angama-500, kuwo kunamadodana alishumi kaHamani. Kazi benzenjani kwezinye izifundazwe na? Yini-ke enye osayicela? Ngizokunika yona. Ucelani? Ngizokwenzela.”
U-Esteri waphendula, wathi: “Uma kukuhle enkosini mayigunyaze abaJuda abahlala eShushani, benze nakusasa njengokomthetho wanamuhla, amadodana kaHamani alishumi aphanyekwe ezigxotsheni zokuphanyeka.”
Inkosi yayaleza ukuba kwenziwe lokho; umthetho washaywa eShushani, amadodana alishumi kaHamani aphanyekwa ezigxotsheni zokuphanyeka.
AbaJuda bahlala eShushani, babuye bahlangana nangosuku lweshumi nane lwenyanga u-Adari, babulala amadoda angama-300 eShushani, kodwa abazange bathathe mpango.
AbaJuda ababehlala ezifundazweni zenkosi bahlangana, bazivikela, bakhululeka ezitheni zabo, babulala amadoda ayizi-75 000, kodwa abathatha mpango.
Zonke lezo zinto zenzeka mhla zilishumi nantathu, ngenyanga u-Adari, namhla zilishumi nane, babe sebephumula. Lolo suku balwenza lwaba wusuku lwedili nenjabulo.
Kepha abaJuda ababehlala eShushani bahlangana ngomhla zili-13, nangomhla zili-14, baphumula mhla zili-15, lolo suku balwenza usuku lwedili nentokozo.
Yingakho abaJuda abahlala emizaneni engaphandle kwemizi, nalabo abahlala emizaneni, umhla ziyishumi nane ngenyanga u-Adari kuwusuku lwentokozo nedili, neholide abaphana ngalo izipho zokudla.
UMoridekhayi waloba zonke lezo zinto phansi. Wababhalela izincwadi bonke abaJuda ababehlala kuzo zonke izifundazwe zenkosi u-Ahasheveroshi, ezikude neziseduze.
Wabayala ukuba usuku lwe-14 nolwe-15, lwenyanga u-Adari, bazigcine zibe yizinsuku zokugubha umkhosi minyaka yonke.

Ngalezo zinsuku, abaJuda bakhululwa ezitheni zabo, ngenyanga lapho usizi lwabo lwaphenduka injabulo, ukulila kwabo kwaba yintokozo. Kwakumele kube yizinsuku zedili nentokozo, izinsuku zokuphana izipho ezingukudla, nezipho eziya kwabampofu.
AbaJuda bakwemukela lokho abase bekuqalile nalokho uMoridekhayi ayebabhalele khona.
UHamani, indodana kaHamedatha, umAgagi oyisitha sabo bonke abaJuda, wenza unkatho okuthiwa “yiPhure” ehlose ngalo ukubenza okubi, nokubabhubhisa,

kodwa u-Esteri eseyitshelile inkosi ngaleyo ndaba, yathi akubhalwe izincwadi zokuguqula lelo lisu elibi likaHamani ayehlose ngalo ukucekela phansi abaJuda, lelo cebo laba yisijeziso esehlela yena namadodana akhe, baphanyekwa ezigxotsheni zokuphanyeka.
Yingakho lezo zinsuku zabizwa ngokuthi “yiPhurimi” kususelwa egameni elithi: “iPhure.” Ngenxa yezincwadi zikaMoridekhayi nangenxa yakho konke okwabehlela,

abaJuda bakwenza kwaba ngumthetho wabo, nezizukulwane zabo, nanoma ngubani osephenduke umJuda, ukuthi ngesikhathi esifaneleyo ngonyaka lezo zinsuku ezimbili zigcinwe njengokusho komyalelo kaMoridekhayi, kungaphuthi.

Lezo zinsuku kufanele zikhunjulwe futhi zigcinwe yizizukulwane ngezizukulwane kuyo yonke imindeni, izifundazwe nemizi. Izinsuku zePhurimi akumele zephulwe phakathi kwabaJuda, nokukhunjulwa kwazo kungapheli phakathi kwezizukulwane zabo.
Indlovukazi u-Esteri, indodakazi ka-Abhihayili, benoMoridekhayi babhala izincwadi, bayiqinisekisa iPhurimi ngamandla ababegunyazwe ngawo.
Izincwadi zathunyelwa kubona bonke abaJuda ababesezifundazweni eziyi-127 zombuso wenkosi u-Ahasheveroshi, bebafisela ukuthula nokuvikeleka,

futhi bagcine izinsuku zomkhosi wePhurimi ngesikhathi esifaneleyo, njengoba umJuda uMoridekhayi nendlovukazi u-Esteri bakuqinisekisa kubaJuda, njengalokhu bazibophezela nezizukulwane zabo maqondana nemithetho ephathelene nokuzila neyokulila.
Umyalo ka-Esteri wayiqinisekisa imithetho yePhurimi, yabhalwa phansi emqulwini.
Inkosi u-Ahasheveroshi yathelisa intela izwe nababeseziqhingini zolwandle.
Zonke izinto ezinkulu, nezimangalisayo azenzayo, nendaba yonke yokukhushulelwa kukaMoridekhayi esikhundleni esikhulu, kubhaliwe emilandweni yamakhosi amaMediya namaPheresiya.

UMoridekhayi, umJuda, wayengowesibili ngokwesikhundla embusweni wenkosi u-Ahasheveroshi, enamandla phakathi kwabaJuda, iningi labakubo limthanda, ngokuba wayesebenzela inhlalakahle yabantu bakubo, elwela ukuphatheka kahle kwazo zonke izizukulwane zabo.
Kwakukhona indoda e-Uzi egama layo kwakunguJobe; leyo ndoda yayingenasici; iqotho, imesaba uNkulunkulu, futhi ikugwema okubi.
Yayizele amadodana ayisikhombisa namadodakazi amathathu.

Yayinezimvu eziyizi-7 000 namakameli ayizi-3 000, nezinkabi ezingamabhangqa angama-500 nezimbongolo zezinsikazi ezingama-500 nezisebenzi eziningi kakhulu. Leyo ndoda yayiyisikhulu esiphezulu kunabo bonke abantu basempumalanga.
Amadodana ayo ayevame ukuhamba enze idili endlini yaleyo naleyo ndodana, ngosuku lwayo. Ayethumela, ameme odadewabo abathathu ukuze badle, baphuze ndawonye.

Kwakuthi lapho sezedlule izinsuku zedili, uJobe athumele awangcwelise. Wayevuka ekuseni, anikele ngeminikelo yokushiswa ngokwenani lawo, ethi: “Hleze izingane zami zonile, zamqalekisa uNkulunkulu ezinhliziyweni zazo.” Wenza kanjalo uJobe zonke izinsuku.
Langa limbe, amadodana kaNkulunkulu eza azibonakalisa phambi kukaSimakade, noSathane wafika waba mdibi munye nawo.
USimakade wathi kuSathane: “Uvelaphi na?” USathane wamphendula uSimakade, wathi: “Ngivela ekuzulazuleni emhlabeni, ngehla ngenyuka kuwo.”
USimakade wathi kuSathane: “Inhliziyo yakho isike yayiqaphela yini inceku yami uJobe na? Ngokuba akukho muntu namunye ofana naye emhlabeni, ongenasici, oqotho, owesaba uNkulunkulu nogwema okubi.”
USathane wamphendula uSimakade, wathi: “Ngabe uJobe umesaba uNkulunkulu kungenasizathu na?
Kanti awumbiyelanga yini nxazonke ngothango, yena nabomndeni wakhe, nakho konke anakho, wabusisa nomsebenzi wezandla zakhe na? Imfuyo yakhe iwuchibidolo ezweni.
Kepha-ke ake welule isandla sakho uthinte konke anakho, ubone ukuthi akazukukuqalekisa yini, ebusweni bakho.”
USimakade wathi kuSathane: “Kulungile-ke, konke anakho kusesandleni sakho, kodwa uze ungamthinti yena ngesandla sakho.” USathane wayesesuka ehamba ebukhoneni bukaSimakade.
Kwathi ngolunye usuku, lapho amadodana namadodakazi kaJobe edla, ephuza iwayini endlini yezibulo lakhe,
kwafika isigijimi kuJobe, sathi: “Izinkabi bezilima, izimbongolo ziklabe eduze nazo,
ngesikhathi kufika amaShebha akuthumba, abulala izinceku ngenkemba; yimina nje ngedwa engiphunyulile, ukuze ngizokubikela.”
Sisakhuluma, kwafika esinye, sathi: “Kwehle umlilo kaNkulunkulu uvela ezulwini, washisa izimvu nezinceku, wakuqothula; yimina nje ngedwa engiphunyulile, ukuze ngizokubikela.”
Sisakhuluma, kwafika esinye, sathi: “AmaKhaledi enze amaviyo amathathu, ahlasela, athumba amakameli, abulala izinceku ngenkemba; yimina nje ngedwa engiphunyulile, ukuze ngizokubikela.”
Sisakhuluma naleso kwafika esinye, sathi: “Amadodana namadodakazi akho abedla, ephuza iwayini endlini yendodana yakho endala,
kwase kufika esikhulu isishingishane sivela ngasehlane, sawashaya omane amagumbi endlu, yawela phezu kwabantwana, bafa ujuqu. Yimina nje ngedwa engiphunyulile, ukuze ngizokubikela.”
UJobe wayesesukuma, waklebhula isembatho sakhe, waphuca ikhanda lakhe, wawela emhlabathini, wakhuleka,
wathi: “Ngaphuma ngize esizalweni sikamame, futhi ngizobuyela khona ngize. USimakade usisile, uSimakade usethathile; malibongwe igama likaSimakade.”
Sekwenzekile konke lokhu uJobe akazange one, akamthelanga ngehlazo uNkulunkulu.
Ngelinye ilanga kwafika amadodana kaNkulunkulu, azibonakalisa phambi kukaSimakade; noSathane wafika wema kanye nawo phambi kukaSimakade.
USimakade wathi kuSathane: “Uvelaphi na?” USathane wamphendula uSimakade, wathi: “Ekuzulazuleni emhlabeni ngehla ngenyuka kuwo.”

Wayesethi uSimakade kuSathane: “Inhliziyo yakho iyiqaphele yini inceku yami uJobe na? Akekho onjengaye emhlabeni, umuntu ongenasici, oqotho, owesaba uNkulunkulu, ogwema okubi, osabambelele ebumsulweni bakhe noma ungibelesela ukuba ngimelane naye, ngimbhubhise engenacala.”
USathane wamphendula uSimakade, wathi: “Uma nje ungathinta inyama yakhe uyobona. Konke umuntu anakho angakunikela ukuze asindise ukuphila kwakhe.
Ake welule isandla sakho uthinte amathambo akhe nenyama yakhe, uzobona uyakukuthuka bukhoma.”
USimakade wayesethi kuSathane: “Kulungile-ke, ngimnikela esandleni sakho, kodwa ungalinge uthinte umphefumulo wakhe.”
USathane wayesemuka ebukhoneni bukaSimakade. Wamshaya uJobe ngamathumba amabi, kusukela ematheni onyawo kuze kube sokhakhayini.
UJobe wathatha udengezi ukuba azenwaye ngalo; wayehleli emlotheni.
Umkakhe wayesethi kuye: “Usabambelele yini ebumsulweni bakho na? Thuka uNkulunkulu, ufe.”
Kepha uJobe wathi kuye: “Ukhulumisa okowesifazane oyisiwula. Siyakwamukela okuhle kuphela yini kuNkulunkulu, asiyukwamukela yini nokubi na?” Kukho konke lokho uJobe akonanga ngomlomo wakhe.

Kwathi ukuba abangani abathathu bakaJobe bezwe ngakho konke okubi okwakumehlele, bafika njengokuvumelana kwabo ukuzomkhalela nokumduduza, yilowo nalowo esuka endaweni yakhe: u-Elifazi umThemani, uBhilidadi umShuhi, noZofari umNahama.
Kuthe besebuqamama baphakamisa amehlo abo, kodwa abambonanga ukuthi nguye; badazuluka bakhala, kwayilowo nalowo waklebhula ingubo yakhe, bazithela amakhanda ngothuli beluphonsa phezulu.
Bahlala naye emhlabathini izinsuku eziyisikhombisa nobusuku obuyisikhombisa, bengasho lutho kuye, ngokuba babona ukuthi wayesebuhlungwini obukhulu kakhulu.
Emveni kwalokho uJobe wakhuluma; waqalekisa usuku lwakhe.
UJobe wathi:
“Malubhubhe usuku engazalwa ngalo, nobusuku okwathiwa: ‘Ukhulelwe ingane yomfana.’
Lolo lusuku malube ngubumnyama, uNkulunkulu ephezulu makangalunaki, ukukhanya makungakhanyi kulo.
Ubumnyama nethunzi lokufa makunikwe lona, kuhlale ifu phezu kwalo, ubumnyama bosuku bulethuse.
Lobo busuku mabubanjwe yisigayegaye sobumnyama, bungathokozi phakathi kwezinsuku zonyaka, lungabalwa phakathi kwezinsuku zenyanga.
Yebo, lobo busuku mabube yinyumba, kungezwakali msindo wenjabulo kubo.
Mabaluqalekise labo abaqalekisa usuku, labo abalungele ukuvusa uLeviyathani.
Izinkanyezi zokuhwelela kobusuku maziphenduke ubumnyama, mabulindele ukukhanya kodwa kungabi bikho, mabungakuboni ukuntwela kokusa,
ngokuba abuzivalanga izivalo zesizalo sikamame, abuyifihlanga inkathazo emehlweni ami.
“Kungani ngingafelanga esiswini na? Angibhubhanga ngani lapho ngiphuma esizalweni na?
Amadolo angemukelelani, namabele ukuba ngincele na?
Ngokuba manje ngabe ngilele, ngithule, ngabe ngilele ubuthongo, ngiphumule
kanye namakhosi nabeluleki bomhlaba, labo abazakhela kabusha izindawo ezazicekelwe phansi,
noma kanye nezikhulu ezinegolide, ezazigcwalise izindlu zazo ngesiliva;
noma kungani ngingagcwatshwanga njengokuphuphumileyo nanjengombungu ongalibonanga ilanga?
Lapho izikhohlakali zingasakwazi ukuhlupha, nalapho abakhathele besekuphumuleni.
Lapho iziboshwa zicanasa khona ndawonye, nezwi labacindezelayo zingasalizwa.
Lapho abancane nabakhulu befana; isigqila sikhululekile kumniniso.
“Kungani ukukhanya kunikwa ososizini, nokuphila, kwabanomunyu emphefumulweni,
abalangazelela ukufa, kodwa kungafiki, abakufuna ukwedlula ingcebo ethukusiweyo,
abathokoza, bethabe, bajabule uma bethola ingcwaba?
Kungani ukukhanya kunikwa umuntu ongayiboni indlela yakhe, lowo uNkulunkulu ambiyele nxazonke na?
Ukugquma kimi sekufana nokudla, nokububula kwami kuphophoza njengamanzi.
Ngehlelwa yilokho engikwesabayo, nalokho enginovalo ngakho kuyangehlela.
Anginakuthula, anginaluxolo, anginakuphumula; inkathazo ingehlele.”
U-Elifazi umThemani, waphendula, wathi:
“Uma umuntu ezama ukukhuluma nawe, uzokhathazeka yini na? Ngubani ongazibamba angasho lutho na?
Yebo, ubafundisile abaningi, waqinisa izandla ezintekenteke.
Amazwi akho aphakamisa okhubekayo, aqinisa amadolo antekenteke naxegayo.
“Uma sekufike kuwe, awusenasineke. Uma sekuthinta wena uyadangala.
Ukwesaba kwakho uNkulunkulu akusilo yini ithemba lakho, nokwethembeka kwezindlela zakho, akusiso yini isisekelo sakho na?
Ake ukhumbule ukuthi ngubani owake wabhujiswa engenacala na? Babhujiswa kuphi abalungileyo na?
Ngibabonile abahlwanyela inkohlakalo, nabalima inkathazo, bavuna inhlupheko.
Ngokuphephetha kukaNkulunkulu bayabhubha, ngomoya wentukuthelo yakhe, bayashabalala.
Ukubhodla kwengonyama, nomsindo webhubesi, kuyathula, namazinyo amabhongo amabhubesi ayephuka.
Ibhubesi elinamandla liyafa ngenxa yokweswela impango, amawundlu ebhubesi ayahlakazeka.
“Izwi lafika isinyenyela kimi, indlebe yami yezwa ukunyenyeza kwalo.
Phakathi kwemicabango yemibono yasebusuku, lapho abantu sebehlelwe ngubuthongo obunzima,
ngafikelwa yingebhe nokuthuthumela okwaqhaqhazelisa wonke amathambo ami.
Kwedlula umoya ebusweni bami, waqubula uhlevane esikhumbeni sami.
Kwema kwathi phuhle, kodwa angikwazanga ukubona isimo sakho. Kwakumi okuthile phambi kwami, ngezwa ukunyenyeza nezwi, lithi:
‘Umuntu angalunga yini kunoNkulunkulu na? Umuntu uhlambulukile yini kunoMenzi wakhe na?
Bheka, akethembi ngisho izinceku zakhe, nezingelosi zakhe uzibeka icala.
Kakhulu kangakanani-ke labo abahlezi ezindlini zodaka, abasisekelo sabo sisothulini, abachotshozwa njengenundu na?
Kusukela ekuseni kuze kube kusihlwa bayagxotshwa, bayabhubha kuze kube phakade kungekho nonake utho ngabo.
Intambo yethende labo ayibhonculiwe yini kubo, futhi bafe bengenakho ukuhlakanipha na?’ ”
“Ake umemeze: ukhona yini okuphendulayo na? Yimuphi kwabangcwele oyakuphendukela kuye na?
Ngokuba isiwula sibulawa ngukukhathazeka, nesiduphunga sibhujiswa ngumhawu.
Ngisibonile isiwula sisimama siba nezimpande, ngase ngiqalekisa indlu yaso ngokuphazima kweso.
Abantwana baso abavikelekile impela, bayagandaywa esangweni, abanaye umhlengi.
Isivuno sabo sidliwa ngabalambileyo, basikhipha ngisho emeveni, nabanxaniwe balangazelela ingcebo yabo.
Usizi aluveli othulini, nenhlupheko ayiphumi emhlabathini.
Wonke umuntu uzalelwe ukuhlupheka, njengoba nezinhlansi ziqhasha zibheke phezulu.
“Kepha mina bengiyakumfuna uNkulunkulu, kuNkulunkulu bengiyakuyibeka indaba yami,
Yena owenza izinto ezinkulu, ezingaphenyekiyo, izimangaliso ezingenakubalwa,
Yena onisa imvula emhlabeni, athumele amanzi ebusweni bomhlaba,
ukuze aphakamise abaphansi, aphakamisele phezulu, endaweni ephephileyo, abakhalayo.
Ubhuntshisa amacebo abanobuqili, ukuze izandla zabo zingabi nampumelelo.
Ubamba abahlakaniphileyo ebuqilini babo, achithe ngokushesha iseluleko soyisigwegwe.
Bahlangabezana nobumnyama emini kwabha, baphuphutheke emini, kube sengathi kusebusuku.
Kepha abantulayo uyabasindisa enkembeni yemilomo yabo, nasesandleni sonamandla.
Ngakho-ke ompofu unethemba; ububi buvale umlomo wabo.
“Uyadela lowo muntu uNkulunkulu amsolayo, ngakho-ke ungakwedeleli ukuqondisa kukaSomandla.
Ngokuba uyalimaza, abuye abophe, uyashaya, kodwa izandla zakhe zibuye ziphilise.
Uyokuhlenga ezinhluphekweni eziyisithupha, yebo, nakweziyisikhombisa awuyukuthintwa wububi.
Endlaleni uyakukuhlenga, ungafi, akukhulule nasemandleni enkemba empini.
Uyakukufihla olimini oluhlabayo, awuyukwesaba ukubhubha lapho kufika.
Ukubhubha nendlala uyokuhleka usulu, ungazesabi nezilo zomhlaba.
Ngokuba unesivumelwano namatshe asendle, izilo zasendle zihlalisana ngokuthula nawe.
Uyokwazi ukuthi ithende lakho liphephile, lapho uhlola indlu yakho, uyothola ukuthi awulahlekelwe yilutho.
Uyokwazi ukuthi izizukulwane zakho ziyakuba ziningi, nabozalo lwakho babe njengotshani emhlabeni.
Uyokufa usumdala impela, njengesixha samabele esibhulweni, ngesikhathi sawo.
Bheka lokhu, sikuphenyisisile, kunjalo, kulalele, ukwazi wena luqobo.”
UJobe waphendula wathi:
“Sengathi usizi lwami nenhlekelele engehlele kungalinganiswa nokulinganiswa, nokubhujiswa kwami kubekwe esilinganisweni kanyekanye.
Ngokuba manje kuyasinda kwedlula isihlabathi solwandle, ngakho amazwi ami abengumbhedo nje.
Ngokuba imicibisholo kaSomandla ikimi, ubuthi bayo buphuzwa ngumoya wami, ukwesabisa kukaNkulunkulu kunami shaqa.
Imbongolo yasendle iyakhala yini inotshani na? Inkabi iyakhala yini inotshani na?
Okuduma kungadliwa yini ngaphandle kukasawoti na? Kuyahlwabusa yini okumhlophe kweqanda na?
Umphefumulo wami uyenqaba ukukuthinta, kungukudla okunengekayo kimi.
“Sengathi isicelo sami singezwakala, uNkulunkulu angiphe engikufisayo.
Sengathi uNkulunkulu angangiphihliza, avule isandla sakhe, angibhubhise.
Lokho bekuyoba yinduduzo kimi, bengiyojabuliswa yizinhlungu ezingapheliyo, ngokuba angiwagodlanga amazwi oNgcwele.
Ayini amandla ami ukuba ngingawethemba na? Siyini isiphetho sami ukuba ngingasibekezelela na?
Ngabe amandla ami angamandla amatshe na? Inyama yami iyithusi na?
Angikwazi ukuzisiza, usizo lwami lususiwe kimi.
“Ogodlela umngani wakhe odangele umusa, ulahla ukwesaba uSomandla.
Abafowethu bambuluzile njengomfudlana, nanjengemithonjana eshayo,
emnyama ngenxa yeqhwa, lapho ungqoqwane uzinqwabela kuyo.
Ngesikhathi sokufudumala, iyanyamalala, uma sekushisa iyasha, iphele endaweni yayo.
Abahamba ngezindlela zayo bayaphambuka, benyukela oqwathuleni, babhubhe.
Izindwendwe zabahwebi bakwaThema zabafuna, nemiqobo yezihambi zakwaShebha zibheke ngethemba.
Zadumala, ngoba zazinokuzethemba, lapho sezifike khona zadangala,
nani seninjalo-ke kimi; nibone okwethusayo, nesaba.
Ngasho yini kini, ngathi: ‘Ngipheni isipho empahleni yenu’ na?
noma: ‘Ngikhululeni esandleni sesitha, ningihlenge esandleni sezidlova’ na?
“Ngifundiseni, mina ngizothula du, ningichazele ukuthi ngone ngani.
Ukukhuluma okuqotho kunamandla kangakanani na? Kepha ukusolwa yinina kusiza ngani na?
Nicabanga ukuthi ningawasola amazwi, ngokungathi ukukhuluma kophelelwe yithemba, kungumoya nje na?
Nenza unkatho ngentandane, nithengisa ngomngani wenu.
Manje-ke, phendukani, ningibheke, ngokuba angisoze ngawaqamba amanga kini.
Ake niphenduke, kungabi bikho owenza ukungalungi. Phendukani, indaba yami ilungile.
Kukhona yini ukungalungi engikusho ngolimi lwami na? Ulwanga lwami alunakukwehlukanisa yini okubi na?”
“Umshikashika akusiwo yini owabantu emhlabeni, nemihla yabo ayinjengayo yini eyomqashwa na?
Njengesigqila silangazelela ithunzi, nosebenzayo elindele umholo wakhe,
kanjalo ngabelwe izinyanga zokungenanzuzo, ngamiselwa ubusuku benhlupheko.
Nxa ngilala ngithi: ‘Ngiyovuka nini na?’ Ubusuku bude, kuze kuse ngibinyabinyeka.
Umzimba wami wembozwe yizimpethu nothuli. Isikhumba sami siyaphola, sibuye sibhicike.
“Imihla yami iyashesha kunesaluko, iphela ingenathemba.
Khumbula ukuthi ukuphila kwami kungumoya, iso lami aliyukubuye likubone okuhle.
Iso elingibonayo alisayukungibona, amehlo akho esangibhekile, ngiyobe ngingasekho.
Njengokuba ifu linyamalala lingabe lisaba bikho, unjalo-ke owehlele endaweni yabafileyo, akasayukukhuphuka.
Akasayukubuyela endlini yakhe, indawo yakhe ayisayukumazi.
“Ngakho-ke nami angizukuwunqanda umlomo wami, ngizokhuluma nginobuhlungu emoyeni wami, ngikhononde ngomunyu emphefumulweni wami.
Ngilulwandle yini, noma inkanyamba yolwandle, uze ungibekele abalindi na?
Lapho ngithi: “Umbhede wami uzongiduduza, icansi lami lingithwalise ukukhononda kwami,
uyangesabisa ngamaphupho, ungethuse ngemibono,
ukuze umphefumulo wami uqoke ukuklinywa nokufa kunokuba ngibe kulo mzimba.
Ngiyakuzonda ukuphila kwami, angiyukuhlala njalo, ngiyeke, ngokuba imihla yami iyize.
Uyini umuntu ukuba umenze abe mkhulu, nokuba ubeke inhliziyo yakho kuye,
nokuba umhambele njalo ekuseni, umhlole imizuzu ngemizuzu na?
Kuyoze kube nini ungawasusi amehlo akho kimi na? Ngiyeke ngize ngigwinye isikhwehlela sami.
Uma ngona, ngenzani kuwe mlindi wabantu na? Ungimiseleni ngibe yinkololo yakho, ngize ngibe ngumthwalo nakimi na?
Awusithetheleli ngani isiphambeko sami, ususe isono sami na? Ngokuba manje ngiyakulala phansi othulini, uyakungifuna, kepha angiyukuba bikho.”
Wayesethatha uBhilidadi, umShuhi, wathi:
“Kuyoze kube nini ukhuluma lezi zinto, amazwi akho abe ngumoya onamandla, na?
Ngabe uNkulunkulu uyabuhlanekezela ubulungiswa, uSomandla aphendukezele ukulunga na?
Uma abantwana bakho bonile kuye, wabanikela emandleni eziphambeko zabo.
Kuyothi lapho umfuna uNkulunkulu, umnxusa uSomandla,
uma uhlambulukile, uqotho, Yena uyokubheka, akubuyisele endaweni yakho efaneleyo.
Nakuba ukuqala kwakho kwakungokuncane, nokho ikusasa lakho liyokhula kakhulu.
Ake ubuze manje ngezizukulwane ezakwandulelayo, uqaphele okwatholwa ngokhokho bazo,
ngoba thina singabayizolo nje, asinalwazi; izinsuku zethu emhlabeni ziyithunzi.
Bona abayukukufundisa yini, bakutshele, bakhiphe amazwi ezinhliziyweni zabo na?
Umhlanga ungahluma yini lapho kungenaxhaphozi khona na? Ibhuma lingamila yini kungekho amanzi na?
Uma liseluhlaza, lingakakhiwa, liyabuna phambi kwabo bonke utshani.
“Zinjalo-ke izindlela zabo bonke abakhohlwa nguNkulunkulu, ithemba longenabunkulunkulu liyakushabalala.
Ithemba lakhe liyakunqunywa, nesisekelo sakhe siyindlu yolwembu.
Uyakwencika endlini yakhe, kepha ayiyukuma; uma ebambelela kuyo, ayiyukuqina.
Yena uluhlaza phambi kwelanga; imixhantela yakhe iyenaba ensimini yakhe.
Izimpande zakhe ziyathandela enqwabeni yamatshe, zikhule phakathi kwamatshe.
Uma ebhujiswa endaweni yakhe, iyakumphika ithi: ‘Angikaze ngikubone.’
Bheka, lokho kuyindlela yakhe yokuthokoza. Kusazovela omunye othulini.
“Phela uNkulunkulu akayukumlahla ongenasici, akayukuzibamba izandla zabenza okubi,
aze agcwalise umlomo wakho ngokuhleka, nezindebe zakho ngenhlokomo yokwethaba.
Abakuzondayo bayothelwa ngehlazo; ithende lezikhohlakali alisayukuba bikho.”
UJobe wayesephendula ethi:
“Impela ngiyazi ukuthi kunjalo, kodwa umuntu angaba kanjani ngolungileyo phambi kukaNkulunkulu na?
Uma efuna ukuthetha icala naye, angemphendule nakwelilodwa kwayinkulungwane.
Uhlakaniphile ngenhliziyo, unamandla amakhulu, ngubani owake wamelana naye, waphumelela na?
Yena ogudluza izintaba, zingazi, Yena ozigumbuqela ngentukuthelo yakhe,
ozamazamisa umhlaba usuke endaweni yawo, kuthuthumele izinsika zawo,
oyala ilanga lingaphumi, avalele izinkanyezi,
oweneka izulu yedwa, ahambe phezu kwamaza olwandle,
owenza iNdonsa, iKhwezi, iSilimela, iSicelankobe noMthala oseningizimu,
owenza izinto ezinkulu ezingenakukhohlweka, yebo, izimangaliso ezingenakubalwa.
Bheka, uyedlula ngakimi, ngingaboni, uyedlula, kodwa ngingamuzwa.
Bheka, uyabamba, ngubani ongamkhalima na? Ngubani oyakusho kuye, athi: ‘Wenzani na?’
“UNkulunkulu akayukulunqanda ulaka lwakhe; bayakhothama abasizi bakaRahabi phansi kwakhe.
Pho mina ngingamphendula ngithini, ngingawathathaphi amazwi aqondene naye na?
Noma ngingenacala, angikwazi ukumphendula, kufanele ngicele umusa kumehluleli wami.
Uma bengimbizile wase engiphendula, angikholwa ukuthi ulilalele izwi lami.
Ngokuba uyangilimaza ngesiphepho, wandisa amanxeba ami ngaphandle kwesizathu.
Akangivumeli ukuba ngiphefumule, kepha ungigcwalisa ngomunyu.
Ukuba besizwana amandla, nguye onamandla. Ukuba bekungubulungiswa, ngubani ongambizela icala na?
Nakuba ngilungile, umlomo wami uyakungilahla, noma ngimsulwa, uyakungibeka icala.
Ngimsulwa, kodwa angizazi, ngiyakuzonda ukuphila kwami.
Ngakho-ke konke kuyafana, yingakho ngithi: ‘Ubhubhisa omsulwa nesikhohlakali.’
Uma kwehla inhlekelele ngokuzuma, uyakuhleka ukuphelelwa yithemba kwabangenacala.
Umhlaba unikelwe esandleni sezikhohlakali, uyabumboza ubuso babehluleli bawo, uma kungesiye, pho ngubani na?
“Izinsuku zami ziyashesha ukwedlula umgijimi, ziyabaleka zingakubonanga okuhle.
Zitshuza njengesikebhe somhlanga, nanjengokhozi luphuthuma ukudla kwalo.
Uma ngithi: ‘Ngizokhohlwa ngukukhononda, ngizoyeka ukunyukubala, ngithakase,’
nokho ngiyabesaba bonke ubuhlungu bami, ngiyazi awuyukungithatha njengongenacala.
Mina ngizolahlwa ngecala, pho kungani ngikhandlekela ize na?
Noma ngingageza ngamanzi eqhwa, ngihlanze izandla zami ngensipho,
nokho uyakungicwilisa emgodini, nginengwe yizingubo zami.
Ngokuba akasiye umuntu njengami ukuba bengingaqagulisana naye, nokuba ngibhekane naye esigcawini.
Akukho mlamuli phakathi kwethu, ongabeka isandla sakhe phezu kwethu sobabili, asilamule.
Makayisuse induku yakhe kimi, nengebhe yakhe ingangesabisi,
khona ngiyokhuluma ngingamesabi, ngoba angiyikho lokhu okucatshwangwa ngami.”
“Ngiyakuzonda ukuphila kwami, ngizokhononda ngokukhululeka, ngizokhuluma ebumunywini bomphefumulo wami.
Ngiyakuthi kuNkulunkulu: ‘Ungangilahli njengonecala, kodwa ngazise; kuyini ongiphikisa ngakho na?
Kuhle yini kuwe ukuba ucindezele, ulahle umsebenzi wezandla zakho, uphumelelise icebo lezikhohlakali na?
Unawo yini amehlo enyama na? Uyabona yini njengabantu na?
Imihla yakho injengemihla yomuntu na? Neminyaka yakho injengezinsuku zabantu na?
Kungani ungiphenya, ufunisisa ngesono sami,
noma wazi kahle ukuthi anginacala, futhi akekho ongangihlenga esandleni sakho na?
Izandla zakho zingibumbile, zangenza ngokupheleleyo nxazonke, nokho uyangibhubhisa.
Ake ukhumbule ukuthi nguwe owangibumba njengobumba, pho uyakungibuyisela othulini na?
Awungithululanga yini njengobisi, wangijiyisa njengoshizi na?
Awungembathisanga yini isikhumba nenyama, wangiphica ngamathambo nangemisipha na?
Ungiphe impilo, wangenzela umusa, ukunginakekela kwakho kuwulondile umoya wami.
Kepha lokhu ukufihlile enhliziyweni yakho, ngiyazi ukuthi lokhu ubukusophile:
uma ngona, uyangiqaphela, awuyukungithethelela isono sami.
Uma ngenzile okubi, maye kimi! Uma bengilungile, bengingayukuliphakamisa ikhanda lami, lokhu ngisuthi ihlazo, ngibona ukuhlupheka kwami.
Nokuba bengiziphakamisa, ubuyakungizingela njengengonyama, ubuye uzenze omangalisayo kimi.
Ubuyakuletha kimi ofakazi abasha, wandise intukuthelo yakho kimi, amaviyo ngamaviyo angithelekele.
“ ‘Wangivumelelani ukuba ngizalwe, ngiphume esibelethweni na? Ngangingafi ngani ngingakabonwa nangelilodwa iso na?
Kwakuyoba sengathi angikaze ngibe khona, ngiphume esibelethweni, ngiyiswe ethuneni.
Izinsuku zokuphila kwami aziyingcosana yini na? Ake ungiyeke, kengithole ukuthokoza kancane nje,
ngaphambi kokuba ngihambe, ngingaphinde ngibuye, ngiye ezweni lobumnyama nesigayegaye,
izwe lobumnyama nesiphithiphithi sobumnyama, lapho ukukhanya kufana nobumnyama.’ ”
Wayesethatha uZofari waseNahama, wathi:
“Ngabe awayukuphendulwa yini amazwi amaningi kangaka na? Iphoshophosho lingaxolelwa yini na?
Ukuqavitha kwakho kufanele kubathulise yini abantu na? Nalapho ukloloda, akekho yini ongakuthela ngehlazo na?
Ngokuba uthe: ‘Ukufundisa kwami kulungile; ngimsulwa emehlweni akho Nkulunkulu.’
Sengathi uNkulunkulu angakhuluma, akuvulele izindebe zakhe,
akwazise izimfihlakalo zokuhlakanipha kwakhe, ngokuba ukuhlakanipha kwakhe kubanzi, ukuze wazi ukuthi uNkulunkulu uzokwenza ukhohlwe yingxenye yecala lakho, ukuze kube kuhle kuwe.
“Ungayithola yini imfihlakalo kaNkulunkulu na? Ungawuthola yini umkhawulo kaSomandla na?
Kuphakeme kunezulu, ungenzani na? Kujulile kunendawo yabafileyo, ungazini ngakho na?
Isilinganiso sakho side kunomhlaba, sibanzi kunolwandle.
Uma edlula, avalele, abizele ekwehluleleni, ngubani ongamvimba na?
Ngokuba uyabazi abantu bamanga, lapho ebona inkohlakalo, akayukuyinaka yini na?
Uma umuntu ongahlakaniphile engaba ngohlakaniphileyo, nethole lembongolo yasendle lingazalwa lingumuntu.
“Uma uqondisa kahle inhliziyo yakho, welulela izandla zakho kuye,
uma udedisele kude inkohlakalo esesandleni sakho, ungakuhlalisi ukungalungi emathendeni akho,
impela uyakubuphakamisa ubuso bakho ungenamahloni, uyokuma uqine, ungenakwesaba.
Uyakukhohlwa ukuhlupheka kwakho, uyakukukhumbula njengamanzi adlulileyo.
Ukuphila kwakho kuyokhanya kunemini; nobumnyama buyofana nokusa nje.
Uyoba ngophephile, ngokuba likhona ithemba, uyovikeleka kahle, ulale phansi uphephile.
Uyakulala, kungabi bikho okuphazamisayo; abaningi bayakuzincengela kuwe.
Kepha amehlo ezikhohlakali ayakufiphala; ayiyukuba bikho nendawo yokuphephela; ithemba lazo liyakuba ngukuphuma komphefumulo.”
UJobe waphendula, wathi:
“Akuthandabuzwa ukuthi yini nodwa abantu, nokuhlakanipha kuyofa nani.
Kepha nami nginengqondo njengani, aningedluli ngalutho. Ngubani ongazazi izinto ezinjengalezi na?
Sengiyinhlekisa kumngani wami, mina ebengikhala kuNkulunkulu angiphendule; umuntu olungileyo nongenasici, useyisigcono.
Labo abahleli kahle bayibukela phansi ingozi, ilungiselelwe abanezinyawo ezishelelayo.
Amathende abaphangi anokuthula, abachukuluza uNkulunkulu balondekile, labo abaletha onkulunkulu babo ngezandla zabo.
Kepha ake ubuze izilwane, zizokufundisa, nezinyoni zezulu, ukuze zikutshele.
Khuluma kuwo umhlaba, ukuze ukufundise, nasezinhlanzini zolwandle ukuze zikulandise.
Ngubani phakathi kwabo bonke laba, ongazi ngakho konke lokho ukuthi isandla sikaSimakade sikwenzile lokhu na?
Esandleni sakhe kukhona imiphefumulo yakho konke okuphilayo, kanjalo nomoya wabo bonke abaphilayo.
Indlebe ayiwahloli yini amazwi, nolwanga alukunambithi yini ukudla na?
Ukuhlakanipha kutholakala ezimpungeni, nangobude bezinsuku kwabanokuqonda.
“Ukuhlakanipha namandla kukuye, amasu nokuqonda kungokwakhe.
Yena uma ebhidliza, akekho ongakha kabusha, uma evalela umuntu, akekho ongamvulela.
Uyawavimba amanzi, ashe, awathumele agumbuqele umhlaba.
Amandla nokuhlakanipha okungqokolo kungokwakhe, oduka endleleni nalowo omdukisayo bangabakhe.
Uyaphuca abeluleki ukuhlakanipha, enze abehluleli babe yiziwula.
Uthukulula izintambo zamakhosi, awabophe ngebhande ezinkalweni zawo.
Ugodukisa abaphristi bengenalutho, athele phansi othulini izikhulu.
Uyazithulisa izindebe zabathembekileyo, aphuce amalunga ukuqonda.
Uthela izikhulu ngehlazo, athukulule amabhande abanamandla.
Wembula izinto ezijulileyo ebumnyameni, aveze obala izinto ezisebumnyameni obukhulu.
Wenza izizwe zibe zinkulu, bese ezibhubhisa, ukhulisa izizwe, bese ezihlakaza.
Uphuca abaholi bezizwe zomhlaba ukuqonda, abahlwathizise lapho kungekho ndlela khona, ehlane, kwahlongasibi.
Baphuphutheka ebumnyameni bengenakukhanya, ubabhamazelisile njengezidakwa.”
“Bheka, iso lami likubone konke, nendlebe yami yezwa, yaqonda.
Enikwaziyo nami ngiyakwazi, aningedluli ngalutho.
Kepha ngizokhuluma kuSomandla, ngifisa ukuqagulisana noNkulunkulu.
Kepha nina ningababheci ngamanga, nonke niyizinyanga ezingathi shu.
Sengathi impela ningawuhlaba inhlali, lokho kuyoba ngukuhlakanipha kini.
Ake nilalele ukuqagulisana kwami, nizwe isikhalo sezindebe zami.
Niyokhuluma okubi yini ngoNkulunkulu, niyokhuluma inkohliso ngaye na?
Niyobuvuna yini ubuso bakhe, nimmele uNkulunkulu na?
Kuyakuba kuhle yini lapho eniphenya na? Ningamkhohlisa yini njengalokhu kukhohliswa umuntu na?
Impela uyakunisola uma niyokwenzelela ngasese.
Ubukhosi bakhe abuyukunethusa yini, nokwesabisa kwakhe kwehlele kini na?
Izikhumbuzo zenu ziyizaga zomlotha, nezivikelo zenu ziyizivikelo zobumba.
“Thulani, ukuze ngikhulume, noma ngabe ngehlelwa yini akusho lutho lokho.
Yingani ngibeka ukuphila kwami engcupheni, ngibeka impilo yami ezandleni zami na?
Uzongibulala, angisenathemba, ngizozivikela izindlela zami, ngilubeke udaba lwami phambi kwakhe.
Lokhu kuyakuba yinsindiso yami, ukuthi ongenaNkulunkulu akayukuza phambi kwakhe.
Lalelisisani amazwi ami, nengikushoyo kungene ezindlebeni zenu.
Bhekani-ke, sengizilungiselele ukwethula udaba lwami, futhi ngiyazi ukuthi icala lizongithetha.
Ngubani ozophikisana nami na? Ngokuba uma kunjalo ngizozithulela ngize ngife.
Zimbili kuphela izinto engicela ungenzele zona, ukuze ngingabucasheli ubuso bakho:
dedisela kude nami isandla sakho, ukwesabeka kwakho kungangethusi.
Khuluma, ngizophendula, noma mangikhulume, Wena ungiphendule.
Zingakanani iziphambeko zami nezono zami na? Ngazise izeqo zami nezono zami.
Ubufihleleni ubuso bakho, ushaye sengathi ngiyisitha sakho na?
Uzokwethusa iqabunga eliphephukayo, uxoshe inkunkuma eyomileyo na?
Ngokuba ubhala izinto ezibuhlungu ngami, ungijezisela iziphambeko zasebusheni bami.
Izinyawo zami uzichome ezingongolweni, waziqaphela zonke izindlela zami, wamisa umkhawulo ematheni ezinyawo zami.
Ngiyaphela njengobolayo, nanjengengubo edliwa ngubuvunya.”
“Umuntu ozelwe ngowesifazane imihla yakhe mifushane, igcwele inkathazo.
Uyaqhakaza njengembali, abuye abune, ubalekisa okwethunzi, akami ndawonye.
Ngabe ugxilisa amehlo akho konje, ungiyisa ekwehlulelweni kanye nawe na?
Ngubani ongaveza okuhlanzekile kokungcolile na? Akekho noyedwa.
Uma imihla yakhe inqunyiwe, nenani lezinsuku zakhe zikuwe, uwumisile umkhawulo wakhe, akasoze aweqa.
Bheka kude naye, uke umyeke, aze athokoze osukwini lwakhe, njengomqashwa.
“Ngokuba kukhona ithemba emthini: uma unqunywa, uyakubuye uhlume, nehlumela lawo aliyukuphela.
Noma impande yawo iguga emhlabathini, nesiqu sawo sifela othulini,
ngephunga lamanzi uyakuhluma, uveze amagatsha njengesithombo.
Kepha umuntu uyafa, abe buthakathaka, umuntu obhubhile uphi na?
Njengamanzi anyamalele olwandle, nomfula oshile waze woma,
kanjalo umuntu ulala phansi, angabe esavuka, lize lingabi bikho izulu abayukuvuka, abayukuphaphanyiswa ebuthongweni babo.
Sengathi ungangifihla endaweni yabafileyo, ungisithe kuze kudlule intukuthelo yakho, unginqumele isikhathi, ungikhumbule.
Uma umuntu efa, uyakubuye aphile yini na? Bengiyakulinda zonke izinsuku zomshikashika wami, kuze kufike ukuphunyuzwa kwami.
Uyakungibiza, ngisabele, uyakuwulangazelela umsebenzi wezandla zakho,
ngalokhu awuyukuzibala izinyathelo zami, awuyukusinaka isono sami.
Isiphambeko besiyakuvalelwa esikhwameni, bese usibekela ukona kwami.
“Kepha intaba iyawa, idilike, nedwala lisuswe endaweni yalo,
amanzi ayagudla amatshe, ukuphuphuma kwawo kukhukhula uthuli lomhlaba, nethemba lomuntu lishafiswe kanjalo.
Uyamehlula kuze kube phakade, ahambe, uyabuguqula ubuso bakhe, umhambise.
Amadodana akhe ayahlonishwa, engazi yena, ayehliswa, yena angakuboni lokho.
Umzimba wakhe kuphela ozwa ubuhlungu, umphefumulo wakhe umlilele wona kuphela.”
Kwase kuthatha u-Elifazi, umThemani, wathi:
“Ohlakaniphileyo uyakuphendula yini ngolwazi olungathi shu, agcwalise isisu ngomoya wasempumalanga na?
Aphikisane ngamazwi angasizi lutho nangezinkulumo ezingenalusizo na?
Kepha wena uyakuchitha ukwesaba, uqede ukuzindla phambi kukaNkulunkulu.
Ngokuba iziphambeko zakho zifundisa umlomo wakho; ukhetha ukukhuluma kwamaqili.
Ngumlomo wakho okulahla ngecala, yizindebe zakho uqobo, hhayi mina, ezifakaza okumelene nawe.
Ngabe ungumuntu wokuqala yini owazalwa na? Wabakhona zingakabi bikho nezintaba na?
Wakuzwa yini okwakhulunywa emkhandlwini kaNkulunkulu, wazigodlela wedwa ukuhlakanipha na?
Yini oyaziyo thina esingayaziyo na? Yini oyiqondayo thina esingayiqondiyo na?
Izimpunga, nabamnkantshubomvu abadala kunoyihlo bangakithi.
Incane yini kuwe induduzo kaNkulunkulu, nezwi elikhulunywa kahle kuwe na?
Kungani inhliziyo yakho ikumukisa na? Kungani amehlo akho egcwala intukuthelo,
bese ubhokela uNkulunkulu ngolaka, ukhulume amazwi anje ngomlomo wakho na?
Uyini umuntu ukuba angaba ngohlanzekileyo, nozelwe ngowesifazane ukuba abe ngolungileyo na?
Nabangcwele bakhe akabethembi, nezulu alihlanzekile emehlweni akhe,
kakhulu kangakanani onengekayo nowonakeleyo, umuntu ophuza ububi njengamanzi na?
“Ngizokutshela, ngilalele, ngizokulandisa engikubonileyo,
lokho okwakhulunywa yizihlakaniphi ezingakufihlanga kokhokho bazo,
izwe elanikwa zona kuphela, akukho mfokazi owadabula phakathi kwabo.
Umuntu oyisikhohlakali ubinyabinyeka ebuhlungwini imihla yonke, ngayo yonke iminyaka isidlova esibekelwe yona.
Ukunkeneneza okwesabisayo kusezindlebeni zakhe, uyothi esahlezi enethezekile, kutheleke umphangi.
Akethembi ukuthi uyobuya ebumnyameni, ulindelwe yinkemba.
Uhamba ezulazula, efuna ukudla, athi: kuphi na? Uyazi ukuthi usuku lobumnyama selusesandleni sakhe.
Ukuhlupheka nosizi kuyamethusa, kumkhungatha njengenkosi ezilungiselele ukuya empini,
ngokuba waphonsela uNkulunkulu inselelo, wazigabisa kuSomandla.
Wamelana naye ngeqholo, ethembele emahawini akhe aqinileyo,
ngokuba wasibekela ubuso bakhe ngamafutha akhe, wenza umvingqi okhalo lwakhe.
Wahlala emizini eyincithakalo, nasezindlini okungahlali muntu kuzo, ezimiselwe ukuba ngamanxiwa.
Akayukuceba, nengcebo yakhe ayiyukuhlala, nempahla yakhe ayiyukwanda ezweni.
Akayukusuka ebumnyameni, ilangabi liyakubunisa amagatsha akhe, apheshulwe ngukuphefumula komlomo wakhe.
Makangethembi okuyize, azikhohlise ngokuyize, ngokuba ize liyakuba ngumvuzo wakhe.
Kuyokwenzeka kungakabi yisikhathi, igatsha lakhe lingakakhuli libe luhlaza.
Uyakuvuthulula amagilebhisi akhe aluhlaza njengomvini, awohloze imbali yakhe njengomnqumo.
Ngokuba umshungu wabangenabunkulunkulu uyinyumba, nomlilo uqothula amathende athengwa ngokufunjathiswa.
Bakhulelwa inkathazo, bazale inkohlakalo, isisu sabo silungiselela inkohliso.”
UJobe waphendula, wathi:
“Ngizizwile izinto eziningi ezinjengalezi, nonke ningabaduduzi ababi.
Awukho yini umkhawulo emazwini ayize na? Ucunulwa yini ukuze ungiphendule na?
Nami bengingakhuluma njengani, ukuba benisesikhundleni sami, bengingayihlanganisa inkulumo, ngimelane nani, ngininikinele ikhanda.
Benginganikhuthaza ngomlomo, induduzo yezindebe zami idambise izinhlungu zenu.
“Uma ngikhuluma, ubuhlungu bami abuyukudanjiswa, nalapho ngithula, bungakanani obusukayo kimi na?
Nokho manje uNkulunkulu ungikhathazile, yonke indlu yami uyenze incithakalo.
Ungibambile, lokhu kungubufakazi, ukuzaca kwami kumile kungubufakazi phambi kwami.
Ulaka lwakhe luyadwengula, luyangisibekela, ungiququdela amazinyo, isitha sami singihlahlela amehlo.
Bangikhamisela imilomo, bengiklolodela, bangishaya esihlathini, bengigcona, bayangihlanganyela.
UNkulunkulu unginikele kubantu abonakeleyo, ungiphonse esandleni sezikhohlakali.
Ngangihlezi kahle, wangiphihliza, ungibambe ngentamo, wangiphahlaza, ungimise ngaba yinkololo yakhe.
Abacibishelayo bakhe bangihaqile, uqhekeze izinso ngokungenaluzwelo, inyongo yami uyichithe emhlabathini.
Ungishaya ephindelela, ungidumela njengeqhawe.
“Ngithungele indwangu eyisaka esikhumbeni sami; ngabeka amandla ami othulini.
Ubuso bami buklwele babomvu ngukukhala, kunobumnyama obukhulu ezinkopheni zami,
nakuba kungekho budlova ezandleni zami, nokukhuleka kwami kulungile.
Mhlaba, uze ungaligqibi igazi lami, ukukhala kwami makungayitholi indawo yokuphumula.
Ngisho manje, ufakazi wami usezulwini, ummeli wami usezindaweni eziphakemeyo.
Abangani bami bayangiklolodela, iso lami liphophoza izinyembezi kuNkulunkulu,
ukuze abeke udaba lomuntu kuNkulunkulu, njengomuntu ekhulumela umngani wakhe.
Ngokuba sekusele iminyaka embalwa, ngithathe indlela engingenakubuya kuyo.”
“Umoya wami wephukile, imihla yami iyaphela, sengibhekene negodi.
Impela kukhona abangiklolodelayo eduze kwami, neso lami lihleli ekungichukuluzeni kwabo.
Ake unginike isibambiso, ungimele, ngubani oyokwenza isivumelwano nami na?
Ngokuba uzivalile izingqondo zabo, ukuze zingaqondi, ngakho-ke awuyukubaphakamisa.
Okhaphela abangani bakhe ngenxa yesabelo; amehlo abantwana bakhe ayakufiphala.
Ungenze isiga ebantwini, nokhafulelwa ebusweni.
Iso lami lifiphele ngenxa yosizi, wonke amalungu ami anjengethunzi.
Abaqotho badumele ngalokhu, ukuthi ongenacala uvukela ongenabunkulunkulu.
Olungileyo uyobambelela endleleni yakhe, onezandla ezihlanzekileyo uyakukhula emandleni.
Kepha nina buyani manje ngothi lwenu, nokho angiyukumthola ohlakaniphileyo phakathi kwenu.
Izinsuku zami seziphelile, amasu ami asechithiwe, nezifiso zenhliziyo yami.
Ubusuku babenza imini, bathi: ‘Ukukhanya kuseduze nobumnyama.’
Uma ngithemba ukuthi indawo yabafileyo iyindlu yami, ngendlale ukhukho lwami ebumnyameni,
ngibize ingcwaba ngithi: ‘Ungubaba,’ nezimpethu: ‘Mame nodadewethu.’
Liphi pho ithemba lami na? Yebo, ithemba lami, ngubani oyakulibona na?
Ngabe liyokwehlela ezinsikeni zendawo yabafileyo, sehle kanyekanye, siyophumula othulini na?”
UBhilidadi umShuhi wayesethatha, ethi:
“Uyokuyeka nini lokhu kukhuluma na? Ake ucabangisise, bese siyakhuluma.
Kungani sithathwa njengezilwane, siyizithutha yini emehlweni akho na?
Wena ozidwengulayo ngenxa yolaka lwakho, umhlaba uyoshiywa yini ngenxa yakho, nedwala lisuswe endaweni yalo emhlabeni na?
Yebo, ukukhanya kwesikhohlakali kuyacishwa, nelangabi lomlilo waso aliyukukhanya.
Ukukhanya kuyafiphala ethendeni laso, nesibani saso siyacima phezu kwaso.
Izinyathelo zaso ezinamandla ziyafinyezwa, namasu aso asiqumbe phansi.
Ngokuba izinyawo zaso zibanjwe enethini, sihamba phezu komwowane.
Unoxhaka usibambe esithendeni, nogibe lwasibamba.
Sithukuselwe isihibe emhlabathini, nonoxhaka endleleni.
Ingebhe iyasethusa nxazonke, isezithendeni zaso.
Inhlupheko isilambele, nenhlekelele isilindele lapho sikhubeka.
Izingxenye zesikhumba saso ziyakudliwa, yebo, izibulo lokufa kuyawadla amalungu aso.
Siyakususwa ethendeni laso esilethembayo, siyiswe enkosini yengebhe.
Ethendeni laso kuyohlala okungesibo abaso, indawo yaso ichelwe ngesibabuli.
Kuyokoma izimpande zaso phansi, phezulu kubune amagatsha aso.
Kuyakuphela ukukhunjulwa kwaso emhlabeni, kungabi bikho okhumbula igama laso emigwaqweni.
Siyakuxoshwa ekukhanyeni, siyiswe ebumnyameni, sixoshwe emhlabeni.
Asiyukuba nabantwana noma abazukulu phakathi kwabakubo, noyosinda lapho sasihlala khona.
Abasentshonalanga bethuswa lusuku lwaso, nabasempumalanga bakhungathwa ngukwesaba.
Impela lezi yizindlu zowenza okubi, impela lena yindawo yongamazi uNkulunkulu.”
UJobe wayesephendula, ethi:
“Kuyoze kube nini nihlupha umphefumulo wami, ningihlifiza ngamazwi na?
Sekuze kwaba kalishumi ningingcofa, kodwa anizange nibe namahloni okuthi ningiphathe kabi.
Uma impela ngonile, ukona kwami kuhleli kimi.
Uma impela niyozikhukhumeza ngaphezu kwami, niphikisana nami ngehlazo lami,
yazini-ke ukuthi nguNkulunkulu owenze okubi kimi, wangigubuzela ngenetha lakhe.
Noma ngikhalile ngathi: ‘Indluzula!’ kepha angiphendulwanga, ngicele ukusizwa, kodwa abukho ubulungiswa.
Uyivalile indlela yami ukuze ngingedluli, wabeka ubumnyama ezindleleni zami.
Uluhlubulile udumo lwami kimi, wasusa umqhele ekhanda lami.
Ungidilizele phansi nxazonke, ngaphela nya, ithemba lami ulisiphule njengesihlahla.
Ungivuthele ngentukuthelo yakhe, wangithatha njengesitha sakhe.
Amabutho akhe atheleke kanyekanye, angizungeza ngemigoqo yokuhlasela, akanisa nxazonke zethende lami.
“Uqhelisele kude abafowethu, abazana nami bangihlubuka impela.
Izihlobo zami zingishiyile, nengazana nabo bangikhohliwe.
Abagogobele endlini yami nezincekukazi zami bangenza umfokazi, sengingowezizwe emehlweni abo.
Uma ngibiza inceku yami, ayisabeli, sekuyimina engiyincenga ngomlomo wami.
Umoya wami uyanuka kumkami, sebeyanengwa yimi, ngisho nabantwana esaphuma nabo siswini sinye kumame.
Sengedelelwa ngisho nayizingane, uma ngivuka, zikhuluma kabi ngami.
Abangani bami ebesingamathe nolimi nabo sebeyangenyanya, nalabo engibathandayo sebengifulathele.
Amathambo ami anamathela esikhumbeni sami nasenyameni yami, ngisinde ngokulambisa kuphela.
Ngihawukeleni, ngihawukeleni, nina bangani bami, ngokuba isandla sikaNkulunkulu singishayile.
Ningihluphelani njengalokhu noNkulunkulu enza na? Anisuthi yini yinyama yami na?
“Sengathi amazwi ami angalotshwa phansi! Sengathi amazwi ami abengaqoshwa emqulwini,
aqoshwe edwaleni ngosiba lwensimbi nomthofu, ukuze ahlale ingunaphakade!
Kepha mina ngiyazi ukuthi uMhlengi wami uyaphila, ekupheleni uyakuma othulini.
Lapho sesishabalele isikhumba sami, ngiyakumbona uNkulunkulu ngingokhululekile emzimbeni.
Ngiyakumbona mina uqobo lwami, amehlo ami ayakumbona, hhayi njengomfokazi, umphefumulo wami uqhilika injabulo uma ngicabanga ngalokho.
Uma nithi: ‘Siyakumhlupha kanjani!’ bese nithi: ‘Umongo wendaba ukuye,’
yesabeni nina uqobo inkemba, ngokuba ulaka lungolweziphambeko ezifanele inkemba, ukuze nazi ukuthi ukwehlulela kukhona.”
UZofari, umNahama, waphendula, wathi:
“Imicabango yami engihluphayo ingenza ngishe amashushu ngokukuphendula, ngenxa yokuba ngikhathazeke kakhulu.
Sengizizwile izinsolo zakho ezingithunazayo, kodwa manje umoya wami wokuqonda ungenza ngiphendule.
“Awazi yini lokhu ukuthi kusukela emandulo, lapho kubekwa abantu emhlabeni,
ukuthi ukujabula kwezikhohlakali kufushane, nokuthokoza kwabangenankulunkulu kungokomzuzwana nje na?
Noma ukuphakama kwakhe kungakhuphukela ezulwini, nekhanda lakhe lifinyelele emafini,
uyakubhubha kuze kube phakade, njengendle yakhe; abambonayo bayakuthi: ‘Ukuphi na?’
Uyakundiza njengephupho, angafunyanwa, axoshwe njengombono wasebusuku.
Iso elimbonile alisayukuphinde limbone, nendawo yakhe ayisayukumbona.
Abantwana bakhe bayonxephezela abampofu, izandla zabo ziwubuyisele kubo umcebo wakhe.
Amathambo akhe ayogcwala ugqozi lobusha, kodwa ayolala othulini kanye naye.
“Noma ububi bumnandi emlonyeni wakhe, ebufihla phansi kolimi lwakhe,
noma ebugodla engabushiyi, ebugcina emlonyeni wakhe,
nokho ukudla kwakhe kuyomphendukela esiswini, kube ngubuthi bezimfezi ezibilini zakhe.
Umcebo awugwinyile, uyobuye awuhlanze, nguNkulunkulu oyakuwukhipha esiswini sakhe.
Uncela isihlungu sezimfezi, abulawe wulimi lwenyoka.
Akayukuyibuka imifula nemifudlana egeleza uju nezaqheqhe.
Ubuyisa konke akukhandlekelayo, engakakugwinyi, akayukujabula ngempahla ayitholileyo.
Ngokuba ubacindezele, wabalahla abampofu, udle indlu angazange ayakhe.
“Ngokuba akakwazi ukuthula ngaphakathi kwakhe, kulokho akufisayo akuphumeleli lutho.
Akusalanga lutho angaludlanga, ngakho-ke impumelelo yakhe ayinakuma.
Kuyothi kusamhambela kahle, ehlelwe yizinhlupheko; izandla zabo bonke abahluphekayo ziyakuza kuye.
UNkulunkulu uyakugcwalisa isisu sakhe ngezinhlupheko, anise ukuvutha kwentukuthelo yakhe phezu kwakhe.
Uyakubalekela isikhali sensimbi, kodwa agwazwe ngumnsalo wethusi.
Uwubhoncula uphume ngasemhlane, awubone ubengezela igazi lakhe, maqede akhungathwe yingebhe.
Ubumnyama obupheleleyo buyakuba phezu komcebo wakhe wonke, umlilo ongavuthelwanga muntu uyakumqothula, okuseleyo ethendeni lakhe kushe kungqongqe.
Izulu liyoveza obala isiphambeko sakhe, umhlaba umelane naye.
Ifa lendlu yakhe liyoshabalala, linyamalale ngosuku lwentukuthelo kaNkulunkulu.
Lesi yisabelo somuntu okhohlakele, esivela kuNkulunkulu, nefa alimiselwe nguNkulunkulu.”
UJobe waphendula, wathi:
“Walaleleni ngokucophelela amazwi ami; lokhu makube yinduduzo evela kini.
Ngibekezeleleni, ngizakukhuluma, ningangiklolodela-ke lapho sengiqedile ukukhuluma.
“Ngabe ukukhononda kwami kungomuntu yini na? Kungani umphefumulo wami ungebekezele na?
Ngibhekeni, nishaqeke, nibambe ongezansi.
Uma ngikhumbula lokhu, ngiyaphazamiseka, ukwesaba kuhlasimulise umzimba wami.
Kungani izikhohlakali ziphila, zize zibe zindala, yebo, zidlondlobale zibe namandla na?
Abantwana bazo bekhula bamiswe phambi kwazo, nozalo lwazo, phambi kwamehlo azo.
Izindlu zazo zivikelekile, akukho ukwesaba kuzo; uswazi lukaNkulunkulu alukho phezu kwazo.
Inkunzi yazo iyakhwela, kayiphuthi; inkomazi yazo iyazala, kayiphunzi.
Zikhipha amankonyane azo njengomhlambi; abantwana bazo bayatshakadula.
Bahlabelela ngesigubhu nangehabhu, bathokoza ngomsindo womtshingo.
Ziphetha imihla yazo ngokuhle, zehlela endaweni yabafileyo ngokuthula.
Nokho zithe kuNkulunkulu: ‘Suka kithi, asifuni ukwazi izindlela zakho.
USomandla uyini ukuba simkhonze na? Siyakuzuzani uma sikhuleka kuye na?’
Bhekani, impumelelo yazo isezandleni zazo; izeluleko zezikhohlakali zikude nami.
“Kukangaki lapho isibani sezikhohlakali sicinywa khona, zehlelwe yinhlekelele, zabelwe isabelo ngentukuthelo yakhe na?
Zifana nezibi phambi komoya, namakhoba epheshulwa yisiphepho.
UNkulunkulu ukubekele abantwana bazo ukukhohlakala kwazo, kodwa makabuphindisele kuzo uqobo, ukuze zikwazi.
Mazikubone ukubhubha kwazo ngamehlo azo, ziphuze intukuthelo kaSomandla.
Zinandabani nabendlu yazo uma sezingasekho, lapho umumo wezinyanga zazo usunqunyiwe na?
Ukhona yini ongafundisa uNkulunkulu ukwazi, Yena owehlulela abaphakemeyo na?
“Omunye ufa esemi kahle kukho konke, ezinzile, enokuthula.
Umzimba wakhe unonophele, umnkantsha wamathambo akhe ucebile.
Omunye ufa enomphefumulo onomunyu, engakaze adle okuhle.
Bayolala phansi othulini kanyekanye, izimpethu zibemboze.
Bhekani, ngiyayazi imicabango yenu, namacebo enu enifuna ukungihlukumeza ngawo.
Nithi: ‘Iphi indlu yezikhulu, liphi ithende elihlala izikhohlakali na?’
Anibabuzanga yini abadlula ngendlela? Anibamukeli yini ubufakazi babo
bokuthi omubi uyokophulwa ngosuku lwenhlekelele, nokuthi bayaphunyuka ngosuku lwentukuthelo na?
Ngubani oyakumtshela kwezikabhoqo ngendlela yakhe na? Ngubani oyakuphindisela ngalokho akwenzileyo na?
Uyakuyiswa ethuneni, kube khona olinda elibeni.
Amagabade asesigodini ayakuba mnandi kuye; bonke abantu bayakumlandela njengokuba bengenakubalwa nababephambi kwakhe.
“Pho ningiduduzelani ngeze, lokhu ezimpendulweni zenu kusele inkohliso yodwa na?”
U-Elifazi umThemani wayesethatha, ethi:
“Umuntu angaba yini wusizo kuNkulunkulu na? Ohlakaniphe kakhulu angaba wusizo yini kuye na?
Kuyintokozo yini kuSomandla uma ulungile? Kunomvuzo yini kuye uma wenza izindlela zakho zibe msulwa na?
“Ngabe ukusola ngenxa yokumesaba kwakho yini, aze angene nawe ekwehlulelweni na?
Ububi bakho abubukhulu yini na? Izono zakho azinakuphela.
Ngokuba uthathe ngeze izibambiso kubafowenu, wahlubula abampofu izingubo zabo.
Awumphuzisanga amanzi okhatheleyo, awumnikanga ukudla olambileyo.
Umuntu onamandla, izwe lingelakhe; ohlonishwayo uhlala kulo.
Uxoshe abafelokazi bengenalutho, wafihliza izingalo zezintandane.
Ngakho-ke uzohaqwa yizingibe; wethuswe wuvalo oluzumayo.
Uyokwembozwa ngubumnyama, ukuze ungaboni, nesikhukhula samanzi siyakukusibekela.
“UNkulunkulu akekho yini phezulu ezulwini na? Bheka, izinkanyezi eziphakemeyo ukuthi ziphakeme kangakanani.
Uthi wena: ‘UNkulunkulu wazini na? Angehlulela yini engale kwesigayegaye na?
Amafu ayamsibekela ukuze angaboni; uhamba esiyingelezini sezulu.’
Uyakuyigcina yini indlela yasemandulo eyahanjwa yizikhohlakali na?
Yizo ezahlwithwa kungakabi yisikhathi, ezisisekelo sazo sathululwa njengomfula,
ezazithi kuNkulunkulu: ‘Suka kithi; uSomandla angenzani na?’
Kepha nguye owagcwalisa izindlu zazo ngokuhle. Amasu ezikhohlakali akude nami.
“Abalungileyo bayakukubona, bathokoze; abangenasici bayabaklolodela, bathi:
‘Impela ababemelene nathi sebebhujisiwe, nabakushiyileyo kuqothulwe ngumlilo.’
“Mawubuyisane noNkulunkulu, ukuze ube nokuthula; ngaleyo ndlela, okuhle kuyakufika kuwe.
Ake wemukele imfundiso ephuma emlonyeni wakhe, ubeke amazwi akhe enhliziyweni yakho.
Uma ubuyela kuSomandla, uyakusimamiswa, uma ususa ukungalungi ethendeni lakho,
ulahle igolide lakho othulini, nelase-Ofiri ulitshinge phakathi kwamatshe esigodini,
uSomandla uyakuba yigolide lakho nesiliva elikhazimulayo kuwe.
Ngalokho uyothokoza ngoSomandla, ubuso bakho ubuphakamisele kuNkulunkulu.
Uyakukhuleka kuye, akuzwe, wena ufeze izithembiso zakho.
Uyakunquma ukwenza okuthile, kwenzeke, ukukhanya kuyokhanya ezindleleni zakho.
Uma bekwehlisa isithunzi, uyakuthi: ‘Kungukuphakanyiswa!’ ngokuba uyamsindisa ozithobayo.
Umuntu ongemsulwa uyakumhlenga naye, uyakumhlenga ngobumsulwa bezandla zakho.”
Wayesephendula uJobe, wathi:
“Nanamuhla ukukhononda kwami kumunyu; isandla sami sinzima, nakuba ngibubula.
Sengathi ngabe ngiyazi ukuthi ngizomthola kuphi, ukuze ngifike endaweni yakhe.
Bengiyakulwethula udaba lwami phambi kwakhe, umlomo wami ngiwugcwalise ngamazwi empikiswano.
Bengiyakuwazi amazwi abeyokungiphendula ngawo, ngikuqonde abezokusho kimi.
Ubeyakuphikisana nami yini ngamandla akhe amakhulu na? Qha, ubeyongilalela.
Olungileyo ubengaphikisana naye, mina ngikhululwe kumehluleli wami ingunaphakade.
Kepha uma ngiya phambili, akekho lapho, uma ngiya emuva, angimboni
ngakwesokhohlo, lapho ezifihle khona, angimboni; ujikela ngakwesokunene, kepha angimboni.
“Ngokuba uyayazi indlela yami; esengivivinyile, ngiyakuphuma nginjengegolide.
Unyawo lwami lunamathele ezinyathelweni zakhe; ngiyigcinile indlela yakhe, angiphambukanga.
Angichezukanga emyalweni wezindebe zakhe; amazwi akhe ngiwagcinile esifubeni sami.
“Yena akaguquki, ngubani ongamguqula na? Wenza lokhu okufiswa ngumphefumulo wakhe.
Uyakukufeza lokho angiqokele khona; nokunye okuningi okusemqondweni wakhe.
Ngakho-ke ngiyamesaba nxa ngiphambi kwakhe, uma ngicabanga ngaye ngiba nengebhe ngaye.
UNkulunkulu uyidangalisile inhliziyo yami. uSomandla ungethusile,
Angibhujiswanga phambi kwesigayegaye, nakuba okumnyama kungisibekele.”
“Kungani ukuba izikhathi zokwehlulela zingagcinwa nguSomandla, futhi kungani labo abamaziyo bengaziboni lezo zinsuku zakhe na?
Abantu bagudluza izikhonkwane zemingcele, baphange imihlambi, bayiklabise.
