Thumela ukukhanya kwakho neqiniso lakho, makungihole kungiyise entabeni yakho engcwele, nasezindlini zakho,
ngize ngifike e-althare likaNkulunkulu, kuNkulunkulu oyinjabulo yami nokwethaba kwami; ngikudumise ngokhehlegume, Nkulunkulu, Nkulunkulu wami.
Mphefumulo wami, kungani udangele, uyaluza ngaphakathi kwami na? Themba uNkulunkulu, ngokuba ngisazomdumisa uMsindisi wami, noNkulunkulu wami.
Nkulunkulu, sizwile ngezindlebe zethu, nokhokho bethu besitshela lokho owakwenza emihleni yabo, emihleni yasemandulo.
Wena ngesandla sakho, waxosha izizwe, bona wabatshala; wazibhubhisa izizwe, bona wabakhulula.
Ngokuba abalidlanga izwe ngenkemba yabo, nengalo yabo ayibasindisanga, kodwa kwaba yisandla sakho sokunene nengalo yakho, nokukhanya kobukhona bakho, ngokuba wethaba ngabo.
Wena uyiNkosi yami, Nkulunkulu, yaleza ukunqoba kukaJakobe.
Ngawe sizakuzilahla phansi izitha zethu, ngegama lakho sizakubanyathela abasivukelayo.
Ngokuba angethembele emnsalweni wami, nenkemba yami ayingisindisanga.
Kepha nguwe osisindisile ezitheni zethu, wabathela ngehlazo abasizondayo.
Sizincoma njalo ngoNkulunkulu wethu, silibonge igama lakho ingunaphakade.
Nokho usilahlile, wasijabhisa, futhi awusaphumi nezimpi zethu.
Usihlehlisela emuva esitheni, abasizondayo bayaziphangela.
Usenze safana nezimvu zokuhlatshwa, wasihlakazela phakathi kwezizwe.
Isizwe sakho usithengise ngenani eliphansi, wangathola nzuzo ngaso.
Usenze isethuko komakhelwane bethu, inhlekisa nendumalo kwabasiphahlileyo.
Usenze isaga kwabezizwe, banikina amakhanda phakathi kwabantu.
Usuku lonke, ukudunyazwa kwami kuphambi kwami, ihlazo lemboze ubuso bami
ngenxa yoklolodayo nojivazayo, nangenxa yesitha nomphindiseleli.
Konke lokhu kusehlele, kodwa akusenzanga sakhohlwa nguwe, asisephulanga isivumelwano sakho.
Izinhliziyo zethu azikufulathelanga, izinyathelo zethu aziphambukanga endleleni yakho,
kodwa usiphahlazele endaweni yezimpungushe, wasemboza ngethunzi lokufa.
Uma singakhohlwa yigama likaNkulunkulu wethu, noma izandla zethu sizivulele unkulunkulu ongaziwa,
ngeke yini uNkulunkulu azi ngalokho na? Ngokuba Yena wazi izimfihlo ezisenhliziyweni.
Ngenxa yakho, sibulawa usuku lonke, sifana nezimvu zokuhlatshwa.
Vuka, Nkosi! Ulaleleni na? Ungasilahli njalonjalo.
Ubufihlelani ubuso bakho, ukhohlwe ukuhlupheka nokucindezelwa kwethu na?
Ngokuba sibishe othulini; imizimba yethu inamathele emhlabathini.
Sukuma, usisize. Sihlenge ngenxa yomusa wakho.
Inhliziyo yami iyaphuphuma ngenxa yendaba enhle, ngikhuluma ngegama engiliqambe ngenkosi, ulimi lwami lulusiba lobhala ngokushesha.
Wena umuhle kunabo bonke abantu, umusa uthululelwe ezindebeni zakho. Ngakho-ke uNkulunkulu ukubusisile kuze kube phakade.
Gaxa inkemba yakho enqulwini, wena qhawe, ngodumo nobukhosi bakho.
Gibela ebukhosini bakho ngokunqoba, ngenxa yeqiniso, ukuthobeka nokulunga; isandla sakho sokunene masikufundise izenzo ezimangalisayo.
Imicibisholo yakho icijile, ingena enhliziyweni yezitha zenkosi, izizwe ziwa phansi kwakho.
Nkulunkulu, isihlalo sakho sobukhosi simi kuze kube phakade. Intonga yokulunga iyintonga yombuso wakho.
Uthanda ukulunga, uzonde ububi. Yingakho uNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu wakho, ekugcobe ngamafutha entokozo ngaphezulu kwabangani bakho.
Zonke izingubo zakho ziqholwe ngemure nenhlaba nekhasiya. Imiqangala evela ezigodlweni zophondo lwendlovu iyakwethabisa.
Amadodakazi amakhosi aphakathi kwabesifazane bakho abadumileyo, indlovukazi imi ngakwesokunene sakho, ihlobe ngegolide lase-Ofiri.
Lalela-ke, ndodakazi, qaphela, ubeke indlebe yakho, ukhohlwe ngabantu bakini nangendlu kayihlo,
khona inkosi izokhangwa ngubuhle bakho, ngokuba yona iyinkosi yakho, uboyikhothamela.
Indodakazi yaseThire nabantu abacebileyo bancenga umusa wakho ngesipho.
Indodakazi yenkosi yinhle kakhulu ilapho phakathi; ingubo yayo ifekethiswe ngegolide.
Iyiswa enkosini igqoke izingubo ezifekethisiweyo, ikhashwa yizintombi ezingabangani bayo, zilethwa kuwe.
Ngenjabulo nangentokozo, bayazihola njengoba zingena esigodlweni senkosi.
Amadodana akho ayohlala esikhundleni sawoyihlomkhulu, uwabeke abe yizikhulu emhlabeni wonke.
Igama lakho ngizolenza likhunjulwe yizizukulwane ngezizukulwane, ngakho-ke izizwe ziyokubonga kuze kube phakade.
UNkulunkulu uyisiphephelo sethu namandla ethu, ufunyaniswa elusizo impela ekuhluphekeni.
Ngakho-ke angiyukwesaba nakuba umhlaba uguquka, nezintaba zidilikela ekujuleni kolwandle,
nakuba amanzi alo ehlokoma, ekhephuzela, nezintaba zizamazama ngokudlanga kwalo.
Ukhona umfula omanzi awo athokozisa umuzi kaNkulunkulu, indlu engcwele yoPhezukonke.
UNkulunkulu uphakathi kwawo, awuyukuzanyazanyiswa, uNkulunkulu uyakuwusiza ngovivi lokusa.
Izizwe ziyaxokozela, imibuso iyazamazama; uphumisela izwi lakhe, umhlaba uncibilike.
USimakade Wamabandla unathi, uNkulunkulu kaJakobe uyinqaba yethu.
Wozani, nibone imisebenzi kaSimakade, incithakalo ayehlisele emhlabeni.
Uqeda izimpi kuze kube semikhawulweni yomhlaba, wephula umnsalo, anqume umkhonto, izinqola zempi azishise ngomlilo.
Thulani, niqonde ukuthi Mina nginguNkulunkulu, ngiyakuphakama kwabezizwe, ngiphakame emhlabeni.
USimakade Wamabandla unathi, uNkulunkulu kaJakobe uyinqaba yethu.
Zizwe zonke, shayani izandla, hlokomani ngezwi lokuhalalisa kuNkulunkulu.
Ngokuba uSimakade Ophezukonke uyesabeka, uyiNkosi enkulu phezu komhlaba wonke.
Izizwe wazithobisa zaba phansi kwethu, nabantu phansi kwezinyawo zethu.
Wasikhethela ifa lethu, udumo lukaJakobe amthandayo.
UNkulunkulu wenyuke ngenhlokomo, uSimakade ngokukhala kwecilongo.
Hubelani uNkulunkulu, mdumiseni! Hubelani iNkosi yethu, hubani!
UNkulunkulu uyinkosi yomhlaba wonke, hubani ihubo!
UNkulunkulu ubusa izizwe, uNkulunkulu uhlezi esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi esingcwele.
Izikhulu zabantu zibuthene, zibe yisizwe sikaNkulunkulu ka-Abhrahama, ngokuba izihlangu zomhlaba zingezikaNkulunkulu, uphakeme kakhulu.
Mkhulu uSimakade, makadunyiswe emzini kaNkulunkulu wethu, entabeni yakhe engcwele.
Inhle ngokuphakama, ingukuthokoza komhlaba wonke, intaba iZiyoni isemaphethelweni enyakatho, umuzi weNkosi enkulu.
UNkulunkulu uyaziwa ezigodlweni ukuthi uyinqaba.
Ngokuba amakhosi abuthana, aqhubeka kanyekanye.
Ayibona intaba iZiyoni, amangala, ashaywa wuvalo, aphaphatheka,
akhungathwa yingebhe lapho nemihelo, njengokowesifazane otetayo.
Ngomoya wasempumalanga, waphula imikhumbi yaseTharishishi.
Njengalokhu sizwile, kanjalo sikubonile emzini kaSimakade Wamabandla, emzini kaNkulunkulu wethu, uNkulunkulu uyowumisa kuze kube phakade.
Sizindla ngomusa wakho, Simakade, siphakathi ethempelini lakho.
Njengoba linjalo igama lakho, Nkulunkulu, zinjalo nezibongo zakho kuze kube semikhawulweni yomhlaba, isandla sakho sokunene sigcwele ukulunga.
Intaba iZiyoni mayithokoze, kwethabe amadodakazi akwaJuda, ngenxa yezehlulelo zakho.
Hambani nizungeze iZiyoni, nihambe kuyo yonke indawo, nibale imibhoshongo yalo.
Qaphelani izindonga zalo, nidabule ezigodlweni zalo, ukuze nilandise ngalo isizukulwane esisazozalwa,
ukuthi impela lo Nkulunkulu, unguNkulunkulu wethu waphakade naphakade. Uzosihola kuze kube sekufeni.
Lalelani lokhu nina bantu, nonke bekani indlebe, nonke zakhamuzi zasemhlabeni,
abantukazana nezikhulu, abacebileyo nabantulayo.
Umlomo wami uzokhuluma ukuhlakanipha, ukuzindla kwenhliziyo yami kuzokuba ngukuqonda.
Ngizakubeka indlebe yami kuso isaga, ngiphenye imfumbe yami ngehabhu.
Yini ebengizoyesaba ngesikhathi senhlupheko, lapho ngihaqwa wububi babangizingelayo,
labo abethembela engcebeni yabo, baqhoshe ngobuningi bomcebo wabo na?
Impela umuntu angemhlenge umfowabo, noma amhlawulele kuNkulunkulu.
Ngokuba ukuhlengwa kwempilo yakhe kubiza kakhulu, ngeke kwafinyelelwa kukho nanini,
ukuze umuntu aphile ingunaphakade, angaliboni igodi.
Qha, uyabona ukuthi abahlakaniphileyo bayafa, nokuthi isiwula nesiphukuphuku siyabhubha; umcebo wabo bawushiyele abanye.
Ukucabanga kwabo kuthi izindlu zabo zizakuma kuze kube phakade, nemizi yabo, ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane; amazwe abo bawaqamba ngamagama abo.
Kepha umuntu, nakuba enodumo, akayukuhlala angafi, ufana nezilwane ezibhubhayo.
Le ndlela yabo ingubuwula babo, balandelwa ngabathokozela amazwi abo.
Baqhutshelwa endaweni yabafileyo njengezimvu, ukufa kuyakubelusa, ngakusasa abaqotho babusa phezu kwabo, isimo sabo siqedwe yindawo yabafileyo, bangabe besaba nandlu.
Kepha uNkulunkulu uyakuwukhulula umphefumulo wami esandleni sendawo yabafileyo, ngokuba uyakungamukela.
Ungesabi uma umuntu eba yisicebi, nxa umcebo wendlu yakhe wanda.
Ngokuba ekufeni kwakhe akayukumuka nalutho, umcebo wakhe awuyukwehla naye.
Noma engawubusisa umphefumulo wakhe esaphila, futhi abantu bamtuse, ngokuba uzenzele kahle,
nokho uyakuya esizukulwaneni sokhokho bakhe, abayukukubona ukukhanya naphakade.
Umuntu ebukhazikhazini bakhe engenakuqonda, unjengezilwane ezibhubhayo.
UNkulunkulu uMninimandla wonke, uSimakade uyakhuluma, ubiza umhlaba kusukela ekuphumeni kwelanga lize liyoshona.
EseZiyoni, ekupheleleni kobuhle bakhe, uSimakade uqhakazile.
UNkulunkulu wethu uyeza, akayukuthula, phambi kwakhe kunomlilo oqothulayo, uphahlwe yisivunguvungu esinamandla.
Ubiza izulu ngaphezulu nomhlaba, ukuba ahlulele isizwe sakhe:
“Buthelani kimi abathembekileyo bami, abenza isivumelwano nami ngomhlatshelo.”
Amazulu amemezela ngokulunga kwakhe, ngokuba uNkulunkulu ungumehluleli.
“Lalelani, bantu bami, ngizokhuluma, Israyeli, ngizomelana nani. NginguNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu wakho.
Ngenxa yemihlatshelo yakho, angiyukukujezisa, ngokuba iminikelo yakho yokushiswa iphambi kwami njalo.
Angiyukuthatha nkunzi endlini yakho, nampongo ezibayeni zakho,
ngokuba zingezami zonke izilwane zehlathi, nezinkomo eziyizinkulungwane ezisezintabeni.
Ngizazi zonke izinyoni ezisezintabeni, nezilwane zasendle zaziwa yimi.
Ukuba bengilambile, bengingeke ngitshele wena, ngokuba ungowami umhlaba wonke, nakho konke okukuwo.
Mina ngizokudla inyama yezinkunzi, ngiphuze igazi lezimpongo na?
Nikela kuNkulunkulu umnikelo wokubonga, uzifeze izithembiso zakho kuye Ophezukonke,
ngibize ngosuku lwenhlupheko, ngiyakukukhulula, wena uyakungidumisa.”
Kepha komubi, uNkulunkulu uthi: “Yini ukuba ushumayele ngezimiso zami, ukhulume ngesivumelwano sami,
ingani uyakuzonda ukuyalwa, amazwi ami uwabukela phansi na?
Uma ubona isela, uvumelana nalo, neziphingi uhlanganyela nazo.
Umlomo wakho uwuyekela ebubini, ulimi lwakho lubopha inkohliso.
Uhlala ugxibha umfowenu, unyevuza indodana kanyoko.
Lokho ukwenzile, ngathula, ushaye sengathi Mina nginjengawe; ngizakukusola, ngikubeke icala.
“Nina enikhohlwa nguNkulunkulu, kuqapheleni lokho, funa nginidwengudwengule, kungabi bikho onisindisayo.
Onikela ngomnikelo wokubonga uyangidumisa, oqaphela indlela yakhe ngiyakumbonisa insindiso kaNkulunkulu.”
Ngihawukele, Nkulunkulu, ngokomusa wakho, wesule iziphambeko zami ngokobubele bakho obukhulu.
Ngigezisise ebubini bami, ungihlanze esonweni sami.
Ngiyazazi iziphambeko zami, isono sami siphambi kwami njalo.
Ngonile kuwe, kuwe wedwa, ngenza okubi emehlweni akho. Wena ulungile nxa wehlulela, futhi kucacile ukwehlulela kwakho.
Impela ngazalelwa ebubini, umame wangikhulelwa esonweni.
Wena uthanda iqiniso ngaphakathi enhliziyweni, uyongifundisa ukuhlakanipha ekujuleni kwenhliziyo.
Ngihlanze ngehisophi, ngihlambuluke, ngigeze, ngibe mhlophe kuneqhwa.
Ngizwise intokozo nenjabulo, ukuze ethabe amathambo owachobozileyo.
Fihla ubuso bakho ezonweni zami, uzesule zonke iziphambeko zami.
Nkulunkulu, dala kimi inhliziyo ehlanzekileyo, uvuse umoya oqinileyo phakathi kwami.
Ungangilahli ebusweni bakho, ungangemuki uMoya wakho oyiNgcwele.
Buyisela kimi ukuthokoza kwensindiso yakho, ungiphase ngomoya ovumayo.
Yikhona ngiyofundisa abaphambukayo izindlela zakho; nezoni ziphendukele kuwe.
Nkulunkulu, ngikhulule ecaleni legazi, Nkulunkulu wensindiso yami, yikhona ulimi lwami luzohuba ngokulunga kwakho.
Nkosi, vula izindebe zami, ukuze umlomo wami ulande ngodumo lwakho.
Ngokuba awuwuthandi umhlatshelo, noma bengizakukunika umnikelo wokushiswa, ubungayukuthokoza ngawo.
Iminikelo kaNkulunkulu ingumoya owephukileyo. Nkulunkulu, awuyukuyidelela inhliziyo eyaphukileyo nedabukileyo.
IZiyoni lenzele okuhle ngokomusa wakho, uzakhe izingange eJerusalema.
Khona uzojabulela iminikelo yokulunga engeyokushiswa naleyo eshiswa yonke, banikele nangezinkunzi phezu kwe-althare lakho.
We siqhwaga, uziqhayiselani ngokubi na? Umusa kaNkulunkulu umi njalo.
Ulimi lwakho luhlale lusongoza amacebo amabi, njengensingo ebukhali, wena menzi wobubi,
uthanda okubi kunokuhle, amanga kunokulungileyo.
Wena lulimi lwenkohliso, uthanda onke amazwi abhubhisayo.
Kepha uNkulunkulu uzokuqumba phansi kuze kube phakade; uzokubamba, akukhiphe ethendeni lakho, akusiphule nasezweni labaphilayo.
Abalungileyo bayokubona lokho, besabe; bakuhleke, bathi:
“Bheka, nasi isiqhwaga esingazange simenze uNkulunkulu abe yinqaba yaso, kodwa sethembela ebuningini bomcebo waso, sabambelela kakhulu ebubini baso.”
Kepha mina ngifana nesihlahla somhlwathi esiluhlaza, endlini kaNkulunkulu. Ngethembele emseni kaNkulunkulu kuze kube phakade.
Ngizokudumisa kuze kube phakade, ngokuba ukwenzile lokho. Ngizolindela igama lakho, ngokuba lihle phambi kwabathembekile bakho.
Isiwula sithi enhliziyweni yaso: “Akekho uNkulunkulu.” Bonakele, benze izinto ezinengekayo eziphambene nobulungiswa. Akukho noyedwa owenza okuhle.
UNkulunkulu esezulwini ubheka phansi, abone amadodana abantu, ukuze abone ukuthi ukhona yini onokuqonda, ofuna uNkulunkulu.
Bonke baphambukile, bonke bakhohlakele, akukho noyedwa owenza okuhle, akukho noyedwa.
Abanakwazi yini abenza okubi, abadla abantu bami njengalokhu bedla isinkwa, bengakhuleki kuNkulunkulu na?
Besaba kakhulu, kube kungekho okwesabisayo. UNkulunkulu uwasakazile amathambo alowo okuvimbezelayo. Wena uzobathela ngehlazo, ngokuba uNkulunkulu ubalahlile.
Ukusindiswa kuka-Israyeli kuzovela eZiyoni, lapho uNkulunkulu ebusisa abantu bakhe; uJakobe ethabe, no-Israyeli athokoze.
Nkulunkulu, ngisindise ngegama lakho, ngamandla akho ungehlulele.
Yizwa umkhuleko wami, Nkulunkulu, ubeke indlebe emazwini omlomo wami.
Abafokazi bangivukele, izidlova zizingela impilo yami. Azimgqizi qakala uNkulunkulu.
Bheka, uNkulunkulu ungumsizi wami. INkosi igcina umphefumulo wami.
Iyokuphindisela okubi okwenziwe yizitha zami; zibhubhise ngeqiniso lakho.
Ngizonikela kuwe ngenkululeko, ngibonge igama lakho Simakade, ngokuba lihle.
Igama lakho lingikhulule kuzo zonke izinkathazo, iso lami lizibonile izitha zami zinqotshwa.
Nkulunkulu, lalela umkhuleko wami, ungazifihli ekunxuseni kwami.
Ngizwele, ungiphendule; ngikhathazekile, ngiyabubula, ngixakekile,
ngenxa yezwi lesitha, nangenxa yokucindezela komubi, bagingqela okubi phezu kwami, bangizingela bengithukuthelele.
Inhliziyo yami iyathuthumela ngaphakathi, ukwesaba ukufa kungehlele.
Nginengebhe, ngiyaqhaqhazela, ngikhungethwe wukwesaba.
Ngibe sengithi: “Ukuba benginamaphiko njengejuba, ngabe ngindizela kwelikude, ngihlale khona nginethezeke.”
Bengiyakubaleka, ngiye kude, ngihlale ehlane.
Bengizophuthuma ngithole umpheme ukuze ngiphephe ezivunguvungwini naseziphephweni.
Bahlakaze, Nkosi, uphithanise ulimi lwabo, ngokuba ngibone ubudlova nengxabano emzini.
Emini nasebusuku, bazulazula bezungeza phezu kwezingange zawo, inkohlakalo nenkathazo kukuwo.
Incithakalo itholakala kuwo, ingcindezelo nenkohliso akusuki esigcawini sawo.
Ukuba bengiklolodelwa yisitha, bengizokubekezelela lokho, nokuba bekungongizondayo oziphakamise phezu kwami, bengizomcashela.
Kepha nguwe ntanga yethu, mhlobo wami nomngani wami.
Besihlala ndawonye kamnandi; besihamba simshungu munye siya endlini kaNkulunkulu nebandla elithokozayo.
Ukufa makubazume, behlele endaweni yabafileyo besaphila, ngokuba ububi busezindlini zabo, phakathi kwabo.
Kepha mina ngizokhala kuNkulunkulu uSimakade, uzongisindisa.
Ekuseni, emini nantambama ngizokhala kuye, ngibubule, uzolizwa izwi lami.
Uyakuwukhulula umphefumulo wami ngokuthula, empini engibhekene nayo, ngokuba baningi abamelene nami.
UNkulunkulu esesihlalweni kwasemandulo uzongizwa, abathobise, ngokuba abaphenduki, futhi abamesabi uNkulunkulu.
Ugadla kulabo ahlalisene kahle nabo, usijivazile isivumelwano sakhe,
amazwi akhe abushelelezi kunamafutha, kodwa inhliziyo igaya izibozi.
Phonsa umthwalo wakho kuSimakade, Yena uzokusimamisa. Akayukuvuma naphakade ukuba olungileyo azanyazanyiswe.
Wena Nkulunkulu uzobaphonsa emgodini ojulileyo abantu abomele igazi nabakhohlisayo; izinsuku zabo zokuphila aziyukuba ngisho nayingxenye yazo, kodwa mina ngizokwethemba Wena.
Nkulunkulu, yiba nomusa kimi, ngokuba abantu bafuna ukungenzakalisa. Bangilwisa usuku lonke, bayangicindezela.
Izitha zami zingenzakalisa njalo, ngokuba baningi abalwa nami ngokuqhosha.
Mhla ngesabayo ngiyokwethembela kuwe.
KuNkulunkulu engidumisa izwi lakhe, kuNkulunkulu ngibeka ithemba lami, angiyukwesaba; umuntu angangenzani na?
Usuku lonke bahlanekezela amazwi ami. Yonke imicabango yabo ihlose ukungilimaza.
Bayangihlasela, bangicuthele, baqaphe izinyathelo zami, baqamekele umphefumulo wami.
Ungabavumeli baphunyule ngenxa yobubi babo, ngentukuthelo, qumba phansi izizwe, Nkulunkulu.
Wena ukunakile ukuzulazula kwami, izinyembezi zami zethe egabheni lakho. Kanti azikho yini encwadini yakho na?
Izitha zami bese zibuyela emuva mhla ngikhalayo, ngiyakwazi lokhu, ukuthi uNkulunkulu unami.
KuNkulunkulu, engiyakulidumisa izwi lakhe, kuSimakade, engiyakulidumisa izwi lakhe.
Ithemba lami likuNkulunkulu, angiyukwesaba. Umuntu angangenzani na?
Nkulunkulu, izifungo zami zingibophezele kuwe, ngiyakunikela kuwe iminikelo yokubonga.
Ngokuba umphefumulo wami uwukhulule ekufeni, nezinyawo zami, ekukhubekeni, ukuze ngihambe phambi kukaNkulunkulu, ekukhanyeni kwabaphilayo.
Yiba nomusa kimi, Nkulunkulu, ngihawukele. Ngokuba umphefumulo wami uphephela kuwe. Ngizokhosela emthunzini wamaphiko akho, zize zedlule izinhlekelele.
Ngizokhala kuNkulunkulu oPhezukonke, kuNkulunkulu ongiphindiselelayo.
Uzothumela esezulwini, angisindise. Uyamsola ofuna ukungifihliza. UNkulunkulu uzothumela umusa wakhe neqiniso lakhe.
Umphefumulo wami uphakathi kwamabhubesi, ngilele phakathi kwabakhafula umlilo, ngisho nabantwana babantu, abamazinyo ayimikhonto nemicibisholo, abalulimi luyinkemba ebukhali.
Phakama, Nkulunkulu phezu kwezulu, inkazimulo yakho ibe phezu komhlaba wonke.
Izinyathelo zami bazicuphe ngogibe, umphefumulo wami udangele, bangimbele umgodi, kwakhalakathela bona kuwo.
Inhliziyo yami yethabile, Nkulunkulu, inhliziyo yami igxilile. Ngizohlabelela, ngihube.
Vuka mphefumulo wami, vukani lugubhu nehabhu! Ngizovusa intathakusa.
Nkosi ngizokubonga phakathi kwabantu, ngikuhashe phakathi kwezizwe.
Ngokuba umusa wakho mkhulu, kuze kube sezulwini, nokwethembeka kwakho, kuze kube semafini.
Phakama, Nkulunkulu, phezu kwezulu, inkazimulo yakho ibe phezu komhlaba wonke.
Kungabe impela nikhuluma ukulunga nobuqotho na? Madodana abantu, ngabe nehlulela ngobuqotho na?
Qha, ingani ezinhliziyweni niphehla imisebenzi yokungalungi, ezweni nikala ngendluzula evela ezandleni zenu.
Ababi bahlubuka kwasesibelethweni, abaqamba amanga baduka kwasesiswini.
Isihlungu sabo sinjengesihlungu senyoka, banjengemamba edlebelekile, esivale amadlebe
ukuze ingalizwa izwi labalumbi abalumba ngobuchule.
Nkulunkulu, yephula amazinyo abo emilonyeni yabo. Simakade, phohloza amazinyo emihlathi yamabhongo ezingonyama.
Mabahwamuke njengamanzi achithekayo; lapho ekhomba ngemicibisholo yakhe, mayibe sengathi inqundekile.
Mababe njengomnenke oncibilika uphele, njengokuphuphume kowesifazane, okungalibonanga ilanga.
Amabhodwe enu engakakuzweli ukushisa kwezinkuni zameva, uyakuziphephula, noma ziluhlaza, noma zivutha.
Olungileyo uyojabula uma ebona impindiselo, uyogeza izinyawo zakhe egazini lababi,
abantu baze bathi: “Impela ukhona umvuzo wolungileyo; impela ukhona uNkulunkulu owehlulelayo emhlabeni.”
Nkulunkulu wami, ngikhulule ezitheni zami, ungivikele kwabangivukelayo.
Ngikhulule kwabenza okubi, ungisindise kubantu abomele igazi.
Ngokuba, bheka, baqamekela impilo yami, iziqhwaga ziyangihlanganyela, kungekho siphambeko nasono kimi, Simakade.
Ziyagijima, zizilungisele, ngingenacala, vuka ungihlangabeze, uzibonele ngawakho.
Wena, Simakade Nkulunkulu Wamabandla, Nkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, vuka ujezise zonke izizwe, ungahawukeli namunye kwabahlubukileyo.
Babuya kusihlwa, bahlabe umkhulungwane njengenja, bezulazula emzini.
Bheka, bayakhafula ngemilomo yabo, amazwi abo ayizinkemba ezindebeni zabo, ngokuba bathi: “Ngubani ozwayo na?”
Kepha Wena Simakade uyabahleka, ubaklolodele bonke abezizwe.
Ngenxa yamandla akho, ngizokulindela, ngokuba uNkulunkulu uyinqaba yami.
UNkulunkulu wami uzongihlangabeza ngomusa wakhe; uNkulunkulu uzongibonisa izitha zami zinqotshwa.
Ungazibulali, funa abantu bakithi bakhohlwe, kodwa zihlakaze ngamandla akho, uziqumbe phansi, Nkosi, sihlangu sethu.
Amazwi eziwasho ngezindebe zazo ayisono esiphuma emlonyeni wazo, mazibambeke ekuqhosheni kwazo, nangenxa yesiqalekiso namanga eziwakhulumayo.
Ziqede nya, ngolaka, uzishabalalise ziphele nya, mazazi ukuthi nguNkulunkulu obusa kwaJakobe, kuze kube semikhawulweni yomhlaba.
Zibuya kusihlwa, zihlabe umkhulungwane njengenja, zizulazule emzini.
Zehla zenyuka zifuna ukudla; uma zingasuthi, ziyagwavuma.
Kepha mina ngizakuhlabelela ngamandla akho, ngithabele umusa wakho ekuseni, ngokuba uyinqaba yami nesiphephelo sami ngosuku lokuhlupheka kwami.
Mandla ami, ngizohubela Wena; ngokuba uNkulunkulu, uyinqaba yami, unguNkulunkulu wami onomusa.
Nkulunkulu usilahlile, usibhubhisile, ngoba usithukuthelele; ake usivuselele futhi.
Uwuzamazamisile umhlaba, wawuqhekeza, zivale izimfa zawo, ngokuba uyazamazama.
Isizwe sakho usibonisile izinto ezinzima, wasiphuzisa iwayini, sadiyazela.
Abakwesabayo ubanike ifulegi ukuba baliphakamise ngenxa yeqiniso.
Ukuze abathandekayo bakho bakhululwe, sindisa ngesandla sakho sokunene, usiphendule.
UNkulunkulu ukhulumile esebungcweleni bakhe, wathi: “Ngizokunqoba, ngihlukanise iShekemi, ngisilinganise iSigodi iSukhothi.
UGileyadi noManase bangabami, u-Efrayimi uyisivikelo sekhanda lami, uJuda uyintonga yami yokubusa.
UMowabi uyisitsha sami sokuhlambela, ngiphonsa isicathulo sami phezu kuka-Edomi. Filistiya, hlokoma ngenjabulo ngenxa yami.”
Ngubani oyakungiyisa emzini oqinileyo na? Ngubani oyakungiholela kwa-Edomi na?
Nkulunkulu, akuWena yini osilahlileyo na? Awusaphumi namabutho ethu, Nkulunkulu.
Sisize esitheni, ngokuba ukuhlenga kwabantu kuyize.
Sizonqoba ngoNkulunkulu; Yena uzozinyathela izitha zethu.
Nkulunkulu, yizwa ukukhala kwami, ubeke indlebe emkhulekweni wami.
Ngisemkhawulweni womhlaba, ngikhala kuwe lapho inhliziyo yami idangele. Ngiholele edwaleni eliphakemeyo kunami.
Ngokuba Wena ube yisiphephelo sami, umbhoshongo oqinileyo phambi kwesitha sami.
Mangihlale ethendeni lakho ingunaphakade. Mangikhosele emthunzini wamaphiko akho.
Ngokuba Wena, Nkulunkulu, uzizwile izifungo zami, wanginika isabelo salabo abesaba igama lakho.
Uzokwandisa izinsuku zokuphila kwenkosi, iminyaka yayo ibe miningi ngangezizukulwane.
Iyohlala embusweni, phambi kukaNkulunkulu ingunaphakade. Yiqokele ububele neqiniso, ukuba kuyilonde.
Ngakho-ke ngizolihubela igama lakho kuze kube phakade, ukuze ngifeze izifungo zami usuku nosuku.
Mphefumulo wami, thula, ulindele uNkulunkulu kuphela, ngokuba insindiso yami ivela kuye.
NguYena kuphela oyidwala lami nensindiso yami; inqaba yami, angisoze nganyakaziswa.
Kuyoze kube nini, nisukela umuntu ukuba nimbulale nonke, njengodonga olutshekile nothango oludilikayo na?
Baceba ukuwisa umuntu oqavileyo. Bathokozela amanga, bayabusisa ngemilomo yabo, kodwa ngengaphakathi, bayaqalekisa.
Mphefumulo wami, thula, ulindele uNkulunkulu kuphela, ngokuba ithemba lami livela kuye.
NguYena kuphela oyidwala lami, nensindiso yami, nenqaba yami; angiyukunyakaziswa.
Ukuhlengwa kwami nodumo lwami kukuNkulunkulu, idwala lami eliqinileyo, isiphephelo sami sikuNkulunkulu.
Bantu, yethembelani kuye ngezikhathi zonke, inhliziyo yenu niyithululele phambi kwakhe, uNkulunkulu uyisiphephelo sethu.
Abantukazana bangumoya nje, nezikhulu zingamabunga, uma bekalwa isilinganiso siyenyuka, kodwa bonke balula kunomoya.
Maningathembeli ekuqhwageni, ningazigabisi ngokuphangiweyo. Uma imfuyo yanda, ningayibeki inhliziyo kuyo.
UNkulunkulu ukhulume kanye, ngakuzwa kabili lokho: amandla angakaNkulunkulu,
nobubele bungobakho, Nkosi. Umuntu umvuza ngangokwenza kwakhe.
Nkulunkulu, Wena unguNkulunkulu wami, ngiyakufuna. Umphefumulo wami womele Wena, umzimba wami ulangazelela Wena, ezweni eligagadekileyo, lapho kungekho khona amanzi.
Yingakho ngikufuna endaweni engcwele, ngibone amandla akho nenkazimulo yakho.
Ngokuba umusa wakho muhle kunokuphila, izindebe zomlomo wami zizokudumisa.
Yingakho ngizokubonga, inqobo nje uma ngisaphila. Ngizophakamisa izandla zami egameni lakho.
Umphefumulo wami uyosutha kube sengathi usuthiswe ngamanoni namafutha, umlomo wami ukudumise ngezindebe ezethabayo,
lapho ngikukhumbula embhedeni wami, ngizindla ngawe kwesikabhadakazi.
Wena ungisizile, ngizokwethaba emthunzini wamaphiko akho.
Umphefumulo wami ubambelele kuwe, esokunene sakho singisekele.
Kepha abazingela umphefumulo wami ukuba bawenzakalise, bazokwehlela ezindaweni zomhlaba eziphansi.
Bazonikelwa esandleni senkemba, babe wukudla kwezimpungushe.
Kepha inkosi izothokoza ngoNkulunkulu, bonke abafunga Yena bayomdumisa, ngokuba imilomo yabakhuluma amanga izovalwa.
Yizwa izwi lami, Nkulunkulu, ekukhaleni kwami, ulondoloze impilo yami ezinsongweni zesitha.
Ngifihle kuyo inguyazana yababi, nasesixukwini sabenza okubi,
abalola ulimi lwabo njengenkemba, bacibe imicibisholo yabo engamazwi ababayo,
ukuze bazume ongenacala bamdubule, bamdubule engazelele; abanaluvalo.
Badudana ngecebo elibi, bahlele ukucupha izingibe, bethi: “Siyobonwa ngubani na?”
Basongoza izenzo ezimbi, bathi: “Siliphethile icebo elisongoziweyo;” izibilini nenhliziyo yomuntu kujulile.
Kepha uNkulunkulu uyakubaciba ngomcibisholo, bagwazwe ngokuzunywa.
Bayakuwiswa, bahilwe lulimi lwabo, bonke abababonayo bayonikina amakhanda.
Bonke abantu bayokwesaba, bayoshumayela ngemisebenzi kaNkulunkulu, bakuqonde akwenzileyo.
Olungileyo uyothokoza kuSimakade, aphephele kuye. Bonke abaqotho ngenhliziyo, badumise.
Udumo lufanele Wena, Nkulunkulu, eZiyoni kuyofezeka isithembiso kuwe.
Wena oyizwayo imikhuleko, bonke abantu beza kuwe.
Iziphambeko zingigabhile, uyazithethelela iziphambeko zethu.
Ubusisiwe okhethwe nguwe, wamsondeza ukuba ahlale emagcekeni akho. Siyosuthiswa ngokuhle okuvela endlini yakho, ithempeli lakho elingcwele.
Uyakusiphendula ngezenzo ezesabekayo ekulungeni, Nkulunkulu wensindiso yethu. Wena uyithemba lemikhawulo yonke yomhlaba nelolwandle olukude,
Yena omisa izintaba ngamandla akhe, obhince amandla,
othulisa ukuduma kwezilwandle, inhlokomo yamaza azo nomsindo wabantu.
Abakhile emikhawulweni yomhlaba bayesaba ngezibonakaliso zakho, ujabulisa impumalanga nentshonalanga.
Uhambela umhlaba, unisa imvula, uwuvundisa kakhulu, umfula kaNkulunkulu ugcwele amanzi, abantu ubalungisela ukudla.
Umatisa imisele yawo, ulalise amasoyi awo, uwuthambise ngezihlambi, ubusise okumila kuwo.
Unyaka uwuhlobisa ngobumnene bakho, imikhondo yakho iconsa amafutha.
Amadlelo asehlane ayaconsa, amagquma abhinca injabulo.
Amadlelo embethe izimvu, nezigodi zisibekelwe ngokusanhlamvu, konke kuyajabula, kuyahlabelela.
Mhlaba wonke, hubelani uNkulunkulu ngentokozo.
Hubelani udumo lwegama lakhe, nimnike udumo nimbonga.
Yishoni kuNkulunkulu, nithi: “Yeka ubukhulu bemisebenzi yakho! Ngenxa yobukhulu bamandla akho, izitha zakho ziyothoba phansi kwakho.
Umhlaba wonke ukhuleke kuwe, ukudumise, bahubele igama lakho.”
Wozani nibone ukuthi uNkulunkulu wenzeni, akwenzayo kuyesabeka phakathi kwabantu.
Ulwandle uluphendule umhlaba owomileyo; bawela umfula behamba ngezinyawo; sathokoza kuye lapho.
Ubusa ngamandla akhe kuze kube phakade. Amehlo akhe aqaphe izizwe, abanenkani bangaziphakamisi.
Bongani uNkulunkulu wethu nina zizwe, nizwakalise izwi lokudunyiswa kwakhe,
olonda ukuphila kwethu, ongavumanga ukuba izinyawo zethu zishelele.
Ngokuba Wena, Nkulunkulu, usivivinyile, wasihlanza njengalokhu kuhlanzwa isiliva.
Usiphonse enethini, wasethwesa umthwalo onzima.
Abantu wabavumela ukuba bakhwele phezu kwamakhanda ethu. Sadabula emlilweni nasemanzini, kodwa wasikhiphela endaweni ebanzi.
Ngizongena endlini yakho neminikelo yokushiswa, ngizifeze izifungo engazenza kuwe,
lezo engazikhipha ngezindebe zomlomo, ngazisho ngomlomo wami ngisekuhluphekeni.
Ngizonikela kuwe ngeminikelo yokushiswa yezikhuluphalisiweyo, nomusi womhlatshelo wezinqama; ngenze umnikelo ngezinkunzi nezimbuzi.
We nina nonke enesaba uNkulunkulu, wozani nilalele, nginilandise ngalokho angenzele khona.
Ngakhala kuye, nginxusa, ukudumisa kwakusolimini lwami.
Uma bengiqonde ububi enhliziyweni yami, ibingayukungizwa iNkosi.
Impela uNkulunkulu uzwile, waqaphela izwi lomkhuleko wami.
Makabongwe uNkulunkulu ongawenqabanga umkhuleko wami, noma wasisusa isihawu sakhe kimi.
UNkulunkulu makabe nomusa kithi, asibusise, makakhanyise ubuso bakhe phezu kwethu,
ukuze indlela yakho yaziwe emhlabeni, insindiso yakho, kubo bonke abezizwe.
Abantu mabakubonge, Nkulunkulu, ubongwe ngabantu bonke.
Izizwe mazijabule, zihube ngentokozo, ngokuba abantu ubehlulela ngokulunga, uhole izizwe emhlabeni.
Abantu mabakubonge, Nkulunkulu, ubongwe ngabantu bonke.
Umhlaba uthele izithelo zawo, uNkulunkulu wethu usibusisile.
Sengathi uNkulunkulu angaqhubeka asibusise, yonke imikhawulo yomhlaba imesabe.
Makavuke uNkulunkulu, izitha zakhe zihlakazeke, labo abamzondayo babaleke phambi kwakhe.
Njengokuphephuka komusi, nokuncibilika kwengcina phambi komlilo, bachithwa kanjalo ababi phambi kukaNkulunkulu.
Kepha abalungileyo mabajabule, bethabe phambi kukaNkulunkulu, bathokoze nokuthokoza.
Hubelani uNkulunkulu, nidumise igama lakhe, lowo ogibela amafu, nimenzele indlela, igama lakhe nguSimakade, yethabani phambi kwakhe.
UnguYise wezinkedama, nomvikeli wabafelokazi; unguNkulunkulu osendaweni yakhe yokuhlala engcwele.
UNkulunkulu uhlalisa imihlalaqha ezindlini, akhulule iziboshwa bese zinethezeka, abahlubukayo bodwa abahlala emaqwaqwasini.
Nkulunkulu, ekuphumeni kwakho phambi kwabantu bakho, ekudabuleni kwakho ihlane,
umhlaba wazamazama, izulu laconsa phambi kukaNkulunkulu, neSinayi yazamazama phambi kukaNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.
Wanisa imvula enkulu, Nkulunkulu; ifa lakho selehlulekile, waliqinisa.
Ibandla lakho lakha kulo, ngobuhle bakho, wabalungisela abahluphekayo, Nkulunkulu.
INkosi ikhiphe izwi, isixuku esikhulu sabesifazane sabika indaba ejabulisayo.
Amakhosi ahola izimpi acela empunzini, athi galo yephuka. Abesifazane abasekhaya babelana impango,
noma belala ezibuyeni, kunjengamaphiko ejuba ambozwe ngesiliva, izimpaphe zamaphiko alo zahuqwa ngegolide elikhazimulayo.
Ngesikhathi uSomandla ehlakaza amakhosi lapho, kwakhithika iqhwa eZalimoni.
Intaba kaNkulunkulu yintaba iBhashani; intaba eneziqongo.
Kungani nina zintaba ezimagqumagquma nibuka, niyibuka ngonya intaba uNkulunkulu athanda ukuhlala kuyo na? Yebo, uSimakade uzohlala kuyo kuze kube phakade.
Izinqola zempi zikaNkulunkulu ezinamandla eziyizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili, izinkulungwane ngezinkulungwane iNkosi iphakathi kwazo, iSinayi isendaweni engcwele.
Wena wenyukele phezulu, wathumba abathunjiweyo, wapha abantu izipho, nakulabo abebehlubukile, ukuze uSimakade uNkulunkulu ahlale khona.
Mayibongwe iNkosi esithwalela imithwalo yethu imihla ngemihla, uNkulunkulu uyinsindiso yethu.
UNkulunkulu wethu unguNkulunkulu okhululayo, ukukhulula ekufeni kungokukaSimakade, iNkosi.
Kepha uNkulunkulu uzophohloza amakhanda ezitha zakhe, ukhakhayi lwalowo onesihluthu ohamba ezindleleni zokona kwakhe.
INkosi yathi: “Ngizobabuyisa bevela eBhashani, ngibabuyise bevela ekujuleni kolwandle,
ukuze ugeze izinyawo zakho egazini, nezilimi zezinja zakho zibe nesabelo ezitheni.”
Nkulunkulu, abantu bayibonile inhlabaluhide iya endlini engcwele, izindwendwe zikaNkulunkulu wami, iNkosi yami.
Phambili kuhamba abahlabeleli, emuva abashaya ugubhu, phakathi yizintombi ezishaya izigubhu.
Bongani uNkulunkulu ebandleni elikhulu; Simakade, Wena ungumthombo ka-Israyeli.
Nango uBhenjamini ongomncinyane kubo bonke, uyababusa, izikhulu zakwaJuda zingumzimba, nezikhulu zakwaZebuloni nezakwaNafethali.
UNkulunkulu wakho ukumisele amandla akho, qinisa, Nkulunkulu, lokho osenzele khona.
Ngenxa yethempeli lakho eJerusalema, amakhosi ayokulethela izipho.
Zikhuze izilwane ezihlala emhlangeni, imihlambi yezinkunzi namankonyane ezizwe, ukuze beze bakukhothamele bonke, bethule kuwe izinhlamvu zesiliva, uhlakaze izizwe ezithokozela ukulwa.
Izikhulu ziyakuvela eGibhithe, amaKhushe ayakwelulela ngokushesha izandla zawo kuNkulunkulu.
Nina mibuso yomhlaba, mhubeleni uNkulunkulu, nidumise iNkosi,
yona ekhwela phezu kwamazulu aphezulu asendulo, iyezwakalisa izwi layo, izwi elinamandla.
Nikani uNkulunkulu amandla, ubukhosi bakhe buphezu kuka-Israyeli, amandla akhe asemafini.
Nkulunkulu, uyesabeka ezindaweni zakho ezingcwele, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli abantu bakhe ubapha amandla nezikhwepha. Makadunyiswe uNkulunkulu.
Ngisindise, Nkulunkulu, ngokuba amanzi asesentanyeni.
Ngibisha obhukwini lodaka, akukho ndawo yokubeka unyawo, ngingene otweni ngathi shi, imisinga iyangisibekela.
Ngikhathele wukukhala, umphimbo wami ugagadekile. Amehlo ami anqundekile ngukulindela uNkulunkulu wami.
Abangizondela ize baningi ukwedlula izinwele ekhanda lami, baningi abafuna ukungibhubhisa; izitha zami zingethwesa icala ngeze. Kumele ngibuyisele engingakwebanga.
Nkulunkulu, Wena uyabazi ubuwula bami, nezono zami azifihlakele kuwe.
Mabangahlazeki ngami abakulindelayo, Nkosi, Simakade Wamabandla. Mabangathelwa ngehlazo ngenxa yami labo abakufunayo, Nkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.
Ngokuba ngichashwa ngenhlamba ngenxa yakho, ihlazo lisibekele ubuso bami.
Sengaba ngumfokazi kubafowethu, nowezizwe kubantwana bakamame.
Ngokuba ukushisekela indlu yakho kungidlile, izinhlamba zabakuthukayo zehlele phezu kwami.
Ngakhala, umphefumulo wami wazila, kwaba ngukudunyazwa kwami.
Isaka ngalenza isembatho sami, ngaba yisaga kubo.
Abahlezi esangweni bakhuluma ngami, izidakwa zihaya ingoma ngami.
Kepha mina ngikhuleka kuwe, Simakade. Ngesikhathi esifanele, Nkulunkulu, ngobukhulu bomusa wakho, ngiphendule ngeqiniso lensindiso yakho.
Ngitakule odakeni, ngingabishi, mangikhululwe ezitheni zami nasemanzini ajulileyo.
Izikhukhula mazingangisibekeli, utwa lungangigwinyi, nomgodi ungangivaleli.
Ngiphendule, Simakade, ngokuba umusa wakho muhle, ngokwesihawu sakho esikhulu, phendukela ngakimi.
Ungayifihleli ubuso bakho inceku yakho, ngokuba ngikhathazekile, phuthuma ungiphendule.
Sondela kuwo umphefumulo wami, uwuhlenge, ngikhulule ngenxa yezitha zami.
Wena uyakwazi ukwethukwa kwami, nehlazo lami, nokudunyazwa kwami. Zonke izitha zami ziphambi kwakho.
Ukwethukwa kuyephulile inhliziyo yami, ngagula kakhulu, ngafisa ukuzwelwa, kodwa angitholanga baduduzi.
Banginika inyongo ibe ngukudla kwami, ekomeni kwami bangiphuzisa uviniga.
Itafula labo malibe wugibe kubo, nesihibe sezitha zabo.
Amehlo abo mawanqundeke ukuze bangaboni, izinkalo zabo ziqhaqhazele njalo.
Ukunengwa kwakho kuthele phezu kwabo, intukuthelo yakho evuthayo ibafice.
Umuzi wabo ubhubhe, kungabi bikho ohlala emathendeni abo.
Bahlukumeze labo obashayile, bakhuluma ngobuhlungu babalinyaziweyo bakho.
Yengeza ukona kwabo phezu kokunye, mabangezi ekulungeni kwakho.
Mabesulwe encwadini yabaphilayo, bangalotshwa kanye nabalungileyo.
Kepha mina ngihluphekile, nginobuhlungu. Nkulunkulu, insindiso yakho mayingilondoloze.
Ngizolibonga igama likaNkulunkulu ngehubo, ngimbabaze ngokubonga.
Lokho kuzomthokozisa kakhulu uSimakade, ukwedlula inkabi noma inkunzi enezimpondo nezinselo.
Akuthi lapho abacindezelweyo bekubona, bethabe, nina enifuna uNkulunkulu mazivuseleleke izinhliziyo zenu.
Ngokuba uSimakade uyabezwa abentulayo, akabadeleli abakhe ababoshiweyo.
Izulu nomhlaba makumbonge, izilwandle nakho konke okuphila kukho.
Ngokuba uNkulunkulu uzolisindisa iZiyoni, ayakhe imizi yakwaJuda, bahlale kuyo, libe yifa labo.
Abantwana bezinceku zakhe bazolidla libe yifa labo, nalabo abathanda igama lakhe bazohlala kulo.
Nkulunkulu, phangisa ungikhulule. Simakade, phuthuma ungisize.
Abazingela umphefumulo wami mabathelwe ngehlazo, bahlazeke. Nalabo abafuna ukungenzakalisa, mababuyiselwe emuva bejabhisiwe.
Abathi: “Ashila, ashila!” mababuyele emuva ngenxa yehlazo labo.
Bonke abakufunayo mabajabule, bethabe kuwe. Nalabo abathanda insindiso yakho, bahlale njalo bethi: “UNkulunkulu mkhulu.”
Kepha mina ngimpofu futhi ngiyantula, phuthuma ungisize, Nkulunkulu! Ulusizo lwami nomkhululi wami. Simakade, ungalibali.
Kuwena, Simakade, ngiyakhosela, mangingajabhi naphakade.
Ngokulunga kwakho ngikhulule, ungihlenge; beka indlebe yakho kimi, ungisindise.
Yiba yidwala lami lokukhosela, engiza kulo njalo; uyalezile ukuba ngisindiswe, ngokuba uyidwala lami nenqaba yami.
Nkulunkulu wami, ngikhulule esandleni sesikhohlakali, nasekuxhakathisweni yisandla sowenza okubi nesowonakeleyo.
Ngokuba Wena, Nkosi Simakade, uyithemba lami; ngethembele kuwe kwasebusheni bami.
Ngancika kuwe kwasekuzalweni kwami, nguwe owangikhipha esibelethweni sikamame. Ukudumisa kwami njalo kungawe.
Kwabaningi bengifana nesimangaliso, kodwa Wena uyisiphephelo sami esinamandla.
Usuku lonke, umlomo wami ugcwele ukukubonga nokukubabaza.
Ungangilahli ngesikhathi sobudala, ungangishiyi lapho sengiluphele,
ngokuba izitha zami zikhuluma ngami, nabaqamekela umphefumulo wami bahlangana ngami, bangihlebe,
bathi: “UNkulunkulu umshiyile; mxosheni, nimbambe, ngokuba akekho ongamkhulula.”
Nkulunkulu, ungabi kude nami, Nkulunkulu, phuthuma ungisize.
Abamelene nami befuna umphefumulo wami mabajabhe, baphele. Labo abafuna ukungilimaza, mabathelwe ngehlazo, bahlazeke.
Kepha mina ngizohlala ngikwethemba njalo, ngizokubonga ngingaphezi.
Umlomo wami uzolanda ngokulunga kwakho nensindiso yakho usuku lonke, ngokuba anginakukubala.
Ngizofika ngikubonge ngezenzo zamandla zeNkosi uNkulunkulu; ngizokudumisa ngokulunga kwakho, kwakho wedwa.
Nkulunkulu, wangifundisa kwasebusheni bami, namanje ngisamemezela ngemisebenzi yakho emangalisayo.
Nalapho sengimdala, sengiyimpunga, uze ungangishiyi, ukuze ngishumayele ubukhulu bakho kwabasazozalwa, namandla akho ezizukulwaneni.
Nkulunkulu, ukulunga kwakho kufinyelela ezulwini, Wena owenza izinto ezinkulu. Nkulunkulu, ngubani onjengawe na?
Wena owasikhombisa izinhlupheko ezimbi eziningi, uyobuye usiphilise, usikhuphule ezinzulwini zomhlaba.
Yandisa udumo lwami, ubuye ungiduduze.
Nkulunkulu wami, ngizobubonga ubuqotho bakho, ngogubhu lwezintambo, ngikudumise ngehabhu, Wena oNgcwele ka-Israyeli.
Izindebe zomlomo wami zizojabula, nomphefumulo wami ukuhubele, ngokuba ungihlengile.
Usuku lonke ulimi lwami luzokhuluma ngokulunga, ngokuba labo abafuna ukungenzakalisa bazothelwa ngehlazo, baphoxeke.
Nkulunkulu, yipha inkosi ubulungiswa nenkosana ukulunga kwakho.
Iyokwehlulela isizwe sakho ngeqiniso, nabampofu bakho, ngobulungiswa.
Izintaba ziyakuletha impumelelo kubantu, namagquma, ukulunga.
Mayivikele abantu abampofu, isindise abantwana babantulayo, iphohloze umcindezeli.
Bayakwesaba Wena, kusekhona ilanga nenyanga, izizukulwane ngezizukulwane.
Mayifane njengemvula otshanini, nanjengesihlambi simatisa umhlaba.
Ezinsukwini zayo olungileyo uyakuqhakaza, kuvame ukuthula, ize ingabi bikho inyanga.
Iyakubusa kusukela olwandle kuze kube solwandle, kusukela emfuleni kuze kube semikhawulweni yomhlaba.
Abakhe ehlane bayokhothama phambi kwayo, izitha zayo zikhothe uthuli.
Amakhosi aseTharishishi nawaseziqhingini ayakuletha izipho. Amakhosi aseShebha naseSebha ayoletha izipho.
Wonke amakhosi ayokhothama phambi kwayo, zonke izizwe ziyikhonze.
Ngokuba iyakukhulula ompofu ozikhalela kuyo, nohluphekayo ongenamsizi.
Iyakuhawukela odangeleyo nompofu, isindise imiphefumulo yabampofu.
Iyokhulula impilo yabo kumcindezeli nonendluzula, igazi labo liyigugu emehlweni ayo.
Mayiphile, bayinike igolide laseShebha, bayithandazele njalo, bayibusise usuku lonke.
Makube khona inala yokudla ezweni, esiqongweni sezintaba, ukudla kwalo kuyohashazela njengeLebhanoni, abemizi bayokhahlela njengotshani bomhlaba.
Igama layo malime kuze kube phakade, udumo lwayo luphakame njengelanga. Zonke izizwe mazidunyiswe ngayo, bonke abezizwe mabathi ibusisiwe.
Makabongwe uSimakade uNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, okunguYena kuphela owenza izimangaliso.
Malibongwe igama lakhe elikhazimulayo kuze kube phakade, umhlaba wonke ugcwale inkazimulo yakhe. Amen, Amen.
Lesi yisiphetho semikhuleko kaDavide indodana kaJese.
UNkulunkulu umnene impela ku-Israyeli, kulabo abanenhliziyo ehlanzekileyo.
Kepha mina izinyawo zami zicishe zakhubeka, kwasala kancane ukuba izinyathelo zami zishibilike.
Ngaba nomhawu ngabazidlayo, lapho ngibona ababi bephumelela.
Ngokuba abanazinhlungu, kuze kube sekufeni kwabo, bayizitetelegu.
Abahlupheki njengabanye abantu, futhi abehlelwa wubhubhane njengabanye abantu.
Ngakho-ke ukuqhosha ngumgexo wabo, indluzula bayembethe njengengubo.
Amehlo abo aphinqekile ngukunona, imicabango yenhliziyo iyachichima.
Baklolodela abanye, bakhulume okubi, baziqhenye, bahlongoze ukubacindezela.
Umlomo wabo bawuphakamisela ezulwini, ulimi lwabo luhamba emhlabeni.
Ngakho-ke isizwe sakhe sibuyela lapha, amanzi amaningi bazimuncela wona.
Bathi: “UNkulunkulu wazi kanjani? Imbala kukhona yini ukwazi koPhezukonke na?”
Bheka, laba bayizikhohlakali, bahlala bekhululekile, bandisa imfuyo.
Impela inhliziyo yami ngiyigcinele ize, ihlanzekile, nezandla zami ngazihlamba ngingenacala,
ngokuba ngahlushwa usuku lonke, kwasa ngijeziswa.
Uma bengithe ngizakukhuluma kanjalo, ngabe ngisikhohlisile isizukulwane sabantwana bakho.
Kwathi ngicabanga ukuba ngikuqonde lokho, kwaba luhlupho emehlweni ami,
ngaze ngangena endlini engcwele kaNkulunkulu, ngaqaphelisisa ukugcina kwabo.
Impela ubabeka ezindaweni ezibushelelezi, ubawise babe yincithakalo.
Maye, bachithwa ngokuphazima kweso! Bafa, babhubha benovalo.
Njengephupho ekuphaphameni, Nkosi, uyakuwedelela umfanekiso wabo ekuvukeni kwakho.
Kwathi lapho inhliziyo yami iba nomunyu, nezinso zami zibhokodwa,
ngaba yisiphukuphuku, angaze ngazi lutho, ngaba yisilwane kuwe.
Kepha mina ngiyakube nginawe njalo, ungibambile ngesandla sami sokunene.
Uyakungihola ngesiluleko sakho, andukuba ungamukele enkazimulweni.
Nginobani ezulwini na? Uma nginawe, angifuni lutho emhlabeni.
Umzimba wami nenhliziyo yami kuyaphela, nokho uNkulunkulu uyidwala lenhliziyo yami nesabelo sami kuze kube phakade.
Ngokuba abakude nawe bayakubhubha, uyabachitha bonke abahlubuka kuwe ngokuphinga.
Kepha mina kungilungele ukusondela kuNkulunkulu, ngiyenzile iNkosi uSimakade ibe yisiphephelo sami, ukuze ngishumayele zonke izenzo zakho.
Nkulunkulu, usilahleleni kwaze kwaba phakade na? Izimvu zedlelo lakho uzithunqiselelani ngentuthu yolaka lwakho na?
Khumbula ibandla lakho owalizuza kwasemandulo, walikhulula ukuze libe yisizwe esiyifa lakho, nentaba iZiyoni ohlala kuyo.
Phangisa uzobona incithakalo yaphakade, isitha sesone konke endlini engcwele.
Izitha zakho zibhonge phakathi endlini yakho yokuhlanganela, zamisa izimpawu zazo zaba ngamabhanela,
kwangathi ngumuntu ephakamisa izembe phakathi kwemithi eminyeneyo.
Konke okwayo okubaziweyo zakuphohloza ngembazo nangesando.
Indlu yakho engcwele zayokhela ngomlilo. Indlu yegama lakho zayidumaza, zayicekela phansi.
Zathi enhliziyweni yazo: “Masibabhubhise kanyekanye;” zazishisa zonke izindlu zikaNkulunkulu zokuhlanganela.
Izimpawu zethu asiziboni, akusekho mphrofethi, akekho kithi owaziyo ukuthi kuyoze kube nini.
Nkulunkulu, kuyoze kube nini umcindezeli esithuka, isitha sihlala sihlambalaza igama lakho na?
Usigodleleni isandla sakho, isandla sakho sokunene na? Sikhiphe esifubeni sakho, uzibhubhise.
UNkulunkulu uyiNkosi yami kuze kube phakade, nguye owenza insindiso emhlabeni.
NguWena owehlukanisa ulwandle ngamandla akho, waphohloza amakhanda ezilo zasemanzini ezesabekayo.
NguWena owaphohloza amakhanda kaLeviyathani, wamnika izidalwa zasendle, zamudla.
NguWena owaveza isiphethu nomfudlana; nguWena owomisa imifula egobhoza ingashi.
Usuku lungolwakho, nobusuku bungobakho; nguWena owenza ukukhanya nelanga.
NguWena owamisa yonke imikhawulo yomhlaba; nguWena owenza ihlobo nobusika.
Simakade, khumbula lokhu, isitha sisethukile, nesizwe esinobuwula silihlambalazile igama lakho.
Ungawunikeli umphefumulo wejuba lakho esilwaneni; ungakhohlwa ukuphila kwezihlupheki zakho.
Khumbula isivumelwano, ngokuba izindawo zezwe ezimnyama, zigcwele izindlu zobudlova.
Ocindezelweyo makangabuyi ejabhile, ohluphekayo nompofu mababonge igama lakho.
Vuka, Nkulunkulu, uyimele indaba yakho, khumbula ukuthi uklolodelwa yiziwula usuku lonke.
Ungakhohlwa yizwi lezitha zakho, ukuxokozela kwabakuvukelayo kuya ngokuya kwenyukela.
Siyakubonga Nkulunkulu, siyabonga; igama lakho liseduze, balanda ngezimangaliso zakho.
Wena uthi: “Uma ngiqoka isikhathi esimisiweyo, yiMina engehlulela ngokulunga.
Umhlaba uyancibilika nabo bonke abakhe kuwo; Mina ngizimisile izinsika zawo.”
Ngithe kwabazidlayo: “Ningazidli,” nakwababi: “Ningaziphakamisi.
Ningazikhukhumezi; ningakhulumi ngokwedelela nokuqhosha.”
Ngokuba ukuphakanyiswa akuveli empumalanga, entshonalanga nasehlane ezintabeni,
kodwa uNkulunkulu ungumehluleli; omunye uyamehlisa, omunye amphakamise.
Esandleni seNkosi kukhona isitsha, iwayini liyakhephuzela, sigcwele iwayini eliqungiweyo; yiyona elithunga ngaso. Bonke ababi abasemhlabeni impela boyimunca inhlese yalo, bayiphuze.
Kepha mina ngiyakumemezela ngakho kuze kube phakade, ngidumise uNkulunkulu kaJakobe.
Wonke amandla ezikhohlakali ngiyowaqeda nya, kodwa ngiwandise awabalungileyo.
UNkulunkulu uyaziwa kwaJuda, igama lakhe likhulu kwa-Israyeli.
Ithabanakeli lakhe liseSalema, nendlu yakhe iseZiyoni.
Kulapho ayephula khona imicibisholo yomnsalo, isihlangu, inkemba, nempi.
Lapho uvela ezintabeni zempango, uyakhazimula ngobukhosi.
Amaqhawe aphangiwe, alala obokugcina, akukho qhawe elikwaze ukusebenzisa izandla zalo.
Ngokusola kwakho, Nkulunkulu kaJakobe, inqola nehhashi kwehlelwe ngubuthongo.
Wena, yebo, Wena uyesabeka; ngubani ongema phambi kwakho lapho uthukuthele na?
Wezwakalisa ukwehlulela kuvela ezulwini, umhlaba wesaba, wathula
mhla evuka uNkulunkulu ukuba ahlulele, asindise bonke abathobekileyo bomhlaba.
Ngokuba ulaka lomuntu luyakukudumisa, insalelo yolaka uyakuyibhinca.
Thembisani, nizifeze izithembiso enizenza kuSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu. Bonke abamzungezileyo mabalethe izipho kuye owesabekayo.
Unquma umoya wezikhulu, uyesabeka emakhosini omhlaba.
Ngikhala kuNkulunkulu ngezwi eliphakemeyo, ngiyamemeza ukuze angizwe uNkulunkulu.
Ngosuku losizi lwami, ngifuna iNkosi, ebusuku ngelule isandla sami ngingakhathali. Umphefumulo wami uyenqaba ukududuzwa.
Ngikhumbula uNkulunkulu, ngibubule; ngiyazindla, umoya wami udangele.
Uzibambile izinkophe zami, amehlo ami awavaleki. Ngikhathazekile, akusakhulumeki.
Ngininga ngezinsuku zasemandulo, ngikhumbula iminyaka yakudala.
Ebusuku ngiyakhumbula ukubetha kwami ugubhu, ngizindla enhliziyweni yami, nomoya wami uyahlolisisa.
“Ngabe iNkosi iyokuyekelela kuze kube phakade na? Ayiyukuphinda yini ikwenzele umusa?
Ngabe ububele bayo sebuphele ingunaphakade na? Ngabe isithembiso seminyaka sesiphelile yini ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane na?
Ngabe uNkulunkulu usekulibele yini ukuba nozwelo? Ngabe ulaka lwakhe selugabhe uzwelo analo na?”
Ngase ngithi: “Kungukuhlupheka kimi ukuthi isandla soPhezukonke sesiguqukile.”
Ngiyakuzikhumbula izenzo zikaSimakade, yebo, ngizikhumbule izimangaliso zasendulo,
ngicabange ngawo wonke umsebenzi wakho, ngizindle ngezenzo zakho.
Indlela yakho, Nkulunkulu, ingcwele. Yimuphi unkulunkulu omkhulu njengoNkulunkulu wethu na?
Wena unguNkulunkulu owenza izimangaliso, amandla akho uwazisile ezizweni.
Ngengalo yamandla wabasindisa abantu bakho, amadodana kaJakobe noJosefa.
Amanzi akubona, Nkulunkulu, amanzi akubona, athuthumela, nezintwa zazamazama.
Laduma izulu, amafu adedela imvula, imicibisholo yakho yathi chithi saka.
Izwi lokuduma kwakho lisesiphephweni, imibani yakhanyisa izwe, umhlaba wandindizela, wazamazama.
Indlela yakho yayisolwandle, imendo yakho isemanzini amaningi, kodwa amanyathelo akho awabonakalanga.
Abantu bakho wabahola njengezimvu ngesandla sikaMose no-Aroni.
Bantu bami, yizwani umthetho wami, nibeke izindlebe zenu emazwini omlomo wami.
Umlomo wami ngizowuvula, ngisho umfanekiso, ngizobonakalisa izimfihlakalo zasemandulo,
izinto esezwa ngazo sazazi, esazitshelwa ngokhokho.
Asiyukubafihlela zona abantwana babo, kodwa siyotshela izizukulwane izibongo zikaSimakade, amandla akhe nemisebenzi emangalisayo ayenzileyo.
Wamisa isiyalo kwaJakobe, washaya umthetho kwa-Israyeli, wayala ukuba okhokho bethu bawufundise abantwana babo,
ukuze waziwe yisizukulwane esilandelayo, abantwana abayobazala nabo bavuke, batshele abantwana babo ngawo.
Bayobeka ithemba labo kuNkulunkulu, bangakhohlwa yimisebenzi kaNkulunkulu, ukuze bagcine imiyalo yakhe.
Bangabi njengawoyisemkhulu, isizukulwane esiphambeneyo nesihlubukayo, isizukulwane esingaqinisanga inhliziyo yaso, nesimoya waso wawungathembekile kuNkulunkulu.
Abantu bakwa-Efrayimi, sebehlomile bephethe iminsalo, babuyela emuva ngosuku lwempi.
Kabasigcinanga isivumelwano sikaNkulunkulu, benqaba ukuhamba ngomthetho wakhe.
Bayikhohlwa imisebenzi yakhe nezimangaliso zakhe ayebabonise khona.
Izimangaliso wazenza phambi koyisemkhulu eGibhithe, eZowani.
Wehlukanisa ulwandle, wabadabulisa kulo, amanzi wawamisa anjengodonga.
Emini wabahola ngefu, ubusuku bonke, ngokukhanya komlilo.
Waqhekeza amadwala ehlane, wabaphuzisa benela, kungathi kuvela ekujuleni.
Wenza kwagobhoza imithombo edwaleni, amanzi wawenza ageleza njengemifula.
Nokho baqhubeka bona kuye, bamhlubuka Ophezukonke ehlane.
Bamlinga uNkulunkulu enhliziyweni yabo ngokucela ukudla ababekufisa.
Bakhuluma kabi ngoNkulunkulu, bathi: “UNkulunkulu angalendlala yini itafula ehlane na?
Noma ashaya idwala kwaphuma amanzi, kwampompoza imifula; angabapha yini isinkwa noma abahlinzeke ngenyama abantu bakhe na?”
Ngakho-ke lapho uSimakade ekuzwa lokho, wathukuthela, kwavutha umlilo kwaJakobe, ulaka lwakhe lwehlela ku-Israyeli,
ngoba abakholwanga nguNkulunkulu, abaze bethembela ensindisweni yakhe.
Nokho wayala amafu, wavula iminyango yezulu,
wanisela phezu kwabo imana ukuze badle, wabapha ukudla kwasezulwini.
Abantu badla isinkwa sezingelosi, wabathumelela insada yokudla.
Wadedela umoya wasempumalanga ezulwini, ngamandla akhe waqhuba umoya waseningizimu.
Wanisa inyama phezu kwabo njengothuli, nezinyoni ezinamaphiko zafana nesihlabathi solwandle.
Lokho wakwehlisa phakathi kwenkambu yabo, naphakathi kwezindlu zabo.
Badla basutha kakhulu, ngokuba Yena wabapha ababekufisa.
Babengakehlukani nokufisa kwabo, besakumumethe ukudla kwabo emilonyeni,
ulaka lukaNkulunkulu lwehlela phezu kwabo, wazibulala iziqhwaga, waziqumba phansi izinsizwa zakwa-Israyeli.
Phezu kwakho konke lokho baqhubeka nokona, abaze bazikholwa izimangaliso zakhe.
Ngakho-ke izinsuku zabo waziqeda njengomoya, neminyaka yabo, ngokwesaba.
Lapho ebabulala, bamfuna, babuye bamfunisisa uNkulunkulu.
Bakhumbula ukuthi uNkulunkulu uyidwala labo; uNkulunkulu Ophezukonke ungumkhululi wabo.
Ngemilomo yabo babemthopha, kodwa beqamba amanga bngezilimi zabo.
Inhliziyo yabo yayingabambelele kuye, bengathembekile esivumelwanei sakhe.
Kepha Yena waba nobubele, wabathethelela ububi babo, akaze ababhubhisa, yebo, wazibamba kaningi olakeni lwakhe, wangayikhiphela kubo yonke intukuthelo yakhe.
Wakhumbula ukuthi bangabantu nje, bangumoya owedlulayo ongenakubuya.
Babemhlubuka kaningi kangakanani ehlane, bemdabukisa ogwadule!
Bamlinga uNkulunkulu bephindelela, bemdabukisa oNgcwele ka-Israyeli.
Kabazange bawakhumbule amandla akhe, nosuku abahlenga ngalo ezitheni,
ngesikhathi enza izibonakaliso nezimangaliso eGibhithe, eZowani.
Waphendula imifula yabo yaba yigazi, ukuze bangakwazi ukuphuza emithonjeni yabo.
Wabathumelela izibawu ezabalumayo, namaselesele ababhubhisayo.
Ukudla kwabo wakunika imiswenya, nomsebenzi wabo, isikhonyane.
Imivini yabo wayibulala ngesichotho, nemikhiwane yabo, ngesangquma.
Izinkomo zabo wazinikela esichothweni nezimvu nezimbuzi zabo, emibanini.
Ukuvutha kolaka lwakhe wakuthululela phezu kwabo, ulaka, ukufutheka nokuhlupheka, ngokuthuma izithunywa zobubi.
Walungisela intukuthelo yakhe indlela, akawuphephisanga umphefumulo wabo ekufeni, kepha wanikela ukuphila kwabo ezifweni.
Washaya amazibulo wonke aseGibhithe, okokuqala kwamandla abo, emathendeni kaHamu.
Kepha abantu bakhe wabakhipha njengezimvu, njengomhlambi wabahola ehlane.
Wabahola kahle, abaze besaba; ulwandle lwazisibekela izitha zabo.
Wabayisa emngceleni wakhe ongcwele entabeni eyayizungezwe yisandla sakhe sokunene.
Waxosha abezizwe phambi kwabo. Wadabula izwe, wababela lona, laba yifa labo, izizwe zakwa-Israyeli wazihlalisa emathendeni azo.
Nokho bamlinga, bamhlubuka uNkulunkulu oPhezukonke, abaze babugcina ubufakazi bakhe.
Bahlehlela emuva, njengoyisemkhulu, bamkhohlisa, baphambuka njengomnsalo ogejile.
Bamthukuthelisa ngezindawo zabo eziphakemeyo, bamcunula ngezithombe zabo.
Ngesikhathi uNkulunkulu ekuzwa lokho wabathukuthelela, wamlahla impela u-Israyeli.
Walilahla ithabanakeli eliseShilo, ithende ayelimise phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
Amandla akhe wawanikela ekuthunjweni, nenkazimulo yakhe, esandleni sesitha.
Abantu bakhe wabanikela enkembeni, ifa lakhe walithukuthelela.
Izinsizwa zakhona zagwinywa ngumlilo, izintombi zakhona zangahayelwa nkondlo.
Abaphristi bakhona bawa ngenkemba, abafelokazi bakhona abaze balila.
INkosi yayisivuka kwasengathi ibikade ilele njengeqhawe elehlulwe yiwayini.
Izitha zayo yazichithela emuva, yazithela ngehlazo elingunaphakade.
Yayilahla indlu kaJosefa, ayaze yasikhetha isizwe sakwa-Efrayimi.
Kepha yaqoka isizwe sakwaJuda, intaba iZiyoni eyithandayo.
Indlu yayo engcwele yayakha njengezintaba, nanjengomhlaba ewusekele kuze kube phakade.
Yakhetha uDavide, inceku yayo, yamthatha ezibayeni zezimvu.
Wayeselandela izimvukazi ezenyisayo, yamthatha ukuba eluse abantu bayo, uJakobe nefa layo, u-Israyeli.
Wabelusa ngenhliziyo eqotho. Wabahola ngesandla esinekhono.
Nkulunkulu, abezizwe bahlasele ifa lakho, bangcolisa ithempeli lakho elingcwele, iJerusalema baliphendula incithakalo.
Izidumbu zezinceku zakho bazinika izinyoni zezulu, zaba ngukudla kwazo, inyama yabakwesabayo bayinika izilo zomhlaba.
Igazi labo balichithe njengamanzi nxazonke zeJerusalema, akubangabikho obambelayo.
Sesiphenduke isethuko komakhelwane bethu, umbhinqo nenhlekisa kwabasiphahlileyo.
Kuyoze kube nini, Simakade, ulokhu uthukuthele, isifithifithi solaka lwakho sivutha njengomlilo na?
Thela ulaka lwakho phezu kwabezizwe abangakwaziyo, naphezu kwemibuso engalibizi igama lakho.
Ngokuba sebemdlile uJakobe, umuzi wakhe sebewubhubhisile.
Mawungasibaleli amacala akuqala, umusa wakho mawusheshe usihlangabeze, ngokuba sesibuthakathaka kakhulu.
Sisize, Nkulunkulu wensindiso yethu, ngenxa yenkazimulo yegama lakho, usikhulule, usithethelele izono zethu ngenxa yegama lakho.
Kungani abeziwe bethi phambi kwamehlo ethu: “Ukuphi uNkulunkulu wabo na?” Ukuphindiselelwa kwegazi lezinceku zakho elichithekileyo makwaziwe kwabezizwe.
Ukububula kwesiboshwa makuze phambi kwakho; londoloza ngobukhulu bengalo yakho asebengabantwana bokufa.
Ibuyisele kasikhombisa ezifubeni zomakhelwane bethu inhlamba abakuhlambalaza ngayo, Nkosi.
Khona thina, bantu bakho, izimvu zedlelo lakho, siyakukubonga kuze kube phakade, sishumayele udumo lwakho ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.
Lalela, Malusi ka-Israyeli, Wena ohola uJosefa njengomhlambi. Uhlezi phezu kwamakherubhi, khazimula
phambi kuka-Efrayimi, noBhenjamini noManase, vusa amandla akho, uze usisindise.
Sibuyise, Nkulunkulu, ukhanyise ubuso bakho, khona siyakusindiswa.
Simakade, Nkulunkulu Wamabandla, kuyoze kube nini uyithukuthelele imikhuleko yabantu bakho na?
Ubondle ngesinkwa sezinyembezi, wabaphuzisa izinyembezi ngesilinganiso esikhulu.
Usenze into omakhelwane bethu ababangisana ngayo, izitha zethu zisihleka usulu.
Sibuyise, Nkulunkulu Wamabandla, ukhanyise ubuso bakho, khona siyakusindiswa.
Ukhiphe umvini eGibhithe, wasusa izizwe, wawutshala.
Wawulungisela indawo phambi kwawo, wagxila, wagcwalisa umhlaba.
Izintaba zambozwa ngumthunzi wawo, nemisedari kaNkulunkulu, ngamagatsha awo.
Wenabisa amagatsha awo, aze afika olwandle, namaxhantela awo, aze afika emfuleni.
Uludilizeleni uthango lwawo, baze bawukhe bonke abadlula ngendlela na?
Usudliwa yingulube yehlathi, uqothulwa yizilwane zasendle.
Nkulunkulu Wamabandla, phenduka, siyakucela, bheka phansi usezulwini, ubone, bese uwunakekela lo mvini,
yebo, lo mvini utshalwe yisandla sakho sokunene, nendodana yakho ozikhulisele yona.
Bawushise ngomlilo, bawunquma; mababhubhe ngokukhuza nje kwakho.
Isandla sakho masibe phezu kwalowo ongakwesokunene sakho, simvikele, lowo ozikhulisele yena.
Khona singaseyukubuye sikufulathele; siphilise, khona sizokhuleka egameni lakho.
Sibuyise, Simakade Nkulunkulu Wamabandla, ukhanyise ubuso bakho, khona siyakusindiswa.
Halalisani kuNkulunkulu ongamandla ethu, nimemeze ngenjabulo kuNkulunkulu kaJakobe.
Hubani iculo, nithathe isigubhu nohabhu; imiqangala ekhala kahle.
Shayani icilongo ngokwethwasa kwenyanga nangokugcwala kwayo, ngosuku lomkhosi wethu.
Ngokuba kuyisimiso kwa-Israyeli, nomthetho kaNkulunkulu kaJakobe.
Wakwenza kwaba ngubufakazi obumileyo kwaJosefa, mhlazana ephuma eGibhithe. Ngezwa ulimi engingalwazi luthi:
“Ngasusa ihlombe lakhe emthwalweni, nezandla zakhe zakhululeka eqomeni.
Wakhuleka usosizini, ngakukhulula; ngakuphendula ngisekusithekeni kokuduma, ngakuvivinya ngasemanzini eMeribha.
“Bantu bami, yizwani, ngizofakaza kini ngokuthi: Israyeli, sengathi ungangilalela!
Makungabi bikho kuwe omunye uNkulunkulu, ungakhuleki kunkulunkulu wabezizwe.
Mina nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho owakukhuphula eGibithe; khamisa umlomo wakho, ngiwugcwalise.
“Kepha abantu bami abalilalelanga izwi lami, u-Israyeli wangishaya indiva.
Ngase ngibayekelela enkanini yenhliziyo yabo, bahamba ngokuthanda kwabo.
“Kwangathi abantu bami bangangizwa, u-Israyeli ahambe ezindleleni zami.
Izitha zabo bengizozithobisa ngokushesha, abamelene nabo ngibashaye ngesandla sami.
Abazonda uSimakade bayakuzithoba kuye, ukubhujiswa kwabo kube phakade.
Ngizonondla ngokusanhlamvu kwekhethelo, yebo, nginisuthise ngoju oluvela edwaleni.”
UNkulunkulu umi emhlanganweni wonkulunkulu; uyehlulela phakathi konkulunkulu.
Kuyoze kube nini nehlulela ngokungalungile, nenzelela izikhohlakali na?
Yahlulelani ompofu nentandane, nimenzele okufaneleyo olusizi nontulayo.
Khululani ontulayo nompofu, nibophule esandleni sezikhohlakali.
Kabanakwazi nakuqonda, badukuza ebumnyameni; zonke izisekelo zomhlaba ziyazamazama.
Mina ngathi: “Ningonkulunkulu nina, nonke ningamadodana oPhezukonke.
Kanti nokho niyakufa njengabantu nje, niwe njengesinye sezikhulu.”
Vuka, Nkulunkulu, wehlulele umhlaba, ngokuba Wena uyindlalifa yezizwe zonke.
Nkulunkulu, ungathuli, ungabi yisithulu, ungali ukukhuluma, Nkulunkulu.
Ngokuba bheka, izitha zakho ziyaxokozela, nabakuzondayo bayakuvukela.
Ngobuqili, benza uzungu ngabantu bakho, baceba ukulwa nabafihliweyo bakho.
Bathi: “Wozani sibaqothule, bangabe besaba yisizwe, negama lika-Israyeli lingabe lisakhunjulwa.”
Baceba nganhliziyonye, benza isivumelwano ngawe:
amathende ka-Edomi aka-Ishmayeli, akaMowabi nakaHagari,
noGebhali, u-Amoni, u-Amaleki, iFilistiya nabakhile eThire.
Ne-Asiriya lahlangana nabo, laba yingalo yabantwana bakaLothi.
Yenza kubo njengakuMidiyani, nakuSisera nakuJabhini ngasemfuleni iKishoni,
ababhubhela e-Eni Dori, baba ngumquba emhlabathini.
Izikhulu zabo zenze zibe njengo-Orebhi noZebhi, nawo wonke amakhosana abo abe njengoZebha noZalimuna
ababethi: “Masizithathele amadlelo kaNkulunkulu.”
Nkulunkulu wami, benze bafane nothuli lwesikhwishikazana, bafane namakhoba emoyeni.
Njengomlilo oshisa ihlathi, njengelangabi elithungela izintaba,
baxoshe kanjalo ngesivunguvungu sakho, ubethuse ngesiphepho sakho.
Ubuso babo ubuthele ngehlazo, baze bafune igama lakho, Simakade.
Mabahlazeke, baphele amandla kuze kube phakade, mabahluleke, babhubhe,
bazi ukuthi nguwe wedwa ogama lakho linguSimakade, ungoPhezukonke emhlabeni wonke.
Wo, zithandeka kangaka izindlu zakho, Simakade Wamabandla!
Umphefumulo wami ulangazelela, womela amagceke kaSimakade. Inhliziyo yami nomzimba wami kuhuba ngokwethaba kuNkulunkulu ophilayo.
Ngokuba inyoni ifumene isidleke, nenkonjane yazitholela isidleke sayo, lapho ingabeka khona amaphuphu ayo, ngisho kuma-althare akho, Simakade Wamabandla, Nkosi yami, Nkulunkulu wami.
Babusisiwe abahlala endlini yakho; bayakuhlala bebonga Wena.
Ubusisiwe umuntu omandla akhe akuwe, abazindlela zakho zisezinhliziyweni zabo.
Bedabula esigodini iBhakha, basenza saba yindawo yeziphethu, nemvula yokuqala iyayisibekela ngezibusiso.
Baqhubeka emandleni, baze babonakale phambi kukaNkulunkulu eZiyoni.
Simakade Nkulunkulu Wamabandla, yizwa umkhuleko wami, ubeke indlebe, Nkulunkulu kaJakobe.
Wena Nkulunkulu, Sihlangu sethu, bheka, ubuke ubuso bogcotshiweyo wakho.
Ngokuba usuku lulunye emagcekeni akho, luhle kunezinye eziyizinkulungwane. Ngiyakhetha ukulinda emnyango wendlu kaNkulunkulu wami, kunokuhlala emathendeni ezikhohlakali.
Ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu, uyilanga nesihlangu, uSimakade uyakupha umusa nodumo, akayukubenqabela okuhle abahamba ngobuqotho.
Simakade Wamabandla, ubusisiwe okwethembayo.
Simakade, ulibusisile izwe lakho, wamenzela inhlalakahle futhi uJakobe.
Walisusa icala labantu bakho, wazisibekela zonke izono zabo.
Uyihoxisile yonke intukuthelo yakho, waphenduka ekuvutheni kolaka lwakho.
Sibuyise, Nkulunkulu wensindiso yethu, uyeke ukusicasukela.
Uzohlala usithukuthelele yini na? Ulaka lwakho ulwedlulisele phezu kwezizukulwane ngezizukulwane na?
Awuzukusivusa yini, sibuye siphile, ukuze abantu bakho bathokoze ngawe na?
Sikhombise ububele bakho, Simakade, usiphe insindiso yakho.
Ngizokuzwa lokho uNkulunkulu uSimakade azokusho, uzosho ukuthula kubantu bakhe, nakulabo abamesabayo. Mabangabuyeli ebuwuleni!
Impela insindiso yakhe iseduzane nabamesabayo, ukuze inkazimulo yakhe ihlale ezweni lakithi.
Kuyakuhlangabezana umusa neqiniso, kwangane ukulunga nokuthula.
Iqiniso liyovumbuka emhlabeni, ukulunga kubheke phansi kusezulwini.
USimakade uyoveza okuhle, nezwe lethu liyothela izithelo zalo.
Ukulunga kuyohamba phambi kwakhe, kuhlelembele izinyawo zakhe indlela.
Simakade, beka indlebe yakho ungiphendule, ngokuba ngilusizi, ngimpofu.
Londoloza umphefumulo wami, ngokuba ngingoqotho; Wena Nkulunkulu wami, sindisa inceku yakho ekwethembayo.
Yiba nomusa kimi, Nkosi, ngokuba ngikhala kuwe usuku lonke.
Thokozisa umphefumulo wenceku yakho, ngokuba kuWena, Nkosi, ngiyawuphakamisela umphefumulo wami.
Wena, Nkosi umuhle, ungothethelelayo, unomusa omkhulu kubo bonke abakhala kuwe.
Simakade, lalela umkhuleko wami, uzwe izwi lokunxusa kwami.
Ngosuku lokuhlupheka kwami ngikhala kuwe, ngokuba uzongiphendula.
Phakathi kwabo bonke onkulunkulu, akekho onjengawe, Nkosi, akukho okunjengemisebenzi yakho.
Zonke izizwe ozidalileyo zizofika, zikhuleke phambi kwakho, Nkosi, zidumise igama lakho,
ngokuba Wena umkhulu, wenza izimangaliso, unguNkulunkulu, Wena wedwa.
Simakade, ngifundise indlela yakho, ngizohamba eqinisweni lakho. Inhliziyo yami yenze iqonde into eyodwa vo, yesabe igama lakho.
Nkosi Nkulunkulu wami, ngikubonga ngenhliziyo yami yonke, igama lakho ngilidumise kuze kube phakade,
ngokuba umusa wakho phezu kwami mkhulu, ukhulule umphefumulo wami endaweni yabafileyo ephansi.
Nkulunkulu, izedeleli zingivukele, isigejana sezixhwanguxhwangu sizingele umphefumulo wami, sangaba nandaba nawe.
Wena Nkosi unguNkulunkulu ohawukelayo, unomusa nokubekezela, uvame ubumnene nokwethembeka.
Phendukela ngakimi, ube nomusa kimi, inceku yakho yiphe amandla akho, usindise indodana yencekukazi yakho.
Ngibonise isibonakaliso somusa wakho, ukuze abangizondayo bakubone lokho, bajabhe, ngokuba Wena Simakade, uyangisiza, uyangiduduza.
Isisekelo sakhe sisezintabeni ezingcwele.
USimakade uyawathanda amasango eZiyoni kunayo yonke imizi kaJakobe.
Kukhulunywa izinto ezidumisekayo ngawe, muzi kaNkulunkulu.
Ngibala iRahabhi, neBhabhele kulabo abazi mina, bheka, iFilistiya, iThire neKhushe, laba bazalelwa lapho.
Kuyothiwa ngeZiyoni: “Yilo, nalo bazalelwa khona, Ophezukonke uyaliqinisa.”
Mhla uSimakade eloba izizwe, uyakubala ukuthi lo, wazalelwa khona.
Abahubayo nabasinayo bathi: “Imithombo yami yonke ikuwe.”
Simakade, Nkulunkulu wensindiso yami, ngikhala imini nobusuku phambi kwakho.
Beka indlebe yakho ekunxuseni kwami, umkhuleko wami mawufike kuwe.
Umphefumulo wami ugcwele izinsizi, ukuphila kwami kusondele endaweni yabafileyo.
Sengibalwa nabehlela emgodini, sengifana nomuntu ongasenamandla.
Ukhukho lwami luphakathi kwabafileyo, nginjengababuleweyo, abalele ethuneni, ongasabakhumbuli, asebesusiwe esandleni sakho.
Ungibeke emgodini ojule kunayo yonke, ebumnyameni, otweni.
Ukuthukuthela kwakho kuphezu kwami; ungishaye ngamadlambi akho wonke.
Ubaxoshele kude ebengikade ngazana nabo, ungenze ngaba yisinengiso kubo; ngivalelwe, angikwazi ukuphuma.
Iso lami liyafa wusizi, ngikhala kuwe, Simakade imihla yonke, izandla zami ngizelulela kuwe.
Uyakubenzela yini abafileyo isimangaliso na? Izithunzi ziyovuka yini zikubonge na?
Ethuneni kuyolandiswa yini ngomusa wakho, nangokwethembeka kwakho, endaweni yokubhujiswa na?
Ziyaziwa yini izimangaliso zakho ebumnyameni, nokulunga kwakho ezweni lokukhohlwa na?
Simakade, mina ngikhala kuwe, ekuseni umkhuleko wami uyenyuka phambi kwakho.
Simakade, uwulahlelani umphefumulo wami? Ungifihlelelani ubuso bakho na?
Kusukela ebusheni bami ngihluphekile, ngaba ngofayo, ngathwala ukwesabeka kwakho, ngaphela.
Ulaka lwakho oluvuthayo lungehlele, ukwesabisa kwakho kungiqedile.
Imihla yonke kungizungeze njengamanzi, kungikake kanyekanye.
Ubaxoshele kude isihlobo nomngani, ubumnyama yibona obungumhlobo wami.
Ngizohlabelela ngomusa kaSimakade kuze kube phakade, ngomlomo wami, ngazise izizukulwane ngezizukulwane ukwethembeka kwakho.
Ngimemezele ngithi: “Umusa wakho umi ingunaphakade, ukwethembeka kwakho ukuqinise emazulwini.”
Ngenzile isivumelwano nokhethiweyo wami, ngafunga kuDavide, inceku yami, ngathi:
“Uzalo lwakho ngizoluqinisa kuze kube phakade, isihlalo sakho sobukhosi ngisisimamise izizukulwane ngezizukulwane.”
Simakade, izimangaliso zakho ziyodunyiswa ngamazulu, ukwethembeka kwakho, ebandleni labangcwele.
Ngubani osemafini ongalinganiswa noSimakade na? Ngubani phakathi kwamadodana kaNkulunkulu ongafaniswa noSimakade na?
UNkulunkulu uyesabeka kakhulu emkhandlwini wabangcwele, umelwe ukuhlonishwa kakhulu yibo bonke abamzungezileyo.
Simakade, Nkulunkulu Wamabandla, ngubani onjengawe na? Somandla, Simakade, ukwethembeka kwakho kukuzungezile.
Wena ubusa amadlambi olwandle lapho amaza alo ephakama, Wena uyawathulisa.
URahabi umchoboze wanjengobuleweyo, ngengalo yakho enamandla, wahlakaza izitha zakho.
Izulu lingelakho, nomhlaba ungowakho, izwe nokugcwala kwalo, kukho konke, nguwe obeke isisekelo.
Nguwe owadala inyakatho neningizimu, iThabhori neHermoni kuyathokoza egameni lakho.
Ingalo yakho inobuqhawe, isandla sakho sinamandla, esokunene sakho siphakeme.
Ukulunga nobulungiswa kuyisisekelo sesihlalo sakho sobukhosi, umusa nokwethembeka kuhamba phambi kwakho.
Sibusisiwe isizwe esikwazi ukuhlabelela ngenjabulo, sihamba ekukhanyeni kobukhona bakho, Simakade.
Sithokoza egameni lakho usuku lonke, siyaphakanyiswa ngokulunga kwakho,
ngokuba Wena uyinkazimulo yamandla abo, udumo lwethu luyophakama ngomusa wakho.
Ngokuba isihlangu sethu singesikaSimakade, inkosi yethu ingeyoNgcwele ka-Israyeli.
Ngaleso sikhathi wakhuluma ngombono kwabethembekileyo bakho, wathi: “Ngimsizile onamandla, ngimphakamisile okhethwe phakathi kwabantu.
Ngiyifumene inceku yami, uDavide, ngayigcoba ngamafutha ami angcwele.
Isandla sami siyakuba naye, simsimamise, ingalo yami imqinise.
Isitha asiyukumehlula, nendodana yobubi ayiyukumhlupha.
Izitha zakhe ngiyozichoboza ebuka, ngibhubhise abamzondayo.
Ukwethembeka kwami nomusa wami kuyakuba naye, egameni lami luyakuphakama udumo lwakhe.
Ngiyakubeka isandla sakhe phezu kolwandle, esokunene sakhe phezu kwemifula.
Uyakungibiza, athi: “UnguBaba, unguNkulunkulu wami nedwala lensindiso yami.”
Ngiyomenza abe yizibulo nophakemeyo kunamakhosi omhlaba.
Umusa wami ngiyomgcinela wona kuze kube phakade; isivumelwano sami siyohlala siqinile kuye.
Uzalo lwakhe ngiyolwenza lume kuze kube phakade, isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi siyokuma, inqobo nje kusekhona isibhakabhaka.
“Uma abantwana bakhe bewushiya umthetho wami, bengahambi ngezehlulelo zami,
uma bephula izimiso zami, bengayigcini imiyalo yami,
ngiyakujezisa iziphambeko zabo ngenduku, namacala abo ngemivimbo.
Kepha umusa wami angiyukuwususa kuye, ngingaphikisi ukuthembeka kwami.
Isivumelwano sami angiyukusaphula, nengikukhiphe ngezindebe zami angiyukukuguqula.
Ngafunga ubungcwele bami kwakanye, angiyukuwaqamba amanga kuDavide.
Abozalo lwakhe bayakuma kuze kube phakade, isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi sibe njengelanga phambi kwami.
Bayakuma kuze kube phakade njengenyanga, ibe ngufakazi esibhakabhakeni.”
Nokho ogcotshiweyo wakho usumlahlile, wamala, wamthukuthelela.
Usichithile isivumelwano senceku yakho, wawungcolisa othulini umqhele wayo.
Udilize zonke izindonga zakhe, wazenza izinqaba zakhe zaba yincithakalo.
Bonke abadlula ngendlela bayamphanga, useyihlazo kwabakhelene naye.
Uphakamise esokunene sezitha zakhe, wajabulisa zonke izitha zakhe.
Futhi uyenze yaba buthuntu inkemba yakhe, awumsekelanga empini.
Uyisusile inkazimulo yakhe, wasiwisa phansi emhlabathini isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi.
Uzifinyezile izinsuku zobusha bakhe, wamthela ngamahloni.
Simakade, kuyoze kube nini uzisithile, nentukuthelo yakho ivutha njengomlilo na?
Khumbula ukuthi isikhathi sami singakanani, nokuthi bonke abantwana babantu wabadalela ize.
Ngubani oyophila angakuboni ukufa, akhulule umphefumulo wakhe emandleni endawo yabafileyo na?
Nkosi, uphi umusa wakho wakuqala owawufungela kuDavide ngokwethembeka kwakho na?
Khumbula, Nkosi, ihlazo lezinceku zakho, nokuthi ngithwele esifubeni sami ihlazo lezizwe eziningi kakhulu,
ezisola ngalo izitha zakho, Simakade, ezisola ngalo ukuhamba kogcotshiweyo wakho.
Makabongwe uSimakade, kuze kube phakade. Amen, Amen.
Nkosi, Wena uyisiphephelo sethu izizukulwane ngezizukulwane.
Zingakaveli izintaba, umhlaba, nezwe ungakakudali, kusukela phakade kuze kube phakade, Wena, Nkulunkulu, ukhona.
Umuntu uyambuyisela othulini, uthi: “Buyani, bantwana babantu.”
Ngokuba emehlweni akho inkulungwane yeminyaka ingangosuku lwayizolo olwedlule, imfushane ngangomlindo wasebusuku.
Ubakhukhula njengesikhukhula; banjengobuthongo, nanjengotshani obuhluma ekuseni.
Ekuseni buyahluma, bukhahlele, kusihlwa bubune, bunqunywe.
Ngokuba siqedwa yintukuthelo yakho, ulaka lwakho luyasithuthumelisa.
Amacala ethu uwabeke phambi kwakho, izono zethu ezifihliweyo zisekukhanyeni kobuso bakho.
Ngokuba izinsuku zethu zidlula phansi kwentukuthelo, iminyaka yethu iphela ngokuphazima kweso.
Izinsuku esiziphilayo ziyiminyaka engamashumi ayisikhombisa, kuthi uma ziziningi, zibe yiminyaka engamashumi ayisishiyagalombili.
Ngubani owazi amandla entukuthelo yakho nolaka lwakho olunjengokwesabeka kwakho na?
Nkosi, sifundise ukubala kahle izinsuku zethu, ukuze sizuze inhliziyo enokuhlakanipha.
Buya, Simakade! Kuyoze kube nini na? Hawukela izinceku zakho.
Sisuthise ngomusa wakho ekuseni, ukuze sithokoze, sijabule izinsuku zethu zonke.
Sithokozise ngangezinsuku owasihlupha ngazo, nangangeminyaka esabona okubi ngayo.
Izenzo zakho mazibonakale kuzo izinceku zakho, nenkazimulo yakho, kubantwana bazo.
Umusa weNkosi, uNkulunkulu wethu, mawube phezu kwethu, imisebenzi yezandla zethu ichume, yisimamise imisebenzi yezandla zethu.
Lowo ohlala emphemeni woPhezukonke akhosele emthunzini kaSomandla,
uyothi kuSimakade: “Uyisiphephelo sami nenqaba yami, unguNkulunkulu wami engethembele kuye.”
Ngokuba nguYena oyokuhlenga ogibeni lomcuphi nasobhubhaneni,
uyokusibekela ngezimpaphe zakhe, uphephele phansi kwamaphiko akhe, ukwethembeka kwakhe kuyisihlangu nogange.
Awuyukwesaba okwesabisayo ebusuku, nomcibisholo ondizayo emini,
nobhubhane oluhamba ebumnyameni, nesifo esibhubhisayo emini bebade.
Bayakuwa abayizinkulungwane ngaseceleni kwakho, nabayizinkulungwane ezilishumi ngakwesokunene sakho, kodwa akuyukukuthinta wena.
Uyobona ngamehlo akho, ubone izikhohlakali zijeziswa.
Ngokuba uSimakade umenze wayisiphephelo sakho, oPhezukonke waba yinqaba yakho.
Okubi akuyukukwehlela, nesifo asiyukusondela ethendeni lakho.
Ngokuba uyakuyaleza izingelosi zakhe ngawe, zikulondoloze ezindleleni zakho zonke.
Ziyokuphakamisa ngezandla zazo, unyawo lwakho aluyukuqhuzulwa yitshe.
Uyonyathela ingonyama nebululu, ufihlize phansi ibhongo lengonyama nodrago.
Ngoba ubambelele kimi, ngizomhlenga, ngimvikele, ngokuba walazi iGama lami.
Uyakungibiza, ngimphendule, ngibe naye lapho esosizini, ngimkhulule, ngimenze abe nodumo.
Ngiyomsuthisa ngobude bezinsuku zokuphila, ngimbonise insindiso yami.
Kuhle ukubonga uSimakade, nokuhubela igama lakho, Wena oPhezukonke,
ukumemezela umusa wakho ekuseni, nokwethembeka kwakho ebusuku,
nokushaya ugubhu olunezintambo ezilishumi, umqangala nohabhu okuzwakala kamnandi.
Ngokuba Wena, Simakade, ungithokozisile ngemisebenzi yakho. Ngizohuba ngentokozo ngemisebenzi yezandla zakho.
Simakade, yeka ubukhulu bemisebenzi yezandla zakho! Imicabango yakho ijule kakhulu.
Umuntu oyisiwula akanalwazi, nesiphukuphuku asikuqondi lokhu.
Ngisho izikhohlakali zingahluma njengotshani, nabo bonke abenza okubi baqhakaze, bayobhubha ingunaphakade.
Kepha Wena, Simakade, uphakeme kuze kube phakade.
Ngokuba izitha zakho, Simakade, izitha zakho ziyakubhubha, bonke abenza okubi bayakuhlakazwa,
kodwa udumo lwami uluphakamise lwanjengophondo lwenyathi, ngagcotshwa ngamafutha amasha.
Iso lami liyakuzibona ngokujabula izitha zami, nezindlebe zami ziyakuzwa ngokuthokoza ngabenzi bokubi abangivukelayo.
Olungileyo uhluma njengesundu, akhule njengomsedari eLebhanoni.
Batshalwe endlini kaSimakade, bamilile emagcekeni kaNkulunkulu wethu.
Nalapho sebebadala bayakuthela izithelo, bahlume babe luhlaza,
ukuze bamemezele ukuthi uSimakade ulungile, uyidwala lami, kuye akukho ukungalungi.
USimakade uyiNkosi, wembethe ubukhosi, uSimakade uvunule, ubhince amandla. Izwe ulimise laqina, alinakunyakaziswa.
Isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi simi siqinile kwasemandulo. Wena ukhona kuze kube phakade.
Simakade, imifula iholoba ngamandla, imifula iholoba kakhulu, imifula iduma ngamandla amakhulu.
USimakade kweliphezulu unamandla ukwedlula ukuhlokoma kwamanzi amaningi, nokuduma kwamadlambi olwandle.
Ubufakazi bakho buqinisekile impela. Simakade, ubungcwele buyifanele indlu yakho kuze kube phakade.
Nkulunkulu ophindiselelayo, Simakade, Nkulunkulu ophindiselelayo, vela ukhanye.
Phakama, Mehluleli womhlaba, uziphindisele kwabazidlayo izenzo zabo.
Simakade, kuyoze kube nini ababi, kuyoze kube nini ababi bethaba na?
Bakhulumela futhi, bakhuluma amagama ayiziswana, bonke abenzi bokubi bayazigabisa.
Simakade, baphohloza isizwe sakho, nefa lakho balinyathela phansi.
Babulala abafelokazi nabafokazi, babulale nezintandane.
Bathi: “USimakade akaboni, uNkulunkulu kaJakobe akanaki.”
Qaphelani nina zithutha eziphakathi kwabantu, nani ziwula, niyakuqonda nini na?
Owenza indlebe kanakuzwa na? Owadala iso kanakubona na?
Othethisa abezizwe, Yena ofundisa abantu ukwazi, kanakujezisa na?
USimakade uyayazi imicabango yabantu ukuthi ingumoya nje.
Simakade, ubusisiwe umuntu omyalayo, omfundisa ngomthetho wakho.
Umenza aphumule ezinsukwini ezimbi, aze ambele umgodi lowo ongenamthetho.
Ngokuba uSimakade akayukubalahla abantu bakhe, nefa lakhe akayukulishiya.
Ngokuba ukulunga kuyakubuyela ekwehluleleni, bonke abaqotho ngenhliziyo bakulandele.
Ngubani oyakungimela phambi kwababi na? Ngubani oyakungelekelela kwabenza okubi na?
Ukuba uSimakade ubengesilo usizo lwami, umphefumulo wami ubuyakushesha ukuhlala endaweni yabafileyo.
Lapho ngithi unyawo lwami lushibilikile, umusa wakho, Simakade, wangiphasa.
Emicabangweni eminingi yenhliziyo yami, ukududuza kwakho kuyawuthokozisa umphefumulo wami.
Isihlalo sobubi singahlanganyela yini nawe, leso esisebenza okubi kungathi kusemthethweni na?
Bahlangana ukuvukela umphefumulo wolungileyo, balahla umuntu ongenacala ukuba afe.
Kepha uSimakade waba yinqaba yami, uNkulunkulu wami waba yidwala engiphephela kulo.
Ukukhohlakala kwabo ukuphindisela kubo, uyobaqeda nya ngobubi babo; uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu uyabaqeda.
Wozani simhubele uSimakade, silihlokomele ngenjabulo idwala lensindiso yethu.
Masize phambi kwakhe ngokubonga, simhubele amahubo.
Ngokuba uSimakade unguNkulunkulu omkhulu, uyiNkosi enkulu ngaphezu konkulunkulu bonke.
Esandleni sakhe kukhona izinzulu zomhlaba, neziqongo zezintaba ngezakhe nazo.
Ulwandle ngolwakhe, walwenza, nomhlabathi owomileyo wawubumba ngezandla zakhe.
Wozani sikhuleke, sikhothame, siguqe phambi kukaSimakade, uMenzi wethu.
Ngokuba Yena unguNkulunkulu wethu, thina singabantu bedlelo lakhe nezimvu zesandla sakhe.
Ningayenzi lukhuni inhliziyo yenu njengaseMeribha, njengasosukwini lwaseMasa, ehlane,
lapho okhokho benu bangilinga khona, bangivivinya, bewubonile umsebenzi wami.
Iminyaka engamashumi amane, nganengwa yileso sizukulwane, ngaze, ngathi: “Bangabantu abanhliziyo zabo zidukile, abangazazanga izindlela zami.”
Ngafunga ngabo olakeni lwami, ngathi: “Abasoze bangena ekuphumuleni kwami.”
Hlabelelani uSimakade ihubo elisha, nimhlabelele uSimakade, mhlaba wonke.
Mhubeleni uSimakade, nibonge igama lakhe, nimemezele insindiso yakhe imihla ngemihla.
Landani ngenkazimulo yakhe kwabezizwe, nezimangaliso zakhe kubantu bonke.
Mkhulu uSimakade, udumisekile kakhulu, uyesabeka ngaphezu konkulunkulu bonke.
Bonke onkulunkulu babezizwe bayizithombe, kodwa uSimakade wenza izulu.
Udumo nobukhosi kusebusweni bakhe, amandla nenkazimulo kusendlini yakhe engcwele.
Nina mindeni yabantu nikani uSimakade, mnikeni uSimakade inkazimulo namandla.
Mnikeni uSimakade inkazimulo yegama lakhe, nilethe umnikelo, ningene emagcekeni akhe.
Khulekani kuSimakade, nihlobe ngobungcwele, nithuthumele ebusweni bakhe, mhlaba wonke.
Shonini phakathi kwezizwe, nithi: “USimakade uyinkosi;” umhlaba umi uqinile, awunakunyakaziswa. Uyokwehlulela izizwe ngobuqotho.
Malijabule izulu, umhlaba uthokoze, maluhlokome ulwandle, nakho konke okukulo.
Mawethabe amasimu, nakho konke okukuwo, kwename imithi yonke yehlathi
phambi kukaSimakade, ngokuba uyeza, impela uyeza ukuzokwehlulela umhlaba. Uzowehlulela ngobuqotho umhlaba, nezizwe ngokwethembeka kwakhe.
USimakade uyabusa, umhlaba mawuthokoze, zethabe iziqhingi eziningi.
Yena uphahlwe ngamafu nobumnyama, ukulunga nobulungiswa kuyisisekelo sesihlalo sakhe sobukhosi.
Umlilo uhamba phambi kwakhe, uzishwabadele nxazonke izitha zakhe.
Imibani yakhe ikhanyisa umhlaba, ukubona lokho umhlaba qede uthuthumele.
Izintaba zincibilikisa okwengcina phambi kukaSimakade, phambi kweNkosi yawo wonke umhlaba.
Amazulu ashumayela ngokulunga kwakhe, nezizwe zonke ziyayibona inkazimulo yakhe.
Bonke abakhonza izithombe ezibaziweyo mabajabhe, labo abazigabisa ngezithombe. Bonke onkulunkulu bakhothame phambi kwakhe.
IZiyoni liyezwa, futhi lithokozile, namadodakazi akwaJuda ayethaba, ngenxa yezehlulelo zakho, Simakade,
ngokuba Wena Simakade ungoPhezu kwawo wonke umhlaba, uphakeme kakhulu, ngaphezu kwabo bonke onkulunkulu.
Nina enithanda uSimakade kuzondeni okubi, Yena olondoloza imiphefumulo yabathembekile, abasindise ezandleni zezikhohlakali.
Ukukhanya kukhanyisela olungileyo, nokujabula kwabanhliziyo ziqotho.
Thokozani kuSimakade, nina balungileyo, nibonge lapho nikhumbula ubungcwele bakhe.
Hubelani uSimakade ihubo elisha, ngokuba wenze izimangaliso, esokunene sakhe nengalo yakhe engcwele kumzuzele ukunqoba.
USimakade uyenze yaziwa insindiso yakhe, ukulunga kwakhe wakwembula emehlweni abezizwe.
Uwukhumbulile umusa wakhe nokwethembeka kwakhe kwabendlu yakwa-Israyeli. Yonke imikhawulo yomhlaba iyibonile insindiso kaNkulunkulu wethu.
Hlokomelani uSimakade mhlaba wonke, qhumukani, nihlabelele ngenjabulo, nihube amahubo.
Mhubeleni uSimakade ngehabhu, ngehabhu nangezwi lehubo,
ngamacilongo nangokukhala komtshingo, hlokomani ngezwi lokuhalalisa phambi kweNkosi uSimakade.
Ulwandle maludume nakho konke okukulo, nezwe nabakhileyo kulo.
Imifula mayishaye ihlombe, izintaba zihube ndawonye ngentokozo,
phambi kukaSimakade, ngokuba uyeza, uzokwehlulela umhlaba. Uzolehlulela ngokulunga izwe, nezizwe ngobuqotho.
USimakade uyabusa, abantu mabathuthumele, uhleli phezu kwamakherubhi, umhlaba mawuzamazame.
USimakade mkhulu eZiyoni, uphakeme phezu kwezizwe zonke.
