Mabalibonge igama lakhe elikhulu nelesabekayo; ungcwele Yena.
Nkosi enamandla, mthandi wokulungileyo, uqinise ubuqotho, waphakamisa ubulungiswa nokulunga kwaJakobe.
Mphakamiseni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu, nikhuleke ngasesenabelweni sezinyawo zakhe; ungcwele Yena.
UMose no-Aroni babengabanye babaphristi bakhe, uSamuweli engomunye wababekhuleka eGameni lakhe. Bakhuleka kuSimakade, Yena wabaphendula.
Wakhuluma kubo esensikeni yefu, bagcina ubufakazi bakhe nezimiso abanika zona.
Simakade Nkulunkulu wethu, Wena wabaphendula, waba nguNkulunkulu othethelelayo kubo, nophindiselayo ngezenzo zabo.
Mphakamiseni uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu, nikhuleke nisentabeni yakhe engcwele, ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu ungcwele.
Hlokoma kuSimakade ngezwi lokuhalalisa, mhlaba wonke.
Mkhonzeni uSimakade ngokwethaba, nisondele phambi kwakhe, nihuba ngentokozo.
Yazini ukuthi uSimakade unguNkulunkulu; nguYena osidalileyo, asizidalanga thina, singabantu bakhe, nezimvu zedlelo lakhe.
Ngenani emasangweni akhe ngokubonga, nasemagcekeni akhe ngokudumisa, mbongeni, nidumise igama lakhe.
Ngokuba uSimakade muhle, umusa wakhe umi phakade, nokwethembeka kwakhe, ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.
Ngizohuba ngomusa nobulungiswa, ngikudumise Wena Simakade.
Ngizohamba ngobuqotho, ngingabi nacala. Uyakuza nini kimi na? Ngizohamba nginenhliziyo emsulwa endlini yami.
Angizukuyibeka phambi kwamehlo ami into embi; ngiyakuzonda okwenziwa ngabahlubukayo, akuyukunamathela kimi.
Ngiyakuziqhelelanisa nenhliziyo edukileyo, omubi angiyukumnaka.
Ohleba umakhelwane wakhe esithe ngiyombhubhisa, angiyukumbekezelela ozikhukhumezayo.
Amehlo ami akwabathembekileyo bomhlaba ukuze bahlale nami, ohamba endleleni engenacala, uyakungikhonza.
Akukho namunye owenza inkohliso, oyohlala endlini yami, namunye oqamba amanga, oyokuma phambi kwamehlo ami.
Njalo ekuseni ngizobabhubhisa ababi ezweni, ngibaqede bonke abenzi bokubi emzini kaSimakade.
Simakade, yizwa umkhuleko wami, ukukhala kwami makufiyinyelele kuwe.
Ungangifihleli ubuso bakho ngosuku losizi lwami; beka indlebe yakho kimi, ngosuku engikumemeza ngalo, usheshe ungiphendule.
Izinsuku zami ziphele njengomusi, namathambo asha njengezinkuni.
Umphefumulo wami udangele, wabunisa okotshani, inhliziyo yami imnyama, ukudla akusangeni.
Ngenxa yokugqiha kwami, ngibubula, amathambo ami asenamathele esikhumbeni.
Ngifana nomandukulu ehlane, nginjengesikhova kwahlongasibi.
Abehli ubuthongo, ngifana nenyoni ehleli yodwa ophahleni lwendlu.
Izitha zami zingethuka usuku lonke, abangihlambalazayo bayangiqalekisa.
Ngikhume umlotha njengesinkwa, nengikuphuzayo ngakuxubanisa nezinyembezi,
ngenxa yentukuthelo nolaka lwakho, ungiqukule wangilahla kude.
Izinsuku zami zifana nethunzi seliyoshona, mina luqobo, ngibuna njengotshani.
Wena Simakade uyohlala kuze kube phakade, nesikhumbuzo sakho, izizukulwane ngezizukulwane.
Uzovuka, uhawukele iZiyoni, ngokuba sekuyisikhathi somusa wakho kulo, isikhathi esinqunyiweyo sesifikile.
Ngokuba izinceku zakho ziyathokoza ngamatshe alo, ziyadabuka ngothuli lwalo.
Yikhona abezizwe bezolesaba igama likaSimakade, namakhosi wonke omhlaba, inkazimulo yakho.
Ngokuba uSimakade ulakhile iZiyoni, ubonakele enkazimulweni yakhe.
Wawunaka umkhuleko wabangenalutho, akaze awedelela umthandazo wabo.
Lokhu makulotshelwe isizukulwane, ukuze abantu abangakazalwa bamdumise uSimakade.
USimakade wabuka phansi, esekuphakameni ezulwini, endaweni yakhe engcwele, wabuka emhlabeni
ukuba ezwe ukububula kweziboshwa, akhulule labo abase beqonde ekufeni,
ukuze igama likaSimakade lishunyayelwe eZiyoni, nodumo lwakhe, eJerusalema,
lapho izizwe zibuthana ndawonye nemibuso, ukuzodumisa uSimakade.
Wanciphisa amandla ami endleleni, wafinyeza izinsuku zami.
Ngithi: “Nkulunkulu wami, uze ungangithathi ngisemncane, Wena ominyaka yakho ihlezi izizukulwane ngezizukulwane.
Izisekelo zomhlaba wazibeka kwasemandulo, namazulu angumsebenzi wezandla zakho.
Kuyobhubha lokhu, kodwa Wena uyokuma, konke kuyoguga njengengubo, njengesembatho, uyokuguqula kushabalale,
kepha Wena unguwe njalo, iminyaka yakho ayinasiphetho.
Abantwana bezinceku zakho bayakuhlala, izizukulwane zabo ziyovikeleka phambi kwakho.”
Mbonge uSimakade, mphefumulo wami, konke okungaphakathi kimi makulibonge igama lakhe elingcwele.
Mbonge uSimakade, mphefumulo wami, ungaze wakhohlwa yimisebenzi yakhe yonke yomusa,
Yena othethelela zonke izono zakho, owelapha zonke izifo zakho,
okhulula ukuphila kwakho ekubhujisweni, okuqhelisa ngomusa nangobubele,
osuthisa ukulangazelela kwakho ngokuhle, ubusha bakho bubuyiswe njengokhozi.
USimakade ubenzela bonke abacindezelweyo ukulunga nobulungiswa.
Wamazisa uMose izindlela zakhe, nabantu bakwa-Israyeli, izenzo zakhe.
USimakade unobubele nesihawu, uyephuza ukuthukuthela, uvame umusa.
Akathethi njalonjalo, akayigcini intukuthelo yakhe kuze kube phakade.
Akasiphathi njengokufanele izono zethu, akasivuzi njengokwamacala ethu.
Ngokuba njengokuphakama kwezulu phezu komhlaba, unjalo umusa wakhe phezu kwabamesabayo.
Njengokuba impumalanga yahlukene nentshonalanga, uzidedise kangako iziphambeko zethu.
Njengalokhu uyise ebahawukela abantwana bakhe, kanjalo noSimakade uyabahawukela abamesabayo.
Ngokuba uyazi ukuthi sibunjwe kanjani, uyakhumbula ukuthi siluthuli nje.
Izinsuku zomuntu zinjengotshani; ukhahlela njengembali yasendle,
ipheshethwa ngumoya, bese inyamalala, nendawo yayo ingabe isayazi.
Kepha umusa kaSimakade uphezu kwabamesabayo phakade naphakade, nokulunga kwakhe kubantwana babantwana,
abagcina isivumelwane sakhe, bakhumbule ukwenza iziyalezo zakhe.
USimakade umise isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi ezulwini, umbuso wakhe ubusa phezu kwakho konke.
Bongani uSimakade nina zingelosi zakhe, nina maqhawe anamandla enigcina izwi lakhe nilalele okushiwo yilo.
Bongani uSimakade nina mabandla akhe wonke, nina zinceku zakhe enenza intando yakhe.
Bongani uSimakade, nina misebenzi yakhe yonke ezindaweni zonke zombuso wakhe. Mbonge uSimakade, mphefumulo wami.
Mbonge uSimakade, mphefumulo wami, Simakade Nkulunkulu wami, umkhulu, wembethe udumo nobukhosi,
wembethe ukukhanya njengengubo, weneka izulu njengendwangu.
Ubeka imishayo yezindlu zakhe emanzini, wenza amafu abe yinqola yakhe, uhamba ngamaphiko omoya,
wenza umoya ube yizithunywa zakhe, izikhonzi zakhe zibe yilangabi lomlilo.
Umhlaba uwumise phezu kwezisekelo zawo, ukuze unganyakaziswa kuze kube phakade naphakade.
Wawumboza ngolwandle njengengubo, amanzi ema phezu kwezintaba.
Ngokukhuza kwakho abaleka, ngezwi lokuduma kwakho ashesha asuka.
Enyuka izintaba, ehla izigodi, aze afika endaweni owawuyimisele wona.
Uwamisele umngcele ukuba angaweqi, angabuyi ukuzosibekela umhlaba.
Uthumela imithombo ezigodini, yona igijima phakathi kwezintaba.
Iphuzisa izilwane zonke zasendle, izimbongolo zasendle zicime ukoma kwazo.
Izinyoni zezulu zakhe ngakuyo, zizwakalisa izwi lazo phakathi kwamagatsha.
Uchelela izintaba ngokuvela emakamelweni akhe aphezulu, umhlaba uyaneliswa yisithelo semisebenzi yakho.
Uhlumisela izinkomo utshani nemifino yokusiza umuntu, ukuze athole ukudla okuvela emhlabeni,
newayini elijabulisa inhliziyo yomuntu, namafutha okukhazimulisa ubuso, nesinkwa esiqinisa inhliziyo yomuntu.
Imithi kaSimakade iyasuthisa, imisedari eLebhanoni ayitshalileyo,
kwakhela kuyo izinyoni, unogolantethe unesidleke kuyo imisayiphuresi.
Izintaba eziphakemeyo ngezezimbuzi zasendle, amawa ayisiphephelo sezimbila.
Wenza inyanga ukuba ibe ngeyokwehlukanisa izinkathi, ilanga liyazi ukuthi lishona nini.
Ubumnyama wenza ukuba bube wubusuku, phakathi kwabo izilo zonke zasehlathini ziyaphuma.
Amabhongo amabhubesi agwavumele inyamazane, efuna ukudla kwawo kuNkulunkulu.
Kuthi ngokuphuma kwelanga abuyele phansi emiphandwini yawo, alale.
Kube sekuphuma umuntu, aye emsebenzini wakhe nasemshikashikeni wakhe, kuze kuhlwe.
Simakade, yaze yaba miningi imisebenzi yakho, yonke uyenze ngokuhlakanipha; umhlaba ugcwele izidalwa zakho.
Bheka nje ulwandle, lukhulu, lubanzi, kulo kukhona izilwanyana ezinwabuzelayo ezingenakubalwa, izilwane ezincane nezinkulu.
Kulo kuntweza imikhumbi, inkanyamba yasolwandle oyidalileyo idlala kulo.
Zonke lezi zidalwa zibheke Wena, ukuze uzinike ukudla kwazo ngesikhathi esifaneleyo.
Uyazinika ukudla, zikubuthe; uvula isandla sakho, zisuthe ngokuhle.
Uyasitheza ubuso bakho, zethuke, uyasusa umphefumulo wazo, zife, zibuyele othulini lwazo.
Uyathumela umoya wakho, zidalwe; wenza bube busha ubuso bomhlaba.
Inkamulo kaSimakade mayime kuze kube phakade; uSimakade makathokoze ngemisebenzi yakhe,
Yena obheka umhlaba, maqede uthuthumele, athinte izintaba, zithunqe.
Ngizomhubela uSimakade, inqobo nje uma ngisaphila. Ngizohlabelelela uNkulunkulu wami ngisekhona.
Kwangathi izizindlo zami zingamthokozisa, ngokuba ukuthokoza kwami kukuSimakade.
Izoni maziphele emhlabeni, kungabe kusaba bikho zikhohlakali. Mbonge uSimakade, mphefumulo wami, Haleluya!
Bongani uSimakade, nibize igama lakhe, izenzo zakhe nizazise phakathi kwabantu.
Mhlabeleleleni, nimhubele, nikhulume ngazo zonke izimangaliso zakhe.
Dumisani igama lakhe elingcwele, mazithokoze izinhliziyo zabafuna uSimakade.
Mfuneni uSimakade namandla akhe, nifunisise ubuso bakhe njalonjalo.
Khumbulani izimangaliso zakhe azenzileyo, nezibonakaliso zakhe, nezehlulelo zomlomo wakhe,
nina bozalo luka-Abhrahama, inceku yakhe, nina bantwana bakaJakobe, abakhethiweyo bakhe.
Yena unguSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu, izehlulelo zakhe zisemhlabeni wonke.
Kuyoze kube phakade esikhumbula isivumelwano sakhe, izwi ayala ngalo izizukulwane ngezizukulwane,
avumelana ngaso no-Abhrahama, nesifungo asenza ku-Isaka,
wasiqinisa kuJakobe, saba ngumthetho naku-Israyeli saba yisivumelwano esiphakade.
Wathi: “Ngizokunika iKhanani, libe yisabelo sefa lakho.”
Ngaleso sikhathi babeyingcosana ngenani, yebo, babeseyingcosana, futhi babengabafokazi kulo.
Bazulazula ezizweni ngezizwe, besuka kulo mbuso, beya kwabanye abantu.
Akavumelanga muntu ukubahlupha, wajezisa amakhosi ngenxa yabo,
ethi: “Ningabathinti abagcotshiweyo bami, ningabalimazi abaphrofethi bami.”
Lapho ethumela indlala ezweni, kwavaleka umthombo wokudla.
Wathumela indoda, yabendulela, uJosefa owathengiswa waba yisigqila,
balimaza izinyawo zakhe ngamaketanga, waboshwa ngensimbi.
Kwaze kwaba yisikhathi elagcwaliseka ngaso izwi lakhe, izwi likaSimakade lamhola.
Inkosi yathumela, yamkhulula, umbusi wabantu wamdedela.
Wamenza umphathi wendlu yakhe, nenduna yezinto zakhe zonke,
ukuze abophe izikhulu zakhe ngokuthanda kwakhe, afundise amalunga akhe ukuhlakanipha.
U-Israyeli wayesefika eGibhithe, uJakobe wagogobala ezweni likaHamu.
USimakade wabenza banda kakhulu abantu bakhe, wabenza baba namandla kunezitha zabo.
Wayiguqula inhliziyo yabantu baseGibhithe, babazonda abantu bakhe, baziphatha ngobuqili izinceku zakhe.
Wathumela uMose inceku yakhe, no-Aroni ayemkhethile.
Benza izibonakaliso nezimangaliso zakhe phakathi kwabo, ezweni likaHamu.
Wabehlisela ngobumnyama, kwaba mnyama ezweni, kepha baphambana namazwi akhe.
Waphendula amanzi abo aba yigazi, wabhubhisa izinhlanzi zabo.
Izwe labo lagcwala amasele nasezindlini zamakhosi abo.
Wakhuluma, kwavela izibawu nomiyane emingceleni yabo yonke.
Wabanika isichotho saba yimvula yabo, amalangabi omlilo ezweni lakubo.
Washaya nemivini yabo nemikhiwane yabo, waphula imithi yasezweni labo.
Wakhuluma, kwavela isikhonyane nezinkumbi ezingenakubalwa.
Zona zadla imifino yonke yezwe lakubo, zaqothula nezithelo zomhlabathi wabo.
Washaya namazibulo wonke ezweni lakubo, okokuqala kwamandla abo.
Abantu bakhe wayesebakhipha benesiliva negolide, kungekho ontengezelayo emindenini yakubo.
IGibhithe lajabula ekuphumeni kwabo, ngokuba ukwesaba kwabehlela.
Wendlala ifu lokubasibekela, nomlilo wokubakhanyisela ebusuku.
Bacela, waletha izigwaca, wabasuthisa ngesinkwa sasezulwini.
Wavula idwala, kwampompoza amanzi, agobhoza ogwadule kwangathi ngumfula.
USimakade walikhumbula izwi lakhe elingcwele no-Abhrahama, inceku yakhe.
Wayesebakhipha abantu bakhe bethokozile, abakhethiweyo bakhe bahuba ngokwethaba.
Wabapha amazwe abezizwe, badla umcebo wabezizwe,
ukuze baqaphele ukugcina izimiso zakhe nemithetho yakhe. Haleluya!
Haleluya! Bongani uSimakade ngokuba muhle, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.
Ngubani ongalanda ngezenzo zamandla kaSimakade, ezwakalise lonke udumo lwakhe na?
Babusisiwe abagcina ubulungiswa, abenza ukulunga ngezikhathi zonke.
Ngikhumbule, Simakade, lapho wenzela abantu bakho umusa, ungihambele ngensindiso yakho,
ukuze ngibone impumelelo yabakhethiweyo bakho, ngithokoze ngentokozo yesizwe sakho, ngizibonge kanye nefa lakho.
Thina nokhokho bethu sonile, senze okubi, sikhohlakele.
Okhokho bethu beseseGibhithe abaziqondanga izibonakaliso zakho, ababukhumbulanga ubuningi bezenzo zakho zomusa, bakuhlubuka bengasolwandle, oLwandle Lomhlanga.
Nokho wabasindisa ngenxa yegama lakhe, ukuze abonakalise amandla akhe.
Wakhuza uLwandle Lomhlanga, lwasha, wabaholela ekujuleni njengasehlane.
Wabasindisa esandleni sababazondayo, wabakhulula esandleni sesitha.
Amanzi azisibekela izitha zabo, akwaze kwasala nesisodwa kuzo.
Base bewakholwa amazwi akhe, bahlabelela ngodumo lwakhe.
Kepha basheshe bayikhohlwa imisebenzi yakhe, ababe besasilandela iseluleko sakhe.
Baba nenkwankwa nokuhaha ehlane, bamlinga uNkulunkulu kwahlongasibi.
Wabanika abakufisayo, kodwa wabathumela ngesifo esincunzayo.
Baba nomona ngoMose ekamu, nango-Aroni ongcwele kaSimakade.
Umhlaba wavuleka, wamgwinya uDathani, wagqiba iviyo lika-Abhiramu.
Iviyo labo lathungelwa ngomlilo, ilangabi labashisa labaqeda ababi.
Babumba ithole eHorebhe, bakhuleka kuso isithombe esibunjiweyo.
Baguqula inkazimulo kaNkulunkulu, bayifanisa nenkabi edla utshani.
Bakhohlwa nguNkulunkulu, uMsindisi wabo, owayenze izinto ezinkulu eGibhithe,
izimangaliso ezweni lika-Hamu, nokwesabekayo ngasoLwandle Lomhlanga.
Wayesethe uzobabhubhisa, ukuba uMose okhethiweyo wakhe, akemanga phambi kwakhe wabakhulumela, ukuze adambise intukuthelo yakhe, funa ababhubhise.
Badelela izwe elihle, babengakholwa yizwi lakhe.
Bakhononda besemathendeni abo; abaze balihlonipha izwi likaSimakade.
Ngakho-ke waphakamisa isandla sakhe, wafunga kubo ukuthi uzobabhubhisa ehlane,
izizukulwane zabo azisakaze phakathi kwabezizwe, abahlakazele emazweni.
Bazihlanganisa noBhali Pheyori, badla okuhlatshelwe abafileyo.
Bamchukuluza ngezenzo zabo, kwaqubuka ubhubhane phakathi kwabo.
UFinehasi wasukuma, wabanxusela, lwase luphela ubhubhane,
lokho kwase kubalelwa kuye kuba ngukulunga ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane kuze kube phakade.
Bamthukuthelisa uSimakade bengasemanzini eMeribha, lokho kwaba kubi kuMose ngenxa yabo.
Ngokuba bawukhuba umoya wakhe, waze wakhuluma amagama aqinile.
Abazibhubhisanga izizwe njengalokhu uSimakade ayebayalile,
bazihlanganisa nabezizwe, bafunda ukugila imikhuba yabo.
Bakhonza izithombe ezibaziweyo zabezizwe, ezaphenduka zaba wugibe kubo.
Amadodana namadodakazi abo bawahlabela amademoni.
Bachitha igazi elingenacala, igazi lamadodana abo namadodakazi abo, abawahlabela izithombe zaseKhanani; izwe langcoliswa yigazi.
Ngenxa yezenzo zabo baba ngabangcolileyo, baphinga ngezenzo zabo.
Intukuthelo kaSimakade yabavuthela abantu bakhe, ifa lakhe laba yisinengiso kuye.

Uma abantwana bakho besigcina isivumelwano sami nobufakazi bami engiyobafundisa bona, impela abantwana babo bayohlala esihlalweni sakho kuze kube phakade.”
USimakade uqoke iZiyoni, ulithandile ukuba libe yindawo yakhe yokuhlala, wathi:
“Nansi indawo yami yokuphumula kuze kube phakade, ngizohlala kuyo, ngokuba yiMina engiyithandile.
Ngiyakubusisa kakhulu ukudla kwalo, abantulayo ngiyakubasuthisa ngesinkwa.
Abaphristi ngiyobembesa insindiso, abethembekileyo bayohlokoma ngenjabulo.
“Ngiyakuhlumisa uphondo lukaDavide, ogcotshiweyo wami ngimlungisele isibani.
Izitha zalo ngiyozithela ngehlazo, kepha kuye, umqhele wakhe uyokhazimula.”
Bheka, kuhle, kumnandi kangaka ukuba abazalwane bahlalisane ndawonye bemunye.
Kufana namafutha amahle ekhanda, ehlela esilevini, isilevu sika-Aroni, ehlela nasemphethweni wezembatho zakhe.
Kufana namazolo eHermoni ehlela ezintabeni iZiyoni. Ngokuba uSimakade wayaleza khona isibusiso, ukuphila kuze kube phakade.
Bhekani, bongani uSimakade nina nonke zinceku zakhe, enimi endlini kaSimakade ebusuku.
Phakamiselani izandla zenu ngasendaweni engcwele, nibonge uSimakade.
USimakade makakubusise eseZiyoni, Yena owenze izulu nomhlaba.
Haleluya! Dumisani igama likaSimakade; mdumiseni nina zinceku zikaSimakade,
enikhonza endlini yakhe, emagcekeni endlu kaNkulunkulu wethu.
Mdumiseni uSimakade, ngokuba Yena muhle, lihubeleni igama lakhe, ngokuba lihle.
Ngokuba uSimakade uziqokele uJakobe no-Israyeli, ukuba abe yifa lakhe.
Impela ngiyazi ukuthi uSimakade mkhulu, nokuthi iNkosi yethu ingaphezu konkulunkulu bonke.
Noma yini uSimakade ayithandayo uyayenza, ezulwini nasemhlabeni, emanzini nasezinzulwini zonke.
Ukhuphula izinkungu emikhawulweni yomhlaba, enze imibani ibe yimvula, akhiphe umoya ezinqabeni zakhe.
Washaya amazibulo aseGibhithe, awabantu nawezilwane.
Wathumela izibonakaliso nezimangaliso phakathi kwakho, Gibhithe, phezu kukaFaro nezinceku zakhe zonke.
Washaya izizwe ezinkulu, wabulala amakhosi anamandla:
uSihoni, inkosi yama-Amori, u-Ogi, inkosi yaseBhashani, nemibuso yonke eKhanani.
Wathatha izwe labo laba yifa, laba yifa lika-Israyeli, isizwe sakhe.
Simakade, igama lakho limi ingunaphakade. Simakade, ukhunjulwa yizizukulwane ngezizukulwane.
Ngokuba uSimakade uyokwehlulela abantu bakhe, azihawukele izinceku zakhe.
Izithombe zabezizwe ziyisiliva negolide, umsebenzi wezandla zomuntu.
Umlomo zinawo, kepha azikhulumi, amehlo zinawo, kodwa aziboni.
Izindlebe zinazo, kepha azizwa, nomoya awukho emlonyeni wazo.
Abazenzayo bayafana nazo, bonke abazithembayo.
Wena ndlu ka-Israyeli, mbonge uSimakade, wena ndlu ka-Aroni, mbonge uSimakade.
Wena ndlu kaLevi, mbonge uSimakade, nina enimesabayo uSimakade, mbongeni uSimakade.
USimakade makabongwe eZiyoni, yena owakhe eJerusalema. Haleluya!
Bongani uSimakade, ngokuba muhle, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.
Bongani uNkulunkulu wonkulunkulu, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.
Bongani iNkosi yamakhosi, ngokuba umusa wayo umi phakade;
yona yodwa eyenza izimangaliso ezinkulu, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
owenze izulu ngokuhlakanipha, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
owendlale umhlaba phezu kwamanzi, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
owenza izinkanyiso ezinkulu, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
ilanga ukuba libuse emini, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
inyanga nezinkanyezi ukuba kubuse ebusuku, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
owabulala amazibulo abaseGibhithe, amazibulo alo, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
owamkhipha u-Israyeli phakathi kwabo, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade,
ngesandla esinamandla nangezikhwepha, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
owehlukanisa kabili uLwandle Lomhlanga, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
owawelisa u-Israyeli phakathi kwalo, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
owachitha uFaro nempi yakhe oLwandle Lomhlanga, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
owahola abantu bakhe ehlane, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
owashaya amakhosi amakhulu, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
owabulala amakhosi adumileyo, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade:
uSihoni, inkosi yama-Amori, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade,
no-Ogi, inkosi yaseBhashani, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
owabapha izwe labo laba yifa, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade,
laba yifa lika-Israyeli, inceku yakhe, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
owasikhumbula sinqotshwe yizitha zethu, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
owasikhulula ezitheni zethu, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
opha bonke abantu ukudla, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.
Bongani uNkulunkulu wezulu, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.
Ngasemifuleni eBhabhele sahlala khona, sakhala, lapho sikhumbula iZiyoni.
Amahabhu ethu sawaphanyeka eminyezaneni eyayilapho.
Ngokuba ababesithumbile bacela ukuba sihlabelele ihubo, nabahluphi bethu bafuna ukujatshuliswa, bethi: “Sihlabeleleleni amanye amahubo aseZiyoni.”
Siyakulihlabelela kanjani ihubo likaSimakade sikwelinye izwe na?
Uma ngikhohlwa wena Jerusalema, isandla sami sokunene masikhohlwe ubuciko baso.
Ulimi lwami malunamathele olwangeni lwami, uma ngingakukhumbuli, uma ngingaphakamisi iJerusalema phezu kwentokozo yami enkulu.
Khumbula, Simakade, usuku lweJerusalema, ngenxa yabakwa-Edomi, abathi: “Dilizani, dilizani, kuze kube sesisekelweni salo.”
Ndodakazi yaseBhabhele, wena oyobhujiswa, ubusisiwe oyophindisela kuwe ngezenzo zakho owazenza kithina.
Ubusisiwe obamba izingane zakho aziphahlaze edwaleni.
Ngiyokubonga ngenhliziyo yami yonke, ngikuhubele phambi konkulunkulu.
Ngiyakukhuleka phambi kwethempeli lakho elingcwele, ngibonge iGama lakho, ngenxa yomusa wakho neqiniso lakho, ngokuba phezu kwakho konke, uphakamisile iGama lakho nezwi lakho.
Ngosuku engakhala ngalo, wangiphendula; waqinisa umoya wami, ngaba namandla.
Wonke amakhosi omhlaba mawakubonge, Simakade, ngokuba ezwile amazwi omlomo wakho.
Mawahlabelele ngezindlela zikaSimakade, ngokuba inkulu inkazimulo kaSimakade.
Nakuba uSimakade ephakeme, uyamnakekela ophansi; ozidlayo umazi ekude.
Noma ngihamba ngikhungethwe ukuhlupheka, uyongilondoloza, uyokwelula isandla sakho ungivikele olakeni lwezitha zami, esokunene sakho singisindise.
USimakade uzoyifeza injongo yakhe ngami. Simakade, umusa wakho umi phakade, ungayishiyi imisebenzi yezandla zakho.
Wena Simakade ungihlolisisile, uyangazi.
Uyakwazi ukuhlala kwami nokuma kwami, uqonda umcabango wami ukude.
Uhlola ukuhamba kwami nokulala kwami, uzazi zonke izindlela zami.
Ngaphambi kokuba ngiphimise izwi ngomlomo wami, Wena Simakade usuke usukwazi konke.
Ungizungeze ngemuva nangaphambili, wabeka isandla sakho phezu kwami.
Ukwazi okunjalo kuyangimangalisa, kuphakeme, anginakufinyelela kukho.
Ngiyakuya kuphi, ngisuke eMoyeni wakho na? Ngiyakubalekelaphi, ngisuke phambi kwakho na?
Uma ngikhuphukela ezulwini, Wena ulapho; uma ngendlala icansi lami endaweni yabafileyo, nangu Wena.
Uma ngithatha amaphiko okusa, ngiye ngihlale emikhawulweni yolwandle,
nalapho isandla sakho siyakungihola, esokunene sakho singibambe.
Uma bengithi: “Ubumnyama mabungehlele, ukukhanya kube ngubusuku kimi,”
ubumnyama bebungayukuba ngubumnyama kuwe, ngokuba ubusuku bebuyakukhanya njengemini, ubumnyama bufane nokukhanya.
NguWena owenza izinso zami, wangiphica ngisesesibelethweni sikamame.
Ngiyakukubonga ngokuba ngenziwa ngokwesabekayo nangokumangalisayo; imisebenzi yakho iyamangalisa, umphefumulo wami ukwazi kahle.
Amathambo ami ayengafihlekile kuwe lapho ngenziwa ekusithekeni, ngibunjwa ezindaweni ezijulileyo zomhlaba.
Amehlo akho angibona ngiseyihlule, zonke izinsuku zami zalotshwa encwadini yakho, zanqunywa, lungakafiki nolulodwa kuzo.
Imicabango yakho, Nkulunkulu, ingamagugu kimi; bukhulu kangaka ubuningi bayo.
Uma bengiyakuyibala, miningi kunesihlabathi; lapho ngivuka, bengiyakuba nawe.
Sengathi ungazibulala izikhohlakali, Nkulunkulu, ngalokho-ke sukani kimi, nina bachithi begazi.
Izitha zakho zikhuluma kabi ngawe, zihlambalaza igama lakho.
Simakade, kanti angibazondi yini abakuzondayo na? Anginengwa yini ngabakuvukelayo na?
Ngiyabazonda ngenzondo epheleleyo, bayizitha kimi.
Ngihlole, Nkulunkulu, uyazi inhliziyo yami; ngilinge, uyazi imicabango yami,
ubone ukuthi kukhona yini okubi ngaphakathi kwami, ungiholele endleleni yaphakade.
Simakade, ngikhulule kumuntu omubi, ungivikele kumuntu oyisidlova.
Baceba okubi emiqondweni yabo, njalo baphehla udweshu.
Ulimi lwabo balulola lukhaliphe njengolwenyoka, isihlungu samabululu siphansi kwezindebe zabo.
Ngivikele ezandleni zomubi, ungilonde kumuntu oyisidlova, oceba ukukhubekisa izinyawo zami.
Abazidlayo bangithukusele ugibe, ngezintambo bendlala inetha, eceleni kwendlela, bangibekela izihibe.
Ngathi kuSimakade: “Wena, unguNkulunkulu wami.” Simakade, yizwa izwi lokunxusa kwami.
Simakade, Nkosi yami, mandla ensindiso yami, uvikela ikhanda lami ngosuku lwempi.
Simakade, ungazivumeli izifiso zezikhohlakali, ungawaphumelelisi amacebo azo, funa zizikhukhumeze.
Abangibunganyele mabasibekelwe ngububi bomlomo wabo.
Amalahle ashisayo mawawele phezu kwabo, mabaphonswe emlilweni nasemigodini ejulileyo, bangabe besavuka.
Umuntu ohlebayo makangavunyelwa asimame emhlabeni, ububi mabusilandele isidlova, sibhujiswe.
Ngiyazi ukuthi uSimakade uyabamela abahluphekayo, abehlulele ngobulungiswa abampofu.
Impela abalungileyo bayolibonga iGama lakho; abaqotho bayohlala phambi kwakho.
Simakade, ngikhala kuwe, phuthuma uze kimi, lalela izwi lami lapho ngikhuleka kuwe.
Umkhuleko wami mawufane nempepho phambi kwakho, nokuphakanyiswa kwezandla zami, njengomnikelo wakusihlwa.
Simakade, bekela umlomo wami umlindi, ugcine umnyango wezindebe zami.
Ungayiphenduleli inhliziyo yami entweni embi ukuba ngenze imisebenzi yenkohlakalo kanye nabantu abenza inkohlakalo, ngingadli izibiliboco zabo.
Olungileyo makangishaye, kungumusa kimi; angisole, kungamafutha ekhanda; ikhanda lami malingawenqabi, ngokuba umkhuleko wami umelane nobubi babo.
Abehluleli babo bayakuphonswa eweni; bayakuzwa ukuthi amazwi ami amnandi.
Njengalokhu umuntu elima, eklaya umhlabathi, amathambo ethu ahlakazekile ngasemlonyeni wendawo yabafileyo.
Amehlo ami akuwe Simakade, Nkosi yami, mina ngiphephela kuwe, uze ungangishiyi ngingenamvikeli.
Ngihlenge ogibeni abangicuphe ngalo, nasezihibeni zabenza okubi.
Ababi mabawele emanetheni abo, mina ngidlule kuwo.
Ngezwi lami ngikhala kuSimakade, ngezwi lami nginxusa uSimakade.
Isikhalo sami ngisithulula phambi kwakhe, ngimtshela ngenhlupheko yami.
Lapho umphefumulo wami udangala, Wena uyayazi indlela yami, endleleni engihamba ngayo, bangithukusele ugibe.
Bheka ngakwesokunene sami, uyabona, akukho namunye onginakekelayo, angisenasiphephelo, akekho osawukhathalela umphefumulo wami.
Ngikhala kuwe Simakade, ngithi: “Wena uyisiphephelo sami nesabelo sami ezweni labaphilayo.”
Kulalele ukukhala kwami, ngokuba ngicindezeleke kakhulu, ungihlenge kwabangizingelayo, ngoba banamandla kunami.
Umphefumulo wami ukhulule ejele, ukuze ngibonge iGama lakho. Abalungileyo bayongizungeza, ngoba uzongiphatha kahle.
Simakade, yizwa umkhuleko wami, ubeke indlebe yakho ekunxuseni kwami. ungiphendule ngokwethembeka kwakho nangokulunga kwakho.
Ungayethwesi cala inceku yakho, ngokuba akukho namunye ophilayo olungile phambi kwakho.
Isitha sizingela umphefumulo wami, impilo yami siyigandaya emhlabathini, singenze ngahlala ebumnyameni njengalabo abafa kudala.
Umoya wami udikibele, inhliziyo yami idangele.
Ngiyazikhumbula izinsuku zasendulo, ngizindla ngemisebenzi yakho yonke, ngicabange ngezenzo zezandla zakho.
Izandla zami ngizelulela kuwe, umphefumulo wami womela Wena njengomhlaba owomileyo.
Simakade, shesha ungiphendule, umphefumulo wami udangele, ungangifihleli ubuso bakho, funa ngifane nabashona egodini.
Mangizwe ububele bakho ekuseni, ngokuba ngethembela kuwe; ngazise indlela engifanele ukuhamba ngayo, ngokuba umphefumulo wami ngiwuphakamisela kuwe.
Ngihlenge ezitheni zami, Simakade, ngicashe kuwe.
Ngifundise ukwenza intando yakho, ngokuba Wena unguNkulunkulu wami, uMoya wakho omuhle mawungihole emhlabathini ohlelembekile.
Simakade, ngiphilise ngenxa yegama lakho, ngokulunga kwakho uwukhiphe umphefumulo wami ekuhluphekeni.
Ngomusa wakho uzishabalalise izitha zami, ubabhubhise bonke abahlupha umphefumulo wami, ngokuba ngiyinceku yakho.
Makabongwe uSimakade, idwala lami, ofundisa izandla zami ukuhlasela, neminwe yami, ukulwa,
umusa wami nenqaba yami, umbhoshongo wami ophakemeyo nomkhululi wami, isihlangu sami, nengiphephela kuye, nothobisa izizwe phansi kwami.
Simakade, uyini umuntu ukuba umazi, nendodana yomuntu ukuba uyikhumbule na?
Umuntu ufana nomoya; izinsuku zakhe zinjengethunzi elidlulayo.
Thobisa amazulu akho, Simakade, wehle, thinta izintaba, zithunqe.
Imibani mayinyazime, ubahlakaze, thumela imicibisholo yakho, ubaphithizise.
Yelulela isandla sakho phezulu, ungikhulule, ungihlenge emanzini amaningi, nasesandleni sabafokazi
abamlomo wabo ukhuluma inkohliso, nesandla sabo sokunene singesokunene samanga.
Ngiyakuhlabelela kuwe Nkulunkulu isihlabelelo esisha, ngogubhu olunezintambo ezilishumi, ngiyakukuhubela.
Nguye opha amakhosi insindiso, osindisa inceku yakhe, uDavide, enkembeni yababi.
Ngikhulule, ungihlenge esandleni sabafokazi abamlomo wabo ukhuluma inkohliso, nesandla sabo sokunene singesokunene samanga.
Makuthi amadodana ethu, ebusheni bawo, afane nezithombo ezikhule kahle, amadodakazi ethu afane nezinsika zamakhona eziqoshelwe ukwakha isigodlo.
Kwangathi izinqolobane zethu zingaphuphuma isivuno esehlukahlukene, izimvu zethu zande ngezinkulungwane, izinkulungwane ezilishumi emadlelweni akithi.
Sengathi izinkomo zethu zingaba namathole amaningi. Makungabi bikho kufohla ogangeni, kungathunjwa muntu, futhi kungabi bikho ukukhala emigwaqweni yakithi.
Babusisiwe abantu abayokwehlelwa yizibusiso ezinjalo, babusisiwe abantu abaNkulunkulu wabo unguSimakade.
Ngiyakuphakamisa Wena Nkulunkulu wami, Nkosi, ngilituse igama lakho phakade naphakade.
Imihla yonke ngiyakukubonga, ngilidumise igama lakho phakade naphakade.
USimakade mkhulu, umelwe ukudunyiswa kakhulu, ubukhulu bakhe abuqondakali.
Isizukulwane siyakuyibabaza kwesinye imisebenzi yakho, simemezele izenzo zakho zamandla.
Ngiyakuzindla ngenkazimulo nodumo lobukhosi bakho nangezimangaliso zakho.
Abantu bayakukhuluma ngamandla ezenzo zakho ezesabekayo, ubukhulu bakho ngiyakubumemezela.
Bayakugubha umkhosi bekhumbula ubuhle bakho obukhulu, bahube ngokulunga kwakho.
USimakade unobubele nobumnene, uyephuza ukuthukuthela, unomusa omkhulu.
USimakade muhle kubo bonke, uyayihawukela imisebenzi yakhe yonke.
Yonke imisebenzi yakho iyakukudumisa, abathembekileyo bakho bakubonge.
Bayokhuluma ngenkazimulo yombuso wakho,
ukuze babazise abantwana babantu izenzo zakho zamandla nenkazimulo yobukhosi bombuso wakho.
Umbuso wakho ungumbuso kuze kube phakade, ubukhosi bakho busezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.
USimakade uyabaphasa bonke abawayo, abaphakamise bonke abathotshisiweyo.
Amehlo abo bonke alinda Wena; uyabanika ukudla ngesikhathi esiyiso.
Uyavula isandla sakho, usuthise ukufisa kwakho konke okuphilayo.
USimakade ulungile ezindleleni zakhe zonke, unomusa emisebenzini yakhe yonke.
USimakade useduze nabo bonke abambizayo, bonke abambiza ngeqiniso.
Usuthisa ukufisa kwabamesabeyo, uyakuzwa ukukhala kwabo, abasindise.
USimakade uyabavikela abamthandayo, kodwa zonke izikhohlakali uyozibhubhisa.
Umlomo wami uyokhuluma ngodumo lukaSimakade, abantu bonke babonge igama lakhe elingcwele kuze kube phakade.
Haleluya! Dumisa uSimakade, mphefumulo wami.
Ngisaphila ngizomdumisa uSimakade, ngihube kuNkulunkulu wami ngisadla anhlamvana.
Ningathembeli ezikhulwini nasemadodaneni abantu, eningeke nathola lusizo kubo.
Umoya wakhe uyaphuma, yena abuyele emhlabathini wakhe, ngalo lolo suku amacebo akhe ayaphela.
Ubusisiwe lowo omsizi wakhe kunguNkulunkulu kaJakobe, othemba lakhe likuSimakade uNkulunkulu wakhe,
owenze izulu nomhlaba, nolwandle, nakho konke okukulo, ogcina iqiniso kuze kube phakade.
Obenzela ubulungiswa abacindezelweyo, opha abalambileyo ukudla, uSimakade uyazikhulula iziboshwa.
USimakade uyawavula amehlo ezimpumputhe, zibone. USimakade uyabavusa abathotshisiweyo. USimakade uyabathanda abalungileyo.
USimakade uyabavikela abafokazi, asize intandane nomfelokazi, kodwa abhuntshise indlela yezikhohlakali.
USimakade ubusa kuze kube phakade, uNkulunkulu wakho, wena Ziyoni, izizukulwane ngezizukulwane. Haleluya!
Haleluya! Kumnandi kakhulu ukuhlabelelela uNkulunkulu wethu, ngokuba unomusa, indumiso imfanele.
USimakade wakha iJerusalema, uqoqa abakwa-Israyeli ababexoshiwe.
Welapha abanhliziyo zephukile, abophe izilonda zabo.
Ubala inani lezinkanyezi, azibize zonke ngamagama.
INkosi yethu inkulu, makhulu amandla ayo; ukuqonda kwayo akunakulinganiswa.
USimakade uyabaphakamisa abathobekileyo, izikhohlakali uziqumba phansi.
Hubelani uSimakade ngokubonga, nimdumise uNkulunkulu wethu ngehabhu,
osibekela izulu ngamafu, olungisela umhlaba imvula, ohlumisa utshani ezintabeni.
Unika izinkomo ukudla kwazo, namazinyane egwababa akhalayo.
Akathokozi ngamandla ehhashi, akajatshuliswa yijubane lomuntu.
USimakade ujatshuliswa ngabamesabayo, labo abathembela emuseni wakhe.
Jerusalema, mbabaze uSimakade, Ziyoni, mdumise uNkulunkulu wakho,
ngokuba imigoqo yamasango uyiqinisile, ubabusisile abantwana bakho ngaphakathi kwakho.
Wenza kube nokuthula emingceleni yakho, akusuthise ngokolo.
Uthumela umyalo wakhe emhlabeni, izwi lakhe ligijima ngesikhulu isivinini.
Wendlala iqhwa njengoboya, asakaze isithwathwa njengomlotha.
Wehlisa isichotho njengezinhlamvu; ngubani ongema phambi kwamakhaza akhe na?
Usho ngezwi, kuncibilike; wenza umoya uphephethe, amanzi ageleze.
Uzwakalisa izwi lakhe kuJakobe, izimiso zakhe nezehlulelo zakhe, ku-Israyeli.
Asikho isizwe ake wenza kanjalo kuso, azizazi izehlulelo zakhe. Haleluya!
Haleluya! Dumisani uSimakade ezulwini, nimdumise kweliphezulu.
Mdumiseni nina zingelosi zakhe zonke, nimdumise nina mabandla akhe wonke.
Mdumiseni nina langa nenyanga, nimdumise nina zinkanyezi zonke ezikhanyayo.
Mdumiseni nina mazulu amazulu, nina manzi aphezu kwezulu.
Konke makudumise igama likaSimakade, ngokuba nguYena owayaleza, kwadaleka.
Wakumisa kwaze kwaba phakade naphakade, wakushayela umthetho okungenakuweqa.
Mdumiseni uSimakade emhlabeni nina mikhomo nezintwa zonke,
nawe mlilo nesichotho, liqhwa nenkwezane, nawe siphepho esenza okwezwi lakhe,
nani zintaba namagquma wonke, nani mithi ethelayo, nayo yonke imisedari,
nani zilwane nemfuyo yonke, nani eninwabuzelayo nezinyoni ezindizayo,
nani makhosi omhlaba nabantu bonke, nani zikhulu nabehluleli bonke bomhlaba,
nani zinsizwa nezintombi, nani maxhegu nabafana.
Manidumise igama likaSimakade, ngokuba ngelakhe lodwa igama eliphakemeyo, inkazimulo yakhe iphezu komhlaba nezulu.
Useluphakamisile udumo lwabantu bakhe, ngalokho-ke abethembekileyo bakhe bayamdumisa, abantu bakwa-Israyeli; abantu abaseduze naye. Haleluya!
Haleluya! Hubelani uSimakade ihubo elisha, izibongo zakhe, emhlanganweni wabathembekileyo.
U-Israyeli makathokoze ngoMenzi wakhe, abantwana baseZiyoni bethabele iNkosi yabo.
Mabadumise igama lakhe ngokusina, bamhubele ngesigubhu nehabhu,
ngokuba uSimakade uyathokoza ngabantu bakhe abathobekileyo, ubahlobisa ngensindiso.
Abathembekileyo mabathokoze ngokunqoba, mabahlabelele ngentokozo.
Ukuphakamisa uNkulunkulu makube semilonyeni yabo, baphathe ngesandla inkemba ekhaliphe nhlangothi zombili,
ukuze baziphindiselele ezizweni, bajezise abezizwe.
Amakhosi abo bawabophe ngamaketanga, nabadumileyo babo, ngezibopho zensimbi,
ukuze babajezise ngesijeziso esilotshiweyo. Kuludumo kubo bonke abathembekileyo bakhe. Haleluya!
Haleluya! Dumisani uNkulunkulu endlini yakhe engcwele, nimdumise emkhathini wakhe wamandla.
Mdumiseni ngenxa yezenzo zakhe zamandla, nimdumise ngenxa yobukhosi bakhe obukhulu.
Mdumiseni ngezwi lecilongo, nimdumise ngogubhu nehabhu.
Mdumiseni ngesigubhu nokusina, nimdumise ngezigubhu ezinezintambo ezilishumi, nemitshingo.
Mdumiseni ngamasimbali ancencethayo, nimdumise ngezinsimbi ezikhencezayo.
Konke okuphefumulayo makudumise uSimakade. Haleluya!
Lezi yizaga zikaSolomoni, indodana kaDavide, inkosi yakwa-Israyeli.
Ngezokufunda ukuthi kuyini ukuhlakanipha, nokufundisa ukuqonda amazwi ajulile,
ukuthola ingqondo ekhanyiselwe, ubulungiswa nobuqotho.
Zibanika ubuhlakani abangenakuqonda, ulwazi nokuqaphela kwabasha,
ukunikeza ukuqonda izaga nezisho ezifihlakele, izisho zabahlakaniphe kakhulu neziphicaphicwano zabo,
ukuze aqonde izaga, nemizekeliso, namazwi ezihlakaniphi.
Ukumesaba uSimakade kuyisiqalo sobuhlakani. Iziwula ziyakwedelela ukuhlakanipha nokuyalwa.
Ndodana yami, lalela ukuqondisa kukayihlo, ungayedeleli imfundiso kanyoko,
iyoba ngumqhele wobuhle ekhanda lakho, nomgexo entanyeni yakho.
Ndodana yami, uma izoni zikuyenga, ungavumi,
uma zithi kuwe: “Woza, hamba nathi ukuze sibalalele unyendle, ngaphandle kwesizathu, sichithe igazi labangenacala!
Masibagwinye bezwa okwendawo yakwalasha, sibaphonse egodini bephila.
Siyozitholela yonke ingcebo eyigugu, sigcwalise izindlu zethu ngempango,
senze unkatho phakathi kwethu, sabelane sonke sikhwameni sinye!”
Ndodana yami, ungazibandakanyi nabo, ungalubhadi unyawo lwakho ezindleleni zabo,
ngoba izinyawo zabo zigijimela ebubini, bayashesha ukuchitha igazi.
Ngokuba balendlalele ize inetha labo, ukucupha ugibe izinyoni zonke zibuka.
Laba baqamekela elabo igazi, balala unyendle belalela impilo yabo.
Zinjalo izindlela zabo bonke abathola inzuzo ngokungafanele; leyo nzuzo iyakuthatha impilo yomniniyo.
Ukuhlakanipha kuyampongoloza emigwaqweni, kuyaqandula ezigcawini.
Kumemeza ezinkundleni nasemasangweni omuzi, kukhuluma kuthi:
“Kuyoze kube nini ziwula ndini nithanda ubuwula, nani zedeleli, nithokoziswa ngukweyisa, nani ziwula nizonda ulwazi na?
Buyani ngenxa yokusola kwami, lalelani, manginithululele okusemoyeni wami, nginazise amazwi ami.
Ngenxa yokuba ngimemezile, nenqaba, ngininike isandla sami, kodwa anizange ninake.
Anizinakanga zonke izeluleko zami, anikwemukelanga ukusola kwami.
Ngakho-ke nami ngiyonihleka usulu ngesikhathi nehlelwa yinhlekelele, nginiklolodele lapho senigcwele uvalo.
Lapho kufika isiphepho esibhubhisayo, nokwesaba kwenu sekufana nembubhiso, nenhlekelelo yenu ifika njengesivunguvungu, nalapho inhlupheko nosizi kunehlela,
khona bayakungibiza, kodwa angiyukuphendula; bayakungifunisisa, kodwa ngeke bangifumane,
ngenxa yokuba bazonde ulwazi, bakhetha ukungamesabi uSimakade.
Abasilalelanga iseluleko sami, bakudelela ukusola kwami.
Ngakho-ke bazokuvuna lokho abakutshalile, basuthiswe yizithelo zobuqili babo.
Ukweduka kwabangenamqondo kuyakubabulala, nokudembesela kweziwula kuyozibhubhisa.
Kodwa lowo ongilalelayo uyohlala ephephile, angabi naluvalo lokwehlelwa ngokubi.”
Ndodana yami, uma ulalela amazwi ami, ugcine imithetho yami,
wenze indlebe yakho ilalele ukuhlakanipha, nenhliziyo yakho ithambekele ekuqondeni;
uma ukhala ngokuhlaziya, ulizwakalisa izwi lakho ngokuqonda;
uma ukufuna njengesiliva ukufunisisa njengengcebo efihliweyo,
khona uyakuqonda ukuthi kuyini ukumesaba uSimakade, uthole ulwazi ngoNkulunkulu.
Ngokuba uSimakade uyokupha ukuhlakanipha, emlonyeni wakhe kuphuma ukwazi nokuqonda.
Uyabela abaqotho impumelelo, uyisihlangu salabo abahamba ngokwethembeka.
Uyabavikela labo abahamba ngokwendlela yezahlulelo zakhe,
khona uyoqonda ukulunga, nokwehlulela neqiniso, nezindlela zonke ezinhle.
Ngokuba ukuhlakanipha kuyongena enhliziyweni yakho, ukwazi kuthokozise umphefumulo wakho.
Amasu ayakukuvikela, ukuqonda kukugcine.
Ukuhlakanipha kuyokophula endleleni yokubi, nakulabo abakhuluma okuphambene,
abadela izindlela zobuqotho, bahambe ebumnyameni.
Abathokozela ukwenza okubi, bakikizelele okuphambeneyo,
abandlela zabo zigwegwile, nemikhondo yabo imazombezombe.
Lokhu kuyokusindisa kowesifazane ondindayo, nakowezizwe omazwi akhe ayashelela,
oshiya isithandwa sobusha bakhe, akhohlwe yisivumelwano noNkulunkulu wakhe.
Ngokuba indlu yakhe iholela ekufeni, nezindlela zakhe emathunzini.
Bonke abazisondeza kuye ababuyi, abafinyeleli emikhondweni yokuphila,
ukuze bahambe ezindleleni zabahle, bagcine izindlela zabalungileyo,
ngokuba abaqotho bayakuhlala ezweni, abamsulwa basale kulo.
Kepha izikhohlakali ziyakunqunywa ezweni, nabangethembekile bayosishulwa kulo.
Ndodana yami, ungawukhohlwa umthetho wami, kepha inhliziyo yakho mayilonde imiyalelo yami,
khona iyakwenezela kuwe izinsuku, neminyaka yokuphila nokuthula.
Ububele neqiniso makungakushiyi; kubophele entanyeni yakho, ukulobe esibhebheni senhliziyo yakho,
ukuze uthole umusa nodumo oluhle emehlweni kaNkulunkulu nabantu.
Thembela kuSimakade ngayo yonke inhliziyo yakho, unganciki kokwakho ukuqonda.
Mazise Yena ezindleleni zakho zonke, uyakuqondisa imikhondo yakho.
Ungazishayi ohlakaniphileyo emehlweni akho; mesabe uSimakade, uqhele ebubini.
Lokho kuyakuba yimpilo emzimbeni wakho, nokuhlunyelelwa kwamathambo akho.
Mhloniphe uSimakade ngempahla yakho, nangolibo lwazo zonke izithelo zakho,
ukuze izinqolobane zakho ziphuphume ngobuningi bomkhiqizo, nezikhamo zakho zichichime iwayini elisha.
Ndodana yami, ungakwedeleli ukuyala kukaSimakade, ungakwenyanyi ukusola kwakhe.
Ngokuba uSimakade uyamyala amthandayo, njengoyise eyala indodana ayithandayo.
Ubusisiwe umuntu othola ukuhlakanipha, nomuntu ozuza ukuqonda,
ngokuba inzuzo yakho yinhle kunenzuzo yesiliva; nenzuzo yakho kunegolide.
Ukuhlakanipha kuyigugu kunamarubhi, nakho konke okunxanelekayo akunakuqhathaniswa nakho.
Impilo ende isesandleni sakho sokunene, kwesokhohlo sakho kukhona ingcebo nodumo.
Izindlela zakho ziyizindlela zobumnandi; yonke imikhondo yakho ingukuthula.
Kungumuthi wokuphila kulabo abakubambayo, babusisiwe labo ababambelela baqine kukho.
USimakade wasekela umhlaba ngokuhlakanipha; wamisa amazulu ngokuqonda.
Ngokwazi kwakhe izinzulu zaqhekezwa, amafu aconsa amazolo.
Ndodana yami, makungasuki emehlweni akho, gcina ukuhlakanipha namasu,
kuyokuba ngukuphila emphefumulweni wakho, nomgexo entanyeni yakho.
Khona uyohamba endleleni yakho uphephile, unyawo lwakho lungaqhuzuki.
Uma ulala, awuyukwesaba lutho; nalapho usulele, uyoba nobuthongo obumnandi.
Awuyukwesaba inhlekelele ezumayo, nokubhujiswa okulethwa yizikhohlakali,
ngokuba uSimakade uyakuba seduze nawe, agcine unyawo lwakho ukuba lungabhajwa.
Ungabagodleli okuhle labo abakufanele, uma lokho kusemandleni akho ukuba ukwenze.
Ungathi kumakhelwane wakho: “Hamba, ubuye kusasa, ngiyokunika khona,” ube unakho lokho akufunayo.
Ungacebi okubi ngomakhelwane wakho, lapho ehlezi nawe elondekile.
Ungaphikisani namuntu ngeze uma engakonanga ngalutho.
Ungabi namhawu ngomuntu oyisidlova, ungakhethi neyodwa yezindlela zakhe,
ngokuba oyisigwegwe uyisinengiso kuSimakade, kepha abaqotho bayisifuba sakhe.
Isiqalekiso sikaSimakade sisendlini yezikhohlakali, kodwa uyalibusisa ikhaya labalungileyo.
Izedeleli uyazedelela, kepha abathobekileyo ubapha umusa.
Abahlakaniphileyo bayozuza udumo, kepha iziwula ziyothelwa ngehlazo.
Yizwani madodana ami, ukuyala kukayihlo, nilalelelisise, ukuze nazi ukuqonda.
Ngokuba ngininika imfundiso enhle; ningawushayi indiva umthetho wami.
Ngokuba ngangiyindodana kababa, ngintekentekana, futhi ngingedwa kumame,
wangifundisa, wathi, kimi: “Inhliziyo yakho mayibambelele emazwini ami, ugcine imiyalelo yami, uphile.
Zuza ukuhlakanipha, uzuze ukuqonda; ungakhohlwa, ungachezuki emazwini omlomo wami;
ungakushiyi, kuyakukugcina; kuthande, kuyakukulondoloza.
Ukuqala kokuhlakanipha yilokhu: zuza ukuhlakanipha; yebo, ngakho konke okutholileyo, zuza ukuqonda.
Kuhloniphe, kuyakukuphakamisa; kuyakukudumisa, lapho ukugona.
Kuyakukufaka umqhele womusa ekhanda lakho, kukunike umqhele wodumo.”
Yizwa ndodana yami, wemukele amazwi ami khona iminyaka yokuphila kwakho iyoba miningi.
Ngikufundisile indlela yokuhlakanipha, ngakuhola emikhondweni yobuqotho.
Lapho uhamba, izinyathelo zakho aziyukuthiywa yilutho, nalapho ugijima awuyukukhubeka.
Bambelela ekuyalweni, ungakuyeki; kulonde, ngokuba kungukuphila kwakho.
Ungalubhadi unyawo lwakho endleleni yezikhohlakali, ungahambi emkhondweni wababi.
Yigweme, ungahambi ngayo; chezuka kuyo,
Ngokuba abalali uma bengakwenzanga okubi; bayaqwasha uma bengakhubekisanga muntu;
kwazise badla isinkwa senkohlakalo, baphuze iwayini lobudlova.
Indlela yabalungileyo injengokukhanya kokusa okuqhubeka kukhanye kuze kube semini.
Indlela yezikhohlakali injengobumnyama; abazi nokuthi bakhutshwa yini.
Ndodana yami, lalela amazwi ami, ubeke indlebe yakho kukho ukukhuluma kwami.
Makungasuki emehlweni akho, ukugcine ekujuleni kwenhliziyo yakho,
ngokuba kungukuphila kwabakufumanayo, nempilo emzimbeni wonke.
Gcina inhliziyo yakho kukho konke okulondayo, ngokuba yona ingumthombo wokuphila.
Qhela ekukhulumeni okugwegwile, dedisela kude nawe izindebe ezonakele.
Amehlo akho mawabheke phambili, nezinkophe zakho ziqonde phambi kwakho.
Hlelemba indlela yezinyawo zakho ukuze ziphephe zonke izindlela zakho.
Ungaphambukeli kwesokunene nakwesokhohlo; dedisa unyawo lwakho kokubi.
Ndodana yami, lalela ukuhlakanipha kwami, ubeke indlebe yakho ekuqondeni kwami.
Amasu nokwazi makukugcine, khona kuyakulonda izindebe zakho.
Izindebe zowesifazane ondindayo ziconsa uju; umlomo wakhe ubushelelezi kunamafutha,
kodwa ekugcineni uyababa njengenhlaba, ubukhali njengenkemba ekhaliphe nhlangothi zombili.
Izinyawo zakhe zehlela ekufeni; izinyathelo zakhe zibheke endaweni yabafileyo.
Akayiqikeleli indlela yokuphila, funa ukwenza kwakhe kuguquke engazelele.
Ngakho-ke madodana ami, ngilaleleni, ningachezuki emazwini omlomo wami.
Dedisela kude naye indlela yakho, ungasondeli emnyango wendlu yakhe,
funa unikele ngodumo lwakho kwabanye, neminyaka yakho kwabanonya,
funa abafokazi badle basuthe ngamandla akho, kuthi umsebenzi wakho owukhandlekele uye endlini yomfokazi.
Uyobubula ekugcineni, lapho umzimba wakho nenyama yakho sekuphela,
uthi: “Yeka ukuzonda kwami ukuyalwa, nokwedelela kwenhliziyo yami ukusolwa!
Angililalelanga izwi labafundisi bami; angibekanga indlebe yami kubo ababengifundisa.
Ngacishe ngabhubha ngaphela phakathi kwebandla nasenhlanganweni.”
Phuza amanzi kowakho umthombokwakhiwa, amanzi agobhozayo esuka kowakho umthombo.
Ngabe imithombo yakho isisabalele yonke indawo, nemifula yamanzi ezigcawini na?
Mayibe ngeyakho wedwa nje kuphela, ingabi ngeyabafokazi abahlala phakathi kwakho.
Mawubusiswe umthombo wakho, uthokoze ngomfazi wobusha bakho.
Uyindluzelekazi ethandayo, negogokazi elihle; amabele akhe mawakwenelise njalo, uhlale ugajwe uthando lwakhe.
Ndodana yami, yini ekwenza uhlanyiswe ngumfazi ondindayo, ugone umfazi ongamazi esifubeni na?
Ngokuba izindlela zomuntu ziphambi kwamehlo kaSimakade; uyayilinganisa yonke imikhondo yakhe.
Isikhohlakali siyakubhajwa ekukhohlakaleni kwaso, sibhajwe yizintambo zesono saso.
Siyakufa ngenxa yokweswela ukuyalwa, nangenxa yobukhulu bobuwula baso, siyoduka.
Ndodana yami, uma ube yisibambiso somakhelwane wakho, naze naxhawulana nomfokazi;
usubanjwe ngamazwi akho, wabhajwa ngenxa yalokho okushilo.
Ngakho-ke yenza lokhu, ndodana yami, ukuze uzikhulule, ngokuba usuphila phansi kwesandla sikamakhelwane wakho: khothama phambi kwakhe, umncengisise.
Amehlo akho ancishe ubuthongo, nezinkophe zakho, ukozela.
Zisindise njengensephe esandleni somzingeli, nanjengenyoni esandleni somcuphi.
Yana entuthwaneni, vilandini, ubone izindlela zayo, uhlakaniphe;
yona ethi ingenamholi, nambonisi, nambusi,
nokho ilungise ehlobo isinkwa sayo, ibuthe ukudla kwayo ngesikhathi sokuvuna.
Uyakulala kuze kube nini, vilandini? Uyakuvuka nini ebuthongweni bakho na?
Ngobuthongo nje obuncane, nokozela nje okuncane, ukusonga izandla kancane kuze kulalwe;
ubuphofu buyokwehlela njengomhambuma, ukuntula kukuhlasele njengendoda ehlomileyo.
Umuntu ongenamsebenzi walutho, umuntu wokona, uhamba ephafuza inkohliso;
ucifa iso, ashuduze ngezinyawo, aqhwebe ngeminwe;
njalo uceba okubi nenkohliso enhliziyweni yakhe, futhi uphehla udweshu.
Ngakho-ke uyokwehlelwa yinhlekelele engazelele; ngokuphazima kweso, uyobhubha angasindi.
Kukhona izinto eziyisithupha azizondayo uSimakade, yebo, eziyisikhombisa eziyisinengiso esikhulu emphefumulweni wakhe:
Ngamehlo azidlayo, ulimi lwamanga, izandla ezichitha igazi elingenacala;
inhliziyo eceba okubi, izinyawo ezishesha ukugijimela ebubini;
ufakazi ofakaza amanga ophafuza inkohliso, odala ingxabano kubafowabo.
Ndodana yami, gcina umyalo kayihlo, ungawushiyi umthetho kanyoko.
Yibophele njalo enhliziyweni yakho, uyithandele entanyeni yakho.
Mayikuhole ekuhambeni kwakho, ikulinde lapho ulele, ikhulume nawe lapho uvuka.
Ngokuba imiyalo iyisibani, nomthetho ungukukhanya, nokusola ngokuyala kuyindlela yokuphila,
ukuze uvikeleke kowesifazane okhohlakeleyo, nasekuthopheni kolimi lowesifazane ondindayo.
Ungabukhanuki ubuhle bakhe enhliziyweni yakho, angakubambi ngezinkophe zakhe.
Ngokuba owesifazane oyisiphingi ungamkhokhela ngeqebelengwane lesinkwa, kepha umfazi ophingayo womuntu, uzingela impilo eyigugu yendoda.
Umuntu angawubeka yini umlilo esifubeni sakhe, izingubo zakhe zingashi na?
Umuntu angahamba yini phezu kwamalahle avuthayo, izinyawo zakhe zingashi na?
Unjalo-ke olala nomfazi kamakhelwane wakhe: noma yimuphi omthintileyo uyakujeziswa.
Abamdeleli yini oyisela uma entshontsha ukuze azisuthise lapho elambile na?
Uma ebhadanyiwe, bamhlawulisa ngokuphindwe kasikhombisa, akhokhe ngayo yonke impahla yomuzi wakhe.
Ophinga nowesifazane akanakho ukuqonda; owenza lokho ubhubhisa impilo yakhe.
Uyakuthola imivimbo nokuphoxeka, ukwethukwa kwakhe akuyukwesulwa.
Ngokuba isikhwele sivusa ulaka endodeni yakhe, uma isiziphindiselela ngeke ibe nasihawu.
Ayiyukufuna nhlawulo; ayiyukukwemukela ukufunjathiswa.
Ndodana yami, gcina amazwi ami, uzilondele imiyalelo yami.
Gcina imiyalelo yami, uphile, nemfundiso yami, njengenhlamvu yeso lakho.
Kubophele eminweni yakho, ukulobe esibhebheni senhliziyo yakho.
Yisho kukho ukuhlakanipha uthi: “Wena ungudadewethu,” ubize ukuqonda, ukubize ngokuthi yisihlobo sakho,
ukuze kukuvikele kowesifazane ondindayo, nakowezizwe onamazwi athophayo.
Ngisefasiteleni lendlu yami, ngalunguza ngekhethini lami,
ngabona phakathi kwabangenalwazi, ngabona phakathi kwabasha insizwa engenakuqonda,
idlula emgwaqweni eduze negumbi lakhe, ibheke ngasendlini yakhe;
kwasekuhwelela kusihlwa, esigayegayeni sobusuku nobumnyama.
Bheka, owesifazane wamhlangabeza egqokise okwesifebe, ezembozile.
Uyaphishaphisheka akanakuthula; izinyawo zakhe azivumi ukuhlala endlini yakhe,
manje usesemigwaqweni, nanguya esesezigcawini, uyacutha emajikeni wonke.
Uyayibamba, uyayiqabula, engenamahloni, uthi kuyo:
“Namuhla ngiyenzile iminikelo yokuthula; ngazigcwalisa izithembiso zami.
Ngakho-ke ngiphumile ngizokuhlangabeza, ngizofuna ubuso bakho, manje sengikutholile.
Umbhede wami wendlalwe ngezindwangu zokwemboza, nelineni laseGibhithe elinemishu.
Umbhede wami ngiwufafaze ngemure, ngenhlaba nangekinamona.
Woza sizanelise ngothando kuze kuse; sijabule ngokuthandana.
Indoda yami ayikho ekhaya; ithathe uhambo olude.
Ithathe isikhwama semali ngesandla; iyoze ibuye ekhaya ngokudilingana kwenyanga.”
Uyiphambukisa ngamazwi akhe amaningi ahehayo; uyiyenga ngokuthopha kwezindebe zakhe.
Iyamlandela masinyane njengenkabi iya ekuhlatshweni nanjengenyamazane ingena esihibeni;
uze umcibisholo uhlabe esibindini sayo; isheshela ogibeni njengenyoni, ingazi ukuthi lubekelwe ukuphila kwayo.
Ngakho-ke bantwana, ngizweni, nilalele amazwi aphuma emlonyeni wami.
Inhliziyo yakho mayingaphambukeli ezindleleni zakhe, ungahambi emikhondweni yakhe.
Ubawisile abaningi, bafa; ubulele izindimbane.
Indlu yakhe iyindlela eqonde endaweni yabafileyo, eyehlela emakamelweni okufa.
Ukuhlakanipha akumemezi yini, nokuqonda akuvezi yini ilaka lakho na?
Kumi ezindaweni eziphakemeyo ngasendleleni, kwakhile ngaseziphambanweni zezindlela,
ngasekungeneni, emasangweni omuzi kuyamemeza, kuthi:
“Ngiyanibiza nina bantu; izwi lami liqondiswe kubantwana babantu.
Nina eningenalwazi qondani ukuhlakanipha; nani ziwula, yibani nenhliziyo eqondayo.
Lalelani izinto ezinkulu engizikhulumayo; amazwi aphuma ezindebeni zomlomo wami angubuqotho,
ngokuba umlomo wami uzakukhuluma iqiniso; ububi buyisinengiso ezindebeni zami.
Wonke amazwi avela emlonyeni wami angukulunga; akukho lutho kuwo okuyisigwegwe nokuphambeneyo.
Kumuntu oqondayo wonke aqondile, alungile kulowo othole ulwazi.
Yamukelani ukuyala kwami kunesiliva, nolwazi, kunegolide lekhethelo,
ngokuba ukuhlakanipha kuhle kunobucwebecwebe, akukho lutho olunye olufiswayo olungaqhathaniswa nakho.
Mina kuhlakanipha ngihlala ekuqondeni, ngithola ulwazi namasu.
Ukwesaba uSimakade kungukuzonda okubi. Ukuzikhukhumeza, ukuzidla, indlela embi, nomlomo ophoxayo, ngiyakuzonda.
Kimina kuneseluleko nokuhlakanipha, ngingukuqonda, namandla angawami.
Amakhosi abusa ngami, nababusi bashaya imithetho elungile ngami.
Izikhulu zibusa ngami, namakhosana, nabo bonke abehluleli bomhlaba.
Ngiyabathanda abangithandayo; nalabo abangifunisisayo, bayangifumana.
Ingcebo, udumo, nomnotho omningi nokulunga, kukimi.
Isithelo sami sihle kunegolide, kunegolide elicolisekileyo, nenzuzo yami, kunesiliva lekhethelo.
Ngihamba endleleni yokulunga, emikhondweni yobulungiswa,
labo abangithandayo ngibanika ifa, ngigcwalise izinqolobane zabo zengcebo.
“USimakade wangidala kuqala kunayo yonke imisebenzi yakhe; ngingowokuqala emisebenzini yakhe.
Wangimisa kwasemandulo, ekuqaleni, ngaphambi kokusekelwa komhlaba.
Zingakabi bikho izinzulu nemithombo egcwele amanzi, ngazalwa.
Zingakasekelwa izintaba nangaphambi kokuba amagquma abe khona, ngazalwa,
ngaphambi kokuba enze umhlaba namasimu, nohlamvu lokuqala lothuli lomhlaba.
Ngesikhathi ehlela amazulu ngangikhona; nalapho edweba isiyingi ezinzulwini otweni.
Lapho enza isibhakabhaka phezulu siqine, nangesikhathi imithombo yezinzulu iphuphuma ngamandla;
lapho emisela ulwandle umkhawulo, ukuze amanzi angeqi umyalo wakhe; lapho emisa izisekelo zomhlaba,
ngangiseduze kwakhe, ngiyingcweti yomsebenzi, ngiyintokozo yakhe imihla ngemihla, ngiyintokozo yakhe, ngidlala phambi kwakhe sonke isikhathi.
Ngajabula kuyo yonke indawo emhlabeni wakhe, intokozo yami yayikanye nabantwana babantu.
“Ngakho-ke bantwana, ngizweni, ngokuba babusisiwe abagcina izindlela zami.
Lalelani ukuyalwa, nenze ngokuhlakanipha; ningakushayi indiva.
Ubusisiwe umuntu ongilalelayo, alinde imihla ngemihla emasangweni ami, ahlale ngasezinsikeni zeminyango yami.
Ngokuba ongifunayo, ufumana ukuphila, azuze umusa kuSimakade.
Kodwa lowo owehluleka ukungifumana, uzigwaza ngowakhe; bonke abangizondayo bathanda ukufa.”
Ukuhlakanipha sekwakhe indlu yakho; kuzibazile izinsika zakho eziyisikhombisa.
Kuhlabe umhlatshelo, kwavubela iwayini lakho, kwadeka netafula lakho.
Kuthume izintombi zakho, kuyamemeza emagqumeni aphakemeyo omuzi, kuthi:
“Ongenalwazi makaphambukele lapha;” nakulowo ongenangqondo, kuthi kuye:
“Wozani nidle isinkwa sami, niphuze iwayini engilivubeleyo.
Shiyani izinto zobuwula, niphile, nihambe ngendlela yokuqonda.
“Osola isedeleli uzibangela ukwethukwa, nothethisa isikhohlakali uziholela ukulimala.
Ungasithethisi isedeleli, funa sikuzonde; sola ohlakaniphileyo, uyakukuthanda.
Yala ohlakaniphileyo, uzohlakanipha kakhulu; ufundise olungileyo, uzothuthuka ngokuqonda.
“Ukuqala kokuhlakanipha kungukumesaba uSimakade, nokumazi oNgcwele kungukuqonda.
Izinsuku zakho ziyokwanda ngami, kwenezelwe neminyaka yokuphila kwakho.
Uma uhlakaniphile, uzihlakaniphele; uma wedelela, uyakukuthwala wena wedwa.”
Owesifazane oyisiwula unomsindo, uyisiwula, akazi lutho.
Uhlala ngasemnyango wendlu yakhe, esihlalweni esisendaweni ephakemeyo yomuzi,
ukuze ameme abedlula ngendlela, abaqondile emikhondweni yabo, athi:
“Ongenalwazi makaphambukele ngapha;” kulowo ongenangqondo, uthi kuye:
“Amanzi okwebiwa amnandi, nesinkwa esidlelwa esithe siyenamisa.”
Kepha ophambukayo akazi ukuthi kukhona izithunzi lapho, nokuthi izimenywa zakhe zisendleleni eya kwelabafileyo.
Nazi izaga zikaSolomoni: Indodana ehlakaniphileyo iyamthokozisa uyise, kodwa eyisiwula, iwusizi kunina.
Ingcebo yenkohlakalo ayisizi ngalutho, kodwa ukuziphatha ngokulunga kukhulula ekufeni.
USimakade akavumi ukuba olungileyo alambe, kepha ababi ubayeka babulawe yindlala.
Isandla esidembeselayo siletha ubuphofu, kodwa esikhutheleyo siyacebisa.
Obutha ehlobo uyindodana ehlakaniphileyo; olele ubuthongo ngesikhathi sokuvuna uyindodana ehlazisayo.
Izibusiso zisekhanda lolungileyo, kodwa umlomo wezikhohlakali ufihla ubudlova.
Ukukhunjulwa kolungileyo kuyisibusiso, kepha igama lezikhohlakali liyakubola.
Ohlakaniphile ngenhliziyo uyayemukela imiyalelo, kodwa isiwula esiyiqhalaqhala, esiphafuza ubuwula, siyakubhujiswa.
Ohamba ngobuqotho uhamba evikelekile, kodwa ohlanekezela izindlela zakhe, uyodaluleka.
Ocifa iso udala usizi, kepha osola obala uletha ukuthula.
Umlomo wolungileyo ungumthombo wokuphila, kepha umlomo wezikhohlakali ufihla ubudlova.
Inzondo ibanga ingxabano, kodwa uthando lusibekela zonke iziphambeko.
Ezindebeni zalowo ocubungulayo kufunyanwa ukuhlakanipha, kepha uswazi lungolomhlane walowo ongenangqondo.
Ohlakaniphileyo uqongelela ulwazi, kodwa umlomo wesiwula uletha imbubhiso.
Ingcebo yocebileyo iyinqaba yakhe, kodwa ubuphofu babampofu bungukubhubha.
Umvuzo wolungileyo ungukuphila, kodwa inzuzo yezikhohlakali ingukujeziswa ngesono.
Oqaphela ukuyalwa usendleleni eya ekuphileni, kepha owenqaba ukusolwa uyaduka.
Ofihla inzondo unezindebe zamanga; odalula umbiko omubi uyisiwula.
Lapho kunokukhuluma okuningi akupheli ukona; othiba ulimi lwakhe uhlakaniphile.
Ulimi lolungileyo luyisiliva elikhethekileyo; inhliziyo yezikhohlakali iyinto engelutho.
Izindebe zolungileyo zondla abaningi, kepha iziwula ziyafa ngokuswela ingqondo.
Isibusiso sikaSimakade siyacebisa; akenezeleli usizi kuso.
Ukwenza inkohlakalo kufana nomdlalo esiwuleni, kanti umuntu ohlakaniphileyo uthokozela ukuqonda.
Akwesabayo omubi kuyamehlela, kodwa abakufisayo abalungileyo bayakuphiwa khona.
Lapho kwedlula isivunguvungu omubi usuke engasabonwa, kanti olungileyo uyisisekelo esingunaphakade.
Njengoviniga emazinyweni, nentuthu emehlweni, linjalo ivila kwabalithumileyo.
Ukwesaba uSimakade kwandisa izinsuku, kodwa iminyaka yezikhohlakali iyancishiswa.
Ithemba labalungileyo liyintokozo, kodwa ithemba lezikhohlakali liyashabalala.
Indlela kaSimakade iyinqaba koqotho, kodwa ukubhujiswa kumiselwe izikhohlakali.
Olungileyo akayukuzanyazanyiswa kuze kube phakade, kepha izikhohlakali aziyukuhlala ezweni.
Umlomo wolungileyo ukhuluma ukuhlakanipha, kodwa ulimi oluphambeneyo luyanqunywa.
Izindebe zolungileyo ziyakwazi okwamukelekileyo, kepha umlomo wezikhohlakali ukhuluma okuphambeneyo.
Isilinganiso esikhohlisayo siyisinengiso kuSimakade, kepha isisindo esiyiso siyintokozo kuye.
Lapho kuvela ukuziqhenya kulandela ihlazo, kodwa kwabathobekileyo kukhona ukuhlakanipha.
Ukwethembeka kwabaqotho kuyabahola, kepha ubugwegwe babambuluzayo buyababhubhisa.
Ingcebo ayisizi ngosuku lolaka, kodwa ukulunga kuyahlenga ekufeni.
Ukulunga komsulwa kuyayiqondisa indlela yakhe, kodwa isikhohlakali siyowiswa yinkohlakalo yaso.
Ukulunga kuyabasindisa abaqotho, kodwa abanobuqili bayobhajwa ezinkanukweni zabo.
Lapho omubi efa liyashabalala nethemba lakhe, nethemba lokwenza okubi liyashabalala.
Olungileyo uyakhululwa osizini, kodwa esikhundleni sakhe kungena isikhohlakali.
Ukukhuluma komuntu ongenabunkulunkulu kuyambulala umakhelwane wakhe, kepha abalungileyo bakhululwa ngolwazi.
Uma kubahambela kahle abalungileyo umuzi uyathokoza; lapho izikhohlakali zibhubha kuba khona umsindo wentokozo.
Ngesibusiso sabaqotho umuzi uyaphakanyiswa, kepha ngomlomo wezikhohlakali ucekelwa phansi.
Umuntu owedelela umakhelwange wakhe akanakuhlakanipha, kodwa onengqondo uyazithulela.
Oyinhlebi uhamba edalula izimfihlo, kepha othembekile emoyeni uyayisibekela indaba.
Lapho kungekho zeluleko khona abantu bayawa, kodwa lapho kunabeluleki abaningi khona kuba nokuphumelela.
Oba yisibambiso somfokazi uhlupheka kakhulu, kodwa ozonda ukwenza kanjalo ulondekile.
Owesifazane onomusa uzuza udumo, kodwa izidlova zizuza ingcebo.
Umuntu onesihawu uwenzela okuhle umphefumulo wakhe, kepha ononya uzilimaza yena uqobo.
Isikhohlakali sizuza ngokukhohlisa, kepha ohlwanyela ukulunga unomvuzo weqiniso.
Ogxilile ekulungeni uyakuphila, kepha olandela okubi kuyakuba ngukufa kuye.
Abanezinhliziyo eziphambeneyo bayisinengiso kuSimakade, kodwa abahamba ngezindlela ezimsulwa bayintokozo kuye.
Impela omubi akayukuyekwa angajeziswa, kodwa isizukulwane sabalungileyo siyakuhlengwa.
Njengendandatho yegolide ekhaleni lengulube, unjalo owesifazane omuhle ebe engenangqondo.
Abalungileyo bafisa okuhle kodwa; ithemba lezikhohlakali wulaka.
Ophanayo wandelwa yingcebo yakhe, kodwa oncishanayo uzibangela ubuphofu bodwa.
Umuntu ophanayo uyakuceba; ophuzisa abanye amanzi uyakuphuziswa naye.
Abantu bayamqalekisa oncishana ngokudla, kepha isibusiso siyakuba sekhanda lothengisa ngakho.
Ofuna okuhle ufuna okwamukelekayo, kepha ofunisisa okubi kuyakumehlela.
Othembele engcebeni yakhe uyakuwa, kepha abalungileyo bayakuhluma njengamaqabunga aluhlaza.
Ohlupha indlu yakhe uyozuza ize, nesiwula siyakuba yinceku yonenhliziyo ehlakaniphileyo.
Isithelo solungileyo singumuthi wokuphila, nohlakaniphileyo uyayizuza imiphefumulo.
Olungileyo uthola umvuzo emhlabeni; kangakanani-ke isikhohlakali nesoni?
Othanda ukuyalwa uthanda ulwazi, kodwa ozonda ukusolwa uyisiwula.
Umuntu owenza kahle uthola umusa kuSimakade, kepha onamacebo amabi uyamlahla.
Umuntu akanakuma ngenkohlakalo, kepha impande yabalungileyo ayiyukunyakaziswa.
Owesifazane okhutheleyo ungumqhele kumyeni wakhe, kepha ohlazisayo ufana nokubola emathanjeni omyeni wakhe.
Amacebo abalungileyo angubulungiswa, kepha izeluleko zababi ziyinkohliso.
Amazwi ezikhohlakali aqamekela ukuchitha igazi, kepha umlomo wabaqotho uyabahlenga.
Izikhohlakali ziyobhujiswa, ziphele nya, kodwa indlu yabalungileyo iyokuma njalo.
Umuntu utuswa ngokuhlakanipha kwakhe, kepha onhliziyo iphambene uyadelelwa.
Kungcono ukuba ngodelelekile kodwa ube nenceku, kunokuba ngoziqhakambisayo ube weswele ukudla.
Olungileyo uyayinakekela impilo yesilwane sakhe, kepha isihe sezikhohlakali siwulunya.
Olima insimu yakhe uyodla asuthe, kodwa olandela amayiyane akanangqondo.
Isikhohlakali silangazelela impango yababi, kepha impande yabalungileyo iyathela.
Omubi ubanjwa ukuphambuka kwakhe kwakusho ngomlomo wakhe, kodwa olungileyo uyaphuma enkathazweni.
Umuntu uyasutha ngokuhle okuyisithelo somlomo wakhe, nemisebenzi yezandla zakhe imlethela inzuzo.
Indlela yesiwula ibukeka ilungile emehlweni aso, kepha lowo olalela iseluleko uhlakaniphile.
Isiwula sikukhombisa masinyane ukuthukuthela kwaso, kodwa onengqondo uyalifihla ihlazo.
Okhuluma ukwethembeka umemezela ukulunga, kepha ufakazi wamanga ukhuluma inkohliso.
Ukukhuluma kwabanye ngokuhlaphaza kufana nokuhlaba kwenkemba, kodwa ulimi lwabahlakaniphileyo luyaphilisa.
Izindebe ezikhuluma iqiniso ziyakuma kuze kube phakade, kepha ulimi lwamanga lungolomzuzwana nje.
Kunokukhohlisa ezinhliziyweni zabaceba okubi, kepha ukuthula nenjabulo kukubaluleki beqiniso.
Olungileyo akayukwehlelwa nangokukodwa okubi, kepha izikhohlakali zigcwele ukukhathazeka.
Izindebe ezikhuluma amanga ziyisinengiso kuSimakade, kodwa abenza iqiniso bayintokozo yakhe.
Umuntu ohlakaniphileyo uyalufihla ulwazi, kepha izinhliziyo zeziwula ziphafuza ubuwula.
Isandla sabakhuthele siyobusa, kodwa amavila ayophoqwa ukusebenza.
Ukukhathazeka enhliziyweni yomuntu kuyayidangalisa, kepha izwi elihle liyayithokozisa.
Olungileyo ungumholi womngani wakhe, kepha indlela yezikhohlakali iyazidukisa.
Ivila aliyosi inyamazane yalo, kodwa okhuthele unengcebo eningi.
Endleleni yokulunga kunokuphila, emikhondweni yakho akukho ukufa.
Indodana ehlakaniphile iyayalwa nguyise, kodwa isedeleli asilaleli lapho sikhuzwa.
Umuntu uyakudla okuhle okuvela emazwini akhe amahle, kepha abambuluzayo balambele ubudlova.
Oqaphela akushoyo ulonda impilo yakhe; uphoshozwayo uyobhubha.
Umphefumulo wevila uyafisa ungatholi lutho, kepha imiphefumulo yabakhutheleyo iyakuneliswa.
Olungileyo uyawazonda amazwi angamanga, kodwa isikhohlakali sidala amahloni nehlazo.
Ukulunga kuyamlondoloza ondlela yakhe iqotho, kodwa inkohlakalo iyasibhubhisa isoni.
Kukhona ozishaya inkinsela kodwa engenalutho, nozishaya ompofu ebe ecebe kakhulu.
Inhlawulo yokuphila komuntu yingcebo yakhe, kepha ompofu akalaleli ekhuzwa.
Ukukhanya kwabalungileyo kukhanya bha, kepha izibani zezikhohlakali ziyacima.
Ukuziqhenya kudala ingxabano yodwa, kodwa kulabo abemukela ukwelulekwa kukhona ukuhlakanipha.
Ingcebo etholakala kalula iyancipha, kepha eqongelelwa kancane, kancane, iyanda.
Ithemba elingakagcwaliseki ligulisa inhliziyo; isifiso esiphumelele singumuthi wokuphila.
Owedelela izwi uzehlisela ukubhujiswa, kepha owesaba imiyalelo uyakuvuzwa.
Ukufundisa kohlakaniphileyo kungumthombo wokuphila, ukuze kudedwe ezihibeni zokufa.
Ukuqonda kahle kuveza umusa, kepha indlela yabambuluzayo ilukhuni.
Bonke abahlakaniphileyo basebenza ngokwazi, kepha isiwula sisabalalisa ubuwula.
Isithunywa esikhohlakele siwela ebubini, kepha isigijimi esithembekileyo siletha ukuphila.
Ubuphofu nehlazo kukulowo owenqaba ukuyalwa, kepha oqaphela ukusolwa uyatuswa.
Isifiso esifezekile siyathokozisa emphefumulweni, kepha ukudeda ebubini kuyisinengiso kwabayiziwula.
Ohamba nabahlakaniphileyo uyakuhlakanipha, kepha ongumngani weziwula uyolimala.
Ingozi ilandela izoni, kepha abalungileyo bavuzwa ngokuhle.
Olungileyo ushiyela abantwana babantwana bakhe ifa, kepha ingcebo yesoni ibekelelwa olungileyo.
Emqathweni wabampofu kukhona ukudla okuningi, kepha kuyashabalala ngenxa yokungalungi.
Oyeka uswazi uyayizonda indodana yakhe, kodwa oyithandayo uyanakekela ukuba ayiyale.
Olungileyo udla asuthe eneliswe, kepha isisu sezikhohlakali seswele esingasuthiswa ngakho.
Owesifazane ohlakaniphileyo uyayakha indlu yakhe, kodwa oyisiwula uyibhidliza ngezandla zakhe.
Ohamba ngobuqotho uyamesaba uSimakade, kodwa ozindlela zakhe zigwegile uyamedelela.
Emlonyeni wesiwula kuhluma ukuziqhenya, kepha izindebe zabahlakaniphileyo ziyabalondoloza.
Lapho kungenazinkomo khona umkhombe awunalutho, kepha isivuno esikhulu siba khona ngenxa yamandla ezinkabi.
Ufakazi weqiniso akawaqambi amanga, kodwa ufakazi wamanga uphafuza inkohliso.
Isedeleli sifuna ukuhlakanipha kodwa singakutholi, kanti ulwazi lutholakala kalula koqondayo.
Suka phambi komuntu oyisiwula, ngokuba lapho awunakuwathola amazwi anolwazi.
Ukuhlakanipha koqondayo kungukuqonda indlela yakhe, kepha ubuwula beziwula buyinkohliso.
Iziwula ziyawudelela umnikelo wecala, kepha kwabaqotho wemukelekile.
Inhliziyo iyabazi ubuhlungu bayo, kodwa umfokazi akanakuhlanganyela entokozweni yayo.
Indlu yezikhohlakali iyabhujiswa, kepha ithende labaqotho liyachuma.
Kukhona indlela ebonakala sengathi ilungile kumuntu, kepha ukuphela kwayo kuyindlela yokufa.
Noma kuhlekwa inhliziyo inobuhlungu, ukuphela kwentokozo kulusizi.
Umuntu ohlehlayo uyothola umvuzo wezindlela zakhe, kodwa olungileyo uvuna akutshalileyo.
Ongenalwazi ukholwa yikho konke, kodwa ohlakaniphileyo uyaziqaphela izinyathelo zakhe.
Ohlakaniphileyo uyesaba, futhi uyadeda ebubini, kodwa isiwula siyaqhosha, asinaki lutho.
Umuntu onesififane wenza ubuwula, nomuntu onamacebo amabi uyazondwa.
Abangenalwazi badla ifa lobuwula, kepha abanokuqonda baqheliswa ngolwazi.
Ababi bakhothama phambi kwabalungileyo, nezikhohlakali, emasangweni abalungileyo.
Ompofu uyazondwa ngisho ngumakhelwane wakhe, kepha ocebileyo uthandwa ngabaningi.
Owedelela umakhelwane wakhe uyona, kodwa lowo onomusa kwabampofu ubusisiwe.
Abaduki yini abaceba okubi na? Umusa neqiniso kungokwabahlela okuhle.
Wonke umshikashika unenzuzo, kepha amazwi omlomo abanga ukuswela kuphela.
Umqhele wabahlakaniphileyo uyingcebo yabo, umgexo weziwula ungubuwula.
Ufakazi weqiniso uhlenga imiphefumulo, kepha ophafuza amanga unenkohliso.
Ekumesabeni uSimakade kunethemba elinamandla; lokho kubantwana bakhe kuyakuba yisiphephelo.
Ukwesaba uSimakade kungumthombo wokuphila, ukuze umuntu adede ezingibeni zokufa.
Udumo lwenkosi lusebuningini babantu ebabusayo, kepha ukuswela abantu kungukubhubha kombusi.
Owephuzayo ukuthukuthela unokuqonda okukhulu, kepha lowo othukuthela ngokushesha uphakamisa ubuwula.
Ingqondo enokuthula inikeza ukuphila emzimbeni, kodwa umhawu ukubolisa amathambo.
Ocindezela ompofu usola uMenzi wakhe, kodwa onomusa kontulayo uhlonipha uMenzi wakhe.
Isikhohlakali siqunjwa phansi ukukhohlakala kwaso, kodwa olungileyo unenqaba ngisho ekufeni kwakhe.
Ukuhlakanipha kuhlala enhliziyweni yonokuqonda, kodwa eziwuleni, akwaziwa.
Ukulunga kuyasiphakamisa isizwe, kodwa ukona kuyihlazo kubantu.
Isisa senkosi sisencekwini ehlakaniphileyo, kepha intukuthelo yayo ikulabo abenza okuyihlazo.
Impendulo ezothile iyaludambisa ulaka, kodwa izwi elilimazayo libhebhezela intukuthelo.
Ulimi lwabahlakaniphileyo lukhombisa ulwazi oluhle, kodwa umlomo weziwula uphafuza ubuwula.
Amehlo kaSimakade asezindaweni zonke, aqapha abahle nababi.
Ulimi oluphilisayo lungumuthi wokuphila, kepha olobuqili luyawephula umoya.
Isiwula siyakwedelela ukuyala kukayise, kepha onaka ukusolwa uhlakaniphile.
Indlu yolungileyo igcwele ingcebo eningi, kepha enzuzweni yezikhohlakali kukhona ukuhlupheka.
Izindebe zabahlakaniphileyo zisabalalisa ulwazi, kepha akunjalo enhliziyweni yeziwula.
Umhlatshelo wezikhohlakali uyisinengiso kuSimakade, kodwa umkhuleko wabaqotho uyintokozo kuye.
Indlela yezikhohlakali iyisinengiso kuSimakade, kepha uyamthanda olandela ukulunga.
Kunesijeziso esibuhlungu kulowo oshiya indlela; lowo ozonda ukusolwa uyakufa.
Indawo yabafileyo nokubhubha kuphambi kukaSimakade; kakhulu kangakanani izinhliziyo zabantwana babantu na?

Beka indlebe yakho, uzwe amazwi ezihlakaniphi, usigcine enhliziyweni yakho isifundiso sami,
ngokuba kuyokuba mnandi ukuba ukulonde enhliziyweni yakho, lapho konke sekulungele izindebe zakho.
Ukuba ithemba lakho libe kuSimakade, ngikwazisile khona namuhla, yebo, wena.
Angikulobelanga yini izeluleko nokwazi ezinsukwini ezintathu,
ukuba kukufundise iqiniso, namazwi athembekile, ukuze uthumele impendulo eyiqiniso kwabakuthumileyo na?
Ungamqoli ompofu ngoba ubona ubuphofu bakhe; ungamcindezeli ohluphekile esangweni,
ngokuba uSimakade uyayimela indaba yabo, kuthi ababephucayo Yena abephuce ukuphila kwabo.
Ungabi ngumngani womuntu onolaka, ungahambi nomuntu othukutheleyo,
funa ufunde izindlela zakhe, umphefumulo wakho uwele ogibeni.
Ungazibandakanyi nabenza izibambiso, noma ube yisibambiso sesikweletu;
uma kungekho ongakhokha ngakho, uyakuthathelwani umbhede wakho phansi kwakho na?
Ungasisusi isikhonkwane esidala esashayelwa ngokhokho bakho.
Uyambona umuntu onekhono, uyosebenzela amakhosi, hhayi abantukazana.
Uma uhlezi etafuleni udla nombusi, qaphelisisa ukuthi yini ephambi kwakho;
uma uyisiminzi uzithibe, ubeke ummese emphinjeni wakho.
Ungazihaheli izilovela ezivela kumbusi, ngokuba ziwudobo lokukuyenga.
Ungazikhandli ukuze ucebe; hlakanipha ngokwanele, ulinde.
Usathi phayiphayi amehlo, akusekho, ngokushesha sekumile amaphiko njengokhozi, kwajubalalela emazulwini.
Ungadli ukudla koneso elibi, ungafisi izilovela zakhe,
ngokuba ungozicabangelayo, athi kuwe: “Yidla uphuze,” kepha inhliziyo yakhe ayikho kuwe.
Umthamo owudlileyo uyakuwuphalaza, udlale ngamazwi akho okuncoma.
Ungasikhuzi isiwula, ngoba siyakudelela ukuhlakanipha kwamazwi akho.
Ungasusi isikhonkwane esidala, ungangeni emasimini ezintandane,
ngokuba umhlengi wazo unamandla; uyakuyimela indaba yazo.
Beka inhliziyo yakho ekuyalweni, nezindlebe zakho emazwini olwazi.
Ungayeki ukumyala umntwana, ngokuba uma umshaya ngoswazi akayukufa.
Uma umshaya ngoswazi, uhlenga umphefumulo wakhe endaweni yabafileyo.
Ndodana yami, uma inhliziyo yakho ihlakanipha, inhliziyo yami iyakuthokoza, yebo, eyami.
Izibilini zami ziyakujabula, lapho izindebe zakho zikhuluma okulungileyo.
Inhliziyo yakho mayingabi nomhawu ngezoni, kunalokho mesabe njalo uSimakade.
Impela likhona ikusasa, nethemba lakho aliyukushatshalaliswa.
Ndodana yami, lalela uhlakaniphe, inhliziyo yakho uyihole ngendlela enhle.
Ungabi mdibimunye nezinkolotshe zewayini namakloza,
ngokuba inkolotshe nesiminzi bagcina bempofu, ukozela kubenze bagqoke amanikiniki.
Lalela uyihlo owakuzalayo, ungamdeleli unyoko lapho esemdala.
Thengisisa iqiniso, ukuhlakanipha, ukuyalwa, nokuqonda, ungathengisi ngakho.
Uyise wohlakaniphileyo uyethaba nokwethaba, nozala ohlakaniphileyo uyathokoza ngaye.
Mabathokoze oyihlo nonyoko, ethabe owakuzalayo.
Ndodana yami, ngiphe inhliziyo yakho, amehlo akho enamele izindlela zami.
Ngokuba isifebe singumgodi ojulileyo, nowesifazane ondindayo uligodi eliminyeneyo.
Ucutha njengomphangi, andise inani labantu abambuluzayo.
Ngubani othi: “Maye!” Ngubani onosizi na? Ngubani onengxabano na? Ngubani okhonondayo na? Ngubani olimele kungenasisusa na? Ngubani onamehlo aklwelileyo na?
Yilabo abahlalela iwayini, abaphuza noma yiliphi iwayini elixutshiweyo.
Ungabolibuka iwayini ulibone libomvu, licwebezela endebeni, lehla kalula emphinjeni,
ekugcineni liluma njengenyoka; lihlaba njengebululu.
Amehlo akho azobona imihlola, inhliziyo yakho ikhulume okuphambeneyo.
Uyakuba njengolele ekujuleni kolwandle, nohlezi esihlokweni sensika yomkhumbi.
Uyakuthi: “Bagadlile, angalimala; bangishayile, ngangaqonda ukuthi kwenzekeni. Ekuvukeni kwami, ngisayobuye ngilifune.”
Ungabi namhawu ngabantu ababi, ungafisi ukuba nabo.
Ngokuba inhliziyo yabo iceba ubudlova, nezindebe zabo zibhunga inkathazo.
Indlu yakhiwa ngokuhlakanipha, iqiniswe ngokuqonda.
Amakamelo agcwaliswa ngolwazi, nangayo yonke ingcebo enqabileyo neyigugu.
Umuntu ohlakaniphileyo wedlula onamandla, nonolwazi wedlula onezikhwepha.
Ngokucabanga okwephusile ungaphaka impi, nokunqoba kusebuningini babeluleki.
Ukuhlakanipha kuphakeme kakhulu esiwuleni, sona asiwuvuli umlomo waso esangweni.
Ocabanga ukwenza okubi uyakubizwa ngokuthi owenza amacebo amabi.
Ukuceba ubuwula kuyisono, nobhinqayo uyisinengiso kubantu.
Uma uxega amadolo ngosuku lokuhlupheka, amandla akho mancane.
Bahlenge abayiswa ekufeni, ubambe abantengantenga beyobulawa.
Uma uthi: “Bheka, besingakwazi lokhu;” akakuqondi yini lowo ohlola izinhliziyo na? Nolonda umphefumulo wakho akakwazi na? Futhi akayukuphindisela yini kumuntu ngokwemisebenzi yakhe na?
Ndodana yami, yidla uju, ngokuba lumnandi; uju olusemakhekhebeni luyanambitheka emlonyeni.
Yazi ukuthi kunjalo ukuhlakanipha emphefumulweni wakho; uma ukutholile, likhona ikusasa, nethemba lakho aliyukushabalala.
Wena sikhohlakali ungayicutheli indlu yolungileyo, ungayibhubhisi indawo yakhe yokuphumula,
ngokuba noma olungileyo angawa kasikhombisa, uyobuye avuke, kepha izikhohlakali ziyowiswa ngokubi.
Ungathokozi lapho isitha sakho siwa, nenhliziyo yakho mayingajabuli ngokukhubeka kwaso,
funa uSimakade akubone lokho, kube kubi phambi kwakhe, ayisuse intukuthelo yakhe kuso.
Ungazikhathazi ngabenza okubi, ungabi namhawu ngezikhohlakali.
Ngokuba omubi akayukuba nalo ikusasa, nesibani sezikhohlakali siyakucima.
Ndodana yami, mesabe uSimakade nenkosi, ungazihlanganisi nabamelana nabo,
ngokuba inhlekelele izobehlela ngokuzuma. Ngubani owazi ukubhujiswa okungalethwa yibo bobabili na?
Nanka amanye amazwi okuhlakanipha: akukuhle ukubheka ubuso bomuntu lapho wehlulelwa.
Othi esikhohlakalini: “Ulungile,” abantu bayakumqalekisa, nezizwe ziyakumhlamuka.
Kwabamthethisayo kuyokuba mnandi, kwehlele phezu kwabo isibusiso esihle.
Impendulo eyiqiniso injengokuqabula ezindebeni.
Qeda umsebenzi wakho ngaphandle, uzilungiselele wona ensimini yakho, emveni kwalokho yakha indlu yakho.
Ungabi ngufakazi omelana nomakhelwane wakho kungenasizathu; uyakukhohlisa ngezindebe zakho na?
Ungabosho ukuthi: “Njengalokho enzile kimi, kanjalo ngiyakwenza kanjalo kuye; ngizakuphindisela kuye njengokwezenzo zakhe.”
Ngedlula ngasensimini yomuntu oyivila, nasesivinini somuntu ongenangqondo;
bheka, kwakumile ukhula lwameva, kwembozwe gimbici yimbabazane, nomthangala okubiyeleyo udilikele phansi.
Mina ngakubona lokho, ngacabanga; ngabona, ngathola isifundo sokuthi:
ngokozela kancane, nokuthatha isihlwathi, usonge izandla kuze kuyolalwa,
ubuphofu behlela phezu kwakho ube njengomhambuma, weswele njengebutho elihlale lithwele isihlangu.
Nazi ezinye izaga zikaSolomoni ezaphinde zaqoshwa ngamadodana kaHezekiya, inkosi yakwaJuda.
Kuludumo kuNkulunkulu ukusibekela izinto, kodwa kuludumo lwamakhosi ukuphenyisisa udaba.
Njengalokhu amazulu ephakeme, nomhlaba ujulile, injalo nenhliziyo yamakhosi, ayiphenyisiseki.
Susa amanyela esiliveni ukuze umkhandi athole azokwakha ngakho isitsha.
Susa isikhohlakali phambi kwenkosi, khona isihlalo sayo sobukhosi sizoqiniswa ngokulunga.
Ungaziphakamisi phambi kwenkosi, ungami endaweni yabakhulu,
ngokuba kungcono ukuba kuthiwe kuwe: “Yenyukela lapha,” kunokuba wehliselwe phansi phambi kwesikhulu asesibonile amehlo akho.
Ungasheshi uphume uye enkantolo, ngokuba uyokwenzenjani ekugcineni, lapho umakhelwane wakho esekuthela ngehlazo na?
Khuluma udaba lwakho nomakhelwane wakho, ungayidaluli imfihlo yomunye,
funa okuzwayo akuthele ngehlazo, ungabe usahlonishwa.
Izwi elikhulunywe ngesikhathi esifaneleyo lifana namahhabhula egolide asezitsheni zesiliva.
Njengecici legolide nemvunulo yegolide elicolisekileyo, unjalo osola ohlakaniphileyo onendlebe elalelayo.
Njengokubanda kweqhwa ngosuku lokuvuna, sinjalo isithunywa esithembekileyo kosithumileyo, ngokuba sivuselela ukuphila kumniniso.
Njengamafu nomoya ngaphandle kwemvula, unjalo umuntu ozincoma ngesipho angasiphiwanga.
Ngokubekezela, umbusi angathanjiswa, nolimi oluthambileyo luyawaphoqoza amathambo.
Uma uthole uju, yidla okwanele wena, funa lukucike, bese uphalaza.
Unyawo lwakho malungavami endlini yomakhelwane wakho, funa adinwe nguwe, bese ekuzonda.
Umuntu ofakaza amanga ngomakhelwane wakhe, ufana nesando, nenkemba, nomcibisholo obukhali.
Ukwethemba ombuluzayo ngosuku lokuhlupheka, kunjengezinyo elephukileyo nonyawo olwenyelileyo.
Ohubela inhliziyo edangeleyo izihlabelelo, unjengokhumula ibhantshi ngosuku kumakhaza, nanjengothela uviniga esilondeni.
Uma okuzondayo elambile, mnike ukudla, adle; uma omile, muphe amanzi aphuze.
Ngokuba uyakuthela amalahle omlilo ekhanda lakhe, bese kuthi wena uSimakade akuvuze.
Umoya wasenyakatho uletha imvula, nolimi oluhlebayo ludala ubuso obuthukuthele.
Kungcono ukuhlala egumbini lophahla, kunokuhlala endlini nowesifazane onothuthuva.
Njengamanzi aqandayo emphinjeni owomileyo, unjalo umbiko omuhle ovela ezweni elikude.
Njengomthombo odungekileyo nesiphethu esonakeleyo, unjalo olungileyo ozanyazanyiswa phambi komubi.
Akukuhle ukudla uju oluningi, nokuzifunela udumo phezu kodumo.
Umuntu ongakwazi ukuzithiba, ufana nomuzi odiliziwe, ongasenalo ugange.
Njengeqhwa ehlobo, nemvula ngesikhathi sokuvuna, kanjalo udumo alusifanele isiwula.
Njengenyoni ekuhambeni kwayo, nenkonjane ekundizeni kwayo, sinjalo isiqalekiso esingenasizathu.
Isiswebhu singesehhashi, netomu lingelembongolo, noswazi lungolomhlane weziwula.
Ungasiphenduli isiwula njengobuwula baso, funa ufane naso.
Phendula isiwula njengobuwula baso, funa sibe ngohlakaniphileyo emehlweni aso.
Othumela umbiko ngesiwula uzigwaza ngowakhe; ufana nozinqume izinyawo.
Njengemilenze yokhubazekileyo elengayo, sinjalo nesaga emilonyeni yeziwula.
Onika isiwula udumo ufana nobophela itshe endwayimaneni.
Njengeva elihlaba isandla sesidakwa, sinjalo nesaga emilonyeni yeziwula.
Njengomnembi ngomcibisholo olimaza bonke, unjalo oqasha isiwula esizidlulelayo.
Njengenja ebuyela ebuhlanzweni bayo, kanjalo isiwula siphinda ubuwula baso.
Kunethemba ngesiwula kunozibona ehlakaniphile emehlweni akhe.
Ivila lithi: “Kukhona ingonyama endleleni, nebhubesi phakathi esigcawini.”
Isicabha siphenduka ngezingibe zaso, nevila ecansini lalo.
Ivila liyasifihla isandla salo esitsheni; alisibuyiseli emlonyeni walo.
Ivila lihlakaniphile emehlweni alo, kunabayisikhombisa abakhuluma okuhluzekile.
Njengomuntu obamba inja eyedlulayo ngamadlebe, unjalo ozigaxa engxabanweni yabanye abantu.
Njengohlanya oluphonsa izikhuni nemicibisholo ebulalayo,
unjalo umuntu okhohlisa umakhelwane wakhe, athi: “Bengizintelela nje.”
Ngaphandle kwezikhuni, umlilo uyacima, kanjalo lapho kungekho khona abahlebayo, ingxabano iyaphela.
Njengamalahle othuthwini nezinkuni emlilweni, unjalo umuntu ophehla udweshu.
Amazwi ohlebayo anjengesibiliboco: ayehlela ezibilini zomuntu.
Njengesiliva okucakwe ngalo isitsha sobumba, zinjalo izindebe ezishelelayo nenhliziyo embi.
Onenzondo uyazenzisa ngokukhuluma kwakhe, ebe enenhloso embi enhliziyweni yakhe.
Lapho ekhuluma ngendlela emnene, ungakholwa, ngokuba kunezinengiso eziyisikhombisa enhliziyweni yakhe.
Noma inzondo yakhe isibekelwa yinkohliso, ububi bakhe buyodaluleka ebandleni.
Omba umgodi uyakuphonseka kuwo, nogingqa itshe liyakubuya ligaye yena.
Ulimi oluhubhuza amanga luyabazonda olubalimazile; nomlomo othophayo uyabhubhisa.
Ungazigabisi ngekusasa, ngoba awazi ukuthi usuku lukuphatheleni.
Mawutuswe ngomunye, kungabi ngowakho umlomo; kube ngumfokazi, hhayi izindebe zakho.
Itshe liyasinda nesihlabathi sinzima, kodwa ukuchukuluza kwesiwula kusinda ukwedlula kokubili.
Ulaka lungulunya nentukuthelo iyisikhukhula, kepha ngubani ongema phambi komhawu na?
Ukusola okusobala kungcono kunothando olufihliweyo.
Amanxeba adalwe ngumngani anokwemukeleka kunokwanga okuningi kwesitha.
Umphefumulo osuthi uyacikwa wuju, kodwa emphefumulweni olambileyo, ngisho okubabayo imbala, kumnandi.
Njengenyoni esuka ibaleka esidlekeni sayo, unjalo umuntu obalekele indawo yakhe.
Amafutha namakha kuyayithokozisa inhliziyo, kodwa umphefumulo udabukiswa yinhlupheko.
Ungamlahli umngani wakho noma okayihlo; ungabalekeli endlini yomfowenu ngosuku lwenhlekelele. Ungcono umakhelwane oseduze kunesihlobo esihlala kude.
