Ngokuba iNkosi uSimakade Wamabandla uyokuphelelisa ukubhujiswa osekunqunywe emhlabeni wonke.

Ngalokho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade Wamabandla, ithi: “Bantu bami, enihlala eZiyoni, ningabesabi abase-Asiriya lapho benishaya ngentonga yabo, bephakamisa induku yabo ukumelana nani, njengoba kwenza abaseGibhithe.
Ngokuba ngesikhashana nje izokwehla intukuthelo yami, ulaka lwami kube ngolokubhujiswa kwabo.”
USimakade Wamabandla uzobaxebula ngenkalivasi njengoba enza mhla eshaya abakwaMidiyani ngasedwaleni i-Orebhi, nentonga yakhe iyakuba phezu kolwandle; uyakuyiphakamisa njengoba enza eGibhithe.
Kuyothi ngalolo lusuku umthwalo wabo uyakususwa emahlombe akho, nejoka labo entanyeni yakho, ijoka liyonqamuka ngenxa yokunona.
Liyeza i-Ayi, ledlula eMigroni; lethula impahla yalo eMikhimashi,
badlula entubeni, ebusuku bahlala eGebha; iRama liyathuthumela, iGibheya likaSawule lithi galo yephuka.
Khamuluka ndodakazi yaseGalimi; qaphela Layishi, yiphendule Anathothi.
IMadimena selibalekile, izakhamuzi zaseGebhimi sezibhacile.
Namuhla izokanisa eNobhi, izakuzivocavocela intaba yendodakazi yaseZiyoni negquma eJerusalema, isibhakela sayo.
INkosi uSimakade Wamabandla iyonquma amagatsha ngesihluku, kudicilelwe phansi abaphakemeyo, nabazikhukhumezayo behliswe.
Ihlozi lehlathi liyogencwa ngembazo, neLebhanoni liyowa ngenxa yoNamandla.
Kuyakuvela ihlumela esiqwini sikaJese, kumile igatsha ezimpandeni zakhe, lithele.
UMoya kaSimakade uyohlala phezu kwakhe, umoya wokuhlakanipha nowokuqonda, umoya wamasu nowamandla, umoya wokwazi nowokumesaba uSimakade.
Intokozo yakhe iyakuba sekumesabeni uSimakade; akayukwehlulela ngokubona kwamehlo akhe, noma anqume ngakuzwe ngosizwile.
Kepha uyakwehlulela abampofu ngokulunga, alunqume ngokufaneleyo udaba lwabathobekileyo bomhlaba, uyakushaya umhlaba ngentonga yomlomo wakhe, ababulale ababi ngokuphefumula kwezindebe zakhe.
Ukulunga kuyoba yibhande okhalo lwakhe, ukwethembeka kube yibhande lamanyonga akhe.
Inkentshane liyoquba newundlu, ingwe ibuthise ndawonye nezinyane lembuzi, ithole nebhongo lengonyama; kukhuluphaliswe ndawonye, kuqhutshwe yingane encane.
Inkomo nebhele kuyakuklaba ndawonye, namazinyane akho abuthise ndawonye, ibhubesi lidle utshani njengenkabi.
Umntwana osancela uyodlala ngasemgodini wemfezi; olunyuliwe afake isandla sakhe emgodini webululu.
Abayukukwenza okubi, noma babhubhise entabeni yami engcwele, ngokuba umhlaba wonke uyogcwala ukumazi uSimakade njengamanzi esibekela ulwandle.
Ngalolo lusuku impande kaJese iyakuma njengebhanela lezizwe; abezizwe bayoyifuna, nendawo yayo iyokuba nodumo.

Kuyothi ngalolo lusuku, iNkosi ibuye yelule isandla sayo okwesibili ukubutha insali yabantu bayo e-Asiriya, eGibhithe, ePhathirosi, eKhushe, e-Elamu, eShineyari, eHamathi, naseziqhingini ezisolwandle.
Iyophakamisela abezizwe ibhanela, ibuthe abaxoshiweyo bakwa-Israyeli, iqoqe abahlakazekileyo bakwaJuda emagumbini omane omhlaba.
Umona ka-Efrayimi uyophela, nalabo abahlukumeza uJuda bayakunqunywa; u-Efrayimi akaseyukuba nomona ngoJuda, noJuda akaseyukumhlukumeza u-Efrayimi.
Bayohlangana bahlasele amaFilisti entshonalanga, baphange abantu basempumalanga, bayakumelana nabakwa-Edomi nabakwaMowabi, ama-Amori ayoba ngaphansi kwesandla sabo.
USimakade uyoqalekisa itheku lolwandle leGibhithe, anyakazise isandla sakhe phezu komfula awuhwamukise ngekhoza lomoya wakhe, awushaye ube yimifudlana eyisikhombisa, ongayiwela uhamba ngezinyawo.
Kuyoba khona umgwaqo wensali yabantu bakhe eyosala e-Asiriya, njengalokhu kwakunjalo ku-Israyeli ngosuku akhuphuka ngalo eGibhithe.
Ngalolo lusuku uyothi: “Ngiyakubonga, Simakade, ngokuba ubungithukuthelele, kodwa intukuthelo yakho uyinqandile, wangiduduza.
UNkulunkulu uyinsindiso yami; ngiyakumethemba, angiyukwesaba, ngokuba uSimakade, Yena ungamandla ami nezikhwepha zami; uyinsindiso yami.”
Niyokukha amanzi ngokujabula emithonjeni yensindiso.
Ngalolo lusuku niyothi: “Bongani uSimakade, nibize igama lakhe, nazise phakathi kwezizwe izenzo zakhe, nimemezele ukuthi igama lakhe liphakeme.
Hlabelelani izindumiso kuSimakade, ngokuba wenze izinto ezinkulu; lokhu makwaziwe emhlabeni wonke.
Kikizani, nijabule zakhamuzi zaseZiyoni, ngokuba mkhulu oNgcwele ka-Israyeli phakathi kwenu.”
Isiphrofetho ngeBhabhele asibona u-Izaya, indodana ka-Amozi.
Phakamisani ibhanela entabeni eluqhwathule, nimemeze, nibaqhwebe, ukuba bangene emasangweni abakhulu.
Mina uqobo ngibayalile abangcwele bami. Ngiwabizile amaqhawe ami, abangabami abajabula ngokuziqhenya, ukuze babonise intukuthelo yami.
Yizwani umsindo ezintabeni, inhlokomo kungathi ngeyabantu abaningi! Yizwani ukuxokozela kwemibuso yabezizwe ihlangana ndawonye! USimakade Wamabandla uqoqa impi yakhe.
Ivela emazweni akude, emikhawulweni yezulu. USimakade uze nezikhali zentukuthelo yakhe, ukuzobhubhisa umhlaba wonke.
Lilani, ngokuba usuku lukaSimakade lusondele; luyofika njengencithakalo evela kuSomandla.
Ngalokho zonke izandla ziyakuba ntekenteke, nezinhliziyo ziphele amandla.
Bayakushaqeka, babanjwe yiminjunju nobuhlungu, bayoba neminjunju enjengemihelo yowesifazane ebeletha. Bayobhekana nomakhelwano babo ngeziqu zamehlo. Ubuso babo bubheje bube bomvu okwamalangabi.
Bheka, usuku lukaSimakade luyeza; luwusuku lolunya, nentukuthelo nolaka oluvuthayo, ukuchitha umhlaba, nokubhubhisa zonke izoni ezikuwo.
Ngokuba izinkanyezi zezulu nomthala akuyukukhanya; ukukhanya kwakho kuyofiphala, ilanga liyoshona entathakusa, nenyanga lapho iphuma ayiyukukhanya.
Umhlaba ngiyokuwujezisela iziphambeko zawo, nezikhohlakali, izono zazo, ngiyoqeda ukuzidla kwabaphakameyo, ngikuqede ukwedelela kwabacindezeli.
Ngiyokwenza umuntu abe yigugu kunegolide elicwengekileyo; yebo, umuntu muhle kunegolide elicwengekileyo lase-Ofiri.
Ngosuku lokuvutha kwentukuthelo yakhe ngiyokwenza izulu lithuthumele, nomhlaba uzamazame endaweni yawo, ngenxa yokuvutha kwentukuthelo kaSimakade Wamabandla.
Bayophendukela kubantu bakubo njengensephe ehujwayo, nanjengezimvu ezingaqoqwa muntu, babaleke, yilowo nalowo aphindele ezweni lakubo.
Bonke abayotholwa bayogwazwa, nabayobanjwa, badliwe yinkemba.
Abantwana babo bayophohlozwa bebuka, izindlu zabo ziphangwe, omkabo badlwengulwe.
Bhekani, ngizobavusela amaMede, isizwe esingenandaba nasiliva nagolide.
Ayobulala izinsizwa ngeminsalo yawo; angabi nasihe esithelweni sesibeletho sabo; abayukuba nasihawu kubantwana.
IBhabhele, udumo lwemibuso, igugu nokuzigqaja kwamaKhaledi, liyofana neSodoma neGomora lapho uNkulunkulu elichitha.
Aliyukubuye lihlale muntu, akusekho muntu oyokwakha kulo, izizukulwane ngezizukulwane, umArabhu akayukukanisa kulo, nabelusi abayukulala lapho nemihlambi yabo.
Kodwa izilwane zasehlane ziyobuthisa khona, nezindlu zalo ziyogcwala izikhova; kuyohlala lapho izintshe, kugcakagce khona amademoni.
Izimpisi ziyokhala ezinqabeni zalo, namakhanka, ezindlini zamakhosi; sesiseduze ukufika isikhathi salo, nezinsuku zalo aziyukwandiswa.
USimakade uyoba nesihawu kuJakobe, abuye amkhethe u-Israyeli, amuphe ukuthula ezweni lakhe; nabafokazi bayozihlanganisa naye, banamathele endlini kaJakobe.

Izizwe ziyobathumba, zibayise endaweni yazo; indlu ka-Israyeli iyozidla lezo zizwe, zibe yifa layo, zibe yizinceku nezincekukazi ezweni likaSimakade; iyobathumba labo ababekade beyithumbile, ibuse phezu kwabacindezeli bayo.
Kuyothi lapho uSimakade eseniphumuzile ebuhlungwini, enhluphekweni, nasemsebenzini onzima ababenenzisa wona,
nihaye le ngoma, nedelele inkosi yaseBhabhele, nithi: “Yeka ukuphela komcindezeli nokuqedwa kokuqhosha!
USimakade waphule induku yezikhohlakali nentonga yababusi,
eyashaya abantu ngentukuthelo ingaphezi, yabusa izizwe ngolaka nangokucindezela okunganqandekiyo.
Wonke umhlaba uphumule, unokuthula; kuqhumuke inhlokomo kubantu.
Ngisho imisayiphuresi nemisedari eLebhanoni, iyathokoza ngawe, ithi: ‘Selokhu walaliswa phansi, akukho mgawuli okhuphukele kithi ukuba asigawule.’
Indawo yabafileyo phansi inyakazisiwe ukuba ikuhlangabeze uma ufika kuyo, ikuvusele izithunzi zazo zonke izikhulu zomhlaba, isukumise wonke amakhosi ezizwe ezihlalweni zawo zobukhosi.
Wonke ayophendula, athi kuwe: ‘Kanti nawe usubuthakathaka njengathi, usufana nathi?’
Ukuphakama kwakho sekwehliselwe endaweni yabafileyo, kanjalo nomsindo wezingubhu zenu; izimpethu zendlaliwe phansi kwakho, nezibungu ziyakusibekela.
“Yeka ukuwa kwakho ezulwini, khwezi elikhanyayo, ndodana yokusa, nokuqunjwa kwakho phansi, wena owawunqoba izizwe.
Wena wathi enhliziyweni yakho: ‘Ngiyokhuphukela ezulwini, ngiphakamise isihlalo sami sobukhosi phezu kwezinkanyezi zikaNkulunkulu; ngiyohlala entabeni yomhlangano ngasemaphethelweni aseZafoni.
Ngiyokhuphuka ezindaweni eziphakemeyo phezu kwamafu, ngizenze ngibe njengoPhezukonke.’
Nokho wehliselwe endaweni yabafileyo, emajukujukwini omgodi.
“Abakubonayo bayokubhekisisa, bakuqaphelisise, bese bethi: ‘Nguye yini lo muntu owazamazamisa umhlaba, wanyakazisa imibuso,
owenza izwe laba yihlane, wabhubhisa imizi yalo, akazivumela iziboshwa ukuba zibuyele emakhaya na?’
Wonke amakhosi ezizwe, wonke alale ngodumo, yileyo naleyo edlinzeni layo.
Kodwa wena ulahlwe ngaphandle kwethuna lakho njengegatsha elinengekayo, ligqokwe ngababuleweyo, abagwazwe ngenkemba, behlela emgodini wamatshe njengesidumbu esinyathelweyo.
Awusoze wahlangana nabo egodini, ngokuba waba yimbangela yencithakalo ezweni lakini; wabulala abantu bakini. Sengathi izizukulwane zezikhohlakali zingebe zisaphathwa naphakade.
Lungisani indawo yokubulalela abantwana bakhe, ngenxa yenkohlakalo yokhokho babo. Mabangaphinde bavuke, ukuba badle ifa lomhlaba, bagcwalise izwe ngemizi.
“Ngiyobavukela,” kusho uSimakade Wamabandla, “nginqume eBhabhele igama nensali, indodana nomzukulu,” kusho uSimakade.
“Ngiyolenza libe yifa lezingungumbane namaxhaphozi anomhlanga, ngiyolishanela ngomshanelo wembubhiso,” kusho uSimakade Wamabandla.
USimakade Wamabandla ufunge wathi: “Impela njengoba ngihlosile kuyokuba kanjalo, nanjengoba ngihlelile kuyokuma kanjalo,
ukuthi ngiyolicoboshisa i-Asiriya ezweni lami, ngiligxobe ezintabeni zami; lisuswe kubantu bani ijoka lalo nomthwalo walo osemahlombe abo.”
Yilesi isinqumo esinqunyiwe emhlabeni wonke; yilesi isandla esizoshaya izizwe zonke.
Ngokuba uSimakade Wamabandla unqumile; ngubani oyakuguqula lokho na? Isandla sakhe sizogadla; ngubani oyakusinqanda na?
Ngonyaka wokufa kwenkosi u-Ahazi, kwavela lesi siphrofetho.
Ungathokozi wena Filistiya namaphethelo, ngokuthi intonga ekushayileyo yephukile, ngokuba esiqwini senyoka kuyophuma ibululu, nenzalo yalo ibe yinkanyamba endizayo.
Amazibulo abampofu ayodla, abantulayo balale belondekile; kodwa ngiyobulala impande yakho ngendlala, ngibhubhise nensali yakho.
Lila wena sango, udazuluke wena muzi; phela amandla wena Filistiya lonke! Ngokuba kuvela intuthu enyakatho; akekho oyokwehlukana nebutho lakhe.
Ziyophendulwa ngokuthini izithunywa zesizwe na? Kuyothiwa nguSimakade omisele abahluphekileyo babantu bakhe iZiyoni, ukuba bayophephela kulo.
Isiphrofetho ngoMowabi. Impela ngabusuku bunye i-Ari Mowabi linqotshiwe, labhujiswa. Impela ngabusuku bunye iKhiri Mowabi linqotshiwe, lachithwa.
Bayokhuphukela ethempelini; iDibhoni lenyukele ezindaweni eziphakemeyo ukuyokhala. AbakwaMowabi bayalila ngeNebho nangeMedebha; wonke amakhanda ayizimpandla, nezilevu zonke ziphuciwe.
Babhince amasaka kuyo yonke imigwaqo, nasophahleni lwabo, nasezigcawini zabo, bonke bayalila, kugobhoza izinyembezi.
IHeshibhoni ne-Elehale kuyakhala; izwi labo lizwakala naseJahazi; amabutho akwaMowabi ayamemeza, umphefumulo wawo uyathuthumela.
Inhliziyo yami ikhalela abakwaMowabi; ababalekileyo bakhona babalekela eZowari nase-Egila shelishiya; bakhuphukela eLuhithe bekhala, nasendleleni eya eHoronayimi bayadazuluka.
Ngokuba amanzi aseNimrimi ashile, utshani bomile, uhlaza luphelile, akusekho okuluhlaza.
Yingakho abakutholileyo obekusasele, nemfuyo yabo, bakuwelise uMfula Weminyezane,
ngokuba ukukhala kwabakwaMowabi kuzungeze imingcele yakhona, ukulila kwabo kuze kufinyelele e-Egelayimi, nokububula kwabo kufike eBheri Elimi.
Amanzi aseDimoni agcwele igazi; iDimoni ngisazolehlisela okukhulu, ingonyama ngiyibekele abayosinda bakwaMowabi, nabaseleyo ezweni.
Thumelani imvana kumbusi wezwe, ivela eSela ngendlela esehlane, iye entabeni yendodakazi yaseZiyoni.
Amadodakazi akwaMowabi ayoba njengezinyoni ezizulazulayo, namaphuphu ahlakazekileyo, emazibukweni e-Arinoni.
“Lulekanani, nithathe isinqumo, umphefumulo wabo ube njengobusuku phakathi kwemini, nibhacise abaxoshiweyo, ningabadaluli ababalekileyo.
Abaxoshiweyo bakwaMowabi mabagogobale phakathi kwenu, nibe yisiphephelo sabo kumbhubhisi.” Kuyothi lapho umcindezeli engasekho, nokubhujiswa sekuphelile, seziqediwe nezidlova ezweni,
kumiswe isihlalo sobukhosi ngomusa, ethendeni likaDavide, kuhlale kuso ngokwethembeka umehluleli oyofuna ubulungiswa, asheshe ukwenza okulungileyo.
Sizwile ngokuziqhayisa kukaMowabi ukuthi uphakeme kakhulu, nangokuzidla kwakhe, nokuqhosha kwakhe, nokuchwensa kwakhe; ukuzikhukhumeza kwakhe kuyize.
Ngakho-ke abakwaMowabi mabamlilele uMowabi; bonke balikhalele ikhekhe elinamagilebhisi omisiwe laseKhiri Haresethi. Lilani nidabukele kuphela abavithizwe yizinhlupheko.

Amasimu aseHeshibhoni ashaziwe, kwabuna nezivini eSibhima, ezixha zawo zamagilebhisi ekhethelo, ayedaka amakhosi ezizwe afinyelela naseJazeri, enabela nasehlane; amahlumela awo elulwa, awela ulwandle.
Ngakho-ke khalela izivini eSibhima njengokulila kweJazeri. Ngikuthela ngezinyembezi zami wena Heshibhoni, nawe Elehale, ngokuba ukujabulela isivuno sakho sezithelo nesokusanhlamvu kuphelile.
Ukuthokoza nokujabula kususiwe ensimini yezithelo, akusahlatshelelwa maculo; ezivinini akusamenyezwa, abanyathelayo abalinyatheli iwayini ezikhamweni; ngikuqedile ukumemeza.
Ngakho-ke ingaphakathi lami likhala njengehabhu ngoMowabi, nomphefumulo wami, ngeKhiri Heresi.
Kuyothi lapho uMowabi ezibonakalisa, ezikhathaza endaweni ephakemeyo, aye ethempelini lakhe ukuyothandaza, angaphumeleli.
Yilelo izwi uSimakade alisho ngoMowabi ngaleso sikhathi.
Manje uthi: “Eminyakeni emithathu, njengeminyaka yomqashwa, udumo lukaMowabi luzobukelwa phansi, ngisho noma enesixuku esikhulu; insali iyokuba yingcosana, futhi ingabi namandla.”
Isiphrofetho ngeDamaseku. “Yazini ukuthi iDamaseku liyoshatshalaliswa, lingabe lisaba ngumuzi, libe yinxiwa nencithakalo.
Imizi e-Aroweri iyakushiywa ibe ngeyemihlambi; ibuthise khona, ingethuswa muntu.
Kuyobhidlika inqaba kwa-Efrayimi, nombuso eDamaseku, nensali e-Aramu, kube njengodumo lwabantu bakwa-Israyeli,” kusho uSimakade Wamabandla.
“Ngalolo lusuku udumo lukaJakobe luyodanjiswa, kuphele ukukhuluphala emzimbeni wakhe, azace.
Kuyoba njengomuntu evuna amabele emazimbeni asamile, nengalo yakhe ivuna izikhwebu, nanjengokhothozayo esigodini samaRefa.
Umkhwanyo uyosala njengokusale kuwohlozwa iminqumo: izithelo ezimbili noma ezintathu ezihlokweni phezulu, ezine noma ezinhlanu emagatsheni omuthi,” kusho uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.
Ngalolo lusuku abantu bayomfuna uMdali wabo, amehlo abo agqolozele oNgcwele ka-Israyeli.
Abasayukuwanaka ama-althare abo, umsebenzi wezandla zabo, abasayukuwubheka kulokho okwenziwe yiminwe yabo, o-Ashera nama-althare empepho.
Ngalolo lusuku imizi ebiyelweyo iyofana namanxiwa asehlathini naseziqongweni zezintaba, eyashiwa ngabantu bakwa-Israyeli, yaba yincithakalo.
Ngokuba umkhohliwe uNkulunkulu wensindiso yakho, awulikhumbulanga iDwala ophephela kulo, ngalokho-ke noma utshala izithombo zekhethelo, uhlwanyele amahlumela angaziwayo,
noma ungazenza zikhule ngosuku ezitshalwe ngalo, wenze okuhlwanyelweyo kuqhakaze ngakusasa, nokho akuyukuba khona sivuno ngalolo lusuku lokulila nobuhlungu obungelapheki.
Maye, ukuhlokoma kwezizwe eziningi, zihlokoma njengokuduma kolwandle; nomsindo wokuxokozela kwabezizwe, unjengokuhlokoma kwamanzi amaningi.
Izizwe zihlokomisa okwamanzi amaningi, kodwa uyakuzijezisa, zibalekele kude, zixoshwe njengamakhoba epheshulwa ngumoya ezintabeni, nanjengothuli lupheshulwa yisiphepho.
Ngokuhlwa, kuba yingebhe yodwa; kuthi kungakasi zibe zingasekho. Yileso-ke isabelo sabasiphangayo, nonkatho lwabasiqhwagayo.
Maye, kuwe lizwe elibhakuzisa amaphiko, eliphesheya kwemifula eKhushe,

elithumela izithunywa ngolwandle, zintweze emanzini ngemikhumbi yomhlanga! Hambani zithunywa ezinejubane, niye esizweni sabantu abade abasikhumba sibushelelezi, abantu abesatshwa kude naseduze, isizwe esinamandla nezidlova; esizwe laso lihlukaniswe yimifula.
Nina nonke enakhile ezweni, nina nonke enihlezi emhlabeni, bhekani lapho sekuphakanyiswa ibhanela ezintabeni, nilalele lapho kukhala icilongo.
Ngokuba ungitshelile uSimakade, wathi: “Ngizobuka, ngithule ngisendaweni yami, njengokushisa kwelanga, nanjengefu lamazolo ekushiseni ngesikhathi sokuvuna.”
Ngokuba ngaphambi kokuvuna, lapho imbali isiqhakaze yaze yaphenduka igilebhisi elivuthiweyo, uzowanquma wonke amagatsha ngocelemba, namagatsha enabileyo uwanqume, uwasuse.
Ayoshiywa ndawonye, abe ngawamanqe asezintabeni, nawezilwane zasemhlabeni. Amanqe ayohlala kuwo ehlobo, ebusika kuhlale kuwo zonke izilwane zomhlaba.

Ngaleso sikhathi abantu abade, abanesikhumba esibushelelezi, bayoletha izipho kuSimakade Wamabandla, zivela kubantu abesatshwa kude naseduze; isizwe esinamandla nesinqobayo, esilizwe laso lihlukaniswe yimifula. Bayoziletha entabeni iZiyoni, indawo yegama likaSimakade Wamabandla.

Isiphrofetho ngeGibhithe. Bheka, uSimakade ugibele efini elisheshayo, uyeza eGibhithe; onkulunkulu baseGibhithe bazothuthumela phambi kwakhe, nezinhliziyo zabaseGibhithe ziphele amandla phakathi kwabo.
“Ngizonyakazisa abaseGibhithe bavukelane bodwa, umfowabo alwe nomfowabo, umakhelwane alwe nomakhelwane, umuzi ulwe nomuzi, nombuso ulwe nomunye umbuso.
AbaseGibhithe bayokhanywa baphele umoya, ngizowabhuntshisa amacebo abo. Bayofuna, bahlole konkulunkulu mbumbulu, nasemimoyeni yabafileyo, nasemadlozini, nakubathakathi.
AbaseGibhithe ngiyobanikela esandleni senkosi enolunya namandla, ibabuse,” kusho uSimakade Wamabandla.
Amanzi olwandle ayokusha, umfula wome nkwe.
Imifula iyonuka, imifudlana eGibhithe iyoncipha, ishe, kubune umhlanga nebhuma.
Kuyoba namaqwaqwasi ngaseNayili, osebeni lweNayili, konke okutshalwe ngaseNayili kuyokoma, kuhlakazwe, kungabe kusaba bikho.
Abadoba izinhlanzi bayokhala; bonke abaphonsa izindobo eNayili balile, nabaphonsa amanetha emanzini ayo bayodabuka.
Abasebenza ngefilakisi, nabeluka ilineni bayodumala.
Abeluki bakhona bayodumala, nabasebenzela ukuhola badabuke ezinhliziyweni.
Izikhulu zaseZowani ziyiziwula ngempela, abeluleki abahlakaniphileyo bakaFaro beluleka ubuwula. Ningasho kanjani kuFaro, nithi: “Ngiyindodana yezihlakaniphi, isizukulwane samakhosi asemandulo” na?
Pho baphi manje abahlakaniphileyo bakini na? Mabakutshele, bakwazise okucetshwa nguSimakade Wamabandla ngeGibhithe.
Izikhulu zaseZowani seziphenduke iziwula, izikhulu zaseNofi ziluthekile. Labo abayizinsika zezizwe zalo balidukisile iGibhithe.
USimakade uthelile phakathi kwalo umoya wokudideka, balenze iGibhithe ladiyazela kukho konke elikwenzayo, njengesidakwa sididizela ebuhlanzweni baso.
Akukho lutho olungasiza iGibhithe, ngisho ikhanda noma umsila, igatsha lesundu noma umhlanga.
Ngalolo lusuku abaseGibhithe bayofana nabesifazane, bathuthumele ngukwesaba, ngenxa yesandla sikaSimakade Wamabandla esimelene nabo.
Izwe lakwaJuda liyobafaka ingebhe abaseGibhithe. Bonke okuyokhulunywa kubo ngalo bayongenwa wukwesaba ngenxa yecebo uSimakade Wamabandla alicebile ngalo.
Ngalolo lusuku, eGibhithe, kuyoba nemizi emihlanu ekhuluma ulimi lwaseKhanani, eyokwenza isifungo sokwethembeka kuSimakade Wamabandla. Omunye waleyo mizi uyobizwa ngokuthi nguMuzi Wembubhiso.
Ngalolo lusuku kuyoba khona i-althare likaSimakade phakathi nezwe eGibhithe, nensika kuSimakade emngceleni walo.
Liyokuba yisibonakaliso nobufakazi kuSimakade Wamabandla eGibhithe. Bayokhala kuSimakade ngenxa yabacindezeli; abathumelele umkhululi, abavikele, abakhulule.
USimakade uyozibonakalisa kwabaseGibhithe ngalolo lusuku, nabaseGibhithe bayomazi uSimakade, bayakumkhonza ngomhlatshelo nangomnikelo wokushiswa, benze izifungo kuSimakade, bazifeze.
USimakade uyolishaya iGibhithe, alishaye abuye aliphilise; bayobuyela kuSimakade, bamnxuse, abaphulukise.
Ngalolo lusuku kuyoba khona umgwaqo omkhulu osuka eGibhithe uye e-Asiriya, i-Asiriya liyokuya eGibhithe, neGibhithe liye e-Asiriya, abaseGibhithe bayokhonza nabase-Asiriya.
Ngalolo lusuku owakwa-Israyeli uyoba ngowesithathu, ehlangene nabaseGibhithe nabase-Asiriya, babe yisibusiso phakathi komhlaba.
USimakade Wamabandla awubusisile, ethi: “Malibusiswe iGibhithe, abantu bami ne-Asiriya, umsebenzi wezandla zami, no-Israyeli ifa lami.”
Ngonyaka okwafika ngawo umkhuzi wempi e-Ashidodi, ethunywe nguSarigoni, inkosi yase-Asiriya, walwa nalo, walinqoba.

Ngaleso sikhathi uSimakade wakhuluma ngesandla sika-Izaya, indodana ka-Amozi, wathi: “Hamba ukhumule indwangu eyisaka esokhalo lwakho, nezicathulo ezinyaweni zakho.” Wenza kanjalo, wahamba nqunu, engafake nazicathulo.
USimakade wathi: “Njengalokhu inceku yami, u-Izaya, isihambe nqunu ingafake nazicathulo iminyaka emithathu, iyisibonakaliso nesimangaliso eGibhithe naseKhushe.
Inkosi yase-Asiriya iyobahambisa benqunu abathunjwa baseGibhithe, nabaxoshiweyo baseKhushe: abadala nabancane, izinqe ziyoba sobala, kube yihlazo eGibhithe.
Bayophela amandla, babe namahloni ngeKhushe, ithemba labo, nangeGibhithe abazigabisa ngalo.

Ngalolo lusuku izakhamuzi zasogwini ziyothi: ‘Bheka ukuthi kwenzekeni kulabo ebesethembele kubo, nalabo ebesibalekela kubo ukuyocela usizo nokukhululwa enkosini yase-Asiriya. Pho thina-ke, siyophunyuka kanjani na?’ ”
Isiphrofetho ngehlane eligudle ulwandle. Njengesiphepho sivunguza eningizimu, kukhona ozayo ovela ehlane, ezweni elesabekayo.
Ngiboniswe umbono oshaqisayo: umkhapheli ekhaphela, nombhubhisi ebhubhisa. Yenyuka Elamu, uvimbezele Mediya; ngizokuqeda konke ukukhala kwenu.
Ngalokho ukhalo lwami lugcwele izinhlungu; ngibanjwe yimihelo njengowesifazane obelethayo; ngikhonkobele ngengikuzwile, ngethukile ngengikubonile.
Inhliziyo yami iyadwanguza, iyathuthumela; ukuhwelela ebengikulangazelela kungehlele, sekuphenduke ixhala kimi.
Balungisa itafula, bendlala izindwangu, bayadla, bayaphuza. Hhayi bo, zikhulu, sukumani! Gcobani amahawu.
Ngokuba iNkosi ithe kimi: “Hamba uyomisa umlindi ozakukwazisa akubonayo.
Lapho ebona umgibeli, nabagibele amahhashi ngababili, ogibele imbongolo nogibele ikameli, uyoqaphelisisa, alalele ngokucophelela okukhulu.”
Ibhubhesi lamemeza, lathi: “Nkosi, ngihlale ngimi embhoshongweni wami nsuku zonke, nasendaweni engibekwe kuyo ubusuku bonke.
Bheka, sekuza umuntu ngenqola yamahhashi. Umemeza athi: ‘Liwile, liwile iBhabhele, nazo zonke izithombe zonkulunkulu balo; kuphelele phansi.’ ”
Wena ongokubhuliweyo kwesibuya sami, lokhu engikuzwe ngoSimakade Wamabandla, uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli; ngiyakukumemezela kuwe.
Lesi yisiphrofetho ngeDuma. Kukhona ongimemeza eseSeyiri, ethi: “Mlindi, yisikhathi sini sobusuku na? Mlindi, yisikhathi sini sobusuku na?”
Umlindi wathi: “Ukusa kuyeza, nobusuku ngokunjalo; uma nifuna ukubuza, buzani; nibuye futhi.”
Isiphrofetho nge-Arabhiya. Niyakulala ehlozini elisemathafeni e-Arabhiya, nina mahele aseDedanimi.
We zakhamuzi zakwaThema, lethelani abomileyo amanzi, bahlangabezeni ngokudla abafokazi.
Ngokuba babalekele izinkemba, izinkemba ezihoshiweyo, neminsalo ensaliweyo, nobunzima bempi.
Ngokuba iNkosi ithe kimi: “Ngesikhathi esingangonyaka, ngokubalwa kweminyaka yoqashiweyo, lonke udumo lweKhedari luzophela;
inani lensali yabaciba ngemicibisholo, amaqhawe aseKhedari, iyoba yingcosana,” ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli ukhulumile.
Isiphrofetho ngesiGodi Sombono. Kwenzenjani nize nonke ngothi lwenu, nenyukele ophahleni lwendlu,
muzi ogcwele ukumemeza, muzi oxokozelayo, nomuzi othokozayo na? Ababuleweyo bakho ababulawanga ngenkemba, futhi abafelanga empini.
Bonke ababusi benu babaleke kanyekanye, babanjwa ngaphandle kokusebenzisa iminsalo. Bonke abakini abatholakala, babanjiwe noma babebalekele kude.
Ngalokho ngithi: “Ningangibuki mina, ngizonikhombisa umunyu ngokulila kalusizi; ningazami ukungiduduza ngenxa yokubhujiswa kwendodakazi yabantu bami.”
Ngokuba wusuku lweNkosi uSimakade Wamabandla, usuku lokukhathazeka nokucindezelwa, lokudideka eSigodini Sombono; usuku lokudilizwa kwezingange nolokukhalela ukusizwa ezintabeni.
I-Elamu lithathe umgodla nezinqola zempi nabamahhashi; iKhiri laveza isihlangu salo.
Izigodi zakho ezikhethekileyo zagcwala izinqola zempi, abamahhashi abanamandla bazihlela ngasesangweni.
Usisusile isembozo sikaJuda. Ngalolo lusuku wena wabheka ezikhalini zendlu yehlathi.
Nabona ukuthi miningi imifantu emzini kaDavide, nase niyokha amanzi echibini elisezansi.
Nazibala izindlu zaseJerusalema, nazibhidliza ukuze niqinise ugange.
Nakhe indawo yokugcina amanzi phakathi kwezindonga ezimbili, ukugcina amanzi echibi elidala. Kodwa anibhekanga kulowo owalenzayo, animnakanga lowo okade wanquma ukulenza.
Ngalolo lusuku iNkosi uSimakade Wamabandla wanibiza ukuba nikhale, nilile, niphuce amakhanda, nigqoke indwangu eyisaka,
kodwa kunalokho kwakunenjabulo nedili, kuhlatshwa izinkabi nezimvu, kudliwa inyama, kuphuzwa iwayini, nathi: “Masidle, siphuze, ngokuba kusasa sizokufa.”
USimakade Wamabandla uzambulile ezindlebeni zami, wathi: “Impela lesi siphambeko aniyukuthethelelwa sona nize nife,” kusho iNkosi uSimakade Wamabandla.
Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade Wamabandla, ithi: “Woza, uhambe uye enduneni uShebhina owengamele indlu, uthi kuye:
‘Wenzani lapha? Unobani lapha ohlobene naye, ukuze uziqophele ithuna lapha, uziqophele ithuna endaweni ephakeme, uzisikele indawo yokuhlala edwaleni?’
“Bheka, wena mlisa, uSimakade uzokukulahla kude, kabuhlungu, uzakukubamba aqinise.
Uyokusonga akuqinise, akulahle njengebhola ezweni elibanzi. Uyofela lapho; izinqola zakho zodumo ziyolala lapho, wena olihlazo lendlu yenkosi yakho.
Ngiyakukwehlisa esikhundleni sakho, ngikukhiphe emsebenzini wakho, ngikuqumbe phansi.
“Kuyothi ngalolo lusuku ngibize inceku yami; u-Eliyakimi, indodana kaHilikiya;
ngimembathise ingubo yakho, ngimqinise ngebhande; ngiyakumnika esandleni amandla akho, abe nguyise wabakhileyo eJerusalema nakuyo indlu yakwaJuda.
Ngiyakubeka isihluthelelo sendlu kaDavide ehlombe lakhe; uyakuvula kungavali muntu, avale kungavuli muntu.
Ngiyomqinisa njengesikhonkwane endaweni eqinileyo, abe yisihlalo sokuhlonipheka endlini kayise.
Bayakugaxa kuye lonke udumo lwendlu kayise, abozalo nezizukulwane, zonke izitsha ezincane, imicengezi nezinkamba.
“Ngalolo lusuku,” kusho uSimakade Wamabandla. “Isikhonkwane esasibethelwe endaweni eqinileyo siyobhoncuka, sikhishwe, siyowa kuthi nomthwalo obukuso unqunywe,” kusho uSimakade.
Isiphrofetho ngeThire. Lilani Mikhumbi yaseTharishishi, ngokuba indlu yenu ishatshalalisiwe, nokungena kwayo ivela eKhithimi kwambuliwe.
Thulani nina zakhamuzi zasogwini, nina bahwebi baseSidoni, izithunywa zenu ziwele ulwandle,
emanzini amaningi; imbewu yaseSihori nokuvuna kweNayili kwakuyinzuzo yalo; laliyindawo izizwe ezazithenga kuyo.
Yiba nezinhloni wena Sidoni, ngokuba ulwandle lukhulumile, inqaba yolwandle, ithi: “Angisikwanga, angibelethanga, angikhulisanga nsizwa, angondlanga ntombi.”
Lapho umbiko ufinyelela eGibhithe, liyoba sebuhlungwini ngenxa yeThire.
Welelani eTharishishi, nilile, nina zakhamuzi zasogwini.
Ngabe ngumuzi wenu lona, enijabula ngawo, owavela ezinsukwini zasemandulo, onyawo zawo zawuthwala waze wayohlala kude na?
Ngubani owenze leli cebo ngeThire, umethwesi wemiqhele, obahwebi bakhona bekuyizikhulu, nabathengi bakhona bengabahlonishwayo emhlabeni?
NguSimakade Wamabandla ocebe lokho, ukuba konakaliswe ukuziphakamisa kwabo bonke ubukhosi, badeleleke bonke abadumileyo bomhlaba.
Sabalalani nezwe lonke, nina bomuzi waseTharishishi, kuhle komfula iNayili lapho udla izindwani, ugabha imfunda.
Isandla sakhe uselulele phezu kolwandle, wazamazamisa imibuso, uSimakade uyaleze ngeKhanani ukuba kudilizwe izinqaba zalo.
Wathi: “Awusayukujabula wena ntombi ethelwe ngehlazo, ndodakazi yaseSidoni; vuka, uwelele eKhithimi, nalapho awuyukukuthola ukuphumula.”
Bheka izwe lamaKhaledi, leso sizwe asisekho, saqedwa yi-Asiriya, laphenduka indawo yezilwane zasendle. Lamisa imibhoshongo yokuvimbezela, izindlu zamakhosi lazenza ize, izwe laphenduka incithakalo.
Lilani nina mikhumbi yaseTharishishi, ngokuba inqaba ibhujisiwe.
Kusukela ngalolo lusuku, iThire liyolibaleka iminyaka engama-70, isikhathi sokuphila kwenkosi eyodwa. Ekupheleni kweminyaka engama-70, eThire kuyokwenzeka njengokwezwi leculo lesifebe, elithi:
“Thatha ihabhu, uhambahambe emzini, wena sifebe esikhohlakeleyo, ubethe kamnandi, uhlabelele izihlabelelo eziningi, ukuze ukhunjulwe.”
Kuyothi ngasekupheleni kweminyaka engama-70, uSimakade ahambele iThire, lona libuyele enzuzweni yalo, lifebe nayo yonke imibuso yezwe ebusweni bomhlaba.
Intengo yalo nenzuzo yalo kuyoba ngcwele kuSimakade; ayiyukunqwatshelwa, ilondolozwe, ngokuba intengo yalo iyoba ngeyabahlala phambi kukaSimakade, ukuze badle, basuthe, babe nezingubo ezinhle.
Manje uSimakade usezowenza incithakalo umhlaba, ube yize, agumbuqele ubuso bawo, ahlakaze abakhileyo kuwo.

Njengoba kuyakuba njalo kubantu, kuyakuba njalo nakubaphristi; njengoba kuyakuba njalo nasesigqileni, kuyakuba njalo nakumniniso; njengoba kunjalo encekukazini, kuyakuba njalo nasenkosikazini; njengoba kunjalo kumthengi, kuyakuba njalo nakumthengisi; njengoba kunjalo kobolekisayo, kuyakuba njalo nakobolekayo; njengoba kunjalo kokweletisayo, kuyakuba njalo nakokweletayo.
Umhlaba uyokuba yincithakalo, uphangwe impela, ngokuba uSimakade ulishilo leli lizwi.
Umhlaba womile, ubunile, izwe liyashabalala, liyaphela, abahloniphekile bomhlaba bayaphela.
Umhlaba ungcolisiwe ngabakhileyo kuwo, ngokuba bayeqile imithetho, baphambuka ezimisweni, basephula isivumelwano saphakade.
Ngakho-ke isiqalekiso siyawubhuqabhuqa umhlaba, izakhamuzi zitholwe zinecala; ngalokho abakhileyo emhlabeni bayashiswa, kusale ingcosana nje kuphela.
Iwayini elisha liphelile, imivini iyabuna; bayabubula bonke abanhliziyo zeneme.
Ukuzijabulisa ngokhehlegume akusekho, ukuxokozela kwabajabulayo kuphelile, nenjabulo yehabhu inqamukile.
Abasahubi lapho bephuza iwayini, uphuzo olunamandla seluyababa kulabo abaluphuzayo.
Umuzi wenxushunxushu ubhidliziwe, zonke izindlu zivaliwe ukuze kungangeni muntu kuzo.
Kunesililo emigwaqweni, kukhalelwa iwayini; yonke intokozo iphele nya, injabulo yezwe ixoshiwe.
Kusele incithakalo emzini, amasango afahlaziwe aba yimvithi.
Kuyokuba kanjalo emhlabeni phakathi kwezizwe. Kuyakuba njengomnqumo uvithikile, nanjengokukhothoza sekwedlule isikhathi sokuvuna amagilebhisi.
Abantu bayophakamisa izwi labo, bababaze ubukhosi bukaSimakade entshonalanga.
Ngakho-ke empumalanga mdumiseni uSimakade, emazweni asogwini likhazimuliseni igama likaSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.

Emikhawulweni yomhlaba sizwa amahubo okudumisa, athi: “Udumo malube koLungileyo!” Kodwa mina ngithi: “Maye, kimina, ngokuba ngiyafa, ngiyafa!” Ngokuba abakhohlisi bakhohlisile, abakhohlisi bakhohlisile kakhulu.
Ukwesaba, umgodi nogibe kuphezu kwenu, nina enakhileyo emhlabeni.
Kuyothi obalekela umsindo wokwesaba awele emgodini; ophuma emgodini uyobanjwa wugibe. Ngokuba amafasitela ezulu avuliwe, nezisekelo zomhlaba ziyazamazama.
Umhlaba uyophihlizwa, ube yimvithi, uqhekezeke, umhlaba uyakuzanyazanyiswa kanzima.
Umhlaba uzontengezela njengodakiweyo, untengantenge njengexhokovana, isiphambeko sawo siyakuba nzima phezu kwawo, uwe ungaphinde uvuke nanini.
Ngalolo lusuku uSimakade uyowajezisa amabandla asezulwini phezulu, namakhosi omhlaba emhlabeni.
Bayohlanganiswa ndawonye, njengeziboshwa ziqoqelwa emgodini, bayovalelwa ejele, kuthi emva kwezinsuku eziningi, bajeziswe.
Inyanga iyakukhophozela, ilanga libe namahloni, ngokuba uSimakade Wamabandla uyobusa entabeni iZiyoni naseJerusalema, phambi kwamalunga akhe, inkazimulo yakhe ibe phambi kwamalunga akhe.
Wena Simakade unguNkulunkulu wami; ngizokuphakamisa ngilidumise igama lakho, ngokuba wenze izimangaliso ezacetshwa emandulo, ngokwethembeka nangeqiniso.
Ngokuba umuzi uwuphendule imvithi, umuzi obiyelweyo waba yincithakalo; umuzi wabafokazi awuseyiwo umuzi, awusoze wakhiwa kabusha nanini.
Ngakho-ke izizwe ezinamandla ziyokudumisa, imizi yezizwe ezinonya ikwesabe.
Ngokuba ube yinqaba kwabampofu, inqaba kwabantulayo ekuxakekeni kwabo, umpheme esivunguvungwini nomthunzi ekushiseni, lapho umoya wabanonya unjengesivunguvungu ebusika,
Umsindo wabafokazi ufana nokushisa ezweni elomileyo, uyodambisa ukushisa ngomthunzi wamafu, uthulise nehubo labanonya.
Kule ntaba kaSimakade Wamabandla uyokwenzela zonke izizwe idili ngokukhulupheleyo nokunomnkantsha, idili lewayini eliqoqodileyo, elinenhlese ecwengekileyo.
Uyobhubhisa kule ntaba isembozo esemboze bonke abantu, nomgubuzelo ogubuzele zonke izizwe.
Ukufa kuyokugwinywa kuze kube phakade. INkosi uSimakade iyokuzesula izinyembezi ebusweni bonke, isuse ihlazo labantu bayo emhlabeni wonke ngokuba uSimakade ukhulumile.
Kuyothiwa ngalolo lusuku: “Bheka, lo unguNkulunkulu wethu; simlindele, futhi uyakusisindisa, sisinde. Masijabule, sithokoze ngensindiso yakhe.”
Ngokuba isandla sikaSimakade siyophumula phezu kwale ntaba. AbakwaMowabi bayodovadovwa endaweni yakubo, njengenqwaba yotshani bunyathelwa endundumeni yobulongwe.
Noma bephakamisa izandla zabo, bephakathi kwayo njengababhukudayo, bevula izandla zabo bebhukuda, ukuphakama kwabo kuyothotshiswa naphezu kokuba begwedla kangaka ngezandla zabo.
Izinqaba eziphakemeyo ezingangeni zakhe ziyobhidlizwa, ziyakuwiselwa phansi zidicilelwe emhlabathini, ngisho othulini imbala.
Ngalolo lusuku, ezweni lakwaJuda kuyohlatshelelwa lesi sihlabelelo esithi: Sinomuzi oqinileyo, usimisela insindiso ibe yizingange nezindunduma.
Vulani amasango ukuze isizwe esilungileyo esigcina iqiniso singene.
Inhliziyo eqinileyo uyayilinda ngokuthula okupheleleyo, ngokuba yethemba kuwe.
Thembani kuSimakade kuze kube phakade, ngokuba unguSimakade, yebo, uSimakade uyidwala elingunaphakade.
Uyothobisa abakhe endaweni ephakemeyo, umuzi ophakemeyo uwubhidliza awuthele othulini.
Unyathelwe ngonyawo, yizinyawo zabampofu, ugxotshwe nangabantulayo.
Indlela yabalungileyo iqondile, Wena Olungileyo uyenza ibe bushelelezi indlela yoqotho.
Simakade siyakulindela endleleni yezehlulelo zakho. Umphefumulo wami ulangazelela igama lakho, nezikhumbuzo zakho.
Ebusuku umphefumulo wami uyakulangazelela, ngiyokufunisisa ngomoya ongaphakathi kwami. Ngokuba lapho izehlulelo zakho zisemhlabeni, izakhamuzi zasemhlabeni zifunda ukulunga.
Uma omubi enzelwa umusa akakufundi ukulunga; ezweni lobuqotho wenza ukonakala, angabuboni ubukhosi bukaSimakade.
Simakade, isandla sakho siphakeme, kodwa abasiboni. Mababone intshisekelo yakho ngabantu bakho, babe namahloni; bazoqothulwa ngumlilo owubekele izitha zakho.
Simakade, uzosenzela ukuthula, ngokuba yonke imisebenzi yethu siyenzelwe nguwe.
Simakade Nkulunkulu wethu, sibuswe ngamanye amakhosi esikhundleni sakho, kodwa thina sidumisa igama lakho kuphela.
Abafileyo abasaphili, imimoya yabo ayiyukuvuka; yingakho-ke wabajezisa, wababhubhisa, wenza ukuba bangabe besakhunjulwa.
Simakade, usandisile isizwe, sanda, wadunyiswa, wandisa yonke imingcele yezwe.
Simakade, bakufunile besosizini, bazethula kuwe ngemikhuleko lapho ubasola.
Njengowesifazane okhulelweyo osezobeletha ekhaliswa yizinhlungu zokusikwa, saba njalo phambi kwakho, Simakade.
Sasikhulelwe, sisezinhlungwini, sazala umoya nje. Akukho nsindiso esayiletha emhlabeni, asizalanga bantu balo mhlaba.
Abafileyo bakho bayophila, izidumbu zabo zivuke. Vukani, nihlokome ngenjabulo nina enihlala othulini, ngokuba amazolo akho ayoba njengokukhanya kwasekuseni, nomhlaba uyokhipha abafileyo.
Hambani bantu bami, niye ezindlini zenu, nizivalele khona, nicashe isikhashana, luze lwedlule ulaka.
Bhekani, uSimakade uyaphuma endaweni yakhe ukuba ajezise abakhileyo emhlabeni ngenxa yesiphambeko sabo. Umhlaba uzodalula igazi elichithwe kuwo, ungabe usabafihla ababulawelwe kuwo.
Ngalolo lusuku uSimakade uyojezisa uLeviyathani ngenkemba yakhe enonya, elukhuni nemandla. ULeviyathani yinkanyamba esheshayo, futhi ethandelayo, uyobulala nenkanyamba yasolwandle ehlala khona.
Ngalolo lusuku kuyoba khona isivini esinxanelekayo. Hlabelelani ngaso, nithi:
“Mina Simakade ngingumlindi waso; njalo ngiyasichelela; ngisilinda ubusuku nemini, kungaze kube khona osonakalisayo.
Angisithukutheleli. Uma singivezela ameva namakhakhasi, ngizolwa nawo ngiwashise.
Kungenjalo, masithandele kimi ukuze sivikeleke, masibe nokuthula nami, masenze ukuthula nami.”
Ngesikhathi esizayo uJakobe uyogxila, u-Israyeli aqhakaze, akhahlele, athele izithelo, agcwalise umhlaba wonke.
Ngabe uSimakade ushaye u-Israyeli ngendlela abashaya ngayo abamshayayo na? Ngabe ubabulele ngendlela abulala ngayo abambulala na?
Ngokubaxosha nokubadingisa ubajezisile, wabasusa ngomoya wakhe onamandla, ngosuku lomoya wasempumalanga.

Ngalokhu ububi bukaJakobe buzohlangulwa, kube yisithelo esiphelele sokususa isono sakhe, lapho enza wonke amatshe ase-althare abe yimvithi afane nomcako, kungabe kusamiswa nsika engu-Ashera, ngisho nama-althare empepho imbala.
Ngokuba umuzi obiyelweyo usuyize, ikhaya lishiyiwe, lalahlwa, lanjengehlane; ithole seliklaba kulo, libuthise, lidle, liphundle amagatsha.
Lapho amagatsha awo esebunile, ayogencwa, kufike abesifazane baphembe ngawo umlilo. Ngokuba laba bantu bayisizwe esingenakuqonda; owabenzayo akayukubahawukela, nowababumbayo akayukuba namusa kubo.
Kuyothi ngalolo lusuku uSimakade avuthulule emfuleni omkhulu, kuze kufike emfuleni eGibhithe, nina bantu bakwa-Israyeli niqoqwe ngamunye ngamunye.
Ngalolo lusuku kuyobethwa icilongo elikhulu, labo ababedukele e-Asiriya nalabo ababexoshwe eGibhithe, bayofika badumise uSimakade entabeni engcwele eJerusalema.
Maye, kuwo umqhele wokuzikhukhumeza kwezidakwa zakwa-Efrayimi, nasembalini ebunayo yobuhle obukhazimulayo bawo, osenhloko yesigodi esivundile, salabo abanqotshwe yiwayini!
INkosi inalowo oqinileyo nonamandla, ngesandla sakhe uyogumbuqela umhlaba njengesivunguvungu esinesichotho, nesiphepho esichithayo, namanzi anamandla akhukhulayo.
Uyakufihliza ngezinyawo umqhele wokuzikhukhumeza, wezidakwa zakwa-Efrayimi.
Imbali ebunayo yobuhle bawo obukhazimulayo, osenhloko yesigodi esivundile, iyofana nekhiwane elivuthwe kuqala lingakangeni ihlobo, noma ngubani olibonayo ulikha alisobozele lisesesandleni.
Ngalolo lusuku uSimakade Wamabandla uyoba ngumqhele wobukhosi, nesicoco esihle ensalini yabantu bakhe.
Uyoba ngumoya wobulungiswa kumehluleli, namandla kwabavimba impi esangweni.
Abaphristi nabaphrofethi bacwile shi ezinkambeni, babona imibono eyize, bakhubeke ekwehluleleni. Labo ababhukuda ewayinini, babhamazeliswa wuphuzo olunamandla.
Wonke amatafula agcwele ubuhlanzo nokungcola, akusekho ndawo ehlanzekileyo.
“Ngubani ayomfundisa ukwazi, umbiko uyowuchazela bani na? Laba abalunyulwe ebeleni, bayekiswa ukuncela ubisi na?
Ngokuba kuyisiyalezelo phezu kwesiyalezelo, isiyalezelo phezu kwesiyalezelo, umthetho phezu komthetho, umthetho phezu komthetho, ingcosana lapha, ingcosana laphaya.”
Impela uyokhuluma kulaba bantu ngezindebe ezingingizayo nangolimi olungaziwayo.
Athi kubo: “Lokhu ngukuphumula, phumuzani abantekenteke; lokhu kungukuhlunyelelwa;” nokho abezwanga.

Ngakho-ke izwi likaSimakade yileli: isiyalezelo phezu kwesiyalezelo, isiyalezo phezu kwesiyalezo, umthetho phezu komthetho, umthetho phezu komthetho, ingcosana lapha, ingcosana laphaya, ukuze bahambe, bawe nyovane, bephuke, bacushwe, babanjwe.
Nina bantu abedelelayo, ababusa abantu baseJerusalema, yizwani izwi likaSimakade,
ngokuba nithe: “Senze isivumelwano nokufa, sivumelene nendawo yabafileyo; lapho isiswebhu esiyishoba sedlula, asiyukuza kithi, ngoba amanga siwenze ayisiphephelo sethu, sacasha phansi kwenkohlakalo.”
Ngakho-ke, ithi iNkosi uSimakade: “EZiyoni ngibeka itshe lesisekelo elivivinyekileyo, itshe legumbi eliyigugu elinqabileyo lesisekelo soqobo, owethembayo akayukuxhamazela.
Ubulungiswa ngizobenza umucu wokukala, ukulunga kube ngumthofu wokuqondisa, isichotho siyophephetha inqaba yamanga, amanzi akhukhule umpheme.
Isivumelwano senu nokufa siyochithwa, ukuvumelana kwenu nendawo yabafileyo akuseyukuma; lapho isiswebhu esikhukhulayo sedlula, siyonifihliza.
Njalo lapho sedlula siyonibamba. Siyodabula njalo ekuseni, nasemini nasebusuku.” Kuyokwesabeka kakhulu ukuqondwa kombiko.
Ngokuba umbhede uyokuba mfishane ukuba umuntu azelule kuwo, nengubo ibe ncane ukuba ayembathe.
USimakade uyophakama njengentaba iPharazimi, athukuthele njengesigodi iGibheyoni, ukuze enze umsebenzi wakhe, umsebenzi wakhe awejwayelekile, afeze umsebenzi wakhe, izenzo zakhe ezimangalisayo!
Manje maningedeleli funa izibopho zenu ziqiniswe, ngokuba ngisizwile isimemezelo sokubhubhisa wonke umhlaba, siqhamuka eNkosini uSimakade Wamabandla.
Lalelani, nizwe izwi, bekani indlebe, nilalele inkulumo yami.
Ngabe abalimi balima njalo bangayeki na? Badubuza amagabade, bambe imigodi na?
Lapho sebehlelembe umhlabathi abatshali yini imbewu eyehlukene ngemigqa ibhali nokolo endaweni yakho na?
UNkulunkulu wakhe uyamkhaliphisa, amfundise indlela eyiyo.
Uphoko alubhulwa ngesibhulo esibukhali, nesondo lenqola aliphendulwa phezu kwekhumini. Kodwa uphoko lushaywa ngenduku, nekhumini ngogongolo.
Okusanhlamvu kokwenza isinkwa kuyagaywa, kodwa umuntu akakubhuli njalo, ngisho engakufihliza ngenqola edonswa ngamahhashi, akusoze kwacoliseka.
Nalokho kuvela kuSimakade Wamabandla omangalisayo ekwalulekeni, nohlakaniphe ngokwedlulele.
Maye, kuwe Ariyeli, muzi lapho uDavide ake akanisa khona. Yengeza unyaka phezu komunye, imikhosi uqhubeke nokuyigubha njengenjwayelo.
Nokho ngizolikhathaza i-Ariyeli, kuzoba nokukhala nokulila, lizofana ne-Ariyeli.
NjengoDavide ngizokanisa, ngimelane nawe, ngikuhaqe nxazonke, ngikuvimbezele ngezinqaba, ngimise izindonga.
Uzodilizwa, ukhulume usemhlabathini, amazwi akho azophuma phansi othulini, izwi lakho livele emhlabathini njengelomthakathi, inkulumo yakho iyonyenyeza, ivela othulini.
Kodwa isixuku sezitha zakho siyofana nebhuqu elicolisekileyo, noquqaba lwabacindezeli lube njengamakhoba aphephukayo, kwenzeke ngokuphazima kweso.
USimakade Wamabandla uyokuhambela ngokushesha nangokuduma, nangokuzamazama, nangomsindo omkhulu, nangesivunguvungu, nangesiphepho nangelangabi lomlilo oqothulayo.
Isixuku sezizwe ezazilwa ne-Ariyeli, zilwa nalo nenqaba yalo, zilicindezela, ziyokuba njengesiphepho nanjengombono ebusuku.
Kuyofana nalapho umuntu olambile ephupha edla, kodwa avuke esalokhu elambile, noma owomileyo ephupha ephuza, kepha avuke eyethile wukoma. Siyoba njalo-ke isixuku sezizwe zonke ezilwa nentaba iZiyoni.
Zimangaliseni, nimangale; ziphuphuthekiseni nibe yizimpumputhe; dakwani, kodwa kungengawayini; bhamazelani, kodwa kungengaluphuzo olunamandla!
Ngokuba uSimakade uthululele kini umoya wobuthongo obunzulu, uvale amehlo abaphrofethi bakini, wemboza amakhanda ezangoma zakini.
Umbono ngakho konke lokho kimi wafana namazwi encwadi esicilelweyo, uma inikwa labo abakwazi ukufunda, nomyalo othi: “Fundani lokhu,” bayothi: “Ngeke sikwazi ukukufunda, ngokuba isicilelwe.”
Kuthi lapho inikwa labo abangakwazi ukufunda, kuthiwe: “Fundani lokhu,” bathi: “Asikwazi ukufunda.”

INkosi yathi: “Ngenxa yokuthi laba bantu basondela kimi ngemilomo nje, futhi bangidumise ngezindebe zabo nje, izinhliziyo zabo zibe zikude nami, ukungidumisa kwabo kungumyalo wabantu abawufundisiweyo nje,
ngakho ngizobuye ngibenzele izinto ezimangalisayo laba bantu, ezethusayo nezimangalisayo. Ukuhlakanipha kwezihlakaniphi zakhona kuzophela, nokuqonda kwabaqondayo bakhona kusitheke.”
Manje kwabafihlela uSimakade amasu abo, abazenzo zabo zisebumnyameni, abathi: “Ngubani osibonayo? Ngubani osaziyo na?”

Izinto niyazihlanekezela. Umbumbi angathathwa yini njengebumba na? Izinto ezenziweyo zingasho yini kumenzi wazo, zithi: “Akangenzanga.” Into ebunjiweyo ingasho yini kokubumbileyo, ithi: “Akazi lutho,” na?
ILebhanoni alizukuphenduka yini maduzane nje libe yinsimu yezithelo, kuthi nensimu yezithelo ibe yihlathi na?
Ngalolo lusuku izithulu ziyowezwa amazwi encwadi, amehlo ezimpumputhe ayobona ebumnyameni obuyisigayegaye.
Abathobekileyo bayofumana kabusha intokozo kuSimakade, nabantulayo phakathi kwabantu bayojabulela oNgcwele ka-Israyeli.
Ngokuba umcindezeli akaseyukuba bikho, kungabe kusaba khona sedeleli, bonke abaceba ububi bayoqedwa nya.
Ababeka umuntu icala ngezwa bethi, babekele ugibe umthethi wamacala esigcawini, bachezukise olungileyo ngento engelutho.
Ngakho-ke uSimakade owahlenga u-Abhrahama, uthi ngendlu kaJakobe: “UJakobe akasayukuba namahloni, nobuso bakhe abusayukuphaphatheka,
ngokuba nxa ebona izingane zakhe umsebenzi wezandla zami, phakathi kwakhe, ziyongcwelisa iGama lami, zingcwelise oNgcwele kaJakobe, zimesabe uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.
Abaduka emoyeni, bayofinyelela ekwazini, nalabo abakhonondayo, bayokwamukela umyalo.”
USimakade uthi: “Maye, kubantwana abahlubukayo, abenza amacebo okungewona awami, abenza isivumelwano esiphambene nomoya wami, ukuze bathasisele isono phezu kwesinye.
Abehlela eGibhithe ngaphandle kweseluleko sami, ukuze baphephele ekuvikelweni nguFaro, bafune ukukhosela emthunzini eGibhithe.
Ukukhosela kwenu kuFaro kuzophenduka ichilo kini, nokukhosela emthunzini eGibhithe kuyonithela ngehlazo.
Ngisho noma izikhulu zakhona ziseZowani, nezithunywa zakhona zifinyelela eHanesi,
bonke bayodumala ngenxa yabantu abangenakubasiza abangalethi nsizakalo nanzuzo, kunalokho bengamahloni nehlazo kuphela.”

Isiphrofetho maqondana nezilwane zaseNegevu. Badabula ezweni losizi nenhlupheko, elebhubesi nebhubesikazi, elebululu nenkanyamba; umcebo wabo bawethwesa izimbongolo, ingcebo yabo bayibeka emalundeni amakameli, bayiyisa kubantu abangenakubasiza ngalutho.
Ngokuba usizo lweGibhithe luyize, futhi alunto yalutho, yingakho ngilibiza ngoRahabi ohleze ethule.
Hamba manje, ukulobe phambi kwabo esibhebheni, ukubhale encwadini ukuze kuthi ngesikhathi esizayo kube ngubufakazi baphakade.
Bangabantwana abahlubukileyo, abantwana abaqamba amanga, abantwana abangathandi ukulalela umthetho kaSimakade,
abathi ezangomeni: “Ningasibhuleli,” nakubaphrofethi, bathi: “Ningaphrofethi okuliqiniso, kodwa sitsheleni izinto ezikhohlisayo, niphrofethe inkohliso;
chezukani endleleni, niphambuke emkhondweni, msuseni phambi kwethu oNgcwele ka-Israyeli.”
Ngakho-ke uthi oNgcwele ka-Israyeli: “Ngenxa yokuba nililahlile leli lizwi, nethembela ekucindezeleni nasenkohlisweni, nencika kukho,
ngalokho lobu bubi buyofana nomfantu ovulekile obondeni oluphakemeyo, osekuseduze lubhidlike, oluyowa ngokuphazima kweso, kungalindele muntu.

Luzobhidlizwa njengokuphahlazeka kwesitsha sombumbi, esiphihlizwa singahawukelwa, kuze kungabe kusatholakala phakathi kwezingcezu ngisho nelokuthatha umlilo eziko, nelokucakula amanzi kuwo umthombokwakhiwa.”
Ngokuba yasho njalo iNkosi uSimakade oNgcwele ka-Israyeli, yathi: “Lapho niphenduka niphumula, niyakusindiswa, amandla enu abe sekuthuleni nasekwethembeni, kepha anithandanga.
Kodwa nathi: ‘Qha, siyakubaleka ngamahhashi,’ ngakho niyakubaleka: ‘Siyakubaleka sigibele anejubane,’ ngalokho abanixoshayo bayakuba nejubane.
Inkulungwane iyakubaleka isongelwa ngoyedwa; kuthi ngokusongelwa ngabayisihlanu niyakubaleka, nize nishiywe ninjengensika esiqongweni sentaba, nanjengebhanela phezu kwegquma.”
Ngalokho uSimakade ulindele ukuba abe nomusa kini; ngalokho uyakuphakama abe nesihawu kini, ngokuba uSimakade unguNkulunkulu wobulungiswa; babusisiwe bonke abamlindelayo.
Wena sizwe esakhe eZiyoni, nina zakhamuzi zaseJerusalema, ningabe nisakhala; impela uyokwenzela umusa, lapho ezwa ukukhala kwakho, uyokuphendula.
Nakuba iNkosi ikunike isinkwa sosizi namanzi okuhlupheka, abafundisi benu abasayukucasha, kodwa amehlo enu ayakubabona abafundisi benu,
nakuba niphambukela ngakwesokunene noma ngakwesokhohlo, izindlebe zenu ziyakuzwa izwi emva kwenu, lithi: “Nansi indlela; hambani ngayo.”

Niyokuthatha njengokungcolile okunamekiweyo kwezithombe zenu ezibaziweyo zesiliva, nesimbozo sezithombe zenu zegolide ezibunjiweyo; niyakuzilahla njengokowesifazane okungcolileyo, nithi kukho: “Suka lapha.”
Uyonisa imvula embewini yenu eniyihlwanyela emhlabathini, aninike umhlabathi ovundileyo, uthele kakhulu, ube nokudla okuningi. Ngalolo lusuku imfuyo yenu iyoklaba emadlelweni abanzi.
Izinkabi nezimbongolo ezilima umhlabathi ziyokudla ukudla okuyolisiweyo, okweliwe ngefosholo nangembenge.
Kuzo zonke izintaba eziphakeme nasemagqumeni amade, kuyoqhuma imifula nemifudlana, ngosuku okuyoba khona ngalo ukubulalana okukhulu, lapho kubhidlika imibhoshongo.

Ngosuku uSimakade ayobopha ngalo amanxeba abantu bakhe, aphulukise izilonda abashaya zona; ukukhanya kwenyanga kuyoba njengokukhanya kwelanga, nokukhanya kwelanga kuphindwe kasikhombisa, kube njengokukhanya kwamalanga ayisikhombisa.
Igama likaSimakade liyeza, livela kude, livutha ulaka lwakhe, ligqunqile; izindebe zakhe zigcwele intukuthelo, nolimi lwakhe lunjengomlilo oqothulayo;
ukuphefumula kwakhe kunjengomfula okhukhulayo, oze ufinyelele ezinkwazini, ukuzohlunga izizwe ngesihlungo sokubhubhisa. Itomu elidukisayo liyoba semihlathini yezizwe.
Niyakuhlabelela njengasebusuku lapho kugujwa umkhosi, nithokoze ngenhliziyo njengalokho kuhanjwa kubethwa imitshingo, kuyiwa entabeni kaSimakade, kulo iDwala lika-Israyeli.
USimakade uyokwenza izwi lakhe elimangalisayo lizwakale, enze ingalo yakhe ibonakale yehla ngolaka lwakhe oluvuthayo, nangelangabi lomlilo oqothulayo, nangesivunguvungu, nangesiphepho, nangesichotho.
Ngokuba ngezwi likaSimakade, i-Asiriya liyothuthumela lapho elishaya ngenduku.
Konke ukushaywa uSimakade abashaye ngakho kuyohambisana nomculo wamahabhu nogubhu, alwe nabo empini, ebashaya ngengalo yakhe.
Indawo yakhe yokushisela ihlelwe kudala, ilungiselwe inkosi; uyenze yajula, yaba banzi, wabeka izinkuni eziningi, nokuphefumula kukaSimakade kunjengomfula wesibabule, kuyakuyithungela ngomlilo.

Maye, kulabo abehlela eGibhithe ukuyocela usizo, abethembele emahhashini nasezinqoleni zempi ngoba ziziningi, nakubagibeli bamahhashi ngokuba benamandla, kodwa bengabheki koNgcwele ka-Israyeli, bengamfuni uSimakade!
Naye uhlakaniphile, uletha inhlekelele, kalibuyiseli emuva izwi lakhe, kodwa uyomelana nendlu yababi, nosizo lwabenza okubi.
AbaseGibhithe bangabantu, abasiye uNkulunkulu, namahhashi abo ayizilwane, awasiwo umoya. Lapho uSimakade elula isandla sakhe, umsizi uyokhubeka, nosizwayo awe, babhubhe kanyekanye.

Usho kanje uSimakade kimi, uthi: “Njengengonyama ibhodla, nebhongo lengonyama ligwavuma phezu kwenyamazane, aliphazanyiswa wumsindo wokumemeza kwabelusi abaningi abasuke bebizwe ukumelana nalo, futhi alithikanyezwa ngumsindo wabo, kanjalo uSimakade Wamabandla uyokwehla ukuba alwe entabeni iZiyoni nasegqumeni layo.
Njengezinyoni ezindiza phezu kwamakhanda, kanjalo uSimakade Wamabandla uyolivikela iJerusalema, uyolivikela, alisindise, adlule phezu kwalo, alikhulule.”
Nina bantu bakwa-Israyeli, buyelani kuye lona enimhlubuke kakhulu kangaka.
Ngokuba ngalolo lusuku, kuyoba yilowo nalowo alahle izithombe ezibaziweyo zesiliva nezegolide, enizenze ngezandla zenu zaba yisono senu.
“Abase-Asiriya bayofa ngenkemba, kungeyona eyomuntu; inkemba okungesiyona eyomuntu iyobaqothula, bayothi galo yephuka phambi kwenkemba. Izinsizwa zakhona ziyoba yizisebenzi ezingakhokhelwa.
Idwala lalo liyoshabalala ngenxa yovalo, izikhulu zakhona ziyoshiya ibhanela, ngenxa yokudangala,” kusho uSimakade omlilo wakhe useZiyoni, nosithando sakhe siseJerusalema.
Kuyoba khona inkosi eyobusa ngokulunga, nezikhulu zibuse ngobulungiswa.
Yilowo nalowo uyofana nendawo yokukhosela emoyeni, nesivikelo esivunguvungwini, njengemithombo yamanzi endaweni eyomileyo, nanjengomthunzi wedwala ezweni eligagadekile.
Amehlo alabo ababonayo awayukuvaleka, nezindlebe zalabo abezwayo ziyokuzwa.
Izinhliziyo zabanamawala ziyokwazi, zihlolisise. Izilimi zabanamalimi ziyothombuluka bakhulume kucace.
Isiwula asisayukubizwa ngokuthi siyisikhulu, nomkhohlisi akusayukuthiwa uhloniphekile.
Ngokuba isiwula sikhuluma ubuwula, nengqondo yaso iceba ububi, yenza ukungalungi, ikhulume okuphambeneyo noNkulunkulu, ingamsuthisi olambileyo nowomileyo imncishe okuphuzwayo.
Izikhali zomkhohlisi zimbi, uhlela amacebo amabi, ukuze abhubhise abampofu ngamazwi angamanga, ngisho nalapho ontulayo ekhuluma okulungileyo.
Kodwa ohloniphekileyo uceba okuhloniphekileyo, futhi umi ngezinto ezihloniphekile.
Vukani nina besifazane abanethezekileyo, yizwani izwi lami, nibeke indlebe kwengikushoyo, nina madodakazi azethembayo.
Ezinsukwini ezingaphezu konyaka niyoqhaqhazela nina besifazane abazethembayo ngokuba iwayini eliphambili lizophela, nokuvunwa kwezithelo akuyukufika.
Thuthumelani nina besifazane abazinzileyo, nihlupheke nina enizethembayo, khumulani nibe nqunu, nibophe izinkalo zenu.
Thwalani imikhono emakhanda, ngenxa yamasimu amahle, nezivini ezithelayo.
Ezweni labantu bami kuyakumila amakhakhasi nameva, yebo, kuzo zonke izindlu zokujabula emzini ojabulayo.
Inqaba iyosala dengwane, kukhale ibhungane emzini obunabantu abaningi. Igquma nombhoshongo kuyoba yimigede kuze kube phakade; kube yinjabulo yezimbongolo zasendle nedlelo lemihlambi,
kuze kuthululelwe kithi uMoya ovela phezulu, ihlane liphenduke insimu yezithelo, nensimu yezithelo kuthiwe iyihlathi.
Ubulungiswa buyohlala ehlane, nokulunga kuhlale ensimini yezithelo.
Umsebenzi wokulunga uyokuba ngukuthula, umvuzo wokulunga ube ngukuthula nokulondeka kuze kube phakade.
Abantu bami bayakuhlala emathendeni okuthula, asezindlini eziphephileyo, nasezindaweni zokuphumula ezinokuthula.
Ihlathi liyovithizwa yisichotho, liphele nya, nomuzi udilizelwe phansi.
Nibusisiwe nina enitshala ngasemifuleni yonke, enivumela izinkabi nezimbongolo zihambe ngokukhululeka.
Maye, kuwe mbhubhisi ongakaze wena ubhujiswe, nakuwe mkhohlisi ongakaze yena akhohliswe! Uma nje sewuqedile ukubhubhisa, nawe uzobhujiswa; nalapho uyeke nje ukukhohlisa, nawe abantu bazokukhohlisa.
Simakade, yiba nomusa kithi, thina sikulindile Wena. Yiba yingalo yethu enamandla njalo ekuseni, nomhlengi wethu, ngesikhathi sokuhlupheka.
Lapho bezwa umsindo wenhlokomo, abantu bayabaleka; ngokuphakama kwakho, izizwe ziyahlakazeka.
Impango yakho iyobuthwa njengalapho kubuthwa isikhonyane, nanjengesikhonyane sitheleka phezu kwayo.
USimakade uphakeme, uhlala kweliphezulu, uligcwalisile iZiyoni ngobulungiswa nokulunga.
Uyoba ngukuzinza esikhathini senu, abe ngukuphelela kokusindiswa, ukuhlakanipha nokwazi; ukumesaba uSimakade kuyakuba yingcebo yakhe.
Lalelani ukukhala kwamaqhawe emigwaqweni, izithunywa zokuthula zikhala umunyu.
Kukhala ibhungane emigwaqweni, izihambi azisabonwa ezindleleni. Isivumelwano sichithiwe, imizi kayisanakiwe, nokuphila komuntu akushaywa mkhuba.
Izwe lididekile, lidangele, iLebhanoni lithelwe ngamahloni, liyabuna, iSharoni linjengehlane, iBhashani neKharmeli kuyavuthuluka.
“Manje sengizovuka” kusho uSimakade; “manje sengizophakanyiswa, sengizophakanyiswa impela.
Niyokhulelwa amakhoba, nizale amabibi, ukuphefumula kwenu kuzokuba ngumlilo ozoqothula nina uqobo.
Abantu bayosha njengokusha komcako, nanjengameva agawuliweyo; bayoshiswa ngomlilo.”
Yizwani nina enikude engikwenzileyo; nani eniseduze, vumani amandla ami.
Izoni eZiyoni ziyesaba, abangenabunkulunkulu bakhungethwe yitwetwe. “Ngubani phakathi kwethu ongahlala nomlilo oqothulayo na? Ngubani phakathi kwethu ongahlala namalangabi aphakade na?”

Yilowo ohamba ngokulunga, okhuluma okuqotho, ongayithathi inzuzo ngokungafanele, ongavumeli izandla zakhe zamukele imivuzo yobuqili, ovala izindlebe ukuze angezwa ngokuchithwa kwegazi, ovala amehlo akhe angabuboni ububi,
yena uyohlala endaweni ephakemeyo, imigede emaweni iyoba yizinqaba zakhe, uyophiwa isinkwa, ahlale njalo ethola amanzi.
Amehlo akho ayoyibona inkosi ebuhleni bayo, ayobona izwe elendlalekile.
Umqondo wakho uyocabanga ngovalo, uthi: “Uphi lona owabalayo na? Uphi lona owakala intela na? Uphi owabala imibhoshongo na?”
Awusayukubuye uzibone izidlova, abantu abakhuluma okungaqondakali nokungezwakali, abalulimi lukwitiza kungekho ongaluqonda.

Bheka, iZiyoni umuzi wemikhosi yethu emisiweyo. Amehlo akho ayakubona iJerusalema, indlu yokuthula, ithende elingenakususwa, okungekho muntu ongabhongcula izikhonkwane zalo, nezintambo zalo akuyukugqashulwa nanini.
Kodwa lapho uSimakade ebukhosini bakhe, uyokuba nathi khona endaweni yemifula ebanzi nemithombo, lapho kungahambi khona zikebhe ezigwedlwayo, kungadabuli mikhumbi emikhulu.
Ngokuba uSimakade ungumehluleli wethu, uSimakade usishayela imithetho, uSimakade uyinkosi yethu; Yena uyokusisindisa.
Izintambo zakho ziyaxega, azinakuyiqinisa insika endaweni yayo, azinakuwugcina useyili wendlalekile. Lapho impango ephangiweyo iyokwehlukaniswa ngobuningi, ngisho nezinyonga ziyothola impango.
Akukho sakhamuzi esiyothi: “Ngiyagula.” Abantu abahlala lapho bayothethelelwa iziphambeko zabo.
Sondelani nina zizwe, nizwe, nina bantu, lalelani! Mawuzwe umhlaba nakho konke okuwugcwalisile makuzwe izwe nakho konke okuphuma kulo.
Ngokuba uSimakade uthukuthelela izizwe zonke, ufuthekela yonke impi yazo; uzakuzibhubhisa, azinikele ukuba zibulawe.
Ababuleweyo bazo bayakulahlwa ngaphandle, kwenyuke ukunuka kwezidumbu zabo, kuncibilike izintaba ngenxa yegazi labo.
Ibandla lonke ezulwini liyakuphela, izulu lisongwe njengomqulu; ibandla lonke liyakubuna njengokubuna kweqabunga emvinini, nanjengokubuna kwekhiwane emkhiwaneni.
Uma inkemba yami isidle yaneliswa ezulwini, iyokwehlela phezu kuka-Edomi naphezu kwabantu engibamisele ukubabhubhisa ngesehlulelo.

USimakade unenkemba; igcwele igazi, izinonisile ngamanoni egazi lezimvana nelezimbuzi, nangamanoni ezinso zezinqama, ngokuba uSimakade uyanikela umhlatshelo eseBhozira, uyazihlabela kakhulu kwa-Edomi.
Izinyathi ziyokuwa kanye nabo, kuwe amavukana nezinkunzi ezinamandla. Izwe labo liyogcwala igazi, nothuli lwakhona lucifike amafutha.
Ngokuba uSimakade unosuku lwempindiselo, unonyaka wempindiselo ngenxa yeZiyoni.
Imifudlana iyophenduka ikolitayi, uthuli lwakhona lube yisibabule, nezwe lakhona libe yikolitayi elivuthayo.
Aliyukucinywa ubusuku nemini, intuthu yalo iyothunqa yenyuke kuze kube phakade. Liyohlala liyincithakalo izizukulwane ngezizukulwane, akukho muntu oyodabula kulo nanini.
Liyakuba yifa lonogolantethe nenhloli, kuyohlala isikhova negwababa kulo. Uyokwelulela phezu kwalo intambo yokukala yencithakalo, nomthofu wokumisa okuyize.
Bayolibiza ngokuthi: umbuso ongelutho, abantu nezikhulu zalo bayakuba yinto engelutho.
Kuyakumila ameva namakhakhasi ezindlini zamakhosi akhona, izinqaba zalo zibe yikhaya lezimpisi, nendawo yezintshe.
Izilwane zasendle ziyakuhlangana nezimpisi, kuyakumemezana izimbuzi eziyimilalandle, imimoya emibi yasebusuku, ihlale khona, izitholele indawo yokuphumula.
Isikhova siyakuzakhela isidleke lapho, sizalele kuso, size sichamsele, sifukamele ethunzini laso; kuyobuthana khona onhloyile, yilowo nalowo nomngani wakhe.
Funani encwadini kaSimakade, nifunde; akukho nokukodwa kwalokhu okungeyukuvela, ayikho engeyukuba namngani. Ngokuba uyalezile ngomlomo wakhe, noMoya wakhe wakuhlanganisa.
Ukwenzele unkatho, isandla sakhe sakukala ngentambo, sababela, kwaba yifa labo laphakade, izizukulwane ngezizukulwane ziyohlala kulo.
Kuyakuthokoza ihlane nendawo eyomileyo, kujabule ugwadule luqhakaze njengentebe.
Luzokhahlela kakhulu luthokoze, lujabule, lugide. Inkazimulo yeLebhanoni izobuyiselwa kulo nobukhosi beKharimeli nobeSharoni. Bayakubona inkazimulo kaSimakade, ubukhosi bukaNkulunkulu wethu.
Qinisani izandla eziyethileyo, niqinise amadolo axegayo.
Yishoni kwabanhliziyo enokwesaba, nithi: “Yimani isibindi, ningesabi, bhekani, uNkulunkulu wenu uyeza ngempindiselo, impindiselo kaNkulunkulu, nguye oza ukunisindisa.”
Amehlo ezimpumputhe ayakuvuleka, izindlebe zezithulu zivuleke,
izinyonga ziyakutshekula njengendluzele, nolimi lwesimungulu luhlabelele ngentokozo. Ngokuba kuyoqubuka amanzi ehlane, nemifudlana ogwadule.
Isihlabathi esishisayo siyophenduka ichibi, umhlabathi owomileyo ube yimithombo yamanzi; ikhaya lezimpungushe liyophenduka ixhaphozi, utshani bube ngumhlanga nekhwani.
Kuyakuba khona umendo nendlela eyakuthiwa iNdlela Yobungcwele; ongcolileyo akayukuhamba ngayo, kepha iyakuba ngeyabantu bakhe; abahamba ngayo, noma beyiziwula, abayukuduka kuyo.
Akuyukuba khona lapho ingonyama, nesilwane esihahayo asiyukukhuphukela khona; lokho akuyukufunyanwa khona, kepha abakhululiweyo bayakuhamba ngayo.
Abahlengiweyo bakaSimakade bayakubuya baye eZiyoni ngokwethaba, intokozo engunaphakade ibe phezu kwamakhanda abo; bayakuthola ukujabula nokuthokoza, kubaleke usizi nokububula.
Kwathi ngonyaka we-14 wokubusa kwenkosi uHezekiya, kwasuka uSanekheribhi, inkosi yase-Asiriya, wenyuka wahlasela yonke imizi yakwaJuda ebiyelweyo, wayidla.
Inkosi yase-Asiriya yathumela uRabi Shake, esuka eLakhishi, waya eJerusalema enkosini uHezekiya, enempi enkulu; wamisa ngasemseleni wechibi elingenhla, elingasendleleni yeNsimu Yomhlanzi.
Kwase kuphuma u-Eliyakimi, indodana kaHilikiya okunguyena owayephethe isigodlo, noShebhina umabhalane, noJowa indodana ka-Asafa, umgcini mlando, baya kuye.
URabi Shake wathi kubo: “Mtsheleni uHezekiya, nithi: ‘Isho kanje inkosi enkulu, inkosi yase-Asiriya, ithi: Yini lena owethembele kuyo na?
Ucabanga ukuthi ukukhuluma nje ngomlomo kungamasu namandla okulwa na? Ngubani owethembele kuye uze uhlubuke kimi na?
Wethembe intonga yalo mhlanga ofecekileyo oyiGibhithe, eligwaza isandla sanoma ngubani oncika kulo. Unjalo-ke uFaro, inkosi yaseGibhithe, kwabathembele kuye.’

Kodwa uma nithi kimi: ‘Sethemba uSimakade uNkulunkulu wethu,’ akusiye yini uHezekiya osuse izindawo zakhe eziphakemeyo nama-althare akhe, wathi kuJuda nakulo iJerusalema: ‘Niyakukhuleka phambi kwaleli althare’ na?
“ ‘Uma wenza isivumelwano nenkosi yami, inkosi yase-Asiriya, ngiyokunika amahhashi ayizi-2 000, uma ungase ukwazi ukugibelisa abagibeli kuwo.
Pho ungaphindisela kanjani emuva induna eyodwa ezincekwini ezincane zenkosi yami na? Nokho wethembele kwabaseGibhithe ukuthola khona izinqola nabamahhashi.
Manje ngeke ngenyukele yini kuleli lizwe ngaphandle kukaSimakade ukuba ngilichithe, na? USimakade wathi kimi: “Yenyukela kuleli lizwe, ulibhubhise.” ’ ”
U-Eliyakimi noShebhina noJowa, bathi kuRabi Shake: “Ake ukhulume ezincekwini zakho ngesi-Aramu, ngokuba siyasizwa, kodwa ungakhulumi kithi ngolimi lwabaJuda ezindlebeni zabantu abasogangeni.”
Kepha uRabi Shake wathi: “Ngabe inkosi yami ayingithumile yini enkosini yakho nakuwena ukusho lawa mazwi, nakulaba bantu abahlezi ogangeni ukuba badle indle yabo, baphuze umchamo wabo kanye nani na?”
Wayesema uRabi Shake, wamemeza ngezwi elikhulu, ngolimi lwabaJuda, wathi: “Zwanini amazwi enkosi enkulu, inkosi yase-Asiriya.
Isho kanje inkosi, ithi maningakhohliswa nguHezekiya, ngokuba akayukuba namandla okunikhulula;
futhi uHezekiya makanganenzi nethembe uSimakade ngokuthi: ‘USimakade uyakusikhulula impela, nalo muzi awuyukunikelwa esandleni senkosi yase-Asiriya.’

“Ningamlaleli uHezekiya, ngokuba isho kanje inkosi yase-Asiriya, ithi: ‘Yakhani uxolo nami, niphume nize kimi, nidle, kube yilowo nalowo emvinini wakhe, kube yilowo nalowo emkhiwaneni wakhe, niphuze, yilowo nalowo amanzi omthombo wakhe,
ngize ngifike, nginiyise ezweni elinjengezwe lakini, izwe lokusanhlamvu nelewayini, izwe lesinkwa nelezivini.’
“Xwayani ukuba uHezekiya anganiyengi ngokuthi: ‘USimakade uyakusikhulula.’ Onkulunkulu bezizwe bake bawakhulula yini amazwe azo esandleni senkosi yase-Asiriya na?
Baphi onkulunkulu baseHamathi nase-Ariphadi; baphi onkulunkulu baseSefarivayimi na? Balikhululile yini iSamariya esandleni sami na?
Ngobani phakathi kwabo bonke onkulunkulu balawa mazwe abake bakhulula amazwe abo esandleni sami, ukuba uSimakade angalikhulula iJerusalema esandleni sami na?”
Bathula, abamphendulanga ngazwi, ngokuba umyalo wenkosi, wathi: “Ningamphenduli.”
U-Eliyakimi, indodana kaHilikiya owayengamele indlu, noShebhina umbhali, noJowa, indodana ka-Asafa, umabhalane, baya kuHezekiya sebedabule izingubo zabo, bamlandisa amazwi kaRabi Shake.
Kwathi ukuba inkosi uHezekiya ikuzwe lokho, yaklebhula izingubo zayo, yagqoka indwangu eyisaka, yangena endlini kaSimakade.
Yathumela u-Eliyakimi owayengamele isigodlo, noShebhina unobhala, namalunga abaphristi, bembethe izindwangu ezingamasaka, baya ku-Izaya umphrofethi, indodana ka-Amozi.
Bathi kuye: “Usho kanje uHezekiya, uthi lolu wusuku losizi, lokukhankathwa nokwedelelwa. Abantwana sebelungele ukuzalwa, kodwa amandla okubazala awekho.

Mhlawumbe uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho uwezwile amazwi uRabi Shake awathunywe yinkosi yase-Asiriya, inkosi yakhe, okweyisa uNkulunkulu ophilayo, amsole ngawo uSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho; ngalokho phakamisela insali esaseleyo umkhuleko wakho.”
Izinceku zenkosi uHezekiya zafika ku-Izaya,
u-Izaya wathi kuzo: “Niyosho enkosini yenu, nithi: ‘Usho kanje uSimakade: “Ungawesabi amazwi owezwileyo, izinceku zenkosi yase-Asiriya ezingethuke ngawo.
Ngiyakubeka umoya kuyo, izwe amahemuhemu, ibuyele ezweni lakubo, ngiyiwise ngenkemba ezweni lakubo.” ’ ”
Wabuya uRabi Shake, wafumana inkosi yase-Asiriya ilwa neLibhina, ngokuba wayezwile ukuthi isukile eLakhishi.
Esezwile ngoThirahaka, inkosi yaseKhushe, kuthiwa: “Uphumile ukuzolwa nawe,” isikuzwile lokho, yathumela izithunywa kuHezekiya, yathi kuye:
“Anokuthi kuHezekiya, inkosi yakwaJuda: uNkulunkulu wakho omethembayo makangakuyengi ucabange ukuthi iJerusalema aliyukunikelwa esandleni senkosi yase-Asiriya.
Uzwile ukuthi amakhosi ase-Asiriya enzeni kuwo wonke amazwe ewabhubhisa; pho wena ucabanga ukuthi uyosinda kanjani na?
Onkulunkulu balezo zizwe bazophula yini izizwe ezabhujiswa ngokhokho bami, iGozani, iHarana, iRezefi, abantu base-Edene ababeseThelasari na?
Iphi inkosi yaseHamathi, neyase-Ariphadi, neyomuzi waseSefarivayimi, neyaseHena, neyase-Iva na?”
UHezekiya wayamukela incwadi esandleni sezithunywa, wayifunda; uHezekiya wayesenyukela endlini kaSimakade, wayendlala phambi kukaSimakade.
UHezekiya wakhuleka kuSimakade, wathi:
“Simakade Wamabandla, Nkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, oqhwakele phezu kwamakherubhi, unguNkulunkulu, Wena wedwa, wemibuso yonke yomhlaba, nguWena owenze izulu nomhlaba.
Beka indlebe yakho Simakade, ulalele; vula amehlo akho Simakade, ubone, yizwa wonke amazwi uSanekheribhi awathumelele ukweyisa uNkulunkulu ophilayo.
“Kuyiqiniso, Simakade, ukuthi amakhosi ase-Asiriya azibhubhisile izizwe zonke namazwe azo,
aphonsa onkulunkulu bazo emlilweni, nakuba bebengesibo onkulunkulu, bebengumsebenzi wezandla zomuntu, bewukhuni namatshe nje, ngakho-ke babhujiswa.
Manje, Simakade Nkulunkulu wethu, sisindise esandleni sakhe ukuze yonke imibuso yomhlaba yazi ukuthi Wena wedwa, unguSimakade.”
U-Izaya, indodana ka-Amozi, wayesethumela kuHezekiya, wathi: “Usho kanje uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, uthi: ngenxa yokuba ukhulekile kimi mayelana noSenakheribhi, inkosi yase-Asiriya,
nanti izwi uSimakade alikhulumile maqondana naye, uthi: “Uyakwedelela, uyakungcofa, ntombi, ndodakazi yaseZiyoni; ukunikinela ikhanda, ndodakazi yaseJerusalema.
Ngubani lona omedelelile, nomethukile na? Ngubani lona omphakamisele izwi lakho, nobhekisa amehlo akho phezulu, umqhoshela na? Ngabe ukwenza lokhu koNgcwele ka-Israyeli!

Ngesandla sezinceku zakho uyidelelile iNkosi, wathi: ‘Ngezinqola zami eziningi ngenyukele phezulu ezintabeni, kuze kube semikhawulweni yeLebhanoni; ngagawulela phansi imisedari yalo emide, nemisayiphuresi yalo ekhethekileyo, ngafinyelela emajukujukwini ekuphakameni kwalo, nasesijwini sehlathi elicinene.
Ngamba, ngaphuza amanzi; ngiyonyathela ngonyawo lwami, kome yonke imifula eGibhithe.’ ”
“Awuzwanga yini ukuthi lokhu ngakuhlela kwasemandulo na? Ngakuceba ngezinsuku zakudala, lokhu engikwenzayo manje ukucekela phansi imizi ebiyelweyo, ibe yizindunduma zemvithi.
Ababakhe kuyo baphelelwa ngamandla, besaba, bajabha; baba njengembali notshani obuluhlaza, njengokuluhlaza ophahleni lwezindlu, nanjengamabele antshwamile, engakakhuli kahle.
“Ngiyakwazi ukusukuma kwakho, nokuhlala phansi kwakho; ukuphuma nokungena kwakho, nokubhovumula kwakho ngami;
ukufutheka kolaka lwakho ngami, nokuzidla kwakho sekufinyelele ezindlebeni zami; ngizofaka ingwegwe yami emakhaleni akho, netomu lami emlonyeni wakho; ngikubuyisele emuva ngendlela oweza ngayo.
“Lokhu kuyakuba yisibonakaliso kuwe: “Kulo nyaka niyokudla okuzimileleyo, ngonyaka wesibili nidle okumila kulokho, ngonyaka wesithathu hlwanyelani nivune, nitshale izivini, nidle izithelo zazo.
Abasindileyo bendlu yakwaJuda, abaseleyo bayakubuye benabise izimpande, bagxile phansi, bathele izithelo phezulu.
Ngokuba eJerusalema kuyophuma insali, nabasindileyo entabeni iZiyoni; ukushisekela kukaSimakade Wamabandla kuyokufeza lokho.
“Ngalokho usho kanje uSimakade ngenkosi yase-Asiriya, uthi: “Ayiyukuza kulo muzi, ayiyukucibishela mcibisholo kuwo, ayiyukuza kuwo iphethe isihlangu, noma yenze kuwo izindunduma zokuhlasela.
Iyophindela emuva ngendlela eyeza ngayo; ayiyukuza kulo muzi,” kusho uSimakade.
“Ngiyakuwuvikela lo muzi ngiwusindise ngenxa yami nangenxa kaDavide inceku yami.”
Ingelosi kaSimakade yaphuma yabulala enkanjini yabase-Asiriya abayizi-185 000. Kuvukwa ngakusasa, babona ukuthi bonke babefile kuyizigingqane zezidumbu.
USenakheribhi, inkosi yase-Asiriya, wasuka wabuyela emuva, wahlala eNineve.

Kwathi esakhuleka endlini kaNishirokhi, unkulunkulu wakhe, amadodana akhe, o-Adiramelekhi noSarezeri, bambulala ngenkemba, base bebalekela e-Ararathi. U-Esarihadoni, indodana yakhe, waba yinkosi esikhundleni sakhe.

Ngalezo zinsuku uHezekiya wagula wabangwa nezibi. Kwase kufika kuye umphrofethi u-Izaya, indodana ka-Amozi, wathi: “Usho kanje uSimakade, uthi: ‘Lungisa izindaba zendlu yakho ngokuba uzokufa, ngeke uze usinde.’ ”
UHezekiya waphendulela ubuso bakhe obondeni, wakhuleka kuSimakade,
wathi “Ngiyakuncenga Simakade ukuba ukhumbule ukuthi ngihambe phambi kwakho ngeqiniso nangenhliziyo epheleleyo, ngenza okuhle emehlweni akho.” UHezekiya wayesekhala umunyu.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika ku-Izaya, lathi:

“Hamba uye kuHezekiya, uthi: ‘Usho kanje uSimakade uNkulunkulu kaDavide, ukhokho wakho, uthi: “Ngiwuzwile umkhuleko wakho, ngizibonile izinyembezi zakho; ngizonezelela iminyaka eli-15 ezinsukwini zakho zokuphila.
Ngizokusindisa, wena nalo muzi, esandleni senkosi yase-Asiriya, ngiwuvikele lo muzi.
“ ‘ “Yilesi isibonakaliso esivela kuSimakade sokuthi uSimakade uzokwenza lokho akwethembisile kuwe.

Bheka, ngizokwenza isithunzi selanga sibuyele emuva izinyathelo ezilishumi ebelizehlile ezitebhisini zika-Ahazi.” ’ ” Ngakho-ke ilanga labuyela emuva izinyathelo ezilishumi, ezinyathelweni elizehlileyo.
Ihubo likaHezekiya, inkosi yakwaJuda, emveni kokugula nokusinda kwakhe:
Ngathi: “Ngangiphakathi nempilo yami ngizongena emasangweni endawo yabafileyo, ngaphucwe ingxenye yeminyaka yami.”
Ngathi: “Angiyukumbona uSimakade, uSimakade ezweni labaphilayo; angisayukubona muntu phakathi kwabakhileyo ezweni.
Idokodo lami lisishuliwe, lasuswa kimi njengethende lomelusi; Njengomaluki, ukuphila kwami ngakusonga, uyanginquma esalukweni, kusukela emini kuze kube sebusuku uyayiphelisa impilo yami.
Ngakhala ngifuna usizo kwaze kwasekuseni; uyawephula wonke amathambo ami njengengonyama; kusukela emini kuze kube sebusuku, uyayiqeda impilo yami.
Njengenkonjane noma indwa ngiyatshiyoza, ngiyakhala njengejuba; amehlo ami akhathele ukubheka phezulu; Nkosi, ngicindezelwe, yiba lusizo lwami.”
Ngingathini na? Phela ukhulumile kimi, futhi ukwenzile yena. Ngiphelelwe ngubuthongo ngenxa yomunyu emphefumulweni wami.
Nkosi, abantu baphila ngalezi zinto, nokuphila komphefumulo wami kukuzo zonke lezi zinto; ngiphulukise, ungiphilise.
Impela, kwakungenxa yami ukuba ngibe nomunyu omkhulu; nguwena owawuthanda umphefumulo wami, waze wawophula egodini lokubhujiswa, ngokuba uzintshinge emuva kwakho zonke izono zami.
Ngokuba indawo yabafileyo ayinakukubonga, nokufa akunakukudumisa; abehlela egodini abanakuthembela ekulungeni kwakho.
Abaphilayo, abaphilayo bayakubonga njengami namuhla; oyise bayabazisa abantwana ngokuthembeka kwakho.
USimakade uyakungisindisa; ngalokho siyakucula sisine zonke izinsuku zokuhamba kwethu endlini kaSimakade.
U-Izaya wayethe: “Mabathathe isigaxa samakhiwane basibeke ethumbeni, ukuze asinde.”
NoHezekiya wayethe: “Sibonakaliso sini sokuthi ngiyokwenyukela endlini kaSimakade na?”

Ngalesi sikhathi uMerodaki Bhaladani, indodana kaBhaladani inkosi yaseBhabhele, wathumela izithunywa kuHezekiya ziphethe izincwadi nesipho, ngokuba wayezwile ukuthi uHezekiya kade egula kodwa useluleme.

UHezekiya wazemukela, wayesezikhombisa indlu yengcebo yakhe, isiliva, igolide, amakha, amafutha amahle, zonke izikhali zakhe, nakho konke okwakusendlini yokugcina ingcebo yakhe, akukho lutho esigodlweni sakhe nasembusweni wakhe angabakhombisanga khona.
Kwase kufika umphrofethi u-Izaya kuHezekiya, inkosi, wathi kuye: “Bebethini laba bantu; baphumaphi njengoba beze kuwe na?”
Waqhubeka, wathi: “Baboneni endlini yakho?” UHezekiya wathi: “Bakubone konke okusendlini yami; akukho lutho olusendlini yengcebo yami engingababonisanga khona.”
U-Izaya wathi kuHezekiya: “Yizwa izwi likaSimakade Wamabandla.
Izinsuku ziyeza, lapho konke okusendlini yakho, nalokho okhokho bakho abakugcinile kuze kube namuhla, kuyakuyiswa eBhabhele; akuyukusala lutho, kusho uSimakade.
Namanye amadodana akho oyakuwazala, ayakuthathwa abe ngabathenwa esigodlweni senkosi yaseBhabhele.”
Wayesethi uHezekiya ku-Izaya: “Lihle izwi likaSimakade olikhulumileyo.” Wathi futhi: “Ngokuba kuyakuba khona ukuthula nokulondeka emihleni yami.”
Duduzani, nibaduduze abantu bami, kusho uNkulunkulu wenu.
Liqungeni isibindi iJerusalema, nimemezele kulo ukuthi ukulwa kwalo sekuphelile, nobubi balo buhlanguliwe, ngokuba lamukele kuSimakade isijeziso ngokuphindiwe ngenxa yazo zonke izono zalo.
Izwi liyamemeza, lithi: “Lungisani indlela kaSimakade ehlane, nihlelembe umgwaqo kaNkulunkulu wethu ongcwele.
Zonke izigodi ziyophakanyiswa, zonke izintaba namagquma kuyokwehliswa; amagebhugebhu ayakuhlelenjwa, nemigoxigoxi iyakuba yithafa.
Inkazimulo kaSimakade iyobonakaliswa, bonke abantu bayakuyibona kanyekanye ngokuba umlomo kaSimakade ukhulumile.”
Izwi lithi: “Memeza!” Ngathi: “Ngiyakumemeza ngithini na?” Bonke abantu bangutshani, nabo bonke ubuhle babo bunjengembali yasendle.
Utshani buyabuna, imbali iyavuthuluka, ngokuba uMoya kaSimakade uyakuphephetha. Impela abantu bangutshani.
Utshani buyabuna, imbali ivuthuluke, kodwa izwi likaNkulunkulu wethu limi kuze kube phakade.

Khuphukela entabeni ephakemeyo, wena Ziyoni, ophethe izindaba ezinhle. Phakamisa izwi lakho ngamandla, Jerusalema ophethe izindaba ezinhle; liphakamise ungesabi, yisho emizini yakwaJuda, uthi: “Bhekani, nangu uNkulunkulu wenu.”
Bhekani, iNkosi uSimakade iyeza ngamandla; izobusa ngengalo yayo; bhekani, umvuzo wayo uza nayo, nenkokhelo yayo iphambi kwayo.
Iyokwelusa umhlambi wayo njengomelusi, iqoqe izimvana ngezingalo zayo, izigone esifubeni sayo, ihole ngesinono izindlezane.
Ngubani olinganise amanzi ngentende yesandla sakhe, walinganisa izulu ngeminwe eyeluliweyo, wahlanganisa uthuli esilinganisweni, walinganisa izintaba ngesikalo namagquma ngezisindo, na?
Ngubani oqondise uMoya kaSimakade, wamfundisa, waba ngumeluleki wakhe na?
Welulekana nobani waze wamnika ukuqonda, wamfundisa indlela yobulungiswa, wamnika indlela yokwazi, wamazisa indlela yokuqonda na?
Impela, izizwe zinjengethonsi esitsheni, zifana nothuli esikalini; uyakuphakamisa iziqhingi njengothuli olucolisekileyo.
ILebhanoni alanele ukushisa, nezilwane ezikulo azanele ukuba zibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa.
Zonke izizwe ziyinto engelutho phambi kwakhe, uzithatha njengento engelutho neyize.
Ningamfanisa nobani uNkulunkulu na? Ningamqhathanisa namuphi umfanekiso na?
Isithombe esibunjwe ngumbumbi, umkhandi wasinameka ngegolide, wasincibilikisela amaketanga esiliva na?
Ompofu ukhetha ukhuni olungaboliyo anikele ngalo, bese efuna ingcweti yombazi ukuba imenzele isithombe esibaziweyo, esingenyakaziswe.
Anazi yini? Anizwa yini? Anitshelwanga yini kwasekuqaleni, aniqondanga yini kwasekusekelweni komhlaba na?
NguYena ohleli esiyingelezini somhlaba, abakhileyo kuwo banjengezintethe; nguyena oweneka izulu njengekhethini, alendlale njengethende ukuba kuhlalwe kulo;
nguyena owenza izikhulu zibe yinto engelutho, abehluleli babe yize.
Bathi besanda kutshalwa nje, beqeda nje ukuhlwanyelwa, nesiqu sabo singakagxiliswa izimpande emhlabathini, wabaphephetha, babuna, isivunguvungu sabasusa njengamabibi.
“Ngubani eningamfanisa nami neningangilinganisa naye na?” kusho oNgcwele.

Phakamiselani amehlo enu phezulu, nibone. Ngubani odale lezo zinto na? Nguye okhipha amaviyo azo, awabale; azibize zonke ngamagama. Ngokuba unamandla amakhulu nezikhwepha zakhe zinkulu, yingakho kungasilele neyodwa.
Ukhulumelani wena Jakobe, usholoni wena Israyeli, ukuthi: “Indlela yami isithekile kuSimakade, nelungelo lami akalinaki uNkulunkulu wami na?”
Awuzange wazi yini? Awuzwanga yini na? USimakade unguNkulunkulu ongunaphakade, uMdali wemikhawulo yomhlaba, akapheli amandla, akakhathali; nokuqonda kwakhe akunakuphenywa.
Nguye opha oyethileyo amandla, andise izikhwepha kongenamandla.
Izinsizwa ziyaphela amandla, zikhathale, nabasha bawa nokuwa,
kepha abamethembayo uSimakade bayakuthola amandla amasha, bayakukhuphuka ngamaphiko njengezinkozi, bagijime bengakhathali, bahambe bengapheli amandla.
“Thulani phambi kwami, nina ziqhingi, izizwe mazithole amandla amasha, mazisondele bese zikhuluma, mazisondele zonke ukuba zehlulelwe ndawonye.

“Ngubani okuvusile ukulunga ukuba kuphume empumalanga, akubize ukuba kumlandele, anikele izizwe phambi kwakhe, anyathele amakhosi, awenze abe njengothuli ngenkemba yakhe, nanjengamabibi epheshulwa ngumnsalo wakhe na?
Uyabaxosha, adlule ngokuthula, kungathi kalubeki phansi endleleni unyawo lwakhe.
Ngubani okwenzileyo lokhu, wakudala, wabiza izizukulwane kwasekuqaleni na? Mina, Simakade ngingowokuqala, futhi ngingowokugcina.”
Iziqhingi zibonile, ziyesaba; imikhawulo yomhlaba iyathuthumela, iyasondela, futhi isifikile.
Yilowo nalowo usiza umakhelwane wakhe ethi esihlotsheni sakhe: “Yima isibindi.”
Umbazi uqunga umkhandi isibindi, nololonga ngesando uqunga oshaya isikhandelo isibindi, ethi konamathelisa ngomthofi: “Kuhle,” ekuqinisa ngezipikili, ukuze kunganyakaziswa.
“Kepha wena Israyeli, nceku yami, wena Jakobe engikukhethileyo, wozalo luka-Abhrahama umngani wami,
wena engikuthathe emikhawulweni yomhlaba, ngakubiza emajukujukwini awo, ngathi kuwe: ‘Wena uyinceku yami, ngikukhethile, angikulahlanga.’
Ungesabi, ngokuba Mina nginawe; ungabi naluvalo, ngokuba Mina nginguNkulunkulu wakho; ngiyakuqinisa, futhi ngiyakusiza, yebo, ngiyakusekela ngesandla sokunene sokulunga kwami.
“Bazoba namahloni, bajabhiswe bonke abakuthukuthelele, bayoba njengento engelutho, babhubhe bonke abamelana nawe.
Uyakubafuna, kodwa awuyukubafumana; labo bantu abaxabana nawe, abalwa nawe, bayakuba njengento engelutho, nanjengeze.
Mina nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wakho, okubamba ngesandla sakho sokunene, athi kuwe: ungesabi, ngiyakusiza.
Ungesabi wena mpethu, Jakobe, nani bantu bakwa-Israyeli; Mina ngiyokusiza,” kusho uSimakade uMhlengi wakho oNgcwele ka-Israyeli.
“Ngizokwenza ube yisibhulo esisha, esibukhali esinamazinyo; uyobhula izintaba, uzicolise, wenze amagquma abe njengamakhoba.
Uyowahlakaza, umoya uwasuse, isivunguvungu siwachithe; uyothokoza ngoSimakade, uzibonge ngoNgcwele ka-Israyeli.
“Abampofu nabaswelayo bafuna amanzi, kodwa abawafumani, ulimi lwabo lugagadekile wukoma; Mina Simakade ngiyakubaphendula, Mina Nkulunkulu ka-Israyeli angiyukubashiya.
Ngiyakuvula imifula emadulini angenalutho, nemithombo phakathi kwezigodi; ngiyalenza ihlane libe yichibi lamanzi, nomhlabathi owomileyo ube yiziphethu zamanzi.
Ngiyakutshala umsedari ehlane, umtholo, umbomvana, nomnqumo, ngibeke kwahlongasibi umsayiphuresi, umthidari nomkhoba kanyekanye,
ukuze babone futhi bazi, baqaphele, babe nokuqonda ukuthi yisandla sikaSimakade esenze lokho, nokuthi ngoNgcwele ka-Israyeli okudalile.
“Lethani udaba lwenu,” kusho uSimakade, “nisondeze izizathu zenu,” kusho iNkosi kaJakobe.
“Mabasondele, basitshele okuyakwenzeka, ukuthi zaziyini izinto zakuqala na? Mabasitshele zona ukuba sizibeke ezinhliziyweni zethu, sazi umphumela wazo, noma sazi izinto ezizayo.
Sitsheleni okuzayo ngesikhathi esizayo, sazi ukuthi ningonkulunkulu; yebo, yenzani okuhle noma okubi, ukuze sesabe, sikubone kanyekanye.
Bhekani, nivela ezeni, nemisebenzi yenu ayilutho; uyisinengiso onikhethayo.
