“Ndodana yomuntu, wena uhlala phakathi kwendlu ehlubukayo, banamehlo okubona kodwa ababoni, banezindlebe zokuzwa, kepha abezwa, ngokuba bayindlu ehlubakayo.

“Wena ndodana yomuntu, bopha umthwalo wakho ulungele ukuya ekuthunjweni, uzohamba uye ekuthunjweni emini kwabha, bekubuka. Suka endaweni ohlala kuyo, bebuka, uye kwenye indawo. Mhlawumbe bayakubona ukuthi bayindlu ehlubukayo.
Uyowukhipha umthwalo wakho emini bekubuka, njengomthwalo wabaya ekuthunjweni. Wena uyakuphuma kusihlwa bekubuka, njengalabo abaya ekuthunjweni.
Gebhula ugange bekubuka, bese uwukhipha lapho umthwalo wakho.
Uyakuwuthwala ehlombe bekubuka, uphume nawo sekuhlwile, umboze ubuso bakho ukuze ungaliboni izwe, ngokuba ngikwenze waba yisibonakaliso kuyo indlu yakwa-Israyeli.”

Ngenza kanjalo njengoba ngangiyaliwe. Ngawukhipha umthwalo wami emini kwabha, njengomthwalo wokuya ekuthunjweni. Kuthe kusihlwa ngagebhula ugange ngesandla, kwathi lapho sekumnyama, ngawukhipha umthwalo wami, ngawetshatha ehlombe, ngahamba bengibuka.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi ekuseni, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, ayibuzanga yini kuwe indlu yakwa-Israyeli, indlu ehlubukayo, ukuthi: ‘Wenzani na?’
“Yisho kuyo, uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Lesi yisiphrofetho esimayelana nesikhulu esiseJerusalema, nayo yonke indlu yakwa-Israyeli nabakulo.” ’ ”
“Yisho, uthi: ‘Mina ngiyisibonakaliso kini.’ “Njengalokhu ngenzile, kuyakwenzeka kanjalo kubo. Bayakuya ekuthunjweni beboshiwe.
“Isikhulu esiphakathi kwabo siyakuwetshatha umthwalo ehlombe kusihlwa, sihambe. Bayakugebhula ugange ukuze kukhishwe khona umthwalo; siyokwemboza ubuso baso, ukuba singaliboni izwe ngamehlo aso.
Ngiyakwendlala inetha lami phezu kwaso, sibanjwe ogibeni lwami, ngisiyise eBhabhele, ezweni lamaKhaledi. Kepha kasiyukulibona, siyakufela lapho.
Bonke abasizungezileyo, abasizi baso, nawo wonke amabutho aso, ngiyakubahlakazela kuyo yonke imimoya, ngibalandele, ngikhokhe inkemba.
“Bayakukwazi ukuthi Mina nginguSimakade, lapho ngibahlakazela ezizweni, ngibasabalalise emazweni.
Kepha ngiyakuyishiya insali eyingcosana, isinde enkembeni, endlaleni, nasobhubhaneni, ukuze ilande ngazo zonke izinengiso zabo ezizweni lapho beyakuya khona, bayakukwazi ukuthi Mina nginguSimakade.”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, yidla isinkwa sakho uqhaqhazela, uphuze amanzi akho uthuthumela, futhi wesaba,

bese uthi kubantu bezwe: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade kwabakhileyo eJerusalema, ezweni lakwa-Israyeli, ithi: “Bayakudla ukudla kwabo ngokwesaba, baphuze amanzi abo ngokuthuthumela, ngokuba izwe lakubo liyakuba yincithakalo, liphundlwe konke okugcwele kulo, ngenxa yobudlova babo bonke abahlala kulo.
Imizi okuhlalwa kuyo iyakubhujiswa, izwe libe yincithakalo, niyakukwazi ukuthi Mina nginguSimakade.” ’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, saga sini lesi eninaso ezweni lakwa-Israyeli, esithi: ‘Izinsuku ziyedlula, yonke imibono iphenduka ize’ na?

“Ngakho yisho kubo uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngizosiqeda leso saga, bangaphindi basisho nanini kwa-Israyeli,” ’ ” kodwa-ke khuluma kubo, uthi: “Izinsuku ziyasondela, nemibono iphelela ezeni.
“ ‘Ngokuba akusayukuba khona umbono oyize nokubhula okukhohlisayo endlini yakwa-Israyeli.

Kepha Mina Simakade ngiyakukhuluma lokho engiyakukukhuluma, izwi liyakufezeka, futhi aliyukubambezeleka, ngokuba ngezinsuku zenu, nina ndlu ehlubukayo, ngiyakukhuluma izwi, ngilenze, kusho iNkosi uSimakade.’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu; indlu ka-Israyeli, ithi: ‘Umbono awubonayo ungowezinsuku eziningi ezizayo, uphrofetha ngezikhathi ezisekude.’
“Ngakho-ke yisho kubo uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Wonke amazwi ami awayukubambezeleka; lokho engiyakukukhuluma kuyakufezeka,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, phrofetha umelane nabaphrofethi bakwa-Israyeli abaphrofethayo. Yithi kubaphrofethi abaphrofetha abakucabangayo: ‘Zwanini izwi likaSimakade.
Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Maye, kubaphrofethi abayiziwula, abalandela umoya wabo, nalokho abangakubonanga!
Wena Israyeli, abaphrofethi bakho bafana nezimpungushe ezindaweni eziyincithakalo.
Anenyukelanga ezikhaleni, navala ugange lwendlu ka-Israyeli, ukuze nimelane nempi ngosuku lukaSimakade.” ’ ”
Bakubonile okuyize namanga okubhula, labo abathi: “Kusho uSimakade,” kodwa uSimakade akabathumanga, nokho balindele ukuthi lifezeke izwi labo.
Anibonanga yini umbono oyize, nabhula okungamanga, lapho nithi: “Kusho uSimakade,” ngibe Mina ngingazange ngikhulume na?
“ ‘Ngakho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngenxa yokuba nikhulume okuyize, nabona okungamanga; ngalokho-ke, ngimelene nani, kusho iNkosi uSimakade.

Isandla sami siyakumelana nabaphrofethi ababona okuyize nababhula amanga. Abayukuba semkhandlwini wabantu bami, ngeke balotshwe encwadini yendlu yakwa-Israyeli, futhi abayukungena ezweni lakwa-Israyeli, niyakukwazi ukuthi Mina ngiyiNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Ngokuba, impela, babadukisile abantu bami, bathi: Ngukuthula, kube kungekho ukuthula, nangenxa yokuthi lapho kwakhiwa ugange, bona balugudule ngomcako.
Batshele abagudula ngomcako ukuthi luyakuwa ugange. Kuyakuna imvula enkulu enezikhukhula, nina matshe esichotho niyakuwa, nomoya wesivunguvungu ulubhidlize.”
“ ‘Lapho ugange seluwile, akuyukushiwo yini kini, kuthiwe: “Uphi umcako enigudule ngawo?” na?
“ ‘Ngakho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngiyakudedela isivunguvungu ngentukuthelo yami, nemvula enezikhukhula ngolaka lwami, kwehle isichotho ngolaka oluqothulayo.
Ngiyakulubhidliza ugange enalugudula ngomcako, ngiluthele othulini, kwambuleke nesisekelo salo. Luyakuwa, nina enikulo niqedwe nya, niyakukwazi ukuthi Mina nginguSimakade.
Ulaka lwami ngizolukhiphela ogangeni, nakulabo abalugudula ngomcako, bese ngithi kini: Alusekho ugange, abasekho nabalugudulayo,
abaphrofethi bakwa-Israyeli abaphrofetha kulo iJerusalema, nabalibonela imibono yokuthula, kube kungekho kuthula, kusho iNkosi uSimakade.” ’
“Wena ndodana yomuntu, bhekisa ubuso bakho kumadodakazi abantu bakini, umelane nawo, abaphrofetha okuvela enhliziyweni yawo, bese uphrofetha kuwo.

Uyakuthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Maye kwabesifazane abathunga izigqizo zezihlakala zezandla zabo bonke, benze amaveyili amade emakhanda ezithombe zonke, ukuze bazingele imiphefumulo yabantu. Niyoyizingela yini imiphefumulo yabantu bami, niyilondoloze eyenu imiphefumulo na?

Nina ningihlambalazile kubantu bami, ngoba nifuna inkeshezana yebhali nezingcezwana zesinkwa. Nibulale labo obekungafanele bafe, nalondoloza labo ebebengezukuphila, lapho nikhuluma amanga kubantu bami abawalalelile.”

“ ‘Ngakho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Mina ngimelene nezigqizo enizigome ngazo, nenizingela ngazo imiphefumulo njengezinyoni. Ngizakuzidabula ezingalweni zenu, ngikhulule imiphefumulo eniyizingela njengenyoni.
Ngizakudabula amaveyili enu amade, ngibakhulule abantu bami esandleni senu, bangaphinde futhi babe yimpango esandleni senu, niyakukwazi ukuthi Mina nginguSimakade.
Ngokuba nidabukise inhliziyo yolungileyo ngamanga; Mina angizange ngimdabukise; niqinise izandla zezikhohlakali ukuze zingaphenduki endleleni yazo embi, zisindiswe.
Ngakho anisayukukubona okuyize, anisayukubhula. Ngiyakubahlenga futhi abantu bami esandleni senu, niyakukwazi ukuthi Mina nginguSimakade.” ’ ”
Kwase kufika kimi amadoda angamalunga akwa-Israyeli, ahlala phambi kwami.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, lawa madoda azifake ezinhliziyweni izithombe zawo, abeka isikhubekiso sokona kwawo phambi kwawo. Imbala ngingawavumela yini nempela ukuba azobuza kimi na?

Ngakho-ke khuluma kuwo, uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Yilowo nalowo muntu wendlu yakwa-Israyeli, ofaka izithombe zakhe enhliziyweni yakhe, nobeka isikhubekiso sokona kwakhe phambi kwakhe, bese eza kumphrofethi, Mina Simakade ngiyakumphendula ngobuningi bezithombe zakhe,
ukuze ngibambe indlu ka-Israyeli ededileyo kimi ngenhliziyo yayo ngenxa yazo zonke izithombe zayo.” ’ ”
“Ngakho-ke yisho kuyo indlu yakwa-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Phendukani! Nilahle izithombe zenu, nizifulathele zonke izinengiso.

“ ‘ “Ngokuba yilowo nalowo owendlu ka-Israyeli nomfokazi ogogobele kwa-Israyeli, ozehlukanisa nami, afake izithombe enhliziyweni yakhe, abeke isikhubekiso sokona kwakhe phambi kwakhe, bese eya kumphrofethi ukuba abuze ngami, Mina Simakade, ngiyakumphendula mathupha.
Ngiyakubhekana ngqo nalowo muntu, ngimenze abe yisibonakaliso nesaga, ngimsuse kubantu bami, niyakukwazi ukuthi Mina nginguSimakade.
“ ‘ “Uma umphrofethi eyengeka bese ekhuluma izwi, Mina Simakade ngimyengile lowo mphrofethi; ngiyakwelulela isandla sami kuye, ngimelane naye, ngimbhubhise kubantu bami u-Israyeli.
Bobabili bayakuthwala icala, lowo obuzile uyakuba necala kanjalo nomphrofethi okubuzwe kuye,

ukuze indlu yakwa-Israyeli ingabe isaduka futhi isuke kimi, ingazingcolisi futhi ngazo zonke iziphambeko zayo, kodwa iyakuba ngabantu bami, Mina ngibe nguNkulunkulu wayo, kusho inkosi uNkulunkulu.” ’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, uma izwe lona kimi ngokwenza ukungethembeki, ngiyakwelula isandla sami ngimelane nalo, ngiqede umthombo walo wokudla, ngithumele indlala kulo, ngibulale abantu nezilwane okukulo.
Noma ngabe bekukhona kulo lawa madoda amathathu: uNowa, uDaniyeli noJobe, bona bebeyakuyisindisa impilo yabo ngenxa yokulunga kwabo, kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“Uma ngithumela izilwane zasendle ezweni ukuba zilenze lingabi nabantwana, libe yincithakalo, kungadluli umuntu kulo ngenxa yezilwane,

noma ngabe abekhona kulo lawo madoda amathathu, ngifunga ngiyagomela, kusho iNkosi uSimakade, abengeke akwazi ukusindisa amadodana namadodakazi awo, kodwa bekuyosindiswa wona kuphela, izwe libe yincithakalo.
“Nakuba ngehlisela inkemba ezweni, ngithi: ‘Inkemba mayidabule ezweni,’ ngibulale kulo abantu nezilwane,
noma ngabe abekhona lawo madoda amathathu kulo, ngifunga ngiyagomela, kusho iNkosi uSimakade, abengeke akwazi ukusindisa amadodana namadodakazi awo, kodwa bekuyosindiswa wona kuphela.
“Nakuba bengiyakuthumela ubhubhane kulelo lizwe, ngithululele kulo ulaka lwami ngokuba kuchitheke igazi ukuba ngiqede nya abantu nezilwane kulo,

noma ngabe bekungaba khona uNowa, uDaniyeli, noJobe kulo, ngifunga ngiyagomela, kusho iNkosi uSimakade, bebengeke bakwazi ukusindisa amadodana namadodakazi awo, kodwa bebeyosindisa impilo yabo kuphela, ngenxa yokulunga kwabo.

“Ngokuba isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Kakhulu kangakanani, lapho sengithumela eJerusalema izehlulelo zami ezine ezimbi: inkemba, indlala, izilwane zasendle nobhubhane, ukuba kubhubhise izilwane nabantu okukulo!

Kepha, kuyosala kulo insali ephunyukileyo; amadodana namadodakazi ayakukhishwa kulo, ayokuza kini, kuyothi lapho nibona ukuziphatha kwawo nemisebenzi yawo, niduduzeke, ngenxa yobubi engibenze behlela iJerusalema, nangenhlekelele engiyehlisele phezu kweJerusalema.’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, kungani ukuba ukhuni lomvini luyedlule yonke eminye imithi, negatsha lomvini phakathi kwezinye izihlahla ehlathini na?
Kungathathwa yini ukhuni kuwo ukuba kwenziwe ngalo okuthile na? Abantu bangawenza yini amahhuku okuphanyeka okuthile?
Lapho selufakwe emlilweni ukuba kubaswe izihloko zalo zombili sezidliwe ngumlilo, kanjalo nesiqu salo sesishile, ngabe lusenawo yini umsebenzi na?
Uma ngesikhathi lusaphelele belungenamsebenzi walutho, kungenziwani ngalo lapho seludliwe ngumlilo, lwasha na?
“Ngakho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘njengokhuni lomvini oluphakathi kwezihlahla zehlathi, engilunikele emlilweni ukuba lushe, kanjalo-ke ngizinikele izakhamuzi zaseJerusalema.
Ngiyakubhekana nazo ngqo, ngimelane nazo, nakuba ziphumile emlilweni, nokho ziyakuqedwa yiwo umlilo, niyakukwazi ukuthi Mina nginguSimakade lapho sengibhekene nazo ngqo.
Izwe ngiyakulenza libe yincithakalo, ngokuba abethembekanga, kusho iNkosi uSimakade.’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, lazise iJerusalema ngezinengiso zalo,
uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade kulo iJerusalema, ithi: “Indabuko yakho nokuzalwa kwakho kuseKhanani. Uyihlo wayengumAmoni, unyoko engumHithi.
Ekuzalweni kwakho, ngosuku owazalwa ngalo, inkaba yakho ayinqunywanga, awugezwanga ngamanzi ukuba uhlambuluke, awuhlikihlwanga ngosawoti, awusongwanga nakusongwa.
Akukho liso elakubheka lakuhawukela ukuba wenzelwe okukodwa kwalokho, ukhonjiswe ububele, kodwa walahlwa endle, ngokuba wanengeka ngosuku owazalwa ngalo.
“ ‘ “Ngesikhathi ngidlula ngakuwe, ngakubona ungqashangqasha egazini lakho, ngathi kuwe: wena osegazini lakho: Phila! Yebo, ngasho kanjalo usegazini lakho, ngathi kuwe: Phila!
Wande njengehlumela lasendle. Ngakwenza wakhula, waba muhle kakhulu; wahlosa amabele, wamila izinwele, kodwa wawunqunu, uhamba ze.

“ ‘ “Ngesikhathi ngiphinda ngidlula ngakuwe, ngakubuka; ngabona ukuthi usukhulile, usungathanda. Ngase ngendlala isembatho sami phezu kwakho, ngafihla ubunqunu bakho, yebo, ngafunga kuwe, ngenza nawe isivumelwano,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade, waba ngowami.
“ ‘ “Ngakugeza emanzini, ngasusa igazi elalikuwe, ngakugcoba ngamafutha.
Ngakwembesa ngengubo efekethisiweyo, ngakufaka izicathulo zesikhumba, ngakwethwesa ilineni elicolekileyo ekhanda, ngase ngikwemboza ngosilika.
Ngakuvunulisa ngemvunulo kanokusho, ngakufaka amasongo ezandleni zakho nomgexo entanyeni.
Ngakufaka indandatho ekhaleni, amacici ezindlebeni zakho, nomqhele omuhle ekhanda lakho.

Wahlotshiswa ngegolide nangesiliva, isembatho sakho sasiyilineni elicolekileyo, usilika, nengubo efekethisiweyo. Wadla impuphu ecolisekileyo, uju, namafutha. Impela wawumuhle kakhulu, waphumelela, waze waba yindlovukazi.
Igama lakho laduma ezizweni ngenxa yobuhle bakho, ngokuba laliphelele ngenxa yemihlobiso engangikuvunulise ngayo,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Kepha wethembela ebuhleni bakho, waba yisifebe ngenxa yodumo lwakho, wabuthululela bonke ubufebe bakho kwabadlulayo, baba ngobabo.
Wathatha ezinye zezingubo zakho, wazenzela izindawo eziphakemeyo ezikhangayo, wafebela kuzo, okungakaze kwenzeke futhi okungasoze kwenzeka nanini.
Wathatha imvunulo yobuhle bakho, egolideni lami nasesiliveni lami engangikuphe khona, wazenzela izithombe zabesilisa, wafeba nazo.
Wathatha izingubo zakho ezifekethisiweyo, wasibekela ngazo izithombe, wabeka amafutha ami nempepho yami phambi kwazo.

Wathatha nesinkwa sami engangikunike sona, impuphu ecolisekileyo, amafutha, noju engangikunike khona ukuba ukudle, wakubeka phambi kwazo, kwaba yiphunga elimnandi; kwaba kanjalo-ke,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Wathatha amadodana namadodakazi akho owawungizalele wona, wawahlabela zona ukuba azidle. Babubuncane yini ubufebe bakho na?
Wabulala abantwana bami, wanikela ngabo kuzo, wabadabulisa emlilweni.
Kuzo zonke izinengiso owazenza, nobufebe bakho, awuzikhumbulanga izinsuku zobusha bakho, ngesikhathi wawunqunu, uhamba ze, ungqashangqasha egazini lakho.
“ ‘ “Maye! Maye,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade. “ ‘ “Ngokuba kwathi emveni kwakho konke lokho kona kwakho,
wazakhela iqhugwane, wazenzela indawo ephakemeyo ezigcawini zonke.
Ekuqaleni kwayo yonke imigwaqo, wakha izindawo zakho eziphakemeyo, wenza ubuhle bakho baba yisinengiso, imilenze yakho wayenekela bonke abedlulayo, wandisa ubufebe bakho.
Wafeba nabaseGibhithe, omakhelwane bakho, abagcwele inkanuko enkulu, wandisa ubufebe bakho ukuba ungichukuluze, ukuze ngithukuthele.
Ngelulela isandla sami kuwe, ngamelana nawe, ngasinciphisa isabelo sakho sokudla, ngakunikela entandweni yabakuzondayo. Amadodakazi amaFilisti ayenamahloni ngendlela owawulihathanga ngayo.
Wafeba nabantu base-Asiriya, ngokuba wawungeneliswa; yebo, wafeba nabo, kodwa kuze kube manje awukadeli.
Wandisa ubufebe bakho baze bafinyelela nasezweni labahwebi, iKhalideya, kepha nalokho akukwenelisanga.
“ ‘ “Maye, ubuthakathaka benhliziyo yakho, ngokuba wenza konke lokhu okwenziwe yisifebe esingakwazi ukuzithiba!” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Lapho wakha iqhugwane lakho ekuqaleni kwemigwaqo, wenza indawo yakho ephakemeyo kuzo zonke izigcawu, wawungafani nesifebe esikhokhelwayo,
wena mfazi ophingayo, othatha abafokazi esikhundleni sendoda yakhe.
Zonke izifebe ziyakhokhelwa, kodwa wena nguwe okhokhela zonke izithandwa zakho, uzifumbathisile ukuba zize kuwe, zivela ezindaweni zonke, ngobufebe bakho.
Wehlukile kwabanye besifazane ngokufeba kwakho, akekho okulandelayo ukuze afebe nawe, ngokuba nguwe okhokhayo; wena awukhokhelwa lutho, ngalokho-ke wena wehlukile kwezinye izifebe.
“ ‘ “Ngakho-ke sifebe ndini, yizwa izwi likaSimakade.

Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: Ngenxa yokuthi inkanuko yakho ithululiwe, nobunqunu bakho bembuliwe ngobufebe bakho nezithandwa zakho, nangenxa yazo zonke izithombe zakho eziyizinengiso, nangegazi labantwana bakho owanikela ngalo;

ngakho-ke bheka, ngiyakuziqoqa zonke izithandwa zakho ozithokozise ngazo, zonke ozithandileyo, nazo zonke ozizondileyo; ngiyakuziqoqela kuwe zivela kuzo zonke izindawo, ngizembulele ubunqunu bakho ukuba zibubone bonke.
Ngiyakukwehlulela ngesehlulelo seziphingikazi nesabachithi begazi, ngehlisele phezu kwakho igazi lolaka nomhawu.
Ngiyakukunikela ezandleni zazo, zilibhidlize iqhugwane lakho, zizidilize izindawo zakho eziphakemeyo, zikuhlubule izingubo zakho, zithathe izinto zakho ezinhle, zikushiye unqunu, uhamba ze.
Ziyakuza kuwe nesixuku, zikukhande ngamatshe, zikuhlahlele ngezinkemba zazo.
Ziyakushisa izindlu zakho ngomlilo, zikwehlulele phambi kwabesifazane abaningi. Ngiyakukwenza ukuba uyeke ukufeba, ungabe usakhokhela muntu.
Ngiyakulubohlisa ulaka lwami kuwe, ngisuse umona wami kuwe, ngibe nokuthula, ngingabe ngisakuthukuthelela futhi.

“ ‘ “Ngenxa yokuthi awuzikhumbulanga izinsuku zobusha bakho, kodwa ungithukuthelisile ngakho konke lokhu, nami-ke ngizokwehlisela phezu kwekhanda lakho konke okwenzileyo, ukuze ungabe usazikhanukela zonke ezinye izinengiso zakho,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Bonke abacaphuna izaga, bayakucaphuna lesi mayelana nawe, bathi: Ukhamba lufuze imbiza.
“ ‘ “Wena ufuze unyoko, owayenengwa yindoda yakhe, nayizingane zakhe. Ungudade owayenodadewabo, ababenengwa ngamadoda abo nabantwana babo. Unyoko wayengumHithi, uyihlo engumAmori.
Udadewenu omdala kwakuyiSamariya, amadodakazi akhe, akhe ngasenyakatho yakho. Udadewenu omncane kunawe, wayehlala ngaseningizimu kwakho, uyiSodoma namadodakazi alo.
Awuhambanga njengezindlela zabo, awenzanga njengezinengiso zabo, kodwa ngesikhashana nje esincane, wena wonakala ukwedlula bona, ezindleleni zakho zonke.
Ngifunga ngiyagomela,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade, “ ‘ “udadewenu uSodoma namadodakazi akhe, akenzanga njengoba kwenze wena namadodakazi akho.
“ ‘ “Nakhu okwakungukona kukadadewenu uSodoma: ukuzikhukhumeza, ukuba yisiminzi, nokunethezeka namadodakazi akhe; kodwa ababasizanga abampofu nabantulayo.
Babeziphakamisa, benza izinengiso phambi kwami, ngase ngibasusa njengokubona kwami.
ISamariya, izono elizenzileyo azisiyo ngisho ingxenye yezono zakho; wena wandise kakhulu izinengiso zakho kunabo, odadewenu ubenze babukeka belungile kunawe ngenxa yalezi zinengiso ozenzileyo.
Zithwalele ihlazo lakho, ngokuba ubavunile odadewenu ngezono zakho ozenzileyo ezinengekayo; bona sebelungile kunawe. Yebo, mawujabhe, ulithwale ihlazo lakho lokubavuna odadewenu.
“ ‘ “Ngiyakukuguqula ukuthunjwa kwabo, ukuthunjwa kweSodoma namadodakazi alo, nokuthunjwa kweSamariya namadodakazi alo, nokuthunjwa kwabo bonke abathunjiweyo abaphakathi kwabo,
ukuze ulithwale ihlazo lakho, uthunazeke ngenxa yakho konke okwenzileyo, lapho ubaduduza.
Odadewenu, iSodoma namadodakazi alo, bayakubuyela esimweni sabo sokuqala, neSamariya namadodakazi alo, bayakubuyela esimweni sabo sokuqala, wena namadodakazi akho niyakubuyela esimweni senu sokuqala.
Udadewenu uSodoma awukhulumanga kahle ngaye ngesikhathi usazikhukhumeza,
lapho bungakambulwa ububi bakho, njengasesikhathini sehlazo lamadodakazi ase-Aramu, nawo wonke amadodakazi amaFilisti alizungezileyo, akudumaza nhlangothi zonke.
Uyakulithwala icala lokukhanuka kwakho nezinengiso zakho,” ’ ” kusho uSimakade.
“ ‘Ngokuba isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngizokwenza uvune okutshalileyo, udelele isifungo ngokwephula isivumelwano.
Kepha Mina ngiyakusikhumbula isivumelwano sami nawe, sasemihleni yobusha bakho, bese ngikumisela isivumelwano saphakade.
Uyakuzikhumbula izindlela zakho, ube namahloni, lapho wemukela odadewenu, omdala kunawe nomncane kunawe, ngikunike bona babe njengamadodakazi, kodwa hhayi ngenxa yesivumelwano sami nawe.
Ngiyakumisa isivumelwano sami nawe, wazi ukuthi nginguSimakade,
ukuba ukhumbule, ube namahloni, ungabe usawuvula umlomo wakho futhi, ngenxa yehlazo lakho, lapho sengikuthethelele konke okwenzileyo,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, banike imfumbe, ukhulume ngomfanekiso kuyo indlu yakwa-Israyeli,
uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ukhozi olukhulu olunamaphiko amakhulu nezimpaphe ezinkulu, lunezimpaphe eziningi ezinemibala eyehlukeneyo, lwafika eLebhanoni, lwathatha isihloko somsedari,
lwanquma igatsha elisha eliphezulu, lwaluyisa ezweni labahwebi, lwalubeka emzini wabathengi.
“ ‘ “Lwathatha embewini yezwe, lwayoyitshala emhlabathini ovundileyo, lwayihlwanyela ngasemanzini amaningi, lwayitshala njengomnyezane.
Yamila yaba ngumvini owenabayo, nokho omfushane, ukuze amagatsha awo abheke ngakuwo, nezimpande zawo zibe phansi kwawo. Waba ngumvini-ke, waba namagatsha, kwavela amahlumela.

“ ‘ “Kepha kwafika olunye ukhozi olukhulu futhi, lunamaphiko amakhulu nezimpaphe eziningi. Lo mvini-ke wabhekisa izimpande zawo ngakulo, amagatsha awo lwawenabisela kulo ukuze luwunisele, lapho wawutshalwe khona.
Wawusemhlabathini omuhle ngasemanzini amaningi ukuba uveze amagatsha, uthele izithelo, ube ngumvini omuhle.” ’ ”

“Batshele uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngabe uyakuphumelela na? Ukhozi aluyukuzisiphula yini izimpande zawo, lunqume izithelo zawo, ukuze ubune, kubune wonke amaqabunga abehlume kuwo, bese kungadingeki amandla amakhulu nabantu abaningi ukuba usishulwe nezimpande zawo na?
Pho lapho usutshaliwe, uyakuphumelela yini na? Awuyukubuna nokubuna yini lapho ushaywa ngumoya wasempumalanga, lapho utshalwe khona na?” ’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:

“Ake ukhulume kuyo indlu ka-Israyeli ehlubukayo, uthi: ‘Anazi yini ukuthi lezi zinto ziyini na?’ Yisho uthi: ‘Inkosi yaseBhabhele yaya eJerusalema, yathumba inkosi yalo nezikhulu zakhona, yaziyisa kanye nayo eBhabhele.
Yayisithatha owozalo lwasebukhosini, yenza naye isivumelwano, yamfungisa, yathumba nabaholi balelo lizwe,
ukuze umbuso uthotshiswe, ungaziphakamisi, kodwa uqhubeke nokugcina isivumelwano sakhe.

Kepha inkosi yayivukela inkosi yaseBhabhele ngokuthumela izithunywa zayo eGibhithe, ukuba ithole amahhashi nabantu abaningi. Uyophumelela yini na? Uyophunyuka yini owenza lezi zinto? Uyophunyuka yini owephula isivumelwano na?
“ ‘Ngifunga ngiyagomela,’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade, “ ‘impela endaweni yenkosi eyambeka waba yinkosi, wedelela isifungo sayo, wasaphula isivumelwano sayo; naye uyakufela khona eBhabhele.
UFaro, ngempi yakhe enkulu nebandla elikhulu analo, akayukumsiza empini, nalapho kwenziwa indunduma, kwakhiwa udonga lokuvimbezela ukuze kubulawe abantu abaningi.
Ngokuba wedelele isifungo ngokwephula isivumelwano, wenza konke lokho nakuba ethembisile; ngakho-ke akayukuphunyuka.
“ ‘Ngakho-ke’ ” isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘Ngifunga ngiyagomela, impela isifungo sami asedeleleyo, nesivumelwano sami asaphulileyo; ngiyakukwehlisela phezu kwekhanda lakhe.
Ngiyakwendlala inetha lami phezu kwakhe, abanjwe ogibeni lwami, ngimyise eBhabhele, ngimehlulele khona lapho ngokungethembeki kwakhe kimi.
Kuyakuthi bonke ababalekayo bempi yakhe, bawe ngenkemba, kuthi abasindileyo bahlakazelwe kuzo zonke izindawo, kulapho-ke niyokwazi ukuthi Mina Simakade ngikhulumile.’
“Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Mina luqobo, ngiyakuthatha esihlokweni somsedari omude, ngitshale, nginqume emagatsheni amasha aphezulu, elithambileyo, ngilitshale entabeni ende ephakemeyo,

ngilitshale esicongweni sentaba yakwa-Israyeli; lihlume amagatsha, lithele izithelo, libe ngumsedari omuhle; kuhlale phansi kwamagatsha awo zonke izinyoni ezinhlobonhlobo, zihlale emthunzini wamagatsha awo.

Zonke izihlahla zasendle ziyakukwazi ukuthi Mina Simakade ngenza isihlahla eside sibhashe kuthi esibhashile ngisenze sikhule sibe side. Ngiyasomisa isihlala esiluhlaza, bese ngisihlumisa esomileyo sibe luhlaza. “ ‘Mina Simakade ngikhulumile futhi ngiyakukwenza lokho.’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Kungani nisho lesi saga kwa-Israyeli, esithi: “ ‘Oyise badla amagilebhisi amuncu, amazinyo abantwana aba buthuntu,’ na?
“Ngifunga ngiyagomela,” kusho iNkosi uSimakade, “asisayukubuye sishiwo lesi saga kwa-Israyeli.
Bheka, yonke imiphefumulo ingeyami. Umphefumulo kayise kanjalo nomphefumulo wengane ingeyami; umphefumulo owonayo, uyakufa.
“Uma umuntu olungileyo enza ubulungiswa nokulunga,
engadli ezintabeni, engaphakamiseli amehlo akhe ezithombeni zendlu yakwa-Israyeli, enganukubezi umfazi kamakhelwane wakhe, engasondeli kowesifazane osesikhathini,
engacindezeli muntu, ebuyisela kotshelekayo isibambiso sakhe, engaphangi nokuphanga, kepha epha abalambileyo isinkwa sakhe, embathisa abanqunu,
engabolekisi ukuze athole inzalo, engamukeli nzuzo ngokungafanele, eziqoqa ebubini, enza ubulungiswa phakathi kwabantu abaphikisanayo,
futhi ehamba ngezimiso zami, egcina izehlulelo zami ukuze enze iqiniso; ungolungileyo, impela uyakuphila nokuphila,” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“Uma ezala indodana eyisidlova, echitha igazi, noma eyenza okunye kwalokho,
nakuba uyise engakwenzanga lokho: idla ezintabeni, inukubeza umfazi kamakhelwane wayo,
icindezela abampofu nabantulayo, iphanga nokuphanga, ingasibuyisi isibambiso, iphakamisela amehlo ayo ezithombeni, yenza izinengiso,
ibolekisa ukuze ithole inzalo, ithatha inzalo; ngabe iyakuphila yini na? Qha, ayiyukuphila, ngokuba yenze zonke lezo zinengiso; iyakubulawa nokubulawa, igazi layo libe phezu kwayo.
“Uma le ndoda izala indodana bese ibona konke okubi okwenziwa nguyise, kodwa ingakwenzi lokho:
ingadli ezintabeni, ingaphakamiseli amehlo ayo ezithombeni zendlu yakwa-Israyeli, ingamnukubezi umfazi kamakhelwane wayo,
ingacindezeli muntu, ingasamukeli isibambiso, ingaphangi nokuphanga, kodwa ipha abampofu isinkwa sayo, yembathisa abanqunu,
ingabancishi abampofu, ingamukeli inzalo nenzuzo, yenza izehlulelo zami, futhi ihamba ngezimiso zami; ayiyukufa ngenxa yokona kukayise, iyakuphila nokuphila.
Uyise, ngokuba yena waba yiqola, waphanga nokuphanga umfowabo, wenza okungalungile phakathi kwabantu bakubo; uyakufa ngenxa yokona kwakhe.
“Kepha nithi: ‘Kungani indodana ingalithwali icala likayise na?’ Uma indodana yenzile ubulungiswa nokulunga, yagcina zonke izimiso zami, yazenza, ngalokho iyakuphila nokuphila.
Umphefumulo owonayo uyakufa. Indodana ayiyukukuthwala ukona kukayise, noyise akayukukuthwala ukona kwendodana. Olungileyo uyakuphila ngokulunga, nowonayo uyakujeziselwa ukona kwakhe.
“Kepha uma omubi ephenduka kuzo zonke izono zakhe azenzileyo, agcine zonke izimiso zami, enze ubulungiswa nokulunga, uyakuphila nokuphila, akayukufa.
Akuyukukhunjulwa nasinye kuzo zonke iziphambeko zakhe azenzileyo, kodwa uyakuphila ngenxa yokulunga kwakhe akwenzileyo.
Ngikwenamela ngempela yini ukufa komubi, kunokuba aphenduke, aphile na?” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.

“Kepha-ke uma olungileyo ephenduka ekulungeni kwakhe, enze okubi, enze nazo zonke izinengiso ezenziwa yizikhohlakali, ngabe uyakuphila yini na? Impela zonke izenzo zakhe ezilungileyo azenzileyo akukho nesisodwa esiyakukhunjulwa, uyakufela eziphambekweni azenzileyo nasezonweni one ngazo.
“Kepha nithi: ‘Indlela yeNkosi ayilungile.’ Ake nizwe nina ndlu yakwa-Israyeli: indlela yami ayilungile yini na? Akusizo yini izindlela zenu ezingalungile na?
Lapho olungileyo ephenduka ekulungeni kwakhe, bese enza okubi, uyakufa ngakho, uyakufa ngenxa yokubi akwenzileyo.
Lapho omubi ephenduka ebubini bakhe abenzileyo, enze ubulungiswa nokulunga, uyakuwusindisa umphefumulo wakhe.
Ngokuba ubonile, waphenduka eziphambekweni zakhe zonke azenzileyo, impela uyakuphila akayukufa.
Kepha indlu yakwa-Israyeli ithi: ‘Indlela yeNkosi ayilungile.’ Wena ndlu yakwa-Israyeli, izindlela zami azilungile yini na? Akusizo yini izindlela zenu ezingalungile na?
“Ngakho-ke ngiyakunehlulela nina ndlu ka-Israyeli, yilowo nalowo ngokwezindlela zakhe, kusho iNkosi uSimakade. Buyani, phendukani, eziphambekweni zenu zonke, ukuze ububi bungabi yisikhubekiso kini.
Lahlani zonke iziphambeko zenu eniphambuke ngazo, nizenzele inhliziyo entsha nomoya omusha; uyakufelani wena ndlu ka-Israyeli na?
Angikwenameli ukufa kofayo, ngakho-ke phendukani, niphile,” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“Wena, khihla isililo ngenxa yezikhulu zakwa-Israyeli, uthi:
“ ‘Unyoko wayeyingonyamakazi enjani phakathi kwezingonyama na? Wayebuthisa phakathi kwamabhongo, ondle amawundlu akhe.
Wakhulisa elinye lamawundlu akhe, laba yibhongo, lafunda ukudwengula inyamazane, ladla nabantu.
Izizwe zezwa ngalo, labanjwa, layiswa ngezingwegwe eGibhithe.
“ ‘Walinda, wabona ukuthi ulindele ize, ithemba lakhe selishabalele, wathatha elinye iwundlu lakhe, walenza ibhongo.
Lazulazula phakathi kwezingonyama, liyibhongo, laze lafunda ukudwengula inyamazane, ladla nabantu.
Labhidliza izinqaba zabo, labhubhisa imizi yabo; izwe laba yincithakalo, nakho konke okukulo, kwathuthumela ngenxa yokubhonga kwalo.
Izizwe zase zigasela kulo, zivela kuwo wonke amazwe akhelene nalo, zendlala inetha phezu kwalo, labanjwa ogibeni lwazo.
Zalifaka ngezingwegwe endlwaneni evaliweyo, zaliyisa enkosini yaseBhabhele, zalifaka ezinqabeni ukuze ukubhonga kwalo kuphinde kuzwakale ezintabeni zakwa-Israyeli.
“ ‘Unyoko wayenjengomvini otshalwe ngasemanzini; othela kakhulu futhi ugcwele amagatsha ngenxa yamanzi amaningi.
Wawunamagatsha aqinileyo, aba yizintonga zababusi; isiqu sawo sasiphakeme phakathi kwamagatsha amaningi, wawubonakala ngobude bawo, nangobuningi bamagatsha awo.
Kepha wasishulwa ngolaka, wathelwa othulini, umoya wasempumalanga womisa isithelo sawo; isiqu sawo esiqinileyo, sabuna, saqothulwa ngumlilo.
Manje usutshalwe ehlane, ezweni eligagadekileyo nelomileyo.
Umlilo uphumile esiqwini sawo, wadla amagatsha awo nesithelo sawo, akusalanga gatsha kuwo eliqinileyo, nantonga yokubusa.’ “Lesi yisililo; impela makube yisililo.”
Kwathi ngonyaka wesikhombisa, ngenyanga yesihlanu, ngosuku lweshumi lwenyanga, kwafika amadoda angamalunga akwa-Israyeli ukuzobuza kuSimakade; ahlala phambi kwami.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, khuluma namalunga akwa-Israyeli, uthi kuwo: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Nize ukuzobuza kimi na? Ngifunga ngiyagomela, angiyukubuzwa yinina,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“Ndodana yomuntu uzakubehlulela yini, uzakubehlulela na? Bazise izinengiso zokhokho babo,
uthi kubo: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngosuku engamkhetha ngalo u-Israyeli ngafunga ozalweni lwendlu kaJakobe, ngazambula kubo eGibhithe, ngafunga ngathi: NginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.
“ ‘ “Ngalolo lusuku ngafunga kubo ukuba ngibakhiphe eGibhithe, ngibayise ezweni engangibakhethele lona, izwe elichichima ubisi noju, futhi elihle kunawo wonke amazwe.
Ngathi kubo: Makube yilowo nalowo alahle okwenyanyekayo emehlweni akhe, ningazingcolisi ngezithombe zaseGibhithe; nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.”

“ ‘Kepha bangihlubuka, abafunanga ukungilalela, kwaba yilowo nalowo akaze azilahla izinto ezenyanyekayo ezaziphambi kwakhe; abazishiyanga izithombe zaseGibhithe, ngase ngithi ngiyakuthululela ulaka lwami phezu kwabo; intukuthelo yami ephelele ngiyithululele kubo eGibhithe.
Ngakwenza lokho ngenxa yegama lami ukuba lingangcoliswa phambi kwezizwe ababephakathi kwazo, engazazisa kuzo bebuka, ngokubakhipha eGibhithe.
Ngase ngibakhipha eGibhithe, ngabayisa ehlane.
Ngabanika izimiso zami, ngabazisa izehlulelo zami umuntu ayakuphila ngazo uma ezenza.
Ngabanika futhi amasabatha ami ukuba abe yisibonakaliso phakathi kwami nabo, ukuze bazi ukuthi nginguSimakade obangcwelisayo.

“ ‘Kepha indlu yakwa-Israyeli yangihlubuka ehlane; ayihambanga ngezimiso zami, yazilahla izehlulelo zami umuntu ayakuphila ngazo uma ezenza; amasabatha ami yawangcolisa kakhulu; ngase ngithi ngiyakuthulula ulaka lwami phezu kwabo ehlane, ngibaqothule.
Ngakwenza lokho ngenxa yegama lami, ukuba lingangcoliswa phambi kwezizwe engabakhipha zizibonela ngawazo.
Phezu kwalokho ngafunga kubo ehlane ukuthi angiyukubangenisa ezweni engangibanike lona, elichichima ubisi noju, elihle kunawo wonke amazwe,
ngokuba bazilahla izehlulelo zami, abahambanga ngezimiso zami, bawangcolisa amasabatha ami, ngokuba izinhliziyo zabo zalandela izithombe zabo.
Nokho iso lami lababheka ngesihawu ukuba ngingababhubhisi, ngingabaqedi nya ehlane.
Ngathi kubantwana babo ehlane: “Ningahambi ngezimiso zoyihlo, ningazigcini izehlulelo zabo, ningazingcolisi ngezithombe zabo.
NginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu: hambani ngezimiso zami, nizigcine izehlulelo zami, nizenze,
angcweliswe amasabatha ami, abe yisibonakaliso phakathi kwami nani, ukuze nazi ukuthi nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wenu.”

“ ‘Kepha nabantwana bangihlubuka, abahambanga ngezimiso zami, abazigcinanga izehlulelo zami ukuba bazenze ukuze umuntu aphile ngazo; bawangcolisa amasabatha ami, ngase ngithi ngizakuthululela intukuthelo yami kubo, ngiphelelise ulaka lwami phezu kwabo ehlane.
Nokho ngayeka ukukwenza lokho ngenxa yegama lami, ukuba lingangcoliswa phambi kwezizwe engabakhipha zizibonela ngawazo.
Ngaphakamisela isandla sami ehlane ukuba ngibahlakazele ezizweni, ngibasabalalisele emazweni.
Ngokuba abazenzanga izehlulelo zami, bazilahla izimiso zami, bawangcolisa amasabatha ami, amehlo abo alangazelela izithombe zoyise.
Nami ngabanika izimiso ezazingezinhle nezehlulelo ababengayukuphila ngazo.
Ngabangcolisa ngeminikelo yabo ngokudabulisa emlilweni wonke amazibulo, ukuze ngibesabise, yikhona bezokwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.’
“Ngakho-ke ndodana yomuntu, khuluma kwabendlu yakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Kulokhu futhi, oyihlo bangihlambalaza, benza isiphambeko,

ngesikhathi sengibangenise ezweni engangifungile ukuthi ngiyobanika lona. Kwathi lapho bebona amagquma aphakemeyo nazo zonke izihlahla ezinamacembe, base benikela lapho ngemihlatshelo yabo, bangichukuluza ngeminikelo yabo, benza lapho kwaba nephunga elimnandi, bathululela lapho iminikelo yokuphuzwayo.
Ngase ngithi kubo: iyini indawo ephakemeyo eniya kuyo na?” ’ ” Lase libizwa igama layo ngokuthi indawo ephakemeyo, kuze kube namuhla.
“Ngakho yisho kuyo indlu yakwa-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Niyakuzingcolisa yini nani ngendlela okhokho benu abaziphatha ngayo, nilandele ekuphingeni kwabo okunyanyekayo na?

Lapho niletha iminikelo yenu, nidabulisa amadodana enu emlilweni, niyazingcolisa ngazo zonke izithombe kuze kube namuhla. Niyakubuza kimi yini, nina ndlu ka-Israyeli na? Qha, ngifunga ngiyagomela, ngeke ngibuzwe yini,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Lokhu okusengqondweni yenu, impela akusoze kwenzeka, enicabanga, nithi: Siyakufana nezizwe, sifane nabantu bezwe, nathi sikhonze ukhuni netshe.
“ ‘ “Ngifunga ngiyagomela; impela ngesandla esinamandla, nangengalo eluliweyo, nangolaka olutheliweyo; ngiyakubusa phezu kwenu,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Ngiyakunikhipha phakathi kwabantu, nginiqoqe emazweni enihlakazelwe kuwo, ngesandla esinamandla, ngengalo eyeluliweyo, nangolaka olutheliweyo.
Ngiyakuniyisa ehlane labantu, nginehlulele lapho sibhekene ubuso nobuso.
Njengalokhu ngehlulelana nokhokho benu ehlane eGibhithe, ngiyakwehlulelana nani kanjalo-ke,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Ngiyakunidlulisa phansi kwentonga, nginingenise phansi kwesibopho sesivumelwano,
ngihlunge kini abahlubuki nabaphambukayo kimi, ngibakhiphe ezweni lapho begogobele khona, kepha abayukungena kwelakwa-Israyeli, niyokwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.

“ ‘ “Nina ndlu yakwa-Israyeli,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade, “ ‘ “hambani; kube yilowo nalowo ayokhonza isithombe sakhe, kodwa kamuva niyakungilalela, ningabe nisalingcolisa igama lami elingcwele ngeminikelo yenu nangezithombe zenu.

Ngokuba entabeni yami engcwele, esicongweni sentaba yakwa-Israyeli, yonke indlu yakwa-Israyeli iyakungikhonza kuyo ezweni; ngiyakubemukela khona, ngifune iminikelo yenu, okwekhethelo kwenu nakho konke okungcwele okungokwenu,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Ngiyakunemukela ngephunga elimnandi, lapho nginikhipha ezizweni, nginiqoqe emazweni lapho nihlakazekele khona, ngizibonakalise ukuthi ngingcwele phakathi kwenu, emehlweni ezizwe.
Niyokwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade, lapho nginingenisa ezweni lakwa-Israyeli, izwe engalifungela ukulinika okhokho benu.
Niyakukhumbula izindlela zenu nazo zonke izenzo zenu enizingcolise ngazo, nenyanye ubuso benu ngakho konke okubi enikwenzileyo.
Niyakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade lapho ngenza lokho kini ngenxa yegama lami, hhayi ngokwezindlela zenu ezimbi nezenzo zenu zenkohlakalo; nina ndlu yakwa-Israyeli,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, bhekisa ubuso bakho ngaseningizimu, ukhulume umelene nenyakatho, uphrofethe ngehlathi elisendle eningizimu,

uthi kulelo hlathi laseningizimu: ‘Lalela izwi likaSimakade: isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngizothungela umlilo kuwe, udle yonke imithi eluhlaza nayo yonke imithi eyomileyo, ilangabi liyobhebhetheka lingacimeki, kushe kungqongqe konke okulapho, kusuka eningizimu kuya enyakatho.
Abantu bonke bayobona lapho-ke ukuthi Mina uSimakade ngiwuthungele, awuyukucinywa.” ’ ”
Ngathi: “Maye, Nkosi Simakade! Bathi ngami: ‘Akakhulumi ngezaga nje na?’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, bhekisa ubuso bakho ngaseJerusalema, izwi lakho lizwakale ezindaweni ezingcwele, uphrofethe ngezwe lakwa-Israyeli,
uthi kulo: ‘Usho kanje uSimakade, uthi: “Bheka, ngimelene nawe. Ngiyakuhosha inkemba yami emgodleni wayo, ngibulale abalungileyo nezikhohlakali.
Ngakho-ke inkemba yami iyakuphuma emgodleni wayo, iphumele abantu bonke kusukela eningizimu kuya enyakatho.
Bonke abantu bayokwazi ukuthi Mina Simakade, ngiyihoshile inkemba emgodleni wayo, ayisayukubuyela emuva.” ’ ”
“Kepha wena ndodana yomuntu, bubula, ububule ngomunyu bekubuka, ngenxa yokhalo lwakho olwaphukileyo.

Kuyakuthi lapho bethi kuwe: ‘Ububulelani na?’ uthi kubo: ‘Kungenxa yombiko, ngokuba ngesikhathi oyakufika ngaso, zonke izinhliziyo ziyakudikibala, izandla zidangale, yonke imiphefumulo ibe buthakathaka, kugcwale amanzi emadolweni.’ Lokhu kuyeza, futhi kuyakwenzeka,” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, phrofetha uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi, ithi: “ ‘ “Inkemba, inkemba iloliwe, yamenyezeliswa.
Ilolelwe ukuba ibulale ngempela, imenyezeliselwe ukuba ibe njengonyazi. “ ‘ “Pho besiyakujabulelani na? Le ntonga, ndodana yami, idelela konke okomuthi.
“ ‘ “Inkemba inikelwe ukuba imenyezeliswe, ukuze ibanjwe ngesandla. Yebo, inkemba isiloliwe, isimenyezelisiwe ukuba inikelwe esandleni sombulali.
Khala, udinde isililo, ndodana yomuntu, ngokuba iyakwehlela kubantu bami, yehlele kuzo zonke izikhulu zakwa-Israyeli, zinikelwe enkembeni nabantu bami, ngakho-ke thwala imikhono ekhanda.
“ ‘ “Bekuyisivivinyo nje; kunganjani uma intonga edelelayo manje ingayukuba bikho na?” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“Wena-ke, ndodana yomuntu, phrofetha, ushaye izandla. Inkemba mayigadle kabili, kathathu, iyinkemba yokubulala, inkemba yokubulala okukhulu, isibazungeze nxazonke.
Ukuze izinhliziyo zabo ziphele amandla, kwande nezikhubekiso kubo, ngiyokwenza babeke inkemba ekhazimulayo kuwo wonke amasango abo. Yebo, yenziwe yanjengonyazi, ihoshelwe ukubulala.
Bulala ngakwesokunene, udlulele ngakwesokhohlo, lapho ubuso bakho bubheke ngakhona.
Nami luqobo ngiyakushaya izandla, nganelise intukuthelo yami; Mina Simakade ngikhulumile.”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Wena ndodana yomuntu, zenzele izindlela ezimbili okuzofika ngazo inkemba yenkosi yaseBhabhele, zombili zisuke ezweni elilodwa, wenze inkombandlela, uyibeke engosini yezindlela zomuzi.
Enye indlela okuzofika ngayo inkemba, uyenze eRabha labakwa-Amoni nakwaJuda eJerusalema elibiyelweyo.
Ngokuba inkosi yaseBhabhele isimi egumbini lezindlela, engosini yezindlela zombili, ukuba ibhule; ixhakazisa imicibisholo, ibuza amatherafi, ihlola esibindini.

Ngakwesokunene kwenziwe unkatho ngeJerusalema, ukuba kubekwe imigoqo yokubhodloza, kumenyezelwe ukubulala, ngokuthi kukhuzwe iziqubulo zempi, kubekwe imigoqo yokubhodloza emasangweni, kwenziwe izindunduma, kwakhiwe nodonga lokuvimbezela.
Kubo kuyobonakala sengathi ubhula amanga; kukhona abasenza isifungo kubo, kodwa iyakubakhumbuza ngokona kwabo, ukuze babanjwe.

“Ngakho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Ngokuba nizikhumbuzile ngobubi benu, zembulwa iziphambeko zenu ukuze izono zenu zibonakale kukho konke enikwenzayo, yebo, ngenxa yokuba nikhunjuliwe, niyakubanjwa ngesandla.
“ ‘Wena-ke sikhulu sakwa-Israyeli, shinga elikhohlakeleyo, usuku lwakho-ke selufikile, isikhathi sakho sokujeziswa okokugcina;
isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Khumula umshuqulu, wethule umqhele wakho, akusezukufana nakuqala. Phakamisa okuthobekileyo, uthobise okuphakemeyo.
Incithakalo, incithakalo, ngiyakwenza incithakalo; nalokhu akuyukwenzeka kuze kufike isehlulelo kulowo esimfanele, bese ngimnika sona.” ’

“Wena ndodana yomuntu, phrofetha uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uNkulunkulu ngabakwa-Amoni nangehlazo labo, ithi: wena batshele, uthi: “ ‘ “Inkemba, inkemba ihoshiwe, yamenyezeliselwa ukuba ibulale, futhi iqothule njengonyazi,
besalibele ukubona amanga ngawe, bebhula inkohliso ngawe, bethi uyakubekwa ezintanyeni zezikhohlakali ezabulawayo, abalusuku lwabo luyofika ngesikhathi okuyoqedwa ngalo okubi.
Mayibuyiselwe emgodleni. Endaweni lapho wadalwa khona, ezweni owadabuka kulo, ngiyakukwehlulela khona lapho.
Intukuthelo yami ngiyakuyithululela phezu kwakho, ngikufuthe ngomlilo wolaka lwami, ngikunikele ezandleni zabantu abanonya, abangongoti bokubhubhisa.
Uyakuba ngukudla komlilo, igazi lakho lichithekele emhlabathini; awusayukuphinde ukhunjulwe, ngokuba Mina Simakade ngikhulumile.” ’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Wena ndodana yomuntu uyakwehlulela, uyakuwehlulela yini umuzi ochitha igazi na? Nguwe oyakuwazisa zonke izinengiso zawo,
uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Wena muzi ochitha igazi phakathi kwakho, isikhathi sakho siyeza; wenze izithombe ukuba uzingcolise ngazo,

unecala-ke ngegazi olichithileyo, nangezithombe ozenzileyo; ungcolile. Wenze ukuba izinsuku zakho zisheshe zifike, futhi sewufikile esiphethweni seminyaka yakho, ngakho-ke ngizokukwenza ube yihlazo ezweni, nenhlekisa emazweni wonke.
Abaseduze nabakude nawe bayakukuhleka wena onegama elingcolileyo, ogcwele isiphithiphithi.
“ ‘ “Bheka nje, yileso naleso sikhulu sakwa-Israyeli esasihlala kuwe, senza ngokusemandleni aso ukuba sichithe igazi.
Babaphatha ngendlakadla oyise nonina kuwe, abafokazi abagogobele kuwe babacindezela, kwathi izintandane nabafokazi abakuwe baphathwa kabi.
Ukwedelelile okungcwele kwami, wawona amasabatha ami.
Abantu abahlebayo babekuwe ukuba bachithe igazi, badla kuwe ezintabeni, bekuwe benza ubufebe.
Bekuwe bahlubula oyise babanqunu, bahlukumeza abesifazane abangcolileyo besesikhathini.
Omunye wenze isinengiso nomkamakhelwane wakhe. Omunye wangcolisa umalokazana wakwakhe ngobufebe, omunye kubo wone udadewabo, indodakazi kayise.
Bamukele umfumbathiso kuwe ukuba bachithe igazi, wena wathatha inzalo nenzuzo, waphanga omakhelwane bakho ngokubacindezela, kodwa wangikhohlwa Mina, kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Impela ngenxa yenzuzo engaka engalungile oyenzile, nangegazi elikuwe, Mina ngishaya izandla ngibabaza.
Uyakuba naso yini isibindi, nezandla zakho ziyakuqina yini ngezinsuku engiyakubhekana ngazo nawe na? Mina Simakade ngikhulumile, futhi ngiyakukwenza lokho.
Ngiyakukuhlakazela ezizweni, ngikusabalalisele emazweni, ngikuqede ukungcola kwakho okukuwe.
Wena uyakungcoliswa emehlweni ezizwe. Kulapho-ke uyokwazi khona ukuthi nginguSimakade.” ’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, indlu yakwa-Israyeli isingamanyela kimi. Bonke sebeyithusi, ithini, insimbi nomthofu phakathi esithandweni somlilo; bangamanyela esiliva.
Ngalokho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Ngenxa yokuba seningamanyela nonke, ngakho-ke bhekani, ngiyakuniqoqela phakathi eJerusalema.

Njengalokhu kuqoqwa isiliva, ithusi, insimbi, umthofu, nethini phakathi esithandweni somlilo, ukuba kuvuthelwe umlilo phezu kwakho ukuze kuncibikaliswe, kanjalo-ke nami ngiyakuniqoqa ngentukuthelo yami, nangolaka lwami, nginifake khona, nginincibilikise.
Yebo, ngiyakuniqoqa, nginivuthele ngomlilo wentukuthelo yami, nincibilikiswe kuwo.
Njengalokhu isiliva lincibilikiswa phakathi esithandweni somlilo, kanjalo nani niyakuncibilikiswa phakathi kwaso, niyakukwazi-ke ukuthi Mina Simakade ngithululele ulaka lwami phezu kwenu.’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, yisho kulo izwe, uthi: ‘Wena uyizwe elingahlanjululwanga, futhi langanethwa yimvula ngosuku lolaka lwami.’
“Kukhona uzungu lwabaphrofethi bawo abakuwo, olunjengengonyama ebhongayo edwengula impango. Badle abantu, bathatha ingcebo nokuyigugu, benza baba baningi abafokazi abakuwo.

Abaphristi bawo bawudlovile umthetho wami; bazingcolisile izinto zami ezingcwele, abakwehlukanisanga okungcwele nokuyichilo. Ababafundisanga abantu ukwehlukanisa phakathi kokungcolileyo nokuhlambulukileyo, bashalazela amasabatha ami ngokungawagcini; ngihlanjalaziwe phakathi kwabo.
Izikhulu zawo ezikuwo, zinjengezimpisi ezidwengula impango ukuba zichithe igazi, zibaqede nya abantu, ukuze zithole inzuzo embi.
Abaphrofethi bakhona bawugudule ngomcako, bebona okuyize, bebabhulela amanga, bethi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade,’ nakuba uSimakade engakhulumanga.
Abantu bezwe bacindezele nokucindezela, baphangile nokuphanga, yebo, babaphathe kabi abampofu nabantulayo, babacindezele abafokazi ngokungenabulungiswa.
“Ngafuna kubo umuntu owayezokwakha ugange, ame esikhaleni phambi kwami ngenxa yezwe, ukuze ngingalibhubhisi, kodwa angimtholanga.
Ngase ngithululela ulaka lwami phezu kwabo, ngabaqeda nya ngomlilo wentukuthelo yami, kwathi konke abakwenzileyo ngakuthela phezu kwamakhanda abo,” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, kwakukhona abesifazane ababili, amadodakazi amfazi munye.
Babefeba eGibhithe, bafeba kusukela ebusheni babo; amabele abo awotwawotwa khona, zapotozwa lapho izingono zobuntombi babo.
Amagama abo ngu-Ohola, okunguyena omdala, no-Oholiba udadewabo; babengabami, bazala amadodana namadodakazi. Amagama abo yilawa: u-Ohola yiSamariya kuthi u-Oholiba kube yiJerusalema.
“U-Ohola wafeba esengowami, wakhanukela izithandwa zakhe, abase-Asiriya, abangamabutho empi,
ababembethe okuluhlaza, ababusi, izikhulu, izinsizwa zonke ezingamageza, nabagibeli bamahhashi.
Wazinikela kubo, wafeba nabo, bengamadoda akhethekileyo ase-Asiriya; bonke wabakhanukela, wayesezingcolisa yena ngazo zonke izithombe zabo.
Nokho akabuyekanga ubufebe bakhe ayebuqale eGibhithe, ngokuba balala naye kusukela ebusheni bakhe, bacindezela izingono zobuntombi bakhe, bathululela kuye ubufebe babo.
“Ngalokho-ke ngamnikela esandleni sezithandwa zakhe, esandleni sabase-Asiriya abakhanukelayo.
Bamambula ubunqunu bakhe, bathatha amadodana akhe namadodakazi akhe. Yena bambulala ngenkemba, waba yisaga kwabesifazane, futhi wehlulelwa.
“Udadewabo u-Oholiba wakubona lokho, kodwa wonakala ngokwedlulele kunaye ekukhanukeni kwakhe, nasebufebeni bakhe obabedlula obukadadewabo.
Wakhanukela abase-Asiriya, izikhulu, ababusi, namabutho empi, ababehlobe ngemvunulo, bengabagibeli bamahhashi, bonke beyizinsizwa ezingamageza.
Ngabona ukuthi naye uzingcolisile; bobabili bahamba ndlelanye.
“Wanezezela ebufebeni bakhe, ngokuba wabona amadoda ayedwetshwe odongeni, imifanekiso yamaKhaledi eyayidwetshwe ngebomvu,
ebophe amabhande okhalo lwawo, ethwele amaqhiya emakhanda, wonke ebukeka njengezikhulu zaseBhabhele, edabuka eKhaledi.
Kwathi nje lapho ewabona, wawakhanuka, wathumela kuwo izithunywa eKhaledi.
Amadodana aseBhabhele eza kuye, alala naye, amngcolisa ngobufebe bawo; kwathi lapho esemngcolisile, amshiya dengwane.
Wabambula ubufebe bakhe, nobunqunu bakhe. Ngazehlukanisa naye njengoba ngangimlaxazile nodadewabo.
Kepha wabandisa ubufebe bakhe, ekhumbula izinsuku zobusha bakhe ayefebe ngazo eGibhithe.
Wawakhanukela amashende alapho, azinduku zawo zinjengezinduku zezimbongolo, nemiphambili yawo echitha njengeyamahhashi.
Wakulangazelela ukukhanuka kobusha bakho useseGibhithe, lapho izingono zakho zamabele obusha bakho zazipotozwa khona.
“Ngalokho-ke Oholiba, isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Ngiyakukuvusela izithandwa zakho, umphefumulo wakho owehlukene nazo, ngizilethe kuwe zivela macala wonke,
abaseBhabhele, amaKhaledi wonke, iPhekodi, iShowa, iKhowa, bonke abase-Asiriya, izinsizwa ezingamageza, ababusi, nezikhulu zabo, nazo zonke izikhulu ezaziwa ngabagibeli bamahhashi,

bayakuza kuwe bakuthelekele ngezikhali, izinqola, okunamasondo, nesixuku sabantu, bayakukuvimbezela nxazonke ngamahawu nezihlangu, nezigqoko zempi. Ngiyakubanika igunya lokwehlulela, bayakukwehlulela ngezehlulelo zabo.

Ngiyakumelana nawe ngenxa yesikhwele enginaso ngawe, bakuphathe ngonya, banqume ikhala lakho nezindlebe zakho, kuthi abaseleyo bakini, bafe ngenkemba. Bayakuthatha amadodana akho namadodakazi akho, bese kuthi insali yakini, idliwe ngumlilo.
Bayakukuhlubula izingubo zakho, bakuqhwage imvunulo yakho ohlobe ngayo.
Ngiyakuyiqeda nya inkanuko yakho nobufebe bakho owabuqala kusukela eGibhithe. Awuyukukubheka lokho ngokukulangazelela, ungabe usalikhumbula futhi iGibhithe.’
“Ngokuba isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Ngiyakukunikela esandleni salabo obazondayo, esandleni salabo umphefumulo wakho owehlukane nabo usubenyanya.
Bayakukuphatha ngenzondo, bakuqhwage konke lokho osukusebenzele, bakuphundle, usale unqunu, ubunqunu bobufebe bakho bube sobala. Ukukhanuka kwakho nobufebe bakho
yikhona okwenze lokho kuwe, ngokuba ufebile, walandela abezizwe, wazingcolisa wena uqobo ngezithombe zabo.
Uhambe ngendlela kadadewenu, ngalokho-ke ngiyakunikela indebe yakhe esandleni sakho.’
“Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘Uyakuphuza endebeni kadadewenu ejulileyo, futhi ebanzi, iyakwenza ukuba uhlekwe usulu, futhi wedelelwe, iqukethe okuningi.
Uyakugcincwa ngokudakwa nosizi: indebe yokwesabekayo neyencithakalo, indebe kadadewenu iSamariya.
Uyakuphuza kuyo, uze uyiminye, uyiphihlize ibe yizingcezu; uklwebhe amabele akho, ngokuba Mina ngikhulumile,’ kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“Ngalokho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Ngokuba ungikhohliwe Mina, wangifulathela, uyakukuthwala ukungcola kwakho nobufebe bakho.’ ”
Wayesethi uSimakade kimi: “Ndodana yomuntu, uyakubehlulela yini o-Ohola no-Oholiba na? Batshele-ke ngezinengiso zabo.
Ngokuba baphingile, negazi lisezandleni zabo; baphinge nezithombe zabo, kwathi abantwana abangizalela bona babadabulisa emlilweni, baba ngukudla kwazo.
Benza lokhu futhi kimi: ngalolo lusuku abangcolisa ngalo indlu yami engcwele, bawona namasabatha ami.
Kwathi ngalolo lusuku benzela izithombe zabo umhlatshelo ngabantwana babo, base beya endlini yami engcwele ukuba bayingcolise. Uyabona, benza kanjalo-ke endlini yami.
“Bathumela izithunywa ukuba zilande amadoda avela kude. Kwathi lapho efika, wena wageza ngenxa yawo, wagqaba amehlo akho, wahloba ngobucwebecwebe,
wahlala esihlalweni esihle esintofontofo; itafula elilungisiweyo laliphambi kwaso, wabeka kulo impepho yami namafutha ami.
“Umsindo wesixuku esihlezi kahle wawuzwakala lapho; kwalethwa nezidakwa zasehlane, bazifaka amabhengele ezandleni zazo, nemiqhele emihle emakhanda azo.
Ngase ngithi ngalo osephele nya ngukufeba: ‘Impela bayakufeba naye, naye afebe nabo, ngokuba yilokho ayikho.’
Balala naye njengalokhu amadoda elala nesifebe; balala kanjalo-ke no-Ohola no-Oholiba, abesifazane abakhanukayo.
Abantu abalungileyo bayakubehlulela ngokwehlulelwa kowesifazane ophingayo nangokwabesifazane abachitha igazi, ngokuba bayiziphingi, futhi negazi lisezandleni zabo.
“Ngokuba isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Ngiyakuletha kubo isixuku esiyakumelana nabo, ngibanikele ekusatshisweni nasekuphangweni.
Isixuku siyakubakhanda ngamatshe, sibahlahlele ngezinkemba zaso, sibulale amadodana abo namadodakazi abo, sizishise ngomlilo izindlu zabo.
“ ‘Ngiyakukuqeda nya ukukhanuka ezweni, ukuze baxwayiswe bonke abesifazane ukuba bangakhanuki njengoba bekwenza nina.
Bayakukuphindisela kini ukukhanuka kwenu, nizithwale nina izono zezithombe zenu, niyakukwazi ukuthi Mina ngiyiNkosi uSimakade.’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi ngonyaka wesishiyagalolunye, ngenyanga yeshumi, ngosuku lweshumi enyangeni, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, zilobele igama losuku, lona lolu lusuku; inkosi yaseBhabhele seyilivimbezele iJerusalema ngalolu lusuku.
Khuluma ngomfanekiso kuyo indlu ehlubukayo, uthi kubo: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘ “Beka ibhodwe emlilweni, libeke, uthele amanzi kulo.
Faka kulo isitho senyama, isitho senyama enhle; umlenze nomkhono. Ligcwalise ngamathambo ekhethelo.
Thatha okukhethekileyo emhlanjini, ukhwezele izikhuni phansi kwalo, uligxabhise impela, kuphekwe namathambo kulo.”
“ ‘Ngakho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘ “Maye, kumuzi ochitha igazi, ibhodwe elinokugqwala, nokugqwala kwalo okungasukanga kulo! Khipha kulo isitho nesitho, nakuba ungadliwanga wunkatho.
“ ‘ “Ngokuba igazi elilichithile likuwo; lilichithele edwaleni elingenalutho; alilichithelanga emhlabathini ukuba limbozwe wuthuli.
Igazi lawo ngalichithela edwaleni elingenalutho, ukuba lingambozwa yilutho, ukuze kuvuswe ulaka lwami, ngiziphindiselele.
“ ‘ “Ngakho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘ “ ‘Maye, kumuzi ochitha igazi! Nami futhi ngiyakuzifaka kakhulu izinkuni.
Nqwabela izinkuni, ukhwezele umlilo, uqothule inyama, kushe umhluzi, ashiswe angqongqe namathambo.
Bese ulibeka emalahleni awo lingenalutho, ukuze lishise, kushe ithusi lalo, kuncibilikiswe kulo ukungcola kwalo, kuqedwe ukugqwala okukulo.
Lizikhathazele ize, nokho ukugqwala kwalo okuningi akuphelanga kulo; ukugqwala kwalo makube semlilweni.’ ”
“ ‘Ekungcoleni kwakho ngenxa yobufebe ngakuhlambulula, kodwa awuhlambulukanga ekungcoleni kwakho, ngeke uphinde uhlanzeke ngize ngilwanelise ulaka lwami, ngimelene nawe.

“ ‘Mina Simakade ngikukhulumile lokho; kuyakwenzeka, ngiyakukwenza; angiyukukuyeka, angiyukuhawukela, angiyukuzisola. Uyakwehlulelwa njengokuziphatha kwakho nangezenzo zakho,’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, ngiyakususa kuwe okunxanelekayo emehlweni akho ngokuphazima kweso, kepha ungakhali, ungakhihli sililo, futhi kungaphumi zinyembezi kuwe.
Bubula buthule; ungamlileli ofileyo, uzibophele umshuqulu wakho, ufake izimbadada zakho ezinyaweni, ungawambozi amadevu akho, ungakudli ukudla okulethwe ngabantu abalilayo.”
Ngase ngikhuluma kubantu ekuseni; kwathi kusihlwa umkami wafa; ngakusasa ekuseni ngenza njengalokhu ngiyaliwe.
Abantu bangibuza, bathi: “Kusho ukuthini kithi lokhu okwenzayo na?”
Ngathi kubo: “Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:

‘Yisho kuyo indlu yakwa-Israyeli, uthi: “Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: uyabona-ke, sengizoyingcolisa indlu yami engcwele; ukuzigabisa ngamandla enu, ukunxanela kwamehlo enu, nokuthanda kwempilo yenu. Amadodana namadodakazi enu eniwashiyile, ayakudliwa yinkemba.
Niyakwenza njengoba ngenzile: aniyukuwamboza amadevu enu, ningakudli ukudla okulethwe ngabantu abalilayo.
Imishuqulu yenu iyakuba semakhanda enu, nezimbadada zenu ezinyaweni zenu; ningakhali, ningasikhihli isililo, kodwa-ke niyokonda ngenxa yeziphambeko zenu, nibubulelane omunye komunye.
UHezekeli uyakuba yisibonakaliso kini; niyakukwenza konke akwenzayo. Kuyakuthi lapho sekwenzekile lokhu, bese niyazi ukuthi Mina ngiyiNkosi uSimakade.” ’
“Wena ndodana yomuntu, angithi ngalolo lusuku engiyosusa ngalo inqaba yabo, intokozo yobuhle babo, okunxanelekayo emehlweni abo, okulangazelelwa ngumphefumulo wabo, amadodana abo namadodakazi abo,
angithi ngalolo lusuku ophunyukileyo uyakuza kuwe, akubikele ngalezo zindaba na?
Ngalolo lusuku umlomo wakho uyakuvulwa; wena uyakukhuluma nophunyukileyo, ungabe usaba yisimungulu. Uyakuba yisibonakaliso kubo, bayakukwazi ukuthi Mina nginguSimakade.”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, bhekisa ubuso bakho kwabakwa-Amoni, uphrofethe ngabo, umelene nabo,

uthi kubo: ‘Zwanini izwi leNkosi uSimakade. Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngokuba wathi ashila kuyo indlu yami engcwele lapho ingcoliswa, nakulo izwe lakwa-Israyeli ngesikhathi lenziwa incithakalo, nakuyo indlu yakwaJuda lapho beya ekuthunjweni,
ngakho-ke sengizokunikela kwabasempumalanga, ube yifa labo. Bayakukanisa kuwe, bamise amathende abo kuwe, badle isithelo sakho, baphuze nobisi lwakho.
IRabha ngiyakulenza libe yidlelo lamakameli, abakwa-Amoni babe yindawo yokubuthisa izimvu, niyakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.
Ngokuba isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: njengoba ushaye ihlombe, wagidagida ngezinyawo, wathokoza ngabo bonke ububi obusenhliziyweni yakho, umelene nezwe lakwa-Israyeli,

ngalokho-ke ngiyakwelulela isandla sami kuwe, ngimelane nawe, ngikunikele ukuba ube yimpango ezizweni. Ngiyakukususa kubantu, ngikushabalalise emazweni, ngikubhubhise, uyakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.” ’ ”
“Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Ngenxa yokuba uMowabi neSeyiri bathe: “Bheka, indlu yakwaJuda injengazo zonke ezinye izizwe,”
“ ‘uyabona-ke manje, sengizowuvula umthambeka kaMowabi, angabe esaba namizi, kusukela emizini esemingceleni, indawo enhle yezwe: iBhethi Jeshimothi, iBhali Mehoni, neKiriyathayimi,
bese ngiwunika abasempumalanga nabakwa-Amoni, ube yifa labo, ukuze abantu bakwa-Amoni bangabe besakhunjulwa ezizweni.
Ngiyakwehlisela isijeziso phezu kukaMowabi, bayakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.’ ”
“Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Ngenxa yokuba u-Edomi uziphindiselele endlini yakwaJuda, usenecala elikhulu ngokwedlulele njengoba eziphindiselele kubo.

Ngalokho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngiyakwelulela isandla sami ku-Edomi ngimelane naye, ngibulale abantu nezilwane, ngimenze abe yincithakalo kusukela eThemani kuze kube seDedani, bayakufa ngenkemba.
Ngiyakuziphindiselela ku-Edomi ngesandla sabantu bami, u-Israyeli; bayakwenza kwa-Edomi ngokwentukuthelo yami nangokolaka lwami, bayakuyazi-ke impindiselo yami, kusho iNkosi uSimakade.” ’
“Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Ngenxa yokuba amaFilisti aziphindiselele, ephindisela nokuphindisela ngobubi obusenhliziyweni yawo, ukuba abhubhise ngenzondo engapheliyo,
ngalokho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: bheka, sengizokwelulela isandla sami kumaFilisti, ngimelane nawo, ngiwabulale amaKherethi, ngibhubhise insali esogwini lolwandle.
Ngiyakuziphindiselela ngokwedlulele kubo, ngezijeziso zolaka lwami; bayakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade, lapho sengiziphindiselele kubo.’ ”
Kwathi ngonyaka we-11, ngosuku lokuqala enyangeni, kwafika kimi izwi likaSimakade, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, njengoba iThire likhulumile mayelana neJerusalema, lathi: ‘Ashila; liphukile isango lezizwe; seliphendukele kimi; ngiyakuphumelela njengoba lona seliyincithakalo,’
ngakho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Ngiphezu kwakho Thire; ngiyakwenyusela kuwe izizwe eziningi njengolwandle lugubha amagagasi, zimelane nawe.
Ziyakubhidliza izingange zeThire, zidilize imibhoshongo yalo. Ngiyakuyikhukhuluza imvithi yalo, ngilenze libe yidwala elingenalutho.
Liyakuba yindawo yokwendlala amanetha phakathi kolwandle, ngokuba Mina sengikhulumile, liyakuba yimpango yezizwe,’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Amadodakazi alo asezweni ayakudliwa yinkemba, ayakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.

“ ‘ “Ngokuba isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: bheka, sengizomyisa eThire uNebukhadinezari, inkosi yaseBhabhele, ukuba amelane nalo evela enyakatho, nguye oyinkosi yamakhosi; unamahhashi, izinqola zempi, abagibeli bamahhashi, nesixuku esikhulu samabutho.
Uyakuyithelekela ngenkemba imizana yakho esezweni, akhe udonga lokukuvimbezela, enze indunduma, akuphakamisele nehawu, alwe nawe.
Uyakubeka ezingangeni zakho imigoqo yakhe yokubhidliza, abhidlize imibhoshongo yakho ngemigxala yakhe.

Ngenxa yobuningi bamahhashi akhe, uyakumbozwa wuthuli lwawo, izingange zakho zizamazame ngenxa yomsindo wabagibele amahhashi, nangenxa yobukhehlekhehle bamasondo nezinqola zempi, kuthi lapho engena emasangweni akho, kube sengathi kungenwa emzini ozingange zawo zibhidliziwe.
Uyakuyigxobagxoba yonke imigwaqo yakho ngezinselo zamahhashi akhe, abulale abantu bakini ngenkemba, nezinsika zakho eziqinileyo ziwele phansi.

Bayakuwuphanga umcebo wakho, bayithathe njengempango impahla yakho ohweba ngayo. Bayakuzibhidliza izingange zakho, badilize izindlu zakho ezinhle, balahle amatshe akho, imithi yakho, nemfucuza yakho emanzini.
Ngiyakuwuqeda umsindo wezingoma zakho, nokunkeneneza kwamahabhu akho akuseyukuzwakala nanini.
Ngiyakukwenza ube yidwala elingenalutho, indawo yokwendlala amanetha; awusayukwakhiwa kabusha futhi, ngokuba Mina Simakade ngikhulumile,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade kulo iThire, ithi: ‘Iziqhingi aziyukuzamazama yini ngenxa yomsindo wokuwa kwakho, lapho abanamanxeba bebubula, nabafayo bebulawelwa kuwe na?

Zonke izikhulu zamazwe agudle ulwandle, ziyakwehla ezihlalweni zazo zobukhosi, ziyishiye phansi imijiva yazo, zikhumule izingubo zazo ezifekethisiweyo, bese zembatha ukuthuthumela, zihlale emhlabathini, zithuthumele njalo, futhi zimangale ngawe.

Ziyakukhihla isililo ngawe, zithi kuwe: “ ‘ “Maye, ngokushabalala kwakho, wena obekuhlala kuwe abasuka olwandle; muzi odumileyo, owawunamandla olwandle; wena nabakhileyo kuwe, owenza ukuba besatshwe bonke abakhileyo kuwe!
Manje iziqhingi ziyazamazama ngosuku lokuwa kwakho; ziyazamazama iziqhingi ezisolwandle ngokubhubha kwakho.” ’ ”
Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Kuyakuthi lapho ngikwenza umuzi oyincithakalo njengemizi okungahlalwa kuyo, nalapho ngikhuphulela kuwe izinzulu zolwandle, namanzi azo amaningi akusibekele,

ngiyakukwehlisa nabehlela egodini, kubantu basemandulo, ngikuhlalise ekujuleni komhlaba nabehlela egodini njengasezindaweni eziyincithakalo, kusukela emandulo, ukuze ungaphindi ubuye, ungabi nandawo futhi ezweni labaphilayo.
Ngiyakwenza isiphetho sakho sibe ngokwesabekayo, ungabe usaba bikho; uyakufunwa, kodwa awuyukutholakala kuze kube phakade,” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Wena ndodana yomuntu, dinda isililo ngeThire,
uthi kulo iThire elingasekungeneni kolwandle, elihwebelana nezizwe eziqhingini eziningi, isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘Thire, wena uthi: “ ‘Ngimuhle ngiphelele.’
“ ‘Imingcele yakho isenhliziyweni yolwandle; abakhi bakho babuphelelisile ubuhle bakho.
Bakwenzele amapulangwe akho ngemisayiphuresi yaseSeniri; balanda umsedari eLebhanoni ukuba benze insika yakho.
Ngemi-okhi yaseBhashani benzile izigwedlo zakho; indawo yakho okuhanjwa kuyo bayenze ngomsayiphuresi ovela eziqhingini eKhithimi, bayihlobisa ngophondo lwendlovu.
Ilineni elicolekileyo nelifekethisiweyo elivela eGibhithe, lalinguseyili wakho nebhanela lakho; umpheme wakho wenziwe ngokuluhlaza nokubukhwebezane, uvela eziqhingini e-Elisha.
Abakhileyo eSidoni nase-Arivadi babe ngabagwedli bakho; izingcweti zakho, Thire, zazikuwe, zingabagwedli bakho.
Amalunga aseGebhali nezihlakaniphi zakhona babekuvala izimfa. Yonke imikhumbi yasolwandle namatilosi ayo babe kuwe ukuba bahwebe ngempahla yakho.
“ ‘AbasePheresiya abaseLude nabasePhuthi babesempini yakho, bengamabutho empi yakho. Baphanyeka kuwe izihlangu nezigqoko zempi; bakuhlobisa waba muhle.
Abantu base-Arivadi namabutho akho babesezingangeni zakho nxazonke, abaseGamadi besemibhoshongweni yakho; nabo baphanyeka izihlangu zabo ezingangeni zakho nxazonke; babuphelelisa ubuhle bakho.
“ ‘ITharishishi lalihwebelana nawe ngenxa yobuningi bayo yonke ingcebo yakho; behwebelana nawe ngesiliva, ngensimbi, ngethini nangomthofu.
“ ‘AbaseJavani, abaseThubhali nabaseMeshekhe babengabahwebi bakho, behwebelana nawe ngabantu nezitsha zethusi ukuba bathole impahla yakho.
“ ‘Abendlu yaseThogarma bahweba ngamahhashi, nangamahhashi empi, nangeminyuzi ngenxa yempahla yakho.
“ ‘Abantu baseDedani bahwebelana nawe; iziqhingi eziningi kwakuyizindawo zakho zokuhweba; baletha kuwe uphondo lwendlovu nezingodo ezimnyama zomthombothi, kwaba yisipho sakho.

“ ‘Abase-Aramu babengabahwebi bakho ngenxa yobuningi bomkhiqizo wakho. Bahweba ngempahla yakho ngama-emeralidu, ngokubukhwebezane, ngokufekethisiweyo, ngelineni elicolekileyo, ngekhorali nangamarubhi.
“ ‘UJuda nezwe lakwa-Israyeli babehweba kuwe; bahweba impahla yakho ngokolo waseMinithi, ngojeqe, ngoju, ngamafutha nangebhalisamu.
“ ‘AbaseDamaseku babengabathengi bakho, ngenxa yobuningi bomkhiqizo wakho, nangawo wonke umcebo wakho, bona babekuhwebela ngewayini laseHelibhoni noboya obumhlophe.
“ ‘AbaseVedani nabaseJavani bahwebelana nawe; ngensimbi ecangcathiweyo, ikhasiya nekhalamusi, kwaba ngokwakho.
“ ‘AbaseDedani babehwebelana nawe ngezindwangu zezihlalo zamahhashi ezinhle.
“ ‘Abase-Arabhiya nazo zonke izikhulu zaseKedari babethenga kuwe; babehwebelana nawe ngamawundlu, ngezinqama nangezimbuzi.
“ ‘Abahwebi baseShebha nabaseRama babethenga kuwe, behwebelana nawe ngazo zonke izinongo zekhethelo, ngawo wonke amatshe ayigugu, nangegolide.
“ ‘AbaseHarana, abaseKhane abase-Edene, abaseShebha, abase-Asiriya nabaseKilimadi babehwebelana nawe.
Babehwebelana nawe ngezingubo ezinhle, eziluhlaza nezifekethisiweyo, ngezindwangu ezimibalabala, nangemijiva eyelukwe ngezintambo eziqinileyo, ezindaweni zakho zokuhwebelana.
“ ‘Imikhumbi yaseTharishishi yayikuthwalela impahla yakho. Wathwaliswa imithwalo, wanyinyitheka kakhulu ekujuleni kolwandle.
Abagwedli bakho bakuyisa emanzini amaningi; umoya wasempumalanga wakuphahlaza phakathi kolwandle.
Ingcebo yakho, impahla yakho, abagwedli bakho, abakuvala izimfa, abahwebelana nawe; wonke amabutho, wonke akuwe, nesixuku sonke esikuwe bayakuphonseka phakathi olwandle ngosuku oyakuwa ngalo.
Amaza ayakuzamazama ngenxa yomsindo wokukhala kwabagwedli bakho.
Bonke abagwedla izigwedlo, amatilosi nabo bonke abashayeli basolwandle, bayokuma emhlabathini,
bezwakalise izwi labo kuwe, bakhale ngomunyu, bathele uthuli emakhanda abo, bahuquzele emlotheni,
baphuce amakhanda abo ngenxa yakho, babhince indwangu eyisaka, bakulilele kalusizi.
Bayakudinda isililo ngenxa yakho, bakulilele, bathi: “ ‘ “Ngubani onjengeThire, onjengothulisiweyo phakathi kolwandle na?”
“ ‘Wasuthisa abantu abaningi ngesikhathi kuphuma impahla yakho; ngobuningi bomcebo wakho nempahla yakho, wacebisa amakhosi omhlaba.
Kwathi lapho usufahlazwe ngamanzi ekujuleni kolwandle, impahla yakho naso sonke isixuku sakho kwawela kuwe.
Bonke abakhileyo eziqhingini, bamangala ngawe; amakhosi azo athuthumela, kwashwaqa izinwele ngenxa yovalo.
Abahwebi ezizweni bayakukunximfela; usuyincithakalo; awusayukuba bikho kuze kube phakade.’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:

“Ndodana yomuntu, yisho kumbusi waseThire, uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘ “Uqhoshile enhliziyweni yakho, wathi: “ ‘ “Ngingunkulunkulu, ngihlala esihlalweni sonkulunkulu, phakathi olwandle.” “ ‘Ingani wena ungumuntu nje, awusiye unkulunkulu, nakuba wenze inhliziyo yakho yaba njengekankulunkulu.
Wena uhlakaniphile kunoDaniyeli, ayikho imfihlakalo abangakufihlela yona;
ngokuhlakanipha kwakho nangokuqonda kwakho uzizuzele ingcebo, wafaka igolide nesiliva ezinqolobaneni zakho;
ngokuhlakanipha kwakho okukhulu, ekuhwebeni wandise ingcebo yakho; inhliziyo yakho yaqhosha ngenxa yomcebo wakho.
“ ‘Ngakho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘ “Ngokuba inhliziyo yakho uyenze yaba njengekankulunkulu,
ngiyakuthumela kuwe abafokazi bezizwe abanonya; bayakubuhoshela izinkemba ubuhle bokuhlakanipha kwakho, bakungcolise ukukhazimula kwakho.
Bakwehlisele egodini, ufe njengofele olwandle.
Ngabe usasho yini kokubulalayo, uthi: “ ‘ “ ‘Mina ngingunkulunkulu na?’ “ ‘ “Ingani wena ungumuntu nje, awusiye unkulunkulu, ezandleni zokugwazayo.
Uyakufa ukufa kwabangasokile, ngesandla sabafokazi; ngokuba Mina ngikhulumile,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Izwi likaNkulunkulu lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, khihla isililo ngenkosi yaseThire, uthi kuyo: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘ “Wawuyisibonelo sokupheleleyo; ugcwele ukuhlakanipha, uphelele ngobuhle.

Use-Edene, ensimini kaNkulunkulu; wonke amatshe ayigugu ekusibekele; irubhi, ithopazi, idayimani, ishohamu, ijasiphi, isafire, isimaragidu, ikhrisolithe; imvunulo yakho, nezisekelo zamatshe zaziyigolide, zilungiswe ngosuku owadalwa ngalo.
Wagcotshwa waba yikherubhi elingumlindi; ngakubeka entabeni engcwele kaNkulunkulu, wahamba ematsheni omlilo.
Wawungenasici ezindleleni zakho, kusukela osukwini owadalwa ngalo kwaze kwaba lapho kutholakala okubi kuwe.
Ngokuhweba kwakho kakhulu, wagcwala ubudlova, waphambuka; ngakulahla entabeni kaNkulunkulu usungcolile, ngakubhubhisa wena kherubhi elingumlindi, wasuka ematsheni omlilo.
Inhliziyo yakho yakhukhumala ngenxa yobuhle bakho, wakonakalisa ukuhlakanipha kwakho ngokukhazimula kwakho. Ngakuqumba phansi, ngabeka amakhosi ukuba akuqaphe.

Wazingcolisa izindlu zakho ezingcwele, ngenxa yobuningi bobubi bakho, nangenxa yokuhweba kwakho okungalungile; ngenza ukuba kuqubuke umlilo kuwe, wakushisa wangqongqa. Ngakwenza waba ngumlotha emhlabathini, phambi kwabo bonke abakubonayo.
Zonke izizwe ezazikwazi zamangala ngenxa yakho; usufike esiphethweni esesabekayo, awusayukuba bikho kuze kube phakade.” ’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, bhekisa ubuso bakho eSidoni, uphrofethe umelene nalo,

uthi kulo: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘ “Bheka, ngimelene nawe Sidoni; ngiyakudunyiswa ngawe, abantu bayakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade, lapho sengilehlulela, ngizibonakalise ngingcwele kulo.
Ngiyakuthumela kulo ubhubhane negazi ligeleze emigwaqweni yalo. Abadliwe yinkemba bayakudindiliza kulo nxazonke, bayakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.
“ ‘ “Akusayukuba bikho makhakhasi nameva okuhlabayo nokulimazayo endlini yakwa-Israyeli, kusukela kulabo abazungeze nxazonke nalabo ababadelelayo; bayakukwazi ukuthi ngiyiNkosi uSimakade.

“ ‘ “Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: kuyakuthi lapho sengibaqoqa abendlu yakwa-Israyeli ezizweni abahlakazelwe kuzo, ngizibonakalise ngingcwele kubo, nasemehlweni ezizwe. Bayakuhlala ezweni labo engalinika inceku yami, uJakobe.

Bahlale kulo belondekile, bakhe izindlu, batshale izivini, bahlale bevikelekile, ngesikhathi ngibehlulela bonke ababedelelayo ababazungeze nxazonke, bayakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo.” ’ ”
Ngonyaka weshumi, ngenyanga yeshumi, ngosuku lwe-12 enyangeni, izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, bhekisa ubuso bakho kuFaro, inkosi yaseGibhithe, uphrofethe umelene naye nalo lonke iGibhithe,
ukhulume uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘ “Bheka, ngimelene nawe Faro, nkosi yaseGibhithe, silwanekazi sasolwandle, obuthisa emifuleni yakho, uthi: “ ‘ “Umfula ungowami, ngiwenze mina.”

“ ‘Ngiyakufaka amahhuku emihlathini yakho, nginamathelise izinhlanzi zemifula yakho ezingcwecweni zakho, ngikukhuphule emifuleni yakho nazo zonke izinhlanzi zemifula yakho ezinamathele ezingcwecweni zakho.
Ngiyakukulahla ehlane, wena nazo zonke izinhlanzi zemifula yakho, uwe ebusweni bomhlaba; awuyukubuthwa, noma ucoshwe; ngiyakukunikela ezilwaneni zomhlaba, nasezinyonini zezulu, ube ngukudla kwazo.
Bonke abakhileyo eGibhithe bayakukwazi ukuthi Mina nginguSimakade, ngokuba bebeludondolo lomhlanga lwendlu yakwa-Israyeli.
Kuthe lapho bekubamba ngesandla, wephuka, waklunyula amahlombe abo; nalapho bencika kuwe, waphoqoka, wazintengantengisa zonke izinkalo zabo.
“ ‘Ngalokho-ke, isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: uyabona-ke, sengizokwehlisela phezu kwakho inkemba, ngibulale abantu bakini nemfuyo yakho.
IGibhithe lizoba yincithakalo nehlane, bazokwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade, ngokuba wathi: “INayili ingeyami, ngiyenze mina.”
“ ‘Ngalokho-ke ngimelene nawe nemifula yakho. IGibhithe ngiyakulenza libe yincithakalo, imbubhiso nehlane, kusukela eMigidoli kuye eSevene, kuze kube semngceleni eKhushe.
Akukho nyawo lwamuntu nanselo yasilwane okuyakudabula kulo, futhi aliyukuhlalwa muntu iminyaka engama-40.

Ngiyakwenza iGibhithe libe yincithakalo emazweni asenziwe incithakalo, kuthi imizi yalo esemizini esiyincithakalo, nayo ibe yincithakalo iminyaka engama-40. AbaseGibhithe ngiyakubahlakazela ezizweni, ngibasabalalisele emazweni.
“ ‘Ngokuba isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngasekupheleni kweminyaka engama-40, ngiyakubaqoqa abaseGibhithe kubantu abahlakazekelwe kubo,
ngibabuyise ekuthunjweni, ngibabuyisele ePhathirosi, izwe abadabuka kulo, babe ngumbuso othobekileyo lapho.
IGibhithe liyakuba ngumbuso othobekileyo kuneminye imibuso, futhi alisayukuziphakamisa kwezinye izizwe, ngiyakulithena amandla ukuba lingazibusi izizwe.
Alisayukuba yithemba labendlu yakwa-Israyeli, kodwa liyakuba yisikhumbuzo sokona kwabo, lapho bephendukela kulo becela usizo, bayakukwazi ukuthi Mina ngiyiNkosi uSimakade.” ’ ”
Kwathi ngonyaka wama-20, ngenyanga yokuqala, ngosuku lokuqala enyangeni, izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:

“Ndodana yomuntu, uNebukhadinezari, inkosi yaseBhabhele, wawasebenzisa kanzima amabutho akhe ngesikhathi emelene neThire. Wonke amakhanda enziwa izimpandla, namahlombe wonke aklunyulwa, kodwa yena namabutho akhe abakhokhelwanga lutho ngomsebenzi wabo wokuhlasela iThire.

Ngalokho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Bheka, sengizonika uNebukhadinezari, inkosi yaseBhabhele, iGibhithe; uzoyithatha ingcebo yalo, aphange impango yalo, bese ethatha impango yalo, ibe yinkokhelo yamabutho akhe.
Ngimnike iGibhithe ukuba libe yinkokhelo yakhe ngokuzikhandla kwakhe, ngokuba yena namabutho akhe bakwenzele Mina lokho,’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘Ngalolo lusuku ngizokwenza abendlu yakwa-Israyeli badlondlobale ngamandla, ngikuvumele ukuba ukhulume kubo, bazokwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, phrofetha uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘Lilani, nithi: “ ‘ “Maye, ngalolo lusuku!”
“ ‘Ngokuba usuku luseduze, usuku lukaSimakade selusondele; luzokuba lusuku lwamafu nesikhathi senhlekelele kwabezizwe.
Inkemba izokwehlela eGibhithe, kube nobumayemaye eKhushe, lapho abagwaziweyo befumbeka phansi eGibhithe; bazoyithatha ingcebo yalo, kudilizwe nezisekelo zalo.
“ ‘IKhushe, iPhuthi, iLude, neKhubi, nabantu bezwe abenze isivumelwano nabo bazokufa ngenkemba.

“ ‘Usho kanje uSimakade, uthi: “ ‘Nalabo ababesekela iGibhithe bazoqumbeka phansi, nokuzigqaja ngamandla alo kuzophela nya; bazodliwa yinkemba bekulo, kusukela eMigidoli kuze kube seSevene,’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘Bazokuba yincithakalo emazweni aseyincithakalo, imizi yalo ibe semizini ebhidliziweyo.
Bazokwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade, lapho sengithungela ngomlilo iGibhithe, bacoboshiswe bonke abangumfelandawonye nalo.
“ ‘Ngalolo lusuku kuyakuphuma izithunywa ngemikhumbi zivela kimi, ukuba zilesabise iKhushe elinethezekileyo, kube nobumayemaye kulo ngosuku lwenhlekelele eGibhithe, ngokuba bheka, luyeza usuku.
“ ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘ “Isixuku saseGibhithe ngiyakusiqeda nya, ngesandla sikaNebukhadinezari, inkosi yaseBhabhele.
Yena nabantu bakhe nabezizwe abanonya, bayakuthunyelwa ukuba balibhubhise izwe, iGibhithe balihoshele izinkemba zabo, izwe baligcwalise ngababuleweyo.
Ngiyakwenza imifula ishe, ngithengise ngezwe esandleni sababi; izwe nakho konke okukulo, ngilibhubhise ngesandla sabafokazi, ngokuba Mina Simakade sengikhulumile.”
“ ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘Ngiyakuzishabalalisa izithombe, ngibaqede nya onkulunkulu abayize eNofi; akusayukuba bikho nkosana evela eGibhithe; ngiyakulifaka ingebhe iGibhithe.
IPhathirosi ngiyakulenza libe lihlane, ngiphembe umlilo eZowani, ngilijezise iNo.
Ngiyakuthululela ulaka lwami phezu kweSini, inqaba yaseGibhithe, ngibulale isixuku saseThebe.
Ngiyakuthungela umlilo eGibhithe; iSini libinyabinyeke ezinhlungwini, iThebe ibhodlozwe, iMemfisi ihlaselwe emini.
Izinsizwa zase-Aveni nasePhi Bhesethi ziyakufa ngenkemba, abahlala emizini bathunjwe.
Usuku luyakuba mnyama eThehafenehesi, lapho nginqamula khona amajoka aseGibhithe; nokuzikhukhumeza ngamandla alo kuyakuphela kulo. Liyakusitshekelwa yifu, kuthunjwe nabahlala emizaneni yalo.
Ngiyakulijezisa iGibhithe, futhi bayakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.’ ”
Kwathi ngonyaka we-11, ngenyanga yokuqala, ngosuku lwesikhombisa, izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, ngiyephulile ingalo kaFaro inkosi yaseGibhithe; ayiboshiwe ukuba yelapheke, noma izongolozelwe ukuba iqine ikwazi ukubamba inkemba.
Ngakho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Uyabona-ke, ngimelene noFaro, inkosi yaseGibhithe; ngiyakuzephula izingalo zakhe, eqinileyo neyephukileyo, ngenze ukuba inkemba iwe esandleni sakhe.
AbaseGibhithe ngiyakubahlakazela ezizweni, ngibasabalalise emazweni.
Ngiyakuziqinisa izingalo zenkosi yaseBhabhele, ngibeke inkemba yami esandleni sayo, kepha ngiyakuzephula izingalo zikaFaro, abubule phambi kwayo njengokububula komuntu olinyaziweyo.

Yebo, ngiyakuziqinisa izingalo zenkosi yaseBhabhele, bese kuthi izingalo zikaFaro ziyethe. Bayakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade, lapho sengibeka inkemba yami esandleni senkosi yaseBhabhele; yona iyakuyelulela phezu kweGibhithe, imelane nalo.
AbaseGibhithe ngiyakubahlakazela ezizweni, ngibasabalalise emazweni, bayakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.’ ”
Kwathi ngonyaka we-11, ngenyanga yesithathu, ngosuku lokuqala enyangeni izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, khuluma kuFaro, inkosi yaseGibhithe nasesixukwini sakhe, uthi: “ ‘Ngubani ongalinganiswa nawe ngobukhulu na?
Cabanga nje i-Asiriya, elalingumsedari waseLebhanoni; unamagatsha amahle, namaqabunga anomthunzi, nesiqu esiphakemeyo; isihloko sawo sifinyelela emafini.
Amanzi awukhulisa, izinzulu zemithombo zawuphakamisa. Imifula yawo yayigeleza nxazonke lapho utshalwe khona; yayisithumela imifudlana yayo kuzo zonke izihlahla zasendle.
Ngalokho-ke isiqu sawo sasiphakeme kunayo yonke imithi yasendle; amagatsha awo aba makhulu, namagatsha awo enaba ngenxa yamanzi amaningi.
Zonke izinyoni zezulu zakha izidleke zazo emagatsheni awo, izilwane zonke zasendle zazalela phansi kwamagatsha awo; zonke izizwe ezinkulu zahlala phansi komthunzi wawo.
Wawumuhle ngobukhulu bawo, nangobude bamagatsha awo, ngokuba izimpande zawo zazilapho kunamanzi amaningi khona.
Imisedari esensimini kaNkulunkulu yayingenakuwusitha; imisayiphuresi ingafani namagatsha awo, nemiphelathani ingenjengamagatsha awo, kungekho nowodwa umuthi ensimini kaNkulunkulu ofana nawo ngobuhle.
Ngawenza waba muhle ngobuningi bamagatsha awo, yonke imithi yase-Edene eyayisensimini kaNkulunkulu, yaba nomhawu ngawo.
“ ‘Ngakho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Njengoba ubuphakeme ngobude, wafinyelelisa isihloko sawo phakathi kwamafu, nenhliziyo yawo yazikhukhumeza ngenxa yokuphakama kwawo,
ngiyakuwunikela esandleni somholi wezizwe, impela yena uyakwenza okufanele kuwo ngangokukhohlakala kwawo, bese ngiwuxosha.

Abafokazi bezizwe ezinonya, bawunqumile, base bewushiya. Amagatsha awo awele ezintabeni nasezigodini, kwathi amagatsha awo aphukela kuyo yonke imifudlana yezwe, futhi bonke abantu basukile emthunzini wawo, bawushiya kanjalo.
Kuyakuhlala zonke izinyoni zezulu esiqwini sawo, zonke izilwane zasendle zibe semagatsheni awo,

ukuba kungabi bikho muthi ongasemanzini, oyakuba mude ngokuphakama kwawo, ungasifinyelelisi isihloko sawo emafini, futhi kungabi bikho mithi eyophuza amanzi, ikhule ibe mide ngangawo, ngokuba yonke inikelwe ekufeni phansi komhlaba, ebantwaneni babantu, labo abehlela egodini.” ’

“ ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngosuku owehlela ngalo endaweni yabafileyo, ngenza ukuba izinzulu ziwulilele, ngawusibekela, ngavimba imifula yalo, namanzi amaningi awangageleza. ILebhanoni ngalifaka inzilo ngenxa yawo; imithi yonke yasendle yadangala ngawo.

Izizwe ngazithuthumelisa ngomsindo wokuwa kwawo, lapho ngiwehlisela endaweni yabafileyo, nalabo abehlela egodini. Yaduduzwa phansi komhlaba yonke imithi yase-Edene ekhethekileyo neyaseLebhanoni emihle, nayo yonke eniseliweyo.
Labo ababehlala emthunzini wawo, nezizwe ezazingumfelandawonye nawo, nabo behlela nawo endaweni yabafileyo, baya kulabo ababebulawe ngenkemba.
