“ ‘ “Pho yimuphi umuthi wase-Edene ongalinganiswa nawe ngodumo nangobukhulu na? Nokho uyakwehliselwa phansi komhlaba nemithi yase-Edene, ulale nabangasokile nababulawe ngenkemba. Lowo-ke nguFaro, naso sonke isixuku sakhe,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Kwathi ngonyaka we-12, ngenyanga ye-12, ngosuku lokuqala enyangeni, izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:

“Ndodana yomuntu, khihla isililo ngoFaro, inkosi yaseGibhithe, uthi kuye: “ ‘Wazifanisa nebhongo lengonyama ezizweni, kepha unjengesilwanekasi sasolwandle, lapho utheleka emifuleni yakho, ushaya idadamu ngezinyawo zakho, udunge imifula.’
“ ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘Ngiyakwendlala inetha lami phezu kwakho, phakathi kwesixuku sabantu abaningi, bakukhuphule ngenetha lami.
Ngiyakukulaxaza emhlabathini, ngikuntshinge endle, ngihlalise phezu kwakho zonke izinyoni zezulu, ngizisuthise ngawe zonke izilwane zomhlaba.
Ngiyakubeka inyama yakho ezintabeni, ngigcwalise izigodi ngezimpethu zakho.
Izwe ngiligcwalise ngegazi eliyakugeleza liphuma kuwe, kuze kube sezintabeni, imifula igcwaliswe ngokuphuma kuwe.
Kuyakuthi lapho sengiqeda nya ngawe, ngisibekele amazulu, ngenze izinkanyezi zawo zibe mnyama, ngilemboze ngefu ilanga, nenyanga ingakhanyisi ngokukhanya kwayo.
Zonke izikhanyisi ezikhanyayo emazulwini ngiyakuzenza zibe mnyama phezu kwakho, ngehlisele ubumnyama ezweni lakho, kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Ngiyakuzikhathaza izinhliziyo zezizwe eziningi, lapho sengiletha ukubhujiswa kwakho ezizweni, emazweni ongawazanga.

Ngiyakwenza ukuba abantu abaningi bamangale ngawe, amakhosi abo agedezele wuvalo lapho ngisikaza ngenkemba yami phambi kwawo. Ngosuku lokuwa kwakho, yileyo naleyo iyakuthuthumela umzuzu nomzuzu ngenxa yempilo yayo.
“ ‘Ngokuba isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “ ‘ “Inkemba yenkosi yaseBhabhele iyakuza kuwe.
Ngiyakusiqumba phansi isixuku sakho, ngenkemba yezizwe zonke ezinonya; ziyakukuqeda nya ukuzigqaja kweGibhithe, naso sonke isixuku salo siyakubhujiswa.
Ngiyakuyibhubhisa yonke imfuyo yalo engasemanzini amaningi, angabe esanyakaziswa lunyawo lwamuntu, nenselo yemfuyo ingawadungi.
Ngiyakwenza ukuba amanzi abo abohle, ngigelezise imifula yabo njengamafutha,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.

“ ‘ “Kuyakuthi lapho iGibhithe sengilenze laba yincithakalo nehlane, izwe eseliphundlwe konke obekugcwele kulo, lapho sengibulala zonke izakhamuzi zalo, kulapho-ke beyakukwazi khona ukuthi nginguSimakade.
“ ‘ “Leso-ke yisililo abantu abayakusihlabelela. Amadodakazi ezizwe ayakusihlabelela, elilela iGibhithe naso sonke isixuku salo,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Kwathi ngonyaka we-12, ngosuku lwe-15 enyangeni, izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, lilela isixuku saseGibhithe, usehlisele phansi komhlaba, namadodakazi ezizwe ezinamandla, nalabo abehlela egodini.
Khuluma kubo uthi: ‘Wena udlula bani ngobuhle na? Yehla, ulaliswe nabangasokile.’
Bayakuwela kulabo ababulawe ngenkemba; inkemba seyihoshiwe, lihuduleni naso sonke isixuku salo.
Abaholi bamaqhawe bayakukhuluma ngalo nangomfelandawonye walo, besendaweni yabafileyo, bathi: ‘Sebehlile, sebelele nabangasokile, labo ababulawe ngenkemba.’
“Lapho kukhona i-Asiriya neviyo lalo lonke, amathuna alo alizungeze nxazonke, bonke bafe ngenkemba.
Amathuna alo asekujuleni kwegodi, iviyo lalo lizungeze ithuna nxazonke, bonke labo abafake ingebhe ezweni labaphilayo babulewe, bafe ngenkemba.

“Lapho kukhona i-Elamu naso sonke isixuku salo nxazonke zethuna, babulawe bonke, baqunjwa phansi ngenkemba, behlela phansi komhlaba bengasokile, labo abafake ingebhe ezweni labaphilayo; sebethwele ihlazo nalabo abehlela egodini.

I-Elamu balilungisele umbhede naso sonke isixuku salo, amathuna alo alizungeze nxazonke, bonke abangasokanga babulawe ngenkemba, ngokuba benza ukuba besatshwe ezweni labaphilayo, sebethwele ihlazo labo nalabo abehlela egodini; yebo, balele nababuleweyo.
“Lapho kukhona uMeshekhe, uThubhali, naso sonke isixuku sabo esizungeze amathuna abo nxazonke, bonke abangasokanga, babulawe ngenkemba, ngokuba bafaka ingebhe ezweni labaphilayo.

Abalali yini namabutho angasokile asebulewe, ehlela endaweni yabafileyo nezikhali zawo zempi, nezinkemba zawo ezabekwa phansi kwamakhanda awo na? Isijeziso sokona kwawo sasisemathanjeni awo, nakuba ukwesatshwa kwamabutho kwakusezweni labaphilayo.
“Nawe uyakuphoqozwa, ulale nabangasokile nababulawe ngenkemba.
“Lapho kukhona u-Edomi, amakhosi akhe, nazo zonke izikhulu zakhe, okuthe nakuba bebengamaqhawe nokho balaliswa nababulawe ngenkemba, abangasokile, nalabo abehlela egodini.

“Lapho kukhona zonke izikhulu zasenyakatho, nabo bonke abaseSidoni, abehlele phansi nababuleweyo. Babesatshwa ngenxa yobuqhawe babo, kepha sebehlazekile, balale bengasokile nababulawe ngenkemba, bathwele ihlazo labo nalabo abehlele egodini.
“UFaro uyakubabona, aduduzeke ngaso sonke isixuku sakhe, yena nawo wonke amabutho akhe babulawe ngenkemba,” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“Ufake uvalo ezweni labaphilayo, kepha uyakulaliswa phakathi kwabangasokile nalabo ababulawe ngenkemba, uFaro nezinkumbi zakhe,” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, khuluma kubantu bakini, uthi kubo: ‘Ngiyakwehlisela inkemba phezu kwezwe, bese abantu bakhona bekhetha omunye umuntu phakathi kwabo, bambeke abe ngumlindi wabo,
kuyothi lapho yena esebona kwehlela inkemba phezu kwezwe, ashaye icilongo, axwayise abantu.
Umuntu oyokuzwa ukukhala kwecilongo nokho angaxwayi, kuthi inkemba yehle imbhubhise, igazi lakhe liyakuba sekhanda lakhe.
Ngokuba ukuzwile ukukhala kwecilongo nokho akaze exwaya; igazi lakhe liyakuba kuye, ngokuba ukuba ubexwayile, ngabe uyisindisile impilo yakhe.

Kepha-ke uma umlindi eyibonile inkemba yehla, akaze alishaya icilongo ukuba abantu baxwaye, inkemba ize yehlele kubo, ibhubhise umuntu phakathi kwabo, lowo muntu uyakubhubha ngenxa yokona kwakhe, kodwa igazi lakhe ngiyakulibiza esandleni somlindi.’
“Ndodana yomuntu, wena-ke, ngikubeke umlindi wendlu yakwa-Israyeli. Lalela ilizwi eliphuma emlonyeni wami, ubaxwayise, lokho kuvela kimi.

Kuyakuthi lapho ngithi komubi: ‘Muntu omubi, uyakufa nokufa,’ bese wena ungakhulumi ukuba uxwayise umuntu omubi ayishiye indlela yakhe, lowo muntu omubi uyakufa ngenxa yokona kwakhe, kodwa igazi lakhe ngiyakulibiza kuwe.
Kepha uma umxwayisile omubi ukuba ayishiye indlela yakhe, nokho yena akaze ayishiya indlela yakhe, uyakufa nokufa ngenxa yobubi bakhe, kodwa wena uyakube uyihlengile impilo yakho.

“Wena ndodana yomuntu, tshela indlu yakwa-Israyeli, uthi kuyo: ‘Nisho kanje, nithi: “Ngenxa yokuthi iziphambeko zethu nezono zethu kuphezu kwethu, siyazaca ngenxa yazo, pho-ke sizophila kanjani na?” ’

“Batshele, uthi kubo: ‘Ngifunga ngiyagomela, kusho iNkosi uSimakade, angithokoziswa ngukufa komubi, kodwa ngithokoza uma isoni siphenduka endleleni yaso, siphile. Phendukani, nishiye izindlela zenu ezimbi, nina ndlu yakwa-Israyeli niyakufelani na?’

“Kepha wena ndodana yomuntu, batshele abantu bakini, uthi kubo: ‘Ukulunga kolungileyo akusoze kwamsindisa ngosuku ayokona ngalo, nokona komubi akuyukumkhubekisa ngosuku ayophenduka ngalo ekuphambukeni kwakhe, nolungileyo akayukuphila ngakho ngosuku lokona kwakhe.’

“Kuyakuthi lapho ngithi kolungileyo uyakuphila nokuphila, kodwa yena ethembele ekulungeni kwakhe, bese enza okubi; akusayukukhunjulwa ngisho nesisodwa sezenzo zakhe ezilungileyo, kepha uyakufela ebubini abenzileyo.
Lapho ngithi komubi: ‘Uyakufa nokufa,’ bese yena ephenduka esonweni sakhe, enze okufaneleyo nokulungileyo,
yena lowo omubi abuyise isibambiso, akhokhe ayekuthathile, ahambe ngezimiso zokuphila, angakwenzi okubi, impela uyakuphila, angafi.
Akayukukhunjulelwa nesisodwa sezono zakhe azenzileyo, ngokuba ukwenzile okufaneleyo nokulungileyo; uyakuphila.
“Kepha abantu bakini, bathi: ‘Indlela yeNkosi ayilungile.’ Kepha yindlela yabo engalungile.
Lapho olungileyo eyeka ukwenza okulungileyo, bese enza okubi, uyakufela kukho.
Nalapho omubi ephenduka ebubini bakhe, enze okufaneleyo nokulungileyo, uyakuphila ngakho.
Nokho nisho kanje, nithi: ‘Indlela yeNkosi ayilungile.’ “Nina ndlu yakwa-Israyeli ngiyakunehlulela, kube yilowo nalowo ngokwenza kwakhe.”
Kwathi ngonyaka we-12 wokuthunjwa kwethu, ngosuku lweshumi enyangeni, kwafika kimi ophunyukileyo eJerusalema, wathi: “Umuzi unqotshiwe.”

Kwathi kusihlwa, engakafiki lowo owayekade ephunyuke eJerusalema, isandla sikaSimakade saba phezu kwami, wawuvula umlomo wami engakafiki kimi ekuseni. Wavulwa-ke umlomo wami, angabe ngisaba yisimungulu.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, izakhamuzi ezindaweni ezichithakele kwa-Israyeli, zithi: ‘U-Abhrahama wayeyedwa, wadla ifa lezwe, kodwa thina sibaningi, siliphiwe lona libe yifa lethu.’

Ngakho-ke batshele lokhu, uthi kubo: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Nina nidla okunegazi, niphakamisa amehlo enu ezithombeni zenu, nichitha igazi. Pho niyakulidla kanjani izwe libe yifa lenu na?
Nethembele enkembeni yenu, nenza izinengiso; ningcolisa, kube yilowo nalowo umkamakhelwane wakhe. Pho-ke niyakulidla kanjani izwe libe yifa lenu na?” ’

“Uyakuthi kubo: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngifunga ngiyagomela ngithi, labo abasezindaweni ezichithakele impela bayokufa ngenkemba, osendle ngiyakumnikela ezilwaneni ukuba zimudle, nabasezinqabeni nasemigedeni bayobulawa wubhubhane.
Izwe ngiyakulenza libe yincithakalo neze, ukuzidla ngamandla alo kuyakuphela nya; izintaba zakwa-Israyeli ziyakubhujiswa ukuze kungabi bikho odlula kuzo.
Kulapho-ke bayakungazi khona ukuthi nginguSimakade, lapho izwe sengilenze laba yincithakalo neze, ngenxa yazo zonke izinengiso zabo abazenzileyo.” ’

“Wena-ke ndodana yomuntu, abantu bakini bakhuluma ngawe ngasezindongeni naseminyango yezindlu, bakhuluma omunye komunye, omunye kumfowabo, bathi: ‘Woza uzokuzwa ukuthi yizwi elithini elivela kuSimakade.’

Bafika kuwe bengabantu, bahlale phambi kwakho njengabantu bami, balalele amazwi akho, nokho abawagcini. Ngomlomo wabo babonakalisa uthando olukhulu, kodwa inhliziyo yabo ibe ilandela inzuzo yabo engafanele.
Uyabona-ke, unjengesihlabelelo sothando, unephimbo elimnandi kubo, ulushaya kamnandi ugubhu, bayawezwa amazwi akho, kodwa abenzi lutho ngawo.
“Kuyakuthi lapho sekwenzeka lokhu; ngempela kuyeza, bayokwazi lapho ukuthi kwakukhona umphrofethi phakathi kwabo.”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:

“Ndodana yomuntu, phrofetha umelane nabelusi bakwa-Israyeli; phrofetha uthi kubo: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Maye, kubelusi bakwa-Israyeli abazicabangela bona! Kanti abelusi akumele yini ukuba beluse izimvu na?
Nina nidla amanoni, nembathe uboya, nihlabe ezikhulupheleyo, kodwa izimvu anizelusi.
Ezibuthakathaka aniziqinisi, egulayo aniyelaphi, elahlekileyo aniyicingi, kodwa niziphatha ngendlakadla.
Bezihlakazekile ngenxa yokweswela umelusi; zahlakazeka zaba ngukudla kwazo zonke izilwane zasendle.
Izimvu zami bezizulazula kuzo zonke izintaba nakuwo wonke amagquma aphakemeyo. Yebo, izimvu zami zazihlakazekele ebusweni bonke bomhlaba, akwaba bikho ozifunayo nozicingayo.
“ ‘ “Ngakho-ke belusi, yizwani izwi likaSimakade elithi:

ngifunga ngiyagomela,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade, “ ‘ “impela ngenxa yokuthi izimvu zami zaba yimpango, futhi zaba ngukudla kwazo zonke izilwane zasendle, lokhu zingenamelusi, nokuthi abelusi bami abangazange bazicinge, baba ngogombela kwesabo, bangazelusa izimvu zami,
ngalokho-ke yizwani izwi likaSimakade, belusi, elithi:

isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: bhekani-ke, ngimelene nabelusi, ngizozifuna izimvu zami esandleni sabo, ngenze ukuba bangabe besazelusa, futhi bangabe besaba ngogombela kwesabo. Ngizohlenga izimvu zami emlonyeni wabo, zingabe zisaba ngukudla kwabo.”
“ ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Mina ngizozicinga izimvu zami, ngizifune.
Njengalokhu umelusi ewufuna umhlambi wakhe lapho uhlakazekile, kanjalo-ke ngiyakuzifuna izimvu zami, ngizihlenge kuzo zonke izindawo ezihlakazelwe kuzo ngosuku lwamafu nesigayegaye sobumnyama.
Ngiyakuzikhipha ezizweni, ngiziqoqe emazweni, ngiziyise ezweni lazo, bese ngizelusela ezintabeni zakwa-Israyeli, nangasemifuleni, nasezindaweni zonke okuhlalwa kuzo ezweni.
Ngiyakuzelusela emadlelweni amahle; amadlelo azo ayakuba sezintabeni eziphakemeyo kwa-Israyeli. Ziyakubuthisa emadlelweni amahle, ziklabe emadlelweni aluhlaza ezintabeni kwa-Israyeli.
Ngiyakuzelusela Mina izimvu zami, ngizenze zibuthise,” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“Ezilahlekileyo ngiyakuzifuna, ngizibuyise ezidukileyo, ngibophe ezaphukileyo, ngiqinise ezigulayo, kodwa ezikhulupheleyo nezinamandla ngiyakuzibhubhisa; ngiyakuzinakekela ngobulungiswa.
“ ‘ “Nina-ke zimvu zami, isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ngiyakwehlulela phakathi kwemvu nemvu naphakathi kwezinqama nezimpongo.
Kuyize yini kini ukuba niklabe edlelweni elihle bese ninyathela ngezinyawo zenu okuseleyo edlelweni lenu, nokuba niphuze amanzi acwebileyo qede niwadunge ngezinyawo zenu aseleyo na?
Izimvu zami zidla okudovadovwe ngezinyawo zenu, ziphuza okudungwe yizinyawo zenu.
“ ‘ “Ngakho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade kuzo, ithi: Mina ngiyakwehlulela phakathi kwezimvu ezikhulupheleyo nalezo ezondileyo.
Ngokuba nizisunduza ngohlangothi nangehlombe, niqhubukusha zonke ezigulayo ngezimpondo zenu, nize nizihlakazele ngaphandle,
ngiyakuzisindisa izimvu zami, azisayukuba yimpango, bese ngehlulela phakathi kwezimvu nezimvu.
Ngiyakubeka kuzo umelusi, azeluse: inceku yami uDavide; uyakuzelusa, abe ngumelusi wazo.
Mina Simakade ngiyakuba nguNkulunkulu wazo, inceku yami uDavide ibe yisikhulu kuzo; Mina Simakade ngikhulumile.
“ ‘ “Ngiyakwenza nazo isivumelwano sokuthula, ngiqede izilwane ezimbi ezweni, zihlale zilondekile ehlane, zilale emahlathini.
Ngiyakuzibusisa zona nezindawo ezizungeze intaba yami, ngehlise imvula ngesikhathi sayo, ibe yizihlambi zesibusiso.

Umuthi osendle uyakuthela izithelo zawo, umhlabathi ukhiqize ukudla kwawo, zihlale zilondekile ezweni lazo; ziyakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade, lapho sengizaphulile izikeyi zejoka lazo, futhi ngazihlenga esandleni salabo ababezenze izikhonzi zabo.
Azisayukuba yimpango yabezizwe, nesilwane somhlaba asiyukuzidla, kepha ziyakuhlala ngokulondeka, zingesatshiswa muntu.
Ngiyakuzivusela insimu edumileyo; azisayukususwa yindlala ezweni, azisayukulithwala ihlazo labezizwe.
Ziyakukwazi ukuthi Mina Simakade uNkulunkulu wazo nginazo, nokuthi zona, indlu yakwa-Israyeli, zingabantu bami,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Nina niyizimvu zami, niyizimvu zedlelo lami, nabantu bami, Mina nginguNkulunkulu wenu,” ’ ” kusho uSimakade.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, bhekisa ubuso bakho ngasentabeni iSeyiri uphrofethe umelane nayo,
uthi kuyo, ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngimelene nawe ntaba iSeyiri; ngiyakwelulela isandla sami kuwe, ngikushaye, ngikwenze ube yincithakalo neze.
Imizi yakini ngiyakuyenza ibe yihlane, wena ube yincithakalo; uyakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.
“ ‘ “Ngenxa yokuba unobutha obungapheliyo, futhi unikele abakwa-Israyeli ukuba badliwe yinkemba lapho behlelwa yisigemegeme, ngesikhathi bethola isijeziso sabo sokugcina,
ngakho-ke ngifunga ngiyagomela,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uNkulunkulu, “ ‘ “ngiyakukunikela ekuchithekeni kwegazi, ukuchitheka kwegazi kube yinsakavukela kuwe, ngokuba awukuzondi ukuchitha igazi.
Intaba iSeyiri ngiyakuyenza ibe yincithakalo neze, ngimbulale odlula kuyo nobuya kuyo.
Ngiyakugcwalisa izintaba zayo ngababuleweyo bayo, abagwazwe ngenkemba bayakuwela emagqumeni akho, ezigodini zakho, nakuyo yonke imifula yakho.
Ngiyakukwenza incithakalo yaphakade, imizi yakini ingabe isahlala muntu, ukuze nazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.
“ ‘ “Ngokuba wathi: ‘Lezi zizwe ezimbili nalawa mazwe amabili kuyakuba ngokwami, ngidle ifa lakho,’ nakuba uSimakade ebelapho,
ngakho-ke ngifunga ngiyagomela,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade, “ ‘ “ngiyakwenza njengolaka lwakho nanjengomhawu wakho obafele wona ngokubazonda kwakho, ngizazise kubo, lapho sengikwehlulela.
Kulapho-ke uyokwazi khona ukuthi nginguSimakade. Ngiyizwile yonke inhlamba yakho oyithuke usezintabeni zakwa-Israyeli, uthi: Yincithakalo; siphiwe zona ukuba sizidle.
“ ‘ “Nizikhukhumezile kimi ngomlomo wenu, naphindaphinda amazwi enu. Mina ngizwile.” ’ ”
Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Kuyakuthi lapho umhlaba wonke uthokoza, wena ngikwenze ube yincithakalo.

Njengoba nawe wathokoza ngefa lendlu yakwa-Israyeli, lapho iba yincithakalo, ngiyakwenza kanjalo nakuwe. Wena ntaba iSeyiri uyakuba yincithakalo, naye wonke u-Edomi, yebo, wonke jikelele, bayakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.”
“Wena ndodana yomuntu, phrofetha kuzo izintaba zakwa-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Nina zintaba zakwa-Israyeli, zwanini izwi likaSimakade.
Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngenxa yokuba isitha sithe kini: Ashila, sabuye sathi: Izindawo eziphakemeyo zasemandulo seziyifa lethu.
“Ngakho-ke phrofetha, uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngokuba impela banenza naba yincithakalo, banilimaza nxazonke ukuba nibe yifa lezizwe eziseleyo,

ngakho-ke zintaba zakwa-Israyeli, zwanini izwi leNkosi uSimakade, elithi: Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade kuzo izintaba, emagqumeni, emifuleni, ezigodini, ezindaweni eziyincithakalo, emizini esisele dengwane, osekuyimpango nenhlekisa yezizwe eziseleyo ezizungeze gimbici,

isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: impela ngentukuthelo yami evuthayo, ngikhulumile ngamelana nensali ezizweni naye wonke u-Edomi, abenze izwe lami laba yifa labo ngentokozo nangenhliziyo yabo embi, ukuze lilahlwe libe yimpango.” ’ ”

Ngakho-ke phrofetha ngezwe lakwa-Israyeli, uthi ezintabeni, emagqumeni, emifuleni nasezigodini: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngikhulume nginesikhwele nolaka oluvuthayo, ngokuba benithwele ihlazo labezizwe.
Ngakho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ngisiphakamisile isandla sami, ngafunga ngathi impela abezizwe abanizungeze ndawo zonke bayakulithwala ihlazo labo.
“ ‘ “Kepha nina zintaba zakwa-Israyeli niyakuhluma amagatsha, nithelele abantu bami izithelo, ngokuba sekuseduze ukuba babuye.
Bhekani, nginani; ngiyakubuyela kini, nilinywe, futhi nihlwanyelwe.
Ngiyakwandisa inani labantu bakini, bonke abendlu yakwa-Israyeli, ngothi lwabo. Yonke imizi yakhona kuyakuhlalwa kuyo, kuthi izindawo ezibhidliziweyo zakhiwe kabusha.
Ngiyakuwandisa umumo wabantu nezilwane, kwande, kuzalane. Ngiyakwenza ukuba kuhlalwe kini njengakuqala, nginenzele okuhle kunakuqala, niyakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.
Ngiyakukwenza abantu bami u-Israyeli ukuba bachachaze phezu kwenu, bayakunithatha nibe yifa labo; awusayukuphinde ubaphuce abantwana.
“ ‘ “Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi ngokuba bathi kuwe: Wena udla abantu, nguwe ophuce isizwe sakini abantwana,
“ ‘ “ngakho-ke awusayukuphinde ubadle abantu, futhi awusayukusiphuca isizwe sakini abantwana,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Ngiyakwenza ukuba ungabe usazizwa izinhlamba zabezizwe. Awusayukulithwala ihlazo labantu, ungabe usasikhubekisa nesizwe sakini,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:

“Ndodana yomuntu, ngesikhathi indlu ka-Israyeli isahlala ezweni layo, balingcolisa ngokuziphatha kabi kwabo nangezenzo zabo. Indlela ababeziphethe kabi ngayo yayingcolile phambi kwami, ifana nowesifazane ekungcoleni kwakhe.
Ngase ngithululela ulaka lwami phezu kwabo ngenxa yegazi ababelichithe ezweni, nangenxa yokuba babelingcolisile ngezithombe zabo.
Ngabahlakazela ezizweni, basatshalaliselwa emazweni; ngabehlulela ngangokuziphatha kabi kwabo nangezenzo zabo.
Kwakuthi lapho befika ezizweni ababeya kuzo, balihlambalaze igama lami elingcwele, lapho kwakuthiwa ngabo: ‘Laba bangabantu bakaSimakade, kodwa nakuba kunjalo balishiyile izwe lakhe.’
Kepha ngadabukela igama lami elingcwele, indlu yakwa-Israyeli eyayilingcolisile phakathi kwezizwe ababeye kuzo.

“Ngalokho yisho kuyo indlu yakwa-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Angikwenzi lokhu ngenxa yenu nina ndlu yakwa-Israyeli, kepha ngenxa yegama lami elingcwele enilihlambalazileyo ezizweni, lapho benikade nikhona.

Ngiyakulingcwelisa igama lami elikhulu elihlanjalaziweyo ezizweni, enilihlambalazileyo kuzo, izizwe ziyakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade, lapho ngizibonakalisa ngani phambi kwazo ukuthi Mina ngingcwele,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Ngiyakunithatha ezizweni, nginiqoqe emazweni wonke, nginiyise ezweni lakini.
Ngiyakunifafaza ngamanzi acwebe cwe, nihlambuluke, nginihlambulule kukho konke ukungcola kwenu nakuzo zonke izithombe zenu.
Ngiyakuninika inhliziyo entsha, ngifake umoya omusha ezibilinini zenu, ngiyikhiphe inhliziyo yetshe emzimbeni wenu, ngininike inhliziyo yobuntu.
Ngiyakufaka uMoya wami ezibilinini zenu, ngenze ukuba nihambe ngezimiso zami; niyakuzigcina izehlulelo zami, futhi nizenze.
Niyakuhlala ezweni engalinika okhokho benu, nibe ngabantu bami, Mina ngibe nguNkulunkulu wenu.
Ngiyakunihlenga kukho konke ukungcola kwenu; ngibize okusanhlamvu, ngikwenze kube yinsada, ngingabe ngisayehlisela kini indlala.
Ngiyakuzandisa izithelo ezihlahleni zenu nesivuno emasimini, ukuze ningathelwa ngehlazo ezizweni ngenxa yendlala.
Niyakuzikhumbula izindlela zenu ezimbi nezenzo zenu ezingezinhle, nizenyanye nina uqobo, ngenxa yobubi benu nangenxa yezinengiso zenu.
Makwazeke kini ukuthi lokhu angikwenzi ngenxa yenu, kodwa yibani namahloni nihlazeke ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi kwenu, nina ndlu yakwa-Israyeli.”
“ ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Kuyakuthi mhla nginihlambulula ebubini benu bonke, bese ngenza ukuba kuhlalwe kuyo yonke imizi, nezindawo ezibhidliziweyo zakhiwe kabusha.
Izwe ebelisele dengwane liyakulinywa kunokuba libe yincithakalo emehlweni abo bonke abadlulayo.
Bayakuthi: “Leli lizwe ebeliyihlane selifana nensimu yase-Edene; nemizi ebibhujisiwe, ebiyincithakalo nebibhidliziwe isibiyelwe, sekukhona abahlala kuyo.

Izizwe eziyakusala zinizungeze nxazonke ziyokwazi ukuthi yiMina Simakade engiyakhe kabusha imizi ebibhidliziwe, ngatshala endaweni ebisiyincithakalo; Mina Simakade ngikhulumile, futhi ngizokwenza lokho.’ ”
“Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Kuyakuthi lapho indlu yakwa-Israyeli inginxusa ukuba ngiyenzele lokhu: ngiyakuyandisela abantu bayo, babe ngangezimvu.

Babe baningi ngangemihlambi yaseJerusalema eyehlukaniselwe umhlatshelo ngesikhathi esimiselwe imikhosi yakhona. Kanjalo-ke nemizi ebisele dengwane iyakugcwala izinkumbi zabantu, bayakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.’ ”
Isandla sikaSimakade sasiphezu kwami, sangikhipha ngoMoya kaSimakade, sangibeka phakathi esigodini esasigcwele amathambo.
Wangidlulisa kuwo, ngawazungeza; bheka, impela ayemaningi ngokwedlulele kuso isigodi, futhi ayome kakhulu.
Wayesethi kimi: “Ndodana yomuntu, lawa mathambo angaphila na?” Ngathi: “Nkosi Simakade, nguWena owaziyo.”
Wayesethi kimi: “Phrofetha phezu kwalawa mathambo, uthi kuwo: ‘Nina mathambo omileyo, yizwani izwi likaSimakade.
Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade kulawa mathambo, ithi: Bhekani, ngiyakufaka umoya kini, niphile.
Ngiyakubeka imisipha phezu kwenu, ngihlumise inyama phezu kwenu, nginimboze ngesikhumba, ngifake umoya kini, niphile, niyakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.’ ”
Ngase ngiphrofetha njengoba ngangiyaliwe. Kwathi lapho ngisaphrofetha kwaba khona umsindo nobukhehlekhehle; amathambo asondelana, kwayilelo thambo lisondela kwelinye.
Ngase ngibona kuvela imisipha phezu kwawo, kwahluma inyama, isikhumba sawamboza ngaphezulu, kodwa umoya wawungekho kuwo.
Wayesethi kimi: “Ndodana yomuntu, phrofetha kuwo umoya, phrofetha uthi kuwo: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Woza, moya uvele emimoyeni yomine, uphefumulele laba ababuleweyo, ukuze baphile.” ’ ”
Ngase ngiphrofetha njengoba ngiyaliwe; umoya wangena kuwo, aphila, ema ngezinyawo zawo, aba yimpi enkulu kakhulu impela.
Wayesethi kimi: “Ndodana yomuntu, lawa mathambo ayindlu yonke yakwa-Israyeli, bathi: ‘Bheka, amathambo ethu omile, siphelelwe yithemba, sibhujisiwe.’
“Ngakho-ke phrofetha, uthi kubo: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngiyakuvula amathuna enu, nginikhuphule emathuneni enu, nina bantu bami, nginiyise kwa-Israyeli.
Niyakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade lapho sengiwavulile amathuna enu, nganikhuphula kuwo, nina bantu bami.
Ngiyakuwufaka uMoya wami kini, bese niphila, nginibeke ezweni lakini; niyakukwazi ukuthi Mina Simakade ngikhulumile, futhi ngiyakukwenza lokho,” ’ ” kusho uSimakade.
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:

“Wena ndodana yomuntu, zithathele induku, ulobe kuyo, uthi: ‘EkaJuda nabakwa-Israyeli abangabangani bakhe.’ “Thatha enye induku futhi, ulobe kuyo, uthi: ‘EkaJosefa, induku ka-Efrayimi nendlu yonke yakwa-Israyeli, abangabangani bakhe.’
Zihlanganise ndawonye, zibe yinduku eyodwa, induku eyodwa esandleni sakho.
“Kuyothi lapho abantu bakini bekubuza, bethi: ‘Ungesitshele yini ukuthi lezi zinduku zichazani kuwe na?’

“Ubobatshela uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Induku kaJosefa esesandleni sika-Efrayimi nezizwe zakwa-Israyeli ezingabangani bakhe, ngiyakukuthatha ngikubeke endukwini kaJuda, ngikwenze kube yinduku eyodwa, babe munye esandleni sami.” ’
“Izinduku olobe kuzo ziyakuba sesandleni sakho bazibonele ngawabo amehlo.
Khuluma kubo, uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngiyakubathatha abakwa-Israyeli ezizweni lapho baya khona, ngibaqoqe nxazonke, ngibayise ezweni lakubo.
Ngiyakubenza babe yisizwe esisodwa ezweni, ezintabeni zakwa-Israyeli, kube nenkosi eyodwa eyakubabusa bonke, bangabe besaba yizizwe ezimbili, futhi bangabe besahlukaniswa babe yimibuso emibili.

Abasayukuzingcolisa ngezithombe zabo, ngokunengekayo kwabo, nangesisodwa seziphambeko zabo, kepha ngiyakubasindisa kukho konke ukuhlubuka kwabo abone ngakho, ngibahlambulule babe ngabantu bami, Mina ngibe nguNkulunkulu wabo.
“ ‘ “Inceku yami, uDavide, iyakuba yinkosi, ibabuse, bonke babe nomelusi oyedwa, bayakuhamba ezehlulelweni zami, bazigcine izimiso zami, futhi bazenze.

Bayakuhlala ezweni engilinike inceku yami, uJakobe, ababehlala kulo okhokho bakho; bayakuhlala kulo, bona nabantwana babo, nezizukulwane zabo kuze kube phakade. UDavide inceku yami uyakuba yinkosi yabo kuze kube phakade.
Ngiyakukwenza isivumelwano sokuthula nabo, sibe yisivumelwano saphakade; ngiyakubahlalisa bazinze, ngibandise, ngibeke indlu yami engcwele phakathi kwabo kuze kube phakade.
Indawo yami yokuhlala iyakuba kubo, Mina ngiyakuba nguNkulunkulu wabo, bona babengabantu bami.
Izizwe ziyakukwazi ukuthi Mina Simakade ngingcwelisa u-Israyeli, lapho indlu yami engcwele isiphakathi kwabo, kuze kube phakade.” ’ ”
Izwi likaSimakade lafika kimi, lathi:
“Ndodana yomuntu, bhekisa ubuso bakho kuGogi, izwe likaMagogi isikhulu sakwaRoshe eMeshekhe naseThubhali, uphrofethe umelene naye,
uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngimelene nawe Gogi, sikhulu sakwaRoshe, eMeshekhe naseThubhali.

Ngiyakukuguqula, ngifake izingwegwe emihlathini yakho, ngikukhiphe nayo yonke impi yakho, amahhashi nabagibeli bawo, bonke bevunule bephelele, iviyo elikhulu eliphethe amahawu nezihlangu, bonke bephethe izinkemba zabo zimenyezela.
IPheresiya, iKhushe nePhuthi kukanye nabo, bonke bephethe izihlangu, befake nezigqoko zensimbi,
iGomere nawo wonke amabutho alo, iBhethe Thorigama engasekugcineni kwasenyakatho nawo wonke amaviyo akhe, abantu abaningi bekanye nawe.
“ ‘ “Yima ngomumo, yebo, uzilungiselele, wena nawo wonke amaviyo akho abuthene kuwe, ukuba ube ngumlindi wawo.

Kuyokwedlula izinsuku eziningi bese uqoqwa; kuyakuthi ngeminyaka yokugcina ungene ezweni elibuyiswe enkembeni, eliqoqwe ezizweni eziningi, ezintabeni zakwa-Israyeli ezazihlala ziyincithakalo, selikhishiwe kubantu, manje sebezohlala belondekile bonke.
Uyakukhuphukisa okwesishingishane, usibekele izwe njengefu, wena nawo wonke amaviyo akho, nezizwe eziningi zikanye nawe.”
“ ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Kuyakuthi ngalolo lusuku kufike imizindlo enhliziyweni yakho, bese uceba amacebo amabi.
Uyakuthi: Ngiyakwenyukela ezweni elinemizana engabiyelwe, ngiye kwabazinzileyo abahlala belondekile, bonke abahlala lapho kungenalugange khona, kungekho migoqo namasango,
bese ngibaphanga, ngibaqhwage impahla, ngelule isandla sami, ngimelane nezindawo okungahlali muntu kuzo, nabantu abaqoqwe ezizweni base bezizuzela imfuyo nempahla, labo abahlala enkabeni yezwe.

“ ‘ “ISheba, iDedani nabahwebi baseTharishishi nayo yonke imizana yakini, kuyakuthi kuwe: Ngabe uzophanga yini na? Uqoqe iviyo lakho ukuba uzoqhwaga impahla, uthathe isiliva, igolide, imfuyo, nempahla, uphange impango eningi na?” ’
“Ngakho-ke ndodana yomuntu, phrofetha, uthi kuGogi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Angithi uyakukwazi lokho ngalolo lusuku, lapho abantu bami u-Israyeli behleli ngokulondeka na?
Uyakufika usuka kude endaweni yakho esekugcineni enyakatho, wena nezizwe eziningi oyakuba uhamba nazo, bonke begibele amahhashi, iviyo elikhulu nempi enamandla.

Uyakukhuphukela khona ukuba uthelekele abantu bami u-Israyeli, njengefu lisibekela izwe. Kuyakuthi ngezinsuku ezizayo ngikuyise kubantu bami, ukuze izizwe zazi lapho ngizibonakalisa ngawe, Gogi, ukuthi ngingcwele, ziyakuzibonela ngawazo amehlo.”

“ ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Akuwena yini engakhuluma ngaye ngezinsuku zasemandulo ngomlomo wezinceku zami, abaphrofethi bakwa-Israyeli ababephrofetha ngalezo zinsuku, iminyaka eminingi ukuthi ngiyakukuthumela kubo ukuba umelane nabo na?
Kuyakuthi ngalolo lusuku, mhla uGogi ehlasela izwe lakwa-Israyeli, kuvuke ulaka lwami oluvutha bhe.
Ngesikhwele nangolaka lwami oluvuthayo ngikhulumile, ngathi: Impela ngalolo lusuku kuyakuba khona ukuzamazama okukhulu ezweni lakwa-Israyeli.

Kuyakuthuthumela ebukhoneni bami izinhlanzi zolwandle, izinyoni zezulu, izilwane zasendle, zonke izilwanyana ezinwabuzelayo emhlabeni, bonke abantu abasebusweni bomhlaba, izintaba zidilikele phansi, kuwe amawa nazo zonke izingange.
Ngiyakumbizela inkemba uGogi imelane naye, ivela kuzo zonke izintaba zami, inkemba yalowo nalowo iyakumelana nomfowabo.

Ngiyakumehlulela ngobhubhane nangokuchitheka kwegazi, ngimthelekele ngemvula ekhukhulayo, ngamatshe esichotho, nesibabule esivuthayo ngisehlisele kuye, emabuthweni akhe, nasezizweni eziningi ezikanye naye.
Ngiyakububonakalisa kanjalo-ke ubukhulu bami nobungcwele bami, futhi ngizazise phambi kwezizwe eziningi, ziyakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.” ’ ”
“Wena ndodana yomuntu, phrofetha umelane noGogi, uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Ngimelene nawe, Gogi, sikhulu sakwaRoshe, eMeshekhe naseThubhali.
Ngiyakukuguqula, ngikuhole, ngikwenyusele ezindaweni ezikude ezisenyakatho, ngikuyise ezintabeni zakwa-Israyeli,
ngiwushaye umnsalo osesandleni sakho sokhohlo, ngiwise imicibisholo yakho esesandleni sakho sokunene.
Uyakuwa ezintabeni zakwa-Israyeli, wena namaviyo akho wonke, nezizwe ezikanye nawe, ngikunikele kuzo zonke izinyoni ezinhlobonhlobo ezidla inyama, nasezilwaneni zasendle ukuba zikudle.
Uyakuqumbeka phansi ebusweni bomhlaba, ngokuba Mina ngikhulumile,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Ngiyakuthumela umlilo kuMagogi, nakulabo abahlala ngokulondeka eziqhingini; bayakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade.

“ ‘ “Ngiyakukwenza ukuba igama lami elingcwele laziwe phakathi kwabantu bami, u-Israyeli, ngingabe ngisavuma ukuba igama lami elingcwele lingcoliswe, izizwe ziyakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade, oNgcwele kwa-Israyeli.
Uyabona-ke, kuyeza, futhi kuzokwenzeka; yilolo-ke usuku engikhulume ngalo,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.

“ ‘ “Abahlala emizini yakwa-Israyeli bayakuphuma, baphembe umlilo ngezikhali, bazishise izihlangu, amahawu, iminsalo, imicibisholo, izinduku, nemikhonto, konke lokho bayakubasa ngakho umlilo, iminyaka eyisikhombisa.
Abayukutheza zinkuni endle, abayukugawula emahlathini, ngokuba bayakuphemba umlilo ngezikhali, baphange ababaphangayo, baqhwage impahla yalabo ababaqhwagayo,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.

“ ‘ “Kuyakuthi ngalolo lusuku, nginike uGogi indawo yokungcwaba kwa-Israyeli, isigodi salabo abedlula empumalanga yolwandle, abavimbe abadlulayo, bayakumngcwaba lapho uGogi naso sonke isixuku sakhe, bayibize ngokuthi isigodi iHamoni Gogi.
“ ‘ “Indlu yakwa-Israyeli iyakubangcwaba izinyanga eziyisikhombisa, ukuze ilihlambulule izwe.
Bonke abantu bezwe bayakubangcwaba, lokho kuyakuba ludumo lwabo ngosuku engiyakukhazimuliswa ngalo,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘Bayakubakhetha njalo abantu abayakudabula ezweni, behamba bengcwaba labo ababathola bedindilizile ezweni, ukuba balihlambulule izwe izinyanga eziyisikhombisa.
Kuyakuthi uma labo abahamba bedabula ezweni bebona ithambo lomuntu, babeke uphawu eceleni kwalo, ukuze kuthi labo abangcwabayo balingcwabe esigodini iHamoni Gogi.
Kuyakuba khona omunye umuzi ogama lawo liyakuba yiHamoni. Bayakulihlambulula kanjalo-ke izwe.’

“Wena ndodana yomuntu, isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Tshela izinyoni ngezinhlobo zazo, nazo zonke izilwane zasendle, uthi: “Qoqanani, nihlangane ndawonye nisuka nxazonke, nize emhlatshelweni wami enginihlabele wona, ngumhlatshelo omkhulu osezintabeni zakwa-Israyeli; niyakuzitika ngenyama, niphuze igazi.
Niyakudla inyama yamaqhawe, niphuze igazi lezikhulu zezwe, elezinqama, elamawundlu, elezimbuzi nelazo zonke izinkunzi ezikhulupheleyo zaseBhashani.
Niyakudla amanoni nize nisuthe, niphuze igazi nize nidakwe, emhlatshelweni wami enginihlabele wona.
Etafuleni lami niyakudla nisuthe inyama yamahhashi, eyabagibeli bawo, eyamaqhawe, neyawo wonke amabutho empi,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“Inkazimulo yami ngiyakuyibonakalisa ezizweni, zonke izizwe ziyakukubona ukwehlulela kwami engikwenzileyo, nesandla sami engisibeke kuzo.
Indlu yakwa-Israyeli iyakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wayo, kusukela ngalolo lusuku.

Izizwe ziyakukwazi ukuthi indlu yakwa-Israyeli yaya ekuthunjweni ngenxa yokona kwayo. Ngokuba babengathembekile kimi, ngase ngibusitheza ubuso bami kubo; ngabanikela esandleni sezitha zabo, bafa bonke ngenkemba.
Ngenza kubo njengokungcola kwabo nanjengezeqo zabo, ngabusitheza ubuso bami kubo.
“Ngakho-ke isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘UJakobe ngiyakumbuyisa ekuthunjweni, yonke indlu yakwa-Israyeli ngiyihawukele, ngibe nentshisekelo ngenxa yegama lami elingcwele.
Bayakulikhohlwa ihlazo labo, nakho konke ukungethembeki kwabo abakwenze kimi, lapho sebehleli ngokulondeka ezweni lakubo, kungekho muntu obesabisayo,
ngesikhathi sengibabuyisile ezizweni, ngabaqoqa emazweni ezitha zabo; ngizibonakalisa ngawe ngingcwele emehlweni ezizwe eziningi.
Bayakukwazi ukuthi nginguSimakade uNkulunkulu wabo, ngabayisa ekuthunjweni, ngiyakubaqoqa ukuba babuyele ezweni lakubo, futhi angiyukushiya noyedwa lapho;
angisayukubusitheza ubuso bami kubo, ngokuba ngiyakuthulula uMoya wami phezu kwendlu yakwa-Israyeli,’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Kwathi ekuqaleni konyaka wama-25 sisekuthunjweni, ngosuku lweshumi enyangeni, ngonyaka we-14 emva kokunqotshwa komuzi, kwathi ngalolo lusuku isandla sikaSimakade saba phezu kwami, wangiyisa lapho.
Ngemibono kaNkulunkulu wangiyisa ezweni lakwa-Israyeli, wangibeka entabeni ephakeme kakhulu, okwakuphezu kwayo kwakungathi isakhiwo somuzi ongaseningizimu.
Wangiyisa khona; ngabona umuntu osimo sakhe sasinjengesimo sethusi; wayephethe intambo yelineni esandleni sakhe, nohlanga lokulinganisa, emi esangweni.

Lo muntu wathi kimi: “Ndodana yomuntu, bheka ngamehlo akho, uzwe ngezindlebe zakho, ubeke inhliziyo yakho kukho konke engizokukhombisa khona, ngokuba ulethwe lapha ukuba ngikukhombise. Tshela indlu yakwa-Israyeli ngakho konke lokhu okubonayo.”

Kwakukhona ugange ngaphandle kwendlu, luzungeze nxazonke, esandleni somuntu kukhona uhlanga lokulinganisa, lungamakhubhithi ayisithupha, yileyo naleyo iyikhubhithi engububanzi besandla. Walinganisa ububanzi besakhiwo: uhlanga olulodwa, nokuphakama: ububanzi besakhiwo babuluhlanga olulodwa, kanjalo nokuphakama kwaso kuwuhlanga olulodwa.
Wayeseya esangweni elalibheke empumalanga, wakhuphuka ngezitebhisi zalo, walinganisa umbundu wesango; ububanzi bawo babuluhlanga olulodwa.

Ubude bekamelo labalindi babuluhlanga olulodwa, nobubanzi balo buluhlanga olulodwa; okwakuphakathi kwamakamelo kwakungamakhubhithi ayisihlanu; umbundu wesango eceleni kompheme wesango ngasendlini nawo wawuluhlanga olulodwa.
Walinganisa nompheme wesango ngasendlini: uwuhlanga olulodwa.
Wayeselinganisa umpheme wesango: wawungamakhubhithi ayisishiyagalombili; nezinsika zalo: ungamakhubhithi amabili; umpheme wesango ungasendlini.
Amakamelo abalindi ayesesangweni ngasempumalanga, emathathu ngapha nangapha, eyisilinganiso esisodwa, kanjalo nezinsika zaziyisilinganiso esisodwa ngapha nangapha.
Walinganisa ububanzi besikhala sesango: sasingamakhubhithi alishumi; ubude besango: bungamakhubhithi ali-13;
ekugcineni ngaphambi kwamakamelo abalindi: uyikhubhithi elilodwa; umkhawulo ngalapha: uyikhubhithi elilodwa; namakamelo abalindi: ungamakhubhithi ayisithupha ngapha nangapha.
Walinganisa isango, kusukela ophahleni lwelinye ikamelo kuze kube sophahleni lwelinye, ububanzi bungamakhubhithi angama-25, umnyango ubhekene nomunye.
Wenza nezinsika: zingamakhubhithi angama-60, isango lifinyelela ensikeni yegceke nxazonke.
Kusukela phambi kwesango ngasekungeneni kuze kube phambi kompheme wesango elingaphakathi kwakungamakhubhithi angama-50.
Kwakukhona amafasitela avaliweyo, emakamelweni; ezinsikeni ngaphakathi kwesango nxazonke, nasemiphemeni yendlu ngaphandle; kukhona amafasitela nxazonke ngaphakathi namasundu ezinsikeni.
Wayesengingenisa egcekeni elingaphandle; uyabona-ke, lapho kwakukhona amakamelo nendawo egandayiweyo egcekeni nxazonke; kwakukhona namakamelo angama-30 endaweni egandayiweyo.
Indawo egandayiwe yayiseceleni kwamasango, ilingene nobude bamasango; lokhu kwakuyindawo egandayiwe ephansi.
Wayeselinganisa ububanzi kusukela phambi kwesango elingezansi, kuze kube phambi kwegceke elingaphakathi ngaphandle: kungamakhubhithi ayikhulu ngasempumalanga nangasenyakatho.
Wayeselinganisa ubude nobubanzi besango legceke elingaphandle elibheke ngasenyakatho.

Amakamelo alo abalindi ayemathathu ngapha nangapha; izinsika zalo nemipheme yalo kwakufana nesilinganiso sokuqala sesango; ubude balo babungamakhubhithi angama-50, ububanzi bungamakhubhithi angama-25.
Amafasitela alo, imipheme yalo, namasundu alo kwakufana nesilinganiso sesango elibheke ngasempumalanga; bakhuphukela kulo ngezitebhisi eziyisikhombisa, imipheme yalo yayiphambi kwazo.
Kwakukhona isango legceke elingaphakathi maqondana naleli sango ngasenyakatho nangasempumalanga; walinganisa kusukela esangweni kuze kube sesangweni, kwaba ngamakhubhithi ayikhulu.
Wayesengiyisa ngaseningizimu; lapho kwakukhona isango lingaseningizimu. Wazilinganisa izinsika zalo nemiphemegumbi yalo njengezilinganiso ezishiwo ngenhla.
Kwakukhona amafasitela kulo nasemiphemeni yalo nxazonke, kufana namafasitela abalulwe ngenhla; ubude babungamakhubhithi angama-50 nobubanzi bungamakhubhithi angama-25.
Kwakukhona izitebhisi eziyisikhombisa zokukhuphukela kulo, kunemiphemegumbi phambi kwazo; lalinamasundu, lilodwa ngapha nangapha ezinsikeni zalo.
Isango legceke elingaphakathi lalingaseningizimu; walinganisa, kusukela esangweni kuze kube sesangweni ngaseningizimu, kungamakhubhithi ayikhulu.
Wayesengingenisa egcekeni elingaphakathi ngesango eliseningizimu; walilinganisa lelo sango njengezilinganiso ezibalulwe ngenhla.

Amakamelo alo abalindi, izinsika zalo, nemiphemegumbi yalo kwakufana nezilinganiso ezibalulwe ngenhla, kukhona amafasitela kulo nasemiphemenigumbi nxazonke; ubude balo babungamakhubhithi angama-50, ububanzi balo bungamakhubhithi angama-25.
Kwakukhona imiphemegumbi nxazonke, ubude bayo bungamakhubhithi angama-25, ububanzi bayo bungamakhubhithi ayisihlanu.
Imiphemegumbi yalo yayibheke egcekeni elingaphandle; amasundu esezinsikeni zalo; kwakukhushukelwa kulo ngezitebhisi eziyisishiyagalombili.
Wayesengingenisa egcekeni elingaphakathi ngasempumalanga, walilinganisa isango njengezilinganiso ezishiwo ngenhla,

amakamelo alo abalindi, izinsika zalo, nemiphemegumbi yalo kwakunjengezilinganiso ezibalulwe ngenhla, kukhona amafasitela kulo nasemiphemenigumbi yalo nxazonke; ubude babungamakhubhithi angama-50, ububanzi bungamakhubhithi angama-25.
Imiphemegumbi yalo yayibheke egcekeni elingaphandle; amasundu esezinsikeni zalo, ngapha nangapha; kwakukhushukelwa kulo ngezitebhisi eziyisishiyagalombili.
Wayesengiyisa esangweni elisenyakatho, walilinganisa njengezilinganiso ezibalulwe ngenhla,
amakamelo alo abalindi, izinsika zalo, nemiphemegumbi yalo; lalinamafasitele nxazonke; ubude bungamakhubhithi angama-50, ububanzi bungamakhubhithi angama-25.
Izinsika zalo zazibheke egcekeni elingaphandle; amasundu ayesezinsikeni zalo ngapha nangapha; kwakukhushukelwa kulo ngezitebhisi eziyisishiyagalombili.
Kwakukhona ikamelo nomnyango walo ngasezinsikeni emasangweni; babewugezela lapho umnikelo wokushiswa.
Emphemenigumbi wesango kwakukhona amatafula amabili ngapha nangapha ukuba kuhlatshelwe kuwo umnikelo wokushiswa, umnikelo wesono nomnikelo wecala.
Eceleni ngaphandle lapho kwakukhushukelwa esivalweni sesango ngasenyakatho, kukhona amatafula amabili, emabili futhi nakolunye uhlangothi olungasemphemenigumbi wesango.
Amatafula amane ayengapha nangapha eceleni kwesango, amatafula ayeyisishiyagalombili ababehlabela kuwo.

Amatafula amane omnikelo wokushiswa ayenziwe ngamatshe abaziweyo, ubude buyikhubhithi nengxenye, ububanzi buyikhubhithi nengxenye, nokuphakama kuyikhubhithi; babebeka phezu kwawo lokho ababekusebenzisa uma behlaba, benza umnikelo wokushiswa nomhlatshelo.
Izingwegwe, ubude bazo obabungangobubanzi besandla, zazifakwe ngaphakathi nxazonke. Kwakukhona inyama yomnikelo ematafuleni.

Ngaphandle kwesango elingaphakathi kwakukhona amakamelo abahlabeleli esegcekeni elingaphakathi, elaliseceleni kwesango elisenyakatho, libheke ngaseningizimu, elinye eliseceleni kwesango elisempumalanga, libheke ngasenyakatho.
Wathi kimi: “Leli kamelo elibheke ngaseningizimu ngelabaphristi abagcina inkonzo yasendlini.
Ikamelo elibheke ngasenyakatho ngelabaphristi abagcina inkonzo yase-althare, abangamadodana kaZadoki, okuyibo emadodaneni kaLevi, angasondela kuSimakade ukuba amkhonze.”
Wayeselilinganisa igceke, ubude balo babungamakhubhithi ayikhulu, nobubanzi bungamakhubhithi ayikhulu, kuyizinhlangothi ezine; i-althare laliphambi kwendlu.
Wayesengingenisa emphemenigumbi wendlu, walinganisa izinsika zomphemegumbi: kungamakhubhithi ayisihlanu ngapha nangapha; ububanzi besango babungamakhubhithi amathathu ngapha nangapha.
Ubude bomphemegumbi babungamakhubhithi angama-20, nobubanzi bungamakhubhithi ali-11 ngasezitebhisini okwakukhushukelwa ngazo kulo; kukhona nezibonda ngasezinsikeni, ngapha nangapha.
Wayesengingenisa ethempelini, wakala izinsika ngayinye, ububanzi babungamakhubhithi ayisithupha ngapha nangapha, yilobo-ke ububanzi bezinsika, zethabanakeli.

Ububanzi bomnyango babungamakhubhithi alishumi, amacele omnyango engamakhubhithi amahlanu ngakulolu hlangothi emi kanjalo nangakolunye. Wakala ubude balo: babungamakhubhithi angama-40; ububanzi balo bungama-20.
Wayesengena phakathi, walinganisa izinsika zomnyango: kwaba ngamakhubhithi amabili: umnyango ungayisithupha, ububanzi bomnyango, bungayisikhombisa.
Wakala ubude bokuphakathi kwaba ngamakhubhithi angama-20 phambi kwethempeli. Wayesethi kimi: “Lena yindawo engcwele kakhulu.”
Wayesekala udonga lwendlu lwaba ngamakhubhithi ayisithupha; ububanzi bamakamelo ezinhlangothi bungamakhubhithi amane, nxazonke zendlu.

Indlu yayinamakamelo amathathu ezinhlangothini, elakanyene elinye phezu kwelinye, esewonke engama-30. Ingaphandle lodonga lwendlu kulelo nalelo kamelo lalinonqenqema olwaluzungeze udonga lwendlu, lusekele amakamelo asemaceleni ukuze angasekelwa ludonga lwendlu.

Amakamelo ezinhlangothi aba banzi ekukhuphukeni nxazonke, ngokuba okuzungeza indlu kwakukhuphuka nxazonke zendlu; ngalokho indlu yaba banzi ekukhuphukeni njalo; kwakhushukwa ekamelweni eliphansi kwaze kwaba kweliphezulu neliphakathi.
Ngabona futhi ukuthi indlu izungezwe unqenqema nxazonke, isilinganiso sezisekelo zamakamelo sasilingana nohlanga olungamakhubhithi ayisithupha ubude.
Uhlonze lodonga olungaphandle emakamelweni lwalungamakhubhithi amahlanu, kunendawo ebanzi phakathi kwamakamelo nendlu, leyo ndawo yayingeyamakamelo ayesezinhlangothini zendlu.
Phakathi kwamakamelo kwakukhona indawo ebanzi engamakhubhithi angama-20 nxazonke zendlu emaceleni wonke.
Iminyango yamakamelo ezinhlangothi yayibheke endaweni eseleyo, omunye umnyango ungasenyakatho nomunye ungaseningizimu; ububanzi bendawo eseleyo babungamakhubhithi ayisihlanu nxazonke.

Isakhiwo esasiphambi kwendawo eyahlukanisiweyo ngasentshonalanga, ububanzi baso babungamakhubhithi angama-70; uhlonze lodonga lwendlu lungamakhubhithi ayisihlanu nxazonke, ubude balo bungamakhubhithi angama-90.
Wayikala indlu, ubude bayo babungamakhubhithi ayikhulu, kuthi indawo eyahlukanisiweyo, isakhiwo nezindonga zaso, ubude bakho bungamakhubhithi ayikhulu.
Ububanzi obungaphambi kwendlu nendawo eyahlukanisiweyo ngasempumalanga babungamakhubhithi ayikhulu.

Wayesekala ubude besakhiwo esasiphambi kwendawo eyahlukanisiweyo eyayingemuva kwaso nemiphemegumbi yayo nxazonke; yaba ngamakhubhithi ayikhulu, kanjalo nethempeli elingaphakathi, nemiphemegumbi yegceke.
Imibundu, amafasitele avaliweyo, imipheme elakanyene kathathu nxazonke eqondene nombundu, kwakwembozwe ngokhuni nxazonke, kusukela phansi kuze kube semafasiteleni. Amafasitele ayemboziwe,
kuze kube phezu komnyango nasendlini engaphakathi nangaphandle. Lonke udonga lwakalwa nxazonke ngaphakathi, nangaphandle,
kwakwenziwe ngamakherubhi, nangamasundu; phakathi kwalelo nalelo kherubhi kwakunesundu. Ikherubhi ngalinye linobuso obubili.
Ubuso bomuntu babubheke ngakuleli sundu, ngakwelinye icala kunobuso bebhongo lengonyama, bubheke isundu ngale, kwakwenziwe kanjalo nxazonke zendlu.
Kusukela phansi kuze kube phezu komnyango, kwakwenziwe amakherubhi namasundu, kanjalo nasodongeni lwethempeli.
Ethempelini, izinsika zomnyango zazinezinhlangothi ezine, ubuso bendawo engcwelengcwele, isimo sabo sasifana nesethempeli.

I-althare lalenziwe ngokhuni, ukuphakama kwalo kungamakhubhithi amathathu, ubude balo bungamakhubhithi amabili; lalinamagumbi. Ubude balo nezindonga zalo kwakwenziwe ngokhuni; wathi kimi: “Leli yitafula eliyakuba phambi kukaSimakade.”
Ithempeli nendawo engcwelengcwele kwakunezivalo ezimbili.
Iminyango yayinezicabha ezimbili, izicabha ezimbili eziphendukayo, ezimbili zingezomunye umnyango, nezimbili zingezomunye.
Ezivalweni zethempeli kwakwenziwe amakherubhi namasundu njengoba ayenziwe ezindongeni. Kwakukhona isivikelo esasenziwe ngokhuni phezu komphemegumbi ngaphandle.
Ngapha nangapha emaceleni omphemegumbi kukhona amafasitele avaliweyo namasundu, nasemakamelweni ezinhlangothini zendlu, kanjalo nasesivikelweni.
Wayesengikhipha egcekeni elingaphandle elingasenyakatho, wangingenisa ekamelweni elibhekene nendawo eyahlukanisiweyo, eliqondene nesakhiwo esingasenyakatho,
ohlangothini olude, ubude balo babungamakhubhithi ayikhulu, umnyango walo ungasenyakatho. Ububanzi bawo babungamakhubhithi ayisihlanu.

Ngakolunye uhlangothi kwakungamakhubhithi angama-20, ayezungeze igceke elingaphakathi, kuthi maqondana nendawo egandayiweyo eyayingeyegceke elingaphandle kube khona umpheme oqondene nemipheme eyelakanyene kathathu.
Kwakukhona umhubhe phambi kwamakamelo, ububanzi bawo bungamakhubhithi alishumi ngaphakathi, ubude bawo buyikhulu; iminyango yawo yayingasenyakatho.
Amakamelo aphezulu ayemafishane, ngokuba imipheme yayithathe indawo enkulu kuwo kunaleyo eyayikweyangaphansi neyayiphakathi esakhiweni.
Ayengenazo izinsika ezazifana nezinsika zamagceke, njengoba wona ayelakanyene kathathu; lawo ayengaphezulu ayemancane kunalawo ayengaphansi naphakathi kusukela emhlabathini.
Ugange olwalungaphandle eceleni kwamakamelo ngasegcekeni elingaphandle lwalungamakhubhithi angama-50.
Nakuba amakamelo ayesegcekeni elingaphandle, ubude bawo babungamakhubhithi angama-50, kodwa phambi kwethempeli kwakungamakhubhithi ayikhulu.
Kusukela phansi kwalawo makamelo, kwakukhona indawo yokungena ngasempumalanga, lapho kwakungenwa khona uma uvela egcekeni elingaphandle.
Lapho ugange lwegceke lwalubanzi khona ngasempumalanga, phambi kwendawo eyahlukanisiweyo naphambi kwesakhiwo; nalapho kwakukhona amakamelo.
Indlela eyayiphambi kwawo yayifana neyamakamelo ayengasenyakatho, ububanzi bufana nobude; kanjalo nezindawo zawo zokuphuma neminyango yazo.
Njengeminyango yamakamelo ayeseningizimu, kwakukhona umnyango ekuqaleni kwendlela, indlela yayiqondene nogange ngasempumalanga, lapho kungenwa kuwo.

Wayesethi kimi: “Amakamelo asenyakatho namakamelo aseningizimu aphambi kwendawo eyahlukaniswe ngamakamelo angcwele, lapho abaphristi abaseduze noSimakade beyakudlela khona okungcwelengcwele. Bayakubeka lapho umnikelo wokusanhlamvu, umnikelo wesono nomnikelo wecala, ngokuba leyo ndawo ingcwele.

Kuyakuthi lapho abaphristi sebengenile, bangaphumeli endaweni engcwele ukuba baye egcekeni elingaphandle, bengakazibeki lapho izembatho zabo abakhonze ngazo, ngokuba zingcwele. Bayakwembatha ezinye izingubo, bese besondela kulokho okungokwabantu.”
Kwathi lapho eseqedile ukulinganisa indlu engaphakathi, wangikhipha ngendlela yesango elalingasempumalanga, walinganisa nxazonke.
Walulinganisa uhlangothi lwasempumalanga ngohlanga lokulinganisa: kwaba yizinhlanga ezingama-500 uma sekulinganiswe ngohlanga gimbici.
Walulinganisa uhlangothi lwasenyakatho: kwaba yizinhlanga ezingama-500 uma sekulinganiswe ngohlanga nxazonke.
Walulinganisa nohlangothi lwaseningizimu: kwaba yizinhlanga ezingama-500 uma sekulinganiswe ngohlanga lokulinganisa.
Wayesephendukela ohlangothini olungasentshonalanga walulinganisa: kwaba yizinhlanga ezingama-500 uma sekulinganiswe ngohlanga lokulinganisa.
Wayilinganisa ezinhlangothini zozine. Yayinogange oluyizungeze gimbici, ubude balo babungamakhubhithi angama-500 kanjalo nobubanzi balo, ukuba kwehlukaniswe phakathi kokungcwele nokungengcwele.
Umuntu wayesengithatha engiyisa esangweni elibheke ngasempumalanga.
Bheka, inkazimulo kaSimakade yavela empumalanga, izwi lakhe lezwakala njengokuhaza kwamanzi amaningi, inkazimulo yakhe yawukhanyisa umhlaba.

Isimo sombono engawubonayo sasifana nombono engangiwubone ngesikhathi ngiza ngizobhubhisa umuzi. Imibono yayinjengombono engangiwubone ngasemfuleni iKhebhari; ngase ngiwa ngobuso, ngathi mbo emhlabathini.
Inkazimulo kaSimakade yangena endlini ngendlela yesango elibheke ngasempumalanga.
UMoya wangiphakamisa, wangingenisa egcekeni elingaphakathi; bheka, inkazimulo kaSimakade yayigcwalisa indlu.
Ngase ngizwa okhuluma kimi ephakathi endlini; kwakumi umuntu eceleni kwami.

Wathi kimi: “Ndodana yomuntu, le ndawo iyisihlalo sami sobukhosi, nendawo yamathe ezinyawo zami, lapho ngiyakuhlala khona phakathi kwabantu bakwa-Israyeli kuze kube phakade. Indlu yakwa-Israyeli ayisayukulingcolisa igama lami elingcwele, yona namakhosi ayo, ngokuphinga kwayo nangezidumbu zamakhosi ayo ezindaweni zayo eziphakemeyo.

Umbundu wabo bawubeka ngasembundwini wami, nensika yabo yomnyango eceleni kwensika yami, kwaba ludonga kuphela oluphakathi kwami nabo, balingcolisa igama lami elingcwele ngezinengiso zabo abazenzayo, yingakho-ke ngabaqeda ngolaka lwami.
Manje-ke mabakudedisele kude nami ukuphinga kwabo, nezidumbu zamakhosi abo, ukuze ngihlale phakathi kwabo kuze kube phakade.
“Wena ndodana yomuntu, chaza ngendlu kwabendlu yakwa-Israyeli ukuze babe namahloni ngobubi babo, bacabangisise ngesimo sayo.

Uma benamahloni ngakho konke abakwenzileyo, mawubazise ngesimo sendlu, ngokuhleleka kwayo, ngezindawo zayo zokuphuma nezokungena, impela, sonke isimo sayo nazo zonke izimiso zayo, izimo zayo zonke nemithetho yayo yonke, ukulobe bezibonela ngawabo amehlo, ukuba basigcine sonke isimo sayo, nazo zonke izimiso zayo, bakwenze lokho.”
“Nanku umthetho wendlu: Esiqongweni sentaba, wonke umngcele wayo oyizungeze gimbici, uyakuba ngcwele kakhulu. Uyabona-ke, lokho kungumthetho wendlu.

“Nazi izilinganiso ze-althare ngokwamakhubhithi, ikhubhithi nengxenye ububanzi, isisekelo salo sinomsele oyikhubhithi ukuphakama kwawo, nobubanzi bawo buyikhubhithi. Umngcele walo, emaceleni nxazonke, wawunjengokuvuleka kweminwe: kwakunjalo-ke ukuphakama kwe-althare.

Kusukela phansi esisekelweni esinomsele kuze kube sonqenqemeni oluphansi, kwakungamakhubhithi amabili, ububanzi buyikhubhithi. Ukusuka onqenqemeni oluncane kuze kube sonqenqemeni olukhulu, kwakungamakhubhithi amane, ububanzi buyikhubhithi.
Iziko le-althare lalingamakhubhithi amane, kusukela kulo kuya phezulu, kukhona nezimpondo ezine.
Iziko le-althare ubude balo babungamakhubhithi ali-12, kanjalo nobubanzi balo; lalinezinhlangothi ezine ezilinganayo.

Ubude bonqenqema babungamakhubhithi ali-14, kanjalo nobubanzi balo, lunezinhlangothi ezine ezilinganayo. Umngcele walo, nxazonke, wawuyingxenye yekhubhithi, umsele walo wawuyikhubhithi nxazonke, izikhwelo zalo zibheke ngasempumalanga.”
Wayesethi kimi: “Ndodana yomuntu, isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi nazi izimiso ze-althare ngosuku abayakulenza ngalo, ukuba banikele phezu kwalo umnikelo wokushiswa, balifafaze ngegazi.
Uyakunika abaphristi abangabaLevi, ozalweni lukaZadoki, abaseduze nami ukuba bangikhonze, balethe iduna libe ngumnikelo wesono,” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“Uyakuthatha igazi ulibhece kuzona zozine izimpondo zalo, emagumbini omane onqenqema, nasemaphethelweni nxazonke, ulihlambulule, ulenzele ukubuyisana.
Uyakuthatha inkunzi yomnikelo wesono, ishiswe endaweni yendlu ekhethiweyo, engaphandle kwendlu engcwele.
“Ngosuku lwesibili uyakunikela ngempongo engenasici, ibe ngumnikelo wesono; bayakuhlambulula i-althare njengoba lihlanjululwa ngenkunzi.
Kuyakuthi lapho usuqedile ukulihlambulula, bese unikela ngeduna elingenasici, nangenqama engenasici.
Uyakukusondeza phambi kukaSimakade, abaphristi bathele usawoti kukho, banikele ngakho, kube ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuSimakade.
“Izinsuku eziyisikhombisa uyakunikela ngempongo, ibe ngumnikelo wesono, usuku nosuku, kunikelwe nangeduna nenqama, kuthathwe emhlanjini, kungabi nasici.
I-althare bayakulenzela ukubuyisana izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, balihlambulule, balingcwelise.

Kuyakuthi uma seziphelile lezo zinsuku, kube ngusuku lwesishiyagalombili kuya phambili, bese abaphristi benikela iminikelo yenu yokushiswa e-althare, neminikelo yenu yokuthula; ngiyakunamukela-ke,” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Wayesengibuyisa ngendlela yesango lendlu engcwele, elingaphandle, elibheke ngasempumalanga.
USimakade wathi kimi: “Leli sango liyakuvalwa, lingavulwa, kungangeni muntu ngalo, ngokuba uSimakade uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli ungene ngalo, yingakho-ke liyakuhlala livaliwe.
Kepha isikhulu yisikhulu, sona siyakuhlala kulo, sidle phambi kukaSimakade, singene ngendlela yompheme wesango, futhi siphume ngendlela yawo.”
Wayesengiyisa phambi kwendlu ngendlela yesango esenyakatho. Ngabuka; bheka, inkazimulo kaSimakade yagcwalisa indlu yakhe; ngase ngiwa ngithi mbo ngobuso.

USimakade wathi kimi: “Ndodana yomuntu, qaphelisisa, uzibonele ngawakho amehlo, uzizwele ngezakho izindlebe konke engikukhuluma kuwe maqondana nazo zonke izimiso zendlu kaSimakade, nangayo yonke imithetho yayo; uyiqaphelisise indawo yokungena yendlu, nazo zonke izindawo zokuphuma zendlu engcwele.
Uyakusho endlini ehlubukayo yakwa-Israyeli, uthi: ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Maye, nina ndlu yakwa-Israyeli, sezanele izinengiso zenu!

Ngokuba ningenise abezizwe abangasokile enhliziyweni nasenyameni, ukuba bangene endlini yami engcwele, bayingcolisa indlu yami; lapho ninikela kimi ngesinkwa, ngamanoni nangegazi; nasephula isivumelwano sami ngazo zonke izinengiso zenu.
Aniyigcinanga inkonzo yezinto zami ezingcwele, kodwa nizibekele abayakunigcinela inkonzo endlini yami engcwele.”
Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ‘Endlini yami engcwele akayukungena owezizwe ongasokile enhliziyweni nongasokile enyameni, kubo bonke abezizwe abahlala nabantu bakwa-Israyeli.
“ ‘ “Kepha abaLevi baqhelela kude nami ngesikhathi u-Israyeli eduka, ephambuka, elandela izithombe zabo, nabo bayakubuthwala ububi babo.
Bayakuba yizikhonzi endlini yami engcwele, babengababonisi emasangweni endlu, bakhonze endlini, bahlabe imihlatshelo yokushiswa nabayihlabela abantu, bame phambi kwabo ukuba basize abantu.

Ngokuba babebasebenzela phambi kwezithombe zabo, baba yisikhubekiso ngobubi babo kuyo indlu yakwa-Israyeli; ngakho-ke ngiphakamise isandla sami ngamelana nabo, ukuba bakuthwale ukona kwabo,” ’ kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘Abasayukusondela kimi ukuba bangikhonze bengabaphristi, futhi abayukusondela ezintweni zami ezingcwele, izinto ezingcwelengwele, kodwa bayakulithwala ihlazo labo nezinengiso zabo abazenzileyo.
Nokho, ngiyakubenza babe ngabagcini benkonzo yendlu, kuwo wonke umsebenzini wayo, nakukho konke okuyakwenziwa kuyo.

“ ‘Kepha abaphristi babaLevi, amadodana kaZadoki, ababegcina inkonzo yendlu yami engcwele ngesikhathi abakwa-Israyeli bephambuka kimi, yibona abayakusondela kimi, bangikhonze, bame phambi kwami, banikele ngamanoni nangegazi, kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
Bayakungena endlini yami engcwele, basondele etafuleni lami ukuba bangikhonze, futhi bayigcine inkonzo yami.
“ ‘Kuyothi lapho bengena emasangweni egceke elingaphakathi, bembathiswe izembatho zelineni, bangembathi sembatho esenziwe ngensonto ngesikhathi bekhonza emasangweni egceke elingaphakathi nasendlini.
Bayakuthwala izigqoko zelineni emakhanda abo, ngaphansi bagqoke izimpahla zelineni, bangakubhinci okhalo lwabo okujulukisayo.

Kuyothi lapho bephumela egcekeni elingaphandle, okuyigceke labantu, bazikhumule izembatho zabo abakhonza ngazo, bazibeke emakamelweni angcwele, bagqoke ezinye izingubo, funa bangcwelise abantu ngezembatho zabo.
“ ‘Abayukuphuca emakhanda abo, bangabi nazihluthu, kepha bagunde emakhanda abo.
Akukho noyedwa kulabo baphristi oyakuphuza iwayini ngesikhathi bengena egcekeni elingaphakathi.
Abayukumthatha umfelokazi nolahliweyo babe ngabafazi babo, kodwa bayakuthatha izintombi ozalweni lwendlu yakwa-Israyeli, noma umfelokazi obegane umphristi.
Bayakubafundisa abantu bami ukwehlukanisa okungcwele nokuyichilo, benze umehluko phakathi kokungcolileyo nokuhlanzekileyo.
“ ‘Kuyakuthi uma kunombango, basukume ukuba behlulele. Bayakwehlulela ngokwezehlulelo zami, bagcine imithetho yami nezimiso zami emikhosini yonke yami, futhi balingcwelise isabatha lami.
“ ‘Abayukusithinta isidumbu, funa bazigcolise, kodwa bangazingcolisa ngokuthinta esikayise, esikanina, esendodana, esendodakazi, esomfowabo, nesikadadewabo ongenandoda.
Nxa esehlambulukile, uyakubalelwa izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Ngosuku angena ngalo endlini engcwele, egcekeni elingaphakathi, ukuyokhonza kuyo, uyakunikela ngomnikelo wakhe wesono,’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘Bayakuba nefa; Mina ngiyifa labo; aniyukubanika imfuyo kwa-Israyeli; Mina ngiyimfuyo yabo.
Bayakudla umnikelo wokusanhlamvu, umnikelo wesono, nomnikelo wecala, konke lokho okwehlukanisiweyo kwa-Israyeli kuyakuba ngokwabo.

Lonke ulibo lokuqala lwakho lwekhethelo, konke nayo yonke iminikelo yakho, konke eminikelweni yenu yonke, kuyakuba ngokwabaphristi, nimnike umphristi ulibo lwenhlama yenu, ukuze isibusiso sihlale endlini yakho.
Abaphristi abayukuyidla inyoni noma isilwane esizifeleyo noma esidweshuliweyo.’ ”

“ ‘Kuyothi lapho izwe senilehlukanisa ngonkatho ukuba libe yifa, bese ninikela kuSimakade ingxenye yalo ekhethekileyo, ubude balelo lizwe kube ngamakhubhithi ayizi-25 000; ububanzi bube ngamakhubhithi ayizi-10 000; liyakuba yindawo engcwele, kuyo yonke imingcele yalo nxazonke.
Ingxenye yalo iyakuba yindawo engcwele engamakhubhithi angama-500 nxazonke, nendawo eyisikwele eyizungezile engenalutho engamakhubhithi angama-50.
Kulesi siqinti esikhethekileyo uyakukala indawo engamakhubhithi ayizi-25 000 ubude, nayizi-10 000 ububanzi, ibe yindawo engcwele, nendawo engcwelengcwele.
Iyakuba yisiqinti esingcwele ezweni, ibe ngeyabaphristi, abakhonza endaweni engcwele, labo abasondela kuSimakade ukuba bamkhonze. Iyakuba yindawo yabo yokuhlala, ibuye ibe yindawo engcwele.
Esinye isiqinti sendawo esingamakhubhithi ayizi-25 000 ubude, nayizi-10 000 ububanzi, siyakuba yindawo yabaLevi abakhonza ethempelini, sibe yindawo enemizi abahlala kuyo.
“ ‘Maqondana nesiqinti esehlukaniselwe ukuba yindawo engcwele, kuyakuthi umuzi osondele kuso ube ngoka-Israyeli wonkana, ububanzi buyakuba yizi-5 000, ubude bube yizi-25 000.

“ ‘Umhlaba wesikhulu uyakusiphahla isiqinti esingcwele nefa lomuzi, ube phambi kwefa lomuzi naphambi komnikelo; ube ngasohlangothini olusentshonalanga kubheke entshonalanga, nangasohlangothini olusempumalanga kubheke empumalanga, ubude baso bulingane nesinye sezabelo zezizwe, kusukela emngceleni entshonalanga kuze kube semngceleni empumalanga.
Lesi siqinti sendawo siyakuba yifa laso ezweni lakwa-Israyeli, izikhulu zami azisayukubacindezela abantu bami, kodwa indlu yakwa-Israyeli ziyakuyinika ngangomumo wezizwe zayo.

“ ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Sekwanele we zikhulu, zikhulu zakwa-Israyeli! Yekani ukucindezela abantu ngobudlova; nehlulele ngobulungiswa nobuqotho, nikuyeke ukuxosha abantu bami,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘ “Niyakusebenzisa izilinganiso ezifaneleyo, isilinganiso esifaneleyo se-efa nesifaneleyo sebhathi.
I-efa nebhathi kuyakuba nesisindo esifanayo, ibhathi libe ngokweshumi kwehomere, isilinganiso salo sifane nokwehomere.
Ishekeli liyakuba ngamagera angama-20; amashekeli angama-20, angama-25, nali-15 ayakuba ngumina kinina.
“ ‘ “Nanku umnikelo eniyakuwunikela: ingxenye yokwesithupha ye-efa lehomere likakolo, nengxenye yokwesithupha ye-efa lehomere lebhali,
isilinganiso samafutha esinqunyiweyo, ibhathi lamafutha: ingxenye yokweshumi yebhathi lekhori elingamabhathi alishumi njengehomere, ngokuba amabhathi alishumi ayihomere.

Kuyakuthathwa newundlu elilodwa ezimvini ezingama-200 ezivela emadlelweni anamanzi kwa-Israyeli, kube nomnikelo wokusanhlamvu, umnikelo wokushiswa nomnikelo wokuthula, ukuba benzelwe ukubuyisana,” ’ ” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.
“ ‘Bonke abantu bakulelo lizwe bayakuzibandakanya kulo mnikelo wesikhulu sakwa-Israyeli.

Kuyakuba ngumsebenzi wesikhulu ukunikela ngeminikelo yokushiswa, iminikelo yokusanhlamvu, iminikelo yokuphuzwayo emikhosini, ekwethwaseni kwenyanga nangamasabatha, emikhosini yonke emisiweyo yendlu yakwa-Israyeli. Isikhulu siyakuletha umnikelo wesono, umnikelo wokusanhlamvu, umnikelo wokushiswa neminikelo yokuthula, ukuba kwenzelwe indlu yakwa-Israyeli ukubuyisana.
“ ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: ngenyanga yokuqala, ngosuku lwayo lokuqala, uyakuthatha inkunzi neduna elingenasici, bese uhlambulula indlu engcwele.
Umphristi uyakuthatha egazini lomnikelo wesono, alibhece ezinsikeni zendlu, emagumbini omane onqenqema lwe-althare nasezinsikeni zesango legceke elingaphakathi.
Uyakwenza kanjalo ngosuku lwesikhombisa enyangeni, ngenxa yanoma ngumuphi umuntu ophambukayo nongenalwazi, nenzele indlu ukubuyisana.
“ ‘Ngenyanga yokuqala, ngosuku lwe-14 enyangeni, niyakuba nephasika; umkhosi wezinsuku eziyisikhombisa, kudliwe isinkwa esingenamvubelo.
Ngalolo lusuku isikhulu siyakuzilungisela sona nabantu bonke bakulelo lizwe, inkunzi ibe ngumnikelo wesono.

Ngezinsuku eziyisikhombisa zomkhosi siyakunikela kuSimakade umnikelo wokushiswa, izinkunzi eziyisikhombisa nezinqama eziyisikhombisa ezingenasici, ngalezo zinsuku eziyisikhombisa; sinikele ngempongo usuku nosuku, ibe ngumnikelo wesono.
Siyakunikela ngokusanhlamvu; nge-efa, kube ngokweduna ngalinye, ne-efa ngenqama ngayinye, nehini lamafutha nge-efa elilodwa.

“ ‘Kuyakuthi ngenyanga yesikhombisa, ngosuku lwe-15 enyangeni yomkhosi, isikhulu siyakunikela njengoba senzile ngezinsuku eziyisikhombisa, kube ngumnikelo wesono, umnikelo wokushiswa, umnikelo wokusanhlamvu, namafutha.’ ”

“ ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Isango legceke elingaphakathi, elibheke ngasempumalanga liyakuvalwa izinsuku eziyisithupha zokusebenza, kepha ngosuku lwesabatha nangosuku lokwethwasa kwenyanga, liyakuvulwa.

Isikhulu siyakungena ngendlela yomphemegumbi wesango elingaphandle, sime ngasensikeni yesango, abaphristi banikele umnikelo waso wokushiswa neminikelo yaso yokuthula, sikhuleke ngasembundwini wesango, bese siphuma, kodwa isango aliyukuvalwa kuze kube kusihlwa.
Abantu abahlala kulelo lizwe bayokhothama, bakhuleke kuSimakade phambi kwalelo sango ngamasabatha nangokwethwasa kwenyanga.
Ngosuku lwesabatha isikhulu siyakunikela kuSimakade ngomnikelo wokushiswa oyakuba ngamawundlu ayisithupha angenasici nenqama engenasici.
Siyakunikela nomnikelo wokusanhlamvu oyi-efa ngenqama; ngamawundlu, siyakuletha umnikelo wokusanhlamvu ngewundlu ngalinye, nehini lamafutha nge-efa.
Ngosuku lokwethwasa kwenyanga siyakunikela ngeduna elingenasici, amawundlu ayisithupha nenqama, konke lokhu kungabi nasici.
Isikhulu siyakuletha umnikelo wokusanhlamvu: i-efa ngenkunzi ne-efa ngenqama; ngamawundlu, kube ngangamandla aso, bese kuba yihini lamafutha nge-efa.
Lapho isikhulu singena, siyakungena ngendlela yomphemegumbi wesango, sibuye siphume ngendlela yawo.

Kuyothi lapho abantu abahlala ezweni bengena phambi kukaSimakade ngesikhathi semikhosi emisiweyo, kuthi lowo ongene ngendlela yesango elisenyakatho ukuba ayokhuleka, aphume ngesango eliseningizimu. Umuntu oyakungena ngendlela yesango eliseningizimu uyakuphuma ngendlela yesango elisenyakatho. Akayukubuyela emuva ngendlela angene ngayo, kodwa uyakuphuma esangweni elimaqondana nalelo angene ngalo.
Isikhulu siyakuba nabo lapho bengena; kuthi uma sebephuma, siphume nabo.
“ ‘ “Emikhosini nasemihlanganweni emisiweyo, umnikelo wokusanhlamvu uyakuba yi-efa ngenkunzi ne-efa ngenqama; ngamawundlu, kube ngangamandla aso, nehini lamafutha nge-efa.

Isikhulu siyakuvulelwa isango elibheke ngasempumalanga lapho siletha umnikelo wesihle, umnikelo wokushiswa neminikelo yokuthula ukuba ibe ngumnikelo wesihle kuSimakade. Siyakunikela umnikelo waso wokushiswa neminikelo yaso yokuthula njengoba senza ngosuku lwesabatha, bese siphuma. Isango liyakuvalwa uma sesiphumile.
“ ‘ “Nsuku zonke, njalo ekuseni, uyakunikela ngewundlu elinonyaka elingenasici, libe ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuSimakade.

Uyakunikela njalo ekuseni, ngomnikelo wokusanhlamvu, ingxenye yesithupha ye-efa, nengxenye yesithathu yehini lamafutha, ukuba kuxovwe impuphu ecolisekileyo, kube ngumnikelo wokusanhlamvu kuSimakade, isimiso saphakade.
Bayakunikela njalo ekuseni ngewundlu, ngomnikelo wokusanhlamvu nangamafutha, kube ngumnikelo wokushiswa imihla yonke.”
“ ‘Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Uma isikhulu sipha enye yamadodana aso isipho, siyakuba yifa lendodana yaso, nelesizukulwane sayo, kube ngokwabo ngokwabiwa kwefa.
Kepha uma isikhulu sinika enye yezinceku zaso isipho efeni laso, siyakuba ngesenceku kuze kube ngunyaka wokukhululeka, bese sibuyela esikhulwini, kodwa impela ifa laso liyakuba ngelamadodana aso.

Isikhulu asiyukuthatha lutho efeni labantu, singabaqhwagi impahla yabo, kodwa amadodana aso siyakuwabela ifa empahleni yaso, ukuze abantu bami bangahlakazeki, kube yilowo nalowo ashiye ifa lakhe.” ’ ”
Wayesengingenisa ngendawo yokungena eseceleni kwesango emakamelweni angcwele abaphristi, abheke ngasenyakatho. Kwakukhona lapho indawo esekugcineni ngasentshonalanga.

Wathi kimi: “Nansi-ke indawo lapho abaphristi beyakuphekela khona umnikelo wecala nomnikelo wesono, futhi babhakele lapho umnikelo wokusanhlamvu, ukuze bangawukhipheli egcekeni elingaphandle, bangcwelise abantu.”
Wayesengikhiphela egcekeni elingaphandle, wangedlulisa emagumbini omane egceke: kwakukhona ibala kuwo wonke amagumbi.

Ezingosini zozine zegceke kwakukhona amabala ehlukanisiweyo; ubude balelo nalelo bala babungamakhubhithi angama-40, ububanzi bungamakhubhithi angama-30. Lawo mabala amane ayesezingosini ayelingana ncimishi.
Phakathi kwawo kwakukhona ugange lwamatshe nxazonke, kanjalo namaziko ayenziwe phansi kwalo, macala wonke.
Wathi kimi: “Lezi yizindlu zalabo abaphekayo abayakuphekela kuzo imihlatshelo elethwa ngabantu.”

Wayesengibuyisela emnyango wendlu. Kwakugeleza amanzi phansi kombundu wendlu ngasempumalanga, ngokuba indlu yayibheke ngasempumalanga. Amanzi aphophoza ephuma phansi ohlangothini lwakwesokunene lwendlu, ngaseningizimu ye-althare.

Wayesengikhipha ngendlela yesango ngasenyakatho, wangizungezisa ngendlela engaphandle esangweni elingaphandle, elibheke endleleni esempumalanga. Bheka, kwakuphophoza amanzi ohlangothini lwaseningizimu.
Kwase kuphuma umuntu, eya ngasempumalanga, ephethe umucu wokulinganisa esandleni sakhe, walinganisa kwaba ngamakhubhithi ayinkulungwane, wayesengiweza emanzini, amanzi ayefinyelela emaqakaleni.
Wabuye walinganisa enye inkulungwane, wangidabulisa emanzini, amanzi ayesefinyelela amadolweni. Walinganisa enye futhi inkulungwane, wangiweza emanzini, amanzi ayesefinyelela okhalo.
Waphinda walinganisa enye inkulungwane; kwakungumfula engangingekwazi ukuwuwela, ngokuba amanzi ayesejulile, sekungamanzi okubhukuda kuwo, umfula okungenakuweleka kuwo.
Wathi kimi: “Ndodana yomuntu, usubonile yini na?” Wayesengihambisa, wangibuyisela osebeni lomfula.
Kuthe sengibuyile, ngabona izihlahla eziningi kakhulu osebeni lomfula, ziwuphahlile.
Wayesethi kimi: “Lawa manzi agelezela esifundeni empumalanga, ehlele e-Araba, aye olwandle, angene khona; lawa manzi aphophozayo aya olwandle, ukuze amanzi alo abe masha.
Noma kuphi lapho umfula ugelezela khona, zonke izidalwa eziphilayo eziswebezelayo ziyakuphila, kube khona izinhlanzi eziningi kakhulu, ngokuba lawo manzi ayakuba esegelezele khona.

Abadobi bezinhlanzi bayakuma ogwini lolwandle, kusukela e-Eni Gedi kuya e-Eni Egilayimi; kuyakuba yindawo yokuphonsa amanetha, kudotshwe izinhlanzi ezinhlobonhlobo njengezinhlanzi zoLwandle Olukhulu, zibe ziningi kakhulu.
Kepha amaxhaphozi alo nezimbuku zalo akuyukwenziwa kube kusha, kuyakuyekwa kunosawoti.

Ngasosebeni lomfula ngapha nangapha, kuyakumila zonke izinhlobo zemithi ethela izithelo, amaqabunga ayo awayukubuna, nezithelo zayo aziyukuphela; iyakuthela zinyanga zonke, ngokuba amanzi asuka endlini engcwele agelezela kuzo; izithelo zayo ziyakuba ngukudla, kuthi amaqabunga ayo abe ngawokuphilisa.”
Isho kanje iNkosi uSimakade, ithi: “Nanku umngcele eniyakulehlukanisa ngawo ifa lezwe ngokwezizwana ezili-12 zakwa-Israyeli, uJosefa abe nezabelo ezimbili.
Niyakwabelana lona ngokulinganayo, ngokuba ngasiphakamisa isandla sami, ngafunga ukuba ngilinike okhokho benu; leli lizwe liyakuba yifa lenu.
“Lona-ke kuyakuba ngumngcele wezwe: ohlangothini olusenyakatho, kusukela oLwadle Olukhulu ngendlela eseHethiloni, eZedadi,
eHamathi, eBherotha, eSibhirayimi ephakathi komngcele eDamaseku naseHamathi, kuze kube seHazeri Hathikhoni eliwumngcele ongaseHawurana.
Umngcele osuka olwandle uyakuba yiHazari Enani engumngcele eDamaseku; enyakatho, ngasenyakatho umngcele yiHamathi. Lolu-ke wuhlangothi olusenyakatho.

“Uhlangothi olusempulanga, lusukela phakathi kweHawurana neDamaseku, naphakathi kweGileyadi nakwa-Israyeli. Lolu luyakuba yiJordani; luyakusuka kulo mngcele luze lufike olwandle empumalanga naseThamari. Lolu-ke wuhlangothi olusempumalanga.
“Uhlangothi oluseningizimu: Eningizimu luyakusukela eThamari luze lufike emanzini eMeribhathi Kadeshi, ngasemfudlaneni ongasoLwandle Olukhulu. Lolu-ke wuhlangothi oluseningizimu, ngaseningizimu.
“Uhlangothi olusentshonalanga luyakuba luLwandle Olukhulu, kusukela emngceleni kuze kuqondane neLebo Hamathi. Lolu wuhlangothi olusentshonalanga.
“Leli lizwe niyakuzehlukanisela lona ngokwezizwe zakwa-Israyeli.

Niyakulehlakunisa ngonkatho, libe yifa lenu nelabafokazi abagogobele kini baze bazala abantwana behleli nani. Labo-ke seniyokubathatha njengeminsinsi yokuzimilela kubantu bakwa-Israyeli, nabo bayakwabelwa ifa kanye nani ezizweni zakwa-Israyeli.
Kuyakuthi esizweni umfokazi agogobele kuso, nimabele ifa lakhe khona lapho,” kusho iNkosi uSimakade.

“Nanka amagama ezizwe: UDani uyakuba nesabelo, kusukela emngceleni osenyakatho eceleni komgwaqo eHethiloni kuya eLebho Hamathi, kuze kuyofika eHazari Enani elingumngcele eDamaseku ngasenyakatho eceleni kweHamathi, kuya ohlangothini olusempumalanga kuze kube sentshonalanga.
U-Asheri uyakuba nesabelo ngasemngceleni wakwaDani, kusukela ohlangothini olusempumalanga kuze kube kolusentshonalanga.
“UNafethali uyakuba nesabelo ngasemngceleni wakwa-Asheri, kusukela ohlangothini olusempumalanga kuze kube kolusentshonalanga.
“UManase uyakuba nesabelo ngasemngceleni wakwaNafetali, kusukela ohlangothini olusempumalanga kuze kube kolusentshonalanga.
“U-Efrayimi uyakuba nesabelo ngasemngceleni wakwaManase, kusukela ohlangothini olusempumalanga kuze kube kolusentshonalanga.
“URubeni uyakuba nesabelo ngasemngceleni wakwa-Efrayimi, kusukela ohlangothini olusempumalanga kuze kube kolusentshonalanga.
“UJuda uyakuba nesabelo ngasemngceleni wakwaRubeni, kusukela ohlangothini olusempumalanga kuze kube kolusentshonalanga.

“Ngasemngceleni wakwaJuda, kusukela ohlangothini olusempumalanga kuze kube kolusentshonalanga, kuyakuba ngumnikelo eniyakunikela ngawo; ububanzi bube ngamakhubhithi ayizi-25 000, ubude bube njengesinye sezabelo kusukela ohlangothini olusempumalanga kuze kube kolusentshonalanga. Indlu engcwele iyakuba phakathi naso.
“Umnikelo eniyakunikela ngawo kuSimakade uyakuba ngamakhubhithi ayizi-25 000 ubude, ububanzi bube ngayizi-10 000.

Nanku umnikelo ongcwele: owabaphristi uyakuba ngamakhubhithi ayizi-25 000 ngasenyakatho, entshonalanga ube ayizi-10 000 ububanzi, empumalanga ube ayizi-10 000 ububanzi, nangaseningizimu ube ayizi-25 000 ubude. Indlu engcwele kaSimakade iyakuba phakathi nawo.
Uyakuba ngowabaphristi, abehlukaniselweyo emadodaneni kaZadoki, abagcine inkonzo yami; abangadukanga ngesikhathi kuduka abakwa-Israyeli, njengoba kwaduka abaLevi.
Kuyakuba ngumnikelo okhethekileyo kubo, umnikelo wezwe, endaweni engcwelengcwele, ngasemngceleni wabaLevi.
“Maqondana nomngcele wabaphristi, abaLevi bayakuba nesabelo esingamakhubhithi ayizi-25 000 ubude, ububanzi bube ayizi-10 000, bonke ubude bube ayizi-25 000, ububanzi bube ayizi-10 000.
Abayukuthengisa ngawo, bangananiselani ngawo; lena yindawo ekhethekileyo yezwe, bangalidluliseli komunye umuntu izwe, ngokuba lingcwele kuSimakade.
“Indawo eseleyo engamakhubhithi ayizi-5 000 ububanzi nangayizi-25 000 ubude, iyakuba ngengengcwele; ibe ngeyomuzi, eyokwakha, neyamadlelo. Umuzi uyakuba phakathi nayo.
Nazi izilinganiso zalo izwe: uhlangothi olusenyakatho kuyakuba ngamakhubhithi ayizi-4 500, oluseningizimu kube ayizi-4 500, olusempumalanga kube ayizi-4 500, nolusentshonalanga kube ayizi-4 500.
Umuzi uyakuba namadlelo: ngasenyakatho kuyakuba ngamakhubhithi angama-250, eningizimu abe ngama-250, empumalanga abe ngama-250, nangasentshonalanga abe ngama-250.

Indawo eseleyo emaqondana nendawo yomnikelo ongcwele, ubude bayo buyakuba ngamakhubhithi ayizi-10 000 ngasempumalanga, nayizi-10 000 ngasentshonalanga, kuqondane nomnikelo ongcwele. Izithelo zayo ziyakuba ngukudla kwabasebenza emzini.
Abasebenza emzini bayakuwulima, bevela kuzo zonke izizwe zakwa-Israyeli.
Wonke umnikelo uyakuba ngamakhubhithi ayizi-25 000, nayizi-25 000, ninikele ngomnikelo ongcwele, unezinhlangothi ezine nefa lomuzi.

“Okuseleyo kuyakuba ngokwesikhulu ngapha nangapha komnikelo ongcwele, nefa lomuzi maqondana namakhubhithi ayizi-25 000 zomnikelo ngasemngceleni empumalanga, nasentshonalanga maqondana namakhubhithi ayizi-25 000 ngasemngceleni entshonalanga, kuqondane nezabelo, kube ngokwesikhulu. Umnikelo ongcwele nendlu engcwele kuyakuba phakathi nakho.
Isabelo sabaLevi nendawo yomuzi kuyakuba phakathi kokwesikhulu, kuthi okwesikhulu kube phakathi komngcele wakwaJuda nomngcele wakwaBhenjamini.
“Izizwe eziseleyo-ke: UBhenjamini uyakuba nesabelo, kusukela ohlangothini olusempumalanga kuze kube kolusentshonalanga.
“Ngasemngceleni wakwaBhenjamini, uSimeyoni uyakuba nesabelo, kusukela ohlangothini olusempumalanga kuze kube kolusentshonalanga.
“Ngasemngceleni wakwaSimeyoni, u-Isakhare uyakuba nesabelo, kusukela ohlangothini olusempumalanga kuze kube kolusentshonalanga.
“Ngasemngceleni wakwa-Isakhare, uZebuloni uyakuba nesabelo, kusukela ohlangothini olusempumalanga kuze kube kolusentshonalanga.
“Ngasemngceleni wakwaZebuloni, uGadi uyakuba nesabelo, kusukela ohlangothini olusempumalanga kuze kube kolusentshonalanga.
“Ngasemngceleni wakwaGadi, ohlangothini oluseningizimu ngaseningizimu, umngcele uyakusuka eThamari kuze kube semanzini eMeribhathi Kadeshi nasemfudlaneni, ngasoLwandle Olukhulu.
“Yilo leli lizwe eniyakulehlukanisa ngonkatho, libe yifa lezizwe zakwa-Israyeli. Ilezo-ke izabelo zazo, kusho iNkosi uSimakade.”
“Nanka amasango okuphuma omuzi: Kusukela ohlangothini olusenyakatho kuyakuba ngamakhubhithi ayizi-4 500 ngokulinganisa.
Amasango omuzi ayakubizwa ngamagama ezizwe zakwa-Israyeli, amasango amathathu abe ngasenyakatho: elinye kuyakuba yisango lakwaRubeni, elinye kube ngelakwaJuda, elinye kube ngelakwaLevi.
“Nasohlangothini olusempumalanga kuyakuba ngamakhubhithi ayizi-4 500, namasango amathathu: elinye kube yisango lakwaJosefa, elinye kube ngelakwaBhenjamini, elinye kube ngelakwaDani.
“Nasohlangothini oluseningizimu kuyakuba yizi-4 500 ngokulinganisa, namasango amathathu: elinye kuyakuba yisango lakwaSimeyoni, elinye kube ngelakwa-Isakhare, elinye kube ngelakwaZebuloni.
“Ohlangothini olusentshonalanga kuyakuba ngamakhubhithi ayizi-4 500, namasango awo amathathu: elinye kuyakuba yisango lakwaGadi, elinye kube ngelakwa-Asheri, elinye kube ngelakwaNafetali.
“Kuyakuba ngamakhubhithi ayizi-18 000 nxazonke. “Igama lomuzi, kusukela ngalolo lusuku, kuyakuthiwa USIMAKADE ULAPHA.”
Ngonyaka wesithathu wokubusa kukaJehoyakimi, inkosi yakwaJuda, kwafika uNebukhadinezari, inkosi yaseBhabhele, eJerusalema, walivimbezela.

INkosi uNkulunkulu yanikela esandleni sakhe uJehoyakimi, inkosi yakwaJuda, nengxenye yezitsha zasendlini kaNkulunkulu, waziyisa eShineyari endlini kankulunkulu wakhe; izitsha wazibeka endlini yengcebo kankulunkulu wakhe.
Inkosi yakhuluma ku-Ashiphenazi, induna yabathenwa bayo, ukuba athathe kubantu bakwa-Israyeli abozalo lwenkosi nezikhulu, abalethe kuyo.

Aqoke abafana abangenasici, ababukeka kahle, abanengqondo ekuhlakanipheni konke, abanolwazi ekwazini, abanokuqonda ekwazini, abanamandla okukhonza endlini yenkosi; abafundise izincwadi nolimi lwamaKhaledi.
Inkosi yabamisela isabelo semihla ngemihla sokudla kwenkosi nesewayini eliphuzayo, ukuba bondliwe iminyaka emithathu; kuyakuthi ngasekugcineni kwayo, bame phambi kwenkosi.
Kulabo kwakukhona abantu bakwaJuda: uDaniyeli, uHananiya, uMishayeli, no-Azariya.
Induna yabathenwa yabaqamba amagama; uDaniyeli yamqamba ngokuthi uBhelitheshazari, uHananiya waba nguShadiraki, uMishayeli waba nguMeshakhi, no-Azariya waba ngu-Abhedi Nego.
Kepha uDaniyeli wazimisela enhliziyweni yakhe ukuba angazingcolisi ngesabelo sokudla kwenkosi nangewayini eliphuzayo; wayesecela enduneni yabathenwa ukuba angazingcolisi.
UNkulunkulu wenza ukuba uDaniyeli athole umusa nobumnene emehlweni enduna yabathenwa.

Induna yabathenwa yathi kuDaniyeli: “Mina ngiyesaba ukuthi inkosi yami, inkosi, emisile ukudla kwenu nokuphuza kwenu, iyakubona ubuso benu ukuthi buxhozekile kunobabafana abangontanga yenu, bese nibeka impilo yami engcupheni enkosini.”
Wayesethi uDaniyeli encekwini, induna yabathenwa eyayibekwe phezu koDaniyeli, uHananiya, uMishayeli, no-Azariya:
“Ake ulinge izinceku zakho izinsuku ezilishumi, basiphe imifino yokudla namanzi okuphuza.
Bese kuvezwa ubuso bethu phambi kwakho nobuso babafana abadla isabelo sokudla kwenkosi, wenze ezincekwini zakho njengokubona kwakho.”
Yabalalela kulokho, yabalinga izinsuku ezilishumi.
Ngasekupheleni kwezinsuku ezilishumi, ubuso babo babonakala bubuhle, babekhuluphele emzimbeni kunabo bonke abafana ababedla isabelo sokudla kwenkosi.
Inceku yayisisusa isabelo sokudla newayini lokuphuza, yabapha imifino.
Laba bafana abane uNkulunkulu wabanika ukwazi nokuqonda encwadini nasekuhlakanipheni; uDaniyeli wayenengqondo kuyo yonke imibono namaphupho.
Ngasekugcineni kwezinsuku inkosi eyayishilo ukuthi bazakungeniswa ngazo, induna yabathenwa yabangenisa phambi kukaNebukhadinezari.
Inkosi yakhuluma nabo; phakathi kwabo bonke akufunyaniswanga muntu onjengoDaniyeli, uHananiya, uMishayeli, no-Azariya, ngenkathi sebemi phambi kwenkosi.
Ezintweni zonke zokuhlakanipha nezokuqonda inkosi eyayibabuza ngazo, yabafumanisa bedlula kalishumi zonke izanusi nabathwebulayo ababesembusweni wayo wonke.
UDaniyeli wayekhona, kwaze kwaba ngunyaka wokuqala kaKhoresi, inkosi.
Ngonyaka wesibili wokubusa kukaNebukhadinezari, uNebukhadinezari waphupha amaphupho; umoya wakhe wakhathazeka, wayeseqwasha.
Yayisiyaleza inkosi ukuba kubizwe izanusi, abathwebulayo, abalumbi, namaKhaledi ukuba bachazele inkosi amaphupho ayo. Bangena, bama phambi kwenkosi.
Inkosi yayisithi kubo: “Ngiphuphe iphupho, umoya wami ukhathazekele ukulazi iphupho.”
Ayesekhuluma amaKhaledi enkosini ngesi-Aramu, athi: “Mana njalo, nkosi; yisho ezincekwini zakho iphupho, thina silichaze.”
