Wayefundisa emasinagogeni abo, edunyiswa yibo bonke.
Wafika eNazaretha lapho akhulela khona, wangena esinagogeni ngosuku lwesabatha njengalokhu ayevame ukwenza kanjalo, wasukuma ukuba afunde.
Wanikwa umqulu ka-Izaya, umphrofethi, wawuvula, wafumana indawo okulotshwe kuyo kwathiwa:
“UMoya weNkosi uphezu kwami, ngokuba ingigcobile ukuba ngishumayele ivangeli kwabampofu; ingithumele ukumemezela ukukhululwa kwabathunjiweyo, ukuvula amehlo ezimpumputhe, ukuhlenga abacindezelweyo,
nokumemezela unyaka omuhle weNkosi.”
Wawugoqa umqulu, wawunika isikhonzi, wahlala; amehlo wonke ababesesinagogeni amgqolozela.
Waqala ukukhuluma kubo, ethi: “Namhlanje ugcwalisekile lo mbhalo njengoba nizwa ngezenu izindlebe.”
Bonke bakhuluma kahle ngaye, bemangaliswa ngamazwi omusa aphuma emlonyeni wakhe, bathi: “Kanti lo akasiyo yini indodana kaJosefa na?”
Wathi kubo: “Impela niyakusisho kimi lesi saga, nithi: ‘Nyanga, zelaphe wena. Lokhu esizwa ukuthi ukwenzile eKhaphernawume, kwenze phela nalapha ezweni lakini.’ ”
Wathi-ke: “Ngiqinisile ngithi kini: akukho mphrofethi owemukelekayo ezweni lakubo.
Kepha impela ngithi kini: ngezinsuku zika-Eliya kwakukhona abafelokazi abaningi kwa-Israyeli; izulu lomisile iminyaka emithathu nezinyanga eziyisithupha; kwaba khona indlala enkulu ezweni lonke.
Kepha u-Eliya akathunyelwanga nakoyedwa wabo, kuphela kowesifazane ongumfelokazi, eZarephitha eSidoni.
Kwakukhona abaningi ababenochoko kwa-Israyeli ngesikhathi sika-Elisha, umphrofethi, kodwa akukho namunye kubo owahlanjululwa, kuphela uNayimani, umSiriya.”
Bonke ababesesinagogeni bagcwala intukuthelo enkulu lapho bekuzwa lokho.
Basukuma, bamxosha emzini, bamqhubela esiweni esasisentabeni umuzi wabo owawakhiwe phezu kwayo, ukuze bamkhalakathelise kuso.
Kepha Yena wadabula phakathi kwabo wahamba.
Wehlela eKhaphernawume, umuzi iGalile. Wayebafundisa abantu kulusuku lwesabatha.
Bamangala ngokufundisa kwakhe, ngokuba izwi lakhe lalinegunya.
Kwakukhona esinagogeni umuntu onomoya wedimoni elingcolileyo, wamemeza ngezwi elikhulu, wathi:
“Habe, ufunani nje kithi Jesu waseNazaretha? Uze ukuzosibhubhisa yini na? Ngiyakwazi ukuthi ungubani: ungoNgcwele kaNkulunkulu.”
UJesu wamkhuza, wathi: “Thula, uphume kuye!” Idimoni lamqumba phansi phambi kwabo, laphuma kuye lingamlimazanga.
Bonke bafikelwa ngukwesaba, bakhuluma bodwa, bathi: “Lizwi lini leli, ngokuba ukhuluma ngegunya namandla, ukhuza imimoya engcolileyo, iphume na?”
Udumo lwakhe lwasabalala kuzo zonke lezo zindawo.
Waphuma esinagogeni, wangena endlini kaSimoni. Kepha umkhwekazi kaSimoni wayebanjwe ngumkhuhlane onzima; bamnxusa uJesu ukuba amsize.
UJesu wamengama, wawukhuza umkhuhlane, waphela. Wasuka ngokushesha wabakhonza.
Kwathi selishona ilanga, baletha kuye bonke abagulayo nababekhwelwe yizifo ezehlukene; wabeka izandla phezu kwabo ngamunye, wabaphilisa.
Kwaphuma amadimoni kwabaningi, ememeza ethi: “Wena uyiNdodana kaNkulunkulu.” Kepha wawakhuza, kawavumelanga ukuba akhulume, ngokuba ayemazi ukuthi unguKhristu.
Kuthe sekusile, wathi shelele, waya endaweni eyihlane. Izixuku zamfuna, zaze zamthola, zazama ukumvimba ukuba angamuki kuzo.
Kepha wathi kuzo: “Kufanele ukuba ngishumayele ivangeli lombuso kaNkulunkulu nakweminye imizi, ngokuba ngathunyelelwa lokhu.”
Waqhubeka eshumayela emasinagogeni eJudiya.
Kwathi uJesu emi ngasolwandle iGenezaretha, isixuku samngunga ukuze sizwe izwi likaNkulunkulu.
Wabona izikebhe ezimbili zimi ngasolwandle, abadobi babengekho kuzo, besahlanza amanetha.
Wangena kwesinye sezikebhe okwakungesikaSimoni, wamcela ukuba athi ukuqhela kancane emhlabathini. UJesu wahlala phansi, wasifundisa isixuku esesikebheni.
Eseqedile ukukhuluma, wathi kuSimoni: “Qhubekela ekujuleni, nehlise amanetha enu, nibambe.”
USimoni waphendula, wathi: “Nkosi, sisebenze ubusuku bonke, kodwa asibambanga lutho. Kepha njengoba usho, ngizakuwehlisa amanetha.”
Sebekwenzile lokho babamba izinhlanzi eziningi kakhulu, aze amanetha abo aqala ukudabuka.
Baqhweba abangani babo abakwesinye isikebhe ukuba beze, babasize. Beza-ke, bagcwalisa zombili izikebhe, zaze zacishe zazika.
Kuthe uSimoni Phethro ekubona lokho, waziphonsa phansi ngasemadolweni kaJesu, wathi: “Suka kimi, Nkosi, ngokuba ngingumuntu oyisoni.”
Phela yena kanye nabo bonke bamangaliswa ukubona ubuningi bezinhlanzi ababezibambile,
kanjalo noJakobe noJohane amadodana kaZebedewu ababesizana noSimoni. UJesu wathi kuSimoni: “Ungesabi; kusukela manje usuzakudoba abantu.”
Kuthe izikebhe sebezisondeze emhlabathini, bashiya phansi konke, bamlandela uJesu.
Kwathi ekomunye wemizi; kwafika indoda eyayigcwele uchoko. Kuthe imbona uJesu, yawa ngobuso, yamnxusa ithi: “Nkosi, uma uthanda ungangihlambulula.”
UJesu welula isandla sakhe, wayithinta, wathi: “Ngiyathanda, hlambuluka.” Masinyane uchoko lwaphela kuyo.
Wayiyala ukuba ingatsheli muntu, kepha wathi: “Hamba, uzibonakalise kumphristi, unikele umnikelo wokuhlanjululwa kwakho njengalokhu uMose wayala, kube ngubufakazi kubo.”
Kepha imibiko ngaye yasabalala kakhulu. Izixuku eziningi zaba naye ukuze zilalele, futhi ziphulukiswe ezifweni zazo.
Kepha uJesu wamonyuka, waya ehlane, ukuyokhuleka.
Ngolunye lwalezo zinsuku uJesu efundisa, kwakuhleli lapho abaFarisi nezazimthetho ababephuma kuzo zonke izifunda eGalile, eJudiya naseJerusalema. Amandla eNkosi ayekuye ukuba aphulukise.
Kwafika amadoda ethwele ngohlaka umuntu ofe uhlangothi. Ayefuna ukungena naye endlini, ambeke phambi kukaJesu.
Kepha lapho engayitholi indlela yokumngenisa ngenxa yesixuku, agibela ophahleni lwendlu, aluqaqa, amehlisela phansi ngohlaka phambi kukaJesu.
UJesu ekubona ukukholwa kwawo, wathi: “Mngani, uthethelelwe izono zakho.”
Izazimthetho nabaFarisi baqala ukuphikisana, bethi: “Ngubani lo muntu ohlambalazayo na? Ngubani ongathethelela izono ngaphandle kukaNkulunkulu kuphela na?”
Kepha uJesu eyazi imidlinzo yabo, waphendula, wathi kubo: “Nidlinzelani ezinhliziyweni zenu na?
Yikuphi okulula ukukusho, ukuthi: ‘Uthethelelwe izono zakho,’ noma ngukuthi: ‘Vuka uhambe na?’
Kepha ukuze nazi ukuthi iNdodana yomuntu inegunya lokuthethelela izono emhlabeni,” wathi kofe uhlangothi: “Ngithi kuwe: vuka uthabathe uhlaka lwakho, uye endlini yakho.”
Wasukuma masinyane bebuka, wathatha uhlaka ayelele kulo, wahamba waya endlini yakhe, emdumisa uNkulunkulu.
Bonke bathuthumela, base bemdumisa uNkulunkulu futhi begcwele ukwesaba, bathi: “Sibone izinto ezimangalisayo namuhla.”
Emveni kwalokho uJesu waphuma, wabona umthelisi ogama lakhe nguLevi, ehleli endaweni okuthelwa kuyo, wathi kuye: “Ngilandele.”
Wakushiya konke, wasukuma, wamlandela.
ULevi wamenzela uJesu idili elikhulu endlini yakhe. Kwakukhona isixuku sabathelisi esikhulu nabanye ababehleli nabo esidlweni.
AbaFarisi nezazimthetho bakhononda kubafundi bakhe, bathi: “Yini ukuba nidle niphuze nabathelisi nezoni na?”
UJesu waphendula, wathi kubo: “Abaphilileyo abayidingi inyanga, kodwa labo abagulayo kuphela.
Kangizanga ukuzobiza abalungileyo, kodwa izoni, ukuze ziphenduke.”
Base bethi kuye: “Abafundi bakaJohane bazila kaningi, futhi bakhuleke, kanjalo nababaFarisi, kodwa abakho bayadla, bayaphuza.”
Kepha uJesu wathi kubo: “Ikhetho ningalenza yini lizile nxa umyeni esenalo na?
Kepha izinsuku ziyeza lapho umyeni eyakususwa kulo, liyakuzila-ke ngalezo zinsuku.”
Wabatshela futhi nomzekeliso othi: “Akukho muntu oklebhula isichibi engutsheni entsha achibele ngaso ingubo endala. Uma enza lokho, zombili ziyakuklebhuka, isichibi esisha siklebhule ingubo endala.
Akukho muntu futhi othela iwayini elisha ezimvabeni ezindala, funa iwayini elisha lidabule izimvaba, lichitheke, bese konakala nezimvaba.
Kepha iwayini elisha lithelwa ezimvabeni ezintsha.
Akukho muntu othi esephuze iwayini elidala, abuye afune elisha, ngokuba uthi elidala limnandi.”
Kwathi ngesabatha, uJesu nabafundi bakhe bedabula emasimini, abafundi bakhe bakha izikhwebu, bazihlikihla ngezandla, bazidla.
Kepha abanye babaFarisi bathi: “Nikwenzelani okungavunyelwe ngesabatha na?”
UJesu wabaphendula, wathi: “Anifundanga yini ngokwenziwa nguDavide mhlazana yena nababenaye belambile,
ukuthi wangena endlini kaNkulunkulu, wathatha izinkwa zobukhona, okungavunyelwe ukuba zidliwe yinoma ngubani ngaphandle kwabaphristi kuphela, wazidla, wanika nababenaye na?”
Wathi kubo: “Indodana yomuntu iyiNkosi yesabatha.”
Kwathi ngelinye isabatha uJesu wangena esinagogeni, wafundisa. Kwakukhona lapho umuntu owayeshwabene isandla sokunene.
Izazimthetho nabaFarisi babeqaphile ukuthi uzakuphulukisa yini ngesabatha, ukuze bathole utho abangambeka icala ngalo.
Kepha uJesu ekwazi abakudlinzayo, wathi endodeni enesandla esishwabeneyo: “Sukuma ume phakathi nendawo.” Yasukuma, yema.
UJesu wathi kubo: “Ngiyanibuza ukuthi kuvunyelwe yini ukwenza okuhle noma okubi ngesabatha, ukusindisa noma ukubulala na?”
Wabaqalaza bonke qede wathi kuyo: “Yelula isandla sakho.” Yenza kanjalo, isandla sayo saphiliswa.
Bathukuthela bathelwa ngamanzi, bakhuluma bodwa bebonisana ukuthi bangamenzenjani uJesu.
Kwathi ngalezo zinsuku uJesu waphuma waya entabeni eyokhuleka; wahlala ubusuku bonke ekhuleka kuNkulunkulu.
Kuthe sekusile, wababiza abafundi bakhe, wakhetha kubo abali-12, wababiza ngokuthi abaphostoli:
USimoni owamqamba wathi nguPhethro, abanye kwakungo-Andreya umfowabo, uJakobe, uJohane, uFiliphu, uBhartholomewu,
uMathewu, uThomase, uJakobe ka-Alifewu, uSimoni okuthiwa isishisekeli,
uJuda kaJakobe, noJuda Iskariyothe owamkhaphelayo.
Wayesehla nabo, wema endaweni eyithafa nesixuku esikhulu sabafundi bakhe, noquqaba lwabantu ababevela kulo lonke iJudiya, eJerusalema, nangasolwandle iThire neSidoni,
ababeze ukuzomlalela nokuba baphulukiswe ezifeni zabo, nalabo ababehlushwa ngomoya abangcolileyo; baphulukiswa.
Sonke isixuku sasifuna ukumthinta, ngokuba kwakunamandla ayephuma kuye aphilisa bonke.
UJesu, ewaphakamisela amehlo ngakubafundi, wathi: “Nibusisiwe nina enimpofu, ngokuba umbuso kaNkulunkulu ungowenu.
Nibusisiwe nina enilambileyo manje, ngokuba niyakusuthiswa. Nibusisiwe nina enikhalayo manje, ngokuba niyakuhleka.
Nibusisiwe nxa abantu benizonda, benihlulula, benithuka, belichitha igama lenu sengathi libi, ngenxa yeNdodana yomuntu.
“Thokozani ngalolo lusuku, nitshekulise okwamathole yinjabulo. Ngokuba umvuzo wenu mkhulu ezulwini. Oyise benza kanjalo kubaphrofethi.
“Kepha maye, kinina enicebileyo, ngokuba senikwemukele ukududuzwa kwenu!
Maye, kinina enisuthiyo manje, ngokuba niyakulamba! Maye, kinina enihlekayo manje, ngokuba niyakukhala, nikhihle isililo!
Maye, kinina nonke abantu abakhuluma kahle ngani, ngokuba oyise benza kanjalo kubaphrofethi mbumbulu.
“Kepha kinina eningilaleleyo, ngithi kini: thandani izitha zenu, nenze okuhle kwabanizondayo,
nibabusise abaniqalekisayo, nibakhulekele abanihlukumezayo.
Lowo okushaya esihlathini, mnike nesinye, nokwaphuca ingubo, ungamnqabeli nebhantshi.
Yilowo nalowo ocela utho kuwe, muphe, nalowo okwephuca okungokwakho, ungakufuni futhi kuye.
Lokhu enithanda ukuba abantu bakwenze kini nani kwenzeni kanjalo kubo.
“Uma nithanda abanithandayo, niyakutuswa ngani na? Ngokuba nezoni ziyabathanda abazithandayo.
Uma nenza okuhle kwabenza okuhle kini, pho niyakubongwa ngani na? Ingani nezoni ziyakwenza khona lokho.
Uma nitsheleka labo enithemba ukwemukela kubo, niyakubongwa ngani na? Ingani nezoni ziyazitsheleka izoni, zibuyelwe okungangalokho ezikubolekisile.

Kepha thandani izitha zenu, nenze okuhle, nitshelekise ningalindele kubuyiselwa, uma nenze kanjalo uyakuba mkhulu umvuzo wenu, nibe ngabantwana boPhezukonke, ngokuba Yena umnene kwabangabongiyo nababi.
Yibani nesihawu, njengalokhu uYihlo enesihawu.
“Ningehluleli, khona ningayukwehlulelwa; ningalahli muntu ngecala, khona ningayukulahlwa ngecala; thethelelani, khona niyakuthethelelwa.
Yiphani, khona niyakuphiwa; bayakunipha eziqabethweni zenu isilinganiso esihle, esigxishiweyo, sashukuziswa, sagcwala phama, ngokuba ngesilinganiso enilinganisa ngaso, nani niyakulinganiselwa ngaso.”
Wabatshela nomzekeliso, wathi: “Impumputhe ingayihola yini enye impumputhe na? Aziyukukhalakathela emgodini zombili na?
Umfundi kangaphezulu komfundisi, kepha lowo oqeqeshwe ngokuphelelisiweyo, uyakuba njengomfundisi wakhe.
“Ubhekelani uthi olusesweni lomfowenu, ube ungaluboni ugongolo olukwelakho iso na?

Ungasho kanjani kumfowenu uthi: ‘Mfowethu, ake ngikhiphe uthi olusesweni lakho,’ ube wena ungaluboni ugongolo olukwelakho iso na? Mzenzisi, khipha kuqala ugongolo olusesweni lakho, khona uzakubonisisa uthi olusesweni lomfowenu ukuze ulukhiphe.
“Ngokuba awukho umuthi omuhle othela isithelo esibi, futhi nomuthi omubi awutheli isithelo esihle.
Ngokuba yilowo nalowo muthi waziwa ngesithelo sawo. Akukhiwa amakhiwane emeveni, nezithelo zomvini azikhiwa ejikijolweni.
Umuntu omuhle uveza okuhle engcebweni yenhliziyo enhle, nomubi uveza okubi engcebweni embi, ngokuba umlomo wakhe ukhuluma ngokuchichima kwenhliziyo.
“Ningibizelani nithi: ‘Nkosi, Nkosi,’ nibe ningakwenzi engikushoyo na?
Yilowo nalowo oza kimi, ezwe amazwi ami, awenze, ngizakunikhombisa ukuthi ufana nobani.
Ufana nomuntu owathi uma akha indlu, wemba wajula, wabeka isisekelo edwaleni. Kwafika izikhukhula, umfula wayishaya leyo ndlu, kepha awukwazanga ukuyinyakazisa, ngokuba yayakhiwe kahle.
Kodwa ozwayo angenzi, unjengomuntu owakha indlu emhlabathini ngaphandle kwesisekelo; umfula wayishaya, yawa masinyane; kwaba kukhulu ukudilika kwaleyo ndlu.”
Kwathi uJesu eseqedile ukukhuluma wonke lawo mazwi kubantu, wangena eKhaphernawume.
Induna yekhulu yayinenceku eyithandayo eyayisigulela ukufa.
Isizwile ngoJesu, yathumela kuye amalunga abaJuda, ukuba ayomcela eze azokwelapha inceku yayo.
Esefikile kuJesu, amncengisisa, ethi: “Ufanelekile lona ukuba umenzele lokhu,
ngokuba uyasithanda isizwe sakithi, nguye futhi osakhele isinagoge.”

UJesu wayesehamba nawo. Kuthe eseseduze nendlu yenduna yekhulu, induna yekhulu yathumela abahlobo bayo ukuba bathi kuye: “Nkosi, ungazihluphi, ngokuba angifanele ukuba ungangena phansi kophahla lwami.
Ngakho-ke angifanele ukuba ngingeza kuwe, kodwa khipha izwi nje, ukuze inceku yami isinde.
Ngokuba nami ngingumuntu ophethe, nginamabutho aphansi kwami. Ngithi kwelinye: ‘Hamba,’ lihambe. Kwelinye ngithi: ‘Woza,’ lize, nasencekwini yami ngithi: ‘Yenza lokhu,’ ikwenze.”
UJesu ewezwa lawo mazwi, wamangala ngayo, wayesephendukela esixukwini esasimlandela, wathi: “Ngithi kini: angikaze ngikufumane ukukholwa okungaka kwa-Israyeli.”
Lapho sebebuyela endlini yenduna yekhulu, bafika inceku isisindile.
Kwathi ngakusasa, uJesu waya emzini okuthiwa yiNayini; abafundi bakhe babehamba naye nesixuku esikhulu.
Esesondele ngasesangweni lomuzi, wathola kukhona ofileyo owayethwelwe eyongcwatshwa, indodana eyodwa vo kunina, owayengumfelokazi. Kwakunesixuku esikhulu sabantu balowo muzi ababemphelekezela.
INkosi yakubona lokho, yaba nesihe, yathi kuye: “Ungakhali.”
Yasondela, yathinta uhlaka; ababeluthwele bema. Yayisithi: “Nsizwa, ngithi kuwe: vuka!”
Obefile wavuka, wahlala ngezinqe, waqala ukukhuluma. Wayesemnikeza unina.
Bonke behlelwa wukwesaba, bamdumisa uNkulunkulu, bathi: “Kufike umphrofethi omkhulu phakathi kwethu,” bathi futhi: “UNkulunkulu ubahambele abantu bakhe.”
Lezi zindaba ngoJesu zasabalala kulo lonke iJudiya nasezindaweni ezakhelene nalo.
Abafundi bakaJohane bambikela ngazo zonke lezi zinto. UJohane wayesebiza ababili kubafundi bakhe,
wabathumela eNkosini, wathi: “Unguye yini ozayo, noma silindele omunye na?”
Afika kuye lawo madoda, athi: “Sithunyiwe kuwe nguJohane uMbhabhadisi, obuza ukuthi: ‘Unguye yini ozayo, noma silindele omunye na?’ ”
Ngaleso sikhathi iNkosi yaphulukisa abaningi ababekhungethwe yizifo, nezinhlungu, nomoya ababi. Wavula namehlo ezimpumputhe eziningi, zabona.

UJesu waphendula, wathi kuwo: “Hambani nilandise uJohane ngalokho enikubonileyo nenikuzwileyo, nithi: izimpumputhe ziyabona, izinyonga ziyahamba, abanochoko bayahlanjululwa, izithulu ziyezwa, abafileyo bayavuswa, abampofu bayashunyayezwa ivangeli.
Ubusisiwe lowo ongayukukhubeka ngami.”
Kuthe sezihambile izithunywa zikaJohane, waqala ukukhuluma ezixukwini ngoJohane, ethi: “Naphuma naya ehlane ukuyobonani na? Umhlanga ontengantengiswa ngumoya na?
Kanti naphuma ukuyobonani na? Umuntu owembethe izingubo ezintofontofo na? Phela abembethe okukhazimulayo, futhi betamasa, basezigodlweni zamakhosi.
Kepha naphuma ukuyobonani na? Umphrofethi? Yebo, ngithi kini: owedlula umphrofethi.
Nguye okulotshwe ngaye ukuthi: “ ‘Ngiyathuma isithunywa sami phambi kwakho, esiyakulungisa indlela yakho phambi kwakho.’
“Ngithi kini: akukho namunye kwabazelwe ngowesifazane omkhulu kunoJohane, kepha omncinyane embusweni kaNkulunkulu, mkhulu kunaye.”
Abantu bonke, yebo, nabathelisi sebekuzwile lokho bavuma ukuthi uNkulunkulu ulungile, babhabhadiswa ngombhabhadiso kaJohane.
Kepha abaFarisi nezazimthetho abayemukelanga inhloso kaNkulunkulu emaqondana nabo, benqaba ukubhabhadiswa nguye.
“Ngakho, ngingabafanisa nani abantu balesi sizukulwane na? Bafana nani?
Bafana nabantwana abahlezi esigcawini, bememezana bethi: “ ‘Sinishayele imitshingo, kodwa anisinanga; sahlabelela ingoma yesililo, kodwa anililanga.’
“Ngokuba uJohane uMbhabhadisi wafika engadli sinkwa, engaphuzi wayini; nathi: ‘Unedimoni.’
INdodana yomuntu ifike yadla, yaphuza, kepha nithi: ‘Bhekani lo umuntu oyisiminzi nenkolotshe, umngani wabathelisi nezoni.’
Kepha ukuhlakanipha kubonakaliswa kuyiqiniso kulabo abakwemukelayo.”
Omunye wabaFarisi wamema uJesu ukuba azokudla naye. UJesu wafika-ke endlini yomFarisi, wahlala naye esidlweni.
Owesifazane wakulowo muzi, owayeyisoni, esezwile ukuthi uJesu usesidlweni endlini yomFarisi, waya khona ephethe umfuma wamafutha ngojeke we-alabhasta.
Wema ngemuva kukaJesu, ngasezinyaweni zakhe, ekhala. Waqala ukumatisa izinyawo zikaJesu ngezinyembezi zakhe, wayesezesula ngezinwele zakhe, wazanga izinyawo ephindelela, wayesezigcoba ngamakha.
Kepha lapho umFarisi owayemmemile ekubona lokhu, wadlinza wathi: “Lo muntu ukuba ubengumphrofethi, ngabe wazile ukuthi ngubani futhi uluhlobo luni lo wesifazane omthintayo, ngokuba uyisoni.”
UJesu wamphendula, wathi kuye: “Simoni, kukhona engifuna ukukutshela khona.” Wathi: “Mfundisi, ngitshele.”
“Umbolekisi othile wayenabantu ababili ababemkweleta. Omunye wayekweleta odenariyu abangama-500, omunye ekweleta odenariyu abangama-50.
Lokhu babengenalutho lokumkhokhela, wabaxolela bobabili. Imuphi kulaba oyakumthanda kakhulu na?”
USimoni waphendula wathi: “Ngicabanga ukuthi yilowo oxolelwe kokuningi.” UJesu wathi kuye: “Uyihlabe esikhonkosini.”

Waphendukela kowesifazane, wathi kuSimoni: “Uyambona lo wesifazane na? Ngingene endlini yakho, awunginikanga amanzi okugeza izinyawo, kodwa lo wesifazane umantisile izinyawo zami ngezinyembezi zakhe, wazesula ngezinwele zakhe.
Awunganganga, kepha lo wesifazane, yilokhu ngingenile, akazange ayeke ukwanga izinyawo zami.
Awuligcobanga ikhanda lami ngamafutha, kepha lo wesifazane uzigcobile izinyawo zami ngamafutha.
Ngenxa yalokho, ngithi kuwe: izono zakhe eziningi zithethelelwe, ngokuba uveze uthando olukhulu. Kepha lowo othethelelwe okuncane, uthanda kancane.”
Wayesethi kowesifazane: “Izono zakho zithethelelwe.”
Ababehleli naye esidlweni baqala ukukhuluma bodwa, bethi: “Ngubani kanti lo, othethelela nezono na?”
Kepha wathi kowesifazane: “Ukukholwa kwakho kukusindisile. Hamba, ngokuthula.”
Emveni kwalokho, uJesu wahamba ephuma engena emizini nasemizaneni, ememezela, eshumayela ivangeli lombuso kaNkulunkulu. Abali-12 babenaye.
Kwakukhona nabanye besifazane ababephulukiswe komoya ababi nasezifweni: kwakungoMariya obizwa ngoMagdalena, okwakuphume kuye amadimoni ayisikhombisa,
uJowana umkaKhuza, induna kaHerodi, uSusana, nabanye abaningi ababebalekelela ngalokho ababenakho.
Kwabuthana ndawonye isixuku esikhulu sivela emizini ngemizi, size kuye. Wayesekhuluma ngomzekeliso, wathi:
“Kwaphuma umhlwanyeli wayohlwanyela imbewu yakhe. Ekuhlwanyeleni kwakhe, enye imbewu yawela ngasendleleni; yanyathelwa, zayidla nezinyoni zezulu.
Enye yawela edwaleni; yamila, kodwa yasheshe yabuna, ngokuba kwakungekho mswakama.
Enye yawela phakathi kwameva; akhula kanye nayo, ayiminyanisa.
Enye yawela emhlabathini ovundileyo; yamila, yathela izithelo ngekhulu.” Washo lokhu, wayesememeza ethi: “Onezindlebe zokuzwa makezwe.”
Abafundi bakhe bambuza ukuthi uchazani lo mzekeliso na.
Wathi: “Nina ninikezwe ukuba nazi izimfihlakalo zombuso kaNkulunkulu, kodwa abanye batshelwa ngemizekeliso, ukuze kuthi bebona, kodwa bangabonisisi, bathi bezwa, kepha bangaqondi.
“Nakhu-ke okuqondwe yilo mzekeliso: imbewu iyizwi likaNkulunkulu.
Abangasendleleni, yilabo abathi sebelizwile, izwi, bese kufika uSathane, alisuse enhliziyweni yabo, funa bathi bangakholwa, basindiswe.
Abasedwaleni, yilabo okuthi lapho belizwa izwi, balamukele ngokuthokoza, kodwa laba kabanampande, bayakholwa isikhashana, kuthi uma kufika isikhathi sokulingwa bahlubuke.
Abawele emeveni, yilabo okuthi sebelizwile izwi, bahambe, baminyaniswe yiminako, yingcebo, nenjabulo yokuphila, bangatheli izithelo eziqhamileyo.
Abasemhlabathini ovundileyo, yilabo abathi uma sebelizwile izwi, balamukele, babambelele kulo ngenhliziyo eqotho nelungileyo, kuthi ngokubekezela, bathele izithelo.
“Akekho othi angokhela isibani, bese esimboza ngesitsha noma asibeke phansi kombhede, kodwa usifaka othini, ukuze abangenayo babone ukukhanya.
Ngokuba akukho okufihliweyo okungayukuvela obala, nokuyisifuba okungayukudaluleka, kube sobala.
Ngakho-ke qaphelani ukuthi nizwa kanjani, ngokuba yilowo nalowo onakho, uyakuphiwa, kodwa lowo ongenakho, uyakwemukwa nalokho anakho.”
Kwase kufika kuye unina nabafowabo, kepha behluleka ukufinyelela kuye ngenxa yesixuku.
Wabikelwa ukuthi: “Unyoko nabafowenu bami ngaphandle, bafuna ukukubona.”
Kepha waphendula, wathi kubo: “Umame nabafowethu yilabo abathi bangalizwa izwi likaNkulunkulu, balenze.”
Kwathi ngolunye usuku uJesu wagibela esikebheni nabafundi bakhe, wayesethi kubo: “Ake siwelele ngaphesheya kolwandle.” Basuka-ke.
Besagwedla, bewelela ngaphesheya ngesikebhe, uJesu wazunywa ngubuthongo, walala. Kwase kuhlasela isivunguvungu somoya olwandle, isikebhe sagcwala amanzi, baze baba sengozini.
Base besondela kuye, bamvusa bethi: “Nkosi, Nkosi, siyafa.” Wavuka, wawukhuza umoya namagagasi agubhayo. Kwanqamuka, kwathula kwathi du.
Wayesethi kubo: “Kuphi ukukholwa kwenu na?” Besaba; bamangala, bathi omunye komunye: “Ngubani kanti lo okhuza umoya namanzi, kumlalele na?”
Bafika ngesikebhe ezweni lamaGerasa, elimaqondana neGalile.
Esehlele emhlabathini, indoda ethile eyayinamadimoni, ivela emzini, yamhlangabeza. Kwase kuyisikhathi lowo muntu engasagqoki lutho, futhi engasahlali ekhaya kodwa ehlala emathuneni.
Lowo muntu, embona uJesu, wadazuluka, wayesewa phansi phambi kwakhe, washo ngezwi elikhulu wathi: “Ufunani kimi, Jesu Ndodana kaNkulunkulu oPhezukonke na? Ngiyakuncenga, ungangihluphi,”

ngokuba uJesu wayesewuyalile lo moya omubi ukuba uphume kulo muntu. Izikhathi eziningi, lo moya wawusumbambe kaningana, kwale noma eseboshwe ngozankosi nangamaketango ezinyaweni, eqashelwe. Wayezigqabula izibopho; wayeqhutshwa yilawo madimoni, amuyise ehlane.
UJesu wambuza wathi: “Ungubani igama lakho?” Wathi: “NginguLegiyona,” ngenxa yokuba kwakungene kuye amadimoni amaningi.
Kepha amadimoni amncenga ukuba angawayali ukuya kwalasha.
Kwakukhona budebuduze entabeni umhlambi omkhulu wezingulube owawuklabe lapho. Amncenga ukuba awavumele ukuba angene kuzo, nempela wawavumela.
Ngakho-ke amadimoni aphuma kulowo muntu, angena ezingulubeni; umhlambi wabaleka wakhalakathela eweni olwandle, waminza.
Ababelusile bebona okwenzekileyo, babaleka bayobika emzini nasemakhaya.
Baphuma ukuyozibonela okwenzekileyo, bafika kuJesu, bafica umuntu obenamadimoni ehleli ezinyaweni zikaJesu, idimoni seliphumile kuye, egqokile futhi ingqondo yakhe ibuye ngokuphelele, baba nokwesaba.
Ababezibonele ngawabo, babatshela ukusuka nokuhlala kwendaba ukuthi wayesinde kanjani obekade ephethwe ngamadimoni.
Bonke abantu, nomakhelwane baseGerasa, bamcela ukuba asuke kubo, ahambe, ngokuba babekhungethwe ngukwesaba okukhulu. Ngakho-ke uJesu wangena esikebheni, wabuyela lapho ayevela khona.
Indoda okwakuphume kuyo amadimoni yamnxusa ukuba ahambe nayo, kodwa wayibuyisela emuva, ethi:
“Buyela ekhaya, ubalandise ukuthi uNkulunkulu ukwenzele ini.” Nempela yahamba yabalandisa emzini wakubo wonke, ukuthi kungakanani uJesu ayeyenzele khona.
Ekubuyeni kwakhe uJesu, isixuku samemukela ngokuba sasimlindele ngabomvu.
Kwase kufika indoda okuthiwa nguJayiru. Le ndoda eyayingumphathi wesinagoge, yaziphonsa phansi ngasezinyaweni zikaJesu, yamncenga ukuba angene endlini yayo,
ngokuba yayinendodakazi eyodwa vo, eneminyaka eli-12, eyayigulela ukufa. UJesu esaya lapho isixuku samminyanisa.
Owesifazane owayenesifo somopho iminyaka eli-12, owayesezame kwabaningi efuna ukuphulukiswa kodwa akaze akuthola.
Wasondela ngasemuva, wathinta umphetho wengubo kaJesu, umopho wathi nqamu, khona manjalo.
UJesu wathi: “Ngubani ongithintileyo na?” Lapho bonke bephika, uPhethro wathi: “Nkosi, izixuku zikuhaqile futhi ziyadudulana ukuba zisondele kuwe.”
Kepha uJesu waqhubeka wathi: “Ukhona ongithintileyo, ngokuba ngizwile amandla ephuma kimi.”

Owesifazane ebona ukuthi ngeke esazifihla, weza ethuthumela, waziphonsa phambi kukaJesu, walanda phambi kwabo bonke abantu ukuthi nguye othinte ingubo kaJesu, nokuthi uphulukiswe kanjani khona manjalo.
UJesu wayesethi kuye: “Ndodakazi, ukukholwa kwakho kukusindisile. Hamba ngokuthula.”
Esakhuluma uJesu, kwafika othile evela emzini womphathi wesinagoge, wathi kuye: “Indodakazi yakho isifile; ungabe usamkhathaza uMfundisi.”
UJesu emuzwa lowo, waphendula wathi kuye: “Ungesabi; kholwa kuphela; indodakazi izakusinda.”
Sebefikile endlini yomphathi wesinagoge, akavumelanga muntu ukuba angene endlini naye, kuphela uPhethro, uJohane, uJakobe uyise nonina bentombazane.
Bonke babekhala, belila, kodwa wathi kubo: “Ningakhali, ayifile; ilele.”
Bamhleka usulu ngoba bazi ukuthi ife ngempela.
Kepha Yena wayibamba ngesandla, wamemeza wathi: “Ntombazana, vuka!”
Khona manjalo umoya wayo wabuyela kuyo, yavuka ngokushesha; wabayala ukuba bayinike ukudla.
Abazali bayo bamangala. UJesu wabayala ukuba bangatsheli muntu ngalokho okwenzekileyo.
UJesu esebabizele kuye abali-12, wabanika amandla negunya lokukhipha amadimoni nokuphilisa abagulayo.
Wabathuma ukuba bashumayele ngombuso kaNkulunkulu nokuba baphilise abagulayo.
Wathi kubo: “Ningaphathi lutho lwendlela: naludondolo, nasikhwama sokuthekela, nasinkwa, namali; ningawaphathi amabhantshi amabili.
Noma yiyiphi indlu eningenisa kuyo, hlalani kuyo, nize nihambe lapho.
Bonke abangayukunamukela, anothi uma senisuka kulowo muzi, nithintithe uthuli ezinyaweni zenu, ukuze kube ngubufakazi obumelene nabo.”
Baphuma-ke, badabula imizi ngemizi, bevangela, futhi bephilisa abagulayo ezindaweni zonke.
Kwathi uHerode, uMthethrakhi, ezwa ngakho konke okwakwenzeka, wadideka kakhulu, ngokuba abanye bathi kuye uJohane uvukile kwabafileyo,
abanye bathi u-Eliya uvukile, nabanye bathi kuvuke umphrofethi othile wasemandulo.
Kepha uHerode wathi: “UJohane ngamnquma ikhanda; pho-ke ngubani lo engizwa ngaye ngalezi zinto na?” Wafuna ukumbona.
Sebebuyile abaphostoli, bamlandisa ngakho konke abakwenzileyo; wabathatha, wahamba nabo ngasese, baya emzini okuthiwa yiBhethsayida.
Kepha izixuku sezazi ngalokho zamlandela; wazemukela, wakhuluma kuzo ngombuso kaNkulunkulu, wabaphulukisa abadinga ukuphiliswa.
Kuthe seliyozilahla kunina, abafundi abali-12 beza kuye, bathi: “Baxoshe abantu baye emizaneni nasemakhaya azungezileyo, bangenise khona, ukuba bathole ukudla, ngokuba lapha sisendaweni eyihlane.”
Wathi kubo: “Bapheni nina ukudla.” Kepha bathi: “Esinakho yizinkwa eziyisihlanu nezinhlanzi ezimbili kuphela, ngaphandle-ke uma singahamba siyothengela bonke laba bantu ukudla.”
Lapho kwakukhona amadoda ayelinganiselwa ezi-5 000. Wathi kubafundi bakhe: “Bahlaliseni ngamaqembu angama-50.”
Benza kanjalo, babahlalisa bonke.
Wazithatha izinkwa eziyisihlanu nezinhlanzi ezimbili, wabheka ngasezulwini, wazibusisa, wazihlephula, wazinika abafundi ukuba bazabele isixuku sabantu.
Badla, basutha bonke, kwabuthwa imvuthuluka eyasala kubo, engamaqoma ali-12.
Kwathi esakhuleka eyedwa, abafundi benaye, wayesebabuza ethi: “Abantu bathi ngingubani na?”
Baphendula bathi: “UJohane uMbhabhadisi”, kepha abanye bathi: “Ngu-Eliya”, abanye bathi: “Kuvuke umphrofethi othile wasemandulo.”
Wayesethi kubo: “Nina-ke nithi ngingubani na?” UPhethro waphendula wathi: “UnguKhristu kaNkulunkulu.”
Wabadonsa ngendlebe, wabayala ukuba bangakutsheli muntu lokho,
wathi: “INdodana yomuntu imelwe ukuhlupheka ngokuningi, ilahlwe ngamalunga nabaphristi abakhulu nezazimthetho, ibulawe, ivuswe ngosuku lwesithathu.”
Wayesethi kubo bonke: “Uma umuntu ethanda ukungilandela, makazidele, athathe isiphambano sakhe imihla ngemihla, angilandele.
Ngokuba yilowo nalowo othanda ukusindisa ukuphila kwakhe, uyakulahlekelwa yikho; kepha lowo olahlekelwa ngukuphila kwakhe ngenxa yami, uyakukusindisa.
Ngokuba kuyakumsiza ngani umuntu ukuzuza izwe lonke, kepha yena alahlekelwe noma alimaze ukuphila kwakhe na?
Ngokuba yilowo nalowo onamahloni ngami nangamazwi ami, iNdodana yomuntu iyakuba namahloni ngalowo lapho iza ngenkazimulo yayo, nekaYise neyezingelosi ezingcwele.
Kepha nginitshela iqiniso ukuthi bakhona abanye kwabemi lapha abangayukufa, baze bawubone umbuso kaNkulunkulu.”
Kwathi cishe emva kwezinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili ekukhulumile lokho, wathatha uPhethro, uJohane, noJakobe; wenyukela nabo entabeni ukuba ayokhuleka.
Esakhuleka, isimo sobuso bakhe saguquka, nezingubo zakhe zaba mhlophe qwa, zacwebezela.
Kwase kubonakala amadoda amabili, uMose no-Eliya, bekhuluma naye;
abonakala ngenkazimulo, ekhuluma naye ngohambo lwakhe okumele aluphothule eJerusalema.
Kepha uPhethro nababenaye babelele zwi, kodwa kuthe sebephapheme, babona inkazimulo yakhe namadoda amabili ayemi naye.

Kuthe esehlukene naye, uPhethro wathi kuJesu: “Nkosi, kuhle ukuba sibe lapha; masakhe amadokodo amathathu, elinye kube ngelakho, elinye kube ngelikaMose, elinye kube ngelika-Eliya.” Wayengazi ukuthi uthini.
Esakhuluma lokhu, kwafika ifu, labasibekela; besaba lapho ifu libamboza.
Kwezwakala izwi efini, lithi: “Lo uyiNdodana yami ekhethiweyo; yizweni.”
Kuthe selizwakele izwi, uJesu wabonakala esesele yedwa. Bathula du, abangatshela muntu lokho ababekubonile ngaleyo mihla.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, sebehlile entabeni, isixuku esikhulu samhlangabeza.
Indoda eyayisesixukwini yamemeza yathi: “Mfundisi, ngiyakunxusa ukuba uzongibonela indodana yami, okungukuphela kwayo.
Umoya uyayidumela, idazuluke masinyane, uyithele phansi, ikhihlize amagwebu, kuthi uqambe uhamba, ibe isiyimvithi nje.
Ngibanxusile abafundi bakho ukuba bawukhiphe, kepha behluleka.”
UJesu waphendula wathi: “Hhawu, sizukulwane esingakholwayo nesonakeleyo, kuyoze kube nini nginani, nginibekezelela na? Yilethe lapha indodana yakho.”
Kuthe iseza, idimoni layiqumba phansi, layihlukumeza kakhulu; uJesu wawukhuza umoya ongcolileyo, umfana waphiliswa, wayesembuyisela kuyise.
Bamangala bonke ngamandla amakhulu kaNkulunkulu. Kuthe besamangele bonke ngakho konke akwenzileyo, wathi kubafundi bakhe:
“Vulani izindlebe zenu nilalele lawa mazwi, ngokuba iNdodana yomuntu izakukhashelwa ezandleni zabantu.”
Kabaqondanga ukuthi isho ukuthini inkulumo yakhe, ngokuba yayifihliwe kubo, funa bayiqonde, futhi besaba ukumbuza ngayo.
Kwaqubuka impikiswano phakathi kwabo yokuthi ngubani ongomkhulu kubo.
UJesu eyazi impikiswano esenhliziyweni yabo, wathatha umntwana, wammisa eduze kwakhe,
wathi kubo: “Yilowo nalowo oyakwamukela lo mntwana egameni lami, wamukela Mina; ongamukelayo Mina, uyamamukela nongithumileyo, ngokuba omncinyane kini nonke nguye omkhulu.”
UJohane waphendula wathi: “Nkosi, sibone umuntu ekhipha amadimoni ngegama lakho, samnqabela, ngokuba engahambisani nathi.”
Kepha uJesu wathi kuye: “Ningamnqabeli, ngokuba ongamelene nani, ungakini.”
Kwathi sekusondele izinsuku zokuba enyuselwe ezulwini, wanquma ukuya eJerusalema.
Wathumela izithunywa, zamendulela; zahamba, zangena emzini wamaSamariya ukuba zimlungiselele.
Kepha awamemukelanga, ngokuba wayelibangise eJerusalema.
Abafundi bakhe, oJakobe noJohane, bekubona lokho, bathi: “Nkosi, uyathanda yini ukuba sibize umlilo wehle ezulwini, uwabhubhise na?”
Kepha waphenduka, wabathethisa, wathi: “Anazi ukuthi ningabamuphi umoya.
Ngokuba iNdodana yomuntu ayizanga ukuzobhubhisa imiphefumulo yabantu, kodwa ukuzoyisindisa;” base bedlulela komunye wemizana.
Kuthe besahamba endleleni, othile wathi kuye: “Ngizakukulandela, noma kuphi lapho uya khona.”
UJesu wayesethi kuye: “Izimpungushe zinemigodi, nezinyoni zezulu zinezidleke, kepha iNdodana yomuntu kayinandawo lapho ingacamelisa khona ikhanda.”
Wayesethi komunye: “Ngilandele.” Kepha yena wathi: “Ngivumele ngiyongcwaba ubaba kuqala.”
Kepha wathi kuye: “Yekela abafileyo bambele abafileyo babo, kodwa wena hamba, ushumayele ngombuso kaNkulunkulu.”
Omunye futhi wathi: “Nkosi, ngizakukulandela, kodwa ngivumele ngiyovalelisa kuqala kwabasekhaya.”
Kepha uJesu wathi kuye: “Akekho othi esebeke isandla sakhe egejeni, aphinde abheke emuva, owufanele umbuso kaNkulunkulu.”
Sekwedlule konke lokho, iNkosi yakhetha abanye abangama-70, yabathumela ngababili ukuba bayandulele, baye emizini nasezindaweni zonke ezakuya kuzo.
Yathi kubo: “Isivuno sikhulu, kepha ziyingcosana izisebenzi, ngakho-ke nxusani ukuba inkosi yokuvuna ithumele izisebenzi esivunweni sayo.
Nina hambani, ngiyanithuma; ninjengamawundlu phakathi kwezimpisi.
Ningaphathi sikhwama samali, nasikhwama sokuthekela, nazicathulo, futhi ningabingeleli muntu endleleni.
“Noma iyiphi indlu eningenisa kuyo, niyakuqala nithi: ‘Ukuthula makube kule ndlu.’
Uma kukhona lapho umuntu wokuthula, ukuthula kwenu kuyakuhlala phezu kwakhe, kepha uma kungenjalo, kuyakubuyela kini.
Hlalani kuleyo ndlu, nidle, niphuze abanipha khona, ngokuba isisebenzi siyifanele inkokhelo yaso. Ningaphumi ningena izindlu ngezindlu.
“Noma yimuphi umuzi eningena kuwo, banamukele, yidlani lokho abakubeka phambi kwenu,
baphiliseni abagulayo abakuwo, nithi kubo: ‘Umbuso kaNkulunkulu ususondele kini.’
Noma yimuphi umuzi eningena kuwo, banganamukeli, phumelani emigwaqweni yawo, nithi:
‘Ngisho uthuli lomuzi wakini olunamathele ezinyaweni zethu, siluthintithela kini, nokho yazini lokhu ukuthi umbuso kaNkulunkulu ususondele.’
Ngithi kini: kuyakuba ngcono kwabaseSodoma ngalolo lusuku kunakulowo muzi ngomhla wokwehlulela.”
“Maye, kuwe Khorazini! Maye, kuwe Bhethsayida! Ngokuba ukuba le misebenzi yamandla eyenziwe kini beyenziwe eThire naseSidoni, ngabe kade baphenduka, bembatha eyamasaka, bazihuqa ngomlotha.
Kepha kuyakuba ngcono eThire naseSidoni ngosuku lokwehlulelwa kunakini.
Nawe Khaphernawume uthi kambe uyakuphakanyiselwa ezulwini na? Phinde, uyakwehliselwa eHayidesi.
“Onizwayo nina, uyangizwa Mina; onganemukeli nina, akangamukeli Mina; ongangemukeli Mina, akamemukeli ongithumileyo.”
Abangama-70 babuya bejabulile, bethi: “Nkosi, ngisho namadimoni ayasithobela ngegama lakho.”
Kepha wathi kubo: “Ngabona uSathane ewa ezulwini njengonyazi.
Niyabona, ngininike igunya lokunyathela izinyoka nawofezela, naphezu kwamandla wonke esitha; akukho lutho oluyakunilimaza.
Nokho ningathokozi ngalokhu ukuthi imimoya iyanithobela, kodwa jabulelani ukuthi amagama enu alotshiwe ezulwini.”

Ngaleso sikhathi uJesu wathokoza kuMoya oNgcwele, wathi: “Ngiyakubonga, Baba, Nkosi yezulu nomhlaba, ngokuba ukufihlile lokhu kwabahlakaniphileyo nabanokuqonda, wakwembulela izingane; yebo, Baba, ngokuba kwaba kuhle phambi kwakho ukuba kube kanjalo.
Konke kunikelwe kimi nguBaba; akekho owaziyo ukuthi iNdodana ingubani, kuphela uYise, nokuthi uYise ungubani, kuphela iNdodana, nalowo iNdodana ethanda ukumembulela yena.”
Wayesephendukela kubafundi bakhe, wakhuluma nabo bebodwa, wathi: “Abusisiwe amehlo abona enikubonayo.
Ngokuba ngithi kini: baningi abaphrofethi namakhosi ababefisa ukubona enikubonayo, kodwa abakubonanga; nokuzwa enikuzwayo, kepha abakuzwanga.”
Kwase kusukuma isazimthetho esithile, samlinga sathi: “Mfundisi, ngizakwenzani ukuba ngidle ifa lokuphila okuphakade na?”
Wathi kuso: “Kulotshweni emthethweni na? Uwufunda kanjani na?”

Saphendula sathi: “Woyithanda iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ngayo yonke inhliziyo yakho, nangawo wonke umphefumulo wakho, nangawo wonke amandla akho, nangayo yonke ingqondo yakho; umthande nomakhelwane wakho njengalokhu uzithanda wena.”
Wayesethi kuso: “Uphendule kahle; yenza lokho, uzakuphila.”
Kepha sona sithanda ukuzithetha, sathi kuJesu: “Umakhelwane wami ngubani na?”
UJesu wathatha wathi: “Umuntu othile wehla eJerusalema eya eJerikho; wazithela phezu kwezigcwelegcwele, zamhlubula izingubo, zamshaya, zahamba, zimshiya sekusele umndondo nje.
Kwathi kungalindelekile, kwehla umphristi othile ngaleyo ndlela; kuthe lapho embona, wachezuka endleleni.
Kanjalo nomLevi; kwathi uma efika kuleyo ndawo embona, wamgwema wedlula.
Kepha umSamariya othile owayesendleleni, wazithela kuye; kuthe embona, wamhawukela;
waya kuye, wambopha amanxeba, wathela amafutha newayini kuwo, wamgibelisa esilwaneni sakhe, wamusa endlini yezihambi, wamnakekela.
Ngakusasa wakhipha odenariyu ababili, wabanika umninindlu yezihambi, wathi kuye: ‘Mnakekele, zonke izindleko ezenzekayo ngaphezu kwalokhu, ngiyakukukhokhela zona uma sengibuya.’
“Ngumuphi kulaba abathathu owaba ngumakhelwane walo owazithela phezu kwezigcwelegcwele na?”
Sathi: “Yilowo owamhawukelayo.” Wayesethi uJesu kuso: “Hamba wenze kanjalo nawe.”
Besahamba, wangena emzaneni othile; owesifazane mumbe, ogama lakhe nguMartha, wamemukela endlini.
Wayenodadewabo okuthiwa nguMariya, owahlala ngasezinyaweni zeNkosi, walalela izwi layo.
Kepha uMartha wayematasatasa, enza imisebenzi eminingi; waya kuJesu, wathi: “Nkosi, akukukhathazi yini ukuthi udadewethu ungishiyile, ngisebenza ngedwa na? Ngakho-ke mtshele angisize.”
Kepha iNkosi yamphendula, yathi: “Martha, Martha, ukhathazekile futhi uphazanyiswa yizinto eziningi.
Kepha kunye okudingekileyo; uMariya ukhethe okuyikhona kungcono, angayukwephucwa khona.”
Ngelinye ilanga uJesu eseqedile ukukhuleka endaweni ethile, omunye wabafundi bakhe weza kuye, wathi: “Nkosi, sifundise ukukhuleka, njengokuba noJohane wabafundisa abafundi bakhe.”
Wayesethi kubo: “Uma nikhuleka, anothi: “ ‘Baba, malingcweliswe igama lakho; mawufike umbuso wakho;
siphe namuhla isinkwa sethu semihla ngemihla;
sithethelele izono zethu, njengokuba nathi sibathethelela bonke abanecala kithi; ungasingenisi ekulingweni.’ ”
Wayesethi kubo: “Ngubani kini othi enomngani, aye kuye phakathi kobusuku, athi kuye: ‘Mngani, ake ungenanele izinkwa ezintathu,
ngokuba ngifikelwe ngumhlobo wami osohambeni, kepha anginalutho engingamupha khona adle;’
bese umngani esendlini aphendule athi: ‘Ungangihluphi; sekuvaliwe emnyango, sesilele, mina kanye nabantwana bami; anginakuvuka, ukuba ngikunike utho.’
Ngithi kini: noma engezukuvuka amnike utho ngokuba engumngani wakhe, kodwa ngenxa yokubelesela kwakhe uyakumnikeza konke akudingayo.
“Ngakho-ke ngithi kini: celani, niyakuphiwa; funani, niyakufumana; ngqongqothani, niyakuvulelwa.
Ngokuba yilowo nalowo ocelayo uyamukeliswa, nofunayo uyafumana, nongqongqothayo uyakuvulelwa.
“Ngubani kini nina bobaba, okungathi uma indodana icela inhlanzi, ayinike inyoka esikhundleni senhlanzi;
kuthi uma icela iqanda, ayinike ufezela na?
Ngakho-ke uma nina eningababi, nikwazi ukubapha abantwana benu izipho ezinhle, kakhulu kangakanani-ke uYihlo osezulwini uzakubapha abacelayo kuye uMoya oNgcwele.”
UJesu wakhipha idimoni elaliyisimungulu; kuthe seliphumile, wakhuluma obeyisimungulu, isixuku samangala.
Kepha abanye babo bathi: “Ukhipha amadimoni ngoBhelzebhule, umbusi wamadimoni.”
Abanye bamlinga, bafuna ukuba enze isibonakaliso esivela ezulwini.
Kepha Yena eyazi imicabango yabo, wathi kubo: “Yilowo nalowo mbuso owehlukene wodwa, uyakuchithwa; nendlu ehlukene yodwa, iyakuwa.
Kanjalo uma uSathane ehlukene yedwa, umbuso wakhe uyakuma kanjani na? Ngokuba nithi ngikhipha amadimoni ngoBhelzebhule.
Uma Mina ngikhipha amadimoni ngoBhelzebhule, pho amadodana enu awakhipha ngobani na? Ngakho-ke amadodana enu ayakuba ngabehluleli benu.
Kepha uma ngikhipha amadimoni ngomunwe kaNkulunkulu, kusho ukuthi umbuso kaNkulunkulu usufikile kini.
“Uma isiqhwaga sihlome saphelela, silinda umuzi waso, impahla yaso ihlala iphephile.
Kepha uma onamandla kunaso esihlasela, asinqobe, uyasiqhwaga izikhali zaso ebesigabe ngazo, bese eyaba impango yaso.
“Ongahambisani nami, umelene nami; ongabuthi nami, uyahlakaza.
“Lapho umoya ongcolileyo uphuma kumuntu, uyahamba udabule ezindaweni ezigagadekile, ufuna indawo yokuphumula; uma ungayifumani, bese uthi: ‘Ngizakubuyela endlini yami engaphuma kuyo.’
Uma ufika, uyifice ishaneliwe, futhi ilungiswe kahle;
uyahamba ulande abanye omoya abayisikhombisa, ababi kunawo, bangene bahlale lapho, kuthi isiphetho sibe sibi ngokwedlulele kunesiqalo.”
Kuthe esakhuluma ngalokho, owesifazane othile esixukwini wamemeza, wathi kuye: “Sibusisiwe isisu esakuthwalayo namabele owawancelayo.”
Kepha uJesu wathi: “Yebo kunjalo, kodwa kakhulu babusisiwe abalizwa izwi likaNkulunkulu, balilondoloze.”
Ngesikhathi isixuku sikhula, waqala ukukhuluma, wathi: “Lesi sizukulwane siyisizukulwane esibi, sifuna isibonakaliso, kodwa asiyukunikwa sibonakaliso, ngaphandle kwesibonakaliso sikaJona.
Ngokuba njengalokhu uJona waba yisibonakaliso kwabaseNineve, iNdodana yomuntu iyakuba kanjalo kulesi sizukulwane.

Mhla kwehlulelwa, indlovukazi yaseningizimu iyakusukuma kanye namadoda alesi sizukulwane, iwalahle ngecala, ngokuba yasuka kwelikude izwe izokuzwa ukuhlakanipha kukaSolomoni; lapha kukhona omkhulu kunoSolomoni.
Amadoda aseNineve ayakusukuma kanye nalesi sizukulwane ngosuku lokwehlulela, asilahle ngecala. Ngokuba aphenduka lapho ngokushumayela kukaJona. Lapha kukhona omkhulu kunoJona.”
“Akukho muntu othi angokhela isibani asibeke ekusithekeni, phansi kwesitsha, kodwa usifaka othini ukuze abangenayo babone ukukhanya.
Iso lakho liyisibani somzimba; uma iso lakho liphilile, umzimba wakho wonke ugcwele ukukhanya; kepha uma lilibi, umzimba wakho ungubumnyama.
Ngakho-ke qaphela, funa ukukhanya okukuwe kube ngubumnyama.
Uma umzimba wakho wonke ungukukhanya, kungekho cashaza elimnyama, uyakukhanya wonke njengesibani sikukhanyisa ngokukhanya kwaso.”
Esakhuluma, omunye umFarisi wammema ukuba azokudla naye. UJesu esengenile endlini, wahlala esidlweni.
Kepha umFarisi ebona ukuthi uJesu udla engaqalanga ngokugeza, wamangala.
INkosi uJesu yayisithi kuye: “Nina baFarisi nigeza ingaphandle lenkezo nesitsha, kepha ingaphakathi lenu ligcwele ubugovu nokonakala.
Ziwula, lo owenza ingaphandle, akalenzanga yini nengaphakathi na?
Kepha-ke lokho okungaphakathi kupheni abampofu, konke kuzakube kuhlambulukile kini.

“Kepha, maye, kini baFarisi, ngokuba nikhipha okweshumi kweshaladi nopelepele, nazo zonke izinhlobo zemifino, kodwa nibushaya indiva ubulungiswa nokuthanda uNkulunkulu. Lokho-ke bekufanele nikwenze, kodwa ningaziyeki nezinye.
“Maye, kini baFarisi, ngokuba nithanda ukuhlala ezihlalweni eziphambili emasinagogeni, nokukhothanyelwa ezindaweni zokuhwebelana!
“Maye, kini, ngokuba nifana namathuna angasabonakali, asebehamba phezu kwawo, bengawaboni!”
Omunye wezazimthetho wayesephendula, wathi kuye: “Mfundisi, uma ukhuluma kanje phela, uyaseyisa thina.”
Kepha uJesu wathi: “Maye, nakini zazimthetho, maye, ngokuba nithwesa abantu imithwalo enzima! Nina uqobo lwenu nibe ningayithinti leyo mithwalo nangowodwa weminwe yenu.
“Maye, kini, ngokuba nakha amatshe amahle emathuneni abaphrofethi ababulawa ngokhokho benu.
Ngalokho-ke niyafakaza, futhi nivuma imisebenzi eyenziwa ngoyihlomkhulu, ngokuba bona bababulala abaphrofethi, nina-ke senakha amatshe amathuna abo.
Ngenxa yalokho, lowo ongukuhlakanipha kukaNkulunkulu, wathi: ‘Ngiyakuthumela kubo abaphrofethi nabaphostoli, abanye benu bayakubabulala, abanye babazingele.’
Lokho kwenzeka ukuze igazi labaphrofethi bonke elachithwa kusukela umhlaba wasekelwa, libizwe kulesi sizukulwane;
kusukela egazini lika-Abela kuze kufike egazini likaZakhariya, owabulawa phakathi kwe-althare nethempeli. Yebo, ngithi kini: lizakubizwa kulesi sizukulwane.
“Maye, kini zazimthetho, ngokuba nisithathile isihluthulelo solwazi! Nina luqobo aningenanga, nabangenayo nabavimbela.”
Kuthe ephuma lapho, izazimthetho nabaFarisi baqala ukumthukuthelela kakhulu. Base bemxina ngemibuzo ngezinto eziningi;
behlose ukumhila, ukuze bambambe ngamazwi akhe.
Ngaleso sikhathi kwabuthana izindimbane zabantu, zaze zanyathelana; uJesu wayeseqala ukukhuluma kubafundi bakhe, ethi: “Xwayani imvubelo yabaFarisi engukuzenzisa.
Akukho okusitshekelweyo okungayukwambulwa, nokufihliweyo okungayukwaziwa.
Ngakho-ke konke enikukhuluma ebumnyameni, kuyakuzwakala ekukhanyeni; nalokho enikukhuluma nikuhleba emakamelweni, kuyakumenyezelwa phezu kwezindlu.
“Kepha ngithi kini, bangani bami: ningabesabi ababulala umzimba, bengenakwenza lutho okunye emva kwalokho.
Kepha-ke ngizakunitshengisa okufanele nimesabe. Mesabeni lo othi esebulele, abuye abe namandla okuphonsa esihogweni. Impela, ngithi kini: mesabeni lowo.
Akuthengiswa yini imizwilili emihlanu ngezindibilishi ezimbili na? Nokho akukho namunye awukhohlwayo uNkulunkulu.
Phela ngisho izinwele ezisekhanda lakho uyazazi, zonke uzibalile. Ningesabi, ngokuba nina niyayedlula imizwilili.”
“Ngithi kini, yilowo nalowo oyakungivuma phambi kwabantu, neNdodana yomuntu iyakumvuma phambi kwezingelosi zikaNkulunkulu.
Kepha ongiphikayo phambi kwabantu, uyakuphikwa phambi kwezingelosi zikaNkulunkulu.
Noma ngubani okhuluma kabi ngeNdodana yomuntu, uyakuthethelelwa; kodwa ohlambalaza uMoya oNgcwele, akayukuthethelelwa.
“Uma benihudulela emasinagogweni nakubabusi neziphathimandla ukuba nehlulelwe, ningakhathazeki ukuthi niyakuphendula kanjani, nokuthi niyakuthini.
Ngokuba uMoya oNgcwele uyakunifundisa ngaleso sikhathi okufanele nikusho.”
Omunye esixukwini wathi kuye: “Mfundisi, tshela umfowethu ukuba angabele nami ifa lakwethu.”
Kepha uJesu wathi kuye: “Mngani, ngubani ongibeke ukuba ngibe ngumehluleli noma ngumabi wefa lakwenu na?”
UJesu wayesethi kubo: “Qaphelani, nilwexwaye lonke uhlobo lokuhaha, ngokuba ukuphila komuntu akumisiwe ngubuningi bomcebo wakhe.”
Wabalandisa umzekeliso, wathi: “Amasimu omuntu othile owayeyisicebi ayekhiqiza isivuno esihle.
Wazindla wathi: ‘Ngizokwenzenjani, ngokuba anginandawo engizofaka kuyo isivuno sami na?’
“Wayesethi: ‘Nakhu engizakukwenza: ngizakuzidiliza izinqolobane zami, ngakhe ezinkulu, ngibuthele kuzo sonke isivuno sokusanhlamvu, nempahla yami.
Bese ngithi emphefumulweni wami: “Mphefumulo, usunezimpahla eziningi ezilondolozelwe wena iminyaka eminingi. Ngakho-ke phumula, udle, uphuze, futhi ujabule.”’
“Kepha uNkulunkulu wathi kuye: ‘Siwula ndini, ngalobu busuku umphefumulo wakho uzakuthathwa kuwe. Pho-ke ziyakuba ngezikabani lezi zinto ozilungisileyo na?’
“Kubanjalo-ke kumuntu ozibekelela ingcebo ebe engacebile ngokukaNkulunkulu.”
Wayesethi kubafundi bakhe: “Ngakho-ke ngithi kini: ningakhathazeki ngokuphila kwenu nangemizimba yenu ukuthi niyakudlani, nanokuthi niyakwembathani.
Ngokuba ukuphila kubalulekile kunokudla, nomzimba kunesembatho.
Ake nibheke nje amagwababa; awalimi, awavuni, futhi awanazilulu nazinqolobane, kepha uNkulunkulu uyawondla. Kakhulu kangakanani-ke nina eniyigugu ukwedlula izinyoni!
Ngubani kini okuthi ngenxa yokukhathazeka, athasisele usuku olulodwa nje eminyakeni yokuphila kwakhe na?
Ngakho-ke njengokuba ningenamandla okwenza nokuncane nje, pho nizikhathazelani ngalokhu okunye na?
“Bhekani nje, nansi iminduze yasendle, ukuthi ikhula kanjani. Ayizikhandli, ayizithungeli zembatho, kodwa ngithi kini: ngisho noSolomoni, ebukhazikhazini bakhe bonke, wayengavunulisile okomunye wayo.
Uma-ke uNkulunkulu embathisa utshani basendle obukhona namuhla, kuthi ngakusasa buphonswe eziko, kakhulu kangakanani nina eninokukholwa okuncane.
Ningafuni ukuthi niyakudlani nokuthi niyakuphuzani; ningakhathazeki ngalokho.
Ngokuba konke lokhu kufunwa ngabezizwe baleli lizwe; kodwa uYihlo uyazi ukuthi niyakudinga lokhu.
Kepha funani umbuso kaNkulunkulu, yikhona konke lokhu kuyakwenezelwa kini.
“Ungesabi, mhlambi omncane, ngokuba kuyintando kaYihlo ukuba aninike umbuso.
Thengisani ngeninakho, nabele abampofu, nizenzele izikhwama zemali ezingagugiyo, ingcebo engapheliyo ezulwini; lapho kungasondeli khona sela nanundu, ukuba yone.
Ngokuba lapho ingcebo yenu ikhona, nenhliziyo yenu iyakuba khona lapho.”
“Izinkalo zenu mazihlale ziboshiwe, nezibani zenu zivutha.
Yibani njengezinceku ezilindele inkosi yazo ezobuya emshadweni, ukuze kuthi lapho ifika, ingqongqoza, ziyivulele masinyane.
Zibusisiwe lezo zinceku okuyakuthi lapho inkosi yazo ifika, izifice zilindile. Ngiqinisile ngithi kini: inkosi yazo iyakubopha ibhande okhalo, izihlalise phansi, ize yona uqobo iziphe ukudla.
Zibusisiwe lezo zinceku okuyakuthi noma inkosi yazo ifika kwesikabhadakazi noma entathakusa, izifumane zilindile.
Kepha-ke yazini lokhu, ukuthi uma umninindlu ebesazi isikhathi isela eliyakufika ngaso, ubengayukuvuma ukuba indlu yakhe igqekezwe.
Nani-ke hlalani nilindile, ngokuba anilazi ihora iNdodana yomuntu eyakufika ngalo.”
UPhethro wayesethi: “Nkosi, ngabe lo mzekeliso uwuqondise kithi noma kubantu bonke na?”
INkosi yaphendula yathi: “Iyiphi inceku ethembekileyo nehlakaniphileyo, inkosi yayo eyakuyibeka ukuba yengamele abendlu yayo, ibabele isabelo sokudla ngesikhathi esifaneleyo na?
Ibusisiwe leyo nceku okuyakuthi lapho inkosi yayo ifika, iyifumane yenza kanjalo.
Ngiqinisile, ngithi: iyakuyibeka phezu kwakho konke enakho ukuba ikwengamele.
Kepha uma leyo nceku ithi enhliziyweni yayo: ‘Inkosi yami isalibele ukuba ifike,’ bese iqala ukushaya izisebenzi zesilisa nezesifazane, idle, iphuze, idakwe,
inkosi yaleyo nceku iyakufika ngosuku engayilindele ngalo, nangomzuzu engawaziyo, iyijezise ngokuyibulala kabuhlungu, bese iyilahla nabangakholwayo.
“Inceku eyaziyo ukuthi inkosi ifunani, kodwa ingazilungiseleli ukwenza lokho okufunwa yinkosi, iyakushaywa imivimbo eminingi.
Kepha leyo eyenze okungafanele ngenxa yokungazi, iyakushaywa imivimbo embalwa. Yilowo nalowo ophiwe okuningi, kuyakufunwa okuningi kuye, nophathiswe okuningi, kuyakubizwa okuningi kakhulu kuye.”
“Ngize ukuphonsa umlilo emhlabeni; ngifisa kakhulu kangakanani ukuba ngabe sewokhelekile!
Nginombhabhadiso engizakubhabhadiswa ngawo; ngikhathazekile kakhulu, uze ufezeke.
Nicabanga ukuthi ngilethe ukuthula emhlabeni na? Phinde! Kepha ngithi kini: ngilethe ukwehlukana.
Ngokuba kusukela manje kuyakuba khona abayisihlanu endlini, abathathu bamelane nababili, nababili bamelane nabathathu.
Kuyokuba khona ukwehlukana: uyise amelane nendodana, nendodana imelane noyise, unina amelane nendodakazi, nendodakazi nonina, uninazala amelane nomalokazana, nomalokazana amelane noninazala.”
Wayesethi nakuzo izixuku: “Uma nibona kukhuphuka ifu entshonalanga, nisheshe nithi: ‘Kuza isiphepho,’ kube njalo.
Uma kuvunguza umoya weningizimu, nithi: ‘Lizakushisa likhiphe umkhovu etsheni,’ kube njalo nempela.
Bazenzisi, niyakwazi ukubona okwenzeka emhlabeni nasesibhakabhakeni, pho kungani ningakwazi ukuqonda okwalesi sikhathi na?
“Yini ningakwazi ukubona okufanele nikwenze na?
Uma uhambisana nesitha sakho, niya kumehluleli, sincenge nisesendleleni, nibuyisane, funa nifike kumehluleli, umehluleli akwedlulisele ephoyiseni, bese iphoyisa likuphonsa ejele.
Ngithi kuwe: awusoze waphuma ejele, uyoze ukhiphe ifadingi lokugcina.”
Kwakukhona ngaleso sikhathi abathile ababikela uJesu ngabaseGalile, abagazi labo uPilatu ayelixube nelemihlatshelo yabo.
Waphendula wathi kubo: “Nicabanga ukuthi labo bantu baseGalile babeyizoni kunabo bonke yini abanye baseGalile, ngokuba behlelwa yilowo mshophi na?
Ngithi kini: akunjalo, kodwa uma ningaphenduki, niyakubhubha nonke njengabo.
Nalabo abali-18 okwawela kubo umbhoshongo eSilowama, wababulala, nisho ukuthi babeyizoni ukwedlula bonke abantu ababehlala eJerusalema na?
Ngithi akunjalo: kodwa uma ningaphenduki niyakubhubha nonke njengabo.”
Wayesebalandisa lo mzekeliso wathi: “Umuntu othile wayetshale umkhiwane esivinini sakhe. Waya kuwo efuna isithelo sawo, kepha akafumananga lutho.
Wayesethi kosebenza esivinini: ‘Phela sekuyiminyaka emithathu ngifika ngizofuna amakhiwane kulo mkhiwane, kodwa ngingatholi lutho. Ngakho-ke wunqume: kungani ulokhu ugugisa umhlabathi na?’
“Kepha waphendula, wathi: ‘Nkosi, ake uwuyeke nakulo nyaka, ngize ngimbe umhlabathi emaceleni awo, ngithele umquba;
mhlawumbe ungase uthele ngonyaka ozayo, kodwa-ke uma kungenjalo, uyowunquma.’ ”
UJesu wayefundisa kwelinye lamasinagoge ngesabatha.
Lapho kwakukhona owesifazane owayenomoya omubi usumgulise iminyaka eli-18; wayeseze waqhotha, engasakwazi ukuma aqonde.
UJesu embona, wambiza, wathi kuye: “Mame, usuphilisiwe ekuguleni obunakho.”
Wabeka izandla phezu kwakhe, wayeselulama khona manjalo, wamdumisa uNkulunkulu.

Umphathi wesinagoge wacasuka ngokuba uJesu esindise umuntu ngesabatha, wayesekhuluma esixukwini ethi: “Kunezinsuku eziyisithupha okufanele ukuba kusetshenzwe ngazo. Ngakho-ke wozani ngalezo zinsuku ukuze niphiliswe, hhayi ngosuku lwesabatha.”
Kepha iNkosi yamphendula, yathi: “Bazenzisi, yilowo nalowo kini kayikhiphi yini ngesabatha inkabi yakhe noma imbongolo yakhe esibayeni, ayiqhube ukuba iyophuza na?
Bekungafanele yini-ke lo oyindodakazi ka-Abhrahama, obeboshwe nguSathane, iminyaka eli-18, ukuba akhululwe kulokho kuboshwa ngosuku lwesabatha na?”
Wathi ukuba asho lokho, bajabha bonke ababemelene naye, kepha isixuku sonke sathokoza ngenxa yemisebenzi yonke emangalisayo ayenzileyo.
Ngakho-ke uJesu wathi: “Umbuso kaNkulunkulu ufana nani na? Ungafaniswa nani na?
Ufana nohlamvu lwesinaphi aluthatha umuntu, waluhlwanyela ensimini yakhe; lwamila, lwaba yisihlahla; izinyoni zezulu zakhela emagatsheni aso.”
Wabuye wathi: “Umbuso kaNkulunkulu ungafaniswa nani na?
Ufana nemvubelo eyathathwa ngowesifazane, wayifaka emaqomeni amathathu empuphu, kwaze kwabila konke.”
UJesu wahamba phakathi kwemizi nemizana efundisa, esendleleni, elibhekise eJerusalema.
Umuntu othile wayesethi kuye: “Nkosi, bayingcosana yini abasindiswayo na?” UJesu wathi kubo:
“Phikelelani ukungena ngomnyango omncane. Ngokuba ngithi kini: baningi abayakufuna ukungena, kodwa behluleke.
Uma umninindlu esesukumile wavala umnyango, niyakuma ngaphandle, ningqongqoze emnyango, nithi: ‘Nkosi, sivulele,’ yena uyakuphendula, athi: ‘Anginazi ukuthi nivela kuphi.’
“Kulapho niyakuqala khona, nithi: ‘Sasidla, siphuza nawe, wawufundisa emigwaqweni yakithi.’
“Kepha yena uyakuthi: ‘Ngithi kini: anginazi ukuthi nivela kuphi. Sukani kimi nina nonke, benzi bobubi.’ ”
“Lapho kuyakuba khona ukukhala nokugedla amazinyo, uma senibona u-Abhrahama, u-Isaka, uJakobe, nabaphrofethi bonke embusweni kaNkulunkulu, kodwa nina nikhishelwe phandle.
Bayakufika bevela empumalanga, entshonalanga, enyakatho, naseningizimu; bonke bahlale esidlweni embusweni kaNkulunkulu.
Bakhona abokugcina abayakuba ngabokuqala, bakhona nabokuqala abayakuba ngabokugcina.”
Ngaleso sikhathi kweza kuJesu, abanye babaFarisi bathi kuye: “Suka, uhambe lapha, ngokuba uHerode ufuna ukukubulala.”
UJesu wathi kubo: “Hambani nitshele leyo mpungushe nithi: ‘Ngikhipha amadimoni, ngiphilise abagulayo, namuhla nakusasa, kuthi ngosuku lwesithathu ngipheleliswe.’
Nokho kumele ukuba namuhla nakusasa nangomhlomunye ngihambe, ngokuba akunakwenzeka ukuba umphrofethi afele ngaphandle kwaseJerusalema.

“Jerusalema! Jerusalema! Wena obulala abaphrofethi, ukhande ngamatshe labo abathunyelwe kuwe, kukaningi ngilangazelela ukuqoqa abantu bakho njengesikhukhukazi sikhoselise amachwane aso phansi kwamaphiko aso, kodwa anivumanga.
Indlu yenu isele iyinxiwa kini, kodwa ngithi kini: anisoze nangibona, kuze kube mhla nithi: ‘Ubusisiwe ozayo egameni leNkosi.’ ”
Kwathi ngesabatha uJesu waya endlini yomunye wabaFarisi oyisikhulu, eyokudla, bembheke ngeso lokhozi.
Kwakukhona phambi kwakhe umuntu othile owayenesifo sokuvuvuka.
UJesu wayesebuza kuzo izazimthetho nabaFarisi, wathi: “Kuvunyelwe yini ukuphilisa ngesabatha noma qha na?”
Kepha bathula du. Wayesemthinta lowo muntu, wamphilisa, wammukisa.
Wayesethi kubo: “Ngubani kini okungathi indodana yakhe noma inkabi yakhe ikhalakathele emgodini, angaphuthumi ayikhiphe, ngosuku lwesabatha na?”
Bahluleka ukumphendula nakulokho.
Wayesebalandisa abamenyiweyo umzekeliso, ebona beziqokela izihlalo eziphambili, wathi kubo:
“Uma umenyiwe emshadweni, ungahlali esihlalweni esiphambili, hleze kukhona omkhulu kunawe ammemileyo.
Bese eza kuwe onimemileyo, athi: ‘Dedela lona, kule ndawo ohleli kuyo’, bese wena uhamba uyohlala kwesingezansi, uphoxekile.
Kepha uma umenyiwe, hamba uhlale endaweni engezansi, ukuze kuthi lapho efika okumemileyo, athi kuwe: ‘Mngani, yenyukela ngenhla;’ khona uyakuba nodumo phambi kwabo bonke abahlezi nawe esidlweni.
Ngokuba bonke abaziphakamisayo bayakuthotshiswa; nozithobayo uyakuphakanyiswa.”

Wayesethi kommemileyo: “Uma wenza isidlo sasemini noma sakusihlwa, ungamemi abangani bakho, abafowenu, umndeni wakini, nomakhelwane bakho abacebileyo, funa nabo babuye bakumeme, lokho kube ngumvuzo kuwe.
Kepha uma wenza idili, mema abampofu, abakhubazekileyo, izinyonga, nezimpumputhe;
uyakubusiswa, ngokuba abananto yokukubuyisela, kepha uyakuthola umvuzo ekuvukeni kwabalungileyo.”
Esekuzwile lokho omunye wababehlezi naye esidlweni, wathi kuye: “Ubusisiwe lowo oyakudla isinkwa embusweni kaNkulunkulu.”
Kepha uJesu wathi kuye: “Umuntu othile wenza isiphihli sedili, wamema abaningi,
wayesethumela inceku yakhe ngesikhathi sedili, kulabo abamenyiwe, ukuyokuthi: ‘Wozani, ngokuba sekulungisiwe konke.’
“Kepha bonke ngothi lwabo, baqala ukuzilandulela, bebeka izaba; owokuqala wathi kuye: ‘Ngithenge insimu, kudingekile ukuba ngihambe ngiyoyibona; ngiyakucela, ngixolisele impela.’
“Omunye wathi: ‘Ngithenge amabhanqa ezinkabi eziyisihlanu, ngisayozihlola; ngiyakucela, ngixolisele impela.’
“Omunye wathi: ‘Ngisanda kuthatha umfazi, ngalokho-ke angiphumeleli ukuza.’

“Inceku isibuyile, yayibikela inkosi yayo ngalokho. Umninindlu wathukuthela, khona wayesethi encekwini yakhe: ‘Phuthuma, uye emigwaqweni nasemihubheni yomuzi; ungenise lapha abampofu, abakhubazekile, izimpumputhe, nezinyonga.’
“Yathi inceku: ‘Nkosi, sekwenziwe lokho obuyale ngakho, kepha isekhona indawo.’
“Inkosi yathi encekwini: ‘Phuma uye emigwaqweni nasezindleleni, ubanxenxe ukuba beze ukuze indlu yami igcwale phama.’
Ngokuba ngithi kini: akukho namunye kulabo abamenyiweyo oyakukuthi mbibi ukudla kwedili lami.”
Kwakukhona izixuku eziningi ezazihamba noJesu; waphenduka, wathi kuzo:
“Uma umuntu eza kimi, kepha engamdeli uyise, unina, umkakhe, abantwana, abafowabo, odadewabo, ngisho nokuphila kwakhe imbala, ngeke abe ngumfundi wami.
Nalowo ongathwali isiphambano sakhe, angilandele, ngeke abe ngumfundi wami.
“Ngokuba ngubani kini ongathi efuna ukwakha umbhoshongo, angaqali ahlale phansi, abale izindleko ukuthi unakho yini okokuwuqeda na?
Funa kuthi lapho esebeke isisekelo, bese engabi namandla okuwuqeda, kuthi bonke abakubonayo lokho, baqale ukumbhuqa,
bathi: ‘Lo muntu waqala ukwakha kodwa kakwazanga ukuqeda.’
“Noma iyiphi inkosi eya kwenye inkosi iyoyihlasela, ingaqalanga ngokuhlala phansi, icabangisise ukuthi iyokwazi yini ukubhekana nayo njengoba yona inezi-10 000 leyo eya kuyo inezi-20 000 na?
Kungenjalo, ingathi isekude leyo nkosi, bese ithumela amanxusa, ukuba acele uxolo.
Kanjalo-ke yilowo nalowo kini ongakudeli konke anakho, ngeke abe ngumfundi wami.
“Usawoti muhle, kepha uma usawoti usuduma, uyakuyoliswa ngani na?
Awusakufanele ngisho ukusetshenziswa emhlabathini nasemqubeni, kepha ukuba ulahlwe ngaphandle. Onezindlebe zokuzwa makezwe.”
Kwase kusondela kuye abathelisi nezoni ukuba bamlalele.
Kepha abaFarisi nezazimthetho bakhononda, bethi: “Lo muntu wamukela izoni, futhi adle nazo.”
UJesu wayesebalandisa lo mfanekiso, ethi:
“Ngubani kini ongathi enezimvu eziyikhulu, alahlekelwe ngenye yazo, angazishiyi edlelweni ezingama-99, ahambe ayofuna elahlekileyo, aze ayithole na?
Kuthi lapho eseyitholile, ayetshathe emahlombe ethokoza.
Esefikile ekhaya ameme abangani nomakhelwane, athi kubo: ‘Thokozani nami, ngokuba ngiyitholile imvu yami ebilahlekile.’
Ngithi kini: kanjalo kuyakuba khona ukuthokoza ezulwini ngesoni sisinye esiphendukayo, kunabalungileyo abangama-99 abangakudingi ukuphenduka.
“Noma-ke ngumuphi owesifazane ongathi enezinhlamvu zesiliva ezilishumi, alahlekelwe wuhlamvu olulodwa, angokheli isibani, ashanele endlini, alufunisise, aze aluthole na?
Kuthi eselutholile ameme abangani nomakhelwane, athi: ‘Thokozani nami, ngokuba ngilutholile uhlamvu lwami obelungilahlekele.’
Ngithi kini: kanjalo-ke kukhona ukuthokoza phambi kwezingelosi zikaNkulunkulu ngesoni esisodwa esiphendukayo.”
Wayesethi: “Umuntu othile wayenamadodana amabili.
Encane yathi kuyise: ‘Baba, nginike isabelo sefa esingesami;’ uyise wawabela ifa.
“Kwathi emva kwezinsukwana nje, indodana encane yaqoqa konke okungokwayo yahamba, yaya ezweni elikude, yafike yalisaphaza ifa layo, iphila ngendlela eyonakeleyo.
Kuthe isilisaphaze lonke, kwaba khona indlala enkulu kulelo lizwe; yaqala ukweswela.
Yahamba-ke yayosebenza komunye umuntu walelo lizwe. Wayithumela emadlelweni akhe ukuba iyokwelusa izingulube.
Yafisa ukuthiba iphango ngemidumba edliwa yizingulube, kepha kayiphiwanga muntu.
“Kuthe sekubuye umqondo, yathi: ‘Kambe bangaki abaqashwe ngubaba abadla baze bakubuke, mina ngibe ngibulawa yindlala lapha na?
Ngiyakusuka, ngiye kubaba, ngithi kuye: baba, ngonile kuNkulunkulu nakuwe;
angisafanele ukubizwa ngendodana yakho; ngenze ngibe njengomunye wezisebenzi zakho.’
Yayisisuka, yaya kuyise. Kepha kuthe isekude, uyise wayibona, waba nesihe, wagijima, wayisingatha entanyeni, wayanga.
“Indodana yayisithi kuye: ‘Baba, ngonile kulo izulu nakuwe; angisafanele ukubizwa ngendodana yakho.’
“Kepha uyise wathi ezincekwini zakhe: ‘Sheshani nilethe ingubo yakwanokusho, niyembathise, niyifake indandatho esandleni sayo nezicathulo ezinyaweni,
nilethe ithole elikhuluphalisiweyo, nilihlabe, sidle, sijabule.
Ngokuba le ndodana yami ibifile, yabuye yaphila; ibilahlekile, isitholakele,’ base beqala ukujabula.
“Kepha indodana yakhe endala yayisensimini; kuthe lapho isondela ngasekhaya, yezwa kuhlatshelelwa, futhi kusinwa.
Yabiza enye yezinceku, yabuza ukuthi kwenzenjani.
Yathi kuyo: ‘Kufike umnawakho, uyihlo wayesehlaba ithole elikhuluphalisiweyo, ngokuba ubuye wamthola esaphila.’
“Kepha indodana endala yathukuthela, yenqaba ukungena ekhaya. Uyise wayesephuma, wayincenga.

Kepha yaphendula, yathi kuyise: ‘Bheka nje, iminyaka engaka ngikusebenzela; angizange ngiweqe umyalo wakho, kepha mina awukaze ungihlabise ngisho nezinyane lembuzi leli, ukuba ngithokoze nabangani bami.
Kepha kuthe ukuba kufike le ndodana yakho ebhubhudle ifa lakho nezifebe, wayihlabisa ithole elikhuluphalisiweyo.’
“Wayesethi uyise kuyo: ‘Ndodana, wena uhlala nami njalo; konke okwami kungokwakho.
Kepha kufanele sijabule, sithokoze, ngokuba umfowenu lo ubefile, manje useyaphila; ubelahlekile, kodwa usetholakele.’ ”
UJesu wayesekhuluma futhi kubafundi bakhe, ethi: “Kwakukhona umuntu othile oyisicebi, owayenenduna; yamangalelwa kuye ngokuthi isaphaza impahla yakhe.
Wayibiza wathi kuyo: ‘Yini le engiyizwayo ngawe na? Ngilandise ngobunceku bakho, ngokuba ngeke usaqhubeka ukuba yinduna.’
“Yayisicabanga induna, ithi: ‘Ngizakwenzenjani, lokhu inkosi yami ingiyekisa ukuba yinduna na? Anginamandla okulima, futhi nginamahloni okunxiba.
Ngiyakwazi engiyakukwenza ukuze lapho sengikhishiwe ebuduneni, bangamukele ezindlini zabo.’
“Yababiza ngamunye ababekweleta inkosi yayo, yathi kowokuqala: ‘Uyikweleta okungakanani inkosi yami na?’
“Wathi: ‘Amabhati ayikhulu amafutha.’ “Yayisithi kuye: ‘Thatha incwadi yakho yesikweletu, usheshe uhlale phansi, ubhale angama-50.’
“Yayisithi komunye: ‘Wena-ke ukweleta okungakanani na?’ “Wathi: ‘Izilinganiso eziyikhulu zikakolo.’ “Yathi kuye: ‘Thatha incwadi yakho yesikweletu, ubhale ezingama-80.’
“Inkosi yayibabaza induna engathembekile, ngokuba yenza ngokuhlakanipha, ngokuba abantu balesi sikhathi esizukulwaneni sabo bahlakaniphile kunabantwana bokukhanya.
Nami ngithi kini: zenzeleni nina abangani ngomamona ongalungile, ukuze kuthi nxa esephelile, banemukele emakhaya aphakade.
“Othembekile kokuncinyane, uthembekile nakokukhulu; ongalungile kokuncinyane, kalungile nakokukhulu.
Ngakho uma ningathembekile ekuphatheni umcebo ongalungile, pho ngubani oyakuniphathisa umcebo woqobo na?
Uma futhi ningathembekile kokomunye, ngubani oyakuninika okungokwenu na?
“Akukho nceku engakhonza amakhosi amabili, ngokuba iyakuzonda enye, ithande enye; noma ibambelele kwenye, iyeyise enye. Ningeze nakhonza uNkulunkulu nengcebo.”
Kuthe abaFarisi ababethanda imali, bangakuzwa konke lokho, bamedelela.
Wayesethi kubo: “Nina nizenza abalungileyo phambi kwabantu, kodwa uNkulunkulu uyazazi izinhliziyo zenu, ngokuba lokho okutuseka kakhulu kubantu kuyisinengiso emehlweni kaNkulunkulu.
“Umthetho nabaphrofethi kwakukhona kwaze kwafika uJohane; kusukela ngaleso sikhathi, ivangeli lombuso kaNkulunkulu liyashunyayelwa, wonke umuntu uyafuzula ukuba angene kuwo.
Kepha kulula ukuba kudlule izulu nomhlaba kunokuba kusuke icashazana lokulotshwe emthethweni.”
“Yilowo nalowo olahla umkakhe, aganwe ngomunye, uyaphinga; noganwa ngolahlwe yindoda yakhe, uyaphinga.
“Kwakukhona umuntu othile onothileyo, owayegqoka ezibukhwebezane nezelineni elihle, ezithokozisa imihla ngemihla, etamasa.
Kwakukhona futhi othile ompofu, igama lakhe kunguLazaru. Wayebekiwe ngasesangweni lesicebi, egcwele izilonda,
elangazelela ukudla imvuthuluka ewa etafuleni lesicebi. Yebo, kweza nezinja zamkhotha izilonda.
“Wayesefa ompofu, wathwalwa yizingelosi, wayiswa esifubeni sika-Abhrahama. Safa nesicebi, sangcwatshwa.
Kuthe sesisendaweni yabafileyo sisezinhlungwini, saphakamisa amehlo aso, sabona u-Abhrahama ekude, noLazaru esesifubeni sakhe.
Samemeza sathi: ‘Baba Abhrahama, ngihawukele, uthume uLazaru, ukuba agcobhoze isihloko somunwe wakhe emanzini, apholise ulimi lwami, ngokuba ngisezinhlungwini ezinzima kabi kuleli langabi.’
“Kepha u-Abhrahama wathi: ‘Ndodana, khumbula ukuthi wamukela okuhle kwakho ngesikhathi usaphila, noLazaru ngokunjalo wamukela okubi, kodwa manje uyaduduzwa yena lapha, wena usuyahlupheka.
Ngaphezu kwakho konke lokho, kubekiwe umhosha omkhulu phakathi kwethu nani, ukuze abafuna ukusuka lapha baye kini bangaphumeleli; kanjalo nabalapho, bangaweleli kithi.’
“Isicebi sase sithi: ‘Ngakho-ke ngiyacela, baba, ukuba umthumele endlini kababa,
ngokuba nginabafowethu abayisihlanu, ukuze abaxwayise, funa nabo beze kule ndawo yobuhlungu.’
“Kepha u-Abhrahama wathi: ‘Abafowenu banemithetho kaMose nemibhalo yabaphrofethi, mabalalele bona.’
“Sathi-ke: ‘Qha, baba Abhrahama, kodwa uma kusuka umuntu kwabafileyo, aye kubo, bayakuphenduka.’
“Kepha u-Abhrahama wathi kuso: ‘Uma bengakulaleli okushiwo nguMose nabaphrofethi, abayukuzwa, noma kungavuka umuntu kwabafileyo.’ ”
Wayesethi kubafundi bakhe: “Akunakwenzeka ukuba zingabi bikho izikhubekiso, kodwa maye, kulowo eziza ngaye!
Kungangcono kuye ukuba itshe lokusila ligaxwe entanyeni yakhe, aphonswe olwandle, kunokuba akhubekise abe munye kulaba abancinyane.”
“Qaphelani nina. Uma umfowenu ona, mkhuze, uma ephenduka, mthethelele.
Uma ekona kuze kube kasikhombisa ngosuku, elokhu ebuyela kuwe kasikhombisa, athi: ‘Ngiyaphenduka,’ womthethelela.”
Abaphostoli base bethi eNkosini: “Yandisa ukukholwa kwethu.”
INkosi yayisithi: “Uma beninokukholwa okungangohlamvu lwesinaphi, beningathi kulesi sihlahla somthombe: ‘Zimbuka, utshaleke olwandle,’ sinilalele.
“Ngubani kini ongathi enenceku elimayo noma eyelusayo, bese kuthi isanda kubuya nje endle, athi kuyo: ‘Sondela ngokushesha, uhlale phansi, udle’ na?
Kunalokho akayukusho yini kuyo, athi: ‘Faka iphinifa lakho, ungilungisele engizokudla, ngidle, ngiphuze, andukuba wena udle, uphuze’ na?
Uyayibonga yini inceku, ngokuba ikwenzile lokho ekuyalelweyo na?
Kanjalo nani, uma senikwenzile konke enikuyalelweyo, anothi: ‘Asizinceku zalutho, ngokuba sikwenzile lokho obekufanele ukuba sikwenze.’ ”
Kwathi uJesu esahamba elibangise eJerusalema, wadabula eSamariya naseGalile.
Esangena emzaneni othile, wahlangana namadoda alishumi anochoko, ema buqamama,
ayesememeza ethi: “Jesu Nkosi, sihawukele!”
Lapho esewabonile, wathi kuwo: “Hambani, niyoziveza kubaphristi.” Kwathi esahamba, ahlanjululwa.
Enye yawo ibona ukuthi iphilisiwe, yabuyela emuva imdumisa uNkulunkulu ngezwi elikhulu.
Yakhothama, yathi mbo ngobuso ngasezinyaweni zikaJesu, imbonga; yayingumSamariya.
Kepha uJesu wakhuluma, wathi: “Akuhlanjululwanga yini abalishumi na? Pho baphi abayisishiyagalolunye?
Abatholakalanga yini abazobuya bamnike udumo uNkulunkulu, ngaphandle kwalo wabezizwe na?”
UJesu wayesethi kuye: “Sukuma uhambe; ukukholwa kwakho kukusindisile.”
AbaFarisi bambuza uJesu ukuthi umbuso kaNkulunkulu uzakufika nini. Wabaphendula wathi: “Umbuso kaNkulunkulu awufiki nje ubonwa ngamehlo.
Futhi abayukusho, bathi: ‘Bhekani, nanku,’ noma ‘nankuya,’ ngokuba phela umbuso kaNkulunkulu ukini.”
Wayesethi kubafundi: “Izinsuku ziyeza, lapho niyakufisa ukubona lube lunye lwezinsuku zeNdodana yomuntu, kodwa aniyukulubona.
Bayakuthi kini: ‘Bhekani, nansiya; bhekani, nansi.’ Ningayi lapho, futhi ningabalandeli.
Ngokuba njengonyazi, nxa lunyazima kusukela ngapha kwesibhakabhaka kuya ngale, iyakuba njalo-ke iNdodana yomuntu ngosuku lwayo.
Kepha kuqala, kufanele ihlupheke ngokuningi, ilahlwe yilesi sizukulwane.
“Njengokuba kwakunjalo emihleni kaNowa, kuyakuba kanjalo nasemihleni yeNdodana yomuntu.
Babedla, bephuza, beganwa, bendiswa, kwaze kwaba wusuku uNowa angena ngalo emkhunjini; kwafika uzamcolo, wababhubhisa bonke.
“Kanjalo njengalokhu kwenzeka ngezinsuku zikaLothi, babedla, bephuza, bethenga, bethengisa, betshala futhi bakha.
Kepha kwathi ngosuku uLothi aphuma ngalo eSodoma, lana umlilo nesibabule kuvela ezulwini, kwababhubhisa bonke.
Kuyakuba njalo-ke ngosuku eyakubonakaliswa ngalo iNdodana yomuntu.
Ngalolo lusuku oyakube ephezu kophahla lwendlu, impahla yakhe isendlini, makangehli ukuyoyithatha; kanjalo nosensimini, makangabuyeli emuva.
Khumbulani umkaLothi.
Ofuna ukulondoloza ukuphila kwakhe, uyakulahlekelwa yikho; kepha olahlekelwa yikho, uyakukulondoloza.
Ngithi kini: ngalobo busuku, kuyakuba khona ababili embhedeni munye; omunye uyakuthathwa, omunye ashiywe.
Kuyakuba khona ababili begaya ndawonye; omunye uyakuthathwa, omunye ashiywe.
Kuyakuba khona ababili ensimini; omunye uyakuthathwa, omunye ashiywe.”
Base bephendula, bethi kuye: “Nkosi, lokho kuyokwenzeka kuphi na?” Wathi kubo: “Lapho kunesidumbu khona, kulapho-ke namanqe ebuthana khona.”
UJesu wayesebalandisa umzekeliso, ebafundisa ukuthi kufanele bakhuleke njalo, bangadangali.
Wathi: “Emzini othile kwakukhona umehluleli othile owayengamesabi uNkulunkulu, futhi engenandaba namuntu.
Kulowo muzi kwakukhona futhi umfelokazi owayelokhu egqigqa, ethi kuye: ‘Ngenzele ubulungiswa maqondana nomelene nami.’
“Kwaba yisikhathi eside umehluleli engathandi. Kepha kamuva wadlinza, wathi: ‘Nakuba ngingamesabi uNkulunkulu, futhi ngingenandaba namuntu,
kodwa-ke ngokuba lo mfelokazi ulokhu engibelesele, ngizakumenzela ubulungiswa, funa ekugcineni angicasule.’ ”
INkosi yayisithi: “Lalelani-ke ukuthi wathini umehluleli okhohlakeleyo.
UNkulunkulu akayukubenzela yini ubulungiswa abakhethiweyo bakhe, abakhala kuye imini nobusuku, ababekezelele na?
Ngithi kini: uyakubenzela ubulungiswa ngokushesha. Ngabe iNdodana yomuntu iyokufumana yini ukukholwa emhlabeni mhla ifika na?”
UJesu wakhuluma nabanye ababezigabisa ngokuthi balungile, bedelela abanye; wabatshela lo mzekeliso, wathi:
“Abantu ababili benyukela ethempelini ukuyokhuleka, omunye engumFarisi, omunye engumthelisi.
UmFarisi wema, wakhuleka wathi: ‘Nkulunkulu, ngiyakubonga ngokuba ngingenjengabo abanye abantu: izigebengu, izikhohlakali, iziphingi, nanjengalo mthelisi.
Ngizila ukudla kabili ngeviki, nginikela ngokweshumi kwakho konke engikutholayo.’
“Kepha umthelisi wema kude engafuni ngisho nokuphakamisela amehlo akhe ngasezulwini, kodwa wazithoba ezisola, ethi: ‘Nkulunkulu, ngihawukele mina soni.’
“Ngithi kini: lo wabuyela ekhaya elungisisiwe kunomFarisi. Ngokuba yilowo nalowo oziphakamisayo, uzakuthotshiswa; kodwa ozithobayo, uzakuphakanyiswa.”
Baletha futhi kuJesu abantwana ukuba abaphathe; kodwa abafundi bekubona lokho, babakhuza.
Kepha uJesu wababiza, ethi: “Vumelani abantwana beze kimi, ningabenqabeli, ngokuba umbuso kaNkulunkulu ungowabanje.
Ngiqinisile ngithi kini: yilowo nalowo ongawemukeli umbuso kaNkulunkulu njengomntwana, kasoze angena kuwo.”
Umbusi othile wayesembuza, ethi: “Mfundisi omuhle, ngiyakwenzenjani ukuze ngidle ifa lokuphila okuphakade na?”
Kepha uJesu wathi kuye: “Ungibizelani ngokuthi ngimuhle na? Akekho omuhle, kuphela, uNkulunkulu.
Uyayazi imiyalelo ethi: ‘Ungaphingi, ungabulali, ungebi, ungafakazi amanga, hlonipha uyihlo nonyoko.’ ”
Kepha yena wathi: “Konke lokho ngikugcinile kusukela ebusheni bami.”
Esekuzwile lokho, uJesu wathi kuye: “Kunye kuphela okusakusalele: thengisa ngakho konke onakho, uphe abampofu, khona-ke uzakuba nengcebo ezulwini, bese uza, ungilandele.”
Kuthe ekuzwa lokho, waphatheka kabi, ngokuba wayecebe kakhulu.
UJesu embona ukuthi ulimele kakhulu, wathi: “Kulukhuni kuyitshe kwabanothileyo ukuba bangene embusweni kaNkulunkulu.
Kulula ukuba ikameli lingene ngembobo yosungulo, kunokuba onothileyo angene embusweni kaNkulunkulu.”
Abakuzwayo lokho base bethi: “Pho kuyakusindiswa bani na?”
Kepha uJesu wathi kubo: “Okungenzeki kubantu, kungenzeka kuNkulunkulu.”
UPhethro wayesethi: “Thina sishiye okungokwethu, sakulandela.”
UJesu wathi kubo: “Ngiqinisile ngithi kini: akukho muntu oshiye indlu, noma umkakhe, noma abafowabo, noma abazali, noma abantwana, ngenxa yombuso kaNkulunkulu,
ongayukukwamukeliswa okuphindwe kaningi kulesi sikhathi, esikhathini esizayo, ukuphila okuphakade.”
Wabasondeza kuye abali-12, wathi kubo: “Lalelani, sikhuphukela eJerusalema; konke okulotshwe ngabaphrofethi maqondana neNdodana yomuntu, kuzakugcwaliseka.
Izakukhashelwa kwabezizwe, iklolodelwe, iphathwe kabi, ikhafulelwe ngamathe,
bayishaye, bayibulale; kodwa ngosuku lwesithathu, izakuvuka.”
Kepha abakuqondanga lokho; leli lizwi laliyimpicabadala kubo, abakuqondanga lokho akushoyo.
Kwathi esesondela eJerikho, impumputhe ethile yayihleli ngasendleleni inqiba.
Kuthe lapho izwa isixuku sidlula ngakuyo, yabuza yathi: “Ngabe kuyini lokhu na?”
Base beyitshela bathi: “NguJesu waseNazaretha owedlulayo.”
Yayisimemeza ithi: “Jesu, Ndodana kaDavide, ngihawukele!”
Ababehamba ngaphambili bayikhuza ukuba ithule, kodwa kwayilapho isho kakhulu ngengila, ithi: “Ndodana kaDavide, ngihawukele!”
UJesu wema, wabayala ukuba bayilethe kuye. Kuthe isisondele wayibuza wathi:
“Ufuna ukuba ngikwenzeleni na?” Yathi: “Nkosi, ukuba ngibuye ngibone.”
UJesu wathi kuyo: “Bona! Ukukholwa kwakho kukusindisile.”
Yayisibona khona manjalo, yamlandela imdumisa uNkulunkulu, nabantu bonke bekubona lokho bamdumisa uNkulunkulu.
UJesu wangena eJerikho, wadabula kulo.
Kwakukhona indoda okuthiwa nguZakewu, ingumthelisi omkhulu, futhi icebile.
Yayifuna ukumbona uJesu ukuthi ungubani, kodwa yehluleka ngenxa yesixuku sabantu, ngokuba yayimfushane.
Yagijimela phambili, yagibela esihlahleni somthombe, ukuze imbone, ngokuba wayezakwedlula ngalapho.
UJesu esefikile kuleyo ndawo, wabheka phezulu, wathi kuyo: “Zakewu, shesha wehle, ngokuba namuhla kufanele ngingenise endlini yakho.”
UZakewu washesha wehla, wamemukela ngokuthokoza.
Kuthe lapho bekubona lokho, bakhononda bonke, bathi: “UJesu ungenise endlini yendoda eyisoni.”
Kepha uZakewu wasukuma, wathi eNkosini: “Nkosi, ngipha abampofu ingxenye yempahla yami; kuthi uma ngimqolile umuntu okuthile, ngikubuyisele kuye sekuphindwe kane.”
UJesu wathi kuye: “Namuhla insindiso ifikile kule ndlu, lokhu naye uyindodana ka-Abhrahama.
Ngokuba iNdodana yomuntu ize ukuzofuna nokusindisa okulahlekileyo.”
Kuthe abantu besalalele lokho, uJesu waqhubeka wabalandisa umzekeliso, ngokuba wayeseduze neJerusalema, nangokuba babethi umbuso kaNkulunkulu uzakubonakala masinyane.
Wathi-ke: “Kwakukhona umuntu wasebukhosini owaya ezweni elikude eyozithathela umbuso bese ebuya.
Wabiza izinceku zakhe ezilishumi, wazinika uhlamvu lwemali ngayinye, wathi kuzo: ‘Hwebani ngazo ngize ngibuye.’
“Kepha abantu bezwe lakhe babemzonda, ngakho-ke bathumela amanxusa, amlandela, ukuba afike lapho, athi: ‘Asithandi ukuba lo abuse phezu kwethu.’
“Kwathi esebuyile ekuthatheni umbuso, wazibiza lezo zinceku ayezinike imali ukuze ezwe ukuthi zizuzeni ngokuhweba.
“Kweza eyokuqala, yathi: ‘Nkosi, uhlamvu lwakho lwemali luzuze izinhlamvu zemali ezilishumi.’
“Wathi kuyo: ‘Kuhle-ke, nceku enhle, ngokuba wethembekile kokuncane, uzakubusa imizi elishumi.’
“Kweza neyesibili, yathi: ‘Nkosi, uhlamvu lwakho lwemali luzuze eziyisihlanu.’
“Wathi nakuleyo: ‘Nawe busa imizi emihlanu.’
“Kweza nenye, yathi: ‘Nkosi, nantu uhlamvu lwakho lwemali engalusonga ngendwangu ngalulondoloza.
Phela bengikwesaba, kwazise ungumuntu olukhuni. Uthatha ongazange ukubeke, uvune ongazange ukuhlwanyele.’
“Wathi kuyo: ‘Ngizakwehlulela ngamazwi akho, wena nceku embi. Ubuwazi kahle ukuthi ngingumuntu olukhuni: ngithatha engingazange ngikubeke, ngivune engingakuhlwanyelanga.
Kungani ungalufakanga uhlamvu lwemali yami ebhange, khona kuzothi ekubuyeni kwami, ngiluthole nenzalo na?’
“Wayesethi kwababemi lapho: ‘Mephuceni uhlamvu lwemali, nilunike onezilishumi.’
“Kepha bathi kuye: ‘Nkosi, unezinhlamvu zemali ezilishumi.’
“Ngithi kini: yilowo nalowo onakho, uyakuphiwa; kodwa lowo ongenakho, uyakwemukwa nalokho anakho.
Kepha lezo zitha zami ezazingathandi ukuba ngizibuse, ziletheni lapha, nizibulale ngizibonela ngawami.”
Kuthe esekushilo lokho wayeseqhubeka nohambo, wakhuphukela eJerusalema.
Kwathi uJesu esesondele eBhethifage naseBhethani, ngasentabeni okuthiwa eYeminqumo, wathuma abafundi ababili,
ethi: “Hambani niye emzaneni oqondene nani, kuzakuthi lapho ningena, nifumane ithole lembongolo likhulekiwe, okungazange kuhlale muntu kulo. Lithukululeni, nililethe lapha.
“Uma kukhona umuntu onibuzayo, ethi: ‘Nilithukulelani na?’ anothi: ‘INkosi iyalidinga.’ ”
Ababethunyiwe bahamba, bathola kunjengalokhu ayebatshelile.
Kuthe besalithukulula ithole, abaninilo bathi kubo: “Nilithukululelani ithole na?”
Bathi: “INkosi iyalidinga.”
Base beliletha kuJesu, babeka izingubo zabo phezu kwalo, bamgibelisa kulo uJesu.
Esahamba, bendlala izingubo zabo endleleni.
Kuthe esesondele emehlelweni weNtaba Yeminqumo isixuku sonke sabafundi saqala ukuthokoza nokudumisa uNkulunkulu ngezwi elikhulu ngazo zonke izimangaliso esizibonileyo,
sithi: “Ubusisiwe uMbusi ozayo egameni leNkosi, ukuthula ezulwini nenkazimulo kweliphezulu!”
Abanye babaFarisi besesixukwini, bathi kuye: “Mfundisi, bakhuze abafundi bakho.”
Waphendula wathi: “Ngithi kini: uma bethula laba, amatshe azakumemeza.”
Kwathi lapho esondela, ewubona umuzi, wawukhalela.
Wathi: “Sengathi ngabe nawe ubuwazi ngalolu lusuku, lokho okungakulethela ukuthula. Kepha manje kufihlakele emehlweni akho.
Ngokuba uyakufikelwa yizinsuku lapho izitha zakho ziyakwakha ugange, zikuhaqe, zikuvimbezele macala wonke.
Zikuqumbe phansi othulini, wena nabantu abanawe; aziyukushiya litshe phezu kwelinye phakathi kwakho. Ngokuba awusazanga isikhathi sokuhanjelwa kwakho.”
UJesu wangena ethempelini, waqala ukuxosha abathengisayo,
wathi kubo: “Kulotshiwe ukuthi: ‘Indlu yami iyakuba yindlu yokukhuleka,’ kodwa nina niyenze ‘umhume wabaphangi.’ ”
Wayefundisa ethempelini imihla ngemihla. Kepha abaphristi abakhulu, izazimthetho, nezikhulu zabantu, zafuna ukumbulala.
Kepha babengazi ukuthi bazokwenza kanjani, ngokuba bonke abantu babenamathele kuye, bemlalele.
Kwathi ngolunye usuku uJesu efundisa abantu ethempelini futhi eshumayela ivangeli, abaphristi abakhulu, izazimthetho namalunga, bamvukela.
Bakhuluma bathi kuye: “Sitshele ukuthi lokhu ukwenza ngagunya lini, nokuthi ngubani okunike leli gunya na?”
Waphendula wathi kubo: “Nami ngizakunibuza igama elilodwa zwi, ningiphendule.
Umbhabhadiso kaJohane wawuvelaphi, ezulwini noma kubantu na?”
Babonisana bodwa, base bethi: “Uma sithi: ‘Ezulwini,’ uzakuthi: ‘Pho anikholwanga ngani nguye na?’
“Kepha uma sithi: ‘Kubantu,’ abantu bonke bazakusikhanda ngamatshe, ngokuba bayakholwa ngukuthi uJohane ungumphrofethi.”
Base bephendula bethi: “Asazi ukuthi wavela kuphi.”
UJesu wayesethi kubo: “Nami angizukunitshela ukuthi lokhu ngikwenza ngagunya lini.”
Waqala ukulandisa abantu lo mzekeliso, wathi: “Umuntu othile watshala isivini, wasiqashisa kubalimi, wayesehamba isikhathi eside.
